verses.1: Hahuu fo-foun, Maromak kria lalehan no rai.
verses.2: Rai nee seidauk iha forma no mamuk. Nakukun taka hela fatin klean nia leten. No Maromak nia Espíritu book aan ba-mai iha bee nia leten.
verses.3: Maromak dehan, “Naroman mosu ba.” Depois, naroman iha.
verses.4: Maromak haree katak naroman nee diak. Maromak haketak naroman nee hosi nakukun.
verses.5: Maromak foo naran ba naroman nee, ‘Loron’, no nakukun nee Nia foo naran, ‘Kalan’. Hosi kalan too dadeer nee mak loron primeiru.
verses.6: Maromak dehan, “Fatin luan mosu ba iha bee nia leet, no buat nee bele haketak bee fatin ida hosi bee fatin seluk.”
verses.7: Maromak halo fatin luan nee no haketak bee nebee iha fatin luan nia okos hosi bee nebee iha fatin luan nia leten. Ida nee mosu duni.
verses.8: Maromak foo naran ba fatin luan nee, ‘Lalehan’. Hosi kalan too dadeer nee mak loron rua.
verses.9: Maromak dehan, “Bee iha lalehan okos halibur ba iha fatin ida, no rai maran mosu ba.” Ida nee mosu duni.
verses.10: Maromak bolu rai maran nee ‘Rai’. Ba bee nebee halibur hamutuk nee, Nia bolu ‘Tasi’. Maromak haree katak buat sira nee diak.
verses.11: Maromak dehan, “Duut moris ba hosi rai nee, no ai horis nebee foo musan, no ai huun nebee foo fuan ho nia musan iha laran, tuir ida-idak nia modelu, iha rai nee.” Ida nee mosu duni.
verses.12: Duut moris hosi rai nee, ho ai horis nebee foo musan tuir nia modelu, no ai huun nebee foo fuan ho musan tuir nia modelu. No Maromak haree katak buat sira nee diak.
verses.13: Hosi kalan too dadeer nee mak loron tolu.
verses.14: Maromak dehan, “Naroman sira mosu ba iha fatin luan iha lalehan hodi haketak loron hosi kalan. Sira sei sai sinál, no hatudu tempu, loron no tinan.
verses.15: Sira sei sai naroman iha fatin luan iha lalehan hodi foo naroman ba rai.” Ida nee mosu duni.
verses.16: Maromak halo naroman rua nebee boot: ida nebee boot liu hodi ukun loron, no ida nebee laduun boot hodi ukun kalan. No Nia halo mos fitun sira.
verses.17: Maromak tau naroman sira nee iha fatin luan iha lalehan hodi foo naroman ba rai,
verses.18: hodi ukun loron no kalan, no hodi haketak naroman hosi nakukun. Maromak haree katak buat sira nee diak.
verses.19: Hosi kalan too dadeer nee mak loron haat.
verses.20: Maromak dehan, “Kriatura bar-barak mosu ba iha tasi nee, no manu nebee semo mosu ba iha rai nia leten, iha loro leten nee.”
verses.21: Maromak kria animál boot sira iha tasi, no kriatura hotu nebee nani ba-mai, no habarak iha tasi laran, tuir sira nia modelu. No Nia kria manu hotu-hotu nebee iha liras, tuir sira nia modelu. Maromak haree katak buat sira nee diak.
verses.22: Maromak foo bensaun ba sira no dehan, “Halo oan ba no aumenta barak too bee iha tasi nee sai nakonu. No husik manu bele aumenta barak iha rai nee.”
verses.23: Hosi kalan too dadeer nee mak loron lima.
verses.24: Maromak dehan, “Animál sira mosu ba hosi rai, tuir sira nia modelu: animál hakiak sira, buat hotu nebee dolar, no animál fuik sira nebee iha rai, tuir sira nia modelu.” Ida nee mosu duni.
verses.25: Maromak halo animál fuik sira iha rai, tuir sira nia modelu, no animál hakiak sira, tuir sira nia modelu, no buat hotu nebee dolar iha rai, tuir sira nia modelu. Maromak haree katak buat sira nee diak.
verses.26: Maromak dehan, “Mai Ita halo ema tuir Ita nia ilas, hanesan Ita nia Aan. Sira sei domina ikan iha tasi, no manu iha loro leten, no animál nebee hakiak, no rai tomak, no buat hotu nebee dolar iha rai.”
verses.27: Nunee Maromak kria ema tuir Ninia ilas rasik,
verses.28: Maromak foo bensaun ba sira, no Maromak dehan ba sira, “Halo oan ba no aumenta barak too rai nakonu. Ukun rai ba: domina ikan iha tasi, manu iha lalehan no buat hotu nebee moris no muda ba-mai iha rai.”
verses.29: Maromak dehan, “Haree lai, Hau foo ona ba imi ai horis hotu nebee iha musan, nebee iha rai leten, no ai huun hotu nebee iha fuan ho musan. Imi sei hetan buat sira nee nudar imi nia ai haan.
verses.30: Hau foo ai horis hotu hodi sai ai haan ba animál fuik hotu iha rai, no ba manu hotu iha loro leten, no ba buat hotu nebee dolar iha rai, buat hotu nebee dada iis.” Ida nee mosu duni.
verses.31: No Maromak haree buat hotu nebee Nia halo ona, no tebes, buat hotu nee diak loos. Hosi kalan too dadeer nee mak loron neen.

verses.1: Nunee lalehan no rai kompletu ona, ho buat hotu nebee iha laran nee.
verses.2: Iha loron hitu, Maromak nia servisu nebee Nia halo remata ona. Nunee Nia deskansa iha loron hitu hosi Ninia servisu hotu nebee Nia halo ona.
verses.3: Maromak foo bensaun ba loron hitu, Nia halo loron nee santu, tanba iha loron nee Nia deskansa hosi Ninia servisu hotu nebee Nia halo iha kriasaun nee.
verses.4: Nee mak istória
verses.5: Molok ai horis ida mosu iha rai, no molok duut matak moris iha rai (tanba Nai Maromak seidauk haruka udan ba rai no la iha ema ida hodi halo toos,
verses.6: maibee abu-abu sae hosi rai no habokon rai leten hotu)
verses.7: Nai Maromak forma mane ida hosi rai rahun, no huu iis moris nian ba nia inus, no mane nee sai klamar ida nebee moris.
verses.8: Nai Maromak kuda jardín ida iha Eden, iha parte lorosae, no Nia tau mane ida nebee Nia forma ona iha fatin nebaa.
verses.9: No Nai Maromak kuda iha rai nee ai horis oi-oin nebee furak no diak atu haan. Ai Huun Moris Nian mak iha jardín nee nia klaran, no Ai Huun Hodi Hatene Diak No Aat.
verses.10: Mota ida suli sai hosi Eden hodi foo bee ba jardín nee. Depois mota nee fahe ba mota ulun haat.
verses.11: Mota ba dala ida naran Pizón, mota ida nee haleu rai Havila tomak, iha fatin nebee iha osan mean.
verses.12: No osan mean iha rai nee diak. Rai nee iha mos ai been morin no fatuk onix.
verses.13: Mota ba dala rua naran Gión, ida nebee haleu rai Kuxe tomak.
verses.14: Mota ba dala tolu naran Tigre, ida nebee suli liu hosi Asíria nia parte lorosae. Mota ba dala haat naran Eufrates.
verses.15: Nai Maromak foti mane ida nee no tau nia iha jardín iha Eden hodi servisu no tau matan ba jardín nee.
verses.16: Nai Maromak foo orden ba mane nee dehan, “O bele haan hosi ai huun hotu iha jardín nee.
verses.17: Maibee o keta haan hosi Ai Huun Hodi Hatene Diak No Aat. Tanba iha loron nebee o haan hosi ai huun nee, o sei mate duni.”
verses.18: Nai Maromak dehan, “Mane hela mesak nee la diak. Hau sei halo maluk ida hodi ajuda nia.”
verses.19: Nai Maromak forma animál fuik hotu iha rai no manu hotu iha loro leten. Nia lori sira ba mane nee atu haree mane nee foo naran saida ba sira. No naran saida deit nebee mane foo, nee mak ida-idak nia naran duni.
verses.20: Mane nee foo naran ba animál hakiak hotu, ba manu sira iha loro leten, no ba animál fuik hotu iha rai. Maibee nia la hetan maluk ida hodi ajuda nia.
verses.21: Nunee Nai Maromak halo mane nee toba dukur loos. Bainhira nia toba dukur, Maromak foti ruin knosen ida hosi nia no taka fatin nee ho isin.
verses.22: No Nai Maromak halo feto ida hosi ruin knosen nebee nia foti hosi mane nee. Depois nia lori feto nee ba mane.
verses.23: Mane nee dehan,
verses.24: Tanba nee mane ida sei husik ninia inan-aman, no hela hamutuk ho ninia feen, no sira sei sai isin ida deit.
verses.25: Sira nain rua nee isin molik, mane no feto, maibee sira la senti moe.

verses.1: Tuir mai, iha samea ida nebee matenek liu animál fuik hotu iha rai nebee Nai Maromak halo ona. Nia dehan ba feto nee, “Maromak hatete duni hanesan nee ka, ‘Imi keta haan hosi ai huun naran deit iha jardín nee’?”
verses.2: No feto nee hataan ba samea, “Ami bele haan ai fuan hosi ai huun sira iha jardín nee.
verses.3: Maibee kona ba ai fuan hosi ai huun ida nebee iha jardín klaran nee, Maromak hatete ona, ‘Imi keta haan hosi ai huun nee, no mos imi keta book. Se lae, imi sei mate.’”
verses.4: Samea dehan ba feto nee, “Imi sei la mate duni.
verses.5: Tanba Maromak hatene katak iha loron nebee imi haan ai fuan nee, imi nia matan sei nakloke, imi sei sai hanesan Maromak, no imi sei hatene buat diak no buat aat.”
verses.6: Bainhira feto nee haree katak ai huun ida nee diak atu foo ai haan, no furak atu haree, no ai huun nee diak atu foo matenek, nunee nia kuu ai fuan nee no nia haan. Nia foo mos ba ninia laen nebee hamutuk ho nia, no ninia laen haan.
verses.7: Depois sira nain rua nia matan nakloke, no sira hatene kedas katak sira isin molik. Entaun sira suku ai figeira tahan hamutuk hodi halo ropa simples.
verses.8: Depois sira rona lian hosi Nai Maromak tanba Nia lao iha jardín laran no hola anin iha tempu nee. Mane ida nee ho nia feen subar aan hosi Nai Maromak iha ai laran nebee iha jardín nee.
verses.9: Nai Maromak bolu mane nee no dehan, “O iha nebee?”
verses.10: Adão hataan, “Hau rona O nia lian iha jardín laran, no hau tauk tanba hau isin molik hela, no hau subar aan.”
verses.11: Maromak dehan, “See mak foo hatene katak o molik? O haan ona hosi ai huun nebee Hau bandu o keta haan nee ka?”
verses.12: Mane nee hataan, “Feto ida nebee O foo mai hau, nia mak foo ai fuan nee mai hau, no hau haan.”
verses.13: Nai Maromak dehan ba feto nee, “Saida mak o halo nee?” No feto hataan, “Samea bosok hau, no hau haan.”
verses.14: Nai Maromak dehan ba samea nee,
verses.15: Hau sei halo o no feto nee odi malu,
verses.16: Maromak dehan ba feto nee,
verses.17: Maromak dehan ba Adão,
verses.18: Ai tarak no duut tarak sei mosu mai hosi rai nee ba o,
verses.19: Liu hosi o nia kosar been
verses.20: Adão foo naran ‘Eva’ ba ninia feen, tanba Eva mak inan ba ema hotu-hotu nebee moris.
verses.21: Nai Maromak halo ropa hosi animál nia kulit hodi Adão no nia feen bele hatais.
verses.22: No Nai Maromak dehan, “Haree lai, mane nee sai ona hanesan Ita hodi hatene buat diak no buat aat. Nunee keta halo be nia lolo nia liman hodi kuu mos hosi Ai Huun Moris Nian, no haan no moris ba nafatin.”
verses.23: Tanba nee Nai Maromak haruka nia sai hosi toos iha Eden, hodi fila rai. Tanba nia moris mai hosi rai nee.
verses.24: Nunee Nia duni sai mane nee, no Nia tau fali kerubim sira iha Eden iha toos nia sorin lorosae. No sira kaer surik lakan nebee dulas ba-mai hodi taka dalan ba Ai Huun Moris Nian.

verses.1: Adão toba ho ninia feen Eva, no Eva sai isin rua. Eva tuur ahi hetan Kaín no dehan, “Hau hetan mane ida hosi Nai.”
verses.2: Depois nia tuur ahi hetan Kaín nia alin, Abel. Abel hein bibi, maibee Kaín fila rai.
verses.3: Tuir mai, iha tempu nebaa, Kaín lori produtu hosi rai hodi foo oferta ba Nai.
verses.4: Abel mos lori bibi oan primeiru nebee bokur hosi ninia bibi lubun. No Nai simu Abel no ninia oferta.
verses.5: Maibee Nai la simu Kaín no ninia oferta. Kaín hirus makaas no nia oin suar.
verses.6: Nai hatete ba Kaín, “Nusaa mak o hirus? Tanba saa mak o nia oin suar?
verses.7: Se karik o halo diak, laos Hau sei simu o? No se karik o la halo diak, sala mak hein iha o nia odamatan. Nia hakarak kasa o, maibee o tenki domina nia.”
verses.8: Kaín koalia ho nia alin Abel. No bainhira sira lao too iha rai luan, Kaín ataka nia alin Abel, no oho nia.
verses.9: Depois, Nai dehan ba Kaín, “O nia alin Abel iha nebee?” Nia hataan, “Hau la hatene, hau tenki hein hau nia alin ka?”
verses.10: Nai dehan, “O halo saida? Lian hosi o nia alin nia raan hakilar mai Hau hosi rai.
verses.11: Agora, o hetan malisan hosi rai nebee loke nia ibun hodi simu o nia alin nia raan hosi o nia liman.
verses.12: Bainhira o fila rai, rai nee sei la foo rezultadu diak ba o. O sei sai ema lao rai no lao tuun-sae nafatin iha rai nee.”
verses.13: Kaín hataan ba Nai, “Hau la bele lori hau nia kastigu nee tanba todan liu.
verses.14: Tebes, loron ohin O duni hau hosi rai nia oin, no hau sei subar hosi O nia oin. Hau sei sai nudar ema lao rai no hau sei lao tuun-sae nafatin iha rai. Nunee, ema see deit nebee hetan hau sei oho hau.”
verses.15: No Nai hatete ba nia, “La bele! Ema see deit nebee oho Kaín sei hetan kastigu todan liu dala hitu.” Depois Nai tau sinál ida iha Kaín, hodi ema see deit nebee hetan nia la bele oho nia.
verses.16: No Kaín sai hosi Nai nia prezensa no baa hela iha rai Node iha Eden nia sorin lorosae.
verses.17: Kaín toba ho ninia feen, no ninia feen sai isin rua. Feen nee tuur ahi ba Enok. Nia harii sidade ida no tau naran ba sidade ida nee tuir nia oan mane nia naran, Enok.
verses.18: Enok iha oan naran Irad. Irad iha oan naran Meujael. Meujael iha oan naran Metusael. Metusael iha oan naran Lamek.
verses.19: Lamek hola feto nain rua: ida naran Ada no ida fali naran Zila.
verses.20: Ada iha oan naran Jabál. Nia mak aman ba sira nebee hela iha tenda no hakiak animál.
verses.21: Ninia alin nia naran Jubál. Nia mak aman ba ema hotu nebee toka harpa no huu flauta.
verses.22: No Zila tuur ahi mos ba Tubal-Kaín. Nia bele baku besi no riti hodi halo sasaan oi-oin. Tubal-Kaín nia alin feto mak Naama.
verses.23: Lamek hatete ba nia feen rua nee,
verses.24: Se karik Kaín nia vingansa kastigu dala hitu,
verses.25: Adão toba fali ho nia feen. Ninia feen tuur ahi ba oan mane ida no hanaran nia Set. Tanba nia dehan, “Maromak tau oan ida mai hau hodi troka Abel, tanba Kaín oho tiha nia.”
verses.26: Set mos hetan oan mane ida no nia hanaran oan nee Enos. Iha tempu nebaa, ema komesa bolu ba Nai Maromak nia naran.

verses.1: Ida nee mak livru kona ba Adão nia jerasaun sira. Bainhira Maromak kria ema, Nia halo ema tuir Maromak nia ilas.
verses.2: Nia kria ema mane no feto, no Nia foo bensaun ba sira. Bainhira Nia kria sira Nia hanaran sira ‘Ema’.
verses.3: Bainhira Adão moris too tinan atus ida tolu-nulu (130), nia hetan oan ida hanesan ho nia no tuir ninia ilas, no nia hanaran oan nee Set.
verses.4: Nee liu tiha, bainhira nia hetan ona Set, Adão moris tan tinan atus ualu (800), no nia hetan tan oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.5: Nunee Adão moris too tinan atus sia tolu-nulu (930), depois nia mate.
verses.6: Bainhira Set moris too tinan atus ida resin lima (105), nia hetan Enos.
verses.7: Nee liu tiha, bainhira nia hetan ona Enos, Set moris tan tinan atus ualu resin hitu (807), no nia hetan tan oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.8: Nunee Set moris too tinan atus sia sanulu resin rua (912), depois nia mate.
verses.9: Bainhira Enos moris too tinan sia-nulu (90), nia hetan Kenan.
verses.10: Nee liu tiha, bainhira nia hetan ona Kenan, Enos moris tan tinan atus ualu sanulu resin lima (815), no nia hetan tan oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.11: Nunee Enos moris too tinan atus sia resin lima (905), depois nia mate.
verses.12: Bainhira Kenan moris too tinan hitu-nulu (70), nia hetan Maalalel.
verses.13: Nee liu tiha, bainhira nia hetan ona Maalalel, Kenan moris tan tinan atus ualu haat-nulu (840), no nia hetan tan oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.14: Nunee Kenan moris too tinan atus sia sanulu (910), depois nia mate.
verses.15: Bainhira Maalalel moris too tinan neen-nulu resin lima (65), nia hetan Jared.
verses.16: Nee liu tiha, bainhira nia hetan ona Jared, Maalalel moris tan tinan atus ualu tolu-nulu (830), no nia hetan tan oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.17: Nunee Maalalel moris too tinan atus ualu sia-nulu resin lima (895), depois nia mate.
verses.18: Bainhira Jared moris too tinan atus ida neen-nulu resin rua (162), nia hetan Enok.
verses.19: Nee liu tiha, bainhira nia hetan ona Enok, Jared moris tan tinan atus ualu (800), no nia hetan tan oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.20: Nunee Jared moris too tinan atus sia neen-nulu resin rua (962), depois nia mate.
verses.21: Bainhira Enok moris too tinan neen-nulu resin lima (65), nia hetan Matusalém.
verses.22: Nee liu tiha, bainhira nia hetan ona Matusalém, Enok lao hamutuk ho Maromak tinan atus tolu (300), no nia hetan tan oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.23: Nunee Enok moris too tinan atus tolu neen-nulu resin lima (365).
verses.24: Enok lao hamutuk ho Maromak depois nia la iha ona, tanba Maromak foti nia.
verses.25: Bainhira Matusalém moris too tinan atus ida ualu-nulu resin hitu (187), nia hetan Lamek.
verses.26: Nee liu tiha, bainhira nia hetan ona Lamek, Matusalém moris tan tinan atus hitu ualu-nulu resin rua (782), no nia hetan tan oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.27: Nunee Matusalém moris too tinan atus sia neen-nulu resin sia (969), depois nia mate.
verses.28: Bainhira Lamek moris too tinan atus ida ualu-nulu resin rua (182), nia hetan oan mane ida.
verses.29: Nia hanaran oan mane nee Noé, tanba nia dehan, “Oan nee sei halo kamaan ita nia servisu no moris nebee todan iha ita nia liman, tanba Nai foo ona malisan ba rai nee.”
verses.30: Nee liu tiha, bainhira nia hetan ona Noé, Lamek moris tan tinan atus lima sia-nulu resin lima (595), no nia hetan tan oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.31: Nunee Lamek moris too tinan atus hitu hitu-nulu resin hitu (777), depois nia mate.
verses.32: Bainhira Noé moris too tinan atus lima (500), nia hetan Sem, Kam no Jafet.

verses.1: Bainhira ema komesa sai barak iha mundu, no sira hetan oan feto sira,
verses.2: Maromak nia oan mane sira haree katak ema nia oan feto sira bonita, no sira fihir feto tuir sira nia hakarak hodi sai sira nia feen.
verses.3: Depois Nai dehan, “Hau nia Espíritu sei lakohi diskuti malu ho ema ba nafatin, tanba nia isin deit. Nunee nia moris deit too tinan atus ida rua-nulu.
verses.4: Iha tempu nebaa, ema ain aas hela iha mundu, no mos iha tempu tuir mai. Tanba Maromak nia oan mane sira hola ema nia oan feto sira, no sira hetan oan sira. Oan sira nee sai asuwain iha tempu antigu, nebee ema konhesidu.
verses.5: Depois Nai haree ema sai aat tebes iha mundu. Buat hotu nebee sira hanoin iha sira nia fuan laran sei aat nafatin.
verses.6: No Nai tristi tanba Nia halo ona ema iha mundu, no Nia hanoin ho laran susar.
verses.7: Nunee Nai dehan, “Hau sei halakon ema nebee Hau kria ona nee hosi mundu tomak, inklui ema no animál, buat nebee dolar no manu iha lalehan, tanba Hau tristi katak Hau halo ona sira.
verses.8: Maibee Noé hetan grasa iha Nai nia oin.
verses.9: Ida nee mak Noé nia jerasaun sira. Noé mak ema nebee moris loos no perfeitu iha povu nia leet, no Noé lao hamutuk ho Maromak.
verses.10: Noé hetan oan mane nain tolu, naran Sem, Kam no Jafet.
verses.11: Iha tempu nebaa, mundu mak aat iha Maromak nia oin, no mundu nee nakonu ho violénsia.
verses.12: Maromak hateke ba mundu no haree katak fatin nee aat tanba ema hotu nebee iha mundu lao ho hahalok aat.
verses.13: No Maromak dehan ba Noé, “Hau desidi ona atu hamate ema hotu, tanba mundu nee nakonu ho violénsia liu hosi sira. Tebes, Hau sei destrui sira ho mundu nee.
verses.14: Halo roo boot ida hosi ai kakeu. Halo kuartu sira iha roo laran, no taka roo nia laran no liur ho alkatraun.
verses.15: Halo roo hanesan nee: nia naruk metru atus ida tolu-nulu resin lima (135m), nia luan metru rua-nulu resin rua ho balu (22,5m), no nia aas metru sanulu resin tolu ho balu (13,5m).
verses.16: Halo kakuluk iha roo leten nebee husik kuak sentimu haat-nulu resin lima (45cm) hosi roo leten. Halo odamatan iha roo sorin, no halo roo nee ho andár tolu.
verses.17: Tebes, Hau sei haruka udan boot too rai nabeen iha mundu hodi destrui isin hotu, buat hotu nebee dada iis iha lalehan nia okos, no buat hotu iha mundu sei mate.
verses.18: Maibee Hau sei estabelese Hau nia aliansa ho o. O sei tama roo boot nee, hamutuk ho o nia oan sira, o nia feen no o nia oan sira nia feen sira nebee sei hamutuk ho o.
verses.19: No hosi animál hotu nebee moris, o sei hatama rua-rua hodi hakiak sira hamutuk ho o, aman ida no inan ida.
verses.20: Inklui manu tuir sira nia modelu, no animál nebee lao tuir sira nia modelu, no animál nebee dolar tuir sira nia modelu, rua-rua hosi animál oi-oin sei mai hodi bele moris hela.
verses.21: No mos, haloot ai haan nebee o presiza haan. Halibur ai haan nee ba o no animál hotu nee hodi haan.”
verses.22: Noé halo tuir buat hotu nebee Maromak haruka nia halo.

verses.1: Depois Nai hatete ba Noé, “Tama ba roo laran, o no o nia família tomak. Tanba hosi jerasaun nee, Hau haree katak o mak moris loos iha Hau nia oin.
verses.2: Hosi animál hotu nebee moos, o sei foti pár hitu, aman no inan. Hosi animál nebee la moos, o sei foti pár ida, aman no inan.
verses.3: Hosi manu iha loro leten, o sei foti pár hitu, aman no inan. Nunee animál sira nee bele moris nafatin iha mundu tomak.
verses.4: Tanba iha loron hitu ba oin, Hau sei haruka udan ba mundu too loron haat-nulu no kalan haat-nulu. Hau sei destrui buat hotu nebee moris iha mundu tomak nebee Hau halo nee.”
verses.5: No Noé halo tuir buat hotu nebee Nai haruka nia halo.
verses.6: Noé tinan atus neen (600) bainhira udan boot mai iha mundu.
verses.7: Noé tama ba roo laran ho nia oan mane sira, nia feen no nia oan mane sira nia feen sira, tanba rai nabeen.
verses.8: Hosi animál moos, no animál la moos, no manu sira no buat hotu nebee dolar iha rai,
verses.9: sira tama ba roo laran hamutuk ho Noé, rua-rua, aman no inan, hanesan Maromak haruka ona ba Noé.
verses.10: Liu tiha loron hitu, udan boot mai no halo rai nabeen iha mundu.
verses.11: Bainhira Noé tinan atus neen (600), iha fulan segundu, iha loron sanulu resin hitu, iha loron nee, bee matan hotu iha fatin klean liu nakloke, no janela sira iha lalehan nakloke.
verses.12: No udan mai mundu durante loron haat-nulu no kalan haat-nulu.
verses.13: Iha loron nee duni, Noé, no Noé nia oan mane Sem, Kam no Jafet, no Noé nia feen, no ninia oan mane sira nia feen nain tolu, tama ba roo laran.
verses.14: Sira tama hamutuk ho animál fuik oi-oin tuir sira nia modelu, no animál hakiak oi-oin tuir sira nia modelu, no buat hotu nebee dolar iha rai tuir sira nia modelu, no manu oi-oin tuir sira nia modelu, inklui manu kiik oi-oin.
verses.15: Sira tama ba roo laran hamutuk ho Noé, rua-rua, hosi buat hotu nebee moris no dada iis.
verses.16: Sira tama ba, aman no inan, hosi buat hotu nebee moris, tuir Maromak nia orden ba Noé. No Nai taka nia iha laran.
verses.17: Udan boot kontinua mai iha mundu durante loron haat-nulu. No bee sae ba beibeik too hiit roo boot nee. Roo nee sae iha mundu leten.
verses.18: Bee aumenta boot tan, no sae aas iha mundu, no roo boot nee namlele iha bee leten.
verses.19: Bee aumenta boot tan iha mundu too taka foho aas hotu nebee iha lalehan tomak nia okos.
verses.20: Bee aumenta too aas liu foho, no taka sira too iha metru hitu iha foho leten.
verses.21: Buat hotu nebee moris iha mundu mate, inklui manu, animál hakiak, animál fuik, buat hotu nebee dolar iha rai, no ema hotu.
verses.22: Buat hotu nebee dada iis hodi moris, buat hotu iha rai maran nee mate.
verses.23: Buat hotu nebee moris iha mundu nee lakon, inklui ema, no animál hakiak, no buat sira nebee dolar no manu sira iha loro leten. Sira lakon hosi mundu. Só deit Noé moris hela, ho sira nebee hamutuk ho nia iha roo boot laran.
verses.24: Bee boot taka mundu durante loron atus ida lima-nulu (150).

verses.1: Maromak hanoin Noé, no buat hotu nebee moris, no animál hakiak hotu nebee hamutuk ho nia iha roo laran. Maromak haruka anin huu iha rai leten, no bee boot nee komesa tuun.
verses.2: Bee matan hosi fatin klean no lalehan nia janela sira mos taka, no udan la tuun hosi lalehan.
verses.3: Nunee bee tuun fali hosi mundu, no liu tiha loron atus ida lima-nulu, bee nee tuun ona.
verses.4: Iha fulan hitu, iha loron sanulu resin hitu iha fulan nee, roo boot nee kona rai iha foho Ararat.
verses.5: Bee nee tuun ba beibeik too fulan sanulu. Iha loron primeiru, iha fulan sanulu nee, sira bele haree foho nia tutun sira.
verses.6: Liu tiha loron haat-nulu, Noé loke janela nebee nia halo iha roo boot.
verses.7: Nia husik manu metan, nebee semo ba-mai too bee sai maran iha mundu.
verses.8: Nia husik mos manu pombu hodi haree bee tuun ona iha mundu ka lae.
verses.9: Maibee manu pombu nee la hetan fatin hodi tuur deskansa, nunee nia fila fali ba Noé iha roo laran, tanba bee sei taka mundu tomak. Noé lolo ninia liman hodi simu manu nee no lori nia tama ba roo laran.
verses.10: Noé hein loron hitu tan, depois nia husik fali manu pombu hosi roo boot.
verses.11: Manu pombu nee fila mai iha lokraik, no Noé haree katak manu nee lori ai oliveira nia tahan nurak iha nia ibun. Nunee Noé hatene katak bee tuun ona hosi mundu.
verses.12: Noé hein loron hitu tan no nia husik fali manu pombu maibee manu pombu nee la mai fali.
verses.13: Entaun, iha tinan atus neen ida (601), iha fulan primeiru, iha loron primeiru, bee sai maran ona iha mundu. Noé loke roo boot, no nia haree, no tebes, rai maran ona.
verses.14: Iha fulan rua, iha loron rua-nulu resin hitu iha fulan nee, mundu maran duni.
verses.15: Maromak koalia ho Noé dehan,
verses.16: “Sai hosi roo boot, o no o nia feen, no o nia oan mane sira, no o nia oan mane sira nia feen sira nebee hamutuk ho o.
verses.17: Lori sai buat moris hotu nebee hamutuk ho o, animál hotu, manu sira, animál hakiak sira no animál hotu nebee dolar iha rai. Husik sira hahoris oan sira no habarak iha mundu.”
verses.18: Nunee Noé sai ho nia oan mane sira, nia feen, no nia oan mane sira nia feen sira nebee hamutuk ho nia.
verses.19: Animál hotu, buat hotu nebee dolar, manu hotu no buat hotu nebee book aan iha mundu, tuir sira nia modelu, sai hosi roo boot nee.
verses.20: Depois Noé harii altár ida ba Nai. Nia foti animál sira hosi animál moos no manu moos, no nia oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk sira iha altár nee.
verses.21: Nai horon iis morin, no Nai dehan iha Nia fuan laran, “Hau sei la foo tan malisan ba rai nee tanba ema. Tanba ema sempre hanoin buat aat iha nia fuan laran hosi kiik kedas. Hau sei la oho tan buat hotu nebee moris hanesan Hau foin halo nee.
verses.22: Bainhira mundu sei iha, tempu kuda no tempu kolheta, tempu malirin no tempu manas, loron no kalan sei la para.

9.title: ema seluk sei fakar fali ninia raan,

verses.1: Maromak foo bensaun ba Noé no ninia oan mane sira no dehan ba sira, “Halo oan no habarak ba, no halo nakonu mundu nee.
verses.2: Animál hotu iha mundu, manu hotu iha lalehan, buat hotu nebee dolar iha rai no ikan hotu iha tasi sei sai tauk tebes tanba imi. No Hau foo sira ba imi nia liman.
verses.3: Buat hotu nebee muda no moris sei sai hahaan ba imi. Hanesan Hau foo ona ai tahan matak, nunee Hau foo buat hotu.
verses.4: Maibee imi keta haan naan nebee moris, katak naan nebee sei iha raan.
verses.5: Hau sei kastigu duni nia nebee fakar imi nia raan hosi imi nia moris: animál hotu tenki selu no ema tenki selu. Ema tenki selu tanba raan nebee nia fakar hosi ninia maluk nia moris.
verses.6: See mak fakar ema nia raan,
verses.7: No imi tenki halo oan tan no habarak ba. Aumenta barak iha mundu no habarak ba iha fatin nee.
verses.8: Maromak koalia ho Noé no nia oan mane sira nebee hamutuk ho nia, no dehan,
verses.9: “Tebes, Hau sei estabelese Hau nia aliansa ho o no ho o nia bei-oan sira nebee tuir mai,
verses.10: no ho kriatura hotu nebee moris, manu, animál hakiak no animál fuik sira nebee iha mundu hamutuk ho o, buat hotu nebee sai hosi roo boot, animál hotu iha mundu.
verses.11: Hau sei estabelese Hau nia aliansa ho o hodi nunka akontese fali katak udan boot halo rai nabeen too isin hotu mate, no rai nabeen sei nunka destrui fali mundu.”
verses.12: No Maromak dehan, “Aliansa ida nebee Hau halo entre Hau ho imi no kriatura hotu nebee moris, too jerasaun hotu ba futuru, niasinál mak nee:
verses.13: Hau tau Hau nia arkuiris iha kalohan, no ida nee sei sai sinál ba aliansa entre Hau ho mundu.
verses.14: Bainhira Hau haruka kalohan iha mundu leten, Hau sei haree arkuiris nee iha kalohan.
verses.15: No Hau sei hanoin hetan Hau nia aliansa entre Hau ho o no kriatura hotu nebee moris, no udan nee sei la halo rai nabeen hodi destrui isin hotu.
verses.16: Arkuiris nee sei iha kalohan no Hau sei haree nia, no Hau sei hanoin hetan aliansa rohan laek nian entre Maromak ho kriatura hotu katak isin hotu iha mundu.”
verses.17: No Maromak dehan ba Noé, “Ida nee mak sinál ba aliansa nebee Hau estabelese ona entre Hau ho isin hotu iha mundu.”
verses.18: Noé nia oan sira nebee sai hosi roo boot mak Sem, Kam no Jafet. Kam mak Kanaan nia aman.
verses.19: Nain tolu nee mak Noé nia oan sira, no hosi oan sira nee povu hotu tama ba mundu tomak.
verses.20: Noé sai ema ida nebee halo toos, no nia kuda toos uvas.
verses.21: Nia hemu tua uvas no nia lanu. Depois nia toba isin molik iha ninia tenda laran.
verses.22: No Kam, nebee Kanaan nia aman, haree ninia aman nia isin molik, no nia foo hatene ba ninia maun rua iha liur.
verses.23: Sem no Jafet foti manta ida no tau iha sira nia kabaas, no sira hakiduk hodi baa taka sira nia aman nia isin molik. Sira nia oin fila hodi sira la haree sira nia aman nia isin molik.
verses.24: Bainhira Noé hadeer fali hosi tua uvas nee, nia hatene saida mak ninia oan kiik halo ona ba nia,
verses.25: no nia dehan,
verses.26: Nia dehan mos,
verses.27: Maromak sei aumenta Jafet,
verses.28: Liu tiha rai nabeen nee, Noé sei moris tan tinan atus tolu lima-nulu (350).
verses.29: Noé moris too tinan atus sia lima-nulu (950), depois nia mate.

verses.1: Jerasaun sira hosi Noé nia oan sira, Sem, Kam no Jafet, mak nee. Liu tiha rai nabeen nee, sira hetan oan mane sira.
verses.2: Jafet nia oan mane sira mak nee: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Mezek no Tiras.
verses.3: Gomer nia oan mane sira mak nee: Askenaz, Rifat no Togarma.
verses.4: Javan nia oan mane sira mak nee: Elisa, Tarsis, Kitim no Dodanim.
verses.5: Liu hosi ema sira nee, nasaun sira fahe ba sira nia rai nebee besik tasi; ida-idak ho ninia lian, ho ninia família sira, no ninia nasaun sira.
verses.6: Kam nia oan mane sira mak nee: Kus, Mizraim, Put no Kanaan.
verses.7: Kus nia oan mane sira mak nee: Seba, Havila, Sabta, Raamá no Sabteká. Raamá nia oan mane sira mak nee: Saba no Dedan.
verses.8: Kus hetan oan ida naran Nimrod, no nia mak ema primeiru iha mundu atu sai forti.
verses.9: Nia mak kasadór ida nebee forti iha Nai nia oin. Tanba nee ema dehan, “Hanesan Nimrod, kasadór forti iha Nai nia oin.”
verses.10: No ninia reinu hahuu ho Babel, Erek, Akad no Kalné, iha rai Sinear.
verses.11: Hosi rai nee nia baa Asúr, no nia harii Nínive, Reobote-Ir, Kalá,
verses.12: no Resén nebee entre Nínive no Kalá; ida nee mak sidade boot.
verses.13: Mizraim hetan oan Ludim, Anamim, Leabim, Naftuim,
verses.14: Patrusim, Kasluim (ema Filisteu sira mai hosi nia), no Kaftorim.
verses.15: Kanaan hetan oan boot Sidon, depois Hiti,
verses.16: no ema Jebuseu, Amoreu, Girgaseu
verses.17: Heveu, Areui, Sieui,
verses.18: Arvadeu, Zemareu no Hamateu. No tuir mai jerasaun Kanaan sira namkari ba.
verses.19: Kanaan nia rai hahuu hosi Sidon, liu hosi Gerar, too iha Gaza; inklui Sodoma, Gomora, Admá no Zeboím, too iha Lasa.
verses.20: Ema sira nee mak Kam nia oan mane sira, tuir sira nia família, lian, rai no nasaun sira.
verses.21: Sem, nebee Jafet nia maun, nia mos iha oan sira, no nia sai bei-ala ba Eber nia oan hotu.
verses.22: Sem nia oan sira mak nee: Elam, Asúr, Arpaxad, Lud no Aram.
verses.23: Aram nia oan sira mak nee: Uz, Hul, Geter no Mas.
verses.24: Arpaxad hetan Selá, no Selá hetan Eber.
verses.25: Eber hetan oan mane rua: ida naran Peleg, tanba iha ninia tempu mundu fahe, no ninia alin nia naran Joktan.
verses.26: Joktan hetan Almodá, Selef, Hazar-Mavet, Jera,
verses.27: Adoram, Uzal, Dikla,
verses.28: Obal, Abimael, Seba,
verses.29: Ofir, Havila, ho Jobabe. Sira hotu nee mak Joktan nia oan mane sira.
verses.30: Sira nia rai nebee sira hela komesa hosi Mesa, iha diresaun ba Sefar, too iha foho iha rai lorosae.
verses.31: Ema sira nee mak Sem nia oan mane sira, tuir sira nia família, lian, rai no nasaun sira.
verses.32: Ema sira nee mak Noé nia oan mane sira nia família, tuir sira nia jerasaun iha sira nia nasaun sira nee. No tuir tempu rai nabeen, liu hosi ema sira nee nasaun fahe no namkari iha mundu.

verses.1: Mundu tomak iha lian ida deit, no koalia ho liafuan nebee hanesan.
verses.2: Tuir mai, bainhira sira muda hosi fatin lorosae, sira hetan rai tetuk iha rai Sinear, no sira hela iha nebaa.
verses.3: Sira dehan ba malu, “Mai, ita halo tijolu sira no tunu sira di-diak.” Sira uza tijolu hanesan fatuk, no sira uza alkatraun hanesan masa.
verses.4: No sira dehan, “Mai, ita halo sidade ida ho uma aas ida nebee nia tutun bele sae too lalehan. Hodi nunee ita hetan naran boot. Se lae, ita sei namkari ba rai hotu-hotu iha mundu tomak.”
verses.5: Depois Nai tuun mai hodi haree sidade nee no uma aas nebee ema sira nee harii.
verses.6: No Nai hatete, “Tebes, povu nee ida deit, no sira hotu iha lian ida deit. Sira foin mak hahuu atividade nee. Agora, la iha buat ida nebee sira la bele halo, tuir sira nia planu.
verses.7: Mai, Ita tuun ba no haketak sira nia lian hodi nunee sira la bele kompriende malu.”
verses.8: Entaun Nai halo ema sira nee namkari hosi fatin nee baa rai hotu iha mundu tomak. No sira husik planu atu harii sidade nee.
verses.9: Nunee fatin nee hanaran Babél tanba iha nebaa Nai haketak lian mundu tomak nian. No hosi fatin nee Nai halo ema namkari ba rai hotu iha mundu tomak.
verses.10: Ida nee mak Sem nia jerasaun. Bainhira udan boot liu tiha ona tinan rua, no Sem tinan atus ida, nia hetan oan ida naran Arpaxad.
verses.11: Bainhira nia hetan ona Arpaxad, Sem sei moris tan tinan atus lima (500), no nia hetan oan mane no oan feto sira seluk.
verses.12: Bainhira Arpaxad tinan tolu-nulu resin lima (35), nia hetan oan ida naran Xela.
verses.13: Bainhira nia hetan ona Xela, Arpaxad sei moris tan tinan atus haat resin tolu (403), no nia hetan oan mane no oan feto sira seluk.
verses.14: Bainhira Xela tinan tolu-nulu (30), nia hetan oan ida naran Eber.
verses.15: Bainhira nia hetan ona Eber, Xela sei moris tan tinan atus haat resin tolu (403), no nia hetan oan mane no oan feto sira seluk.
verses.16: Bainhira Eber tinan tolu-nulu resin haat (34), nia hetan oan ida naran Peleg.
verses.17: Bainhira nia hetan ona Peleg, Eber sei moris tan tinan atus haat tolu-nulu(430), no nia hetan oan mane no oan feto sira seluk.
verses.18: Bainhira Peleg tinan tolu-nulu (30), nia hetan oan ida naran Reú.
verses.19: Bainhira nia hetan ona Reú, Peleg sei moris tan tinan atus rua resin sia (209), no nia hetan oan mane no oan feto sira seluk.
verses.20: Bainhira Reú tinan tolu-nulu resin rua (32), nia hetan oan ida naran Serug.
verses.21: Bainhira nia hetan ona Serug, Reú sei moris tan tinan atus rua resin hitu (207), no nia hetan oan mane no oan feto sira seluk.
verses.22: Bainhira Serug tinan tolu-nulu (30), nia hetan oan ida naran Naor.
verses.23: Bainhira nia hetan ona Naor, Serug sei moris tan tinan atus rua (200), no nia hetan oan mane no oan feto sira seluk.
verses.24: Bainhira Naor tinan rua-nulu resin sia (29), nia hetan oan ida naran Tera.
verses.25: Bainhira nia hetan ona Tera, Naor sei moris tan tinan atus ida sanulu resin sia (119), no nia hetan oan mane no oan feto sira seluk.
verses.26: Bainhira Tera tinan hitu-nulu (70), nia hetan oan sira naran Abrão, Naor no Haran.
verses.27: Tera nia jerasaun hanesan nee. Tera hetan oan sira naran Abrão, Naor no Haran. Haran hetan oan ida naran Ló.
verses.28: Haran mate iha nia aman Tera nia prezensa. Nia mate iha nia moris fatin nebee iha Ur, iha ema Kaldeia sira nia rai.
verses.29: Depois Abrão no Naor hola feto sira. Abrão nia feen nia naran Sarai no Naor nia feen nia naran Milka, nebee Haran nia oan feto. Haran mak Milka nia aman no Iská nia aman.
verses.30: Maibee Sarai la bele isin rua entaun oan la iha.
verses.31: Tera lori nia oan mane Abrão, no nia bei-oan Ló nebee Haran nia oan mane, no nia feto foun Sarai nebee nia oan mane Abrão nia feen, no sira hotu lao hamutuk sai hosi rai Ur, ema Kaldeia sira nia rai, hodi baa rai Kanaan. Maibee bainhira sira too iha rai Haran sira hela iha nebaa.
verses.32: Tera moris too tinan atus rua resin lima (205), depois nia mate iha Haran.

verses.1: Nai hatete ba Abrão, “Lao sai hosi o nia rai, hosi o nia família, no hosi o nia aman nia uma, no baa rai ida nebee Hau sei hatudu ba o.
verses.2: No Hau sei halo nasaun boot hosi o, no Hau sei haraik bensaun ba o, no Hau sei halo o nia naran boot, no o sei sai bensaun ida.
verses.3: Hau sei foo bensaun ba sira nebee foo bensaun ba o, no Hau sei foo malisan ba sira nebee foo malisan ba o, no família hotu-hotu iha mundu sei hetan bensaun liu hosi o.”
verses.4: Nunee Abrão sai, tuir Nai nia liafuan ba nia. Ló mos baa ho nia. Abrão tinan hitu-nulu resin lima (75) bainhira nia sai hosi Haran.
verses.5: No Abrão lori nia feen Sarai, no nia alin nia oan Ló, no sira nia riku-soin hotu nebee sira halibur ona, no ema hotu nebee sira hetan iha Haran. Depois sira sai hodi baa rai Kanaan. Tuir mai sira too rai Kanaan.
verses.6: Abrão lao liu hosi rai nee too Sikém, iha fatin rai tetuk iha Moré. Iha tempu nee, ema Kanaan sira sei hela iha rai nee.
verses.7: Nai hatudu aan ba Abrão, Nia dehan, “Hau sei foo rai nee ba o nia bei-oan.” Abrão harii altár ida ba Nai nebee hatudu aan ba nia.
verses.8: Abrão sai hosi fatin nee no baa too foho ida iha Betél nia sorin lorosae. Nia tau nia tenda iha nebaa. Betél iha sorin loromonu no Ai iha sorin lorosae. Iha fatin nee nia harii altár ida ba Nai, no nia bolu ba Nai nia naran.
verses.9: Depois Abrão lao fali no nia baa rai Negeb.
verses.10: Iha tempu nee, akontese rai hamlaha boot. Abrão lao tuun too Ejitu hodi hela iha nebaa tanba rai hamlaha boot tebes.
verses.11: Tuir mai, bainhira nia besik atu tama ba Ejitu, nia dehan ba nia feen Sarai, “Haree lai, hau hatene katak o oin bonita loos.
verses.12: Nunee bainhira ema Ejitu sira haree o, sira sei hatete, ‘Feto nee mak nia feen.’ Depois sira sei oho hau maibee sira sei husik o moris.
verses.13: Favór ida, hatete deit katak o mak hau nia alin. Nunee sira sei haree hau diak no hau sei moris tanba o.”
verses.14: Hafoin Abrão tama ba iha Ejitu, ema Ejitu sira haree feto nee bonita loos.
verses.15: Faraó nia xefi boot sira mos haree feto nee no sira baa gaba feto nee iha Faraó nia oin. Nunee sira foti feto nee no lori nia ba Faraó nia uma.
verses.16: No Faraó halo diak ba Abrão tanba Sarai. Abrão hetan bibi, karau, kuda buru aman, atan mane, atan feto, kuda buru inan no kuda kamelu sira.
verses.17: Maibee Nai kastigu Faraó no nia uma kain ho terus boot tanba Sarai, Abrão nia feen.
verses.18: Faraó bolu Abrão no dehan, “Saida mak o halo mai hau? Tanba saa mak o la foo hatene katak nia mak o nia feen?
verses.19: Nusaa mak o hatete, ‘Feto nee mak hau nia alin?’ hodi nunee hau foti nia sai hau nia feen. Agora, haree o nia feen, foti nia no baa deit.”
verses.20: No Faraó foo orden ba ninia ema kona ba Abrão, no sira haruka Abrão sai hamutuk ho ninia feen no ho ninia riku-soin hotu.

verses.1: Abrão sai hosi Ejitu hamutuk ho ninia feen no ninia sasaan. No Ló baa hamutuk ho nia no sira tama ba rai Negeb.
verses.2: Abrão riku loos ho karau sira, osan mutin no osan mean.
verses.3: No nia halo viajen hosi Negeb too iha Betél. Nia baa fatin nebee uluk nia harii ninia tenda, entre Betél no Ai,
verses.4: iha fatin nebee uluk nia harii altár ida. Iha fatin nee, Abrão bolu ba Nai nia naran.
verses.5: No Ló, nebee baa hamutuk ho Abrão, nia mos iha karau, bibi no tenda.
verses.6: No rai nee la too ba sira hotu hodi sira bele hela hamutuk. Sira la bele hela hamutuk tanba sira iha sasaan barak.
verses.7: Nee duni Abrão nia bibi atan sira no Ló nia bibi atan sira istori malu. Iha tempu nebaa, ema Kanaan sira no ema Perizeu sira hela iha rai nee.
verses.8: Depois Abrão dehan ba Ló, “Ita la bele istori malu, entre hau ho o, ka hau nia bibi atan sira no o nia bibi atan sira, tanba ita maun-alin.
verses.9: Laos rai tomak iha o nia oin? Mai ita haketak malu. Se karik o baa sorin karuk, hau sei baa sorin loos; ka se o baa sorin loos, hau sei baa sorin karuk.”
verses.10: Ló foti matan no haree rai tetuk hotu iha Jordaun. Nia haree katak rai nee iha bee barak iha fatin hotu hanesan Nai nia jardín, hanesan rai Ejitu, iha dalan ba Zoar. (Ida nee uluk Nai estraga Sodoma no Gomora.)
verses.11: Entaun Ló hili rai tetuk hotu no nia lao ba área lorosae. Nunee sira fahe malu.
verses.12: Abrão hela iha rai Kanaan nian, no Ló hela iha sidade sira iha rai tetuk. Ló harii ninia tenda besik Sodoma.
verses.13: Maibee ema Sodoma sira nee aat tebes. Sira mak sala nain makaas iha Nai nia oin.
verses.14: Bainhira Ló husik tiha Abrão, Nai dehan ba Abrão, “Foti o nia matan, no haree hosi o nia fatin nee ba parte norte, parte súl, parte lorosae no parte loromonu.
verses.15: Tanba Hau sei foo rai hotu nebee o haree nee ba o no o nia bei-oan too tinan ba tinan.
verses.16: No Hau sei aumenta o nia bei-oan sira hanesan rai rahun iha mundu, no hanesan nee o sei iha bei-oan barak.
verses.17: Hamriik ba, lao ba-mai iha rai nee hosi leten ba kraik no sorin ba sorin, tanba Hau sei foo rai nee ba o.”
verses.18: Nunee Abrão foti nia tenda no nia baa no hela iha rai tetuk Mamre, nebee iha Hebron, no nia harii altár ida ba Nai.

verses.1: Iha tempu nee, Amrafel liurai hosi Sinear, Arioke liurai hosi Elasar, Kedorlaomer liurai hosi Elam, no Tidal liurai hosi Goim,
verses.2: sira halo funu hasoru Bera liurai hosi Sodoma, no Birsa liurai hosi Gomora, Sinab liurai hosi Adma, Semeber liurai hosi Zeboim, no liurai hosi Bela, nebee Zoar.
verses.3: Sira hotu hasoru malu iha Rai Tetuk Sidim, nebee iha Tasi Masin.
verses.4: Sira serví Kedorlaomer too tinan sanulu resin rua, maibee iha tinan ba dala sanulu resin tolu sira kontra nia.
verses.5: Depois, iha tinan sanulu resin haat, Kedorlaomer mai ho liurai sira nebee hamutuk ho nia. Sira manaan ema Refaim sira iha Astoret-Karnaim, ema Zuzim sira iha Ham, ema Emim sira iha Savé-Kiriataim,
verses.6: no ema Hori sira iha foho Seir, too El-Parán nebee besik iha rai fuik.
verses.7: Depois sira fila ba too iha En-Mispat, katak Kades, no manaan fali rai hotu nebee ema Amalek sira nian, no mos ema Amoreu sira nebee hela iha Hazezon-Tamar.
verses.8: Depois liurai hosi Sodoma, liurai hosi Gomora, liurai hosi Adma, liurai hosi Zeboim no liurai hosi Bela, katak Zoar, sira hotu sai ba no halo funu iha rai tetuk Sidim.
verses.9: Sira hasoru Kedorlaomer liurai hosi Elam, Tidal liurai hosi Goim, Amrafel liurai hosi Sinar, no Arioke liurai hosi Elasar. Liurai nain haat hasoru liurai nain lima.
verses.10: Rai Tetuk Sidim nee iha rai kuak barak nebee nakonu ho alkatraun, no liurai sira hosi Sodoma no Gomora halai no monu iha nebaa, no ema restu halai ba foho.
verses.11: No sira nebee manaan funu nee foti sasaan hotu hosi Sodoma no Gomora, inklui sira nia ai haan hotu, no sira baa.
verses.12: No sira foti Ló, Abrão nia maun nia oan, nebee hela iha Sodoma, ho ninia sasaan no sira sai ba.
verses.13: Depois, ema ida halai no foo hatene ba Abrão, ema Ebreu nee. Nia hela iha ai huun boot iha Mamre nia rai. Mamre mak ema Amoreu, no nia maun-alin sira mak Eskol no Aner, no sira halo akordu ho Abrão.
verses.14: Bainhira Abrão rona katak ema kastigu ninia alin, nia halibur ninia ema nebee treinu ona, nebee moris iha ninia uma kain, ema nain atus tolu sanulu resin ualu (318), no nia duni sira too iha Dan.
verses.15: Nia fahe ninia atan sira hodi hasoru sira iha kalan, no nia manaan sira no duni sira too Hoba, nebee iha Damasku nia sorin karuk.
verses.16: Depois nia lori fali ba sasaan hotu, no mos nia lori fila fali ninia alin Ló, no Ló nia sasaan, no feto sira, no ema seluk.
verses.17: Bainhira Abrão fila mai hosi funu nebee nia manaan Kedorlaomer, no liurai sira nebee hamutuk ho nia, liurai hosi Sodoma sai hodi hasoru nia iha Rai Tetuk Savé, nebee iha Rai Tetuk Liurai Nian.
verses.18: No Melkizedek, liurai hosi Salém, lori mai paun no tua uvas. Nia mak saserdote ba Maromak Nebee Aas Liu.
verses.19: Melkizedek foo bensaun ba Abrão no dehan,
verses.20: no adora ba Maromak Nebee Aas Liu,
verses.21: Liurai hosi Sodoma dehan ba Abrão, “Foo fali ema sira nee maibee lori sasaan hotu.”
verses.22: Abrão hataan ba liurai hosi Sodoma, “Hau foti sae tiha hau nia liman hodi jura ba Nai, Maromak Nebee Aas Liu, Maromak nebee kria lalehan no mundu,
verses.23: katak hau sei la foti kabas lahan ida ka tali ida hosi sapatu ka buat naran deit nebee ita boot nian, hodi ita boot la bele dehan, ‘Hau mak halo Abrão sai riku.’
verses.24: Só deit, buat nebee joven mane sira mak haan ona, no kona ba mane sira nebee baa hamutuk ho hau, mak Aner, Eskol no Mamre, husik sira foti parte nebee sira nian.”

verses.1: Nee liu tiha, Nai nia liafuan mai Abrão iha vizaun ida, no Nia dehan, “Keta tauk, Abrão, tanba Hau mak o nia eskudu no o sei hetan prémiu boot tebes.”
verses.2: Abrão hataan, “Nai Maromak, O sei foo saida mai hau tanba hau la iha oan? Nunee ema ida nebee simu hau nia uma nudar liman rohan mak Eliezer hosi Damasku.”
verses.3: No Abrão dehan, “Tebes, O la foo oan mai hau, nee duni ema ida nebee moris iha hau nia uma kain mak hetan hau nia liman rohan.”
verses.4: No tebes, Nai nia liafuan mai Abrão, no Nia dehan, “Nia sei la hetan o nia liman rohan, maibee o nia oan mane rasik sei hetan o nia liman rohan.”
verses.5: Maromak lori Abrão sai ba liur no dehan, “Haree took ba lalehan no sura fitun sira nee, se karik o bele sura sira.” No Nia dehan ba Abrão, “O nia bei-oan sira sei sai hanesan nee.”
verses.6: Abrão fiar ba Nai, no Nai sura fiar nee nudar moris loos ba nia.
verses.7: Nai dehan ba Abrão, “Hau mak Nai, nebee lori o sai hosi Ur nebee iha ema Kasdim nia rai, hodi foo rai ida nee ba o nudar liman rohan.”
verses.8: No nia hataan, “Nai Maromak, oinsaa hau bele hatene katak hau sei simu rai nee nudar liman rohan?”
verses.9: Maromak dehan ba nia, “Foti karau inan nebee tinan tolu, bibi inan nebee tinan tolu, bibi malae aman nebee tinan tolu, manu lakateu ida no manu pombu oan ida.”
verses.10: Abrão lori buat hotu nee, no nia koa sira fahe ba rua. Nia tau naan nee hodi sorin ida hasoru sorin seluk, maibee manu sira nee nia la koa.
verses.11: No bainhira makikit sira tuun mai ba naan nee, Abrão duni sai sira.
verses.12: Bainhira loro matan monu dadaun, Abrão toba dukur haluha rai. No tebes, nakukun boot no terus monu ba nia.
verses.13: No Maromak dehan ba Abrão, “Hatene lo-loos katak o nia bei-oan sira sei sai estranjeiru iha rai nebee laos sira nian, no sira sei serví ema sira iha nebaa. No ema sira nee sei hanehan sira too tinan atus haat.
verses.14: No mos, Hau sei tesi lia ba nasaun nee, nebee sira serví. Liu tiha nee, sira sei sai ho sasaan barak.
verses.15: No o sei baa o nia bei-ala sira ho dame, no ema sei hakoi o ho idade boot nebee diak.
verses.16: Maibee iha jerasaun haat ba oin, sira sei fila fali mai iha nee, tanba ema Amoreu nia hahalok aat seidauk kompletu.”
verses.17: Tuir mai, bainhira loro matan monu ona no rai nakukun, tebes fugaun suar ida ho lampu lakan ida mai liu iha naan sira nia klaran.
verses.18: Iha loron nee, Nai halo aliansa ho Abrão no dehan, “Hau foo rai nee ba o nia bei-oan sira, hosi mota iha Ejitu too iha mota boot, katak Mota Eufrates.
verses.19: Nee mak rai hosi ema Keneu, ema Kenizeu, ema Kadmoneu,
verses.20: ema Hiti, ema Perizeu, ema Refaim,
verses.21: ema Amoreu, ema Kanaan, ema Girgaseu no ema Jebuseu sira.”

verses.1: Sarai, Abrão nia feen, la iha oan. Nia iha atan feto ida nebee ema Ejitu, ho naran Hagar.
verses.2: No Sarai dehan ba Abrão, “Tebes, Nai prevene hau atu la bele iha oan. Favór ida, tama ba hau nia atan feto. Karik hau bele hetan oan sira liu hosi nia.” No Abrão rona tuir Sarai nia liafuan.
verses.3: Bainhira Abrão hela tinan sanulu ona iha rai Kanaan, Sarai, Abrão nia feen, foti ninia atan feto Hagar no foo ba nia laen Abrão nudar Abrão feen kiik.
verses.4: Abrão tama ba Hagar, no Hagar isin rua. Bainhira Hagar haree katak nia isin rua ona, nia hateke ba ninia senhora no despreza nia.
verses.5: Sarai dehan ba Abrão, “Terus nebee kona hau nee mai tanba o nia sala! Hau foo tiha hau nia atan feto hodi o bele kous, no bainhira nia haree katak nia isin rua nia despreza fali hau. Nunee Nai sei tesi lia entre hau ho o!”
verses.6: Maibee Abrão dehan ba Sarai, “Tebes, o nia atan feto mak iha o nia liman. Halo ba nia tuir o nia hakarak.” Entaun Sarai hatuun Hagar, nunee Hagar halai hosi Sarai nia oin.
verses.7: Depois, Nai nia anju hetan Hagar besik bee matan iha rai fuik, nebee bee matan iha dalan ba Sur.
verses.8: No nia dehan, “Hagar, Sarai nia atan feto, o mai hosi nebee? O baa nebee?” No feto dehan, “Hau halai hosi hau nia senhora Sarai.”
verses.9: No Nai nia anju dehan ba nia, “Fila fali ba o nia senhora, no haraik aan ba ninia direitu.”
verses.10: Nai nia anju dehan ba nia, “Hau sei habarak o nia bei-oan sira hodi sai barak loos too la bele sura ema lubun boot nee.”
verses.11: No Nai nia anju dehan ba nia,
verses.12: Nia sei sai hanesan kuda buru fuik,
verses.13: Hagar hanaran Nai nebee koalia ho nia, “Maromak nebee haree hau.” Tanba nia dehan, “Hau haree ona Nia nebee tau matan mai hau.”
verses.14: Nunee sira bolu bee matan nee, Beer-Lahai-Roi, no tebes fatin nee iha Kades no Bered nia klaran.
verses.15: Hagar hetan oan mane ida ba Abrão. No Abrão hanaran ninia oan mane hosi Hagar nee Ismael.
verses.16: Abrão tinan ualu-nulu resin neen bainhira Hagar hetan oan mane ida ho Abrão.

verses.1: Bainhira Abrão tinan sia-nulu resin sia, Nai mosu mai no dehan ba nia, “Hau mak Maromak Kbiit Makaas, lao iha Hau nia oin ho hahalok perfeitu.
verses.2: No Hau sei halo aliansa entre Hau ho o, no hau sei halo o sai barak tebes.”
verses.3: Abrão hakruuk ho oin ba rai. Maromak dehan ba nia,
verses.4: “Tebes, Hau halo aliansa ho o, no o sei sai aman ba nasaun barak.
verses.5: No o nia naran laos Abrão ona, maibee o nia naran mak Abraão. Tanba Hau halo o sai aman ba nasaun barak.
verses.6: No Hau sei halo hodi o iha bei-oan barak, no Hau sei halo nasaun sira hosi o, no liurai sira sei sai hosi o.
verses.7: Hau sei estabelese Hau nia aliansa ho o, no ho o nia bei-oan sira nebee tuir o hosi jerasaun ba jerasaun. No aliansa nee sei lao too tinan ba tinan. Hodi nunee Hau mak Maromak ba o no ba o nia bei-oan sira nebee tuir o.
verses.8: Hau sei foo rai Kanaan hotu ba o, no ba o nia bei-oan sira nebee tuir o. O sei hela nudar ema lao rai iha rai nee. Maibee rai nee sei sai o nian too tinan ba tinan. No Hau sei sai o nia bei-oan sira nia Maromak.”
verses.9: Maromak dehan ba Abraão, “O tenki halo tuir Hau nia aliansa, o no o nia bei-oan sira nebee tuir o iha sira nia jerasaun sira.
verses.10: Ida nee mak Hau nia aliansa nebee o sei halo tuir, entre Hau ho o, no o nia bei-oan sira nebee tuir o: oan mane ida-idak tenki hetan sirkunsizaun.
verses.11: Imi tenki hetan sirkunsizaun ba imi nia oin-lulik nia kulit rohan iha imi nia isin. Ida nee sei sai sinál ba aliansa entre Hau ho imi.
verses.12: Nia nebee halo loron ualu ona iha imi nia leet tenki hetan sirkunsizaun. Ida nee inklui oan mane hotu iha imi nia jerasaun sira, nia nebee moris iha imi nia uma kain, ka nia nebee imi sosa ho osan hosi estranjeiru see deit, nebee laos hosi imi nia bei-oan sira.
verses.13: Nia nebee moris iha imi nia uma kain, no nia nebee imi sosa ho osan tenki hetan sirkunsizaun. Hau nia aliansa sei iha imi nia isin hodi sai aliansa too tinan ba tinan.
verses.14: Oan mane nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun ba ninia oin-lulik nia kulit rohan iha isin nee, imi tenki hasai nia hosi ninia povu tanba nia kontra ona Hau nia aliansa.”
verses.15: Maromak dehan ba Abraão, “Kona ba o nia feen Sarai, o la bele bolu nia Sarai ona, tanba ninia naran sei sai Sara.
verses.16: No Hau sei haraik bensaun ba nia no foo oan mane ida ba o liu hosi nia. Hau sei foo bensaun ba nia no nia sei sai inan ba nasaun sira no liurai sira sei mai hosi nia.”
verses.17: Depois Abraão hakruuk ho oin ba rai no nia hamnasa no dehan iha nia fuan laran, “Ema ida nebee tinan atus ida sei hetan oan ka? No Sara nebee tinan sia-nulu sei tuur ahi ka?”
verses.18: Abraão dehan ba Maromak, “Oh katak Ismael bele hela iha O nia oin!”
verses.19: Maromak hataan, “Sara, o nia feen, nia sei tuur ahi duni no o sei hetan oan mane ida, no o sei hanaran nia Isak. No Hau sei estabelese Hau nia aliansa hodi sai aliansa too tinan ba tinan ho ninia bei-oan sira nebee tuir nia.
verses.20: Kona ba Ismael, Hau rona ona o nia liafuan. Tebes, Hau haraik bensaun ona ba nia, no Hau sei halo nia sai barak, no nia sei hetan oan barak tebes. Nia sei hetan liurai sanulu resin rua, no Hau sei halo nia sai nasaun ida nebee boot.
verses.21: Maibee Hau sei estabelese Hau nia aliansa ho Isak, nebee o hetan hosi Sara, iha tinan oin iha tempu hanesan nee."
verses.22: Bainhira Nia koalia hotu ona ho Abraão, Maromak sae ba no husik hela Abraão.
verses.23: Abraão foti ninia oan mane Ismael, no ema hotu nebee moris iha ninia uma kain, no ema hotu nebee nia sosa ho osan. Nia foti mane hotu iha sira nia leet iha Abraão nia uma kain. No nia halo sirkunsizaun ba sira nia oin-lulik nia kulit rohan iha loron nebaa, tuir buat nebee Maromak hatete ona ba nia.
verses.24: Abraão tinan sia-nulu resin sia bainhira nia hetan sirkunsizaun iha ninia oin-lulik nia kulit rohan.
verses.25: No Ismael nia oan tinan sanulu resin tolu bainhira nia hetan sirkunsizaun iha ninia oin-lulik nia kulit rohan.
verses.26: Iha loron nebaa Abraão no ninia oan mane Ismael hetan sirkunsizaun.
verses.27: Mane hotu iha ninia uma kain, inklui sira nebee moris iha uma kain nee no sira nebee nia sosa hosi estranjeiru, sira hotu hetan sirkunsizaun hamutuk ho nia.

verses.1: Nai mosu mai ba Abraão iha ai huun boot sira iha Mamre. Abraão tuur iha ninia tenda nia odamatan iha oras nebee loron manas.
verses.2: Nia foti matan no nia haree ba, no tebes, nia haree mane nain tolu hamriik iha ninia oin. Bainhira nia haree sira, nia halai hosi ninia tenda nia odamatan hodi hasoru sira no nia hakruuk ba rai.
verses.3: Nia dehan, “Hau nia senhor, se karik hau hetan grasa iha ita boot sira nia oin, favór ida keta lao liu deit hosi ita boot sira nia atan hau.
verses.4: Favór ida, husik ema kuru bee uitoan hodi fasi ita boot sira nia ain no ita boot sira bele deskansa iha ai huun okos.
verses.5: No hau sei lori paun uitoan hodi hafoun ita boot sira nia laran. Depois ita boot sira bele kontinua lao ba, tanba ita boot sira mai tiha ona ba ita boot sira nia atan hau.” No sira hataan, “Bele halo tuir o nia liafuan nee.”
verses.6: Entaun Abraão halai ba nia tenda laran ba Sara no dehan, “Lalais, sukat trigu diak too baldi boot ida! Kumu no halo paun.”
verses.7: No Abraão halai ba karau sira no foti karau oan ida nebee diak ho isin mamar, no nia foo ba joven mane ida hodi prepara.
verses.8: No nia foti keiju, susu been no naan karau nebee prepara ona no nia tau iha sira nia oin. Nia hamriik iha sira nia sorin no sira haan.
verses.9: Sira dehan ba nia, “O nia feen Sara iha nebee?” No nia hataan, “Tebes, iha tenda laran.”
verses.10: Nai dehan, “Tinan oin tempu hanesan nee, Hau sei fila fali mai, no Sara sei iha oan mane ida.” No Sara rona hosi tenda nia odamatan iha sira nia kotuk.
verses.11: Abraão no Sara katuas no ferik no idade boot ona no Sara nia fulan la mai ona.
verses.12: Nunee Sara hamnasa iha nia laran no dehan, “Hau ferik ona, nunee hau bele sai kontenti ka? Hau nia senhor mos idade ona!”
verses.13: Nai dehan ba Abraão, “Tanba saa mak Sara hamnasa no dehan, ‘Hau sei hetan oan duni bainhira hau ferik ona ka?’
verses.14: Iha buat ida nebee susar liu ba Nai ka? Tuir tempu nebee marka ona, Hau sei fila fali ba imi, tinan oin maizoumenus tempu hanesan nee, no Sara sei iha oan mane ida.”
verses.15: Maibee Sara nega liafuan nee no dehan, “Hau la hamnasa.” No Nia hataan, “Lae, maibee o hamnasa duni.”
verses.16: Depois ema sira nee hamriik no haree ba Sodoma no Abraão lao ho sira hodi foo adeus ba sira.
verses.17: No Nai dehan, “Hau sei subar hosi Abraão buat nebee Hau atu halo ka?
verses.18: Tanba Abraão sei sai nasaun ida nebee boot no forti, no nasaun hotu iha mundu sei hetan bensaun liu hosi nia.
verses.19: Tanba Hau hatene katak Abraão sei diriji ninia oan sira no ninia uma kain nebee tuir nia hodi sira halo tuir Nai nia dalan, liu hosi halao hahalok loos no justisa. Nunee Nai sei haraik ba Abraão buat nebee Nia promete ona ba Abraão.”
verses.20: No Nai dehan, “Tanba lian halerik hasoru Sodoma no Gomora, no sira nia sala mak todan duni,
verses.21: nunee Hau sei tuun hodi haree karik sira halo duni tuir lian halerik nebee too mai Hau ka lae. Se lae, Hau sei hatene.”
verses.22: Depois mane sira nee see aan hodi ba Sodoma, maibee Abraão hamriik hela iha Nai nia oin.
verses.23: Abraão hakbesik ba Nia no husu, “O sei halakon ema nebee moris loos hamutuk ho ema nebee hahalok aat ka?
verses.24: Se karik O hetan ema nain lima-nulu nebee moris loos iha sidade laran, O sei harahun sidade nee no la husik fatin nee tanba ema moris loos nebee iha laran?
verses.25: Hadook tiha hosi O atu halo nunee, atu oho ema moris loos hamutuk ho ema aat sira, hodi ema moris loos hetan kastigu hanesan mos ema aat sira. Laos Juis ba mundu tomak sei halo loos ka?”
verses.26: No Nai hataan, “Se karik Hau hetan ema nain lima-nulu nebee moris loos iha sidade Sodoma, nunee Hau sei husik fatin nee tanba sira.”
verses.27: Abraão hataan, “Tebes, agora hau koko ona hodi koalia ba Nai, maski hau mak rai rahun no ahi kdesan.
verses.28: Se karik fatin nee falta nain lima hosi nain lima-nulu nebee moris loos, nunee O sei harahun sidade hotu tanba falta nain lima deit ka?” Nia dehan, “Se karik Hau hetan deit nain haat-nulu resin lima, Hau sei la harahun sidade nee.”
verses.29: No Abraão koalia tan no dehan, “Karik O hetan nain haat-nulu iha nebaa.” Nia dehan, “Hau sei la halo ida nee tanba nain haat-nulu.”
verses.30: Abraão dehan, “Oh Nai, keta hirus hau no hau sei koalia. Karik O hetan nain tolu-nulu iha nebaa.” Nia dehan, “Hau sei la halo, se karik Hau hetan nain tolu-nulu iha nebaa.”
verses.31: Abraão dehan, “Tebes, agora hau koko ona hodi koalia ho Nai. Karik O hetan nain rua-nulu iha nebaa.” Nia dehan, “Hau sei la halo tanba nain rua-nulu.”
verses.32: Abraão dehan, “Oh Nai, keta hirus hau no hau sei koalia dala ida tan. Karik O hetan nain sanulu iha nebaa.” Nia dehan, “Hau sei la halo tanba nain sanulu.”
verses.33: No bainhira Nai koalia hotu ona ho Abraão, Nia lao ba no Abraão fila fali ba ninia fatin.

verses.1: Anju rua baa too iha Sodoma iha tempu rai nakaras no Ló tuur hela iha portaun Sodoma nian. Ló haree sira nain rua nee no nia hamriik hodi hasoru sira. Nia hakruuk ho nia oin ba rai.
verses.2: No nia dehan, “Hau nia senhor sira, favór ida, bele mai no tama ita boot sira nia atan hau nia uma. Bele toba kalan tomak, fasi ain, no hadeer sedu hodi kontinua ita boot sira nia viajen.” Sira hataan, “Lae, ami sei toba iha fatin liur deit.”
verses.3: Maibee nia obriga sira makaas, no sira ba ho nia no tama ninia uma. No nia foo hemu ba sira no tunu paun nebee fermentu la iha no sira haan.
verses.4: Maibee molok sira toba, mane sira hosi sidade nee, nebee ema Sodoma, haleu uma nee, ema katuas no ema joven, ema hotu hosi fatin hotu.
verses.5: Sira bolu Ló no dehan, “Mane sira nebee tama ba o nia uma iha kalan nee agora iha nebee? Lori sira mai ami nunee ami bele toba ho sira.”
verses.6: Ló sai hosi nia uma hodi hasoru sira no taka odamatan iha nia kotuk.
verses.7: Nia dehan, “Favór ida, maluk sira, keta halo buat aat nee.
verses.8: Tebes, hau iha oan feto rua nebee seidauk toba ho mane. Favór ida, husik hau bele foo sira ba imi hodi imi bele halo ba sira tuir imi nia hakarak. Maibee keta halo buat ida ba mane sira nee tanba sira tama ona iha hau nia uma kakuluk nia mahon.”
verses.9: Maibee sira dehan, “Sees tiha!” No sira dehan, “Mane ida nee mai nudar ema lao rai, no agora nia sai juis! Agora, ami sei halo aat ba o liu fali sira.” Sira dudu makaas Ló nee, no sira besik atu baku tuun odamatan.
verses.10: Maibee ema nain rua iha laran lolo liman no dada Ló tama ba uma laran, no sira taka tiha odamatan.
verses.11: No sira halo ema iha odamatan liur sai matan delek, ema kiik no boot. Ema iha liur buka la hetan odamatan nee too sira kole.
verses.12: No sira nain rua nee dehan ba Ló, “O iha família seluk iha nee ka lae? O nia mane foun, oan mane no oan feto sira ka ema seluk tan nebee hela iha sidade nee, lori sira sai hosi fatin nee.
verses.13: Tanba ami atu harahun fatin nee, tanba lian halerik hasoru povu nee sai makaas tebes iha Nai nia oin. Nunee Nai haruka ami mai harahun fatin nee.”
verses.14: Nunee Ló sai ba no koalia ho nia mane foun sira, nebee atu kaben ho nia oan feto sira, no nia dehan, “Hadeer lai, no sai hosi fatin nee, tanba Nai atu harahun sidade nee.” Maibee ninia mane foun sira hanoin katak nia koalia halimar deit.
verses.15: Iha dadeer-saan, anju sira nee obriga Ló no dehan, “Hadeer lai! No lori o nia feen no o nia oan feto nain rua nebee hamutuk ho o. Se lae, o sei lakon hamutuk ho sidade nia hahalok aat nee.”
verses.16: No bainhira Ló dada tempu, ema nain rua nee foti nia liman no nia feen nia liman, no nia oan feto nain rua nia liman, tanba Nai hanoin tebes sira. No ema nain rua nee lori sira sai ba sidade liur.
verses.17: Bainhira sira lori Ló sira ba liur ona, sira dehan, “Halai hodi salva imi nia moris. Keta hateke ba kotuk, no keta para iha nebee deit iha rai tetuk, maibee halai ba foho hodi imi la bele lakon.”
verses.18: Ló dehan ba sira, “Oh, la bele, hau nia Nai!
verses.19: Tebes, agora ita boot nia atan hau hetan grasa ona iha ita boot nia oin, no ita boot hatudu ona domin metin nebee boot mai hau. Maibee hau la bele halai ba foho, keta halo be buat aat akontese mai hau no hau mate.
verses.20: Tebes, sidade ida nee mak besik atu hau bele halai ba. Husik hau bele halai ba nebaa. Laos fatin nee kiik deit? No hau bele salva hau nia moris.”
verses.21: No nia dehan ba Ló, “Tebes, hau simu mos o nia liafuan kona ba ida nee, no hau sei la harahun aldeia nee, nebee o koalia tiha ona.
verses.22: Lalais, halai ba nebaa. Tanba hau la bele halo buat ida too o baa too aldeia iha nebaa.” Nunee aldeia nee hetan naran Zoar.
verses.23: Loron matan sae ona iha rai nee bainhira Ló tama ona Zoar.
verses.24: Depois Nai fakar tuun fatuk klaak no ahi hosi Nai, nebee hosi lalehan.25 No Nia harahun sidade sira nee, no rai tetuk hotu, no ema hotu iha sidade sira nee, no ai horis hotu nebee moris iha rai.
verses.26: Maibee Ló nia feen hateke ba kotuk no nia sai riin masin ida.
verses.27: Abraão hadeer sedu iha dadeer no nia baa fatin nebee uluk nia hamriik iha Nai nia oin.
verses.28: No nia hateke ba fatin Sodoma no Gomora, no ba rai tetuk tomak. Nia haree ba no tebes, ahi suar sae hosi rai nee hanesan ahi suar hosi fornu.
verses.29: Entaun bainhira Maromak halakon sidade sira iha rai tetuk, Nia hanoin Abraão no Nia haruka Ló sai hosi dezastre laran nee, iha tempu nebee Nia harahun sidade sira nebee uluk Ló mak hela.
verses.30: Ló sai hosi Zoar no hela iha foho ho nia oan feto nain rua.
verses.31: Oan feto boot dehan ba ninia alin, “Ita nia aman katuas ona, no ita la iha mane ida hodi toba ho ita hanesan baibain ema halo iha mundu tomak.
verses.32: Mai ita halo ita nia aman hemu tua no ita sei toba ho nia hodi ita bele hetan oan sira hosi ita nia aman.”
verses.33: Iha kalan nee, sira halo sira nia aman hemu tua, no oan feto boot tama ba no toba ho nia aman, no aman la hatene bainhira oan feto nee toba no bainhira oan feto nee hadeer.
verses.34: Tuir mai, iha aban dadeer, oan feto boot dehan ba ninia alin, “Tebes, hori kalan hau toba ho hau nia aman. Mai ita halo nia hemu tua orasida kalan mos. No o tama ba no toba ho nia hodi ita bele hetan oan sira hosi ita nia aman.”
verses.35: Sira halo sira nia aman hemu fali tua iha kalan nee. No alin feto hamriik no baa toba ho nia. Nia la hatene bainhira oan feto nee toba no bainhira oan feto nee hadeer.
verses.36: Nunee Ló nia oan feto nain rua hetan oan liu hosi sira nia aman.
verses.37: Oan feto boot tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida no hanaran nia Moab. Nia mak aman ba ema Moab sira too ohin loron.
verses.38: Oan feto kiik mos tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida no hanaran nia Ben-Ami. Nia mak aman ba ema Amon sira too ohin loron.

verses.1: Abraão lao hosi fatin nee ba rai Negeb no hela iha Kades no Súr nia klaran. No nia lao ba-mai iha Gerar.
verses.2: No Abraão dehan kona ba ninia feen Sara, “Nia mak hau nia alin feto.” Entaun Abimelek, liurai hosi Gerar, haruka ema ba foti Sara.
verses.3: Maibee Maromak hasoru Abimelek liu hosi mehi iha kalan ida, no Nia dehan, “Tebes, o mak ema mate ona tanba feto nebee o foti nee, tanba nia mak mane ida nia feen.”
verses.4: Maibee Abimelek seidauk hakbesik ba feto nee. Abimelek dehan, “Nai, O sei oho mos nasaun ida nebee hahalok loos ka?
verses.5: Laos Abraão dehan mai hau, ‘Nia mak hau nia alin feto’? No feto rasik mos dehan, ‘Nia mak hau nia maun.’ Hau halo buat nee ho laran loos no liman moos.”
verses.6: Maromak dehan ba nia iha mehi, “Sin, Hau hatene katak o halo buat nee ho laran loos. Nunee Hau tahan o hodi o la halo sala hasoru Hau. Tanba nee Hau la husik o atu book nia.
verses.7: Agora, foo fali ba mane nee ninia feen. Tanba nia mak profeta ida, no nia sei halo orasaun ba o hodi o bele moris hela. Se karik o la foo fali feto nee, hatene lo-loos katak o sei mate duni, inklui ema hotu nebee o nian.”
verses.8: Entaun Abimelek hadeer iha dadeer-saan no nia bolu ninia atan sira mai. Nia foo hatene buat hotu nee ba sira no sira sai tauk loos.
verses.9: Abimelek bolu Abraão no dehan ba nia, “Ita halo saida mai ami? Sala saida mak hau halo hasoru ita, katak ita lori sala boot nee mai hau, no hau nia reinu boot. Tuir lo-loos, ita la bele halo hanesan nee.”
verses.10: No Abimelek dehan ba Abraão, “Ita hanoin saida, hodi nunee ita halo buat nee?”
verses.11: Abraão hataan, “Tanba hau hanoin, tebes ema iha fatin nee la hamtauk ba Maromak, nunee sira sei oho hau tanba hau nia feen.
verses.12: No tuir lo-loos, nia mak hau nia alin feto duni, tanba nia mak hau nia aman nia oan feto maibee laos hau nia inan nia oan feto, no nia sai hau nia feen.
verses.13: No bainhira Maromak haruka hau lao ba hosi hau nia aman nia uma, hau dehan ba nia, ‘Hatudu domin metin mai hau hanesan nee: Iha fatin nebee deit ita baa, bele dehan kona ba hau, Nia mak hau nia maun.’”
verses.14: Depois Abimelek foti bibi, karau, atan mane no atan feto sira no foo ba Abraão, no nia foo fali Abraão nia feen Sara.
verses.15: No Abimelek dehan, “Tebes, hau nia rai hotu mak iha ita nia oin, hela iha nebee deit tuir ita nia hakarak.”
verses.16: No ba Sara nia dehan, “Tebes, hau foo ona ba o nia maun osan mutin rihun ida. Tebes, ida nee sai sinál ba ita no ema hotu hamutuk ho ita katak ita loos ona.”
verses.17: Abraão halo orasaun ba Maromak no Maromak kura Abimelek no ninia feen no ninia atan feto sira no sira hetan oan sira.
verses.18: Tanba iha Abimelek nia uma kain, Nai taka ona sira nia oan fatin hotu, tanba Sara, Abraão nia feen.

verses.1: Nai mai ba Sara tuir Ninia liafuan no Nai halo ba Sara tuir Ninia promesa.
verses.2: No Sara isin rua no tuur ahi oan mane ida ba Abraão bainhira nia katuas ona, tuir tempu nebee Maromak hatete ona ba nia.
verses.3: Abraão hanaran oan mane nebee nia hetan liu hosi Sara ho naran Isak.
verses.4: Abraão halo sirkunsizaun ba ninia oan mane Isak bainhira nia moris loron ualu ona, tuir Maromak nia mandamentu ba Abraão.
verses.5: Abraão tinan atus ida bainhira nia hetan oan mane Isak.
verses.6: Sara dehan, “Maromak halo hau hamnasa, nunee ema hotu nebee rona sei hamnasa tanba hau.”
verses.7: No nia dehan, “Uluk nee, see mak bele dehan ba Abraão katak Sara atu foo susu ba oan ida? Maibee hau hetan oan mane ida ba nia bainhira nia katuas ona.”
verses.8: Labarik sai boot dadaun too loron nebee nia haketak susu. No Abraão halo festa boot iha loron nebee Isak haketak susu.
verses.9: Maibee Sara haree katak Hagar, ema Ejitu, nia oan mane nebee Hagar hetan ba Abraão nee goza fali Isak.
verses.10: Nunee Sara dehan ba Abraão, “Duni sai tiha atan feto nee no ninia oan mane, tanba atan feto nee nia oan mane sei la hetan liman rohan hamutuk ho hau nia oan mane Isak.”
verses.11: Ida nee susar loos ba Abraão tanba ninia oan mane.
verses.12: Maibee Maromak dehan ba Abraão, “Keta laran susar tanba labarik mane nee no tanba o nia atan feto. Halo tuir buat hotu nebee Sara dehan ona ba o, tanba liu hosi Isak mak o sei hetan bei-oan atu lori o nia naran.
verses.13: No Hau halo mos atan feto nee nia oan mane sai nasaun ida tanba nia mak o nia oan.”
verses.14: Entaun Abraão hadeer sedu iha dadeer-saan no foti paun no bee iha kulit ida no foo ba Hagar. Abraão tau ba feto no labarik nia kabaas no haruka sira sai. Nunee sira sai no lao ba-mai iha rai fuik iha Beer-Seba.
verses.15: Bainhira bee nee hotu ona, Hagar husik nia oan iha ai badak ida nia okos.
verses.16: Nia baa no tuur dook uitoan, ho distánsia hanesan ema hana rama oan. Nia dehan, “Keta husik hau haree labarik nee mate.” Nia tuur iha nebaa no tanis ho lian makaas.
verses.17: No Maromak rona lian hosi labarik nee no anju ida bolu Hagar hosi lalehan no dehan ba nia, “Hagar, nusaa? Keta tauk, tanba Maromak rona ona labarik nee nia lian hosi nia fatin.
verses.18: Hamriik ba, foti labarik nee no kaer ninia liman, tanba hau sei halo nia sai nasaun boot ida.”
verses.19: Maromak loke Hagar nia matan no nia haree bee posu ida. Nia baa no enxe bee nakonu iha kulit no foo hemu ba ninia oan.
verses.20: Maromak hamutuk ho labarik nee no nia sai boot no hela iha rai fuik no sai hanadór.
verses.21: Nia hela iha rai fuik naran Paran, no ninia inan foti feto ida hosi Ejitu hodi sai ninia feen.
verses.22: Tuir mai, iha tempu nebaa, Abimelek no Fikól, nebee komandante ba ninia forsa, koalia ho Abraão no dehan, “Maromak hamutuk hela ho ita ho buat hotu nebee ita halo.
verses.23: Nunee jura mai hau liu hosi Maromak katak ita la bosok hau, ka hau nia oan, ka hau nia bei-oan sira. Maibee tuir domin metin nebee hau hatudu ona ba ita, nunee ita mos sei hatudu domin metin mai hau no ba rai nebee ita lao dadaun iha laran nee.
verses.24: Abraão hataan, “Hau jura.”
verses.25: Depois Abraão kesar Abimelek kona ba bee posu ida nebee Abimelek nia atan sira hadau.
verses.26: Abimelek dehan, “Hau la hatene see mak halo ida nee. No ita seidauk foo hatene mai hau no hau seidauk rona kona ba ida nee too agora.”
verses.27: Abraão foti bibi no karau sira no foo ba Abimelek, no sira nain rua halo aliansa.
verses.28: No Abraão haketak bibi malae oan hitu hosi bibi sira seluk.
verses.29: Abimelek dehan ba Abraão, “Tanba saa mak ita haketak bibi malae oan hitu nee?”
verses.30: Abraão hataan, “Tanba ita atu simu bibi malae oan hitu nee hosi hau nia liman, hodi sira bele sai sasin katak hau mak kee ona bee posu nee.”
verses.31: Nunee Abraão bolu fatin nee Beer-Seba, tanba sira nain rua halo aliansa iha nebaa.
verses.32: Entaun sira halo aliansa iha Beer-Seba. Depois Abimelek hamriik, hamutuk ho Fikól nebee komandante forsa nian, no sira fila fali ba rai Filistia.
verses.33: Abraão kuda ai tamargeira ida iha Beer-Seba no iha nebaa nia bolu ba Nai, Maromak Rohan Laek, nia naran.
verses.34: No Abraão lao ba-mai too tempu kleur iha ema Filisteu nia rai.

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, Maromak koko Abraão no dehan ba nia, “Abraão!” No Abraão hataan, “Hau mak nee.”
verses.2: Maromak dehan, “Agora, lori o nia oan mane, o nia oan mane mesak Isak, nebee o hadomi, no lao ba rai Moriá. No oferese nia iha nebaa nudar sakrifísiu tunu motuk iha foho ida nebee Hau sei hatudu ba o.”
verses.3: Entaun Abraão hadeer sedu iha dadeer-saan, no tau sela ba ninia kuda buru no lori joven mane nain rua hodi lao hamutuk ho nia no ninia oan mane Isak. Nia tesi ai ba oferta nee no nia hamriik no baa fatin nebee Maromak dehan ona ba nia.
verses.4: Iha loron terseiru, Abraão foti matan no haree fatin nee hosi dook.
verses.5: Abraão dehan ba ninia joven mane sira nee, “Hein iha nee ho kuda buru. Hau ho labarik ida nee sei baa iha nebaa hodi adora no fila fali mai.”
verses.6: Abraão foti ai ba oferta tunu motuk no tau ba ninia oan mane Isak. Nia lori ahi no tudik iha ninia liman no sira nain rua lao hamutuk.
verses.7: Isak koalia ho ninia aman Abraão no dehan, “Apaa!” Abraão hataan, “Hau mak nee, hau nia oan.” Isak dehan, “Haree lai, ahi no ai sei iha. Maibee bibi hodi halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk nee iha nebee?”
verses.8: Abraão dehan, “Hau nia oan, Maromak rasik sei foo bibi nudar sakrifísiu tunu motuk.” No sira nain rua kontinua lao hamutuk.
verses.9: Bainhira sira too iha fatin nebee Maromak dehan nee, Abraão harii altár ida iha nebaa. Nia prepara ai no kesi nia oan mane Isak. Nia tau Isak iha altár nee iha ai nia leten.
verses.10: Abraão lolo ninia liman no foti ninia tudik atu oho ninia oan mane.
verses.11: Maibee Nai nia anju bolu ba nia hosi lalehan no dehan, “Abraão, Abraão!” Nia hataan, “Hau mak nee.”
verses.12: Anju dehan, “Keta book labarik nee no keta halo buat ida ba nia. Tanba agora Hau hatene ona katak o hamtauk Maromak no la tahan hosi Hau o nia oan mane, nebee o nia oan mane mesak.”
verses.13: Abraão foti nia matan no haree, no tebes, nia haree iha nia kotuk bibi malae aman ida. Bibi nee nia dikur kait hela iha ai sanak sira. Abraão baa no foti bibi malae aman nee no oferese nia nudar sakrifísiu tunu motuk troka ninia oan mane nia fatin.
verses.14: Abraão hanaran fatin nee ‘Nai Sei Foo,’ no sira dehan too ohin loron, ‘Iha Nai nia foho, Nia sei foo’.
verses.15: Nai nia anju bolu Abraão ba dala rua,
verses.16: no dehan, “Liu hosi Hau nia aan rasik Hau jura,” hatete Nai, “tanba o halo ona ida nee, no la tahan o nia oan mane, nebee o nia oan mane mesak,
verses.17: nunee Hau jura katak Hau sei haraik duni bensaun ba o, no Hau sei habarak duni o nia bei-oan sira hanesan fitun iha lalehan, no hanesan rai henek iha tasi ibun. No o nia bei-oan sira sei hadau sira nia inimigu sira nia portaun.
verses.18: Nasaun hotu iha mundu sei simu bensaun liu hosi o nia bei-oan, tanba o halo tuir Hau nia lian.”
verses.19: Entaun Abraão fila fali ba ninia joven mane sira. Depois sira hamriik no fila hamutuk ba Beer-Seba. No Abraão hela iha Beer-Seba.
verses.20: Liu tiha nee, ema foo hatene ba Abraão dehan, “Tebes, Milka tuur ahi hetan oan sira ba ita nia maun Naor:
verses.21: oan boot naran Uz, nia alin Buz no Kemuél nebee Aram nia aman,
verses.22: no mos Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaf no Betuél.”
verses.23: (Betuél hetan oan Rebeka.) Milka hetan oan ualu nee ba Naor, Abraão nia maun.
verses.24: No nia feen kiik, naran Reumá, nia mos hetan Teba, Gaham, Tahas no Maaka.

verses.1: Sara moris too tinan atus ida rua-nulu resin hitu ‘(127)’; nee mak tinan hotu iha Sara nia moris.
verses.2: Sara mate iha Kiriat-Arba, nebee Hebron, iha rai Kanaan. Abraão tama atu halerik tanba Sara no atu tanis tanba nia.
verses.3: Abraão hamriik iha mate isin nia oin no koalia ba Hiti nia oan mane sira, no nia dehan,
verses.4: “Hau mak estranjeiru no ema nebee lao rai iha imi nia leet. Foo mai hau fatin ida iha rai nee hodi hau bele hakoi hau nia ema mate hodi hau la haree tan nia.”
verses.5: Ema Hiti sira hataan no dehan ba Abraão,
verses.6: “Rona lai, ami nia senhor, ita boot mak xefi boot iha ami nia leet. Ita boot bele hakoi ita boot nia feen nia mate isin iha ami nia rate fatin nebee diak liu. Ami la tahan fatin ida hosi ita boot hodi ita boot bele hakoi ita boot nia feen nia mate isin.”
verses.7: Abraão hamriik no hakruuk ba povu iha rai nebaa, ba ema Hiti sira.
verses.8: No nia koalia tan ho sira, “Se karik imi hanoin katak hau bele hakoi mate isin nee hodi hau la haree tan nia, nunee rona tuir hau lai no husu ba Efron, oan mane hosi Zoar.
verses.9: Husu nia atu foo mai hau fatuk kuak iha Makpela, iha rai nebee ninian. Rai nee mak iha ninia toos nia ninin. Husik nia bele faan mai hau tuir rai nee nia folin kompletu ho osan mutin hodi sai hau nia fatin hodi hau iha rate ida iha imi nia leet.”
verses.10: Efron hamriik hela iha ema Hiti sira nia leet. No Efron, ema Hiti nee, hataan ba Abraão iha ema Hiti sira nia prezensa, iha ema hotu nia oin nebee iha sidade nee nia portaun, no nia dehan,
verses.11: “Lae, hau nia senhor, rona hau lai. Rai nee hau foo deit ba ita boot hamutuk ho fatuk kuak iha nebaa. Buat nee hau foo deit. Iha hau nia povu nia prezensa hau foo deit. Hakoi ita boot nia ema mate nee.”
verses.12: Abraão hakruuk iha povu nia oin iha rai nee.
verses.13: Depois nia koalia ho Efron iha povu hosi rai nee nia oin, no nia dehan, “Maibee se ita hakarak rona mai hau: hau sei selu rai nee nia folin. Simu hosi hau, nunee hau bele hakoi hau nia ema mate iha nebaa.”
verses.14: Efron hataan ba Abraão no dehan ba nia,
verses.15: “Hau nia senhor, rona hau lai, rai nee nia folin mak osan mutin pedasuk atus haat, maibee saida mak nee entre hau ho ita boot? Hakoi ita boot nia ema mate nee.”
verses.16: Abraão rona tuir Efron no nia tetu osan mutin nee ba Efron, nebee Efron hatete iha ema Hiti sira nia prezensa. Osan mutin pedasuk atus haat, tuir sasukat nebee negosiante sira uza.
verses.17: No Efron nia rai ida nee, nebee iha Makpela, iha Mamre nia oin, no fatuk kuak iha rai nee nia laran, no ai hotu iha rai nee, iha balixa nia laran nee sai
verses.18: Abraão nian iha ema Hiti nia oin, iha ema hotu nia oin nebee tama iha portaun sidade nian.
verses.19: Liu tiha nee, Abraão hakoi nia feen Sara iha fatuk kuak iha rai iha Makpela, iha Mamre nia oin. Fatin nee mak Hebron iha rai Kanaan.
verses.20: Entaun rai nee ho rai nia fatuk kuak sai Abraão nian hosi ema Hiti sira hodi nia iha rate ida.

verses.1: Bainhira Abraão katuas ona no idade boot, no Nai haraik bensaun ona ba Abraão liu hosi buat hotu,
verses.2: Abraão dehan ba ninia atan primeiru iha nia uma kain, nebee toma-konta ba ninia sasaan hotu, “Favór ida, tau o nia liman iha hau nia ain kelen okos,
verses.3: no hau sei halo o jura liu hosi Nai, Maromak iha lalehan, no Maromak iha mundu, katak o sei la foti feen ida ba hau nia oan mane hosi ema Kanaan nia oan feto sira, iha fatin nebee hau hela nee.
verses.4: Maibee o sei baa hau nia rai, no baa hau nia família, no foti feen ida ba hau nia oan mane Isak.”
verses.5: Maibee atan nee dehan ba nia, “Se karik feto nee lakohi tuir hau too iha fatin nee, nunee hau tenki lori ita boot nia oan mane ba ita boot nia rai iha nebaa ka?”
verses.6: Abraão hataan ba nia, “Kuidadu katak o la lori hau nia oan mane baa nebaa.
verses.7: Nai Maromak iha lalehan, nebee foti hau hosi hau nia aman nia uma kain, no hosi hau nia família nia rai, no koalia ba hau, no jura ba hau dehan, ‘Hau sei foo rai nee ba o nia bei-oan’, Nia mak haruka anju uluk o, no o sei hetan feen ida ba hau nia oan mane hosi fatin nebaa.
verses.8: Se karik feto nee lakohi tuir o, nunee o sei livre hosi juramentu nee, só deit keta lori hau nia oan baa nebaa.”
verses.9: Entaun atan nee tau nia liman iha nia patraun Abraão nia ain kelen okos no jura ba nia kona ba buat nee.
verses.10: Depois atan nee foti kuda kamelu sanulu hosi ninia patraun nia kuda kamelu sira no nia sai. Nia lori sasaan oi-oin hosi ninia patraun. Nia hamriik no nia baa too iha Mezopotámia, ba sidade Naor.
verses.11: No nia halo nia kuda kamelu sira tuur iha sidade liur besik iha bee posu ida iha tempu rai nakaras, iha tempu nebee feto sira sai mai hodi kuru bee.
verses.12: No nia dehan, “Oh Nai, hau nia patraun Abraão nia Maromak, favór ida, foo susesu mai hau ohin loron, no hatudu domin metin ba hau nia patraun Abraão.
verses.13: Tebes, hau hamriik dadaun iha bee posu nia sorin no ema sidade nia oan feto sira sai mai hodi kuru bee.
verses.14: Husik buat nee bele akontese, katak feto ida nebee hau dehan, ‘Favór ida, hatuun o nia sanan rai, hodi hau bele hemu,’ no nia hataan, ‘Hemu ba, no hau sei foo hemu mos ba ita boot nia kuda kamelu sira,’ katak feto nee mak ida nebee O hili ba O nia atan Isak. Liu hosi sinál nee hau bele hatene katak O mak hatudu tiha domin metin ba hau nia patraun.”
verses.15: Molok nia koalia hotu ona, tebes, Rebeka sai mai, nebee moris hosi Betuel, oan mane hosi Milka, feen hosi Naor, Abraão nia maun. Rebeka mai ho nia sanan rai iha nia kabaas leten.
verses.16: No feto nee oin bonita loos no nia sei virjen hela. Mane ida seidauk toba ho nia. Nia tuun ba bee matan no enxe nakonu ninia sanan rai no sae mai.
verses.17: No atan nee halai hodi hasoru nia no dehan, “Favór ida, foo bee uitoan hosi o nia sanan rai hodi hau bele hemu.”
verses.18: No nia hataan, “Hemu ba, hau nia senhor.” No nia hatuun lalais ninia sanan rai iha nia liman no foo ba nia hemu.
verses.19: Bainhira Rebeka foo ona ba nia hodi hemu, Rebeka dehan, “Hau sei kuru mos bee ba ita boot nia kuda kamelu sira, too sira hemu hotu.”
verses.20: Rebeka baa lalais no fui bee hosi ninia sanan rai ba animál nia hemu fatin, no nia halai fali ba bee matan hodi kuru bee. Nunee nia kuru bee ba mane nee nia kuda kamelu hotu.
verses.21: Mane nee hakfodak tanba feto nee. Maibee nia nonook hela hodi haree oinsaa Nai foo susesu ba ninia viajen ka lae.
