verses.22: Tuir mai, bainhira kuda kamelu sira hemu too hotu, mane nee foti brinkus inus nian ida hosi osan mean pedasuk sorin, no kelu osan mean rua ba nia liman ho todan hanesan osan mean pedasuk sanulu.
verses.23: Nia dehan, “O mak oan feto hosi see? Favór ida, foo hatene mai hau. O nia aman iha fatin hodi ami bele toba kalan nee ka?”
verses.24: Feto nee hataan ba nia, “Hau mak oan feto hosi Betuel, oan mane hosi Milka, nebee laen mak Naor.”
verses.25: No feto nee dehan tan ba nia, “Ami iha duut no ai haan natoon ba animál sira, no kuartu hodi toba.”
verses.26: Mane nee hakruuk ho oin ba rai no adora ba Nai.
verses.27: Nia dehan, “Adora ba Nai, hau nia patraun Abraão nia Maromak, nebee la husik Ninia domin metin no fidelidade ba hau nia patraun. Hau lao iha dalan no Nai lori hau ba hau nia patraun nia maun nia uma.”
verses.28: Depois feto raan nee halai no foo hatene ba ninia inan nia uma kain kona ba buat hotu nee.
verses.29: Rebeka iha maun ida naran Labão, no Labão halai ba mane nebee sei iha bee posu.
verses.30: Bainhira nia haree brinkus no kelu sira iha ninia alin feto nia liman, no bainhira nia rona ninia alin feto Rebeka nia liafuan, nebee dehan, “Mane nee koalia hanesan nee mai hau,” nunee nia baa hasoru mane ida nee, no tebes mane nee sei hamriik ho nia kuda kamelu sira iha bee posu.
verses.31: Labão dehan, “Tama mai, ida nebee simu bensaun hosi Nai, nusaa mak ita boot hamriik iha liur? Tanba hau prepara tiha uma no fatin ba kuda kamelu sira.
verses.32: Mane nee tama uma, no kore ninia kuda kamelu sira, no foo ba kuda kamelu sira duut no ai haan. Nia hetan bee hodi fasi nia ain no ba ema sira nebee hamutuk ho nia hodi sira bele fasi sira nia ain.
verses.33: Depois ema tau hahaan iha mane nee nia oin hodi nia bele haan. Maibee nia dehan, “Hau lakohi haan too hau hatoo hau nia mensajen.” Labão dehan, “Koalia ba.”
verses.34: No nia dehan, “Hau mak Abraão nia atan.
verses.35: Nai mak haraik bensaun boot ba hau nia patraun, no nia sai ema boot. Nai foo ba nia bibi lubun sira, karau lubun sira, osan mutin, osan mean, atan mane sira, atan feto sira, kuda kamelu no kuda buru sira.
verses.36: Sara, hau nia patraun nia feen, tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida ba hau nia patraun bainhira feto nee ferik ona. No hau nia patraun foo buat hotu ba oan mane ida nee.
verses.37: Hau nia patraun obriga hau jura no nia dehan, ‘Keta foti feen ida ba hau nia oan mane hosi ema Kanaan nia oan feto sira, iha rai nebee hau hela nee.
verses.38: Maibee o tenki baa hau nia aman nia uma kain, no baa hau nia família, no foti feen ida ba hau nia oan mane hosi nebaa.’
verses.39: Hau dehan ba hau nia patraun, ‘Se karik feto nee lakohi tuir hau.’
verses.40: No nia hataan, ‘Hau lao iha Nai nia oin. Nia sei haruka Ninia anju baa hamutuk ho o no foo susesu iha o nia dalan. O sei foti feen ida ba hau nia oan mane hosi hau nia família no hosi hau nia aman nia uma kain.
verses.41: Depois o sei livre hosi hau nia juramentu nee, bainhira o baa too hau nia família. Se karik sira la foo feto ida, o sei sai livre hosi hau nia juramentu.’
verses.42: Tuir mai, iha ohin loron nee, hau mai too bee posu nee no dehan, ‘Oh Nai, hau nia patraun Abraão nia Maromak, se karik O bele foo susesu agora ba hau nia dalan,
verses.43: tanba tebes, hau hamriik hela besik bee posu nee. Bainhira feto raan ida mai hodi kuru bee no hau dehan ba nia, “Favór ida, foo mai hau bee hemu uitoan hosi o nia sanan rai,”
verses.44: no nia hataan, “Ita boot hemu ba, no hau sei kuru bee ba ita boot nia kuda kamelu sira,” nunee husik feto ida nee sai ida nebee Nai mak hili ba hau nia patraun nia oan mane.’
verses.45: No molok hau koalia hotu ona iha hau nia fuan laran, tebes, Rebeka sai mai ho ninia sanan rai iha nia kabaas leten. Nia tuun ba bee posu hodi kuru bee no hau dehan ba nia, ‘Favór ida, husik hau bele hemu,’
verses.46: no nia hatuun ninia sanan rai lalais no dehan, ‘Hemu ba, no hau sei foo hemu mos ba ita boot nia kuda kamelu sira.’ Nunee hau hemu, no nia foo hodi kuda kamelu mos bele hemu.
verses.47: Hau husu nia, ‘O mak oan feto hosi see?’ no nia dehan, ‘Oan feto hosi Betuel, oan mane hosi Naor, nebee moris hosi Milka.’ Depois hau tau brinkus ba nia inus no kelu iha nia liman.
verses.48: Hau hakruuk ho oin too rai no hahii Nai, no adora Nai, hau nia patraun nia Maromak, nebee lori hau iha dalan loos ba hau nia patraun nia maun nia oan feto no nia oan mane.
verses.49: Agora, se karik ita bele halao domin metin no fidelidade ho hau nia patraun entaun foo hatene mai hau, maibee se lae, foo hatene mai hau, hodi nunee hau bele fila ba sorin loos ka sorin karuk.”
verses.50: Labão no Betuel hataan, “Buat nebee mai hosi Nai nee, ami la bele koalia katak buat nee diak ka la diak.
verses.51: Tebes, Rebeka mak iha ita nia oin, foti nia no baa, no husik nia sai ita nia patraun nia oan mane nia feen, tuir buat nebee Nai koalia ona.”
verses.52: Bainhira Abraão nia atan rona sira nia liafuan, nia hakneak kedas ba Nai ho oin ba rai.
verses.53: Atan nee lori mai sasaan osan mutin nebee furak, no sasaan osan mean nebee furak, no ropa sira no foo ba Rebeka. No nia foo mos ba Rebeka nia maun no buat furak sira ba Rebeka nia inan.
verses.54: Sira haan no hemu, atan nee no mane sira nebee hamutuk ho nia, no sira toba kalan tomak. Depois sira hadeer iha dadeer, no atan nee dehan, “Haruka hau fila ba hau nia patraun.”
verses.55: Rebeka nia maun no nia inan dehan, “Husik feto nee hela ho ami loron balu, too loron sanulu ba leten, depois nia bele baa.”
verses.56: Maibee nia dehan ba sira, “Keta halo demora hau. Tanba Nai foo susesu tiha ona ba hau nia dalan. Haruka hau sai hodi hau bele baa hau nia patraun.”
verses.57: Sira dehan, “Ami sei bolu feto raan nee, no husu nia hanoin nusaa.”
verses.58: Entaun sira bolu Rebeka no dehan ba nia, “O bele baa ho mane ida nee ka lae?” Nia hataan, “Hau bele baa.”
verses.59: No sira haruka Rebeka sira nia alin feto, no feto nebee hakiak nia, no Abraão nia atan no ninia mane sira.
verses.60: Sira foo bensaun ba Rebeka no dehan ba nia,
verses.61: Rebeka hamriik, hamutuk ho ninia atan feto sira, no sira sae kuda kamelu sira no tuir mane nee. No atan mane nee lori Rebeka no nia lao baa.
verses.62: Isak fila mai hosi dalan ba Beer-Lahai-Roi, tanba nia hela iha rai Negeb.
verses.63: Isak lao sai ba rai luan hodi medita iha tempu rai nakaras. Nia foti matan no haree, no tebes nia haree kuda kamelu sira mai.
verses.64: Rebeka foti matan no bainhira nia haree Isak nia hatuun hosi kuda kamelu.
verses.65: Tanba nia dehan ona ba atan mane nee, “See mak mane iha nebaa nebee lao iha rai luan nee hodi hasoru ita?” No atan mane nee dehan, “Ida nee mak hau nia patraun.” Nunee nia foti veo ida no taka ninia oin.
verses.66: Atan mane nee foo hatene ba Isak buat hotu nebee nia halo.
verses.67: No Isak lori Rebeka ba ninia inan Sara nia tenda, no Isak kaben ho feto nee. Isak hadomi Rebeka, no nia hetan laran kamaan tanba ninia inan nebee mate ona.

25.title: Abraão Mate No Nia Bei-Oan Sira

verses.1: Abraão foti feto ida tan naran Ketura.
verses.2: Ketura hetan oan Zimran, Joksan, Medan, Midian, Isbak no Suá.
verses.3: Joksan hetan Saba no Dedan. Dedan nia oan mane sira mak Asurim, Letusim no Leumim.
verses.4: Midian nia oan mane sira mak Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida no Elda. Ema hotu nee mak Ketura nia bei-oan sira.
verses.5: Abraão foo buat hotu nebee ninian ba Isak.
verses.6: Maibee ba feen kiik nia oan mane sira, nebee Abraão nian nee, Abraão foo prezenti no haruka sira sai hosi nia oan mane Isak bainhira Abraão sei moris hela. No sira baa diresaun lorosae nian, too iha rai iha parte lorosae.
verses.7: Abraão moris too tinan atus ida hitu-nulu resin lima (175).
verses.8: Abraão iis kotu, no nia mate ho idade diak, ema katuas no nakonu ho tinan sira, nunee nia halibur ba ninia bei-ala sira.
verses.9: Nia oan mane Isak no Ismael hakoi nia iha rai kuak iha Makpela. Nee mak rai hosi Efron, oan mane hosi Zoar, ema Hiti, nebee iha Mamre nia oin.
verses.10: Rai nee mak rai nebee Abraão sosa hosi ema Hiti sira. No sira hakoi Abraão iha nebaa hamutuk ho nia feen Sara.
verses.11: Tuir mai, bainhira Abraão mate ona, Maromak haraik bensaun ba Abraão nia oan mane Isak, no Isak hela besik Beer-Lahai-Roi.
verses.12: Jerasaun sira mai hosi Ismael, Abraão nia oan mane nebee Hagar hetan ba Abraão. Feto nee mak ema Ejitu nebee Sara nia atan feto.
verses.13: Ismael nia oan mane sira nia naran sira, tuir sira nia jerasaun sira, mak nee: Ismael nia oan boot mak Nebaiote, depois Kedar, Abdeel, Mibsam,
verses.14: Misma, Duma, Masá,
verses.15: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Nafis no Kedema.
verses.16: Mane sira nee mak Ismael nia oan sira, tuir sira nia naran, aldeia no fatin ho moru; liurai nain sanulu resin rua ba sira nia povu.
verses.17: Ismael moris too tinan atus ida tolu-nulu resin hitu, no nia iis kotu, nia mate no nia halibur hamutuk ho nia bei-ala sira.
verses.18: Sira hela iha rai hosi Havila too iha Sur nebee iha Ejitu nia oin, iha dalan ba Asur. No Ismael hasoru nia maun-alin sira hotu.
verses.19: Ida nee mak Abraão nia oan mane Isak nia jerasaun sira. Abraão hetan Isak.
verses.20: Isak tinan haat-nulu bainhira nia kaben ho Rebeka. Rebeka mak oan feto hosi Betuel, nebee ema Aram hosi Padan-Aram. Nia mak Labão, ema Aram, nia alin feto.
verses.21: Isak halo orasaun ba Nai tanba ninia feen la iha oan. Nai simu nia orasaun no ninia feen Rebeka sai isin rua.
verses.22: Oan rua dudu malu iha Rebeka nia laran. Rebeka dehan, “Se karik hanesan nee, tanba saa mak hau hetan ida nee?” No nia baa halo orasaun ba Nai.
verses.23: Nai dehan ba nia,
verses.24: Bainhira nia loron tuur ahi too ona, tebes, iha oan kaduak iha ninia kabun laran.
verses.25: Ida primeiru sai ho isin kór mean no fulun taka nia isin tomak hanesan ropa fulun nian, no sira hanaran nia Esau.
verses.26: Tuir mai, nia alin sai, no nia liman kaer hela ba Esau nia ain tuban no sira hanaran nia Jacó. Isak tinan neen-nulu bainhira Rebeka hetan sira.
verses.27: Bainhira oan rua sira nee boot ona, Esau sai kasadór matenek no mane ida nebee iha rai luan, no Jacó sai ema hakmatek no hela iha tenda nia laran.
verses.28: Isak hadomi Esau tanba nia gosta haan ninia naan, maibee Rebeka hadomi Jacó.
verses.29: Iha loron ida, Jacó daan hela sasoru no Esau tama mai hosi rai luan ho isin fraku.
verses.30: No Esau dehan ba Jacó, “Favór ida, foo sasoru mean nee mai hau, tanba hau fraku!” Nunee nia naran mos Edom.
verses.31: Jacó hataan, “Faan uluk lai ita nia direitu nudar oan boot mai hau.”
verses.32: Esau dehan, “Tebes, hau besik atu mate, nunee direitu nudar oan boot nee iha benefísiu saida mai hau?”
verses.33: Jacó dehan, “Jura uluk lai mai hau.” No Esau jura ba nia no nia faan ninia direitu nudar oan boot ba Jacó.
verses.34: Depois Jacó foo ba Esau paun no sasoru ho koto mean. Esau haan hemu no nia hamriik no baa. Nunee Esau despreza tiha ninia direitu nudar oan boot.

verses.1: Rai nee hetan tempu rai hamlaha nebee ketak hosi rai hamlaha primeiru iha tempu Abraão nian. Isak baa Abimelek, ema Filisteu nia liurai, nebee iha Gerar.
verses.2: Nai mosu mai Isak no Nia dehan, “Keta tuun ba Ejitu. Hela iha rai nebee Hau hatudu ba o.
verses.3: Lao ba-mai iha rai nee, no Hau sei hamutuk ho o, no Hau sei haraik bensaun ba o. Tanba Hau sei foo rai hotu nee ba o, no ba o nia bei-oan sira. Hau sei kumpri juramentu nebee Hau jura ona ba o nia aman Abraão.
verses.4: Hau sei habarak o nia bei-oan sira hanesan fitun sira iha lalehan. Hau sei foo rai hotu nee ba o nia bei-oan sira. No liu hosi o nia bei-oan sira nasaun hotu iha mundu sei hetan bensaun.
verses.5: Tanba Abraão halo tuir Hau nia lian, no nia halo tuir Hau nia hakarak, Hau nia ukun fuan sira, Hau nia estatutu sira no Hau nia lei sira.”
verses.6: Entaun Isak hela iha Gerar.
verses.7: Bainhira ema iha fatin nebaa husu kona ba ninia feen, nia dehan, “Nia mak hau nia alin feto.” Nia tauk atu dehan, “Nia mak hau nia feen,” tanba karik mane sira iha fatin nebaa oho nia tanba Rebeka, tanba Rebeka oin bonita.
verses.8: Tuir mai, bainhira nia hela kleur ona iha nebaa, Abimelek, liurai hosi ema Filisteu sira, hateke hosi nia janela no haree, no tebes, Isak halimar ho nia feen Rebeka.
verses.9: Abimelek bolu Isak no dehan, “Tebes duni, feto nee mak o nia feen. Nusaa mak o dehan, ‘Nia mak hau nia alin feto’?” No Isak hataan ba nia, “Tanba hau hanoin, ‘Karik hau mate tanba nia.’”
verses.10: Abimelek dehan, “O halo saida mai ami? Karik ema ida toba ho o nia feen, nunee o lori sala boot mai ami.”
verses.11: Abimelek foo orden ba nia povu tomak no dehan, “Nia nebee book mane ida nee ka ninia feen sei mate duni.”
verses.12: Isak kuda toos iha rai nebaa no iha tinan hanesan nia simu rezultadu dala atus ida. No Nai haraik bensaun ba nia.
verses.13: Mane nee sai riku tan, no nia lao ba oin too nia sai ema riku liu.
verses.14: Tanba nia iha bibi, karau no atan barak. No ema Filisteu sira laran moras ba nia.
verses.15: (Ema Filisteu sira taka bee posu hotu nebee Isak nia aman nia atan sira mak kee iha tempu Abraão nian. Ema Filisteu sira halo bee posu sira nee nakonu ho rai.)
verses.16: Abimelek dehan ba Isak, “Sai hosi ami, tanba ita mak riku liu ami.”
verses.17: Nunee Isak sai hosi fatin nee, no nia harii ninia tenda iha rai tetuk Gerar no hela iha nebaa.
verses.18: Isak kee fali bee posu nebee sira kee iha nia aman Abraão nia tempu. Tanba ema Filisteu sira taka tiha bee posu sira nee bainhira Abraão mate ona. No Isak hanaran bee posu sira nee tuir naran nebee uluk ninia aman hanaran ona nee.
verses.19: Isak nia atan sira kee rai iha rai tetuk no sira hetan bee matan ho bee nebee suli sai.
verses.20: Bibi atan sira hosi Gerar istori malu ho Isak nia bibi atan sira no dehan, “Bee nee mak ami nian.” No nia hanaran bee posu nee Esek, tanba sira haksesuk malu ho nia.
verses.21: Sira kee rai halo bee posu ida tan no sira istori malu mos kona ba bee posu nee. No nia hanaran bee posu nee Sitna.
verses.22: Isak sai hosi fatin nee no nia kee bee posu ida fali no sira la istori malu ho nia. Entaun nia hanaran bee posu nee Reobote, tanba nia dehan, “Agora, Nai halo ona fatin luan mai ami, no ami sei sai buras iha rai nee.”
verses.23: Isak sai hosi fatin nee no baa Beer-Seba.
verses.24: Nai mosu ba nia iha kalan nee no dehan, “Hau mak o nia aman Abraão nia Maromak. Keta tauk, tanba Hau hamutuk ho o, no Hau sei haraik bensaun ba o, no habarak o nia bei-oan sira tanba Hau nia atan Abraão.”
verses.25: No Isak harii altár ida iha nebaa no bolu ba Nai nia naran. Nia tau nia tenda iha nebaa no ninia atan sira kee bee posu iha nebaa.
verses.26: Depois Abimelek sai hosi Gerar ho nia maluk Ahuzate no Fikól, komandante ba ninia forsa, no sira baa too Isak.
verses.27: Isak dehan ba sira, “Nusaa mak imi mai hasoru hau? Tanba imi odi hau no haruka ona hau sai hosi imi.”
verses.28: Sira hataan, “Ami haree duni katak Nai sei hamutuk ho ita. No ami dehan, mai ita halo akordu ida entre ita ho ami, no husik ami halo aliansa ida ho ita,
verses.29: hodi ita la halo aat mai ami hanesan ami la book ita. Tanba ami la halo buat ida nebee aat ba ita só ami halo diak deit, no haruka ita sai ho dame. Ita mak ema nebee simu bensaun hosi Nai.”
verses.30: Depois Isak halo festa ida ba sira no sira haan hemu.
verses.31: Aban dadeer-saan sira hadeer no jura ba malu no Isak haruka sira sai no sira sai hosi nia ho dame.
verses.32: Tuir mai, iha loron hanesan nee, Isak nia atan sira mai no foo hatene ba nia kona ba bee posu nebee sira kee, no sira dehan “Ami hetan ona bee.”
verses.33: Isak hanaran bee posu nee Seba, nunee sidade nebee iha nebaa mak hetan naran Beer-Seba too ohin loron.
verses.34: Bainhira Esau tinan haat-nulu nia kaben ho Judit, nebee oan feto hosi Beeri, ema Hiti, no mos ho Basemat, oan feto hosi Elon, ema Hiti.
verses.35: Sira halo moris susar ba Isak no Rebeka.

verses.1: Bainhira Isak katuas ona, no nia matan malahuk liu ona too nia la bele haree, nia bolu nia oan mane boot Esau, no dehan ba nia, “Hau nia oan mane.” Esau hataan, “Tebes, hau mak nee.”
verses.2: Isak dehan, “Agora, hau katuas ona no hau la hatene loron ida nebee mak hau mate.
verses.3: Entaun, favór ida, foti o nia rama oan sira no o nia rama, no baa rai luan. Kasa animál fuik ida ba hau.
verses.4: No prepara hahaan gostu, nebee hau gosta haan, no lori mai hau. Nunee hau bele haan no hau nia klamar bele foo bensaun ba o molok hau mate.”
verses.5: Rebeka rona bainhira Isak koalia ho nia oan mane Esau. No Esau baa rai luan atu kasa animál fuik hodi lori mai.
verses.6: Entaun Rebeka koalia ho nia oan mane Jacó dehan, “Tebes, hau rona o nia aman koalia ho o nia maun Esau, no nia dehan,
verses.7: ‘Lori mai hau animál fuik no prepara hahaan gostu. Nunee hau bele haan no foo bensaun ba o iha Nai nia oin molok hau mate.’
verses.8: Entaun, hau nia oan mane, halo tuir hau nia liafuan nebee hau manda ba o.
verses.9: Favór ida, baa foti bibi oan rua nebee diak hosi bibi lubun no hau sei prepara hahaan gostu ba o nia aman nebee nia gosta.
verses.10: No o sei lori hahaan nee ba o nia aman, hodi nia bele haan no nia bele foo bensaun ba o molok nia mate.”
verses.11: Jacó hataan ba nia inan Rebeka, “Tebes, hau nia maun Esau mak ema nebee isin fulun no hau mak ema nebee isin kabeer.
verses.12: Se karik hau nia aman kona hau, nunee nia sei hanoin katak hau bosok. Depois hau sei hetan malisan, laos bensaun.”
verses.13: Ninia inan dehan ba nia, “Hau nia oan, husik o nia malisan kona fali hau, maibee o halo tuir hau nia liafuan, no baa foti buat sira nee.”
verses.14: Entaun Jacó baa no foti bibi no lori sira ba ninia inan. Ninia inan prepara hahaan gostu nebee ninia aman gosta.
verses.15: Rebeka foti ninia oan boot Esau nia ropa diak nebee iha nia uma laran, no foo hatais ba ninia oan ikun Jacó.
verses.16: No nia tau bibi oan sira nia kulit iha Jacó nia liman no iha nia kakorok.
verses.17: Nia foo ba nia oan Jacó nia liman hahaan gostu nee no paun nebee nia prepara ona.
verses.18: Jacó baa ninia aman no dehan, “Hau nia apaa.” Isak hataan, “Hau mak nee. Hau nia oan, o mak see?”
verses.19: Jacó dehan ba ninia aman, “Hau mak Esau, ita nia oan boot. Hau halo tiha tuir buat nebee ita haruka hau halo. Favór ida, tuur ba no haan hau nia naan animál fuik nian. Nunee ita nia klamar bele foo bensaun mai hau.”
verses.20: Isak dehan ba ninia oan mane, “Hau nia oan, oinsaa mak o bele hetan naan lalais nee?” Nia hataan, “Tanba Nai, ita nia Maromak, lori buat nee mai hau.”
verses.21: Isak dehan ba Jacó, “Favór ida, habesik hau hodi hau bele kaer o, hau nia oan, no hau bele hatene duni katak o mak hau nia oan Esau ka lae.”
verses.22: Jacó hakbesik ba ninia aman Isak, no Isak lamas nia no dehan, “Lian nee mak Jacó nia lian, maibee liman nee mak Esau nia liman.”
verses.23: No nia la hatene loos tanba Jacó iha liman fulun hanesan ninia maun nia liman. Entaun Isak foo bensaun ba nia.
verses.24: Isak dehan, “O mak hau nia oan Esau duni ka lae?” Jacó hataan, “Hau mak nee duni.”
verses.25: No Isak dehan, “Lori hahaan mai hau no hau bele haan naan animál fuik nian hosi hau nia oan hodi hau nia klamar bele foo bensaun ba o.” No nia lori hahaan nee ba Isak no Isak haan. Jacó foo tua no nia hemu. Jacó lohi ninia aman hodi hetan bensaun.
verses.26: Ninia aman Isak dehan ba nia, “Agora, hau nia oan, hakbesik no rei hau.”
verses.27: Jacó hakbesik no rei ninia aman, no Isak horon hosi nia ropa, no Isak foo bensaun ba nia no dehan,
verses.28: Entaun, Maromak foo ba o mahobeen hosi lalehan,
verses.29: Husik povu bele serví ba o
verses.30: Bainhira Isak foin foo bensaun ba Jacó, no Jacó foin sai hosi ninia aman Isak nia oin, nia maun Esau tama mai hosi kasa.
verses.31: Esau halo mos hahaan gostu no lori ba ninia aman no nia dehan ba ninia aman, “Hadeer ba, apaa, no haan naan animál fuik nian hosi apaa nian oan mane, hodi ita nia klamar bele foo bensaun mai hau.”
verses.32: Isak nia aman dehan ba nia, “See mak o?” No nia hataan, “Hau mak Esau, o nia oan boot.”
verses.33: Isak nakdedar makaas, no dehan, “Entaun see mak lori ona mai hau naan animál fuik nian? Hau haan hotu tiha ona molok o mai, no hau foo ona bensaun ba nia no nia sei hetan duni bensaun.”
verses.34: Rona tiha ninia aman nia liafuan nee, Esau hakilar makaas no tanis ho laran susar loos. Nia dehan ba ninia aman, “Foo bensaun mai hau, mai hau mos, Oh hau nia apaa!”
verses.35: Isak hataan, “O nia alin mai bosok tiha hau no nia hadau ona o nia bensaun.”
verses.36: Esau hataan, “Laos nia iha naran loos nebee ‘Jacó’? Tanba nia hamatak tiha hau dala rua ona. Nia hadau ona hau nia direitu oan boot nian, no tebes, agora nia hadau hau nia bensaun.” No Esau husu tan, “Ita sei iha bensaun ida mai hau?”
verses.37: Isak hataan no dehan ba Esau, “Tebes, hau halo Jacó sai o nia nai. Hau foo ona ninia maun-alin hotu hodi sai ninia atan sira. Hau sustenta nia ho batar no tua uvas. Nunee, hau nia oan, hau bele halo saida ba o?”
verses.38: Esau dehan ba ninia aman, “Ita iha hela bensaun ida deit, hau nia apaa? Foo bensaun mai hau, mai hau mos, Oh hau nia apaa!” No Esau foti nia lian no tanis.
verses.39: Ninia aman Isak hataan no dehan ba nia:
verses.40: O sei moris liu hosi surik,
verses.41: Esau odi Jacó tanba nia hetan bensaun hosi ninia aman. Esau dehan iha nia fuan laran, “Tempu tanis lelir ba hau nia apaa besik mai ona. Depois hau sei oho hau nia alin Jacó.”
verses.42: No ema foo hatene ba Rebeka kona ba Esau nia liafuan nee. Entaun Rebeka bolu nia oan ikun Jacó no dehan ba nia, “Tebes, o nia maun Esau hamaus aan tanba nia halo ona planu atu oho o.
verses.43: Nunee, hau nia oan, halo tuir hau nia liafuan. Hamriik ba, no halai ba hau nia maun Labão nebee iha Haran.
verses.44: Hein iha nebaa loron balu too o nia maun nia laran manas tuun ona.
verses.45: Bainhira o nia maun nia laran manas tuun hosi o, no nia haluha ona buat nebee o halo tiha ona ba nia, nunee hau sei haruka mensajen no lori o mai fali. Tanba saa mak hau tenki lakon imi nain rua iha loron ida deit?”
verses.46: Rebeka dehan ba Isak, “Hau lakohi ona hau nia moris tanba oan feto sira hosi Hiti. Se karik Jacó hetan feen ida hosi Hiti nia oan feto sira, nebee oan feto hosi rai nee, nunee hau nia moris iha folin saida mai hau?”

verses.1: Entaun Isak bolu Jacó no foo bensaun ba nia. Isak foo orden ba nia dehan, “Keta foti feen ida hosi feto Kanaan sira.
verses.2: Hamriik no baa Padan-Aram, ba o nia inan nia aman Betuel nia uma. Foti feen ida hosi nebaa, hosi Labão nia oan feto sira, nebee o nia inan nia maun.
verses.3: Maromak Kbiit Makaas sei foo bensaun ba o, no habarak o, hodi o sai povu boot.
verses.4: Husik Nia foo bensaun Abraão nian ba o, no ba o nia bei-oan sira nebee hamutuk ho o, hodi o bele simu rai nebee o lao dadaun nee nudar estranjeiru, nebee Maromak foo ba Abraão.”
verses.5: No Isak haruka Jacó sai ba. Jacó baa Padan-Aram, ba Labão, nebee oan mane hosi Betuel, ema Aram. Labão mak Rebeka nia maun. Rebeka nee mak Jacó no Esau nia inan.
verses.6: Esau haree katak Isak foo ona bensaun ba Jacó no haruka nia sai ba Padan-Aram hodi hetan feen hosi nebaa. No nia haree katak bainhira Isak foo bensaun ba Jacó, Isak foo mos orden ba Jacó katak, “Keta foti feen ida hosi feto Kanaan sira.”
verses.7: No Esau haree katak Jacó halo tuir ninia inan-aman nia hakarak no nia ba Padan-Aram.
verses.8: No Esau haree katak nia aman Isak la kontenti ho nia feen sira hosi ema Kanaan.
verses.9: Nunee Esau ba Ismael no foti feto ida sai nia feen. Mezmu nia iha feen sira ona, nia kaben ho Mahalat, oan feto hosi Ismael, Abraão nia oan mane. Mahalat mak Nebayot nia alin feto.
verses.10: Jacó sai hosi Beer-Seba no lao ba Haran.
verses.11: Bainhira nia too iha fatin ida, nia toba kalan tomak iha nebaa tanba loro matan monu ona. Nia foti fatuk ida iha fatin nebaa no uza atu tau ninia ulun. Depois nia toba dukur.
verses.12: Nia mehi, no tebes, nia haree eskada ida sae hosi rai no eskada tutun sae too lalehan. No tebes, Maromak nia anju sira tuun-sae iha eskada nee.
verses.13: Tebes, Nai hamriik iha eskada leten no dehan, “Hau mak Nai, o nia avoo Abraão nia Maromak no o nia aman Isak nia Maromak. Hau sei foo rai nebee o toba dadaun nee ba o no ba o nia bei-oan sira.
verses.14: O nia bei-oan sira sei sai barak hanesan rai rahun iha mundu. No o sei namkari ba parte loromonu no lorosae, no ba parte norte no súl. Família hotu iha mundu sei hetan bensaun liu hosi o no o nia bei-oan.
verses.15: Tebes, Hau mak hamutuk ho o, no Hau sei tau matan ba o iha fatin hotu nebee o baa. Hau sei lori o mai fali rai iha nee, tanba Hau la husik o too Hau kumpri Hau nia liafuan nebee Hau hatoo ona ba o.”
verses.16: Depois Jacó hadeer hosi nia tempu toba dukur nee no nia dehan, “Tebes, Nai mak iha fatin nee no hau la hatene.”
verses.17: Nia tauk no dehan, “Fatin nee perigu loos! Fatin nee mak Maromak nia uma duni, no iha nee mak portaun ba lalehan.”
verses.18: Jacó hadeer sedu iha dadeer-saan, no nia foti fatuk nebee nia uza hodi tau nia ulun no nia harii fatuk nee sai fatuk riin ida. No nia fui mina iha fatuk leten.
verses.19: Nia hanaran fatin nee Betél, maibee uluk sidade iha nebaa iha naran Luz.
verses.20: Jacó jura no dehan, “Se karik Maromak hamutuk ho hau, no tau matan ba hau iha dalan nebee hau lao tuir nee, no foo paun hodi hau bele haan no ropa hodi hau bele hatais,
verses.21: too hau fila fali ba hau nia aman nia uma ho dame, nunee Nai sei sai hau nia Maromak.
verses.22: No fatuk nee, nebee hau harii ona nudar fatuk riin, sei sai Maromak nia uma. No hosi buat hotu nebee O foo mai hau, nee duni hau sei foo fali porsentu sanulu ba O.”

29.title: Jacó Kaben Ho Lea No Rakél

verses.1: Depois Jacó kontinua ninia viajen, no nia baa too iha povu iha parte lorosae nia rai.
verses.2: Nia haree, no tebes, nia hetan bee posu iha rai luan. Tebes, fatin nee iha bibi lubun tolu nebee toba iha nebaa. Tanba hosi bee posu nee ema foo hemu ba sira nia bibi lubun sira. No fatuk boot taka hela bee posu nee.
verses.3: Baibain bibi lubun hotu halibur iha nebaa no ema duir fatuk hosi bee posu hodi foo hemu ba bibi sira. Depois sira taka fali bee posu ho fatuk boot nee.
verses.4: Jacó dehan ba sira, “Hau nia maluk sira, imi hosi nebee?” Sira hataan, “Ami hosi Haran.”
verses.5: Nia husu sira, “Imi konhese Labão, oan mane hosi Naor, ka?” Sira hataan, “Ami konhese.”
verses.6: Nia husu sira, “Nia diak ka lae?” Sira hataan, “Nia diak. Haree ba, nia oan feto Rakél mai ho bibi sira!”
verses.7: Nia dehan, “Aii, loron manas hela, no nee laos tempu atu halibur animál sira. Foo hemu ba bibi sira no lori sira ba.”
verses.8: No sira hataan, “Ami la bele, too bibi lubun hotu mai hamutuk. Depois ema sira duir fatuk nee hosi bee posu, foin ami bele foo hemu ba bibi sira.”
verses.9: Bainhira nia koalia hela ho sira, Rakél mai ho ninia aman nia bibi sira, tanba Rakél hein bibi sira nee.
verses.10: Bainhira Jacó haree Rakél, oan feto hosi Labão nebee ninia inan nia maun, nia hakbesik no duir fatuk hosi bee posu no foo hemu ba bibi lubun hosi Labão, ninia inan nia maun.
verses.11: No Jacó rei Rakél, no nia tanis ho lian makaas.
verses.12: Jacó foo hatene ba Rakél katak nia mak Rakél nia aman nia alin, no nia mak Rebeka nia oan mane. Nunee Rakél halai no foo hatene ba ninia aman.
verses.13: Bainhira Labão rona liafuan kona ba Jacó nebee nia alin feto nia oan, nia halai ba Jacó no rei nia no lori Jacó tama ba ninia uma. No Jacó konta buat hotu ba Labão.
verses.14: Labão dehan ba nia, “Loos duni, o mak hau nia ruin no hau nia isin!” No Jacó hela ho Labão too fulan ida.
verses.15: Labão hatete ba Jacó, “Tanba o mak hau nia alin, nunee o sei servisu mai hau saugati deit ka? Foo hatene lai, hau tenki selu saida ba o nia kolen?”
verses.16: Labão iha oan feto rua, oan primeiru naran Lea no oan segundu naran Rakél.
verses.17: Lea iha matan fraku, maibee Rakél bonita loos no oin kapaas.
verses.18: Jacó hadomi Rakél no nia dehan, “Hau sei serví ita too tinan hitu hodi hetan Rakél, ita nia oan segundu.
verses.19: Labão dehan, “Diak liu hau foo nia ba o, duké hau foo nia ba mane seluk. Entaun hela ho hau.”
verses.20: Nunee Jacó serví too tinan hitu hodi hetan Rakél, maibee nia senti katak tempu nee hanesan loron balu deit, tanba domin nebee nia iha ba Rakél.
verses.21: Depois Jacó dehan ba Labão, “Foo hau nia feen mai hau, tanba tempu nee hotu ona, nunee hau bele tama ba nia.”
verses.22: Entaun Labão halibur ema hotu hosi fatin nee no halo festa boot.
verses.23: Maibee, iha kalan nee, nia foti nia oan feto Lea, no lori ba Jacó, no Jacó tama ba nia.
verses.24: Labão foo Zilpa ba nia oan feto Lea hodi sai atan feto ba nia.
verses.25: Tuir mai, iha dadeer-saan, tebes feto nee mak Lea! No Jacó dehan ba Labão, “Ita halo saida mai hau? Laos hau serví ita tanba Rakél? Nusaa mak ita bosok hau?”
verses.26: Labão dehan, “Tuir ami nia kultura, ami la bele halo hanesan nee, atu foo oan feto segundu molok oan feto primeiru.
verses.27: Halo tuir ho feto nee too semana ida, depois ami sei foo feto ida fali hodi selu o nia kolen. Naran katak o servisu mai hau tinan hitu tan.
verses.28: Entaun Jacó halo tuir no kumpri feto primeiru nia semana ida. Depois Labão foo mos nia oan feto Rakél ba nia hodi sai ninia feen.
verses.29: No Labão foo Bila ba nia oan feto Rakél hodi sai ninia atan feto.
verses.30: Jacó tama mos ba Rakél. Nia hadomi Rakél liu fali Lea. No Jacó serví Labão too tinan hitu tan.
verses.31: Bainhira Nai haree katak Jacó odi Lea, nunee Nai loke Lea nia oan fatin, maibee Rakél la bele iha oan.
verses.32: Lea isin rua no tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida, no nia hanaran oan nee Ruben, tanba nia dehan, “Tanba Nai haree hau nia terus. Agora, hau nia laen sei hadomi hau.”
verses.33: Nia isin rua fali no tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida, no dehan, “Tanba Nai rona ona katak hau hetan ódiu, nunee Nia foo mos oan mane nee.” No nia hanaran oan mane nee Simeão.
verses.34: No nia isin rua fali no tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida, no dehan, “Agora, iha tempu nee, hau nia laen hakarak hamutuk ho hau tanba hau hetan oan mane tolu ba nia.” Nunee nia hanaran oan nee Levi.
verses.35: No nia isin rua fali no tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida, no nia dehan, “Agora, hau sei hahii Nai.” Nunee nia hanaran oan nee Judá. Depois nia la hetan tan oan.

verses.1: Bainhira Rakél haree katak nia la hetan oan ba Jacó, Rakél sai laran moras ba ninia biin no dehan ba Jacó, “Foo oan sira mai hau, se lae, hau mate!”
verses.2: Jacó sai hirus ho Rakél, no nia dehan, “Hau mak iha Maromak nia fatin ka? Nia mak halo hodi o nia kabun laran la bele iha oan.”
verses.3: Rakél dehan, “Haree lai, hau nia atan feto Bila, tama ba nia. Nia bele tuur ahi, hodi hau bele hetan oan sira liu hosi nia.”
verses.4: No Rakél foo nia atan feto Bila ba Jacó nudar feen ida, no Jacó tama ba nia.
verses.5: Bila sai isin rua, no nia tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida.
verses.6: Rakél dehan, “Maromak tesi lia ona mai hau, no Nia rona ona hau nia lian no foo oan mane mai hau.” Nunee nia hanaran oan mane nee Dan.
verses.7: Rakél nia atan feto Bila sai isin rua fali no tuur ahi hetan oan mane segundu ba Jacó.
verses.8: Rakél dehan, “Hau hadau malu makaas ho hau nia biin no hau mak manaan.” No nia hanaran oan mane nee Naftali.
verses.9: Bainhira Lea haree katak nia la oan tan, nia foti nia atan feto Zilpa, no foo nia ba Jacó nudar feen ida.
verses.10: No Lea nia atan feto Zilpa tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida ba Jacó.
verses.11: Lea dehan, “Sorte diak!” No nia hanaran oan mane nee Gad.
verses.12: Lea nia atan feto Zilpa tuur ahi hetan oan mane segundu ba Jacó.
verses.13: Lea dehan, “Hau haksolok, tanba feto sira sei bolu hau haksolok.” No nia hanaran oan mane nee Aser.
verses.14: Iha tempu koa trigu, Ruben tama ba rai luan no hetan ai mandrágora no lori sira ba ninia inan Lea. Depois Rakél dehan ba Lea, “Favór ida, foo ita nia oan mane nia ai mandrágora balu mai hau.”
verses.15: Lea dehan ba nia, “Ida nee buat kiik katak o foti hau nia laen ka? Agora o hakarak foti mos hau nia oan nia ai mandrágora?” Rakél dehan, “Entaun, foo ita nia oan nia ai mandrágora mai hau no Jacó bele toba ho ita orsida kalan.”
verses.16: Bainhira Jacó mai hosi rai luan iha rai nakaras Lea sai baa hodi hasoru nia, no dehan, “Ita tenki tama mai hau, tanba tebes hau aluga ona ita ho hau nia oan mane nia ai mandrágora.” No Jacó toba ho Lea iha kalan nee.
verses.17: Maromak rona Lea no nia isin rua no tuur ahi hetan oan mane ba dala lima ba Jacó.
verses.18: Lea dehan, “Maromak foo ona mai hau tuir hau nia kolen, tanba hau foo ona hau nia atan feto ba hau nia laen.” No Lea hanaran oan mane nee Isakar.
verses.19: Lea isin rua fali no tuur ahi hetan oan ba dala neen ba Jacó.
verses.20: Lea dehan, “Maromak foo prezenti diak mai hau. Agora hau nia laen hakarak hela ho hau tanba hau hetan ona oan neen ba nia.” No Lea hanaran oan mane nee Zebulón.
verses.21: Liu tiha nee, nia tuur ahi hetan oan feto ida nebee hanaran Dina.
verses.22: Maromak hanoin Rakél no Maromak rona nia no Maromak loke ninia oan fatin.
verses.23: No Rakél isin rua no tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida no dehan, “Maromak mak hasai ona hau nia moe.”
verses.24: Rebeka hanaran oan mane nee José, no nia dehan, “Nai sei aumenta oan mane ida tan mai hau.”
verses.25: Bainhira Rakél hetan ona José, Jacó dehan ba Labão, “Haruka hau sai, hodi hau bele baa hau nia fatin, no ba hau nia rai.
verses.26: Foo hau nia feen sira no hau nia oan sira, nebee hau selu kotu ona ho hau nia servisu ba ita, no husik hau baa. Tanba ita hatene hau nia servisu nebee hau halo ona ba ita.
verses.27: Labão dehan ba nia, “Favór ida, se karik hau hetan grasa iha ita nia oin, hau aprende liu hosi liafuan siik nian katak Nai haraik ona bensaun mai hau tanba ita.”
verses.28: No nia dehan, “Foo hatene mai hau ita nia kolen nee too hira no hau sei foo.”
verses.29: Jacó dehan ba nia, “Ita hatene ona oinsaa hau serví ona ba ita, no oinsaa hau lori ita nia animál sira.
verses.30: Tanba bainhira hau mai, ita iha uitoan deit maibee agora animál sira nee aumenta too lubun boot. No Nai mak haraik bensaun ba ita hosi tempu nebee hau mai. Agora, bainhira mak hau hetan mos ba hau nia uma kain?”
verses.31: Entaun Labão husu, “Saida mak hau foo ba ita?” Jacó hataan, “Ita lalika foo buat ida mai hau, se karik ita halo buat nee mai hau nunee hau sei hein no tau matan ba ita nia bibi lubun.
verses.32: Hau sei lao liu ita nia bibi lubun tomak ohin loron no hasai animál sira nebee iha kór ka makerek, bibi malae hotu nebee kór metan, no bibi timor nebee makerek no iha kór. Buat sira nee mak hau nia kolen.
verses.33: Nunee hau nia hahalok loos bele defende hau iha tempu tuir mai, bainhira hau sura hau nia kolen iha ita nia oin. Bibi timor hotu nebee la iha kór ka makerek, no bibi malae nebee la metin - buat sira nee bele sura nudar buat nebee hau naok.”
verses.34: Labão dehan, “Tebes, buat nee sei tuir ita nia liafuan.”
verses.35: Depois, iha loron nee kedas, Labão haketak bibi timor aman nebee iha riska-riska no makerek no bibi inan hotu nebee iha kór no makerek, no bibi malae hotu nebee mutin uitoan ho kór metan. Nia haketak bibi hotu nee no nia entrega sira ba ninia oan mane sira nia liman.
verses.36: Depois nia haruka ninia oan mane sira lao loron tolu hodi hela dook hosi Jacó. No Jacó hein bibi nebee sei hela hosi Labão nia bibi lubun sira.
verses.37: Jacó foti ai sanak sira hosi ai kananga, ai kalesi no ai bubur nebee sei nurak no nia loke ai sanak sira nee nia kulit hodi haree hetan ai sanak nia laran nebee mutin.
verses.38: No nia foti ai sanak nee, nebee nia hasai tiha sira nia kulit, no tau iha bibi lubun sira nia oin iha tanke bee nebee sira uza hodi foo hemu ba bibi lubun sira, iha fatin nebee sira sai isin rua bainhira sira hemu.
verses.39: No bibi lubun sira nee isin rua iha ai sanak nia oin no sira hahoris oan sira nebee riska-riska, kór no makerek.
verses.40: Jacó haketak bibi oan sira nee no halo hodi bibi lubun sira haree ba sira nebee riska-riska no sira hotu nebee metan iha Labão nia bibi lubun nia leet. No nia tau ninia bibi lubun sira ketak no la kahur sira ho Labão nia bibi lubun sira.
verses.41: No bainhira bibi nebee forti hola malu, Jacó tau ai sanak sira nee iha bibi sira nia oin iha tanke bee nian hodi sira bele hola malu iha ai sanak sira nia oin.
verses.42: Maibee bainhira bibi fraku mai, nia la tau ai sanak sira nee. Nunee bibi nebee fraku mak Labão nian, no bibi nebee forti mak Jacó nian.
verses.43: Entaun mane nee aumenta ba beibeik, no nia hetan bibi barak, no atan feto, atan mane, kuda kamelu no kuda buru sira.

verses.1: Jacó rona liafuan hosi Labão nia oan mane sira. Sira dehan, “Jacó mak hadau buat hotu nebee ami nia aman nian. Nia hetan riku-soin hotu nee hosi ami nia aman nia sasaan.”
verses.2: Jacó haree Labão nia oin, no tebes, nia la hanesan uluk.
verses.3: No Nai dehan ba Jacó, “Fila fali ba o nia bei-ala nia rai, ba o nia maluk sira no Hau sei hamutuk ho o.”
verses.4: Jacó haruka ema bolu Rakél no Lea atu mai ninia bibi lubun iha rai luan.
verses.5: Nia dehan ba sira, “Hau haree imi nia aman nia oin, katak nia la hanesan uluk, maibee hau nia aman nia Maromak mak hamutuk ho hau.
verses.6: Imi hatene katak hau serví ona imi nia aman ho hau nia kbiit tomak.
verses.7: Maibee imi nia aman bosok hau no nia muda hau nia saláriu dala sanulu ona. Maibee Maromak la husik nia atu estraga hau.
verses.8: Se karik nia dehan nee, ‘Makerek nian mak o nia kolen,’ nunee bibi sira hahoris bibi makerek. No se karik nia dehan, ‘Riska-riska nian mak o nia kolen,’ nunee bibi sira hahoris bibi riska-riska.
verses.9: Hanesan nee Maromak foti animál sira hosi imi nia aman no foo mai hau.
verses.10: Iha loron ida, iha tempu nebee bibi sira hola malu, hau foti matan no haree mehi ida. Tebes, bibi aman sira nebee sae bibi inan sira mak riska-riska, makerek no kór oi-oin.
verses.11: Maromak nia anju koalia ho hau iha mehi ida no dehan, ‘Jacó!’ No hau hataan, ‘Hau mak nee.’
verses.12: Nia dehan, ‘Foti matan agora no haree ba, bibi aman hotu nebee sae bibi inan iha riska-riska, makerek no kór oi-oin. Tanba Hau haree ona buat hotu nebee Labão halo ona ba o.
verses.13: Hau mak Maromak hosi Betél, iha fatin nebee o fui mina ba fatuk riin, no iha fatin nebee o halo juramentu mai Hau. Agora, hamriik no sai hosi rai nee no fila fali ba o nia maluk sira nia rai.’”
verses.14: Rakél no Lea rona no hataan ba nia, “Ami iha parte ka liman rohan tan iha ami nia aman nia uma ka?
verses.15: Laos nia haree ami nudar ema estranjeiru? Tanba nia faan ona ami no ami nia osan nee nia haan hotu ona.
verses.16: Tanba riku-soin hotu nebee Maromak foti hosi ami nia aman nee mak ami nian, no ami nia oan sira nian. Agora, buat hotu nebee Maromak hatete ona ba ita, nunee ita halo tuir.”
verses.17: Depois Jacó hamriik, no tau nia oan mane sira no nia oan feto sira iha kuda kamelu sira.
verses.18: Nia lori sai ninia animál sira hotu no ninia sasaan hotu nebee nia hetan. Buat sira nee mak nia animál sira nebee ninian, nebee nia hetan iha Padan-Aram. No nia lao ba hodi baa nia aman Isak iha rai Kanaan.
verses.19: Labão baa ona fatin ida hodi tesi ninia bibi malae nia fulun. No Rakél naok estátua lulik sira nebee ninia aman nian.
verses.20: Jacó baa nonook deit hodi Labão, ema Aram, la hatene, no Jacó la foo hatene ba Labão katak nia halai ona.
verses.21: Entaun nia halai ho buat hotu nebee ninian. Nia hamriik no hakur Mota Eufrates no fila nia oin ba foho Gilead.
verses.22: Liu tiha loron tolu, ema foo hatene ba Labão katak Jacó halai tiha ona.
verses.23: Entaun nia foti ninia maluk sira no halai duni Jacó too loron hitu. No nia hetan Jacó iha foho Gilead.
verses.24: Maromak mai Labão, ema Aram, iha mehi ida iha kalan no dehan ba nia, “Kuidadu katak o la koalia buat ida ba Jacó, se buat diak ka buat aat.”
verses.25: Entaun Labão hetan Jacó. Jacó halo akampamentu iha foho no Labão hamutuk ho ninia maluk sira halo akampamentu iha foho Gilead.
verses.26: Labão dehan ba Jacó, “Ita halo saida? Nusaa mak ita halai nonook hodi hau la hatene, no lori sai hau nia oan feto sira hanesan ema dadur nebee foti ho surik?
verses.27: Tanba saa mak ita halai sub-subar, no baa nonook deit, no la foo hatene mai hau hodi hau la bele haruka ita sai ho haksolok no kanta, ho tamborin no harpa?
verses.28: Nusaa mak ita la foo tempu hodi hau bele rei hau nia bei-oan mane no bei-oan feto sira? Ita halo buat beik.
verses.29: Hau iha podér iha hau nia liman hodi halo aat ba ita. Maibee ita nia aman nia Maromak koalia ona ho hau hori kalan no dehan, ‘Kuidadu katak o la koalia buat ida ba Jacó, se buat diak ka buat aat.’
verses.30: Agora, ita baa tanba ita hanoin duni ita nia aman nia uma, maibee tanba saa mak ita naok hau nia maromak sira?”
verses.31: Jacó hataan no dehan ba Labão, “Hau halo hanesan nee tanba hau tauk, no hau hanoin karik ita foti fali ita nia oan feto sira hosi hau.
verses.32: Maibee ita bele oho ema ida nebee iha ita nia maromak sira. Iha ita nia maluk sira nia oin bele haree buat nebee ita nian iha hau nia sasaan.” Tanba Jacó la hatene katak Rakél mak naok buat sira nee.
verses.33: Labão tama Jacó nia tenda, no Lea nia tenda, no atan feto rua nia tenda maibee nia la hetan. Depois nia sai hosi Lea nia tenda no tama Rakél nia tenda.
verses.34: Rakél foti ona estátua lulik sira nee no tau sira iha kuda kamelu nia sela no tuur iha sira nia leten. Labão buka iha tenda ida nee nia laran tomak maibee nia la hetan.
verses.35: No Rakél dehan ba ninia aman, “Hau nia senhor, keta hirus hau katak hau la hamriik iha ita boot nia oin, tanba hau nia raan fulan mai.” Entaun Labão buka la hetan estátua lulik sira nee.
verses.36: Depois Jacó hirus no diskuti malu ho Labão. Jacó dehan ba Labão, “Oinsaa mak hau kontra hasoru ita? No hau nia sala saida katak ita halai duni hau?
verses.37: Ita buka iha hau nia sasaan hotu maibee sasaan ida nebee mak ita nian? Tau sasaan ida nee iha hau nia maluk sira nia oin no ita nia maluk sira nia oin hodi sira bele tesi lia entre ita nain rua.
verses.38: Hau mak hamutuk ho ita durante tinan rua-nulu no ita nia bibi malae inan no bibi timor inan la soe sira nia oan sira no hau la haan ita nia bibi aman sira hosi ita nia bibi lubun.
verses.39: Buat nebee animál fuik lees tiha nee hau la lori ba ita maibee hau mak simu buat nebee lakon. Hau nia liman la husu hosi ita maski ema naok iha loron ka naok iha kalan.
verses.40: Hau hela hanesan nee: Loron manas haan hau durante loron, no jelu kona fali hau iha kalan, no hau toba la dukur.
verses.41: Hau hanesan nee durante tinan rua-nulu iha ita nia uma. Hau serví ita too tinan sanulu resin haat hodi hetan ita nia oan feto rua no tinan neen hodi hetan ita nia bibi lubun. No dala sanulu ita muda ona hau nia kolen.
verses.42: Se karik hau nia aman nia Maromak nebee Abraão nia Maromak la hamutuk ho hau, no Isak nia Hamtauk la hamutuk ho hau, tebes ita mak haruka hau sai ho liman mamuk. Maromak haree hau nia terus no hau nia liman nia servisu no Nia mak hasee ita hori kalan.”
verses.43: Labão hataan no dehan ba Jacó, “Oan feto sira nee mak hau nia oan feto sira, no bei-oan sira nee mak hau nia bei-oan sira, no bibi sira nee mak hau nia bibi sira, no buat hotu nebee ita haree mak hau nian.
verses.44: Maibee saida mak hau bele halo ba hau nia oan feto sira, ka sira nia oan sira nebee sira hetan? Entaun, mai ita halo aliansa ida entre hau no ita, no husik aliansa nee sai sasin entre hau no ita.”
verses.45: No Jacó foti fatuk ida hodi harii nudar fatuk riin.
verses.46: Jacó dehan ba nia maluk sira, “Halibur fatuk sira.” No sira foti fatuk sira no halo bou ida no sira haan hamutuk iha fatuk bou nee.
verses.47: Labão hanaran fatuk bou nee Jegar-Saaduta, maibee Jacó hanaran bou nee Galeed.
verses.48: Labão dehan, “Bou ida nee mak sasin entre hau no ita iha loron nee.” Tanba nee mak fatin nee iha naran Galeed,
verses.49: no Mizpá, tanba nia dehan, “Nai sei haree entre hau no ita, bainhira ita dook malu.
verses.50: Se ita foo terus ba hau nia oan feto sira, ka se ita hola feto sira seluk nudar feen, nebee laos hau nia oan feto sira nee, no la iha ema ida hamutuk ho ita hodi haree, maibee Maromak sei sai sasin entre hau no ita.”
verses.51: Labão dehan ba Jacó, “Haree bou nee no haree fatuk riin nee, nebee hau harii entre hau no ita.
verses.52: Bou nee sai sasin, no riin nee sai sasin, katak hau sei la lao liu bou nee ba ita, no ita sei la lao liu bou no riin nee mai hau hodi halo aat.
verses.53: Abraão nia Maromak, Naor nia Maromak, no sira nia aman nia Maromak, sei tesi lia entre ita.” No Jacó jura liu hosi ninia aman Isak nia Hamtauk.
verses.54: Depois Jacó oferese sakrifísiu iha foho nee, no bolu ninia maluk sira mai haan paun no sira haan paun no hein kalan tomak iha foho nee.
verses.55: Iha dadeer-saan, Labão hadeer no rei ninia oan mane no oan feto sira, no foo bensaun ba sira. Depois Labão sai no fila fali ba ninia uma.

verses.1: Jacó lao baa no Maromak nia anju sira hasoru nia.
verses.2: Bainhira Jacó haree sira nia dehan, “Nee mak Maromak nia akampamentu!” No nia hanaran fatin nee Maanaim.
verses.3: Jacó haruka manu-ain sira baa uluk nia atu baa ninia maun Esau iha rai Seir, nebee rai Edom.
verses.4: Nia manda sira no dehan, “Imi koalia hanesan nee ba hau nia senhor Esau: Ita boot nia atan Jacó dehan, ‘Hau hela ho Labão, no hau iha nebaa kleur too agora.
verses.5: Hau iha karau, kuda buru, bibi lubun, atan mane no atan feto sira. No hau haruka foo hatene ba hau nia senhor hodi hau bele hetan grasa iha ita boot nia oin.’”
verses.6: Depois manu-ain sira fila mai Jacó no dehan, “Ami baa too ita boot nia maun Esau. Nia mai dadaun atu hasoru ita boot, no mane nain atus haat (400) mai hamutuk ho nia.”
verses.7: Nunee Jacó tauk loos no laran taridu. Nia fahe ema nebee hamutuk ho nia, no bibi lubun, karau lubun no kuda kamelu sira nee nia fahe ba akampamentu rua.
verses.8: Nia dehan, “Se karik Esau hasoru grupu ida no oho sira, ida fali bele halai.”
verses.9: No Jacó dehan, “Oh Maromak nebee hau nia aman Abraão nian, no Maromak nebee hau nia aman Isak nian, Nai nebee dehan mai hau, ‘Fila fali ba o nia rai, no ba o nia família, no Hau sei halo diak ba o.’
verses.10: Hau la merese atu simu buat kiik ida hosi domin metin no fidelidade hotu nebee O hatudu ona ba O nia atan hau. Tanba ho hau nia ai tonka deit hau hakur Jordaun nee no agora hau sai akampmentu rua nee.
verses.11: Favór ida, salva tiha hau hosi hau nia maun nia liman, hosi Esau nia liman. Tanba hau tauk nia katak nia atu mai oho hau, no mos inan sira hamutuk ho oan sira nee.
verses.12: No O dehan ona, ‘Hau sei halo duni buat diak ba o no halo o nia bei-oan sira sai hanesan rai henek iha tasi nebee la bele sura tanba barak liu.’”
verses.13: Jacó toba kalan ida iha fatin nee. Depois nia foti hosi buat nebee nia iha atu foo prezenti ba nia maun Esau:
verses.14: bibi inan atus rua, bibi aman rua-nulu, bibi malae inan atus rua, bibi male aman rua-nulu,
verses.15: kuda kamelu inan tolu-nulu nebee susu hela ho sira nia oan sira, karau inan haat-nulu, karau aman sanulu, kuda buru inan rua-nulu no kuda buru aman sanulu.
verses.16: Nia fahe lubun sira nee keta-ketak. Depois nia foo lubun sira nee ba nia atan sira no dehan, “Hakur mota uluk hau, no husik lubun ida-idak lao tuir dook malu.”
verses.17: Nia manda ida nebee primeiru no dehan, “Bainhira hau nia maun hasoru o no husu, ‘O mai hosi see? O baa nebee? No animál sira nee see nian?’,
verses.18: entaun o tenki dehan, ‘Buat sira nee mak ita boot nia atan Jacó nian. Nia haruka sira nudar prezenti ba hau nia senhor Esau, no tebes nia lao tuir ami.’”
verses.19: No nia manda ida segundu hanesan nee mos, no ida terseiru, no sira hotu nebee lori animál lubun sira nee, no nia dehan, “Imi tenki koalia hanesan nee ho Esau bainhira imi hasoru nia.
verses.20: No mos imi sei dehan, ‘Tebes, ita boot nia atan Jacó lao tuir ami.’” Tanba nia dehan, “Hau sei hetan perdaun hosi Esau ho prezenti nebee lao uluk hau. Depois hau sei haree ninia oin, karik nia bele simu hau.”
verses.21: Entaun prezenti sira hakur uluk nia maibee nia rasik toba iha kalan nee iha akampamentu.
verses.22: Iha kalan nee, nia hadeer no nia foti nia feen rua, nia atan feto rua, nia oan mane sanulu resin ida no nia hakur Mota Jabok.
verses.23: Nia foti sira no haruka sira hakur mota kiik nee no haruka buat nebee nia iha.
verses.24: Nunee Jacó hela mesak deit. No mane ida mai deut malu ho nia too loro matan sae.
verses.25: Bainhira mane nee haree katak nia la bele manaan Jacó, nia book Jacó nia kidan ruin fukun, no Jacó nia kidan ruin fukun naksalak bainhira sira deut malu hela.
verses.26: Ema nee dehan, “Husik hau tanba loro matan sae.” Jacó dehan, “Hau sei la husik ita too ita foo bensaun mai hau.”
verses.27: No nia dehan ba Jacó, “O nia naran saida?” Jacó hataan, “Jacó.”
verses.28: Nia dehan, “O nia naran laos tan Jacó, maibee Israel. Tanba o luta hasoru Maromak no ema, no o manaan.”
verses.29: Jacó husu nia, “Favór ida, foo hatene ita nia naran saida?” Nia dehan, “Nusaa mak o husu hau nia naran?” No nia foo bensaun ba Jacó iha nebaa.
verses.30: Jacó hanaran fatin nee Peniel tanba nia dehan, “Hau haree Maromak oin ba oin, no hau sei moris hela.”
verses.31: Loro matan sae dadaun bainhira nia hakur iha Peniel, no nia lao kudeik tanba ninia kidan ruin.
verses.32: Tanba nee ema Israel sira la haan naan uat iha kidan ruin fukun too ohin loron. Tanba mane nee book Jacó nia kidan ruin fukun iha fatin nebee iha naan uat.

verses.1: Jacó foti matan no haree, no tebes Esau mai, no nia iha mane nain atus haat hamutuk ho nia. Jacó fahe nia oan sira ba Lea no Rakél, no ba atan feto rua nee.
verses.2: Nia tau atan feto no sira nia oan sira iha oin, tuir mai Lea no ninia oan sira, depois Rakél no Jacó tuir ikus.
verses.3: No nia lao ba Esau no hakruuk dala hitu too nia besik ba ninia maun.
verses.4: Esau halai hodi hasoru nia no hakuak nia makaas no rei nia. No sira tanis.
verses.5: Esau foti matan no haree feto no labarik sira no nia husu, “See mak sira nebee hamutuk ho ita?” Nia hataan, “Sira mak hau nia oan sira nebee Maromak foo ho grasa ba ita nia atan hau.”
verses.6: Tuir mai atan feto sira mai, hamutuk ho sira nia oan sira, no hakruuk ba Esau.
verses.7: No Lea mos ho ninia oan sira mai no hakruuk ba Esau. Tuir mai Rakél hamutuk ho José hakbesik no hakruuk ba Esau.
verses.8: Esau dehan, “Tanba saa mak ita haruka uluk animál lubun sira nebee hau hasoru ona nee?” Jacó hataan, “Hodi hetan grasa iha hau nia senhor nia oin.”
verses.9: Esau dehan, “Hau nia alin, hau iha barak ona. Rai hela buat hotu nee ba ita.”
verses.10: Jacó dehan, “Lae, favór ida, se karik hau hetan grasa iha ita boot nia oin, entaun simu hau nia prezenti hosi hau nia liman. Tanba hau haree ona ita boot nia oin, nebee hanesan hau haree Maromak nia oin, no ita boot mak simu ona hau.
verses.11: Favór ida, foti hau nia bensaun nebee hau lori ba ita boot tanba Maromak mak hatudu grasa ona mai hau no hau iha barak ona.” Nunee Jacó obriga nia no nia simu buat sira nee.
verses.12: Depois Esau dehan, “Mai ita baa hamutuk. Ita bele baa no hau sei lao iha ita nia oin.”
verses.13: Jacó dehan ba nia, “Hau nia senhor hatene katak labarik sira nee sei kiik, no bibi lubun no karau lubun sira nebee hamutuk ho hau iha mos oan sira. Se karik ema dudu makaas sira iha loron ida deit lubun sira hotu sei mate.
verses.14: Favór ida, hau nia senhor bele lao uluk ninia atan hau. Hau sei lao neineik, tuir animál sira nebee lao uluk hau no labarik sira nia kbiit, too hau hetan hau nia senhor iha Seir.
verses.15: Esau dehan, “Entaun hau bele husik ema balu nebee hamutuk ho hau hodi baa ho ita.” Jacó hataan, “Tanba saa mak hanesan nee? Husik hau hetan grasa iha hau nia senhor nia oin.”
verses.16: Entaun Esau fila fali iha loron nee no nia lao iha dalan ba Seir.
verses.17: No Jacó lao ba Sukot no harii uma ida no animál luhan sira. Nunee fatin nee iha naran Sukot.
verses.18: Entaun Jacó sai hosi Padan-Aram no halo viajen diak too iha sidade Sikém nebee iha rai Kanaan. Nia harii ninia tenda iha sidade nee nia oin.
verses.19: No nia sosa rai ida iha nebaa, iha fatin nebee nia tau ninia tenda. Nia sosa rai nee hosi Hamor nia oan sira, nebee Sikém nia aman, ho osan mutin atus ida.
verses.20: Nia harii altár ida iha nebaa no hanaran altár nee El-Elohe-Israel.

verses.1: Dina, nebee oan feto hosi Lea no Jacó, sai hodi baa haree feto sira iha rai nebaa.
verses.2: No Sikém mak oan mane hosi Hamor nebee ema Hiti, liurai iha rai nebaa. Bainhira Sikém haree feto Dina nee, Sikém foti nia no toba ho nia no hamoe nia.
verses.3: Sikém nia laran monu tebes ba Dina, oan feto hosi Jacó. Nia hadomi feto nee no koalia ho laran diak ba nia.
verses.4: Sikém koalia ho nia aman Hamor no dehan, “Foti feto nee hodi sai hau nia feen.”
verses.5: Jacó rona katak Sikém mak estraga nia oan feto Dina. Ninia oan mane sira sei hein hela ninia animál sira iha rai luan. Entaun Jacó nonook too sira fila mai.
verses.6: Sikém nia aman Hamor sai hodi baa hasoru Jacó no koalia ho nia.
verses.7: Bainhira Jacó nia oan mane sira mai hosi rai luan, sira rona kona ba buat nee no sira laran kanek. Sira hirus tebes tanba Sikém halo buat aat loos iha Israel. Tanba Sikém toba ho Jacó nia oan feto, nebee tuir loloos la bele halo hanesan nee.
verses.8: Hamor koalia ho sira no dehan, “Hau nia oan mane Sikém nia laran monu ba ita nia oan feto. Favór ida, foo feto nee ba nia hodi sai ninia feen.
verses.9: Imi bele hola malu ho ami. Foo imi nia oan feto sira mai ami no foti ami nia oan feto sira ba imi.
verses.10: No imi sei hela ho ami no imi bele uza rai nee. Hela no lori bisnis iha rai nee, no hetan riku-soin iha rai nee.”
verses.11: Sikém dehan ba Dina nia aman, no ba Dina nia maun sira, “Husik hau hetan grasa iha imi nia oin, no saida mak imi husu nee hau sei foo ba imi.
verses.12: Husu barlake naran deit no prezenti saida deit, no hau sei foo tuir imi nia liafuan mai hau. Só deit imi foo feto nee hodi sai hau nia feen.”
verses.13: Jacó nia oan mane sira hataan ba Sikém no nia aman Hamor ho liafuan bosok tanba Sikém estraga ona sira nia alin Dina.
verses.14: Nunee sira dehan ba Hamor no Sikém, “Ami la bele halo hanesan nee, atu foo ami nia alin feto ba mane nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun, tanba nee mak hamoe ami.
verses.15: Maibee ami sei simu imi hanesan nee: Se karik imi sai hanesan ami, nebee imi nia mane ida-idak tenki hetan sirkunsizaun.
verses.16: Depois ami sei foo ami nia oan feto sira ba imi, no ami bele foti imi nia oan feto sira mai ami. No ami sei hela hamutuk ho imi no ita sei sai povu ida deit.
verses.17: Maibee se karik imi lakohi rona tuir ami, atu hetan sirkunsizaun, entaun ami sei foti ami nia oan feto nee no ami baa deit.”
verses.18: Hamor no nia oan mane Sikém kontenti ho sira nia liafuan nee.
verses.19: Joven mane nee la dada tempu hodi halo buat nee tanba nia gosta Jacó nia oan feto. No ema respeita nia barak liu fali ema hotu iha ninia aman nia uma kain.
verses.20: Hamor no nia oan mane Sikém baa too iha sira nia sidade nia portaun no koalia hamutuk ho mane hosi sidade nee. Sira dehan,
verses.21: “Mane iha nebaa halo dame ho ami. Nunee husik sira hela iha rai nee no halo bisnis iha nee. Tebes rai nee sei luan no sira mos bele uza. Ita bele foti sira nia oan feto sira hodi sai ita nia feen sira, no ami bele foo ami nia oan feto sira ba ema sira nebaa.
verses.22: Só sira husu buat ida deit hosi ita hodi hela hamutuk ho ita, hodi sai povu ida deit. Sira husu katak ita nia mane ida-idak tenki hetan sirkunsizaun, hanesan sira mos hetan ona sirkunsizaun.
verses.23: Laos sira nia animál sira no sira nia riku-soin no sira nia karau hotu sai ita nian? Nunee mai ita simu sira nia liafuan no sira bele hela ho ita.”
verses.24: Nunee ema hotu iha sidade nia portaun nee rona tuir Hamor no Sikém. Mane ida-idak, nebee ema hotu hosi sidade nee, hetan sirkunsizaun.
verses.25: Tuir mai, iha loron terseiru, bainhira sira moras hela, Jacó nia oan mane rua, Simeão no Levi, nebee Dina nia maun rasik sira, lori sira nia surik no tama sidade nee. Bainhira sidade nee senti seguru, Simeão no Levi oho mane sira hotu.
verses.26: Sira oho Hamor no nia oan mane Sikém ho surik, no sira foti Dina hosi Sikém nia uma no sai ba.
verses.27: Jacó nia oan mane sira nee tama ba ema mate sira nia fatin, no sira hadau sasaan hosi sidade nee, tanba ema sira nee mak estraga sira nia alin feto.
verses.28: Sira foti sira nia bibi, karau, kuda buru, no buat nebee iha sidade laran no buat nebee iha sira nia rai luan.
verses.29: Sira foti ema sira nee nia riku-soin hotu, no sira nia labarik hotu, no sira kastigu ema sira nee nia feen sira no hadau buat hotu iha sira nia uma laran sira nee.
verses.30: Jacó dehan ba Simeão no Levi, “Imi kria problema mai hau, no halo hau sai dois iha ema sira nia leet nebee hela iha rai nee, nebee ema Kanaan sira no ema Perizeu sira. Ita mak ema uitoan deit no sira bele halibur malu hodi hasoru hau no sira bele destrui hau no hau nia uma kain.”
verses.31: Sira hataan, “Nia bele halo ba ami nia alin feto hanesan ho feto aat ka?”

verses.1: Maromak dehan ba Jacó, “Hamriik no sae ba Betél no hela iha nebaa. No halo altár ida iha nebaa ba Maromak nebee hasoru o bainhira o halai hosi o nia maun Esau nia oin.”
verses.2: Entaun Jacó dehan ba nia uma kain, ba ema hotu nebee hamutuk ho nia, “Hasai tiha imi nia maromak sira hosi nasaun seluk nebee iha imi nia leet, hamoos imi nia aan, no troka imi nia ropa.
verses.3: Ita sei hamriik no sae ba Betél. Hau sei halo altár ida ba Maromak nebee hataan hau iha loron nebee hau laran taridu no Nia mak hamutuk ho hau iha dalan hotu nebee hau lao tuir ona.”
verses.4: Sira foo ba Jacó sira nia maromak falsu hotu nebee sira iha, no sira nia brinkus nebee iha sira nia tilun, no Jacó subar sasaan nee iha ai huun boot ida nia okos besik Sikém.
verses.5: Entaun sira lao ba, no Maromak halo sidade sira nebee haleu sira sai tauk. Nunee ema iha sidade sira nee la duni Jacó nia oan mane sira.
verses.6: Jacó no ema hotu nebee ho nia baa too iha Luz nebee iha rai Kanaan, nebee Betél.
verses.7: No nia harii altár ida no hanaran fatin nee El-Betél tanba Maromak mosu ba nia iha nebaa bainhira nia halai hosi ninia maun nia oin.
verses.8: No Debora nebee hakiak Rebeka mak mate. Sira hakoi feto nee iha Betél kraik, iha ai huun boot ida nia okos, no fatin nee sira hanaran Alon-Bakut.
verses.9: Maromak mosu fali ba Jacó bainhira nia sai hosi Padan-Aram no haraik bensaun ba nia.
verses.10: Maromak dehan ba nia, “O nia naran mak Jacó, maibee ema sei la bolu tan o ho naran Jacó. Agora o nia naran mak Israel.” No Maromak bolu nia Israel.
verses.11: Maromak dehan ba nia, “Hau mak Maromak Kbiit Makaas. Halo oan sira no aumenta barak. O sei sai nasaun ida, no nasaun barak sei sai hosi o, no liurai sira sei sai hosi o nia oan fatin.
verses.12: No rai nebee hau foo ona ba Abraão no Isak nee, Hau foo ba o. No Hau foo rai nee ba o nia oan sira nebee tuir o.”
verses.13: Maromak sae hosi Jacó iha fatin nebee Nia koalia ho Jacó.
verses.14: Jacó harii fatuk riin ida iha fatin nebee nia koalia ho Maromak. No nia fui oferta hemu nian iha fatuk leten nee, no nia fui mina iha fatuk leten nee.
verses.15: Jacó foo naran Betél ba fatin nebee Maromak koalia ho nia.
verses.16: Sira lao sai hosi Betél. Bainhira sira sei dook uitoan hosi Efrata, Rakél hetan kanotak moras nebee todan loos.
verses.17: Depois, iha tempu nee, bainhira nia kanotak moras makaas hela, parteira dehan ba nia, “Keta tauk, tanba ita hetan oan mane fali.”
verses.18: Bainhira Rakél nia klamar atu sai, tanba nia atu mate, nia hanaran oan mane nee Ben-Oni. Maibee ninia aman hanaran nia Benjamin.
verses.19: Depois Rakél mate, no sira hakoi nia iha dalan ba Efrata, nebee Belém.
verses.20: Jacó harii fatuk riin iha Rakél nia rate leten, no ida nee mak Rakél nia rate nia fatuk riin nebee sei iha too ohin loron.
verses.21: Israel kontinua ninia viajen no halo akampamentu iha Uma Aas Edar nia sorin ba.
verses.22: Bainhira Israel hela iha nebaa, Ruben tama no toba ho Bila, nebee ninia aman Israel nia feen kiik. No Israel rona kona ba buat nee. Jacó iha oan mane nain sanulu resin rua.
verses.23: Lea nia oan mane sira mak Ruben, nebee Jacó nia oan primeiru, no Simeão, Levi, Judá, Isakar no Zebulón.
verses.24: Rakél nia oan mane sira mak José no Benjamin.
verses.25: Rakél nia atan feto Bila nia oan mane sira mak Dan no Naftali.
verses.26: Lea nia atan feto Zilpa nia oan mane mak Gad no Aser. Jacó nia oan mane sira nee mak moris iha Padan-Aram.
verses.27: Jacó baa ninia aman Isak iha Mamre, iha Kiriat-Arba. Fatin nee mak Hebron, iha fatin nebee Abraão no Isak lao ba no hela.
verses.28: Isak nia idade mak tinan atus ida ualu-nulu (180).
verses.29: Isak nia iis kotu no nia mate, no nia halibur ba ninia bei-ala sira, tanba nia katuas ona no ninia moris nee too ona. Ninia oan mane Esau no Jacó hakoi nia.

verses.1: Ema sira nee mak bei-oan sira hosi Esau, nebee Edom.
verses.2: Esau hetan ninia feen sira hosi ema Kanaan. Feen sira mak Ada, oan feto hosi Elon, ema Hiti; no Aholibama, oan feto hosi Aná, nebee oan feto hosi Zibeon, ema Hevi;
verses.3: no mos Basemat, oan feto hosi Ismael, nebee Nebajot nia alin feto.
verses.4: Esau nia feen Ada tuur ahi hetan Elifaz, no Basemat hetan Reuel.
verses.5: Aholibama hetan Jeus, Jalam no Kora. Ema sira nee mak Esau nia oan mane sira nebee nia hetan iha rai Kanaan.
verses.6: Esau foti nia feen sira, ninia oan mane no ninia oan feto sira, ema hotu iha ninia uma kain, ninia karau no animál hotu, no ninia sasaan hotu nebee nia hetan iha rai Kanaan, no nia baa rai seluk nebee dook hosi ninia alin Jacó.
verses.7: Tanba sira nia riku-soin sai barak liu too sira la bele hela besik malu, no rai nebee sira hela nudar estranjeiru sira la bele lori sira tanba sira nia animál sira nee.
verses.8: Nunee Esau hela iha foho Seir. (Esau nee mak Edom.)
verses.9: Ida nee mak Esau nia jerasaun sira. Esau mak aman ba ema Edom iha foho Seir.
verses.10: Esau nia oan mane sira nia naran mak nee: Elifaz, oan mane hosi Ada, Esau nia feen; no Reuel, oan mane hosi Basemat, Esau nia feen.
verses.11: Elifaz nia oan mane sira mak Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam no Kenaz.
verses.12: Esau nia oan mane Elifaz iha feen kiik ida naran Timna nebee tuur ahi no hetan Amalek. Ema sira nee mak bei-oan sira hosi Ada, nebee Esau nia feen.
verses.13: Reuel nia oan mane sira mak Nahat, Zera, Sama no Miza. Ema sira nee mak bei-oan sira hosi Basemat, nebee Esau nia feen.
verses.14: Oan mane sira hosi Esau nia feen Aholibama, nebee oan feto hosi Aná, oan feto hosi Zibeon, mak nee: nia hetan Jeus, Jalam no Kora, nebee oan mane sira ho Esau.
verses.15: Ema sira nee mak xefi sira ba Esau nia oan mane sira: oan mane sira hosi Elifaz, nebee Esau nia oan primeiru, xefi Teman, xefi Omar, xefi Zefo, xefi Kenaz,
verses.16: xefi Kora, xefi Gatam no xefi Amalek. Ema sira nee mak xefi sira hosi Elifaz iha rai Edom, nebee Ada nia bei-oan sira.
verses.17: Oan sira hosi Reuel, nebee oan mane hosi Esau, mak nee: xefi Nahat, xefi Zera, xefi Sama no xefi Miza. Ema sira nee mak xefi sira hosi Reuel iha rai Edom, nebee oan hosi Esau nia feen Basemat.
verses.18: Ema sira nee mak oan mane sira hosi Esau nia feen Aholibama: xefi Jeus, xefi Jalaum no xefi Kora. Ema sira nee mak xefi sira hosi Esau nia feen Aholibama, oan feto hosi Aná.
verses.19: Ema sira nee mak oan sira hosi Esau, nebee Edom, no xefi sira nebee mai hosi sira.
verses.20: Seir, ema Hori nebee hela iha rai nebaa, iha oan mane sira naran Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon, Aná,
verses.21: Dison, Ezer no Disan. Ema sira nee mak xefi sira ba ema Hori sira, no oan sira hosi Seir iha rai Edom.
verses.22: Lotan nia oan mane sira mak Hori no Hemam. Lotan nia alin feto mak Timna.
verses.23: Sobal nia oan mane sira mak Alvan, Manaat, Ebal, Sefo no Onam.
verses.24: Zibeon nia oan mane sira mak Ahias no Aná. Aná ida nee mak Aná nebee hetan bee matan manas iha rai fuik maran bainhira nia foo haan ba ninia aman Zibeon nia kuda buru sira.
verses.25: Aná nia oan mak Dison no nia oan feto mak Aholibama.
verses.26: Dison nia oan mane mak Hemdan, Esban, Itran no Keran.
verses.27: Ezer nia oan mane sira mak Bilan, Zaavan no Akan.
verses.28: Disan nia oan mane mak Uz no Aran.
verses.29: Ema sira nee mak xefi sira ba ema Hori: xefi Lotan, xefi Sobal, xefi Zibeon, xefi Aná,
verses.30: xefi Dison, xefi Ezer no xefi Disan. Ema sira nee mak xefi sira ba ema Hori, nebee iha xefi nia leet iha rai Seir.
verses.31: Ema sira nee mak liurai sira nebee ukun iha rai Edom, molok ema Israel sira iha liurai ida.
verses.32: Belá, oan mane hosi Beor, ukun iha Edom. Ninia sidade nia naran mak Dinaba.
verses.33: Bainhira Belá mate, Jobab, oan mane hosi Zerá nebee hosi Bozra, ukun troka nia.
verses.34: Bainhira Jobab mate, Husam hosi rai Temani, ukun troka nia.
verses.35: Bainhira Husam mate, Hadad, oan mane hosi Bedad, ukun troka nia. Hadad oho Midian iha Moab nia rai luan. Ninia sidade nia naran mak Avit.
verses.36: Bainhira Hadad mate, Samla hosi Masreka ukun troka nia.
verses.37: Bainhira Samla mate, Saul hosi Reobote, nebee besik mota, ukun troka nia.
verses.38: Bainhira Saul mate, Baal-Hanan, oan mane hosi Akbor, ukun troka nia.
verses.39: Bainhira Baal-Hanan, oan mane hosi Akbor, mate, Hadar ukun troka nia. Ninia sidade nia naran mak Pau no ninia feen nia naran mak Mehetabel, oan feto hosi Matred, nebee oan feto hosi Mezaab.
verses.40: Ema sira nee mak xefi sira hosi Esau, tuir sira nia família sira, tuir sira nia fatin sira no tuir sira nia naran sira: xefi Timna, xefi Alva, xefi Jetet,
verses.41: xefi Aholibama, xefi Elá, xefi Pinon,
verses.42: xefi Kenaz, xefi Teman, xefi Mibzar,
verses.43: xefi Magdiel no xefi Iram. Ema sira nee mak xefi sira hosi Edom, tuir sira nia hela fatin iha rai nebee sira nian. Nee mak Esau, ema Edom sira nia aman.

verses.1: Jacó hela iha rai Kanaan, nebee uluk nia aman lao nudar ema estranjeiru.
verses.2: Ida nee mak Jacó nia jerasaun sira. Bainhira José tinan sanulu resin hitu, nia hein bibi ho ninia maun sira. Joven mane nee hamutuk ho oan mane sira hosi Bila no Zilpa, nebee ninia aman nia feen sira. No José foo hatene ba ninia aman kona ba buat aat nebee sira halo.
verses.3: Israel hadomi José liu fali oan mane sira seluk, tanba nia hetan José bainhira nia katuas ona. No Israel halo batina furak ba José.
verses.4: Bainhira nia maun sira haree katak sira nia aman hadomi nia liu fali nia maun sira hotu, nunee sira odi nia no lakohi koalia diak ho nia.
verses.5: José hetan mehi ida, no nia foo hatene ba ninia maun sira. Entaun sira odi nia liu tan.
verses.6: José dehan ba sira, “Favór ida, rona lai, hau hetan mehi ida.
verses.7: Tebes, ita kesi trigu halo futun sira nee iha rai luan. Tebes, hau nia futun hadeer no hamriik loos. Tebes, imi nia futun sira hamriik haleu hau nia futun no hakruuk ba nia.”
verses.8: No nia maun sira dehan ba nia, “O sei ukun fali ami ka? O sei domina fali ami ka?” No sira odi nia liu tan, tanba ninia mehi no ninia liafuan.
verses.9: Depois nia hetan mehi ida tan, no nia foo hatene ba ninia maun sira no dehan, “Tebes, hau hetan mehi ida tan. Tebes, loro matan, fulan no fitun sanulu resin ida hakruuk mai hau.”
verses.10: Nia konta mehi nee ba ninia aman no ninia maun sira. No ninia aman hasee nia no dehan ba nia, “Saida mak mehi nebee o hetan nee? Hau ho o nia amaa no o nia maun sira sei mai no hakruuk aan ba rai iha o nia oin ka?”
verses.11: No ninia maun sira laran moras ba nia, maibee ninia aman hanoin hela liafuan nee.
verses.12: José nia maun sira lori sira nia aman nia bibi lubun ba Sikém.
verses.13: Israel dehan ba José, “Laos imi nia maun sira hein bibi iha Sikém? Mai lai, no hau sei haruka o baa sira.” No nia dehan, “Hau prontu.”
verses.14: Israel dehan ba nia, “Favór ida, baa no haree o nia maun sira diak ka lae, no bibi lubun sira nee diak ka lae. No lori mai hau liafuan ruma kona ba sira.” Entaun Israel haruka nia sai hosi rai tetuk iha Hebron, no nia baa too iha Sikém.
verses.15: Mane ida hetan nia bainhira nia lao tuun-sae iha rai luan. Mane nee husu nia, “O buka saida?”
verses.16: Nia hataan, “Hau buka hau nia maun sira. Favór ida, bele foo hatene sira hein bibi iha nebee?”
verses.17: Mane ida nee dehan, “Sira sai ona hosi fatin nee, no hau rona sira dehan, ‘Mai, ita baa Dotan.’” Entaun José, buka tuir ninia maun sira no hetan sira iha Dotan.
verses.18: Bainhira José nia maun sira haree nia hosi dook, no molok nia too sira, sira halo planu aat hasoru nia hodi oho nia.
verses.19: No sira dehan ba malu, “Tebes, mehi door nee mai ona!
verses.20: Mai, ita oho nia no soe nia ba rai kuak ruma no ita bele dehan animál fuik mak haan nia. Depois ita sei haree oinsaa kona ba ninia mehi.”
verses.21: Ruben rona nunee no nia koko atu salva José hosi sira nia liman, no nia dehan, “Ita lalika oho nia.”
verses.22: No Ruben dehan, “Keta fakar raan, maibee soe nia ba rai kuak nee iha rai fuik maran, no lalika book nia.” Nia koalia hanesan nee hodi hasai José hosi sira nia liman, hodi foo fali nia ba ninia aman.
verses.23: Bainhira José foin too ona, ninia maun sira rakut sai tiha José nia batina, nebee batina furak nebee nia hatais.
verses.24: Sira foti nia no soe nia ba rai kuak ida nebee mamuk no iha laran bee la iha.
verses.25: Depois sira tuur hodi haan paun. No sira foti sira nia matan no haree, no tebes, ema Ismael lubun ida mai hosi Gilead ho sira nia kuda kamelu. Sira lori ai morin ladanu, mina balsamu no mira hodi tuun ba Ejitu.
verses.26: Judá dehan ba ninia maun sira, “Ita manaán saida se karik ita oho ita nia alin mane no subar ninia raan?
verses.27: Mai, ita bele faan nia ba ema Ismael sira, no la bele book nia. Tanba nia mak ita nia alin no isin rasik.” No ninia maun-alin sira kontenti ho liafuan nee.
verses.28: Entaun bainhira ema Midian sira nebee halo negósiu atu lao liu, José nia maun sira dada José sae hosi rai kuak no faan nia ba ema Ismael sira no hetan osan mutin rua-nulu. No ema Midian sira lori nia ba Ejitu.
verses.29: Bainhira Ruben fila ba rai kuak nee, tebes, José laos iha rai kuak laran. No Ruben lees ninia ropa.
verses.30: Nia fila ba ninia alin sira no dehan, “Labarik nee la iha, agora hau halo saida?”
verses.31: Sira foti José nia batina, no oho bibi ida no foti batina no reta iha bibi nia raan.
verses.32: Depois sira haruka batina furak nee, hodi lori ba sira nia aman no dehan, “Ami hetan buat nee. Haree took, karik ida nee mak ita nia oan mane nia batina ka lae.”
verses.33: Jacó haree no hatene, no nia dehan, “Ida nee mak hau nia oan mane nia batina. Animál aat ida mak haan nia. Loos duni, animál fuik ida lees tiha José nia isin.”
verses.34: Nunee Jacó lees ninia ropa, no hatais hena karoon iha nia kanotak, no nia tanis loron barak tanba ninia oan mane.
verses.35: Ninia oan mane no oan feto hotu mai hodi koko hamaus nia, maibee nia lakohi rona, no nia dehan, “Hau sei tuun ba rate laran ba hau nia oan mane ho tanis halerik.” Nunee José nia aman tanis ba nia.
verses.36: No ema Midian sira faan José iha Ejitu ba Potifar. Potifar mak Faraó nia funsionáriu ida nebee xefi seguransa.

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, Judá husik hela ninia maun-alin sira. Nia lao tuun no baa hela ho ema ida naran Hirá, nebee ema Adulam.
verses.2: Judá haree oan feto ida hosi Sua, ema Kanaan. Judá foti nia no tama ba nia.
verses.3: Feto nee isin rua no tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida. Nia hanaran oan nee Er.
verses.4: Nia isin rua fali no hetan oan mane ida fali. Nia hanaran oan nee Onan.
verses.5: Nia isin rua dala ida tan no hetan oan mane ida. Nia hanaran oan nee Selá. Judá iha Kezib bainhira feto nee tuur ahi.
verses.6: Judá foti feto ida hodi sai feen ba Er, nia oan primeiru. Feto nee nia naran mak Tamar.
verses.7: Er, Judá nia oan primeiru, mak ema nebee iha hahalok aat iha Nai nia oin. No Nai oho nia.
verses.8: Judá dehan ba Onan, “Tama ba o nia maun nia feen no kaben ho nia hodi foo oan ba o nia maun.”
verses.9: Maibee Onan hatene katak oan nee sei la sai ninian. Entaun, bainhira nia tama ba ninia maun nia feen, nia soe ninia been nee ba rai, hodi la foo oan ba ninia maun.
verses.10: No Nai la kontenti ho ninia hahalok nee, nunee Nai oho mos nia.
verses.11: Depois Judá dehan ba ninia feto foun, Tamar, “Hela iha o nia aman nia uma nudar feto faluk too hau nia oan mane Selá sai boot.” Tanba nia hanoin, keta halo be nia oan ikun mos mate hanesan ninia maun sira. Nunee Tamar baa no hela iha ninia aman nia uma.
verses.12: Liu tiha tempu nee, Sua nia oan feto, nebee Judá nia feen, mak mate. Bainhira tempu lutu nee hotu tiha, Judá sae ba Timna iha fatin nebee ema tesi ninia bibi malae nia fulun. Nia baa hamutuk ho nia kolega Hira, ema Adulam.
verses.13: Ema foo hatene ba Tamar dehan, “Tebes, o nia banin mane lao dadaun no sae ba Timna hodi tesi ninia bibi malae nia fulun.
verses.14: Entaun Tamar hasai ninia ropa faluk nian no taka nia oin ho veo ida. Nia hatais aan no tuur iha Enaim nia portaun, nebee iha dalan ba Timna. Tanba nia haree katak Selá boot ona no sira seidauk foo nia nudar feen ba Selá.
verses.15: Bainhira Judá haree nia, Judá hanoin katak nia mak feto luroon ida, tanba nia taka ninia oin.
verses.16: No Judá fila ba nia no dehan, “Favór ida, mai husik hau tama ba o.” Tanba Judá la hatene katak feto nee mak ninia feto foun. No feto nee husu, “Ita foo saida mai hau, hodi ita bele tama mai hau?”
verses.17: Judá hataan, “Hau sei haruka bibi oan ida hosi bibi lubun.” Nia dehan, “Ita bele foo buat ruma nudar garantia, too ita haruka buat nee?”
verses.18: Judá husu, “Hau bele foo saida ba o nudar garantia?” Nia hataan, “Ita nia kadeli karimbu, ita nia tali no ita nia ai tonka iha ita nia liman.” Nunee Judá foo kedas sasaan nee. Judá tama ba nia no nia isin rua.
verses.19: Depois feto nee hamriik no sai ba. Nia hasai ninia veo no hatais fali ropa faluk nian.
verses.20: Depois Judá haruka bibi oan ida liu hosi ninia kolega, ema Adulam, hodi hetan ninia sasaan garantia hosi feto nee nia liman. Maibee kolega nee la hetan feto nee.
verses.21: Nia husu ema sira iha fatin nebaa no dehan, “Feto templu nee iha nebee, ida nebee tuur iha dalan ninin iha Enaim?” Ema sira nee hataan, “Iha fatin nee, feto templu la iha.”
verses.22: Entaun nia fila ba Judá no dehan, “Hau la hetan feto nee, no mos ema sira iha fatin nebaa hatete katak feto templu iha fatin nebaa la iha.”
verses.23: Judá dehan, “Husik hela sasaan nee ba nia hodi ema la hamoe ita. Tebes, hau haruka ona bibi oan nee no ita la hetan nia.”
verses.24: Liu tiha fulan tolu, ema foo hatene ba Judá no dehan, “Ita nia feto foun Tamar halo aan hanesan feto aat, no mos, tebes nia sai isin rua ona liu hosi sala seksuál nee.” Judá dehan, “Lori nia sai, no sunu tiha nia.”
verses.25: Bainhira sira lori nia sai dadaun, nia haruka lia menon ba ninia banin mane dehan, “Liu hosi sasaan nee nia nain mak hau sai isin rua. Favór ida, haree took sasaan nee see nian: kadeli karimbu, tali no ai tonka.”
verses.26: Judá haree di-diak sasaan nee no dehan, “Feto nee iha hahalok nebee loos liu fali hau, tanba hau la foo nia ba hau nia oan mane Selá.” No Judá la toba fali ho nia.
verses.27: Tuir mai, bainhira Tamar atu tuur ahi, tebes, oan kaduak iha ninia kabun laran.
verses.28: No bainhira nia tuur ahi, oan ida nia liman sai uluk. Parteira nee kesi kabas mean ida ba nia liman no dehan, “Oan ida nee sai uluk.”
verses.29: Depois oan nee dada fila fali ninia liman, no tebes ninia alin moris uluk nia. Entaun parteira dehan, “Oinsaa o sai mai?” Nunee oan nee nia naran mak Perez.
verses.30: Tuir mai, ninia maun moris mai, ida nebee iha kabas mean iha nia liman, no sira hanaran nia Zera.

verses.1: Ema Ismael sira lori José tuun ba Ejitu. Iha nebaa, Potifar, Faraó nia funsionáriu nebee xefi seguransa, sosa José hosi ema Ismael sira nia liman.
verses.2: Nai hamutuk ho José no nia hetan susesu, no nia hela iha ninia senhor nia uma.
verses.3: Ninia senhor haree katak Nai hamutuk ho nia no Nai foo susesu ba buat hotu nebee nia halo.
verses.4: Entaun José hetan grasa iha ninia senhor nia oin no José serví ninia senhor. Senhor nee halo José sai mandór ba ninia uma, no entrega buat hotu ba José nia liman.
verses.5: Hosi tempu nebee José simu knaar sai mandór iha uma kain nee, ba buat hotu nebee nia senhor iha, Nai haraik bensaun ba ema Ejitu nee nia uma tanba José. No Nai nia bensaun kona buat hotu nebee iha nia uma nee no iha nia rai luan.
verses.6: Potifar husik buat hotu nebee nia iha ba José nia liman. No Potifar la hanoin kona ba buat nebee nia iha, só deit paun nebee nia haan. José mak ema diak no nia ema bonitu.
verses.7: Liu tiha tempu nee, José nia senhor nia feen haree ba José no nia dehan, “Toba lai ho hau.”
verses.8: Maibee José lakohi no dehan ba ninia senhor nia feen, “Tebes, hau nia senhor la hanoin kona ba saida mak iha hau nia liman iha nia uma nee. No nia entrega buat hotu nebee nia iha ba hau nia liman.
verses.9: La iha ema boot liu hau iha uma nee no senhor la tahan buat ida hosi hau só ita deit, tanba ita mak ninia feen. Entaun oinsaa hau bele halo sala boot hanesan nee? Oinsaa hau bele sala hasoru Maromak?”
verses.10: No bainhira feto nee koalia ho José loro-loron, José la rona tuir nia hodi toba ho nia ka tuur hamutuk ho nia.
verses.11: Iha tempu nebaa, José tama ba uma hodi halao ninia servisu no mane seluk iha uma laran nee la iha.
verses.12: Feto nee kaer José nia ropa no dehan, “Toba ho hau!” No José husik nia ropa iha feto nee nia liman no halai sai.
verses.13: Bainhira feto haree katak José husik nia ropa iha feto nee nia liman, no halai sai,
verses.14: nia hakilar ba mane sira hosi uma nee no dehan ba sira, “Haree took, senhor nee lori mai ema Ebreu hodi hamnasa ita. Nia tama hodi toba ho hau no hau hakilar ho lian makaas.
verses.15: No bainhira nia rona katak hau hakilar tiha, nia halai sai.”
verses.16: No feto nee rai José nia ropa too José nia senhor fila mai uma.
verses.17: Nia koalia ho senhor nee no dehan, “Ema Ebreu nebee ita lori mai, nia tama mai hau hodi halimar ho hau.
verses.18: No bainhira hau foti hau nia lian no hakilar nia husik ninia ropa ho hau no halai sai.”
verses.19: Bainhira José nia senhor rona ona ninia feen nia liafuan nebee nia foo hatene ba nia nee, “Ita nia atan halo hanesan nee mai hau,” nia sai hirus loos.
verses.20: José nia senhor foti nia no hatama nia ba komarka, iha fatin nebee liurai nia ema dadur hetan kastigu. No José hela iha komarka nebaa.
verses.21: Maibee Nai hamutuk ho José no hatudu domin metin ba nia. Nai foo grasa ba nia iha xefi komarka nia oin.
verses.22: Xefi komarka entrega ema dadur hotu nebee iha komarka laran ba José nia liman. No buat hotu nebee halao iha nebaa, José mak halo.
verses.23: Xefi komarka la haree ba buat ida nebee iha José nia liman tanba Nai hamutuk ho nia. No Nai foo susesu ba buat hotu nebee nia halo.

40.title: José Foo Mehi Nia Sentidu Iha Komarka

verses.1: Liu tiha tempu nee, ema nebee toma konta ba buat nebee liurai Ejitu mak hemu no liurai nia padeiru halo sala hasoru sira nia senhor, liurai Ejitu.
verses.2: Faraó sai hirus ba ninia funsionáriu nain rua nee, ba xefi hemu nian no ba xefi padeiru.
verses.3: Liurai hatama sira ba kadeia iha xefi seguransa nia fatin, nebee iha komarka, iha fatin nebee José iha kastigu.
verses.4: Xefi seguransa foo knaar ba José hodi tau matan ba sira no nia serví sira. Nunee sira hela iha kadeia nee too tempu balu.
verses.5: Iha kalan ida, sira nain rua hetan mehi - liurai Ejitu nia xefi hemu nian no xefi padeiru nebee hetan kastigu iha komarka. Ida-idak hetan ninia mehi no mehi ida-idak iha ninia signifikadu.
verses.6: Iha dadeer-saan, José tama ba sira no haree sira no tebes sira nain rua tristi.
verses.7: Entaun José husu Faraó nia funsionáriu nain rua nebee iha ninia senhor nia kadeia hamutuk ho nia no dehan, “Tanba saa mak imi oin tristi ohin loron?”
verses.8: Sira hataan, “Ami hetan mehi no la iha ema ida nebee bele esplika signifikadu.” José dehan ba sira, “Laos signifikadu mak Maromak nian? Favór ida, konta took mai hau.”
verses.9: Entaun xefi hemu nian konta ninia mehi ba José no dehan, “Iha hau nia mehi, tebes ai uvas huun ida mak iha hau nia oin.
verses.10: No ai uvas nee iha sanak tolu. Sanak nee dikin no funan mosu mai. Nia foo fuan kedas nebee iha uvas tasak.
verses.11: Hau kaer Faraó nia kopu iha hau nia liman no hau foti uvas sira nee no buti hodi nia been tama Faraó nia kopu. Depois hau foo kopu nee ba Faraó nia liman.”
verses.12: José dehan ba nia, “Ida nee mak signifikadu: ai sanak tolu mak loron tolu.
