verses.13: Iha loron tolu nia laran, Faraó sei foti sae ita nia ulun no hatama fali ita ba ita nia fatin. No ita sei servisu hodi foo kopu ba Faraó nia liman, hanesan tempu uluk bainhira ita toma konta ba liurai nia kopu hemu nian.
verses.14: Maibee bainhira ita hetan moris diak, hanoin hau no favór ida hatudu domin metin mai hau no foo hatene ba Faraó kona ba hau hodi hasai hau hosi kadeia nee.
verses.15: Tanba tuir lo-loos, ema naok hau hosi ema Ebreu sira nia rai no iha nee mos hau la halo buat ida hodi sira hatama hau ba rai kuak nee.”
verses.16: Bainhira xefi padeiru haree katak signifikadu nee diak, nia dehan ba José, “Hau mos iha mehi, no tebes, raga tolu iha hau nia ulun ho paun.
verses.17: Raga ida iha leten liu iha hahaan oi-oin nebee tunu ba Faraó. No manu sira haan buat nee hosi raga nebee iha hau nia ulun leten.”
verses.18: José hataan ba nia no dehan, “Signifikadu mak nee: raga tolu mak loron tolu.
verses.19: Iha loron tolu nia laran Faraó sei foti sae ita nia ulun - hosi ita nia isin lolon! No nia sei tara ita iha ai huun ida no manu sira sei haan ita nia isin.”
verses.20: Liu tiha loron tolu, iha loron nebee Faraó halo tinan, no nia halo festa ida ba ninia atan sira hotu. Faraó foti sae ulun hosi xefi padeiru no xefi hemu nian iha ninia atan sira nia leet.
verses.21: No nia foo fali knaar ba xefi hemu nian hodi xefi nee bele foo hemu fali, no xefi nee foo fali kopu ba Faraó nia liman.
verses.22: Maibee Faraó tara mate xefi padeiru tuir signifikadu nebee José konta ona ba sira.
verses.23: Maibee xefi hemu nian nee la hanoin José, no nia haluha José.

41.title: José Foo Signifikadu Ba Faraó Nia Mehi

verses.1: Liu tiha tinan rua, Faraó hetan mehi, no tebes, nia hamriik iha Mota Nilu ninin.
verses.2: Tebes, karau hitu sae mai hosi mota nee, karau nebee isin diak no bokur no sira haan iha duut fatin nee.
verses.3: No tebes, tuir mai, karau hitu tan sae mai hosi Mota Nilu, karau nebee isin la diak no krekas no sira hamriik iha karau sira seluk nee nia sorin iha mota ninin.
verses.4: Depois karau sira nebee isin la diak no krekas nee haan fali karau hitu nebee isin diak no bokur. Depois Faraó hadeer.
verses.5: Faraó toba dukur fali no nia hetan mehi segundu: tebes, batar fulin hitu mosu mai iha kain ida, no sira boot no diak.
verses.6: No Tebes, batar fulin hitu mosu mai tuir batar uluk nian, no sira krekas no maran tanba anin manas hamaran sira.
verses.7: No batar fulin hitu nebee krekas tolan fali batar fulin hitu nebee diak no nakonu. Depois Faraó hadeer, no tebes buat nee mak mehi deit.
verses.8: Iha dadeer-saan, Faraó iha laran susar. Nia haruka ema bolu ema matan dook hotu iha Ejitu, no ema matenek klean hotu, no Faraó konta ninia mehi ba sira. Maibee la iha ema ida nebee bele foo mehi nia signifikadu ba Faraó.
verses.9: Depois, Faraó nia xefi hemu nian koalia no dehan, “Hau hanoin hau nia sala sira ohin loron.
verses.10: Uluk, Faraó hirus ho ninia atan sira, no hatama hau iha kadeia nebee iha xefi seguransa nia uma, hau no xefi padeiru.
verses.11: Iha kalan ida, ami hetan mehi, hau no nia. Ami ida-idak iha ninia mehi no mehi rua nee iha signifikadu keta-ketak.
verses.12: Iha fatin nebaa iha joven mane ida, ema Ebreu ida, nebee xefi seguransa nia atan. No ami konta mehi nee ba nia no nia foo mehi nia signifikadu. Nia konta signifikadu ida-idak ba ami nain rua.
verses.13: No tuir mai, buat nebee akontese tuir ninia liafuan. Hau tama fali ba hau nia servisu no ema seluk tara mate tiha.”
verses.14: Entaun Faraó haruka ema bolu José, no sira lori nia lalais hosi rai kuak. Nia koi ninia fuuk, troka ninia ropa no tama ba Faraó.
verses.15: Faraó dehan ba José, “Hau hetan mehi ida no la iha ema ida nebee bele foo ninia signifikadu. Hau rona istória kona ba o katak o bele kompriende mehi no foo ninia signifikadu.”
verses.16: José hataan ba Faraó no dehan, “Laos hau, maibee Maromak sei foo liafuan diak nian ba Faraó.”
verses.17: Faraó dehan ba José, “Iha hau nia mehi, tebes, hau hamriik iha Mota Nilu nia ninin.
verses.18: No tebes, karau hitu sae mai hosi mota nee, no sira iha isin diak no bokur, no sira haan iha duut fatin.
verses.19: No tebes, karau hitu seluk sae mai tuir karau uluk sira. No karau sira nee mak fraku no isin la diak liu no krekas, hanesan hau nunka haree karau aat hanesan nee iha rai Ejitu tomak.
verses.20: No karau sira nebee krekas no isin la diak mak haan karau bokur sira nebee mai uluk.
verses.21: Bainhira karau sira nee haan tiha hotu, ita la bele hatene katak sira haan ona, maibee sira la diak hela hanesan uluk. Depois hau hadeer.
verses.22: No hau haree iha mehi fali, no tebes, batar fulin hitu mosu mai hosi kain ida, nakonu no diak.
verses.23: No tebes, iha batar fulin hitu nebee namlaik, krekas no maran tanba anin manas. No batar nee mosu mai tuir uluk nian.
verses.24: No batar fulin sira nebee krekas tolan batar fulin hitu nebee diak. Hau foo hatene ona mehi nee ba matan dook sira maibee la iha ida nebee bele esplika mai hau.”
verses.25: José dehan ba Faraó, “Faraó nia mehi mak mehi ida deit. Maromak hatudu ona ba Faraó saida mak Nia atu halo.
verses.26: Karau hitu diak nee mak tinan hitu, no batar fulin hitu diak mak tinan hitu. Mehi nee mak mehi ida deit.
verses.27: Karau hitu nebee krekas no la diak nebee tuir uluk nian mak tinan hitu, no batar fulin nebee mamuk no maran tanba anin manas huu mak tinan hitu mos nebee rai hamlaha.
verses.28: Buat nebee hau konta ona ba Faraó mak buat nebee Maromak atu halo no Nia hatudu ba Faraó.
verses.29: Tebes, tinan hitu sei mai nebee ita hetan barak loos iha rai Ejitu tomak.
verses.30: Tuir tinan sira nee mak tinan hitu nebee rai hamlaha. No ema sei haluha buat barak nebee mai uluk iha rai Ejitu. Rai hamlaha nee sei tolan rai.
verses.31: No ema sei la hatene katak rai nee uluk hetan barak tanba rai hamlaha nebee tuir mai, tanba tempu nee sei sai tempu todan loos.
verses.32: Faraó hetan mehi rua nee tanba Maromak halo planu nee metin ona no tempu nee besik mai ona.
verses.33: Nunee diak liu Faraó buka ema ida nebee iha kompriensaun no matenek klean no foo knaar ba nia hodi tau matan ba rai Ejitu.
verses.34: Faraó bele haruka ema ida nee tau funsionáriu sira iha rai nee no foti porsentu rua-nulu hosi rai Ejitu durante tinan hitu nebee ita hetan produsaun barak.
verses.35: No husik nia haloot ai haan hotu nee hosi tinan diak sira nebee atu mai nee. Haloot ai haan nee hodi Faraó mak kontrola. Sira bele rai ai haan nee iha sidade sira nia laran.
verses.36: No reserva ai haan nee ba rai Ejitu hodi hasoru rai hamlaha durante tinan hitu nebee sei kona rai Ejitu, hodi rai nee la lakon iha tempu rai hamlaha.” José nia kadeli iha karimbu hodi taka metin surat
verses.37: No liafuan nee diak iha Faraó nia oin no iha ninia atan hotu nia oin.
verses.38: Faraó dehan ba ninia atan sira, “Ita bele hetan mane ida seluk nebee hanesan nee ka, nebee iha Espíritu Maromak nian?”
verses.39: Faraó dehan ba José, “Maromak hatudu ona buat hotu nee, no la iha ema ida nebee iha kompriensaun no matenek klean hanesan o.
verses.40: Nunee o sei tau matan ba hau nia uma, no hau nia povu hotu sei hakruuk ba o nia liafuan, só iha hau nia kadunan deit mak hau boot liu o.”
verses.41: No Faraó dehan ba José, “Haree katak hau foo rai Ejitu tomak ba o.”
verses.42: Faraó hasai ninia kadeli nebee karimbu hosi ninia liman no tau ba José nia liman. Nia foo hatais José ho ropa diak no tara korenti osan mean ba José nia kakorok.
verses.43: Faraó foo ninia kuda kareta segundu nian ba José. Ema lao uluk José no hakilar, “Hakneak ba!” No nia halo hodi José bele ukun rai Ejitu tomak.
verses.44: Faraó dehan ba José, “Hau mak Faraó, nunee la iha mane ida nebee foti nia liman ka ain iha rai Ejitu tomak, só o foo lisensa lai.”
verses.45: Faraó hanaran José, Zafnat-Panea, no nia foo kaben José ho feto ida naran Asenat, oan feto hosi Potifera, nebee amu lulik iha On.
verses.46: José tinan tolu-nulu bainhira nia hamriik hodi serví Faraó, liurai hosi Ejitu. José sai hosi Faraó nia prezensa no lao ba-mai iha rai Ejitu tomak.
verses.47: Iha tinan hitu nebee iha ai haan barak, sira hetan rezultadu boot hosi rai.
verses.48: José haloot ai haan hotu hosi rai Ejitu durante tinan hitu nee. Nia tau ai haan nee iha sidade sira nia laran. Nia tau ai haan hosi toos nebee haleu sidade ida-idak nia rai iha sidade ida-idak nee nia laran.
verses.49: José halibur batar barak la halimar, hanesan rai henek iha tasi, too nia husik sistema nebee sura, tanba ai haan nee la bele sura.
verses.50: Molok tempu rai hamlaha, José iha oan mane nain rua, nebee Asenat hetan. Feto nee mak oan feto hosi Potifera, amu lulik iha On.
verses.51: José hanaran oan mane primeiru Manasés, no nia dehan, “Tanba Maromak halo hau haluha tiha hau nia tempu susar hotu no hau nia aman nia uma kain tomak.”
verses.52: Oan segundu nia hanaran Efraim, “Tanba Maromak halo hau foo fuan iha rai nebee hau hetan terus.”
verses.53: Tinan hitu nebee hetan barak loos iha rai Ejitu remata ona.
verses.54: No tinan hitu nebee tempu hamlaha mai, tuir José nia liafuan. No tempu hamlaha hasoru rai hotu, maibee iha rai Ejitu, ai haan sei iha.
verses.55: Bainhira rai tomak iha Ejitu mak hamlaha, povu nee hakilar ba Faraó hodi hetan ai haan no Faraó dehan, “Imi baa José, no tuir ninia liafuan.”
verses.56: Rai hamlaha kona rai hotu iha mundu. José loke armajén sira nee no faan ba ema Ejitu sira. Rai hamlaha nee sai susar liu iha rai Ejitu.
verses.57: Nasaun hotu mai Ejitu ba José hodi sosa ai haan tanba rai hamlaha nee susar loos iha rai hotu.

42.title: José Nia Maun Sira Baa Ejitu

verses.1: Bainhira Jacó hatene katak batar iha Ejitu, nia dehan ba ninia oan mane sira, “Nusaa mak imi hateke ba malu deit?”
verses.2: No nia dehan, “Tebes, hau rona ona katak batar iha Ejitu. Tuun ba Ejitu no sosa hosi nebaa hodi ita bele moris hela no la mate.”
verses.3: José nia maun nain sanulu tuun ba hodi sosa batar iha Ejitu.
verses.4: Maibee Jacó la haruka Benjamin, José nia alin, atu baa hamutuk ho ninia maun sira tanba nia dehan, “Keta halo be buat aat hasoru nia.”
verses.5: Israel nia oan mane sira mai hodi sosa ai haan hamutuk ho ema seluk tanba rai hamlaha kona mos rai Kanaan.
verses.6: José mak governadór iha rai nebaa no nia faan ai haan ba ema hotu iha rai nee. No José nia maun sira mai no hakneak ho oin ba rai iha José nia oin.
verses.7: José haree ninia maun sira no nia konhese sira maibee nia la foo sai ninia aan ba sira. Nia koalia hirus ho sira no nia husu, “Imi hosi nebee?” Sira hataan, “Hosi rai Kanaan hodi sosa ai haan.”
verses.8: No José konhese ninia maun sira maibee sira la konhese nia.
verses.9: José hanoin hetan ninia mehi nebee nia mehi kona ba sira, no nia dehan ba sira, “Imi mak espiaun! Imi mai hodi buka rai nee nia fatin nebee fraku.”
verses.10: Sira hataan ba nia, “Lae, ami nia senhor, maibee ita boot nia atan ami nee mai hodi sosa ai haan.
verses.11: Ami hotu mak oan mane sira hosi aman ida deit. Ami koalia loos, ita boot nia atan ami nee laos espiaun.”
verses.12: José dehan, “Lae! Maibee imi mai hodi buka rai nee nia fatin nebee fraku.”
verses.13: Sira dehan, “Ita boot nia atan ami nee mak ema nain sanulu resin rua. Ami mak oan mane sira hosi mane ida iha rai Kanaan. Tebes, alin ikun sei hela ho ami nia aman, no ida la iha ona.”
verses.14: José dehan ba sira, “Nee mak hanesan hau hatete ona, ‘Imi mak espiaun’.
verses.15: Imi bele prova aan hanesan nee: hodi Faraó nebee moris, imi sei la sai hosi fatin nee, só deit imi nia alin ikun mai iha nee.
verses.16: Haruka ema ida hosi imi nia leet hodi baa no lori mai imi nia alin nee. Imi restu sei tama ba komarka too imi nia istória prova loos ona, hodi haree katak imi koalia loos ka lae. Se lae, hodi Faraó nebee moris, imi mak espiaun duni.”
verses.17: No nia tau sira hamutuk iha uma kadeia too loron tolu.
verses.18: Iha loron terseiru nia dehan ba sira, “Halo tuir hanesan nee no imi sei moris, tanba hau hamtauk Maromak.
verses.19: Se imi koalia loos, husik ema ida hetan kastigu hela iha uma kadeia nee no imi restu bele baa. Lori batar nee tanba imi nia uma kain sira hasoru rai hamlaha.
verses.20: Maibee lori imi nia alin ikun mai fali hau hodi prova imi nia liafuan. Nunee imi sei la mate.” No sira halo tuir.
verses.21: Sira dehan ba malu, “Tuir loloos, ita hetan terus nee tanba ita nia sala uluk kona ba ita nia alin. Ita haree ninia terus iha nia klamar bainhira nia husu grasa maibee ita la rona.”
verses.22: Ruben hataan ba sira no dehan, “Laos hau koalia ona ba imi no dehan, ‘Keta halo sala hasoru labarik nee’, maibee imi lakohi rona. Tebes, ita tenki selu fali kona ba ninia raan.”
verses.23: Sira la hatene katak José kompriende sira, tanba nia koalia ho sira liu hosi ema ida nebee tradus ninia liafuan.
verses.24: No nia fila oin hosi sira no tanis. Depois nia fila ba sira no koalia ho sira. Nia foti Simeão no kesi nia iha sira nia oin.
verses.25: Depois José haruka ema enxe nakonu sira nia karoon sira ho batar no foo fali ema ida-idak nia osan iha ninia karoon no foo bukae hodi haan iha dalan. Nunee ema halo hanesan nee ba sira.
verses.26: Sira tau batar nee ba sira nia kuda buru sira no sai hosi fatin nee.
verses.27: No bainhira sira too iha toba fatin, ema ida loke ninia karoon hodi foo haan ba ninia kuda buru no nia haree ninia osan tanba tebes osan nee iha saku nia ibun.
verses.28: Nia dehan ba ninia maun-alin sira, “Hau hetan hau nia osan fali, no tebes, osan nee iha hau nia karoon.” No sira nia fuan laran nakdedar. Sira sai tauk no dehan ba malu, “Saida mak Maromak halo ba ita?”
verses.29: Bainhira sira too sira nia aman Jacó iha rai Kanaan, sira konta buat hotu nebee akontese ba sira no dehan,
verses.30: “Mane ida nebee nai ulun iha rai nebaa, nia koalia hirus mai ami, no nia hanoin katak ami mak espiaun iha rai nebaa.
verses.31: No ami dehan ba nia, ‘Ami koalia lo-loos. Ami laos espiaun.
verses.32: Ami mak maun-alin sira nain sanulu resin rua, oan mane sira hosi ami nia aman. Alin ida la iha ona no alin ikun sei hela ho ami nia aman iha rai Kanaan.’
verses.33: No mane ida nebee nai ulun iha rai nebaa dehan mai ami, ‘Liu hosi liafuan nee mak hau bele hatene katak imi koalia lo-loos: husik ema ida hosi imi nia leet hodi hela ho hau, no foti ai haan ba imi nia uma kain nebee ai haan la iha no baa.
verses.34: Depois lori mai hau imi nia alin ikun. Nunee hau sei hatene katak imi laos espiaun maibee ema loos. Depois hau sei husik imi nia maluk ida nee no imi bele lao ba-mai iha rai nee.’”
verses.35: Bainhira sira hasai ai haan hosi sira nia karoon sira nee, tebes, ema ida-idak hetan ninia osan iha ninia karoon. Bainhira sira haree sira nia osan hamutuk ho sira nia aman nee, sira tauk.
verses.36: Sira nia aman Jacó dehan ba sira, “Imi halakon hau nia oan sira: José la iha, Simeão la iha no imi sei lori Benjamin. Buat hotu nee hasoru hau.”
verses.37: Ruben koalia ho ninia aman no dehan, “Se karik hau la lori fali Benjamin ba ita, nunee ita bele oho hau nia oan mane rua. Entrega nia ba hau nia liman no hau sei lori nia mai fali.”
verses.38: Maibee Jacó dehan, “Hau nia oan mane sei la tuun ba ho imi. Tanba ninia maun mate ona, no hela nia deit. Se karik buat aat hasoru nia iha dalan nebee imi lao, nunee imi sei hatuun hau nia fuuk mutin ba rate ho laran tristi.”

43.title: José Nia Maun-Alin Sira Fila Fali Ba Ejitu

verses.1: Rai hamlaha boot sei kona rai nee.
verses.2: Bainhira sira haan hotu batar nebee sira lori hosi Ejitu, sira nia aman dehan ba sira, “Baa fali no sosa ai haan uitoan.”
verses.3: Judá hataan ba nia, “Mane ida nee koalia klaru ona mai ami no dehan, ‘Imi la bele haree hau nia oin fali, só imi nia alin mane hamutuk ho imi.’
verses.4: Se ita haruka ami nia alin mane nee baa ho ami, nunee ami sei tuun ba no sosa ai haan ba ita.
verses.5: Maibee sei ita la haruka nia, ami sei la tuun ba. Tanba mane nee dehan ona, ‘Imi la bele haree hau nia oin fali, só imi nia alin mane hamutuk ho imi.’”
verses.6: Israel dehan, “Tanba saa mak imi halo aat mai hau no foo hatene ba mane nee katak imi sei iha alin mane ida?”
verses.7: Sira hataan, “Mane nee husu deit kona ba ami nia moris no ami nia família. Nia husu, ‘Imi nia aman moris hela ka? Imi iha alin mane ida tan ka?’ No ami foo hatene ba nia tuir ninia pergunta. Oinsaa ami bele hatene katak nia atu dehan, ‘Lori imi nia alin tuun mai’?”
verses.8: Judá dehan ba ninia aman Israel, “Haruka labarik nee baa hamutuk ho hau, no ami sei hamriik no baa, hodi ami bele moris no la mate, inklui ami no ita no ita nia oan kiik sira.
verses.9: No hau rasik sei sai garantia ba nia, no ita bele husu hetan nia hosi hau nia liman. Se hau la lori nia mai fali no rai nia iha ita nia oin, ita bele foo sala nee mai hau too rohan laek.
verses.10: Tanba se karik ami la dada tempu ona, ami bele ba-mai ba dala rua ona.”
verses.11: Nunee sira nia aman Israel dehan ba sira, “Se karik tenki hanesan nee agora, entaun halo tuir liafuan nee: lori ai fuan sira nebee diak liu hosi rai nee iha imi nia sanan sira, no lori prezenti ida ba mane nee, mina balsamu uitoan, bani been uitoan, ai morin ladanu, mira, pistásia no amendueira sira.
verses.12: No lori osan dala rua iha imi nia liman. Lori fali osan nebee imi hetan iha imi nia karoon. Karik sira tau sala.
verses.13: Lori mos imi nia alin mane. Hamriik ba no fila fali ba mane nee.
verses.14: No hau hein katak Maromak Kbiit Makaas sei foo laran luak ba mane nee katak nia bele haruka sai imi nia maun seluk nee no mos Benjamin. Sei karik hau lakon sira, entaun hau lakon ba.”
verses.15: Entaun mane sira nee lori prezenti ida nee, osan dala rua no Benjamin. Sira hamriik no tuun ba Ejitu no hamriik iha José nia oin.
verses.16: Bainhira José haree Benjamin hamutuk ho sira, nia koalia ba mane ida nebee tau matan ba ninia uma no dehan, “Lori mane sira nee ba hau nia uma, oho animál ida no prepara ba, tanba mane sira nee sei haan meiudia ho hau.”
verses.17: No ema ida nee halo tuir José nia liafuan. Ema nee lori mane sira nee ba José nia uma.
verses.18: Mane sira nee sei tauk, tanba ema lori sira ba José nia uma no sira dehan, “Tanba osan nebee ami hetan iha ami nia karoon iha tempu primeiru, tanba nee mak nia lori ami tama uma nee. Hodi nunee nia bele halo aat mai ami, no kastigu ami, no halo ami sai ninia atan sira no hetan ami nia kuda buru sira.”
verses.19: Sira baa ema ida nebee tau matan ba José nia uma no sira koalia ho nia iha odamatan ba uma nee,
verses.20: no sira dehan, “Oh senhor, loos duni ami tuun mai ba dala ida hodi sosa ai haan.
verses.21: Bainhira ami lao fila fali too toba fatin, ami loke ami nia karoon sira, no tebes, mane ida-idak nia osan mak iha ninia karoon nia ibun laran, ami nia osan hotu. Nunee ami lori mai fali iha ami nia liman.
verses.22: No ami lori osan tan hodi sosa ai haan. Maibee ami la hatene see mak tau osan nee iha ami nia karoon.”
verses.23: Mane nee hataan, “Salóm, keta tauk. Imi nia Maromak, no imi nia aman nia Maromak mak foo riku-soin iha imi nia karoon. Hau hetan ona imi nia osan.” Depois nia lori Simeão sai ba sira.
verses.24: Mane nee lori sira tama ba José nia uma. Nia foo bee ba sira hodi fasi sira nia ain no nia foo haan ba sira nia kuda buru sira nee.
verses.25: No sira prepara sira nia prezenti hodi foo ba José bainhira nia mai iha meiudia tanba sira rona katak sira atu haan iha nebaa.
verses.26: Bainhira José fila ba uma, sira lori prezenti ida nee ba uma laran no hakneak ho oin ba rai iha José nia oin.
verses.27: José husu sira oinsaa no dehan, “Imi nia aman nebee katuas ona nee diak ka lae? Nia moris hela ka?”
verses.28: Sira hataan, “Ita boot nia atan ami nia aman sei diak no nia moris hela.” No sira hakruuk fali no hakneak iha nia oin.
verses.29: José foti nia matan no haree ninia alin Benjamin, nebee ninia inan rasik nia oan mane, no nia husu, “Ida nee mak imi nia alin mane nebee imi konta uluk mai hau ka?” No nia dehan, “Maromak haraik grasa ba o, hau nia oan mane.”
verses.30: No José sai lalais, tanba nia laran hanoin tebe-tebes ba ninia alin mane nee. Nia buka fatin hodi tanis, no nia tama ba ninia kuartu no tanis iha nebaa.
verses.31: Depois nia fasi ninia oin no sai fali. Nia kontrola aan no dehan, “Lori paun lai.”
verses.32: No atan sira lori hahaan ketak ba nia, no hahaan ketak ba sira, tanba iha ema Ejitu seluk nebee haan ho José. Ema Ejitu la haan hamutuk ho ema Ebreu, tanba buat nee mak sala ba ema Ejitu.
verses.33: José nia maun-alin sira tuur iha nia oin, oan mane primeiru tuir ninia direitu nudar oan boot too oan mane ikun tuir ninia idade joven nian. No mane sira nee haree ba malu no hakfodak.
verses.34: José haruka ema foo haan ba sira hosi ninia meza, maibee Benjamin nia hahaan mak barak liu dala lima kompara ho nia maun sira seluk. Nunee sira haan-hemu too bosu ho José.

verses.1: José haruka ema nebee tau matan ba ninia uma no dehan, “Halo nakonu mane ida-idak nia karoon ho ai haan, barak too sira la bele lori tan, no tau fali mane ida-idak nia osan iha ninia karoon nia ibun laran.
verses.2: No tau hau nia kopu, ida nebee kopu osan mutin, iha ema ikun nee nia karoon nia ibun laran hamutuk ho nia osan nebee nia lori hodi sosa ai haan.” No ema nee halo tuir José nia liafuan.
verses.3: Iha dadeer-saan bainhira rai foin naroman ona, ema haruka mane sira nee sai hamutuk ho sira nia kuda buru sira.
verses.4: Bainhira sira sai ona hosi sidade nee, no seidauk dook, José haruka ema nebee tau matan ba ninia uma, “Hamriik ba, no duni tuir ema sira nee. Bainhira o toman sira, husu ba sira, ‘Tanba saa mak imi selu fali buat diak ho buat aat?
verses.5: Laos buat nee mak hau nia senhor nia kopu nebee nia rasik uza hodi hemu no hodi siik? Imi nia hahalok nee mak aat.’”
verses.6: Bainhira nia toman sira nia koalia hanesan nee ba sira.
verses.7: Sira hataan ba nia, “Nusaa mak ami nia senhor koalia hanesan nee? Dook hosi ami, nebee ita boot nia atan sira, katak ami halo hanesan nee.
verses.8: Tebes, osan nebee uluk ami hetan iha ami nia karoon ibun sira, osan nee ami lori fila fali hosi ami nia rai Kanaan. Nunee oinsaa mak ami naok fali osan mean ka osan mutin hosi ita boot nia senhor nia uma?
verses.9: Se karik ita boot hetan buat nee iha ita boot nia atan ami nee, husik ema ida nee bele mate, no ami seluk bele sai ita boot nia atan sira.”
verses.10: Nia hataan, “Bele tuir hanesan imi nia liafuan: ema ida nebee iha buat nee sei sai hau nia atan, maibee imi restu nee sei inosenti.”
verses.11: Depois sira hatuun lalais sira nia karoon sira ba rai. No ema ida-idak loke ninia saku.
verses.12: José nia mane nee revista, no nia komesa hosi ida primeiru too ida ikun, no nia hetan kopu nee iha Benjamin nia karoon.
verses.13: Sira lees sira nia ropa. No ema ida-idak tau fali ninia karoon ba ninia kuda buru no sira fila ba sidade.
verses.14: Judá no ninia maun-alin sira baa too iha José nia uma, tanba nia iha nebaa hela, no sira monu ba rai iha ninia oin.
verses.15: José dehan ba sira, “Imi halo saida? Imi la hatene ka, katak hau mak ema nebee bele siik?”
verses.16: Judá dehan, “Ami bele dehan saida ba ami nia senhor? Oinsaa ami bele koalia? Oinsaa ami bele hatudu ami nia laran loos? Maromak mak hetan sala iha ita boot nia atan ami. Tebes, ami mak hau nia senhor nia atan sira, ami hotu inklui ida nebee iha kopu nebee ema foin hetan nee.”
verses.17: José dehan, “Dook hosi hau, katak hau halo hanesan nee. Mane ida deit nebee iha kopu iha nia liman, nia mak sai hau nia atan. Maibee imi seluk, hamriik no baa ho dame ba imi nia aman.”
verses.18: Nunee Judá hakbesik ba José no dehan, “Oh hau nia senhor, favór ida, husik ita boot nia atan hau koalia liafuan ida iha hau nia senhor nia tilun, tanba ita boot mak hanesan Faraó.
verses.19: Hau nia senhor husu ona ninia atan ami no dehan, ‘Imi iha aman ka alin mane ka?’
verses.20: no ami hataan ba hau nia senhor, ‘Ami iha aman ida nebee katuas ona, no mos labarik ida nebee nia hetan bainhira nia katuas. Labarik nee kiik oan deit, no nia maun rasik mate ona. Só nia mesak deit hosi ninia inan rasik no ninia aman hadomi nia.
verses.21: No ita boot dehan ba ita boot nia atan ami, ‘Lori nia tuun mai hau, hodi hau bele haree nia.’
verses.22: Ami dehan ba hau nia senhor, ‘Labarik nee la bele husik ninia aman, tanba sei karik nia husik ninia aman, nunee ninia aman sei mate.’
verses.23: No ita boot dehan ba ita boot nia atan ami, ‘Se karik imi nia alin mane la tuun mai ho imi, nunee imi sei la haree tan hau nia oin.’
verses.24: Tuir mai, bainhira ami too ita boot nia atan, nebee hau nia aman, ami foo hatene ba nia kona ba hau nia senhor nia liafuan.
verses.25: No ami nia aman dehan, ‘Baa fali, no sosa ai haan uitoan tan.’
verses.26: No ami dehan, ‘Ami la bele tuun ba. Se karik ami nia alin mane ikun nee baa hamutuk ho ami, nunee ami sei tuun baa. Tanba ami la bele haree fali mane nee nia oin, só deit ami nia alin mane ikun mak hamutuk ho ami.’
verses.27: No ita boot nia atan, nebee hau nia aman, dehan mai ami, ‘Imi hatene katak hau nia feen tuur ahi ona no hetan oan rua.
verses.28: Ida sai ona hosi hau no hau dehan: Loos duni buat ruma lees mate nia, no too agora hau la haree fali nia.
verses.29: No se karik imi lori mos oan ida nee hosi hau no buat aat ruma hasoru nia, nunee imi sei hatuun hau nia fuuk mutin ba rate ho laran tristi.’
verses.30: Nunee bainhira hau fila ba ita boot nia atan, nebee hau nia aman nee, no labarik nee la hamutuk ho ami, no tanba ninia moris mak kesi hamutuk ho labarik nee nia moris,
verses.31: bainhira nia haree katak labarik nee la iha, nia sei mate kedas, no ita boot nia atan ami sei hatuun ita boot nia atan, nebee ami nia aman, nia fuuk mutin ba rate ho laran tristi.
verses.32: Tanba ita boot nia atan hau sai garantia ba labarik nee ba hau nia aman, no hau dehan, ‘Se karik hau la lori fali nia ba ita, entaun aman sei foo sala nee mai hau no hau sei lori sala nee too rohan laek.’
verses.33: Entaun, favór ida, simu ita boot nia atan hau hodi sai hau nia senhor nia atan, no husik labarik nee fila fali ho ninia maun sira.
verses.34: Tanba oinsaa hau bele fila fali ba hau nia aman no labarik nee la iha? Keta halo be hau haree buat aat nee akontese ba hau nia aman.”

45.title: José Foo Sai Ninia Aan Ba Sira

verses.1: José la bele kontrola aan iha ema sira nebee hamriik iha nia oin, no nia hakilar, “Haruka ema hotu sai hosi hau!” Entaun la iha ema ida nebee hamriik ho nia bainhira nia foo sai ninia aan ba ninia maun-alin sira.
verses.2: José tanis makaas no ema Ejitu sira no Faraó nia uma kain rona.
verses.3: José dehan ba ninia maun-alin sira, “Hau mak José! Hau nia apaa moris hela ka?” Ninia maun-alin sira la bele hataan ba nia tanba sira hakfodak iha ninia prezensa.
verses.4: José dehan ba ninia maun-alin sira, “Favór ida, hakbesik mai hau.” No sira hakbesik ba. Nia dehan, “Hau mak José, imi nia alin, nebee imi faan ba iha Ejitu.
verses.5: Agora, keta tristi ka hirus ho imi nia aan katak imi faan hau ba iha fatin nee, tanba Maromak mak haruka hau uluk imi hodi kuidadu ema nia moris.
verses.6: Tanba rai hamlaha too tinan rua ona, maibee sei hela tinan lima nebee ema la fila rai ka hetan rezultadu.
verses.7: Maromak haruka hau uluk imi hodi kuidadu imi nia jerasaun iha mundu nee, hodi imi nia bei-oan barak bele kontinua moris.
verses.8: Nunee laos imi mak haruka hau mai iha nee maibee Maromak. Nia mak halo hau sai aman ba Faraó, no nai ulun ba Faraó nia uma tomak, no ukun nain ba rai Ejitu tomak.
verses.9: Fila lalais ba hau nia aman no dehan ba nia, ‘Ita nia oan mane José dehan, Maromak mak halo hau sai nai ulun ba Ejitu tomak. Tuun mai hau lai, no keta hein.
verses.10: Ita sei hela iha rai Gosen, hodi ita hela besik hau, ita, ita nia oan sira no ita nia bei-oan sira, ita nia bibi lubun sira, ita nia karau lubun sira no buat hotu nebee ita iha.
verses.11: No iha nebaa hau sei foo haan ba ita, tanba rai hamlaha sei lao too tinan lima tan. Keta halo be ita, ita nia uma kain no buat hotu nebee ita iha sai kiak liu.’
verses.12: Tebes, imi nia matan haree, no hau nia alin Benjamin nia matan haree, katak hau nia ibun rasik koalia ho imi.
verses.13: Imi tenki foo hatene ba hau nia aman kona ba hau nia glória hotu iha Ejitu, no kona ba buat hotu nebee imi haree ona. Baa lalais no lori hau nia aman tuun mai iha nee.”
verses.14: Depois nia hakuak ninia alin Benjamin no tanis iha Benjamin nia kakorok, no Benjamin mos tanis iha José nia kakorok.
verses.15: José rei ninia maun sira hotu no tanis ho sira. Depois ninia maun-alin sira koalia ho nia.
verses.16: Ema hotu iha Faraó nia uma rona kona ba istória nee no sira dehan, “José nia maun-alin sira mai ona.” No Faraó no ninia atan sira kontenti kona ba ida nee.
verses.17: Faraó dehan ba José, “Foo hatene ba o nia maun-alin sira, ‘Halo ida nee: tau sasaan ba imi nia animál sira no baa rai Kanaan.
verses.18: No foti imi nia aman, imi nia uma kain sira no fila mai hau. No hau sei foo ba imi buat diak hosi rai Ejitu no imi sei haan bokur iha rai nee.’
verses.19: No José, o tenki dehan, ‘Halo ida nee: lori kuda kareta boot sira hosi rai Ejitu hodi tula imi nia oan kiik sira no imi nia feen sira, no lori imi nia aman mai.
verses.20: Lalika hanoin kona ba imi nia sasaan tanba buat diak liu hosi rai tomak iha Ejitu mak imi nian.’”
verses.21: Entaun Israel nia oan sira halo tuir. José foo kuda kareta boot ba sira, tuir Faraó nia orden, no nia foo bukae ba sira nia viajen.
verses.22: Nia foo ba sira hotu ropa hodi hatais. Maibee ba Benjamin nia foo osan mutin atus tolu, no ropa tahan lima.
verses.23: Nia haruka ba nia aman: kuda buru sanulu nebee tula sasaan diak hosi Ejitu no kuda buru inan sanulu nebee tula batar, paun no bukae ba ninia aman nia viajen.
verses.24: Nunee nia haruka ninia maun-alin sira sai, no nia dehan ba sira, “Keta hirus malu iha dalan.”
verses.25: Entaun sira sai hosi Ejitu no baa too iha rai Kanaan, ba sira nia aman Jacó.
verses.26: Sira foo hatene ba nia no dehan, “José moris hela no nia mak ukun nain ba rai Ejitu tomak!” No Jacó sai bilaan tanba nia la fiar sira.
verses.27: Maibee bainhira sira foo hatene José nia liafuan hotu nebee nia konta ona ba sira. No bainhira Jacó haree kuda kareta boot sira nebee José haruka hodi lori nia, nunee sira nia aman Jacó nia espíritu moris fali.
verses.28: Israel dehan, “Too ona. Hau nia oan mane José sei moris hela. Hau sei baa no haree nia molok hau mate.”

46.title: José Lori Ninia Família Baa Ejitu

verses.1: Israel halo viajen ho buat hotu nebee nia iha no nia baa too Beer-Seba. Nia oferese sakrifísiu sira ba nia aman Isak nia Maromak.
verses.2: Maromak koalia ho Israel liu hosi vizaun sira iha kalan, no Nia dehan, “Jacó, Jacó!” No Jacó hataan, “Hau mak nee.”
verses.3: Nia dehan, “Hau mak Maromak, o nia aman nia Maromak. Keta tauk atu tuun ba Ejitu tanba iha nebaa Hau sei halo o sai nasaun ida nebee boot.
verses.4: Hau rasik sei tuun ba Ejitu ho o, no tebes Hau sei lori imi sai fali. No José nia liman sei taka o nia matan.”
verses.5: Jacó sai hosi Beer-Seba. Israel nia oan sira lori sira nia aman Jacó, sira nia oan kiik sira, no sira nia feen sira iha kuda kareta boot sira nebee Faraó mak haruka hodi tula sira.
verses.6: Sira lori sira nia animál sira no sira nia sasaan nebee sira hetan iha rai Kanaan no sira baa too iha Ejitu, Jacó hamutuk ho ninia família tomak.
verses.7: Jacó tama mai Ejitu hamutuk ho ninia oan mane sira, bei-oan mane sira, oan feto sira, bei-oan feto sira no ninia família tomak.
verses.8: Ida nee mak Israel nia oan sira nia naran nebee tama Ejitu, nebee Jacó no ninia oan mane sira: Ruben mak Jacó nia oan primeiru.
verses.9: Ruben nia oan mane sira: Hanok, Palu, Hezron no Karmi.
verses.10: Simeão nia oan mane sira: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zoar no mos Saul nebee oan mane hosi feto Kanaan.
verses.11: Levi nia oan mane sira: Gerson, Koat no Merari.
verses.12: Judá nia oan mane sira: Er, Onan, Sela, Perez no Zera. Maibee Er no Onan mate iha rai Kanaan. Peres nia oan mane sira mak Hezron no Hamul.
verses.13: Isakar nia oan mane sira: Tola, Puva, Job no Simron.
verses.14: Zebulón nia oan mane sira: Sered, Elon no Jaleel.
verses.15: Ema sira nee mak Lea nia oan mane sira nebee nia hetan ba Jacó iha Padan-Aram, ho ninia oan feto Dina. Ninia oan mane no oan feto sira nee hamutuk tolu-nulu resin tolu.
verses.16: Gad nia oan mane sira: Zifion, Hagi, Suni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi no Areli.
verses.17: Aser nia oan mane sira: Jimna, Isua, Isui, Beria no sira nia alin feto Sera. Beria nia oan mane sira: Heber no Malkiel.
verses.18: Ema sira nee mak oan mane sira hosi Zilpa, feto nebee Labão foo ba nia oan feto Lea. Zilpa hetan oan sira nee ba Jacó - ema nain sanulu resin neen.
verses.19: Oan mane sira hosi Rakél, Jacó nia feen: José no Benjamin.
verses.20: José hetan oan mane rua iha rai Ejitu: Manasés no Efraim, nebee hetan hosi Asenat, oan feto hosi Potifera, amu lulik iha On.
verses.21: Benjamin nia oan mane sira: Bela, Beker, Asbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Ros, Mupim, Hupim no Arde.
verses.22: Ema sira nee mak oan mane nebee mai hosi Rakél - hamutuk ema nain sanulu resin haat.
verses.23: Dan nia oan mane: Husim.
verses.24: Naftali nia oan mane sira: Jazeel, Guni, Jezer no Silem.
verses.25: Ema sira nee mak oan sira hosi Bila, feto nebee Labão foo ba nia oan feto Rakél. Bila hetan oan sira nee ba Jacó - hamutuk ema nain hitu.
verses.26: Ema hotu nebee tama mai Ejitu ho Jacó, nebee mai hosi ninia isin, nebee la inklui ninia oan sira nia feen sira, mak ema nain neen-nulu resin neen.
verses.27: José nia oan mane sira nebee moris iha Ejitu mak ema nain rua. Nunee ema hotu iha Jacó nia uma kain, nebee tama mai Ejitu hamutuk ema nain hitu-nulu.
verses.28: Jacó haruka Judá baa uluk nia hodi baa José hodi hatudu dalan ba Gosen. Nunee sira tama rai Gosen.
verses.29: José prepara ninia kuda kareta no nia sae ba hodi hasoru ninia aman Israel iha Gosen. Nia hatudu aan ba ninia aman no hakuak nia no tanis kleur iha nia aman nia kakorok.
verses.30: Israel dehan ba José, “Agora husik hau mate tanba hau haree ona o nia oin, no o sei moris hela.”
verses.31: José dehan ba ninia maun-alin sira, no ba ninia aman nia uma kain, “Hau sei baa no foo hatene ba Faraó no dehan ba nia, ‘Hau nia maun-alin sira, no hau nia aman nia uma kain, nebee uluk iha rai Kanaan, agora too ona mai hau.
verses.32: No ema sira nee mak bibi atan sira, tanba sira nia servisu mak hakiak animál sira. Nunee sira lori sira nia bibi lubun sira, karau lubun sira no buat hotu nebee sira iha.’
verses.33: Tuir mai, bainhira Faraó sei bolu imi, no nia dehan, ‘Imi halo servisu saida?’
verses.34: Nunee imi sei dehan, ‘Ita boot nia atan sira nia servisu kona ba hakiak animál sira hosi tempu nebee ami sei joven too agora, hanesan ami nia bei-ala sira.’ Hodi nunee imi bele hela iha rai Gosen, tanba bibi atan hotu mak foer loos ba ema Ejitu sira.”

47.title: Jacó Nia Família Hela Iha Gosen

verses.1: José baa no foo hatene ba Faraó no dehan, “Hau nia aman no maun-alin sira, no sira nia bibi lubun sira, karau lubun sira no buat hotu nebee sira iha, mai ona hosi rai Kanaan. No tebes, sira too iha rai Gosen.
verses.2: José hili ninia maun nain lima no lori sira baa hasoru Faraó.
verses.3: Faraó dehan ba José nia maun sira, “Imi halo servisu saida?” Sira hataan ba Faraó, “Ita boot nia atan sira mak bibi atan, hanesan ami nia bei-ala sira.”
verses.4: No sira aumenta liafuan ba Faraó, “Ami mai hodi lao ba-mai iha rai nee, tanba ita boot nia atan sira la iha duut hodi foo ba ami nia bibi lubun sira, tanba rai Kanaan hamlaha boot. Nunee, favór ida, husik ita boot nia atan sira hela iha Gosen.”
verses.5: Faraó koalia ho José no dehan, “O nia aman no maun-alin sira mai ona too o.
verses.6: Rai Ejitu mak iha o nia oin. Haruka o nia aman no maun-alin sira baa hela iha rai nebee diak liu. Husik sira hela iha rai Gosen. Se o hatene ema ruma iha sira nia leet nebee iha forsa, entaun foo knaar ba sira hodi tau matan ba hau nia animál sira.”
verses.7: Depois José lori mai ninia aman Jacó hodi hasoru Faraó, no Jacó foo bensaun ba Faraó.
verses.8: Faraó dehan ba Jacó, “Ita tinan hira ona?”
verses.9: Jacó hataan ba Faraó, “Tempu nebee hau halo viajen durante hau nia moris nee too tinan atus ida tolu-nulu. Tempu nee mak uitoan deit no aat durante hau nia moris. No hau la moris naruk too hanesan hau nia bei-ala sira nia tempu bainhira sira halo viajen durante sira nia moris.”
verses.10: Jacó foo bensaun ba Faraó, depois nia sai hosi Faraó nia prezensa.
verses.11: José lori ninia aman no maun-alin sira no foo fatin ba sira iha rai Ejitu, iha rai nebee diak liu, rai iha Ramesés, tuir Faraó nia orden.
verses.12: José foo ai haan ba ninia aman no nia maun-alin sira. Nia foo ai haan ba ninia aman nia uma kain tomak tuir sira nia família sira.
verses.13: Iha tempu nebaa, iha rai hotu ai haan la iha tanba hamlaha boot tebes. Nunee rai Ejitu no rai Kanaan sai fraku tanba rai hamlaha.
verses.14: José halibur osan hotu nebee iha rai Ejitu no rai Kanaan tanba ema sosa batar nee. No José lori osan nee ba Farão nia uma.
verses.15: Bainhira osan hotu ona iha rai Ejitu no iha rai Kanaan, ema Ejitu hotu mai José no dehan, “Foo ai haan mai ami, nusaa mak ami mate iha ita boot nia oin?” Tanba osan la iha.
verses.16: José dehan, “Foo imi nia animál sira, no hau sei foo ai haan troka imi nia animál sira, se osan la iha.”
verses.17: Entaun sira lori sira nia animál sira ba José. No José foo ai haan ba sira troka sira nia kuda, bibi lubun, karau lubun no kuda buru sira nee. Nia foo ai haan ba sira troka ho sira nia animál sira nee durante tinan ida tan.
verses.18: Bainhira tinan nee remata, sira ba fali José iha tinan tuir mai no dehan ba nia, “Ami sei la subar hosi ami nia senhor katak ami nia osan uza hotu ona. Ami nia senhor iha mos ami nia animál lubun sira. Agora ami la iha buat ida iha senhor nia oin – só deit ami nia isin lolon sira nee no ami nia rai.
verses.19: Nusaa mak ami no ami nia rai sei mate iha ita boot nia oin? Sosa ami no ami nia rai ho ai haan, nunee ami no ami nia rai sei sai atan ba Faraó. Foo batar mai ami hodi ami bele moris hela no la mate, no hodi rai nee la lakon.”
verses.20: Entaun José sosa rai tomak iha Ejitu ba Faraó, tanba ema Ejitu hotu faan sira nia rai, tanba hamlaha boot nee domina sira. Nunee rai nee sai Faraó nian.
verses.21: José muda ema hotu ba sidade sira hosi Ejitu nia área tomak, hosi sor-sorin.
verses.22: Só deit nia la sosa amu lulik sira nia rai tanba amu lulik sira hetan ai haan hosi Faraó no sira sei haan ai haan nebee Faraó foo hela ba sira. Nunee sira la faan sira nia rai.
verses.23: Depois José dehan ba povu nee, “Tebes, ohin loron hau sosa imi no imi nia rai ba Faraó. Haree fini nee, lori ba no kuda iha rai.
verses.24: No tuir mai, imi tenki foo hosi rezultadu nee parte ida hosi parte lima ba Faraó, no parte haat mak imi nian hodi rai fini, no hetan ai haan, no foo haan ba imi nia uma kain sira no foo haan ba imi nia kiik-oan sira.”
verses.25: Povu hataan, “Ita boot mak salva ona ami nia moris. Husik ami hetan grasa iha ami nia senhor nia oin, tanba ami sei sai Farão nia atan sira.”
verses.26: José halo lei ida iha rai Ejitu nebee sei iha too ohin loron, katak Faraó tenki hetan parte ida hosi parte lima. Só deit la inklui amu lulik sira nia rai, nebee la sai Faraó nian.
verses.27: Israel hela iha rai Ejitu, iha área Gosen. Sira hetan riku-soin iha nebaa, no sira aumenta ba beibeik too barak loos.
verses.28: Jacó hela iha rai Ejitu tinan sanulu resin hitu tan. Nunee Jacó nia idade kompletu mak tinan atus ida haat-nulu resin hitu.
verses.29: Bainhira Israel nee besik atu mate, nia bolu ninia oan mane José no dehan ba nia, “Agora, se hau hetan grasa iha o nia oin, favór ida, tau o nia liman iha hau nia kelen okos. Hatudu domin metin no laran loos mai hau no, favór ida, la bele hakoi hau iha Ejitu.
verses.30: Maibee hau sei mate hamutuk ho hau nia bei-ala sira, no o sei lori hau sai hosi Ejitu no hakoi hau iha hau nia bei-ala sira nia rate.” José hataan, “Hau sei halo tuir apaa nia liafuan nee.”
verses.31: Jacó dehan, “Jura mai hau.” No José jura ba nia. Depois Israel hakruuk aan iha ninia kama ulun.

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, ema ida foo hatene ba José, “Tebes, ita boot nia aman moras.” Entaun José baa hamutuk ho nia oan mane rua, Manasés no Efraim.
verses.2: Ema foo hatene ba Jacó, “Tebes, ita nia oan mane José mai atu hasoru ita.” No Israel hakaas aan hodi tuur iha ninia kama.
verses.3: Jacó dehan ba José, “Maromak Kbiit Makaas mak hatudu aan mai hau iha Luz, nebee iha rai Kanaan, no Nia foo bensaun mai hau.
verses.4: Nia dehan mai hau, ‘Tebes Hau sei foo oan ba o, no habarak o, no Hau sei halo o sai povu ida nebee ema lubun boot, no Hau sei foo rai nee ba o nia bei-oan sira too tinan ba tinan.
verses.5: Agora, o nia oan mane rua nee, Efraim no Manasés, nebee o hetan iha rai Ejitu molok hau mai too o iha Ejitu, oan rua nee mak hau nian, hanesan Ruben no Simeão, sira sei sai hau nian.
verses.6: No oan sira nebee o hetan tuir oan rua nee mak o nian. Maibee nain rua nee sei hetan naran hanesan sira nia maun sira tuir sira nia liman rohan.
verses.7: No kona ba hau, bainhira hau mai hosi Padan, Rakél mate iha hau nia sorin iha rai Kanaan bainhira ami iha dalan besik too iha Efrata. No Hau hakoi nia iha nebaa, iha dalan ba Efrata. Fatin nee mak Belém.”
verses.8: Israel haree José nia oan mane sira no nia husu, “See mak sira nee?”
verses.9: José dehan ba ninia aman, “Sira mak hau nia oan mane sira, nebee Maromak foo mai hau iha fatin nee.” Jacó dehan, “Favór ida, lori sira mai hau no hau sei foo bensaun ba sira.”
verses.10: Israel nia matan delek tanba nia idade boot ona no nia la bele haree. José lori nia oan sira hakbesik ba Jacó no nia rei oan sira nee no hakuak sira.
verses.11: Israel dehan ba José, “Uluk hau la hanoin atu haree fali o nia oin, maibee tebes, Maromak mak hatudu mos o nia oan sira mai hau.”
verses.12: José foti sira hosi Jacó nia ain tuur, no nia hakruuk ho oin ba rai.
verses.13: No José foti sira nain rua nee, ho Efraim iha nia liman loos hodi ba Israel nia liman karuk, no Manasés iha nia liman karuk hodi ba Israel nia liman loos. Hanesan nee mak José lori sira ba Israel.
verses.14: No Israel lolo nia liman loos no tau ba Efraim nia ulun leten, nebee oan segundu, no nia tau ninia liman karuk ba Manasés nia ulun leten. Israel hatene buat nebee nia halo, maski Manasés mak oan primeiru.
verses.15: Jacó foo bensaun ba José no dehan,
verses.16: Anju ida nebee hola fali hau hosi buat hotu nebee aat,
verses.17: Bainhira José haree katak ninia aman tau liman loos iha Efraim nia ulun leten, nia la kontenti. José foti ninia aman nia liman hodi hasai hosi Efraim nia ulun no tau fali ba Manasés nia ulun.
verses.18: José dehan, “La bele hanesan nee, hau nia apaa. Ida nee mak hau nia oan primeiru, tau ita nia liman loos ba ninia ulun.”
verses.19: Maibee ninia aman lakohi no dehan, “Hau hatene, hau nia oan, hau hatene. Nia mos sei sai povu ida, no nia sei sai boot, maibee ninia alin sei sai boot liu nia, no ninia bei-oan sira sei sai nasaun barak.”
verses.20: Entaun nia foo bensaun ba sira iha loron nebaa, no nia dehan,
verses.21: Israel dehan ba José, “Tebes, hau atu mate, maibee Maromak mak hamutuk ho o no Nia sei lori o ba o nia bei-ala sira nia rai.
verses.22: No mos, hau foo ona ba o fatin ida liu fali o nia maun-alin sira, nebee hau hadau hosi ema Amoreu sira ho hau nia surik no hau nia rama.”

49.title: Jacó Foo Bensaun ba Oan Mane Sira

verses.1: Jacó bolu ninia oan mane sira no dehan, “Halibur hamutuk hodi hau bele foo sai ba imi buat nebee sei akontese ba imi iha futuru.
verses.2: Mai hamutuk no rona lai, Oh Jacó nia oan mane sira,
verses.3: Ruben, o mak hau nia oan primeiru,
verses.4: Maibee o hanesan bee nebee la metin, nunee o sei la sai aas liu,
verses.5: Simeão no Levi nee maun-alin,
verses.6: Keta husik hau nia klamar tama ba sira nia segredu,
verses.7: Hau foo malisan ba sira nia hirus nebee makaas,
verses.8: Judá, o nia maun-alin sira sei hahii o,
verses.9: Judá mak liaun oan,
verses.10: Rota sei la sai hosi Judá,
verses.11: Nia kesi nia kuda buru oan ba ai uvas huun,
verses.12: Ninia matan sei mean liu tua uvas,
verses.13: Zebulón sei hela iha tasi ibun,
verses.14: Isakar mak kuda buru ida nebee forti,
verses.15: Nia haree fatin deskansa nebee diak,
verses.16: Dan sei tesi lia ba ninia povu,
verses.17: Dan sei sai samea ida iha dalan,
verses.18: Hau hein O nia salvasaun, Oh Nai.
verses.19: Kona ba Gad nee, naok-teen sira sei hadau nia,
verses.20: Aser nia hahaan nee mak bokur,
verses.21: Naftali mak bibi rusa nebee husik ona,
verses.22: José mak ai huun nebee iha fuan barak,
verses.23: Hanadór sira halo ataka makaas ba nia,
verses.24: Maibee ninia rama sei metin hela,
verses.25: Liu hosi o nia aman nia Maromak nebee sei ajuda o,
verses.26: Bensaun sira nebee mai hosi o nia aman,
verses.27: Benjamin mak asu fuik nebee hamlaha loos,
verses.28: Ema sira hotu nee mak suku sanulu resin rua hosi Israel. No sira nia aman koalia ho sira ho liafuan nee no nia foo bensaun ba sira. Nia foo bensaun ba ema ida-idak tuir bensaun nebee diak ba sira.
verses.29: No nia foo orden ba sira no dehan, “Hau atu halibur ba hau nia povu, nunee hakoi hau ho hau nia aman sira iha rai kuak nebee iha Efron, ema Hiti nia toos,
verses.30: iha rai kuak nebee iha toos iha Makpela, nebee iha Mamre nia oin, iha rai Kanaan. Ida nee mak fatin nebee Abraão sosa ho toos nee hosi Efron, ema Hiti, hodi sai ninia rate.
verses.31: Sira hakoi Abraão no nia feen Sara iha nebaa. No sira hakoi Isak no nia feen Rebeka iha nebaa. No hau hakoi Lea iha nebaa.
verses.32: Sira sosa toos nebee iha rai kuak nee hosi ema Hiti sira.”
verses.33: Bainhira Jacó foo tiha orden hotu nee, nia foti nia ain tama ba ninia kama, no nia iis kotu no nia halibur ba ninia povu.

verses.1: José monu ba ninia aman nia oin, no nia tanis ba nia no rei nia.
verses.2: No José haruka ninia atan sira nebee doutór sira hodi prepara ninia aman nia mate isin. Entaun doutór sira prepara Israel.
verses.3: Sira prepara ninia mate isin too loron haat-nulu, tanba sira presiza loron sira nee hodi prepara mate isin ida. No ema Ejitu sira tanis lelir too loron hitu-nulu.
verses.4: Bainhira loron tanis lelir nian hotu ona, José koalia ho Faraó nia uma kain no dehan, “Se hau hetan grasa iha ita boot sira nia oin, favór ida, koalia ho Faraó no dehan,
verses.5: ‘Hau nia aman haruka hau jura, no nia dehan, “Tebes, hau atu mate. Hakoi hau iha rate nebee hau kee ona iha rai Kanaan.” Entaun, favór ida, husik hau baa no hakoi hau nia aman. Depois hau sei fila fali mai.’”
verses.6: Faraó dehan, “Baa lai, no hakoi o nia aman tuir buat nebee nia haruka o jura nee.”
verses.7: Entaun José sae baa hodi hakoi ninia aman. Faraó nia atan sira hotu sae baa hamutuk ho nia, no ema boot sira hosi Faraó nia uma kain, no ema boot sira hotu hosi rai Ejitu,
verses.8: no mos José nia uma kain, no ninia maun-alin sira, no ninia aman nia uma kain. Só sira nia kiik oan sira no sira nia bibi lubun no karau lubun sira nee mak sira husik deit iha rai Gosen.
verses.9: Kuda kareta sira no kuda sae baa hamutuk ho José, no ema sira hotu nee barak loos.
verses.10: Sira sae too Atad nia fatin nebee baku trigu, nebee iha Jordaun sorin ba, no iha nebaa sira tanis halerik makaas loos. José tanis lelir too loron hitu tanba ninia aman nee.
verses.11: Bainhira ema Kanaan sira nebee hela iha rai nebaa haree ema tanis lelir iha Atad nia fatin nebee baku trigu, sira dehan, “Ida nee mak tanis lelir makaas tebes hosi ema Ejitu sira.” Nunee sira hanaran fatin iha Jordaun sorin ba nee, Abel-Mizraim.
verses.12: No Jacó nia oan mane sira halo tuir ninia orden ba sira.
verses.13: Tanba ninia oan mane sira lori nia ba rai Kanaan, no sira hakoi nia iha rai kuak iha toos nebee iha Makpela. Uluk Abraão sosa fatin nee ho toos hosi Efron nebee ema Hiti, iha Mamre, hodi sai ninia rate.
verses.14: Bainhira sira hakoi tiha Jacó, José fila ba Ejitu, nia no ninia maun-alin sira no ema hotu nebee sae baa hamutuk ho nia hodi hakoi ninia aman.
verses.15: Bainhira José nia maun sira haree katak sira nia aman mate ona, sira dehan, “Se karik José odi ita no nia sei selu fali ba ita tuir buat hotu nebee ita halo ona ba nia.”
verses.16: Entaun sira haruka manu-ain ba José no dehan, “Ita nia aman foo orden molok nia mate no dehan,
verses.17: ‘Imi sei dehan ba José, “Favór ida, perdua o nia maun sira nia sala hasoru o no sira nia sala seluk, tanba sira halo ona buat aat ba o.” Entaun, agora favór ida, perdua ami nia sala nee, tanba ami mak ita nia aman nia Maromak nia atan sira.’” No José tanis bainhira sira koalia ho nia.
verses.18: Nia maun sira mos baa no monu ho oin ba rai iha nia oin no sira dehan, “Tebes, ami mak ita boot nia atan sira.”
verses.19: José dehan ba sira, “Keta tauk! Hau iha Maromak nia fatin ka?
verses.20: Tanba imi hanoin aat hasoru hau, maibee Maromak halo buat nee tuir Ninia planu diak, no Nia halao planu nee too ohin loron, hodi salva ema barak nia moris.
verses.21: Nunee, keta tauk. Hau sei foo haan ba imi no imi nia kiik oan sira.” No nia hamaus sira, no koalia diak ba sira.
verses.22: José hela iha rai Ejitu hamutuk ho ninia aman nia uma kain. No José moris too tinan atus ida sanulu (110).
verses.23: José haree Efraim nia bei-oan nia oan sira. No Manasés nia oan mane Makir lori mos ninia oan sira ba Jacó no tau ba José nia ain tuur.
verses.24: José dehan ba ninia maun-alin sira, “Hau atu mate. Maromak sei mai vizita imi no lori imi sai hosi rai nee ba rai nebee Nia promete ona ba Abraão, Isak no Jacó.”
verses.25: No José husu Israel nia oan sira nee halo juramentu, no nia dehan, “Maromak sei mai vizita duni imi, no imi tenki lori hau nia ruin hosi fatin nee.”
verses.26: Depois José mate ho idade tinan atus ida sanulu. No sira prepara ninia mate isin no tau nia iha kaixaun ida iha Ejitu.

1.title: Ema Israel Sira Hetan Terus iha Ejitu

verses.1: Israel nia oan sira nia naran nebee baa Ejitu ho Jacó hamutuk ho sira nia família ida-idak mak hanesan tuir mai nee:
verses.2: Ruben, Simeão, Levi, Judá,
verses.3: Isakar, Zebulón, Benjamin,
verses.4: Dan, Naftali, Gad no Aser.
verses.5: Jacó nia família hamutuk ema nain hitu-nulu. José hela ona iha Ejitu.
verses.6: Tempu tuir mai, José ho nia maun-alin sira no jerasaun tomak nee mate,
verses.7: maibee ema Israel sira nia oan sira no bei-oan sira aumenta barak tebe-tebes. Sira aumenta makaas, too rai nee nakonu ho sira.
verses.8: Tuir mai liurai foun ida ukun Ejitu, no nia la konhese José.
verses.9: Liurai nee hatete ba ninia povu, “Haree ema Israel sira nee aumenta barak no iha forsa liu ita.
verses.10: Hanoin di-diak kona ba sira. Sira la bele aumenta barak liu tan. Se karik iha funu ruma, sira bele muda hodi suporta inimigu sira hodi hasoru ita. Depois sira sei halai no husik rai nee.”
verses.11: Entaun ema Ejitu sira hili mandór sira hodi hanehan ema Israel liu hosi servisu todan. Ema Israel sira harii sidade Piton no Ramesés ba Faraó hodi rai sasaan.
verses.12: Maibee bainhira ema Ejitu halo terus tan ba ema Israel, ema Israel sira aumenta liu tan. Sira sai makaas liu tan too ema Ejitu hanoin laran susar tanba ema Israel.
verses.13: Depois ema Ejitu ho brutu halo terus ba ema Israel.
verses.14: Ema Ejitu halo sira nia moris sai susar no terus. Ema Ejitu obriga ema Israel halo servisu todan. Ema Israel tenki hanesan halo masa, tijolu no servisu oi-oin iha toos. Ema Ejitu ho brutu obriga sira halo servisu hotu nee.
verses.15: Depois liurai Ejitu foo orden ba parteira Ebreu sira, ida naran Sifra no ida seluk naran Pua.
verses.16: Nia dehan “Bainhira imi ajuda feto Ebreu sira tuur ahi, imi tenki haree di-diak bainhira bebee nee foin moris mai. Se bebee nee oan mane imi tenki oho tiha nia. Maibee se karik oan feto imi bele husik nia moris.”
verses.17: Maibee parteira rua nee mak ema nebee hamtauk Maromak. Sira la halo tuir liurai Ejitu nia orden no sira husik moris bebee mane sira nee.
verses.18: Tuir mai, liurai Ejitu bolu parteira sira nee hodi husu ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi halo nunee, no imi husik moris bebee mane sira nee?”
verses.19: Parteira rua nee hataan ba Faraó, “Tanba feto Ebreu sira la hanesan ho feto Ejitu sira. Sira iha forsa. Molok parteira too, sira tuur ahi tiha ona.”
verses.20: Nunee Maromak foo bensaun ba parteira sira nee. No ema Israel sira aumenta barak tebe-tebes no sai forti.
verses.21: Maromak foo uma kain ba parteira sira nee tanba sira hamtauk ba Maromak.
verses.22: Depois Faraó foo orden ba nia povu hotu, dehan, “Sira nia oan mane nebee foin moris soe iha mota, maibee oan feto sira husik moris.”

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, iha mane ida hosi suku Levi nebee kaben ho feto ida hosi suku Levi.
verses.2: Depois feto nee isin rua no tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida. Bainhira nia haree katak ninia oan nee bonitu nia subar ninia oan too fulan tolu.
verses.3: Maibee nia la bele subar nia oan nee kleur liu tan. Nunee nia foti luhu ida nebee halo ho duut teberau no taka ho alkatraun. Nia tau nia oan ba iha luhu laran nee, no tau iha duut teberau nia leet iha mota ninin.
verses.4: Bebee nee nia biin hamriik dook hodi haree saida mak sei akontese ho nia alin mane.
verses.5: Iha tempu nee Faraó nia oan feto mai hariis iha mota nee, no ninia atan sira lao ba-mai iha mota ninin. Derepenti liurai nia oan feto haree luhu ida iha teberau nia leet, no nia haruka ninia atan ida ba foti luhu nee.
verses.6: Bainhira nia loke luhu, nia haree bebee ida iha laran no bebee nee tanis hela. Nia hadomi tebe-tebes bebee nee no dehan, “Bebee nee mak ema Ebreu nia oan.”
verses.7: Depois bebee nia biin husu ba Faraó nia oan feto, “Hau bele bolu feto Ebreu ida atu mai foo susu ba bebee nee ka?”
verses.8: Faraó nia oan feto hataan, “Bele!” Nunee labarik feto nee ba bolu bebee nia inan rasik.
verses.9: Faraó nia oan feto hatete ba feto Ebreu nee, “Lori bebee nee, foo susu no hakiak ba. Depois hau sei selu o nia kolen.” Senhora nee lori bebee nee no foo susu ba nia.
verses.10: Bainhira bebee nee komesa boot ona, ninia inan entrega nia ba Faraó nia oan feto. Depois Faraó nia oan feto foti bebee nee sai nia oan hakiak, no nia foo naran Moisés ba labarik nee no nia dehan, “Tanba hau foti nia hosi bee.”
verses.11: Iha tempu nebaa, bainhira Moisés idade boot ona, nia baa vizita ninia maluk sira. Nia haree oinsaa sira halo servisu todan. Nia haree mos ema Ejitu ida baku ema Ebreu ida nebee ninia maluk ida.
verses.12: Moisés haree ba-mai, no nia la haree ema ida, entaun nia baku mate ema Ejitu nee no subar ema Ejitu nia mate isin iha rai henek laran.
verses.13: Loron tuir mai, Moisés baa fali no nia haree ema Ebreu nain rua baku malu. No nia husu ba ema ida nebee sala nee, “Tanba saa mak o baku o nia maluk?”
verses.14: Ema nee hataan, “See mak foti ita sai ami nia xefi no juis? Ita atu oho mos hau hanesan ema Ejitu nebee ita oho tiha ona nee ka?” Nunee Moisés tauk no hanoin, “Hau nia hahalok nee ema hatene ona.”
verses.15: Kuandu Faraó rona kona ba ida nee, nia buka dalan atu oho Moisés. Maibee Moisés halai hosi Faraó nia oin. Nia baa hela iha rai Midian no nia tuur iha bee posu ida.
verses.16: Iha Midian nee iha amu lulik ida nebee iha oan feto nain hitu. Feto sira nee mai atu kuru bee. Sira enxe nakonu tanki badak hodi foo hemu ba sira nia aman nia bibi.
verses.17: Maibee bibi atan sira seluk mai duni sees feto sira nee. Depois Moisés hamriik no salva feto sira nee no foo bee hodi sira nia bibi bele hemu.
verses.18: Bainhira feto sira nee fila fali ba sira nia aman Reuel, nia husu, “Tanba saa mak ohin imi fila sedu?”
verses.19: Sira hataan, “Iha ema Ejitu ida nebee salva ami hosi bibi atan sira nia liman. No nia rasik kuru bee no foo mai ami no foo hemu ba ita nia bibi sira.”
verses.20: Depois aman nee husu ba ninia oan feto sira, “Nia agora iha nebee? Nusaa mak imi husik ema nee? Imi ba bolu nia mai haan lai.”
verses.21: Moisés kontenti atu hela hamutuk ho mane nee. Tuir mai, mane nee foo ninia oan feto Zipora kaben ho Moisés.
verses.22: Depois Zipora tuur ahi oan mane ida. Moisés hanaran nia Gerson, tanba Moisés hanoin, “Hau ema rai liur nebee lao iha rai estranjeiru nee.”
verses.23: Liu tiha tinan barak, liurai Ejitu nee mate ona. Maibee povu Israel sei halerik tanba sira servisu todan hela. Nunee sira hakilar, no sira nia lian sae too iha Maromak tanba sira nia servisu todan.
verses.24: Maromak rona sira nia lian, no Maromak hanoin hetan Ninia aliansa nebee Nia halo ona ho Abraão, Isak no Jacó.
verses.25: Maromak haree ema Israel sira, no Maromak hatene ona.

verses.1: Iha tempu nee, Moisés hein bibi sira nebee Jetro nian, nebee Moisés nia banin mane. Jetro nee servisu nudar amu lulik iha rai Midian. Bainhira Moisés lori bibi sira nee ba iha rai fuik nia sorin ba, nia too iha Maromak nia foho, naran Horeb.
verses.2: Iha nebaa, Nai nia anju hatudu aan ba nia liu hosi ahi lakan nebee sai hosi ai badak. Moisés haree ahi lakan iha ai badak nee, maibee ahi la haan ai badak nee.
verses.3: Moisés dehan, “Diak liu hau hakbesik ba hodi haree di-diak buat furak nee, no tanba saa mak ahi la haan ai badak nee?”
verses.4: Bainhira Nai haree Moisés hakbesik ba hodi haree, Maromak bolu nia hosi ai badak laran dehan, “Moisés! Moisés!” Nia hataan, “Hau mak nee.”
verses.5: Maromak dehan, “Keta hakbesik liu tan. Hasai tiha o nia sandálias lai, tanba fatin nebee o hamriik mak rai santu.”
verses.6: Nia mos hatete, “Hau mak o nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak, Abraão nia Maromak, Isak nia Maromak no Jacó nia Maromak.” Entaun Moisés taka tiha nia oin, tanba nia tauk atu hateke ba Maromak.
verses.7: Depois Nai hatete, “Hau haree ona Hau nia povu nia terus iha Ejitu, no Hau rona ona sira nia lian tanba ema sira nebee hanehan sira. Hau hatene katak sira hetan terus tebe-tebes.
verses.8: Tanba nee Hau sei tuun ba hodi salva sira hosi ema Ejitu sira nia liman no lori sira sai hosi rai nebaa hodi baa iha rai nebee diak no luan; rai nebee suli ho susu been no bani been. Rai nee mak ema Kanaan sira nian, ema Hiti, ema Amoreu, ema Perizeu, ema Heveu no ema Jebuseu sira nian.
verses.9: Agora, ema Israel sira nia halerik too ona mai Hau. No Hau mos haree oinsaa ema Ejitu hanehan sira.
verses.10: Entaun, Hau haruka o baa hasoru Faraó hodi o lori Hau nia povu, ema Israel sira, sai hosi Ejitu.”
verses.11: Maibee Moisés hataan ba Maromak, “Hau nee see, hodi ba hasoru Faraó no lori sai ema Israel hosi Ejitu?”
verses.12: Maromak hataan, “Maibee Hau sei hamutuk ho o. Ida nee mak sinál katak Hau mak haruka o: Bainhira o lori povu Israel sai hosi Ejitu, o sei serví Hau iha foho ida nee.”
verses.13: Moisés hataan ba Maromak, “Maibee se hau hasoru ema Israel no dehan ba sira, ‘Imi nia bei-ala nia Maromak haruka hau mai hasoru imi,’ no sira sei husu, ‘Ninia naran mak saida?’ Oinsaa mak hau hataan ba sira?”
verses.14: Maromak hatete ba Moisés, “Hau Mak Hau.” Maromak hatete tan, “O tenki dehan nunee ba ema Israel sira, ‘Hau Mak Hau nee, Nia mak haruka hau ba imi.’”
verses.15: Tuir mai, Maromak dehan ba Moisés, “O sei hatete nunee ba ema Israel sira, ‘Nai, imi nia bei-ala nia Maromak, Abraão nia Maromak, Isak nia Maromak no Jacó nia Maromak, mak haruka hau ba imi.’ Hau nia naran mak nee too tinan ba tinan, no imi sei hanoin hetan Hau nia naran nee hosi jerasaun ba jerasaun.
verses.16: Baa halibur lider Israel sira hotu. Hatete ba sira, ‘Nai, imi nia bei-ala nia Maromak, Abraão, Isak no Jacó nia Maromak, hatudu aan ona mai hau no nia hatete, “Hau haree ona imi no buat nebee ema Ejitu sira halo ona ba imi.
verses.17: Hau desidi ona atu lori imi sai hosi terus iha Ejitu, no lori imi ba rai ida nebee suli ho bani been no susu been. Rai nee mak ema Kanaan sira nian, ema Hiti, ema Amoreu, ema Perizeu, ema Heveu no ema Jebuseu sira nian.”’
verses.18: Depois sira sei rona buat nebee o sei dehan. No o tenki baa hamutuk ho lider Israel sira hodi hasoru liurai Ejitu no hatete ba nia, “Nai, ema Ebreu sira nia Maromak, hatudu aan ona mai ami. Tanba nee, favór ida, foo lisensa mai ami hodi ami lao loron tolu ba rai fuik hodi foo sakrifísiu ba Nai, ami nia Maromak.”
verses.19: Hau hatene duni katak liurai Ejitu sei la husik imi baa, too liman forti mak obriga nia.
verses.20: Nunee Hau sei lolo liman hodi kastigu ema Ejitu sira ho Hau nia milagre hotu iha sira nia leet. Depois nia sei haruka imi baa.
verses.21: No Hau sei halo ema Ejitu sira hatudu grasa ba imi. Nunee bainhira imi sai imi sei la baa ho liman mamuk.
verses.22: Maibee feto Israel ida-idak sei husu ba sira nia vizinha nebee ema Ejitu sira no hosi feto Ejitu sira nebee hela hamutuk ho sira, hodi nunee ema Ejitu sei foo sasaan osan mutin no osan mean. Sira sei foo mos ropa hodi imi bele foo hatais ba imi nia oan feto no oan mane sira. Nunee imi sei hetan ema Ejitu sira nia riku-soin.”

verses.1: Depois Moisés hataan, “Maibee oinsaa, se ema Israel sira la fiar no la foo atensaun ba hau nia liafuan nee? No sira sei dehan, ‘Nai la hatudu aan ba ita.’”
verses.2: Nunee Nai husu ba nia, “Saida mak iha o nia liman nee?” Nia hataan, “Ai tonka.”
verses.3: Nai hatete, “Soe ida nee ba rai.” Moisés soe ai tonka ba rai, no ai tonka nee nakfilak aan ba samea ida. Moisés halai kedas hosi samea nee.
verses.4: Nai hatete ba Moisés, “Lolo o nia liman no kaer nia ikun.” Moisés lolo liman no kaer samea nee, nunee samea nakfilak aan ba ai tonka iha nia liman.
verses.5: Nai hatete, “Halo nunee hodi ema Israel sira fiar katak Hau, Nai, nebee sira nia bei-ala nia Maromak, Abraão nia Maromak, Isak nia Maromak no Jacó nia Maromak, mak hatudu aan ba o.”
verses.6: Nai hatete tan ba nia, “Agora, hatama o nia liman ba o nia batina laran.” Nia hatama ninia liman ba ninia batina laran. Depois nia dada sai ninia liman no liman nee mutin, tanba moras lepra, no liman nee mutin hanesan neve.
verses.7: Depois Nai hatete, “Hatama fali o nia liman ba o nia batina laran.” Nia hatama fali ninia liman ba ninia batina laran, no bainhira nia dada sai fali ninia liman hosi batina laran, liman nee diak fali hanesan ninia isin tomak.
verses.8: “Tuir mai, se sira lakohi fiar ba o, ka sira la foo atensaun ba sinál primeiru, mak sira sei fiar ba sinál segundu.
verses.9: No se sira la fiar nafatin ba sinál rua nee no lakohi rona o nia liafuan, entaun o sei baa kuru bee uitoan hosi Mota Nilu no fakar iha rai maran, no bee nee sei sai raan iha rai maran.”
verses.10: Depois Moisés dehan ba Nai, “Oh hau nia Nai, hau laos ema ida nebee matenek atu koalia, hori uluk kedas no too agora, bainhira Nai koalia hela ho hau. Maibee hau nia ibun todan no nanaal toos.”
verses.11: Maibee Nai dehan ba nia, “See mak halo ema nia ibun? See mak halo ema monok ka ema diuk? Ka halo ema haree ka ema delek? Laos Hau, Nai?
verses.12: Entaun baa deit. Hau sei akompanha o nia ibun no hanorin o buat nebee o sei koalia.”
verses.13: Maibee Moisés dehan, “Oh hau nia Nai, favór ida, haruka deit ema seluk.”
verses.14: Depois Nai sai hirus tan ho Moisés no hatete, “Laos Arão iha nebaa, nebee o nia maun, ema Levi nee? Hau hatene katak nia matenek atu koalia. Agora nia lao dadaun iha dalan atu mai hasoru o, no bainhira nia haree o, nia sei haksolok iha nia fuan laran.
verses.15: O sei koalia ho nia no tau liafuan nee iha nia ibun. Hau sei akompanha o nia ibun no ninia ibun no hanorin imi buat nebee imi sei halo.
verses.16: Nia tenki koalia hodi o nia naran iha povu nia oin. Nia sei sai hanesan o nia ibun no o sei sai hanesan Maromak ba nia.
verses.17: No lori ai tonka nee iha o nia liman hodi o bele halo sinál sira.”
verses.18: Moisés fila ba Jetro nia uma, nebee nia banin mane, no dehan ba nia, “Favór ida, foo lisensa hodi hau bele fila ba Ejitu hodi vizita hau nia maun-alin sira hodi haree sira sei moris ka lae.” Jetro hataan ba Moisés, “Baa ho dame.”
verses.19: No Nai dehan ba Moisés iha rai Midian, “Fila ba Ejitu, tanba ema hotu nebee hakarak oho o nee mate ona.”
verses.20: Entaun Moisés bolu nia feen ho nia oan mane sira no tula sira ho kuda buru no sira fila fali hamutuk ba rai Ejitu. No Moisés kaer Maromak nia ai tonka nee iha ninia liman.
verses.21: Nai hatete ba Moisés, “Bainhira o fila tiha ba Ejitu o tenki halo milagre sira nee hotu iha Faraó nia oin, milagre sira nebee Hau foo ona ba o. Maibee, Hau sei halo nia fuan toos, hodi nia la husik povu nee atu baa.
verses.22: Nunee o tenki hatete ba Faraó, ‘Nai hatete nunee, “Israel mak Hau nia oan mane boot,
verses.23: nee duni Hau dehan ba o, ‘Husik Hau nia oan baa, hodi nia bele serví Hau.’ Maibee se o la hataan atu husik nia baa, mak Hau sei oho o nia oan mane boot!”’”
verses.24: Maibee iha dalan klaran, iha fatin ida nebee sira toba kalan, Nai hasoru Moisés atu oho nia.
verses.25: Depois Zipora foti fatuk kroat ida hodi tesi ninia oan mane nia oin-lulik nia kulit rohan no kose buat nee ba Moisés nia ain no dehan, “Ita mak laen ida ke raan mai hau.”
verses.26: Iha tempu nee nia dehan ida nee, “Ita laen ida ke raan,” tanba iha relasaun ho sirkunsizaun. Nunee Nai husik Moisés.
verses.27: Iha tempu nee, Nai hatete ba Arão, “O ba hasoru Moisés iha rai fuik.” Arão baa no nia hasoru ninia alin iha Maromak nia foho, no Arão rei nia.
verses.28: Moisés konta ba Arão buat hotu nebee Nai hatete ba nia, bainhira Nai haruka nia, no mos milagre sira nebee nia tenki halo.
verses.29: Tuir mai Moisés no Arão baa no halibur lider sira hotu hosi ema Israel sira.
verses.30: Arão konta ba sira liafuan hotu nebee Nai hatete ba Moisés, no Moisés halo milagre sira iha ema sira nee nia oin.
verses.31: Entaun sira hotu fiar, no bainhira sira rona katak Nai vizita ona povu Israel no haree sira nia terus, sira hakneak hodi adora.

verses.1: Depois Moisés no Arão baa hasoru Faraó, no dehan ba nia, “Nai, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee, ‘Husik Hau nia povu atu baa, hodi sira bele halo selebra ba Hau iha rai fuik.’”
verses.2: Maibee Faraó dehan, “See mak Nai atu nunee hau tenki rona tuir Ninia liafuan hodi husik ema Israel sira baa? Hau la konhese Nai nee, no hau sei la husik ema Israel sira atu baa.”
verses.3: Depois sira dehan, “Ema Ebreu sira nia Maromak hasoru ona ami. Favór ida, husik ami lao too loron tolu ba rai fuik, hodi halo sakrifísiu ba Nai, ami nia Maromak, nunee Nia la haruka moras ka surik atu kona ami.”
verses.4: Maibee liurai hosi Ejitu hatete ba sira, “Moisés no Arão, tanba saa mak imi hakarak hasai povu nee hosi sira nia servisu? Baa ona, no halo imi nia servisu.”
verses.5: Faraó hatete tan, “Tebes, ema hosi rai nee agora barak ona. Tanba saa mak imi hapara sira hosi sira nia servisu!”
verses.6: Iha loron nee mos, Faraó foo orden ba povu nee nia mandór sira, no sira nia xefi sira,
verses.7: “Keta foo tan duut maran ba sira hanesan baibain hodi halo tijolu. Husik sira rasik atu baa buka duut.
verses.8: Maibee sira tenki halo nafatin tijolu sira hanesan uluk no la bele hamenus kuantidade nee, tanba sira baruk-teen. Tanba nee mak sira husu beibeik, ‘Husik ami baa hodi halo sakrifísiu ba ami nia Maromak.’
verses.9: Aumenta sira nia servisu, nunee sira sei kontinua servisu nafatin no la bele rona liafuan bosok nee.”
verses.10: Nunee povu nia mandór sira no sira nia xefi sira sai baa no dehan ba povu, “Faraó hatete nunee: Hau la foo ona duut ba imi.
verses.11: Imi rasik baa buka duut iha fatin nebee deit imi bele hetan. Maibee imi nia servisu sei la hamenus.”
verses.12: Nunee ema Israel sira lao lemo rai iha Ejitu tomak atu halibur duut kain hodi uza nudar kain maran.
verses.13: Depois mandór sira obriga sira dehan, “Halo imi nia servisu loro-loron nian too hotu, hanesan uluk bainhira imi simu deit duut.”
verses.14: Depois Faraó nia mandór sira baku ema Israel sira nia xefi servisu sira, nebee mandór sira mak hili ona nee, no husu ba sira, “Tanba saa mak ohin no horiseik imi la halo tijolu hotu hanesan baibain?”
verses.15: Nunee ema Israel sira nia xefi sira baa hasoru Faraó no hakilar, “Tanba saa mak ita boot halo hanesan nee ba ita boot nia atan oan sira nee?
verses.16: Mezmu duut la foo ona mai ami, maibee sira dehan mai ami, ‘Halo tijolu sira!’ No sira baku tan ita boot nia atan sira nee, maibee tuir lo-loos, ita boot nia povu mak sala.”
verses.17: Maibee nia hatete, “Imi baruk-teen! Imi baruk-teen deit! Tanba nee mak imi hatete, ‘Husik ami baa halo sakrifísiu ba Nai!’
verses.18: Nunee duni, agora baa no halo servisu! Hau sei la foo tan duut ba imi, maibee imi tenki halo tijolu too kuantidade nebee hanesan uluk.”
verses.19: Nunee ema Israel sira nia xefi sira hatene katak sira hetan tempu susar, tanba liafuan nee, “Imi la bele hamenus tijolu nebee imi halo loro-loron.”
verses.20: Bainhira sira sai hosi enkontru ho Faraó, sira hasoru Moisés no Arão nebee hein hela iha dalan,
verses.21: Depois xefi sira dehan ba sira nain rua, “Diak se Nai haree imi nia hahalok no kastigu imi, tanba imi halo ami nia naran dois iha Faraó nia oin, no nia atan sira nia oin, nunee imi foo ona surik iha sira nia liman hodi oho ami.”
verses.22: Entaun Moisés baa no halo orasaun ba Nai dehan, “Nai, tanba saa mak O foo terus ba povu nee? Tanba saa mak O haruka hau?
verses.23: Tanba dezde hau baa hasoru Faraó no koalia ho nia hodi O nia naran, nia halo aat ba povu nee, no O la foo liberdade ba O nia povu.”

verses.1: Maibee Nai hatete ba Moisés, “Agora o sei haree saida mak Hau atu halo ba Faraó. Tanba nia sei husik povu nee atu baa ho liman forti. No nia sei duni sira sai hosi ninia rai ho liman forti.”
verses.2: Depois Maromak hatete ba Moisés, “Hau mak Nai.
verses.3: Hau hatudu aan tiha ona ba Abraão, ba Isak no ba Jacó hanesan Maromak Kbiit Makaas. Maibee ho Hau nia naran Nai, Hau seidauk foo konhesimentu ba sira.
verses.4: Hau mos halo aliansa ho sira hodi foo rai Kanaan, fatin nebee uluk sira lao ba-mai no hela nudar ema lao rai.
verses.5: No mos, Hau rona tiha ona ema Israel sira nia tanis tanba ema Ejitu sira sei kastigu sira. No Hau hanoin hetan Hau nia aliansa.
verses.6: Tanba nee hatete ba ema Israel, ‘Hau mak Nai, no Hau sei lori imi sai hosi Ejitu sira nia todan. Hau sei hasai imi hosi sira nia kastigu. Hau sei hola fali imi ho liman forti no ho julgamentu nebee makaas.
verses.7: Hau sei foti imi hodi sai Hau nia povu no Hau sei sai imi nia Maromak. Nunee imi bele hatene katak Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak, nebee lori imi sai hosi Ejitu sira nia todan.
verses.8: Hau sei lori imi ba rai nebee Hau jura tiha ona atu foo ba Abraão, Isak no Jacó. Hau sei foo rai nee ba imi nudar liman rohan ida. Hau mak Nai.’”
verses.9: Moisés koalia hanesan nee ba ema Israel, maibee sira la rona Moisés tanba sira nia espíritu iha terus, no sira nia kastigu todan tebes.
verses.10: Depois Nai dehan ba Moisés,
verses.11: “Baa hasoru Faraó, liurai iha Ejitu nee, no hatete ba nia katak nia tenki husik ema Israel sira sai hosi ninia rai.”
verses.12: Maibee Moisés hatete ba Nai, “Tebes, ema Israel rasik la rona hau, nunee oinsaa Faraó bele rona hau? Hau ema nebee koalia ho nanaal toos!”
verses.13: Maibee Nai koalia ho Moisés no Arão, no haruka sira baa hasoru ema Israel sira no Faraó, liurai Ejitu, hodi husu ema Israel sira bele sai hosi Ejitu.
verses.14: Ema sira nee mak ulun ba sira nia família: Ruben, Israel nia oan primeiru, nia oan sira: Henoke, Palu, Hezron no Karmi; sira nee mak Ruben nia jerasaun.
verses.15: Simeão nia oan sira: Jemuel, Jamin, Oade, Jakin, Zoar no Saul nebee feto Kanaan ida nia oan; sira nee mak Simeão nia jerasaun.
verses.16: Levi nia oan sira nia naran mak nee, tuir sira nia jerasaun: Gerson, Koat no Merari; Levi nia tinan hotu mak atus ida tolu-nulu resin hitu.
verses.17: Gerson nia oan sira: Libni no Simei, tuir sira nia jerasaun.
verses.18: Koat nia oan sira: Amram, Isar, Hebron no Uziel. Koat nia tinan hotu mak atus ida tolu-nulu resin tolu.
verses.19: Merari nia oan sira: Mali no Musi. Ida nee mak família sira hosi Levi tuir sira nia jerasaun sira.
verses.20: No Amram foti Jokebed, nebee ninia aman nia alin feto hodi sai nia feen, no feto nee hetan oan rua naran Arão no Moisés. Amram nia tinan hotu mak atus ida tolu-nulu resin hitu.
verses.21: Isar nia oan sira: Kora, Nefege no Zikri.
verses.22: Uziel nia oan sira: Misael, Elzafa no Sitri.
verses.23: No Arão foti Eliseba, Aminadab nia oan feto, nebee Naason nia alin, atu sai ninia feen. Feto nee hetan oan naran Nadab, Abiu, Eleazar no Itamar.
verses.24: Kora nia oan sira: Asir, Elkana, no Abiasaf. Ida nee mak ema Kora sira nia jerasaun sira.
verses.25: Eleazar, Arão nia oan, hola Putiel nia oan feto ida, no nia hetan oan ida naran Fineias. Ema sira nee mak xefi ba família Levi nian tuir sira nia jerasaun.
verses.26: Nain rua nee mak Arão no Moisés nebee Nai foo orden, “Lori ema Israel sira sai hosi rai Ejitu.”
verses.27: Sira mak koalia ba Faraó, liurai Ejitu, hodi sira bele lori ema Israel sira sai hosi rai Ejitu. Nain rua nee mak Arão no Moisés.
verses.28: Tuir mai, iha loron nebee Nai koalia ho Moisés iha rai Ejitu,
verses.29: Nai dehan ba nia, “Hau mak Nai. Hatete ba Faraó, liurai hosi Ejitu nee, buat hotu nebee Hau dehan ba o.”
verses.30: Maibee Moisés hatete ba Nai, “Tebes, hau koalia ho nanaal toos. Oinsaa Faraó bele rona hau?”

verses.1: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Tebes, Hau halo o sai hanesan Maromak ba Faraó, no o nia maun Arão sei sai hanesan o nia profeta.
verses.2: O sei dehan buat hotu nebee Hau manda ba o, no o nia maun Arão nee sei hatoo liafuan nee ba Faraó. Nunee nia bele haruka ema Israel sira sai hosi ninia rai.
verses.3: Maibee Hau sei halo Faraó nia fuan laran sai toos. Hau sei habarak Hau nia sinál sira no Hau nia milagre sira iha Ejitu.
verses.4: Mezmu nunee, Faraó sei la rona imi. Ho ida nee Hau sei hatuun Hau nia liman ba Ejitu no lori sai Hau nia forsa sira, nebee Hau nia povu, ema Israel sira. Hau sei lori sira sai hosi Ejitu liu hosi julgamentu nebee makaas.
verses.5: No ema Ejitu sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau lolo Hau nia liman hasoru sira no lori ema Israel sira sai hosi sira nia leet.”
verses.6: Moisés no Arão halo tuir. Sira halo tuir saida deit nebee Nai manda ba sira.
verses.7: Moisés nia tinan ualu-nulu tiha ona no Arão nia tinan ualu-nulu resin tolu, bainhira sira baa no koalia ho Faraó.
verses.8: Nai dehan ba Moisés no Arão,
verses.9: “Bainhira Faraó hatete ba imi, ‘Hatudu took milagre ida,’ nunee o sei dehan ba Arão, ‘Foti o nia ai tonka no soe ba Faraó nia oin, hodi ai tonka nee bele nakfilak ba samea naga.’”
verses.10: Depois Moisés no Arão baa no hasoru Faraó. No sira halo tuir saida mak Nai foo orden tiha ona ba sira. Arão soe nia ai tonka iha Faraó no ninia atan sira nia oin, nunee ai tonka nee sai samea naga ida.
verses.11: Entaun Faraó mos bolu ema matenek no astrolojia sira. No matan dook sira hosi Ejitu mos halo hanesan liu hosi sira nia lulik.
verses.12: Sira ida-idak soe sira nia ai tonka no ai tonka sira nee sai samea naga. Maibee Arão nia ai tonka nee tolan sira nia ai tonka hotu.
verses.13: Maibee Faraó nia fuan toos, nunee nia lakohi rona sira nain rua, hanesan Nai hatete tiha ona ba sira.
verses.14: Nunee Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Faraó nia fuan laran sai toos ona. Nia lakohi husik povu nee atu baa.
verses.15: Aban dadeer-saan baa hasoru fali Faraó iha fatin nebee baibain nia sai ba mota. No o sei hein nia iha Mota Nilu nia ninin no kaer ai tonka, ida nebee uluk nakfilak ba samea nee, iha o nia liman.
verses.16: No hatete ba nia, ‘Nai, ema Ebreu sira nia Maromak, haruka ona hau mai hasoru o hodi dehan: Husik Hau nia povu baa, nunee sira bele serví Hau iha rai fuik. Maibee too agora o lakohi rona.
verses.17: Tanba nee mak Nai dehan: O sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai liu hosi ida nee: Tebes, ho ai tonka nebee iha hau nia liman nee, hau sei baku bee nebee iha Mota Nilu, no bee sei sai raan,
verses.18: no ikan nebee iha mota laran sei mate, nunee bee iha Mota Nilu sei sai dois, no ema Ejitu sira sei lakohi hemu bee hosi Mota Nilu nee.’”
verses.19: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Hatete ba Arão: Foti o nia ai tonka, no lolo liman ba Ejitu nia bee, ba sira nia mota sira, no sira nia bee dalan sira, no sira nia bee lihun sira, no sira nia tanki sira hotu, hodi sira sai raan. Nunee sira hetan raan iha rai Ejitu tomak, inklui baldi ai no fatuk kuak sira hotu.”
verses.20: Depois Moisés no Arão halo tuir buat nebee Nai dehan ba sira. Nia foti ai tonka nee no baku ba bee iha Mota Nilu, iha Faraó nia oin no iha nia atan sira nia oin. Ho ida nee bee hotu nebee iha Mota Nilu nee nakfilak sai raan.
verses.21: No ikan sira iha Mota Nilu nee mate. Nunee Mota Nilu sai dois no ema Ejitu sira la bele hemu bee hosi Mota Nilu. No iha rai Ejitu tomak bee sai raan.
verses.22: Maibee matan dook sira iha Ejitu mos halo hanesan nee ho sira nia lulik. Nunee Faraó nia fuan laran sai toos no nia lakohi rona sira nain rua, hanesan Nai dehan tiha ona.
verses.23: Faraó fila fali no tama ba ninia uma no nia lakohi hanoin kona ba ida nee iha ninia fuan laran.
verses.24: Maibee ema Ejitu sira kee besik iha Mota Nilu hodi buka bee atu hemu, tanba sira la bele hemu bee hosi Mota Nilu.
verses.25: Nai nia kastigu kona bee iha Mota Nilu nee too loron hitu.

verses.1: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Baa hasoru Faraó no hatete ba nia, ‘Nai hatete nunee: Husik Hau nia povu baa, atu nunee sira bele serví ba Hau.
verses.2: Se o lakohi husik sira baa, Hau sei kastigu o nia rai Ejitu tomak ho manduku.
verses.3: Mota Nilu nee sei iha manduku barak demais, no sira sei sae ba o nia uma no iha o nia kuartu, too iha o nia kama. Sira sei tama ba o nia atan sira nia uma, no ba o nia povu, no iha fugaun no iha fatin deut paun mos.
verses.4: Manduku sira nee sei sae ba no kona o, no o nia povu no mos o nia atan hotu nia isin lolon.’”
verses.5: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Hatete ba Arão: Lolo o nia liman ho ai tonka nee ba Mota Nilu, no bee dalan sira no bee lihun sira, hodi halo manduku sira mosu mai ba rai Ejitu nee.”
verses.6: Depois Arão lolo liman ba bee fatin sira iha Ejitu. No manduku sira komesa mosu no taka rai Ejitu tomak.
verses.7: Maibee matan dook sira mos bele halo hanesan nee ho sira nia lulik, nunee sira mos halo manduku sira mosu iha rai Ejitu.
verses.8: Depois Faraó bolu Moisés no Arão no hatete, “Halo orasaun ba Nai, hodi hasai tiha manduku sira hosi hau no hosi hau nia povu, nunee hau sei husik povu nee baa, hodi sira bele halo sakrifísiu ba Nai.”
verses.9: Moisés dehan ba Faraó, “O bele hili tempu atu haruka hau halo orasaun ba Nai kona ba o, o nia atan sira no o nia povu, hodi hasai manduku sira nee hosi imi no imi nia uma. Nunee manduku sira bele hela deit iha Mota Nilu.”
verses.10: Nunee Faraó hataan, “Aban.” Depois Moisés dehan, “Ida nee sei akontese tuir o nia liafuan, hodi o bele hatene katak la iha ida hanesan Nai, ami nia Maromak.
verses.11: Nunee manduku sira nee sei sai hosi o, hosi o nia uma sira, hosi o nia atan sira, no hosi o nia povu. No manduku sira nee sei hela deit iha Mota Nilu.”
verses.12: Depois Moisés no Arão sai hosi Faraó. Moisés halo orasaun ba Nai kona ba manduku sira nebee Nia haruka mai hasoru Faraó.
verses.13: No Nai halo tuir Moisés nia liafuan. Nunee manduku sira nee mate no lakon hosi uma, hosi aldeia sira no hosi rai sira nee.
verses.14: Sira halibur manduku mate barak no rai nee dois loos.
verses.15: Maibee bainhira Faraó haree katak ida nee diak ona, ninia fuan sai toos no nia lakohi rona sira nain rua, hanesan Nai koalia ona.
verses.16: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Hatete ba Arão: Lolo o nia ai tonka nee no baku rai rahun hodi sai kutun iha rai Ejitu tomak.”
verses.17: No sira halo tuir. Arão lolo liman ho ai tonka no baku rai. Depois kutun sira mai no tata ema no animál sira. Rai rahun sira hotu sai kutun iha Ejitu tomak.
verses.18: Matan dook sira mos koko halo hanesan nee ho sira nia lulik maibee sira la bele. Nunee kutun sira nee tata ema no animál.
verses.19: Depois matan dook sira nee hatete ba Faraó, “Ida nee mak Maromak nia liman.” Maibee Faraó nia fuan toos, no nia lakohi rona sira, hanesan Nai koalia ona.
verses.20: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Hadeer dadeer-saan sedu no hein Faraó iha tempu nebee baibain nia sai atu baa mota. No hatete ba nia, ‘Nai hatete nunee: Husik Hau nia povu baa, atu nunee sira bele serví ba Hau.
verses.21: Tanba se o la husik Hau nia povu baa, tebes Hau sei haruka lalar barak mai iha o, o nia atan sira, o nia povu no o nia uma sira. Nunee ema Ejitu sira nia uma no rai iha fatin nebee sira hamriik sei sai nakonu ho lalar barak.
verses.22: Maibee iha tempu nebaa Hau sei haketak rai Gosen, tanba Hau nia povu sira hela iha nebaa. Nunee rai iha nebaa sei la hetan lalar barak, no o sei hatene katak Hau, Nai, iha rai laran nee.
verses.23: Tanba Hau sei haketak Hau nia povu hosi o nia povu. Aban sinál nee sei akontese.’”
