verses.24: Nai halo hanesan nee duni. Lalar barak demais mai iha Faraó nia uma no iha nia atan sira nia uma no iha rai Ejitu tomak. Rai nee sai aat tanba lalar barak nee.
verses.25: Depois Faraó bolu Moisés no Arão, no nia hatete ba sira, “Baa ona, halo sakrifísiu ba imi nia Maromak iha rai nee.”
verses.26: Maibee Moisés hatete, “Ami la bele halo hanesan nee. Tanba sakrifísiu nebee ami atu halo ba Nai, ami nia Maromak, nee ladiak ba ema Ejitu sira. Bainhira ami halo sakrifísiu nebee la diak ba ema Ejitu sira, iha sira nia oin, laos sira sei tuda ami ho fatuk?
verses.27: Ami tenki lao loron tolu baa iha rai fuik hodi halo sakrifísiu nee ba Nai, ami nia Maromak, hanesan Nia manda ona mai ami.”
verses.28: Depois Faraó hataan, “Hau sei husik imi baa hodi halo sakrifísiu ba Nai, imi nia Maromak, iha rai fuik. Maibee imi keta baa dook liu. No halo orasaun ba Nai kona ba hau.”
verses.29: Depois Moisés dehan, “Agora, hau sei husik hela ita, no halo orasaun ba Nai, hodi aban lalar barak sei sai hosi Faraó, hosi nia atan sira no hosi nia povu. Maibee Faraó keta bosok tan ema Israel sira hodi la husik sira baa halo sakrifísiu ba Nai.”
verses.30: Depois Moisés sai hosi Faraó, no nia halo orasaun ba Nai.
verses.31: No Nai halo tuir Moisés nia liafuan. Nia hasai tiha lalar barak nee hosi Faraó, hosi nia atan sira no hosi nia povu. La iha lalar ida tan iha nebaa.
verses.32: Maibee, iha tempu nee mos, Faraó halo nia fuan toos, no nia lakohi husik povu Israel baa.

9.title: Kastigu Ba Dala Lima: Animál Mate

verses.1: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Baa hasoru Faraó no dehan ba nia: Nai, ema Ebreu nia Maromak, hatete nunee: Husik Hau nia povu baa, atu nunee sira bele serví ba Hau.
verses.2: Tanba se o lakohi husik sira baa no kaer sira nafatin,
verses.3: tebes, Nai nia liman sei kona o nia animál sira iha rai laran nee. Ninia liman sei kona kuda, kuda buru, kuda kamelu, karau no bibi malae sira, nunee sira sei hetan susar boot nebee todan liu.
verses.4: Maibee Nai sei haketak animál sira hosi ema Israel no animál sira hosi ema Ejitu, hodi ema Israel nia animál ida mos sei la mate.”
verses.5: Depois Nai desidi tempu ida, no Nia dehan, “Nai sei kastigu rai nee iha loron aban.”
verses.6: No Nai kastigu animál iha loron aban. Ema Ejitu sira nia animál mate hotu. Maibee la iha animál ida nebee mate hosi ema Israel sira nian.
verses.7: Depois Faraó haruka ema baa haree no tebes la iha animál ida nebee mate hosi ema Israel. Maibee Faraó nia fuan laran toos nafatin no nia lakohi husik povu nee atu baa.
verses.8: Nai dehan ba Moisés no Arão, “Foti ahi kdesan uut hosi fornu, no Moisés bele soe ba leten iha Faraó nia oin.
verses.9: Ahi kdesan nee sei sai rai rahun hodi taka rai Ejitu hotu. No ida nee sei lori moras fisur ho been nebee kona ema no animál sira iha rai Ejitu tomak.”
verses.10: Depois sira foti ahi kdesan hosi fornu, no hamriik iha Faraó nia oin, no Moisés soe ahi kdesan nee ba leten. Nunee moras fisur ho been kona ema no animál sira.
verses.11: No matan dook sira la bele hamriik iha Moisés nia oin, tanba moras fisur sira nee. Tanba fisur sira nee kona matan dook sira no ema Ejitu hotu.
verses.12: Maibee Nai halo Faraó nia fuan laran toos Nunee nia lakohi rona sira hanesan Nai dehan ona ba Moisés.
verses.13: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Hadeer dadeer-saan no hamriik iha Faraó nia oin no hatete ba nia: Nai, ema Ebreu nia Maromak, hatete nunee, ‘Husik Hau nia povu baa, atu nunee sira bele serví ba Hau.
verses.14: Tanba iha tempu nee Hau sei haruka Hau nia susar boot hotu atu hasoru o rasik, o nia atan sira, no o nia povu. Nunee o bele hatene katak la iha ida hanesan Hau iha mundu tomak.
verses.15: Tuir lo-loos Hau bele lolo ona Hau nia liman atu oho o no o nia povu ho moras, nunee o lakon hosi mundu nee.
verses.16: Maibee tanba razaun nee mak Hau foti o sai boot, hodi hatudu Hau nia kbiit ba o. Nunee Hau nia naran bele sai boot iha mundu tomak.
verses.17: Too agora o sei foti aan hodi hasoru Hau nia povu, no o sei la husik sira baa.
verses.18: Tebes, aban iha oras hanesan nee, Hau sei haruka udan nebee jelu fatuk boot, nebee seidauk akontese iha Ejitu dezde hahuu too agora.
verses.19: Tanba nee, haruka ema lori o nia animál no buat hotu nebee iha o nia rai ba fatin nebee seguru. Ema hotu no animál hotu nebee sei iha liur no la fila fali ba uma, jelu fatuk sei kona sira too mate.’”
verses.20: Nunee Faraó nia atan sira nebee hamtauk ba Nai nia liafuan, haruka sira nia atan sira no animál sira atu halai ba uma laran.
verses.21: Maibee sira nebee lakohi rona Nai nia liafuan, husik sira nia atan no animál sira iha liur.
verses.22: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Foti o nia liman ba lalehan, nunee udan jelu fatuk sei tuun ba iha rai Ejitu tomak. Udan jelu fatuk sei kona ema, animál no ai horis hotu nebee iha rai Ejitu.”
verses.23: Depois Moisés foti sae nia ai tonka ba lalehan no Nai halo rai tarutu no haruka udan jelu fatuk, no ahi mos kona rai. No Nai hatuun udan jelu fatuk ba rai Ejitu.
verses.24: No udan jelu fatuk, no ahi nebee hamutuk ho udan jelu fatuk nee, mai ho forsa, nebee seidauk akontese iha rai Ejitu tomak, dezde sira sai nasaun ida.
verses.25: Udan jelu fatuk nee estraga buat hotu nebee iha rai Ejitu tomak nebee iha liur, inklui ema no animál no ai horis hotu. No ai huun boot sira mos monu.
verses.26: Só iha rai Gosen deit, rai nebee ema Israel sira hela, mak udan jelu fatuk la iha.
verses.27: Depois Faraó haruka ema bolu Moisés no Arão no hatete ba sira, “Hau halo ona sala ida. Nai mak loos, maibee hau ho hau nia povu mak sala.
verses.28: Halo orasaun ba Nai, tanba rai tarutu no udan jelu fatuk nee too ona. Nunee hau sei husik imi baa no imi lalika hela tan iha nee.”
verses.29: Moisés hatete ba nia, “Bainhira hau sai hosi sidade nee, hau sei foti hau nia liman ba Nai, nunee rai tarutu no udan jelu fatuk nee sei para. Nunee o sei hatene katak mundu nee mak Nai nian.
verses.30: Maibee kona ba o no o nia atan sira, hau hatene katak imi seidauk hamtauk ba Nai Maromak.”
verses.31: Ai tunis no trigu boot nee sai aat hotu ona, tanba trigu boot nee fuan hela no ai tunis mos funan hela.
verses.32: Maibee udan jelu fatuk la estraga trigu no trigu kiik tanba sira seidauk boot.
verses.33: Depois Moses sai hosi sidade no husik hela Faraó. Nia foti ninia liman ba Nai no rai tarutu no udan jelu fatuk nee para. No mos udan la tuun ba rai.
verses.34: Maibee bainhira Faraó haree katak udan jelu fatuk no rai tarutu nee para ona, nia halo sala fali. Nia no mos ninia atan sira kontinua fuan toos.
verses.35: Faraó nia fuan toos, nunee nia la husik ema Israel sira baa, hanesan Nai hatete ona liu hosi Moisés.

verses.1: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Ba hasoru Faraó, tanba Hau halo nia no nia atan sira nia fuan toos. Ho ida nee Hau bele hatudu Hau nia sinál sira iha sira nia leet.
verses.2: No o bele konta ba o nia oan no o nia bei-oan oinsaa Hau halo buat terus sira nee ho ema Ejitu sira. O bele konta sinál sira nebee Hau halo iha sira nia leet, hodi imi bele hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”
verses.3: Depois Moisés no Arão baa hasoru Faraó no hatete ba nia, “Nai, ema Ebreu nia Maromak, hatete nunee, ‘Too bainhira mak imi lakohi haraik aan iha Hau nia oin? Husik Hau nia povu sira baa, nunee sira bele serví ba Hau.
verses.4: Se o lakohi husik Hau nia povu baa, aban Hau sei husik gafanhotu sira mai iha imi nia rai.
verses.5: Gafanhotu sira sei taka rai tomak nee, nunee ema la bele haree hetan rai. Gafanhotu sei haan hotu ai horis restu sira nebee sei moris, buat nebee udan jelu fatuk la konsege estraga ona. Gafanhotu sei haan ai horis hotu nebee iha ai laran.
verses.6: Gafanhotu nee sei sai nakonu iha imi nia uma laran, imi nia atan hotu nia uma no iha ema Ejitu sira nia uma hotu. Imi nia aman no imi nia bei-ala sira seidauk haree ida nee dezde sira moris mai iha mundu too ohin loron.’” Nunee nia fila no husik hela Faraó.
verses.7: Liu tiha nee, Faraó nia atan sira hatete ba nia, “Too bainhira mak ema nee sai lasu ba ita boot? Husik ema sira nee baa hodi sira bele serví sira nia Nai. Ita boot hatene ona ka lae, katak Ejitu nee lakon ona?”
verses.8: Depois sira lori Moisés no Arão ba Faraó no nia dehan ba sira, “Baa ona, serví ba Nai, imi nia Maromak. Maibee see-see mak baa?”
verses.9: Moisés hataan, “Ami sei baa ho ami nia labarik no katuas sira, ho ami nia oan mane no oan feto sira, ho ami nia bibi no karau sira. Ami sira nee sei baa tanba ami sei halo festa ida ba Nai.”
verses.10: Maibee Faraó hatete ba sira, “Nai mak hamutuk ho imi, se hau husik imi baa ho imi nia oan sira! Haree, imi iha laran aat!
verses.11: La bele hanesan nee. Imi bele baa, maibee mane sira deit bele baa hodi serví ba Nai. Tanba imi husu ona ida nee.” Depois ema duni sira sai hosi Faraó nia oin.
verses.12: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Lolo o nia liman ba rai Ejitu hodi gafanhotu sira sei mai iha rai Ejitu, no sira sei haan ai horis hotu iha rai nee, buat hotu nebee sei iha tuir udan fatuk jelu nee.”
verses.13: Depois Moisés lolo ninia ai tonka ba rai Ejitu. Nai haruka anin mai hosi parte lorosae, loron tomak no kalan tomak. No bainhira too ona dadeer-saan, anin lorosae nee lori ona gafanhotu sira mai.
verses.14: Gafanhotu mai nakonu iha rai Ejitu, no barak tebes tuun iha fatin hotu iha rai Ejitu. Molok tempu nee, la iha gafanhotu barak hanesan nee, no sei la akontese tan hanesan nee iha tempu tuir mai.
verses.15: Gafanhotu nee taka rai hotu, nunee rai nakukun. Sira haan hotu ai horis no ai fuan sira nebee sei hela hosi udan jelu fatuk. La iha tahan matak ida nebee sei iha ai horis. La iha ai haan ida iha toos iha rai Ejitu tomak.
verses.16: Nunee Faraó bolu Moisés no Arão no hatete ba sira, “Hau halo ona sala hasoru Nai, imi nia Maromak, no ba imi mos.
verses.17: Tanba nee, dala ida nee, foo perdaun tanba hau nia sala no halo orasaun ba Nai, imi nia Maromak, nunee buat susar atu mate nee bele sai hosi hau.”
verses.18: Depois Moisés sai hosi Faraó no halo orasaun ba Nai.
verses.19: Nunee Nai halo anin boot huu hosi parte loromonu ho forsa, nebee foti gafanhotu sira nee no soe sira ba iha Tasi Teberau. La iha gafanhotu ida nebee sei hela iha rai Ejitu tomak.
verses.20: Maibee Nai halo Faraó nia fuan toos nafatin, nunee nia la husik ema Israel sira baa.
verses.21: Nai dehan ba Moisés: Foti o nia liman ba lalehan, hodi nakukun mai taka rai Ejitu, nakukun ida nebee ema senti kona sira.”
verses.22: Depois Moisés foti nia liman ba lalehan no nakukun loos mai iha rai Ejitu tomak durante loron tolu.
verses.23: Sira la haree malu, no la iha ema ida nebee hadeer hosi nia fatin durante loron tolu. Maibee ema Israel hotu iha naroman iha sira nia hela fatin.
verses.24: Depois Faraó bolu Moisés no dehan, “Baa ona! Serví ba imi nia Nai. Maibee imi nia bibi malae no karau sira tenki hela, no imi nia oan sira bele tuir imi.”
verses.25: Maibee Moisés hatete, “Sakrifísiu oho no sakrifísiu tunu sira o tenki foo mai ami, hodi nunee ami bele prepara ba Nai, ami nia Maromak.
verses.26: No mos ami nia animál tenki tuir ami, ain ida mos la bele hela, tanba hosi animál nee mak ami foti hodi serví ba Nai, ami nia Maromak. Ami la hatene ho saida mak ami atu serví ba Nai, too ami baa too iha nebaa.”
verses.27: Maibee Nai halo Faraó nia fuan toos nunee nia lakohi husik sira baa.
verses.28: Depois Faraó hatete ba nia, “Baa tiha hosi hau nia oin! Kuidadu ba. O la bele haree fali hau nia oin, tanba bainhira o haree hau nia oin fali o sei mate.”
verses.29: Depois Moisés hatete, “Hanesan saida mak ita dehan! Hau sei la haree tan ita nia oin!”

11.title: Foo Hatene Kastigu Ba Dala Sanulu

verses.1: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Hau sei foo kastigu ida tan ba Faraó no Ejitu, depois nia sei husik imi baa. Bainhira nia husik imi baa, nia sei duni sai imi hotu hosi fatin nee.
verses.2: Agora, hatete ba povu nee, mane ida-idak bele husu ninia vizinhu, no feto ida-idak bele husu ninia vizinhu hodi hetan sasaan osan mutin no sasaan osan mean.”
verses.3: Depois Nai halo ema Ejitu hatudu grasa ba ema Israel. Moisés mak ema konhesidu boot iha rai Ejitu, iha Faraó nia atan sira nia oin, no iha povu nia oin.
verses.4: Moisés hatete, “Nai hatete nunee: Iha kalan boot Hau sei lao baa iha ema Ejitu nia leet.
verses.5: No oan primeiru hotu iha rai Ejitu sei mate, inklui oan primeiru hosi Faraó nebee tuur iha nia kadunan too oan primeiru hosi atan feto nebee fai batar, no animál nia oan primeiru hotu.
verses.6: No sira sei hakilar ho lian makaas iha rai Ejitu tomak, nebee seidauk akontese no se la akontese tan.
verses.7: Maibee ba ema Israel, asu mos sei la hatenu ba ema ida ka animál ida, nunee imi bele hatene katak Nai haketak ema Ejitu hosi ema Israel.
verses.8: No o nia atan sira sei tuun mai hau no hatete, ‘Sai ona, o ho o nia povu nebee tuir o.’ Depois hau sei sai.” Depois Moisés husik hela Faraó ho hirus manas.
verses.9: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Faraó sei la rona o, nunee milagre nebee Hau halo sei aumenta tan iha rai Ejitu.”
verses.10: Moisés ho Arão halo tiha milagre hotu nee iha Faraó nia oin. Maibee Nai halo Faraó nia fuan laran toos. Nunee nia la husik ema Israel sira sai hosi ninia rai.

verses.1: Nai koalia ho Moisés no Arão iha rai Ejitu, no Nia hatete,
verses.2: “Fulan ida nee bele hahuu tempu foun ba imi. Fulan nee sei sai fulan primeiru iha imi nia tinan.
verses.3: Hatete ba ema Israel tomak katak iha loron sanulu iha fulan nee, mane ida-idak tenki oho bibi oan ida hodi haan hamutuk ho família hotu: bibi ida ba uma ida.
verses.4: Se membru família uma kain nee mak ema uitoan liu atu la bele haan hotu bibi malae nee, mak família nee bele konvida tan vizinhu sira, tuir ema nebee iha, hodi haan bibi malae. Bibi malae nee tenki fahe tuir ema sira nebee mak haan.
verses.5: Imi bele hili bibi malae ka bibi timor, maibee tenki bibi aman, idade tinan ida, no la iha buat aat ida.
verses.6: Imi tenki rai bibi malae nee too loron sanulu resin haat. Iha lokraik, ema Israel tomak iha sorumutu nee tenki oho bibi oan nee.
verses.7: Depois bibi nia raan balu kose ba odamatan nia arus iha sorin-sorin nee no kose mos ba arus iha odamatan leten. Halo ida nee iha uma fatin nebee ema atu haan bibi.
verses.8: Iha kalan nee mos nia naan tenki tunu ho ahi no sira tenki haan ho paun nebee la kahur fermentu no ho modo moruk.
verses.9: Haan naan tunu nee, keta haan naan matak ka naan daan. bibi oan nee tenki tunu tomak ho ninia ulun, nia ain no kabun laran sira hotu.
verses.10: Keta rai naan uitoan too dadeer-saan. Se karik iha naan restu iha dadeer, imi tenki sunu.
verses.11: Bainhira imi haan, imi tenki hatais hodi halo viajen. Tau sandálias iha ain no kaer ai-tonka. Imi tenki haan lalais. Ida nee mak Nai nia Páskua.
verses.12: Tanba iha kalan nee, Hau sei lao liu rai Ejitu laran tomak, hodi oho oan mane boot hotu-hotu iha Ejitu, inklui ema no animál sira. Hau sei kontra ema Ejitu nia maromak sira. Hau sei tesi lia hasoru sira: Hau mak Nai.
verses.13: Raan nee sei sai sinál ida ba uma nebee imi hela. Bainhira Hau haree raan nee, Hau sei lao liu imi. Nunee imi sei la hetan kastigu nebee bele halakon imi bainhira Hau baku rai Ejitu.
verses.14: Loron nee sei sai istória nebee imi sei hanoin hetan. Imi tenki selebra nudar loron boot ba Nai. Imi ho imi nia jerasaun sira tenki selebra loron boot nee too tinan ba tinan.
verses.15: Nai hatete: durante loron hitu, imi keta haan paun nebee iha fermentu. Iha loron primeiru, imi tenki hasai fermentu hotu hosi imi nia uma. Se karik ema ruma haan paun nebee iha fermentu iha loron hitu nia larannee, entaun ema nee sei lakon tiha hosi Israel.
verses.16: Iha loron primeiru, imi sei halo sorumutu santu. No mos iha loron hitu, imi sei halo sorumutu santu. Iha loron nee imi keta halo servisu ida, só deit hodi prepara hahaan.
verses.17: Imi sei kontinua nafatin selebra Festa Paun Fermentu Laek tanba iha loron nee mak Hau lori imi nia forsa sira sai hosi rai Ejitu. Tanba nee, tinan-tinan imi tenki kontinua nafatin selebra loron nee, nebee loron boot, too tinan ba tinan.
verses.18: Iha fulan primeiru, iha loron sanulu resin haat iha fulan nee, iha lokraik, imi sei haan paun nebee la kahur fermentu too loron rua-nulu resin ida iha fulan nee, iha lokraik fali.
verses.19: Durante loron hitu nia laran keta iha fermentu iha imi nia uma. Tanba se iha ema ruma nebee haan paun nebee iha fermentu, ema nee sei lakon hosi povu Israel. Kastigu nee inklui ema hosi rai liur no ema Israel.
verses.20: Hahaan ruma nebee iha fermentu imi keta haan. Imi haan deit paun nebee la kahur fermentu iha imi nia uma fatin hotu.
verses.21: Moisés bolu Israel nia lideransa sira hotu no dehan ba sira, “Família Israel ida-idak tenki hili bibi ida no oho hodi selebra loron Páskua.
verses.22: Depois imi tenki foti ai isope atu tau ba bibi nia raan nebee iha basia. No kose raan nee ba odamatan nia arus leten no arus sorin-sorin. Keta husik ema ida atu sai hosi ninia uma too dadeer-saan.
verses.23: Bainhira Nai lao iha rai Ejitu hodi oho ema Ejitu sira, Nia sei haree raan iha arus leten no arus sorin-sorin nee. Nunee Nia sei lao liu deit no Nai sei la foo lisensa ba Estragadór atu tama ba imi nia uma hodi oho imi.
verses.24: Imi no imi nia jerasaun sira tenki halo tuir orden nee too tinan ba tinan.
verses.25: Liu tiha tempu nee, bainhira imi tama ba rai nebee Nai foo ba imi, tuir Ninia promesa nebee Nia foo ona, imi sei kontinua halao nafatin serimónia ida nee.
verses.26: Bainhira imi nia oan sira husu, ‘Serimónia ida nee signifika saida?’
verses.27: Imi sei hataan, ‘Ida nee mak Nai nia sakrifísiu Páskua. Tanba Nia lao liu deit ema Israel sira nia uma iha rai Ejitu, iha tempu nebee Nia oho ema Ejitu sira, no Nia salva ita nia família sira.’” Nunee povu nee hakruuk no adora.
verses.28: Depois sira baa no halo tuir saida mak Nai hatete ba Moisés no Arão; sira halo ba.
verses.29: Tuir mai, iha kalan boot, Nai oho ema sira nia oan boot hotu iha rai Ejitu, komesa hosi Faraó nia oan, nebee sei tuur iha kadunan, too ema dadur sira nia oan, nebee sei iha komarka. No Nia oho mos animál sira hotu nebee moris primeiru.
verses.30: Iha kalan nee, Faraó ho nia atan sira no ema Ejitu hotu hadeer. Iha rai Ejitu tomak ema tanis no halerik makaas tanba iha uma ida-idak iha ema ida nebee mate.
verses.31: Iha kalan nee kedas, liurai haruka ema bolu Moisés ho Arão no hatete ba sira, “Imi sai ona hosi hau nia povu, imi ho ema Israel sira hotu! Baa, serví Nai imi nia Maromak tuir buat nebee imi husu ona.
verses.32: Lori imi nia karau no bibi sira hotu, hanesan imi husu, no baa ona! No foo bensaun mai hau mos!”
verses.33: Ema Ejitu husu ba ema Israel atu sai lalais hosi sira nia rai. Sira hatete, “Ami hotu atu mate!”
verses.34: Depois ema Israel sira foti masa paun nebee la kahur fermentu no tau iha basia, no sira falun iha hena no tau ba kabaas.
verses.35: Ema Israel sira halo tuir buat nebee Moisés hatete. Nunee sira husu ba ema Ejitu sira atu foo sira nia kelu no korenti sira nebee osan mutin no osan mean, no sira husu mos ropa.
verses.36: Nai halo ema Ejitu sira hatudu grasa ba ema Israel sira. Nunee saida mak ema Israel husu, sira foo deit. Nunee ema Israel sira hadau ema Ejitu sira nia riku-soin.
verses.37: Ema Israel sira lao sai hosi sidade Ramasés too iha Sukote. Sira maizoumenus mane nain rihun atus neen (600.000) nebee lao ho ain, feto ho labarik la konta.
verses.38: Ema barak nebee estranjeiru oi-oin tuir sira mos. Sira lori karau, bibi malae no bibi barak tebe-tebes.
verses.39: Ema Israel sira tunu paun nebee la kahur fermentu hosi trigu masa nebee sira lori hosi Ejitu. Paun nee fermentu la iha. Ema Ejitu sira duni sira hosi nebaa derepenti deit. Nunee sira la iha tempu hodi prepara bukae.
verses.40: Entaun povu Israel nebee hela iha Ejitu, sira lao ba-mai ona too tinan atus haat tolu-nulu (430).
verses.41: Liu tiha tinan atus haat tolu-nulu, too iha loron hanesan, Nai nia povu iha suku hotu-hotu sai hosi Ejitu.
verses.42: Iha kalan nee, Nai kuidadu sira di-diak hodi lori sira sai hosi Ejitu. Entaun kalan nee mos sai kalan nebee ema Israel foo ba Nai nudar kalan nebee ema Isael tenki komemora nafatin iha sira nia jerasaun hotu.
verses.43: Nai hatete ba Moisés no Arão dehan, “Lei Páskua nian mak nee: ema hosi rai liur keta haan ida nee.
verses.44: Maibee atan nebee imi sosa ho osan bele haan, se nia hetan sirkunsizaun ona.
verses.45: Ema hosi rai liur no ema nebee servisu ba imi keta haan.
verses.46: Naan bibi nee tenki haan hotu iha uma laran. Keta lori sai ba liur. Keta halo tohar bibi nia ruin ida.
verses.47: Ema Israel hotu-hotu tenki selebra ida nee.
verses.48: Se ema rai liur ruma nebee hela ona ho imi hakarak selebra Festa Páskua ba Nai, mane hotu-hotu iha ninia família tenki hetan sirkunsizaun hodi nia bele hakbesik no tuir festa nee. Bele haree sira nudar rai nain. Ema nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun keta haan ida nee.
verses.49: Lei nee hanesan mos ba rai nain hosi Israel no ba ema rai liur nebee hela iha imi nia leet.”
verses.50: Ema Israel hotu-hotu halo tuir orden hotu nebee Nai foo ba Moisés no Arão.
verses.51: Iha loron nee kedas, Nai lori ema Israel hotu sai hosi rai Ejitu tuir sira nia forsa sira.

13.title: Loron Boot: Paun Nebee La Iha Fermentu

verses.1: Nai dehan ba Moisés,
verses.2: “Halo santu ba Hau oan primeiru hotu, ema Israel hotu nebee loke oan fatin ba dala ida, ema no animál. Sira mak Hau nian.”
verses.3: Depois Moisés hatete ba sira, “Hanoin hetan loron ohin, tanba iha loron nee imi sai hosi Ejitu, hosi fatin nebee imi mak atan. Nai lori imi sai hosi nebaa ho liman forti. Nunee keta haan paun nebee iha fermentu.
verses.4: Loron ohin, nebee iha fulan Abib, mak loron nebee imi sai.
verses.5: Bainhira Nai lori imi baa too iha rai Kanaan, nebee ema Hiti, ema Amoreu, ema Heveu no ema Jebuseu nia rai, nebee Nia promete tiha ona ba imi nia bei-ala sira atu foo ba imi, rai nebee nakonu ho susu been no bani been, nunee imi tenki serví Nia iha fulan ida nee.
verses.6: Haan paun nebee la kahur fermentu durante loron hitu. No loron ba dala hitu sei sai loron festa nian ba Nai.
verses.7: Paun nebee la iha fermentu nee imi tenki haan durante loron hitu. Imi keta haree buat foer ruma iha imi nia hela fatin hotu.
verses.8: Iha loron nee, imi tenki foo hatene ba imi nia oan mane sira, ‘Ita halo hanesan nee tanba buat nebee uluk Nai halo ba ita iha tempu nebee ita sai hosi Ejitu.’
verses.9: Ida nee sei sai sinál iha imi nia liman no hodi imi hanoin nafatin iha imi ulun, nunee lei Nai nian sei iha imi nia ibun. Tanba Nai lori ita sai hosi Ejitu ho liman forti.
verses.10: Tinan-tinan imi tenki halo tuir lei nee tuir ninia tempu.
verses.11: Bainhira Nai lori ona imi too iha ema Kanaan nia rai, hanesan Nia jura ona ba imi no imi nia bei-ala sira, rai nebee Nia sei foo duni ba imi,
verses.12: nunee imi tenki foo ba Nai buat hotu nebee loke oan fatin ba dala ida, no animál hotu nebee moris uluk. Imi tenki foo animál aman primeiru nee ba Nai.
verses.13: Kuda buru nebee moris uluk imi tenki hola fali ho bibi ida. Se karik imi lakohi selu nee imi tenki halo tohar ninia kakorok. Maibee kona ba ema, imi nia oan mane primeiru imi tenki selu duni.
verses.14: No bainhira imi nia oan husu ba imi iha loron tuir mai, ‘Ida nee signifika saida?’ Imi tenki hataan ba sira hanesan nee, ‘Nai lori ita sai hosi Ejitu ho liman forti.
verses.15: Bainhira Faraó ho fuan toos lakohi husik ami baa, nunee Nai oho oan primeiru hotu iha rai Ejitu, hosi ema nia oan primeiru too animál nia oan primeiru. Tanba nee hau halo sakrifísiu ba Nai ho buat hotu nebee loke oan fatin ba dala ida, nebee animál aman. Maibee hau nia oan mane primeiru hotu nee, hau tenki hola fali.’
verses.16: Ida nee sei sai sinál iha imi nia liman no sai símbolu iha imi nia reen toos. Tanba Nai lori ita sai hosi Ejitu ho liman forti.”
verses.17: Bainhira Faraó husik povu nee baa ona, Maromak la husik sira atu lao liu hosi ema Filisteu sira nia dalan, maski dalan nee besik liu. Tanba Maromak dehan, “Keta halo be sira arepende bainhira sira hasoru funu, no sira fila fali baa Ejitu.”
verses.18: Maibee Maromak lori sira lao liu hosi dalan ba rai fuik, nebee liu hosi Tasi Teberau. No ema Israel sira prontu atu hasoru funu iha dalan bainhira sira sai hosi Ejitu.
verses.19: Moisés lori José nia ruin. Tanba José haruka ema Israel nia oan sira jura, “Maromak sei mai vizita imi, nunee imi tenki lori hau nia ruin hosi nee mos.”
verses.20: Nunee sira sai hosi Sukote no halo akampamentu iha Etam, iha rai fuik nia ninin.
verses.21: Nai lao iha sira nia oin. Iha tempu loron, riin kalohan hatudu dalan ba sira, no iha kalan, riin ahi foo naroman ba sira. Nunee sira bele lao loron no kalan.
verses.22: Riin kalohan iha loron no riin ahi iha kalan la sai hosi povu nia oin.

verses.1: Nai koalia ho Moisés, no Nia dehan,
verses.2: “Haruka ema Israel atu fila ba Pi-Hairote, entre Migdol no tasi, iha Baal-Zefon nia oin, nebee iha tasi ninin.
verses.3: Nunee Faraó sei koalia kona ba ema Israel, ‘Sira lao dalan sala ona iha rai ida nee. Rai fuik halo sira lao sala ona.’
verses.4: Hau sei halo Faraó nia fuan toos no nia sei duni sira. No Hau sei hatudu Hau Nia glória ba Faraó no nia forsa tomak. Nunee ema Ejitu sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.” Depois sira halo hanesan nee.
verses.5: Bainhira ema foo hatene ba liurai Ejitu katak povu Israel halai tiha ona, nunee liurai Faraó no ninia atan sira troka hanoin kona ba nasaun nee. Sira dehan, “Saida mak ami halo tiha hodi husik ema Israel baa ona hodi la serví tan ami?”
verses.6: Depois nia komesa prepara nia kuda kareta no lori nia povu sira hamutuk ho nia.
verses.7: Nia lori kuda kareta atus neen nebee diak, no kuda kareta hotu iha Ejitu, ida-idak ho nia komandante rasik.
verses.8: Nunee Nai halo liurai Faraó nia fuan toos no sira duni ema Israel sira. Maibee ema Israel sira lao nafatin ho aten brani.
verses.9: Ema Ejitu duni sira, Faraó nia kuda no kuda kareta, no nia ema nebee sae kuda no ninia forsa militár. Ema Ejitu sira duni ema Israel sira no toman sira iha tasi ninin, besik Pi-Hairote, iha Baal-Zefon nia oin.
verses.10: Bainhira Faraó besik ona, ema Israel haree hetan ema Ejitu sira. Tebes duni, ema Ejitu sira komesa tuir sira. Ema Israel sira tauk tebe-tebes no bolu ba Nai.
verses.11: Sira hatete ba Moisés, “La iha rate iha Ejitu ka? Tanba nee ita lori ami mai hodi mate iha rai fuik nee? Tanba saa mak ita halo hanesan nee mai ami no lori ami sai hosi Ejitu?
verses.12: Ami hatete tiha ona ba ita iha Ejitu, ‘Husik ami serví ba ema Ejitu sira. Diak liu ami serví ba ema Ejitu sira duké mate iha rai fuik.’”
verses.13: Maibee Moisés hatete ba povu nee, “Keta tauk, hamriik metin no haree salvasaun nebee mai hosi Nai, nebee Nia sei halo ba imi ohin loron. Imi sei nunka haree fali ema Ejitu sira nee.
verses.14: Nai rasik sei funu iha imi nia fatin, no imi sei nonook deit.”
verses.15: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Tanba saa mak o bolu ba Hau? Haruka ema Israel atu lao ba oin.
verses.16: No foti o nia ai tonka no lolo ai tonka ba tasi hodi fera tasi nee. Nunee ema Israel sira bele lao liu hosi tasi nee nia klaran iha rai maran.
verses.17: Maibee tebes, Hau sei halo ema Ejitu sira nia fuan toos. Nunee sira sei lao tuir ema Israel sira. No Hau sei hatudu Hau nia glória ba Faraó no nia forsa tomak, ninia kuda kareta no ninia ema sira nebee sae kuda.
verses.18: Nunee ema Ejitu sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau hatudu Hau nia glória ba Faraó, ninia kuda kareta, no ninia ema sira nebee sae kuda.”
verses.19: Depois anju Maromak nian, nebee lao iha akampamentu Israel sira nia oin, muda fali ba sira nia kotuk. Riin kalohan nee muda hosi sira nia oin no hamriik iha sira nia kotuk.
verses.20: Nunee riin kalohan nee hamriik iha klaran ho ema Ejitu nia akampamentu iha sorin ida no ema Israel nia akampamentu iha sorin seluk. Nunee sira iha kalohan no nakukun. No iha kalan, kalohan sai naroman. Nunee sira la bele besik ba malu durante kalan tomak.
verses.21: Depois Moisés lolo nia liman ba tasi. No iha kalan nee, Nai halo tasi nee fila fali ba ho anin lorosae. Anin nee huu makaas durante kalan tomak no halo tasi sai maran. Nunee tasi nee fahe ba rua.
verses.22: No ema Israel sira lao liu hosi tasi nia klaran nebee maran. Tasi sai hanesan moru iha sira nia liman loos no liman karuk.
verses.23: Depois ema Ejitu sira duni tuir sira. Faraó nia kuda hotu no nia kuda kareta no nia ema sira nebee sae kuda tama too iha tasi klaran.
verses.24: Iha dadeer-saan, Nai nebee iha riin ahi no riin kalohan haree ema Ejitu sira, no halo konfuzaun ba forsa Ejitu.
verses.25: Nia halo kareta nia roda komesa belit hodi lao ba oin susar. Nunee ema Ejitu sira dehan, “Mai ita halai tiha hosi ema Israel sira. Tanba Nai mak funu iha sira nia fatin hasoru ema Ejitu.”
verses.26: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Lolo o nia liman ba tasi, nunee tasi sei fila no taka ema Ejitu, taka sira nia kuda kareta no ema sira nebee sae kuda.”
verses.27: Nunee Moisés lolo nia liman ba tasi no, iha dadeer-saan, tasi fila fali ba ninia fatin. Ema Ejitu sira halai hasoru tasi nee, no Nai halakon ema Ejitu sira iha tasi klaran.
verses.28: Tasi nee fila fali, no taka kuda kareta no ema sira nebee sae kuda kareta, no Faraó nia forsa tomak, nebee tuir ema Israel sira ba tasi. La iha ema ida hosi sira nebee sei moris.
verses.29: Maibee ema Israel sira lao iha rai maran iha tasi klaran, no tasi nee hanesan moru iha sira nia liman loos no liman karuk.
verses.30: Nunee iha loron nebaa, Nai salva ema Israel sira hosi ema Ejitu sira nia liman. No ema Israel sira haree ema Ejitu sira nia mate isin namkari iha tasi ibun.
verses.31: Bainhira ema Israel sira haree buat nebee Nai halo ho forsa makaas ba ema Ejitu sira, nunee povu nee hamtauk ba Nai no sira fiar ba Nai no Moisés, Ninia atan nee.

verses.1: Depois Moisés hamutuk ho povu Israel kanta knananuk ida nee ba Nai, hanesan nee,
verses.2: Nai mak hau nia forsa no hau nia kanta,
verses.3: Nai mak hau nia funu nain;
verses.4: Faraó nia kuda kareta no nia forsa,
verses.5: Tasi klean taka sira;
verses.6: O nia liman loos, Oh Nai, iha kbiit nebee iha glória,
verses.7: Iha O nia majestade nebee boot , O harahun sira nebee hamriik hodi kontra O;
verses.8: Ho iis nebee huu makaas hosi O nia inus, bee nee halibur hamutuk,
verses.9: Inimigu sira dehan, “Hau sei duni, hau sei toman,
verses.10: O huu ho O nia anin, no tasi taka tiha sira;
verses.11: See mak hanesan O, Oh Nai, iha maromak sira nia leet?
verses.12: O lolo O nia liman loos;
verses.13: Ho O nia domin metin O lori O nia povu nebee O hola fali ona;
verses.14: Povu sei rona no sai tauk,
verses.15: Depois xefi sira iha Edom sei hakfodak,
verses.16: Sira sai tauk no hakfodak,
verses.17: O sei lori sira tama ba, no O sei kuda sira iha foho ida nebee O nian;
verses.18: Nai sei ukun too tinan ba tinan.”
verses.19: Tanba Faraó nia kuda, ninia kuda kareta no ema sira nebee sae kuda tama ba tasi. No Nai halo tasi nee fila no taka sira hotu. Maibee ema Israel sira lao iha fatin maran iha tasi klaran.
verses.20: Depois Miriam, profetisa nee, nebee Arão nia alin feto, foti tamborin ida iha nia liman no feto hotu tuir nia. Sira baku tamborin no dansa.
verses.21: No Miriam diriji sira,
verses.22: Moisés haruka ema Israel sira lao hosi Tasi Teberau. Sira lao iha rai fuik naran Sur. Durante loron tolu nia laran sira lao iha rai fuik no la hetan bee.
verses.23: Sira baa too iha Mara. Maibee sira la bele hemu bee iha Mara tanba bee nee moruk. Tanba nee ema iha rai nee foo naran Mara.
verses.24: Nunee sira murmura ba Moisés dehan, “Ami atu hemu saida?”
verses.25: Moisés bolu ba Nai, no Nai hatudu ai rohan ida ba nia. Moisés soe ai nee ba bee laran no bee nee sai midar. Iha nebaa Nai foo estatutu ida ba sira no regulamentu ida ba sira no iha nebaa Nai koko sira.
verses.26: Nia dehan, “Se imi rona di-diak ba Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia lian, no halo buat nebee loos iha Nia oin, no see imi nia tilun hodi rona Ninia ukun fuan sira no halo tuir Ninia estatutu hotu nee, nunee Hau sei la foo kastigu moras atu kona imi hanesan moras sira nebee Hau foo ona ba ema Ejitu sira. Tanba Hau mak Nai nebee kura imi.”
verses.27: Liu tiha nee, sira too iha Elim. Iha nebaa iha bee matan sanulu resin rua no ai kadiru huun hitu-nulu. Depois sira halo akampamentu iha nebaa besik bee ninin.

verses.1: Bainhira sira sai ona hosi Elim, ema Israel hotu baa too iha rai fuik Sin. Rai Sin nee iha Elim no foho Sinai nia klaran. Sira too iha nebaa iha loron sanulu resin lima, iha fulan segundu, nebee sura hosi loron nebee sira sai hosi Ejitu.
verses.2: Iha rai fuik nee, ema Israel hotu murmura hasoru Moisés no Arão.
verses.3: Ema Israel dehan ba sira, “Diak liu ami mate iha Ejitu liu hosi Nai nia liman. Tanba iha nebaa ami tuur iha sanan sorin nebee nakonu ho naan, no ami haan paun too bosu! Tanba imi lori ami mai rai fuik nee atu oho ami hotu tanba hamlaha.”
verses.4: Depois Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Tebes, Hau atu haraik paun hosi lalehan ba imi. Povu nee sei sai ba no halibur paun natoon ba loro-loron. Nunee Hau bele koko sira, hodi haree sira lao tuir Hau nia lei ka lae.
verses.5: Depois, iha loron neen, bainhira sira prepara buat nebee sira lori ba sira nia tenda, sira tenki aumenta, no prepara loron rua nian.”
verses.6: Depois Moisés no Arão hatete ba ema Israel hotu, “Orasida lokraik, imi sei hatene katak Nai lori tiha ona imi sai hosi rai Ejitu.
verses.7: No aban dadeer imi sei haree Nai nia glória, tanba Nia rona ona imi nia murmura nebee hasoru Nia. Tanba ami rasik nee mak see, hodi nunee imi murmura hasoru ami?”
verses.8: Moisés dehan tan, “Bainhira Nai foo imi haan naan iha tempu lokraik no haan paun too bosu iha tempu dadeer, tanba Nai rona ona imi nia murmura hasoru Nia - nunee, ami nee saida? Imi laos murmura hasoru ami, maibee hasoru Nai.”
verses.9: Moisés dehan ba Arão, “Hatete ba ema Israel hotu: Mai hakbesik ba Nai, tanba Nia rona ona imi nia murmura hasoru Nia.”
verses.10: Tuir mai, bainhira Arão koalia ba ema Israel hotu, sira fila sira nia oin ba rai fuik, no tebes, sira haree Nai nia glória iha kalohan nebaa.
verses.11: Nai koalia ba Moisés no dehan,
verses.12: “Hau rona ona ema Israel sira nia lian murmura nian. Nunee hatete ba sira: Iha tempu rai nakaras imi sei haan naan no iha tempu dadeer-saan imi sei haan paun too bosu. Nunee imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak.”
verses.13: Tuir mai, iha tempu rai nakaras, manu kiukai sira semo mai, no taka tomak akampamentu nee. Iha dadeer-saan, mahobeen mai iha rai nebee haleu akampamentu nee.
verses.14: Bainhira mahobeen nee suar sai ona, tebes, iha rai fuik nee, iha buat ruma kiik hanesan mahobeen jelu.
verses.15: Bainhira ema Israel sira haree, sira hatete ba malu, “Saida mak nee?” Tanba sira la hatene saida mak nee. Maibee Moisés hatete ba sira, “Ida nee mak paun nebee Nai foo ba imi hodi imi bele haan.
verses.16: Nai nia ukun fuan mak nee: halibur ai haan nee. Ema ida-idak foti natoon tuir buat nebee nia presiza. Halibur litru rua kada ema ida, tuir ema nain hira nebee iha imi nia tenda.”
verses.17: Nunee duni ema Israel sira halo tuir, no sira halibur paun. Balu halibur barak no balu uitoan.
verses.18: Maibee bainhira sira tetu, ema nebee halibur barak, nia la iha barak liu, no ema nebee halibur uitoan, nia la iha menus liu. Ema ida-idak halibur natoon tuir buat nebee nia bele haan.
verses.19: Moisés dehan ba sira, “Tenki haan hotu no keta husik too aban dadeer.”
verses.20: Maibee iha ema balu nebee la rona ba Moisés no sira husik hahaan balu nee too aban dadeer, no hahaan nee mosu ular no sai dois loos. Nunee Moisés sai hirus ba sira.
verses.21: Sira baa halibur dadeer-dadeer no ema ida-idak halibur natoon tuir buat nebee nia bele haan. Maibee bainhira loron manas, hahaan iha rai nee nabeen hotu.
verses.22: Tuir mai, ba loron neen nian sira halibur paun loron rua nian, nebee litru haat kada ema ida. No ema nebee lidera povu nee mai foo hatene ba Moisés.
verses.23: Depois Moisés dehan ba sira, “Nai hatete ona hanesan nee: Aban mak loron nebee deskansa, loron Sabdu nebee santu ba Nai. Nunee tunu paun nebee imi hakarak tunu, no daan paun nebee imi hakarak daan. No buat nebee restu bele husik deit iha imi nia fatin too aban dadeer.”
verses.24: Nunee sira husik deit iha sira nia fatin too aban, tuir Moisés nia liafuan ba sira. No paun nee la dois no la iha ular iha laran.
verses.25: Depois Moisés hatete, “Haan ai haan nee loron ohin, tanba loron ohin mak loron Sabdu ba Nai. Iha loron ida nee imi sei la hetan buat ida iha rai nebaa.
verses.26: Halibur ai haan nee durante loron neen, maibee iha loron hitu, loron Sabdu nee, iha loron nebee paun la iha.”
verses.27: Bainhira too iha loron hitu, ema balu sai baa hodi halibur paun, maibee sira la hetan.
verses.28: Nunee Nai hatete ba Moisés, “Too bainhira mak imi lakohi halo tuir Hau nia ukun fuan sira no Hau nia lei sira?
verses.29: Atensaun ba, Nai foo tiha ona Sabdu nee ba imi. Tanba nee loron neen Nia foo ba imi paun ba loron rua nian. Hela iha imi nia fatin ida-idak. Ema ida keta sai hosi nia fatin iha loron hitu nee.”
verses.30: Nunee duni povu deskansa iha loron hitu.
verses.31: Povu Israel hanaran ai haan nee: maná. Maná nee iha oin hanesan fini koentru, nia kór mutin no midar hanesan dosi nebee halo ho bani been.
verses.32: Moisés dehan, “Nunee Nai nia ukun fuan: Halibur maná litru rua hodi tau ba imi nia jerasaun tuir mai, hodi sira bele haree paun nebee Hau foo ba imi atu haan iha rai fuik bainhira Hau lori imi sai hosi Ejitu.”
verses.33: Tanba nee Moisés dehan ba Arão, “Foti buli ida, tau maná litru rua iha laran, no tau iha Nai nia oin, no rai hela buat nee durante imi nia jerasaun hotu.”
verses.34: Entaun Arão halo tuir orden nebee Nai foo ba Moisés, no tau paun nee iha Aliansa nia oin hodi rai di-diak.
verses.35: Ema Israel sira haan maná durante tinan haat-nulu, too sira tama ba rai nebee sira bele hela. Sira haan maná too tempu nebee sira too iha fronteira rai Kanaan nian.
verses.36: (Sasukat nebee sira uza iha tempu nebaa mak porsentu sanulu nebee sukat hosi litru rua-nulu.)

verses.1: Depois ema Israel hotu sai hosi rai fuik Sin. Sira lao hosi fatin nee ba fatin seluk, tuir Nai nia ukun fuan. No sira para iha Refidim. Maibee iha nebaa la iha bee ba povu atu hemu.
verses.2: Nunee sira komesa hirus ho Moisés, no sira dehan, “Foo bee mai ami atu hemu.” Maibee Moisés hataan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi hirus hau? No tanba saa mak imi koko Nai?”
verses.3: Maibee ema sira nee hamrook no bee la iha. Sira murmura hasoru Moisés no dehan, “Tanba saa mak ita lori ami sai hosi Ejitu hodi oho ami no ami nia oan sira no ami nia animál sira tanba hamrook?”
verses.4: Depois Moisés bolu ba Nai, no dehan, “Saida mak hau sei halo ba povu nee? La kleur tan sira sei tuda mate hau ho fatuk!”
verses.5: Nai hataan ba Moisés, “Lao uluk povu nee no lori katuas balu hosi Israel. Lori mos o nia ai tonka iha o nia liman nebee o uza ona hodi baku Mota Nilu no lao ba.
verses.6: Tebes, Hau sei hamriik iha nebaa iha o nia oin iha fatuk leten iha Foho Horeb. O tenki baku fatuk nee no hosi fatuk laran nee bee sei sai. Nunee povu bele hemu.” Entaun Moisés halo tuir orden nee iha katuas Israel sira nia oin.
verses.7: Sira foo naran ba fatin nee Masá no Meribá, tanba ema Israel sira hirus no koko Nai no hatete, “Nai sei hamutuk ho ami ka lae?”
verses.8: Depois Amalek funu hasoru Israel iha Refidim.
verses.9: Moisés dehan ba Josué, “Hili ema sira, no baa funu hasoru Amalek. Aban hau sei hamriik iha foho leten nebaa no kaer ai tonka Nai nian iha hau nia liman.”
verses.10: Entaun Josué halo tuir Moisés nia liafuan. Nia funu hasoru Amalek. No Moisés, Arão no Hur sae ba foho leten.
verses.11: Bainhira Moisés foti nia liman, Israel mak forsa liu, maibee bainhira Moisés hatuun nia liman, Amalek mak forsa liu.
verses.12: Maibee Moisés nia liman sai kole, tanba nee sira foti fatuk ida, sira tau fatuk nee iha nia okos hodi nia tuur iha leten, no Arão ho Hur tonka nia liman, ema ida iha sorin ida no ema ida seluk iha sorin seluk. Nunee nia liman la book aan too loro matan monu.
verses.13: No Josué domina tiha Amalek no Amalek nia povu ho surik ibun.
verses.14: Depois Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Hakerek buat nee iha livru ida hodi hanoin hetan. Foo hanoin nafatin iha Josué nia tilun katak Hau sei halakon Amalek hodi ema hotu iha lalehan okos la hanoin hetan nia.”
verses.15: Depois Moisés harii altár ida no nia foo naran, “Nai mak hau nia bandeira!”
verses.16: Nia dehan, “Foti liman ho bandeira Nai nian! Nai sei funu hasoru Amalek hosi jerasaun ba jerasaun.”

verses.1: Jetro mak saserdote iha Midian, no nia Moisés nia banin mane. Jetro rona buat hotu nebee Maromak halo ba Moisés no Ninia povu Israel, no oinsaa Nai lori ema Israel sai hosi Ejitu.
verses.2: Depois Jetro, Moisés nia banin mane, lori Moisés nia feen Zipora mai. Uluk Moisés haruka nia feen atu fila ba.
verses.3: Zipora iha oan mane nain rua: ida naran Gerson, (tanba Moisés dehan, “Hau sai ema lao rai iha rai liur”),
verses.4: no oan ida seluk naran Eliezar, (tanba nia dehan, “Hau nia aman nia Maromak mak ajuda hau no salva hau hosi surik Faraó nian”).
verses.5: Jetro, nebee Moisés nia banin mane, mai hamutuk ho Moisés nia oan sira no nia feen no sira too Moisés nia fatin iha rai fuik, fatin nebee nia hela iha foho Maromak nian.
verses.6: Nunee Jetro haruka ema foo hatene ba Moisés, “Hau, o nia bani mane, Jetro, mai ona hamutuk ho o nia feen no o nia oan mane nain rua.”
verses.7: Depois Moisés sai ba hodi hasoru ninia banin mane. Nia hakneak ba ninia banin mane no rei nia. Sira husu ba malu diak ka lae, depois sira tama ba tenda laran.
verses.8: Depois Moisés konta ba ninia banin mane kona ba buat hotu nebee Nai halo ba Faraó no ema Ejitu sira tanba Israel, no problema hotu nebee sira hasoru iha dalan no oinsaa Nai salva sira.
verses.9: Jetro haksolok ho buat diak hotu nebee Nai halo ona ba Israel, nebee Nia salva sira hosi ema Ejitu sira nia liman.
verses.10: Depois Jetro dehan, “Hahii ba Nai nebee salva imi hosi ema Ejitu sira nia liman no hosi Faraó nia liman, ba Nia nebee salva povu nee hosi ema Ejitu sira nia liman nia okos.
verses.11: Agora hau hatene, Nai mak boot liu maromak sira seluk hotu. Tanba iha tempu nee, ema Ejitu sira foti aan iha povu Israel nia oin.”
verses.12: No Jetro, Moisés nia banin mane, foo oferta tunu motuk no sakrifísiu sira ba Maromak. Nunee Arão no katuas hotu hosi Israel mai haan hamutuk ho Moisés nia banin mane iha Maromak nia oin.
verses.13: Loron tuir mai, Moisés tuur hodi tesi lia ba ema Israel sira. No ema Israel sira hamriik iha Moisés nia oin hosi dadeer-saan too rai nakaras.
verses.14: Bainhira Moisés nia banin mane haree buat hotu nebee Moisés halo ba ema Israel, nia husu, “O halo saida ba ema Israel sira? Tanba saa mak o tuur mesak deit, no ema sira nee hotu hamriik iha o nia oin hosi dadeer-saan too rai nakaras?”
verses.15: Moisés hataan ba ninia banin mane, “Tanba ema sira nee mai hau hodi husu Maromak nia liafuan.
verses.16: Bainhira sira iha problema ba malu, sira mai hau no hau tesi lia ba sira. Nunee hau foo hatene ba sira kona ba Maromak nia estatutu sira no Ninia lei sira.”
verses.17: Maibee Moisés nia banin mane dehan ba nia, “Buat nebee o halo nee la diak.
verses.18: O sei sai kole loos. O no moos ema sira nebee hamutuk ho o sei sai kole. Tanba servisu nee todan liu ba o, no o la bele halo mesak.
verses.19: Nunee rona tuir hau nia liafuan. Hau sei foo konselhu ba o no Maromak sei hamutuk ho o. O hamriik hodi reprezenta povu iha Maromak nia oin no o lori sira nia problema ba Maromak.
verses.20: O tenki hanorin estatutu no lei sira ba povu, no hatudu ba sira dalan ida nebee sira tenki lao tuir, no servisu nebee sira tenki halo.
verses.21: No moos o tenki buka ema nebee laran forti hosi povu nia leet, no ema nebee hamtauk ba Maromak, ema fiel nebee odi hahalok nebee hadau riku-soin. Hili ema sira nee hodi lidera ema nain rihun ida, lidera ema nain atus ida, lidera ema nain lima-nulu no lidera ema nain sanulu.
verses.22: Loro-loron, sira tenki tesi lia ba ema sira. Sira bele lori problema boot ba o. Maibee problema nebee kiik nee, sira rasik bele tesi lia. Nunee sira bele halo kamaan o nia servisu, no sira bele servisu hamutuk ho o.
verses.23: Se o halo hanesan nee, no Maromak sei manda o hanesan nee, nunee o bele halo nafatin, no ema sira nee bele fila ba sira nia fatin ho laran kamaan.”
verses.24: Moisés rona liafuan nee hosi ninia banin mane no nia halo tuir.
verses.25: Moisés hili ema hosi Israel nebee iha laran forti. Nia foo knaar ba sira atu sai lider ba ema sira nee,. Nunee sira sai lider ba ema nain rihun ida, no lider ba ema nain atus ida, no lider ba ema nain lima-nulu, no lider ba ema nain sanulu.
verses.26: Lor-loron sira tesi lia ba ema Israel sira. Problema sira nebee boot, sira lori ba Moisés. Maibee problema sira nebee kiik, sira rasik tesi lia deit.
verses.27: Depois Moisés husik ninia banin mane atu fila fali baa ninia rai.

19.title: Nai Hatudu Aan Iha Foho Sinai

verses.1: Iha loron primeiru, fulan terseiru, hosi tempu nebee ema Israel sai hosi Ejitu, sira too iha rai fuik Sinai. Sira too iha Sinai iha loron primeiru nee duni.
verses.2: Tanba povu Israel husik tiha Refidim no sira lao too iha rai maran naran Sinai. Israel halo akampamentu iha rai fuik nee hodi hela iha foho Sinai nia huun.
verses.3: no Moisés sae ba foho hodi hasoru Maromak. Nai koalia ba Moisés hosi foho nee, Nia hatete, “Foo hatene ba Jacó nia jerasaun, no dehan ba ema Israel,
verses.4: ‘Imi haree ona saida mak Hau halo ba ema Ejitu sira, no oinsaa Hau lori imi fila fali mai Hau hanesan iha makikit nia liras leten.
verses.5: Agora se imi rona tebe-tebes Hau nia liafuan no kaer metin Hau nia aliansa, nunee imi sei sai Hau nia riku-soin rasik hosi nasaun hotu. Tanba mundu tomak mak Hau nian.
verses.6: Imi sai povu ida nebee reinu saserdote sira nian, nasaun ida nebee santu.’ O tenki hatoo liafuan nee ba ema Israel.”
verses.7: Entaun Moisés tuun mai no bolu lider sira hodi halibur hamutuk. No nia hatoo ba sira liafuan hotu nebee Nai manda ona ba nia.
verses.8: Entaun sira hotu hataan hamutuk, “Ami hakarak halo tuir liafuan hotu nee hosi Nai.” Depois Moisés hatoo povu nia resposta ba Nai.
verses.9: Nai hatete ba Moisés, “Tebes, Hau sei hasoru o maibee Hau sei falun aan ho kalohan metin. Ema sira sei rona Hau koalia ba o, no sira sei fiar o too tinan ba tinan.” Bainhira Moisés hatoo povu nia liafuan ba Nai,
verses.10: Nai hatete ba Moisés, “Baa halibur povu nee, no konsagra sira ohin no aban, no sira tenki fasi sira nia ropa.
verses.11: Iha loron ba dala tolu, imi tenki prontu ona. Tanba iha loron ida nee Hau atu tuun ba foho Sinai hodi povu hotu bele haree.
verses.12: Marka tiha sinál nebee haleu foho nee hanesan baliza, no hatete, ‘Kuidadu aan, keta sae foho nee, no keta book baliza nee. Se ema ruma book foho nee, tenki foo kastigu mate ba nia.
verses.13: Ema tenki tuda ho fatuk ka hana ho rama ba ema nebee book foho nee. Halo ida nee ba ema no animál, keta husik nia moris.’ Bainhira korneta halo lian kleur ona foin povu bele sae foho.”
verses.14: Entaun Moisés tuun hosi foho no konsagra povu no sira fasi sira nia ropa.
verses.15: Nunee Moisés hatete ba povu nee, “Aban bainrua imi tenki prontu no keta halo relasaun seksuál ho feto.”
verses.16: Iha loron terseiru, iha dadeer-saan, povu rona rai tarutu no haree rai lakan. Kalohan metan mosu iha foho leten no korneta halo lian makaas tebes. Ema hotu iha akampamentu nakdedar.
verses.17: Moisés lori sira sai hosi akampamentu hodi hasoru Maromak, no sira hamriik iha foho huun nebaa.
verses.18: Suar taka metin foho Sinai tomak, tanba Nai tuun baa foho nee ho ahi. Suar nee sae hanesan suar nebee sae hosi fornu, no foho tomak nakdedar makaas.
verses.19: Korneta halo lian makaas no aumenta makaas liu tan. Moisés koalia, no Maromak hataan ho lian.
verses.20: Nai tuun ba foho Sinai. Nia tuun ba foho tutun. Nia bolu Moisés atu baa foho tutun nee. No Moisés sae ba leten.
verses.21: Depois Nai hatete ba Moisés, “Tuun ona ba kraik, no manda povu atu keta hakat liu baliza hodi hakbesik no haree Nai, hodi ema barak sei la mate.
verses.22: Maski saserdote sira nee atu hakbesik ba Nai, sira tenki konsagra aan. Se lae, Nai bele kastigu sira.”
verses.23: Moisés hatete ba Nai, “Povu nee la bele sae foho Sinai tanba O foo ona orden mai ami, ‘Marka baliza haleu foho nee hodi halo santu.’”
verses.24: Nai hataan, “Ba lai! Tuun ona ba kraik, depois fila mai iha nee ho Arão. Maibee saserdote sira no povu keta hakat liu baliza hodi mai hasoru Nai. Se sira hakat liu, Hau sei kastigu sira.”
verses.25: Nunee Moisés tuun baa hasoru povu, hodi hatoo lia menon nee ba sira.

verses.1: Maromak koalia liafuan hotu nee, no Nia hatete,
verses.2: “Hau mak Nai, o nia Maromak, nebee lori o sai hosi rai Ejitu, hosi fatin kastigu.
verses.3: O keta iha maromak seluk, só Hau deit.
verses.4: O keta halo estátua, ka buat saida tan nebee iha ilas saida deit hosi buat nebee iha lalehan, ka iha rai, ka iha tasi nebee iha rai okos.
verses.5: O keta hakruuk ba sira ka serví sira, tanba Hau mak Nai, o nia Maromak. Hau mak Maromak ida nebee laran moras. No Hau sei selu ema nia hahalok aat ba sira nia oan sira too jerasaun tolu no haat.
verses.6: Maibee Hau hatudu domin metin ba ema rihun ba rihun nebee hadomi Hau no halo tuir Hau nia ukun fuan.
verses.7: O keta temi Nai, o nia Maromak, nia naran arbiru, tanba Nai sei foo sala ba ema nebee temi Ninia naran arbiru.
verses.8: Hanoin no halo santu loron Sabdu.
verses.9: Durante loron neen, o bele halo servisu, no halao o nia bisnis hotu.
verses.10: Maibee loron ba dala hitu nee mak loron Sabdu ba Nai, o nia Maromak. Nunee, keta halo servisu ida, o, ka o nia oan mane ka o nia oan feto, ka o nia atan mane ka o nia atan feto, ka o nia animál ka ema hosi rai liur nebee hela ho o.
verses.11: Tanba iha loron neen nia laran, Nai halo lalehan no rai, tasi no buat hotu-hotu, no Nia deskansa iha loron hitu. Nunee Nai foo bensaun ba loron Sabdu no halo santu.
verses.12: Foo onra ba o nia inan-aman hodi o bele hetan vida naruk iha rai nebee Nai, o nia Maromak, foo ba o.
verses.13: O keta oho.
verses.14: O keta halo sala seksuál.
verses.15: O keta naok.
verses.16: O keta foo sasin falsu hasoru o nia maluk.
verses.17: O keta kaan o nia maluk nia uma; o keta kaan o nia maluk nia feen, ka ninia atan mane, atan feto, karau, kuda buru, riku-soin ka saida deit nebee o nia maluk nian.”
verses.18: Bainhira povu hotu rona rai tarutu no korneta nia lian, no haree rai lakan no foho suar, sira nakdedar no sai tauk no hamriik deit hosi dook.
verses.19: Sira dehan ba Moisés, “Ita boot deit mak koalia mai ami, no ami sei rona. Maibee keta husik Maromak koalia mai ami, atu nunee ami la mate.”
verses.20: Moisés hataan, “Keta tauk, tanba Maromak mai hodi koko deit imi, atu haree imi hamtauk ba Nia, no katak imi la sala.”
verses.21: Maibee povu nee hamriik hosi dook nafatin. Só Moisés deit mak hakbesik ba kalohan nakukun iha fatin nebee Maromak hela.
verses.22: Nai Maromak foo orden ba Moisés hodi hatoo ba povu Israel, “Imi haree ona, oinsaa Hau, Maromak, koalia ba imi hosi lalehan.
verses.23: Imi keta halo maromak sira hosi osan mutin ka osan mean hodi adora hamutuk ho Hau.
verses.24: Imi tenki halo altár ida hosi rai ba Hau, no iha altár leten imi sei halo sakrifísiu ho imi nia oferta tunu motuk sira, imi nia oferta dame sira, imi nia bibi malae sira, no imi nia karau sira. Iha fatin hotu nebee Hau hatudu Hau nia naran hodi hanoin, iha fatin sira nee Hau sei hasoru imi, no Hau sei foo bensaun ba imi.
verses.25: Se imi halo altár mai Hau hosi fatuk, keta halo ho fatuk nebee ema sabir. Tanba se karik imi uza eskopu ho fatuk nee imi halo fatuk foer ba Hau.
verses.26: Keta halo eskada hodi sae ba Hau nia altár, hodi ema la haree imi nia isin molik.

verses.1: “Ida nee mak regulamentu sira nebee o tenki foo hatene ba sira.
verses.2: Bainhira o sosa atan Ebreu ida, nia tenki servisu ba o durante tinan neen. Maibee iha tinan hitu nia tenki sai hanesan ema nebee livre no la selu buat ida.
verses.3: Se nia mai mesak deit, nunee nia mos sai mesak deit. Se nia iha feen, ninia feen nee tenki iha lisensa atu sai hamutuk ho nia.
verses.4: Se ninia patraun foo nia feto ida atu sai nia feen no feto foo oan mane ka oan feto ba nia; nunee feto ho ninia oan sira tenki hela nafatin ho ninia patraun. Atan mane nee tenki sai mesak.
verses.5: Maibee se atan nee tebe-tebes hatete, ‘Hau hadomi loos hau nia patraun, hau nia feen no hau nia oan sira, no hau lakohi sai nudar ema nebee livre,’
verses.6: nunee ninia patraun nee tenki lori nia ba hasoru Maromak. Patraun sei lori nia ba odamatan ka ba ai riin odamatan, no ninia patraun nee sei halo kuak iha nia tilun ho pregu no atan nee sei servisu ba ninia patraun nee too rohan laek.
verses.7: Bainhira ema ida faan ninia oan feto ida nudar atan, nunee feto nee la bele sai hanesan atan mane sira.
verses.8: Se patraun nee la gosta ona feto nee, no la simu nia atu kaben, nunee patraun nee tenki foo lisensa hodi família bele hola fali feto nee. Ninia patraun la iha direitu atu faan nia ba ema rai liur, tanba nia la tuir ninia promesa ba feto nee.
verses.9: Se ninia patraun nee prepara feto nee ba patraun nia oan mane, nunee patraun tenki halo ba nia hanesan nia halo ba ninia oan feto rasik sira.
verses.10: Se patraun nee kaben ho feto seluk, nia la bele hamenus hahaan ba feto nee. Nia la bele hamenus feto nee nia ropa no patraun nia responsabilidade atu toba hamutuk ho feto nee.
verses.11: Se patraun la halo buat tolu nee, nunee nia tenki foo lisensa hodi husik feto sai gratis, no la bele hetan fali osan.”
verses.12: “See mak baku mate ema seluk, tenki foo kastigu mate ba nia.
verses.13: Maibee se nia la iha planu atu oho ema nee, maibee Maromak mak husik ema nee tama ba ninia liman, nunee Hau sei hatudu fatin ida ba o, hodi nia bele halai ba fatin nee.
verses.14: Maibee se ema ida iha hanoin aat ba ninia maluk, too halo planu bosok hodi oho nia, o tenki foti ema nee hosi Hau nia altár, no foo kastigu mate ba nia.
verses.15: See mak baku ninia aman ka inan, tenki foo kastigu mate ba nia.
verses.16: See mak naok ema ida no faan ema nee, no see mak hetan ema nee, tenki foo kastigu mate ba sira.
verses.17: See mak foo malisan ba ninia aman ka inan, tenki foo kastigu mate ba nia.
verses.18: Bainhira ema hirus malu no ema ida baku ema seluk ho fatuk ka tuku nia ho liman, no ema seluk nee la mate, maibee nia tenki toba iha kama,
verses.19: nunee ema nebee baku nia nee sei la hetan kastigu. Se ida moras nee hamriik fali no lao iha liur uza ai tonka; nia tenki selu ema moras nee tanba nia la bele servisu, no nia selu mos aimoruk too ema moras nee hetan diak.
verses.20: Bainhira ema ida baku mate ninia atan mane ka feto, nia tenki selu.
verses.21: Maibee se atan nee sei moris loron ida ka rua, nunee keta husu patraun atu selu tanba atan nee mak ninian.
verses.22: Bainhira iha ema baku malu no sira kona feto ida nebee isin rua, too nia oan monu maibee la halo feto nee mate, nunee ema tenki simu kastigu tuir buat nebee feto nee nia laen foo ba nia; no nia tenki selu tuir desizaun juis nian.
verses.23: Maibee se feto nee mate, nunee nia tenki selu: moris troka moris,
verses.24: matan troka matan, nehan troka nehan, liman troka liman, ain troka ain,
verses.25: sunu troka sunu, kanek troka kanek, bubu troka bubu.
verses.26: Bainhira ema ida baku ninia atan mane nia matan ka atan feto nia matan no matan nee sai aat, nunee nia tenki husik atan nudar ema livre hodi selu kona ba ninia matan.
verses.27: No se nia baku nia atan mane ka atan feto too nehan monu, nunee nia tenki husik ninia atan nee nudar ema livre hodi selu kona ba ninia nehan.
verses.28: Se karau ida tuku mate mane ka feto ida, nunee tuda mate karau. Keta haan ninia isin, no karau nia nain sei la hetan kastigu.
verses.29: Maibee se karau nee toman atu tuku ema no ema foo hatene tiha ona ba karau nia nain, maibee nia lakohi kuidadu no karau nee tuku mate fali mane ka feto ida, nunee tenki tuda mate karau nee no tenki foo kastigu mate ba karau nia nain.
verses.30: Se imi haruka nia selu osan, nia bele selu atu hola fali ninia moris tuir folin nebee desidi ona.
verses.31: Se karau nee tuku oan mane ka feto, karau nia nain tenki selu tuir tesi lia.
verses.32: Se karau nee tuku atan mane ka atan feto ida, karau nia nain tenki selu osan mutin tolu-nulu, no karau nee tenki tuda mate.
verses.33: Bainhira iha ema ruma loke bee posu ka kee bee posu maibee la taka, no karau ka kuda buru monu ba kuak nee,
verses.34: nunee bee posu nia nain tenki selu. Nia tenki foo osan ba animál nia nain, maibee animál nebee mate nee sei sai ninian.
verses.35: Bainhira ema ida nia karau tuku mate ema seluk nia karau, entaun imi tenki faan karau nebee moris nee. Osan nee tenki fahe no animál nebee mate nee mos tenki fahe.
verses.36: Maibee se karau nee toman atu tuku beibeik no ninia nain lakohi tau matan ba karau, nunee nia tenki selu tomak: karau troka karau, maibee karau nebee mate nee sei sai ninian.”

verses.1: “Bainhira ema ida naok karau ida ka bibi ida, no nia oho ka nia faan, nunee nia tenki selu fali karau lima troka karau ida nebee nia naok tiha. No nia tenki selu bibi haat troka fali bibi ida nebee nia naok tiha.
verses.2: Se ema ida hetan naok-teen nebee tama hela, no nia baku mate naok-teen nee, ema nebee baku la hetan kastigu.
verses.3: Maibee se loro matan sae tiha ona, nunee naok-teen tenki hetan kastigu. Naok-teen nee tenki troka fali sasaan hotu nebee nia naok. Se nia la iha buat ida ona, ema tenki faan nia nudar atan hodi troka sasaan nebee nia naok ona.
verses.4: Se sasaan nebee nia naok sei iha ninia liman no moris hela, nebee karau, kuda buru ka bibi, nunee nia tenki selu dala rua.
verses.5: Bainhira ema lori ninia animál ba haan iha toos ka toos uvas ka nia husik deit ninia animál lao ho livre, no animál nee haan ema seluk nia ai horis hotu iha toos, nia tenki selu fali buat nebee lakon hosi rezultadu nebee diak liu hosi ninia toos luan no hosi ninia toos uvas.
verses.6: Bainhira ema sunu ahi no ahi nee haan duut, maibee ahi haan fali hare nebee kuu ona ka hare nebee seidauk kuu ka ahi haan toos tomak, nunee ema nebee sunu ahi nee tenki selu fali.
verses.7: Bainhira iha ema ida rai osan ka sasaan balu ho ninia maluk, no ema naok hosi ema nee nia uma, no se ema hetan naok-teen nee, nunee nia tenki selu dala rua.
verses.8: Maibee se ema la hetan naok-teen nee, uma nain tenki baa hasoru Maromak hodi jura katak nia la foti ninia maluk nia sasaan.
verses.9: Kona ba hirus malu hotu nee, kona ba karau, kona ba kuda buru, kona ba bibi, kona ba ropa, kona ba sasaan saida deit mak lakon, nebee ema dehan buat nee ninian, ema nain rua nee tenki lori problem ba Maromak nia oin. Ida nebee Maromak mak hatudu, nia tenki selu dala rua ba ninia maluk nee.
verses.10: Bainhira ema ida rai hela kuda buru ida ho ninia maluk, ka karau ida, bibi ida ka animál saida deit, no animál nee mate, ka animál hetan kanek ka ema duni nia no ema ruma la haree,
verses.11: nunee ema nain rua nee tenki jura hodi Nai katak nia la foti ninia maluk nia sasaan. No maluk nee sei simu liafuan nee, no ida seluk la presiza selu fali sasaan nebee lakon.
verses.12: Maibee se loos duni ema naok animál nee hosi nia, nunee nia tenki selu fali ba animál nia nain.
verses.13: Se animál fuik tata mate animál nee, nunee nia tenki lori mai hatudu animál nia isin hodi prova. Nia la presiza selu animál nebee animál fuik tata mate nee.
verses.14: Bainhira ema ida impresta animál ida hosi nia maluk no animál nee hetan kanek ka mate, no ninia nain laos iha nebaa, nunee nia tenki selu.
verses.15: Maibee se animál nee nia nain sei iha nebaa, nia la presiza selu. Se nia aluga animál nee, nunee animál nia folin inklui ona.
verses.16: Bainhira mane ida obriga feto raan ida nebee seidauk troka prenda ho mane seluk, no nia toba hamutuk ho feto nee, nunee nia tenki selu barlaki no hola feto nee hodi sai ninia feen.
verses.17: Se feto nia aman lakohi mane nee atu hola ninia oan feto, nunee mane nee tenki selu barlaki feto raan nian nee.
verses.18: Keta husik buan ida moris.
verses.19: See mak toba ho animál ida, tenki foo kastigu mate ba nia.
verses.20: See mak foo sakrifísiu ba maromak seluk, laos foo ba Nai deit, tenki halakon nia.
verses.21: Keta hanehan ema lao rai sira, tanba uluk imi mos ema lao rai iha Ejitu.
verses.22: Keta halo terus ba feto faluk ka oan kiak.
verses.23: Se imi halo terus naran deit ba sira, no sira bolu ba Hau, nunee Hau sei rona sira.
verses.24: Hau sei sai hirus makaas no oho imi ho surik, no imi nia feen sira sei sai feto faluk no imi nia oan sira sei sai oan kiak.
verses.25: Bainhira imi foo impresta osan ba Hau nia povu, ba ema kiak iha imi nia leet, keta sai ema nebee husu tusan ho funan hosi nia. Keta foo todan ba nia ho funan.
verses.26: Bainhira imi foti nia ropa hanesan garantia, tenki foo fila fali ropa nee ba nia molok loro matan monu.
verses.27: Tanba ho ida nee deit mak nia taka ninia isin. Nia uza ida nee atu toba. Se nia bolu ba Hau, nunee Hau sei rona nia tanba Hau iha grasa.
verses.28: Keta koalia aat hasoru Maromak. Keta foo malisan ba xefi sira iha imi nia rai.
verses.29: Keta tardi atu foo oferta hosi imi nia produsaun no imi nia tua uvas. Imi tenki foo imi nia oan mane primeiru sira mai Hau.
verses.30: Nunee mos imi tenki halo hanesan nee ho imi nia karau no imi nia bibi. Iha loron hitu nia laran, animál nia oan nee tenki hela ho nia inan, maibee iha loron ualu nee o tenki entrega animál nee ba Hau.
verses.31: Imi tenki sai ema nebee santu ba Hau. Imi keta haan animál sira nebee animál fuik tata mate ona iha rai fuik, maibee imi tenki soe ba asu sira.”

verses.1: Keta lori lia bosok; keta sai sasin nebee la loos hodi ajuda ema aat.
verses.2: Keta halo tuir ema lubun boot nebee halo aat. Keta koalia tuir ema barak nebee koalia lia falsu hodi estraga justisa.
verses.3: No keta prefere ema fraku nia kazu iha tribunál.
verses.4: Bainhira o haree o nia inimigu nia karau ka kuda buru lao lakon, lori fali animál nee ba ninia nain.
verses.5: Bainhira o haree kuda buru hosi o nia inimigu nee monu tanba nia lori sasaan todan, keta hein haree deit. O tenki ajuda nia ho nia kuda buru nee.
verses.6: Keta hadau justisa hosi ema mukit iha nia kazu.
verses.7: Hadook aan hosi lia bosok. Keta oho ema inosenti no ema loos. Tanba Hau la hamoos sala hosi ema nebee iha hahalok aat.
verses.8: Keta simu prezenti subar, tanba prezenti subar nee sei halo ema sira nebee haree diak sai delek, no halo liafuan hosi ema loos sai aat.
verses.9: Keta hanehan ema lao rai sira, tanba imi hatene ema lao rai sira nia moris nee oinsaa, tanba uluk imi mos ema lao rai iha Ejitu.
verses.10: Durante tinan neen o sei kuda iha o nia rai no foti rezultadu.
verses.11: Maibee iha tinan hitu, o tenki husik hela deit rai nee. Nunee ema kiak sira hosi o nia povu bele haan. No buat nebee sira husik, animál fuik bele haan. O tenki halo hanesan nee mos ba o nia toos uvas no toos oliveira.
verses.12: O bele servisu iha loron neen nia laran maibee loron hitu o tenki deskansa. Nunee o nia karau no kuda buru bele deskansa. No o nia atan feto nia oan mane no ema lao rai bele dada iis.
verses.13: O tenki rona di-diak ba buat hotu nebee Hau koalia ba o. Keta temi maromak sira seluk nia naran. Keta husik ema seluk rona buat nee hosi o nia ibun.
verses.14: “Imi tenki halo festa tolu ba Hau iha tinan ida nia laran.
verses.15: Imi tenki halo tuir Festa Paun Fermentu Laek. Iha loron hitu nia laran imi tenki haan paun nebee fermentu la iha hanesan Hau manda ona ba imi. Halo tuir festa nee iha loron nebee dehan tiha ona iha fulan Abibe, tanba iha fulan nee mak imi sai hosi Ejitu. Maibee ema la bele mai hasoru Hau ho liman mamuk.
verses.16: Imi mos presiza halo tuir Festa Kolheta, bainhira kuu rezultadu primeiru nebee imi kuda iha toos. No moos Festa Haloot Rezultadu, bainhira rezultadu hosi imi nia kolen tama hotu hosi toos bainhira tinan remata.
verses.17: Tinan ida dala tolu, imi nia mane hotu tenki hasoru Nai Maromak.
verses.18: Keta foo sakrifísiu nia raan ba Hau ho paun nebee iha fermentu. No naan bokur hosi festa nee keta husik too aban dadeer.
verses.19: Rezultadu primeiru hosi imi nia toos nee tenki lori ba Nai nia uma, o nia Maromak nian. Keta daan bibi oan iha nia inan nia susu been.
verses.20: Tebes Hau haruka anju ida iha imi nia oin, hodi kuidadu imi iha dalan no lori imi ba fatin nebee Hau prepara ona.
verses.21: Kuidadu atu rona nia no halo tuir ninia liafuan. Keta kontra nia, tanba nia sei la foo perdaun ba imi, tanba Hau nia naran mak iha nia.
verses.22: Maibee se o rona duni ninia liafuan no halo tuir buat hotu nebee Hau koalia tiha ona, Hau sei sai inimigu ba imi nia inimigu sira, no kontra sira nebee mak kontra imi.
verses.23: Tanba Hau nia anju sei lao iha imi nia oin no lori imi ba ema Amoreu, ema Hiti, ema Perizeu, ema Kanaan, ema Heveu no ema Jabes sira no Hau sei estraga sira.
verses.24: Imi keta adora sira nia maromak sira ka serví sira, no keta tuir sira nia hahalok, maibee imi tenki estraga sira hotu no baku rahun sira nia fatuk lulik sira.
verses.25: Maibee imi tenki serví Nai, imi nia Maromak. Nunee Nia sei foo bensaun ba imi nia ai haan no imi nia bee. No Hau sei hasai tiha moras hosi imi nia leet.
verses.26: Iha imi nia rai, feto sira hotu sei la abortu no sira nia oan hotu sei moris. Hau sei halo imi moris naruk.
verses.27: Hau sei halo ema tauk iha imi nia oin. Hau sei foo konfuzaun ba ema nebee imi hasoru. No Hau sei halo imi nia inimigu sira halai hosi imi.
verses.28: Hau sei haruka dihi siri baa uluk imi, no sira sei duni sai ema Heveu, ema Kanaan, no ema Hiti sira hosi imi nia oin.
verses.29: Hau sei la duni sira sai hosi imi iha tinan ida nia laran, hodi nunee rai nee la bele mamuk, no animál fuik sira la bele aumenta barak liu imi.
verses.30: Hau sei hasai sira neineik-neineik hosi imi nia oin, too imi aumenta ona. Nunee imi sei hela iha rai nebaa.
verses.31: Hau sei tau baliza iha imi nia rai hosi Tasi Teberau too tasi Filisteu nian, hosi rai fuik too Mota Eufrates. Tanba Hau sei entrega ema sira iha rai nebaa ba imi nia liman, nunee imi bele duni sira sai hosi imi nia oin.
verses.32: Keta halo aliansa ho sira ka sira nia maromak sira.
verses.33: Sira la bele hela iha imi nia rai, hodi sira la dada imi atu halo sala hasoru Hau. Tanba se imi serví sira nia maromak sira, ida nee sei sai duni lasu ida ba imi.

verses.1: Depois Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Sae ba hasoru Nai, o ho Arão, Nadab no Abiu no katuas sira nain hitu-nulu hosi Israel no imi adora hosi dook.
verses.2: Moisés mesak deit bele hakbesik ba Nai. Maibee ema sira nee la bele hakbesik ba, no sira nee la bele sae hamutuk ho nia.”
verses.3: Depois Moisés mai foo sai Nai nia liafuan no regulamentu hotu ba ema Israel sira. Nunee ema hotu hataan hamutuk, “Ami sei halo tuir liafuan hotu nebee Nai koalia.”
verses.4: Depois Moisés hakerek Nai nia liafuan hotu. Loron tuir mai, iha dadeer-saan, nia hadeer sedu no harii altár iha foho nia huun. No nia harii ai riin sanulu resin rua tuir suku Israel nian.
verses.5: Depois nia haruka joven mane sira hosi Israel no sira foo oferta tunu sira no oho karau sira hodi halo sakrifísiu dame nian ba Nai.
verses.6: No Moisés foti raan balu, no nia tau iha sanan rai, no nia fakar raan nee iha altár.
verses.7: Nia foti Livru Aliansa no nia lee hodi povu bele rona. No sira dehan, “Buat hotu nebee Nai hatete nunee, ami sei halo tuir no rona hodi halo duni.”
verses.8: Depois Moisés foti raan no hisik ba ema Israel sira no dehan, “Tebes, ida nee mak raan aliansa nebee Nai halo ho imi, tuir liafuan hotu nee.”
verses.9: Nunee Moisés sae ba, hamutuk ho Arão, Nadab ho Abiu, no ema katuas sira nain hitu-nulu hosi Israel.
verses.10: No sira haree Israel nia Maromak Israel. Iha Nia ain okos iha fatuk safira nebee moos loos hanesan lalehan.
verses.11: Maibee Nia liman la kona Israel nia ema katuas sira nee. Sira haree Maromak, depois sira haan no hemu.
verses.12: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Sae mai hasoru Hau iha foho leten no hela iha nebaa. Nunee Hau sei foo fatuk belar sira ba o, hamutuk ho lei no ukun fuan sira nebee Hau hakerek ona, hodi hanorin ba sira.”
verses.13: Nunee Moisés hadeer, hamutuk ho Josué, no sae ba foho Maromak nian.
verses.14: Maibee ba katuas sira nee nia hatete, “Hein ami iha nee too ami fila fali mai imi. Imi haree katak Arão ho Hur mak hamutuk ho imi. Ema nebee iha problema bele mai hasoru sira.”
verses.15: Depois Moisés sae ba foho no kalohan taka foho nee.
verses.16: Nai nia glória hela iha Foho Sinai no kalohan taka foho durante loron neen. Iha loron hitu, Nia bolu Moisés hosi kalohan laran.
verses.17: Maromak nia glória mak hanesan ahi boot iha foho leten no ema Israel sira haree.
verses.18: Moisés tama ba iha kalohan laran no lao sae ba foho. No nia hela iha foho leten durante loron haat-nulu no kalan haat-nulu.

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no Nia dehan,
verses.2: “Hatete ba ema Israel sira, hodi sira lori oferta espesiál ba Hau. O bele simu oferta hosi ema ida-idak nebee prontu atu foo hosi sira nia fuan laran, no o sei foo oferta nee ba Hau.
verses.3: Ida nee mak oferta espesiál nebee imi husu hosi sira: osan mean, osan mutin, no besi riti;
verses.4: kabas kór azúl, kór uvas no kór mean, no hena linhu, no bibi nia fulun;
verses.5: bibi malae aman sira nia kulit nebee tau kór mean, animál seluk sira nia kulit no ai kasi,
verses.6: mina ba lampu, buat morin ba mina unsaun no mina morin seluk,
verses.7: fatuk onix, no fatuk nebee tau iha efode no taka iha sasaan hirus matan nian.
verses.8: No sira bele halo Fatin Santu ba Hau, nunee Hau bele hela iha sira nia leet.
verses.9: Tuir buat sira hotu nebee mak Hau hatudu ona ba o, inklui dezenhu ba Tabernakulu nee no dezenhu ba sasaan hotu nebee uza iha Tabernakulu, nebee imi atu halo.
verses.10: “Sira tenki halo Arka Aliansa hosi ai kasi nebee naruk sentímetru atus ida sanulu, luan sentímetru hitu-nulu no aas sentímetru hitu-nulu.
verses.11: Tenki falun ho osan mean nebee moos iha laran no liur. Iha leten tenki forma ninin ho osan mean nebee haleu nia.
verses.12: O tenki halo kadeli haat ho osan mean no monta kadeli ba iha lidun haat nee; kadeli rua iha sorin ida no kadeli rua seluk iha sorin seluk.
verses.13: O tenki halo ai naruk hosi ai kasi no falun ho osan mean.
verses.14: O tenki hatama ai naruk nee ba kadeli osan mean, hodi bele lori Arka nee.
verses.15: Ai naruk nee tenki hela nafatin iha Arka nia kadeli no keta hasai.
verses.16: O tenki tau testemunha nebee Hau foo ba o iha Arka laran.
verses.17: “O tenki halo nia Matan Dame hosi osan mean nebee moos. Nia naruk sentímetru atus ida sanulu no luan sentímetru hitu-nulu.
verses.18: No o tenki halo kerubim rua hosi osan mean. O tenki halo kerubim nee tuku hosi osan mean, no tau iha Matan Dame nia leten iha sor-sorin.
verses.19: Halo kerubim ida iha sorin ida no kerubim ida seluk iha sorin seluk, no o tenki halo kerubim rua nee sai ida deit ho Arka nia matan iha sorin rua.
verses.20: Kerubim sira tenki loke sira nia liras sira ba leten, no taka Arka nia matan nee ho sira nia liras sira. Kerubim sira nia oin sei haree ba Arka nia matan.
verses.21: O tenki tau matan nee iha Arka nia leten no iha Arka nia laran o tenki tau testemunha nebee Hau sei foo ba o.
verses.22: Iha nebaa Hau sei hasoru malu ho o, no koalia ho o hosi matan nia leten, hosi kerubim rua nia leet iha Arka Aliansa nia leten. Hau sei koalia ho o kona ba buat hotu nebee Hau foo orden ba o hosi ukun fuan hodi hatoo ba ema Israel sira.”
verses.23: “O tenki halo meza hosi ai kasi, nebee naruk sentímetru sia-nulu, luan sentímetru haat-nulu resin lima, no aas sentímetru hitu-nulu.
verses.24: O tenki falun ho osan mean nebee moos no forma dezenhu ho osan mean hodi hadulas meza nee.
verses.25: O tenki halo ninin nebee sae sentímetru hitu ho balu iha meza leten, no halo ho osan mean hodi haleu meza nee.
verses.26: O tenki halo kadeli haat ba meza hosi osan mean no tau kadeli sira nee iha meza nia lidun haat, iha meza nia ain.
verses.27: Kadeli nee tenki besik iha meza ninin atu bele hatama ai naruk hodi lori meza nee.
verses.28: O tenki halo ai naruk hosi ai kasi no falun ho osan mean, no bele lori meza ho ai naruk nee.
verses.29: O tenki halo nia bikan no kanedok insensu nian, no botir ho manko hodi uza ba oferta hemu nian; buat sira nee o tenki halo hosi osan mean nebee moos.
verses.30: No o tenki tau nafatin paun Prezensa nian iha meza nee nia leten iha Hau nia oin.
verses.31: “O tenki halo kandelabru hosi osan mean nebee moos. Halo kandelabru hosi servisu tuku: nia ain, nia liman, nia kopu sira ho dezenhu tahan nian no nia funan sira - buat hotu tenki halo sai buat ida deit.
verses.32: Tenki iha sanak neen iha nia sorin rua, sanak tolu hosi sorin ida no sanak tolu fali hosi sorin seluk.
verses.33: Halo dezenhu tolu hanesan kopu kiik ho oin hanesan ai funan amendoa nian, inklui ai funan tahan no ai funan, no halo iha sanak ida; no halo dezenhu tolu fali hanesan kopu kiik ho oin hanesan ai funan amendoa nian, inklui ai funan tahan no ai funan, no halo iha sanak ida seluk. Nunee o tenki halo ba sanak neen iha kandelabru nee.
verses.34: No iha kandelabru nia sanak iha klaran tenki iha kopu kiik haat ho oin hanesan ai funan amendoa nian, ho ai funan tahan ho sira nia ai funan sira.
verses.35: Iha sanak rua nia kaer fatin nia okos tenki iha ai funan tahan ho ai funan nee, no iha sanak rua seluk nee nia kaer fatin nia okos tenki iha ai funan tahan ho ai funan nee, no iha sanak rua seluk fali nia kaer fatin nia okos tenki iha ai funan tahan ho ai funan nee; nunee o tenki halo ba sanak neen nebee sai hosi kandelabru nee.
verses.36: Ai funan tahan sira no sanak sira nee tenki sai ida deit. No buat hotu nee tenki halo hosi osan mean moos nebee tuku.
verses.37: O tenki halo ahi oan hitu iha kandelabru nee, no ahi oan sira nee tenki tau iha ahi oan nia fatin, nunee bele foo naroman ba nia oin.
verses.38: Kandelabru nia pinsa sira no bikan ahi sira nee tenki halo hosi osan mean nebee moos.
verses.39: Tenki uza osan mean nebee moos tetu kilo tolu-nulu resin lima hodi halo kandelabru no nia sasaan hotu.
verses.40: No haree katak o halo buat hotu nee tuir dezenhu nebee Hau hatudu ona ba o iha foho.

verses.1: “Depois o tenki halo Tabernakulu ho hena sanulu hosi hena linhu nebee suku hamutuk ho kabas kór azúl, kór uvas, no kór mean, no suku dezenhu furak nebee iha kerubim sira.
verses.2: Hena ida naruk metru sanulu resin rua sentímetru neen-nulu no luan metru ida sentímetru ualu-nulu. Hena sira nee tenki naruk hanesan.
verses.3: Hena lima tenki tutan hamutuk no hena lima seluk mos tenki tutan hamutuk.
verses.4: Iha hena sira primeiru nia ninin imi tenki halo tali kabuar nebee kór azúl, nunee mos halo iha hena sira seluk nee nia ninin.
verses.5: Halo tali kabuar lima-nulu iha hena ida no tali kabuar lima-nulu iha hena ida seluk nia ninin nebee iha segundu nian, nunee tali kabuar sira nee bele hasoru malu.
verses.6: No o tenki halo kait lima-nulu hosi osan mean no tutan malu hena sira nee hamutuk ho kait hodi nunee sira sai Tabernakulu ida.
verses.7: No mos o tenki halo hena sira hosi bibi nia fulun hodi taka nudar kakuluk ba Tabernakulu nee. O tenki halo hena sanulu resin ida.
verses.8: Hena ida naruk metru sanulu resin tolu ho balu no nia luan metru ida sentímetru ualu-nulu. No hena sanulu resin ida nee tenki sukat hanesan.
verses.9: Hena lima nee o tenki tutan hamutuk, no hena neen nee tutan hamutuk. Hena ba dala neen nian o tenki dobra ba rua iha Tabernakulu nee nia oin.
verses.10: O tenki halo tali kabuar lima-nulu iha hena primeiru nia ninin, no tali kabuar lima-nulu iha hena segundu nia ninin.
verses.11: O tenki halo kait lima-nulu hosi besi riti no hatama kait sira nee iha tali kabuar sira no tutan hena sira nee hodi sai ida deit.
verses.12: Bele husik hena nia rohan nebee naruk liu hodi taka Tabernakulu kotuk.
verses.13: No hena nia rohan iha sorin naruk, nebee sentímetru haat-nulu resin lima iha sorin ida no sentímetru haat-nulu resin lima iha sorin seluk, bele husik hodi taka iha Tabernakulu nia sorin rua.
verses.14: Nunee moos o tenki halo lona hosi bibi malae aman nia kulit ho kór mean no ida fali hosi animál seluk nia kulit hodi taka tenda nee.
verses.15: O tenki prepara ai kabelak hosi ai kasi nebee hamriik loos hodi uza ba Tabernakulu nee.
verses.16: Ai kabelak ida aas metru haat ho balu no nia luan sentímetru hitu-nulu.
verses.17: Ai kabelak ida-idak tenki iha liman rua nebee monta hanesan. Nunee ai kabelak hotu iha Tabernakulu tenki halo hanesan.
verses.18: O tenki halo ai kabelak rua-nulu iha parte súl.
verses.19: No o tenki halo ain haat-nulu hosi osan mutin hodi tau iha ai kabelak rua-nulu nee nia okos, ain rua iha ai kabelak ida nia okos hodi simu nia liman, no ain rua iha ai kabelak seluk nia okos nebee tuir mai hodi simu ninia liman.
verses.20: No mos hosi sorin norte, o tenki halo ai kabelak rua-nulu
verses.21: ho nia ain hosi osan mutin nee haat-nulu, ain rua iha ai kabelak ida no ain rua iha ai kabelak ida nebee tuir mai.
verses.22: Iha Tabernakulu nia kotuk, hosi parte oeste, o tenki halo ai kabelak neen.
verses.23: Ai kabelak rua o tenki halo iha Tabernakulu nia lidun iha sorin rua.
verses.24: Ai kabelak rua nee tenki iha nia kait kaduak iha kraik no iha leten mos, besik iha kadeli primeiru; nunee halo ba ai kabelak rua nee no sira tenki sai lidun.
verses.25: Nunee tenki iha ai kabelak ualu ho sira nia ain nebee halo ho osan mutin: hamutuk ain sanulu resin neen nebee ain rua iha ai kabelak ida, no ain rua iha ai kabelak nebee tuir mai.
verses.26: O tenki halo ai naruk hosi ai kasi: ai naruk lima ba ai kabelak sira iha sorin ida,
verses.27: no ai naruk lima ba ai kabelak sira iha sorin seluk, no ai naruk lima ba ai kabelak sira iha kotuk, iha sorin oeste.
verses.28: No ai naruk iha ai kabelak nia klaran, tenki halo hosi rohan ida too ba rohan seluk.
verses.29: Ai kabelak sira nee tenki falun ho osan mean, no kadeli sira o tenki halo hosi osan mean hodi hatama ai naruk sira nee. No ai naruk sira nee o tenki falun ho osan mean.
verses.30: Nunee o tenki harii Tabernakulu tuir planu nebee Hau hatudu tiha ona ba o iha foho leten.
verses.31: O tenki halo veo ho kabas kór azúl, kór uvas no kór mean no halo ho hena linhu nebee suku ho dezenhu furak nebee inklui kerubim sira.
verses.32: O tenki tara veo nee iha ai riin haat nebee halo hosi ai kasi nebee falun ho osan mean, no halo sira nia kait ho osan mean hodi tama ba ain haat nebee halo ho osan mutin.
verses.33: Veo nee o tenki tara iha kait sira iha leten no o tenki lori Arka Aliansa nee ba iha veo nia kotuk, nunee veo bele fahe entre Fatin Santu no Fatin Santu Liu.
verses.34: O tenki taka Arka Aliansa ho nia matan iha Fatin Santu Liu.
verses.35: Meza nee o tenki tau iha veo nia sorin liu no tau kandelabru iha meza nia oin. Kandelabru nee iha sorin súl no meza iha sorin norte.
verses.36: O tenki halo odamatan hosi kabas kór azúl, kór uvas no kór mean. Halo ho hena linhu nebee suku borda ho kór oi-oin.
verses.37: O tenki halo ai riin lima hosi ai kasi no falun ho osan mean hodi tara hena odamatan nee. Halo sira nia kait ho osan mean no sira nia ain lima halo ho besi riti.”

verses.1: “O tenki halo altár hosi ai kasi nebee luan metru rua sentímetru rua-nulu resin rua no naruk metru rua sentímetru rua-nulu resin rua, nunee altár nee kuadradu. Nia aas metru ida sentímetru tolu-nulu resin lima.
verses.2: O tenki halo dikur sira iha lidun haat. Dikur sira nee sei sai ida deit ho altár no tenki falun ho besi riti.
verses.3: No o tenki halo sanan sira hodi simu ninia ahi kdesan, no kanuru, manko, garfu no bikan ahi klaak sira. Sasaan sira nee tenki halo hosi riti.
verses.4: O tenki halo redi ida nebee homan ho riti no iha redi nee o tenki tau kadeli haat hosi riti no tau iha lidun haat.
verses.5: O tenki tau redi nee iha altár nia ibun okos, iha altár laran iha klaran.
verses.6: O tenki halo ai naruk rua ba altár nee, halo hosi ai kasi no falun ho riti.
verses.7: Ai naruk sira nee tenki hatama ba kadeli sira, hodi ai naruk sira nee mak iha altár nia sori rua nee hodi lori nia.
verses.8: O tenki halo Altár nee hosi ai kabelak no nia mamuk iha laran, hanesan hatudu tiha ona ba o iha foho.
verses.9: “O tenki halo fatin nebee haleu Tabernakulu: iha parte súl nian halo naruk metru haat-nulu resin lima. Tenki halo hosi hena linhu nebee suku hodi haleu iha Tabernakulu nee.
