verses.57: Karau oan ida nebee aman, bibi malae aman ida no bibi malae oan ida nebee tinan ida, hodi halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk.
verses.58: Bibi timor oan ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian.
verses.59: Karau aman rua, bibi malae aman lima, bibi timor aman lima no bibi malae oan lima nebee tinan ida, hodi halo sakrifísiu dame nian. Ida nee mak oferta hosi Gamaliel, oan mane hosi Pedazur.
verses.60: Iha loron ba dala sia, Abidan, oan mane hosi Gideoni, nebee xefi ba ema Benjamin sira, lori oferta.
verses.61: Ninia oferta nee mak bikan osan mutin ida ho todan kilu ida grama atus lima neen-nulu no manko osan mutin ida ho todan grama atus ualu haat-nulu, tuir osan Fatin Santu nian. No buat rua nee nakonu ho trigu diak nebee kahur ho mina hodi halo oferta trigu nian.
verses.62: Kanuru osan mean ida ho todan grama atus ida rua-nulu, no nakonu ho insensu.
verses.63: Karau oan ida nebee aman, bibi malae aman ida no bibi malae oan ida nebee tinan ida, hodi halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk.
verses.64: Bibi timor oan ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian.
verses.65: Karau aman rua, bibi malae aman lima, bibi timor aman lima no bibi malae oan lima nebee tinan ida, hodi halo sakrifísiu dame nian. Ida nee mak oferta hosi Abidan, oan mane hosi Gideoni.
verses.66: Iha loron ba dala sanulu, Ahiezer, oan mane hosi Amisadai, nebee xefi ba ema Dan sira, lori oferta.
verses.67: Ninia oferta nee mak bikan osan mutin ida ho todan kilu ida grama atus lima neen-nulu no manko osan mutin ida ho todan grama atus ualu haat-nulu, tuir osan Fatin Santu nian. No buat rua nee nakonu ho trigu diak nebee kahur ho mina hodi halo oferta trigu nian.

verses.70: Bibi timor oan ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian.
verses.71: Karau aman rua, bibi malae aman lima, bibi timor aman lima no bibi malae oan lima nebee tinan ida, hodi halo sakrifísiu dame nian. Ida nee mak oferta hosi Ahiezer, oan mane hosi Amisadai.
verses.72: Iha loron ba dala sanulu resin ida, Pagiel, oan mane hosi Okran, nebee xefi ba ema Aser sira, lori oferta.
verses.73: Ninia oferta nee mak bikan osan mutin ida ho todan kilu ida grama atus lima neen-nulu no manko osan mutin ida ho todan grama atus ualu haat-nulu, tuir osan Fatin Santu nian. No buat rua nee nakonu ho trigu diak nebee kahur ho mina hodi halo oferta trigu nian.

verses.75: Karau oan ida nebee aman, bibi malae aman ida no bibi malae oan ida nebee tinan ida, hodi halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk.
verses.76: Bibi timor oan ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian.
verses.77: Karau aman rua, bibi malae aman lima, bibi timor aman lima no bibi malae oan lima nebee tinan ida, hodi halo sakrifísiu dame nian. Ida nee mak oferta hosi Pagiel, oan mane hosi Okran.
verses.78: Iha loron ba dala sanulu resin rua, Ahira, oan mane hosi Enan, nebee xefi ba ema Aser sira, lori oferta.
verses.79: Ninia oferta nee mak bikan osan mutin ida ho todan kilu ida grama atus lima neen-nulu no manko osan mutin ida ho todan grama atus ualu haat-nulu, tuir osan Fatin Santu nian. No buat rua nee nakonu ho trigu diak nebee kahur ho mina hodi halo oferta trigu nian.
verses.80: Kanuru osan mean ida ho todan grama atus ida rua-nulu, no nakonu ho insensu.
verses.81: Karau oan ida nebee aman, bibi malae aman ida no bibi malae oan ida nebee tinan ida, hodi halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk.
verses.82: Bibi timor oan ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian.
verses.83: Karau aman rua, bibi malae aman lima, bibi timor aman lima no bibi malae oan lima nebee tinan ida, hodi halo sakrifísiu dame nian. Ida nee mak oferta hosi Ahira, oan mane hosi Enan.
verses.84: Ida nee mak dedikasaun ba altár iha loron nebee sira fui mina unsaun, nebee hosi xefi Israel sira: bikan osan mutin sanulu resin rua, manko osan mutin sanulu resin rua no kanuru osan mean sanulu resin rua;
verses.85: no bikan osan mutin ida-idak todan kilu ida grama atus lima neen-nulu no manko osan mutin ida-idak todan grama atus ualu haat-nulu, sasaan osan mutin hotu nee iha todan kilu rua-nulu resin ualu grama atus ualu, tuir osan Fatin Santu nian;
verses.86: kanuru osan mutin sanulu resin rua, nebee nakonu ho insensu, ho todan grama atus ida rua-nulu, tuir osan Fatin Santu nian, kanuru osan mean hotu nee iha todan kilo rihun ida grama atus haat haat-nulu;
verses.87: animál hotu ba sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee karau aman sanulu resin rua, bibi malae aman sanulu resin rua, bibi malae oan nebee tinan ida iha sanulu resin rua, ho sira nia oferta trigu nian, no bibi timor oan sanulu resin rua hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian;
verses.88: no animál hotu ba sakrifísiu dame sira nebee karau aman rua-nulu resin haat, bibi malae aman neen-nulu, bibi timor aman neen-nulu, bibi malae oan nebee tinan ida iha neen-nulu. Ida nee mak dedikasaun ba altár bainhira sira fui ona mina unsaun.
verses.89: Bainhira Moisés tama iha Tenda Enkontru hodi koalia ho Nai, nia rona lian nebee koalia ho nia hosi matan dame nebee iha Arka Aliansa nia leten, hosi kerubim rua nia leet, no lian nee koalia ho nia.

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.2: “Koalia ba Arão, no dehan ba nia, Bainhira ita monta lampu sira, lampu hitu nee sei foo naroman iha kandelabru nia oin.”
verses.3: No Arão halo tuir. Nia monta lampu sira iha kandelabru nia oin, hanesan Nai foo orden ba Moisés.
verses.4: Sira halo kandelabru nee ho osan mean nebee sira tuku, inklui ninia ain no ninia fuan nee sira tuku tuir dezenhu nebee Nai hatudu ona ba Moisés, nunee sira halo ona kandelabru.
verses.5: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.6: “Foti ema Levi sira hosi ema Israel sira nia leet no halo sira moos.
verses.7: Tenki halo hanesan nee hodi halo sira moos: hisik bee nebee hamoos sala ba sira, no haruka sira koi sira nia fuuk iha isin tomak no fasi sira nia ropa no hariis aan.
verses.8: Haruka sira foti karau aman nebee oan ida hamutuk ho oferta trigu nian, nebee trigu diak kahur ho mina, no karau aman nebee oan ida hodi halo oferta sala nian.
verses.9: O tenki lori ema Levi sira ba iha Tenda Enkontru nia oin, no halibur ema Israel sira nia komunidade tomak mai hamutuk.
verses.10: No o sei lori ema Levi sira ba iha Nai nia oin, no ema Israel sira sei tau sira nia liman ba ema Levi sira.
verses.11: Arão sei oferese ema Levi sira iha Nai nia oin nudar oferta hosi ema Israel sira, hodi sira bele halao Nai nia ministériu.
verses.12: Ema Levi sira sei tau sira nia liman iha karau aman sira nia ulun, no o sei oferese ida nudar sakrifísiu sala nian no ida seluk nudar sakrifísiu tunu motuk ba Nai hodi taka ema Levi sira nia sala.
verses.13: O sei tau ema Levi sira iha Arão nia oin, no iha ninia oan mane sira nia oin, no oferese sira nudar oferta ida ba Nai.
verses.14: Nunee o sei haketak ema Levi sira hosi ema Israel sira nia leet no ema Levi sira sei sai Hau nian.
verses.15: Tuir mai, ema Levi sira bele tama hodi halao ministériu iha Tenda Enkontru. No o sei halo sira moos no oferese sira nudar oferta ida.
verses.16: Tanba o sei foo sira hotu mai Hau hosi ema Israel sira nia leet hodi troka buat hotu nebee loke oan fatin ba dala ida, hodi troka oan primeiru hosi ema Israel hotu, tanba Hau foti ona sira hodi sai Hau nian.
verses.17: Tanba oan primeiru hotu hosi ema Israel sira mak Hau nian, inklui ema no animál. Tanba iha loron nebee Hau oho oan primeiru hotu iha rai Ejitu, Hau konsagra sira mai Hau.
verses.18: Hau foti ona ema Levi sira hodi troka oan primeiru hosi ema Israel sira.
verses.19: No Hau foo ema Levi sira nudar prezenti ida ba Arão no ninia oan mane sira hosi ema Israel sira nia leet hodi halao ema Israel sira nia ministériu iha Tenda Enkontru, no hodi taka ema Israel sira nia sala. Nunee moras boot la mai iha ema Israel sira nia leet bainhira ema Israel sira hakbesik ba Fatin Santu.”
verses.20: Moisés, Arão no komunidade tomak hosi ema Israel sira halo ba ema Levi sira tuir orden hotu nebee Nai foo ba Moisés kona ba ema Levi sira. Nunee ema Israel sira halo ba ema Levi sira.
verses.21: No ema Levi sira sai moos hosi sala, no sira fasi sira nia ropa. Arão oferese sira nudar oferta ida iha Nai nia oin no Arão taka sira nia sala hodi halo sira moos.
verses.22: Tuir mai, ema Levi sira tama hodi halao ministériu iha Tenda Enkontru iha Arão nia oin, no iha ninia oan mane sira nia oin; tuir orden nebee Nai foo ba Moisés kona ba ema Levi sira, nunee sira halo tuir ba ema Levi sira.
verses.23: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.24: “Buat ida nee aplika ba ema Levi sira: hosi tinan rua-nulu resin lima ba leten sira sei mai hodi halao ministériu iha Tenda Enkontru.
verses.25: Bainhira sira tinan lima-nulu ona sira sei para hosi ministériu, no sira sei la serví tan.
verses.26: Maibee sira sei serví sira nia maluk sira iha Tenda Enkontru liu hosi halo seguransa maibee sira la bele halao ministériu. O tenki halo hanesan nee ba ema Levi sira kona ba sira nia knaar.

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés iha rai fuik Sinai, iha fulan primeiru, iha tinan segundu hosi tempu nebee sira sai hosi rai Ejitu, no Nia dehan,
verses.2: “Husik ema Israel sira halao loron Páskua tuir loron nee nia tempu.
verses.3: Iha loron sanulu resin haat iha fulan nee, iha tempu rai nakaras, o tenki halo tuir iha tempu loos. Halo tuir loron nee nia estatutu hotu, no halo tuir seremónia hotu.
verses.4: No Moisés koalia ho ema Israel sira, hodi sira bele halo tuir loron Páskua.
verses.5: No sira halo tuir loron Páskua iha loron sanulu resin haat, iha fulan primeiru, iha tempu rai nakaras, iha rai fuik Sinai. No ema Israel sira halo tuir orden hotu nebee Nai foo ba Moisés.
verses.6: No ema balu foer hela tanba sira kona mate isin no sira la bele halo tuir loron Páskua iha loron nebaa. Entaun sira mai iha Moisés no Arão nia oin iha loron nebaa.
verses.7: Ema sira nee dehan ba Moisés, “Ami sei foer hela tanba mate isin. Nusaa mak ami la bele halo tuir no ami la bele oferese sakrifísiu ba Nai tuir tempu loos iha ema Israel sira nia leet?”
verses.8: Moisés dehan ba sira, “Hein lai, no hau sei rona Nai nia orden kona ba imi.”
verses.9: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.10: “Koalia ba ema Israel sira, no dehan, Se ema ida hosi imi ka hosi imi nia bei-oan sira sai la moos tanba mate isin, ka nia sei iha viajen nebee nia dook hela, nia sei halo tuir loron Páskua ba Nai.
verses.11: Iha loron sanulu resin haat, iha fulan segundu, iha tempu rai nakaras nia sei halo tuir Páskua, no nia sei haan buat nee no paun nebee fermentu la iha no modo moruk.
verses.12: No sira la bele husik hahaan nee too dadeer fali, no sira la bele halo tohar bibi nia ruin. Sira tenki tuir Páskua nia estatutu hotu.
verses.13: Maibee ema nebee moos, no nia la halo viajen hela, no nia lakohi halo tuir loron Páskua, tenki hakotu ema nee hosi ninia povu nia leet, tanba nia la lori Nai nia oferta tuir tempu loos, nunee ema nee tenki lori ninia sala.
verses.14: Se ema estranjeiru lao hamutuk ho imi no nia hakarak halo tuir loron Páskua ba Nai, entaun nia tenki halo tuir estatutu Páskua nian hodi halao seremónia nee. Imi tenki iha estatutu ida ba ema estranjeiru no ba nia nebee moris iha imi nia rai.”
verses.15: Iha loron nebee sira harii Tabernakulu, kalohan mai no taka Tabernakulu, nebee Tenda Aliansa. No fatin nee iha buat nebee iha oin hanesan ahi nebee iha Tabernakulu leten too dadeer.
verses.16: No Tabernakulu iha buat nee nafatin: kalohan taka fatin nee iha loron, no buat nebee iha oin hanesan ahi iha kalan.
verses.17: Bainhira kalohan sae hosi Tenda nee, ema Israel sira halo viajen. No iha fatin nebee kalohan nee para, ema Israel sira halo sira nia akampamentu.
verses.18: Ema Israel sira halo viajen tuir Nai nia orden, no sira halo akampamentu tuir Nai nia orden. Sira hela iha sira nia tenda bainhira kalohan hela iha Tabernakulu.
verses.19: Bainhira kalohan hela kleur iha Tabernakulu too loron barak, entaun ema Israel sira halo tuir Nai no sira la halo viajen.
verses.20: Bainhira kalohan hela loron balu deit iha Tabernakulu, sira hela iha sira nia tenda tuir Nai nia orden, depois sira halo viajen tuir Nai nia orden.
verses.21: No bainhira kalohan hela hosi rai nakaras too dadeer fali, no kalohan sae fali iha dadeer nee, nunee sira mos halo viajen. Mezmu loron ka kalan, bainhira kalohan sae sira halo viajen.
verses.22: Ka se kalohan hela iha Tabernakulu too loron rua, ka fulan ida, ka tinan ida, nunee ema Israel sira hela iha sira nia tenda no la halo viajen. Bainhira kalohan sae, sira halo viajen.
verses.23: Sira hein iha sira nia tenda tuir Nai nia orden, no sira halo viajen tuir Nai nia orden. Sira halo tuir Nai, nebee sira tuir orden nebee Nai foo ba Moisés.

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.2: “Halo korneta rua hosi osan mutin. Tenki halo hosi osan mutin nebee tuku, hodi uza atu bolu komunidade no foo orden bainhira akampamentu atu halo viajen.
verses.3: Bainhira sira huu korneta rua nee, komunidade tomak tenki mai halibur iha o nia oin iha odamatan ba Tenda Enkontru.
verses.4: Maibee se sira huu korneta ida deit, nunee xefi sira, nebee nai ulun ba suku sira iha Israel tenki mai halibur ba o.
verses.5: Bainhira o huu sinál kleur ida, nunee akampamentu sira nebee hela iha parte leste sei sai ba.
verses.6: Bainhira o huu sinál kleur nee ba dala rua, nunee akampamentu sira nebee hela iha parte súl sei halo sira nia viajen. Nunee sira huu sinál kleur nee hodi sira halo viajen.
verses.7: Maibee atu haruka povu sira mai hamutuk, o huu deit no la presiza foo sinál kleur.
verses.8: Arão nia oan mane sira, nebee saserdote sira, mak huu korneta sira nee; ida nee mak estatutu ba imi too tinan ba tinan durante imi nia jerasaun sira.
verses.9: No bainhira imi funu hasoru imi nia inimigu iha imi nia rai nebee hanehan imi, entaun imi tenki foo sinál kleur ho korneta sira nee; nunee Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei hanoin imi, no Nia sei salva imi hosi imi nia inimigu sira.
verses.10: No iha loron nebee imi haksolok, iha loron seremónia sira no iha imi nia fulan foun sira, imi tenki huu korneta sira bainhira imi halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu dame nian; nunee sira sei foo hanoin ba imi iha imi nia Maromak nia oin. Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak.”
verses.11: Iha tinan ba dala rua, iha fulan rua, iha loron rua-nulu iha fulan nee, kalohan sae hosi Tenda Aliansa.
verses.12: Depois ema Israel sira sai hosi rai fuik Sinai tuir sira nia formatura, no kalohan nee para iha rai fuik Paran.
verses.13: Ida nee ba dala ida nebee sira sai tuir orden Nai nian liu hosi Moisés.
verses.14: Bandeira hosi Judá nia akampamentu sai uluk tuir sira nia forsa sira, no ema nebee lidera forsa nee mak Nason, oan hosi Aminadab.
verses.15: Ema nebee lidera forsa hosi suku Isakar mak Natanel, oan hosi Zuar.
verses.16: Ema nebee lidera forsa hosi suku Zebulón mak Eliab, oan hosi Helon.
verses.17: Liu tiha Tabernakulu nee sobu tiha, Gerson nia jerasaun no Merari nia jerasaun sai ba, no sira lori Tabernakulu nee.
verses.18: Depois bandeira hosi Ruben nia akampamentu sai ba, tuir sira nia forsa sira. Ema nebee lidera forsa nee mak Elizur, oan hosi Sedeur.
verses.19: Ema nebee lidera forsa hosi suku Simeão mak Selumiel, oan hosi Zurisadai.
verses.20: Ema nebee lidera forsa hosi suku Gad mak Eliasaf, oan hosi Deuel.
verses.21: Depois ema Koat sira sai ba, no sira lori sasaan hosi Fatin Santu. No ema harii ona Tabernakulu molok sira too iha nebaa.
verses.22: Depois bandeira hosi Efraim nia akampamentu sai, tuir sira nia forsa sira. Ema nebee lidera forsa nee mak Elisama, oan hosi Amihud.
verses.23: Ema nebee lidera forsa hosi suku Manasés mak Gamaliel, oan hosi Pedazur.
verses.24: Ema nebee lidera forsa hosi suku Benjamin mak Abidan, oan hosi Gideoni.
verses.25: Depois bandeira hosi Dan nia akampamentu sai, nebee sai ikus hosi akampamentu hotu, no sira sai tuir sira nia forsa sira. Ema nebee lidera forsa nee mak Ahiezer, oan hosi Amisadai.
verses.26: Ema nebee lidera forsa hosi suku Aser mak Pagiel, oan hosi Okran.
verses.27: Ema nebee lidera forsa hosi suku Naftali mak Ahira, oan hosi Enan.
verses.28: Nunee ema Israel sira halo viajen tuir sira nia forsa sira, bainhira sira sai ba.
verses.29: Depois Moisés hatete ba Hobabe, oan hosi Reuel, nebee ema Midian, Moisés nia banin-mane, “Ami atu lao ba fatin nebee Nai dehan, ‘Hau sei foo fatin nee ba o.’ Tuir hamutuk ho ami, no ami sei halo diak ba ita, tanba Nai promete tiha ona buat nebee diak ba Israel.”
verses.30: Maibee nia hataan ba Moisés, “Hau la tuir, maibee hau sei ba hau nia rai, no hau nia maun-alin sira.”
verses.31: Moisés hatete, “La bele husik hela ami, tanba ita mak hatene fatin nebee ami bele halo akampamentu iha rai fuik, nunee ita bele hatudu dalan mai ami.
verses.32: Se ita tuir hamutuk ho ami, buat diak nebee Nai halo mai ami, nunee ami sei halo diak ba ita mos.”
verses.33: Nunee sira sai hosi foho Nai nian no lao durante loron tolu nia laran. Nai nia Arka Aliansa lao iha sira nia oin no lao durante loron tolu hodi buka fatin nebee sira bele para.
verses.34: No kalohan Nai nian mak iha sira nia leten iha tempu loron bainhira sira sai hosi akampamentu fatin nee.
verses.35: Bainhira Arka nee sai, Moisés hatete, “Hadeer ba, Oh Nai, no husik O nia inimigu halai namkari, no ema sira nebee odi O sei halai hosi O nia oin.”
verses.36: Bainhira Arka nee para, nia hatete, “Fila fali mai, Oh Nai, ba ema Israel sira nebee rihun ba rihun.”

verses.1: Iha tempu ida, povu nee koalia murmura iha Nai nia oin kona ba sira nia problema sira, no bainhira Nai rona nee, Nai sai hirus, nunee Nai nia ahi sei lakan iha sira nia leet, no sunu akampamentu nia ninin.
verses.2: Depois povu nee hakilar ba Moisés, no Moisés halo orasaun ba Nai, nunee ahi nee mate.
verses.3: Tanba nee ema foo naran ba fatin nee Tabera, tanba ahi Nai nian lakan tiha ona iha sira nia leet.
verses.4: Ema nakar sira, nebee iha sira nia leet, iha laran kaan makaas; no ema Israel mos tanis fali no hatete, “See mak atu foo naan hodi ami bele haan?
verses.5: Ami hanoin hetan ikan nebee uluk ita haan saugati deit iha Ejitu, no pepinu, pateka, liis mean, liis boot no liis asu.
verses.6: Maibee agora ami krekas maran, no la iha buat ida, só deit paun maná nee mak ami haree.”
verses.7: Maná nee hanesan koentru no haree hanesan ai been morin.
verses.8: Povu nee lao ba-mai hodi halibur maná nee, depois sira dulas ka fai ho fatuk inan nebee iha kuak. Sira daan iha sanan no halo sai paun kabuar, no buat nee hanesan haan dosi nebee sona ho mina.
verses.9: No bainhira mahobeen tuun iha tempu kalan, nunee maná moos tuun iha nebaa.
verses.10: Moisés rona povu nee tanis, iha sira nia família hotu, no ema ida-idak tanis iha ninia tenda nia odamatan. No Nai sai hirus makaas, no Moisés mos la kontenti.
verses.11: Depois Moisés hatete ba Nai, “Tanba saa mak O foo terus ba O nia atan oan hau? Tanba saa mak hau la simu grasa iha O nia oin, nunee O foo povu nee nia todan hotu ba hau?
verses.12: Hau mak sai isin rua ho povu tomak nee ka? Hau tuur ahi hetan sira, nunee O hatete mai hau, ‘Hiti sira hanesan amaa nebee hiti oan nebee susu hela,’ no lao ba rai nebee O promete ba sira nia bei-ala sira?
verses.13: Hosi nebee mak hau bele hetan naan atu foo ba povu hotu nee? Tanba sira tanis ba hau, no dehan, ‘Foo mai ami naan atu haan.’
verses.14: Hau mesak deit la bele lori povu hotu nee, tanba sira todan liu ba hau.
verses.15: Se O halo hanesan nee ba hau, diak liu O oho hau deit, se hau hetan grasa iha O nia oin, nunee hau la bele haree hau nia susar nee.”
verses.16: Depois Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Halibur ema katuas sira nain hitu-nulu hosi Israel, nebee o hatene katak sira mak ema nebee simu respeitu hosi povu nee no sira organiza povu, depois lori sira ba Tenda Enkontru, nunee sira bele hamriik iha nebaa hamutuk ho o.
verses.17: Nunee Hau sei tuun no koalia ho o iha nebaa, no Hau sei foti Espíritu balun nebee iha o no tau ba sira, nunee sira sei hamutuk ho o hodi lori povu nee, nunee laos o mesak deit mak lori todan nee.
verses.18: Maibee o hatete ba povu nee, ‘Halo santu imi nia aan ba loron aban, no imi sei haan naan; tanba imi tanis ona iha Nai nia oin no hatete, “See mak atu foo naan mai ami hodi haan? Iha Ejitu buat hotu diak liu mai ami.” Nunee Nai sei foo naan ba imi hodi imi bele haan.
verses.19: Laos loron ida deit mak imi haan, laos loron rua ka loron lima, no laos loron sanulu ka loron rua-nulu,
verses.20: maibee too fulan ida, too buat nee sai hosi imi nia inus no imi baruk, tanba imi rejeita ona Nai nebee iha imi nia leet, no imi tanis iha Nia oin, no hatete, “Tanba saa mak ita sai hosi Ejitu?”’”
verses.21: No Moisés dehan, “Maibee ema sira nebee hamutuk ho hau nee mak ema nain rihun atus neen nebee lao ain, no O dehan, ‘Hau sei foo naan ba sira, no durante fulan ida sira sei haan naan!’
verses.22: Ita sei oho bibi lubun sira no karau lubun sira hodi foo ba sira ka? Buat sira nee sei too ba sira ka? Ka ita sei kaer ikan sira hotu hosi tasi laran hodi foo ba sira ka? Buat sira nee sei too ba sira ka?”
verses.23: Maibee Nai hataan ba Moisés, “Nai nia liman sai badak ona ka? Agora o sei haree Hau nia liafuan nee se akontese ba o ka lae.”
verses.24: Moisés sai ba liur no foo hatene Nai nia liafuan nee ba povu. Nia halibur ema katuas sira nain hitu-nulu no haruka sira hamriik haleu Tenda.
verses.25: Depois Nai tuun mai iha kalohan no koalia ba Moisés. Depois Nia foti Espíritu balun hosi Moisés no tau ba ema katuas nain hitu-nulu nee. Bainhira Espíritu nee hela iha sira, sira foo sai profesia, maibee liu tiha nee la iha tan ona.
verses.26: Ema nain rua sei hela iha akampamentu laran. Ema ida naran Eldad, no ida seluk naran Medad, no Espíritu nee hela iha sira. Sira inklui ho ema nebee rejistu nee, maibee sira la tuir ba iha Tenda, nunee sira foo sai profesia iha akampamentu laran.
verses.27: Depois joven mane ida halai hodi foo hatene ba Moisés, “Eldad no Medad foo sai profesia iha akampamentu.”
verses.28: Nunee Josué, oan hosi Nun, nebee Moisés nia atan komesa hosi joven kedas, nia hataan, “Hau nia senhor Moisés, hapara sira!”
verses.29: Maibee Moisés hatete ba nia, “O laran moras ba sira tanba hau ka? Diak liu Nai nia povu hotu sai profeta sira, no Nai tau Ninia Espíritu ba iha sira!”
verses.30: Depois Moisés fila fali ba akampamentu hamutuk ho katuas Israel sira.
verses.31: Depois anin huu mai hosi Nai. Anin nee lori manu kiukai hosi tasi, no husik sira monu iha akampamentu. Sira tuun iha akampamentu nia sorin mai too maizoumenus distánsia nebee ema bele lao iha loron ida nia laran, no sira tuun iha sorin ba too maizoumenus distánsia nebee ema bele lao iha loron ida nia laran. Sira haleu akampamentu no sira aas too maizoumenus sentimu sia-nulu.
verses.32: Depois iha loron no kalan tomak no loron aban ema Israel sira baa kaer manu kiukai sira nee - maizoumenus ema ida bele kaer too kilu rihun ida. Manu kiukai sira nee sira tau namkari iha akampamentu laran hotu.
verses.33: Bainhira naan nee sei iha sira nehan klaran, molok nata, nunee Nai hirus ba ema Israel sira no Nai foo kastigu boot ba sira.
verses.34: Tanba nee sira foo naran ba fatin nee, Kibrot-Hatava, tanba iha nebaa mak sira hakoi ema sira nebee kaan-teen.
verses.35: Hosi Kibrot-Hatava ema Israel sira lao ba Hazerot, no sira hela iha Hazerot.

verses.1: Miriam no Arão koalia hasoru Moisés tanba feto Kus nebee nia kaben ona. Tanba nia kaben ona ho feto Kus.
verses.2: Sira dehan, “Nai koalia duni liu hosi Moisés deit ka? Laos Nia koalia mos liu hosi ami?” No Nai rona buat nee.
verses.3: Moisés mak ema ida nebee haraik aan tebe-tebes no liu fali ema hotu iha mundu laran.
verses.4: Derepenti Nai koalia ba Moisés no Arão no Miriam, “Imi nain tolu, sai lai hodi mai Tenda Enkontru.” Entaun sira nain tolu sai ba.
verses.5: Nai tuun iha kalohan riin no hamriik iha odamatan ba Tenda, no Nia bolu Arão no Miriam. No sira nain rua hakat ba oin.
verses.6: Nia dehan, “Agora, rona Hau nia liafuan: Se iha profeta ida iha imi nia leet, Hau, Nai, sei hatudu aan ba nia liu hosi vizaun ida, no koalia ho nia liu hosi mehi ida.
verses.7: Maibee Hau la halo hanesan nee ho Moisés. Nia mak ema fiel iha Hau nia uma kain tomak.
verses.8: Hau koalia ho nia oin ho oin, no klaru, laos liu hosi ai sasiik. No nia haree Nai nia ilas. Entaun nusaa mak imi la tauk atu koalia hasoru Hau nia atan Moisés?”
verses.9: Nai sai hirus hasoru sira no Nia sai.
verses.10: Kalohan nee sai hosi Tenda, no tebes, Miriam iha moras lepra no nia mutin hanesan neve. Arão haree Miriam no tebes Miriam iha moras lepra.
verses.11: Arão dehan ba Moisés, “Oh favór ida, hau nia senhór, keta rai sala nee mai ami, tanba ami halo ona buat beik, no ami sala ona.
verses.12: Keta husik Miriam hanesan bebee nebee mate ona bainhira nia foin sai hosi nia inan nia oan fatin no nia isin balu dodok ona.”
verses.13: Moisés hakilar ba Nai no dehan, “Favór ida, kura nia, Oh Maromak - favór ida!”
verses.14: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Se nia aman tafui ba ninia oin, laos nia sai moe too loron hitu ka? Haketak nia iha akampamentu liur too loron hitu. Depois bele simu nia tama mai fali.”
verses.15: Entaun sira haketak Miriam iha akampamentu liur too loron hitu. No povu nee la kontinua sira nia viajen too Miriam bele tama mai fali.
verses.16: Depois povu sai hosi Hazerot no halo akampamentu iha rai fuik Paran.

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.2: “Haruka ema balu baa hafuhu rai Kanaan, rai nebee Hau foo ba ema Israel sira. Haruka ema ida hosi sira nia bei-ala sira nia suku ida-idak, ema nebee ukun nain ida iha sira nia leet.
verses.3: Iha rai fuik Paran, Moisés haruka espiaun sira, tuir Nai nia orden. Sira hotu mak xefi hosi ema Israel sira.
verses.4: No sira nia naran mak nee: hosi suku Ruben, Samua, oan hosi Zakur;
verses.5: hosi suku Simeão, Safate, oan hosi Hori;
verses.6: hosi suku Judá, Kaleb, oan hosi Jefune;
verses.7: hosi suku Isakar, Igal, oan hosi José;
verses.8: hosi suku Efraim, Oseias, oan hosi Nun;
verses.9: hosi suku Benjamim, Palti, oan hosi Rafu;
verses.10: hosi suku Zebulón, Gadiel, oan hosi Sodi;
verses.11: hosi suku José (nee mak suku Manasés), Gadi, oan hosi Susi;
verses.12: hosi suku Dan, Amiel, oan hosi Gemali;
verses.13: hosi suku Aser, Setur, oan hosi Mikael;
verses.14: hosi suku Naftali, Nabi, oan hosi Vofsi;
verses.15: hosi suku Gad, Guel, oan hosi Maki.
verses.16: Nee mak naran ba ema sira nebee Moisés haruka baa hafuhu rai nee. Nia troka Oseias nia naran ba Josué, nebee Nun nia oan.
verses.17: Moisés haruka ema sira nee baa hafuhu rai Kanaan, no nia dehan ba sira, “Imi baa iha rejiaun súl no sae ba foho.
verses.18: Haree di-diak, rai nee oinsaa. Haree mos ema sira nebee hela iha rai nee, forti ka fraku, barak ka uitoan.
verses.19: Haree rai nebee ema sira hela ba nee, diak ka aat, no sira nia sidade nebee ema sira hela ba nee, sira hela iha tenda ka iha fatin forti.
verses.20: Haree di-diak rai nee buras ka lae, rai nee iha ai-laran ka lae. Imi tenki brani, no lori ai-fuan ruma hosi rai nee. (Tempu nee mak ai-uvas nia fuan primeiru nian).
verses.21: Nunee ema sira nee baa hodi hafuhu rai nee, komesa hosi rai fuik Zin too Reobe, nebee besik Amate.
verses.22: Sira sae hosi rejiaun súl no baa too Hebron. Ema nebee hela iha nebaa mak Aiman, Sesai, no Talmai, jerasaun hosi Anak. (Hebron harii tinan hitu molok Zoan iha Ejitu.)
verses.23: Depois sira too iha Rai Tetuk Eskol, iha nebaa sira tesi ai-uvas sanak ida ho uvas ramu ida, no ema nain rua leba iha ai ida. Sira lori mos romaun fuan no figeira fuan.
verses.24: Ema bolu fatin nee rai tetuk Eskol, tanba ai-uvas ramu ida nebee sira tesi iha nebaa.
verses.25: Sira hafuhu rai nee too loron haat-nulu depois sira mai fali.
verses.26: Sira fila ba Moisés no Arão no ema Israel sira nia komunidade tomak, nebee iha rai fuik Paran, iha Kades. No sira konta ba Moisés no Arão no komunidade tomak kona ba fatin nee no hatudu ba sira ai-fuan nebee sira lori hosi rai nebaa.
verses.27: Sira hatete ba Moisés, “Ami baa too ona rai nebee ita boot haruka ami baa nee. Tebes rai nee suli ho susbeen no bani been, no ida nee mak rai nia ai-fuan.
verses.28: Maibee ema sira nebee hela iha nebaa mak ema forti, no sidade sira iha moru haleu no sira boot. Ami mos haree iha nebaa jerasaun hosi Anak.
verses.29: Ema Amalek sira hela iha rai iha rejiaun súl. Ema Eteu, Yebus no Amoreu hela iha rai foho. Ema Kanaan sira hela besik tasi ibun no besik Jordaun.”
verses.30: Maibee Kaleb haruka sira nonook iha Moisés nia oin, no nia dehan, “Ita prontu baa ataka kedas sira hodi hadau sira nia rai. Ita bele manaan sira.”
verses.31: Maibee ema sira nebee fila ho Kaleb nee dehan, “Lae, ita nia forsa la too hodi ataka sira tanba ema iha rai nebaa mak forti liu ita.”
verses.32: Nunee sira foo sai liafuan aat ba ema Israel sira kona ba rai nebee sira baa hafuhu nee. Sira dehan, “Rai nebaa, mak ami foin hafuhu tiha, bele haan ema sira nebee hela iha nebaa. No ema hotu nebee ami haree iha nebaa mak ema ain aas deit.
verses.33: Iha nebaa ami haree ema Nefil sira (nebee oan sira hosi Anak, nebee bei-oan hosi Nefil), no ami senti ami nia aan hanesan gafanhotu, no ema sira nee mos haree ami hanesan gafanhotu.”

14.title: Ema Israel Sira La Tuir Nai

verses.1: Depois povu tomak hakilar ho lian makaas no ema Israel sira tanis iha tempu kalan nee.
verses.2: Ema Israel sira hotu murmura ba Moisés no Arão; no komunidade tomak hatete ba sira, “Diak liu ami mate iha rai Ejitu, ka iha rai fuik nee!
verses.3: Tanba saa mak Nai lori ami mai iha rai nee, hodi nunee ami mate ho surik ka ami nia feen no ami nia oan sira hetan kastigu ka? Karik diak liu ami fila ba Ejitu?”
verses.4: No sira dehan ba malu, “Diak sei ami hili lideransa ida, nunee fila fali ba Ejitu.”
verses.5: Depois Moisés no Arão hakneak iha komunidade tomak nia oin, nebee ema Israel hotu.
verses.6: Maibee Josué, Nun nia oan, no Kaleb, Jefune nia oan, nebee sai manu-ain ba hafuhu rai nee, sira lees sira nia ropa,
verses.7: no hatete ba komunidade Israel tomak, “Rai nebee ami haree nee mak rai diak loos.
verses.8: Se Nai kontenti ho ita, nunee Nia sei lori ita tama ba rai nee no Nia sei foo rai nee ba ita, rai ida nebee suli ho susu been no bani been.
verses.9: Keta fuan toos hasoru Nai, no keta tauk ba ema sira iha rai nebaa, tanba ita sei tolan sira hotu. Sira lakon ona sira nia protesaun, no Nai hamutuk ho ita; keta tauk sira.”
verses.10: Nunee komunidade tomak nee ameasa hakarak tuda sira ho fatuk. Maibee Nai nia glória mosu iha Tenda Enkontru ba ema Israel hotu nia oin.
verses.11: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Too bainhira mak povu nee provoka Hau? Too bainhira mak sira lakohi fiar Hau, mezmu Hau hatudu ona sinál barak iha sira nia leet!
verses.12: Hau sei kastigu sira ho moras todan no hakotu sira hosi Hau nia liman rohan, maibee Hau sei halo o sai nasaun boot no forsa liu sira.” Moisés Halo Orasaun
verses.13: Depois Moisés hatete ba Nai, “Se ema Ejitu sira rona nee, tanba O lori tiha ona nasaun nee ho O Nia forsa hosi sira nia leet,
verses.14: sira sei konta ba ema iha rai nee. Sira rona tiha katak O, Nai, mak iha nasaun nee nia leet, no O, Nai, hatudu O nia aan ba sira ho oin ho oin, no O nia kalohan hamriik iha sira nia leten, no O lao uluk sira iha kalohan riin iha tempu loron no iha ahi riin iha tempu kalan.
verses.15: Nunee se O oho tiha nasaun nee too hotu, nunee rai sira nebee rona tiha ona kona ba O nee sei hatete,
verses.16: ‘Tanba Nai la bele lori nasaun nee tama ba rai nebee Nia jura tiha ona atu foo ba sira, nunee Nia oho sira iha rai fuik.’
verses.17: Nunee agora, husik Nai nia forsa nee hatudu ba, hanesan O promete tiha ona, no dehan,
verses.18: ‘Nai nee iha pasiénsia naruk no Nia nakonu ho domin metin, Nia foo perdua ba hahalok aat no sala nebee kontra lei, maibee Nia sei la hamoos ema nebee halo sala hela, maibee Nia sei selu hahalok aat hosi aman ba nia oan sira, no ba nia bei-oan sira too jerasaun ba dala tolu no dala haat.’
verses.19: Favór ida, foo perdua ba povu nee tuir O nia domin metin nebee boot, hanesan O foo perdua tiha ona ba povu nee hosi Ejitu too agora.”
verses.20: Nai dehan, “Hau foo perdua ba sira tuir saida mak o husu.
verses.21: Maibee tebes, hodi Hau nebee mak moris no Nai nia glória halo nakonu mundu tomak:
verses.22: Ema hotu nebee haree tiha ona Hau nia glória no milagre sira nebee Hau halo iha Ejitu no iha rai fuik, maibee dala sanulu tiha ona koko Hau no lakoi rona Hau nia lian,
verses.23: tebes sira sei la haree rai nebee Hau jura tiha ona ba sira nia bei-ala sira! Sira hotu nebee provoka Hau sei la haree rai nee.
verses.24: Maibee Hau nia atan Kaleb, tanba nia iha espíritu oin seluk, no nia tuir Hau ho nia fuan tomak, Hau sei lori nia tama ba rai nebee nia tama tiha ona, no ninia jerasaun sira sei hetan rai nee.
verses.25: Agora, ema Amalek sira no ema Kanaan sira hela iha rai tetuk nee. Tanba nee fila fali aban no lao ba iha rai fuik, atu ba Tasi Teberau.”
verses.26: Depois Nai koalia tan ba Moisés no Arão, no dehan,
verses.27: “Too bainhira mak povu aat sira nee murmura ba Hau? Buat hotu nebee mak ema Israel sira murmura ba Hau nee, Hau rona tiha ona.
verses.28: Hatete ba sira, ‘Hodi Hau nebee moris, nunee duni Nai nia liafuan, hanesan buat nebee mak imi hatete iha Hau nia oin, nunee Hau sei halo ba imi.
verses.29: Iha rai fuik nee, imi nia mate isin sei namkari ba, ema hotu nebee mak naran hakerek ona iha lista, ema hotu nebee sura tiha nebee tinan rua-nulu ba leten, nebee murmura tiha ona ba Hau,
verses.30: imi sei la tama ba rai nebee Hau jura tiha ona katak Hau sei foo imi hela iha nebaa, só deit Kaleb, Jefune nia oan, no Josué, Nun nia oan!
verses.31: Maibee imi nia oan sira nebee imi hatete tiha ona katak ema sei kastigu sira, Hau sei lori sira tama, nunee sira sei hatene rai nebee imi koalia aat tiha ona.
verses.32: Maibee kona ba imi, imi nia mate isin sira sei namkari iha rai fuik nee,
verses.33: no imi nia oan sira sei lao ba-mai iha rai fuik hanesan bibi atan sira durante tinan haat-nulu no sira sei simu folin hosi imi nia hahalok aat nebee la tuir Hau, too imi nia mate isin sira lakon hotu iha rai fuik.
verses.34: Tuir loron nebee imi ba hafuhu iha rai nebaa, loron haat-nulu, loron ida konta ba tinan ida, nunee durante tinan haat-nulu imi tenki simu kastigu tuir imi nia hahalok aat, nunee imi sei hatene katak Hau fila kotuk ba imi.’
verses.35: Nunee, Hau, Nai, koalia tiha ona. Tebes Hau sei kastigu komunidade tomak nebee aat nee, no sira nebee halibur hamutuk ona hodi hasoru Hau. Iha rai fuik nebaa sira sei lakon, no sira sei mate iha nebaa.”
verses.36: No ema nebee Moisés haruka tiha ona hodi hafuhu rai nee, no sira fila no halo komunidade tomak murmura hasoru nia, no koalia liafuan aat kona ba rai nee,
verses.37: ema sira nebee foo sai liafuan aat kona ba rai nee, sira mate tanba hetan kastigu iha Nai nia oin.
verses.38: Hosi ema sira nebee hafuhu rai nee, só deit Josué, Nun nia oan, no Kaleb, Jefune nia oan, mak sei moris.
verses.39: Bainhira Moisés koalia liafuan nee ba ema Israel sira hotu, nunee nasaun sira nee tristi boot.
verses.40: No aban dadeer-saan sira hadeer no sae ba foho leten no koalia tu-tuir, “Agora ami iha nee ona. Nunee ami sei tama ba rai nebee mak Nai koalia nee; tanba ami halo sala tiha ona.”
verses.41: Maibee Moisés hatete, “Tanba saa mak imi la hakarak tuir Nai nia orden? Imi sei la hetan susesu.
verses.42: La bele sae baa, tanba Nai la iha imi nia leet, hodi nunee imi la bele lakon iha imi nia inimigu nia oin.
verses.43: Tanba ema Amalek sira no ema Kanaan sira iha imi nia oin no imi sei mate ho surik; tanba imi fila kotuk ba Nai, nunee Nai sei la hamutuk ho imi.
verses.44: Mezmu nunee, sira rasik hakarak sae ba foho leten nee, maibee Nai nia Arka Aliansa no Moisés la sai hosi akampamentu nee.
verses.45: Depois ema Amalek sira no ema Kanaan sira nebee hela iha foho nee tuun mai ataka sira no duni sira too Horma.

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.2: “Koalia ba ema Israel no dehan ba sira, Bainhira imi tama ba rai nebee imi atu hela, nebee Hau atu foo ba imi,
verses.3: no imi hakarak foo sakrifísiu ahi ba Nai, hosi karau lubun ka bibi lubun, nebee sakrifísiu tunu motuk ka sakrifísiu oho, atu kumpri juramentu ida ka halo sakrifísiu voluntáriu ka iha tempu festa sira, hodi prepara morin nebee diak ba Nai,
verses.4: nunee ema ida nebee foo sakrifísiu nee ba Nai, tenki oferese oferta trigu nian nebee iha trigu diak litru rua ho balu, nebee kahur ho mina besik litru ida,
verses.5: no ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk ka sakrifísiu oho o tenki oferese tua uvas besik litru ida nudar oferta hemu nian ho bibi malae oan ida-idak.
verses.6: Maibee se o nia sakrifísiu nee mak bibi malae aman ida, o tenki oferese oferta trigu nian nebee iha trigu diak litru lima nebee kahur ho mina litru ida ho balu,
verses.7: no o tenki oferese tua uvas litru ida ho balu nudar oferta hemu nian, nebee morin diak ba Nai.
verses.8: No bainhira ema oferese karau aman ida nudar sakrifísiu tunu motuk ka sakrifísiu oho atu kumpri juramentu ida ka halo sakrifísiu dame nian ba Nai,
verses.9: nunee nia sei lori karau nee ho oferta trigu diak nian litru neen ho balu nebee kahur ho mina litru rua,
verses.10: no o tenki oferese tua uvas litru rua nudar oferta hemu nian, nebee sakrifísiu ahi nian, nebee morin diak ba Nai.
verses.11: Tenki halo hanesan nee ba karau ka bibi malae aman ida-idak, ka bibi malae oan ka bibi timor ida-idak.
verses.12: Tuir animál hira nebee o oferese, o tenki halo hanesan nee ho animál ida-idak.
verses.13: Ema Israel orijinál sira tenki halo hanesan nee, bainhira nia halo sakrifísiu ahi sira nebee morin diak ba Nai.
verses.14: No bainhira ema estranjeiru hela ona ho imi, ka ema seluk nebee hela iha imi nia leet ka hela iha imi nia jerasaun sira iha tempu tuir mai, no sira oferese sakrifísiu ahi nebee morin diak ba Nai, hanesan buat nebee imi halo, ema nee mos tenki halo hanesan nee.
verses.15: Imi iha estatutu ida ba imi iha komunidade nee no ba ema estranjeiru nebee hela ho imi; ida nee mak estatutu ida too tinan ba tinan ba imi nia jerasaun sira. Imi ho ema estranjeiru nee tenki hanesan iha Nai nia oin.
verses.16: Iha lei ida no regulamentu ida ba imi no ema lao rai nebee hela ho imi.”
verses.17: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.18: “Koalia ba ema Israel sira, no dehan, Bainhira imi tama ba iha rai nebee mak Hau lori imi ba,
verses.19: no bainhira imi haan paun hosi rai nia rezultadu nee, imi tenki oferese oferta foti sae ba Nai.
verses.20: Hosi masa paun nian nebee primeiru nee tenki oferese paun kabuar nudar oferta foti sae; hanesan oferta foti sae hosi fatin baku trigu diak, nunee o tenki foti sae oferta nee.
verses.21: Hosi o nia masa paun nian nebee primeiru nee, o tenki foo oferta foti sae ba Nai, hosi jerasaun ba jerasaun.”
verses.22: “Bainhira imi halo sala maibee imi la hatene, no imi la halo tuir ukun fuan hotu nebee Nai koalia tiha ona ba Moisés,
verses.23: hosi orden hotu nebee Nai foo sai tiha ba imi liu hosi Moisés, komesa hosi loron nebee Nia foo lei sira ba Moisés no tuir mai too jerasaun ba jerasaun,
verses.24: entaun, se komunidade nee halo sala maibee sira la hatene, nunee komunidade tomak tenki oferese karau aman ida nebee foin sae nudar sakrifísiu tunu motuk ida nebee morin diak ba Nai, ho oferta trigu nian no oferta hemu nian, tuir regulamentu, no bibi aman ida nudar sakrifísiu sala nian.
verses.25: Nunee saserdote sei taka komunidade Israel nia sala, hodi sira bele hetan perdaun, tanba sira la hatene. Sira tenki lori sira nia sakrifísiu sira nebee sakrifísiu ahi ba Nai, no sakrifísiu sala nian ba iha Nai nia oin, tanba sira nia sala nebee halo bainhira sira la hatene.
verses.26: Komunidade Israel tomak sei simu perdaun, no ema estranjeiru sira nebee hela iha sira nia leet, tanba ema hotu halo sala maibee la hatene.
verses.27: Bainhira ema ida deit halo sala maibee nia la hatene, nia tenki halo sakrifísiu bibi inan ida foin halo tinan ida nudar sakrifísiu sala nian;
verses.28: no saserdote sei taka ema nee nia sala nebee nia halo maibee la hatene nee, bainhira nia halo sala nebee nia la hatene iha Nai nia oin, hodi taka ninia sala, nunee ema nee bele hetan perdaun.
verses.29: Imi tenki iha lei ida deit ba ema nebee sala maibee la hatene, ba ema nebee moris iha ema Israel sira nia leet no ba ema estranjeiru nebee hela iha imi nia leet.
verses.30: Maibee ema nebee halo sala no foti aan kona ba ida nee, inklui ema Israel orijinál no ba ema estranjeiru, ema nee koalia aat ba Nai, no tenki hakotu nia hosi ninia povu.
verses.31: Tanba nia la respeitu ona Nai nia liafuan no estraga Nai nia ukun fuan; tenki hakotu duni nia, no ninia hahalok aat sei kona iha nia leten.”
verses.32: Bainhira ema Israel sira iha rai fuik, sira hetan ema ida nebee halibur ai maran iha loron Sabdu.
verses.33: Ema sira nebee mak hetan nia nebee halibur hela ai nee, lori nia ba hasoru Moisés no Arão no komunidade tomak.
verses.34: Sira hatama ema nee iha uma kastigu nian, tanba sira seidauk hatene atu halo saida ba nia.
verses.35: No Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Tenki oho ema ida nee. Komunidade tomak tenki tuda nia ho fatuk iha akampamentu liur.”
verses.36: Nunee komunidade tomak lori nia sai ba akampamentu liur, depois sira tuda nia ho fatuk too mate, tuir orden nebee Nai foo ona ba Moisés.
verses.37: Nai dehan ba Moisés,
verses.38: “Koalia ba povu Israel no dehan ba sira katak sira tenki halo borlas iha sira nia faru rohan too jerasaun ba jerasaun, no iha sira nia ropa rohan nee tenki suku ho kabas azúl.
verses.39: Nunee borlas nee sei foo hanoin ba imi bainhira imi haree borlas, no imi sei hanoin Nai nia ukun fuan hotu, no imi halo tuir sira, no imi sei la tuir imi nia fuan laran ka imi nia matan rasik, hanesan baibain imi halo tuir hahalok aat.
verses.40: Nunee imi bele hanoin no halo tuir Hau nia ukun fuan hotu no sai santu ba imi nia Maromak.
verses.41: Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak, nebee lori imi sai hosi rai Ejitu, hodi sai imi nia Maromak. Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak.”

verses.1: Kora nebee oan hosi Izar, oan hosi Koat, oan hosi Levi, hamutuk ho Datan no Abiram, oan sira hosi Eliabe, no On, oan hosi Pelete, nebee oan sira hosi Ruben, bolu sira nia ema sira.
verses.2: No sira hamriik hodi kontra Moisés, hamutuk ho ema Israel sira nain atus rua lima-nulu, nebee xefi sira iha komunidade nee, no ema sira nebee ema Israel sira hili, nebee mak ema konhesidu.
verses.3: Nunee sira halibur hamutuk hodi hasoru Moisés no Arão, no hatete ba sira nain rua, “Agora too ona ba! Komunidade tomak mak santu, ema ida-idak, no Nai mak iha sira nia leet. Tanba saa mak imi foti imi nia aan atu sai aas liu komunidade Nai nian?”
verses.4: Bainhira Moisés rona nee nia hakneak ho oin ba rai.
verses.5: No nia dehan ba Kora no nia grupu tomak, “Aban dadeer Nai sei foo hatene, see mak Ninian, no see mak santu, no Nia bele husik ema nee atu hakbesik ba Nia. Ema nebee Nia hili nee, Nia sei husik atu hakbesik ba Nia.
verses.6: Halo hanesan nee: foti manko sira nebee sunu, hai Kora, o hamutuk ho o nia grupu tomak,
verses.7: no aban, tau ahi iha manko laran, iha Nai nia oin, no ema nebee mak Nai hili, nia mak santu. Too ona ba, ema Levi sira!”
verses.8: Nunee Moisés hatete ba Kora, “Agora, rona lai, ema Levi sira!
verses.9: Seidauk too ba imi ka, katak Israel nia Maromak mak haketak imi hosi komunidade Israel hodi lori imi besik Nia, nunee o bele halao ministériu iha Nai nia Tabernakulu, no hamriik iha komunidade nia oin hodi serví sira?
verses.10: No Nia mak lori imi hodi hakbesik ba Nia, hamutuk ho o nia maun-alin sira hotu hosi jerasaun Levi? No agora o hakarak husu sai saserdote tan?
verses.11: Tanba nee o ho o nia grupu tomak, imi halibur hamutuk kontra Nai. Tanba see mak Arão, nunee imi koalia murmura hasoru nia?”
verses.12: Moisés haruka bolu ona Datan no Abiram, Eliabe nia oan sira, maibee sira hataan, “Ami lakohi baa.
verses.13: Seidauk too, katak o lori ami sai hosi rai nebee suli ho susu been no bani been, hodi oho ami iha rai fuik nee, no o sei halo o nia aan sai ami nia patraun ka?
verses.14: Tebes o la lori ami ba rai nebee suli ho susu been no bani been, no o la foo ami liman rohan nebee rai no toos uvas. Tanba saa mak o atu fokit sai ami nia matan? Ami sei la sae baa.”
verses.15: Nunee Moisés hirus loos no hatete ba Nai, “La bele simu sira nia oferta sira. Hau la foti kuda buru ida hosi sira, no hau la halo buat nebee aat ba ema ida hosi sira.”
verses.16: Nunee Moisés hatete ba Kora, “O ho o nia grupu sira tenki hasoru Nai loron aban, o no sira, no Arão.
verses.17: Imi ida-idak lori nia manko no tau insensu iha laran, no imi ida-idak lori ninia manko iha Nai nia oin, manko atus rua lima-nulu; o, no Arão, no ema ida-idak ho nia manko.”
verses.18: Nunee ema ida-idak lori nia manko no tau ahi iha laran, no tau insensu iha leten, depois sira hamriik iha odamatan ba Tenda Enkontru, ho Moisés no Arão.
verses.19: Bainhira Kora halibur komunidade tomak hodi kontra hasoru sira nain rua iha odamatan ba Tenda Enkontru, Nai nia glória mosu ba komunidade tomak.
verses.20: Depois Nai dehan ba Moisés no Arão,
verses.21: “Haketak imi nia aan hosi komunidade nee, nunee Hau sei halakon sira iha momentu ida deit.”
verses.22: Maibee sira nain rua hakneak ho oin ba rai no hatete, “Oh Maromak, Maromak ba espíritu hotu iha kriasaun tomak! Ema ida deit mak sala, tanba saa mak O hirus ba komunidade tomak?”
verses.23: Nunee Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.24: “Koalia ba komunidade nee, no dehan, Haketak tiha hosi Kora, Datan no Abiram sira nia tenda.”
verses.25: Depois Moisés hamriik no baa Datan no Abiram, no katuas Israel sira tuir nia.
verses.26: Nia hatete ba povu sira nee, “Favór ida, imi dook tiha hosi ema aat sira nee nia tenda no imi la bele book sira nia sasaan ruma, nunee imi la bele lakon tanba sira nia sala hotu.”
verses.27: Nunee sira sai tiha hosi Kora, Datan no Abiram sira nia tenda. Datan no Abiram sai no hamriik hamutuk ho sira nia feen sira, no sira nia oan mane sira no kiik-oan sira iha sira nia tenda nia odamatan.
verses.28: Depois Moisés hatete, “Hosi buat nee imi sei hatene katak Nai mak haruka hau mai hodi halo buat sira nee, no laos hosi hau nia fuan rasik:
verses.29: se ema sira nee mate hanesan baibain, hanesan ema seluk nebee mate, ka se buat ruma hasoru sira hanesan hasoru ema hotu, nunee hau laos ema nebee Nai mak haruka.
verses.30: Maibee se Nai halo buat nebee foun no rai loke kedas nia ibun no tolan sira hamutuk ho sira nia sasaan hotu, nunee sira tuun ba rai kuak nee bainhira sira sei moris hela, nunee imi hatene katak ema sira nee provoka ona Nai.”
verses.31: Bainhira nia foin koalia hotu liafuan nee, rai nebee sira hamriik nee nakfera,
verses.32: no rai loke nia ibun no tolan sira, no sira nia uma kain sira nee, no ema hotu nebee hamutuk ho Kora, no sira nia sasaan hotu.
verses.33: Nunee ema sira nebee sei moris nee no buat hotu nebee sira nian tuun ba rai kuak laran; no rai taka sira no sira lakon hosi komunidade nia leet.
verses.34: No ema Israel sira nebee besik sira halai tanba sira rona hakilar nee, tanba sira hatete, “Rai nee bele tolan ami moos!”
verses.35: Depois ahi sai mai hosi Nai, no haan hotu ema nain atus rua lima-nulu nebee oferese hela insensu.
verses.36: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.37: “Koalia ba Eliezar, oan hosi saserdote Arão, katak nia bele foti manko sira hosi ahi lakan nee, no soe namkari tiha ahi nee, tanba buat sira nee santu.
verses.38: No manko sira nee hosi ema nebee mate tanba sira nia sala sira, foti manko nee no halo tahan kabelak hodi taka iha altár tanba sira lori ona manko sira nee ba iha Nai nia oin, nunee buat sira nee santu, no buat sira nee sei sai sinál ba ema Israel sira.”
verses.39: Nunee saserdote Eliezar foti manko riti sira, nebee ema lori no ahi haan ona ema sira nee, no nia halo tahan hodi taka iha altár.
verses.40: Ida nee sai buat ida nebee foo hanoin ba ema Israel sira, katak ema seluk nebee laos hosi Arão nia jerasaun la bele hakbesik hodi sunu insensu iha Nai nia oin, no ema la bele halo hanesan Kora no nia grupu, hanesan Nai koalia tiha ona liu hosi Moisés.
verses.41: Maibee loron tuir mai komunidade Israel tomak murmura hasoru Moisés no Arão, no sira dehan, “Imi oho tiha ona povu Nai nian.”
verses.42: Bainhira komunidade nee halibur hamutuk hodi kontra Moisés no Arão, sira haree ba Tenda Enkontru nee, no tebes, kalohan taka Tenda nee no glória Nai nian mosu iha nebaa.
verses.43: Depois Moisés no Arão ba iha Tenda Enkontru nia oin.
verses.44: No Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.45: “Sai hosi komunidade nia leet, nunee Hau halakon sira iha momentu ida deit.” Nunee sira hakneak kedas ho oin ba rai.
verses.46: Moisés hatete ba Arão, “Foti manko ida, no tau ahi iha manko laran hosi altár, no tau insensu iha leten, no baa lalais no tama ba iha komunidade nia leet hodi taka sira nia sala. Tanba Nai nia hirus makaas sai ona no kastigu komesa ona.”
verses.47: Depois Arão foti ahi klaak nee hanesan saida mak Moisés hatete ona ba nia, no nia halai ba iha komunidade nia klaran, no tebes kastigu komesa ona iha povu nia leet; no nia tau insensu nee no nia taka povu nia sala.
verses.48: Nunee nia hamriik iha ema mate no ema moris nia klaran, no kastigu nee para.
verses.49: No ema nebee mate tanba kastigu nee hamutuk nain rihun sanulu resin haat atus hitu, nebee ketak hosi ema sira nebee mate tanba tuir Kora.
verses.50: Arão fila fali ba Moisés iha odamatan ba Tenda Enkontru, no kastigu nee para ona.

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.2: “Koalia ba ema Israel sira no foti hosi sira ai tonka ida kada suku ida. Sira nia xefi tenki foo kada suku ida, ai tonka nee hamutuk sanulu resin rua. Depois hakerek xefi nia naran iha ai tonka nee.
verses.3: Iha suku Levi imi tenki hakerek Arão nia naran. Suku ida tenki iha ai tonka ida.
verses.4: Depois o tenki tau hotu iha Tenda Enkontru iha Aliansa nia oin, iha fatin nebee Hau hasoru ho imi.
verses.5: No ema nebee Hau hili, ninia ai tonka mak sei funan, nunee Hau sei hapara tiha murmura hosi ema Israel sira ba Hau, nebee sira koalia hasoru imi.”
verses.6: Entaun Moisés koalia tiha ona ba ema Israel sira, no sira nia xefi ida-idak foo ai tonka ida tuir sira nia suku, ai tonka sanulu resin rua, no Arão nia ai tonka mak iha sira nia leet.
verses.7: Moisés tau ai tonka sira nee iha Nai nia oin iha Tenda Aliansa laran.
verses.8: Bainhira loron tuir mai, Moisés tama ba iha Tenda Aliansa nee, no tebes, Arão, hosi suku Levi, ninia ai tonka nee iha dikin foo funan, no foo fuan amendueira.
verses.9: Depois Moisés lori sai ai tonka hotu hosi Nai nia oin ba ema Israel sira hotu; sira haree no ema ida-idak foti ninia ai tonka.
verses.10: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Lori fali Arão nia ai tonka hodi rai iha Aliansa nia oin hodi sai sinál ba ema aat sira, hodi hapara tiha sira nia murmura ba Hau, nunee sira la bele mate.”
verses.11: No Moisés halo buat nebee Nai koalia ba nia, nunee nia halo tuir.
verses.12: Maibee ema Israel hatete ba Moisés, “Tebes ami sei mate, ami atu lakon, ami hotu sei lakon.
verses.13: Se deit mak hakbesik ba Nai nia Tabernakulu, tebes nia sei mate. Ami tenki mate hotu ka?”

18.title: Saserdote No Ema Levi Sira Nia Knaar

verses.1: Nai dehan ba Arão, “O no o nia oan sira no o nia uma kain, nebee hamutuk ho o, tenki simu hahalok aat nebee iha Fatin Santu; no o ho o nia oan mane sira, nebee hamutuk ho o, tenki simu hahalok aat nebee iha imi nia knaar saserdote nian.
verses.2: Haruka mos o nia maluk sira, hosi suku Levi, o nia apaa boot sira nia suku, hodi sira mai ho o, nunee sira hamutuk ho o no bele serví o. Maibee o ho o nia oan mane sira mak iha Tenda Aliansa nia oin.
verses.3: Sira tenki halo tuir o nia orden, no sira tenki tau matan ba Tenda tomak; maibee sira la bele besik ba sasaan hosi Fatin Santu no altár, hodi sira no o mos la mate.
verses.4: Sira tenki kolabora ho o no tau matan ba Tenda Enkontru, no halo servisu hotu nebee iha Tenda; maibee ema estranjeiru la bele besik ba o.
verses.5: No o tenki halo tuir servisu nebee tau matan ba Fatin Santu no tau matan ba altár, nunee Hau nia hirus la bele kona tan ema Israel sira.
verses.6: Tebes Hau rasik foti tiha ona imi nia maun-alin sira, nebee ema Levi sira, hosi ema Israel sira nia leet. Ema Levi sira mak prezenti ida ba imi, nebee entrega ba Nai, hodi halo servisu Tenda Enkontru nian.
verses.7: Entaun o ho o nia oan mane sira sei halo tuir o nia knaar saserdote nian kona ba buat hotu nebee altár nian no iha veo nia kotuk. Ida nee mak imi nia servisu. Hau foo ona o nia knaar saserdote nian nudar prezenti ida ba o hodi halo servisu, maibee ema estranjeiru nebee besik tenki kastigu mate.”
verses.8: Nai koalia ba Arão, “Tebes, Hau rasik foo servisu tiha ona ba o hodi tau matan ba Hau nia oferta sira, nebee buat hotu nebee santu hosi ema Israel sira. Hau foo buat sira nee ba o no ba o nia oan mane sira, hodi sai o nian, no ida nee mak estatutu too tinan ba tinan.
verses.9: Ida nee mak imi nian hosi oferta nebee mak santu liu, hosi parte nebee la sunu: sira nia oferta hotu, sira nia oferta trigu nian hotu, sira nia sakrifísiu sala nian hotu, no sira nia sakrifísiu multa hotu, nebee sira selu ba Hau. Ida nee mak santu liu ba o ho o nia oan mane sira.
verses.10: Imi tenki haan buat sira nee iha fatin nebee santu liu; mane hotu bele haan; no hahaan nee sei sai santu ba o.
verses.11: No ida nee mos o nian: oferta sira nebee sira foo ba o, inklui oferta foti sae nebee ema Israel sira foo. Hau foo buat hotu nee ba o no o nia oan mane no oan feto sira hamutuk ho o. Ida nee mak estatutu too tinan ba tinan. Ema hotu nebee moos iha o nia uma bele haan ai haan sira nee.
verses.12: Buat diak liu hosi mina no buat diak liu hosi tua uvas no hosi trigu diak, no rezultadu primeiru nebee hosi sira nia toos, nebee sira oferese ba Nai, Hau foo ba o.
verses.13: Rezultadu ai haan primeiru nebee sira hetan hosi toos, nebee sira foo ba Nai, buat sira nee sei sai o nian; no ema hotu nebee moos iha o nia uma bele haan ai haan sira nee.
verses.14: Buat hotu nebee ema Israel sira entrega ba Nai sei sai o nian.
verses.15: Buat hotu nebee loke oan fatin ba dala ida, nebee sira lori ba Nai, hosi ema ka hosi animál; buat sira nee mak o nian. Maibee o tenki hola fali ema nia oan primeiru; no animál foer nia oan primeiru nee, o tenki hola fali.
verses.16: Kona ba sira nebee atu hola fali, komesa hosi fulan ida, o tenki hola fali tuir sira nia folin. O tenki selu ho osan mutin lima, tuir Fatin Santu nia osan mutin (osan mutin nebee nia todan grama kiik rua-nulu).
verses.17: Maibee karau nia oan primeiru, bibi malae ka bibi timor nia oan primeiru nee, o la bele hola fali, tanba sira hotu nee mak santu. Sira nia raan o tenki fakar iha altár no sira nia bokur o tenki sunu hanesan sakrifísiu ahi sira nebee sai morin diak ba Nai.
verses.18: Maibee sira nia naan mak o nian, hanesan hirus matan nebee oferta foti sae no kelen loos mak o nian.
verses.19: Oferta santu hotu nebee ema Israel sira oferese ba Nai, Hau foo ba o ho o nia mane sira no o nia oan feto sira nebee hamutuk ho o. Ida nee mak estatutu ida too tinan ba tinan. Ida nee mak aliansa masin nian iha Nai nia oin too tinan ba tinan ba o no o nia jerasaun.”
verses.20: Nai dehan ba Arão, “Iha sira nia rai o sei la hetan liman rohan, no o sei la hetan buat ida hosi sira. Hau mak o nia parte no o nia liman rohan iha ema Israel sira nia leet.
verses.21: Tebes, ba ema Levi sira, Hau foo ba sira porsentu sanulu hosi ema Israel sira nudar liman rohan, hodi selu servisu nebee sira halo, nebee servisu ba Tenda Enkontru.
verses.22: Tanba nee ema Israel sira keta besik ba Tenda Enkontru, keta halo be sira lori sira nia sala no sira mate.
verses.23: Maibee ema Levi sira sei halo servisu iha Tenda Enkontru no sira rasik tenki lori sira nia hahalok aat. Ida nee mak estatutu too tinan ba tinan iha imi nia jerasaun sira, no sira sei la iha liman rohan iha ema Israel sira nia leet.
verses.24: Tanba porsentu sanulu nebee ema Israel sira foo ba Nai nudar oferta foti sae nee, Hau foo ba ema Levi sira nudar sira nia liman rohan; tanba nee Hau koalia tiha ona kona ba sira: Sira sei la hetan liman rohan iha ema Israel sira nia leet.”
verses.25: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.26: “Koalia ba ema Levi sira, no dehan ba sira, Bainhira o simu hosi ema Israel sira oferta porsentu sanulu nebee Hau foo ba o hosi sira nudar o nia liman rohan, o tenki foo oferta hosi buat nee ba Nai, nebee o nia oferta porsentu sanulu nian.
verses.27: Hau sei sura oferta nee hanesan o nia oferta nebee trigu diak hosi fatin baku trigu diak no rezultadu boot hosi fatin sama uvas.
verses.28: Nunee imi tenki foo oferta hotu ba Nai hosi porsentu sanulu nebee imi hetan hosi ema Israel sira. No oferta nebee foo ba Nai nee, imi tenki entrega ba saserdote Arão.
verses.29: Hosi buat hotu nebee ema entrega ba o, hosi buat sira hotu nebee diak, imi tenki foo oferta ba Nai, nebee imi haketak ona nudar santu hosi buat sira nee.
verses.30: Nunee o tenki hatete ba sira, Bainhira imi foo oferta nebee mak diak, ba ema Levi sira nee, imi tenki sura rezultadu diak hosi fatin baku trigu diak no rezultadu diak hosi fatin sama uvas.
verses.31: O bele haan iha fatin naran deit, o no o nia uma kain, tanba ida nee mak o nia kolen, tanba o nia servisu iha Tenda Enkontru.
verses.32: No o sei la simu sala tanba buat nee, maibee imi tenki prepara buat nebee diak hosi nee, nunee o la halo foer buat nebee santu hosi ema Israel sira, hodi nunee o sei la mate.”

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés no Arão, no dehan,
verses.2: “Ida nee mak estatutu hosi lei nebee Nai foo ona: Haruka ema Israel sira lori ba o karau oan ida nebee mean no perfeitu nebee la iha buat aat, no nunka simu ai todan.
verses.3: No foo karau nee ba saserdote Eleazar, hodi nia bele lori karau ba akampamentu liu, no ema tenki oho karau iha ninia oin.
verses.4: Eleazar tenki foti karau nia raan ho nia liman fuan no fakar raan dala hitu iha Tenda Enkontru nia oin.
verses.5: Ema tenki sunu karau iha ninia oin, no nia sei sunu karau nia kulit, isin, raan no teen.
verses.6: No saserdote nee tenki foti ai teka, isope no kabas mean no soe ba karau nebee sunu hela.
verses.7: Depois saserdote sei fasi ninia ropa ho bee, no hariis ho bee no nia la moos too kalan.
verses.8: No ema nebee sunu karau nee sei fasi ninia ropa ho bee, no hariis ho bee no nia la moos too kalan.
verses.9: Ema ida tenki halibur ahi kdesan hosi karau, no rai iha akampamentu liur iha fatin nebee moos, no rai hela ahi kdesan nee ba komunidade Israel hodi uza ba bee kona ba buat nebee foer, no buat nee bele uza ba oferta sala nian.
verses.10: Ema nebee halibur ahi kdesan hosi karau nee tenki fasi ninia ropa ho bee, no nia la moos too kalan. Ida nee sei sai estatutu ba ema Israel sira no ba estranjeiru nebee hamutuk ho sira, too tinan ba tinan.
verses.11: Ema nebee kona mate isin naran deit sei sai la moos too loron hitu.
verses.12: Nia tenki hamoos aan ho bee nee iha loron tolu, no iha loron hitu, no nia sei sai moos. Maibee se nia la hamoos aan iha loron tolu, entaun iha loron hitu nia la moos.
verses.13: Ema nebee kona mate isin hosi ema naran deit nebee mate ona no nia la hamoos aan, nunee nia halo foer Tabernakulu Nai nian. Tenki hakotu ema nee hosi Israel tanba bee hamoos nian la hisik ba nia no nia la moos. Ninia foer sei kona hela nia.
verses.14: Ida nee mak lei bainhira ema ida mate iha ninia tenda. Ema hotu nebee tama tenda nee no buat hotu nebee iha tenda laran sei sai la moos too loron hitu.
verses.15: Sanan hotu nebee la taka ho ninia matan mak la moos.
verses.16: Ema nebee kona ema mate ida iha rai luan nebee mate tanba surik, ka nia kona mate isin, ka mate ruin ka rate, nia sei sai la moos too loron hitu.
verses.17: Ba ema nebee la moos, sira tenki foti ahi kdesan hosi karau nebee sunu tiha nee hodi hamoos sala, no tau ho bee suli iha sanan ida.
verses.18: Ema nebee moos hela sei foti isope, no hoban iha bee nee no hisik ba tenda, no sasaan hotu, no ema sira nebee hela iha nebaa, no nia nebee kona mate ruin, ka ema nebee mate tanba ema oho nia, ka mate isin ka rate.
verses.19: Ema nebee moos tenki hisik ema nebee la moos iha loron tolu no iha loron hitu. Iha loron hitu nia tenki hamoos aan, no nia sei fasi ninia ropa ho bee, no hariis ho bee no nia sai moos iha kalan.
verses.20: Maibee ema nebee la moos hela, no lakohi hamoos aan, tenki hakotu nia hosi komunidade tanba nia halo foer Nai nia Fatin Santu. Ema seidauk hisik nia ho bee sala nian, nunee nia la moos hela.
verses.21: Ida nee mak estatutu too tinan ba tinan ba sira, katak nia nebee hisik bee sala nian tenki fasi ninia ropa, no nia nebee kona bee sala nian sei sai la moos too kalan.
verses.22: Bainhira ema nebee la moos kona sasaan ruma, buat nee sei sai la moos, no ema nebee kona sasaan nee sei sai la moos too kalan.

verses.1: Ema Israel sira, nebee komunidade tomak, tama ba rai maran Zin iha fulan primeiru. Povu nee hela iha Kades. Miriam mate no sira hakoi nia iha nebaa.
verses.2: Komunidade la iha bee no sira halibur hamutuk hodi hasoru Moisés no Arão.
verses.3: Povu nee diskuti malu ho Moisés, no dehan, “Diak liu ami mate hori bainhira ami nia maluk sira mate iha Nai nia oin!
verses.4: Nusaa mak ita boot lori komunidade Nai nian hodi tama rai fuik nee, hodi ami no ami nia animál sira mate iha nee?
verses.5: Nusaa mak ita boot obriga ami sai hosi Ejitu hodi lori ami tama ba rai aat iha nee? Iha fatin nee fini la iha, no la iha ai figeira, ai uvas ka ai delima, no bee hemu la iha.”
verses.6: Moisés no Arão sai hosi komunidade nia prezensa no baa odamatan ba Tenda Enkontru, no sira hakneak ho oin ba rai, no Nai nia glória mosu mai ba sira.
verses.7: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.8: “Foti ai tonka nee, no halibur komunidade hamutuk ho o, no o nia maun Arão, no koalia ba fatuk iha sira nia oin. No fatuk nee sei foo sai ninia bee, no o sei kuru bee hosi fatuk nee ba sira. Nunee o bele foo bee hemu ba komunidade no sira nia animál sira nee.”
verses.9: Moisés foti ai tonka hosi Nai nia oin tuir Nai nia orden ba nia.
verses.10: Moisés no Arão halibur komunidade hamutuk iha fatuk nia oin, no nia dehan ba sira, “Agora rona lai, imi nebee ulun toos, ami tenki kuru bee hosi fatuk ka?”
verses.11: No Moisés foti sae nia liman no ho ninia ai tonka nia baku fatuk nee dala rua. Bee sai makaas no komunidade hemu no sira nia animál sira mos hemu.
verses.12: Nai koalia ba Moisés no Arão, “Tanba imi la fiar Hau, hodi hatudu Hau santu iha ema Israel sira nia oin, nunee imi sei la lori komunidade nee tama ba rai nebee Hau foo ba sira.”
verses.13: Ida nee mak bee Meribá tanba ema Israel sira diskuti malu ho Nai, no liu hosi sira Nia hatudu aan santu.
verses.14: Moisés haruka manu-ain sira hosi Kades ba liurai iha Edom, “Ita boot nia alin Israel hatete nunee: Ita boot hatene terus hotu nebee hasoru ami.
verses.15: No oinsaa ami nia bei-ala sira tuun ba Ejitu, no ami hela kleur iha Ejitu, no ema Ejitu sira hanehan ami no ami nia bei-ala sira.
verses.16: No bainhira ami hakilar ba Nai, Nia rona ami nia lian, no Nia haruka anju ida, no Nia lori ami sai hosi Ejitu. Tebes, ami iha Kades nebee sidade ida iha ita boot nia baliza ninin.
verses.17: Favór ida, husik ami lao liu ita boot nia rai. Ami sei la lao liu rai luan, ka toos uvas, no ami sei la hemu bee hosi bee posu sira nee. Só ami lao deit iha Dalan Liurai Nian. Ami la fila ba liman loos ka liman karuk too ami liu ona ita boot nia baliza fali.”
verses.18: Edom hataan ba nia, “Imi keta liu hosi nee, keta halo be hau sai ba no hasoru imi ho surik.”
verses.19: Ema Israel sira dehan ba nia, “Ami lao liu hosi dalan boot deit, no se ami no ami nia animál sira hemu ita boot nia bee, entaun ami sei selu. Ami hakarak lao liu ho ain deit. Ami la halo buat seluk.”
verses.20: Nia dehan, “Imi keta lao liu.” No Edom sai no hasoru sira ho ema barak no forsa makaas.
verses.21: Entaun Edom la foo lisensa hodi Israel bele lao liu ninia baliza. Nunee Israel fila hosi nia.
verses.22: Ema Israel sira, nebee komunidade tomak, lao hosi Kades no sira baa too iha Foho Hor.
verses.23: Nai koalia ba Moisés no Arão, iha Foho Hor nebee iha Edom nia baliza, no Nia dehan,
verses.24: “Arão atu halibur hamutuk ba ninia bei-ala sira. Nia sei la tama ba rai nebee Hau foo ona ba ema Israel sira, tanba imi kontra Hau nia liafuan iha bee Meribá nian.
verses.25: Lori Arão no nia oan mane Eleazar no sae Foho Hor.
verses.26: Hasai Arão nia ropa no foo hatais fali ninia oan mane Eleazar. No Arão sei halibur hamutuk ho ninia bei-ala sira no nia mate iha nebaa.”
verses.27: Moisés halo tuir Nai nia orden. Sira sae Foho Hor iha komunidade tomak nia oin.
verses.28: Moisés hasai tiha Arão nia ropa no ho ropa nee nia foo hatais Eleazar nebee Arão nia oan mane. No Arão mate iha nebaa, iha foho leten. Depois Moisés no Eleazar tuun hosi foho.
verses.29: Bainhira komunidade tomak haree katak Arão mate ona, sira tanis lelir tanba Arão durante loron tolu-nulu, nebee inklui Israel nia uma kain tomak.

verses.1: Bainhira liurai Arad, ema Kanaan nebee hela iha rai Negeb, rona katak Israel mai liu hosi dalan Atarim, nia baa halo funu hasoru Israel no foti ema balu no kastigu sira.
verses.2: Nunee Israel halo juramentu ba Nai, no dehan, “Se O foo duni povu nee ba hau nia liman, entaun hau sei entrega sira nia sidade hotu hodi halakon sira.”
verses.3: Nai rona Israel nia lian no foo ema Kanaan sira ba Israel. No ema Israel sira entrega ema Kanaan sira hodi halakon sira no sira nia sidade sira. Entaun sira foo naran Horma ba fatin nee.
verses.4: Sira sai hosi Foho Hor no lao liu hosi dalan Tasi Teberau hodi haleu rai Edom. No povu nee lakon pasiénsia tanba dalan nee.
verses.5: Povu koalia hasoru Maromak no Moisés, “Nusaa mak ita boot lori ami sae hosi Ejitu hodi ami mate iha rai fuik maran nee? Paun la iha no bee la iha, no ami nia klamar odi paun mihis nee.”
verses.6: Entaun Nai haruka samea veneno barak iha povu nia leet. Samea sira nee tata povu no ema barak mate.
verses.7: Nunee povu ba hasoru Moisés no dehan, “Ami sala ona, tanba ami koalia hasoru Nai no hasoru ita boot. Halo orasaun ba Nai hodi Nia bele hasai samea sira nee hosi ami nia leet.” Entaun Moisés halo orasaun ba Nai kona ba povu nee.
verses.8: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Halo modelu samea veneno ida no monta iha ai riin. Bainhira ema naran deit haree ba samea nee, nia sei moris hela.”
verses.9: Depois Moisés halo samea riti ida no tara iha ai riin. Bainhira samea ida tata ema naran deit, no ema nee hateke ba samea riti, nia la mate.
verses.10: Ema Israel sira lao ba oin no halo akampamentu iha Obot.
verses.11: Sira lao hosi Obot no halo akampamentu iha Ije-Abarim nebee iha rai fuik maran. Fatin nee iha rai Moab nia oin, iha sorin lorosae.
verses.12: Sira sai hosi fatin nee no halo akampamentu iha Foho Leet Zered.
verses.13: Sira sai hosi fatin nee no halo akampamentu iha Arnon nia sorin ba, nebee iha rai fuik maran besik ema Amoreu sira nia baliza. Tanba Arnon nee mak baliza Moab nian, nebee baliza entre Moab no ema Amoreu sira.
verses.14: Nunee sira hakerek iha Livru Nai Nia Funu Sira,
verses.15: no rai lolon iha valé sira
verses.16: Hosi fatin nee sira baa Beer, fatin nebee Nai dehan ona ba Moisés, “Halibur povu hamutuk no Hau sei foo bee ba sira.”
verses.17: Depois Israel kanta nunee:
verses.18: Bee posu nebee xefi sira kee,
verses.19: Hosi Matana sira baa Naaliel. Hosi Naaliel sira baa Bamot.
verses.20: Hosi Bamot iha rai tetuk, nebee iha rai Moab, sira baa Pisga nia leten, nebee bele hateke ba Jesimon.
verses.21: Israel haruka manu-ain sira ba Seon, nebee ema Amoreu sira nia liurai, no dehan,
verses.22: “Husik hau lao liu ita boot nia rai. Ami sei la fila hodi tama ba toos luan ka toos uvas sira nee. Ami sei la hemu bee hosi bee posu. Maibee ami lao tuir Dalan Liurai Nian too ami liu ona ita boot nia baliza.”
verses.23: Maibee Seon la simu Israel atu lao liu ninia baliza. No nia lao sai hodi hasoru Israel iha rai fuik maran. Nia baa too iha Jaaz no nia halo funu hasoru Israel.
verses.24: Israel oho nia ho surik, no hadau ninia rai hosi Arnon too Jabok, nebee too ema Amon sira. Tanba ema Amon sira nia baliza mak forti.
verses.25: Israel hadau sidade hotu nebee iha nebaa. No Israel hela iha sidade hotu nebee ema Amoreu sira nian, iha Hesbon no iha aldeia hotu iha nebaa.
verses.26: Tanba Hesbon mak sidade Seon nian, liurai ba ema Amoreu sira. Iha tempu uluk, nia halo funu hasoru liurai hosi Moab no foti nia rai hotu hosi nia liman, too iha Arnon.
verses.27: Nunee sira kanta ho liafuan hanesan nee,
verses.28: Tanba ahi sai hosi Hesbon,
verses.29: Susar ba o, Oh Moab!
verses.30: Ami hana sira,
verses.31: Entaun Israel hela iha ema Amoreu sira nia rai.
verses.32: Moisés haruka ema baa hafuhu Jazer. Sira hadau aldeia sira iha nebaa no duni sai ema Amoreu sira nebee hela iha nebaa.
verses.33: Depois sira fila no lao sae liu hosi dalan ba Basan. No Ogue, nebee liurai hosi Basan, sai mai hodi hasoru sira. Ogue sai ho ninia povu tomak hodi halo funu iha Edrei.
verses.34: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Keta tauk ba nia, tanba Hau entrega ona nia, ninia povu tomak no ninia rai, ba o nia liman. O sei halo ba nia hanesan o halo ona ba ema Amoreu sira nia liurai Seon, nebee hela iha Hesbon.”
verses.35: Entaun sira oho Ogue, ninia oan mane sira no ninia povu tomak too la iha ema ida nebee moris, no sira hadau ninia rai.

verses.1: Depois ema Israel sira kontinua lao ba no halo akampamentu iha rai tetuk Moab nian. Fatin nee besik Jerikó maibee iha Jordaun nia sorin mai.
verses.2: Balak, oan mane hosi Zipor, haree ona buat hotu nebee Israel halo ona ba ema Amoreu sira.
verses.3: Moab tauk loos kona ba povu Israel tanba sira mak ema barak. Nia hanoin barak tanba ema Israel sira nee.
verses.4: Entaun Moab dehan ba katuas sira hosi Midian, “Agora lubun boot nee sei haan buat hotu nebee haleu ami hanesan karau haan duut iha rai luan.” Iha tempu nebaa, Balak, oan mane hosi Zipor, mak liurai ba ema Moab sira.
verses.5: Entaun Balak haruka manu-ain sira ba Balaão, oan mane hosi Beor, nebee iha Petor, besik Mota Eufrates nebee iha ninia povu nia rai. Nia bolu Balaão, no dehan, “Tebes, povu mai hosi Ejitu, no tebes sira taka rai boot, no sira hela iha hau nia oin.
verses.6: Favór ida, mai lai, no foo malisan ba povu nee, tanba sira forti liu fali hau. Karik hau bele manaan, no oho sira no duni sira sai hosi rai nee. Tanba hau hatene katak bainhira ita foo bensaun ba ema, nia hetan bensaun, no bainhira ita foo malisan ba ema, nia hetan malisan.”
verses.7: Entaun katuas sira hosi Moab no katuas sira hosi Midian lao sai no lori osan hodi selu servisu matan-dook nian. Sira baa too iha Balaão no hatoo Balak nia liafuan ba nia.
verses.8: Balaão dehan ba sira, “Toba kalan ida iha nee, no hau sei foo hatene liafuan ruma tuir Nai nia liafuan mai hau.” Nunee xefi sira hosi Moab hela ho Balaão.
verses.9: Maromak baa Balaão no dehan, “See mak mane sira nee, nebee hamutuk ho o?”
verses.10: Balaão hataan ba Maromak, “Balak, oan mane hosi Zipor, nebee liurai hosi Moab, haruka sira mai hau, no dehan,
verses.11: ‘Tebes, povu ida sai mai hosi Ejitu nebee taka rai boot. Mai lai, no foo malisan ba sira. Karik hau bele manaan sira no duni sira sai.’”
verses.12: Maromak dehan ba Balaão, “O keta ba ho sira. O keta foo malisan ba povu nee, tanba povu nee iha bensaun ona.”
verses.13: Balaão hadeer iha dadeer-saan no nia dehan ba xefi sira hosi Balak, “Fila fali ba imi nia rai tanba Nai lakohi foo lisensa mai hau hodi baa ho imi.”
verses.14: Entaun xefi sira hosi Moab hamriik no fila baa Balak, no dehan, “Balaão lakohi mai ho ami.”
verses.15: Depois Balak haruka fali xefi barak liu fali no boot liu fali xefi uluk nian.
verses.16: Sira baa too iha Balaão no dehan ba nia, “Balak, oan mane hosi Zipor, hatete nunee, ‘Favór ida, keta husik buat ida hanetik ita atu mai hasoru hau.
verses.17: Tanba hau sei foo onra boot tebes ba ita, no hau sei halo saida deit nebee ita husu. Nunee favór ida, mai lai no foo malisan ba povu nee.’”
verses.18: Balaão hataan no dehan ba Balaão nia atan sira, “Se Balak foo ninia uma nakonu ho osan mutin no osan mean, hau la bele halo liu fali liafuan hosi Nai, hau nia Maromak, atu aumenta ka hamenus.
verses.19: Entaun favór ida, hein iha nee kalan ida nee mos hodi hau bele hatene saida tan nebee Nai sei hatete mai hau.”
verses.20: Maromak baa hasoru Balaão iha kalan no dehan ba nia, “Se karik mane sira nee mai atu bolu o, entaun hamriik no baa ho sira, maibee o tenki halo tuir liafuan nebee Hau sei hatete ba o.”
verses.21: Balaão hadeer iha dadeer-saan no sela ninia kuda buru no nia baa ho xefi sira hosi Moab.
verses.22: Balaão sae ninia kuda buru no nia iha atan rua nebee tuir hamutuk ho nia. Maibee Maromak hirus loos tanba nia baa, no anju ida hamriik iha dalan hodi kontra hasoru nia.
verses.23: Kuda buru nee haree tiha anju Nai nian nebee hamriik iha dalan ho surik nebee anju losu ona no kaer iha nia liman. Kuda buru fila hodi sai hosi dalan nee no tama ba rai luan. Balaão baku kuda buru hodi obriga nia fila fali ba dalan.
verses.24: Maibee anju Nai nian hamriik iha dalan kloot iha toos uvas sira nia laran, nebee iha lutu iha sor-sorin.
verses.25: Bainhira kuda buru haree tiha anju Nai nian nia dudu aan ba lutu iha sorin no hanehan Balaão nia ain kona ho lutu. Nunee Balaão baku fali nia.
verses.26: Anju Nai nian mai oin fali no hamriik iha fatin nebee kloot hodi sira la bele fila ba liman loos ka liman karuk.
verses.27: Bainhira kuda buru haree anju Nai nian, nia toba iha Balaão nia okos. Balaão sai hirus loos no nia baku kuda buru ho ninia ai tonka.
verses.28: Nai loke kuda buru nia ibun no kuda buru dehan ba Balaão, “Hau halo saida ba ita boot, nunee ita boot baku hau dala tolu ona?”
verses.29: Balaão dehan ba ninia kuda buru, “Tanba o hamoe ona hau. Diak liu hau iha surik iha hau nia liman nunee hau bele oho o.”
verses.30: Kuda buru dehan ba Balaão, “Laos hau mak ita boot nia kuda buru nebee ita boot sempre sae hosi tempu nebee ita boot hetan hau too ohin loron? No molok ohin loron nee hau halo hanesan nee ba ita boot ka?” Balaão hataan, “Lae.”
verses.31: Depois Nai loke Balaão nia matan no Balaão haree anju Nai nian nebee hamriik iha dalan ho surik nebee losu ona iha ninia liman. Nunee Balaão hakneak kedas ho oin ba rai.
verses.32: Anju Nai nian dehan ba Balaão, “Tanba saa mak o baku o nia kuda buru dala tolu ona? Tebes, hau sai hodi hamriik hasoru o tanba o halo tuir dalan aat iha hau nia oin.
verses.33: No kuda buru nee haree tiha hau no fila hosi hau dala tolu nee. Se karik nia la fila hosi hau, tebes duni hau oho o no husik nia moris.”
verses.34: Balaão dehan ba anju Nai nian, “Hau mak sala ona, tanba hau la hatene katak ita boot hamriik iha dalan hodi hasoru hau. Nunee agora, se ita boot la kontenti, entaun hau sei fila fali baa.”
verses.35: Anju Nai nian dehan ba Balaão, “Baa hamutuk ho mane sira nee, maibee koalia deit liafuan nebee hau hatete ba o.” Nunee Balaão ba hamutuk ho Balak nia xefi sira.
verses.36: Bainhira Balak rona katak Balaão mai ona, nia sai baa hodi hasoru Balaão iha sidade Moab, nebee iha baliza Arnon nian, baliza nebee dook liu.
verses.37: Balak dehan ba Balaão, “Laos hau mak haruka sira bolu ita? Nusaa mak ita la mai hau? Laos hau bele foo onra ba ita?”
verses.38: Balaão dehan ba Balak, “Tebes hau mai ona ba ita. Maibee hau iha podér atu koalia saida deit ka? Hau sei koalia deit liafuan nebee Maromak tau iha hau nia ibun.”
verses.39: Balaão baa ho Balak no sira baa too iha Kiriat-Kuzot.
verses.40: Balak oho karau no bibi sira no haruka hahaan nee ba Balaão no ba xefi sira nebee hamutuk ho nia.
verses.41: Tuir mai, iha aban dadeer-saan, Balak lori Balaão sae ba foho Barmot-Baal, no hosi fatin nee nia bele haree povu balu.

verses.1: Balaão dehan ba Balak, “Harii altár hitu iha nee, no prepara karau aman hitu no bibi malae aman hitu ba hau.”
verses.2: No Balak halo tuir Balaão nia liafuan. Balak no Balaão oferese karau aman ida no bibi aman ida iha altár ida-idak nia leten.
verses.3: Balaão dehan ba Balak, “Hamriik iha sakrifísiu tunu motuk nia sorin no hau sei baa. Karik Nai sei mai hodi hasoru hau no saida deit nebee Nia hatudu mai hau, nunee hau sei hatoo ba ita.” Depois nia sae ba fatin aas ida.
verses.4: Maromak hasoru Balaão, no Balaão dehan ba Nia, “Hau prepara tiha altár hitu no hau oferese tiha karau aman ida no bibi malae aman ida iha altár ida-idak.”
verses.5: No Nai tau liafuan iha Balaão nia ibun no dehan, “Fila fali ba Balak no koalia nunee.”
verses.6: Nia fila fali ba Balak no tebes Balak hamriik hela iha ninia sakrifísiu tunu motuk nia sorin, hamutuk ho xefi sira hotu hosi Moab.
verses.7: Balaão foo sai ninia provérbiu nee, no dehan,
verses.8: Oinsaa hau bele foo malisan ba sira nebee Maromak la foo malisan?
verses.9: Tanba hosi fatuk boot nia tutun hau haree nia,
verses.10: See mak bele sura rai rahun nee hosi Jacó,
verses.11: Balak dehan ba Balaão, “Ita halo ona saida mai hau? Hau lori ita mai hodi foo malisan ba hau nia inimigu sira, no tebes, ita foo bensaun deit ba sira.”
verses.12: Balaão hataan dehan, “Hau tenki kuidadu atu koalia saida mak Nai tau iha hau nia ibun, loos ka lae?”
verses.13: Balak dehan ba nia, “Favór ida, mai ho hau no ita sei baa fatin seluk hodi ita bele haree sira. Ita sei haree ema balu nee, laos ema hotu. No ita bele foo malisan ba sira hosi fatin nebaa.”
verses.14: Balak lori nia ba rai luan Zofim nian, ba Pisga nia leten no nia harii altár hitu no oferese karau aman ida no bibi malae aman ida iha altár ida-idak.
verses.15: No Balaão dehan ba Balak, “Hamriik iha ita nia sakrifísiu tunu motuk nia sorin no hau sei baa hasoru Nai iha nebaa.”
verses.16: Nai hasoru Balaão no tau liafuan iha nia ibun, no dehan, “Fila fali ba Balak no koalia nunee.”
verses.17: Nia fila fali ba Balak no tebes Balak hamriik hela iha ninia sakrifísiu tunu motuk nia sorin, hamutuk ho xefi sira hosi Moab. No Balak husu nia, “Nai hatete saida?”
verses.18: Balaão foo sai ninia provérbiu nee, no dehan,
verses.19: Maromak nee laos ema ida nebee bosok,
verses.20: Tebes, hau simu ona orden atu foo bensaun,
verses.21: Nia la haree hahalok aat iha Jacó,
verses.22: Maromak lori ona sira sae hosi Ejitu,
verses.23: Tebes, la iha liafuan buan nian nebee bele hasoru Jacó,
verses.24: Tebes, povu nee sei hamriik hanesan liaun inan,
verses.25: Depois Balak hataan no dehan ba Balaão, “Lalika foo malisan ida ka bensaun ida ba sira.”
verses.26: Maibee Balaão hataan no dehan ba Balak, “Laos hau dehan ona hanesan nee, ‘Buat hotu nebee Nai koalia nee, hau tenki halo tuir.’”
verses.27: Balak dehan ba Balaão, “Favór ida, mai no hau sei lori ita ba fatin seluk. Karik Maromak bele foo lisensa hodi ita bele ajuda hau no foo malisan ba sira hosi fatin nebaa.”
verses.28: Balak lori Balaão ba Peor nia tutun nebee bele hateke ba Jesimon.
verses.29: Balaão dehan ba Balak, “Harii altár hitu iha nee, no prepara karau aman hitu no bibi malae aman hitu.”
verses.30: Balak halo tuir Balaão nia liafuan no nia oferese karau aman ida no bibi malae aman ida iha altár ida-idak.

verses.1: Bainhira Balaão haree katak Nai kontenti bainhira nia foo bensaun ba Israel, nia la baa hanesan tempu uluk hodi buka liafuan buan nian, maibee nia hateke ba rai fuik.
verses.2: Balaão foti nia matan no haree Israel halo akampamentu tuir sira nia suku sira, no Espíritu Maromak nian tuun ba nia.
verses.3: No nia foo sai ninia provérbiu nee, no dehan,
verses.4: Liafuan hosi ema ida nebee rona ona Maromak nia liafuan,
verses.5: Oh Jacó, ita nia tenda mak diak loos,
verses.6: Sira hela hanesan rai tetuk sira nebee luan,
verses.7: Bee sei suli ba hosi ninia baldi sira nee,
verses.8: Maromak lori nia sai hosi Ejitu,
verses.9: Nia toba hanesan liaun ida,
verses.10: Balak sai hirus loos ho Balaão, no basa nia liman hamutuk. Balak dehan ba Balaão, “Hau bolu ita dala tolu ona hodi foo malisan ba hau nia inimigu sira, no tebes, ita foo bensaun deit ba sira dala tolu nee.
verses.11: Nunee halai sees ba ita nia hela fatin. Uluk, hau iha planu atu foo onra boot ba ita, maibee tebes, Nai mak tahan ita hosi onra nee.”
verses.12: Balaão dehan ba Balak, “Hau dehan ona mos ba ita nia manu-ain sira nebee ita haruka mai hau, no hau dehan,
verses.13: ‘Se Balak foo ninia uma nakonu ho osan mutin no osan mean, hau sei la bele halo liu Nai nia orden, atu halo buat diak ka aat nebee tuir hau nia hakarak. Maibee hau tenki koalia buat nebee Nai koalia,’ hau dehan hanesan nee loos ka lae?
verses.14: Tebes, agora hau sei baa hau nia povu, entaun mai hau sei foo sai kona ba saida mak povu Israel sei halo ba ita nia povu iha loron tuir mai.”
verses.15: No Balaão foo sai ninia provérbiu nee, no dehan,
