verses.16: Liafuan hosi ema ida nebee rona ona Maromak nia liafuan,
verses.17: Hau sei haree nia, maibee laos agora,
verses.18: Nia sei hadau Edom,
verses.19: Hosi Jacó, nia sei mai no ukun,
verses.20: Depois nia hateke ba Amalek no foo sai ninia provérbiu nee, no dehan,
verses.21: Depois nia hateke ba ema Keni sira no foo sai ninia provérbiu nee, no dehan,
verses.22: maibee ema Keni sira sei lakon,
verses.23: No nia foo sai ninia provérbiu nee, no dehan,
verses.24: Roo sira sei mai hosi Kitim,
verses.25: Depois Balaão hamriik no fila fali baa ninia hela fatin. Balak mos lao tuir ninia dalan.

verses.1: Israel hela iha Sitim no povu komesa halo sala seksuál ho feto Moab sira.
verses.2: Feto sira nee konvida povu hodi baa tuir sakrifísiu ba sira nia maromak sira. Povu Israel haan no hakruuk ba ema Moab sira nia maromak sira nee.
verses.3: Nunee Israel liga aan ba Baal hosi Peor, no Nai sai hirus ho Israel.
verses.4: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Foti povu nia xefi hotu no tara mate sira iha rai manas iha Nai nia oin, hodi Nai nia hirus manas nee bele fila hosi Israel.”
verses.5: Moisés dehan ba juis sira hosi Israel, “Imi ida-idak tenki oho imi nia ema nebee liga aan ba Baal hosi Peor.”
verses.6: No tebes, ema Israel ida foin mai no lori feto Midian ida ba ninia maluk sira iha Moisés nia oin. Ema Israel hotu iha sorumutu nee, nebee tanis hela iha odamatan ba Tenda Enkontru, haree nia.
verses.7: Bainhira Fineias, oan mane hosi Eleazar, nebee oan mane hosi saserdote Arão, haree buat nee, nia hamriik hosi sorumutu nia leet no foti ai dima ida iha nia liman.
verses.8: Nia lao tuir ema Israel nee no tama ninia tenda, no nia sona borus sira nain rua - mane Israel no feto nee iha sira nia kabun. Nunee moras nebee kastigu ema Israel sira para tiha.
verses.9: No ema sira nebee mate ona tanba moras kastigu nee mak rihun rua-nulu resin haat (24.000).
verses.10: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.11: “Fineias, oan mane hosi Eleazar, oan mane hosi saserdote Arão, fila ona Hau nia laran hirus hosi ema Israel sira. Nia hatudu laran manas iha povu nia leet tanba Hau. Nunee Hau la oho ema Israel sira tuir Hau nia laran moras.
verses.12: Entaun Hau dehan katak tebes Hau foo ba nia Hau nia aliansa dame nian.
verses.13: Nia sei hetan buat nee, no ninia bei-oan sira nebee tuir nia. Nia sei hetan aliansa hodi simu knaar saserdote nian too tinan ba tinan. Tanba nia iha laran manas ba ninia Maromak no nia taka ema Israel sira nia sala.
verses.14: Ema mane Israel ida nebee mate hamutuk ho feto Midian nee nia naran mak Zimri. Nia mak oan mane hosi Salu, nebee ema boot hosi uma kain xefi nian iha ema Simeon sira nia leet.
verses.15: No feto Midian ida nebee mate nia naran mak Kozbi, oan feto hosi Zur. No Zur mak nai ulun ba povu ida, no nia hosi uma kain xefi nian iha Midian.
verses.16: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.17: “Ataka ema Midian sira no oho sira,
verses.18: tanba sira mak ataka ona imi ho sira nia liafuan bosok nebee sira bosok imi iha asuntu Peor nian, no kona ba Kozbi, oan feto hosi xefi ida hosi Midian. Feto nee mate iha loron nebee iha moras kastigu tanba buat Peor nian.

verses.1: Tuir moras nebee kastigu nee, Nai koalia ba Moisés no ba Eleazar, oan mane hosi saserdote Arão, no dehan,
verses.2: “Sura komunidade Israel tomak, hosi tinan rua-nulu ba leten, iha sira nia bei-ala sira nia uma kain, ema hotu nebee bele sai hosi Israel no baa halo funu.”
verses.3: Moisés no saserdote Eleazar koalia ba povu iha rai tetuk iha Moab nebee iha Jordaun nia sorin, besik Jerikó, no dehan,
verses.4: “Sura ema hotu hosi tinan rua-nulu ba leten,” tuir Nai nia orden ba Moisés no ema Israel sira nebee sai hosi rai Ejitu.
verses.5: Ruben, oan mane primeiru hosi Israel; oan mane sira hosi Ruben: hosi Hanok, uma kain Hanok nian; hosi Palu, uma kain Palu nian;
verses.6: hosi Hezron, uma kain Hezron nian; hosi Karmi, uma kain Karmi nian.
verses.7: Nee mak uma kain sira hosi ema Ruben sira, no ema sira nebee rejistu nee mak ema nain rihun haat-nulu resin tolu atus hitu tolu-nulu (43.730).
verses.8: Palu nia oan mane mak Eliab.
verses.9: Eliab nia oan mane sira mak Nemuel, Datan no Abiram. Datan no Abiram nee iha konhesidu iha komunidade tanba sira kontra hasoru Moisés no Arão hamutuk ho Kora bainhira sira kontra hasoru Nai.
verses.10: No rai loke nia ibun no tolan sira hamutuk ho Kora, no grupu nee mate no iha tempu nee ahi haan mane nain atus rua lima-nulu, no sira sai sinál ida.
verses.11: Maibee Kora nia oan mane sira la mate.
verses.12: Oan mane sira hosi Simeão tuir sira nia uma kain sira mak nee: hosi Nemuel, uma kain Nemuel nian; hosi Jamin, uma kain Jamin nian; hosi Jakin, uma kain Jakin nian;
verses.13: hosi Zera, uma kain Zera nian; hosi Saul, uma kain Saul nian.
verses.14: Nee mak uma kain sira hosi Simeão, ema nain rihun rua-nulu resin rua atus rua (22.200).
verses.15: Oan mane sira hosi Gad tuir sira nia uma kain sira mak nee: hosi Zefon, uma kain Zefon nian; hosi Hagi, uma kain Hagi nian; hosi Suni, uma kain Suni nian;
verses.16: hosi Ozni, uma kain Ozni nian; hosi Eri, uma kain Eri nian;
verses.17: hosi Arod, uma kain Arod nian; hosi Areli, uma kain Areli nian.
verses.18: Nee mak uma kain sira hosi Gad, no ema sira nebee rejistu nee mak ema nain rihun haat-nulu atus lima (40.500).
verses.19: Oan mane sira hosi Judá mak Er no Onan. Er no Onan mate ona iha rai Kanaan.
verses.20: Oan mane sira hosi Judá tuir sira nia uma kain sira mak nee: hosi Sela, uma kain Sela nian; hosi Perez, uma kain Perez nian; hosi Zera, uma kain Zera nian.
verses.21: Perez nia oan mane sira mak nee: hosi Hezron, uma kain Hezron nian; hosi Hamul, uma kain Hamul nian.
verses.22: Nee mak uma kain sira hosi Judá, no ema sira nebee rejistu nee mak ema nain rihun hitu-nulu resin neen atus lima (76.500).
verses.23: Oan mane sira hosi Isakar tuir sira nia uma kain sira mak nee: hosi Tola, uma kain Tola nian; hosi Pua, uma kain Pua nian;
verses.24: hosi Jasub, uma kain Jasub nian; hosi Simron, uma kain Simron nian.
verses.25: Nee mak uma kain sira hosi Isakar, no ema sira nebee rejistu nee mak ema nain rihun neen-nulu resin haat atus tolu (64.300).
verses.26: Oan mane sira hosi Zebulón tuir sira nia uma kain sira mak nee: hosi Sered, uma kain Sered nian; hosi Elon, uma kain Elon nian; hosi Jaleel, uma kain Jaleel nian.
verses.27: Nee mak uma kain sira hosi Zebulón, no ema sira nebee rejistu nee mak ema nain rihun neen-nulu atus lima (60.500).
verses.28: Oan mane sira hosi José tuir sira nia uma kain sira mak Manasés no Efraim.
verses.29: Oan mane sira hosi Manasés: hosi Makir, uma kain Makir nian. Makir hetan Gilead, no hosi Gilead, uma kain Gilead nian.
verses.30: Oan mane sira hosi Gilead mak nee: hosi Jezer, uma kain Jezer nian; hosi Helek, uma kain Helek nian;
verses.31: hosi Asriel, uma kain Asriel nian; hosi Sikém, uma kain Sikém nian;
verses.32: hosi Semida, uma kain Semida nian; hosi Hefer, uma kain Hefer nian.
verses.33: Hefer nia oan mane, Zelofad, la iha oan mane sira maibee nia iha oan feto sira. Zelofad nia oan feto sira nia naran Mala, Noa, Hogla, Milka no Tirza.
verses.34: Nee mak uma kain sira hosi Manasés, no ema sira nebee rejistu nee mak ema nain rihun lima-nulu resin rua atus hitu (52.700).
verses.35: Ema sira nee mak oan mane sira hosi Efraim, tuir sira nia uma kain sira: hosi Sutela, uma kain Sutela nian; hosi Beker, uma kain Beker nian; hosi Tahan, uma kain Tahan nian.
verses.36: Sutela nia oan mane mak nee: hosi Eran, uma kain Eran nian.
verses.37: Nee mak uma kain sira hosi oan mane sira nebee hosi Efraim tuir ema sira nebee rejistu, ema nain rihun tolu-nulu resin rua atus lima (32.500). Nee mak oan mane sira hosi José, tuir sira nia uma kain sira.
verses.38: Oan mane sira hosi Benjamin, tuir sira nia uma kain sira: hosi Bela, uma kain Bela nian; hosi Asbel, uma kain Asbel nian; hosi Ahiram, uma kain Ahiram nian;
verses.39: hosi Sufam, uma kain Sufam nian; hosi Hufam, uma kain Hufam nian.
verses.40: Bela nia oan mane sira mak Ard no Naaman: hosi Ard, uma kain Ard nian; no hosi Naaman, uma kain Naaman nian.
verses.41: Nee mak oan mane sira hosi Benjamin, tuir sira nia uma kain sira, no ema nebee rejistu nee mak ema nain rihun haat-nulu resin lima atus neen (45.600).
verses.42: Oan mane sira hosi Dan tuir sira nia uma kain sira: hosi Suham, uma kain Suham nian. Nee mak uma kain sira hosi Dan tuir sira nia uma kain sira.
verses.43: Uma kain hotu nebee Suham nian, no ema nebee rejistu nee mak ema nain rihun neen-nulu resin haat atus haat (64.400).
verses.44: Oan mane sira hosi Aser tuir sira nia uma kain sira: hosi Jimna, uma kain Jimna nian; hosi Jesui, uma kain Jesui nian; hosi Berias, uma kain Berias nian.
verses.45: Oan mane sira hosi Berias mak nee: hosi Heber, uma kain Heber nian; hosi Malkiel, uma kain Malkiel nian.
verses.46: No Aser nia oan feto nia naran mak Sera.
verses.47: Nee mak Aser nia oan mane sira nia uma kain sira tuir sira nebee rejistu, ema nain rihun lima-nulu resin tolu atus haat (53.400).
verses.48: Oan mane sira hosi Naftali tuir sira nia uma kain sira: hosi Jazeel, uma kain Jazeel nian; hosi Guni, uma kain Guni nian;
verses.49: hosi Jezer, uma kain Jezer nian; hosi Silem, uma kain Silem nian.
verses.50: Nee mak uma kain sira hosi Naftali tuir sira nia uma kain sira, no ema nebee rejistu nee mak ema nain rihun haat-nulu resin lima atus haat (45.400).
verses.51: Nunee ema Israel sira nebee rejistu mak ema nain rihun atus neen ida atus hitu tolu-nulu (601.730).
verses.52: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.53: “Ita sei fahe rai nee hodi foo liman rohan tuir naran sira nebee rejistu nee.
verses.54: Ba ema nebee barak ita sei aumenta sira nia liman rohan, no ba ema nebee uitoan ita sei hatuun sira nia liman rohan nee. Ita sei foo liman rohan ba ema ida-idak tuir ema sira nebee rejistu ona nee.
verses.55: Maski nunee, ita sei fahe rai nee nudar liman rohan liu hosi dada rifa tuir sira nia bei-ala sira nia suku nia naran.
verses.56: Sira sei fahe rai nee ba ema barak no ema uitoan liu hosi dada rifa.”
verses.57: Ema Levi sira nebee rejistu tuir sira nia uma kain sira mak nee: hosi Gerson, uma kain Gerson nian; hosi Koat, uma kain Koat nian; hosi Merari, uma kain Merari nian.
verses.58: Ema sira nee mak uma kain sira hosi Levi: uma kain Libni nian, uma kain Hebron nian, uma kain Mali nian, uma kain Musi nian, uma kain Kora nian. No Koha hetan Amram.
verses.59: Amram nia feen mak Jokebed, oan feto hosi Levi, nebee Levi hetan iha Ejitu. No feto nee tuur ahi no Amram hetan Arão no Moisés, no sira nia biin Miriam.
verses.60: Arão hetan Nadab, Abiú, Eleazar no Itamar.
verses.61: Nadab no Abiú mate bainhira sira oferese ahi nebee la loos iha Nai nia oin.
verses.62: No ema sira nee nebee rejistu mak ema nain rihun rua-nulu resin tolu (23.000). Sira hotu mak mane nebee idade fulan ida ba leten. Ema la sura sira iha ema Israel sira nia leet, tanba sira la simu liman rohan iha ema Israel sira nia leet.
verses.63: Ema sira nee mak ema nebee Moisés no saserdote Eleazar rejistu, nebee rejistu ema Israel sira iha rai tetuk Moab nian iha Jordaun nia sorin nebee besik Jerikó.
verses.64: Maibee iha sira nia leet, la iha mane ida nebee Moisés no saserdote Arão rejistu iha tempu uluk, bainhira sira rejistu ema Israel sira iha rai fuik Sinai.
verses.65: Tanba Nai hatete tiha ona kona ba sira, “Sira sei mate duni iha rai fuik.” Nunee la iha mane ida hosi ema uluk nee, só deit Kaleb, oan mane hosi Jefune, no Josué, oan mane hosi Nun.

verses.1: Depois oan feto sira hosi Zelofehad mai. Zelofehad mak oan hosi Hefer, oan hosi Gilead, oan hosi Makir, oan hosi Manasés, hosi uma kain Manasés nian nebee oan hosi José. Zelofehad nia oan feto sira nia naran mak Mala, Noa, Hogla, Milka no Tirza.
verses.2: Sira hamriik iha Moisés nia oin no iha saserdote Eleazar nia oin, no xefi sira no komunidade tomak nia oin, nebee iha odamatan ba Tenda Enkontru, no sira dehan,
verses.3: “Ami nia aman mate ona iha rai fuik, no nia la hamutuk ho sira nebee halibur hamutuk hodi kontra Nai iha Kora nia grupu. Maibee nia mate deit tanba ninia sala rasik no nia la iha oan mane sira.
verses.4: Nusaa mak ami nia aman nia naran atu lakon hosi ninia uma kain nia leet tanba nia la iha oan mane? Nunee foo rai mai ami iha ami nia aman nia maun-alin sira nia leet.”
verses.5: Moisés lori sira nia kazu baa iha Nai nia oin.
verses.6: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.7: “Zelofehad nia oan feto sira koalia loos. O tenki foo liman rohan ba sira iha sira nia aman nia maun-alin sira nia leet, no o tenki foo sira nia aman nia liman rohan ba sira.
verses.8: No o tenki hatete ba ema Israel sira, no dehan, ‘Se mane ida mate, no nia la iha oan mane ida, entaun imi tenki foo ninia liman rohan ba ninia oan feto.
verses.9: No se nia la iha oan feto ida, entaun imi tenki foo ninia liman rohan ba ninia maun-alin sira.
verses.10: No se nia la iha maun-alin sira, entaun imi tenki foo ninia liman rohan ba ninia aman nia maun-alin sira.
verses.11: No se ninia aman la iha maun alin sira, entaun imi tenki foo ninia liman rohan ba família nebee iha relasaun besik ho ninia família, no sira sei hetan rai nee. Buat nee sei sai estatutu hodi tesi lia ba ema Israel sira tuir Nai nia orden ba Moisés.’”
verses.12: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Sae foho Abarim nee no haree rai nebee Hau foo ona ba ema Israel sira.
verses.13: No bainhira o haree tiha, o sei halibur aan ba o nia povu, hanesan Arão halibur aan.
verses.14: Tanba o kontra Hau nia mandamentu iha rai fuik Zin, bainhira komunidade nee murmura, no o la hatudu katak Hau mak santu iha sira nia oin, iha bee fatin iha Meribá, iha Kades nebee iha rai fuik Zin.”
verses.15: Moisés koalia ba Nai, no dehan,
verses.16: “Husik Nai, Maromak ba espíritu hotu hosi buat nebee moris, bele hili mane ida hodi tau matan ba komunidade nee.
verses.17: Hili mane ida nebee bele lao sai ba iha sira nia oin, no lao tama mai iha sira nia oin, no bele lori sira sai no lori sira tama, hodi Nai nia komunidade nee la bele sai hanesan bibi nebee bibi atan la iha.”
verses.18: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Foti Josué, oan hosi Nun, nebee mane ida nebee iha espíritu, no tau o nia liman ba nia.
verses.19: Tau nia iha saserdote Eleazar nia oin, no iha komunidade tomak nia oin, no foo knaar ba nia iha sira nia oin.
verses.20: No o sei tau o nia onra ba nia hodi komunidade Israel tomak sei halo tuir nia.
verses.21: No nia sei hamriik iha saserdote Eleazar nia oin, no Eleazar sei husu kona ba nia liu hosi tesi lia ho Urim iha Nai nia oin. No povu nee sei halo tuir ninia liafuan hodi lao sai no sira sei tuir ninia liafuan hodi tama mai. No nia bele lao hamutuk ho ema Israel hotu nebee komunidade tomak nee.”
verses.22: Moisés halo tuir Nai nia orden ba nia, no nia foti Josué no tau nia iha saserdote Eleazar nia oin, no iha komunidade tomak nia oin.
verses.23: Moisés tau nia liman ba Josué no foo knaar ba nia, tuir Nai nia orden nebee mai liu hosi Moisés.

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.2: “Foo orden ba ema Israel sira no dehan ba sira, “Imi tenki halo tuir orden hodi oferese Hau nia oferta no Hau nia paun ba Hau nia sakrifísiu sira, nebee morin diak mai Hau, tuir tempu nebee loos.’
verses.3: No o tenki dehan ba sira, ‘Imi tenki oferese sakrifísiu nee ba Nai: bibi malae oan rua nebee tinan ida no perfeitu. Halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk nee loro-loron nebee halo hela deit.
verses.4: Oferese bibi malae oan ida iha dadeer-saan no bibi malae ida fali iha rai nakaras.
verses.5: No oferese trigu diak litru rua nudar oferta hahaan nian nebee kahur ho mina litru ida nebee baku ona.
verses.6: Ida nee sai oferta tunu motuk nebee hetan hosi Foho Sinai hodi halo morin diak, nebee oferta ida ba Nai.
verses.7: No halo oferta hemu nian nebee litru ida kada bibi malae ida-idak. Iha Fatin Santu o sei fui tua uvas nebee forti ba Nai hodi halo oferta hemu nian.
verses.8: Ba bibi malae oan ida nebee oferese iha rai nakaras nee bele halo hanesan oferta hahaan nian iha dadeer-saan, no hanesan oferta hemu nian nee, no o tenki oferese oferta nee hodi sai morin diak ba Nai.
verses.9: Iha loron Sabdu, bibi malae oan rua nebee tinan ida no perfeitu, no trigu diak litru haat ho balu hodi halo oferta hahaan nian, nebee kahur ho mina, no ninia oferta hemu nian:
verses.10: ida nee mak oferta Sabdu-Sabdu nian, nebee laos oferta tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit ho ninia oferta hemu nian.
verses.11: Bainhira fulan ida foin hahuu, imi tenki oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk ba Nai: karau oan nebee aman, bibi malae aman, bibi malae oan hitu nebee tinan ida no perfeitu.
verses.12: No mos trigu diak litru neen ho balu hodi halo oferta hahaan nian, nebee kahur ho mina, ba karau aman ida; no trigu diak litru rua ho balu hodi halo oferta hahaan nian, nebee kahur ho mina, ba bibi malae aman ida nee.
verses.13: No trigu diak litru rua nebee kahur ho mina hodi halo oferta hahaan nian ba bibi malae oan ida, hodi sai sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee morin diak, nebee oferta ida ba Nai.
verses.14: Sira nia oferta hemu nian mak tua uvas litru rua ba karau aman, litru ida ho balu ba bibi malae aman, no litru ida ba bibi malae oan. Buat nee mak sakrifísiu tunu motuk fulan-fulan nian iha fulan hotu durante tinan tomak.
verses.15: No mos tenki oferese bibi oan ida hodi sai oferta sala nian ba Nai, hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit ho ninia oferta hemu nian.
verses.16: Iha loron sanulu resin haat, iha fulan primeiru, imi tenki selebra loron Páskua ba Nai.
verses.17: Iha loron sanulu resin lima iha fulan nee, imi sei halo festa: durante loron hitu imi sei haan paun nebee la iha fermentu.
verses.18: Iha loron primeiru, imi sei halo sorumutu santu, no imi keta halo servisu saida deit.
verses.19: Maibee imi sei oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk ba Nai: karau oan rua nebee aman, bibi malae aman ida, bibi malae oan hitu nebee tinan ida. Buat sira nee tenki perfeitu.
verses.20: No ba sira nia oferta hahaan nian, tenki oferese trigu diak nebee kahur ho mina: litru neen ho balu ba karau aman ida, no litru haat ho balu ba bibi malae aman,
verses.21: no litru rua tenki oferese kona ba bibi malae oan ida-idak, nebee bibi malae oan hitu,
verses.22: no bibi ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian, hodi taka imi nia sala.
verses.23: Imi sei oferese buat sira nee hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk dadeer-saan nian nebee halo hela deit.
verses.24: No imi tenki halo tuir hanesan nee loro-loron, durante loron hitu nee, ho oferta hahaan nian nebee morin diak ba Nai. Ida nee tenki halo hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit ho ninia oferta hemu nian.
verses.25: Iha loron ba dala hitu, imi tenki halo sorumutu santu no imi keta halo servisu saida deit.
verses.26: Iha loron nebee imi halibur ai haan primeiru hosi imi nia toos, bainhira imi lori oferta hahaan nian hosi rezultadu primeiru ba Nai, iha tempu Festa Semana Nian, imi tenki halao sorumutu santu no imi keta halo servisu saida deit.
verses.27: Maibee imi tenki oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee morin diak ba Nai: karau oan rua nebee aman, bibi malae aman ida, bibi malae oan hitu nebee tinan ida;
verses.28: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian hosi trigu diak nebee kahur ho mina, litru neen ho balu ba karau oan ida-idak, trigu diak litru haat ho balu ba bibi malae aman ida nee,
verses.29: no litru rua ba bibi malae oan ida-idak nebee iha hitu;
verses.30: no mos bibi timor oan ida hodi taka imi nia sala.
verses.31: Imi sei oferese buat sira nee hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit, no ninia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian. Haree katak oferta sira nee perfeitu.

verses.1: Iha loron primeiru, iha fulan hitu, imi tenki halo sorumutu santu, no imi keta halo servisu saida deit. Ida nee mak loron nebee imi huu trombeta.
verses.2: Imi tenki oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee morin diak ba Nai: karau oan nebee aman, bibi malae aman no bibi malae oan hitu nebee tinan ida no perfeitu;
verses.3: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian hosi trigu diak nebee kahur ho mina, litru neen ho balu ba karau oan nee, trigu diak litru haat ho balu ba bibi malae aman nee,
verses.4: no litru rua ba bibi malae oan ida-idak nebee iha hitu;
verses.5: no mos bibi timor oan ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian, hodi taka imi nia sala.
verses.6: Imi sei oferese buat sira nee hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo iha tempu fulan nurak, no ninia oferta hahaan nian, no sakrifísiu tunu motuk loro-loron nian, no ninia oferta hahaan nian ho oferta hemu nian, tuir sira nia regulamentu hodi halo sakrifísiu ida nebee morin diak ba Nai.
verses.7: Iha loron sanulu, iha fulan hitu, imi tenki halo sorumutu santu, no imi tenki hatuun aan, no imi keta halo servisu saida deit.
verses.8: Maibee imi tenki oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee morin diak ba Nai: karau oan ida nebee aman, bibi malae aman ida no bibi malae oan hitu nebee tinan ida, no animál sira nee tenki perfeitu;
verses.9: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian hosi trigu diak nebee kahur ho mina, litru neen ho balu ba karau oan nee, trigu diak litru haat ho balu ba bibi malae aman ida nee,
verses.10: no litru rua ba bibi malae oan ida-idak nebee iha hitu;
verses.11: no mos bibi timor oan ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian; no halo hamutuk ho sakrifísiu sala nian nebee taka sala, no sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit, no ninia oferta hahaan nian ho oferta hemu nian.
verses.12: Iha loron sanulu resin lima, iha fulan hitu, imi tenki halo sorumutu santu no imi keta halo servisu saida deit. Imi tenki halo festa ida ba Nai durante loron hitu.
verses.13: Imi tenki oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk, oferta nebee morin diak ba Nai: karau oan sanulu resin tolu nebee aman, bibi malae aman rua, bibi malae oan sanulu resin haat nebee tinan ida, no animál sira nee tenki perfeitu;
verses.14: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian hosi trigu diak nebee kahur ho mina, litru neen ho balu ba karau oan ida-idak nebee iha sanulu resin tolu, trigu diak litru haat ho balu ba bibi malae aman ida-idak nebee iha rua,
verses.15: no litru rua ba bibi malae oan ida-idak nebee iha sanulu resin haat;
verses.16: no mos bibi timor oan ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian; no halo hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit, no ninia oferta hahaan nian ho oferta hemu nian.
verses.17: Iha loron segundu, imi tenki oferese karau oan sanulu resin rua nebee aman, bibi malae aman rua, bibi malae oan sanulu resin haat nebee tinan ida, no animál sira nee tenki perfeitu;
verses.18: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian ba karau aman, bibi malae aman no bibi malae oan sira nee, tuir sira nia númeru no regulamentu;
verses.19: no mos bibi timor ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian; no halo hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit, no ninia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian.
verses.20: Iha loron terseiru, imi tenki oferese karau oan sanulu resin ida nebee aman, bibi malae aman rua, bibi malae oan sanulu resin haat nebee tinan ida, no animál sira nee tenki perfeitu;
verses.21: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian ba karau aman, bibi malae aman no bibi malae oan sira nee, tuir sira nia númeru no regulamentu;
verses.22: no mos bibi timor ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian; no halo hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit, no ninia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian.
verses.23: Iha loron haat, imi tenki oferese karau oan sanulu nebee aman, bibi malae aman rua, bibi malae oan sanulu resin haat nebee tinan ida, no animál sira nee tenki perfeitu;
verses.24: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian ba karau aman, bibi malae aman no bibi malae oan sira nee, tuir sira nia númeru no regulamentu;
verses.25: no mos bibi timor ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian; no halo hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit, no ninia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian.
verses.26: Iha loron lima, imi tenki oferese karau oan sia nebee aman, bibi malae aman rua, bibi malae oan sanulu resin haat nebee tinan ida, no animál sira nee tenki perfeitu;
verses.27: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian ba karau aman, bibi malae aman no bibi malae oan sira nee, tuir sira nia númeru no regulamentu;
verses.28: no mos bibi timor ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian; no halo hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit, no ninia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian.
verses.29: Iha loron neen, imi tenki oferese karau oan ualu nebee aman, bibi malae aman rua, bibi malae oan sanulu resin haat nebee tinan ida, no animál sira nee tenki perfeitu;
verses.30: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian ba karau aman, bibi malae aman no bibi malae oan sira nee, tuir sira nia númeru no regulamentu;
verses.31: no mos bibi timor ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian; no halo hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit, no ninia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian.
verses.32: Iha loron hitu, imi tenki oferese karau oan hitu nebee aman, bibi malae aman rua, bibi malae oan sanulu resin haat nebee tinan ida, no animál sira nee tenki perfeitu;
verses.33: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian ba karau aman, bibi malae aman no bibi malae oan sira nee, tuir sira nia númeru no regulamentu;
verses.34: no mos bibi timor ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian; no halo hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit, no ninia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian.
verses.35: Iha loron ualu, imi tenki halo sorumutu, no imi keta halo servisu saida deit.
verses.36: Maibee imi tenki oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk, oferta ida nebee morin diak ba Nai: karau oan ida nebee aman, bibi malae aman ida, bibi malae oan hitu nebee tinan ida no perfeitu;
verses.37: no sira nia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian ba karau aman, bibi malae aman no bibi malae oan sira nee, tuir sira nia númeru no regulamentu;
verses.38: no mos bibi timor ida hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian; no halo hamutuk ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee halo hela deit, no ninia oferta hahaan nian no oferta hemu nian.
verses.39: Imi tenki halo buat sira nee ba Nai bainhira imi halo imi nia festa sira. No mos imi sei halo tuir imi nia juramentu no oferta voluntáriu sira nee, ba imi nia sakrifísiu tunu motuk, oferta hahaan nian, oferta hemu nian no oferta dame sira nee.
verses.40: Moisés foo sai buat sira nee ba ema Israel sira tuir orden hotu nebee Nai foo ba Moisés.

verses.1: Moisés koalia ba xefi suku sira kona ba ema Israel sira, no dehan, “Nai foo orden kona ba buat nee:
verses.2: Se mane ida jura juramentu ida ba Nai, ka nia promete promesa ida hodi kesi nia aan ho buat metin, nunee nia la bele troka ninia liafuan, maibee nia tenki halo tuir buat hotu nebee nia foo sai hosi ninia ibun.
verses.3: Se feto ida jura juramentu ida ba Nai, no kesi nia aan ho buat metin, no nia sei joven hela no nia hela iha ninia apaa nia uma,
verses.4: no ninia apaa nonook deit, entaun ninia juramentu hotu nee sei metin, no buat hotu nebee nia dehan ona hodi kesi aan sei sai metin.
verses.5: Maibee se karik ninia apaa la foo lisensa ba nia iha loron nebee apaa rona kona ba buat nee, entaun ninia juramentu hotu nee no liafuan hotu nebee nia foo sai ona hodi kesi aan nee la hamriik metin. Nai sei perdua feto nee, tanba ninia apaa la foo lisensa ba nia.
verses.6: Se feto nee iha laen ida bainhira nia jura ka foo sai buat ruma hodi kesi nia aan,
verses.7: no ninia laen rona no nia nonook deit iha loron nebee nia rona, entaun feto nee nia juramentu sei metin, no buat hotu nebee nia dehan ona hodi kesi aan sei sai metin.
verses.8: Maibee se ninia laen la foo lisensa ba nia iha loron nebee nia laen rona, entaun nia laen nee bele hasai juramentu nebee feto jura, no buat nebee nia dehan ona hodi kesi nia aan metin, no Nai sei foo perdua ba nia.
verses.9: (Maibee juramentu hotu hosi feto faluk ka feto nebee mane soe ona, nebee sira kesi aan metin ona, sei hamriik metin ba sira.)
verses.10: No se nia jura iha ninia laen nia uma, ka kesi aan metin ho promesa ida,
verses.11: no ninia laen rona no nonook hela, no la bandu nia, entaun ninia juramentu hotu sei hamriik metin, no liafuan hotu nebee nia kesi aan metin nee sei hamriik hela.
verses.12: Maibee se ninia laen kansela duni liafuan nee iha loron nebee nia rona, entaun saida deit nebee feto nee foo sai kona ba ninia juramentu sira, ka buat nebee nia kesi aan nee, sei la metin. Ninia laen kansela ona buat sira nee no Nai sei perdua nia.
verses.13: Juramentu hotu, no liafuan hotu nebee kesi aan nee, ninia laen bele estabelese no nia bele kansela liafuan nee.
verses.14: Maibee se ninia laen nonook deit ba nia loro-loron, entaun nia estabelese ninia juramentu hotu, no lia hotu nebee nia kesi aan. Laen nee halo metin tanba nia nonook ho feto nee iha loron nebee nia rona liafuan nee.
verses.15: Maibee, tuir mai, se mane nee buka atu kansela liafuan nee tuir tempu nebee nia rona tiha ona, entaun nia tenki simu feto nee nia sala.
verses.16: Nee mak estatutu sira nebee Nai foo ba Moisés entre mane ida no ninia feen, entre aman ida no ninia oan feto nebee sei joven no hela iha ninia aman nia uma.

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.2: “Selu fali ema Midian sira kona ba buat nebee sira halo ba ema Israel sira. Depois, o sei halibur aan ba o nia povu.”
verses.3: Entaun Moisés koalia ba povu, no dehan, “Prepara ema balu hodi halo funu, no haruka sira sai hodi hasoru ema Midian sira. Ita sei selu Midian kona ba buat nebee sira halo ona ba Nai.
verses.4: Hosi suku ida-idak hili ema nain rihun ida, hosi suku hotu iha Israel, no haruka sira baa halo funu.”
verses.5: Nunee sira hili ema nain rihun ida hosi ema barak iha suku ida-idak, nebee hamutuk ema nain rihun sanulu resin rua nebee prontu atu halo funu.
verses.6: Moisés haruka ema nain rihun ida hosi suku ida-idak hodi baa halo funu. No mos Fineias, oan mane hosi saserdote Eleazar, baa funu ho sira. Nia lori sasaan santu no trombeta nee hodi huu mak iha ninia liman.
verses.7: Sira halo funu hasoru ema Midian sira, tuir Nai nia orden ba Moisés, no sira oho mane hotu.
verses.8: No hamutuk ho ema sira nebee mate, sira oho mos liurai sira hosi Midian, nebee Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur no Rebav - liurai nain lima hosi Midian. No sira oho Balaão, oan hosi Beor, ho surik.
verses.9: Ema Israel sira foti feto Midian sira no kastigu sira, no foti sira nia oan sira, no sira nia karau, bibi lubun no riku-soin hotu.
verses.10: Sira sunu sidade hotu nebee ema Midian sira hela no ahi haan tiha sira nia uma boot hotu nee.
verses.11: Sira foti riku-soin hotu, no buat moris hotu nebee ema no animál.
verses.12: Sira lori ema kastigu, animál sira no riku-soin ba Moisés no saserdote Eleazar, no ba komunidade Israel iha akampamentu nebee iha rai tetuk iha Moab, nebee iha Jordaun nia sorin, besik Jerikó.
verses.13: Moisés no saserdote Eleazar, no xefi sira hotu iha komunidade nee sai ba hodi hasoru sira iha akampamentu liur.
verses.14: Moisés sai hirus loos ho lideransa sira ba forsa nee, no ho komandante sira ba rihun ida, no komandante sira ba atus ida, nebee foin mai hosi funu.
verses.15: Moisés dehan ba sira, “Imi husik moris feto hotu ka?
verses.16: Tebes feto sira nee mak halo ema Israel sira halo sala hasoru Nai iha asuntu iha Peor liu hosi liafuan hosi Balaão, no Nai nia komunidade nee hetan moras kastigu.
verses.17: Nunee agora, oho oan mane hotu hosi labarik sira nee, no oho feto hotu nebee toba ona ho mane.
verses.18: Maibee labarik feto hotu, nebee seidauk toba ho mane bele husik moris ba imi.
verses.19: No imi tenki hela iha akampamentu liur too loron hitu. Ema naran deit nebee oho ona ema ida ka kona ona mate isin. Hamoos imi nia aan no imi nia ema kastigu sira iha loron tolu no iha loron hitu.
verses.20: Fasi imi nia ropa hotu no buat hotu nebee halo ho kulit, no buat hotu nebee halo hosi bibi no sasaan hotu nebee halo hosi ai.
verses.21: Saserdote Eleazar dehan ba soldadu sira nebee halo ona funu nee, “Ida nee mak orden hosi lei nebee Nai foo ona ba Moisés:
verses.22: só deit osan mean, osan mutin, riti, besi, kaleen no makdadi,
verses.23: buat hotu nebee bele liu ahi imi tenki haruka liu hosi ahi hodi sasaan nee sai moos. Maski nunee, imi tenki hamoos sasaan nee ho bee nebee bele hasai foer. Buat hotu nebee la bele liu ahi tenki liu hosi bee.
verses.24: Iha loron hitu, imi tenki fasi imi nia ropa no imi sei sai moos. Depois imi bele tama akampamentu.
verses.25: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.26: “O no saserdote Eleazar no aman xefi hotu hosi komunidade tenki sura buat moris hotu nebee sira foti, ema no animál.
verses.27: Fahe buat hotu nee iha parte rua: parte ida ba sira nebee hola parte iha funu, no parte ida ba komunidade tomak.
verses.28: Haruka ema nebee hola parte iha funu nee atu selu ba Nai buat ida hosi atus lima hosi ema, karau, kuda buru no bibi.
verses.29: Foti buat sira nee hosi sira nia parte no foo ba saserdote Eleazar hodi halo oferta nebee foti sae ba Nai.
verses.30: No hosi ema Israel sira nia parte, o tenki foti buat ida hosi lima-nulu, hosi ema, karau, kuda buru, bibi lubun no animál naran deit, no foo buat sira nee ba ema Levi sira, nebee tau matan ba Tabernakulu Nai nian.
verses.31: Entaun Moisés no saserdote Eleazar halo tuir orden nebee Nai foo ba Moisés.
verses.32: Riku-soin nebee ema funu nain sira hadau ona mak nee: bibi rihun atus neen hitu-nulu resin lima (675.000),
verses.33: karau rihun hitu-nulu resin rua (72.000),
verses.34: kuda buru rihun neen-nulu resin ida (61.000),
verses.35: no ema nain rihun tolu-nulu resin rua (32.000), nebee feto sira nebee seidauk toba ho mane.
verses.36: Parte ida nebee ema funu nain sira hetan mak bibi rihun atus tolu tolu-nulu resin hitu atus lima (337.500).
verses.37: No sira selu ba Nai bibi atus neen hitu-nulu resin lima (675).
verses.38: No karau nee mak rihun tolu-nulu resin neen (36.000), no sira selu ba Nai hitu-nulu resin rua (72).
verses.39: No kuda buru nee mak rihun tolu-nulu atus lima (30.500), no sira selu ba Nai neen-nulu resin ida (61).
verses.40: No ema nee mak ema nain rihun sanulu resin neen (16.000), no sira selu ba Nai ema nain tolu-nulu resin rua (32).
verses.41: Moisés foo buat sira nee ba saserdote Eleazar hodi halo oferta nebee foti sae ba Nai, tuir orden nebee Nai foo ba Moisés.
verses.42: No hosi ema Israel sira nia parte nebee Moisés fahe ketak hosi funu nain sira,
verses.43: sira hetan bibi rihun atus tolu tolu-nulu resin hitu atus lima (337.500),
verses.44: karau rihun tolu-nulu resin neen (36.000),
verses.45: kuda buru rihun tolu-nulu atus lima (30.500),
verses.46: no ema nain rihun sanulu resin neen (16.000).
verses.47: Moisés foti buat ida hosi lima-nulu hosi parte nebee ema Israel sira nian. No nia foo buat sira nee ba ema Levi sira nebee tau matan ba Tabernakulu Nai nian, tuir orden nebee Nai foo ba Moisés.
verses.48: Depois lideransa sira ba forsa rihun sira nee, komandante sira ba rihun ida, no komandante sira ba atus ida nee, sira hakbesik ba Moisés,
verses.49: no sira dehan ba Moisés, “Ita boot nia atan ami nee mak lori ema funu nain hotu nebee ami diriji nee, no ami la lakon ema ida.
verses.50: Entaun ami lori oferta ida ba Nai, buat nebee ema ida-idak hetan nebee sasaan osan mean, korenti, kelu, kadeli, brinkus no fatuk murak sira hodi taka ami nia sala iha Nai nia oin.”
verses.51: Moisés no saserdote Eleazar foti osan mean nee hosi sira no sasaan karun hotu.
verses.52: Osan mean hotu nebee sira oferese ba Nai, hosi komandante sira ba rihun ida, no komandante sira ba atus ida, nee mak kilo atus rua.
verses.53: Tanba funu nain ida-idak hadau ona ninia riku-soin.
verses.54: Moisés no saserdote Eleazar foti osan mean nee hosi komandante sira ba rihun ida no komandante sira ba atus ida, no lori buat nee ba Tenda Enkontru hodi ema Israel sira bele hanoin hetan tempu nee iha Nai nia oin.

verses.1: Ema Ruben sira no ema Gad sira iha karau barak loos. Sira haree rai iha Jazer no rai iha Gilead nee mak rai diak ba karau.
verses.2: Entaun ema Gad sira no ema Ruben sira baa koalia ho Moisés no saserdote Eleazar no xefi sira iha komunidade nee, no sira dehan,
verses.3: “Atarot, Dibon, Jazer, Nimra, Hesbon, Eleala, Sebam, Nebo no Beon,
verses.4: rai nebee Nai baku ona iha komunidade Israel nia oin, rai nee mak rai diak ba karau no ita boot nia atan ami iha karau.”
verses.5: No sira dehan, “Se ami hetan grasa iha ita boot nia oin, husik ita boot foo rai nee ba ita boot nia atan ami hodi sai ami nian, no lalika lori ami ba Jordaun nia sorin ba.”
verses.6: Moisés dehan ba ema Gad sira no ema Ruben sira, “Entaun imi nia maluk sira ba halo funu, no imi tuur iha nee deit ka?
verses.7: Nusaa mak imi halo ema Israel sira hetan laran todan atu nunee sira nia fuan laran lakohi hakur ba rai nebee Nai foo ba sira?
verses.8: Imi nia bei-ala sira halo hanesan nee bainhira hau haruka sira hosi Kades-Barnea hodi haree rai nee.
verses.9: Tanba bainhira sira sae ba Rai Tetuk Eskol, no haree rai nee, sira foo laran todan ba ema Israel sira hodi nunee sira la tama ba rai nebee Nai foo ona ba sira.
verses.10: No Nai sai hirus loos iha tempu nebaa no Nia jura no dehan,
verses.11: ‘Tebes la iha ema ida nebee sae hosi Ejitu, hosi tinan rua-nulu ba leten, nebee bele haree rai nebee Hau jura ona ba Abraão, Isak no Jacó, tanba sira la tuir lo-loos Hau.
verses.12: Só deit, Kaleb, oan hosi Jefune nebee ema Kenez, no Josué, oan hosi Nun, bele haree rai nee tanba sira tuir lo-loos Nai.’
verses.13: Nai sai hirus loos hasoru Israel, no Nia halo sira lao ba-mai iha rai fuik durante tinan haat-nulu, too jerasaun tomak nee, nebee halo aat iha Nai nia oin, mak hotu ona.
verses.14: Tebes, imi sae boot ona no troka imi nia aman sira, no imi sai ema sala nain sira, hodi hatutan Nai nia hirus ba Israel.
verses.15: Tanba se imi fila no la tuir Nia, nunee Nia sei husik fali povu nee iha rai fuik, no imi sei destrui povu tomak nee.”
verses.16: Sira hakbesik ba Moisés no dehan, “Ami bele halo luhan balu iha nee ba ami nia animál sira nee no sidade balu ba ami nia kiik-oan sira,
verses.17: maibee ami sei baa nudar liman kroat iha ema Israel sira nia oin, too ami lori sira ba sira nia rai. No ami nia kiik-oan sira sei hela iha sidade iha nee nebee iha moru tanba ema nebee hela iha rai nee.
verses.18: Ami sei la fila fali ba ami nia uma too ema ida-idak hosi ema Israel sira simu ona ninia liman rohan.
verses.19: Tanba ami sei la simu liman rohan iha Jordaun sorin ba, no rai iha sorin ba, tanba ami nia liman rohan kona ami iha Jordaun nia sorin mai, iha parte lorosae.”
verses.20: Moisés dehan ba sira, “Se imi halo tuir hanesan nee, no imi baa nudar liman kroat iha Nai nia oin hodi halo funu,
verses.21: no imi hotu hakur Jordaun nudar liman kroat iha Nai nia oin, too Nia duni sai ninia inimigu sira hosi Ninia oin,
verses.22: no ita kontrola rai nee iha Nai nia oin, nunee tuir mai, imi bele fila fali mai iha nee no imi la simu sala iha Nai nia oin, no iha Israel nia oin. No rai iha nee sei sai imi nian iha Nai nia oin.
verses.23: Maibee se imi la halo hanesan nee, tebes imi halo ona sala hasoru Nai, no hatene duni katak imi nia sala sei hetan fali imi.
verses.24: Harii sidade balu ba imi nia kiik-oan sira no luhan balu ba imi nia animál sira nee, no halo tuir buat nebee imi promete ona.”
verses.25: Ema Gad sira no ema Ruben sira hataan ba Moisés no dehan, “Ita boot nia atan ami sei halo tuir senhor nia orden.
verses.26: Ami nia kiik-oan no feen sira, no ami nia bibi lubun no karau hotu nee sei hela iha sidade sira iha Gilead.
verses.27: Maibee ita boot nia atan ami sei hakur ba, ema ida-idak prontu atu halo funu iha Nai nia oin, tuir senhor nia liafuan.”
verses.28: Entaun Moisés foo orden kona ba sira ba saserdote Eleazar, Josué, oan hosi Nun, no xefi boot sira hosi ema Israel sira nia suku sira.
verses.29: No Moisés dehan ba sira, “Se ema Gad sira no ema Ruben sira sei hakur Jordaun ho imi nudar liman kroat hodi halo funu iha Nai nia oin, no sira hadau rai nee iha imi nia oin, entaun imi tenki foo rai Gilead ba sira hodi sai sira nian.
verses.30: Maibee, se sira lakohi hakur ho imi nudar liman kroat, sira tenki hetan rai iha imi nia leet iha rai Kanaan.”
verses.31: No ema Gad sira no ema Ruben sira hataan, no dehan, “Ami sei halo tuir buat nebee Nai hatete ona ba ita boot nia atan ami.
verses.32: Ami sei hakur nudar liman kroat iha Nai nia oin ba rai Kanaan, hodi ami bele hetan liman rohan no rai nee iha Jordaun nia sorin mai, hodi rai nee sei sai ami nian.”
verses.33: Entaun Moisés foo ba sira, ba ema Gad sira no ema Ruben sira, no ba suku sorin hosi Manasés, oan hosi José, reinu hosi Sihon, liurai hosi ema Amoreu sira, no reinu hosi Ogue, liurai hosi Basan, inklui rai no sidade sira ho sidade nia rai. Tanba sidade sira iha rai nebee haleu sira nia fatin nee.
verses.34: Ema Gad sira harii Dibon, Atarot, Aroer,
verses.35: Atrot-Sofan, Jazer, Jogbea,
verses.36: Bet-Nimra no Bet-Haran, sidade sira nebee iha moru no luhan balu ba sira nia bibi.
verses.37: No ema Ruben sira harii Hesbon, Eleala, Kiriataim,
verses.38: Nebo, Baal-Meon (sira troka ona sidade nia naran) no Sibma. No sira foo naran seluk ba sidade nebee sira harii.
verses.39: No ema Makir sira, nebee oan hosi Manasés, nia baa Gilead no hadau fatin nee no duni sai ema Amoreu sira nebee iha laran.
verses.40: Moisés foo Gilead ba Makir, oan hosi Manasés, no nia hela iha nebaa.
verses.41: No Jair, oan hosi Manasés, baa no foti aldeia kiik sira iha nebaa no nia foo naran ba sira Havot-Jair.
verses.42: No Noba baa no hadau Kenat no aldeia sira iha nebaa, no nia foo naran Noba, tuir ninia naran rasik.

verses.1: Ida nee mak ema Israel nia viajen bainhira sira sai hosi rai Ejitu ho sira nia forsa sira nebee tuir Moisés no Arão.
verses.2: Moisés hakerek kona ba fatin nebee sira lao iha sira nia viajen nebee tuir Nai nia orden. No sira halo viajen no lao liu fatin sira nee.
verses.3: Sira sai hosi Ramesés iha loron sanulu resin lima iha fulan primeiru, iha loron nebee tuir Páskua, ema Israel sira sai ho haksolok iha ema Ejitu nia oin.
verses.4: Tanba ema Ejitu sira hakoi sira nia oan primeiru nebee Nai mak oho iha sira nia leet, no Nai halao kastigu ba sira nia maromak sira.
verses.5: Depois ema Israel sira sai hosi Ramesés no hela iha Sukot.
verses.6: Sira sai hosi Sukot no hela iha Etam, nebee iha rai fuik nia ninin.
verses.7: Sira sai hosi Etam no fila fali ba Pi-Hairot, nebee iha Baal-Zefon nia oin, no sira hela iha Migdol nia oin.
verses.8: Sira sai hosi Pi-Hairot nia oin no lao liu tasi laran no tama ba rai fuik. Sira lao loron tolu iha rai fuik Etam no hela iha Mara.
verses.9: Sira sai hosi Mara no tama Elim. Elim iha bee matan sanulu resin rua no ai tali hitu-nulu, no sira hela iha nebaa.
verses.10: Sira sai hosi Elim no hela iha Tasi Teberau nia ninin.
verses.11: Sira sai hosi Tasi Teberau no hela iha rai fuik Sin.
verses.12: Sira sai hosi rai fuik Sin no hela iha Dofka.
verses.13: Sira sai hosi Dofka no hela iha Alus.
verses.14: Sira sai hosi Alus no hela iha Refidim, no iha nebaa bee la iha hodi povu bele hemu.
verses.15: Sira sai hosi Refidim no hela iha rai fuik Sinai.
verses.16: Sira sai hosi rai fuik Sinai no hela iha Kibrot-Hatava.
verses.17: Sira sai hosi Kibrot-Hatava no hela iha Hazerot.
verses.18: Sira sai hosi Hazerot no hela iha Ritma.
verses.19: Sira sai hosi Ritma no hela iha Rimon-Perez.
verses.20: Sira sai hosi Rimon-Perez no hela iha Libna.
verses.21: Sira sai hosi Libna no hela iha Risa.
verses.22: Sira sai hosi Risa no hela iha Kehelata.
verses.23: Sira sai hosi Kehelata no hela iha Foho Safer.
verses.24: Sira sai hosi Foho Safer no hela iha Harada.
verses.25: Sira sai hosi Harada no hela iha Makelot.
verses.26: Sira sai hosi Makelot no hela iha Tahat.
verses.27: Sira sai hosi Tahat no hela iha Tara.
verses.28: Sira sai hosi Tara no hela iha Mitka.
verses.29: Sira sai hosi Mitka no hela iha Hasmona.
verses.30: Sira sai hosi Hasmona no hela iha Moserot.
verses.31: Sira sai hosi Moserot no hela iha Bene-Jakan.
verses.32: Sira sai hosi Bene-Jakan no hela iha Hor-Hagidgad.
verses.33: Sira sai hosi Hor-Hagidgad no hela iha Jotbata.
verses.34: Sira sai hosi Jotbata no hela iha Ebrona.
verses.35: Sira sai hosi Ebrona no hela iha Ezion-Geber.
verses.36: Sira sai hosi Ezion-Geber no hela iha rai fuik Zin nebee iha Kades.
verses.37: Sira sai hosi Kades no hela iha Foho Hor, iha rai Edom nia ninin.
verses.38: Iha loron primeiru, iha fulan lima, iha tinan haat-nulu hosi tempu nebee ema Israel sai hosi rai Ejitu, iha loron nee, saserdote Arão sae Foho Hor tuir Nai nia orden, no nia mate iha nebaa.
verses.39: Arão mak tinan atus ida rua-nulu resin tolu bainhira nia mate iha Foho Hor.
verses.40: No liurai Arad, ema Kanaan nebee hela iha Negeb iha rai Kanaan, rona katak ema Israel sira mai.
verses.41: Sira sai hosi Foho Hor no hela iha Zalmona.
verses.42: Sira sai hosi Zalmona no hela iha Punon.
verses.43: Sira sai hosi Punon no hela iha Obot.
verses.44: Sira sai hosi Obot no hela iha Ije-Abarim, iha Moab nia baliza.
verses.45: Sira sai hosi Ije no hela iha Dibon-Gad.
verses.46: Sira sai hosi Dibon-Gad no hela iha Almon-Diblataim.
verses.47: Sira sai hosi Almon-Diblataim no hela iha Foho Abarim, iha Nebo nia oin.
verses.48: Sira sai hosi Foho Abarim no hela iha rai tetuk Moab nian, iha Jordaun nia sorin, besik Jerikó.
verses.49: Sira hela iha Jordaun nia sorin hosi Bet-Jesimot too Abel-Sitim iha rai tetuk Moab nian.
verses.50: Nai koalia ba Moisés iha rai tetuk iha Moab, nebee iha Jordaun nia sorin besik Jerikó, no Nia dehan,
verses.51: “Koalia ba ema Israel sira, no dehan ba sira, Bainhira imi hakur Jordaun ba rai Kanaan,
verses.52: imi sei duni sai ema hotu nebee hela iha rai nebaa hosi imi nia oin, no imi sei destrui sira nia estátua sira, no destrui sira nia idulu besi hotu, no hatuun sira nia fatin aas hotu.
verses.53: Imi sei duni sai sira no imi sei hela iha nebaa, tanba Hau foo ona rai nee hodi sai imi nian.
verses.54: No imi tenki fahe rai nee liu hosi dada rifa tuir imi nia uma kain sira. Ema nebee barak sei hetan liman rohan boot, no ema nebee uitoan sei hetan liman rohan kiik. Ema ida-idak nia fatin sei tuir rifa nebee monu ba nia. Imi sei hetan liman rohan tuir imi nia aman sira nia uma kain sira.
verses.55: Maibee se imi la duni sai ema sira nebee hela iha rai nee hosi imi nia oin, entaun tuir mai, ema nebee sei hela nee sei sai hanesan ai uut iha imi nia matan, no ai tarak iha imi nia sorin, no sira sei foo terus ba imi iha rai nebee imi hela.
verses.56: No tuir mai, Hau sei halo ba imi hanesan Hau hanoin atu halo ba sira.”

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.2: “Foo orden ba ema Israel sira, no dehan ba sira, Bainhira imi tama ba rai Kanaan (ida nee mak rai nebee imi hetan nudar liman rohan, rai Kanaan nebee iha baliza laran nee),
verses.3: nunee imi nia fronteira iha parte súl hahuu iha rai fuik Zin, nebee iha Edom nia sorin, no imi nia baliza iha parte súl nee mak iha Tasi Meer nia rohan, iha sorin lorosae.
verses.4: Depois imi nia baliza sei fila hodi liu fatin nebee sae ba Akrabim, iha nia sorin súl, no kontinua ba Zin, too iha Kades-Barnea, iha nia sorin súl. Depois baliza nee baa Hazar-Adar, no kontinua ba Azmon.
verses.5: Baliza nee sei haleu Azmon no baa too iha mota Ejitu nian, no tuir mota nee too iha tasi.
verses.6: Imi nia baliza iha sorin loromonu nee mak Tasi Boot no baliza nee sei tuir tasi ibun. Ida nee mak imi nia baliza iha sorin loromonu.
verses.7: Imi nia baliza iha sorin norte mak nee: hosi Tasi Boot marka lina ida ba Foho Hor.
verses.8: Hosi Foho Hor, marka lina ida ba Lebo-Hamat, no baliza nia rohan nee sei baa too iha Zedad.
verses.9: Depois baliza nee kontinua ba Zifron, no ninia rohan nee sei baa too iha Hazar-Enan. Ida nee mak imi nia baliza iha sorin norte.
verses.10: Depois imi tenki marka lina kona ba imi nia baliza iha sorin lorosae hosi Hazar-Enan too Sefam.
verses.11: Hosi Sefam, baliza nee sei tuun ba Ribla, iha Ain nia sorin lorosae. No baliza sei tuun no baa too iha Tasi Kineret nia tasi ibun, iha sorin lorosae.
verses.12: Depois baliza sei tuun too iha Jordaun, no kontinua ba hodi too iha Tasi Meer. Ida nee mak imi nia rai ho baliza nebee haleu rai nee.”
verses.13: Moisés foo orden ba ema Israel sira, no dehan, “Ida nee mak rai nebee imi sei simu liu hosi dada rifa, nebee Nai foo orden atu foo rai ba suku sia ho balu.
verses.14: Tanba ema Ruben sira nia suku, tuir sira nia bei-ala sira nia uma kain, no ema Gad sira nia suku, tuir sira nia bei-ala sira nia uma kain, mak simu tiha ona sira nia liman rohan, no mos Manasés nia suku sorin mak simu tiha sira nia liman rohan.
verses.15: Suku rua ho balu nee simu tiha ona sira nia liman rohan iha Jordaun nia sorin mai, iha Jerikó nia parte leste, iha sorin lorosae.
verses.16: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.17: “Ema nia naran nebee sei fahe imi nia rai mak nee: Saserdote Eleazar no Josué, oan hosi Nun.
verses.18: No imi sei foti xefi ida hosi suku ida-idak hodi fahe rai nudar liman rohan.
verses.19: Ema sira nee nia naran mak nee: Hosi suku Judá, Kaleb, oan hosi Jefuné;
verses.20: hosi ema Simeão sira nia suku, Semuel, oan hosi Amihud;
verses.21: hosi suku Benjamin, Elidad, oan hosi Kislon;
verses.22: no xefi ida hosi ema Dan sira nia suku mak Buki, oan hosi Jogli;
verses.23: no xefi ida hosi ema José sira, ba ema Manasés sira nia suku, Haniel, oan hosi Efod;
verses.24: no xefi ida hosi ema Efraim sira nia suku mak Kemuel, oan hosi Siftan;
verses.25: no xefi ida hosi ema Zebulón sira nia suku mak Elizafan, oan hosi Parnak;
verses.26: no xefi ida hosi ema Isakar sira nia suku mak Paltiel, oan hosi Azan;
verses.27: no xefi ida hosi ema Aser sira nia suku mak Ahiud, oan hosi Selomi;
verses.28: no xefi ida hosi ema Naftali sira nia suku mak Pedahel, oan hosi Amihud.
verses.29: Ema sira nee mak ema nebee Nai foo orden atu fahe liman rohan nee ba ema Israel sira iha rai Kanaan.

verses.1: Nai koalia ba Moisés iha rai tetuk iha Moab nebee iha Jordaun nia sorin besik Jerikó, no Nia dehan,
verses.2: “Foo orden ba ema Israel sira hodi foo sidade balu ba ema Levi sira atu hela. Ema Israel sira tenki foo sidade balu hosi sira nia rai nebee sira nia liman rohan, no sira tenki foo mos rai luan nebee haleu sidade sira nee.
verses.3: Nunee ema Levi sira bele hela iha sidade sira nee, no uza rai luan nee ba sira nia karau sira, no buat seluk nebee sira nian no sira nia animál hotu.
verses.4: Sidade sira nia rai luan nebee imi sei foo ba ema Levi sira sei haleu sidade no baa too iha metru atus haat lima-nulu.
verses.5: Imi tenki sukat iha sidade liur, metru atus sia iha sorin lorosae, metru atus sia iha sorin súl, metru atus sia iha sorin loromonu no metru atus sia iha sorin norte. Sidade nee sei iha fatin nee nia laran, no rai nee sei sai sidade nia rai luan.
verses.6: Imi tenki foo sidade neen ba ema Levi sira hodi sai sidade refujiadu nian, nebee imi sei halo hodi simu ema nebee oho ema seluk, hodi nia bele halai ba nebaa. No imi tenki foo tan sidade haat-nulu resin rua ba sira.
verses.7: Nunee sidade hotu nebee imi sei foo ba ema Levi sira mak haat-nulu resin ualu hamutuk ho rai luan nebee haleu sidade sira nee.
verses.8: Imi tenki foo sidade sira nee hosi ema Israel sira nia rai hanesan nee: hosi ema barak tenki foo barak, hosi ema uitoan tenki foo uitoan. Ida-idak tenki foo ba ema Levi sira hosi ninia sidade sira tuir ninia liman rohan nebee nia hetan.
verses.9: Nai koalia ba Moisés, no dehan,
verses.10: “Koalia ba ema Israel sira, no dehan ba sira, Bainhira imi hakur Jordaun no tama rai Kanaan,
verses.11: imi tenki haketak sidade balu hodi sai sidade refujiadu nian hodi ema nebee oho ema seluk bele halai ba nebaa, nebee ema nebee oho ema seluk tanba asidente.
verses.12: Sidade nee sei sai sidade refujiadu nian hosi vingadór, hodi ema nebee oho la bele mate too nia hamriik iha tribunál hodi simu julgamentu.
verses.13: Imi tenki halo sidade neen hosi sidade sira nebee imi foo, hodi sai sidade refujiadu nian.
verses.14: Imi tenki foo sidade tolu iha Jordaun sorin mai, no imi tenki foo sidade tolu iha rai Kanaan hodi sai sidade refujiadu nian.
verses.15: Sidade neen nee sei sai refujiadu nian ba ema Israel sira no ba ema estranjeiru, ka ema nebee lao rai iha sira nia leet. Nunee ema hotu nebee oho ema naran deit tanba asidente bele halai ba nebaa.
verses.16: Maibee se ema ida baku ema seluk ho besi hodi oho ema nee, entaun nia mak oho door. Oho door nee tenki hetan kastigu mate.
verses.17: Se nia tuku ema ho fatuk hodi oho ema nee, no ema nee mate duni, nia mak oho door. Oho door nee tenki hetan kastigu mate.
verses.18: Se nia baku ema ho alat ai nian hodi oho ema nee, no ema nee mate, nia mak oho door. Oho door nee tenki hetan kastigu mate.
verses.19: Vingadór rasik bele oho oho door nee. Bainhira vingadór hasoru ona ema nee, vingadór bele oho kedas nia.
verses.20: No se nia hirus no dudu ema ka tuda buat ruma ba ema nee hosi fatin subar hodi oho nia,
verses.21: ka nia hirus no baku ema ho nia liman hodi oho ema nee, entaun nia nebee oho ema nee tenki hetan kastigu mate tanba nia mak oho door. Vingadór raan nian bele oho kedas oho door bainhira nia hasoru oho door nee.
verses.22: Maibee se ema ida dudu ema seluk derepenti deit no laos tanba nia hirus, ka nia soe buat ruma maibee nia la hein atu halo hanesan nee,
verses.23: ka nia uza fatuk nebee bele oho ema ida maibee nia la haree ema nee, no nia soe deit no oho ema nee, maski ema nee laos inimigu ida no nia la buka atu halo aat ba ema nee,
verses.24: entaun tribunál tenki tesi lia entre ema nebee oho no vingadór raan nian tuir liafuan julgamentu sira nee.
verses.25: Depois tribunál tenki salva ema nebee oho hosi vingadór raan nian. Tribunál nee tenki lori nia ba fali sidade refujiadu nian nebee nia halai ona ba. No ema nee tenki hela iha sidade laran nee too saserdote boot mate, nebee simu unsaun ho mina santu.
verses.26: Maibee iha tempu naran deit, se ema nebee oho sai hosi ninia sidade refujiadu nia baliza, nebee nia halai ona ba,
verses.27: no vingadór raan nian hetan nia iha baliza liur, tanba nia sai ona hosi sidade refujiadu nian, no vingadór nee oho nia, entaun vingadór la simu sala raan nian.
verses.28: Tanba ema nebee oho nee, tuir lo-loos nia tenki hela iha sidade refujiadu nian too saserdote boot mate ona. Maibee bainhira saserdote boot mate ona, ema nee bele fila fali ba ninia rai.
verses.29: Buat sira nee sei sai estatutu julgamentu ba imi durante imi nia jerasaun hotu iha imi nia hela fatin hotu.
verses.30: Ema naran deit nebee oho ema seluk, nebee oho door, nia tenki hetan kastigu mate liu hosi sasin sira nia liafuan. Maibee liafuan hosi sasin ida deit la bele lori ema ida ba kastigu mate.
verses.31: No mos, imi la bele simu buat ruma hodi husik oho door nia moris nebee oho duni ema, nia tenki hetan duni kastigu mate.
verses.32: No imi la bele simu buat ruma hosi ema nebee halai ba ninia sidade refujiadu nian, hodi nia bele fila fali ba ninia rai molok saserdote boot mate.
verses.33: Imi la bele halo foer rai nebee imi hela. Tanba raan mak halo foer rai nee. Imi la bele hamoos rai nebee simu ona ema nia raan, só deit liu hosi raan hosi ema nebee fakar raan uluk nee.
verses.34: Imi la bele halo foer rai nebee imi atu hela ba, rai nebee Hau hela; tanba Hau, Nai, mak hela iha ema Israel sira nia leet.”

verses.1: Xefi aman sira hosi uma kain hosi ema Gilead, oan hosi Makir, oan hosi Manasés, nebee família sira hosi ema José sira, baa hasoru Moisés. Sira koalia iha Moisés nia oin, no iha xefi sira nia oin nebee xefi aman sira hosi ema Israel sira.
verses.2: No sira dehan, “Nai foo ona orden ba senhor hodi foo rai nudar liman rohan liu hosi dada rifa ba ema Israel sira, no Nai foo ona orden ba senhor hodi foo ami nia maluk, Zelofehad, liman rohan ba ninia oan feto sira.
verses.3: No se karik sira kaben ho oan mane naran deit hosi ema Israel sira nia suku sira, entaun sira nia liman rohan sei lakon hosi ami nia aman sira nia liman rohan no sai fali liman rohan ba suku nebee simu feto nee. Nunee rai nee sei lakon hosi ami nia liman rohan.
verses.4: Depois iha tinan Jubileu ba ema Israel sira, feto nee nia liman rohan sei muda ba liman rohan hosi suku ida nebee simu feto nee. Nunee feto nee nia liman rohan sei lakon hosi ami nia aman sira nia suku nia liman rohan.”
verses.5: Moisés foo orden ba ema Israel sira tuir Nai nia liafuan, no nia dehan, “Suku hosi ema José sira nee koalia loos.
verses.6: Nai foo orden ida nee kona ba Zelofehad nia oan feto sira, no Nia dehan, ‘Husik sira bele kaben ho ema nebee sira hakarak, só deit sira tenki kaben ho ema hosi família nebee hosi sira nia aman nia suku.
verses.7: Nunee ema Israel sira nia liman rohan la bele muda hosi suku ida ba suku seluk. Tanba ema ida-idak hosi ema Israel sira tenki kaer nafatin ninia liman rohan hosi ninia aman nia suku.
verses.8: No oan feto ida-idak nebee hetan liman rohan iha suku naran deit iha ema Israel sira nia leet, tenki kaben ho ema ida hosi família ida nebee hanesan ho feto nee nia aman nia suku. Nunee ema ida-idak iha ema Israel sira nia leet bele kaer nafatin ninia liman rohan hosi ninia aman sira.
verses.9: La bele husik liman rohan atu muda hosi suku ida ba suku seluk, maibee ema ida-idak iha ema Israel sira nia suku sira bele kaer metin ba ninia liman rohan rasik.’”
verses.10: Nunee Zelofehad nia oan feto sira halo tuir orden nebee Nai foo ba Moisés.
verses.11: Tanba Mala, Tirza, Hogla, Milka no Noa, nebee Zelofehad nia oan feto sira, kaben ho sira nia aman nia maun-alin sira nia oan mane sira.
verses.12: Sira kaben iha família sira nebee mai hosi oan sira hosi Manasés, oan hosi José, no sira nia liman rohan hela nafatin iha sira nia aman nia família nia suku laran.
verses.13: Nee mak ukun fuan no julgamentu nebee Nai foo ba ema Israel sira liu hosi Moisés nia liman, iha rai tetuk Moab nian iha Jordaun nia sorin, besik Jerikó.

verses.1: Moisés koalia liafuan nee ba povu Israel hotu iha Jordaun sorin mai, iha rai fuik, nebee iha rai tetuk iha Suf nia oin, nebee iha Paran, entre Tofel, Laban, Hazerot no Dizahab.
verses.2: Ita presiza loron sanulu resin rua hodi lao hosi Horeb, liu hosi Foho Seir, too iha Kades-Barnea.
verses.3: Iha loron primeiru, iha fulan sanulu resin ida, iha tinan haat-nulu, Moisés koalia ho ema Israel sira, tuir ukun fuan hotu nebee Nai foo ba nia hodi foo sai ba sira.
verses.4: Nia foo sai liafuan nee bainhira nia oho tiha Seon, liurai hosi ema Amoreu sira nebee hela iha Hesbon, no Ogue, liurai hosi Basan nebee hela iha Astarot, nebee iha Edrei.
verses.5: Iha Jordaun nia sorin mai, iha rai Moab, Moisés hahuu hodi deklara lei nee, no nia dehan,
verses.6: “Nai, ita nia Maromak, koalia ona ba ita iha Horeb no Nia dehan, ‘Imi hela kleur ona iha foho nee,
verses.7: fila ba no halo viajen. Baa ema Amoreu sira nia foho no tama ba fatin hotu iha nebaa. Tama ba rai tetuk, ba foho no ba rai tetuk, ba Negeb no ba tasi ibun, ba rai Kanaan no Lebano, no ba mota boot nebee Mota Eufrates.
verses.8: Tebes, Hau tau rai nee iha imi nia oin, nunee tama ba no hadau rai nee, nebee Nai jura ona atu foo ba imi nia bei-ala sira, ba Abraão, Isak no Jacó, no ba sira nia bei-oan sira nebee tuir mai.’
verses.9: “Iha tempu nebaa hau koalia ba imi, no dehan, ‘Hau mesak la bele lori imi.
verses.10: Nai, imi nia Maromak, mak habarak ona imi, no tebes, ohin loron imi mak ema barak loos hanesan fitun iha lalehan.
verses.11: Husik Nai, imi nia aman sira nia Maromak, bele habarak imi ba dala rihun ida tan, no haraik bensaun ba imi, tuir Ninia promesa ba imi.
verses.12: Oinsaa hau mesak bele lori imi nia todan, imi nia hakarak no imi nia murmura?
verses.13: Hili ema sira nebee iha matenek klean, kompriensaun no konhesidu hosi imi nia suku sira, no hau sei foo knaar ba sira hodi sai imi nia lideransa sira.’
verses.14: No imi hataan ona mai hau, no dehan, ‘Ita boot koalia diak no ami bele halo tuir.’
verses.15: Nunee hau foti xefi sira hosi imi nia suku sira, ema nebee matenek klean no konhesidu, no hau foo knaar ba sira hodi sai nai ulun ba imi, no sai imi nia komandante ba ema rihun sira, no komandante ba ema atus sira, no komandante ba ema sanulu sira, no imi nia funsionáriu sira iha imi nia suku sira.
verses.16: Hau foo orden ba imi nia juis sira iha tempu nebaa, no dehan, ‘Rona imi nia maluk sira nia kazu, no tesi lia loos entre ema ida no ninia maluk, no ba ema estranjeiru nebee hamutuk ho nia.
verses.17: Imi keta fihir ema ida bainhira imi tesi lia, maibee imi tenki rona ema kiik no ema boot. Keta tauk iha ema nia oin, tanba julgamentu nee mak Maromak nian. No se karik asuntu nee mak susar liu ba imi, entaun lori asuntu nee mai hau no hau sei rona buat nee.’
verses.18: Hau foo ona orden ba imi iha tempu nebaa kona ba buat hotu nebee imi tenki halo.
verses.19: “No bainhira ita sai hosi Horeb, ita lao liu rai fuik tomak nee, nebee boot no susar tebes. Imi haree rai nee bainhira ita lao liu dalan ba foho ema Amoreu sira nian. No ita halo viajen nee tuir Nai, ita nia Maromak, nia orden ba ita. Nunee ita too Kades-Barnea.
verses.20: No hau dehan ba imi, ‘Imi too ona foho nebee mak ema Amoreu sira nian, nebee Nai, ita nia Maromak, foo ba ita.
verses.21: Tebes, Nai, imi nia Maromak, tau rai nee iha imi nia oin. Nunee sae ba no hadau rai nee, tuir liafuan hosi Nai, imi nia bei-ala nia Maromak, nebee Nia koalia ona ba imi. Keta tauk no keta lakon brani.’
verses.22: Depois imi hotu hakbesik mai hau no dehan, ‘Ami sei haruka uluk ema balu hodi sira bele buka hatene rai nee, no lori mai fali liafuan ruma kona ba dalan ida nebee ami bele sae ba, no kona ba sidade sira nebee ami sei hasoru.’
verses.23: No hau hanoin liafuan nee diak. Nunee hau hili mane nain sanulu resin rua hosi imi nia suku ida-idak.
verses.24: Sira lao ba no sae foho, no sira tama ba Rai Tetuk Eskol no buka hatene fatin nee.
verses.25: Sira kuu ai fuan hosi rai nee no lori mai fali ita. Sira lori liafuan mai ita no dehan, ‘Rai nebee Nai, ita nia Maromak, foo ba ita mak diak.’
verses.26: Maski nunee, imi lakohi sae ba, maibee imi kontra ukun fuan hosi Nai, imi nia Maromak.
verses.27: Imi murmura iha imi nia tenda laran, no dehan, ‘Tanba Nai odi ami, nunee Nia lori ami sai hosi rai Ejitu no entrega ami ba ema Amoreu sira nia liman hodi halakon ami.
verses.28: Oinsaa ami bele sae ba? Ami nia maluk sira halo ami nia fuan laran nabeen, no sira dehan, “Povu nee mak boot no aas liu ami no sidade sira nee mak boot no iha moru too lalehan. No mos, ami haree ema Anak sira iha nebaa.”’
verses.29: Nunee hau dehan ba imi, ‘Keta hakfodak no keta tauk kona ba sira.
verses.30: Nai, imi nia Maromak, nebee baa uluk imi, Nia sei funu iha imi nia fatin, hanesan buat hotu nebee Nia halo ona ba imi iha rai Ejitu iha imi nia oin.
verses.31: No iha rai fuik imi haree ona oinsaa Nai, imi nia Maromak, lori imi, hanesan mane ida lori ninia oan mane. Nia halo hanesan nee iha fatin hotu nebee imi lao ba, too imi mai iha fatin nee.’
verses.32: Maski hau koalia nunee, imi la fiar Nai, imi nia Maromak,
verses.33: nebee lao uluk imi hodi buka fatin hodi imi bele harii imi nia tenda. Nia hatudu dalan ba imi iha kalan liu hosi ahi, no iha loron liu hosi kalohan.
verses.34: “Nai rona imi nia liafuan no Nia sai hirus. Nia jura no dehan,
verses.35: ‘Tebes, la iha ema ida hosi jerasaun aat nee nebee sei haree rai diak nebee Hau jura ona atu foo ba sira nia bei-ala sira.
verses.36: Só deit Kaleb, oan hosi Jefuné, sei haree rai nee. No Hau sei foo ba nia no ba ninia oan sira rai nebee ninia ain mak sama ona, tanba nia tuir metin ba Nai!’
verses.37: No mos, Nai sai hirus ho hau tanba imi, no Nia dehan, ‘O mos sei la tama ba rai nee.
verses.38: Josué, oan hosi Nun, nebee hamriik iha o nia oin, nia mak sei tama ba. Foo korajen ba nia tanba nia sei halo hodi Israel bele simu rai nee.
verses.39: No imi nia kiik-oan sira, nebee imi dehan katak sira atu mate, no imi nia oan sira, nebee iha loron nebaa sira la hatene buat diak ka aat, sira mak tama ba. No Hau sei foo rai nee ba sira, no sira bele hadau rai nee.
verses.40: Maibee kona ba imi, fila fali ba, no halo viajen hodi tama ba rai fuik liu hosi dalan Tasi Teberau nian.’
verses.41: “Depois imi hataan no dehan mai hau, ‘Ami halo sala ona hasoru Nai, ami sei sae ba no halo funu tuir orden hotu nebee Nai, ami nia Maromak, foo ona mai ami.’ No bainhira mane hotu hatais ninia armas funu nian imi prontu atu sae foho nee.
verses.42: Depois Nai dehan mai hau, ‘Hatete ba sira, La bele sae ba no la bele halo funu, tanba Hau laos iha imi nia leet. Keta halo be imi nia inimigu sira oho imi.’
verses.43: Entaun hau koalia ba imi maibee imi lakohi rona. Imi kontra ukun fuan hosi Nai no imi hanoin deit atu sae foho nee.
verses.44: Depois ema Amoreu sira, nebee hela iha foho nee, sai mai no duni imi hanesan bani duni ema. Sira halakon imi iha Seir too iha Horma.
verses.45: No imi fila mai no tanis iha Nai nia oin, maibee Nai la rona imi nia lian no Nia la see Ninia tilun ba imi.
verses.46: Depois imi hela iha Kades-Barnea loron barak, tuir loron hotu nebee imi hela iha nebaa.”

verses.1: “Depois ita fila no halo viajen ba rai fuik, liu hosi dalan Tasi Teberau nian, tuir Nai nia liafuan mai hau. No ita lao haleu Foho Seir durante loron barak.
verses.2: Depois Nai koalia ba hau, no dehan,
verses.3: ‘Imi lao haleu foho nee kleur ona. Fila ba parte norte.
verses.4: Foo orden ba povu no dehan, “Imi atu lao liu imi nia maluk sira nia baliza, ema Esau sira nebee hela iha Seir. Sira sei tauk imi, nunee imi tenki kuidadu tebes.
verses.5: Keta kria problema ho sira, tanba Hau la foo sira nia rai ba imi, laos ain fatin ida deit. Tanba Hau foo ona Foho Seir ba Esau hodi sai ninian.
verses.6: Imi tenki gasta osan hodi sosa ai haan hosi sira hodi imi bele haan. No imi tenki gasta osan hodi sosa bee hosi sira hodi imi bele hemu.
verses.7: Tanba Nai, imi nia Maromak, mak haraik ona bensaun ba imi liu hosi imi nia liman nia servisu hotu. Nia hatene imi nia viajen liu hosi rai fuik luan nee. Durante tinan haat-nulu, Nai, imi nia Maromak, mak hamutuk ho imi, no imi la falta buat ida.”’
verses.8: Entaun ita lao sees hosi ita nia maluk sira, ema Esau sira, nebee hela iha Seir. Ita lao dook hosi Araba, Elat no Ezion-Geber. Ita fila no lao liu hosi dalan ba rai fuik Moab nian.
verses.9: No Nai dehan, ‘Keta hadau ema Moab sira, no keta sadik sira hodi funu hasoru sira. Hau sei la foo sira nia rai ba imi, tanba Hau foo ona Ar ba ema Ló sira hodi sai sira nian.’
verses.10: (Ema Amim sira hela iha nebaa iha tempu antigu. Povu nee mak boot no barak. Sira mak ain aas hanesan ema Anak sira.
verses.11: Povu nee mos ema Refaim sira, nebee hanesan ho ema Anak sira, maibee ema Moab sira bolu povu nee ema Amim sira.
verses.12: Ema Hor sira mos hela iha Seir iha tempu antigu. Maibee ema Esau sira mak hadau sira, no halakon sira hosi rai nee no hela iha nebaa troka sira; hanesan Israel halo ba rai nebee sai ninian, nebee Nai foo ba sira.)
verses.13: Nai dehan, ‘Agora hamriik ba no hakur Mota Zered.’ Entaun ita hakur Mota Zered.
verses.14: Ita haan tinan tolu-nulu resin ualu hodi lao hosi Kades-Barnea too ita hakur Mota Zered. Durante tempu nee, jerasaun hotu hosi ema funu nain sira mak lakon hosi ita nia akampamentu, tuir Nai nia juramentu ba sira.
verses.15: Tanba loos duni, Nai nia liman hasoru sira hodi halakon sira hosi akampamentu laran, too sira hotu ona.
verses.16: Tuir mai, bainhira ema funu nain sira hotu mak lakon hotu ona no mate hosi povu nia leet,
verses.17: Nai koalia ba hau, no dehan,
verses.18: ‘Ohin loron, imi atu hakur liu hosi Ar, nebee baliza ba Moab.
verses.19: Bainhira imi hakbesik ba ema Amon sira, la bele hadau sira ka sadik sira, tanba Hau sei la foo rai hosi ema Amon sira hodi sai imi nian, tanba Hau foo ona rai nee ba ema Ló sira hodi sai sira nian.’
verses.20: (Ema dehan mos katak rai nee iha ema Refaim sira. Ema Refaim sira hela iha nebaa iha tempu antigu, no ema Amon sira bolu sira ema Zamzumim sira.
verses.21: Povu nee mak boot, no barak no ain aas hanesan ema Anak sira. Maibee Nai halakon sira iha ema Amon sira nia oin, no ema Amon sira hadau sira no hela iha rai nebaa troka sira.
verses.22: Nai halo nunee hanesan Nia halo ba ema Esau sira nebee hela iha Seir bainhira sira halakon ema Hor sira hosi rai nee, no hadau sira no hela iha rai nebaa troka sira too ohin loron.
verses.23: No kona ba ema Avim sira, nebee hela iha aldeia sira too iha Gaza, ema Kaftor sira nebee mai hosi Kaftor mak halakon sira, no hela iha nebaa troka sira.)
verses.24: Nai dehan, ‘Hamriik ba, no lao ba oin! Hakur Mota Arnon. Tebes, Hau foo ba imi Sihon, ema Amoreu nebee liurai hosi Hesbon, no ninia rai. Komesa hadau rai nee no hasoru nia hodi halo funu.
verses.25: Ohin loron, Hau komesa halo nasaun hotu iha lalehan nia okos hakfodak kona ba imi no sai tauk kona ba imi. Sira sei rona istória kona ba imi no nakdedar no hanoin terus tanba imi.’
verses.26: “No hau haruka manu-ain sira hosi rai fuik iha Kedemot ba Sihon, liurai hosi Hesbon, ho liafuan dame nian, no hau dehan,
verses.27: ‘Husik hau bele lao liu ita boot nia rai. Hau sei lao liu hosi dalan boot. Hau sei la fila ba liman loos ka fila ba liman karuk.
verses.28: Ita boot bele faan hahaan mai hau hodi ita boot bele hetan osan no hau bele haan. No ita boot bele foo bee mai hau hodi hetan osan no hau bele hemu. Só hau lao liu deit ho hau nia ain.
verses.29: Halo hanesan ema Esau sira nebee hela iha Seir, no ema Moab sira nebee hela iha Ar. Depois hau sei hakur Jordaun hodi tama ba rai nebee Nai, ami nia Maromak, foo mai ami.’
verses.30: Maibee Sihon, liurai hosi Hesbon la foo lisensa hodi ita bele lao liu. Tanba Nai halo Sihon nia espíritu sai toos, no halo ninia fuan laran sai metin, hodi Nai bele entrega nia ba ita nia liman, no ohin loron buat nee sai hanesan nee ona.
verses.31: No Nai dehan mai hau, ‘Tebes, Hau komesa foo Sihon no ninia rai iha imi nia oin ba imi. Komesa hadau fatin nee hodi imi bele simu ninia rai nee nudar liman rohan.
verses.32: Depois Sihon sai mai hasoru ita, nia no ninia povu hotu, hodi funu hasoru ita iha Jahaz.
verses.33: No Nai, ita nia Maromak, entrega nia iha ita nia oin. Ita oho nia, ninia oan mane sira no ninia povu hotu.
verses.34: Ita foti ninia sidade hotu iha tempu nebaa no halakon hotu ninia mane, feto no kiik-oan sira hosi sidade hotu. Ita la husik hela ema ida.
verses.35: Só ita foti deit karau sira hodi sai ita nian, no mos ita foti riku-soin hosi sidade sira nee.
verses.36: Hosi Aroer, nebee iha Mota Arnon nia ninin, no hosi sidade ida nebee besik mota nee, too iha Gilead, ita la hetan sidade ida nebee forti liu ita. Nai, ita nia Maromak, mak entrega buat hotu ba ita.
verses.37: Só ita la tama ba rai nebee ema Amon sira nian. Ita la baa fatin nebee iha Mota Jabok, ka sidade sira iha foho, ka saida deit nebee Nai, ita nia Maromak bandu ba ita.

verses.1: Depois ita fila no sae liu hosi dalan ba Basan. No Ogue, liurai hosi Basan, sei sai mai hodi hasoru ita. Nia no ninia povu hotu mai hodi halo funu iha Edrei.
verses.2: Nai dehan mai hau, “Keta tauk nia, tanba Hau sei entrega nia, ninia povu hotu no ninia rai ba o nia liman. O sei halo ba nia hanesan o halo ona ba Seon, liurai hosi ema Amoreu sira, nebee hela iha Hesbon.”
verses.3: Nunee Nai, ita nia Maromak, entrega mos ba ita nia liman Ogue, liurai hosi Basan, no ninia povu hotu no ita oho nia too la iha ema nebee hela hosi nia.
verses.4: No ita hadau ninia sidade hotu iha tempu nebaa. La iha sidade ida nebee ita la foti hosi sira. Ita hetan sidade neen-nulu iha área tomak iha Argob, nebee Ogue nia reinu iha Basan.
verses.5: Sidade hotu nee iha moru aas, portaun no besi lolon sira. No mos ita hetan aldeia barak liu nebee moru la iha.
verses.6: Ita halakon sira hotu, hanesan ita halo ona ba Seon, liurai hosi Hesbon. Ita halakon hotu mane, feto no labarik sira iha sidade hotu.
verses.7: Maibee ita hadau animál no riku-soin hotu hosi sidade sira nee hodi sai ita nian.
verses.8: No iha tempu nebaa, ita foti hosi ema Amoreu sira nia liurai rua nee, rai nebee iha Jordaun sorin mai, hosi mota Arnon too iha Foho Hermon.
verses.9: (Ema Sidon sira bolu Hermon nee, ‘Sirion’, no ema Amoreu sira bolu Hermon nee, ‘Senir’.)
verses.10: Ita hetan sidade hotu iha rai tetuk, no área Gilead tomak, no Basan tomak, too iha Saleka no Edrei, nebee sidade iha reinu Ogue nian iha Basan.
verses.11: (Tanba Ogue deit, nebee liurai hosi Basan, sei hela hosi ema Refaim sira nia ema restu nee. Tebes, ninia kama mak kama besi nian. Laos kama nee sei iha Rabat, iha ema Amon sira nia fatin? Karma nee naruk metru haat, no luan besik metru rua, tuir ema nia sukat.)
verses.12: No rai nee, nebee ita hadau iha tempu nebaa, hosi Aroer, nebee besik Arnon, no Foho Gilead nia sorin, no sidade sira nee, hau foo ba ema Ruben sira no ema Gad sira.
verses.13: No Gilead nia sorin restu, no área tomak iha Basan, nebee reinu Ogue nian, hau foo ba suku sorin hosi Manasés. Rai nee inklui área tomak iha Argob no Basan tomak, nebee ema bolu rai Refaim nian.
verses.14: Jair, oan mane hosi Manasés, hadau área tomak iha rai Argob, too iha baliza ho Gesuri no Maakati. Nia foo ninia naran, Havot-Jair, ba rai nee too ohin loron.
verses.15: Hau foo Gilead ba Makir.
verses.16: No ba ema Ruben sira no ema Gad sira hau foo rai hosi Gilead too iha mota Arnon, nebee too foho leet nee nia klaran hodi sai baliza, too iha Mota Jabok, nebee baliza ho ema Amon sira.
verses.17: No hau foo mos rai Araba ho baliza nebee Jordaun, hosi Kineret too iha tasi iha Araba nee, nebee Tasi Meer, iha rai lolon Pisga nian, iha parte lorosae.
verses.18: Hau foo orden ba imi iha tempu nebaa, no hau dehan, ‘Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo rai nee ba imi hodi hadau. Imi tenki hakur ba, prontu atu funu, iha imi nia maluk sira nia oin, nebee ema Israel sira, ema hotu nebee bele halo funu.
verses.19: Maibee imi nia feen sira, kiik-oan sira no animál sira nee (hau hatene katak imi iha animál barak) bele hein hela iha imi nia sidade sira nebee hau foo ona ba imi.
verses.20: Halo tuir hanesan nee too Nai foo deskansa ba imi nia maun-alin sira no mos ba imi, no sira mos hadau rai nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ona ba sira iha Jordaun sorin ba. Depois imi bele fila fali mai, no ema ida-idak bele hetan ninia rai nebee hau foo ona ba imi.’
verses.21: No iha tempu nebaa, hau foo orden ba Josué, no dehan, ‘O nia matan haree ona buat hotu nebee Nai, o nia Maromak, halo ba liurai rua nee. Nunee Nai sei halo ba reinu hotu nebee o hasoru.
verses.22: O keta tauk sira, tanba Nai, o nia Maromak, sei halo funu iha o nia fatin.’
verses.23: “Iha tempu nebaa, hau husu ba Nai, no dehan,
verses.24: ‘Oh Nai Maromak, O mak komesa hatudu ona O nia atan kona ba O nia podér boot no O nia liman nebee forti. Tanba iha maromak ida hosi lalehan ka mundu nebee bele halo hanesan O ka iha kbiit hanesan O?
verses.25: Favór ida, husik hau bele hakur no haree rai diak iha Jordaun sorin ba, no foho diak iha nebaa, no Lebanón.’
verses.26: Maibee Nai mak hirus ho hau tanba imi, no Nia la rona tuir hau. Nai dehan mai hau, ‘Too ona, la bele koalia tan mai Hau kona ba buat nee.
verses.27: Lao sae ba Pisga nia leten no foti sae o nia matan no hateke ba parte loromonu, norte, súl no lorosae. Haree rai nee ho o nia matan deit, tanba o sei la hakur Jordaun.
verses.28: Maibee foo knaar ba Josué, no foo korajen ba nia no foo forsa ba nia. Tanba nia sei hakur iha povu nee nia oin, no nia sei halo hodi sira bele simu rai nudar sira nia liman rohan, rai nebee o sei haree.’
verses.29: Nunee ita hela iha rai tetuk iha Bet-Peor nia oin.”

verses.1: “Agora, Oh Israel, rona estatutu no regulamentu sira nebee hau hanorin ba imi hodi imi bele halo tuir. Nunee imi bele moris hela no tama ba no hadau rai nebee Nai, imi nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak, foo ba imi.
verses.2: Keta aumenta liafuan nebee hau manda ba imi, no keta hamenus liafuan nee. Nunee imi bele halo tuir ukun fuan sira hosi Nai, imi nia Maromak, nebee hau manda ba imi.
verses.3: Imi nia matan rasik haree buat nebee Nai halo iha Baal-Peor. Nai, imi nia Maromak, halakon ema hotu hosi imi nia leet nebee tuir Baal hosi Peor.
verses.4: Maibee imi ida-idak nebee belit ba Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei moris hela too ohin loron.
verses.5: Haree lai, hau hanorin ona estatutu no regulamentu sira ba imi, tuir orden nebee Nai, hau nia Maromak, foo mai hau, hodi imi bele halo tuir iha rai nebee imi atu tama ba no hadau.
verses.6: Proteje no halo tuir estatutu sira nee. Tanba buat sira nee sei foo matenek klean no kompriensaun ba imi iha nasaun sira nia oin. Nasaun sira nee sei rona kona ba estatutu hotu nee no dehan, ‘Tebes nasaun boot nee iha ema nebee matenek klean no iha kompriensaun.’
verses.7: Tanba nasaun boot ida nebee mak iha maromak ida nebee besik ba sira hanesan Nai, ita nia Maromak, mak besik ita iha tempu naran deit bainhira ita bolu ba Nia?
verses.8: Nasaun boot ida nebee mak iha estatutu no regulamentu sira nebee loos hanesan lei tomak nee, nebee hau tau iha imi nia oin ohin loron?
verses.9: “Só deit kuidadu aan, no kuidadu tebes imi nia klamar. Keta halo be imi haluha buat sira nebee imi nia matan haree ona. Keta husik buat sira nee lakon hosi imi nia fuan laran durante imi nia moris tomak. Maibee hanorin buat sira nee ba imi nia oan sira no imi nia bei-oan sira.
verses.10: Hanoin loron nebee imi hamriik iha Horeb iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia oin. Nai dehan ba imi, ‘Halibur povu hamutuk, hodi Hau bele husik sira rona Hau nia liafuan. Nunee sira bele aprende atu hamtauk Hau durante loron hotu nebee sira moris iha mundu no sira bele hanorin sira nia oan sira hanesan nee.’
verses.11: No imi hakbesik ba no hamriik iha foho huun. Foho nee sunu ho ahi too iha lalehan laran no nakukun ho kalohan nebee metan loos.
verses.12: No Nia koalia ba imi hosi ahi nia laran no imi rona lian ida nebee foo sai liafuan nee. Imi la haree ilas ida, só imi rona deit lian.
verses.13: Nia deklara ba imi Ninia aliansa nebee Nia haruka imi halo tuir, ukun fuan sanulu nee. No Nia hakerek ukun fuan sira nee iha fatuk belar rua.
verses.14: Iha tempu nebaa, Nai foo orden mai hau hodi hanorin imi estatutu sira no regulamentu sira nee hodi imi bele halo tuir iha rai nebee imi hakur ba hodi hadau.
verses.15: “Nunee imi tenki kuidadu tebes kona ba imi nia aan, tanba imi la haree ilas ida iha loron nebee Nai koalia ba imi hosi ahi laran iha Horeb.
verses.16: Keta hafoer aan no halo estátua lulik nebee iha ilas saida deit nebee hanesan mane ka feto,
verses.17: hanesan animál ida nebee iha mundu, hanesan manu ida nebee semo iha loro leten,
verses.18: hanesan buat ida nebee dolar iha rai, ka hanesan ikan ida nebee iha bee laran iha rai okos.
verses.19: Keta halo be imi foti imi nia matan ba lalehan, no imi haree loro matan, fulan, fitun no forsa hotu iha lalehan, no imi obriga aan atu adora sira no serví sira nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, mak foo ba nasaun hotu iha lalehan nia okos.
verses.20: Maibee Nai foti ona imi, no lori imi sai hosi fornu besi, hosi Ejitu, hodi sai povu nebee Ninia liman rohan, hanesan ohin loron.
verses.21: Nai sai hirus ho hau tanba imi no Nia jura katak hau la bele hakur Jordaun, no hau la bele tama ba rai diak nee, nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ba imi nudar liman rohan.
verses.22: Maibee hau tenki mate iha rai ida nee. Hau la bele hakur Jordaun. Maibee imi sei hakur ba no hadau rai diak iha nebaa.
verses.23: Kuidadu aan, hodi keta haluha aliansa hosi Nai, imi nia Maromak, nebee Nia halo ho imi, hodi nunee imi la halo estátua lulik, nebee iha ilas saida deit, tanba Nai, imi nia Maromak, mak bandu ona buat nee.
verses.24: Tanba Nai, imi nia Maromak, mak ahi makaas ida. Nia mak Maromak ida nebee iha laran moras.
verses.25: Bainhira imi hetan oan sira, no bei-oan sira, no imi hela kleur ona iha rai nebaa, no imi halo buat aat no halo estátua lulik nebee iha ilas saida deit, no imi halo aat iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia oin hodi provoka Nia sai hirus,
verses.26: nunee hau bolu lalehan no mundu hodi sai sasin hasoru imi ohin loron, hodi imi sei lakon hotu hosi rai nebee imi atu hakur Jordaun no hadau. Nunee imi sei la hela kleur iha rai nebaa maibee imi sei lakon hotu.
verses.27: Nai sei namkari imi ba nasaun sira nia leet. No imi sei sai ema uitoan deit iha estranjeiru nia leet nebee Nai lori imi ba.
verses.28: Iha nebaa imi sei serví maromak sira nebee ema mak kria hosi ai no fatuk, nebee la haree, ka rona, ka haan, ka horon.
