verses.18: Imi keta lori osan nebee uza ona hodi selu feto luroon ka mane luroon, hodi lori ba selu juramentu naran deit iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia uma. Tanba buat rua nee mak foer loos ba Nai, imi nia Maromak.
verses.19: Keta foo impresta ba ita nia maluk hodi manaan osan funan nebee hosi osan, ka ai haan ka saida deit nebee ema foo impresta hodi hetan osan funan.
verses.20: Imi bele foo impresta ba estranjeiru hodi hetan osan funan maibee imi la bele hetan osan funan hosi imi nia maluk. Hodi nunee Nai, imi nia Maromak, bele foo bensaun ba imi liu hosi buat hotu nebee imi halo ho imi nia liman iha rai nebee imi baa hodi hadau.
verses.21: Bainhira imi halo juramentu ba Nai, imi nia Maromak, imi keta tardi atu selu buat nee. Tanba tebes Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei husu tuir buat nee hosi imi, no imi sei hetan sala.
verses.22: Maibee sei imi la halo juramentu, entaun imi la iha sala.
verses.23: Tenki kuidadu kona ba buat nebee imi koalia no imi tenki halo tuir imi nia liafuan, tanba imi promete ho imi nia ibun oferta voluntáriu ba Nai, imi nia Maromak.
verses.24: Bainhira imi tama ba imi nia maluk nia toos uvas, imi bele haan too bosu uvas fuan tuir imi nia hakarak. Maibee imi keta tau uvas fuan nee iha imi nia bornál.
verses.25: Bainhira imi tama ba imi nia maluk nia natar, imi bele kuu hare balu ho imi nia liman. Maibee imi keta koa imi nia maluk nia hare ho sabit ida.

verses.1: Bainhira mane ida foti feto ida no kaben ho nia, no tuir mai nia lakohi feto nee, tanba nia hetan buat nebee foer iha feto nee, entaun husik mane nee bele hakerek surat hodi soe nia. Mane tenki foo surat nee ba feto no haruka feto sai hosi ninia uma.
verses.2: Bainhira feto nee sai hosi mane nee nia uma, nia bele sai fali mane seluk nia feen.
verses.3: No se karik laen segundu nee odi nia no hakerek surat hodi soe nia no foo ba nia liman, no haruka nia sai hosi mane nia uma; ka se laen segundu nee mate, nebee kaben ona ho nia;
verses.4: entaun ninia laen uluk nian, nebee haruka nia sai ona, la bele foti feto nee hodi sai ninia feen fali tanba feto nee foer ona. Hahalok nee mak foer loos iha Nai nia oin. Imi la bele halo rai nee hetan sala nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ba imi nudar liman rohan.
verses.5: Bainhira mane ida foin hola feto ida, nia la bele baa kedas atu tama ba funu, no la bele haruka nia ba halao knaar naran deit. Nia tenki livre iha uma too tinan ida no foo haksolok ba ninia feen nebee nia foin hola.
verses.6: Ema ida keta foti fatuk inan ka fatuk oan dulas trigu nian nudar pinoor tanba buat nee mak hanesan foti ema nia moris nudar pinoor.
verses.7: Se imi hetan ema ida nebee naok ninia maluk hosi ema Israel sira, no kastigu nia sai atan ka faan nia, entaun naok-teen nee tenki mate. Imi tenki hasai buat aat hosi imi nia leet.
verses.8: Kuidadu kona ba moras lepra, no halo tuir lo-loos no halao buat hotu nebee saserdote Levi sira sei hanorin ba imi; hanesan hau foo orden ba sira, nunee imi tenki halo tuir.
verses.9: Hanoin saida mak Nai, imi nia Maromak, halo ba Miriam iha viajen bainhira imi sai hosi Ejitu.
verses.10: Bainhira ita foo impresta ba ita nia maluk buat naran deit, la bele tama ba ninia uma hodi foti pinoor ida.
verses.11: Tenki hamriik iha liur, no ema ida nebee impresta hosi ita sei lori sai pinoor ba ita.
verses.12: No se ema ida nee mak kiak, entaun la bele toba kalan ida ho ninia pinoor.
verses.13: Ita tenki foo fali ninia pinoor bainhira loro matan monu, hodi nia bele toba ho ninia manta nee no foo bensaun ba ita. Buat nee mak hahalok loos ba ita iha Nai, ita nia Maromak, nia oin.
verses.14: Ita keta hanehan ema nebee servisu nebee kiak no mukit, mezmu nia hosi ita nia maluk ka hosi ema estranjeiru sira nebee hela iha imi nia rai iha imi nia sidade sira.
verses.15: Ita tenki selu nia kolen molok loro matan monu tanba nia kiak no nia hakarak tebes osan nee. Keta halo be nia bolu ba Nai kona ba ita, no buat nee sai ita nia sala.
verses.16: Aman sira la bele simu kastigu mate tanba sira nia oan sira, no oan sira la bele simu kastigu mate tanba sira nia aman sira. Ema ida sei simu kastigu mate tanba ninia sala rasik.
verses.17: Imi keta muda justisa tanba estranjeiru ka oan kiak. No keta foti feto faluk nia manta nudar pinoor.
verses.18: Imi tenki hanoin katak uluk imi mak atan iha Ejitu, no Nai, imi nia Maromak, hola fali imi hosi fatin nee. Nunee hau manda imi atu halo tuir orden nee.
verses.19: Bainhira ita koa ita nia rezultadu iha toos no ita haluha futun ida iha toos. Keta baa fali hodi foti futun nee. Husik buat nee ba estranjeiru, ba oan kiak no feto faluk hodi Nai, imi nia Maromak, bele foo bensaun ba imi iha imi nia servisu hotu.
verses.20: Bainhira ita baku ita nia ai oliveira, ita la bele baku fali ai nee. Husik nia ba estranjeiru, oan kiak no feto faluk.
verses.21: Bainhira ita kuu ita nia uvas fuan hosi toos uvas, ita la bele kuu fali fatin nee. Husik restu ba estranjeiru, oan kiak no feto faluk.
verses.22: Ita tenki hanoin katak ita mak atan iha rai Ejitu. Nunee hau manda ita atu halo tuir orden nee.

25.title: Lei Kona Ba Kaben Levi Nian

verses.1: Se karik ema diskuti malu no sira tama ba tribunál hodi simu julgamentu, entaun juis tenki foo justisa ba ema nebee hahalok loos no kondena ema nebee hahalok aat.
verses.2: Se karik ema nebee hahalok aat merese atu simu kastigu baku, entaun juis sei haruka nia toba no ema baku nia iha juis nia oin dala hira tuir ninia sala.
verses.3: Keta baku nia liu dala haat-nulu. Se ita baku nia liu dala haat-nulu nee ho baku dala barak, entaun ita hamoe ita nia maluk nee.
verses.4: Keta taka karau nia ibun bainhira nia sama hela ita nia trigu.
verses.5: Se imi iha maun-alin sira nebee hela hamutuk, no ida mate no nia la iha oan ida, entaun ninia feen la bele kaben fali ho ema estranjeiru. Feto nee nia laen nia maun tenki tama ba nia no hola nia hodi halao ninia knaar nudar laen nia maun ba feto nee.
verses.6: Tuir mai, oan primeiru nebee feto nee hetan sei lori naran hosi ninia apaa nia alin mane nebee mate ona, hodi alin mane nee nia naran la bele lakon hosi Israel.
verses.7: Se karik maun ida nee lakohi hola ninia alin nia feen, entaun husik feto nee baa katuas sira iha portaun no dehan. ‘Hau nia laen nia maun lakohi foo oan ida ba ninia alin mane nia naran iha Israel. Nia lakohi halo tuir ninia knaar nudar hau nia laen nia maun.’
verses.8: Depois katuas sira hosi ema nee nia sidade tenki bolu nia no koalia ho nia. No se karik nia hamriik no dehan, ‘Hau lakohi hola nia,’
verses.9: entaun ninia alin mane nia feen sei hakbesik ba nia iha katuas sira nia oin no losu ninia sandálias hosi nia ain, tafui iha nia oin no hataan ba nia, no dehan, ‘Nunee mak hau halo ba ema ida nebee lakohi foo oan ida ba ninia alin mane nia uma kain.’
verses.10: No ema Israel sira sei temi naran ba ema ida nee nia uma kain, ‘Uma kain hosi nia nebee ema losu ninia sandálias.’
verses.11: Bainhira ema diskuti malu, no ema ida nia feen hakbesik hodi salva ninia laen hosi ema ida nebee baku nia, no feto nee lolo liman hodi kona mane nee nia oin lulik,
verses.12: entaun imi tenki tesi sai ninia liman. Keta hanoin ho laran luak ba feto nee.
verses.13: Keta lori besi oan dasin nian oin rua iha imi nia pasta, nebee boot liu ka kiik liu.
verses.14: Keta iha buat sukat oi-oin, nebee boot liu ka kiik liu.
verses.15: Maibee imi tenki iha besi dasin nian nebee pás no loos, no imi tenki iha buat sukat nebee pás no loos, hodi nunee imi bele hela kleur iha rai nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, mak foo ba imi.
verses.16: Ema hotu nebee halo hanesan nee, no ema hotu nebee halo buat nebee la loos, mak foer loos ba Nai, imi nia Maromak.
verses.17: Hanoin saida mak Amalek halo ba imi iha imi nia viajen bainhira imi sai mai hosi Ejitu.
verses.18: Hanoin oinsaa buat nee hasoru imi iha viajen nee no sira baku imi nia ema iha kotuk – ema hotu nebee la forti, bainhira imi fraku no kole; no nia la hamtauk Maromak.
verses.19: Nunee bainhira Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo deskansa ba imi hosi imi nia inimigu sira nebee iha imi nia sor-sorin, iha rai nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ba imi nudar liman rohan hodi hadau rai nee, depois imi tenki hamoos Amalek hosi lalehan okos hodi ema la hanoin hetan sira. Keta haluha buat nee.”

verses.1: “Tuir mai, bainhira imi tama ba rai nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ba imi nudar liman rohan hodi hadau rai nee, no bainhira imi hela iha nebaa,
verses.2: imi tenki foti produsaun primeiru hosi ai haan hotu hosi rai, no lori mai hosi imi nia rai nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ba imi, no tau iha bote ida. No imi sei baa fatin nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei hili hodi tau Ninia naran iha fatin nebaa.
verses.3: Imi sei baa saserdote iha tempu nebaa, no dehan ba nia, ‘Hau foo sai ohin loron ba Nai, ita nia Maromak, katak hau mai ona too rai nebee Nai jura ba ami nia bei-ala sira atu foo mai ami.’
verses.4: Depois saserdote nee sei foti bote nee hosi imi nia liman no tau iha altár nia oin nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, nian.
verses.5: Imi sei koalia no dehan iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia oin, ‘Hau nia aman mak ema Aram ida nebee lao atu lakon. Nia tuun ba Ejitu no lao iha nebaa ho ema uitoan. Depois nia sai nasaun ida nebee boot, no forti, no ema barak.
verses.6: Ema Ejitu sira halo aat mai ami, no foo terus mai ami no kastigu ami ho servisu todan.
verses.7: Bainhira ami hakilar ba Nai, ami nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak, Nai rona ami nia lian, no haree ami nia terus, no ami nia servisu no ami nia moris susar.
verses.8: No Nai lori ami sai hosi Ejitu ho liman forti, ho liman nebee lolo, ho buat tauk loos, ho sinál no milagre sira.
verses.9: Nia lori ami tama ba rai ida nee, no foo mai ami rai nee, rai ida nebee suli ho susu been no bani been.
verses.10: Agora, tebes, hau lori produsaun primeiru hosi rai nee, nebee O, Oh Nai, foo mai hau.’ Depois imi sei rai oferta nee iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia oin no adora iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia oin.
verses.11: No imi sei haksolok iha buat diak hotu nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ona ba imi, no ba imi nia uma kain, nebee inklui imi, ema Levi no estranjeiru nebee hela iha imi nia leet.
verses.12: Bainhira imi foo buat hotu nebee porsentu sanulu hosi imi nia produsaun iha tinan terseiru, nebee tinan porsentu sanulu nian, no imi foo ona ba ema Levi, estranjeiru, oan kiak no feto faluk, hodi sira bele haan too bosu iha imi nia fatin laran;
verses.13: depois imi tenki dehan iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia oin, ‘Hau hasai tiha ona parte nebee santu hosi hau nia uma, no mos hau foo tiha ona ba ema Levi, estranjeiru, oan kiak no feto faluk, tuir O nia ukun fuan sira nebee O manda mai hau. No hau la halo sala hasoru O nia ukun fuan sira, no hau la haluha ukun fuan sira nee.
verses.14: Hau la haan hosi oferta nee bainhira hau tanis lelir, no hau la foti balu bainhira hau la moos, no hau la oferese balu ba ema mate. Maibee hau rona tuir lian hosi Nai, hau nia Maromak, no hau halo tuir orden hotu nebee O foo ona mai hau.
verses.15: Hateke tuun hosi O nia fatin santu nebee O hela, hosi lalehan, no foo bensaun ba O nia povu Israel, no ba rai nebee O foo ona mai ami, nebee O jura ona atu foo ba ami nia bei-ala sira, rai nebee suli ho susu been no bani been.’
verses.16: Ohin loron, Nai, imi nia Maromak, manda imi atu halao estatutu no regulamentu sira nee. Nunee imi tenki halo tuir buat sira nee ho imi nia fuan tomak no klamar tomak.
verses.17: Imi mak deklara ohin loron katak Nai mak imi nia Maromak, no katak imi sei lao tuir Ninia dalan, no halo tuir Ninia estatutu, ukun fuan no regulamentu sira no rona tuir Ninia lian.
verses.18: No Nai mak deklara ohin loron katak imi mak povu nebee Ninia riku-soin, tuir Ninia promesa ba imi. Nunee imi tenki halo tuir Ninia ukun fuan hotu.
verses.19: No Nai sei halo imi sai aas liu nasaun hotu nebee Nia halo, no imi sei sai povu nebee santu ba Nai, imi nia Maromak, tuir buat nebee Nia dehan ona.”

verses.1: Moisés ho katuas Israel sira manda povu no dehan, “Halo tuir ukun fuan hotu nebee hau manda ba imi ohin loron.
verses.2: No iha loron nebee imi hakur Jordaun no tama ba rai nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ba imi, imi tenki harii fatuk boot sira no reboka sira ho plamir.
verses.3: Imi sei hakerek iha fatuk sira nee liafuan hotu hosi lei nee, bainhira imi hakur ba hodi tama ba rai nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ba imi. Rai ida nee suli ho susu been no bani been, hanesan imi nia bei-ala sira nia Nai Maromak promete ona ba imi.
verses.4: Nunee bainhira imi hakur ona Jordaun, imi tenki harii fatuk sira nee, nebee ohin loron hau haruka imi halo, iha Foho Ebal, no imi tenki reboka sira ho plamir.
verses.5: Iha nebaa imi tenki harii altár ida ba Nai, imi nia Maromak. Halo altár ida ho fatuk no keta uza alat besi ba fatuk.
verses.6: Imi tenki harii altár ba Nai, imi nia Maromak, ho fatuk tomak. No imi sei oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk iha altár nia leten ba Nai, imi nia Maromak.
verses.7: Imi sei oferese oferta dame sira no haan iha nebaa no sai haksolok iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia oin.
verses.8: Imi tenki hakerek moos loos liafuan hotu hosi lei nee ba fatuk sira nee.”
verses.9: Moisés no saserdote Levi sira koalia ba Israel tomak, no dehan, “Nonook no rona lai, Oh Israel: ohin loron imi sai Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia povu.
verses.10: Nunee imi tenki halo tuir Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia lian, no halao Ninia ukun fuan no estatutu sira, nebee hau manda ba imi ohin loron.”
verses.11: Moisés manda povu iha loron hanesan, no dehan,
verses.12: “Suku sira nee sei hamriik iha Foho Gerizim hodi foo bensaun ba povu bainhira imi hakur Jordaun: Simeon, Levi, Judá, Isakar, José no Benjamin.
verses.13: No suku sira nee sei hamriik iha Foho Ebal hodi foo malisan: Ruben, Gad, Aser, Zebulón, Dan no Naftali.
verses.14: No ema Levi sira sei koalia no dehan ba ema Israel hotu ho lian makaas:
verses.15: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee halo estátua lulik ka ídulu besi lulik, nebee foer loos ba Nai, buat nebee badaen nia liman halo, no tau iha fatin subar.’ No ema hotu sei hataan dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.16: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee la respeita ninia inan-aman.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.17: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee hasai ninia maluk nia marka baliza nian.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.18: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee haruka ema matan delek lao iha dalan sala.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.19: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee muda justisa hodi la foo ba estranjieru, oan kiak no feto faluk.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.20: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee toba ho ninia aman nia feen, tanba nia hamoe ninia aman.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.21: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee toba ho animál naran deit.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.22: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee toba ho ninia alin feto, nebee ninia aman nia oan feto ka ninia inan nia oan feto.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.23: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee toba ho ninia banin-feto.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.24: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee baku sub-subar ninia maluk.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.25: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee simu prezenti subar hodi oho ema inosenti.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’
verses.26: ‘Malisan ba ema nebee la kontinua iha liafuan hotu hosi lei nee liu hosi halo tuir buat sira nee.’ No ema hotu sei dehan, ‘Amén.’

28.title: Bensaun Tanba Halo Tuir Ukun Fuan

verses.1: Tuir mai, se imi rona tu-tuir lian hosi Nai, imi nia Maromak, hodi halo tuir Ninia ukun fuan hotu nebee hau manda ba imi ohin loron, nunee Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei tau imi iha fatin aas liu nasaun sira hotu iha mundu.
verses.2: No bensaun hotu nee sei akontese ba imi no imi sei hetan bensaun nee se imi rona tuir Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia lian.
verses.3: Imi sei simu bensaun iha sidade no bensaun iha rai luan;
verses.4: bensaun ba buat nebee mai hosi ita nia kabun laran, no produsaun hosi imi nia rai, no produsaun hosi imi nia animál sira, nebee imi nia karau no imi nia bibi lubun sira;
verses.5: bensaun ba imi nia bote no imi nia sanan;
verses.6: bensaun bainhira imi tama mai no bensaun bainhira imi sai ba.
verses.7: Nai sei halakon hosi imi nia oin imi nia inimigu sira nebee hamriik hodi hasoru imi. Sira sei mai hodi hasoru imi hosi dalan ida maibee sira sei halai liu hosi dalan hitu.
verses.8: Nai sei haraik bensaun ba imi iha imi nia armazén, no iha buat hotu nebee imi nia liman kona. Nia sei haraik bensaun ba imi iha rai nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ba imi.
verses.9: Nai sei estabelese imi nudar povu santu ba Ninia aan rasik, tuir Ninia juramentu ba imi, se imi halo tuir ukun fuan sira hosi Nai, imi nia Maromak, no lao tuir Ninia dalan sira.
verses.10: No povu hotu iha mundu sei haree katak imi mak hela hodi Nai nia naran, no sira sei tauk hosi imi.
verses.11: Nai sei foo sasaan barak ba imi, ho oan barak nebee mai hosi imi nia kabun laran, produsaun hosi imi nia karau, no produsaun hosi imi nia rai, iha rai nebee Nai jura ona ba imi nia bei-ala sira atu foo ba imi.
verses.12: Nai sei loke ba imi Ninia armazén diak, nebee lalehan, hodi foo udan ba imi nia rai iha tempu loos, no hodi foo bensaun ba imi nia liman nia servisu hotu. Imi sei foo impresta ba nasaun barak maibee imi sei la impresta.
verses.13: Nai sei halo imi sai ulun, laos ikun. Imi sei iha leten deit, laos iha okos; se imi rona tuir ukun fuan sira hosi Nai, imi nia Maromak, nebee hau manda ba imi ohin loron, hodi halo tuir buat sira nee.
verses.14: Imi keta fila ba sorin hosi liafuan ida nebee hau manda ba imi ohin loron, ba liman loos ka liman karuk, hodi lao tuir maromak sira seluk ka serví ba sira.
verses.15: Tuir mai, se imi la rona tuir Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia lian hodi halo tuir ukun fuan no estatutu hotu nebee hau manda ba imi ohin loron, entaun malisan hotu nee sei hasoru imi no hadau imi.
verses.16: Imi sei hetan malisan iha sidade, malisan iha rai liur;
verses.17: malisan ba imi nia bote no ba imi nia sanan;
verses.18: malisan ba buat nebee mai hosi ita nia kabun laran, produsaun hosi imi nia rai, no buat nebee imi hetan hosi imi nia karau no bibi lubun sira;
verses.19: malisan bainhira imi tama mai, no malisan bainhira imi sai ba.
verses.20: Nai sei haruka malisan ba imi. Nia sei foo terus no Nia sei hasee imi, iha buat hotu nebee imi tau imi nia liman ba hodi halo, too imi mamuk, no imi lakon lalais. Tanba imi nia hahalok aat iha buat nebee imi halo, nebee imi husik Hau.
verses.21: Nai sei halo susar boot kona imi too Nia halakon imi hosi rai nebee imi atu tama ba no hadau.
verses.22: Nai sei baku imi ho terus hanesan isin krekas, isin manas, isin bubu, ho isin manas loos, ho bailoro naruk, ai tahan namkurut no ai tahan kamutis; no buat sira nee sei duni imi too imi lakon.
verses.23: No lalehan iha imi nia leten sei sai hanesan riti, no rai nebee iha imi nia okos sei sai hanesan besi.
verses.24: Nai sei halo udan iha imi nia rai sai rai uut no rai rahun. Buat nee sei monu hosi lalehan too imi lakon hotu.
verses.25: Nai sei halo inimigu manaan imi. Imi sei lao liu hosi dalan ida hodi hasoru sira no halai hosi sira nia oin liu hosi dalan hitu. Sira sei lori imi ba reinu hotu iha mundu.
verses.26: Imi nia mate isin sei sai hahaan ba manu hotu iha loro leten, no animál sira iha mundu no la iha ema ida hodi duni sees animál sira nee.
verses.27: Nai sei kona imi ho fisur hosi Ejitu, ho kanker no kanek no isin katar, nebee ema la bele kura.
verses.28: Nai sei kona imi ho ulun bulak, matan delek no konfuzaun iha fuan laran;
verses.29: no imi sei lao susar iha meiudia hanesan ema matan delek lao susar iha nakukun. Imi sei la iha susesu iha imi nia moris. Ema sei hanehan imi no estraga imi nafatin hela deit, no la iha ema ida hodi salva imi.
verses.30: Imi sei troka prenda hodi hola feto ida maibee mane seluk sei toba ho nia. Imi sei halo uma ida maibee imi sei la hela iha laran. Imi sei kuda toos uvas maibee imi sei la haan uvas fuan hosi toos nee.
verses.31: Ema sei oho imi nia karau iha imi nia oin maibee imi sei la haan buat nee. Ema sei naok imi nia kuda buru hosi imi nia oin, no imi sei la hetan fali nia. Ema sei foo imi nia bibi ba imi nia inimigu sira no imi sei la iha ema ida hodi salva fali sira.
verses.32: Ema sei foo imi nia oan mane no oan feto sira ba povu seluk, no imi sei haree deit ho imi nia matan no imi nia matan sei sai aat tanba imi buka sira loron tomak, maibee imi la iha forsa tan iha imi nia liman.
verses.33: Nasaun ida nebee imi la konhese sei haan produsaun hosi imi nia rai no hosi imi nia servisu hotu, no sira sei hanehan no baku rahun imi nafatin.
verses.34: Nunee imi sei sai bulak tanba buat nebee imi haree ho imi nia matan.
verses.35: Nai sei kona imi iha imi nia ain tuur no iha imi nia ain, ho fisur moras nebee la bele kura, hosi imi nia ain okos too ulun leten.
verses.36: Nai sei lori imi, no imi nia liurai nebee imi tau iha imi nia leten, ba nasaun ida nebee imi no imi nia bei-ala sira la konhese. No imi sei serví maromak sira seluk iha nebaa, nebee halo ho ai no fatuk.
verses.37: No imi sei sai istória hakfodak no provérbiu ida no liafuan aat iha nasaun hotu nebee Nai lori imi ba.
verses.38: Imi sei lori fini barak ba rai luan, maibee imi nia rezultadu sei kiik, tanba gafanhotu sei haan produsaun nee.
verses.39: Imi sei kuda toos uvas, no hamoos sira, maibee imi sei la hemu tua uvas ka kuu uvas fuan tanba ular sei haan buat sira nee.
verses.40: Imi sei kuda ai oliveira iha imi nia rai tomak maibee imi sei la kose mina tanba imi nia ai oliveira sei soe ninia fuan.
verses.41: Imi sei hetan oan mane no oan feto maibee imi sei la hela kontenti ho sira tanba sira sei tama ba kastigu.
verses.42: Gafanhotu sei haan imi nia ai horis hotu no ai fuan hotu iha imi nia rai.
verses.43: Estranjeiru nebee iha imi nia rai sei sai aas liu imi no imi sei tuun too kraik liu.
verses.44: Sira sei foo impresta ba imi no imi sei la foo impresta ba sira. Sira sei sai ulun no imi sei sai ikun.
verses.45: Malisan hotu nee sei hasoru imi no duni imi no hadau imi too imi lakon. Tanba imi la rona tuir lian hosi Nai, imi nia Maromak, hodi halo tuir Ninia ukun fuan no estatutu sira nebee Nia manda ba imi.
verses.46: Buat sira nee sei sai sinál ida no milagre ida ba imi nia bei-oan sira too tinan ba tinan.
verses.47: Tanba imi la serví Nai, imi nia Maromak, ho haksolok no fuan kontenti ho buat barak nebee imi hetan,
verses.48: nunee imi sei serví imi nia inimigu sira nebee Nai sei haruka hodi hasoru imi, no imi sei hamlaha no hamrook no isin molik no falta buat hotu. Nia sei tau besi todan ba imi nia kakorok too Nia halakon imi.
verses.49: Nai sei haruka nasaun ida hosi rai dook hodi hasoru imi, hosi mundu rohan. Nasaun nee sei mai hanesan makikit nebee semo, nasaun ida nebee sira nia lian imi la kompriende;
verses.50: nasaun nebee iha oin toos no sira la hanoin ema katuas ka hatudu grasa ba labarik sira.
verses.51: Sira sei haan produsaun hosi imi nia karau no produsaun hosi imi nia rai too imi lakon. Sira sei la husik imi nia batar, tua uvas ka mina, ka produsaun hosi imi nia karau ka bibi lubun too sira halakon imi.
verses.52: Sira sei serka imi iha imi nia portaun hotu, too imi nia moru aas nebee imi fiar sei monu tuun. Sira sei serka imi iha imi nia portaun hotu iha imi nia rai tomak nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ona ba imi.
verses.53: Imi sei haan oan nebee mai hosi imi rasik nia kabun laran, isin hosi imi nia oan mane no oan feto sira, nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, foo ba imi, tanba imi nia inimigu sira sei serka imi no foo terus ba imi hodi halo imi nia moris susar.
verses.54: Mane ida nebee fuan laran mamar liu no hela ho vida diak iha imi nia leet, nia sei haree ho matan aat ba ninia maun-alin, ba ninia feen nebee nia hakuak, no ba ninia oan restu nebee sei moris hela.
verses.55: Nunee nia sei la foo ba sira isin hosi ninia oan sira nebee nia atu haan, tanba nia la iha buat ida tan iha tempu nebee inimigu serka no foo terus ba imi iha imi nia sidade hotu.
verses.56: No feto nebee fuan laran mamar liu no hela ho vida riku liu iha imi nia leet, nebee nunka lao iha rai ho ain tanan tanba nia riku no ain mamar loos, nia sei haree ho matan aat ba ninia laen nebee nia hakuak no ninia oan mane no oan feto,
verses.57: nunee nia la foo ninia kaan nebee sai liu hosi ninia ain klaran, ka ninia oan sira nebee nia hetan, tanba nia la iha buat ida nunee nia rasik sei haan sira iha fatin segredu tanba inimigu serka no foo terus ba imi iha imi nia sidade sira nia laran.
verses.58: Se imi la halo tuir liafuan hotu hosi lei nebee hakerek iha livru nee, nunee imi la hamtauk ba Naran nebee iha glória boot no tauk tebe-tebes, nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak,
verses.59: nunee Nai sei haruka susar boot nebee makaas loos ba imi no imi nia bei-oan sira, susar nebee boot no hela kleur, nebee foo moras makaas no hela kleur.
verses.60: No Nia sei haruka moras hotu hosi Ejitu, nebee uluk halo imi tauk, no moras sira nee sei belit ba imi.
verses.61: No mos, Nai sei haruka ba imi moras hotu no susar boot hotu seluk nebee la hakerek iha livru Lei nian nee, too imi lakon.
verses.62: Maski imi mak ema barak hanesan fitun iha lalehan, imi sei iha ema uitoan deit nebee sei hela, tanba imi lakohi rona tuir lian hosi Nai, imi nia Maromak.
verses.63: No tuir mai, hanesan Nai haksolok ba imi hodi halo diak ba imi no habarak imi, hanesan nee Nai sei haksolok hodi estraga imi no halakon imi, no Nia sei fokit sai imi hosi rai nebee imi tama ba hodi hadau.
verses.64: Nai sei namkari imi ba povu hotu nia leet, hosi mundu rohan ida too mundu rohan seluk. No iha nebaa imi sei serví maromak sira nebee imi no imi nia bei-ala sira la konhese, nebee halo hosi ai no fatuk.
verses.65: No iha nasaun sira nee nia leet imi sei la hetan moris diak, no imi nia ain okos nunka deskansa, maibee iha nebaa Nai sei foo ba imi fuan laran nebee tauk loos, matan nebee atu sai delek no klamar nebee tristi.
verses.66: Imi sei la hatene kona ba imi nia moris, imi sei tauk loron-kalan, no imi sei la hatene metin katak imi atu moris hela ka lae.
verses.67: Iha dadeer-saan imi sei dehan, ‘Diak liu tempu rai nakaras mai ona!’ No iha tempu rai nakaras imi sei dehan, ‘Diak liu dadeer-saan mai ona!’ Tanba buat nebee halo imi nia fuan laran tauk, no tanba buat nebee imi nia matan sei haree.
verses.68: Nai sei lori imi tama ba Ejitu fali iha roo laran, no halo viajen nebee Hau dehan ba imi, ‘Imi sei la haree fali fatin nee.’ No iha nebaa ema sei faan imi ba imi nia inimigu sira nudar atan mane no atan feto, maibee la iha ema ida nebee sosa imi.”

verses.1: Ida nee mak liafuan hosi aliansa nebee Nai haruka Moisés halo ho ema Israel sira iha rai Moab, nebee ketak hosi aliansa nebee Nia halo ho sira iha Horeb.
verses.2: Moisés bolu ema Israel hotu no dehan ba sira, “Imi haree ona buat hotu nebee Nai halo iha imi nia oin iha rai Ejitu ba Faraó, no ba ninia atan hotu, no ba ninia rai tomak,
verses.3: nebee terus boot nebee imi nia matan haree, no sinál sira no milagre boot sira.
verses.4: Maibee too ohin loron Nai sei la foo ba imi fuan laran hodi hatene, no matan hodi haree, no tilun hodi rona.
verses.5: Hau lori ona imi durante tinan haat-nulu iha rai fuik no imi nia ropa nebee imi hatais la sai aat, no imi nia sandálias iha imi nia ain la sai aat.
verses.6: Imi la haan paun no imi la hemu tua forti hodi imi bele hatene katak Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak.
verses.7: Bainhira ita mai too fatin iha nee, Sihon, liurai hosi Hesbon, no Ogue, liurai hosi Basan, mai no funu hasoru ita no ita manaan sira.
verses.8: Ita hadau sira nia rai no foo ba ema Ruben sira, ema Gad sira no suku sorin hosi Manasés.
verses.9: Nunee imi tenki halo tuir liafuan hosi aliansa ida nee, no halao sira hodi imi bele iha susesu iha buat hotu nebee imi halo.
verses.10: Imi hotu hamriik ohin loron iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia oin – imi nia xefi suku sira, imi nia katuas sira no imi nia komandante sira, hamutuk ho ema Israel hotu;
verses.11: no imi nia kiik-oan sira, imi nia feen sira no estranjeiru nebee hela iha imi nia akampamentu, hosi nia nebee taa imi nia ai too nia nebee kuru imi nia bee.
verses.12: Imi hotu hamriik hodi imi bele tama ba aliansa ho Nai, imi nia Maromak, no Ninia juramentu nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, halo ho imi ohin loron.
verses.13: Tama ba aliansa nee hodi Nia bele estabelese imi ohin loron nudar Ninia povu, no hodi Nia bele sai imi nia Maromak, hanesan Nia hatete ona ba imi, no hanesan nia jura ona ba imi nia bei-ala sira, ba Abraão, Isak no Jacó.
verses.14: Hau la halo aliansa no juramentu ida nee ho imi deit,
verses.15: maibee ho sira nebee hamriik hamutuk ho imi ohin loron iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia oin no ho sira nebee laos hamutuk ho ita ohin loron.
verses.16: Imi hatene oinsaa ita hela iha rai Ejitu, no oinsaa ita mai liu hosi nasaun sira nebee ita lao liu ona.
verses.17: Imi haree ona sira nia hahalok foer, no sira nia ídulu sira, hosi ai no fatuk, osan mutin no osan mean, nebee iha sira nia leet.
verses.18: Kuidadu katak la iha mane ida ka feto ida, ka família, ka suku, nebee iha fuan laran nebee fila ohin loron hosi Nai, imi nia Maromak, hodi baa no serví maromak sira hosi nasaun sira nee. Kuidadu katak imi la iha abut ida iha imi nia leet nebee foo sai veneno ka ai been moruk.
verses.19: No ema nee, bainhira nia rona liafuan hosi malisan nee, no nia foo bensaun ba nia aan rasik iha nia fuan laran no dehan, ‘Hau sei iha dame, maski hau lao tuir hau nia fuan toos nia hanoin.’ Tanba nunee imi lakon nia nebee lanu no nia nebee hamrook.
verses.20: Nai sei la perdua nia, maibee Nai nia hirus no Ninia laran manas sei suar hasoru ema nee, no malisan hotu nebee hakerek iha livru nee sei kona nia, no Nai sei hamoos ema nee nia naran hosi lalehan okos.
verses.21: Nai sei haketak ema nee hosi suku hotu iha Israel hodi hetan buat aat, tuir malisan hotu nebee hakerek ona iha livru Lei nian.
verses.22: No bainhira jerasaun nebee tuir imi nia oan sira, nebee moris mai tuir imi, no estranjeiru nebee mai hosi rai dook, haree susar boot nebee hasoru rai nee, no moras nebee Nai haruka ba rai nee -
verses.23: rai tomak simu fatuk klaak, masin no sunu, no ema la kuda iha rai nee, no produsaun la iha, no duut la moris iha nebaa, hanesan Sodoma no Gomora, Adma no Zeboim, nebee Nai halakon ho Ninia hirus nebee manas,
verses.24: no nasaun hotu sei dehan, ‘Tanba saa mak Nai halo hanesan nee ba rai ida nee? Tanba saa mak Nia hirus makaas nebee manas loos?’
verses.25: No ema sei hataan, ‘Tanba sira husik aliansa hosi Nai, sira nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak, nebee Nia halo ho sira bainhira nia lori sira sai hosi rai Ejitu.
verses.26: Tanba sira baa no serví maromak sira seluk, no adora sira, nebee maromak sira nebee sira la konhese, no Nia la foo ba sira,
verses.27: no Nai nia laran hirus sai manas hasoru rai nee, hodi lori malisan hotu ba rai nee nebee hakerek ona iha livru nee,
verses.28: no Nai fokit sira sai hosi sira nia rai tanba Nia laran hirus nebee manas, no tanba Nia hirus makaas, no Nia soe sira ba rai seluk too ohin loron.
verses.29: Buat sira nebee segredu mak Nai, ita nia Maromak nian, maibee buat nebee foo sai mak ita nian, no ita nia oan sira nian too tinan ba tinan, hodi ita bele halao liafuan hotu hosi Lei nee.

verses.1: Tuir mai, bainhira buat hotu nee akontese ba imi, bensaun no malisan, nebee hau tau iha imi nia oin, no imi hanoin liafuan nee iha nasaun sira nia leet nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, duni imi ba,
verses.2: no imi fila fali ba Nai, imi nia Maromak, no rona tuir Ninia lian nebee tuir buat hotu nebee hau manda ba imi ohin loron, imi no imi nia oan sira, ho imi nia fuan laran tomak no imi nia klamar tomak,
verses.3: nunee Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei troka imi nia kastigu. Nia sei hatudu laran luak ba imi, no lori imi mai fali no halibur imi hosi nasaun hotu nebee Nai, imi nia Maromak, namkari imi ba.
verses.4: Se iha ema balu hosi imi nebee Nia duni sai ba lalehan sorin ba, hosi fatin nee, Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei halibur imi, no hosi fatin nee Nia sei lori imi mai.
verses.5: Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei lori imi tama mai rai nebee imi nia bei-ala sira mak hadau, no imi sei hadau rai nee. Nia sei halo diak ba imi no habarak imi barak liu imi nia bei-ala sira.
verses.6: Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei halo sirkunsizaun ba imi nia fuan laran, no imi nia bei-oan sira nia fuan laran, hodi imi bele hadomi Nai, imi nia Maromak, ho imi nia fuan laran tomak, no imi nia klamar tomak, hodi imi bele moris hela.
verses.7: Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei tau malisan hotu nee ba imi nia inimigu sira no ba sira nebee odi imi no hanehan ona imi.
verses.8: No imi sei fila fali mai no rona tuir Nai nia lian, no halao Ninia ukun fuan hotu nebee hau manda ba imi ohin loron.
verses.9: Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei foo susesu res-resin ba imi iha imi nia servisu hotu, iha buat nebee mai hosi imi nia kabun laran, produsaun hosi imi nia animál sira no produsaun hosi imi nia rai. Tanba Nai sei haksolok fali tanba imi hodi halo diak ba imi hanesan Nia haksolok ho imi nia bei-ala sira.
verses.10: Nia halo hanesan nee bainhira imi rona tuir Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia lian hodi halo tuir Ninia ukun fuan no estatutu sira nebee hakerek ona iha Livru Lei nee, no bainhira imi fila ba Nai, imi nia Maromak, ho imi nia fuan tomak no imi nia klamar tomak.
verses.11: Tanba ukun fuan nee, nebee hau manda ba imi ohin loron, la subar hosi imi no ukun fuan nee la dook hosi imi.
verses.12: Nia laos iha lalehan hodi imi husu, ‘See mak sae ba lalehan no lori liafuan nee mai ami, hodi ami bele rona no halo tuir?’
verses.13: No nia laos iha tasi sorin ba hodi imi husu, ‘See mak baa too iha tasi sorin ba hodi lori liafuan nee mai ami, hodi ami bele rona no halo tuir?’
verses.14: Maibee liafuan nee mak besik loos ho imi, iha imi nia ibun no iha imi nia fuan laran hodi imi bele halo tuir liafuan nee.
verses.15: Haree lai, ohin loron hau tau iha imi nia oin moris ho diak, no mate ho aat.
verses.16: Ohin loron, hau manda imi atu hadomi Nai, imi nia Maromak, no lao tuir Ninia dalan sira, no halo tuir Ninia ukun fuan, estatutu no regulamentu sira, hodi imi bele moris no sai barak. No Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei foo bensaun ba imi iha rai nebee imi baa hodi hadau.
verses.17: Maibee se imi nia fuan laran fila hodi nunee imi lakohi rona tuir, no ema dada imi sai hodi adora maromak sira seluk no serví sira,
verses.18: nunee ohin loron, hau deklara ba imi katak imi se lakon duni, no imi sei la hela kleur iha rai nebaa, iha fatin nebee imi hakur Jordaun hodi hadau.
verses.19: Ohin loron, hau bolu lalehan no mundu hodi sai sasin hasoru imi. Hau tau iha imi nia oin moris no mate, bensaun no malisan. Nunee hili moris, hodi imi no imi nia bei-oan sira bele moris hela.
verses.20: Nunee imi bele hadomi Nai, imi nia Maromak, no rona tuir Ninia lian, no imi bele belit ba Nia. Tanba Nia mak imi nia moris no vida naruk. No imi bele hela iha rai nebee Nai jura ba imi nia bei-ala sira, ba Abraão, Isak no Jacó, hodi foo ba sira.”

verses.1: Moisés baa no foo sai liafuan nee ba Israel tomak.
verses.2: Nia dehan ba sira, “Ohin loron, hau mak tinan atus ida rua-nulu. Hau la bele kontinua sai ba no tama mai. No mos, Nai dehan ona mai hau, ‘O la bele hakur Jordaun nee.’
verses.3: Nai rasik, imi nia Maromak, sei hakur iha imi nia oin. Nia sei halakon nasaun sira hosi imi nia oin no imi sei hadau sira. Josué mak hakur ba iha imi nia oin, tuir Nai nia liafuan.
verses.4: No Nai sei halo ba ema sira iha nebaa hanesan Nia halo ba Sihon no Ogue, liurai sira hosi ema Amoreu sira, no ba sira nia rai nebee Nai mak halakon ona.
verses.5: Nai sei foo nasaun sira nee iha imi nia oin, hodi imi bele halo ba sira tuir ukun fuan sira nebee hau manda ona ba imi.
verses.6: Imi tenki forti no brani ba. Tanba Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei baa hamutuk ho imi. Nia sei la husik imi ka haluha imi. Keta tauk no keta hakfodak.”
verses.7: Moisés bolu Josué no dehan ba nia iha Israel tomak nia oin, “O tenki forti no brani ba. Tanba o tenki baa ho povu nee hodi tama ba rai nebee Nai jura ona ba sira nia bei-ala sira hodi foo ba sira. No o sei halo hodi sira bele simu rai nee nudar liman rohan.
verses.8: Nai sei baa uluk o. Nia sei hamutuk ho o. Nia sei la husik o ka haluha o. Keta tauk no keta hakfodak.”
verses.9: Moisés hakerek lei nee, no foo ba saserdote sira, nebee bei-oan sira hosi Levi, nebee lori Nai nia Arka Aliansa, no nia foo ba katuas hotu iha Israel.
verses.10: Moisés manda sira no dehan, “Bainhira tinan hitu remata, tuir tempu nebee tinan liberdade nian, iha Festa Baraka nian,
verses.11: bainhira Israel tomak mai iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia oin, iha fatin nebee Nia sei hili, iha tempu nee imi sei lee Lei nee iha Israel tomak nia oin hodi sira bele rona.
verses.12: Halibur povu hamutuk, mane, feto, labarik no estranjeiru nebee iha imi nia sidade sira, hodi sira bele rona. Nunee sira bele aprende no hamtauk ba Nai, imi nia Maromak. Sira bele halo tuir liafuan hotu iha Lei nee.
verses.13: Nunee sira nia bei-oan sira, nebee seidauk hatene, bele rona no aprende atu hamtauk ba Nai, imi nia Maromak, durante imi nia moris tomak iha rai nebee imi hakur Jordaun hodi hadau.
verses.14: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Tebes, loron besik mai ona bainhira o tenki mate. Bolu Josué no hatudu aan iha Tenda Enkontru hodi Hau bele foo knaar ba nia.” Moisés no Josué baa, no hatudu aan iha Tenda Enkontru.
verses.15: Nai mosu mai iha Tenda laran iha riin kalohan. No riin kalohan nee hamriik iha Tenda nia odamatan nia leten.
verses.16: Nai dehan ba Moisés, “Tebes, o atu toba hamutuk ho o nia bei-ala sira. No povu nee sei hamriik no baa halo sala foer ho maromak sira hosi estranjeiru sira iha rai nee, iha sira nia leet, no sira sei husik Hau no estraga aliansa nebee Hau halo ona ho sira.
verses.17: Depois Hau sei sai hirus makaas ho sira iha loron nebaa, no Hau sei husik sira no subar Hau nia oin hosi sira. No buat aat sei haan sira, no buat aat barak no problema barak sei hasoru sira. Iha loron nebaa, sira sei dehan, ‘Laos buat aat sira nee hasoru ami tanba ami nia Maromak laos iha ami nia leet?’
verses.18: Hau sei subar duni Hau nia oin iha loron nebaa tanba buat aat hotu nebee sira halao. Tanba sira fila no tuir maromak sira seluk.
verses.19: Nunee hakerek kanta ida nee ba imi no hanorin ba ema Israel sira. Tau kanta nee iha sira nia ibun hodi kanta nee bele sai sasin ba Hau nebee hasoru ema Israel sira.
verses.20: Tanba bainhira Hau lori sira hodi tama ba rai nebee Hau jura ba sira nia bei-ala sira, rai nebee suli ho susu been no bani been, no sira haan tiha too bosu, no sai bokur, depois sira sei fila ba maromak sira seluk no serví ba sira, no provoka Hau no estraga Hau nia aliansa.
verses.21: Tuir mai, bainhira buat aat barak no problema barak hasoru sira, entaun kanta nee sei sai sasin hasoru sira, tanba sira nia bei-oan sira sei la haluha kanta ida nee hosi sira nia ibun. Tanba Hau hatene sira nia hanoin nebee agora mos sira lao ba-mai no hanoin hanesan nee. Sira hanoin ona hanesan nee molok Hau lori sira tama ba rai nebee Hau jura ona.”
verses.22: Nunee Moisés hakerek kanta nee iha loron nebaa kedas no hanorin ba ema Israel sira.
verses.23: Depois Nai foo knaar ba Josué, oan hosi Nun, no dehan, “O tenki forti no brani ba. Tanba o sei lori ema Israel sira hodi tama ba rai nebee Hau jura ba sira. No Hau sei hamutuk ho o.”
verses.24: Tuir mai, bainhira Moisés hakerek liafuan hotu hosi Lei nee iha livru ida, too buat nee hotu ona,
verses.25: Moisés manda ema Levi sira nebee lori Nai nia Arka Aliansa, no dehan,
verses.26: “Lori Livru Lei ida nee no tau iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia Arka Aliansa nia sorin, hodi livru bele hela iha nebaa hodi sai sasin hasoru imi.
verses.27: Tanba hau hatene katak imi sei la tuir no imi iha ulun toos. Tebes bainhira hau sei moris ho imi ohin loron, imi la tuir Nai, nunee oinsaa liu tan bainhira hau mate ona?
verses.28: Halibur mai hau imi nia katuas hotu hosi imi nia suku sira, no imi nia komandante hotu, hodi hau bele koalia liafuan nee hodi sira bele rona, no hau sei bolu lalehan no mundu hodi sai sasin hasoru sira.
verses.29: Tanba hau hatene katak bainhira hau mate tiha ona, imi sei hafoer aan, no fila hosi dalan nebee hau manda ba imi. No buat aat sei akontese ba imi iha tempu tuir mai. Tanba imi sei halo aat iha Nai nia oin, hodi provoka Nia sai hirus tanba buat nebee imi nia liman halo.”
verses.30: Depois Moisés foo sai liafuan hosi kanta nee too hotu hodi ema Israel sira hotu bele rona:

32.title: rona tuir, Oh mundu, ba liafuan hosi hau nia ibun.

verses.1: “Foo tilun, Oh lalehan sira, no hau sei koalia,
verses.2: Hau nia hanorin sei monu hanesan udan,
verses.3: Tanba hau sei deklara Nai nia naran,
verses.4: Fatuk nee, Ninia hahalok mak perfeitu,
verses.5: Sira halo aat ba Nia;
verses.6: Imi selu fali Nai hanesan nee ka,
verses.7: Hanoin fali tempu antigu,
verses.8: Bainhira Ida Nebee Aas Liu fahe liman rohan ba nasaun sira,
verses.9: Maibee Nai nia parte mak Ninia povu,
verses.10: Nia hetan Jacó iha rai fuik,
verses.11: Hanesan makikit nebee aruma ninia knuuk,
verses.12: Nunee Nai mesak lori Jacó,
verses.13: Nia halo Jacó hodi sae fatin aas iha mundu,
verses.14: no manteiga hosi karau lubun,
verses.15: Maibee Jesurun sai bokur no nia tebe;
verses.16: Sira provoka Nai hodi sai laran moras ho maromak seluk,
verses.17: Sira halo sakrifísiu ba diabu sira,
verses.18: Imi la hanoin Fatuk nebee imi nia Aman,
verses.19: Nai haree hahalok nee no Nia lakohi sira,
verses.20: No Nia dehan, ‘Hau sei subar Hau nia oin hosi sira,
verses.21: Sira halo Hau sai laran moras ho buat nebee laos Maromak,
verses.22: Tanba Hau hirus hanesan ahi lakan,
verses.23: Hau sei aumenta dezastre ba sira,
verses.24: Sira sei sai krekas tanba hamlaha,
verses.25: Surik hosi liur sei hasoru sira,
verses.26: Hau dehan, “Hau atu namkari sira ba rai rohan,
verses.27: maibee Hau hanoin fali inimigu nebee hakarak provoka Hau.
verses.28: Tanba sira nasaun ida nebee la iha liafuan matenek,
verses.29: Se karik sira iha matenek klean sira bele kompriende buat nee,
verses.30: Oinsaa ema nain ida bele duni ema nain sanulu,
verses.31: Tanba sira nia fatuk laos ami nia Fatuk,
verses.32: Tanba sira nia ai uvas nee mak ai uvas hosi Sodoma,
verses.33: Sira nia tua uvas iha aimoruk aat hosi samea naga,
verses.34: ‘Laos Hau rai buat sira nee,
verses.35: Vingansa mak Hau nian, no Hau sei selu fali,
verses.36: Tanba Nai sei tesi lia ba Ninia povu,
verses.37: No Nia sei husu, ‘Sira nia maromak sira iha nebee,
verses.38: nebee haan sira nia sakrifísiu nia bokur,
verses.39: Agora haree katak Hau, Hau duni, mak Nia,
verses.40: Tanba Hau foti sae Hau nia liman ba lalehan,
verses.41: se Hau kadi Hau nia surik nebee naroman,
verses.42: Hau sei halo Hau nia rama oan sira lanu ho raan,
verses.43: Haksolok ho Nia, Oh lalehan sira,
verses.44: Moisés mai no foo sai liafuan hotu hosi kanta nee hodi povu bele rona. Nia mai ho Josué, oan hosi Nun.
verses.45: Bainhira Moisés koalia liafuan hotu nee ba Israel tomak,
verses.46: nia dehan ba sira, “Rona ho fuan laran liafuan hotu nebee hau foo sai iha imi nia leet ohin loron. Manda liafuan nee ba imi nia oan sira hodi sira bele halo tuir liafuan hotu hosi lei nee.
verses.47: Tanba liafuan nee laos liafuan mamuk ba imi, tanba ida nee mak imi nia moris. No liu hosi liafuan nee imi bele hela kleur durante imi nia moris iha rai nebaa, iha fatin nebee imi hakur Jordaun hodi hadau.
verses.48: Nai koalia ba Moisés iha loron nee, no dehan,
verses.49: “Sae Foho Abarim, nebee Foho Nebo, iha rai Moab, nebee iha Jerikó nia oin, no haree ba rai Kanaan, nebee Hau foo ba ema Israel hodi sai sira nian.
verses.50: No o sei mate iha foho nebee o sae, no o sei halibur aan ba o nia povu, hanesan o nia maun Arão mate ona iha Foho Hor, no nia halibur aan ba ninia povu,
verses.51: tanba o halo sala hasoru Hau iha ema Israel sira nia leet iha bee fatin iha Meribá-Kades, iha rai fuik Zin, tanba o la hatudu Hau santu iha ema Israel sira nia leet.
verses.52: Maibee o sei haree rai nee iha o nia oin, maibee o sei la baa too iha rai iha nebaa nebee Hau foo ba ema Israel sira.”

verses.1: Ida nee mak bensaun ida nebee Moisés, ema Maromak nian, koalia hodi foo bensaun ba ema Israel sira molok nia mate.
verses.2: Nia dehan,
verses.3: Sin, Nia hadomi povu.
verses.4: Moisés foo sai lei ida mai ami,
verses.5: Nai sai liurai iha Jesurun,
verses.6: Husik Ruben bele moris no la mate,
verses.7: No nia koalia nunee kona ba Judá:
verses.8: No kona ba Levi, nia dehan:
verses.9: Nia nebee koalia kona ba ninia inan-aman,
verses.10: Sira sei hanorin O nia regulamentu ba Jacó,
verses.11: Foo bensaun, Oh Nai, ba ninia forsa,
verses.12: Kona ba Benjamin, nia dehan:
verses.13: Kona ba José, nia dehan:
verses.14: ho produsaun furak hosi loro matan,
verses.15: no buat nebee diak liu hosi foho antigu nian,
verses.16: no buat nebee furak no produsaun boot hosi rai,
verses.17: Nia iha majestade hanesan karau aman nebee oan primeiru,
verses.18: Kona ba Zebulón, nia dehan:
verses.19: Sira sei bolu povu sira ba foho,
verses.20: Kona ba Gad, nia dehan:
verses.21: Nia hili buat diak liu ba nia aan rasik,
verses.22: Kona ba Dan, nia dehan:
verses.23: Kona ba Naftali, nia dehan:
verses.24: Kona ba Aser, nia dehan:
verses.25: O sei seguru aan ho besi lolon no riti lolon,
verses.26: La iha ida nebee hanesan Jesurun nia Maromak,
verses.27: Maromak rohan laek mak ita nia subar fatin,
verses.28: Nunee Israel hela mesak,
verses.29: O mak haksolok, Oh Israel! See mak hanesan o,

verses.1: Depois Moisés sai hosi rai tetuk Moab too iha Foho Nebo, no sae ba Foho Pisga nia tutun, iha Jerikó nia oin. Iha nebaa Nai hatudu ba Moisés rai hotu nee: hosi Gilead too iha Dan,
verses.2: rai Naftali tomak, rai Efraim no Manasés, rai Judá tomak too tasi iha sorin oeste,
verses.3: rejiaun súl, no rai tetuk iha Jerikó, Sidade Ai Palma, too Zoar.
verses.4: No Nai hatete ba Moisés, “Ida nee mak rai nebee Hau promete ona ba Abraão, Isak no Jacó dehan, ‘Rai nee Hau sei foo ba o nia jerasaun.’ Hau foo lisensa ba o hodi haree ho o nia matan rasik, maibee o la bele hakur ba nebaa.”
verses.5: Nunee Moisés, Nai Maromak Nia atan, mate iha rai Moab, tuir Nai nia liafuan.
verses.6: Nai mak hakoi nia iha nebaa, iha foho huun iha rai Moab, nebee iha sidade Bete-Peor nia oin. Too ohin loron, la iha ema ida nebee hatene fatin nebee hakoi Moisés.
verses.7: Moisés nia idade tinan atus ida rua-nulu, bainhira nia mate, maibee nia matan sei haree moos no nia forsa moris nian seidauk lakon.
verses.8: Iha rai tetuk Moab, ema Israel sira tanis kona ba Moisés mate durante loron tolu-nulu too tempu lutu remata.
verses.9: Moisés tau liman ona ba Josué, Nun nia oan, hodi troka nia. Nunee Josué nakonu ho espíritu no matenek klean. Ema Israel sira rona ba Josué no halo tuir Nai nia lei sira nebee Nia foo liu hosi Moisés.
verses.10: Iha Israel, la iha tan profeta hanesan Moisés nebee Nai konhese oin ho oin.
verses.11: La iha tan ema nebee halo milagre ho sinál sira nebee Nai haruka Moisés halo iha Ejitu hodi kontra Faraó ho nia atan sira hotu no nia rai hotu.
verses.12: La iha profeta seluk nebee iha liman forti no halo buat makaas hanesan Moisés halo ona iha povu Israel hotu nia oin.

verses.1: Bainhira Moisés, Nai nia atan nee, mate ona, Nai hatete ba Moisés nia ajudante, Josué, Nun nia oan,
verses.2: “Hau nia atan Moisés mate tiha ona. Nunee agora, o ho povu Israel hotu hamriik no hakur Jordaun hodi tama ba rai nebee Hau foo ba imi, nebee ba povu Israel.
verses.3: Fatin hotu nebee o sama ba, Hau foo ona ba o, hanesan Hau promete ona ba Moisés.
verses.4: O nia rai baliza hahuu hosi rai fuik, ba foho Líbanon, no too iha mota boot, nebee Mota Eufrates, no rai hotu hosi ema Hete sira, too iha Tasi Boot iha sorin loromonu.
verses.5: Durante o nia moris tomak la iha ema ida nebee bele hamriik hasoru o. Hau sei hamutuk ho o hanesan uluk Hau hamutuk ho Moisés. Hau sei la husik o ka haluha o.
verses.6: O tenki forti no brani, tanba o sei lori povu nee hodi fahe rai nee nudar liman rohan, rai nebee Hau promete ona ba sira nia bei-ala sira atu foo ba sira.
verses.7: Naran katak o tenki forti no brani tebe-tebes. O tenki iha kuidadu no halo tuir lei hotu nebee Hau nia atan Moisés manda ba o. Keta lao ba sorin loos ka ba sorin karuk. Nunee o sei hetan susesu iha fatin nebee deit mak o baa.
verses.8: Livru Lei Nian nee la bele sees hosi o nia ibun. O tenki medita ba livru nee loron-kalan, hodi o bele kuidadu atu halo tuir buat hotu nebee hakerek iha livru laran. Nunee o sei halo o nia dalan sai diak no o sei hetan susesu.
verses.9: Laos Hau manda ona o? O tenki forti no brani ba! O keta tauk ka hakfodak, tanba Hau mak Nai, o nia Maromak, nebee hamutuk ho o iha fatin nebee deit mak o baa.”
verses.10: Entaun Josué foo orden ba povu nia lideransa sira,
verses.11: “Lao liu akapamentu tomak hodi foo orden nee ba povu, no dehan, ‘Prepara bukae, tanba iha loron tolu tan imi tenki hakur Jordaun nee hodi baa hela iha rai nebee Nai, ita nia Maromak, foo ba imi.’”
verses.12: Josué hatete ba suku Ruben, suku Gad no suku Manasés sorin balu,
verses.13: “Hanoin di-diak! Nai nia atan, Moisés, nia liafuan nebee dehan, ‘Nai ita nia Maromak sei foo fatin deskansa no Nia foo rai ida nee.’
verses.14: Imi nia feen sira, imi nia oan sira, no imi nia animál hotu bele hela iha Jordaun nia rai sorin mai nee. Maibee imi nia ema forsa tenki prontu atu ba funu no baa uluk imi nia maun-alin sira no tulun sira,
verses.15: too sira tama ba hodi hela iha rai nebee Nai Maromak foo ona ba imi iha Jordaun nia sorin ba. Bainhira Nai foo ona deskansa ba povu Israel tomak, foin imi fila ba imi nia rai rasik iha Jordaun nia parte lorosae hodi hela iha nebaa, iha fatin nebee Maromak nia atan Moisés foo ba imi.”
verses.16: Entaun sira hataan ba Josué, no dehan, “Buat hotu nebee ita boot haruka ami halo, ami sei halo duni, no ba fatin hotu nebee ita boot haruka ami baa, ami sei baa duni.
verses.17: Ami sei halo tuir ita boot nia hakarak, hanesan mos uluk ami sempre halo tuir Moisés nia hakarak. Só Nai Maromak nebee hamutuk ho Moisés, sei hamutuk mos ho ita boot.
verses.18: Ema nebee kontra ita boot nia ukun fuan, no la halo tuir ita boot nia liafuan, nia sei hetan kastigu mate. Só deit tenki forti no brani ba.”

verses.1: Hosi akampamentu iha Sitim, Josué haruka nonook espiaun nain rua, no dehan, “Baa haree di-diak rai iha nebaa, liu-liu ba sidade Jerikó.” Entaun sira baa, no sira tama ba iha feto aat ida nia uma, feto nee naran Raab, no sira hela iha nebaa.
verses.2: No ema foo hatene ba liurai iha Jerikó, no dehan, “Tebes, iha kalan nee, ema rua hosi ema Israel sira mai hodi haree rai nee.”
verses.3: Entaun liurai Jerikó haruka ema baa Raab, no dehan, “Lori sai tiha ema sira nebee vizita o, no tama ba iha o nia uma laran nee, tanba sira mai hodi haree rai nee hotu.”
verses.4: Maibee Raab foti tiha ona mane rua nee no subar sira. Nia hataan, “Loos duni, ema balu mai iha hau nia uma, maibee hau la hatene sira mai hosi nebee.
verses.5: Bainhira iha oras taka portaun, no rai nakukun ona, mane sira nee sai ona. Hau la hatene sira baa nebee. Halai lalais, duni tuir sira, no imi bele hetan sira.”
verses.6: Maibee Raab lori tiha espiaun sira nee sae ba uma kakuluk nia leten no subar sira ho ai flaxu kain nebee nia aruma iha kakuluk leten.
verses.7: Entaun liurai nia ema sira nee baa ona. Bainhira sira sai hosi sidade, ema taka tiha portaun sidade nian. Sira buka espiaun nain rua nee too iha fatin atu hakur Jordaun.
verses.8: Molok espiaun nain rua nee toba, Raab sae ba uma leten hodi hatete ba sira,
verses.9: “Hau hatene katak Nai foo rai nee ba imi. Ema hotu iha rai nee tauk tebe-tebes imi, no mos ema hotu nebee hela iha sira nia rai nebaa nabeen iha imi nia oin.
verses.10: Tanba ami rona ona kona ba oinsaa Nai halo maran Tasi Teberau iha imi nia oin, bainhira imi sai hosi Ejitu. Ami mos rona oinsaa imi oho Seon ho Ogue, ema Amoreu sira nia liurai hosi Jordaun sorin ba.
verses.11: Bainhira ami rona liafuan nee, ami nia fuan laran nabeen, no mane sira nia espíritu halai lakon hotu tanba imi. Ema hotu-hotu iha nee sira nia brani lakon, tanba imi. Tanba Nai, imi nia Maromak, Nia mak Maromak iha lalehan iha leten no iha mundu iha okos.
verses.12: Nunee agora, favór ida, imi jura hodi Nai nia naran katak imi sei hatudu domin metin ba hau ho hau nia família sira, hanesan hau hatudu ona domin metin ba imi. Nee duni imi tenki foo sinál loos ida mai hau.
verses.13: Imi tenki promete katak imi sei la oho hau nia aman, hau nia inan, no buat hotu nebee sira nian, no imi sei salva ami hosi perigu atu mate nee.”
verses.14: Ema nain rua nee hataan, “Ami promete ho ami nia moris katak bainhira Nai entrega rai nee mai ami, mak ami sei hatudu domin metin no fidelidade ba imi, naran katak o la bele konta ba ema kona ba ami.”
verses.15: Tanba Raab nia uma harii iha moru sidade nian, no nia hela iha moru laran nee, entaun Raab hatuun ema nain rua nee ho tali hosi janela.
verses.16: Raab dehan ba sira nain rua “Imi baa tiha iha foho, hodi ema sira nebee duni imi la bele hetan imi. Subar iha nebaa iha loron tolu nia laran too sira fila, foin imi bele kontinua lao ba.”
verses.17: Mane rua nee hatete ba Raab, “Ami sei la simu sala kona ba juramentu nebee o husu ami jura nee.
verses.18: Só tebes, bainhira ami tama mai rai nee, o tenki kesi tali mean nee iha janela, iha fatin nebee o hatuun ami ba nee. O tenki halibur o nia inan-aman, o nia maun-alin sira, no o nia aman nia uma kain hotu iha o nia uma nee.
verses.19: Se ema ruma sai hosi uma nee, entaun ninia raan sei monu ba ninia ulun fatuk rasik. Ami la simu sala nee. Maibee see-see deit nebee hein ho o iha uma nee, se liman ida kona nia, nunee ninia raan monu ba ami nia ulun fatuk.
verses.20: No se o konta buat nebee ami halo nee, entaun ami sei sai hosi juramentu nebee o husu ami jura nee.”
verses.21: Raab hataan, “Husik buat nee tuir imi nia liafuan.” Depois sira baa. No Raab kesi tali mean iha janela nee.
verses.22: Mane sira nee sai ba no tama ba foho no hela iha nebaa too loron tolu, too ema nebee duni sira fila ona. Ema sira nebee duni sira buka ba-mai iha dalan hotu, maibee la hetan sira.
verses.23: Depois mane nain rua nee fila tuun hosi foho no hakur mota hodi fila ba Josué, oan hosi Nun. Sira nain rua konta buat hotu nebee sira hasoru.
verses.24: Depois sira hatete ba Josué, “Loos duni, Nai foo ona rai nee hotu mai ita nia liman. Tanba ema hotu nebee hela iha rai nebaa sai nabeen tanba ita.”

verses.1: Josué ho ema Israel hotu hadeer dadeer-saan nakukun. Sira sai hosi Sitim no baa too iha Jordaun. Sira halo akampamentu iha nebaa, molok sira hakur mota.
verses.2: Liu tiha loron tolu, lider sira lao ba-mai iha akampamentu laran nee,
verses.3: no foo orden ba povu Israel nunee, “Bainhira imi haree saserdote sira lori Arka Aliansa, nebee Nai ita nia Maromak nian, prepara atu sai hosi fatin nee no tuir Arka.
verses.4: Maibee husik espasu entre imi no Arka, nebee dook maizoumenus kilometru ida. Keta tuir besik. Nunee imi bele hatene dalan nebee imi tenki lao tuir, tanba imi seidauk liu hosi dalan ida nee.
verses.5: Josué dehan ba povu, “Konsagra aan tanba aban Nai sei halo milagre boot iha imi nia leet.”
verses.6: Depois Josué koalia ba saserdote sira no dehan, “Foti Arka Aliansa nee, no lao liu, uluk povu.” Nunee sira foti Arka Aliansa no lao uluk povu.
verses.7: Nai Maromak hatete ba Josué, “Ohin loron, Hau sei komesa halo o sai ema boot iha Israel hotu nia oin. Nunee sira sei hatene katak Hau hamutuk ho o hanesan uluk Hau hamutuk ho Moisés.
verses.8: O sei foo orden ba saserdote sira nebee lori Arka Aliansa nee, no dehan, ‘Bainhira imi too iha Mota Jordaun nia ninin imi tenki hein hamriik iha mota Jordaun nee.’”
verses.9: Depois Josué dehan ba povu Israel, “Mai iha nee hodi rona liafuan hosi Nai, ita nia Maromak.”
verses.10: Depois Josué hatete, “Nunee ita sei hatene katak Maromak Moris mak iha imi nia leet no Nia sei duni sai ema Kanaan, ema Hiti, ema Heveu, ema Perizeu, ema Girgase, ema Amoreu, no ema Jebuseu.
verses.11: Tebes, Arka Aliansa nebee Nai nian, nebee Nai ba mundu tomak, Arka nee sei hakur Jordaun iha imi nia oin.
verses.12: Agora, hili mane sanulu resin rua hosi suku sira iha Israel. Hili ema ida kada suku ida.
verses.13: Kuandu saserdote sira nebee lori Nai nia Arka, nebee Nai ba mundu tomak, tau ain ba iha bee laran iha Jordaun, nunee bee iha mota Jordaun nebee iha kraik sei sai ketak hosi bee nebee suli tuun hosi leten. No bee nebee suli mai sei para kedas no sai aas iha fatin ida.”
verses.14: Entaun, bainhira povu Israel husik sira nia tenda fatin hodi hakur Jordaun hamutuk ho saserdote sira nebee lori Arka Aliansa iha povu nia oin,
verses.15: no bainhira sira nebee lori Arka foin too ona iha Jordaun ibun, sira tau sira nia ain ba bee laran, (iha tempu nee, tempu kolheta, no hanesan baibain mota boot no nakonu resin hosi sorin ba sorin)
verses.16: katak bee nebee suli tuun para kedas, no parte leten sae aas iha fatin dook, nebee iha sidade Adão, nebee iha sidade Zaretan nia sorin. No bee nebee suli tuun ba parte kraik, nebee tuun ba Tasi Mate iha rai Araba, bee sira nee mos ketak. Entaun povu hakur ba iha fatin besik Jerikó.
verses.17: Saserdote sira nebee lori Arka Aliansa hamriik metin iha rai maran iha Jordaun nia klaran. No ema Israel hotu hakur ba iha rai maran. Nunee povu hotu hakur Jordaun.

verses.1: Bainhira povu Israel hotu hakur ona Jordaun, Nai hatete ba Josué, no dehan,
verses.2: “Hili ema sanulu resin rua hosi povu nee, nebee ema ida hosi suku ida-idak.
verses.3: Foo orden ba sira, no dehan, ‘Foti fatuk sanulu resin rua hosi Jordaun nia klaran, iha fatin nebee saserdote sira hamriik. Lori fatuk sira nee no tau iha fatin nebee imi atu hela orsida kalan.’”
verses.4: Entaun Josué bolu ema nain sanulu resin rua nebee hili ona nee hosi ema Israel sira, nebee ema ida hosi suku ida-idak.
verses.5: Josué dehan ba sira, “Imi hakur Jordaun iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia Arka nia oin. No iha Jordaun klaran, ema ida-idak tenki foti fatuk ida hodi hasaan ba, tuir suku sanulu resin rua hosi ema Israel sira.
verses.6: Fatuk sira nee sei sai sinál iha imi nia leet. No aban-bainrua, bainhira imi nia oan sira husu, ‘Fatuk sira nee iha signifika saida?’,
verses.7: imi bele hatete ba sira, ‘Bee nebee suli iha mota Jordaun para tiha iha Nai nia Arka Aliansa nia oin. Bainhira Arka nee hakur Jordaun, nunee mota Jordaun para. No fatuk sira nee sei foo hanoin nafatin ba ema Israel sira too tinan ba tinan.’”
verses.8: Ema Israel sira halo tuir Josué nia orden. Sira foti fatuk hosi Jordaun klaran, tuir buat nebee Nai Maromak dehan ona ba Josué, nebee tuir suku sira nee hosi ema Israel sira. Sira hakur ho fatuk no lori ba tau iha sira nia hela fatin.
verses.9: Josué mos hada fatuk sanulu resin rua iha Jordaun nia klaran, iha fatin nebee saserdote sira nebee lori Arka Aliansa mak hamriik. Fatuk sira nee sei iha nebaa too ohin loron.
verses.10: Tanba saserdote sira nebee lori arka nee hamriik iha Jordaun nia klaran too ema sira nee halo buat hotu nebee Nai haruka sira halo liu hosi Josué. Sira halo buat sira nee tuir instrusaun sira nebee Moisés foo ba Josué. No povu nee hakur ba lalais.
verses.11: Bainhira povu hotu hakur ona mota nee, Arka Aliansa mos hakur ba ho saserdote sira iha povu nia oin.
verses.12: Ema Ruben, ema Gad no suku sorin hosi Manasés hakur ba ho armas funu nian, iha ema Israel sira nia oin, hanesan Moisés koalia ona ba sira.
verses.13: Maizoumenus ema nain rihun haat-nulu (40.000), nebee prontu atu funu hakur mota iha Nai nia oin hodi halo funu no sira baa iha rai tetuk besik Jerikó.
verses.14: Iha loron nee, Nai halo povu Israel hotu respeita Josué nudar ema boot ida. No iha Josué nia moris tomak, sira respeita nia hanesan sira respeita Moisés.
verses.15: Depois Nai koalia ho Josué, no dehan,
verses.16: “Foo orden ba saserdote sira nebee lori Arka Aliansa nee hodi sae mai ona hosi Jordaun.”
verses.17: Nunee Josué foo orden ba saserdote sira, “Sae mai hosi Jordaun.”
verses.18: Bainhira saserdote sira nebee lori Arka Aliansa Nai nian sai ona hosi Jordaun klaran, no sira nia ain too ona iha mota ibun, bee mota Jordaun nian nee fila fali baa sira nia fatin, too mota ibun mos iha bee nakonu resin.
verses.19: Nunee povu Israel sai hosi Jordaun iha loron ba dala sanulu, iha fulan primeiru, no sira halo akampamentu iha Gilgal, nebee iha Jerikó nia baliza iha sorin lorosae.
verses.20: Iha fatin nebaa, Josué hada fatuk sanulu resin rua nebee foti hosi Jordaun.
verses.21: Depois Josué hatete ba ema Israel sira, no dehan, “Aban-bainrua, bainhira imi nia oan sira husu ba imi, no dehan, ‘Saida mak fatuk sira nee?’
verses.22: nunee imi sei foo hatene ba imi nia oan sira, no dehan, “Israel hakur Jordaun nee iha rai maran.’
verses.23: Tanba Nai, imi nia Maromak, halo maran tiha mota Jordaun nee iha imi nia oin, too imi hotu hakur ba, hanesan Nia halo ba Tasi Teberau, nebee sai maran iha ita nia oin, too ami hakur ba.
verses.24: Atu nunee ema hotu-hotu iha mundu bele hatene katak Nai nia liman mak forti. Ho nunee imi bele hamtauk Nai, imi nia Maromak, too rohan laek.

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, bainhira ema Amoreu sira nia liurai hotu nebee hela iha Jordaun nia sorin loro monu, no ema Kanaan nia liurai sira hotu nebee hela besik Tasi Mediterániu, rona katak Nai hamaran Jordaun iha ema Israel sira nia oin, too sira hakur mota nee, nunee sira hotu tauk no nakdedar tanba ema Israel.
verses.2: Iha tempu nebaa, Nai hatete ba Josué dehan, “Halo tudik kroat hosi fatuk, depois halo sirkunsizaun fali ba ema Israel ba dala rua.”
verses.3: Entaun Josué halo tudik kroat hosi fatuk no halo sirkunsizaun ba ema Israel sira iha fatin ida naran Foho Sirkunsizaun.
verses.4: Josué halo sirkunsizaun tanba ema hotu nebee sai hosi Ejitu, nebee mane sira hotu nebee hatene halo funu, sira mate tiha iha dalan iha rai fuik.
verses.5: No ema hotu nebee lao sai nee hetan sirkunsizaun tiha ona. Maibee ema hotu nebee moris iha rai fuik, bainhira sira lao iha dalan nebee sai hosi Ejitu, ema sira nee seidauk hetan sirkunsizaun.
verses.6: Tanba ema Israel sira lao durante tinan haat-nulu iha rai fuik. Sira lao too ema hotu nebee hatene halo funu, nebee sai hosi Ejitu, mak lakon ona. Tanba sira la halo tuir Nai nia lian. No Nai jura ba sira katak Nia sei la hatudu rai nee ba sira, rai nebee Nia jura ba sira nia bei-ala sira atu foo ba ita, rai nebee suli ho susu been no bani been.
verses.7: Nunee Josué halo sirkunsizaun ba sira nia oan sira, nebee Maromak harii hodi troka sira. Tanba sira nia oan mane hotu seidauk hetan sirkunsizaun, tanba sira la halo sirkunsizaun iha dalan.
verses.8: Bainhira Josué halo ona sirkunsizaun ba sira hotu, sira hela iha akampamentu too sira nia kanek diak.
verses.9: Nai hatete ba Josué, dehan, “Ohin loron, Hau hasai ona imi nia moe hosi Ejitu”. Tanba nee mak fatin nee tau naran Gilgal, no naran nee iha too ohin loron.
verses.10: Ema Israel sira hela dadauk iha Gilgal, iha rai tetuk besik Jerikó, no sira selebra Paskua iha loron sanulu resin haat fulan nee.
verses.11: Iha loron tuir mai, sira haan ai haan hosi rezultadu rai Kanaan. Sira haan paun nebee la tau fermentu no batar tunu iha loron nee kedas.
verses.12: Iha tempu nee, maná mos la monu tan hosi loro leten ona. Ema Israel la haan tan maná. Iha tinan nee, sira haan rezultadu hosi rai Kanaan.
verses.13: Bainhira Josué besik sidade Jerikó, nia foti ninia matan no nia haree, no tebes, iha mane ida nebee kaer hela surik ida iha ninia liman, no hamriik hasoru Josué. Josué baa besik ema nee no husu, “Ita mak suporta ami ka ami nia inimigu sira?”
verses.14: Ema nee hataan, “Laos; maibee hau mak komandante hosi forsa Nai nian. Agora hau mai ona.” No Josué hakneak ho oin ba rai hodi adora ema nee. Josué hatete, “Ita boot hatete saida ba ita boot nia atan hau?”
verses.15: Komandante ba forsa Nai nian hatete ba Josué, “Hasai tiha o nia sandálias hosi o nia ain, tanba rai nebee o hamriik ba nee mak santu.” No Josué halo tuir.

verses.1: Iha sidade Jerikó, sira taka metin portaun tanba ema Israel sira. No la foo ema ida tama-sai sidade nee.
verses.2: Nai hatete ba Josué dehan, “Agora Hau entrega Jerikó ba o nia liman, hamutuk ho liurai iha nebaa, no nia tropas asuwain sira hotu.
verses.3: O ho o nia tropas sira tenki marxa haleu sidade nee dala ida kada loron ida, durante loron neen.
verses.4: Saserdote nain hitu sei lori bibi aman dikur iha Arka Aliansa nia oin. Bainhira too ona loron hitu, imi tenki haleu sidade nee dala hitu no saserdote sira sei huu sira nia bibi aman dikur.
verses.5: Tuir mai, saserdote sira nee tenki huu bibi aman dikur halo lian kleur. Bainhira imi rona bibi aman dikur nia lian kleur nunee, tropas sira tenki hakilar makaas, nunee moru sidade nee sei monu rahun tiha. No imi hotu tenki halai sae kedas, no ema ida-idak sei tama loos deit.”
verses.6: Josué bolu saserdote sira, no hatete, “Foti Arka Aliansa nee. Hosi imi, ema nain hitu tenki lao iha Arka Aliansa nia oin lori bibi aman dikur.”
verses.7: Depois Josué haruka nia tropas sira marxa haleu sidade nee, no eskoltu sira lao uluk iha Nai nia Arka Aliansa nia oin.
verses.8: Tuir mai, bainhira Josué koalia tiha ona ba povu nee, katak saserdote sira nebee lori bibi aman dikur, lao liu iha Nai nia oin, no sira huu bibi aman dikur nee. No Nai nia Arka Aliansa tuir sira.
verses.9: Eskoltu sira lao uluk saserdote sira nebee huu bibi aman dikur nee, no ikus mai eskoltu sira tuir hosi Arka nia kotuk. No saserdote sira lao ba oin no huu hela sira nia bibi aman dikur.
verses.10: Depois Josué foo orden ba povu dehan, “Ema ida la bele hakilar, la bele halo lian ida no la bele koalia liafuan ida, too loron nebee hau haruka imi hakilar, depois imi sei hakilar.”
verses.11: Nunee Nai nia Arka hadulas sidade nee dala ida. Depois sira fila fali ba akampamentu, no toba kalan ida iha nebaa.
verses.12: Iha loron tuir mai, Josué hadeer iha dadeer-saan nakukun, no saserdote sira foti Nai nia Arka.
verses.13: Saserdote nain hitu lori bibi aman dikur hitu iha Nai nia Arka nia oin, no sira lao ba oin nafatin deit no huu hela bibi aman dikur nee. Eskoltu sira lao iha oin, no tropas tuir Nai nia Arka nia kotuk. Sira lao ba oin no huu hela sira nia bibi aman dikur.
verses.14: Iha loron segundu, sira lao haleu sidade dala ida depois sira fila ba akampamentu. Sira halo hanesan nee loro-loron durante loron neen nia laran.
verses.15: Iha loron hitu sira hadeer dadeer-saan, bainhira loro matan foin atu sae, no sira lao haleu sidade nee dala hitu ho maneira nebee hanesan. Só iha loron nee sira haleu sidade dala hitu.
verses.16: Depois, iha loron hitu, bainhira saserdote sira huu bibi aman dikur, Josué dehan ba povu, “Hakilar ba! Tanba Nai entrega ona sidade nee ba imi!
verses.17: Tenki halo rahun tiha sidade nee hotu, hamutuk ho buat hotu-hotu nebee iha sidade laran, hanesan oferta ba Nai. Só husik moris deit Raab, feto luroon nee ho ninia uma kain, tanba nia subar ita nia espiaun sira nebee ita haruka ona.
verses.18: Maibee imi tenki proteje aan hosi buat nebee iha malisan nee. Keta halo be ita hetan malisan tanba ema foti buat ruma hosi fatin malisan nee, no imi foo fali malisan ba akampamentu Israel no kria problema.
verses.19: Sasaan hotu nebee osan mutin, osan mean, riti no besi nee konsagra ona ba Nai. Sira tenki tama ba tezourária Nai nian.”
verses.20: Nunee povu hakilar bainhira saserdote sira huu bibi aman dikur. No tuir mai, bainhira povu rona lian hosi bibi aman dikur, no povu nee haklalak ho lian makaas, katak sidade nia moru monu rahun tiha. No povu sae kedas no tama ba sidade laran. Ema ida-idak sae loos deit, no sira hadau sidade nee.
verses.21: Buat hotu nebee iha sidade laran nee, feto-mane, katuas-ferik, labarik no ema idade, karau, bibi no kuda buru mos, sira oho hotu ho surik.
verses.22: Maibee Josué hatete ba ema nain rua nebee hafuhu ona rai nee, no nia dehan, “Imi tama baa iha feto luroon nia uma, no lori sai mai feto nee ho nia uma kain tomak, tuir buat nebee imi jura ona ba nia.”
verses.23: Entaun joven nain rua nee, nebee espiaun sira tama ba, no lori sai Raab hamutuk ho nia inan-aman, nia maun-alin sira, no nia uma kain tomak. Sira lori sai ninia família hotu no husik iha akampamentu Israel nian, iha akampamentu liur.
verses.24: Tuir mai, povu Israel sunu motuk tiha sidade nee ho buat hotu-hotu iha sidade laran. Só sira la sunu osan mutin, osan mean, no sasaan nebee halo ho riti no besi. Sasaan sira nee sira iha tezourária Nai nian.
verses.25: Nunee Josué salva feto luroon Raab nee no husik nia moris hamutuk ho ninia aman nia família hotu ho buat hotu nebee nia iha. No nia hela iha Israel laran too ohin loron. Tanba nia subar espiaun sira nebee Josué haruka baa hafuhu Jerikó nee.
verses.26: Iha tempu nee Josué haruka sira tama juramentu, no nia dehan, “See mak hakarak hamriik no harii fali sidade Jerikó nee, Nai sei foo malisan ba nia:
verses.27: Nunee Nai hamutuk ho Josué, no Josué nia naran sai boot iha rai nee tomak.

verses.1: Maibee povu Israel halo sala kona ba sasaan nebee bandu ona. Akan, oan hosi Karmi, ida nee oan hosi Zinri, no ida nee oan hosi Zera, hosi suku Judá, foti sasaan balu nebee bandu ona. Tanba nunee Nai hirus makaas hasoru povu Israel.
verses.2: Josué haruka mane balu hosi Jerikó baa too sidade Ai, nebee besik Bete-Aven, iha área lorosae hosi sidade Betél. Josué hatete ba sira, “Imi sae ba, hafuhu rai iha nebaa.” Entaun sira sae ba no hafuhu Ai.
verses.3: Bainhira sira fila-fali, sira koalia ba Josué, “La presiza tropas tomak baa ataka Ai. Haruka deit nain rihun rua ka tolu. Keta halo kole tropas tomak. Povu Ai nian la barak.”
verses.4: Nee duni ema nain rihun tolu sae ba maibee sira la konsege manaan no sira halai namkari hosi ema Ai.
verses.5: Ema Ai sira oho sira nain tolu-nulu resin neen. Ema Ai sira halai tuir sira hahuu hosi sidade nia portaun too iha Sebarim, no ataka sira bainhira sira halai tuun foho. Ho nunee, povu Israel sira lakon brani no senti tauk.
verses.6: Nunee Josué, hamutuk ho Israel nia lideransa sira seluk, lees sira nia hena no taka rabat oin kona rai iha Nai nia Arka oin, no hela hanesan nee too rai nakaras.
verses.7: Josué hatete, “Ah, Oh Nai Maromak, tanba saa mak O halo povu nee liu Jordaun, hodi monu iha povu Amoreu sira nia liman no halakon ami? Diak liu ami hela deit iha Jordaun nia sorin seluk nebaa.
verses.8: Oh Nai, agora hau atu koalia saida, bainhira povu Israel lakon ba sira nia inimigu sira?
verses.9: Ema Kanaan sira no povu sira seluk hosi rai nee sei rona nunee, sira sei mai haleu ami no halakon ami nia naran hosi mundu. Depois, oinsaa kona ba O nia naran boot, O sei halo saida?”
verses.10: Nai hatete ba Josué, “Hamriik ba! Tanba saa mak o taka rabat hela iha nebaa?
verses.11: Israel halo sala ona. Sira kontra ona aliansa nebee hau haruka sira atu tuir. Sira foti sasaan nebee hau bandu ona, sira naok sasaan nee, sira bosok no subar hamutuk ho sira nia sasaan.
verses.12: Tanba nee ema Israel la konsege hasoru hodi manaan sira nia inimigu; sira halai hosi inimigu tanba sira hetan malisan. Hau sei la hamutuk tan ho imi se karik imi la hasai buat ruma nebee bandu nian hosi imi nia leet.
verses.13: Hamriik ba! Hamoos tiha povu. Hatete ba sira, ‘Imi hamoos tiha imi nia aan hodi prepara ba aban, tanba Nai, Israel nia Maromak, hatete nunee, “Israel, iha sasaan ruma iha imi nia leet nebee Hau bandu. Imi sei la bele hasoru hodi manaan imi nia inimigu too imi hasai tiha sasaan nebee bandu hosi iha imi nia leet.”
verses.14: Aban dadeer imi aprezenta imi nia aan, kada suku ida ba idak. Suku nebee Nai fihir sei mai iha oin, kada família ida ba idak; família nebee Nai fihir sei mai iha oin, kada uma kain ida ba idak; no uma kain nebee Nai fihir sei mai iha oin, kada ema ida ba idak.
verses.15: Ema ida nebee imi hetan ho sasaan nebee bandu, imi sei sunu nia hamutuk ho ninia sasaan hotu. Tanba nia kontra Nai nia aliansa no nia halo buat ida nebee foer iha Israel nia leet.’”
verses.16: Iha dadeer-saan tuir mai, Josué hadeer no bolu povu Israel sira mai iha oin tuir ida-idak nia suku. Nai fihir suku Judá.
verses.17: Tuir mai uma kain hosi suku Judá ida-idak mai iha oin, no Nai fihir uma família Zerahitas sira nian. Família ida nee mai iha oin kada uma kain ida ba idak, no uma kain nebee Nai fihir mak Zinri nian.
verses.18: Josué haruka uma kain Zinri nian mai iha oin, kada ema ida ba idak, no Nai fihir ema ida naran Akan, oan hosi Carmi, ida nee oan hosi Zinri, ida nee oan hosi Zera, hosi suku Judá.
verses.19: Josué hatete ba Akan, “Hau nia oan, agora, foo onra ba Nai, Israel nia Maromak, no konfesa ba Nia. Hatete mai hau saida mak o halo; keta subar buat ida hosi hau.”
verses.20: Akan hataan, “Tebes duni katak hau halo sala kontra Nai, Israel nia Maromak. Buat nebee hau halo mak nee:
verses.21: bainhira hau haree iha sasaan nia leet hena ida nebee halo iha Babilónia, no mos osan mutin kilu rua ho balu, no mos osan mean pedasuk kabelak ida ho grama atus neen, hau kaan sasaan nee no foti mai hau. Hau subar iha rai okos iha hau nia tenda laran, ho osan mutin iha okos liu.”
verses.22: Josué haruka mane balu baa lalais too iha tenda nee. Sira hetan sasaan hirak nebee subar iha Akan nia tenda nee, ho osan mutin iha kraik liu.
verses.23: Sira hasai sasaan no lori ba Josué no ba povu Israel tomak nebee halibur iha nebaa, no tau sasaan nee iha Nai nia oin.
verses.24: Tuir mai Josué, hamutuk ho povu Israel tomak, lori Akan, bei-oan hosi Zera, hamutuk ho osan mutin, hena, osan mean, nia oan sira mane no feto, nia karau sira, kuda buru sira, bibi malae sira, nia tenda no buat hotu-hotu nebee nia iha, ba fatin ida naran Foho Leet Akor.
verses.25: Josué hatete, “Tanba saa mak o lori susar ida nee mai ami? Ohin Nai sei lori mai susar ba o.” No povu Israel tomak tuda fatuk oho nia, no depois tuda mos nia família hotu. Israel sira sunu sira no tuda fatuk oho sira.
verses.26: Iha Akan nia mate-isin nia leten sira tau fatuk barak too forma foho oan ida, nebee too ohin sei iha nebaa hela. Nunee, Nai nia hirus makaas lakon tiha. Tanba nunee mak fatin nebaa hanaran Foho Leet Akor, naran nebee hela too ohin loron.

verses.1: Nai hatete ba Josué, “Keta tauk! Keta lakon brani! Lori tropas tomak hamutuk ho o no sae ba sidade Ai. Hau entrega liurai Ai nian iha o nia liman, hamutuk ho ninia povu, ninia sidade no rai.
verses.2: Buat nebee o halo ho sidade Jerikó ho nia liurai, halo hanesan ho sidade Ai ho nia liurai. Maibee sasaan no animál sira hosi sidade Ai imi bele foti ba imi. Halo emboskada ida hosi sidade nia kotuk.”
verses.3: Nee duni, Josué no tropas tomak prepara hodi sae ba no ataka sidade Ai. Nia hili soldadu ho forsa no laran forti nain rihun tolu-nulu no haruka sira iha kalan.
verses.4: Nia foo orden ba sira tuir mai nee, “Rona di-diak! Imi prepara emboskada hosi sidade nia kotuk, no la bele hadook aan barak liu hosi sidade nee. Imi hotu tenki matan moris.
verses.5: Hau ho sira hotu nebee hamutuk ho hau sei hakbesik ba sidade. Bainhira tropas Ai mai ataka ami, hanesan sira halo dahuluk, ami sei halai hosi sira.
verses.6: Sira sei halai tuir ami, no ami sei halai nafatin too ami atrai sira baa dook hosi sidade. Sira sei hanoin, ‘Sira halai hosi ita hanesan sira halo dahuluk.’ Nunee, bainhira ami halai hosi sira.
verses.7: Depois imi sei sae hosi emboskada no ataka sidade. Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei entrega sidade iha imi nia liman.
verses.8: Hafoin imi manaan tiha sidade, imi sei tau ahi iha nia. Halo tuir hanesan Nai foo orden ba imi. Rona di-diak hau nia instrusaun sira nee.”
verses.9: Nee duni Josué haruka sira. Sira baa no halo emboskada entre sidade Betél no sidade Ai – iha parte loromonu hosi Ai. Maibee Josué hela kalan nebaa hamutuk ho povu.
verses.10: Iha dadeer-saan tuir mai, Josué hadeer no pasa revista ba tropas sira. Depois nia sae ba Ai hamutuk ho lideransa Israel sira seluk, iha tropas sira nia oin.
verses.11: Tropas funu nain sira hotu nebee hamutuk ho nia marxa hodi avansa ba sidade. Sira hakbesik ba Ai hosi sidade nia oin, no prepara sira nia akampamentu iha parte norte sidade nian. Foho leet ida haketak sira hosi sidade.
verses.12: Josué tau iha pozisaun emboskada soldadu sira nain rihun lima, entre sidade Betél no sidade Ai, iha parte loromonu sidade nian.
verses.13: Bainhira tropas sira hotu hela metin iha sira pozisaun, sira nebee iha akampamentu iha parte norte hosi sidade, no sira nebee iha emboskada iha parte loromonu hosi sidade, iha kalan nebaa, Josué baa iha foho leet klaran.
verses.14: Tuir fali mai, bainhira liurai sidade Ai nian haree tiha nunee, nia hamutuk ho mane sira hotu hosi sidade book aan lalais no iha dadeer-saan sedu sira sai atu baa funu hasoru Israel, tuir oras, iha fatin ida nebee sira bele haree hetan Araba. Maibee sira la hatene kona ba emboskada nebee prepara hela iha sidade nia kotuk.
verses.15: Josué no tropas Israel tomak finji lakon fali no halai hosi sira ba diresaun rai fuik.
verses.16: Mane sira hotu hosi sidade Ai hetan orden atu halai tuir tropas Israel. Sira halai tuir Josué too sira dook hosi sidade.
verses.17: Mane ida la hela iha sidade Ai no sidade Betél. Hotu-hotu halai tuir Israel. Sira husik sidade nakloke hodi ba halai tuir Israel.
verses.18: Nunee, Nai hatete ba Josué, “Foti dima nebee iha o nia liman ba diresaun Ai, tanba hau sei entrega sidade nee iha o nia liman.” Entaun Josué foti dima nebee iha nia liman ba diresaun Ai.
verses.19: Hafoin nia halo nunee, mane sira nebee prepara hela iha emboskada hamriik hosi sira nia pozisaun no halai hodi tama iha sidade. Sira manaan tiha sidade no lalais sira tau ahi iha nia.
verses.20: Bainhira mane sira hosi Ai haree ba kotuk no haree hetan ahi suar sae hosi sidade ba loro leten, sira la hatene atu halai ba nebee, tanba tropas Israel nebee sira halai tuir agora mai hodi hasoru sira.
verses.21: Bainhira Josué no Israel tomak haree katak mane sira nebee iha emboskada manaan tiha ona sidade, no ahi suar sae ona hosi sidade, sira fila hodi mai ataka mane sira hosi Ai.
verses.22: Sira nebee manaan sidade mos mai hodi ataka tropas Ai. Nunee, tropas Ai iha klaran, tropas Israel haleu sira hosi oin no kotuk. Israel oho sira hotu, ema ida mos la moris no la halai.
verses.23: Maibee sira la oho Ai nia liurai, sira kaer nia no lori ba Josué.
verses.24: Tuir fali mai, bainhira Israel oho tiha mane hotu hosi sidade Ai iha kampu funu nian no iha rai fuik, iha fatin nebee sira halai, no bainhira sira hotu monu mate liu hosi surik, Israel sira hotu fila fali ba sidade no oho sira nebee hela iha nebaa.
verses.25: Mane ho feto hamutuk nain rihun sanulu resin rua mate iha loron nebaa, nebee povu hotu hosi sidade Ai.
verses.26: Josué la husik nia dima too konsege oho ema sira hotu hosi sidade Ai.
verses.27: Povu Israel foti ba sira animál no sasaan hosi sidade Ai, tuir Nai nia liafuan nebee Nia foo ba Josué.
verses.28: Depois, Josué sunu Ai, halo hanesan foho oan ida too rohan laek, fatin abandonadu too ohin loron.
verses.29: Nia tara liurai Ai nian iha ai huun ida no husik nia iha nebaa too loro monu. Depois, bainhira loro matan mout ona, Josué foo orden hodi hasai mate isin hosi ai huun no soe iha sidade Ai nia odamatan oin. Sira tau fatuk barak iha mate isin nia leten too forma bou boot ida, nebee hela too ohin loron.
verses.30: Nunee, Josué harii altár ida ba Nai, Israel nia Maromak, iha foho Ebal,
verses.31: tuir orden hosi Nai nia atan Moisés ba povu Israel sira. Nia halo tuir instrusaun nebee hakerek iha Livru Lei Moisés nian: harii altár ho fatuk nebee la fera ho besi kroat ruma. Iha altár nee nia leten sira oferese ba Nai sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu dame nian.
verses.32: Iha nebaa, iha povu Israel nia oin, Josué hakerek halo kópia ida iha fatuk sira, Lei nebee Moisés hakerek uluk.
verses.33: Povu Israel tomak, inklui mos ema estranjeiru ho rai nain sira, hamutuk mos ho nain ulun sira, ema boot no juis sira, sira hotu hamriik iha Arka nia sorin loos ho karuk, iha saserdote Levita sira nia oin, sira nebee tula Nai nia Arka Aliansa. Povu nia sorin balu hamriik iha foho Gerizim nia oin, no sorin balu seluk iha foho Ebal nia oin. Buat hotu-hotu sira halo tuir orden nebee Nai nia atan Moisés foo ona uluk, hodi nunee povu Israel bele simu bénsaun.
verses.34: Tuir mai Josué lee liafuan hotu-hotu hosi Lei, bénsaun no maldisaun, tuir buat hotu nebee hakerek iha Livru Lei nian.
verses.35: La iha liafuan ida hosi Moisés nia orden nebee Josué la lee ba povu Israel tomak nebee halibur iha nebaa, inklui mos feto sira, labarik sira, no ema estranjeiru sira nebee hela ho sira.
