verses.40: Nunee duni nia hatete ba ema Israel hotu, “Imi hotu hamriik iha sorin ida no hau ho hau nia oan Jonatan hamriik iha sorin seluk.” Depois povu Israel sira hataan ba Saul, “Halo tuir buat nebee ita boot hanoin diak.”
verses.41: Depois Saul dehan, “Nai, Israel nia Maromak, tanba saa mak O la hataan ba O nia atan hau iha loron ida nee? Se karik sala nee iha hau ka iha hau nia oan, Oh Nai, Israel nia Maromak, hatudu Urim ba hau; karik sala nee iha O nia povu Israel sira, hatudu Tumim ba.” Depois sira hetan Jonatan ho Saul, maibee povu sira la iha.
verses.42: Saul hatete, “Dada rifa ba hau no hau nia oan.” Bainhira sira dada rifa sira hetan Jonatan.
verses.43: Saul hatete ba Jonatan, “Foo hatene mai hau buat nebee o halo tiha ona.” Depois Jonatan foo hatene nia, katak, “Loos, hau koko tiha ona bani been uitoan ho hau nia ai tonka nia tutun. Hau mak nee; hau prontu atu mate.”
verses.44: Saul dehan, “Hanesan nee mak Maromak kastigu hau, no mos liu tan nee. Tebes duni, Jonatan, o tenki mate.”
verses.45: Maibee povu hatete ba Saul, “Tanba saa mak Jonatan tenki mate? Nia lori ona salvasaun boot ba povu Israel. La bele! Hodi Nai nebee moris, Jonatan nia fuuk lahan ida la bele monu ba rai. Tanba ohin loron nia servisu ho Maromak.” Nunee povu salva Jonatan, no nia la mate.
verses.46: Bainhira sira duni tiha ona ema Filisteu, Saul fila fali. Ema Filisteu sira nee mos fila fali ba sira nia fatin.
verses.47: Bainhira Saul simu knaar nudar liurai ba povu Israel, nia funu hasoru too iha ninia inimigu sira nia fronteira hotu. Nia hasoru Moab, Amon, Edom, liurai sira hosi Zoba no ema Filisteu sira. No iha nebee deit mak nia halo funu nia manaan.
verses.48: Nia halibur forsa ida no nia halakon ema Amalek. No nia lori sai fali ema Israel hosi ema nebee hadau ona sira.
verses.49: Saul nia oan mane mak Jonatan, Isvi no Malkisua. Nia oan feto nain rua nia naran: ida primeiru naran Merabe, no ida segundu naran Mikal.
verses.50: Saul nia kaben naran: Ainoa, oan feto hosi Ahimaaz. Nia komandante funu naran Abner, oan hosi Ner, Saul nia tiu.
verses.51: Kis mak Saul nia aman. Ner, nebee Abner nia apaa, mak oan hosi Abiel.
verses.52: Durante Saul nia tempu tomak, nia halo funu makaas hasoru ema Filisteu. No bainhira Saul haree ema forti ida ka ema ida nebee iha forsa, nia foti ema nee hodi baa hamutuk ho nia.

verses.1: Samuel dehan ba Saul, “Nai haruka ona hau mai hodi konsagra ita sai liurai ba Nia povu Israel. Tanba nee, rona lai Nai nia liafuan.
verses.2: Nai Forsa Nain hatete, ‘Hau sei selu fali saida mak ema Amalek halo ona ba ema Israel. Tanba ema Amalek taka dalan ba ema Israel bainhira sira atu sai hosi Ejitu.
verses.3: Agora, baa no oho ema Amalek. Halakon sira hotu, la husik buat ida. Oho mane no feto, labarik no bebee, karau no bibi, kuda kamelu no kuda buru.’”
verses.4: Saul bolu povu mai hamutuk no sura sira iha Telaim: iha soldadu nain rihun atus rua (200.000) nebee lao deit, no ema Judá nain rihun sanulu (10.000).
verses.5: Bainhira Saul too ona iha sidade Amalek, nia hein subar iha mota.
verses.6: Saul dehan ba ema Keni, “Lao ba ona. Sai hosi ema Amalek sira nia leet. Nunee hau la bele halakon imi hamutuk ho ema Amalek. Laos imi hatudu ona imi nia domin metin ba ema Israel hotu, bainhira sira sai hosi Ejitu?” Entaun ema Keni sai hosi ema Amalek sira nia leet.
verses.7: Nunee Saul oho ema Amalek hosi Havila too Sur iha Ejitu nia sorin.
verses.8: Nia kaer moris Agag, liurai Amalek nian. Maibee nia oho povu hotu ho surik.
verses.9: Saul ho nia povu la oho liurai Agag no animál nebee folin diak liu: bibi, karau, karau oan bokur no bibi malae oan bokur sira nee. Maibee sira oho hotu animál sira nebee aat no fraku.
verses.10: Depois Nai nia liafuan mai Samuel hanesan nee,
verses.11: “Hau laran tristi tanba Hau hili tiha ona Saul nudar liurai. Tanba nia fila ona hosi hahalok nebee tuir Hau no la halo tuir Hau nia ukun fuan sira.” Nunee Samuel nia laran taridu loos no kalan tomak nia hakilar ba Nai.
verses.12: Iha dadeer-saan, Samuel hadeer hodi baa hasoru Saul. Ema foo hatene ba Samuel, “Saul baa ona Karmelu no nia harii monumentu ida ba nia aan rasik. Depois nia fila ona no tuun ba Gilead.”
verses.13: Bainhira Samuel too ona ba Saul, Saul dehan ba nia, “Nai foo bensaun ba ita boot. Hau halo tuir tiha ona Nai nia ukun fuan.”
verses.14: Maibee Samuel hataan, “Se nunee, tanba saa mak bibi nia nameek nee sei mai hela too hau nia tilun, no karau nia lian nee hau sei rona dadaun?”
verses.15: Saul hataan, “Sira lori animál sira nee hosi ema Amalek. Povu husik hela bibi malae no karau nebee diak hodi halo sakrifísiu ba Nai, ita nia Maromak. Maibee sira seluk ami oho hotu ona.”
verses.16: Depois Samuel dehan ba Saul, “Too ona ba! Hau sei foo hatene ba ita kona ba saida mak Nai koalia mai hau hori kalan.” Saul hataan ba nia, “Koalia ba.”
verses.17: Samuel hatete, “Laos ita, mezmu ita kiik tuir ita nia hanoin rasik, maibee ita sai ulun ba suku Israel hotu? Laos Nai konsagra ona ita nudar liurai ba Israel?
verses.18: Nai haruka ita baa ho lia menon nee: ‘Lao ba, oho hotu sala nain sira, ema Amalek sira too hotu.’
verses.19: Tanba saa mak ita la halo tuir Nai nia liafuan nee? Tanba saa mak ita hadau riku-soin nee no halo buat nebee aat iha Nai nia oin?”
verses.20: Saul hataan ba Samuel, “Sin, hau tuir ona Nai nia lian, no hau lao ona iha dalan nebee Nai haruka ona hau, no hau lori ona Agag, Amalek nia liurai, no ema Amalek sira ami oho hotu ona.
verses.21: Maibee povu sira hadau fali riku-soin nee: bibi no karau nebee diak liu hodi halo sakrifísiu ba Nai, ita nia Maromak, iha Gilgal.”
verses.22: Maibee Samuel hataan,
verses.23: Atu la rona, nee hanesan sala matan dook nian,
verses.24: Saul dehan ba Samuel, “Hau sala ona, tanba hau la tuir Nai nia ukun fuan no ita nia liafuan. Maibee hau tauk ba povu, tanba nee hau rona fali povu nia lian.
verses.25: Agora, favór ida, foo perdaun ba hau nia sala. Fila fali hamutuk ho hau, nunee hau bele adora Nai.”
verses.26: Maibee Samuel hataan ba Saul, “Hau sei la fila hamutuk ho ita, tanba ita rejeita ona Nai nia liafuan; no Nai rejeita ona ita nudar liurai ba Israel.”
verses.27: Bainhira Samuel fila hodi baa ona, Saul kaer Samuel nia batina ninin, maibee batina nee naklees.
verses.28: Samuel dehan ba Saul, “Nai lees ona reinu Israel hosi ita loron ohin no foo ona reinu nee ba ita nia maluk nebee diak liu ita.
verses.29: Israel nia Glória nee la bosok no Nia la troka hanoin. Tanba Nia la hanesan ema, hodi Nia troka hanoin.”
verses.30: Maibee Saul dehan, “Hau sala ona; maibee, favór ida, hatudu ita nia onra mai hau iha hau nia povu nia katuas sira nia oin no iha Israel nia oin. Fila fali hamutuk ho hau, nunee hau sei adora Nai, ita nia Maromak.”
verses.31: Entaun Samuel fila fali hamutuk ho Saul. No Saul adora ba Nai.
verses.32: Depois Samuel dehan, “Lori Agag mai, liurai Amalek nee.” Ho laran haksolok Agag baa, tanba nia hanoin, “Mate nia moruk nee liu tiha ona.”
verses.33: Samuel dehan, “Hanesan ita nia surik nebee oho inan nia oan sira, nunee mos ita nia inan sei lakon ninia oan.” Samuel oho Agag no koa rahun nia isin iha Nai nia oin iha Gilgal.
verses.34: Depois Samuel baa Ramá, maibee Saul fila baa nia uma iha Gibea-Saul.
verses.35: Too Samuel mate, nia la hasoru fali Saul, maibee Samuel tristi tanba Saul. Nai iha laran tristi tanba Nia halo Saul sai liurai iha Israel.

16.title: Samuel Fui Mina Unsaun ba David

verses.1: Nai dehan ba Samuel, “Too bainhira mak o kontinua tristi kona ba Saul? Hau rejeita ona nia nudar liurai iha Israel. Tau mina iha bibi dikur no baa. Hau haruka o ba Jessé iha Belém. Tanba Hau hili ona ema ida hosi ninia oan sira hodi sai liurai.”
verses.2: Maibee Samuel hataan, “Oinsaa hau bele baa? Se karik Saul rona planu nee, nia sei oho hau.” Nai hataan, “Lori karau oan ida no hatete ba ema sira iha nebaa, ‘Hau mai atu halo sakrifísiu ba Nai.’
verses.3: Depois o sei konvida Jessé mai iha serimónia sakrifísiu nee. No Hau sei hatete saida mak o tenki halo. Ema ida nebee Hau hatudu ba o nee, o fui mina ba nia.”
verses.4: Samuel halo tuir saida mak Nai dehan ona ba nia. Bainhira nia too iha Belém, líder sira iha sidade nee simu nia ho nakdedar no sira husu ba nia, “Ita boot mai ho dame ka?”
verses.5: Samuel hataan, “Ho dame. Hau mai lori sakrifísiu ba Nai. Nee duni imi tenki hamoos aan hodi tuir serimónia sakrifísiu nee.” Nia hamoos Jessé ho nia oan sira no nia konvida sira mos atu tuir serimónia nee.
verses.6: Bainhira sira too mai, Samuel haree Eliabe no nia hanoin, “Konserteza ema ida nee mak Nai hili.”
verses.7: Maibee Nai dehan ba Samuel, “Keta laran monu ba nia oin diak no nia ain aas nee, Hau la simu nia. Laos tuir ema nia haree maibee tuir Nai nia haree. Ema haree saida mak iha liur, maibee Nai haree ema nia fuan laran.”
verses.8: Depois Jessé bolu nia oan Abinadabe no nia lori ba Samuel. Maibee Samuel dehan, “Ema ida nee mos Nai la hili.”
verses.9: Depois Jessé lori nia oan Samaa ba Samuel. No Samuel dehan, “Nia mos Nai la hili.”
verses.10: Nunee Jessé haruka nia oan nain hitu nee tu-tuir malu ba hasoru Samuel. Maibee Samuel dehan ba Jessé, “Sira nee hotu Nai la hili.”
verses.11: Depois Samuel husu ba Jessé, “O nia oan mak nee deit ka?” Nia hataan, “Sei iha tan oan ikun, maibee nia hein hela bibi.” Samuel dehan ba Jessé, “Haruka ba bolu nia mai, tanba ita sei la haan bainhira nia seidauk too mai.”
verses.12: Tuir mai Jessé haruka bolu nia mai. Afinál nia mane klosan bonitu ida, isin diak no nia matan nabilan. Nai dehan, “Hamriik ba, fui mina ba nia tanba nia mak nee duni!”
verses.13: Samuel foti bibi dikur nebee nakonu ho mina, no fui mina ba nia ulun iha nia maun sira nia oin. No Nai nia Espíritu hamutuk ho David hosi loron ida nee kedas. Depois Samuel hamriik no fila ba Ramá.
verses.14: Nai nia Espíritu sai tiha ona hosi Saul, no Nai haruka espíritu aat ida mai halo terus ba Saul.
verses.15: Saul nia atan sira dehan ba nia, “Agora, espíritu aat ida mai hosi Maromak halo terus senhor.
verses.16: Entaun, liurai bele haruka ita boot nia atan, iha ita boot nia oin, buka ema ida nebee hatene toka harpa. Nunee, bainhira espíritu aat hosi Maromak mai, ema nee sei toka múzika, mak senhor sei senti diak fali.”
verses.17: Entaun Saul foo orden ba nia atan sira, “Imi baa buka ema nebee toka múzika diak, no lori nia mai iha nee.”
verses.18: Rona nunee, Saul nia atan ida hataan, “Agora, hau haree tiha ona Jessé, ema hosi Belém, iha oan mane ida nebee toka múzika diak. Ema nee iha podér no forsa. Nia mane ida nebee funu nain. Nia koalia matenek no oin kapaas. No Nai hamutuk ho nia.”
verses.19: Entaun, Saul haruka manu-ain sira ba Jessé dehan, “Haruka mai hau o nia oan David, nebee hein bibi.”
verses.20: Tuir mai Jessé prepara kuda buru ida hodi tula prezenti nebee paun, tua uvas iha kulit ida, no bibi ida, liu hosi nia oan David hodi baa Saul.
verses.21: Nunee David baa Saul hodi hamriik iha nia oin. Saul hadomi tebe-tebes David no foti nia hodi sai ajudante.
verses.22: Depois Saul haruka lia menon ba Jessé dehan, “Favór ida, husik David hela iha hau nia oin tanba hau gosta nia.”
verses.23: Nunee bainhira espíritu aat hosi Maromak mai iha Saul, David foti nia lira no toka. Depois espíritu aat nee sai hosi Saul, no nia senti hakmatek no diak fali.

verses.1: Iha loron ida, ema Filisteu halibur sira nia tropas hodi baa funu. Sira halibur iha fatin ida naran Soko, sidade ida hosi Judá, no halo sira nia akampamentu entre Soko no Azeka, besik Afes-Damin.
verses.2: Saul ho ema Israel sira mos halibur no tau sira nia akampamentu iha rai tetuk Ela hodi prepara funu hasoru ema Filisteu.
verses.3: Ema Filisteu sira hamriik iha foho sorin ida no ema Israel sira hamriik iha foho sorin seluk. No entre sira iha foho leet ida.
verses.4: Ema funu nain ida naran Golias, hosi sidade Gate, sai hosi ema Filisteu nia akampamentu. Ema nee nia aas besik metru tolu.
verses.5: Nia taka kapaseti halo ho riti no nia hatais faru funu nian halo ho riti, nebee todan maizoumenus kilo lima-nulu resin hitu.
verses.6: Nia ain falun ho sapatu riti, no nia haklili mos rama nebee halo hosi riti.
verses.7: Nia dima boot tebe-tebes, mahar no todan. Dima tutun nee halo ho besi no todan maizoumenus kilo hitu. Nia iha soldadu ida nebee lori nia eskudu iha nia oin.
verses.8: Golias bolu ho lian makaas ba soldadu Israel sira, “Nusaa mak imi forma hodi funu iha nebaa? Hau ema Filisteu no imi mak Saul nia atan sira ka? Imi hili ema ida iha imi nia leet nebee iha brani hodi tuun mai hasoru hau.
verses.9: Se iha funu nee, nia oho hau, ami prontu sai imi nia atan, maibee se hau manaan no oho nia, imi sei sai ami nia atan no serví ami.
verses.10: Agora duni hau dezafia tropas Israel sira. Hili ema ida mai funu hasoru hau!”
verses.11: Bainhira Saul ho nia ema rona liafuan nee, sira hakfodak no tauk tebe-tebes.
verses.12: David mak Jessé nia oan, ema Efrata hosi Belém iha Judá. Jessé iha oan nain ualu. Iha tempu Saul nian, Jessé katuas liu ona no idade boot.
verses.13: Jessé nia oan boot nain tolu tuir Saul ba funu. Ida primeiru naran Eliabe, segundu naran Abinadabe no terseiru naran Samaa.
verses.14: David mak oan ikun. Bainhira nia maun boot nain tolu nee tuir Saul iha funu,
verses.15: David sempre baa iha Saul nia akampamentu depois nia fila ba Belém hodi hein nia aman nia bibi malae.
verses.16: Durante loron haat-nulu, iha dadeer no lokraik, Golias mai hamriik iha sira nia oin.
verses.17: Iha loron ida Jessé dehan ba David, “Foti trigu toradu kilo sanulu resin lima ho paun sanulu, no lori ba o nia maun sira iha akampamentu.
verses.18: Lori mos keiju sanulu nee ba komandante. No husu took o nia maun sira nia kondisaun oinsaa no lori prova ida hosi sira mai hau.”
verses.19: Saul, no sira, no soldadu Israel sira sei iha rai tetuk Ela. No sira funu hela hasoru ema Filisteu.
verses.20: Aban dadeer-saan, David hadeer sedu. Nia foo nia bibi ba ema ida hodi hein, no nia foti ai haan sira nee hodi ba ona, tuir nia aman nia orden. Nia too iha ema Israel sira nia akampamentu iha momentu nebee sira haklalak sai ba funu.
verses.21: Tropas Filisteu ho tropas Israel hasoru malu oin ho oin no prontu ona ba funu.
verses.22: David rai hela nia sasaan ho ema nebee hein armas funu nian. Depois nia halai ba fatin funu hodi hasoru nia maun sira.
verses.23: Maibee bainhira nia koalia ho sira, ema Filisteu, funu nain ida hosi Gat iha Filisteu, naran Golias, lao ba oin, hodi hamoe ema Israel sira, hanesan nia halo baibain. No David mos rona.
verses.24: Bainhira ema Israel sira haree mane ida nee, sira tauk tebe-tebes no halai hosi nia.
verses.25: Ema Israel sira dehan ba malu, “Haree mane ida nebee sai mai nee? Rona nia hamoe Israel. Ita nia liurai Saul promete ona no dehan katak see mak oho Golias, liurai sei foo prezente ho riku-soin boot. Liurai mos sei foo nia oan feto hodi kaben ho ema nee. No nia aman nia uma kain sei la selu tan impostu.
verses.26: Entaun David dehan ba ema nebee halibur besik nia, “Oinsaa ema nebee oho ema Filisteu nee no liberta ema Israel hosi ameasa, nia simu saida? Nusaa mak ema Filisteu nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun nee iha brani atu hamoe Maromak Moris nia tropas sira?”
verses.27: Povu dehan ba nia buat nebee liurai promete ona atu foo ba ema nebee oho Golias.
verses.28: Eliabe, David nia maun boot, rona David nia liafuan nebee David koalia ho soldadu sira. Entaun nia hirus tebes no dehan, “O mai hodi halo saida iha nee? See mak hein o nia bibi uitoan iha rai fuik maran? Hau hatene katak o foti aan no o nia fuan laran mak aat. O mai iha nee só hodi haree deit ema halo funu.”
verses.29: David hataan, “Hau halo sala saida? Afinál, hau husu deit.”
verses.30: Depois David baa husu pergunta hanesan nee ba soldadu sira seluk. No nia simu resposta hanesan.
verses.31: Soldadu balu rona buat nebee David koalia nee, no sira baa no konta ba Saul. Entaun Saul bolu David.
verses.32: David too iha Saul no dehan, “Ita boot nia fuan laran la presiza tauk ba ema Filisteu nee! Atan hau bele baa funu hasoru nia.”
verses.33: Maibee Saul hataan ba David, “O la bele baa funu hasoru ema Filisteu nee. O foin sae, maibee nia funu dezde nia foin sae.”
verses.34: Maibee David hataan ba Saul, “Atan hau baibain hein hau nia aman nia bibi. Bainhira liaun ka ursu mai tata bibi oan,
verses.35: hau duni tuir animál siak nee. Hau baku nia no salva fali bibi nee hosi nia ibun. No se liaun ka animál siak nee ataka hau, hau kaer nia kakorok no hau tuku nia too mate tiha.
verses.36: Atan hau oho ona liaun no ursu, no ema Filisteu nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun nee mos sei sai hanesan animál sira nee. Tanba nia brani atu hamoe Maromak Moris nia tropas sira.
verses.37: Nai mak salva ona hau hosi liaun nia liman no ursu nia liman, Nia sei salva mos hau hosi ema Filisteu nee nia liman.” No Saul dehan ba nia, “Entaun diak, o baa. No Nai hamutuk ho o.”
verses.38: Saul foo ninia ropa funu nian ba David hodi hatais. Depois Saul doku kapaseti riti ida ba David nia ulun.
verses.39: Ikus mai David sikat Saul nia surik ba nia faru besi nee no nia komesa lao, tanba nia seidauk koko buat nee. No David dehan ba Saul, “Hau la bele lao tanba hau la toman hatais ropa nee.” David hasai tiha ropa funu nian.
verses.40: No nia foti nia ai tonka iha ninia liman. Nia hili fatuk kabuar lima hosi mota kiik no tau iha ninia bornál. Nia kaer mos piska nebee dulas. Depois nia sai ba hasoru ema Filisteu.
verses.41: La kleur, ema Filisteu nee lao besik ba David. Ema nebee lori eskudu lao iha nia oin.
verses.42: Maibee bainhira ema Filisteu haree di-diak David, nia hamnasa halo trosa, tanba David foin sae, bonitu no oin kapaas loos.
verses.43: Ema Filisteu dehan ba David, “Ai tonka nee hodi halo saida? O hanoin hau nee asu ka?” Depois ema Filisteu foo malisan ba David hodi nia maromak sira nia naran.
verses.44: No ema Filisteu nee dehan ba David, “Mai iha nee! Hau sei foo o nia isin ba manu iha loro leten no ba animál iha rai nee atu haan.”
verses.45: Maibee David hataan ba ema Filisteu, “O mai hau hasoru ho surik, dima no rama. Maibee hau hasoru o hodi Nai Forsa Nain nia naran, tropas Israel nia Maromak, nebee o koalia aat nee.
verses.46: Loron nee kedas Nai sei entrega o mai hau. Hau sei baku mate o, no tesi o nia kakorok. O nia mate isin, no ita nia tropas Filisteu sira nia mate isin, hau sei foo ba manu iha loro leten no animál fuik iha rai laran. Atu nunee, mundu tomak bele hatene katak Maromak iha Israel,
verses.47: no ema hotu iha nee sei haree katak Nai la presiza surik no dima hodi salva nia povu. Funu nee mak Nai nian no Nia sei entrega imi mai iha ami nia liman.”
verses.48: Depois ema Filisteu nee sae no komesa lao hakbesik ba David. No David halai lalais ba tropas sira hodi funu hasoru ema Filisteu nee.
verses.49: David hatama nia liman ba bornál no foti fatuk ida. Nia dulas tuda kona ema Filisteu nia reen toos. Fatuk nee tama nia reen toos no nia monu kedas ba rai.
verses.50: Nunee David manaan ema Filisteu ho piska dulas no fatuk ida deit nebee kona ema Filisteu nee no oho nia, maski David la iha surik ida iha nia liman.
verses.51: David halai ba hamriik besik ema Filisteu nee, losu ema Filisteu nia surik hosi ninia knuuk no tesi ema Filisteu nee nia kakorok. Bainhira ema Filisteu sira haree sira nia funu nain mate ona, sira halai namkari.
verses.52: Ema Israel sira ho ema Judá sira haklalak no duni tuir ema Filisteu sira too iha sidade Gate no too portaun Ekron nian. Nunee ema Filisteu sira nebee hetan kanek monu iha dalan hosi Saaraim too iha Gate no Ekron.
verses.53: Depois ema Israel para hosi duni tuir ema Filisteu no sira fila hodi foti ema Filisteu nia sasaan nebee sira husik hela iha sira nia akampamentu.
verses.54: David foti ema Filisteu ida nee nia ulun no lori ba Jerusalém, maibee nia rai ninia armas funu nian iha nia baraka rasik.
verses.55: Bainhira Saul haree David baa funu hasoru ema Filisteu, nia husu ba Abner, nebee komandante funu nian, “Abner, joven nee mak see nia oan?” Abner hataan, “Liurai, tuir lo-loos hau la hatene.”
verses.56: Liurai dehan, “Ba husu hatene took, see nia oan mak labarik nee.”
verses.57: David fila ona ba akampamentu bainhira nia oho tiha ona ema Filisteu nee. No Abner lori nia ba hasoru Saul. David sei lori hela ema Filisteu nia ulun fatuk.
verses.58: No Saul husu ba nia, “See nia oan mak o?” David hataan, “Hau nee, mak atan Jessé nia oan, hosi sidade Belém.”

verses.1: Bainhira Saul ho David koalia hotu ona, Jonatan nia laran monu kedas ba David. Nia hadomi David hanesan nia hadomi nia aan rasik.
verses.2: Saul simu David hodi hela ho nia. Hosi loron nee, Saul la foo lisensa ba David atu fila ba nia inan-aman.
verses.3: Jonatan halo akordu ho David, tanba nia hadomi David hanesan nia hadomi nia aan rasik.
verses.4: Jonatan hasai nia batina no foo ba David. Nia foo mos nia ropa funu nian, nia surik, nia rama no nia sintu.
verses.5: David lao ba fatin nebee deit Saul haruka nia baa. No nia sempre hetan susesu. Tanba nee Saul halo nia sai komandante funu nian. Ema hotu-hotu gosta David no mos Saul nia atan sira gosta nia.
verses.6: Soldadu sira fila fali hosi funu ho David nebee oho tiha ona ema Filisteu nee. No feto sira mai hosi sidade-sidade iha Israel hodi hasoru liurai Saul ho kanta no dansa. Sira haksolok no baku tamborin no toka lira.
verses.7: Feto sira toka dadaun no kanta nunee:
verses.8: Rona nunee, Saul hirus tebe-tebes. Nia la kontenti ho liafuan nee. Nia hanoin nunee, “Ba David, feto sira dehan nia oho tokon ba tokon. Maibee ba hau, sira dehan hau oho deit rihun ba rihun. Hela deit sira atu foti David sai liurai.”
verses.9: Komesa iha loron nee, Saul laran moras ona ba David.
verses.10: Iha aban fali, espíritu aat ida hosi Maromak mai tama iha Saul. Depois nia profesia iha nia uma laran. Tempu nee, David toka hela lira hanesan baibain no Saul kaer hela nia dima.
verses.11: Saul hanoin nunee, “Hau sei tuda David ho dima nee too nia belit iha didin lolon.” Depois nia tuda David ho dima dala rua, maibee David sees tiha, la kona.
verses.12: Saul tauk David tanba Nai hamutuk ho David, no husik tiha ona Saul.
verses.13: Entaun Saul muda David sai hosi nia, no haruka nia sai komandante ba soldadu rihun ida. Ho nunee David ba-mai iha povu nia oin.
verses.14: David halao nia servisu hotu ho susesu, tanba Nai hamutuk ho nia.
verses.15: Bainhira Saul haree David sempre iha susesu iha nia servisu, Saul tauk liu tan nia.
verses.16: Maibee ema Israel no ema Judá hotu-hotu hadomi David tanba nia sai no fila fali mai iha sira nia oin.
verses.17: Entaun Saul dehan ba David, “Haree hau nia oan feto boot Merabe iha nee. Hau sei foo kaben ho o, naran katak o sai hau nia oan nebee forti iha Nai nia funu.” Saul hanoin ho dalan ida nee, “Hau nia liman la kona nia, husik ema Filisteu sira nia liman mak kona nia.”
verses.18: David hataan ba Saul, “See mak hau? No saida mak hau nia moris ka hau nia família iha Israel hodi sai liurai nia mane foun?”
verses.19: Maibee, bainhira too ona tempu atu foo Saul nia oan feto Merabe ba David, nia foo Merabe kaben fali ho mane ida naran Adriel, hosi sidade Meolaa.
verses.20: Mical, Saul nia oan feto seluk, nia laran monu ba David. No bainhira ema foo hatene ba Saul, nia kontenti loos.
verses.21: Saul hanoin, “Hau foo nia ba David, no Mical sei sai hanesan lasu ida ba nia, hodi ema Filisteu sira nia liman kona nia.” Entaun Saul dehan ba David, “Loron nee, o hetan fali oportunidade hodi sai hau nia mane foun.”
verses.22: Saul haruka nia atan sira koalia partikulár ho David, hodi sira dehan, “Agora, liurai kontenti ho ita, no nia atan sira hotu hadomi ita. Entaun, agora ita bele sai liurai nia mane foun.”
verses.23: Entaun Saul nia atan sira koalia liafuan nee iha David nia tilun, no David hataan, “Imi hanoin atu sai liurai nia mane foun buat kamaan ka? Hau ema kiak no ema kiik.”
verses.24: Saul nia atan sira konta ba nia saida mak David dehan ona,
verses.25: no Saul dehan, “Hatete fali ba David nunee, ‘Liurai nia hakarak barlake mak nee: ema Filisteu atus ida nia oin-lulik nia kulit rohan, nudar vingansa ba ninia inimigu sira.’” Saul nia planu hanesan nee hodi David monu liu hosi ema Filisteu sira nia liman.
verses.26: Saul nia atan sira konta ba David liafuan nee, no David simu ho haksolok atu sai liurai nia mane foun. Molok loron too,
verses.27: David ho nia soldadu sira ba oho ema Filisteu nain atus rua. No David lori ema Filisteu sira nebee mate nee nia oin-lulik nia kulit rohan hodi ba konta iha liurai Saul nia oin. Nunee nia bele sai liurai nia mane foun. Entaun Saul foo nia oan feto Mical atu kaben ho David.
verses.28: Saul haree no rekonhese katak Nai mak hamutuk ho David, no Mical, Saul nia oan feto, hadomi nia.
verses.29: Nunee, Saul sai tauk liu tan kona ba David no nia odi David iha nia moris tomak.
verses.30: Bainhira xefi Filisteu sira mai hodi funu hasoru sira, David hetan susesu liu fali Saul nia atan sira seluk. Nunee David hetan naran boot.

verses.1: Saul dehan ba nia oan Jonatan no nia atan hotu katak sira tenki oho David. Maibee Jonatan, Saul nia oan, gosta tebes David.
verses.2: Jonatan, Saul nia oan, foo hatene ba David, nia dehan, “Hau nia apaa Saul buka atu oho ita. Tanba nee kuidadu aan too aban dadeer, buka fatin ida hodi tuur no subar aan iha nebaa.
verses.3: Hau sei sai no hamriik iha hau nia apaa nia sorin besik fatin nebee ita subar. Hau sei koalia ho hau nia apaa kona ba ita. No se hau aprende buat ruma, hau sei foo hatene ba ita.”
verses.4: Depois Jonatan konta buat nebee diak kona ba David ba nia aman, Saul, no dehan ba nia, “Liurai, la bele halo sala hasoru David, ita boot nia atan nee, tanba nia la halo sala hasoru ita boot. Nia halo buat nebee diak ba ita boot.
verses.5: Nia foo nia moris hodi funu hasoru ema Filisteu. No liu hosi nee Nai haraik salvasaun boot ba ema Israel hotu. Ita boot rasik haree nee no haksolok tanba nee. Tanba saa mak ita boot hakarak halo sala hasoru raan inosenti, nebee atu oho David maibee razaun la iha?”
verses.6: Saul simu Jonatan nia liafuan, no Saul jura, “Hodi Nai nebee moris, nia sei la simu kastigu mate.”
verses.7: Depois Jonatan bolu fali David no foo hatene ba nia kona ba buat hotu nebee sira koalia. Jonatan lori fali David hodi servísu nafatin ba Saul hanesan uluk.
verses.8: Tuir mai, funu mosu fali. No David ba funu hasoru ema Filisteu sira. Nia manaan boot no sira halai hosi nia oin.
verses.9: Espíritu aat hosi Nai mai kona Saul. Nia tuur iha nia uma no nia kaer hela dima no David halo múzika ho nia liman.
verses.10: Saul koko tuda David ho dima hodi belit nia iha didin. Maibee David sees hosi fatin nee no Saul nia dima kona didin. Nunee David halai sai tiha iha kalan nee kedas.
verses.11: Depois Saul haruka ema sira ba David nia uma hodi hafuhu nia, nunee sira atu oho nia iha tempu dadeer. Mical, David nia kaben, dehan ba nia, “Se ita la halai sai hosi uma nee ohin kalan, aban dadeer ema sei oho ita.”
verses.12: Nunee Mical hatuun nia hosi janela ida no nia halai sai hosi uma.
verses.13: Liu tiha nee, Mical foti estátua lulik no tau iha toba fatin. Nia tau bibi nia fulun hodi halo sumasu no taka ho manta.
verses.14: Depois Saul haruka nia ema sira hodi baa kaer David, maibee feto nee dehan, “Nia moras.”
verses.15: Nunee Saul haruka nia ema sira baa haree David, nia dehan, “Lori nia ho toba fatin mai, nunee hau bele oho nia.”
verses.16: Depois sira tama ba uma laran. Nunee sira haree estátua lulik nee ho sumasu no bibi fulun iha nia ulun.
verses.17: Saul dehan ba Mical, “Tanba saa mak o bosok hau hodi husik hau nia inimigu halai?” Maibee Mical hataan ba Saul, “Nia dehan mai hau, ‘Husik hau baa. Nusaa mak hau oho o?’”
verses.18: Entaun David halai ona. Nia baa Samuel iha Ramá no foo hatene ba Samuel kona ba buat hotu nebee Saul halo ba nia. Nunee nia baa hamutuk ho Samuel hodi hela iha Naiote.
verses.19: Depois ema dehan ba Saul, “David hela iha Naiote besik Ramá.”
verses.20: Nunee Saul haruka ninia ema atu baa foti David. Maibee bainhira sira haree profeta lubun ida profesia, no Samuel lidera hela sira, Maromak nia Espíritu kona fali Saul nia ema, no sira mos profesia.
verses.21: Bainhira Saul rona nunee, nia haruka ema seluk, maibee sira mos profesia. Saul haruka ema ba dala tolu, no ema sira nee mos profesia.
verses.22: Nunee Saul rasik baa Ramá. Bainhira nia besik ona bee matan boot iha Seku, nia husu, “Samuel ho David, sira iha nebee?” Ema hataan, “Iha Naiote, iha fatin Ramá.”
verses.23: Depois nia ba Naiote, besik Ramá, no Maromak nia Espíritu mos kona nia, no nia kontinua lao no nia profesia too Naiote iha Ramá.
verses.24: Nia mos hasai nia ropa no profesia iha Samuel nia oin. Nia taka rabat ba rai ho isin molik iha loron nee tomak no kalan tomak. Nunee ema dehan, “Saul mos iha profeta sira nia leet ka?”

verses.1: Nunee David halai sai hosi Naiote iha Ramá. Nia baa too Jonatan no dehan, “Saida mak hau halo ona? Hau nia hahalok aat nee saida? Saida mak hau nia sala nebee hasoru ita nia aman, nunee nia hakarak oho hau?”
verses.2: Maibee Jonatan dehan ba nia, “Hadook aan tiha hosi buat sira nee! Ita sei la mate. Hau nia apaa nunka halo buat ida, mezmu boot ka kiik, se nia la foo hatene mai hau. Tanba saa mak hau nia apaa subar hela hahalok nee hosi hau? Hau la fiar.”
verses.3: Maibee David jura no hataan, “Ita nia aman hatene duni katak ita hatudu grasa mai hau. Nunee nia hanoin, ‘Jonatan la bele hatene kona ba ida nee, keta halo nia laran susar.’ Nunee duni, hodi Nai nebee moris no ita nebee moris, hau nia moris hela pasu ida deit atu mate.”
verses.4: Jonatan dehan ba David, “Saida deit mak ita hakarak, hau sei halo ba ita.”
verses.5: Depois David dehan ba Jonatan, “Haree lai, aban mak fulan foun. Tuir lo-loos hau sei tuur hodi haan hamutuk ho liurai. Maibee husik hau baa subar iha rai fuik too aban lokraik.
verses.6: Se karik ita nia aman husu buka hau, ita foo hatene ba nia, ‘David husu ona mai hau hodi nia bele baa lalais Belém, ninia moris fatin. Tanba iha nebaa iha serimónia sakrifísiu tinan nian ba ninia família tomak.’
verses.7: Se nia hatete hanesan nee, ‘Diak!’, nunee ita nia atan hau hetan dame. Maibee se karik nia hirus lalais, hatene duni katak nia desidi ona atu halo buat aat.
verses.8: Se nunee, hatudu ita nia domin metin ba ita nia atan hau, tanba ita halo ona akordu iha Nai nia oin hamutuk ho hau. Se karik hau iha sala ruma ita rasik mak oho hau. Tanba saa mak ita entrega fali hau ba ita nia aman?”
verses.9: Maibee Jonatan hataan, “Hadook tiha hosi buat sira nee! Se karik hau hatene lo-loos katak hau nia aman desidi ona hodi halo aat hasoru ita, tanba saa mak hau la foo hatene ba ita?”
verses.10: Nunee David husu ba Jonatan, “See mak bele foo hatene mai hau, se ita nia aman hataan ba ita ho liafuan makaas?”
verses.11: Jonatan hatete ba David, “Mai, ita lao ba rai fuik.” Nunee sira nain rua lao ba rai fuik.
verses.12: Depois Jonatan dehan ba David, “Hodi Nai, Maromak iha Israel, aban ka bainrua, iha oras hanesan nee hau sei buka hatene hau nia apaa nia laran. Se karik nia diak ba David, hau sei foo hatene ba ita.
verses.13: Maibee hau jura, husik Nai kastigu Jonatan, se karik hau nia apaa hakarak halo aat ba ita, hau sei foo hatene ba ita no husik ita lao ba, hodi ita bele baa ho dame. Nai hamutuk ho ita, hanesan Nia hamutuk ho hau nia apaa hori uluk.
verses.14: Se karik hau sei moris, ita mos bele hatudu Nai nia domin metin mai hau. Maibee se karik hau mate ona,
verses.15: ita la bele hakotu ita nia domin metin ba hau nia família too tinan ba tinan, bainhira Nai hakotu David nia inimigu hotu iha mundu nee.”
verses.16: Entaun Jonatan halo akordu ho David no dehan, “Husik Nai rasik kastigu David nia inimigu sira.”
verses.17: Jonatan haruka David jura dala ida tan hodi nia domin ba Jonatan, tanba nia hadomi David hanesan nia aan rasik.
verses.18: Nunee duni Jonatan dehan ba David, “Aban mak fulan foun. Sira sei husu buka ita, tanba ita nia tuur fatin sei mamuk.
verses.19: Maibee aban bainrua ita tenki baa iha fatin nebee ita subar uluk, no hein besik iha fatuk fatin iha nebaa.
verses.20: Hau sei hana rama oan tolu ba fatin nebaa, hanesan hau finji hana ba fatin ida.
verses.21: Nunee hau sei haruka hau nia atan, ‘Lao ba buka rama oan sira nee.’ Se karik hau hatete klaru ba hau nia atan nee, ‘Haree rama oan sira nee iha besik mai, foti ba!’ nunee ita bele mai tanba, hodi Nai nebee moris, ita sei simu dame no la hasoru buat aat.
verses.22: Maibee bainhira hau hatete ba ema joven nee, ‘Haree lai, rama oan sira nee iha sorin baa!’ nunee lao ba tanba Nai haruka ita baa.
verses.23: Kona ba buat nebee ita promesa tiha ona, entre hau ho ita, tebes katak Nai sei hela entre hau ho ita too tinan ba tinan.”
verses.24: Liu tiha nee David subar aan iha rai fuik. Bainhira fulan foun too ona, liurai tuur hodi haan.
verses.25: Liurai tuur iha nia fatin hanesan baibain iha kadeira ida nebee besik didin. Jonatan tuur oin hasoru ho nia. Abner tuur iha Saul nia sorin maibee David nia fatin mamuk.
verses.26: Saul la koalia buat ida iha loron nee, tanba nia hanoin, “Iha buat ruma nebee akontese. Karik nia la moos; sin, nia la moos.”
verses.27: Maibee loron tuir mai, iha fulan foun nia loron rua nee, bainhira David nia tuur fatin sei mamuk nafatin, Saul husu ba Jonatan, nia oan, “Tanba saa mak Jessé nia oan la mai haan, horiseik no ohin?”
verses.28: Jonatan hataan ba Saul, “David husu ona mai hau atu baa Belém,
verses.29: nia dehan, ‘Favór ida, husik hau baa. Tanba hau nia família halo serimónia sakrifísiu iha sidade nee. Hau nia maun obriga hau baa. Tanba nee, se hau hetan grasa iha ita boot nia oin, favór ida, husik hau baa hodi haree hau nia maun sira.’ Tanba nee nia la mai haan hamutuk ho liurai.”
verses.30: Nunee Saul hirus ba Jonatan, no nia dehan, “Oan aat malkriadu! Hau hatene katak o hili atu hamutuk ho Jessé nia oan. O hamoe o nia aan rasik no o nia inan nia isin molik!
verses.31: Tebes duni bainhira Jessé nia oan nee sei moris iha mundu, o no o nia ukun sei la dura. Agora, haruka ema ba bolu no lori nia mai hau, tanba nia tenki mate.”
verses.32: Maibee Jonatan hataan ba Saul, nia apaa, nunee, “Tanba saa mak nia tenki hetan kastigu mate? Saida mak nia halo?”
verses.33: Depois Saul tuda dima ba Jonatan hodi oho nia. Nunee Jonatan hatene katak nia apaa desidi ona atu oho David.
verses.34: Entaun Jonatan hamriik husik hela sira iha meza ho laran hirus makaas. Iha loron rua iha fulan foun nee nia la haan buat ida, nia tristi tanba David, no tanba nia aman hamoe nia.
verses.35: Tuir mai, iha dadeer, Jonatan sai ba rai fuik ho nia atan kiik-oan, tuir nia promesa ba David.
verses.36: Jonatan dehan ba nia atan, “Halai ba buka rama oan sira nebee hau atu hana nee.” Foin atan nee halai ba, Jonatan hana rama oan liu hosi nia atan nia ulun leten.
verses.37: Bainhira atan nee too ba fatin nebee Jonatan hana ona rama oan nee, Jonatan hakilar hosi atan nee nia kotuk, dehan, “Laos rama oan nee dook liu fali?”
verses.38: Nunee Jonatan hakilar hosi atan nee nia kotuk, “Halai, lalais, la bele hein!” Depois Jonatan nia atan hili fali rama oan nee no fila fali ba nia patraun.
verses.39: Maibee nia atan nee la hatene buat ida, só Jonatan no David deit mak hatene.
verses.40: Nunee Jonatan foo nia sasaan funu nian ba nia atan, no dehan ba nia, “Baa ona, lori sasaan nee ba sidade.”
verses.41: Bainhira atan nee fila, David mosu hosi fatuk nia sorin. Nia hakneak no hakruuk dala tolu ho oin ba rai. Sira nain rua rei malu ho tanis. Maibee David tanis liu.
verses.42: Jonatan dehan ba David: Lao ho dame; ita nain rua jura ona ba malu hodi Nai nia naran, katak: Nai entre ita nain rua, entre ita nia jerasaun no hau nia jerasaun too tinan ba tinan.” Liu tiha nee David hamriik no baa. No Jonatan mos fila fali ba sidade.

verses.1: David baa too iha Nobe, ba Aimeleke, saserdote nee. Aimeleke tauk bainhira nia hasoru David no hatete ba nia, “Tanba saa mak ita mesak no la iha ema nebee mai hamutuk ho ita?”
verses.2: David hataan ba saserdote Aimeleke, “Liurai foo servisu mai hau, nia hatete mai hau, ‘See deit la bele hatene buat nebee hau haruka ita halo, no buat nebee hau manda ona ba ita.’ Tanba nee mak hau haruka ona hau nia atan sira baa fatin seluk.
verses.3: Nunee saida mak ita iha agora? Foo mai hau paun lima ka saida deit mak ita iha.”
verses.4: Depois saserdote nee hataan ba nia, “Paun baibain hau la iha, maibee paun santu deit mak hau iha. Naran katak ita nia atan sira kuidadu aan hosi feto sira.”
verses.5: David hataan ba saserdote nee, no dehan ba nia, “Nee loos, ami la book feto durante loron tolu nee, hanesan baibain bainhira ami halo viajen. Ema sira nee iha isin moos bainhira sira lao baibain deit. Nunee liu tan loron ohin sira nia isin moos.”
verses.6: Nunee duni saserdote foo ba David paun santu nee tanba la iha paun seluk. Ema sempre foti Paun Prezensa nee hosi Nai nia oin hodi tau fali paun manas iha loron nebee sira foti paun nee.
verses.7: Iha loron nee iha mos atan Saul nian, nebee serví Nai iha nebaa. Nia naran Doege, ema Edom, no nia mak xefi ba Saul nia bibi atan sira.
verses.8: David hatete ba Aimeleke, “Iha nee, iha dima ka surik? Tanba hau nia surik no hau nia sasaan funu, hau la lori tanba orden nee urjenti deit.”
verses.9: Saserdote nee dehan, “Golias, ema Filisteu, nia surik sei iha nee, hosi ema ita oho iha rai tetuk Elá. Haree lai, ida nee falun hela ho hena iha efode kotuk nebaa. Se ita hakarak foti, foti ba. Surik seluk la iha só mak nee deit.” David hataan, “La iha surik seluk hanesan nee, foo ida nee mai hau.”
verses.10: Nunee David hamriik hodi halai iha loron nee tanba nia tauk Saul. Nia halai ba Akis, liurai hosi Gate.
verses.11: Akis nia atan sira dehan ba sira nia patraun, “Ida nee laos liurai David ka? Laos tanba nia mak ema kanta simu malu too sira bidu, nunee duni,
verses.12: David rona di-diak liafuan nee no nia tauk la halimar ba Akis, liurai hosi Gate.
verses.13: Nunee nia troka nia hahalok iha sira nia oin no nia finji bulak iha sira nia liman. Nia riska tuun sae portaun nee no nia husik nia kabeen suli tuun ba nia hasan rahun.
verses.14: Nunee Akis dehan ba nia atan sira, “Aii, imi la haree katak ema nee bulak ka? Tanba saa mak imi lori nia mai hau?
verses.15: Hau la iha ema bulak sira ka, nunee imi lori ema nee hodi halimar bulak iha hau nia prezensa? Ema ida nee merese atu tama ba hau nia uma ka?”

verses.1: Depois David halai hosi nebaa. Nia baa iha fatuk kuak Adulam. Bainhira nia maun sira no nia família sira hotu rona nunee, sira baa hasoru nia iha nebaa.
verses.2: Ema hotu nebee iha susar boot ka iha debe ka laran moras halibur hamutuk ho nia. Nunee nia sai sira nia lider. Ema sira nebee hamutuk ho nia maizoumenus ema nain atus haat.
verses.3: Hosi nebaa David lao ba Mizpá iha Moab no nia dehan ba liurai Moab, “Hau husu lisensa atu hau nia apaa no amaa bele hela ho ita boot, too hau hatene saida mak Maromak atu halo mai hau.”
verses.4: Depois nia lori sira ba liurai Moab, no sira hela hamutuk ho nia durante tempu nebee David iha fortaleza.
verses.5: Maibee profeta Gad, hatete ba David, “Keta hela iha fortaleza nebaa, lao ba no fila fali ba rai Judá.” Nunee David lao ba no tama ba ai laran Herete.
verses.6: Saul rona katak ema diskobre ona David, no ema sira nebee hamutuk ho nia, no fatin nebee sira subar. Saul hela iha Gibea no nia tuur hela iha ai tamargeira nia mahon. Nia kaer nia dima hamutuk ho nia atan hotu nebee hamriik besik nia.
verses.7: Nunee Saul dehan ba nia atan sira nebee hamriik besik nia, “Rona lai, ema Benjamin sira! Jessé nia oan sei foo imi hotu toos no toos uvas ka? Nia sei foti imi sai xefi ba soldadu rihun ida ka xefi ba soldadu atus ida ka?
verses.8: Nunee imi futu lia hamutuk ka, hodi hasoru hau no la iha ema ida nebee dehan mai hau, katak hau nia oan halo ona akordu ho Jessé nia oan nee? La iha ema ida hosi imi nebee hanoin mai hau, ka foo hatene mai hau katak hau nia oan tau lia ona ba hau nia atan sira hodi hein atu halo aat mai hau hanesan agora dadaun?”
verses.9: Nunee Doege, ema Edomita nebee hamriik ho Saul nia atan sira, nia hataan, “Hau haree ona katak Jessé nia oan nee mai iha Nobe, ba Aimeleke, oan hosi Ahitube.
verses.10: Nia husu Nai nia tulun ba David no foo hahaan ba nia. Nia foo surik ba nia hosi Golias, ema Filisteu nee.”
verses.11: Depois liurai haruka ba bolu saserdote Aimeleke, oan hosi Ahitube, ho nia família hotu, saserdote hotu nebee iha Nobe, hodi mai hasoru liurai.
verses.12: Saul hatete, “Rona lai, Ahitube nia oan!” Aimeleke hataan, “Hau mak nee, hau nia nai.”
verses.13: Depois Saul husu ba nia, “Tanba saa mak o futu lia hasoru hau, o ho Jessé nia oan nee, bainhira o foo paun no surik ba nia, husu Maromak tulun nia, hodi nia hamriik kontra hau no hein atu halo aat mai hau hanesan agora dadaun?”
verses.14: Aimeleke hataan ba liurai, “Maibee atan ida nebee mak metin liu David? Nia mos liurai nia mane foun no nia mos ita boot nia xefi seguransa. Nia ema nebee hetan respeitu iha ita boot nia uma laran.
verses.15: Ida nee laos dala premeiru nebee hau husu tulun hosi Maromak ba nia. Laos hanesan nee! Liurai la bele foo sala mai hau no hau nia família sira hotu, tanba ita nia atan hau la hatene buat ida kona ba nee, buat kiik ka buat boot.”
verses.16: Maibee liurai dehan, “Aimeleke, o tenki mate no o nia família sira hotu.”
verses.17: Depois liurai foo orden ba ema servisu nain sira nebee hamriik besik nia, “Lao ba no oho tiha Nai nia saserdote sira nee tanba sira ajuda ona David. Tanba mezmu sira hatene katak nia halai sai, maibee sira la foo hatene mai hau.” Maibee liurai nia atan sira la brani atu foti liman hodi oho Nai nia saserdote sira.
verses.18: Nunee liurai hatete ba Doege, “Ita lao ba no oho tiha saserdote sira nee.” Entaun Doege, ema Edom, lao ba no oho saserdote sira nee. Iha loron nebaa nia oho ema hamutuk nain ualu-nulu resin lima, nebee hatais efode.
verses.19: Nunee mos Nobe, sidade saserdote nian, nia oho sira ho surik, mane no feto, labarik no bebee sira nebee susu hela, karau, kuda buru no bibi sira. Nia oho hotu ho surik.
verses.20: Maibee oan ida hosi Aimeleke, oan hosi Ahitube, nia naran Abiatar, nia halai hodi lao tuir David.
verses.21: Bainhira Abiatar foo hatene ba David katak Saul oho tiha ona Nai nia saserdote sira,
verses.22: David hatete ba Abiatar, “Loos, iha loron nebaa Doege, ema Edom nee, nia iha nebaa. Hau hatene ona katak nia sei foo hatene ba Saul. Hau mak problema nia huun nebee halo o nia família sira mate hotu.
verses.23: Hela ho hau, keta tauk. Tanba ida nebee hakarak hasai o nia moris, nia mos hakarak hasai hau nia moris. Hamutuk ho hau, o sei hela seguru.”

verses.1: Ema foo hatene ba David, “Ema Filisteu agora funu hasoru sidade Keila no sira hadau ona ai haan hosi fatin nebee baku trigu.”
verses.2: Nunee David husu ba Nai, nia dehan, “Hau bele ba funu hasoru ema Filisteu sira nee ka lae?” Nai hataan ba David, “Lao ba, funu hasoru ema Filisteu hodi salva Keila.”
verses.3: Maibee David nia ema sira hatete ba nia, “Hanoin ba, ami tauk hela iha Judá, saa tan ami ba Keila hodi funu hasoru forsa hosi ema Filisteu.”
verses.4: Nunee David husu tan ba Nai no Nai hataan ba nia, no hatete, “Hamriik ba, no tuun ba Keila, tanba Hau sei entrega ema Filisteu ba o nia liman.”
verses.5: Entaun David lao ba Keila hamutuk ho nia ema sira. Nia funu hasoru ema Filisteu no hadau sira nia animál no oho ema barak. Nunee duni David salva ema Keila.
verses.6: Bainhira Abiatar, oan hosi Aimeleke, halai ba David iha Keila, nia baa ho efode iha nia liman.
verses.7: Ema foo hatene ba Saul katak David tama ona iha Keila. Saul dehan, “Maromak entrega ona nia ba hau nia liman, tanba nia tama ona ba sidade nebee iha portaun sira nebee taka metin ho ai lolon.”
verses.8: Saul bolu povu hotu hodi baa funu hasoru Keila. No atu serka David ho nia ema sira iha nebaa.
verses.9: Bainhira David hatene ona katak Saul halo planu aat ba nia, nia dehan ba saserdote Abiatar, “Lori efode nee mai.”
verses.10: David dehan, “Oh Nai, Maromak iha Israel, O nia atan nee rona katak Saul hanoin atu mai hodi estraga sidade Keila tanba hau.
verses.11: Ema Keila sira atu entrega hau ba nia liman ka? Saul atu mai duni hanesan O nia atan hau rona tiha ona ka? Oh Nai, Maromak iha Israel, favór ida, foo hatene ba O nia atan.” Nai hataan, “Nia sei tuun mai.”
verses.12: Depois David husu, “Ema Keila sira atu entrega hau ho hau nia ema sira ba Saul nia liman ka?” Nai hataan, “Sira sei entrega imi.”
verses.13: Nunee David ho nia ema sira, maizoumenus ema nain atus neen, sira prepara aan no sai hosi Keila hodi baa fatin nebee deit sira bele baa. Bainhira ema foo hatene ba Saul katak David halai sai ona hosi Keila entaun Saul la konsege sai baa.
verses.14: David hela iha rai fuik maran, iha fatin nebee bele subar. Nia hela iha foho iha rai fuik naran Zife. Saul buka nia loro-loron, maibee Maromak la entrega David ba Saul nia liman.
verses.15: David haree katak Saul buka nia hodi oho nia. David hela iha Horesa, iha rai fuik maran Zife.
verses.16: No Jonatan, Saul nia oan, hamriik no baa hasoru David iha Horesa. Nia hametin David nia kbiit iha Maromak.
verses.17: Jonatan dehan ba nia, “Keta tauk, tanba hau nia apaa Saul nia liman sei la kaer ita. Ita sei sai liurai iha Israel no hau sei sai ema segundu. Hau nia apaa hatene ona kona ba nee.”
verses.18: Depois ema nain rua nee kesi malu ho akordu iha Nai nia oin. David hela iha Horesa maibee Jonatan fila ba nia uma.
verses.19: Maibee ema Zife sira baa hasoru Saul iha Gibea no dehan, “David subar besik ami nia fatin iha foho nebee besik Horesa, iha foho Hakila iha parte súl iha rai maran Jesimom.
verses.20: Se karik liurai hakarak tuun mai, bele tuun mai; ami sei entrega nia ba liurai nia liman.”
verses.21: Saul dehan, “Nai sei foo bensaun ba imi, tanba imi hatudu imi nia laran domin nee mai hau.
verses.22: Favór ida, prepara tan no baa buka hatene ninia subar fatin no see mak haree nia iha nebaa. Tanba ema foo hatene ona hau katak nia matenek loos.
verses.23: Entaun haree di-diak, buka hatene fatin hotu nebee nia subar. Depois mai foo hatene mai hau ho informasaun nebee metin no hau sei baa hamutuk ho imi. Tuir mai, tebes se nia iha rai nebaa hau sei buka nia iha fatin rihun ba rihun iha ema Judá sira nia leet.”
verses.24: Nunee sira hamriik no baa uluk Saul iha Zife. David ho nia ema hela iha rai fuik Maon, iha rai maran Jesimom nia sorin súl.
verses.25: Saul mos baa hamutuk ho nia ema hodi buka David. Ema foo hatene ba David. Nunee David tuun baa iha fatuk fatin iha rai fuik Maon. Saul rona katak David ba ona iha rai fuik Maon, nunee nia duni David iha nebaa.
verses.26: Saul lao liu hosi foho sorin ida no David hamutuk ho nia ema lao liu hosi foho ida nee nia sorin ba. David lalais lao dook tanba nia tauk Saul. No Saul ho nia ema besik atu serka ona David ho nia ema hodi ataka sira.
verses.27: Maibee ema ida mai lori lia menon ba Saul, “Lalais hakiduk mai, tanba ema Filisteu haleu ona rai iha nebaa.”
verses.28: Nunee Saul fila hosi duni David no nia ba funu hasoru ema Filisteu sira. Tanba nee ema bolu foho nee Fatuk Haketak.
verses.29: David sai hosi nebaa no nia hela iha fatin fortaleza iha foho En-Gedi.

verses.1: Tuir mai, bainhira Saul fila ona hosi funu hasoru ema Filisteu nee, sira foo hatene ba nia, katak, “David hela iha foho En-Gedi.”
verses.2: Nunee Saul hili ema rihun tolu ho isin di-diak deit hosi ema Israel hotu, no nia baa buka David ho David nia ema sira nebee iha foho fatuk laran bibi nian.
verses.3: Nia baa too bibi luhan nebee iha dalan ninin, iha fatin nebee iha fatuk kuak no Saul tama ba iha fatuk kuak laran hodi soe bee boot, maibee David ho nia ema sira tuur hela iha fatuk kuak nee nia kotuk.
verses.4: David nia ema sira dehan ba nia, “Tebes, loron too ona ba ita, loron ida nebee Nai dehan ba ita, ‘Tebes, hau entrega ona o nia inimigu ba o nia liman hodi o bele halo ba nia buat nebee o hanoin diak.’” Nunee David hamriik no nia tesi nonook Saul nia ropa ninin uitoan.
verses.5: Tuir mai, David nia fuan tuk-tuku, tanba nia tesi tiha ona Saul nia ropa.
verses.6: No nia dehan ba nia ema, “Nai hadook tiha hau hosi buat sira nee ba hau nia patraun, nebee Nai nia unjidu, katak hau nia liman la bele kona nia, tanba ema nee mak Nai nia unjidu.”
verses.7: Nunee David hapara nia ema sira ho liafuan nee. Nia la husik sira asalta Saul. Entaun Saul sai hosi fatuk kuak nee atu kontinua lao fali.
verses.8: Depois David hamriik, nia sai hosi fatuk kuak nee no bolu ba Saul, nia dehan, “Hau nia nai, liurai!” Saul haree ba kotuk. David hakneak ho oin ba rai hodi respeita nia.
verses.9: Nunee David hatete ba Saul, “Tanba saa mak ita boot rona liafuan hosi ema nebee dehan, ‘Tebes, David atu oho ita boot’?
verses.10: Tebes ohin ita haree rasik ho matan, katak ohin Nai entrega ita boot ba hau nia liman iha fatuk kuak nee. Iha ema balu nebee haruka hau oho ita boot. Maibee hau husik ita boot no dehan, ‘Hau nia liman sei la kona hau nia liurai, tanba nia mak ema nebee Nai hili ona ho mina.
verses.11: Haree lai, hau nia apaa. Haree ita boot nia ropa rohan nebee hau tesi ona iha hau nia liman! Tebes katak hau tesi ona ita boot nia batina rohan no la oho ita boot. Hodi nunee ita boot bele hatene no haree katak hau nia liman la halo aat ka nega ita boot. Hau la halo sala hasoru ita boot, mezmu ita boot duni hau hodi oho hau.
verses.12: Nai sei sai juis ba ita nain rua. Nai rasik sei selu ba ita boot, maibee hau nia liman sei la kona ita boot.
verses.13: Hanesan katuas sira konta provérbiu ida, ‘Hosi ema aat mosu buat aat, maibee hau nia liman sei la kona ita boot.’
verses.14: Ba see loos mak liurai Israel sai hodi funu hasoru nia? Ita boot atu duni see? Asu mate! Kutun ida deit!
verses.15: Nunee duni Nai sai juis ba ita nain rua hodi desidi entre hau no ita boot. Nia haree, no Nia sei luta nafatin hodi defende hau nia kazu no Nia sei foo justisa hodi hasai hau hosi ita boot nia liman.”
verses.16: Bainhira David hatete buat hotu nee ba Saul, Saul hataan, “Nee mak o nia lian ka, hau nia oan David?” Liu tiha nee Saul tanis ho lian makaas.
verses.17: Nia dehan ba David, “O iha hahalok loos nebee diak liu hau. Tanba o halo ona buat nebee diak mai hau, no hau halo buat nebee aat ba o.
verses.18: O hatudu ona mai hau loron ohin oinsaa o halo ona buat nebee diak. Mezmu Nai entrega ona hau ba o nia liman maibee o la oho hau.
verses.19: Bainhira ema ida hetan nia inimigu, ema nee sei husik deit nia hodi lao livre ka? Nunee Nai sei selu buat nebee diak ba o hanesan buat nebee o halo ona mai hau ohin loron.
verses.20: Agora, tebes, hau hatene katak o sei sai duni liurai no reinu Israel nee sei sai metin iha o nia liman.
verses.21: Nunee, jura mai hau hodi Nai nia naran katak o sei la oho hau nia jerasaun hotu no o la hamoos hau nia naran hosi hau nia família.”
verses.22: No David jura ba Saul. Depois Saul fila fali ba nia uma no David hamutuk ho ninia ema sira fila fali ba ninia fortaleza.

verses.1: Samuel mate no ema Israel hotu halibur hamutuk no tanis halerik ba nia. Sira hakoi nia iha nia uma iha Ramá. Depois David hamriik no lao ba rai fuik maran Paran.
verses.2: Iha tempu nebaa, iha mane ida hosi Maon nebee lori bisnis iha Karmelo. Ema nee riku loos, nia iha bibi malae rihun tolu no bibi timor rihun ida. Nia tesi bibi malae sira nia fulun iha Karmelo.
verses.3: Ema nee naran Nabal no nia kaben naran Abigail. Feto nee matenek no oin bonita, maibee mane nee hirus door no hahalok aat. Nia jerasaun hosi uma kain Kaleb.
verses.4: Bainhira David rona iha rai fuik maran katak Nabal tesi hela nia bibi malae nia fulun,
verses.5: David haruka joven nain sanulu no David dehan ba ema sira nee, “Imi baa Karmelo hodi hasoru ema ida naran Nabal. Imi foo kumprimentus ba nia hodi hau nia naran.
verses.6: Hatete hanesan nee ba nia nebee hela iha nebaa, ‘Salóm ba ita! Salóm ba ita nia família no salóm ba buat hotu nebee ita iha.
verses.7: Foin lalais hau rona katak ita iha ema sira nebee tesi bibi malae nia fulun. Bainhira ita nia bibi atan sira nee mak hamutuk ho ami, ami la halo aat ba sira no la iha buat ida nebee lakon hosi sira bainhira sira iha Karmelo.
verses.8: Husu took ba ita nia joven sira, no sira sei foo hatene ba ita. Nunee duni husik hau nia joven sira nee hetan grasa iha ita nia oin, tanba ami mai iha loron boot. Favór ida, foo lai ba ita nia atan sira nee no ba ita nia oan David saida mak ita iha.’”
verses.9: Bainhira David nia ema sira nee too iha nebaa, sira koalia ba Nabal hodi David nia naran tuir lia menon hosi David, depois sira hein.
verses.10: Maibee Nabal hataan ba David nia atan sira nee, no dehan, “David nee see? See mak Jessé nia oan nee? Agora dadaun, iha ema barak hanesan nee nebee halai sai hosi sira nia patraun.
verses.11: Tanba saa mak hau foti hau nia paun, hau nia bee no animál sira nebee hau oho tiha ona atu foo haan ba ema sira nebee tesi bibi fulun hodi foo fali ba ema nebee hau la hatene sira mai hosi nebee?”
verses.12: Nunee David nia joven sira fila ba sira nia fatin no bainhira sira too, sira foo hatene ba David liafuan nee.
verses.13: Depois David hatete ba nia ema, “Imi ida-idak, tara imi nia surik!” Nunee sira ida-idak tara sira nia surik. David rasik tara mos ninia surik. No maizoumenus ema nain atus haat lao tuir David. Ema nain atus rua mak hein sira nia sasaan.
verses.14: Maibee joven ida foo hatene ba Abigal, Nabal nia kaben, no nia dehan, “David haruka ema hosi rai fuik maran atu mai foo kumprimentus ba ita nia patraun, maibee nia siak sira.
verses.15: Tuir lo-loos ema sira nee halo diak ba ami. Sira la ameasa ami no la iha buat ida nebee lakon durante tempu nebee ami lao hamutuk ho sira, bainhira ami iha rai nebaa.
verses.16: Sira hanesan moru hadulas ami kalan no loron, durante ami hein bibi besik sira.
verses.17: Agora, tanba nee, hanoin di-diak kona ba saida mak ita atu halo. Tanba buat aat sei kona ita nia patraun no nia uma laran tomak. Patraun nee la iha folin, nunee ema la bele koalia ho nia.”
verses.18: Nunee Abigail servisu lalais. Nia foti paun atus rua, tua uvas iha kulit rua, bibi malae lima nebee tein tiha ona, batar tunu iha baldi lima, uvas maran futun atus ida no dosi figeira atus rua. Sira tula hotu iha kuda buru sira nia leten.
verses.19: Nunee nia dehan ba nia atan sira, “Lao uluk hau; la kleur tan hau lao tuir imi.” Maibee nia la foo hatene ba nia laen, Nabal.
verses.20: Feto nee sae nia kuda buru no nia tuun hosi foho. Nia haree hetan David no David nia ema sira nebee komesa lao tuun mai hodi hasoru nia. No feto nee hasoru sira.
verses.21: David hatete ona, “Hau tau matan ona ba ema nee nia sasaan iha rai fuik maran nee, no la iha buat ida nebee lakon hosi nia, maibee nee saugati deit. Nia selu hau nia hahalok diak ho ninia hahalok aat.
verses.22: Nunee Maromak bele kastigu David nia inimigu no liu tan nee, se karik too dadeer-saan hau sei husik deit buat ida hosi nia nebee bele soe bee iha didin.”
verses.23: Bainhira Abigail haree David, nia tuun lalais hosi nia kuda buru no nia hakneak taka rabat ba rai iha David nia oin.
verses.24: Nia hakneak iha David nia oin hodi dehan, “Hau deit, hau nia senhor, mak simu sala nee. Foo lisensa lai ba ita boot nia atan oan nee hodi koalia, no rona lai ita boot nia atan oan nia liafuan nee.
verses.25: Hau nia senhor, favór ida, la bele hola ba liafuan Nabal nian, nebee la iha folin. Nunee nia naran no nia hahalok mos hanesan. Nia naran Nabal, ema nee beik. Maibee ita boot nia atan hau la haree joven sira nebee ohin senhor haruka baa.
verses.26: Tanba nee, hau nia senhor, hodi Nai nia moris no ita boot nebee moris, Nai rasik tahan ita boot hodi la halo sala hasoru ema nia raan no la buka justisa ho ita boot nia liman rasik. Husik ita boot nia inimigu sira no sira nebee buka aat ba hau nia senhor nee bele sai ema nebee hanesan Nabal!
verses.27: Agora, ita boot nia atan oan hau lori bensaun nee atu foo ba joven sira nebee tuir hau nia senhor.
verses.28: Favór ida, foo perdaun lai ba ita boot nia atan oan hau nebee sala ona. Hau fiar katak Nai sei harii jerasaun ida hosi senhor hodi sai metin liu, tanba hau nia senhor luta iha Nai nia funu no la iha hahalok aat iha senhor nia moris.
verses.29: Bainhira ema hamriik atu duni ita boot no atu oho ita boot, Nai, ita boot nia Maromak, sei futu hau nia senhor nia moris iha Nai nia futun moris. Maibee ita boot nia inimigu sira nia moris, Nai sei soe lakon, hanesan fatuk ida lakon hosi piska dulas nia laran.
verses.30: Tuir fali mai, bainhira Nai halo diak ba ita boot tuir liafuan nebee Nia koalia tiha ona ba ita boot no ita boot sai ulun ba Israel,
verses.31: nunee hau nia senhor lalika laran susar no arepende tanba hasai raan nebee la iha razaun, tanba hau nia senhor la buka justisa ba ita boot nia aan rasik. Depois, bainhira Nai halo diak ba hau nia senhor, hanoin mos ita boot nia atan hau.”
verses.32: David hatete ba nia, “Bensaun ba Nai, Israel nia Maromak, ida nebee haruka o hodi mai hasoru hau loron ohin.
verses.33: Bensaun ba o nia liafuan, no bensaun ba o, nebee hapara hau hodi la hasai ema nia raan no buka justisa ho hau nia liman rasik.
verses.34: Tanba tebes duni, hodi Nai, Israel nia Maromak nebee moris, nebee bele tahan hau hodi la halo aat ba o, se karik ohin o la mai lalais hasoru hau, molok dadeer-saan mai, Nabal sei la iha buat ida nebee bele soe bee ba didin.”
verses.35: Depois David simu saida mak feto nee lori ba nia, no dehan ba nia, “Fila fali baa o nia uma ho dame; haree ba, hau rona ona o nia liafuan no simu ona o.”
verses.36: Abigail fila fali ba Nabal. Nia halo hela festa iha nia uma, hanesan festa liurai nian. Nabal nia fuan laran haksolok tanba nia lanu makaas. Nunee Abigail la foo hatene liafuan ida ba nia too rai loron.
verses.37: Maibee too dadeer-saan, bainhira Nabal nia matan mos ona, nia konta buat hotu ba Nabal. Nunee Nabal nia iis kotu no nia sai hanesan fatuk.
verses.38: No maizoumenus liu tiha loron sanulu Nai kastigu Nabal, nunee nia mate.
verses.39: Bainhira David rona dehan Nabal mate ona, nia dehan, “Bensaun ba Nai nebee defende hau nia kazu tanba Nabal hamoe hau, no Nia kuidadu Nia atan hau hodi la halo buat aat. Nai mak selu hasoru Nabal nia hahalok aat.” Depois David haruka ema ba koalia ho Abigail atu sai nia kaben.
verses.40: David nia atan sira mai hasoru Abigail iha Karmelo no dehan ba nia nunee, “David haruka ami mai hasoru o no husu o atu sai nia kaben.”
verses.41: Depois Abigail hamriik no hakruuk ho oin ba rai no dehan, “Tebes, ita nia atan oan hau nee bele sai atan nebee fasi senhor nia atan sira nia ain.”
verses.42: Nunee Abigail prepara aan lalais no nia sae kuda buru. No feto nain lima nebee serví nia mos tuir. Nia tuir David nia ema hodi sai David nia kaben.
verses.43: No mos David kaben ona ho Ainoa hosi Jezreel. Feto rua nee sai nia kaben.
verses.44: Maibee Saul foo ona nia oan feto, Mical, nebee David nia kaben, ba Palti, oan hosi Laís, nebee hosi Galin.

26.title: David Husik Saul Moris Ba Dala Rua

verses.1: Ema hosi Zif mai hasoru Saul iha Gibea no dehan ba nia, “Laos David subar aan iha foho Hakilá iha rai fuik Jesimon?”
verses.2: Nunee Saul hamriik no lao tuun ba rai fuik Zif ho ema rihun tolu nebee nia hili tiha ona hosi Israel hodi buka David iha rai fuik Zif.
verses.3: Saul halo akampamentu iha foho Hakilá iha Jesimon nia oin, iha dalan ninin. Maibee David hela iha rai fuik no nia haree katak Saul buka duni nia iha rai fuik nee.
verses.4: Entaun David haruka espiaun sira ba hafuhu no nia hatene katak Saul mai duni.
verses.5: David hamriik no nia lao ba too fatin nebee Saul sira hela. No David haree Saul nia toba fatin no Abner, oan hosi Ner, nebee Saul nia komandante tropas. Saul toba iha klaran no povu nia tenda hadulas nia.”
verses.6: David koalia ba Ahimelek, ema Hitita, no ba Abisai, Zeruia nia oan, nebee Joab nia maun, no nia dehan, “See mak tuun hamutuk ho hau ba Saul nia deskansa fatin?” Abisai hataan, “Hau bele tuun hamutuk ho ita.”
verses.7: David ho Abisai baa too povu nee iha tempu kalan. Nia haree hetan Saul toba hela iha tenda klaran. Saul nia dima fai metin hela iha rai besik iha nia ulun. Abner ho povu nee toba haleu nia.
verses.8: Nunee Abisai dehan ba David, “Loron ohin Maromak entrega ona ita nia inimigu ba ita nia liman. Nunee, favór ida, foo lisensa mai hau hodi sona nia ho dima nee ba rai. Hau sei sona nia dala ida deit no la presiza halo ba dala rua.”
verses.9: Maibee David dehan ba Abisai, “Keta halakon nia! See mak bele foti liman hodi hasoru Nai nia unjidu no sei iha hahalok nebee moos hela?”
verses.10: David dehan tan, “Hodi Nai nebee moris, Nai rasik sei oho nia. Loron ida nia mate deit, ka nia tama ba funu no lakon.
verses.11: Nai hadook tiha hau hodi hau nia liman la bele kona Nai nia unjidu. Maibee, favór ida, foti tiha dima nebee besik nia ulun no sanan bee nee, no mai, ita baa deit.”
verses.12: Nunee David foti tiha dima no sanan bee hosi Saul nia ulun sorin, depois sira lao ba. La iha ema ida nebee haree nia. La iha ema ida nebee hatene nia. La iha ema ida nebee hadeer. Sira hotu toba dukur tanba Nai halo sira hotu toba dukur loos.
verses.13: Depois David baa too iha sorin ba, no nia hamriik iha foho leten ho distánsia nebee dook loos hosi sira.
verses.14: David hakilar ba povu nee no ba Abner, oan hosi Ner, no nia dehan, “Abner, tanba saa mak ita la hataan?” Nunee Abner hataan dehan, “See mak nee, hodi hakilar fali ba liurai?”
verses.15: David hataan ba Abner, “Ita laos mane ka? See mak hanesan ita iha Israel? Tanba saa mak ita la hein ita nia liurai? Tanba ema ida hosi povu mai atu oho liurai, ita nia senhor.
verses.16: Buat nebee ita halo nee la diak. Hodi Nai nebee moris, ita tenki mate, tanba ita la tau matan ba ita nia liurai nebee Nai nia unjidu. Agora, haree lai, liurai nia dima ho nia sanan bee iha nia ulun sorin nee, agora iha nebee?”
verses.17: Saul konhese David nia lian, nunee nia dehan, “Ita nia lian mak nee ka, hau nia oan David?” David hataan, “Hau nia lian mak nee, hau nia senhor, Oh liurai.”
verses.18: Nia dehan, “Tanba saa mak senhor duni ita boot nia atan oan nee? Saida mak hau halo ona ba ita boot? Hahalok aat saida mak belit iha hau nia liman?
verses.19: Tanba nee, favór ida, hau nia senhor liurai rona liafuan hosi ita boot nia atan hau. Se karik Nai mak soran ita boot hodi kontra hau, husik Nia horon sakrifísiu ida. Maibee se karik ema mak halo, entaun malisan boot ba sira iha Nai nia oin, tanba sira duni hau no hau la bele hela iha Nai nia fatin. Sira dehan, “Ba ona baa, serví ba maromak seluk.’
verses.20: Tanba nee, keta husik hau nia raan fakar ba rai nebee dook hosi Nai. Tanba liurai Israel sae hodi buka kutun ida deit, hanesan ema buka manu kiukai ida iha foho.”
verses.21: Depois Saul, “Hau halo sala ona. Fila fali mai, hau nia oan David. Tanba hau sei la halo aat tan hasoru o. Tanba ohin loron, hau nia moris iha folin iha o nia matan. Tebes duni katak hau nia hahalok nee beik, no hau nia sala nee boot.”
verses.22: No David hataan, “Ida nee mak liurai nia dima! Haruka joven ida bele lao mai no foti.
verses.23: Nai sei selu ema ida-idak nia hahalok loos no fidelidade. Tanba Nai entrega ona ita boot ba hau nia liman ohin loron maibee hau lakohi oho Nai nia unjidu.
verses.24: Hanesan ita boot nia moris iha folin iha hau nia matan ohin loron, nunee mos hau nia moris sei iha folin iha Nai nia matan. No Nia sei salva hau hosi susar nia laran.”
verses.25: Nunee Saul dehan ba David, “Bensaun ba o, hau nia oan David, o sei halo buat sira nebee boot no ita sei hetan susesu.” Depois David lao ba no Saul fila fali ba nia fatin.

27.title: David Iha Ema Filisteu Sira Nia Leet

verses.1: Maibee David hanoin iha nia fuan laran, “Oinsaa mos iha loron ida hau sei mate iha Saul nia liman. Nunee diak liu hau halai ba ema Filisteu sira nia rai. Nunee Saul sei la buka tan hau iha Israel tomak no hau sei sai hosi nia liman.”
verses.2: Entaun David hamriik no lao ba, hamutuk ho ema atus neen, too Akis, oan hosi Maok, liurai hosi Gate.
verses.3: David no nia ema sira hela ho Akis iha Gate, sira ida-idak ho nia família. David ho nia feen rua nee mak Ahinoam, feto hosi Jezreel, no Abigail, feto hosi Karmelo, Nabal nia feen.
verses.4: No bainhira ema foo hatene ba Saul katak David halai ona ba Gate, nia la buka tan David.
verses.5: David hatete ba Akis, “Se karik hau hetan grasa iha ita boot nia oin, foo netik fatin ida mai hau iha aldeia ida iha foho, nunee hau bele hela iha nebaa. Tanba saa mak ita boot nia atan oan hau nee hela iha ita boot nia sidade reinu nian?
verses.6: Iha loron nebaa Akis foo Ziklag ba nia, tanba nee Ziklag sai fatin ba liurai Judá sira too agora.
verses.7: David hela iha ema Filisteu sira nia rai durante tinan ida fulan haat.
verses.8: David ho nia ema sira sae ba no duni ema Gesu, ema Gersi no ema Amalek. Tanba ema sira nee mak povu hosi rai nebaa hosi tempu antigu; sira hela hosi Sur too Ejitu.
verses.9: No David oho ema hotu iha rai nee, nia la husik ema ida moris, mane ka feto. Nia hadau sira nia bibi, karau, kuda buru, kuda kamelu no ropa. Nunee sira fila fali ba Akis.
verses.10: Bainhira Akis husu, “Ohin, o baa nebee hodi ataka ema?” David hataan, “Iha rai Negev, ema Jerameel,” ka, “Iha rai Negev, ema Keni.”
verses.11: David la husik ema ida moris, mane ka feto, hodi lori ba Gate. Tanba nia hanoin katak depois sira bele foo hatene kona ba ami, no bele dehan, “David halo hanesan nee.” Nunee nia halo hanesan nee durante nia tempu nebee nia hela iha ema Filisteu sira nia rai.
verses.12: Maibee Akis fiar ba David, tanba nia hanoin, “Hau fiar katak nia halo ema Israel odi ona nia, nia sei hela nudar atan ba hau too tinan ba tinan.”

verses.1: Tuir fali mai, iha tempu nebaa, ema Filisteu halibur sira nia tropas sira hodi funu hasoru Israel. Nunee Akis dehan ba David, “Rona di-diak, o ho o nia ema tenki baa funu hamutuk ho hau.”
verses.2: David hataan ba Akis, “Diak, ita boot sei hatene saida mak ita boot nia atan hau nee bele halo.” Depois Akis dehan ba David, “Hau sei foti o hodi sai hau nia xefi seguransa too mate.”
verses.3: Samuel mate ona no ema Israel tanis halerik tiha ona tanba nia. Sira hakoi ona nia iha Ramá, iha nia sidade. No Saul hasai tiha ona ema sira nebee bolu mate klamar no siik door sira hosi Israel.
verses.4: Ema Filisteu sira halibur malu, no sira halo akampamentu iha Sunem. Saul halibur ema Israel hotu, no sira halo akampamentu iha Gilboa.
verses.5: Bainhira Saul haree tropas ema Filisteu nee, nia fuan laran sai tauk too nakdedar.
verses.6: Saul husu ba Nai maibee Nai la hataan nia, laos liu hosi mehi, ka Urim, ka profeta sira.
verses.7: Nunee Saul dehan ba nia atan sira, “Baa buka feto ida nebee bele bolu mate klamar. Hau hakarak hasoru nia hodi husu hatene.” Nia atan sira hataan ba nia, “Iha En-Dor iha feto ida nebee bele bolu mate klamar.”
verses.8: Saul subar nia aan ho hatais ropa seluk no nia baa ho ema nain rua. Bainhira nia too ona feto nee iha kalan, Saul dehan, “Favór ida, o siik took ba hau tuir mate klamar, no bolu ema nebee hau temi ba o hodi nia mai hasoru hau.”
verses.9: Maibee feto nee hataan ba nia, “Rona lai, ita hatene saida mak Saul halo, nia oho hotu ona ema sira nebee bolu mate klamar no siik iha rai ida nee. Tanba saa mak ita halo lasu ba hau hodi hau sei mate?”
verses.10: Nunee Saul jura ba nia hodi Nai, no nia dehan, “Hodi Nai nebee moris, la iha buat aat ida nebee kona o tanba buat nee.”
verses.11: Depois feto nee husu ba nia, “See mak hau bolu hodi nia bele mai hasoru ita?” Nia hataan, “Bolu Samuel hodi mai hasoru hau.”
verses.12: Bainhira feto nee haree Samuel, nia hakilar ho lian makaas. Depois feto nee dehan ba Saul, “Tanba saa mak ita boot bosok hau? Ita boot mak Saul!”
verses.13: Nunee liurai koalia ba nia, “Keta tauk. O haree saida?” Feto nee hataan ba Saul, “Hau haree maromak sira mosu hosi rai okos.”
verses.14: Depois nia husu ba feto nee, “Nia oin oinsaa?” Feto hataan, “Iha ema katuas ida mai, nebee falun ho batina.” Nunee Saul hatene katak ida nee mak Samuel. Depois nia hakneak ho oin ba rai hodi foo respeitu ba nia.
verses.15: Liu tiha nee Samuel koalia ba Saul, “Tanba saa mak o mai bolu hau?” Saul hataan, “Hau iha tempu susar tebes. Ema Filisteu sira funu hasoru hau, no Maromak dook ona hosi hau. Nia la koalia tan mai hau, laos liu hosi profeta sira ka mehi. Tanba nee hau bolu ita boot hodi foo hatene mai hau saida mak hau bele halo.”
verses.16: Depois Samuel koalia, “Entaun nusaa mak o bolu hau? O haree ona katak Maromak husik ona o, no Nia sai o nia inimigu.
verses.17: Nai halo tuir ona saida mak Nia koalia liu hosi hau. Nai foti ona ukun hosi o nia liman no foo ba o nia maluk, nee mak David.
verses.18: Tanba o la rona Nai nia lian atu halo tuir. No o la halao Nai nia laran hirus ba Amalek. Tanba nee mak Nai halo hanesan nee ba o ohin loron.
verses.19: No mos, Nai sei entrega Israel hamutuk ho o ba ema Filisteu sira nia liman. Aban mak o ho o nia oan sira sei mai hamutuk ho hau. No Nai sei entrega tropas Israel ba ema Filisteu nia liman.”
verses.20: Iha tempu nee kedas Saul monu taka rabat ba rai tanba nia tauk rona Samuel nia lian nee. No nia la iha ona forsa tanba kalan ida loron ida nia la haan buat ida.
verses.21: Feto nee hakbesik ba Saul no haree katak nia nakdekar loos. Depois feto nee dehan ba nia, “Haree, ita boot nia atan hau nee rona ona saida mak ita boot husu. Hau la kuidadu hau nia moris no rona saida mak ita boot koalia mai hau.
verses.22: Agora, tanba nee, favór ida, rona mos ita boot nia atan hau nia lian. Husik hau foo paun fuan ida ba ita boot. Haan ba, atu nunee ita boot sei iha forsa bainhira ita lao fila fali ba.”
verses.23: Maibee Saul la simu no nia dehan, “Hau sei la haan.” Maibee bainhira nia atan sira no feto nee mos obriga nia, nunee nia rona ba sira. Depois nia hamriik hosi rai no tuur iha biti nee.
verses.24: Feto nee iha karau oan iha nia uma no nia oho kedas. Nia foti terigu, kumu no tunu sai paun nebee la kahur ho fermentu.
verses.25: Nia tau hotu iha Saul ho nia atan sira nia oin, no sira haan. Depois sira hamriik no fila iha tempu kalan nee kedas.

verses.1: Ema filisteu halibur sira nia tropas hotu iha Afek. No ema Israel sira halo akampamentu besik bee matan iha Jezreel.
verses.2: Ema Filisteu nia liurai sira pasa revista soldadu sira nebee forma tuir soldadu atus ida no soldadu rihun ida. Bainhira David ho nia ema lao liu hosi kotuk hamutuk ho Akis,
verses.3: komandante Filisteu sira nee husu, “Tanba saa mak ema Ebreu sira mak iha nee?” Akis hataan ba komandante Filisteu sira, “Laos nia mak David, nebee Saul, liurai Israel, nia atan, ida nebee hamutuk ona ho hau liu tiha loron sira no tinan sira nee? Hau la hetan falta ida iha nia dezde nia mai iha nee too ohin loron.”
verses.4: Maibee komandante Filisteu sira sai hirus ba nia. Komandante Filisteu sira hatete ba nia, “Haruka ema nee fila, nunee nia fila fali ba nia fatin nebee ita hatudu ba nia. Nia la bele baa halo funu hamutuk ho ami, atu nunee nia la bele sai ami nia inimigu iha funu laran. Tanba oinsaa mak nia bele halo kontenti nia patraun nia fuan laran? Liu hosi foo ita nia ema sira nee nia ulun sira, loos ka lae?
verses.5: Nia mak David nebee ema kanta ho simu malu too bidu, nunee,
verses.6: Depois Akis bolu David, no dehan ba nia, “Hodi Nai nebee moris, o mak ema nebee loos. Hau hanoin ida nee diak katak o lao ba-mai hamutuk ho hau nia soldadu sira. Tanba hau la hetan buat ida nebee aat hosi o, dezde o foin mai too agora. Maibee liurai sira nee la gosta o.
verses.7: Tanba nee, fila fali ba. Lao ba ho diak no la bele halo buat nebee aat iha liurai ema Filisteu sira nia oin.”
verses.8: Maibee David dehan ba Akis, “Saida mak hau halo tiha ona? No sala saida mak ita boot hetan ona iha ita boot nia atan oan hau dezde hau sai atan ba ita boot, atu nunee hau la bele tuir hodi funu hasoru hau nia senhor liurai nia inimigu?”
verses.9: Nunee Akis dehan ba David, “Hau hatene ona. Hau gosta o hanesan Maromak nia manu-ain. Maibee tanba deit komandante Filisteu sira dehan ona, ‘Nia la bele baa halo funu hamutuk ho ami.’
verses.10: Entaun dadeer-saan sedu, o ho o nia ema nebee mai hamutuk ho o, hadeer sedu. Bainhira rai huun mutin, imi baa ona.”
verses.11: Nunee dadeer-saan sedu deit, David hadeer ho nia ema hodi lao fila fali ba ema Filisteu nia rai. No ema Filisteu sira sae ba Jezreel.

30.title: David Funu Hasoru Ema Amalek Sira

verses.1: Tuir fali mai, David ho nia ema mai too iha Ziklag, iha loron ba dala tolu. Maibee ema Amalek hadau tiha ona rai Negeb too Ziklag. Ema Amalek manaan ona Ziklag no sunu ona sidade nee.
verses.2: Sira kaer feto no ema hotu iha nebaa, katuas no joven sira. Sira la oho ida, maibee sira lori ema nee no lao ba oin.
verses.3: Bainhira David no nia ema too iha sidade nee, sira haree ahi haan mohu sidade nee. No sira nia feen, oan mane no oan feto sira nee, ema kaer no dadur hotu ona.
verses.4: Depois David ho povu nebee hamutuk ho nia tanis ho lian makaas, too sira la bele tanis fali.
verses.5: David nia feen rua mos sai ema dadur, Ahinoam, feto hosi Jezreel, no Abigail, uluk Nabal nia feen, ema hosi Karmelo.
verses.6: No David hasoru susar boot, tanba povu hakarak tuda mate nia ho fatuk. Povu tomak laran susar tanba ema ida-idak hanoin nia oan mane no oan feto sira. Maibee David hetan korajen iha Nai, nia Maromak.
verses.7: Depois David foo orden ba saserdote Abiatar, oan hosi Aimeleke, “Favór ida, lori efode nee mai hau.” No Abiatar lori efode nee ba David.
verses.8: Nunee David husu ba Nai, nia dehan, “Hau bele duni grupu nee ka lae? Hau sei toman sira ka lae?” No Nai koalia ba nia, “Duni ba, tanba o sei toman sira no salva fali ema hotu.”
verses.9: Depois David baa hamutuk ho ema atus neen nebee lao ho nia. Nunee sira too ba mota Beso. No ema sira nebee iha kotuk hein iha nebaa.
verses.10: Maibee David hamutuk ho ema atus haat kontinua duni sira. Ema nain atus rua nebee kole no la bele lao liu mota Beso, hela iha nebaa.
verses.11: Depois sira hasoru ema ida hosi Ejitu iha rai fuik no sira lori nia baa hasoru David. Sira foo paun ba nia no nia haan. No sira foo bee hodi hemu.
verses.12: Sira foo dosi figeira pedasuk ida no uvas maran futun rua ba nia. Bainhira nia haan hotu tiha nia hetan forsa fali tanba nia la haan ba kalan tolu no loron tolu.
verses.13: Nunee duni David husu nia, “See mak o nia patraun no o mai hosi nebee?” Nia hataan, “Hau ema joven ida hosi Ejitu, hau atan ba ema Amalek ida. Hau nia patraun husik hau, tanba loron tolu liu ba hau moras.
verses.14: Ami ataka tiha ona rai Negeb iha ema Kereti sira no rai Judá no rai Negeb iha Kaleb, no Ziklag ami sunu hotu ona.”
verses.15: David husu ba nia, “O bele lori hau tuun ba grupu nee ka lae?” Nia hataan, “Jura ba hau hodi Maromak katak ita la oho hau no la entrega hau ba hau nia patraun nia liman no hau sei lori ita tuun ba grupu nee.”
verses.16: Bainhira nia lori David tuun ba, sira haree ema lekar ba iha rai hotu nee. Ema sira nee haan, hemu no dansa dadauk, tanba riku-soin barak tebes nebee sira hadau ona hosi rai Filisteu no rai Judá.
verses.17: No David oho sira hosi tempu kalan nee too rai nakaras iha loron tuir mai. La iha ema ida nebee halai liu, só deit ema nain atus haat nebee halai liu ho kuda kamelu.
verses.18: David hetan fali buat hotu nebee ema Amalek hadau. No nia hasai mos nia feen nain rua nee.
verses.19: La iha buat ida nebee lakon hosi sira, laos buat kiik ka boot, oan mane ka oan feto sira, riku-soin ka buat ida deit nebee ema sira nee mak hadau. David lori fila fali hotu.
verses.20: David foti bibi no karau hotu. Buat nee hotu sira lori fali iha David nia oin, no sira dehan, “Riku-soin nee mak David nian.”
verses.21: David too fali ba ema atus rua nebee kole no la konsege tuir David, nebee nia husik iha mota Beso. Nunee ema sira nee sai mai hodi hasoru David no povu sira nebee hamutuk ho nia. Bainhira David hakbesik ba ema sira nee nia foo kumprimentus ba sira.
verses.22: No ema sira nebee hahalok aat no ema nebee la iha folin nebee tuir David, sira dehan, “Tanba sira la baa hamutuk ho ami, ami sei la foo ba sira buat ida hosi riku-soin nebee ami salva ona nee. Só deit ema ida-idak bele hetan nia feen no oan sira. Ida nee sira bele lori no husik sira ba!”
verses.23: Maibee David dehan, “Hau nia maun-alin sira, imi la bele halo hanesan nee ho buat nebee Nai foo ba ita. Tanba Nia tau matan ona ba ita, no nia entrega ona grupu nee ba ita nia liman.
verses.24: See mak atu rona imi kona ba asuntu ida nee? Tanba ema nia parte nebee hein sasaan sei hanesan ho ema nia parte nebee baa halo funu, nunee tenki fahe hanesan.”
verses.25: Entaun, hosi loron nee ba oin, nia halo liafuan nee hanesan estatutu no regulamentu ida iha Israel too ohin loron.
verses.26: Bainhira David too iha Ziklag, nia haruka riku-soin balu ba katuas sira iha Judá, ba nia kolega sira, ho lia menon, “Ida nee prezenti ida hosi riku-soin nebee mai hosi inimigu Nai nian.”
verses.27: Nia haruka ba sira nebee iha Betél, iha Ramote parte súl, iha Jatir,
verses.28: iha Aroer, iha Sifmote, iha Estemoa,
verses.29: iha Rakal, iha Jerameel sira nia sidade sira, iha Keni sira nia sidade sira,
verses.30: iha Horma, iha Bor-Asaan, iha Atake,
verses.31: iha Hebron, no iha fatin hotu nebee David ho nia ema sira lao ba ona.

verses.1: Ema Filisteu funu hasoru ema Israel. Ema Israel halai hosi ema Filisteu no barak mate iha foho Gilboa.
verses.2: Samuel
verses.3: Nunee funu nee aumenta boot liu tan ba Saul, ema hanadór sira hetan nia no nia simu kanek boot hosi sira.
verses.4: Nunee duni Saul dehan ba ema nebee lori nia sasaan funu, “Losu o nia surik no sona hau ba. Se lae, ema sira nebee la halo sirkunsizaun nee sei mai sona halimar fali hau.” Maibee ema nebee lori nia sasaan funu nee lakohi tanba nia tauk tebes. Depois Saul foti surik ida no nia monu aan ba surik nee.
verses.5: Bainhira ema nebee lori nia sasaan funu nee haree Saul mate tiha ona, nia moos monu aan ba surik, depois nia mate hamutuk ho Saul.
verses.6: Nunee duni Saul, no nia oan nain tolu no ema ida nebee lori nia sasaan funu nee no nia soldadu sira hotu mate hamutuk iha loron ida nebaa.
verses.7: Bainhira ema Israel sira nebee hela iha rai tetuk sorin ba no iha Jordaun sorin ba haree katak ema Israel nee halai ona no Saul ho nia oan sira mate ona, sira hotu husik sira nia sidade sira no sira mos halai. Nunee duni ema Filisteu sira mai hodi hela metin iha nebaa.
verses.8: Dadeer-saan loron tuir mai, ema Filisteu sira mai hadau ema mate sira nia sasaan no sira hetan Saul ho nia oan mane latan mate hela iha foho Gilboa.
verses.9: Sira tesi Saul nia ulun, sira hadau nia sasaan funu hotu no haruka ema lao haleu iha ema Filisteu sira nia sidade hodi foo hatene ba sira nia uma lulik no sira nia povu.
verses.10: Depois sira tau Saul nia sasaan funu sira nee iha templu Astarote no nia mate isin sira prega iha moru Bete-Seán.
verses.11: Bainhira ema sira hosi Jabes Gilead rona kona ba saida mak ema Filisteu sira halo ona ba Saul,
verses.12: ema forti sira hotu hamriik no lao kalan tomak, no sira baa foti Saul no nia oan sira nia mate isin hosi moru Bete-Seán. Depois sira fila fali ba Jabes no sunu mate isin sira nee iha nebaa.
verses.13: Sira foti ruin no hakoi iha ai tamargeira nia okos iha Jabes. Liu tiha nee sira jejún durante loron hitu nia laran.

1.title: David Rona Katak Saul Mate Ona

verses.1: Bainhira Saul mate tiha ona, no David fila fali hosi funu nebee oho ema Amalek, nia hela loron rua iha Ziklag.
verses.2: No iha loron terseiru, ema soldadu ida hosi Saul nia akampamentu mai ho faru naklees no rai rahun iha nia ulun. Bainhira nia mai too David, nia hakneak ba rai no foo respeitu.
verses.3: David husu ba nia, “Ita mai hosi nebee?” Nia hataan ba David, “Hau halai hosi akampamentu Israel.”
verses.4: David husu tan ba nia, “Saida mak akontese? Favór ida, konta mai hau.” Nia hataan, “Povu sira halai ona hosi funu nia laran, no ema barak monu no mate. Saul ho nia oan Jonatan mos mate.”
verses.5: Nunee David hatete ba joven ida nebee mai foo hatene ba nia nee, “Oinsaa o hatene katak Saul ho nia oan Jonatan mate tiha ona?”
verses.6: Joven ida nebee mai foo hatene dehan, “Hau iha foho Gilboa no hau haree hetan Saul sadere ba nia dima. Kuda kareta sira no ema sira nebee lori kuda duni nia.
verses.7: Bainhira nia haree ba kotuk, nia haree hau no nia bolu hau; no hau hataan, ‘Hau mak nee.’
verses.8: Nia husu ba hau, ‘O mak see?’ Hau hataan ba nia, ‘Hau mak ema Amalek.’
verses.9: Depois nia hatete mai hau, ‘Favór ida, mai hamriik lai iha nee no oho hau, tanba hau iha terus boot maibee hau sei moris hela.’
