verses.52: ninia oan mane Meraiot, ninia oan mane Amarias, ninia oan mane Ahitub,
verses.53: ninia oan mane Zadok, ninia oan mane Ahimaz.
verses.54: Nee mak fatin nebee sira hela tuir sira nia hela fatin iha sira nia área rasik: ba jerasaun Arão nian, nebee inklui ema Koat sira nia uma kain, tanba fatin primeiru mak sira nian.
verses.55: Nia foo Hebron ba sira iha rai Judá, ho rai luan nebee rabat ba sidade nee.
verses.56: Maibee sidade nee nia rai luan tan no nia aldeia sira nee, sira foo ona ba Kaleb, oan mane hosi Jefuné.
verses.57: Ba jerasaun Arão nian, sira foo Hebron, nebee sidade refujiadu nian, depois ho tan Libna ho ninia rai luan, ho Jatir no Estemoa ho sira nia rai luan,
verses.58: no Hilén ho ninia rai luan, Debir ho ninia rai luan,
verses.59: Asan ho ninia rai luan, no Bet-Semes ho ninia rai luan.
verses.60: No hosi suku Benjamin: Geba ho ninia rai luan, Alemet ho ninia rai luan no Anatot ho ninia rai luan. Sira nia sidade sira iha sira nia uma kain hotu hamutuk sidade sanulu resin tolu.
verses.61: No ba Koat nia jerasaun restu, sira foo sidade sanulu liu hosi dada rifa, nebee mai hosi suku sorin hosi Manasés.
verses.62: Ba jerasaun Gerson nian, tuir sira nia uma kain, sira foo sidade sanulu resin tolu hosi suku Isakar, hosi suku Aser, hosi suku Naftali no hosi suku Manasés nebee iha Basan.
verses.63: Ba jerasaun Merari nian, tuir sira nia uma kain, sira foo sidade sanulu resin rua liu hosi dada rifa. Sira hetan sidade sira nee hosi suku Ruben, hosi suku Gad no hosi suku Zebulón.
verses.64: Nunee ema Israel sira foo sidade sira nee ba ema Levi sira ho sidade nia rai luan.
verses.65: Sira foo sidade sira nee liu hosi dada rifa. Sidade sira nebee sira temi ona naran nee mai hosi ema Judá sira nia suku, hosi ema Simeão sira nia suku no hosi ema Benjamin sira nia suku.
verses.66: Uma kain sira seluk hosi jerasaun Koat nian simu sidade sira hosi suku Efraim nudar sira nia rai.
verses.67: Sira foo ba ema sira nee, Sikém nebee sidade refujiadu nian, iha foho Efraim, ho ninia rai luan, no Gezer ho ninia rai luan,
verses.68: Jokmeam ho ninia rai luan, Bet-Horon ho ninia rai luan,
verses.69: Aijalon ho ninia rai luan no Gat-Rimon ho ninia rai luan.
verses.70: No hosi suku sorin hosi Manasés: Aner ho ninia rai luan, Bileam ho ninia rai luan. Nunee sidade sira nee sira foo ba uma kain restu hosi jerasaun Koat nian.
verses.71: Ba jerasaun Gerson, sira foo sidade sira hosi uma kain hosi Manasés nia suku sorin: Golan nebee iha Basan ho ninia rai luan, depois Astarot ho ninia rai luan;
verses.72: hosi suku Izakar: Kedes ho ninia rai luan, Daberat ho ninia rai luan,
verses.73: Ramot ho ninia rai luan no Anem ho ninia rai luan;
verses.74: no hosi suku Aser: Masal ho ninia rai luan, Abdon ho ninia rai luan,
verses.75: Hukok ho ninia rai luan no Reob ho ninia rai luan;
verses.76: hosi suku Naftali: Kedes nebee iha Galileia ho ninia rai luan, Hamon ho ninia rai luan no Kiriataim ho ninia rai luan.
verses.77: Merari nia jerasaun restu simu rai hosi suku Zebulón: Rimono ho ninia rai luan no Tabor ho ninia rai luan;
verses.78: no iha Jordaun sorin ba, besik Jerikó, iha parte lorosae hosi Jordaun, sira hetan rai hosi suku Ruben: Bezer nebee iha rai fuik ho ninia rai luan, Jaza ho ninia rai luan,
verses.79: Kedemot ho ninia rai luan no Mefaat ho ninia rai luan;
verses.80: no hosi suku Gad: Ramot iha Gilead ho ninia rai luan, Manaim ho ninia rai luan,
verses.81: Hesbon ho ninia rai luan no Jazer ho ninia rai luan.

verses.1: Oan mane sira hosi Isakar: Tola no Pua, Jasub no Simron, hamutuk nain haat.
verses.2: Oan mane sira hosi Tola: Uzi, Refaias, Jeriel, Jamai, Ibsam no Samuel, nebee nai ulun sira ba sira nia aman Tola nia uma kain. Sira mak asuwain forti iha sira nia jerasaun. No iha tempu David nian sira iha ema nain rihun rua-nulu resin rua atus neen (22.600).
verses.3: Oan mane hosi Uzi: Izraias. Oan mane sira hosi Izraias: Mikael, Obadias, Joel no Isias, hamutuk nain lima. Ema sira nee hotu mak nai ulun sira.
verses.4: No hamutuk ho sira, bazeia ba lista jerasaun, no sira nia aman sira nia uma kain, iha kompanhia militár nian nebee bele halo funu. Sira iha ema nain rihun tolu-nulu resin neen (36.000), tanba sira iha feen no oan barak.
verses.5: Sira nia maun-alin sira hosi uma kain hotu hosi Isakar mak asuwain forti. No sira rejistu ema nain rihun ualu-nulu resin hitu (87.000) tuir sira nia jerasaun.
verses.6: Oan mane sira hosi Benjamin: Bela, Beker no Jediael, hamutuk nain tolu.
verses.7: Oan mane sira hosi Bela: Ezbon, Uzi, Uziel, Jerimot, no Iri, hamutuk nain lima. Sira mak nai ulun iha sira nia aman sira nia uma kain. Sira mak asuwain ho forsa. No sira rejistu ema nain rihun rua-nulu resin rua tolu-nulu resin haat (22.034) tuir sira nia jerasaun.
verses.8: Oan mane sira hosi Beker: Zemira, Joás, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jerimot, Abias, Anatot no Alemet.
verses.9: Sira mak nai ulun iha sira nia aman sira nia uma kain. Sira mak asuwain forti. No sira rejistu ema nain rihun rua-nulu atus rua (20.200) tuir sira nia jerasaun.
verses.10: Oan mane hosi Jediael: Bilan. Oan mane sira hosi Bilan: Jeus, Benjamin, Eud, Kenaana, Zetan, Tarsis no Aisahar.
verses.11: Sira nee hotu mak Jediael nia jerasaun, sira mak nai ulun hosi sira nia aman sira nebee asuwain ho forsa. Ema sira nee mak ema nain rihun sanulu resin hitu atus rua (17.200) nebee prontu atu sai ba no halo funu.
verses.12: Supim no Hupim mak oan mane sira hosi Ir. Husim mak oan mane hosi Aher.
verses.13: Oan mane sira hosi Naftali: Jaziel, Guni, Jezer, no Salum, nebee jerasaun hosi Bila.
verses.14: Oan mane sira hosi Manasés: Asriel nebee moris hosi ninia atan feto hosi Aram nee; feto nee hetan Makir, nebee Gilead nia aman.
verses.15: Makir hola feto ba Hupim no Supim. Ninia alin feto nia naran Maaka. Makir nia oan segundu nia naran Zelofead. Zelofead iha oan feto sira.
verses.16: No Maaka, nebee Makir nia feen nee, hetan oan mane no hanaran nia Peres. Nia alin mane nia naran mak Seres, no nia oan mane sira mak Ulam no Rekem.
verses.17: Oan mane hosi Ulam: Bedan. Sira nee mak oan mane sira hosi Gilead, oan mane hosi Makir, oan mane hosi Manasés.
verses.18: Ninia feton Hamoleket hetan Isod, Abiezer no Mala.
verses.19: Oan mane sira hosi Semida mak Aian, Sikém, Liki no Aniam.
verses.20: Oan mane sira hosi Efraim: Sutela, no nia oan mak Bered, nia oan mak Tahat, nia oan mak Elada, nia oan mak Tahat,
verses.21: nia oan mak Zabad, nia oan mak Sutela, depois Ezer no Elead. Ema Gat nebee moris iha rai nee mak oho sira, tanba sira tuun baa no naok ema sira nee nia animál.
verses.22: Sira nia aman Efraim tanis halerik loron barak. No ninia maun-alin sira mai foo kamaan ba nia.
verses.23: Bainhira nia tama ba ninia feen, feto nee isin rua no hetan oan mane ida. Nia hanaran oan nee Beria, tanba buat aat nebee akontese ona ba ninia família.
verses.24: Ninia oan feto nee mak Sera nebee harii Bet-Horon Kraik no Bet-Horon Leten no mos Uzen-Sera.
verses.25: Beria nia oan mane mak Refa, depois Resef. Resef nia oan mak Tela, nia oan mak Taan,
verses.26: nia oan mak Ladan, nia oan mak Amiud, nia oan mak Elisama,
verses.27: nia oan mak Nun, nia oan mak Josué.
verses.28: Sira nia rai no hela fatin mak Betél ho ninia aldeia sira, Naaran iha parte lorosae no Gezer ho ninia aldeia sira iha parte loromonu. Depois Sikém ho ninia aldeia sira, too iha Aia ho ninia aldeia sira.
verses.29: No besik baliza ho ema Manasés sira: Bet-Sean ho ninia aldeia sira, no mos Taanak ho ninia aldeia sira, Megido ho ninia aldeia sira, Dor ho ninia aldeia sira. José, oan mane hosi Israel, hela iha fatin sira nebaa.
verses.30: Oan mane sira hosi Aser: Imna, Isva, Isvi no Berias. Sera mak sira nia feton.
verses.31: Oan mane sira hosi Berias: Heber no Malkiel; nia mak Birzavit nia aman.
verses.32: Heber hetan Jaflet, Somer no Hotam, no mos sira nia feton Sua.
verses.33: Oan mane sira hosi Jaflat: Pasak, Bimal no Asvat. Sira nee mak oan mane sira hosi Jaflat.
verses.34: Oan mane sira hosi nia alin Samer: Ahi, Roga, Jeuba no Aram.
verses.35: Oan mane sira hosi nia alin Helem: Zofa, Imna, Seles, no Amal.
verses.36: Oan mane sira hosi Zofa: Sua, Harnefer, Sual, Beri no Imra,
verses.37: Bezer, Hod, Sama, Silsa, Itran no Beera.
verses.38: Oan mane sira hosi Jeter: Jefune, Pispa no Ara.
verses.39: Oan mane sira hosi Ula: Ara, Haniel no Rizia.
verses.40: Sira nee hotu mak jerasaun Aser, nebee nai ulun iha sira nia aman nia uma kain. Sira mak asuwain ho forsa, no nai ulun ba xefi sira. Ema sira nebee rejistu iha jerasaun nee, nebee prontu atu halo funu, mak ema nain rihun rua-nulu resin neen (26.000).

verses.1: Benjamin hetan Belá, nebee oan mane ba dala ida, Asbel nebee oan mane ba dala rua, no Aará nebee oan mane ba dala tolu,
verses.2: Noá, nebee oan mane ba dala haat, no Rafa, nebee oan mane ba dala lima.
verses.3: Belá nia oan mane sira mak Adar, Gera, Abiud,
verses.4: Abisua, Naaman, Ahoa,
verses.5: Gera, Sefufan no Huram.
verses.6: Nee mak Ehud nia oan mane sira, sira mak nai ulun sira nia aman sira hosi ema nebee hela iha Geba, nebee ema lori sai ba Manaat nudar ema kastigu:
verses.7: Naaman, Aias no Gera, nebee Heglam. Gera hetan oan Uza no Ahiud.
verses.8: Saaraim hetan oan iha rai Moab, bainhira nia haruka sai tiha ninia feen Husim no Baara.
verses.9: Nia iha tan oan hosi nia feen Hodes, nebee Jobab, Zibia, Mesa, Malkam,
verses.10: Jeuz, Sakia no Mirma. Ema sira nee mak ninia oan mane sira, nebee nai ulun ba sira nia aman sira.
verses.11: Nia hetan mos oan sira hosi Husim, nebee Abitub no Elpaal.
verses.12: Elpaal nia oan mane sira: Eber, Misam no Semed (nebee harii sidade Ono no Lod ho sira nia aldeia sira);
verses.13: no mos Beria no Sema nebee nai ulun ba aman sira nebee hela iha Aijalon; sira mak duni sai tiha ema nebee hela iha Gat;
verses.14: no mos Ahio, Sasak, Jeremot.
verses.15: Zebadias, Arad, Eder,
verses.16: Mikael, Ispa no Joa, sira mak Berias nia oan sira.
verses.17: Zebadias, Mesulam, Hezeki, Heber,
verses.18: Ismerai, Izlias no Jobab, sira mak Elpaal nia oan sira.
verses.19: Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi,
verses.20: Elienai, Ziletai, Eliel,
verses.21: Adaias, Beraias no Simrat, sira mak Simei nia oan mane sira.
verses.22: Ispan, Eber, Eliel,
verses.23: Abdon, Zikri, Hanan,
verses.24: Hananias, Elam, Antotias,
verses.25: Ifdeias no Penuel, sira mak Sasak nia oan mane sira.
verses.26: Samserai, Searias, Atalias,
verses.27: Jaresias, Elias no Zikri, sira mak Jerom nia oan mane sira.
verses.28: Ema sira nee mak nai ulun ba aman sira, tuir sira nia jerasaun ida-idak, nebee nai ulun sira. No ema sira nee hela iha Jerusalém.
verses.29: Gibeon nia aman, Jeiel, hela iha Gibeon, no nia feen nia naran mak Maaka.
verses.30: Ninia oan mane primeiru mak Abdon, depois Zur, Kis, Baal, Nadab,
verses.31: Gedor, Ahio, Zeker
verses.32: no Miklot (nebee hetan Simeia). No ema sira hotu nee mos baa hela ho sira nia maun-alin sira iha Jerusalém, besik sira nia maun-alin sira seluk.
verses.33: Ner hetan Kis, no Kis hetan Saul, no Saul hetan Jonatan, Malkisua, Abinadab no Esbaal.
verses.34: Jonatan nia oan mane mak Meribaal, no Meribaal hetan Mika.
verses.35: Mika nia oan mane sira: Piton, Melek, Tarea no Akaz.
verses.36: Akaz hetan Jeoada, no Jeoada hetan Alemet, Azmavet no Zimri. Zimri hetan Moza.
verses.37: Moza hetan Binea, no ninia oan mak Rafa, no ninia oan mak Eleasa, no ninia oan mak Azel.
verses.38: Azel hetan oan mane nain neen, sira nia naran mak nee: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias no Hanan.
verses.39: Nia alin Esek nia oan mane sira: Ulam, nebee oan mane ba dala ida, Jeus nebee oan mane ba dala rua, no Elifelet nebee oan mane ba dala tolu.
verses.40: Ulam nia oan mane sira nee mak ema forti nebee iha forsa. Sira hatene hana rama. Sira iha oan barak no bei-oan sira too ema nain atus ida lima-nulu. Ema sira nee hotu mai hosi jerasaun Benjamin nian.

verses.1: Ema Israel hotu rejistu tuir sira nia jerasaun. No tebes ema hakerek sira nia naran iha Livru Liurai Israel no Liurai Judá Sira. Ema sira nee mak ema nebee tama ba kastigu iha Babilónia tanba sira nia hahalok nebee la fiel.
verses.2: Ema sira primeiru nebee fila fali ba sira nia rai, iha sira nia sidade sira, nee mak ema Israel, saserdote sira, ema Levi no atan Templu nian.
verses.3: Ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém mak ema Judá, ema Benjamin, no ema hosi Efraim no Manasés:
verses.4: Utai, nebee oan mane hosi Amiud, oan mane hosi Omri, oan mane hosi Imri, oan mane hosi Bani, hosi jerasaun Peres, nebee oan mane hosi Judá.
verses.5: No hosi ema Selá mak Asaias, nebee oan primeiru, ho ninia oan mane sira.
verses.6: Hosi ema Zera mak Jeuel ho ninia maun-alin sira, hamutuk atus neen sia-nulu (690).
verses.7: Hosi ema Benjamin mak Salu, oan mane hosi Mesulam, oan mane hosi Hodavias, oan mane hosi Hasenua;
verses.8: no Ibneias, oan mane hosi Jeroam; no Elá, oan mane hosi Uzi, oan mane hosi Mikri; no Mesulam, oan mane hosi Sefatias, oan mane hosi Reuel, oan mane hosi Ibnias;
verses.9: no sira nia maun-alin sira tuir sira nia jerasaun, hamutuk ema nain atus sia lima-nulu resin neen (956). Ema sira nee hotu mesak nai ulun ba sira nia aman sira nia uma kain sira.
verses.10: Hosi saserdote sira: Jedaias, Jeoiarib, Jakin,
verses.11: no Azarias, nebee oan mane hosi Hilkias, oan mane hosi Mesulam, oan mane hosi Zadok, oan mane hosi Meraiot, oan mane hosi Ahitub, nebee xefi iha Maromak nia uma.
verses.12: Depois Adaias, nebee oan mane hosi Jeroam, oan mane hosi Pasur, oan mane hosi Malkias, oan mane hosi Masai, oan mane hosi Adiel, oan mane hosi Jazera, oan mane hosi Mesulam, oan mane hosi Mesilemit, oan mane hosi Imer,
verses.13: ho sira nia maun-alin sira, nebee nai ulun ba sira nia aman sira nia uma kain sira, hamutuk ema nain rihun ida atus hitu neen-nulu (1.760). Ema sira nee matenek hodi halao servisu nebee serví iha Maromak nia uma.
verses.14: Hosi ema Levi sira: Semaias, nebee oan mane hosi Hasub, oan mane hosi Azrikam, oan mane hosi Hasabias, nebee hosi jerasaun Merari;
verses.15: no Bakebakar, Heres, Galal no Matanias, nebee oan mane hosi Mika, oan mane hosi Zikri, oan mane hosi Asaf;
verses.16: no Obadias, nebee oan mane hosi Semaias, oan mane hosi Galal, oan mane hosi Jedutun, no Berekias, nebee oan mane hosi Asa, oan mane hosi Elkana, nebee hela iha ema Netofa nia aldeia sira.
verses.17: Ema sira nebee hein portaun sira: Salum, Akub, Talmon no Ahiman, no sira nia maun-alin sira (Salum mak xefi).
verses.18: Too tempu nebaa sira iha Portaun Liurai iha parte lorosae. Sira mak hein portaun iha ema Levi nia akampamentu sira.
verses.19: Salum, nebee oan mane hosi Kore, oan mane hosi Ebiasaf, oan mane hosi Kora, no ninia maun-alin sira, nebee uma kain hosi ninia aman, nebee ema Kora, sira toma konta ba servisu nebee serví, no hein fatin atu tama ba Tenda, hanesan sira nia aman sira uluk toma konta ba fatin nebee tama Tenda fatin, iha akampamentu Nai nian.
verses.20: Fineias, nebee oan mane hosi Eleazar, mak sira nia xefi uluk nian; no Nai hamutuk ho nia.
verses.21: Zakarias, oan mane hosi Meselemias, mak seguransa ba portaun ba Tenda Enkontru.
verses.22: Ema sira hotu nee, nebee ema hili nudar seguransa ba portaun sira, mak ema nain atus rua sanulu resin rua (212). Sira hotu rejista ona tuir sira nia jerasaun iha sira nia aldeia sira. David no Samuel, nebee vizaun nain, mak estabelese sira nia pozisaun nee.
verses.23: Entaun sira no sira nia oan mane sira mak hein portaun sira iha Nai nia uma, nebee uma Tenda nee, nudar seguransa.
verses.24: Ema seguransa nee hein iha parte haat: lorosae, loromonu, norte no súl.
verses.25: Kada loron hitu, sira nia maun-alin sira hosi sira nia aldeia sira mai servisu ho ema sira nee.
verses.26: Tanba xefi seguransa nain haat, nebee ema Levi sira, lori sira nia knaar. Sira toma konta ba kuartu sira no tezourária iha Maromak nia uma.
verses.27: Sira toba deit iha fatin nebee haleu Maromak nia uma tanba sira nia knaar nebee atu loke fatin nee dadeer-dadeer.
verses.28: Ema balu hosi sira iha responsabilidade kona ba sasaan serví nian. Sira tenki sura sasaan bainhira ema hasai, no sura bainhira ema hatama fali sasaan nee.
verses.29: Ema balu hosi sira iha responsabilidade ba sasaan seluk nebee sasaan santu, no trigu nebee diak liu, tua uvas, mina, mina morin no ai morin.
verses.30: Ema seluk, nebee ema saserdote sira, prepara mina nebee kahur ai morin sira nee.
verses.31: Matitias, hosi ema Levi sira, nebee oan primeiru hosi Salum, ema Kora nee, iha responsabilidade kona ba tunu paun.
verses.32: No ema seluk hosi maun-alin sira nee, nebee ema Koat sira, toma konta kona ba paun Prezensa nian hodi prepara paun nee Sabdu-Sabdu.
verses.33: Ema sira nee mak kantadór sira, nebee nai ulun ba ema Levi sira nia uma kain sira, nebee hela iha kuartu Templu nian ho liberdade tanba loron no kalan sira sei halo sira nia servisu.
verses.34: Sira nee mak nai ulun ba ema Levi sira uma kain sira, no nai ulun tuir sira nia jerasaun sira. No sira hela iha Jerusalém.
verses.35: Gibeon nia aman, Jeiel, hela iha Gibeon, no nia feen nia naran mak Maaka.
verses.36: Ninia oan mane primeiru mak Abdon, depois Zur, Kis, Baal, Nadab,
verses.37: Gedor, Ahio, Zakarias no Miklot.
verses.38: Miklot nia oan mak Simeia. No sira mos hela ho sira nia maun-alin sira iha Jerusalém, besik sira nia maun-alin sira seluk.
verses.39: Ner hetan Kis, no Kis hetan Saul. Saul hetan Jonatan, Malkisua, Abinadab no Esbaal.
verses.40: Jonatan nia oan mak Meribaal, no Meribaal hetan Mika.
verses.41: Mika nia oan mane sira mak Piton, Melek, Tarea no Akaz.
verses.42: Akaz hetan Jara; Jara hetan Alemet, Azmavet no Zimri; Zimri hetan Moza.
verses.43: Moza hetan Binea; no ninia oan mak Rafaias, no ninia oan mak Eleasa, no ninia oan mak Azel.
verses.44: Azel iha oan mane nain neen, no sira nia naran mak nee: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias no Hanan. Nee mak Azel nia oan mane sira.

verses.1: Ema Filisteu sira funu hasoru ema Israel sira. Ema Israel halai hosi ema Filisteu nia oin no ema Israel monu mate iha Foho Gilboa.
verses.2: Ema Filisteu duni tuir nafatin Saul no ninia oan mane sira. Sira oho Jonatan, Abinadab no Malkisua, nebee Saul nia oan mane sira.
verses.3: Depois funu nee sai manas liu tan hasoru Saul. Hanadór sira hetan nia no nia hetan kanek hosi sira.
verses.4: Depois Saul hatete ba ema nebee lori ninia armas, “Losu o nia surik nee no sona borus hau. Atu nunee ema sira nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun nee la bele mai abuza hau.” Maibee ema nebee lori nia armas nee lakohi, tanba ema nee tauk loos. Entaun Saul foti surik ida no hamonu nia aan ba surik nee nia leten.
verses.5: Bainhira ema nebee lori Saul nia armas nee haree katak Saul mate ona, nia mos hamonu aan ba ninia surik no nia mate.
verses.6: Nunee Saul mate, no ninia oan nain tolu no ninia família hotu mate hamutuk.
verses.7: Bainhira ema Israel hotu iha foho leet nee haree katak tropas sira halai ona, no katak Saul ho ninia oan mane sira mate ona, entaun sira mos husik sira nia sidade sira no halai. Depois ema Filisteu sira mai no hela iha sidade sira nee.
verses.8: Iha loron tuir mai, bainhira ema Filisteu sira mai hodi hasai sasaan hosi mate isin sira nee, sira hetan Saul no ninia oan mane sira nebee monu iha Foho Gilboa.
verses.9: Bainhira sira hasai tiha ona Saul nia sasaan, sira foti ninia ulun fatuk ho ninia armas, depois haruka ema lao haleu ema Filisteu nia rai hodi foo hatene informasaun nee ba sira nia ídulu sira no ba povu.
verses.10: Depois sira tau Saul nia armas iha sira nia maromak sira nia uma. No sira prega ninia ulun fatuk iha Dagon nia templu.
verses.11: Bainhira Jabes-Gilead tomak rona kona ba buat hotu nebee ema Filisteu sira halo ona ba Saul,
verses.12: sira hamriik ba, ema nebee iha forsa, no sira baa foti Saul nia mate isin, no ninia oan mane sira nia mate isin sira. Sira lori hotu too iha Jabes no hakoi sira nia mate ruin iha ai huun boot ida iha Jabes. Depois sira jejún too loron hitu.
verses.13: Entaun Saul mate tanba ninia hahalok nebee kontra hasoru Nai. Tanba nia kontra Nai nia liafuan, no mos tanba nia husu hatene buat ruma hosi mate klamar.
verses.14: No nia la husu hatene hosi Nai. Tanba nee mak Nai oho nia no entrega reinu nee ba David, oan mane hosi Jessé.

verses.1: Depois ema Israel hotu halibur ba David iha Hebron no hatete, “Tebes, ami no ita boot mak ruin no isin ida deit.
verses.2: No mos, iha tempu uluk, bainhira Saul mak liurai, ita boot lori Israel sai no lori Israel tama. No Nai, ita boot nia Maromak, dehan ona ba ita boot. ‘O sei tau matan ba Hau nia povu Israel, no o sei sai komandante ba Hau nia povu Israel.’”
verses.3: Nunee katuas hotu hosi Israel mai hasoru liurai iha Hebron. No David halo aliansa ho sira iha Hebron iha Nai nia oin. No sira fui mina ba David hodi sai liurai ba Israel, tuir Nai nia liafuan liu hosi Samuel.
verses.4: Depois David no ema Israel sira hotu baa too iha Jerusalém, nebee mak Jebus. No ema Jebus hela iha rai nebaa.
verses.5: Ema nebee hela iha Jebus dehan ba David, “O sei la bele tama mai iha nee.” Maibee David konsege hadau fortaleza Zion. No fatin nee mak Sidade David.
verses.6: David hatete, “See mak primeiru atu ataka ema Jebus sira sei sai xefi no komandante.” Entaun Joab, Zeruia nia oan, sae uluk. Nunee nia mak sai xefi.
verses.7: Depois David hela iha fortaleza nee. Tanba nee mak ema hanaran fatin nee, Sidade David.
verses.8: Nia harii moru nebee haleu sidade hosi Milo too haleu sidade hotu. No Joab harii sidade restu iha nebaa.
verses.9: Nunee David sai boot liu tan tanba Nai Forsa Nain mak hamutuk ho nia.
verses.10: Nee mak xefi asuwain sira nebee hamutuk ho David. Sira foo suporta makaas liu ba ninia reinu, hamutuk ho ema Israel tomak. Hodi nunee sira bele foti nia sai liurai, tuir Nai nia liafuan kona ba Israel.
verses.11: Nee mak lista ba asuwain sira nebee hamutuk ho David: Jasobeam, ema Hakmoni, nebee xefi ba komandante sira nee. Nia foti ninia dima hodi funu hasoru ema nain atus tolu iha tempu ida deit.
verses.12: Tuir nia mak Eleazar, oan mane hosi Dodo, nebee ema Ahohi. Nia mos inklui iha asuwain nain tolu.
verses.13: Nia mak hamutuk ho David iha Pas-Damim. No ema Filisteu sira halibur hamutuk iha nebaa atu funu iha toos nebee nakonu ho trigu boot. No tropas sira halai hosi ema Filisteu sira nia oin.
verses.14: Maibee nia tuba rai metin iha kampu nee nia klaran. Sira konsege defende fatin nee no oho ema Filisteu sira. Nunee mak Nai liberta sira liu hosi salvasaun boot.
verses.15: Depois ema nain tolu hosi xefi grupu tolu-nulu mai hasoru David iha fatuk boot ida, nebee iha fatuk kuak Adulam. No tropas Filisteu sira halo hela akampamentu iha foho leet Refaim.
verses.16: Iha tempu nee, David iha hela fortaleza no postu militár Filisteu nian mak iha Belém.
verses.17: Nunee mosu hakarak ida hosi David, no nia hatete, “Oh katak iha ema ida nebee bele kuru bee hosi bee posu iha Belém nebee besik portaun nee!”
verses.18: Depois asuwain nain tolu nee halai saruntu tama ba iha ema Filisteu sira nia akampamentu. Sira kuru bee hosi bee posu iha Belém nebee besik portaun. Depois sira lori fila fali mai no foo ba David. Maibee David lakohi hemu, no nia fui sai bee nee nudar oferta ida ba Nai.
verses.19: Nia dehan, “Hadook tiha buat nee hosi hau, katak hau halo buat nee, Oh hau nia Maromak! Merese ka, katak hau hemu ema sira nee nia raan, nebee hetan perigu boot ba sira nia moris? Tanba ho perigu boot ba sira nia moris, sira lori bee nee mai hau.” Nunee nia lakohi hemu. Asuwain nain tolu nee halo buat sira nee.
verses.20: Abisai, nebee Joab nia alin, mak xefi ba ema nain tolu-nulu nee. Tanba nia foti ninia dima hodi funu hasoru ema nain atus tolu. Nia oho sira no ninia naran sai boot iha asuwain nain tolu-nulu sira nee nia leet.
verses.21: Entre ema nain tolu-nulu sira nee, nia mak ema nebee hetan onra liu. Mezmu nia lidera sira nain tolu-nulu, maibee nia la tama ba grupu nebee asuwain nain tolu.
verses.22: Tuir mai mak Benaias, oan mane hosi Jeoiada, oan mane hosi ema forti hosi Kabzeel, nebee halo buat barak. Nia oho ema nain rua hosi Moab nebee forsa hanesan liaun. No mos nia tama tuun ba iha rai kuak ida iha tempu nebee iha neve no nia oho liaun ida.
verses.23: No mos nia oho ema Ejitu ida, nebee ema aas liu ho medida metru rua ho balu. Ema Ejitu nee kaer dima ida iha nia liman nebee boot hanesan ai lolon nebee badaen soru mak uza. Benaias tuun ba hasoru ema nee ho ai tonka deit. Nia hadau dima hosi ema Ejitu nee nia liman, depois nia uza dima nee hodi oho fali ema Ejitu.
verses.24: Nee mak buat nebee Benaias, oan mane hosi Jeoiada, halo ona. Ninia naran sai boot hanesan asuwain nain tolu nee.
verses.25: No entre ema nain tolu-nulu sira nee, nia mak ema nebee hetan onra boot. Maibee nia la sai boot atu hola parte ho asuwain nain tolu. No David foti nia hodi toma konta ba ninia eskoltu.
verses.26: No mos asuwain sira hosi forsa nee inklui Asael, nebee Joab nia alin; tuir mai, Elanan, oan mane hosi Dodo, nebee hosi Belém;
verses.27: Samot, nebee ema Haror; Helez, ema Peloni;
verses.28: Ira, oan mane hosi Ikes, nebee ema Tekoa; Abiezer, ema Anatot;
verses.29: Sibekai, ema Husa; Ilai, ema Ahohi;
verses.30: Maarai, ema Netofa; Heled, oan mane hosi Baaná, nebee ema Netofa;
verses.31: Itai, oan mane hosi Ribai, ema Gibea nebee hosi ema Benjamin; Benaias, ema Piraton;
verses.32: Hurai hosi Mota Gaas; Abiel, ema Arba;
verses.33: Azmavet, ema Baurim; Eliaba, ema Saalbon;
verses.34: oan mane sira hosi Hasem, ema Gizon; Jonatan, oan mane hosi Sage, ema Harari;
verses.35: Ahiam, oan mane hosi Sakar, ema Harari; Elifal, oan mane hosi Ur;
verses.36: Hefer, ema Mekera; Ahias, ema Peloni;
verses.37: Hezro, ema Karmel; Naarai, oan mane hosi Ezbai;
verses.38: Joel, nebee Natan nia alin; Mibar, oan mane hosi Hagri;
verses.39: Zelek, ema Amon; Naarai, ema Beerot, nebee lori Joab nia armas funu nian (Joab mak Zeruia nia oan mane);
verses.40: Ira, ema Itri; Gareb, ema Itri;
verses.41: Urias ema Heteu; Zabad, oan mane hosi Alai;
verses.42: Adina, oan mane hosi Siza nebee ema Ruben, nebee xefi ba ema Ruben sira no hamutuk ho nia mak ema nain tolu-nulu;
verses.43: Hanan, oan mane hosi Maaka; Josafat, ema Mitni;
verses.44: Uzia, ema Astarot; Sama no Jeiel, nebee Hotão nia oan mane sira, sira mak ema Aroer;
verses.45: Jediael, oan mane hosi Simri, ho nia alin Joa, sira ema Tiz;
verses.46: Eliel, ema Maavi; Jeribai no Josavias, nebee Elnaam nia oan mane sira; Itma, ema Moab;
verses.47: Eliel; Obed; no Jaaziel, ema Mezoba.

verses.1: Ema sira nebee tuir mai nee mak sira nebee mai ba David iha Ziklag, iha tempu nebee nia subar hela hosi Saul, Kis nia oan. Sira mos iha asuwain sira nia leet, nebee ajuda David iha funu laran.
verses.2: Sira lori armas nebee inklui rama, no sira bele uza liman loos no liman karuk hodi tuda fatuk ho piska dulas no hana rama. Sira mak ema Benjamin sira, nebee hosi Saul nia família.
verses.3: Ahiezer mak nai ulun, depois Joás, nebee oan mane sira hosi Semaá, nebee ema Gibea; Jeziel no Pelet, oan mane sira hosi Azmavet; Beraka no Jeú, ema Anatot;
verses.4: Ismaias, ema Gibeon nebee hosi asuwain nain tolu-nulu sira nee, no nia lidera ema nain tolu-nulu; Jeremias, Jaaziel, Joanan no Jozabad, ema Gedera;
verses.5: Eluzai, Jerimot, Bealias, Semarias no Sefatias, ema Harife;
verses.6: Elkana, Isias, Azarel, Joezer no Jasobeam, sira mak ema Kora;
verses.7: Joela no Zebadias, oan mane sira hosi Jeroam, nebee hosi Gedor.
verses.8: No mos iha ema Gad sira nebee haketak aan hodi baa hamutuk ho David iha fortaleza nebee iha rai fuik. Sira mak asuwain nebee forsa, no funu nain nebee prontu atu funu. Sira bele uza eskudu boot no kiik. Sira nia oin haree hanesan liaun no sira nia isin moris hanesan bibi rusa nebee halai iha foho leten.
verses.9: Ezer mak nai ulun, Obadias ema ba dala rua; Eliab ema ba dala tolu;
verses.10: Mismana ema ba dala haat; Jeremias ema ba dala lima;
verses.11: Atai ema ba dala neen; Eliel ema ba dala hitu;
verses.12: Joanan ema ba dala ualu; Elzabad ema ba dala sia;
verses.13: Jeremias ema ba dala sanulu; Makbanai ema ba dala sanulu resin ida.
verses.14: Sira nee hotu mak oan mane sira hosi Gad, nebee komandante ba forsa militár. Ema nebee kiik liu hosi grupu nee bele halo funu hasoru ema nain atus ida, no ida nebee boot liu bele halo funu hasoru ema nain rihun ida.
verses.15: Mane sira nee hakur Jordaun iha fulan primeiru nian, bainhira mota nee sae aas liu mota ninin. Iha tempu nebaa, sira duni ema hotu nebee hela iha foho leet iha parte lorosae no parte loromonu.
verses.16: Ema balu hosi Benjamin no Judá mai ba David iha fortaleza.
verses.17: Depois David sai hodi simu sira no hatete, “Se imi mai ho dame hodi ajuda hau, entaun hau nia fuan laran sei pronto atu sai ida deit ho imi. Maibee se imi mai hodi entrega hau ba hau nia inimigu sira, mezmu hau la halo sala, entaun ita nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak sei haree no tesi lia ba imi.”
verses.18: Depois Espíritu falun Amasai, nebee xefi ba komandante sira nee:
verses.19: No ema balu hosi Manasés fila ba David, bainhira nia baa hamutuk ho ema Filisteu sira hodi funu hasoru liurai Saul. Maibee nia la ajuda ema Filisteu sira. Tanba liurai Filisteu sira koalia hamutuk no foti desizaun atu haruka nia fila fali. Sira hatete, “Karik nia bele fila ba ninia senhor Saul. Nunee nia sei sai perigu boot mai ami.”
verses.20: Bainhira nia baa Ziklag, ema balu hosi suku Manasés fila ba nia: Adna, Jozabad, Jediael, Mikael, Jozabad, Eliú no Ziletai. Sira mak nai ulun ba grupu sira nebee iha soldadu nain rihun ida hosi Manasés.
verses.21: No sira ajuda David hodi funu hasoru grupu naok-teen sira. Tanba sira mak asuwain brani, no komandante ba forsa.
verses.22: Loro-loron ema mai ba David hodi ajuda nia too sira sai forsa nebee boot, hanesan Maromak nia forsa.
verses.23: Nee mak númeru kona ba nai ulun sira ho tropas nebee iha armas no prontu atu funu. Sira mai ba David iha Hebron hodi entrega Saul nia reinu ba nia, tuir Nai nia liafuan.
verses.24: Ema Judá sira nebee lori eskudu no dima, hamutuk ema nain rihun neen atus ualu (6.800), nebee pronto atu funu.
verses.25: Ema Simeão sira nebee asuwain forti iha funu, hamutuk ema nain rihun hitu atus ida (7.100)
verses.26: Ema Levi sira, hamutuk nain rihun haat atus neen (4.600).
verses.27: No Jeoiada, lider ba uma kain Arão nian, no ema nebee hamutuk ho nia nain rihun tolu atus hitu (3.700).
verses.28: No Zadok, ema foin sae nebee asuwain forti, no komandante nain rua-nulu resin rua hosi ninia aman nia uma kain.
verses.29: Ema Benjamin sira, nebee família hanesan ho Saul, iha ema nain rihun tolu (3.000). Tanba too tempu nebaa, sei iha ema barak hosi suku Benjamin nebee halo tuir família Saul nian.
verses.30: Ema Efraim sira, hamutuk nain rihun rua-nulu atus ualu (20.800), nebee asuwain forti, no sira iha konhesidu iha sira nia aman sira nia uma kain.
verses.31: Hosi suku Manasés sorin ida, ema nain rihun sanulu resin ualu (18.000) nebee tau sira nia naran atu baa hasae David nudar liurai.
verses.32: Hosi ema Isakar sira, ema sira nebee kompriende tempu nee hodi hatene saida mak loos nebee ema Israel tenki halo; xefi hamutuk nain atus rua (200) ho sira nia maun-alin sira nebee tuir sira nia orden.
verses.33: Hosi Zebulón, ema sira nebee bele tama forsa militár, nebee matenek hodi halo funu, no uza armas oi-oin: hamutuk ema nain rihun lima-nulu (50.000), nebee bele forma diak no sira iha laran metin.
verses.34: Hosi Naftali, komandante nain rihun ida (1.000) ho ema nain rihun tolu-nulu resin hitu (37.000) nebee lori eskudu no dima.
verses.35: Hosi ema Dan, ema nain rihun rua-nulu resin ualu atus neen (28.600) nebee matenek atu halo funu.
verses.36: Hosi Aser, ema nain rihun haat-nulu (40.000) nebee matenek atu halo funu.
verses.37: Hosi Jordaun sorin ba, hosi ema Ruben, ema Gad no ema Manasés sorin ida, ema sira nebee hatene lori armas oi-oin hodi halo funu, ema nain rihun atus ida rua-nulu (120.000).
verses.38: Funu nain hotu nee, nebee bele forma diak, mai iha Hebron ho fuan tomak atu hasae David nudar liurai ba ema Israel tomak. No ema restu iha Israel iha fuan laran ida deit hodi hasae David nudar liurai.
verses.39: Sira hotu hela iha nebaa hamutuk ho David durante loron tolu. Sira haan hemu iha nebaa tanba sira nia maun-alin sira prepara ona hahaan ba sira.
verses.40: No mos, ema sira nebee hela besik sira, nebee hosi Isakar, Zebulón no Naftali, lori ai haan mai ho kuda buru, kuda kamelu, kuda mula no karau. Sira lori ai haan nebee trigu, dosi figeira, uvas futun, tua uvas, mina, naan karau no naan bibi. Sira lori barak loos tanba ema Israel sai haksolok.

verses.1: David koalia ho komandante ba soldadu nain rihun ida no komandante ba soldadu nain atus ida no mos ho lideransa sira hotu.
verses.2: David hatete ba sorumutu Israel tomak, “Se karik imi hanoin planu nee diak, no mos Nai, ita nia Maromak, hanoin diak, mak ita haruka ema baa foo hatene ba ita nia maun-alin sira nebee sei hela iha rai Israel tomak, no mos ba saserdote sira no ema Levi sira nebee iha sira nia sidade no aldeia sira, atu nunee sira hotu bele mai halibur iha nee.
verses.3: No husik ita lori mai fali ita nia Maromak nia Arka Aliansa. Tanba ita la hanoin Arka nee iha Saul nia tempu.”
verses.4: Nunee sorumutu tomak dehan katak sira sei halo tuir. Tanba tuir sira nia hanoin, planu nee diak.
verses.5: Entaun David halibur hamutuk ema Israel hotu, hosi Sior iha Ejitu too iha Lebo-Hamat, hodi lori Maromak nia Arka Aliansa hosi Kiriat-Jearim.
verses.6: Depois David ho ema Israel sira hotu sae baa too iha Baala, ba Kiriat-Jearim, nebee Judá nian, atu lori Maromak nia Arka Aliansa sae hosi nebaa. Sira bolu Arka nee ho Nai nia naran nebee hela iha kerubim sira nia klaran.
verses.7: Sira lori Maromak nia Arka nee iha kareta foun hosi Abinadab nia uma. Uzá no Ahiu mak lori kareta nee.
verses.8: David no ema Israel hotu dansa makaas ho forsa tomak iha Maromak nia oin, hamutuk ho kanta no toka harpa, lira, tamborin, símbalo no korneta sira.
verses.9: Bainhira sira too iha fatin nebee baku trigu iha Kidon, Uzá lolo nia liman hodi kaer Arka, tanba karau sira sidi atu monu.
verses.10: Nunee Nai sai hirus makaas ho Uzá. Depois Nia oho kedas Uzá, tanba nia lolo liman ba Arka. No Uzá mate iha nebaa iha Maromak nia oin.
verses.11: David sai hirus, tanba Nai baku makaas Uzá. Entaun ema hanaran fatin nee Perez-Uzá too agora.
verses.12: David sai tauk ba Maromak iha loron nebaa. Nia dehan, “Oinsaa mak hau bele lori Maromak nia Arka nee baa hau nia fatin?”
verses.13: Tanba nee David lakohi muda Arka baa iha ninia fatin iha Sidade David. Maibee nia lori baa iha Obed-Edom nia uma, nebee ema Gat.
verses.14: Durante fulan tolu nia laran, Maromak nia Arka hela iha Obed-Edom nia uma. No Nai haraik bensaun ba Obed-Edom nia uma kain no mos buat hotu nebee nia iha.

verses.1: Hirão, liurai hosi Tiro, haruka manu-ain ba David ho ai teka, badaen fatuk no karpenteiru sira hodi harii uma ida ba David.
verses.2: Nunee David hatene katak Nai estabelese ona nia nudar liurai ba Israel, no foti sae David nia reinu tanba Ninia povu Israel.
verses.3: David hola tan feto balu iha Jerusalém, nunee nia iha tan oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.4: David nia oan mane sira nebee moris iha Jerusalém mak nee: Samua, Sobab, Natan, Salomão,
verses.5: Ibar, Elisua, Elpelet,
verses.6: Noga, Nefeg, Jafia,
verses.7: Elisama, Beeliada no Elifilet.
verses.8: Ema Filisteu sira rona katak David simu ona unsaun nudar liurai ba ema Israel tomak. Entaun ema Filisteu sira hotu sae ba hodi buka David. Maibee David rona informasaun nee, nunee nia baa hasoru sira.
verses.9: No ema Filisteu sira nee mai no komesa ataka iha Foho Leet Refaim.
verses.10: Entaun David husu ba Maromak, “Hau bele sae baa no funu hasoru ema Filisteu sira nee ka lae? O sei entrega sira mai hau nia liman ka?” Nai hataan, “Sae ba, tanba Hau sei entrega sira ba o nia liman.”
verses.11: Depois nia sae too iha Baal-Perazim, no David oho sira iha nebaa. David hatete, “Maromak baku hau nia inimigu liu hosi hau hanesan bee nebee baku sai.” Tanba nee ema hanaran fatin nee Baal-Perazim.
verses.12: Ema Filisteu sira nee husik hela sira nia maromak sira iha nebaa. Nunee David foo orden no ema Israel sira sunu estátua sira nee ho ahi.
verses.13: Ema Filisteu sira ataka dala ida tan iha foho leet nebaa.
verses.14: David husu ba Maromak dala ida tan, depois Maromak hataan, “La bele sae ba hodi tuir sira. Maibee fila no lao haleu sira, no ataka sira hosi ai mahon sira nia oin.
verses.15: No bainhira o rona lian iha ai mahon tutun nebee hanesan ema marxa, o tenki sai no funu ba. Tanba Maromak baa ona hodi funu iha o nia oin atu oho ema Filisteu sira nia forsa.”
verses.16: No David halo tuir Maromak nia orden ba nia. No sira oho forsa Filisteu sira, hahuu hosi Gibeon too iha Gezer.
verses.17: Nunee David nia naran sai boot liu iha rai hotu, no Nai halo nasaun sira hotu sai tauk ba nia.

verses.1: David halo ninia uma sira iha Sidade David. No nia prepara fatin ida ba Maromak nia Arka no harii tenda ida ba Arka nee.
verses.2: Depois David dehan, “La bele iha ema ida atu lori Maromak nia Arka nee, só deit ema Levi mak bele. Tanba Nai hili ona sira hodi lori Maromak nia Arka nee no serví ba Nia too tinan ba tinan.”
verses.3: Depois David halibur ema Israel sira hotu iha Jerusalém atu lori Nai nia Arka Aliansa nee ba iha fatin nebee nia prepara ona.
verses.4: David halibur uma kain Arão nian no ema Levi, nebee,
verses.5: oan mane sira hosi Koate: Uriel nebee xefi, no ninia maun-alin sira, ema nain atus ida rua-nulu;
verses.6: oan mane sira hosi Merari: Asaias nebee xefi, no ninia maun-alin sira, ema nain atus rua rua-nulu (220);
verses.7: oan mane sira hosi Gerson: Joel nebee xefi, no ninia maun-alin sira, ema nain atus ida tolu-nulu (130);
verses.8: oan mane sira hosi Elizafan: Semaias nebee xefi, no ninia maun-alin sira, ema nain atus rua (200);
verses.9: oan mane sira hosi Hebron: Eliel nebee xefi, no ninia maun-alin sira, ema nain ualu-nulu (80);
verses.10: oan mane sira hosi Uziel: Aminadab nebee xefi, no ninia maun-alin sira, ema nain atus ida sanulu resin rua (112).
verses.11: Depois David bolu saserdote Zadok no Abiatar ho ema Levi sira, inklui Uriel, Asaias, Joel, Semaias, Eliel no Aminadab.
verses.12: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi nebee nai ulun ba ema Levi nia uma kain sira, konsagra aan ba, imi no imi nia maluk sira. Nunee imi bele lori Nai, Israel nia Maromak nia Arka, baa fatin nebee hau prepara ona nee.
verses.13: Tanba iha loron uluk nee, Nai, ita nia Maromak baku ita, tanba ita la husu uluk ba Nia.”
verses.14: Entaun saserdote sira no ema Levi sira konsagra aan hodi lori Nai, Israel nia Maromak, nia Arka.
verses.15: Tuir mai, ema Levi sira hiit Maromak nia Arka ho ai naruk iha sira nia kabaas, hanesan Moisés haruka ona tuir Nai nia liafuan.
verses.16: David foo orden ba ema Levi nia xefi sira hodi hili sira nia maluk sira nudar kantadór sira, ho alat múzika nian hanesan lira, harpa no símbalo sira. Nunee sira bele toka no kanta ho lian haksolok.
verses.17: Nunee ema Levi sira hili Heman, oan mane hosi Joel; no hosi ninia maun-alin sira, Asaf, oan mane hosi Berekias; no hosi uma kain Merari, hosi sira nia maun-alin sira, Etan, oan mane hosi Kusaias.
verses.18: No sira nia maun-alin sira hosi grau segundu nebee hamutuk ho sira: Zakarias, Jaaziel, Semiramot, Jehiel, Uni, Eliab, Benaias, Maaseias, Matitias, Elifele, Mikneias no Obed-Edom, ho mos Jeiel, nebee servisu nudar seguransa portaun nian.
verses.19: Kantadór sira nebee Heman, Asaf no Etan hodi halo lian ho símbalo riti.
verses.20: Zakarias, Aziel, Semiramot, Jeiel, Uni, Eliab, Maaseias no Benaias hodi halo lian ho lira tuir kanta Alamot.
verses.21: Maibee Matitias, Elifeleu, Mikneias, Obed-Edom, Jeiel no Azazias sei toka diak ho harpa seminit.
verses.22: Kenanias mak xefi ba ema Levi sira nebee halo múzika. Nia diriji múzika, tanba nia matenek.
verses.23: Berekias no Elkana mak seguransa ba fatin nebee tama ba Arka.
verses.24: Sebanias, Josafat, Netanel, Amasai, Zakarias, Benaias no Eliezer, nebee saserdote sira, mak huu korneta iha Maromak nia Arka nia oin. No Obed-Edom ho Jehias mak seguransa ba fatin nebee tama ba Arka nee.
verses.25: Nunee David, katuas sira hosi Israel no komandante sira ba rihun ida baa atu lori sae Nai nia Arka Aliansa hosi Obed-Edom nia uma ho haksolok.
verses.26: Tuir mai, bainhira Maromak ajuda ema Levi sira nebee lori Nai nia Arka Aliansa, sira oferese sakrifísiu karau aman hitu no bibi-malae aman hitu.
verses.27: David hatais unuk hosi hena linhu, ho mos ema Levi sira hotu nebee lori Arka nee, no kantadór sira, no Kenanias nebee xefi ba kanta no kantadór sira. David mos hatais unuk hosi hena linhu.
verses.28: Ema Israel tomak lori Nai nia Arka Aliansa nee ho haklalak kontenti no huu bibi dikur no korneta, halo lian ho símbalo, no toka lira no harpa sira.
verses.29: Bainhira Nai nia Arka Aliansa mai too iha Sidade David, Mikal, Saul nia oan feto, hateke hosi janela. Nia haree liurai David haksoit no dansa makaas. Nunee iha nia laran nia hakribi David.

16.title: Sira Hatama Arka Iha Tenda Laran

verses.1: Depois sira lori Arka Maromak nian no tau iha tenda laran nebee David prepara tiha ona. Sira halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu dame nian iha Maromak nia oin.
verses.2: Bainhira David halo hotu ona sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu dame sira nee, nia foo bensaun ba povu nee hodi Nai nia naran.
verses.3: Nunee nia fahe paun, naan no dosi ho uvas maran ba ema Israel sira hotu, ba mane no feto.
verses.4: Nia hili ema Levi balu hodi serví iha Nai nia Arka nia oin, hodi bolu, foo agradese no hahii ba Nai Maromak iha Israel.
verses.5: Asaf mak xefi, tuir nia mak Zakarias, depois Jeiel, Semiramot, Jehiel, Matitias, Eliab, Benaias, Obed-Edom no Jeiel. Sira toka lira no harpa. No Asaf halo lian ho símbalo.
verses.6: Saserdote Benaias no Jahaziel huu korneta iha Maromak nia Arka Aliansa nia oin.
verses.7: Depois, iha loron nebaa, David foin foo knaar ba Asaf no ninia maluk sira atu kanta agradese ba Nai.
verses.8: Oh foo agradese ba Nai, bolu ba Ninia naran,
verses.9: Kanta ba Nia, hananu ba Nia,
verses.10: Foo sai Ninia naran santu ho glória;
verses.11: Buka Nai no Ninia forsa,
verses.12: Hanoin hetan buat furak nebee Nia halo ona,
verses.13: Oh bei-oan sira hosi Ninia atan Israel,
verses.14: Nia mak Nai, ita nia Maromak,
verses.15: Hanoin hetan Ninia aliansa too tinan ba tinan,
verses.16: nebee Nia halo ona ho Abraão,
verses.17: no Nia konfirma ba Jacó nudar estatutu ida,
verses.18: Nia dehan, “Hau sei foo rai Kanaan ba o,
verses.19: Bainhira sira laduun barak, no ema uitoan deit,
verses.20: no sira lao hosi nasaun ida ba nasaun seluk,
verses.21: Nia la husik ema ida atu halo aat ba sira,
verses.22: “Keta book Hau nia unjidu,
verses.23: Oh kanta ba Nai mundu tomak!
verses.24: Deklara Ninia glória iha nasaun sira nia leet,
verses.25: Tanba Nai mak boot, no ita bele hahii makaas ba Nia,
verses.26: Tanba nasaun sira nia maromak mak ídulu sira,
verses.27: Onra no majestade mak iha Nia oin,
verses.28: Foo ba Nai, Oh povu nia família sira,
verses.29: Foo ba Nai glória ba Ninia naran,
verses.30: hamtauk ba Nia, mundu tomak;
verses.31: Husik lalehan sira haksolok, no mundu bele kontenti,
verses.32: Husik tasi bele hakilar no buat hotu iha laran nee;
verses.33: Nunee ai horis iha ai laran sei kontenti iha Nai nia oin,
verses.34: Foo agradese ba Nai, tanba Nia diak!
verses.35: Dehan mos:
verses.36: Hahii ba Nai, Maromak iha Israel,
verses.37: Entaun David husik Asaf no ninia maluk sira iha nebaa, iha Nai nia Arka Aliansa nia oin, hodi serví nafatin iha Arka nia oin, tuir servisu nebee presiza halo loro-loron,
verses.38: no mos Obed-Edom no ninia maluk sira nebee ema nain neen-nulu resin ualu. No Obed-Edom, oan hosi Jedutun, no Hosa mak hein portaun.
verses.39: Nia husik saserdote Zadok, no ninia maluk nebee saserdote sira, iha Nai nia Tenda nia oin, iha fatin aas nebee iha Gibeon,
verses.40: hodi oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk ba Nai iha altár nebee halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk. Nunee sira bele halo beibeik, dadeer no lokraik, no halo tuir buat hotu nebee hakerek iha lei Nai nian, nebee Nia manda ona ba Israel.
verses.41: Heman no Jedutun sei hamutuk ho sira, no mos ema seluk nebee sira hili. Sira tau ema sira nee nia naran hodi foo agradese ba Nai, tanba Nia domin metin too tinan ba tinan.
verses.42: Heman no Jedutun iha korneta no símbalo hodi halo lian no kanta ba Maromak. No Jedutun nia oan sira hein portaun.
verses.43: Depois povu hotu sai fila ba sira nia uma ida-idak. No David fila ba uma hodi foo bensaun ba ninia uma kain.

verses.1: Tuir mai, bainhira David tuur hela iha nia uma, David hatete ba profeta Natan, “Tebes, hau hela iha uma laran nebee halo ho ai teka, maibee Nai nia Arka Aliansa hela iha tenda laran.”
verses.2: No Natan hatete ba David, “Halo buat hotu nebee iha ita nia fuan laran, tanba Nai mak hamutuk ho ita.”
verses.3: Maibee iha kalan nee kedas, Maromak nia liafuan mai Natan, nunee,
verses.4: “Baa no foo hatene ba Hau nia atan David, ‘Nai hatete nunee: O sei la harii uma ba Hau hodi hela.
verses.5: Hau nunka hela iha uma ida dezde Hau lori ema Israel sae hosi Ejitu too ohin loron, maibee Hau sempre baa hosi tenda ba tenda, no hosi fatin ida ba fatin seluk.
verses.6: Iha fatin hotu nebee Hau lao hamutuk ho ema Israel sira hotu, Hau foo tiha ona liafuan ida ba juis sira iha Israel, nebee Hau haruka tau matan ba Hau nia povu, nunee ka: “Tanba saa mak o la halo Hau nia uma hosi ai teka?”’
verses.7: Tanba nee, o sei hatete ba Hau nia atan David, ‘Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Hau foti ona o hosi duut fatin, bainhira o sei hein bibi malae sira, hodi sai nai ulun ba Hau nia povu Israel.
verses.8: Hau hamutuk ho o iha fatin hotu nebee o baa ona. Hau hasai tiha o nia inimigu hotu hosi o nia oin. No Hau sei halo o nia naran sai boot hanesan ema boot sira iha mundu.
verses.9: Liu tan nee, Hau sei hili fatin ba Hau nia povu Israel, no Hau sei hametin sira, nunee sira bele hela iha fatin nebee sira nian no ema sei la book tan sira. Ema hahalok aat sei la hanehan tan sira hanesan uluk,
verses.10: hosi tempu nebee Hau foin hili Hau nia juis sira hodi lori Hau nia povu Israel. Hau sei hatuun o nia inimigu hotu. No Hau foo hatene ba o katak Nai sei halo uma ba o.
verses.11: Tuir mai, bainhira o nia tinan too ona no bainhira o tenki lao hamutuk o nia bei-ala sira, nunee Hau sei hili o nia oan nebee tuir o, nebee hosi o nia oan rasik sira no Hau sei hametin ninia reinu.
verses.12: Nia mak harii uma ba Hau no Hau sei hametin ninia kadunan too tinan ba tinan.
verses.13: Hau sei sai ninia Aman, no nia sei sai Hau nia oan. Hau sei la foti Hau nia domin metin hosi nia, hanesan Hau foti ona hosi nia nebee uluk o.
verses.14: Maibee Hau sei hametin nia iha Hau nia uma no iha Hau nia reinu too tinan ba tinan. No ninia kadunan sei metin too tinan ba tinan.’”
verses.15: Nunee Natan foo hatene ba David tuir liafuan hotu nee no tuir vizaun tomak.
verses.16: Depois David tama ba laran no tuur iha Nai nia oin no hatete, “See mak hau, Oh Nai Maromak, no saida mak hau nia uma kain, katak O lori hau mai too fatin iha nee?
verses.17: Ida nee mos buat kiik iha O nia oin, Oh Maromak; tanba O mos koalia ona kona ba O nia atan hau nia uma kain iha tempu futuru nebee sei dook. O hanoin hau iha ema nia leet, Oh Nai Maromak.
verses.18: David bele koalia saida tan ba O kona ba onra nebee O foo ona ba O nia atan hau? Tanba O konhese ona O nia atan hau.
verses.19: Tanba O nia atan hau nia naran no tuir O nia hakarak mak O halo buat boot hotu nee no foo hatene ona kona ba buat hotu nebee boot nee.
verses.20: Oh Nai, la iha ida nebee hanesan O, no la iha maromak ida hanesan O, tuir buat hotu nebee ami nia tilun nee rona ona.
verses.21: Nasaun ida nebee mak hanesan O nia povu Israel? Nasaun nee mak nasaun ida nebee Maromak hola fali ba Nia aan rasik, hodi halo Ninia naran sai konhesidu no makaas, liu hosi duni sai nasaun sira hosi O nia povu nia oin, nebee O hola fali hosi Ejitu.
verses.22: O hametin tiha ona O nia povu Israel hodi sai O nia povu too tinan ba tinan. No O, Oh Nai, sai sira nia Maromak.
verses.23: No agora, Oh Nai, estabelese O nia liafuan nebee O koalia tiha ona kona ba O nia atan hau no kona ba nia uma kain hodi hametin too tinan ba tinan, no halo tuir O nia liafuan.
verses.24: Nunee husik O nia naran sai boot too tinan ba tinan no ema sei hatete, ‘Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, mak Israel nia Maromak.’ No husik O nia atan David nia uma kain sai metin iha O nia oin.
verses.25: Tanba O, Oh hau nia Maromak, foo hatene tiha ona ba O nia atan hau katak O sei harii uma ida ba hau. Tanba nee O nia atan hau hetan brani hodi halo orasaun ba O.
verses.26: Agora, Oh Nai, O mak Maromak duni no O promete ona buat diak nee ba O nia atan hau.
verses.27: Entaun agora, O kontenti atu foo bensaun ba O nia atan nia uma kain, hodi uma kain nee bele kontinua too tinan ba tinan iha O nia oin. Tanba O rasik foo bensaun tiha ona, Oh Nai, nunee hau nia uma kain sei hetan bensaun too tinan ba tinan.”

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, David manaan ema Filisteu sira no domina sira. David hadau Gat no aldeia sira iha nebaa hosi ema Filisteu sira nia liman.
verses.2: Nia mos manaan Moab. No ema Moab sai David nia atan no sira tenki selu impostu.
verses.3: David mos manaan Hadadezer, liurai hosi Zoba-Hamat, bainhira Hadadezer baa iha Mota Eufrates hodi hametin ninia podér iha nebaa.
verses.4: David foti hosi Hadadezer kuda kareta rihun ida (1.000), no ema nebee sae kuda nain rihun hitu (7.000) no tropas nain rihun rua-nulu (20.000). David haruka sira oho kuda hotu, maibee nia husik hela kuda hodi lori kuda kareta atus ida deit.
verses.5: Ema Síria mai hosi Damasku hodi ajuda Hadadezer, nebee liurai hosi Zoba. Maibee David oho ema Síria nain rihun rua-nulu resin rua (22.000).
verses.6: Depois David halo postu militár iha Síria nebee iha Damasku. Ema Síria sai David nia atan no sira tenki selu impostu. Nai sempre foo vitória ba David iha fatin naran deit nebee nia baa.
verses.7: David foti eskudu osan mean nebee Hadadezer nia atan sira uza no lori eskudu sira nee ba Jerusalém.
verses.8: Hosi Tibat no Kun, nebee Hadadezer nia sidade sira, David lori riti barak la halimar. Salomão uza riti nee hodi halo tanki riti, ai riin no sasaan seluk hosi riti.
verses.9: Tou, liurai hosi Hamate, rona katak David manaan tiha ona forsa Hadadezer nian hotu.
verses.10: Nunee Tou haruka Hadoram nia oan ba David hodi hatoo kumprimentus no parabéns ba nia, tanba David funu hasoru ona Hadadezer no nia manaan. Tanba Hadadezer sempre funu hasoru Tou. Hadoram lori sasaan oi-oin nebee halo ho osan mean, osan mutin no riti.
verses.11: No sasaan nee mos liurai David dedika ba Nai, hamutuk ho osan mutin no osan mean seluk nebee nia lori ona hosi nasaun hotu nee: hosi Edom, Moab, hosi ema Amon sira, hosi ema Filisteu sira no hosi Amalek.
verses.12: No Abisai, oan hosi Zeruia, oho ema Edom nain rihun sanulu resin ualu (18.000) iha Rai Tetuk Masin.
verses.13: Nunee nia tau postu militár balu iha Edom. Entaun ema Edom hotu sai atan ba David. Nai foo vitória ba David iha fatin naran deit nebee nia baa.
verses.14: Nunee David ukun Israel tomak. David tesi lia no halao justisa ba ninia povu hotu.
verses.15: Joab, oan hosi Zeruia, toma konta ba forsa militár; Josafat, oan hosi Ahilud, sai xefi dokumentu;
verses.16: Zadok, oan hosi Ahitub, no Ahimelek, oan hosi Abiatar, sai saserdote sira; no Savsa sai sekretaris;
verses.17: Benaia, oan hosi Jeoiada, toma konta ba ema Kereti no ema Peleti sira; no David nia oan rasik sira sai ema primeiru iha David nia sorin.

19.title: Ema Amon Hamoe Ema David Nian

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, liurai hosi ema Amon sira mate, no ninia oan sai liurai troka nia.
verses.2: Depois David dehan, “Hau sei hatudu domin metin ba Hanun, oan hosi Nahas, hanesan nia aman hatudu domin metin ona mai hau.” Entaun David haruka manu-ain sira ho lia menon atu foo kamaan ba nia, tanba Hanun nia aman mate. No David nia atan sira tama ba ema Amon sira nia rai ba Hanun hodi foo kamaan ba nia.
verses.3: Ema boot sira hosi ema Amon sira hatete ba Hanun, sira nia senhor, “Ita hanoin oinsaa? David haruka ema mai atu hatoo lia menon kamaan hodi hatudu respeitu ba ita nia aman ka? Laos David haruka nia atan sira mai hodi buka hatene, hadau no hafuhu rai nee?”
verses.4: Nunee Hanun foti David nia atan sira no koa sira nia hasan rahun no tesi badak sira nia ropa too iha parte kidun nian. Depois nia haruka sira sai.
verses.5: Bainhira ema foo hatene ba David kona ba ema sira nee, nia haruka ema hasoru sira tanba ema sira nee moe tebes. Liurai hatete, “Hela iha Jerikó too ita nia hasan rahun nee moris fali, depois fila mai.”
verses.6: Bainhira ema Amon sira haree katak David odi tebes sira, nunee Hanun no ema Amon sira haruka osan mutin kilu rihun tolu atus lima (3.500kg) hodi selu ema sira nebee sae kuda no kuda kareta hosi Mezopotámia, hosi Aram-Maaka, no hosi Zoba.
verses.7: Sira selu hodi hetan kuda kareta rihun tolu-nulu resin rua, no liurai hosi Maaka no ninia povu. Sira mai no halo akampamentu iha Medeba nia oin. No ema Amon sira halibur aan hosi sira nia sidade sira, no mai hodi halo funu.
verses.8: Bainhira David rona, nia haruka Joab lao ba hamutuk ho forsa tomak nebee iha funu nain sira.
verses.9: Depois ema Amon sira lao sai, no forma iha portaun nia oin hodi halo funu. No liurai sira nebee mai hamriik ketak iha rai tetuk nebaa.
verses.10: Bainhira Joab haree, ataka ida nee ameasa nia hosi oin no hosi kotuk, nunee nia hili ema balu nebee diak liu hosi ema Israel sira nia leet, no nia halo sira forma hodi hasoru ema Síria.
verses.11: No nia husu nia alin Abisai atu diriji povu restu nebee forma hodi hasoru ema Amon.
verses.12: Joab hatete, “Se ema Síria mak forti liu hau, nunee ita tenki ajuda hau, maibee se ema Amon mak forti liu ita, hau sei baa ajuda ita.
verses.13: Lao ho brani, hatudu forsa ba tanba ita nia povu, no ita nia Maromak nia sidade sira. Husik Nai halo buat nebee diak tuir Ninia hanoin.”
verses.14: Depois Joab ho ninia soldadu sira nebee hamutuk ho nia baa funu hasoru ema Síria no ema sira nee halai hosi ninia oin.
verses.15: Bainhira ema Amon haree katak ema Síria halai tiha ona, sira mos halai hosi Abisai, Joab nia alin, no tama iha sidade laran. Nunee Joab fila ba Jerusalém.
verses.16: Bainhira ema Síria haree katak sira lakon iha Israel nia oin, sira haruka manu-ain sira, no sira bolu ema hosi Síria nebee iha Mota Eufrates nia sorin ba. Soboke, Hadadezer nia komandante militár, lao iha sira nia oin.
verses.17: Ema foo hatene ba David, no nia halibur ema Israel hotu no sira hakur Jordaun. David hetan ema Síria sira no forma hodi funu hasoru sira. Bainhira David halo nia ema forma hodi hasoru ema Síria, nunee ema Síria funu hasoru nia.
verses.18: Ema Síria halai hosi ema Israel nia oin. No David oho ema Síria nebee sae kuda kareta nain rihun hitu (7.000) no tropas nain rihun haat-nulu (40.000). Nia oho mos Soboke, komandante ba forsa militár.
verses.19: Bainhira Hadadezer nia atan sira haree katak sira lakon ona iha Israel nia oin, sira halo dame ho David no sai ninia atan. Nunee ema Síria lakohi atu foo tan ajuda ba ema Amon sira.

verses.1: Tuir mai, iha tempu bailoron, iha tempu nebee liurai sira baibain baa atu funu, Joab lori sai forsa militár no sira harahun ema Amon sira nia rai no sira baa no serka haleu sidade Rabaa. Maibee David hein hela iha Jerusalém. Joab ataka Rabaa no estraga fatin nee.
verses.2: David foti sira nia liurai nia koroa hosi liurai nia ulun fatuk. Koroa nee iha osan mean nebee todan kilu tolu-nulu resin lima, ho mos fatuk murak nebee folin karun. No sira tau koroa nee ba David nia ulun. Nia foti riku-soin barak loos hosi sidade nee.
verses.3: No David lori povu hosi sidade nee no obriga sira servisu ho kadoo, enxada besi no baliu sira. David halo hanesan nee ba sidade hotu nebee ema Amon sira nian. Depois David ho povu hotu fila fali ba Jerusalém.
verses.4: Liu tiha nee, sira funu fali ho ema Filisteu sira iha Gezer. Iha tempu nebaa, Sibekai, ema Husat, oho Sipai nebee hosi jerasaun ema ain aas. Nunee sira manaan ema Filisteu sira.
verses.5: Depois sira halo funu fali hasoru ema Filisteu sira. No Elanan, oan hosi Jair, oho Lami, Goliat nia alin. Lami nia dima nia parte ai nian mak hanesan ai boot nebee ema uza hodi soru.
verses.6: Depois sira funu dala ida tan iha Gate. Ema ain aas iha nebaa iha liman rua iha liman fuan sanak no ninia ain rua iha ain sanak; nunee hamutuk rua-nulu resin haat. Ema nee mos hosi jerasaun ema ain aas nian.
verses.7: Nia goza ema Israel sira, nunee Jonatan, David nia maun Simea nia oan, oho mate nia.
verses.8: Ema sira nee mai hosi jerasaun nebee hosi ema ain aas iha Gate. Sira mate liu hosi David nia liman no ninia atan sira nia liman.

verses.1: Depois Diabu hamriik hasoru Israel no provoka David atu sura povu.
verses.2: David hatete ba Joab no povu nia xefi sira, “Baa sura Israel, hosi Beer-Seba too iha Dan. Lori rezultadu mai hau hodi hau bele hatene.”
verses.3: Nunee Joab hatete ba liurai, “Husik Nai bele aumenta povu nee ba dala atus ida tan! Maibee hau nia senhor liurai, laos ema hotu nee mak hau nia senhor nia atan sira? Tanba saa mak hau nia senhor hakarak halo hanesan nee? Tanba saa mak ita boot sai huun ba Israel nia sala?”
verses.4: Maibee liurai nia liafuan nee mak aas liu Joab nian. Nunee Joab sai no lao liu hosi rai Israel tomak no mai fali too Jerusalém.
verses.5: Depois Joab foo hatene ba liurai kona ba rezultadu hosi sura povu. Ema Israel sira hotu nee mak ema nain milhaun ida rihun atus ida (1.100.000) nebee hatene kaer surik. No Judá iha ema nain rihun atus haat hitu-nulu (470.000) nebee hatene kaer surik.
verses.6: Maibee Joab la sura ema Levi no ema Benjamin sira tanba liurai nia liafuan mak foer loos ba Joab.
verses.7: Maibee Maromak la kontenti ho hahalok nee, nunee Nia kastigu Israel.
verses.8: David dehan ba Maromak, “Hau halo ona sala boot tanba hau halo buat ida nee. Maibee agora, favór ida, hasai tiha O nia atan hau nia sala nee, tanba hau halo buat beik duni.”
verses.9: Depois Nai koalia ba Gad, David nia vizaun nain, no dehan,
verses.10: “Baa, no foo hatene ba David, no dehan, ‘Nai hatete nunee: Hau foo sai kastigu tolu ba o, hili ida nebee Hau sei halo ba o.’”
verses.11: Depois Gad mai hasoru David no dehan ba nia, “Nai hatete nunee: O tenki hili ida,
verses.12: ita sei hetan rai hamlaha durante tinan tolu, ka ita sei hetan inimigu sira nebee estraga no hadau ita ho surik durante fulan tolu, ka Nai nia surik durante loron tolu, nebee moras peste iha ita nia rai no Nai nia anju sei estraga Israel nia rai tomak. Nunee agora, hanoin di-diak ba, no foo hatene mai hau hodi foo hatene fali ba Ida nebee haruka hau mai iha nee.”
verses.13: Depois David hatete ba Gad, “Hau nia laran susar loos. Husik hau monu ba Nai nia liman, tanba Ninia laran luak boot tebes; maibee keta husik hau monu ba ema sira nia liman.”
verses.14: Nunee Nai haruka moras peste ba ema Israel sira no ema Israel nain rihun hitu-nulu (70.000) mate.
verses.15: Maromak haruka anju ida ba Jerusalém hodi estraga fatin nee, no bainhira nia estraga hela, Nai haree no arepende hosi buat aat nee, no Nia koalia ba anju nebee estraga, “Too ona! Hatuun lai o nia liman.” No Nai nia anju nee hamriik besik iha fatin baku trigu nebee Ornan, ema Jebus, nia fatin.
verses.16: David foti nia matan no haree anju Nai nian nebee hamriik dadaun entre mundu no lalehan, no anju nee kaer hela surik no lolo ninia liman iha Jerusalém nia leten. Nunee David no katuas sira nebee hatais hena karoon monu ho oin rabat ba rai.
verses.17: No David dehan ba Maromak, “Laos hau mak haruka ema baa sura povu? Hau rasik mak sala no hau hatudu hahalok aat loos, maibee bibi malae sira nee, sira halo saida? Favór ida, Oh Nai, hau nia Maromak, husik O nia liman kona hau no hau nia uma kain, maibee la bele kona O nia povu hodi sira hetan moras peste.”
verses.18: Depois Nai nia anju haruka Gad dehan ba David katak David tenki sae ba, no harii altár ida ba Nai iha Ornan, ema Jebus nee, nia fatin baku trigu.
verses.19: David sae ba tuir saida mak Gad hatete, nebee Gad koalia hodi Nai nia naran.
verses.20: Bainhira Ornan baku hela trigu, nia fila no haree anju nee. Nia no ninia oan mane nain haat subar aan.
verses.21: Bainhira David mai too iha Ornan, Ornan hateke no haree hetan David. Nia sai baa hosi fatin baku trigu, no nia hakneak ho oin rabat ba rai iha liurai nia oin.
verses.22: David dehan ba Ornan, “Foo mai hau fatin baku trigu nee hodi hau bele harii altár ida ba Nai. Hau bele selu folin kompletu hodi hapara moras peste nebee kona povu.”
verses.23: Ornan dehan ba David, “Ita boot bele foti deit fatin nee no hau nia senhor liurai bele halo tuir buat nebee ita boot hanoin diak. Haree ba, hau foo karau sira nee hodi halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk. Ita boot bele uza ai sira nee nebee hau uza hodi baku trigu hodi ita boot bele sunu. No ita boot bele uza trigu nee hodi halo oferta trigu nian. Hau foo buat hotu nee.”
verses.24: Maibee liurai David dehan ba Ornan, “Lae. Maibee hau sei sosa duni no selu folin kompletu. Tanba hau lakohi foti deit buat nebee o nian hodi foo ba Nai, no hau lakohi oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee hau la selu buat ida.
verses.25: Nunee David foo ba Ornan osan mean kilo hitu grama atus rua.
verses.26: David harii altár ida ba Nai iha nebaa. Nia oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu dame nian no nia bolu ba Nai. Nai rona nia hosi lalehan no hataan nia ho ahi iha altár nebee iha sakrifísiu tunu motuk.
verses.27: Depois Nai foo orden ba anju no anju nee hatama fali ninia surik ba surik fatin.
verses.28: Iha tempu nebaa, bainhira David haree katak Nai hataan ona nia iha Ornan, ema Jebus, nia fatin baku trigu, entaun nia halo sakrifísiu iha nebaa.
verses.29: Tanba iha tempu nebaa, Tabernákulu Nai nian, nebee Moisés halo iha rai fuik, no altár ba sakrifísiu tunu motuk, mak iha fatin aas iha Gibeon.
verses.30: Maibee David la bele ba iha fatin nebaa nia oin hodi husu ba Maromak, tanba nia tauk surik hosi Nai nia anju.

verses.1: Depois David dehan, “Nai Maromak nia uma sei mai hela iha nee, no iha nee mak altár sakrifísiu tunu motuk nian ba Israel.”
verses.2: David haruka ema halibur hamutuk ema estranjeiru sira iha rai Israel. Nia haruka badaen fatuk hodi prepara fatuk siku hodi harii Maromak nia uma.
verses.3: David prepara besi barak loos hodi halo pregu ba portaun nia odamatan no hodi hatutan sasaan. No nia prepara riti barak too la bele tetu.
verses.4: Nia prepara ai teka barak, tanba ema Sidon no ema Tiro sira lori ai teka barak ba David.
verses.5: David dehan, “Salomão, hau nia oan sei kiik no nurak, no uma nebee nia atu harii ba Nai tenki furak tebes, no iha konhesidu no kapaas tebes iha nasaun hotu nia oin. Nunee hau sei prepara ba fatin nee.” Entaun David prepara sasaan barak loos molok nia mate.
verses.6: Depois David bolu ninia oan mane Salomão, no foo direitu ba nia hodi harii uma ida ba Nai Maromak iha Israel.
verses.7: David dehan ba Salomão, “Hau nia oan, uluk hau hanoin atu harii uma ida ba Nai, hau nia Maromak, nia naran.
verses.8: Maibee Nai nia liafuan mai hau no dehan, ‘O fakar ona raan barak, no o halo ona funu boot. O la bele harii uma ida ba Hau nia naran, tanba o fakar raan barak iha mundu nee iha Hau nia oin.
verses.9: Tebes, o sei hetan oan mane ida nebee sei sai mane dame nian. Hau sei foo dame ba nia hosi ninia inimigu hotu nebee haleu imi. Tanba ninia naran mak Salomão, no Hau sei foo dame no rai hakmatek ba Israel iha ninia tempu.
verses.10: Nia sei harii uma ida ba Hau nia naran no nia sei sai Hau nia oan mane, no Hau sei sai ninia Aman. Hau sei estabelese ninia reinu nia kadunan iha Israel nia leet too tinan ba tinan.’
verses.11: Agora, hau nia oan, Nai mak hamutuk ho o, no foo susesu ho uma nebee o sei harii ba Nai, o nia Maromak, hanesan Nia koalia ona kona ba o.
verses.12: Só, husik Nai foo matenek klean no kompriensaun ba o. Nunee bainhira Nia foo orden ba o kona ba Israel, o bele halo tuir lei nee hosi Nai, o nia Maromak.
verses.13: Nunee o sei hetan susesu, se o halo tu-tuir estatutu no regulamentu nebee Nai foo ba Moisés kona ba Israel. Sai forti no lao ho brani, keta tauk no keta hakfodak.
verses.14: Tebes, liu hosi difikuldade mak hau prepara ona ba uma Nai nian osan mean tonelada rihun tolu atus lima (3.500 ton), osan mutin tonelada rihun tolu-nulu resin lima (35.000 ton), no riti no besi nebee la bele tetu tanba barak tebes. Hau prepara mos ai no fatuk. No o bele aumenta tan.
verses.15: O iha ema barak hamutuk ho o nebee bele servisu: ema nebee tesi ai no fatuk, no badaen ai no badaen fatuk, no badaen sira nebee matenek kona ba servisu oi-oin.
verses.16: O iha osan mean, osan mutin, riti no besi. Nunee hamriik no halo ba, no Nai sei hamutuk ho o!”
verses.17: David mos foo orden ba xefi Israel sira hodi ajuda ninia oan Salomão, no dehan,
verses.18: “Laos Nai, imi nia Maromak, mak hamutuk ho imi? Laos Nia foo deskansa ba imi iha sor-sorin? Tanba Nia entrega ona ema nebee hela iha rai nee ba hau nia liman. Ita manaan ona rai nee iha Nai nia oin no iha povu nia oin.
verses.19: Agora, desidi ho imi nia fuan laran no imi nia klamar atu buka Nai, imi nia Maromak. Hamriik no harii santuáriu ba Nai, imi nia Maromak hodi imi bele lori Nai nia Arka Aliansa Nai mai, no Maromak nia sasaan santu, no hatama ba uma nebee imi harii ba Nai nia naran.”

verses.1: Bainhira David katuas ona no idade boot, nia halo ninia oan mane Salomão sai liurai ukun Israel.
verses.2: Nia halibur hamutuk xefi Israel hotu ho saserdote no ema Levi sira.
verses.3: Sira sura ema Levi sira hosi tinan tolu-nulu ba leten. Bainhira sira sura ona ema nee sira hetan ema nain rihun tolu-nulu resin ualu (38.000).
verses.4: Hosi ema nee, ema nain rihun rua-nulu resin haat (24.000) iha knaar hodi halo servisu iha uma Nai nian, no ema nain rihun neen (6.000) sei sai funsionáriu no juis sira.
verses.5: Ema nain rihun haat (4.000) sei hein portaun, no ema nain rihun haat (4.000) sei hahii Nai ho alat múzika nebee David halo tiha ona hodi hahii Nai.
verses.6: David fahe sira ba grupu tuir Levi nia oan mane sira: Gerson, Koate no Merari.
verses.7: Hosi ema Gerson: Ladan no Simei.
verses.8: Ladan nia oan mane sira: Jehiel nebee xefi, Zetam no Joel, ema nain tolu.
verses.9: Simei nia oan mane sira: Selomit, Haziel no Haran, ema nain tolu. Ema sira nee mak xefi ba uma kain sira hosi Ladan.
verses.10: Simei nia oan mane sira: Jahat, Zina, Jeus no Berias. Oan mane nain haat hosi Simei.
verses.11: Jahat mak xefi, no Ziza mak ema segundu. Maibee Jeus no Berias iha oan mane sira nebee laduun barak. Nunee sira sura nudar uma kain ida deit.
verses.12: Koate nia oan mane sira: Amram, Izar, Hebron no Uziel, ema nain haat.
verses.13: Amram nia oan mane sira: Arão no Moisés. Sira haketak Arão hodi nia bele dedika buat nebee santu liu, nia no ninia oan mane sira too tinan ba tinan. Sira sei foo oferta iha Nai nia oin, serví ba Nia no foo bensaun ba Ninia naran too tinan ba tinan.
verses.14: Moisés, nebee ema Maromak nian, ninia oan mane sira hetan naran iha suku Levi nia leet.
verses.15: Moisés nia oan mane sira: Gersom no Eliezer.
verses.16: Gersom nia oan mane: Sebuel mak xefi.
verses.17: Eliezer nia oan mane: Rehabias mak xefi. Eliezer la iha oan mane sira seluk, maibee Rehabias iha oan mane barak tebes.
verses.18: Izhar nia oan mane: Selomit mak xefi.
verses.19: Hebron nia oan mane sira: Jerias mak xefi, Amarias ba dala rua, Jahaziel ba dala tolu no Jekameam ba dala haat.
verses.20: Uziel nia oan mane sira: Mika mak xefi, no Jesias mak segundu.
verses.21: Merari nia oan mane sira: Mali no Musi. Mali nia oan mane sira: Eleazar no Kis.
verses.22: Eleazar mate no nia la iha oan mane sira maibee nia iha oan feto sira. No sira nia maluk sira nebee Kis nia oan mane sira hola feto sira nee.
verses.23: Musi nia oan mane sira: Mali, Eder no Jeremot, ema nain tolu.
verses.24: Ema sira nee mak ema Levi nia oan sira tuir sira nia uma kain. Sira mak xefi ba aman sira, tuir sistema nebee rejistu sira kada ema ida-idak nebee servisu hodi serví iha uma Nai nia, hosi tinan rua-nulu ba leten.
verses.25: Tanba David dehan, “Nai, Maromak iha Israel, foo tiha ona deskansa ba ninia povu hodi sira bele hela iha Jerusalém too tinan ba tinan.
verses.26: No mos ba ema Levi sira nebee la presiza lori tan Tabernákulu ka fatin nee nia sasaan nebee uza iha ministériu nee.”
verses.27: Tanba liu hosi David nia liafuan ikus sira sura ema Levi sira hosi tinan rua-nulu ba leten.
verses.28: Tanba sira iha knaar atu serví Arão nia oan mane sira iha ministériu ba uma Nai nian, iha fatin nebaa, no kuartu sira nee, no hodi hamoos buat hotu nebee santu, no servisu seluk iha ministériu ba uma Maromak nian.
verses.29: Sira prepara mos paun Prezensa nian, no trigu diak ba oferta trigu nian, ba dosi nebee fermentu la iha, no paun tunu nian, no buat nebee kahur ho mina, no buat oi-oin nebee tetu no sukat.
verses.30: No sira tenki hamriik dadeer dadeer hodi foo agradese no hahii Nai, no mos iha rai nakaras.
verses.31: No sira tenki oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk hotu ba Nai iha loron Sabdu, tempu fulan foun no loron festa nian, tuir ema nain hira nebee presiza, no halo nafatin deit iha Nai nia oin.
verses.32: Nunee sira sei halo tuir orden kona ba Tenda Enkontru, no orden kona ba Fatin Santu, no orden kona ba Arão nia oan mane sira no sira nia maluk sira, iha ministériu nebee halao ba uma Nai nian.

verses.1: Arão nia oan mane sira iha grupu grupu hanesan tuir mai nee. Arão nia oan mane sira: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar no Itamar.
verses.2: Maibee Nadab no Abihu mate molok sira nia aman no sira la iha oan sira. Nunee Eleazar no Itamar halao knaar saserdote nian.
verses.3: David hamutuk ho Zadok hosi Eleazar nia oan sira no Ahimelek hosi Itamar nia oan sira, fahe saserdote sira ba grupu tuir sira nia knaar ministériu nian.
verses.4: Sira hetan xefi barak liu hosi Eleazar nia oan sira duké Itamar nia oan sira, entaun sira fahe hanesan nee. Hosi Eleazar nia oan sira, xefi nain sanulu resin neen tuir sira nia uma kain sira, no xefi nain ualu hosi Itamar nia oan sira tuir sira nia uma kain sira.
verses.5: Sira fahe ema nee liu hosi dada rifa, no sira hotu hetan oportunidade hanesan. Tanba ulun ba Fatin Santu no ulun ba Maromak nia uma mai hosi Eleazar nia oan sira no hosi Itamar nia oan sira.
verses.6: Eskriba Semaias, oan hosi Netanel, nebee ema Levi, hakerek sira nia naran iha liurai nia oin ho xefi sira, saserdote Zadok, Ahimelek nebee oan hosi Abiatar, no xefi ba saserdote no ema Levi sira nia aman sira. Sira hili uma kain ida hodi reprezenta Eleazar no uma kain ida hodi reprezenta Itamar.
verses.7: Rifa ba dala ida nee monu ba Jeorib, dala rua ba Jedaias,
verses.8: dala tolu ba Harim, dala haat ba Seorim,
verses.9: dala lima ba Malkias, dala neen ba Mijamin,
verses.10: dala hitu ba Hakoz, dala ualu ba Abias,
verses.11: dala sia ba Jesua, dala sanulu ba Sekanias,
verses.12: dala sanulu resin ida ba Eliasib, dala sanulu resin rua ba Jakim,
verses.13: dala sanulu resin tolu ba Hupa, dala sanulu resin haat ba Jesebeab,
verses.14: dala sanulu resin lima ba Bilga, dala sanulu resin neen ba Imer,
verses.15: dala sanulu resin hitu ba Hezir, dala sanulu resin ualu ba Hapizez,
verses.16: dala sanulu resin sia ba Petaias, dala rua-nulu ba Jehezkel,
verses.17: dala rua-nulu resin ida ba Jakin, dala rua-nulu resin rua ba Gamul,
verses.18: dala rua-nulu resin tolu ba Delaias, dala rua-nulu resin haat ba Maazias.
verses.19: Sira iha knaar ministériu nian hodi tama ba Nai nia uma tuir sistema loos nebee sira nia bei-ala Arão estabelese ba sira, nebee tuir orden nebee Nai, Maromak iha Israel, foo ba nia.
verses.20: Levi nia oan mane sira seluk mak nee: hosi Amram nia oan sira, Subael; hosi Subael nia oan sira, Jedeias.
verses.21: Hosi Reabias: hosi oan mane sira hosi Reabias, Isias mak oan boot.
verses.22: Hosi ema Izias sira, Selomot; hosi Selomot nia oan sira, Jahat.
verses.23: Oan mane sira hosi Hebron: Jerias mak xefi, Amarias ba dala rua, Jahaziel ba dala tolu, Jekameam ba dala haat.
verses.24: Hosi Uziel nia oan mane sira, Mika; hosi Mika nia oan sira, Samir.
verses.25: Mika nia alin mak Isias. Hosi Isias nia oan sira, Zakarias.
verses.26: Merari nia oan mane sira: Mali no Musi. Jaazias nia oan mane sira: Beno.
verses.27: Merari nia oan sira liu hosi Jaazias: Beno, Soham, Zakur no Ibri.
verses.28: Hosi Mali, Eleazar nebee la iha oan mane.
verses.29: Kona ba Kis, oan mane sira hosi Kis: Jeramel.
verses.30: Oan mane sira hosi Musi: Mali, Eder no Jerimot. Ema sira nee mak ema Levi sira nia oan mane sira tuir sira nia uma kain sira.
verses.31: No ema sira nee, xefi ba uma kain ida-idak no sira nia alin sira dada rifa, hanesan sira nia maluk sira hosi Arão nia oan sira, iha liurai David nia prezensa, hamutuk ho Zadok, Ahimelek, xefi ba saserdote sira no ulun ba saserdote sira nia uma kain sira no ema Levi sira.

verses.1: David no xefi ba ema barak nee haketak Asaf, Heman no Jedutun nia oan mane sira hodi halo ministériu. Ema sira nee foo sai profesia ho harpa, lira no símbalo sira. Sira halo lista ba ema sira nee nebee servisu tuir sira nia ministériu.
verses.2: Hosi Asaf: Zakur, Jose, Netanias no Asarela. Sira mak Asaf nia oan mane no tuir Asaf nia diresaun, nebee foo sai profesia tuir liurai nia orden.
verses.3: Hosi Jedutun nee, Jedutun nia oan mane sira: Gedalias, Zeri, Jesaias, Simei, Hasabias no Matitias. Ema nain neen nebee tuir diresaun hosi sira nia aman Jedutun. Sira foo sai profesia ho harpa no foo agradese no hahii ba Nai.
verses.4: Hosi Heman nee, Heman nia oan mane sira: Bukias, Matanias, Uziel, Sebuel, Jerimot, Hananias, Hanani, Eliata, Gidalti, Romamti-Ezer, Josbekasa, Maloti, Hotir no Mahaziot.
verses.5: Ema hotu nee mak oan sira hosi Heman. No Heman mak liurai nia vizaun nain, tuir Maromak nia liafuan atu foti sae nia. Maromak foo oan mane nain sanulu resin haat no oan feto nain tolu ba Heman.
verses.6: Ema hotu nee tuir sira nia aman nia diresaun hodi kanta iha Nai nia uma ho símbalo, lira no harpa. Sira halao ministériu nee iha Maromak nia uma tuir liurai nia orden ba Asaf, Jedutun no Heman.
verses.7: Nunee ema sura sira hamutuk ho sira nia maluk sira nebee hetan treinamentu hodi kanta ba Nai, ema hotu nebee matenek, no sira mak ema nain atus rua ualu-nulu resin ualu (288).
verses.8: Sira dada rifa kona ba sira nia knaar, ema boot no ema kiik, mestri no estudante.
verses.9: Ba Asaf, rifa ba dala ida monu ba Jose, dala rua ba Gedalia, nebee hamutuk ho ninia maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.10: dala tolu ba Zakur, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.11: dala haat ba Izri, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.12: dala lima ba Netanias, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.13: dala neen ba Bukias, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.14: dala hitu ba Jesarela, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.15: dala ualu ba Jesaias, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.16: dala sia ba Matanias, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.17: dala sanulu ba Simei, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.18: dala sanulu resin ida ba Azareel, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.19: dala sanulu resin rua ba Hasabias, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.20: dala sanulu resin tolu ba Subael, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.21: dala sanulu resin haat ba Matitias, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.22: dala sanulu resin lima ba Jeremot, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.23: dala sanulu resin neen ba Hananias, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.24: dala sanulu resin hitu ba no Josbekasa, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.25: dala sanulu resin ualu ba Hanani, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.26: dala sanulu resin sia ba Maloti, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.27: dala rua-nulu ba Eliata, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.28: dala rua-nulu resin ida ba Hotir, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.29: dala rua-nulu resin rua ba Gidalti, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.30: dala rua-nulu resin tolu ba Mahaziot, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua;
verses.31: dala rua-nulu resin haat ba Romamti-Ezer, no ninia oan no maluk sira mak ema nain sanulu resin rua.

verses.1: Kona ba grupu sira nebee hein portaun: hosi ema Kora sira, Meselemias, oan hosi Kore, nebee hosi Asaf nia oan mane sira.
verses.2: Oan sira hosi Meselemias: Zakarias ba dala ida, Jediael ba dala rua, Zebadias ba dala tolu, Jatniel ba dala haat,
verses.3: Elam ba dala lima, Jehohanan ba dala neen, Elihoenai ba dala hitu.
verses.4: Oan sira hosi Obed-Edom: Semaias ba dala ida, Jehosabad ba dala rua, Joás ba dala tolu, Sakar ba dala haat, Netanel ba dala lima,
verses.5: Amiel ba dala neen, Isakar ba dala hitu, Peultai ba dala ualu, tanba Maromak foo bensaun ba Obed-Edom.
verses.6: No mos ba ninia oan Semaias, oan mane sira moris mai nebee ukun iha sira nia uma kain, tanba sira mak asuwain nebee iha forsa.
verses.7: Oan sira hosi Semaias: Otni, Refael, Obed, Elzabad, nebee iha maluk sira nebee forti mak Elihu no Semakias.
verses.8: Oan sira hotu nee mai hosi Obed-Edom. Sira no sira nia maluk sira, ema nebee iha kbiit hodi halao ministériu mak ema nain neen-nulu resin rua hosi Obed-Edom.
verses.9: Meselemias iha oan mane sira no ninia maluk sira, ema nebee forti, mak ema nain sanulu resin ualu.
verses.10: Hosa, hosi Merari nia oan sira, iha oan mane sira: Simri nebee xefi (nia laos oan primeiru maibee ninia aman halo nia sai xefi),
verses.11: Hilkias ba dala rua, Tebalias tolu, Zakarias ba dala haat. Hosa nia oan mane no maluk sira hotu nee mak ema nain sanulu resin tolu.
verses.12: Grupu sira nee nebee hein portaun, no sira nia xefi sira, iha sira nia knaar ida-idak, hanesan sira nia maluk sira, hodi halao ministériu iha Nai nia uma.
verses.13: Sira dada rifa tuir sira nia uma kain sira, ema boot no ema kiik, hodi hetan sira nia portaun.
verses.14: Rifa ba sorin lorosae monu ba Selemias. Depois ba ninia oan mane Zakarias, konselheiru nebee matenek klean, sira dada rifa no ninia rifa monu ba sorin norte.
verses.15: Obed-Edom nian monu ba sorin súl, no ninia oan mane sira hetan portaun iha nebaa.
verses.16: Supim no Hosa hetan sorin loromonu, iha portaun Saleket, iha dalan nebee sae. Sira tenki hein troka malu.
verses.17: Sorin lorosae iha ema Levi nain neen. Parte norte iha ema nain haat kada loron ida no parte súl iha ema nain haat kada loron ida. No iha portaun nia uma iha ema rua rua.
verses.18: Iha pátiu iha sorin loromonu, ema nain haat iha dalan no rua iha pátiu nee.
verses.19: Nee mak grupu ba sira nebee hein portaun sira hosi Kora no Merari nia oan mane sira nia leet.
verses.20: Hosi ema Levi sira, Ahija mak toma konta ba armazén sira iha Maromak nia uma, no ba armazén nebee rai ema nia oferta.
verses.21: Ladan nia oan mane sira, Gerson nia oan mane sira nebee hosi Ladan, no xefi sira nebee hosi Ladan nebee ema Gerson: Jehieli.
verses.22: Oan mane sira hosi Jehieli: Zetam no ninia alin Joel, nebee toma konta ba armazén sira iha uma Nai nian.
verses.23: Hosi ema Amram sira, ema Izra sira, ema Hebron sira no ema Uziel sira;
verses.24: no Sebuel, oan hosi Gersom, oan hosi Moisés, mak xefi ba armazén sira.
verses.25: Ninia maluk sira: hosi Eliezer, ninia oan Rehabias, no ninia oan Jesaias, no ninia oan Joram, no ninia oan Zikri, no ninia oan Selomot.
verses.26: Selomot no ninia maluk sira nee toma konta ba armazén hotu nebee rai buat nebee ema foo, nebee liurai David, no aman xefi sira, no komandante sira ba ema nain rihun ida no ema nain atus ida, no komandante ba forsa, mak foo ona.
verses.27: Sira foo riku-soin nee hosi buat nebee sira hadau iha funu hodi mantein uma Nai nian.
