verses.13: Nia kontra hasoru mos liurai Nabukodonozor nebee halo ona nia jura hodi Maromak. Maibee nia halo ninia aan sai ulun toos no laran toos, nunee nia la fila ba Nai, Maromak iha Israel.
verses.14: No mos, xefi hotu hosi saserdote sira no povu halo sala aat makaas tuir buat hotu nebee foer nebee nasaun sira seluk halo. Sira halo uma Nai nian sai foer nebee uluk Nai halo santu iha Jerusalém.
verses.15: Nai, sira nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak, haruka manu-ain ba sira dala barak tanba Nia iha laran luak ba Ninia povu no ba Ninia hela fatin.
verses.16: Maibee sira goza nafatin Maromak nia manu-ain sira. Sira despreza Maromak nia liafuan no hamnasa ba Ninia profeta sira, too Nai nia laran hirus hasoru Ninia povu, too la iha dalan hodi hadia situasaun nee.
verses.17: Nunee Nai lori mai liurai hosi ema Kasdim sira hodi hasoru ema Judá sira. Liurai nee oho sira nia joven mane sira ho surik iha uma santu nia laran. Ema Kasdim sira la iha laran luak ba joven mane ka joven feto ka ema katuas ka nia nebee hakruuk tanba idade ona. Nai entrega ema hotu nee ba liurai nia liman.
verses.18: Sasaan hotu nebee iha uma Maromak nian, inklui buat boot no kiik, no riku-soin nebee iha uma Nai nian, no riku-soin hosi liurai no ninia xefi hotu - buat hotu nee, liurai lori ba Babilónia.
verses.19: Sira sunu uma Maromak nian, baku rahun moru Jerusalém, no sunu uma boot hotu ho ahi no estraga sasaan hotu nebee iha folin.
verses.20: Nia lori ema sira nebee la mate ho surik ba Babilónia. Sira sai atan ba nia no ninia bei-oan sira too reinu Persia nian mai no ukun.
verses.21: Buat nee kumpri liafuan Nai nian nebee Jeremias koalia too rai nee bele kontenti ho rai nia tempu deskansa nian. Durante tempu hotu nebee rai mamuk, rai nee halao ninia tempu deskansa, too tinan hitu-nulu.
verses.22: Bainhira Sirus sai liurai hosi Persia, iha ninia reinu nia tinan primeiru, Nai kumpri Ninia liafuan nebee Nia koalia liu hosi Jeremias. Nunee Nai muda Sirus, liurai hosi Persia, nia espíritu. Liurai foo sai avizu ida ba ninia reinu tomak no mos nia hakerek liafuan ida nee, nebee dehan:
verses.23: “Sirus, liurai hosi Persia, hatete nunee, ‘Nai Maromak iha lalehan foo reinu hotu iha mundu mai hau. Nia haruka hau harii uma ida ba Nia iha Jerusalém, nebee iha Judá. Ba Nai nia ema nebee iha imi nia leet, hau hein katak Nai, ema nee nia Maromak, mak hamutuk ho sira. No husik ema sira nee sae ba.’”

verses.1: Bainhira Sirus sai liurai hosi Persia, iha ninia reinu nia tinan primeiru, Nai kumpri Ninia liafuan nebee Nia koalia liu hosi Jeremias. Nai muda Sirus, liurai hosi Persia, nia espíritu. Nunee nia foo sai avizu ida ba ninia reinu tomak no mos nia hakerek liafuan nee, nebee dehan:
verses.2: “Sirus, liurai hosi Persia, hatete nunee: Nai Maromak iha lalehan foo reinu hotu iha mundu mai hau. Nia haruka hau harii uma ida ba Nia iha Jerusalém, nebee iha Judá.
verses.3: Ba Nai nia ema nebee iha imi nia leet, hau hein katak ema nee nia Maromak, mak hamutuk ho sira. No husik ema sira nee sae ba Jerusalém, nebee iha Judá no harii uma Nai nian, nebee Maromak iha Israel. Nia mak Maromak - nebee iha Jerusalém.
verses.4: See-see deit nebee sei hela iha fatin naran deit nebee nia hela, husik ema seluk iha ninia fatin ajuda nia ho osan mutin, osan mean, sasaan no animál sira nudar oferta voluntáriu ba uma Maromak nian nebee iha Jerusalém.”
verses.5: Depois xefi ba aman sira hosi Judá no Benjamin, saserdote no ema Levi sira hamutuk ho ema hotu nebee Maromak nia Espíritu book sira nia laran, ema sira nee hamriik hodi sae ba atu harii uma Nai nian nebee iha Jerusalém.
verses.6: Ema hotu nebee hela iha sira nia fatin foo forsa ba sira nia liman ho sasaan osan mutin, osan mean, riku-soin, animál sira, sasaan karun no buat seluk nebee oferta voluntáriu.
verses.7: No liurai Sirus lori sai sasaan nebee uma Nai nian. Iha tempu uluk, Nabukodonozor lori sasaan nee hosi Jerusalém no tau iha ninia maromak sira nia uma.
verses.8: Sirus, liurai hosi Persia, lori sai sasaan nee liu hosi Mitredate, ema tezoureiru, no sura sasaan ba Sesbazar, xefi hosi Judá.
verses.9: Sira sura sasaan nee: bikan osan mean tolu-nulu, bikan osan mutin rihun ida, manko sunu nian rua-nulu resin sia,
verses.10: manko osan mean tolu-nulu, manko osan mutin atus haat sanulu, no sasaan seluk rihun ida.
verses.11: Buat hotu nee, nebee halo hosi osan mean no osan mutin, sira iha rihun lima atus haat (5.400). Buat hotu nee Sesbazar lori sae bainhira ema kastigu lao hosi Babilónia no sae ba Jerusalém.

verses.1: Ema nebee tuir mai nee mak hosi distritu nebee sae hosi kastigu hosi sira nebee Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, lori sai ba Babilónia. Sira fila fali ba Jerusalém no Judá. Ema ida-idak fila ba ninia sidade.
verses.2: Sira baa ho Zorobabel, Jesua, Neemias, Seraias, Relaias, Mordekai, Bilsan, Mispar, Bigvai, Reum no Bana. Sira sura mane sira hosi povu Israel tuir mai nee:
verses.3: oan mane sira hosi Paros, rihun rua atus ida hitu-nulu resin rua (2.172);
verses.4: oan mane sira hosi Sefatias, atus tolu hitu-nulu resin rua (372);
verses.5: oan mane sira hosi Ara, atus hitu hitu-nulu resin lima (775);
verses.6: oan mane sira hosi Pahat-Moab, nebee oan mane sira hosi Jesua no Joab, rihun rua atus ualu sanulu resin rua (2.812);
verses.7: oan mane sira hosi Elam, rihun ida atus rua lima-nulu resin haat (1.254);
verses.8: oan mane sira hosi Zatu, atus sia haat-nulu resin lima (945);
verses.9: oan mane sira hosi Zakai, atus hitu neen-nulu (760);
verses.10: oan mane sira hosi Bani, atus neen haat-nulu resin rua (642);
verses.11: oan mane sira hosi Bebai, atus neen rua-nulu resin tolu (623);
verses.12: oan mane sira hosi Azgad, rihun ida atus rua rua-nulu resin rua (1.222);
verses.13: oan mane sira hosi Adonikam, atus neen neen-nulu resin neen (666);
verses.14: oan mane sira hosi Bigvai, rihun rua lima-nulu resin neen (2.056);
verses.15: oan mane sira hosi Adin, atus haat lima-nulu resin haat (454);
verses.16: oan mane sira hosi Ater, nebee hosi Ezekias, sia-nulu resin ulau (908);
verses.17: oan mane sira hosi Bezai, atus tolu rua-nulu resin tolu (323);
verses.18: oan mane sira hosi Jora, atus ida sanulu resin rua (112);
verses.19: oan mane sira hosi Hasum, atus rua rua-nulu resin tolu (223);
verses.20: oan mane sira hosi Gibar, sia-nulu resin lima (95);
verses.21: oan mane sira hosi Belém, atus ida rua-nulu resin tolu (123);
verses.22: mane sira hosi Netofa, lima-nulu resin neen (56);
verses.23: mane sira hosi Anatot, atus ida rua-nulu resin ualu (128);
verses.24: oan mane sira hosi Azmavet, haat-nulu resin rua (42);
verses.25: oan mane sira hosi Kiriat-Arim, nebee Kefira no Beerot, atus hitu haat-nulu resin tolu (743);
verses.26: oan mane sira hosi Rama no Geba, atus neen rua-nulu resin ida (621);
verses.27: mane sira hosi Mikmas, atus ida rua-nulu resin rua (122);
verses.28: mane sira hosi Betél no Ai, atus rua rua-nulu resin tolu (223);
verses.29: oan mane sira hosi Nebo, lima-nulu resin rua (52);
verses.30: oan mane sira hosi Mabis, atus ida lima-nulu resin neen (156);
verses.31: oan mane sira hosi Elam seluk, rihun ida atus rua lima-nulu resin haat (1.254);
verses.32: oan mane sira hosi Harom, atus tolu rua-nulu (320);
verses.33: oan mane sira hosi Lod, Hadid no Ono, atus hitu rua-nulu resin lima (725);
verses.34: oan mane sira hosi Jerikó, atus tolu haat-nulu resin lima (345);
verses.35: no oan mane sira hosi Sená, rihun tolu atus neen tolu-nulu (3.630).
verses.36: Saserdote sira mak nee: oan mane sira hosi Jedaias, hosi uma kain Jesua nian, atus sia hitu-nulu resin tolu (973);
verses.37: oan mane sira hosi Imer, rihun ida lima-nulu resin rua (1.052);
verses.38: oan mane sira hosi Pasur, rihun ida atus rua haat-nulu resin hitu (1.247);
verses.39: no oan mane sira hosi Harim, rihun ida sanulu resin hitu (1.017).
verses.40: Oan mane sira hosi Levi sira mak nee: oan mane sira hosi Jesua no Kadmiel, hosi oan mane sira hosi Hodávia, hitu-nulu resin haat (74).
verses.41: Kantadór sira, nebee oan mane sira hosi Asaf, atus ida rua-nulu resin ualu (128).
verses.42: Oan mane sira hosi ema nebee hein portaun mak nee: oan mane sira hosi Salum, oan mane sira hosi Ater, oan mane sira hosi Talmon, oan mane sira hosi Akub, oan mane sira hosi Hatita, oan mane sira hosi Sobai, hamutuk atus ida tolu-nulu resin sia (139).
verses.43: Ema nebee serví iha Templu mak nee: oan mane sira hosi Zia, oan mane sira hosi Hasufa, oan mane sira hosi Tabaot,
verses.44: oan mane sira hosi Keros, oan mane sira hosi Siá, oan mane sira hosi Padon,
verses.45: oan mane sira hosi Lebana, oan mane sira hosi Hagaba, oan mane sira hosi Akub,
verses.46: oan mane sira hosi Hagab, oan mane sira hosi Salmai, oan mane sira hosi Hanan,
verses.47: oan mane sira hosi Gidel, oan mane sira hosi Gahar, oan mane sira hosi Reaias,
verses.48: oan mane sira hosi Rexin, oan mane sira hosi Nekoda, oan mane sira hosi Gazam,
verses.49: oan mane sira hosi Uza, oan mane sira hosi Pasea, oan mane sira hosi Besai,
verses.50: oan mane sira hosi Asna, oan mane sira hosi Meunim, oan mane sira hosi Nefusim,
verses.51: oan mane sira hosi Bakbuk, oan mane sira hosi Hakufa, oan mane sira hosi Harur,
verses.52: oan mane sira hosi Bazlut, oan mane sira hosi Mehida, oan mane sira hosi Harsa,
verses.53: oan mane sira hosi Barkos, oan mane sira hosi Sisera, oan mane sira hosi Tema,
verses.54: oan mane sira hosi Nezia, no oan mane sira hosi Hatifa.
verses.55: Oan mane sira hosi Salomão nia atan sira mak nee: oan mane sira hosi Sotai, oan mane sira hosi Soferet, oan mane sira hosi Perudam,
verses.56: oan mane sira hosi Jaala, oan mane sira hosi Darkon, oan mane sira hosi Gidel,
verses.57: oan mane sira hosi Sefatias, oan mane sira hosi Hatil, oan mane sira hosi Pokeret-Hazabaim, no oan mane sira hosi Ami.
verses.58: Ema hotu hosi atan Templu nian no atan Salomão nian, atus tolu sia-nulu resin rua (392).
verses.59: Ema nebee tuir mai nee mak sira nebee sae hosi Tel-Mela, Tel-Arsa, Kerub, Adan no Imer. Maibee sira la bele prova sira nia uma kain, no jerasaun, katak sira hosi Israel:
verses.60: oan mane sira hosi Delaias, oan mane sira hosi Tobias, oan mane sira hosi Nekoda, atus neen lima-nulu resin rua (652).
verses.61: No mos oan mane sira hosi saserdote sira: oan mane sira hosi Habaias, oan mane sira hosi Koz, no oan mane sira hosi Barzilai (nebee foti feen hosi Barzilai, ema Gilead, nia oan feto sira, no hetan naran hosi sira).
verses.62: Sira buka sira nia naran nebee rejistu tuir sira nia jerasaun maibee sira la hetan. Nunee sira sai nudar ema foer, no sai hosi knaar saserdote nian.
verses.63: Governadór dehan ba sira katak sira la bele haan hosi buat santu liu, too iha saserdote nebee bele hamriik ho Urim no Tumim.
verses.64: Komunidade tomak nee mak ema nain rihun haat-nulu resin rua atus tolu neen-nulu (42.360),
verses.65: no mos sira nia atan mane no atan feto nain rihun hitu atus tolu tolu-nulu resin hitu (7.337), no sira iha kantadór no kantadora nain atus rua (200).
verses.66: Sira iha kuda atus hitu tolu-nulu resin neen (736), kuda mula atus rua haat-nulu resin lima (245),
verses.67: kuda kamelu atus haat tolu-nulu resin lima (435), no kuda buru rihun neen atus hitu rua-nulu (6.720).
verses.68: Bainhira xefi ba uma kain sira balu mai too iha uma Nai nian nebee iha Jerusalém, sira foo oferta voluntáriu ba uma Maromak nian hodi harii uma nee iha nia fatin.
verses.69: Sira foo buat nebee sira bele foo ba tezourária hodi halo servisu nee: osan mean kilo atus lima (500kg), osan mutin tonelada tolu, no ropa saserdote nian atus ida.
verses.70: Saserdote sira, ema Levi sira no ema balu hosi povu, kantadór sira, ema sira nebee hein portaun, no atan sira hosi Templu hela iha sira nia sidade sira. No ema Israel restu hela iha sira nia sidade sira.

verses.1: Iha fulan ba dala hitu, ema Israel sira nebee hela iha sidade sira halibur hamutuk nudar ema ida deit iha Jerusalém.
verses.2: Jesua, oan mane hosi Jozadak, hamriik no ninia maluk sira nebee saserdote sira, no Zorobabel, oan hosi Sealtiel, no ninia maluk sira, no sira harii altár hosi Maromak iha Israel. Sira harii altár nee hodi oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk iha leten tuir buat nebee hakerek ona iha Lei Moisés Nian, nebee ema Maromak.
verses.3: Sira tau altár nee iha nia fatin, tanba sira tauk kona ba povu iha nasaun sira iha nebaa. Sira oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk iha leten ba Nai, nebee sakrifísiu tunu motuk dadeer no lokraik.
verses.4: Sira halo mos Festa Baraka nian, tuir buat nebee hakerek ona, no sira oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk loro-loron nian tuir sakrifísiu hira nebee loos, no tuir kostumi nebee presiza halo loro-loron.
verses.5: No tuir buat nee sira oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk baibain nian, inklui fulan foun no festa hotu nebee Nai konsagra tiha ona. Sira oferese mos oferta voluntáriu ba Nai hosi ema hotu nebee oferese ho laran hakarak.
verses.6: Hosi loron primeiru iha fulan hitu, sira hahuu atu oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk ba Nai. Maibee fundasaun iha Templu Nai nian seidauk halo.
verses.7: Sira foo osan ba badaen fatuk no karpenteiru sira. Sira foo ai haan, buat hemu no mina ba oan mane sira hosi Sidon no Tiro hodi lori mai ai teka hosi Líbanon ba tasi iha Jope, tuir osan nebee sira simu hosi Sirus, liurai hosi Persia.
verses.8: Iha tinan segundu hosi tempu nebee foin mai fali ba uma Maromak nian iha Jerusalém, iha fulan segundu, sira hahuu. Ema nee inklui Zorobabel, oan hosi Sealtiel, Jesua, oan hosi Jozadak, no ema restu hosi sira nia maluk sira nebee saserdote no ema Levi sira, no ema hotu nebee mai hosi rai kastigu too iha Jerusalém. Sira foo knaar ba ema Levi sira, hosi tinan rua-nulu ba leten, hodi tau matan ba servisu atu halo uma Nai nian.
verses.9: Depois Jesua, no ninia oan mane sira no ninia maluk sira, Kadmiel no ninia oan mane sira, no ema Judá, hamriik hamutuk hodi tau matan ba ema nebee servisu hodi halo uma Maromak nian, nebee ema Henadad no sira nia oan mane sira no maluk sira nebee ema Levi.
verses.10: Bainhira badaen sira halo fundasaun ba Templu Nai nian, sira tau saserdote sira, nebee hatais ropa saserdote nian, ho korneta, no ema Levi sira, nebee Asafe nia bei-oan sira, ho símbalo, hodi hahii Nai, tuir orden hosi David, liurai hosi Israel.
verses.11: Sira kanta hamutuk tuir sira nia grupu hodi hahii no foo agradese ba Nai,
verses.12: Maibee saserdote no ema Levi no xefi ba uma kain sira, nebee katuas no sira haree uma uluk nian, bainhira fundasaun ba uma nee halo tiha ona iha sira nia oin, sira tanis ho lian makaas. Maibee ema barak mos hakilar haksolok.
verses.13: Nunee povu la hatene lian nee mak lian hakilar tanba haksolok ka lian hosi ema nebee tanis. Tanba povu nee hakilar ho lian makaas too ema rona hosi fatin dook.

verses.1: Bainhira Judá no Benjamin nia inimigu sira rona katak oan mane sira hosi rai kastigu harii Templu ba Nai, Maromak iha Israel,
verses.2: sira baa too Zorobabel, no xefi ba família sira, no dehan ba sira, “Husik ami bele harii uma nee hamutuk ho imi. Tanba ami buka tuir imi nia Maromak hanesan imi. Ami halo sakrifísiu ba Nia hosi tempu Esarhadon, liurai hosi Asíria, nebee lori ami sae mai iha nee.”
verses.3: Maibee Zorobabel, Jesua no xefi ba uma kain iha Israel, dehan ba sira, “Imi la iha buat ida hamutuk ho ami. Nunee imi la bele harii uma ba ami nia Maromak. Maibee ami rasik mai hamutuk hodi harii uma ba Nai, Maromak iha Israel, tuir liurai Sirus, liurai hosi Persia, nia orden nebee nia foo ona mai ami.”
verses.4: Depois povu hosi rai nee problema ba povu Judá, no sira halo ema Judá tauk atu servisu halo uma nee.
verses.5: Sira selu konselheiru sira hodi kontra ema Judá sira durante Sirus, liurai hosi Persia, nia tempu hotu too reinu hosi Darius, liurai hosi Persia.
verses.6: No iha reinu Ahaseurus, bainhira ninia reinu hahuu, sira hakerek surat ba nia nebee akuza ema nebee hela iha Judá no Jerusalém.
verses.7: Iha Artaxerxes nia tempu, Bislam, Miredate, Tabél no sira nia maluk sira hakerek surat ba Artaxerxes, liurai hosi Persia. Sira hakerek iha lian Aramaiku no foo sai iha lian Aramaiku.
verses.8: Komandante Reum no eskriba Simsai hakerek surat ida ba liurai Artaxerxes nebee kontra Jerusalém hanesan nee:
verses.9: Komandante Reum, eskriba Simsai, no maluk sira seluk, nebee juis, governadór no funsionáriu sira, no oan mane sira hosi Persia, oan mane sira hosi Erek, oan mane sira hosi Babilónia, ema Susa sira nebee ema Elam sira,
verses.10: no nasaun sira seluk nebee Asnapar, ema ida nebee boot no iha onra, mak lori ba sidade sira iha Samaria, no ema seluk nebee iha rejiaun Mota Sorin Ba, iha tempu nee.
verses.11: Ida nee mak kopi hosi surat nebee sira haruka ba nia: “Ba liurai Artaxerxes, hosi ita boot nia atan sira nebee hela iha rejiaun Mota Sorin Ba iha tempu nee.
verses.12: Ami foo hatene ba liurai katak ema Judeu sira nebee mai ami hosi ita boot nee mai ona too iha Jerusalém. Sira harii fali sidade nebee aat no kontra. Sira harii moru tiha ona no halo fundasaun sira.
verses.13: Ami foo hatene agora ba liurai katak, se sira harii sidade nee, no halo fali moru sira, nunee sira sei la selu impostu, taxa no alfandega sira. Nunee osan liurai nian sei tuun.
verses.14: Agora, tanba ami simu saláriu hosi palásiu, ami hanoin laduun diak atu haree ema hatuun liurai nia onra. Nunee ami haruka hodi foo hatene ba liurai.
verses.15: Ami husu ita boot haruka ema buka took iha livru sira nebee hakerek istória hosi ita boot nia bei-ala sira. Nunee ita boot sei hetan iha livru istória nian no ita boot bele hatene katak sidade nee mak sidade ida nebee kontra no kria problema ba liurai sira no rejiaun sira, no sira iha hahalok kontra nian hanesan nee hosi tempu antigu. No tanba nee ema uluk estraga sidade nee.
verses.16: Ami foo hatene ba liurai katak se sira harii fali sidade nee, no harii moru fali, entaun ita boot se la hetan orsamentu hosi rejiaun iha Mota Sorin Ba.”
verses.17: Depois liurai foo resposta ba komandante Reum, eskriba Simsai, no sira nia maluk sira seluk nebee hela iha Samaria, no ba ema seluk nebee hela iha rejiaun Mota Sorin Ba, “Salóm iha tempu nee.
verses.18: Ema lee klaru iha hau nia oin surat nebee imi haruka ona mai ami.
verses.19: Hau haruka tiha ona ema hodi buka took, no sira hetan ona informasaun katak hosi uluk kedas sidade nee kontra hasoru liurai sira. No sira nebee hela iha laran iha hahalok nebee kontra hasoru liurai no bosok.
verses.20: No mos uluk sira iha liurai sira nebee forti iha Jerusalém, nebee ukun rai tomak iha Mota Sorin Ba, no sira hetan osan hosi impostu, taxa no osan alfandega nian nebee ema selu ba sira.
verses.21: Nunee foo orden ba ema nee hodi para, no la bele harii fali sidade nee, too orden seluk mai hosi hau.
verses.22: Kuidadu katak imi la baruk atu halo tuir liafuan nee. Tanba saa mak ita husik problema sai boot nebee halo kanek ba liurai sira?”
verses.23: Bainhira ema lee kopi hosi liurai Artaxerxes nia surat ba Reum, eskriba Simsai no sira nia maluk sira, nunee sira sae lalais ba Jerusalém, ba ema Judeu sira no haruka sira para ho podér no forsa.
verses.24: Entaun sira para servisu nebee halo uma Maromak nian iha Jerusalém. Nunee servisu para too iha tinan segundu iha liurai Darius hosi Persia nia reinu.

verses.1: Depois profeta Ageu no Zakarias, oan hosi Ido, profesia kona ba ema Judeu sira nebee iha Judá no Jeruselém hodi Maromak iha Israel nia naran.
verses.2: Entaun Zorobabel, oan hosi Sealtiel, no Jesua, oan hosi Jozadak, hamriik no hahuu atu harii uma Maromak nian nebee iha Jerusalém. No profeta sira nee nebee hosi Maromak mak hamutuk ho sira no ajuda sira.
verses.3: Iha tempu nee, Tatnai, governadór ba rejiaun Mota Sorin Ba, no Setar-Bozenai, no sira nia maluk sira mai no dehan ba sira, “See mak foo orden ba imi atu harii uma nee, no hadia moru nee?”
verses.4: Depois sira husu hanesan nee, “Ema nebee harii uma nee nia naran saida?”
verses.5: Maibee Maromak tau matan ba katuas hosi ema Judeu sira. Nunee ema la bele haruka sira para too asuntu nee baa too iha Darius no sira hetan resposta fali hosi nia kona ba asuntu nee. Tatenai Haruka Surat Ba Darius
verses.6: Ida nee mak kopi ida hosi surat nebee Tatenai, governadór ba rejiaun iha Mota Sorin Ba, no Setar-Bozenai, no ninia maluk sira, nebee adminstradór sira iha rejiaun Mota Sorin ba, haruka ba liurai Darius.
verses.7: Sira haruka surat ba liurai, no hakerek liafuan nee iha laran: “Ba liurai Darius, salóm nafatin.
verses.8: Ami foo hatene ba liurai katak ami tama ba área Judá, ba Maromak Makaas nia uma. Ema harii uma nee ho fatuk boot no ai nebee taka ba didin. Servisu nee lao lalais, no sira nia liman iha susesu.
verses.9: Depois ami husu katuas sira iha nebaa, no dehan ba sira hanesan nee, ‘See mak foo orden ba imi atu harii uma nee no harii fali moru sira nee?’
verses.10: Depois ami husu mos sira nia naran, hodi hatudu ba ita boot, nunee ami hakerek naran hosi ema sira nebee xefi ba povu nee.
verses.11: No sira hataan ba ami hanesan nee, no dehan, ‘Ami mak atan sira ba Maromak iha lalehan no mundu. Ami harii fali uma nebee ema harii iha tempu antigu, nebee liurai boot hosi Israel mak harii no halo hotu.
verses.12: Maibee tuir mai, ami nia bei-ala sira provoka Maromak iha lalehan hodi sai hirus. Nia entrega povu nee ba Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, ema Kasdi nee, nia liman. Nia harahun uma nee no lori povu sai ba Babilónia.
verses.13: Maibee iha tinan primeiru iha tempu Sirus, liurai hosi Babilónia, foo orden atu harii uma Maromak nian.
verses.14: No sasaan osan mean no osan mutin hosi uma Maromak nian, nebee uluk Nabukodonozor foti hosi Templu iha Jerusalém no lori ba templu iha Babilónia, sasaan nee liurai Sirus foti hosi templu Babilónia no entrega sira ba ema ida naran Sesbazar, nebee liurai foo knaar nudar governadór.
verses.15: Liurai dehan ba governadór, “Foti sasaan nee, no baa, lori sasaan ba Templu nebee iha Jerusalém, no husik sira bele halo uma Maromak nian iha ninia fatin.”
verses.16: Depois Sesbazar halo fundasaun ba uma Maromak nian nebee iha Jerusalém. No hosi tempu uluk nee too agora, sira harii hela uma nee, no sira seidauk halo hotu.’
verses.17: Nunee, se liurai hanoin ideia nee diak, husik liurai nia atan sira buka took iha liurai nia tezourária, nebee iha Babilónia nebaa, no haree loos ka lae. Liurai Síria foo orden ona atu harii uma Maromak nian iha Jerusalém ka lae? No husik liurai haruka surat hodi foo hatene liurai nia hakarak iha asuntu nee.”

verses.1: Depois liurai Darius foo orden, no ema buka iha uma arkivu nebee sira rai dokumentu sira iha Babilónia.
verses.2: No iha Ekbatana, iha kapitál nebee iha rejiaun Mede nian, sira hetan surat ida nebee hakerek: “Surat ida.
verses.3: Iha tinan primeiru iha liurai Sirus nia reinu, liurai Sirus nee foo orden kona ba uma Maromak nian iha Jerusalém: Harii uma nee, iha fatin nebee sira oferse sakrifísiu. Halo fundasaun metin. Halo aas metru rua-nulu resin hitu no luan metru rua-nulu resin hitu.
verses.4: Hada fatuk boot hodi sae tolu, no tau sinta ho ai foun. Husik sira selu ho orsamentu liurai nian.
verses.5: No mos husik sira foti sasaan osan mean no osan mutin nebee uma Maromak nian, nebee uluk Nabukodonozor foti hosi Templu nebee iha Jerusalém hodi lori ba Babilónia. Husik sira hetan sasaan nee no lori fila fali ba Templu nebee iha Jerusalém. Tau sasaan iha sira nia fatin nebee iha uma Maromak nian.”
verses.6: “Nunee agora, Tatenai, governadór iha rejiaun Mota Sorin Ba, Setar-Bozenai, no imi nia maluk sira nebee administradór sira iha Mota Sorin Ba, hadook aan hosi sira.
verses.7: Husik servisu nebee halo uma Maromak nian. Nunee governadór ba ema Judeu sira no katuas Judeu sira bele harii uma Maromak nian iha ninia fatin.
verses.8: No mos, hau foo orden kona ba buat nebee imi tenki halo ba katuas sira hosi ema Judeu sira hodi sira bele harii uma Maromak nian nee: hosi liurai nia riku-soin, nebee osan impostu nebee simu iha Mota Sorin Ba, foo kedas orsamentu ba ema sira nee, hodi sira la para.
verses.9: No foo buat nebee sira presiza, inklui karau oan nebee aman, bibi malae aman no bibi malae oan hodi halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk ba Maromak iha lalehan. Foo trigu, masin, tua uvas no mina, tuir saserdote sira nebee simu knaar iha Jerusalém. Foo buat sira nee loro-loron no keta falta.
verses.10: Nunee sira bele oferese sakrifísiu morin ba Maromak iha lalehan, no halo orasaun ba Maromak kona ba liurai nia moris, no ninia oan mane sira.
verses.11: No hau halo tiha orden katak see-see deit nebee troka liafuan nee, husik ema foti ai lolon ida hosi ema nee nia uma, no harii ai lolon nee no tara mate ema nee iha ai lolon. No halo ninia uma sai fatin nebee ema soe teen.
verses.12: Husik Maromak nebee tau Ninia naran hodi hela iha fatin nebaa bele halakon liurai ka povu naran deit nebee koko atu troka ka estraga uma Maromak nee, nebee iha Jerusalém. Hau, Darius, halo orden ida nee, no husik ema halo tuir kedas.”
verses.13: Depois Tatenai, governadór iha Mota Sorin Ba, Setar-Bozenai no sira nia maluk sira, halo tuir kedas buat nebee liurai Darius haruka sira halo.
verses.14: Katuas sira hosi ema Judeu sira harii uma. Sira hetan susesu liu hosi profesia hosi profeta Ageu no Zakarias, oan hosi Ido. Sira harii uma no halo hotu tuir ukun fuan hosi Maromak iha Israel, no tuir ukun fuan hosi Sirus, Darius no Artaxerxes, liurai hosi Persia.
verses.15: Sira halo uma hotu nee iha loron ba dala tolu, iha fulan Adar, iha tinan ba dala neen iha liurai Darius nia reinu.
verses.16: Ema Israel sira, saserdote sira, ema Levi sira no ema restu hosi tempu kastigu nee dedika uma Maromak nian ho laran haksolok.
verses.17: Bainhira sira dedika uma Maromak nian, sira oferese karau oan nebee aman atus ida, bibi malae aman atus rua no bibi malae oan atus haat. Hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian, sira oferese bibi timor aman sanulu resin rua hodi tuir suku hira nebee iha Israel.
verses.18: Sira tau saserdote sira iha sira nia grupu, no ema Levi sira tuir sira nia fatin hodi halao ministériu ba Maromak, nebee iha Jerusalém, tuir buat nebee hakerek iha Livru Moisés nian.
verses.19: Ema sira hosi kastigu nee halao Páskua iha loron ba dala sanulu resin haat iha fulan primeiru.
verses.20: Saserdote no ema Levi sira hamoos aan hamutuk nunee sira moos hotu. Sira oho bibi Páskua nian ba ema hotu hosi kastigu, ba sira nia maluk sira nebee saserdote no ba sira nia aan rasik.
verses.21: Ema sira nee haan, inklui ema Israel sira nebee mai fali hosi kastigu, no ema hotu nebee haketak aan hosi buat foer hosi nasaun seluk iha rai nebaa hodi buka tuir Nai Maromak iha Israel.
verses.22: Sira halao Festa Paun Fermentu Laek durante loron hitu ho laran haksolok. Tanba Nai halo sira sai haksolok, no Nia fila liurai Asíria nia fuan laran ba sira hodi haforsa sira nia liman iha servisu nebee harii uma Maromak nian, nebee Maromak iha Israel.

verses.1: Liu tiha tempu nee, iha Artaxerxes, liurai hosi Persia, nia reinu, Ezra, oan hosi Seraias, oan hosi Azarias, oan hosi Hilkias,
verses.2: oan hosi Salum, oan hosi Zadok, oan hosi Ahitub,
verses.3: oan hosi Amarias, oan hosi Azarias, oan hosi Meraiot,
verses.4: oan hosi Zeraias, oan hosi Uzi, oan hosi Buki,
verses.5: oan hosi Abisua, oan hosi Fineias, oan hosi Eleazar, oan hosi Arão, nebee xefi saserdote -
verses.6: Ezra ida nee sae hosi Babilónia. Nia mak eskriba matenek iha Lei Moisés Nian, nebee Nai, Maromak iha Israel, foo ona. No liurai nee foo ba Ezra buat hotu nebee nia husu, tanba Nai, ninia Maromak, nia liman tulun nia.
verses.7: Iha tinan ba dala hitu iha liurai Artaxerxes nia reinu, ema Israel balu mos sae ba Jerusalém nebee saserdote, ema Levi, kantadór, ema nebee hein portaun no atan Templu sira.
verses.8: Ezra mai too iha Jerusalém iha fulan ba dala lima, nebee iha tinan ba dala hitu iha reinu liurai nee.
verses.9: Tanba iha fulan primeiru, nia komesa ninia viajen hosi Babilónia. No iha loron primeiru, iha fulan ba dala lima, nia mai too iha Jerusalém, tanba Maromak nia liman diak tulun nia.
verses.10: Tanba Ezra prepara ninia fuan laran hodi buka tuir lei Nai nian, atu halo no hanorin estatutu no regulamentu sira iha Israel.
verses.11: Ida nee mak kopi hosi surat nebee liurai Artaxerxes foo ba saserdote Ezra, nebee ema eskriba. Ezra mak eskriba kona ba liafuan hosi ukun fuan sira nebee mai hosi Nai, no mos Ninia estatutu sira. Ezra simu surat nee ba Israel:
verses.12: “Artaxerxes, liurai ba liurai sira: ba saserdote Ezra, eskriba ida kona ba lei hosi Maromak iha lalehan, kumprimentus. Agora,
verses.13: hau halo orden ida katak ema hotu hosi povu Israel, no saserdote no ema Levi sira, nebee iha hau nia reinu, nebee hakarak sae ba Jerusalém, bele baa ho o.
verses.14: Tanba o hetan direitu nee hosi liurai no hosi ninia konselheiru nain hitu, hodi husu kona ba Judá no Jerusalém, tuir Lei hosi Maromak, nebee iha o nia liman.
verses.15: No mos o sei lori osan mutin no osan mean nebee liurai no ninia konselheiru sira foo gratis ba Maromak iha Israel, nebee hela iha Jerusalém.
verses.16: O bele lori buat nee hamutuk ho osan mutin no osan mean nebee o hetan iha rejiaun Babilónia tomak, no oferta voluntáriu nian hosi povu, no saserdote sira, nebee oferese ho laran ba sira nia Maromak nia uma nebee iha Jerusalém.
verses.17: Nunee o bele sosa kedas ho osan nee karau oan nebee aman, bibi malae aman no bibi malae oan sira, hamutuk ho sira nia oferta trigu nian no oferta hemu nian. O bele oferese buat sira nee iha altár ida nebee iha o nia Maromak nia uma nebee iha Jerusalém.
verses.18: No buat nebee o hanoin diak ba o, no o nia maluk sira, atu halo ho osan mutin no osan mean restu nee, halo ba tuir o nia Maromak nia hakarak.
verses.19: Sasaan nebee o hetan hodi halao ministériu iha o nia Maromak nia uma nee, o tenki foo ba Maromak iha Jerusalém.
verses.20: Saida tan nebee o presiza ba o nia Maromak nia uma, nebee o hetan oportunidade atu foo, entaun foo hosi liurai nia tezourária.
verses.21: No hau rasik, liurai Artaxerxes, halo orden ba tezoureiru hotu nebee iha Mota Sorin Ba, katak saida mak saserdote Ezra, eskriba Lei nian hosi Maromak iha lalehan, presiza, entaun halo kedas.
verses.22: Bele foo too osan mean tonelada tolu ho balu, trigu bidon atus ida, tua uvas baldi boot atus ida, mina baldi boot atus ida, no masin nebee la sura.
verses.23: Buat hotu nebee Maromak iha lalehan manda ba, halo di-diak ba uma hosi Maromak iha lalehan. Nunee ita la hetan Maromak nia laran hirus nebee hasoru liurai no ninia oan mane sira nia reinu.
verses.24: No ami foo avizu katak imi la bele haruka saserdote, ema Levi, kantadór, ema nebee hein portaun, atan Templu ka ema ministériu sira hosi uma Maromak nian nee, atu selu taxa, impostu ka alfandega.
verses.25: No o, Ezra, tuir matenek klean hosi o nia Maromak, nebee iha o nia liman, hili ema tribunál no juis sira nebee bele tesi lia ba povu hotu nebee iha Mota Sorin Ba. Hili ema hotu nee nebee hatene lei hosi o nia Maromak. No hanorin sira nebee la hatene.
verses.26: Ema naran deit nebee la tuir lei hosi o nia Maromak, no lei hosi liurai, tesi lia di-diak ba nia. Nunee foo kastigu mate nian ka haruka nia sai hosi rai ka foti ninia sasaan ka hatama nia ba komarka.”
verses.27: Hahii ba Nai, ita nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak, nebee tau hanoin nee iha liurai nia fuan laran, hodi halo furak Nai nia uma nebee iha Jerusalém.
verses.28: Nai hatudu domin metin mai hau iha liurai nia oin, iha ninia konselheiru sira nia oin, no iha liurai nia xefi podér sira nia oin. Hau hetan kbiit tanba Nai, hau nia Maromak, nia liman tulun hau. No hau halibur xefi sira hosi Israel hodi sae baa hamutuk ho hau.

8.title: Jerasaun Hosi Sira Nebee Fila Fali

verses.1: Ema sira nee mak xefi ba uma kain sira, no ida nee mak jerasaun hosi sira nebee sae baa ho hau hosi Babilónia, iha liurai Artaxerxes nia reinu:
verses.2: Hosi jerasaun Fineias nian, Gerson. Hosi jerasaun Itamar nian, Daniel. Hosi jerasaun David nian, Hatus.
verses.3: Hosi jerasaun Sekanias nian, nebee hosi jerasaun Paros nian, Zakarias, no hamutuk ho nia iha mane nain atus ida lima-nulu nebee hatene sira nia jerasaun.
verses.4: Hosi jerasaun Pahat-Moab nian, Elioenai, oan hosi Zeraias, ho mane nain atus rua hamutuk ho nia.
verses.5: Hosi jerasaun Sekanias nian, Jahaziel nia oan, ho mane nain atus tolu hamutuk ho nia.
verses.6: Hosi jerasaun Adin nian, Ebed, oan hosi Jonatan, no mane nain lima-nulu hamutuk ho nia.
verses.7: Hosi jerasaun Elam nian, Jesaias, oan hosi Atalias, no mane nain hitu-nulu hamutuk ho nia.
verses.8: Hosi jerasaun Sefatias nian, Zebadias, oan hosi Mikael, no mane nain ualu-nulu hamutuk ho nia.
verses.9: Hosi jerasaun Joab, Obadias, oan hosi Jeiel, no mane nain atus rua sanulu resin ualu hamutuk ho nia.
verses.10: Hosi jerasaun Bani, Selomit, Josifias nia oan, no mane nain atus ida neen-nulu hamutuk ho nia.
verses.11: Hosi jerasaun Bebai, Zakarias, oan hosi Bebai, no mane nain rua-nulu resin ualu hamutuk ho nia.
verses.12: Hosi jerasaun Azgad, Joanan, oan hosi Hakatan, no mane nain atus ida sanulu hamutuk ho nia.
verses.13: Hosi jerasaun Adonikam, sira nebee tuir ikus, sira nia naran nee mak Elifelet, Jeiel no Semaias, no mane nain neen-nulu hamutuk ho sira.
verses.14: Hosi jerasaun Bigvai, Utai no Zabud, no mane nain hitu-nulu hamutuk ho sira.
verses.15: Hau halibur sira hamutuk iha mota nebee suli ba Aava. Ami hela iha nebaa iha tenda too loron tolu. Hau revista povu no saserdote sira no hau la hetan ema Levi sira.
verses.16: Entaun hau haruka ema bolu Eliezer, Ariel, Semaias, Elnatan, Jarib, Elnatan, Natan, Zakarias no Mesulam nebee xefi sira. No hau haruka ema bolu Joiarib no Elnatan, ema nebee iha kompriensaun.
verses.17: Hau haruka sira ho orden ba Ido, xefi iha Kasifia. Hau foo hatene ba sira kona ba buat nebee sira atu dehan ba Ido, no ba ninia maluk sira, atan Templu sira, iha Kasifia, katak sira tenki haruka ema ministériu sira ba ami nia Maromak nia uma.
verses.18: Ami nia Maromak nia liman tulun ami, nunee sira lori mai ami ema ida nebee matenek, nebee hosi jerasaun Mali, oan hosi Levi, oan hosi Israel; no Serebias, ho ninia oan sira no maluk sira, hamutuk sanulu resin ualu;
verses.19: no Hasabias ho Jesaias hosi jerasaun Merari, no ninia maluk sira no sira nia oan sira, rua-nulu;
verses.20: no atan Templu sira, nebee David no xefi sira foo knaar hodi serví ema Levi sira, atan Templu nee mak ema nain atus rua rua-nulu. No ema hotu nee rejistu sira nia naran. Jejún no Orasaun Hosi Husu Protesaun
verses.21: Depois hau deklara jejún iha nebaa, iha Mota Aava, hodi ami bele haraik aan iha ami nia Maromak nia oin, hodi buka viajen diak hosi Nia ba ami, no ami nia kiik-oan sira, no ami nia sasaan hotu.
verses.22: Tanba hau moe atu husu liurai foo tropas soldadu no ema nebee sae kuda hodi ajuda ami hasoru inimigu sira iha dalan. Tanba ami koalia tiha ona ba liurai no dehan, “Ami nia Maromak nia liman tulun ema hotu nebee buka tuir Nia, hodi halo diak ba sira. Maibee Ninia podér no laran hirus sei hasoru ema hotu nebee husik Nia.”
verses.23: Nunee ami jejún no harohan ba ami nia Maromak kona ba buat nee. No Nia simu ami nia pedidu.
verses.24: Depois hau haketak ema nain sanulu resin rua hosi xefi saserdote sira, nebee Serebias, Hasabias no ema nain sanulu tan hosi sira nia maluk sira.
verses.25: No hau tetu ba sira osan mutin, osan mean, no sasaan, nebee oferta ba ami nia Maromak nia uma, nebee liurai, ninia konselheiru sira, xefi sira no ema Israel hotu nebee iha nebaa mak oferese.
verses.26: Hau tetu ba sira nia liman osan mutin tonelada rua-nulu resin rua kilu atus hitu lima-nulu (22.750kg), sasaan osan mutin nebee todan tonelada tolu ho balu,
verses.27: manko osan mean rua-nulu nebee kilu ualu ho balu, no sasaan rua hosi riti diak nebee folin hanesan osan mean.
verses.28: No hau dehan ba sira, “Imi mak santu ba Nai, no sasaan nee mos santu. Osan mutin no osan mean mak oferta voluntáriu ba Nai, imi nia bei-ala nia Maromak.
verses.29: Nunee tau matan no kuidadu buat sira nee too imi tetu fali sira iha xefi saserdote nia oin no iha ema Levi sira nia oin, no xefi sira ba jerasaun Israel, iha Jerusalém, iha Nai nia uma nia kuartu sira.”
verses.30: Entaun hau foti saserdote no ema Levi sira hodi tetu osan mutin, osan mean no sasaan seluk, hodi lori ba Jerusalém, ba ami nia Maromak nia uma.
verses.31: Depois ami sai hosi Mota Aava, iha loron ba dala sanulu resin rua, iha fulan primeiru, hodi baa Jerusalém. No ami nia Maromak nia liman tulun ami, no nia salva ami hosi inimigu nia liman no hosi sira nebee hein hodi ataka iha dalan.
verses.32: Nunee ami mai too iha Jerusalém no hela iha nebaa too loron tolu.
verses.33: Iha loron ba dala haat, sira tetu osan mutin, osan mean no sasaan seluk. Sira tetu iha ami nia Maromak nia uma liur hodi entrega ba Meremot nia liman, oan hosi saserdote Urias. No hamutuk ho nia mak Eleazar, oan hosi Fineias. No hamutuk ho sira mak ema Levi sira nebee Jozabad, oan hosi Jesua, no Noadias, oan hosi Binui.
verses.34: Sira sura no tetu sasaan ida-idak, no sira hakerek todan hotu nee iha tempu nebaa.
verses.35: Oan mane sira hosi sira nebee uluk tama ba kastigu, nebee mai fali hosi kastigu, sira oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk sira ba Maromak iha Israel, nebee karau oan nebee aman sanulu resin rua ba Israel tomak, bibi malae aman sia-nulu resin neen, bibi malae oan hitu-nulu resin hitu no bibi timor aman sanulu resin rua nebee sakrifísiu sala nian. Buat hotu nee sai sakrifísiu tunu motuk ba Nai.
verses.36: No sira entrega liurai nia orden sira ba liurai nia nai ulun sira no governadór sira iha rejiaun Mota Sorin Ba, nunee sira ajuda povu no Maromak nia uma.

verses.1: Bainhira sira halo ona buat sira nee, xefi sira mai hau no dehan, “Povu Israel, saserdote sira no ema Levi sira la haketak aan hosi povu iha rai sira nee. Sira halo tuir hahalok foer loos hanesan ema Kanaan, ema Hiti, ema Perizeu, ema Jebus, ema Amon, ema Moab, ema Ejitu no ema Amoreu sira.
verses.2: Tanba sira no sira nia oan mane sira hola ema sira nee nia oan feto sira. Nunee jerasaun santu kahur aan ho povu hosi rai sira nee. No xefi sira no nai ulun sira mak uluk iha sala aat nee.”
verses.3: Bainhira hau rona liafuan nee, hau lees hau nia ropa no manta. Hau fokit hau nia fuuk hosi hau nia ulun leten no hasan rahun. Depois hau tuur bilaan.
verses.4: Ema hotu nebee hamtauk ba liafuan hosi Maromak iha Israel halibur hamutuk mai hau tanba sala aat nebee ema nebee uluk tama kastigu mak halo. No hau tuur bilaan too sakrifísiu lokraik nian.
verses.5: Iha tempu sakrifísiu lokraik nian, hau hamriik hosi hau nia tempu laran tristi. Hau nia ropa no manta nee lees hela. Hau monu ba hau nia ain tuur no lolo hau nia liman ba Nai, hau nia Maromak.
verses.6: No hau dehan, “Oh hau nia Maromak, hau moe no oin mean atu foti hau nia oin ba O, hau nia Maromak. Tanba ami nia hahalok aat mak aas liu ami nia ulun, no ami nia sala nebee falha ona nee sae too lalehan.
verses.7: Dezde ami nia bei-ala sira nia tempu, ami halao sala nebee falha boot too ohin loron. Tanba ami iha hahalok aat, nunee O entrega ami nia liurai sira no saserdote sira ba liurai sira hosi rai sira seluk. O entrega ami ba surik, ba kastigu, ba ema nebee hadau ami, no ba tempu moe. No ami hanesan nee too ohin loron.
verses.8: Agora, durante tempu uitoan, ami simu grasa hosi Nai, ami nia Maromak, nebee husik ema restu nee hodi halai sai hosi kastigu. No O foo oportunidade ida ba ami iha fatin santu nee. Nunee ami nia Maromak foo naroman ba ami nia matan no foo moris uitoan iha ami nia kastigu.
verses.9: Tanba ami mak ema kastigu. Maibee ami nia Maromak la husik ami iha ami nia kastigu nee. Nia hatudu domin metin mai ami iha liurai Persia sira nia oin. Nia foo moris fali ba ami hodi harii uma nee ba ami nia Maromak no hadia buat nebee aat nee. No Nia foo moru mai ami iha Judá no Jerusalém.
verses.10: Agora, Oh ami nia Maromak, ami bele dehan saida tuir hahalok nee? Tanba ami husik ona O nia ukun fuan.
verses.11: O manda ukun fuan sira nee liu hosi O nia atan profeta sira, no dehan, ‘Rai nee, nebee imi baa hodi hadau, mak rai nebee la moos tanba hahalok foer hosi povu iha rai nee. Sira halo buat foer loos no halo rai nakonu ho buat nebee la moos hosi rai rohan ida too rai rohan seluk.
verses.12: Nunee la bele foo imi nia oan feto sira ba sira nia oan mane sira, no la bele foti sira nia oan feto sira hodi foo ba imi nia oan mane sira. No la bele buka sira nia dame ka susesu too tinan ba tinan. Hodi nunee imi bele sai forti no haan buat diak hosi rai nee. No imi bele entrega liman rohan ba imi nia oan sira too tinan ba tinan.’
verses.13: No tuir buat hotu nebee akontese ba ami tanba ami nia hahalok aat, no tanba ami nia sala boot, no ami hatene katak ami nia Maromak la kastigu ami tuir ami nia hahalok aat nee, no O foo salvasaun ba ami nee;
verses.14: nunee ami sei estraga O nia ukun fuan no liga aan ho povu nebee halo buat foer sira nee ka? Laos O sei sai hirus ho ami too O halakon ami, nunee ami la iha ema restu ida no ami la bele halai sai?
verses.15: Oh Nai, Maromak iha Israel, O mak iha moris loos. Tanba ami sei iha nee hela, no ami konsege halai sai too ohin loron. Tebes, ami iha O nia oin ho ami nia sala boot nee. Tanba ami la bele hamriik iha O nia oin tanba hahalok nee.”

verses.1: Bainhira Ezra halo orasaun hela, no konfesa, no tanis no hakneak iha Maromak nia uma nia oin, ema lubun boot hosi Israel halibur aan ba nia. Ema sira nee inklui mane, feto no labarik sira tanba sira tanis makaas.
verses.2: No Sekanias, oan hosi Jeiel, oan hosi Elam, hataan no dehan ba Ezra, “Ami la hatudu laran fiel ba ami nia Maromak, no ami hola feen hosi rai liur nebee hosi povu iha rai nee. Maski nunee ita sei iha esperansa iha Israel.
verses.3: Husik ami halo aliansa ho ami nia Maromak hodi soe ami nia kaben hotu nebee moris hosi nasaun seluk. Ami sei tuir ami nia senhor nia hanoin, no ami tuir sira nebee hamtauk ba ami nia Maromak nia ukun fuan. No husik ami halo tuir Lei.
verses.4: Hamriik ba, tanba asuntu nee mak ita boot nian. Ami sei hamutuk ho ita boot. Sai forti no halo ida nee ba.”
verses.5: Entaun Ezra hamriik no halo sira nia xefi saserdote sira, ema Levi sira no Israel tomak, jura katak sira sei halo tuir sira nia liafuan. Nunee sira jura.
verses.6: Depois Ezra hamriik hosi Maromak nia uma nia oin, no nia baa kuartu hosi Jeoanan, oan hosi Eliasib. Bainhira nia baa nebaa, nia la haan paun ka hemu bee. Tanba nia tanis hela kona ba ema nebee uluk tama kastigu sei hatudu hahalok la fiel.
verses.7: No sira foo avizu iha Judá tomak no Jerusalém ba ema hotu nebee mai hosi kastigu katak sira tenki halibur aan iha Jerusalém.
verses.8: No see-see deit nebee la mai iha loron tolu nia laran, tuir liafuan hosi xefi sira no ema katuas sira, nunee ema nee sei lakon ninia riku-soin hotu no nia rasik sei sai ketak hosi sira nebee mai fali hosi kastigu.
verses.9: Depois ema hotu hosi Judá no Benjamin halibur hamutuk iha Jerusalém iha loron tolu nia laran. Sira halo ida nee iha fulan sia, iha loron ba dala rua-nulu iha fulan nee. No ema hotu tuur iha fatin luan nebee iha uma Maromak nian. Sira nakdedar tanba asuntu nee, no mos tanba udan boot.
verses.10: Saserdote Ezra hamriik no dehan ba sira, “Imi la hatudu ona laran fiel. Imi kaben ho feen hosi rai liur no aumenta ita nia sala aat iha Israel.
verses.11: Nunee agora, konfesa ba Nai, imi nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak, no halo tuir Ninia hakarak. Haketak aan hosi povu iha rai nee, no hosi feen sira nebee hosi rai liur.”
verses.12: Depois sorumutu hotu hataan no dehan ho lian makaas, “Hanesan ita boot dehan ona, nunee ami sei halo tuir.
verses.13: Maibee povu nee sei barak. No tempu nee mak udan boot. Ami la bele hamriik iha liur. No servisu nee laos servisu nebee bele halo iha loron ida ka rua nia laran. Tanba ema barak halo sala nebee kontra iha asuntu nee.
verses.14: Agora, husik ami nia xefi sira hamriik nudar sorumutu tomak. No husik ema hotu nebee kaben ho feen hosi rai liur iha ami nia sidade sira bele mai tuir tempu. Katuas no juis sira hosi sidade ida-idak bele mai hamutuk ho ema sira nee. Ami sei halo nunee too ami nia Maromak nia laran hirus manas sei fila hosi ami tanba asuntu nee.”
verses.15: Só deit Jonatan, oan hosi Asahel, no Jaazias, oan hosi Tikva, hamriik hodi kontra desizaun nee. No Mesulam no Sabetai, nebee ema Levi sira, mak apoia sira.
verses.16: Nunee ema nebee fila mai hosi kastigu halo tuir. Saserdote Ezra, no xefi ba família sira, nebee uma kain sira, nebee hosi sira nia jerasaun, ema hotu tuir sira nia naran sira, haketak aan. Sira tuur iha loron primeiru, iha fulan sanulu hodi buka hatene kona ba asuntu nee.
verses.17: No sira hatene tiha ona kona ba ema hotu nebee kaben ho feen hosi rai liur iha loron primeiru iha fulan primeiru. Sira Nebee Hola Feen Hosi Rai Liur
verses.18: Iha ema saserdote sira nia leet, sira hetan ema nebee kaben ho feen hosi rai liur: hosi jerasaun Jesua nian, oan hosi Jozadak, no ninia maluk sira: Maaseias, Eliezer, Jarib no Gedalias.
verses.19: Sira kaer liman hodi promete katak sira sei soe sira nia feen sira. No tanba sira iha sala aat nee, sira oferese bibi malae aman ida hosi bibi lubun nudar multa.
verses.20: Hosi jerasaun Imer nian: Hanani no Zebedias.
verses.21: Hosi jerasaun Harim: Maaseias, Elias, Semaias, Jeiel no Uzias.
verses.22: Hosi jerasaun Pasur: Elioenai, Maaseias, Ismael, Netanel, Jozabad no Elasa.
verses.23: No mos hosi ema Levi sira: Jozabad, Simei, Kelaias (nebee Kelita), Petaias, Judá no Eliezer.
verses.24: Hosi kantadór sira: Eliasib. No hosi ema nebee hein portaun: Salum, Telem no Uri.
verses.25: No mos hosi ema Israel sira, hosi jerasaun Paros nian: Ramias, Jezias, Malkias, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkias no Benaias.
verses.26: Hosi jerasaun Elam nian: Matanias, Zakarias, Jeiel, Abdi, Jeremot no Elias.
verses.27: Hosi jerasaun Zatu nian: Elioenai, Eliasib, Matanias, Jeremot, Zabad no Aziza.
verses.28: Hosi jerasaun Bebai nian: Jeoanan, Hananias, Zabai no Atlai.
verses.29: Hosi jerasaun Bani nian: Mesulam, Maluke, Adaias, Jasub, Seal no Jeremot.
verses.30: Hosi jerasaun Pahat-Moab nian: Adna, Kelal, Benaias, Maseias, Matanias, Bezalel, Binui no Manasés.
verses.31: Hosi jerasaun Harim nian: Eliezer, Isias, Malkias, Semaias, Simeão,
verses.32: Benjamin, Maluke no Semarias.
verses.33: Hosi jerasaun Hasum nian: Matenai, Matata, Zabad, Elifelet, Jeremai, Manasés no Simei.
verses.34: Hosi jerasaun Bani nian: Maadai, Amram, Uel,
verses.35: Benaias, Bedias, Kelui,
verses.36: Vanias, Meremot, Eliasib,
verses.37: Matanias, Matenai no Jaasu.
verses.38: Hosi jerasaun Binui nian: Simei,
verses.39: Selemias, Natan, Adaias,
verses.40: Maknadebai, Sasai, Sarai,
verses.41: Azarel, Selemias, Semarias,
verses.42: Salum, Amarias no José.
verses.43: Hosi jerasaun Nebo nian: Jeiel, Matitias, Zabad, Zebina, Jadai, Joel no Benaias.
verses.44: Ema hotu nee mak hola feen hosi rai liur. No hosi feto sira nee sira hetan oan sira.

1.title: Neemias Nia Orasaun Ba Ema Judeu Sira

verses.1: Istória Neemias nian, Hakalias nia oan. Iha tempu nebaa, iha fulan Kisleu, iha tinan rua-nulu nia laran, bainhira hau sei iha kapitál Susan,
verses.2: Hanani, hau nia maluk ida, mai vizita hau. Nia mai ho ema balu hosi rai Judá. Nunee hau husu ba sira kona ba ema Judeu sira nia kondisaun, sira nebee halai no sei hela iha nebaa hosi tempu kastigu no mos kondisaun Jerusalém nian.
verses.3: Sira hatete mai hau, “Ema sira nebee fila hosi kastigu nebaa sei hela iha provínsia iha nebaa maibee sira nia kondisaun terus loos no ema despreza hela sira. Moru Jerusalém nian rahun hotu ona no portaun sira mos ahi haan hotu ona.”
verses.4: Bainhira hau rona kona ba informasaun nee, hau tuur tanis ho laran tristi tebes too loron balu. Hau halo jejún no halo orasaun iha Maromak hosi lalehan nia prezensa,
verses.5: no hau hatete, “Favór ida, Oh Nai Maromak iha lalehan, nebee boot no ema hamtauk ba O, Maromak nebee kaer metin Nia aliansa no nia domin metin ba ema sira nebee hadomi Nia no halo tuir nafatin Nia ukun fuan sira,
verses.6: See O nia tilun mai no loke O nia matan no rona ba atan hau nia orasaun. Orasaun nebee hau halo loron-kalan ba O kona ba O nia atan ema Israel sira, no hau konfesa sala hosi ema Israel sira nebee halo hasoru O, no mos hau no hau nia família nia sala.
verses.7: Ami halo sala boot tebes hasoru O, no la halo tuir O nia ukun fuan, estatutu no regulamentu sira nebee O manda ona ba O nia atan Moisés.
verses.8: Hanoin hetan liafuan nebee O manda ona ba O nia atan Moisés, katak, ‘Se imi la iha fidelidade mai Hau, mak Hau sei namkari imi ba iha nasaun sira nia leet.
verses.9: Maibee, se imi fila fali mai Hau no halo tuir nafatin Hau nia ukun fuan sira, mezmu imi hela dook too rai nia rohan, mak Hau sei halibur imi hamutuk fila fali no lori imi ba fatin nebee Hau hili ona atu tau Hau nia naran iha nebaa.’
verses.10: Laos ema sira nee mak O nia atan sira no O nia povu sira nebee O hola fali liu hosi O nia forsa nebee boot no ho O nia liman nebee makaas?
verses.11: Oh Nai, favór ida, see O nia tilun mai atan hau nee nia orasaun no rona mos ba O nia atan sira seluk nebee kontenti atu hamtauk ba O nia naran, no husik O nia atan nee hetan susesu iha loron ida nee iha ema nee nia oin.” Tanba iha tempu nee hau toma konta ba liurai nia hemu.

verses.1: Tuir mai, iha fulan Nisan, iha tinan ba dala rua-nulu iha tempu liurai Artaxerxes nia ukun, bainhira liurai atu hemu tua uvas, nunee hau foti sae tua uvas hodi oferese ba liurai. Hau iha oin nebee tristi no hau nunka halo ida nee iha liurai nia prezensa.
verses.2: Nunee liurai husu mai hau, “Tanba saa mak ita nia oin tristi, mezmu ita la moras? Ida nee mak buat susar nebee afeta ba ita nia laran.” Ho ida nee mak hau foo resposta ho laran tauk tebe-tebes.
verses.3: Hau hataan ba liurai, “Viva liurai too tinan ba tinan! Oinsaa mak hau nia oin la sai tristi, bainhira hau nia sidade no hau nia bei-ala sira nia rate fatin mak aat ona, no portaun sira nee ahi haan motuk ona?”
verses.4: Nunee liurai hatete mai hau, “Entaun, saida mak ita hakarak?” Ho ida nee hau halo orasaun ba Maromak iha lalehan.
verses.5: Hau hataan ba liurai, “Se liurai senti nee diak no liurai nia laran kontenti ho ita nia atan hau, bele haruka hau baa Judá, baa sidade nebee iha hau nia bei-ala sira nia rate fatin, atu nunee hau bele harii fila fali.”
verses.6: Depois liurai husu mai hau, no tempu nee liurai feto tuur hela iha nia sorin, “Durante loron hira mak ita nia viajen too iha nebaa, no bainhira mak ita fila fali mai?” Hau resposta ba loron hira nebee hau determina ona no liurai kontenti atu haruka hau baa.
verses.7: Hau hatete tan ba liurai, “Se liurai senti diak, bele hakerek surat ruma hodi foo mai hau atu nunee hau bele foo ba governadór sira iha área Mota Eufrates sorin ba, nunee sira bele foo lisensa mai hau hodi hau bele liu no baa too rai Judá.
verses.8: No mos surat ida ba Asafe nebee toma konta kona ba liurai nia ai laran, atu nunee nia bele foo ai mai hau hodi hau bele halo ai lolon sira hodi monta hadia portaun ba uma seguru iha templu, balu ba moru sidade no balu tan ba uma nebee hau atu hela.” Nunee liurai aseita hau nia liafuan, tanba hau nia Maromak nia liman diak nebee sempre tulun hau.
verses.9: Depois hau lori surat sira hosi liurai nee baa hatudu ba governadór sira iha área Mota Eufrates sorin ba. No liurai haruka komandante forsa sira no ema balu ho kuda baa hamutuk ho hau.
verses.10: Maibee bainhira Sanbalate, ema Horonita, no atan Tobias, ema Amonita, rona kona ba buat nee sira senti hirus loos katak iha ema nebee mai hodi halo diak ba ema Israel sira.
verses.11: Depois hau nia viajen ba Jerusalém too ona. No hau hela deit iha nebaa durante loron tolu.
verses.12: Depois hau hadeer iha kalan ida ho ema balu nebee hamutuk ho hau. Hau la foo hatene ba ema ida kona ba planu nebee hau nia Maromak tau ona iha hau nia fuan laran atu halo iha Jerusalém. Hau lori deit kuda nebee hau sae no la iha tan animál seluk nebee hau lori.
verses.13: Nunee iha kalan nee hau sai ba liur liu hosi Portaun Foho Leet, nebee iha Bee Matan Samea Naga Nian no Portaun Lixu. Hau halo observasaun di-diak ba moru boot iha Jerusalém nebee aat ona no nia odamatan nebee ahi haan motuk ona.
verses.14: Depois hau kontinua lao ba iha Portaun Bee Matan no Pixina Liurai Nian. Maibee tanba dalan la iha hodi hau nia kuda nebee hau sae nee bele liu.
verses.15: Depois hau lao sae iha tempu kalan liu hosi mota hodi halo observasaun di-diak ba moru nee. Depois hau fila fali hodi tama liu hosi Portaun Foho Leet, nunee hau fila ona.
verses.16: Ukun nain sira la hatene hau fila hosi nebee no halo saida, tanba too iha tempu nee mos hau seidauk foo hatene ba ema Judeu sira, ka saserdote sira, ka ema boot sira, ka ukun nain sira, ka ema funsionáriu sira.
verses.17: Depois hau hatete ba sira, “Imi haree took susar nebee ita hasoru nee, Jerusalém naksobu ona no portaun sira ahi haan motuk ona. Mai ita harii fila fali moru Jerusalém nee, atu nunee ema seluk la bele despreza tan ita.”
verses.18: Nunee hau konta ba sira kona ba Maromak nia liman nebee diak mai hau, no liurai nia liafuan nebee nia hatoo mai hau. Depois sira hataan, “Ami pronto atu harii!” Nunee sira haforsa sira nia liman hodi halo servisu diak nee.
verses.19: Maibee bainhira Sanbalate, ema Horonita, no atan Tobias, ema Amonita, no Gesem hosi rai Arábia, rona kona ba nee, sira komesa goza no hatuun ami. Sira dehan, “Imi halo saida nee? Imi hakarak kontra fali liurai ka?”
verses.20: Hau hataan ba sira, “Maromak iha lalehan nee, Nia halo ami sai susesu! Ami mak Nia atan sira, no ami prontu ona atu harii fila fali moru nee. Maibee imi sei la hetan parte ruma iha nee no imi mos sei la iha direitu atu ema temi imi nia naran iha Jerusalém laran!”

3.title: Ema Judeu Sira Hadia Moru Jerusalém

verses.1: Ho nunee saserdote boot Eliasibe ho nia maun-alin saserdote sira seluk prepara aan no harii fila fali Portaun Bibi Malae. Depois sira konsagra no monta odamatan nee. Sira konsagra fatin nee too Uma Aas Atus Ida, no too Uma Aas Hananeel.
verses.2: Iha sira nia sorin ema sira hosi Jerikó mak servisu hodi harii, no iha ema sira nee nia sorin Zakur, Imri nia oan, mak harii.
verses.3: Maibee Portaun Ikan nee, Hasenaa nia oan mane sira mak harii. Sira monta hotu odamatan nia ai riin sira, depois sira monta tan odamatan ho nia kait no ai kabelak nebee atu satan netik odamatan nian.
verses.4: Iha sira nia sorin Meremote, Urias nia oan, nebee Koz nia oan, mak hadia moru. No iha nia sorin tan Mesulam, Berekia nia oan, nebee Mesezabel nia oan mak hadia moru. Iha sira nia sorin tan Zadok, Baana nia oan, mak hadia moru.
verses.5: No iha sira nia sorin fali ema sira hosi Tekoa mak hadia moru, só sira nia ema boot sira deit mak lakohi ajuda hodi halo servisu.
verses.6: Joiada, Paseia nia oan, ho Mesulam, Besodeias nia oan, mak hadia fila fali Portaun Tuan nian. Sira harii hotu odamatan nia ai riin depois monta odamatan ho nia kait no ai kabelak satan netik odamatan nian.
verses.7: Iha sira nia sorin tan nebee hadia moru mak Malatias, ema Gibeonita, no Jadon, ema Meronote, no ema sira seluk hosi Gibeon no Mizpá nebee iha governadór nia ukun fatin ba área iha Mota Eufrates sorin mai nee.
verses.8: Iha sira nia sorin Uziel mak hadia, nia mak Haraias nia oan, nebee ema hosi badaen osan mean sira. No iha nia sorin fali mak Hananias hadia moru, nia matenek halo mina morin. Sira hadia moru Jerusalém too Moru Luan.
verses.9: Iha sira nia sorin Refaias mak hadia, nia mak Hur nia oan, nebee xefi ba Jerusalém sorin ida.
verses.10: Iha nia sorin Jedaias mak hadia, nia mak Harumafe nia oan. Nia hadia moru iha parte nebee iha nia uma oin. No iha nia sorin tan Hatus mak hadia, nia mak Hasabneias nia oan.
verses.11: Malkias, Harim nia oan, no Hasube, Paata-Moab nia oan, mak hadia parte seluk no mos Uma Aas Fornu Sira.
verses.12: Iha sira nia sorin mak Salum, Haloés nia oan, nebee xefi ba Jerusalém sorin ida, nia hadia moru ho nia oan feto sira.
verses.13: Portaun Foho Leet nee Hanum no ema Zanoa sira mak hadia. Sira hadia hotu depois monta odamatan ho kait sira no ai kabelak sira nebee atu satan netik odamatan nian. No sira mos hadia moru naruk metro atus haat lima-nulu too iha Portaun Foho Leet.
verses.14: Portaun Lixu nian Malkias mak hadia, nia mak Rekabe nia oan, nebee xefi ba área Bete-Hakerem. Nia hadia hotu depois monta odamatan ho kait sira no ai kabelak sira nebee atu satan netik odamatan nian.
verses.15: Portaun Bee Matan nian Salum mak hadia, nia mak Kol-Hoze nia oan, nebee xefi ba área Mizpá. Nia hadia hotu, no taka odamatan nia leten, no depois nia monta odamatan ho kait sira no ai kabelak sira nebee atu satan netik odamatan nian. No nia hadia tan Pixina Siloé, nebee besik iha liurai nia jardin, too iha eskada sira nebee tuun hosi sidade David nian.
verses.16: Iha nia sorin Neemias mak hadia, nia mak Azbuke nia oan, nebee xefi ba área Bete-Zur sorin ida, nia hadia too iha David nia rate, no too iha pixina nebee ema halo, no baa tan too iha ema funu nain sira nia uma.
verses.17: Depois iha nia sorin fali mak ema Levita sira hadia moru, sira mak Reum, Bani nia oan, no iha nia sorin mak Hasabias, nebee ukun área Keila sorin ida, no nia hadia moru iha nia área rasik.
verses.18: Tuir nia mak nia maun-alin sira mos hadia moru, nee mak Bavai, nebee Henadade nia oan, nebee xefi ba área Keila sorin ida.
verses.19: Iha nia sorin Ezer mak hadia, nia mak Jesua nia oan, nebee xefi iha Mizpá, nia hadia tutan fali iha parte dalan sae ba armazén ekipamentu funu nian nia oin, besik moru sikun.
verses.20: Iha nia sorin mak Baruke, Zabai nia oan, nia servisu makaas hodi hadia tutan moru iha sorin, hosi moru sikun nee too iha saserdote boot Eliasibe nia uma nia odamatan oin.
verses.21: Tuir nia mak Meremote, Urias nia oan, nebee Koz nia oan, nia hadia tutan moru hosi Eliasibe nia uma nia odamatan too Eliasibe nia uma rohan.
verses.22: Iha nia sorin mak saserdote sira nebee hosi rai tetuk mos hadia moru.
verses.23: Iha sira nia sorin mak Benjamin no Hasube, sira hadia moru iha parte nebee iha sira nia uma oin. Iha sira nia sorin mak Azarias, Maaseias nia oan, nebee Ananias nia oan, nia hadia moru iha parte nebee iha nia uma sorin.
verses.24: Iha nia sorin mak Binui, Henadade nia oan, nia hadia tutan moru sorin hosi Azarias nia uma too iha moru sikun, iha lidun nee.
verses.25: Palal, Uzai nia oan, mak hadia iha moru sikun nee nia oin too iha Uma Aas Ba Liur nebee iha liurai nia palásiu nia oin, besik iha fatin kadeia nian. Iha nia sorin mak Pedaias, Paros nia oan,
verses.26: ho atan sira hosi Templu nebee hela iha Ofel nee, sira hadia too iha fatin nebee iha Portaun Bee nia oin, iha parte leste, no too iha Uma Aas Ba Liur.
verses.27: Iha sira nia sorin mak ema Tekoa sira hadia tutan moru iha sorin, hosi uma seguransa boot nebee sai ba nia oin too iha moru Ofel.
verses.28: Hosi kedas Portaun Kuda nia leten nee saserdote sira mak hadia, sira ida-idak hadia moru iha sira nia uma oin rasik.
verses.29: Tuir sira mak Zadok, Imer nia oan, nia hadia moru iha nia uma rasik nia oin. Iha nia sorin Semaias mak hadia, nia mak Sekanias nia oan, nebee seguransa iha Portaun Leste.
verses.30: Tuir nia mak Hananias hadia, nia mak Selemias nia oan; no Hanun, nebee oan mane ba dala neen hosi Zalaf, nia mos hadia moru tutan hosi sorin. Tuir nia mak Mesulam, Berekias nia oan, hadia moru hosi nia kuartu oin.
verses.31: Tuir nia Malkias, nebee badaen osan mean nia oan, nia hadia tutan moru nee too iha fatin ba atan sira hosi Templu, no negosiante sira nian, iha Portaun Forma nia oin no too iha kuartu leten sikun nian.
verses.32: Depois entre kuartu leten iha parte sikun nian no Portaun Bibi Malae nian nee, badaen osan mean sira no negosiante sira mak hadia moru.

4.title: Ema Kontra Sira Nebee Halo Moru

verses.1: Bainhira Sanbalate rona katak ami harii fila fali moru Jerusalém, nia hirus tebe-tebes no laran moras ba ami. Nunee nia halo trosa ba ema Judeu sira.
verses.2: Nia halo hanesan nee iha nia maun-alin sira no iha forsa Samaria nia oin, nia dehan, “Haree took ba! Ema Judeu sira nebee fraku nee, sira halo saida? Sira harii buat ruma ka? Ka sira atu hasae sakrifísiu? Sira atu harii moru nee durante loron ida deit ka? Ka sira atu halo moris fila fali fatuk sira hosi rai rahun nebee ahi haan motuk ona nee?”
verses.3: Depois Tobias, ema Amonita nebee hamriik besik nia hatete, “Mezmu sira harii fila fali, se karik asu fuik haksoit sae moru nee, nunee moru sei monu kedas!”
verses.4: Oh, ami nia Maromak, rona took oinsaa ema sira halo trosa ba ami. Husik sira nia liafuan despreza nee fila kona fali ba sira nia ulun rasik no halo sira sai fali refujiadu iha rai seluk.
verses.5: La bele taka sira nia sala sira nee, no mos la bele hamoos sira nia sala nee hosi O nia oin, tanba sira provoka ona O sai hirus iha ema sira nebee hadia hela moru nee nia oin.
verses.6: Maibee ami harii nafatin moru nee sae too klaran too moru nia rohan tutan ba malu, tanba povu tomak servisu ho fuan laran.
verses.7: Bainhira Sanbalate no Tobias ho ema Arábia sira, ema Amon sira no ema Asdode sira rona kona ba servisu nebee ami halo ba moru Jerusalém nee lao ba oin ho diak no moru Jerusalém sira nebee monu nee komesa hadia fila fali, entaun sira sai hirus makaas liu tan.
verses.8: Sira hotu komesa futu lia atu mai hamutuk hodi ataka Jerusalém no mos halo rungu-ranga iha nebaa.
verses.9: Maibee ami halo orasaun ba ami nia Maromak, no tau ema seguransa ba sira loron no kalan tanba sira nia hahalok.
verses.10: Nunee ema Judá sira hatete, “Ema sira nebee tula sasaan nee sai kole loos ona maibee moru rahun sira nee sei barak hela. Nunee ami la bele harii moru nee.”
verses.11: Maibee ami nia inimigu sira nee dehan, “Sira sei la hatene no sei la haree buat ida, too ita tama iha sira nia leet, no oho hotu sira no hapara tiha servisu nee.”
verses.12: Tuir mai, bainhira ema Judeu sira nebee hela besik inimigu sira nee mai, sira foo hatene mai ami dala sanulu ona nunee, “Inimigu sira sei mai ataka ita hosi fatin oi-oin nebee sira hela ba.”
verses.13: Entaun hau monta kedas povu sira hosi sira nia jerasaun ida-idak ho surik, dima no rama iha moru nia kotuk, iha fatin nebee moru sei badak, iha fatin-fatin sira nebee sei luan.
verses.14: Hau haree tiha, depois hau hamriik hodi hatete ba ema boot sira no ukun nain sira no povu hotu, “Keta tauk ba ema sira nee! Hanoin hela Nai nebee boot liu no hamtauk Nia, nunee luta ba, tanba imi nia maun-alin sira, no imi nia oan mane sira, no imi nia oan feto sira, no imi nia feen sira, no imi nia uma sira.”
verses.15: Tuir mai, bainhira ami nia inimigu sira rona katak sira nia planu nee ami hatene ona no Maromak hapara tiha sira nia planu nee, mak ami hotu fila fali baa iha moru huun, no ida-idak komesa halo sira nia servisu fila fali.
verses.16: Hosi loron nee kedas hau nia atan sira sorin halo servisu no sorin seluk kaer dima sira, eskudu sira no rama sira no hatais ropa funu nian; no xefi sira hamriik iha ema Judeu hotu nia kotuk.
verses.17: Ema sira nebee hada fatuk nee, no sira nebee tula fatuk, no sira nebee prepara fatuk, ema ida-idak nee halo servisu ho liman ida no ho liman seluk sira kaer armas funu nian.
verses.18: Ba ema hotu nebee halo servisu ba moru nee sira halo servisu maibee sira mos kesi surik iha sira nia kanotak, no ema nebee huu trombeta hamriik iha hau nia sorin.
verses.19: Hau hatete ba ema boot sira, ba ukun nain sira no mos ba povu hotu, “Servisu nee boot no luan, no ita lao fahe malu, ida seluk dook hosi ida seluk.
verses.20: No karik imi rona trombeta nia lian iha fatin ruma, entaun lalais hodi halibur hamutuk iha nebaa. No ita nia Maromak sei funu ba ita!”
verses.21: Ho nunee ami halo servisu nee, maibee povu sorin nee kaer dima sira hosi dadeer-saan too fali fitun sai ona.
verses.22: Iha momentu nee mos hau foo orden ba povu sira, “Imi hotu-hotu ho imi nia atan tenki deskansa kalan iha Jerusalém laran nee, atu nunee sira bele halo seguransa ba ami iha kalan, no halo sira nia servisu iha loron.”
verses.23: Tan nunee mak hau rasik, hau nia maluk sira, hau nia atan sira no seguransa sira nebee tuir hau, ami hotu la troka ami nia ropa. Ema ida-idak iha nafatin sira nia armas funu nian iha sira nia sorin.

5.title: Ema Boot Nebee Hanehan Ema Kiik

verses.1: Tuir mai barulhu makaas mai hosi povu sira, inklui hosi feen sira, nebee hasoru sira nia maluk ema Judeu sira.
verses.2: Iha balu nebee dehan, “Ami nia oan mane no oan feto barak, tanba nee ami presiza trigu, atu nunee ami bele haan no moris.”
verses.3: No iha balu nebee dehan, “Ami nia rai, ami nia toos uvas nian no ami nia uma nee ami foo hotu hodi debe osan hodi hola trigu tanba tempu rai hamlaha nee.”
verses.4: No iha mos ema balu dehan, “Ami tenki impresta osan hodi bele selu liurai nia taxa. Nunee ami foo mos ami nia rai no toos uvas nian.
verses.5: Agora nee, mezmu ami raan ida no isin ida ho ami nia maun-alin sira, no ami nia oan sira hanesan mos sira nia oan sira, maibee ami iha obrigasaun tenki husik ami nia oan mane no oan feto sira atu sai atan, no ami nia oan feto balu sai atan ona. Ami la bele halo buat ida, tanba ami nia rai no toos uvas sira iha ona ema seluk nia liman.”
verses.6: Nunee hau sai hirus tebes bainhira hau rona hakilar no liafuan nee.
verses.7: Hotu tiha hau hanoin iha hau nia ulun rasik, no hau siak ema boot sira no ukun nain sira. Hau hatete ba sira, “Imi sira nee hotu haan matak ona hosi imi nia maun-alin sira nee!” Depois hau halibur ema lubun boot nebee hasoru sira.
verses.8: Hau hatete ba sira, “Ami sempre hakaas aan hodi bele hola fali ema Judeu sira nebee ema faan ona ba nasaun seluk. Maibee imi sira nee hakarak faan fali imi nia maun-alin sira, atu nunee ami hola fali!” Sira hotu nonook tanba la bele defende aan.
verses.9: Hau dehan tan, “Buat nebee imi halo nee laloos! Tuir lo-loos imi tenki hatudu hamtauk ba ita nia Maromak tanba ita nia inimigu sira iha nasaun seluk nebee despreza hela ita.
verses.10: Hau, no hau nia maluk sira no hau nia atan sira foo hela osan impresta no trigu ba sira. Mai ita hamoos tiha sira nia tusan hotu nee!
verses.11: Agora, ohin loron imi foo fali sira nia rai, toos uvas nian, toos azeite nian no sira nia uma sira, no mos osan funan, trigu, uvas no mina nebee imi foti hosi sira!”
verses.12: Sira hatete, “Buat hirak nee hotu ami sei foo fila! No ami sei la eziji buat ida hosi sira. Ami sei halo tuir hotu saida mak ita boot koalia!” Depois hau bolu saserdote sira hodi sira jura iha oin katak sira sei halo tuir duni saida mak sira promete.
verses.13: No hau dada sai hau nia sintu nebee kesi iha hau nia faru hodi dehan, “See-see deit nebee la halo tuir juramentu nee mak Maromak mos sei dada sai nia hosi nia uma no nia rezultadu toos nian. Nunee Maromak sei hasai nia no nia moris sei la iha folin!” No povu tomak hatete, “Amén!” no hahii Nai. Depois povu tomak halo tuir juramentu nee.
verses.14: No mos, hosi tempu nebee ema foti hau sai governadór iha rai Judá, hosi tinan rua-nulu too iha tinan tolu-nulu resin rua iha liurai Artaxerxes nia ukun, nee hotu mak tinan sanulu resin rua, iha tempu nee hau no hau nia maluk sira nunka haan hahaan nebee lo-loos governadór bele hetan.
verses.15: Maibee governadór sira nebee halao servisu nee molok hau, sira halo terus loos ba povu sira. Governadór sira nee sempre foti osan mutin grama atus haat ualu-nulu no mos paun ho tua uvas hosi povu sira. Too sira nia atan sira mos hanehan loos povu nee. Maibee hau la halo ida nee tanba hau tauk ba Maromak.
verses.16: Nunee hau komesa halo servisu ba moru nee, mezmu hau la hetan rai ruma. No hau halibur hau nia atan sira hotu iha nebaa atu halo servisu ba moru nee.
verses.17: No mos, ema sira nebee tuur iha hau nia meza mak ema Judeu sira no ukun nain sira, sira hamutuk nain atus ida lima-nulu, no ida nee seidauk sura ema hosi nasaun vizinhu sira nebee mai.
verses.18: Buat nebee hau prepara loro-loron mak hanesan nee: karau ida, bibi-malae neen nebee isin diak no manu hakiak balu; no iha loron sanulu dala ida ami iha tua uvas oi-oin. Mezmu ho buat hirak nebee hau halo nee, hau nunka eziji atu hetan paun governadór nian, tanba servisu nee todan tebes ba povu sira.
verses.19: Oh hau nia Maromak, tan hau nia moris diak nee, hanoin hau tuir buat hotu nebee hau halo ona ba povu nee.

6.title: Ema Futu Lia Hodi Koko Oho Neemias

verses.1: Tuir mai, bainhira Sanbalate, Tobias no Gesem, ema Arábia, no ami nia inimigu sira seluk rona katak hau harii hela moru nee, no la iha tan kuak, mezmu iha tempu nee portaun sira hau seidauk monta nia odamatan,
verses.2: Sanbalate no Gesem haruka ema ida lori informasaun mai hau no dehan, “Mai, ita hasoru malu iha Kefirim, iha rai tetuk Ono nian!” Maibee sira iha hanoin aat atu estraga hau.
verses.3: Depois hau haruka fali manu-ain sira ba hodi dehan, “Hau sei halo hela servisu boot ida. Nunee hau la bele baa! Tanba saa mak hau tenki husik servisu nee hodi baa hasoru imi?”
verses.4: Too dala haat sira haruka ema mai koalia liafuan hanesan ba hau, no hau sempre resposta ho liafuan hanesan.
verses.5: Nunee ho maneira nebee hanesan, ba dala lima nian Sanbalate haruka nia atan ida mai hau ho surat ida nebee loke hela.
verses.6: Iha surat nee nia laran hakerek, “Iha lia anin barak entre nasaun sira, nunee Gesem mos hatete katak ita boot no ema Judeu sira iha hanoin atu kontra liurai, tan nunee ita boot komesa harii fila fali moru nee. No iha lia nee, ita boot mos sei sai sira nia liurai.
verses.7: No mos ami rona katak ita boot hili ona profeta sira iha Jerusalém laran, hodi sira sei foo sai katak: ‘Iha liurai ida iha Jerusalém!’ Agora, informasaun ida nee liurai sei rona. Tanba nee, mai ita halo diskusaun ida!”
verses.8: Maibee hau haruka fali ema ida ba nia ho resposta, “Informasaun nebee ita boot koalia nee nunka iha. No ita boot bosok hosi ita nia hanoin rasik!”
verses.9: Tanba sira hotu hakarak halo ami tauk, no sira hanoin kona ba ami hanesan nee, “Ema Judeu sira nia liman sei sai fraku tanba sira nia servisu nee, nunee sira sei la bele halo remata.” Maibee hau halo orasaun, “Haforsa hau nia liman!”
verses.10: Depois hau baa iha Semaias nia uma, nebee oan hosi Delaia, oan hosi Meetabel, nebee tenki hela deit iha ninia uma, no nia dehan, “Diak liu ita baa hasoru malu deit iha Maromak nia uma, iha Templu laran, no nunee ita bele xave tiha Templu nia odamatan halo metin, tanba iha ema balu nebee sei mai oho ita boot, no sira sei mai kalan nee hodi oho ita boot.”
verses.11: Maibee hau hatete, “Ema ida nebee hanesan hau sei halai sees ka? No see mak hanesan hau, nebee tama iha Templu laran hodi salva ninia moris? Hau sei la ba!”
verses.12: Tanba hau hatene lo-loos katak Maromak la haruka nia mai hau. Nia foo sai liafuan nee mai hau tanba Tobias no Sanbalate selu nia.
verses.13: Sira selu nia hodi halo hau sai tauk, no halo sala. Ho maneira nee hodi sira bele hetan oportunidade hodi halo foer hau nia naran, nunee sira bele insulta hau.
verses.14: Oh hau nia Maromak, haree ba, saida mak Tobias no Sanbalate halo dadauk nee! Ho mos profeta feto Noadias no profeta sira seluk nee hakarak halo hau tauk.
verses.15: Moru nebee ami harii nee konsege remata duni iha loron rua-nulu resin lima iha fulan Elul, no servisu nee haan loron lima-nulu resin rua.
verses.16: Bainhira ami nia inimigu sira rona kona ba nee, sira hotu nebee hela besik ami sai tauk tebe-tebes. Sira hotu sai moe no haree katak servisu nebee halao ona nee hetan ajuda hosi ami nia Maromak.
verses.17: Iha tempu nee mos, ema boot sira hosi Judá haruka surat barak ba Tobias, no Tobias mos haruka fila fali surat barak ba sira.
verses.18: Tanba iha ema barak hosi Judá nebee iha relasaun juramentu nian ho nia, tanba nia mane-foun hosi Secanias, no Secanias mak Ará nia oan. No Tobias nia oan mak Joanan nebee kaben ho oan feto hosi Mesulam, nebee oan hosi Berekias.
verses.19: Sira sempre gaba Tobias nia hahalok diak iha hau nia oin no sira mos sempre foo hatene ba Tobias kona ba saida deit nebee hau koalia. Nunee Tobias haruka surat barak mai hau hodi koko halo tauk hau.

verses.1: Tuir mai, bainhira moru nee remata hotu ona, no hau monta ona odamatan no hau hili ona seguransa portaun nian, no ema sira nebee kanta no ema Levita sira,
verses.2: nunee hau hili hau nia maun Hanani no Hananias komandante fortaleza nian hodi toma konta ba Jerusalém laran, tanba Hananias mak ema fiel no nia hamtauk Maromak liu fali ema barak.
verses.3: Hau hatete ba sira, “Keta loke portaun sira nee too loron sae no manas. Odamatan nee hotu tenki taka no satan netik ho ai, maibee seguransa sira halao nafatin sira nia servisu iha sira nia fatin. Ema Jerusalém sira rasik sei sai seguransa, sira ida-idak tenki halao servisu iha sira nia fatin no iha sira nia uma ida-idak.”
verses.4: Sidade nee luan no boot liu, maibee populasaun uitoan deit no uma sira mos seidauk harii.
verses.5: Nunee hau nia Maromak tau planu ida iha hau nia laran atu halibur ema boot sira, ukun nain sira no povu, atu nunee bele halo rejistu ba uma kain. Nunee hau konsege hetan rejistu uma kain sira nebee fila iha tempu primeiru. Iha lista sira nee hakerek:
verses.6: Ida nee mak populasaun iha provínsia nee, nebee uluk lao sai hanesan ema dadur, sira nebee lao sai tanba liurai Nabukodonozor lori sira ba iha Babilónia, nebee konsege fila fali mai iha Jerusalém no Judá no ema ida-idak fila ba ninia fatin.
verses.7: Sira hotu mai hamutuk ho Zorobabel, Jesua, Neemias, Azarias, Raamias, Naamani, Mardokeu, Bilsá, Misperete, Bigvai, Neum no Baaná. Sira hotu nee mak ema Israel nian:
verses.8: jerasaun Paros nian: ema nain rihun rua atus ida hitu-nulu resin rua;
verses.9: jerasaun Sefatias nian: ema nain atus tolu hitu-nulu resin rua;
verses.10: jerasaun Ará nian: ema nain atus neen lima-nulu resin rua;
verses.11: jerasaun Paate-Moab nian, nebee jerasaun hosi Jesuá no Joab: ema nain rihun rua atus ualu sanulu resin ualu;
verses.12: jerasaun Elao nian: ema nain rihun ida atus rua lima-nulu resin haat;
verses.13: jerasaun Zatu nian: ema nain atus ualu haat-nulu resin lima;
verses.14: jerasaun Zakai nian: ema nain atus hitu neen-nulu;
verses.15: jerasaun Binui nian: ema nain atus neen haat-nulu resin ualu;
verses.16: jerasaun Bebai nian: ema nain atus neen rua-nulu resin ualu;
verses.17: jerasaun Azgade nian: ema nain rihun rua atus tolu rua-nulu resin rua;
verses.18: jerasaun Adonikão nian: ema nain atus neen neen-nulu resin hitu;
verses.19: jerasaun Bigvai nian: ema nain rihun rua neen-nulu resin hitu;
verses.20: jerasaun Adim nian: ema nain atus neen lima-nulu resin lima;
verses.21: jerasaun Ater nian nee mak jerasaun Ezekias: ema nain sia-nulu resin ualu;
verses.22: jerasaun Hasum nian: ema nain atus tolu rua-nulu resin ualu;
verses.23: jerasaun Bezai nian: ema nain atus tolu rua-nulu resin haat;
verses.24: jerasaun Harife nian: ema nain atus ida sanulu resin rua;
verses.25: jerasaun Gibeon nian: ema nain sia-nulu resin lima;
verses.26: ema sira hosi Belém no Netofá: ema nain atus ida ualu-nulu resin ualu;
verses.27: ema sira hosi Anatoten: ema nain atus ida rua-nulu resin ualu;
verses.28: ema sira hosi Bete-Azmavete: ema nain haat-nulu resin rua;
verses.29: ema sira hosi Kiriate-Jearim, Kefira, no Beerote: ema nain atus hitu haat-nulu resin tolu;
verses.30: ema sira hosi Ramá no Geba: ema nain atus neen rua-nulu resin ida;
verses.31: ema sira hosi Mikmás: ema nain atus ida rua-nulu resin rua;
verses.32: ema sira hosi Betél no Ai: ema nain atus ida rua-nulu resin tolu;
verses.33: ema sira hosi Nebo ida seluk nian: ema nain lima-nulu resin rua;
verses.34: jerasaun hosi Elao ida seluk nian: ema nain rihun ida atus rua lima-nulu resin haat;
verses.35: jerasaun hosi Harim: ema nain atus tolu rua-nulu;
verses.36: jerasaun hosi Jerikó: ema nain atus tolu haat-nulu resin lima;
verses.37: jerasaun hosi Lode, Hadide no Ono: ema nain atus hitu rua-nulu resin ida;
verses.38: jerasaun hosi Senaá: ema nain rihun tolu atus sia tolu-nulu.
verses.39: Hirak nee mak saserdote sira, jerasaun Jedaias nian, nebee família Jesuá nian: ema nain atus sia hitu-nulu resin tolu;
verses.40: jerasaun Imer nian: ema nain rihun ida lima-nulu resin rua;
verses.41: jerasaun Pasur nian: ema nain rihun ida atus rua haat-nulu resin hitu;
verses.42: jerasaun Harim nian: ema nain rihun ida sanulu resin hitu;
verses.43: Hirak nee mak ema Levita sira, jerasaun Jesuá nian, nebee hosi Kadmiel, ho jerasaun Hodeva nian: ema nain hitu-nulu resin haat.
verses.44: Hirak nee mak ema kantadór sira, hosi jerasaun Asafe nian: ema nain atus ida haat-nulu resin ualu.
verses.45: Hirak nee mak seguransa portaun sira: jerasaun Salum, jerasaun Ater, jerasaun Talmon, jerasaun Akube, jerasaun Hatita no jerasaun Sobai. Sira hamutuk ema atus ida tolu-nulu resin ualu.
verses.46: Hirak nee mak atan sira hosi Templu: jerasaun Ziá, jerasaun Hasufa, jerasaun Tabaote,
verses.47: jerasaun Kerós, jerasaun Siá, jerasaun Padon,
verses.48: jerasaun Lebana, jerasaun Hagaba, jerasaun Salmai,
verses.49: jerasaun Haná, jerasaun Gidel, jerasaun Gaar,
verses.50: jerasaun Reaias, jerasaun Rezin, jerasaun Nakoda,
verses.51: jerasaun Gazao, jerasaun Uzá, jerasaun Paséia,
verses.52: jerasaun Besai, jerasaun Meunim, jerasaun Nefusesim,
verses.53: jerasaun Bakebuke, jerasaun Hakufa, jerasaun Harhur,
verses.54: jerasaun Bazlite, jerasaun Mehida, jerasaun Harsa,
verses.55: jerasaun Barkos, jerasaun Sisera, jerasaun Tamá,
verses.56: jerasaun Nezias, jerasaun Hatifa.
verses.57: Hirak nee mak jerasaun hosi Salomão nia atan sira: jerasaun Sotai, jerasaun Soferete, jerasaun Perida,
verses.58: jerasaun Jaala, jerasaun Darkon, jerasaun Gidel,
verses.59: jerasaun Sefatias, jerasaun Hatil, jerasaun Pokerete-Hazebaim, jerasaun Amon.
verses.60: Atan hotu hosi Templu laran ho jerasaun hosi Salomão nia atan sira: ema nain atus tolu sia-nulu resin rua.
verses.61: Hirak nee mak ema sira nebee fila fali hosi Tel-Mela, Tel-Harsa, Kerube, Adon, no Imer, maibee sira la konsege hatudu katak sira nia jerasaun ka sira nia bei-oan sira lo-loos hosi Israel ka lae;
verses.62: jerasaun Delaias, jerasaun Tobias no jerasaun Nekoda sira hotu: ema nain atus neen haat-nulu resin rua;
verses.63: no entre saserdote sira: jerasaun Habaias, jerasaun Koz, jerasaun Barzilai. Jerasaun Barzilai nee nia bei-ala ida mak ema ida nebee hola oan feto ida hosi Barzilai, ema Gileadita, no foti naran hosi Barzilai nia família.
verses.64: Sira hotu buka sira nia naran iha lista jerasaun nian, maibee sira la hetan, nunee sira foer no la bele tuur iha pozisaun nudar saserdote nian.
verses.65: No governadór dehan ba sira katak sira la bele haan hahaan hosi oferta nebee santu, too saserdote ida bele hamriik hodi kaer Urim no Tumim.
verses.66: Povu sira nee hotu hamutuk mak rihun haat-nulu resin rua atus tolu neen-nulu;
verses.67: nee la sura atan mane no atan feto sira nebee hamutuk ema nain rihun hitu atus tolu tolu-nulu resin hitu; iha mos kantadór mane no kantadór feto sira hamutuk ema nain atus rua haat-nulu resin lima.
verses.68: Sira mos iha kuda atus hitu tolu-nulu resin neen, kuda mula atus rua haat-nulu resin lima,
verses.69: kuda kamelu atus haat tolu-nulu resin lima no kuda buru rihun neen atus hitu rua-nulu.
verses.70: Iha ulun família balu kontribui ba servisu nee: Governadór kontribui ba tezourária osan mean pedasuk rihun ida, manko lima-nulu no saserdote nia ropa atus lima tolu-nulu;
verses.71: no mos xefi família balu kontribui ba tezourária osan mean pedasuk hamutuk rihun rua-nulu no osan mutin kilu rihun ida atus tolu rua-nulu hodi halao servisu nee.
verses.72: Kontribuisaun hosi ema restu nee maka: osan mean pedasuk rihun rua-nulu, osan mutin kilu rihun ida atus rua no saserdote sira nia ropa hamutuk neen-nulu resin hitu.
verses.73: Nunee saserdote sira no ema Levita sira, seguransa portaun sira no kantadór sira, no povu balu, no atan sira iha templu no ema Israel hotu hela iha sira nia sidade sira. Bainhira fulan hitu nee too mai, ema Israel sira hela ona iha sira nia sidade ida-idak.

verses.1: Nunee povu hotu mai halibur hamutuk iha jardin, iha Portaun Bee Nian. Sira husu ba Ezra nebee eskriba, atu lori Livru Lei Nian nebee Moisés hakerek ona, nebee Maromak manda ona ba ema Israel sira.
verses.2: Nunee iha loron primeiru, fulan hitu nian, saserdote Ezra lori Livru Lei Nian nee ba iha povu sira nia oin, iha komunidade nia oin, inklui mane no feto, no mos ba ema naran deit nebee bele rona no kompriende.
