verses.3: Nia lee livru nee iha jardin iha Portaun Bee nia oin hosi dadeer too meiudia iha mane no feto sira nia oin no mos ba ema hotu nebee bele kompriende. Povu tomak rona di-diak ba Livru Lei Nian nee.
verses.4: Ezra hamriik iha palku nia leten nebee ema halo ho ai. Palku nee ema harii hodi saserdote ida bele hamriik iha leten. Ema nebee hamriik iha nia sorin loos mak Matitias, Sema, Anaias, Urias, Hilkias no Maaseias. Iha nia sorin karuk mak Pedaías, Misael, Malkias, Hasum, Hasbadana, Zakarias no Mesulam.
verses.5: Ezra loke livru nee iha povu tomak nia oin no povu tomak bele haree tanba nia aas liu ema hotu. Bainhira nia komesa loke livru nee, ema hotu hamriik.
verses.6: Depois Ezra hahii Nai, Maromak nebee boot liu, no ema hotu foti liman no hataan, “Amén, amén!” Depois sira hakneak adora ba Nai ho oin taka rabat too rai.
verses.7: Ho mos Jesua, Bani, Serebias, Jamin, Akube, Sabetai, Hodias, Maaséias, Kelita, Azarias, Jozabade, Hanan no Pelaias. Sira hotu ema Levita, no sira mos hanorin povu hodi sira bele kompriende Lei nee, no povu nee hamriik iha sira nia fatin.
verses.8: Ezra lee livru nee ho klaru tebes, nunee ema levita sira esplika liafuan nee too sira hotu bele kompriende.
verses.9: Depois Neemias, nebee governadór, no saserdote Ezra, nebee eskriba, no ema Levita sira nebee hanorin povu, hatete ba povu tomak dehan, “Loron nee mak loron santu ba Nai, imi nia Maromak. Imi la bele laran susar no tanis!” Tanba povu tomak tanis bainhira sira rona liafuan hosi Livru Lei Nian nee.
verses.10: Depois nia hatete tan ba sira, “Agora imi bele fila fali baa, no haan hahaan diak nian no hemu ho buat midar sira no lori mos balu ba ema sira nebee la iha liu buat ida, tanba loron nee mak loron nebee santu ba ita nia Nai! Imi la bele laran todan, tanba Nai nia ksolok mak imi nia fatin seguransa!”
verses.11: No ema Levita sira nee mos koko hakalma ema sira nee ho liafuan, “Hakmatek ona! Loron nee loron santu. Imi keta laran todan tan!”
verses.12: Nunee ema sira nee hotu fila fali hodi haan no hemu, no sira mos fahe hahaan ba malu no halo festa boot, tanba sira kompriende hotu liafuan nebee ema foo sai ba sira.
verses.13: Iha loron segundu ulun ba família sira hosi nasaun hotu, no mos ho saserdote sira no ema Levita sira mai hamutuk ho Ezra eskriba nee, atu aprende liafuan hosi Livru Lei Nian.
verses.14: Nunee sira hetan orden ida iha lei nebee Nai foo liu hosi profeta Moisés, katak ema Israel sira tenki hela iha tenda laran durante selebrasaun ba fulan ba dala hitu nian.
verses.15: No tenki foo avizo ba iha sira nia sidade sira no Jerusalém laran katak, “Sira tenki sae ba iha foho leten, hodi foti ai oliveira tahan, ai oliveira tahan, ai murtas tahan, nuu tahan no ai tahan seluk tan hodi bele lori mai hodi halo tenda tuir liafuan nebee hakerek ona iha livru nee nia laran.”
verses.16: Nunee ema sira nee sae ba foho leten hodi foti ai tahan sira hodi mai halo tenda, sira halo tenda nee iha sira nia uma leten, iha uma oin, no mos iha Maromak nia uma fatin sira, iha jardin iha Portaun Bee nia oin no iha jardin iha Portaun Efraim nia oin.
verses.17: Povu tomak nebee fila fali hosi rai kastigu nee, sira hotu halo tenda no hela iha laran. Tanba iha kedas tempu Josué nian, nebee oan hosi Nun, too mai iha loron nee, ema Israel sira nunka halo hanesan nee. Nunee sira haksolok makaas liu.
verses.18: Nia lee liafuan nebee hakerek iha Livru Lei Nian hosi Maromak nee ba sira loro-loron, hosi loron primeiru too remata. Durante loron hitu nia laran sira selebra hamutuk festa nee no iha loron ualu, iha festa sorumutu nian tuir livru hakerek.

verses.1: Iha loron rua-nulu resin haat, iha fulan nebaa, povu Israel tomak halibur hamutuk halo jejún ho hatais hena karoon no tau rai iha sira nia ulun.
verses.2: Nunee jerasaun hotu hosi Israel haketak aan hosi ema nebee hosi rai liur, depois sira hamriik no komesa konfesa sira nia sala no sira nia bei-ala sira nia sala.
verses.3: Bainhira sira hamriik hela iha sira nia fatin, sira lee Livru Lei Nian hosi Nai, sira nia Maromak, durante oras tolu nia laran, depois oras tolu tuir mai tan sira hotu konfesa sira nia sala no hakneak adora ba Nai, sira nia Maromak.
verses.4: Iha palku nebee ema Levita sira hamriik ba nee, iha Jesua, Bani, Kadmiel, Sebanias, Buni, Serebias, Bani no Kenani; sira hamriik ho lian makaas hodi bolu ba Nai, sira nia Maromak.
verses.5: No Jesua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hasabneias, Hodias, Sebanias, no Petaias, ema Levita sira nee hatete, “Hamriik ba, hahii nafatin Nai imi nia Maromak too tinan ba tinan! Bensaun ba O nia naran nebee nakonu ho glória, nebee aas liu bensaun no adorasaun hotu!”
verses.6: “Só O deit mak Nai! O kria ona lalehan, no lalehan sira nia lalehan ho ninia forsa sira hotu. O kria ona rai ho buat hotu iha rai leten nee, no tasi ho buat hotu iha tasi laran. O mak sustenta buat hotu nee. No forsa lalehan nian hakneak hodi adora O.
verses.7: O mak Nai, Maromak nebee hili Abrão no lori nia sai hosi Ur-Kasdim. O foo ba nia naran Abraão.
verses.8: O haree katak Abraão iha laran fiel iha O nia oin. No O halo aliansa ida ho nia katak O sei foo ba ninia bei-oan rai hosi ema Kanaan sira, ema Hete sira, ema Amoreu sira, ema Perizeu sira, ema Jebuz sira, no ema Girgase sira. No O halo tuir ona O nia promesa nee, tanba O mak loos.
verses.9: O haree hotu ami nia bei-ala sira nia terus iha Ejitu no rona sira nia hakilar iha Tasi Teberau nia tasi ibun.
verses.10: O hatudu ona sinál oi-oin no milagre oi-oin iha Farão no nia atan hotu nia oin no mos ba nia povu tomak iha nia rai, tanba ita hatene katak sira foti aan hodi hasoru ba ami nia bei-ala sira. Ho nunee O foti aas O nia naran, nebee hanesan nee too ohin loron.
verses.11: Iha sira nia oin O fera tasi klaran fahe ba rua, nunee sira bele lao liu hosi fatin maran iha tasi klaran. Maibee ema sira nebee duni tuir sira, O halo sira mout iha tasi nebee klean liu, hanesan fatuk nebee mout iha bee perigozu laran.
verses.12: O lidera sira ho ai riin kalohan iha tempu loron no ai riin ahi iha tempu kalan hodi leno sira nia dalan nebee sira liu.
verses.13: O tuun baa sira iha Foho Sinai nia tutun no koalia ba sira hosi lalehan no foo ba sira regulamentu sira nebee justu, lei sira nebee loos, estatutu sira nebee diak no ukun fuan sira.
verses.14: No mos O foo hatene ba sira kona ba O nia loron Sabdu nebee santu no foo ba sira ukun fuan, estatutu no lei sira liu hosi O nia atan Moisés.
verses.15: O haraik ba sira paun hosi lalehan atu halakon sira nia hamlaha no bee O hasai hosi fatuk lolon atu halakon sira nia hamrook. No mos O haruka sira tama no hela iha nasaun nebee O rasik promete ona atu foo ba sira.
verses.16: Maibee ami nia bei-ala sira nee, ulun toos liu, sira lakohi rona no lakohi halo tuir O nia ukun fuan sira.
verses.17: Sira lakohi halo tuir no la hanoin fali milagre sira nebee O halo tiha ona iha sira nia leet. Sira halo sira nia ulun sai toos liu no foti xefi ida atu fila fali ba sira nia kastigu. Maibee O mak Maromak nebee foo perdua, nebee iha grasa no laran luak, neineik atu sai hirus no iha domin metin loos. No O la husik sira.
verses.18: Mezmu, bainhira sira halo estátua karau oan no hatete, ‘Ida nee mak ita nia Maromak nebee hasai ita hosi Ejitu,’ no halo sala boot,
verses.19: O nunka husik sira iha rai fuik tanba O nia laran luak nebee boot liu ba sira. Ai riin kalohan nebee lidera sira nia viajen nee nunka husik sira iha tempu loron, nunee mos ba ai riin ahi nebee lidera sira iha tempu kalan, no hatudu naroman ba sira, no dalan ida nebee sira tenki lao tuir.
verses.20: No O foo ba sira O nia Espíritu nebee diak hodi hanorin sira. No O nia maná nebee O haraik ba sira nee mos O nunka hapara hodi sira bele haan no O foo ba sira bee hodi sira la bele hamrook.
verses.21: Durante tinan haat-nulu O tau matan ba sira iha rai fuik. Sira nunka falta buat ida, sira nia ropa mos nunka aat, no sira nia ain mos nunka moras.
verses.22: O entrega ba sira reinu sira no nasaun sira no fahe fatin hotu nee ba sira, tanba sira rai hosi Seon, liurai hosi Hesbon, no rai hosi Ogue, liurai hosi Basan.
verses.23: O foo ba sira oan barak tebe-tebes hanesan fitun sira iha lalehan no lori sira ba rai nebee O promete ona ba sira nia bei-ala sira atu tama hodi hela.
verses.24: Depois sira nia oan sira tama no hadau tiha rai sira nee, no O hamonu ema rai nain sira iha sira nia oin. Ema sira nee mak ema Kanaan sira, no O entrega ema Kanaan sira, no sira nia liurai sira, no mos povu iha rai nee ba iha sira nia liman, atu nunee sira manda ema sira nee tuir sira nia hakarak.
verses.25: Sira hadau sidade sira nebee metin no sira hadau rai nebee bokur. Sira hadau hotu uma sira nebee nakonu ho riku-soin barak, bee posu sira, toos uvas sira, toos oliveira sira no ai horis barak nebee foo fuan. Sira haan too bosu no sai bokur. Sira sai kontenti iha O nia hahalok diak nebee boot liu ba sira.
verses.26: Maibee sira lakohi rona ba O no sira kontra hasoru O. Sira tau ba kotuk O nia lei sira no sira oho hotu O nia profeta sira nebee sempre hasee sira hodi lori sira fila fali ba O. Sira halo sala boot loos.
verses.27: Nunee O entrega tiha sira ba sira nia inimigu sira nia liman, nebee hanehan sira. No bainhira sira hasoru terus sira foin bolu ba O, depois O rona hosi lalehan, tanba O nia laran luak nebee boot, nunee mak O foo salvadór sira ba povu nee, ema nebee bele salva sira hosi inimigu sira nia liman.
verses.28: Maibee depois sira hetan tempu hakmatek, sira halo aat fali iha O nia oin. Nunee O entrega fali sira ba inimigu sira nia liman hodi ukun sira. Depois sira halerik no bolu fali ba O nia naran, no O rona hosi lalehan, depois O ajuda fila fali sira, tanba deit O nia laran luak.
verses.29: O hasee sira hodi lori sira fila fali mai O nia lei. Maibee sira foti aan, sira lakohi halo tuir O nia ukun fuan sira no sira halo sala kontra O nia regulamentu sira, nebee se ema halo tuir, sira sei moris liu hosi liafuan nee. Sira see kotuk no halo sira nia ulun sai toos liu no sira lakohi rona no halo tuir.
verses.30: Maibee durante tinan barak nia laran O hatudu pasiénsia ba sira. Ho O nia Espíritu ita koriji sira, liu hosi O nia profeta sira, maibee sira lakohi rona, too nunee O entrega fali sira ba povu seluk sira nia liman.
verses.31: Maibee tanba O nia laran luak nebee boot liu ba sira nunee O nunka hamate sira no nunka husik sira, tanba O mak Maromak nebee iha grasa no laran luak.
verses.32: Nunee agora, Oh ami nia Maromak, Maromak nebee boot liu, nebee iha podér no perigozu liu, nebee sempre halo tuir O nia aliansa no domin metin, la bele hanoin katak terus hotu nebee hasoru ona ami nee mak uitoan deit, buat nebee hasoru mos ami nia liurai sira, ami nia xefi sira, ami nia saserdote sira, ami nia profeta sira, ami nia bei-ala sira no O nia povu hotu, hahuu hosi tempu liurai Asíria sira too ohin loron nee.
verses.33: Maibee O halao justisa iha buat hotu nebee hasoru ami, tanba O sempre hatudu fidelidade maibee ami halo sala.
verses.34: No mos ami nia liurai sira, ami nia xefi sira, ami nia saserdote sira, no ami nia bei-ala sira nee lakohi halo tuir O nia ukun fuan sira no O nia testemunha sira nebee O foo ba sira.
verses.35: Tanba iha sira nia reinu mos sira lakohi serví ba O, mezmu O haraik ona buat diak barak ba sira no prepara rai nebee luan no bokur ba sira. Sira lakohi atu fila hosi sira nia hahalok aat.
verses.36: Tebes, agora nee ami mak atan iha rai nebee O foo ona ba ami nia bei-ala sira hodi haan ai fuan no hetan buat diak nee, tebes ami mak atan deit.
verses.37: Rai nee foo rezultadu boot tebes ba liurai sira nebee O haruka atu ukun ami tanba ami nia sala sira. No mos sira domina ami nia isin lolon sira no ami nia animál sira tuir sira nia hakarak. Nunee ami iha terus boot liu.”
verses.38: Tanba buat hotu nee, ami halo aliansa metin ida no hakerek iha surat no tau karimbu, nebee iha ami nia xefi sira, ema Levita sira no saserdote sira nia naran.

verses.1: Ema nebee tau karimbu nee maka: Neemias, nebee governadór, Hakalias nia oan, no Zedekias,
verses.2: Seraias, Azarias, Jeremias,
verses.3: Pasur, Amaria, Malkias,
verses.4: Hatus, Sebanias, Maluke,
verses.5: Harim, Meremote, Obadias,
verses.6: Daniel, Ginetom, Baruke,
verses.7: Mesulam, Abias, Mijamin,
verses.8: Maazias, Bilgai no Semaias. Nain hirak nee mak saserdote sira.
verses.9: Sira nebee hosi suku Levita sira maka: Azanias nia oan Jesua, Binui hosi jerasaun Henadade, Kadmiel;
verses.10: no mos sira nia maun-alin sira, maka: Sebanias, Hodias, Kelita, Pelaias, Hanaun,
verses.11: Mika, Reobe, Hasabias,
verses.12: Zakur, Serebias, Sebanias,
verses.13: Hodias, Bani no Beninu.
verses.14: Povu nia ulun sira: Paros, Paata-Moab, Elão, Zatu, Bani,
verses.15: Buni, Azgade, Bebai,
verses.16: Adonias, Bigvai, Adin,
verses.17: Ater, Ezekias, Azúl,
verses.18: Hodias, Hasum, Bezai,
verses.19: Harife, Anatote, Nobai,
verses.20: Magpias, Mesulam, Hezir,
verses.21: Mesezabel, Zadok, Jadua,
verses.22: Pelatias, Hanã, Anaias,
verses.23: Oseias, Hananias, Hasube,
verses.24: Haloes, Pilea, Sobeke,
verses.25: Reum, Hasabna, Maaseias,
verses.26: Ahias, Hanaun, Anan,
verses.27: Maluke, Harim no Baana.
verses.28: No mos iha povu seluk: saserdote sira, ema Levita sira, seguransa portaun sira, kantadór sira, atan sira hosi Templu no ema hotu nebee haketak aan hosi ema liur hodi tuir Maromak nia Lei, no sira nia ferik oan sira, sira nia oan mane sira no sira nia oan feto sira, ema sira nebee hatene no bele kompriende.
verses.29: Sira halibur aan hamutuk ho sira nia maun-alin sira no sira nia xefi sira. Sira halo juramentu ida hodi lao tuir Maromak nia Lei nebee Nia foo ona liu hosi Moisés, Maromak nia atan, no halo tuir nafatin ukun fuan sira hosi Nai, ita nia Nai, no Ninia regulamentu sira no estatutu sira.
verses.30: No mos ami la bele foo ami nia oan feto sira hodi kaben ho ema liur, no ami mos la bele ba foti ema liur nia oan feto sira hodi kaben ho ami nia oan mane sira.
verses.31: No karik bainhira ema liur mai faan sasaan ka ai haan naran deit iha loron Sabdu ka loron santu sira seluk, mak ami sei la sosa. No ami sei husik toos nia rezultadu ba tinan hitu nian, no kansela osan debe nian hotu.
verses.32: No ami mos halo komitmentu hodi oferese osan mutin grama haat kada tinan ba Maromak nia uma, hodi halao servisu ba templu nian mak hanesan:
verses.33: paun Prezensa nian, oferta trigu nian, oferta sakrifísiu tunu, ba loron Sabdu sira, tempu fulan foun sira no festa loron boot sira, no ba buat santu sira no sakrifísiu sala nian hodi hamoos Israel nia sala, no mos servisu saida deit iha Maromak nia uma.
verses.34: No mos ami hotu, hanesan saserdote sira, ema Levita sira no povu nee dada rifa hodi hatene see mak lori oferta ai sunu nian ba Maromak nia uma, kada uma kain nebee hetan, tuir tempu kada tinan, hodi sunu ahi nebee iha altár Nai nian, ami nia Maromak, tuir saida mak hakerek ona iha livru Lei nian.
verses.35: No mos ami sei lori rezultadu primeiru nian hosi ami nia rai, no ai fuan primeiru nian hotu hosi ami nia ai hotu, kada tinan, hodi hatama ba Nai nia uma.
verses.36: No mos ami sei lori ami nia oan mane primeiru sira no ami nia animál nia oan primeiru sira nudar hakerek ona iha livru Lei nian, no mos ami nia karau nia oan primeiru sira no bibi nia oan primeiru sira, hodi hatama ba ami nia Maromak nia uma, ba saserdote sira nebee serví iha ami nia Maromak nia uma.
verses.37: No mos ami sei lori rezultadu primeiru hosi ami nia trigu nebee dulas, no ami nia oferta sira, no ami nia ai fuan oi-oin hosi ai huun hotu, inklui tua uvas no mina, ami sei foo ba saserdote sira, hodi hatama ba kuartu sira iha ami nia Maromak nia uma. No ami lori porsentu sanulu nian hosi ami nia toos hodi foo ba ema Levita sira, hodi ema Levita sira nee bele hetan porsentu sanulu nian iha sidade hotu nebee ami iha toos.
verses.38: No saserdote ida hosi Arão nia oan sei hamutuk ho ema Levita sira nee bainhira sira simu oferta porsentu sanulu nian. Nunee ema Levita sira nee tenki lori fali oferta porsentu sanulu nian hosi povu nia oferta porsentu sanulu nian ba iha Maromak nia uma, iha kuartu sira nebee iha armazén.
verses.39: Tanba ema Israel sira no ema Levita sira tenki lori oferta trigu nian, tua uvas foun no mina ba iha kuartu sira nebee rai sasaan Fatin Santu nian, inklui mos saserdote sira nebee serví, seguransa portaun sira no kantadór sira. Ami sei la husik ami nia Maromak nia uma.

verses.1: Xefi sira hela iha Jerusalém, no povu restu dada rifa hodi hili ema nain ida hosi nain sanulu hodi bele hela iha Jerusalém, nebee sidade santu, no ema nain sia seluk hosi nain sanulu bele hela iha sidade sira seluk.
verses.2: Povu sira foo bensaun ba ema nebee oferese sira nia aan hodi hela iha Jerusalém.
verses.3: Sira nee mak ulun provínsia Judá nian nebee hela iha Jerusalém, maibee ba sidade seluk sira iha Judá, ema hotu hela iha sira nia rai rasik iha sira nia sidade ida-idak, nebee ema Israel sira, saserdote sira, ema Levita sira, atan sira hosi Templu no jerasaun hosi Salomão nia atan sira.
verses.4: Iha Jerusalém, só deit jerasaun Judá no jerasaun Benjamin mak hela. Jerasaun hosi Judá: Atalias, Uzias nia oan, Zakarias nia oan, Amaria nia oan, Sefatias nia oan, Maalalel nia oan, nebee hosi jerasaun Peres;
verses.5: no Maaseias, Baruke nia oan, Kol-Hozé nia oan, Hazaias nia oan, Adaias nia oan, Joiaribe nia oan, Zakarias nia oan, nebee hosi jerasaun Selane.
verses.6: Jerasaun hosi Peres nian nebee hela iha Jerusalém hamutuk ema nain atus haat neen-nulu resin ualu nebee ema forti.
verses.7: No ida nee mak jerasaun hosi Benjamin: Salu, Mesulam nia oan, Joede nia oan, Pedaias nia oan, Kolaias nia oan, Maaseias nia oan, Iteal nia oan, Jesaias nia oan.
verses.8: No tuir nia: Gabai no Salai. Ema nee hamutuk atus sia rua-nulu resin ualu.
verses.9: Joel, Zikri nia oan, mak administradór, no Judá, Senua nia oan, mak visi administradór sidade nian.
verses.10: Hosi saserdote sira maka: Jedaias, Joiaribe nia oan, no Joakim;
verses.11: Seraias, Hilkias nia oan, Mesulam nia oan, Zadok nia oan, Meraiote nia oan, Ahitub nia oan, nia mak xefi iha Maromak nia uma;
verses.12: no sira nia maun-alin sira nebee halo servisu iha Maromak nia uma nee hamutuk: nain atus ualu rua-nulu resin rua. No mos Adaias, Jeroaun nia oan, Pelalias nia oan, Amzi nia oan, Zakarias nia oan, Pasur nia oan, Malkias nia oan;
verses.13: ho nia maun-alin sira, ulun família nian, hamutuk nain atus rua haat-nulu resin rua. No Amasai, Azarel nia oan, Azai nia oan, Mesilemote nia oan, Imer nia oan;
verses.14: no sira nia maun-alin sira, ema nebee asuwain no iha forsa, sira hamutuk nain atus ida rua-nulu resin ualu, no Zabdiel, Gedolim nia oan, mak sira nia komandante.
verses.15: Hosi ema Levita sira: Semaias, Hasube nia oan, Azrikam nia oan, Hasabias nia oan, Buni nia oan;
verses.16: No mos Sebetai no Jozabade, sira mak ulun ba ema Levita sira nian, nebee kontrola servisu hotu nebee akontese iha Maromak nia uma liur.
verses.17: No Matanias, Mika nia oan, Zabdi nia oan, Asafe nia oan, nia mak ulun múzika hananu no halo orasaun agradesementu nian; no Bakebukias, nebee ema segundu hosi nia maun-alin sira no mos Abda, Samua nia oan, Galal nia oan, Jedutun nia oan.
verses.18: Ema Levita hotu nebee hela iha sidade santu hamutuk nain atus rua ualu-nulu resin haat.
verses.19: Seguransa portaun nian: Akube no Talmon ho nia maun-alin sira nebee toma konta kona ba hein portaun sira, sira hamutuk nain atus ida hitu-nulu.
verses.20: Ema Israel sira seluk, no saserdote sira no mos ema Levita sira, sira hotu nebee hela iha sidade Judá nian, sira ida-idak hela iha sira nia rai rasik.
verses.21: Maibee atan sira hosi Templu, sira hotu hela iha Ofel. Zia no Gispa nebee xefi ba atan sira nee.
verses.22: Xefi ba ema Levita sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém mak Uzi, Bani nia oan, Hasabias nia oan, Matanias nia oan, Mika nia oan, hosi jerasaun Asafe, nia toma konta kona ba múzika iha Maromak nia uma.
verses.23: Tanba nee, iha orden liurai nian ida kona ba sira, hodi rai ai haan ruma ba kantadór sira, atu sira bele simu loro-loron.
verses.24: Petaias, Mesezabel nia oan, hosi jerasaun Zera, Judá nia oan, nia ajuda liurai hodi halo servisu hotu nebee relasaun ho povu nian.
verses.25: Aldeia-aldeia nebee sira hela besik iha toos, jerasaun balu hosi Judá hela iha Kiriate-Arba no nia aldeia sira, iha Dibon no nia aldeia sira no mos iha Jekabzeel ho nia aldeia sira;
verses.26: iha Jesua, iha Molada no iha Bete-Pelete,
verses.27: iha Hazar-Sual, iha Beer-Seba no nia aldeia sira,
verses.28: iha Ziklage, iha Mekona no nia aldeia sira,
verses.29: iha En-Rimon, iha Zora, iha Jarmute,
verses.30: Zanoa, Adulan ho nia aldeia sira, iha Lakis no nia toos, no mos iha Azeka ho nia aldeia sira. Hosi fatin sira nebee sira hela, hahuu hosi Beer-Seba too iha Foho Leet Hinom.
verses.31: No jerasaun Benjamin hela hosi Geba too iha Mikmas, iha Aia, iha Betél no nia aldeia sira,
verses.32: iha Anatote, Nobe no Ananias,
verses.33: iha Hazor, Ramá no Gitaim,
verses.34: iha Hadide, Zeboim no Nebalate,
verses.35: iha Lode no iha Ono, nebee foho leet nebee iha badaen sira.
verses.36: No ema Levita balu hosi Judá baa iha Benjamin.

verses.1: Sira nee mak saserdote sira no ema Levita sira nebee fila fali hamutuk ho Zorobabel, Sealtiel nia oan, no Jesua: Seraias, Jeremias, Ezra,
verses.2: Amaria, Maluke, Hatus,
verses.3: Sekanias, Reum, Meremote,
verses.4: Ido, Ginetoi, Abias,
verses.5: Miamin, Maadias, Bilga,
verses.6: Semaías, Joiaribe, Jedaías,
verses.7: Salu, Amoke, Hilkias no Jedaías. Sira nee hotu mak ulun saserdote nian ho sira nia maun-alin sira iha tempu Jesua.
verses.8: Hosi ema Levita sira: Jesua, Binui, Kadmiel, Serebias, Judá no Matanias. Matanias nee ho nia maun-alin sira lori múzika agradesementu nian.
verses.9: No Bakebukias ho Uni, ho sira nia maun-alin sira, hamriik forma iha sira nia oin hodi haree ministériu nee.
verses.10: Jesua nia oan mak Joiakim, no Joiakim nia oan mak Eliasibe, no Eliasibe nia oan mak Joiada,
verses.11: no Joiada nia oan mak Jonatan, no Jonatan nia oan mak Jadua.
verses.12: Iha tempu Joiakim nian, ema sira nebee sai saserdote mak ulun ba família sira tuir mai nee: Meraias hosi família Seraias, Hananias hosi família Jeremias,
verses.13: Mesulam hosi família Ezra, Joanan hosi família Amária,
verses.14: Jonatas hosi família Maluki, José hosi família Sebanias,
verses.15: Adna hosi família Harim, Helkai hosi família Meraiote,
verses.16: Zakarias hosi família Ido, Mesulam hosi família Gineton,
verses.17: Zikri hosi família Abias, Piltai hosi Miniamin no hosi Moadias,
verses.18: Samua hosi família Bilgai, Jehonatas hosi família Semaias,
verses.19: Matenai hosi família Joiaribe, Uzi hosi família Jedaias,
verses.20: Kalai hosi família Salai, Heber hosi família Amoke,
verses.21: Hasabias hosi família Hilkias, Netanel hosi família Jedaias.
verses.22: Ema Levita sira, iha tempu Eliasibe, Joiada, Joanan no Jadua nian, hakerek lista ulun família sira, hanesan mos saserdote sira too fali tempu liurai Darius, ema Persia nee.
verses.23: Ulun ba família hosi jerasaun Levita sira hakerek iha Livru Krónikas too iha tempu Joanan, oan hosi Eliasibe.
verses.24: Sira nee mak ulun ba ema Levita sira: Hasabias, Serebias no Jesua, nebee Kadmiel nia oan, ho sira nia maun-alin sira nebee hamriik forma iha sira nia oin hodi hananu no foo agradese tuir orden hosi David, ema Maromak nian, no sira forma hosi grupu ba grupu.
verses.25: Matanias, Bakebukias, Obadias, Mesulam, Talmon no Akube, ema sira nee mak seguransa ba portaun. Sira hein iha fatin portaun nian hodi simu sasaan.
verses.26: Sira hotu moris iha tempu Joiakim, Jesua nia oan, Jozadak nia oan, no mos iha tempu Neemias nebee governadór no Ezra nebee saserdote no eskriba.
verses.27: Iha tempu nebee sira halo dedikasaun ba moru Jerusalém nee, sira bolu hotu ema Levita sira hosi fatin fatin hodi mai iha Jerusalém, atu halao seremónia dedikasaun ho ksolok boot ho liafuan agradesementu no hananu ho uza símbalo, liras no harpa sira.
verses.28: Nunee mak kantadór sira hotu halibur iha fatin ida, sira nee hotu mai hosi fatin nebee haleu Jerusalém, no hosi Netofati nia aldeia sira,
verses.29: hosi Bete-Gilgal, no hosi rai Geba no Azmavete; tanba kantadór sira nee harii tiha ona aldeia sira nebee haleu Jerusalém.
verses.30: Saserdote sira no ema Levita sira nee halo santu sira nia aan, depois halo santu mos povu sira nee hotu, no depois portaun sira no moru Jerusalém.
verses.31: Depois hau haruka xefi Judá nian hodi hakat sae ba moru leten no hau forma grupu boot rua atu kanta agradesementu. Grupu ida baa parte loos, ba iha Portaun Lixu nian.
verses.32: Iha sira nia kotuk mak Hosaias ho xefi Judá balu nebee lao tuir sira.
verses.33: Iha mos Azarias, Ezra, Mesulam,
verses.34: Judá, Benjamin, Semaias no Jeremias,
verses.35: no hosi jerasaun saserdote nebee kaer korneta: Zakarias, Jonatas nia oan, Semaias nia oan, Matanias nia oan, Mika nia oan, Zakur nia oan, Asafe nia oan,
verses.36: ho nia maun-alin sira, nebee Semaias, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netanel, Judá no Hanani ho alat múzika hosi David, ema Maromak nian; no eskriba Ezra hamriik iha sira nia oin.
verses.37: Depois iha Portaun Bee Matan nebee iha sira nia oin, sira lao sae kedas iha eskada Sidade David nian, eskada nebee sae ba moru leten, liu hosi palásiu David nian, no depois lao too iha Portaun Bee, iha sorin lorosae nian.
verses.38: No grupu boot segundu nian lao ba parte karuk no hau tuir hosi sira nia kotuk ho ema balu hosi sira, lao liu hosi moru no Uma Aas Fornu Sira too iha Moru Luan.
verses.39: Depois ami lao liu hosi Portaun Efraim nia leten, Portaun Tuan, Portaun Ikan, Uma Aas Hananel, no Uma Aas Atus Ida too fali Portaun Bibi Malae. Depois sira para iha Portaun Kadeia.
verses.40: Depois grupu kantadór rua nee foo agradese iha Maromak nia uma. Hau mos hamutuk ho ukun nain sira balu,
verses.41: ho saserdote sira: Eliakim, Maaséias, Miniamin, Mikaias, Elioenai, Zakarias no Hananias, nebee iha korneta sira,
verses.42: no Maaseias, Semaias, Eleazar, Uzi, Joanan, Malkias, Elaun no Ézer. No kantadór sira nee hananu ho Jezraias nebee lidera sira.
verses.43: Iha loron nebaa, sira oferese sakrifísiu nebee boot tebes. Sira haksolok loos tanba Maromak foo ba sira ksolok boot. Feto sira no labarik sira mos haksolok tebes, too iha fatin dook sira mos ema rona Jerusalém nia ksolok.
verses.44: Iha tempu nebaa, ema balu hetan responsabilidade hodi tau matan ba kuartu sira nebee simu sasaan inklui oferta sira, rezultadu primeiru no ba oferta porsentu sanulu, atu nunee bele simu kontribuisaun sira nee hosi sidade sira nia rai, tuir Lei hodi foo ba saserdote sira no ema Levita sira. Tanba Judá haksolok tebes kona ba saserdote sira no ema Levita sira nia ministériu.
verses.45: Tanba sira halao servisu ba sira nia Maromak, no halo servisu seremónia halo moos nian, nunee mos kantadór sira no seguransa portaun sira, tuir David ho nia oan Salomão sira nia orden.
verses.46: Tanba hahuu hosi uluk kedas, iha tempu David no Asafe nian, iha ona ulun múzika nian, iha múzika adora no múzika agradese ba Maromak.
verses.47: Iha tempu Zorobabel no iha tempu Neemias nian, ema Israel tomak foo kontribuisaun ba kantadór no seguransa portaun sira loro-loron, no sira haketak buat nebee foo ba ema Levita sira, no ema Levita sira haketak fali buat nebee foo ba Arão nia oan sira.

verses.1: Iha loron nebaa, sira lee Livru Moisés Nian ba povu tomak hodi rona. No iha livru laran hakerek katak ema Amonita no ema Moabita sira la bele tama ba komunidade Maromak nian too tinan ba tinan.
verses.2: Tanba sira la foo paun no bee ba ema Israel sira, maibee sira selu Balaão atu hasoru ema Israel sira hodi foo malisan.  Maibee ami nia Maromak muda malisan nee sai fali bensaun.
verses.3: Bainhira sira rona lei nee, sira haketak ema hotu nebee kahur nee hosi ema Israel sira.
verses.4: No molok tempu nee, saserdote Eliasibe, nebee tau matan ba kuartu sira iha ami nia Maromak nia uma, nia hamutuk ho Tobias,
verses.5: no nia prepara tiha kuartu boot ida ba Tobias. Uluk ema uza kuartu nee hodi rai oferta trigu nian, insensu, sanan sira, no oferta porsentu sanulu nian hosi batar, tua uvas foun no mina, buat sira nebee tenki foo ba ema Levita, kantadór no seguransa portaun sira, no mos oferta sira ba saserdote sira.
verses.6: Maibee bainhira buat nee akontese hau la iha Jerusalém, tanba iha tinan tolu-nulu resin rua iha tempu Artaxerxes, liurai hosi Babilónia, nee mak hau ba hasoru liurai. Maibee liu tiha tempu balu hau husu lisensa hosi liurai hodi fila baa.
verses.7: Depois hau too iha Jerusalém, no hau haree Eliasibe nia hahalok aat nebee nia halo hodi halo buat nee ba Tobias, nebee nia prepara ona ba Tobias kuartu ida iha Maromak nia uma fatin.
verses.8: Hau sai tristi loos, depois hau soe sai hotu Tobias nia sasaan nee hosi kuartu nee nia laran.
verses.9: Depois hau haruka sira halo kuartu nee sai moos fali hosi sala nee, no hau lori fali sanan sira hosi Maromak nia uma, ho oferta trigu nian no insensu.
verses.10: No hau mos haree katak sira la foo kontribuisaun ba ema Levita sira, nunee halo ema Levita sira no kantadór sira nebee halao ministériu nee halai hotu ba sira ida-idak nia toos.
verses.11: Hau sai hirus ba lideransa sira, hau hatete, “Tanba saa mak imi husik Maromak nia uma nee sai hanesan nee?” Depois hau halibur fila fali sira no lori fali sira mai iha sira nia fatin.
verses.12: Nunee ema Judá hotu komesa lori fali oferta porsentu sanulu nian hosi batar, no tua uvas foun no insensu ba iha armajen sira nee.
verses.13: Depois hau hili saserdote Selemias no eskriba Zadok, no mos ema Levita naran Pedaias, hodi tau matan ba armajen sira nee. No mos Hanan, Zakur nia oan, Matanias nia oan, hodi ajuda sira. Tanba sira iha fidelidade no sira iha servisu atu fahe sasaan nee ba sira nia maun-alin sira.
verses.14: Oh hau nia Maromak, hanoin hetan hahalok nee no la bele halakon hau nia domin metin nebee hau halo ba hau nia Maromak nia uma, no servisu sira nebee hau halo iha nebaa!
verses.15: Iha tempu nebaa, iha Judá hau haree ema sira sama uvas iha tanki uvas iha loron Sabdu, no mos ema sira lori batar futun sira no tula sae ba kuda buru leten, no mos tua uvas, uvas fuan no figeira fuan no sasaan oi-oin nebee sira lori ba iha Jerusalém iha loron Sabdu. Hau hasee sira bainhira sira faan sira nia ai haan.
verses.16: No mos ema Tiro sira nebee hela iha nebaa, sira lori ikan no sasaan oi-oin hodi faan ba ema Judá sira iha loron Sabdu, liu tan mak sira faan iha Jerusalém laran duni!
verses.17: Depois hau foo sala ba lider Judá sira, no hatete ba sira, “Hahalok aat saida nebee imi halo nee hodi estraga loron Sabdu nee?
verses.18: Imi la haree katak imi nia bei-ala sira halo ona hahalok aat ida nee, no laos ita nia Maromak foo todan hotu nee ba ita no ba sidade nee? Agora imi halo Nia hirus tan ho Israel liu hosi hahalok nebee kontra fali loron Sabdu?”
verses.19: Tuir mai, bainhira besik tempu rai nakaras iha portaun Jerusalém nian molok atu tama ba loron Sabdu, hau haruka taka portaun sira nee no la bele loke too fali loron Sabdu hotu ona. No hau haruka hau nia atan balu atu ba hein iha portaun sira nee, hodi nunee la iha sasaan nebee bele tama iha loron Sabdu.
verses.20: Maibee negosiante sira no faan nain sira, nebee faan sasaan oi-oin, sira toba iha moru Jerusalém nia liur dala ida ka rua hanesan nee.
verses.21: Depois hau hasee sira, no dehan, “Nusaa mak imi toba iha moru liur nee? Se imi halo hanesan nee dala ida tan mak hau nia liman sei kona imi.” Hahuu hosi loron nee kedas sira la mai tan iha loron Sabdu.
verses.22: No depois hau manda ema Levita sira atu halo moos sira nia aan hodi mai hein portaun sira hodi halo santu fali loron Sabdu. Oh hau nia Maromak, hanoin hau no buat nebee hau halo no mos hamahon hau tuir O nia domin metin nebee boot!
verses.23: Iha tempu nebaa mos hau haree ema Judá balu hola feto sira hosi Asdode, Amon no Moab.
verses.24: No hosi sira nia oan sira nee balu koalia lian Asdode nian ka lian nasaun seluk nian, maibee la hatene koalia lian Judeu nian.
verses.25: No hau hasee sira, no foo malisan ba sira, no ema balu hosi sira nee hau baku no hau fokit sira nia fuuk no hau haruka sira halo juramentu hodi Maromak nia naran, hanesan nee, “Keta foo tan imi nia oan feto sira hodi kaben ho sira nia oan mane sira, ka foti sira nia oan feto sira sai imi nia oan mane sira nia feen ka sai imi rasik nia feen!
verses.26: Imi la haree katak, Salomão, liurai Israel nee, halo ona sala hanesan nee? Mezmu la iha liurai ida nebee hanesan nia, nebee Maromak hadomi tebes no foti nia sai liurai ba Israel tomak, maibee nia mos monu ba sala tanba feto liur sira.
verses.27: Nunee ami sei rona imi hodi husik imi halo tuir hahalok aat makaas nee ka? Hodi kontra ita nia Maromak liu hosi hola feto liur?”
verses.28: Iha ema ida nebee Joiada nia oan, Eliasibe nia oan, saserdote boot nee, nia mane foun mak Sanbalate, ema Bete-Horon. Nunee hau duni nia sees hosi hau.
verses.29: Oh hau nia Maromak, hanoin kona ba oinsaa sira halo foer tiha pozisaun nudar saserdote no mos aliansa saserdote nian no ema Levita sira nian.
verses.30: Nunee hau halo sira sai moos hosi buat hotu hosi rai liur, depois hau entrega servisu ida-idak ba saserdote sira no ema Levita sira,
verses.31: no ba oferta ai sunu nian, tuir tempu, no ba rezultadu primeiru nian. Oh hau nia Maromak, hanoin hau, liu-liu ba hau nia moris diak!

verses.1: Iha tempu Asueru (nee mak Asueru nebee ukun hosi Índia too Etiópia, nebee distritu atus ida rua-nulu resin hitu),
verses.2: iha tempu nebaa, liurai Asueru tuur iha ninia reinu nia kadunan nebee iha kapitál Susan.
verses.3: Liu tiha tinan tolu iha ninia ukun, nia halo festa ba ninia xefi hotu no ninia atan sira. Forsa sira hosi Persia no Media, ema boot sira no governadór sira hosi distritu hotu mai partisipa.
verses.4: No nia hatudu ninia riku-soin hosi ninia reinu nia glória no ninia majestade furak nia onra durante loron barak, too loron atus ida ualu-nulu.
verses.5: Bainhira tempu nee hotu ona, liurai halao festa ida tan durante loron hitu, ba ninia povu hotu iha kapitál Susan, hosi ema boot too ema kiik. Sira halo festa nee iha pátiu ida nebee iha jardin iha liurai nia palásiu.
verses.6: Sira enfeita fatin nee ho hena linhu nebee mutin, matak no azúl. Sira kesi hena ho tali nebee halo ho kabas linhu no tali kór uvas ba kadeli osan mutin no ba iha riin fatuk marmore, no iha kama osan mean no osan mutin nebee tau iha rai nebee nahe ho marmore nebee mean, azúl, mutin no metan.
verses.7: Sira hemu hosi kopu osan mean nebee ho modelu oi-oin. Sira hemu liurai nia tua uvas nebee barak loos, tuir liurai nia podér.
verses.8: No liurai mos foo orden kona ba regra hemu nian hodi nunee sira hotu nebee servisu iha palásiu laran la bele obriga ema ida, maibee tenki halo tuir saida mak ema ida-idak hakarak.
verses.9: No mos liurai feto Vasti halo festa ba feto hotu iha liurai Asueru nia palásiu laran.
verses.10: Iha loron ba dala hitu, bainhira liurai haksolok tanba hemu tua uvas, nia foo orden ba ninia ministru palásiu hitu nebee halo servisu iha liurai Asueru nia prezensa. Ema sira nee mak Meuman, Bizta, Harbona, Bigta, Abagta, Zetar no Karkas.
verses.11: Nia haruka sira lori mai liurai feto Vasti ho koroa reinu nian. Tanba nia hakarak hatudu Vasti nia oin bonita ba povu no xefi sira, tanba liurai feto nee bonita tebes.
verses.12: Maibee bainhira ministru palásiu sira hatoo liurai nia orden ba liurai feto Vasti, liurai feto lakohi baa. Nunee liurai hirus tebes ho laran nakali tebes.
verses.13: Nunee liurai husu ba ema matenek nain sira, nebee matenek kona ba tempu sira nee. Tanba liurai halo hanesan nee ba ema hotu nebee matenek kona ba lei no tesi lia.
verses.14: Ema sira nee, nebee hamriik iha ninia sorin, mak Karsena, Setar, Admata, Tarsis, Meres, Marsena no Memukan. Sira nain hitu nee mak nai ulun iha Persia no Media. Sira bele haree liurai nia oin no iha pozisaun aas liu iha reinu laran.
verses.15: Liurai husu sira, “Saida mak ita tenki halo ba liurai feto Vasti tuir lei, tanba nia la halo tuir liurai Asueru nia orden nebee haruka liu hosi ministru sira?”
verses.16: Nunee Memukan hataan iha liurai no nai ulun sira nia oin, “Liurai feto Vasti la halo sala deit hasoru liurai, maibee nia mos halo sala hasoru xefi hotu no povu sira hotu iha liurai Asueru nia distritu hotu.
verses.17: Tanba feto hotu-hotu sei rona kona ba liurai feto nia hahalok nee no sira sei la respeita tan sira nia laen. Ema sei konta, ‘Liurai Asueru foo ninia orden, atu ema lori liurai feto Vasti baa hasoru liurai, maibee nia la baa.’
verses.18: Iha loron nee kedas, xefi sira nia feen sira iha Persia no Media sei koalia hanesan nee tanba sira rona kona ba buat nebee liurai feto nee halo ona. Nunee liafuan aat no hirus sei mosu barak liu.
verses.19: Se karik liurai hanoin diak, liurai bele foo sai orden palásiu nian ida atu nunee bele hakerek iha lei Persia no Media, hodi la bele troka, katak Vasti la bele mai fali iha liurai Asueru nia oin no liurai sei foo Vasti nia pozisaun liurai feto nian ba feto seluk nebee diak liu Vasti.
verses.20: Bainhira ema foo sai liurai nia orden ba reinu tomak, tanba reinu nee boot, nunee feto hotu-hotu sei foo onra ba sira nia laen, hosi ema boot too ema kiik.”
verses.21: Liurai no nai ulun sira hanoin katak liafuan nee diak. Entaun liurai halo tuir Memukan nia liafuan.
verses.22: Nia haruka surat sira ba distritu hotu iha reinu laran, kada distritu ida-idak nia sistema nebee hakerek, no kada povu ida-idak nia lian rasik, katak mane ida-idak tenki sai ulun iha ninia uma no sira tenki koalia tuir sira nia lian rasik.

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, bainhira liurai Asueru nia laran hirus tuun ona, nia hanoin hetan Vasti no buat nebee feto nee halo, no orden nebee nia foo sai hasoru Vasti.
verses.2: Depois liurai nia atan sira nebee serví nia dehan, “Husik ema buka feto klosan nebee bonita ba liurai.
verses.3: Husik liurai hili funsionáriu sira iha distritu hotu iha ninia reinu, hodi sira bele halibur feto klosan hotu nebee bonita no lori ba kapitál Susan. Feto sira nee bele tama ba uma feto nian, ho Hegai, liurai nia ministru nebee kuidadu feto sira. No husik nia foo feto nia ai morin ba sira.
verses.4: No feto ida nebee halo liurai kontenti bele sai liurai feto troka Vasti.” Liurai kontenti ho planu nee no nia halo tuir.
verses.5: Iha kapitál Susan, iha ema Judeu ida naran Mordekai, oan hosi Jair, oan hosi Simei, oan hosi Kis, nebee ema Benjamin ida.
verses.6: Nia mak ema ida nebee sira lori ba kastigu hosi Jerusalém hamutuk ho ema kastigu sira seluk. Sira lori nia iha tempu nebee Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia lori Joakim, liurai hosi Judá.
verses.7: Mordekai hakiak Hadasa, nebee Ester, ninia tiu nia oan feto, tanba Ester la iha inan-aman. No feto nee mak oin bonita no isin diak. Bainhira ninia inan-aman mate, Mordekai foti nia nudar ninia oan feto.
verses.8: Bainhira ema rona liurai nia ukun fuan no ninia orden, sira halibur hamutuk feto klosan barak ba kapitál Susan, hodi Hegai bele tau matan ba sira. Nunee sira lori mos Ester ba liurai nia uma, hodi Hegai bele tau matan ba nia nebee kuidadu feto sira.
verses.9: Nia halo Hegai kontenti. Nunee Hegai hatudu domin metin ba Ester. Hegai foo lalais ai morin ba Ester, buat nebee nia presiza, no feto nain hitu hosi liurai nia uma hodi ajuda nia. No Hegai tau nia no ninia ajudante feto sira nee iha fatin nebee diak liu iha uma feto nian.
verses.10: Ester la foo hatene kona ba ninia povu ka ninia família tanba Mordekai haruka nia la bele foo hatene.
verses.11: Mordekai lao loro-loron iha uma feto nia fatin nia oin hodi hatene Ester nee oinsaa no saida mak akontese ba nia.
verses.12: Feto ida-idak troka malu hodi tama ba liurai Asueru. Maibee molok nee, feto sira gasta fulan sanulu resin rua, tuir kostumi feto nian. Tanba sira haan tempu nee hodi halo aan bonita. Sira uza mina mira too fulan neen no mina morin ho buat seluk too fulan neen hodi sai bonita.
verses.13: Depois feto nee bele tama ba liurai. Sira foo saida deit nebee feto hakarak lori hosi uma feto nian ba uma liurai nian.
verses.14: Nia tama uma liurai iha rai nakaras no aban fali nia fila ba uma feto segundu nian. No Saasgaz, nebee liurai nia ministru, tau matan ba sira tanba nia toma konta kona ba feto sira nee. No feto nee la bele tama fali ba liurai, só deit se liurai kontenti ho nia no bolu nia ho ninia naran.
verses.15: No Ester nia tempu mai. Nia mak oan hosi Abihail, Mordekai nia tiu. Mordekai foti nia nudar ninia oan feto. Bainhira nia tempu mai atu tama, nia la husu buat ida, só deit buat nebee Hegai, liurai nia ministru nebee tau matan ba feto sira nee, mak hili ba nia. No Ester hetan grasa iha ema hotu nia oin nebee haree nia.
verses.16: Nunee sira lori Ester ba liurai Asueru hodi tama ba ninia palasíu liurai nian iha fulan sanulu, nebee fulan Tebet, iha tinan ba dala hitu iha liurai nia reinu.
verses.17: Liurai hadomi Ester liu fali feto hotu, no Ester hetan grasa no domin metin iha liurai nia oin liu fali feto klosan hotu. Nunee liurai tau koroa liurai nian iha ninia ulun no halo nia sai liurai feto troka Vasti.
verses.18: Depois liurai halo festa boot ba ninia xefi no atan sira hotu, nebee festa kona ba Ester. Nia husik distritu sira la presiza selu taxa no nia foo prezenti tuir ninia riku-soin.
verses.19: Bainhira ema halibur feto sira ba dala rua nee, Mordekai tuur iha liurai nia portaun.
verses.20: Ester la foo hatene kona ba ninia família ka ninia povu tuir Mordekai nia orden. Tanba Ester tuir Mordekai nia liafuan hanesan uluk iha tempu nebee Mordekai hakiak nia.
verses.21: Iha tempu nebaa, liurai nia ministru rua, Bigtana no Teres, nebee hein odamatan, sai hirus no buka atu ataka liurai Asueru.
verses.22: Mordekai diskobre planu nee no foo hatene ba liurai feto Ester. Ester foo hatene fali ba liurai hodi Mordekai nia naran.
verses.23: Bainhira sira halo investigasaun ba asuntu nee, sira diskobre planu nee. Nunee sira tara mate ministru nain rua nee iha ai riin. Ema hakerek buat nebee akontese nee iha livru krónikas nian iha liurai nia oin.

3.title: Haman Halo Planu Hasoru Ema Judeu

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, Asueru promove Haman, oan hosi Hamedata, nebee ema Agag. Liurai foti sae nia no tau ninia kadeira aas liu xefi sira seluk nebee hamutuk ho nia.
verses.2: Liurai nia atan sira hotu nebee iha liurai nia portaun hakneak no hakruuk ba Haman. Tanba liurai haruka sira halo hanesan nee ba nia. Maibee Mordekai la hakneak no la hakruuk ba nia.
verses.3: Entaun liurai nia atan sira, nebee iha liurai nia portaun, dehan ba Mordekai, “Tanba saa mak ita kontra liurai nia orden?”
verses.4: Sira koalia loro-loron ba nia no nia la rona tuir sira. Tuir mai, sira foo hatene ba Haman hodi haree saida mak akontese ba Mordekai. Tanba nia foo hatene ba sira katak nia mak ema Judeu.
verses.5: Bainhira Haman haree katak Mordekai la hakneak no nia la hakruuk, Haman sai hirus makaas.
verses.6: Nia hanoin katak la too atu ataka Mordekai mesak deit tanba sira foo hatene kona ba Mordekai nia povu. Nunee Haman hanoin atu halakon ema Judeu hotu nebee iha Asueru nia reinu tomak, tanba sira mak Mordekai nia povu.
verses.7: Iha fulan primeiru, nebee fulan Nisan, iha tinan ba dala sanulu resin rua iha liurai Asueru nia reinu, sira dada Pur, nebee dada rifa, kona ba Mordekai. Sira dada rifa ba loron ida-idak no ba fulan ida-idak, too fulan sanulu resin rua, nebee fulan Adar.
verses.8: Haman dehan ba liurai Asueru, “Ita iha povu ida nebee namkari no fahe iha povu nia leet iha distritu hotu iha ita boot nia reinu. Sira iha lei nebee la hanesan ho povu hotu. No sira la halo tuir liurai nia lei. Nunee liurai la hetan benefísiu hodi tahan sira.
verses.9: Se liurai kontenti, husik ema hakerek orden atu halakon sira. No hau sei selu osan mutin tonelada atus tolu lima-nulu (350t) ba sira nebee tau matan ba liurai nia riku-soin, hodi hatama ba liurai nia tezourária sira.
verses.10: Entaun liurai hasai ninia kadeli hosi ninia liman no foo ba Haman, oan hosi Hamedata, ema Agag, nebee ema Judeu sira nia inimigu.
verses.11: Liurai dehan ba Haman, “Osan mutin nee hau foo ba o, no povu mos, hodi halo tuir o nia hakarak.”
verses.12: Depois ema bolu liurai nia eskriba sira iha loron sanulu resin tolu iha fulan primeiru. Sira hakerek buat hotu nebee Haman manda ba liurai nia administradór sira no governadór sira nebee toma konta ba distritu hotu, no ba povu nia xefi hotu iha distritu hotu, tuir metodu nebee sira hakerek no tuir povu hotu nia lian. Sira hakerek hodi liurai Asueru nia naran no taka ho liurai nia kadeli nudar karimbu.
verses.13: Sira haruka surat sira nee liu hosi manu-ain sira ba liurai nia distritu hotu hodi destrui, oho no halakon ema Judeu hotu, labarik no katuas, kiik-oan no feto, iha loron ida deit nebee iha loron ba dala sanulu resin tolu iha fulan sanulu resin rua, nebee fulan Adar, no bele hadau sira nia riku-soin.
verses.14: Ema halo kopi hosi dokumentu nee nebee foo orden ba povu hotu iha distritu ida-idak hodi sira bele prepara aan ba loron ida nee.
verses.15: Manu-ain sira sai baa, no sira baa lalais tanba sira lori liurai nia orden. No sira foo sai orden nee iha kapitál Susan. Depois liurai no Haman tuur hamutuk hodi hemu. Maibee sidade Susan nee konfuzaun.

verses.1: Bainhira Mordekai haree buat hotu nebee akontese, nia lees ninia ropa no hatais hena karoon no hafoer aan ho ahi kdesan. Nia tama ba sidade laran no tanis ho lian makaas no tristi.
verses.2: Nia baa too iha liurai nia portaun maibee ema la bele tama liu liurai nia portaun bainhira sira hatais hela hena karoon.
verses.3: No iha distritu hotu, iha fatin naran deit nebee ema simu liurai nia mandamentu no ninia orden, ema Judeu sira tanis makaas. Sira jejún, tanis no halo lamentasaun. Ema barak toba iha hena karoon no ahi kdesan.
verses.4: Depois Ester nia ajudante feto sira no ninia ministru sira mai no foo hatene ba nia. Liurai feto nee sai tristi tebes. Nia haruka ropa hodi foo hatais ba Mordekai no foti ninia hena karoon, maibee nia la simu ropa nee.
verses.5: Depois Ester bolu Hatak, nebee liurai nia ministru ida, nebee liurai hili hodi tau matan ba Ester. Ester haruka nia baa Mordekai hodi hatene problema nee saida no tanba saa mak Mordekai mak hanesan nee.
verses.6: Entaun Hatak sai ba Mordekai nebee iha dalan iha sidade, iha liurai nia portaun nia oin.
verses.7: Mordekai foo hatene ba Hatak kona ba buat hotu nebee akontese ba nia no osan hira nebee Haman promete atu selu ba liurai nia tezourária sira hodi halakon ema Judeu sira.
verses.8: Mordekai foo kopi ida hosi surat nebee iha orden nebee ema foo sai iha Susan hodi halakon sira. Mordekai haruka Hatak hatudu surat ba Ester, no esplika orden nee ba nia, no haruka nia baa hasoru liurai atu husu favór hosi liurai, no husu liurai hanoin Ester nia povu.
verses.9: Depois Hatak mai no konta Mordekai nia liafuan ba Ester.
verses.10: Ester koalia ba Hatak no foo orden ba nia atu foo ba Mordekai,
verses.11: “Liurai nia atan hotu, no povu hosi liurai nia distritu hotu hatene katak see-see deit, mezmu mane ka feto, nebee tama ba liurai nebee iha pátiu iha laran liu, bainhira liurai la bolu, iha lei ida deit - ema nee sei hetan kastigu mate. Só deit liurai bele lolo ninia rota osan mean ba ema nee, nunee ema nee bele moris hela. Maibee liurai la bolu hau atu tama ba nia durante loron tolu-nulu ona.”
verses.12: Nunee sira foo hatene ba Mordekai kona ba Ester nia liafuan.
verses.13: Depois Mordekai haruka sira hataan ba Ester, “Keta hanoin katak o rasik bele salva aan iha liurai nia uma, liu fali ema Judeu hotu.
verses.14: Tanba sei o nonook iha tempu nee, liberdade no salvasaun sei mai ema Judeu sira hosi fatin seluk, maibee o no o nia aman nia uma kain sei lakon. See mak hatene, karik o tama ba reinu nee tanba tempu ida nee?”
verses.15: Depois Ester haruka sira hataan ba Mordekai,
verses.16: “Baa, no halibur ema Judeu hotu nebee hela iha Susan, no jejún kona ba hau. La bele haan hemu too loron tolu, loron-kalan. Hau no hau nia ajudante feto sira sei jejún hanesan imi. Nunee hau sei tama ba liurai, maski buat ida nee kontra lei. No se hau mate, nunee hau mate deit.”
verses.17: Entaun Mordekai lao ba no halo tuir buat hotu nebee Ester haruka nia halo.

verses.1: Iha loron terseiru, Ester hatais nudar liurai feto no hamriik iha pátiu laran nebee iha liurai nia uma laran, iha liurai nia fatin nia oin. Liurai tuur hela iha ninia kadunan liurai nian iha liurai nia uma laran nebee iha uma nia portaun nia oin.
verses.2: Bainhira liurai haree Ester nebee liurai feto hamriik hela iha pátiu, Ester hetan grasa iha liurai nia oin. Liurai lolo rota osan mean nebee iha ninia liman. Entaun Ester hakbesik no book rota nia ulun.
verses.3: Depois liurai dehan ba nia, “Nusaa, liurai feto Ester? O husu saida? Hau sei foo too hau nia reinu sorin.”
verses.4: Ester hataan, “Se liurai hanoin diak, husik liurai no Haman mai ohin loron ba festa nebee hau prepara ona ba nia.”
verses.5: Liurai dehan, “Haruka Haman mai lalais hodi ami bele halo tuir Ester nia liafuan.”
verses.6: Bainhira liurai hemu hela tua uvas iha festa nee nia dehan ba Ester, “O hakarak saida? Hau sei foo. No o husu saida? Too hau nia reinu sorin, buat nee hau sei kumpri.”
verses.7: Ester hataan, “Buat nebee hau hakarak no hau husu mak nee:
verses.8: Se hau hetan grasa iha liurai nia oin, no se liurai kontenti atu foo hau nia hakarak, no halo tuir buat nebee hau husu, entaun husik liurai no Haman mai festa nebee hau sei prepara ba sira, no aban mak hau halo tuir liurai nia liafuan nee.”
verses.9: Depois Haman sai ba iha loron nebaa ho laran haksolok no kontenti. Maibee bainhira Haman haree Mordekai iha liurai nia portaun katak nia la hamriik ka nakdedar tanba Haman, nunee Haman sai nakonu ho laran hirus hasoru Mordekai.
verses.10: Maski nunee, Haman kontrola aan. No bainhira nia too iha uma nia haruka ema bolu ninia kolega sira no ninia feen Zeres.
verses.11: Haman konta ba sira kona ba ninia riku-soin nia todan, ninia oan mane barak, oinsaa liurai promove nia, no oinsaa liurai foti nia sae aas liu liurai nia xefi no atan sira.
verses.12: Depois Haman dehan tan, “No liurai feto Ester, nia mos la husu mane ida atu tuir festa ho liurai nebee Ester prepara ona, só hau deit. No aban mos nia konvida hau baa hamutuk ho liurai.
verses.13: Maibee buat hotu nee saugati deit bainhira hau haree Mordekai, ema Judeu nee, tuur hela iha liurai nia portaun.
verses.14: Depois ninia feen Zeres no ninia kolega sira hotu dehan ba nia, “Haruka ema halo ai riin nebee aas too metru rua-nulu resin, no aban koalia ho liurai hodi bele tara mate Mordekai iha nebaa. Depois baa ho haksolok hamutuk ho liurai ba festa nee.” Haman kontenti ho planu nee no nia haruka ema harii ai riin aas.

verses.1: Iha kalan nee, liurai la bele dukur. No nia haruka ema lori livru nebee hakerek krónikas no ema lee livru nee iha liurai nia oin.
verses.2: Sira hetan fatin nebee hakerek kona ba Mordekai nebee foo hatene kona ba Bigtana no Teres, liurai nia ministru nain rua, nebee hein portaun, no buka atu ataka liurai Asueru.
verses.3: Liurai dehan, “Mordekai simu onra no respeitu saida tanba buat nebee nia halo nee?” No liurai nia atan sira nebee serví nia dehan, “Ita la halo buat ida ba nia.”
verses.4: Liurai husu, “See mak iha pátiu laran?” No Haman foin tama iha pátiu nia liur iha liurai nia uma hodi koalia ho liurai atu tara mate Mordekai iha ai riin aas nebee nia prepara tiha ona ba Mordekai.
verses.5: Liurai nia atan sira dehan ba nia, “Tebes, Haman hamriik iha pátiu laran.” No liurai dehan ba nia, “Husik nia tama mai.”
verses.6: Entaun Haman tama mai. No liurai dehan ba nia, “Ba ema nebee liurai hakarak foo onra, ita bele halo saida?” Haman hanoin iha ninia fuan laran, “See mak liu fali hau hodi nunee liurai hakarak atu foo onra?”
verses.7: No Haman hataan ba liurai, “Ba ema nebee liurai hakarak atu foo onra,
verses.8: husik ema lori mai ropa liurai nian nebee liurai uza tiha ona, no kuda nebee liurai sae tiha ona, no koroa liurai nian ida nebee bele tau iha ema nee nia ulun.
verses.9: No husik ita foo ropa no kuda nee ba liurai nia xefi nebee boot liu hodi nia bele foo hatais mane nebee liurai hakarak atu foo onra. No xefi boot nee bele lori mane nee iha kuda no lao liu hosi sidade nia dalan boot no deklara iha ninia oin, ‘Ita halo hanesan nee ba ema nebee liurai hakarak atu foo onra!’”
verses.10: Depois liurai dehan, “Entaun lalais, foti kedas ropa no kuda no halo tuir o nia liafuan. Halo tuir liafuan nee ba Mordekai, ema Judeu nebee tuur iha liurai nia portaun. Keta falta buat ida hosi buat hotu nebee o koalia ona nee.”
verses.11: Depois Haman foti ropa no kuda no foo hatais Mordekai no lori nia ho kuda, no nia lao liu hosi dalan boot iha sidade laran. Haman deklara iha Mordekai nia oin, “Ita halo hanesan nee ba ema nebee liurai hakarak atu foo onra.”
verses.12: Mordekai fila fali ba liurai nia portaun. Maibee Haman fila lalais ba ninia uma ho laran tristi no nia taka ninia ulun.
verses.13: Haman konta ba ninia feen no ninia kolega hotu kona ba buat hotu nebee foin akontese ba nia. Depois ninia ema matenek no ninia feen Zeres dehan ba nia, “Se Mordekai mai hosi jerasaun Judeu nian, no ita boot komesa atu monu iha ninia oin, entaun ita boot la bele manaan hasoru nia. Maibee ita boot sei monu duni iha ninia oin.”
verses.14: No bainhira sira koalia hela, liurai nia ministru sira mai no foti nia lalais hodi lori nia ba festa ida nebee Ester prepara ona.

7.title: Ester Foo Sai Haman Nia Planu

verses.1: Entaun liurai no Haman tama ba festa ho liurai feto Ester.
verses.2: Iha loron segundu, bainhira sira hemu tua uvas iha festa nee, liurai husu fali ba Ester, “O hakarak saida, liurai feto Ester? Hau sei foo. No o husu saida? Too hau nia reinu sorin, buat nee hau sei kumpri.”
verses.3: Liurai feto Ester hataan, “Se hau hetan grasa iha ita boot nia oin, Oh liurai, no se liurai hakarak, hau husu katak liurai foo hau nia moris mai hau, no hau nia pedidu katak liurai foo hau nia povu mai hau.
verses.4: Tanba ema faan tiha ami, hau no hau nia povu, hodi destrui, hodi oho no hodi halakon. Se karik ema faan ami atu sai atan mane no atan feto deit, hau sei nonook hela, tanba terus nee la kompara ho problema nebee ami kria ba liurai.”
verses.5: Depois liurai Asueru husu ba liurai feto Ester, “See mak ema nee? No nia iha nebee? See mak hanoin iha nia fuan laran hodi halo hanesan nee?”
verses.6: Ester dehan, “Akuzadór no inimigu nebee iha hahalok aat nee mak Haman!” Nunee Haman sai tauk iha liurai no liurai feto nia oin.
verses.7: Liurai hamriik kedas hosi festa nebee hemu tua uvas nee, no nia tama ba palásiu nia jardin ho laran hirus. Haman hamriik no husu liurai feto Ester hodi salva ninia moris. Tanba nia haree katak liurai desidi ona atu halo buat aat ba nia.
verses.8: Liurai fila fali hosi palásiu nia jardin no tama ba fatin nebee sira iha festa tua uvas nian. No Haman monu aan dadauk ba kama nebee Ester toba. Entaun liurai dehan, “Nia halo mos abuz ba liurai feto iha hau nia oin iha uma nee ka?” No bainhira liafuan nee foin sai hosi liurai nia ibun, ema taka kedas Haman nia oin.
verses.9: Depois Harbona, nebee ministru ida, dehan iha liurai nia oin, “Tebes mos, Haman haruka ona ema harii ai riin aas too metru rua-nulu resin hodi tara mate Mordekai. Mordekai nee mak ema ida nebee koalia buat diak kona ba liurai. Ai riin aas nee hamriik hela iha Haman nia uma.” Entaun liurai dehan, “Tara nia iha nebaa!”
verses.10: Entaun sira tara mate Haman iha ai riin aas nebee nia prepara tiha ona ba Mordekai. Depois liurai nia laran hirus nee malirin fali.

verses.1: Iha loron nebaa, liurai Asueru foo uma Haman nian, nebee ema Judeu nia inimigu, ba liurai feto Ester. Depois Mordekai mai iha liurai nia oin tanba Ester foo hatene kona ba Mordekai nia relasaun ba nia.
verses.2: Liurai hasai ninia kadeli, nebee nia foti fali hosi Haman, no nia foo ba Mordekai. No Ester foo knaar ba Mordekai hodi toma konta ba uma Haman nian.
verses.3: Ester koalia fali iha liurai nia oin. Ester monu iha liurai nia ain, no nia tanis no husu ba liurai hodi hasai planu aat hosi Haman, ema Agag. Ester husu nia atu resolve problema nebee Haman kria ona hodi hasoru ema Judeu sira.
verses.4: Liurai lolo ninia rota osan mean ba Ester. Nunee Ester sae no hamriik iha liurai nia oin.
verses.5: Ester dehan, “Se liurai hakarak, no se hau hetan grasa iha liurai nia oin, no se hanoin nee diak ba liurai, no liurai kontenti ho hau, nunee husik ema hakerek orden hodi kansela planu iha surat hosi Haman, oan hosi Hamedata, ema Agag. Tanba nia hakerek ona surat nee hodi halakon ema Judeu sira nebee iha liurai nia distritu hotu.
verses.6: Oinsaa hau bele haree hahalok aat nee hasoru hau nia povu? No oinsaa hau bele haree ema halakon hau nia família?”
verses.7: Depois liurai Asueru dehan ba liurai feto Ester no ba Mordekai, ema judeu nee, “Tebes, hau foo tiha ona uma Haman nian. No ema tara mate nia iha ai riin aas nee tanba ninia planu atu ataka ema Judeu sira.
verses.8: Entaun hakerek mos surat ida kona ba ema Judeu sira tuir o nia hakarak. O bele hakerek hodi liurai nia naran no taka ho liurai nia karimbu kadeli nian. Nunee ema la bele kansela.”
verses.9: Entaun sira bolu liurai sira nia eskriba sira iha tempu nebaa, iha fulan ba dala tolu, nebee iha fulan Sivan, iha loron ba dala rua-nulu resin tolu. Sira hakerek surat tuir buat hotu nebee Mordekai manda atu hakerek ba ema Judeu sira, no ba administradór, governadór no xefi sira iha distritu hotu hosi Índia too iha Etiópia. Sira hakerek surat nee ba distritu atus ida rua-nulu resin hitu. Sira hakerek surat tuir distritu ida-idak nia metodu, no tuir povu ida-idak nia lian. Sira hakerek surat nee ba ema Judeu sira tuir sira nia metodu no tuir sira nia lian.
verses.10: Mordekai hakerek hodi liurai Asueru nia naran, no taka ho Asueru nia kadeli. Nia haruka surat sira nee liu hosi manu-ain sira nebee sae kuda lalais, nebee ema hakiak no prepara ba servisu nee deit.
verses.11: Iha surat nee, liurai dehan katak ema Judeu sira iha sidade hotu bele halibur hamutuk no hamriik hodi defende sira nia moris. Sira bele destrui, oho no halakon forsa hotu hosi povu no distritu nebee ataka sira, inklui kiik-oan sira no feto, no bele hadau inimigu sira nia riku-soin.
verses.12: Sira bele halo hanesan nee iha loron ida deit iha liurai Asueru nia distritu hotu, nebee loron ba dala sanulu resin tolu, iha fulan ba dala sanulu resin rua, nebee fulan Adar.
verses.13: Sira halo kopi hosi orden nee hodi lori ba distritu hotu no foo sai ba povu hotu. No ema Judeu sira tenki prepara aan iha loron nebaa hodi selu fali sira nia inimigu sira.
verses.14: Entaun ema nebee halai ho kuda lalais sai baa. No sira hakaas aan hodi baa lalais tanba liurai nia orden. No ema foo sai orden nee iha kapitál Susan.
verses.15: Depois Mordekai sai hosi liurai nia prezensa ho ropa liurai nian nebee kór azúl no mutin. No nia hatais koroa osan mean boot, no iha manta halo hosi hena linhu no kór uvas. No sidade Susan haksolok no kontenti.
verses.16: Ema Judeu sira senti naroman no kontenti. Sira haksolok no hetan onra.
verses.17: Iha distritu hotu no iha sidade hotu, iha fatin nebee deit liurai nia ukun fuan no nia orden mai, ema Judeu sira haksolok no kontenti. Sira halo festa no loron diak. Ema barak sai ema Judeu sira, tanba ema barak hamtauk ema Judeu sira.

9.title: Ema Judeu Halakon Sira Nia Inimigu

verses.1: Iha fulan ba dala sanulu resin rua, nebee fulan Adar, iha loron ba dala sanulu resin tolu, loron ida nebee ema Judeu sira nia inimigu espera atu domina sira, inimigu sira nee prepara atu kumpri liurai nia orden. Maibee planu nee troka - ema Judeu sira konsege domina fali ema nebee odi sira.
verses.2: Nunee ema Judeu sira halibur aan iha sira nia sidade sira iha liurai Asueru nia distritu hotu hodi ataka ema nebee buka atu halo aat ba sira. No la iha ema ida nebee bele hamriik hasoru sira. Tanba povu hotu sai tauk ba sira.
verses.3: Xefi hotu-hotu iha distritu sira, no administradór sira, governadór sira no funsionáriu sira hosi liurai ajuda ema Judeu sira. Tanba sira tauk Mordekai.
verses.4: Tanba Mordekai mak boot iha liurai nia uma, no ninia konhesimentu baa too iha distritu hotu tanba nia sai forti liu tan.
verses.5: Nunee ema Judeu sira ataka sira nia inimigu hotu ho surik, no sira oho no halakon ema sira nee. Sira halo tuir sira nia hakarak ba ema sira nebee odi sira.
verses.6: Iha kapitál Susan, ema Judeu sira oho no halakon ema nain atus lima.
verses.7: Sira oho mos Parsandata, Dalfon, Aspata,
verses.8: Porata, Adalia, Aridata,
verses.9: Parmasta, Arisai, Aridai no Vaizata,
verses.10: nebee oan mane nain sanulu hosi Haman, oan hosi Hamedata, nebee inimigu ba ema Judeu sira. Maibee sira la hadau ema sira nee nia riku-soin.
verses.11: Iha loron nebaa, ema foo hatene ba liurai kona ba ema nain hira nebee mate iha kapitál Susan.
verses.12: Liurai dehan ba liurai feto Ester, “Ema Judeu sira oho no halakon ema nain atus lima iha kapitál Susan, inklui mos Haman nia oan mane nain sanulu. Nunee sira konsege halo saida iha liurai nia distritu sira seluk? Agora, o hakarak saida? Tanba o sei hetan. No o husu saida tan? Tanba ema bele halo tuir.
verses.13: Ester dehan, “Se liurai kontenti, husik ema Judeu sira nebee iha Susan bele halo tuir orden nee aban hanesan sira halo tuir ohin loron. No husik ema tara Haman nia oan mane nain sanulu iha ai riin aas.”
verses.14: Entaun liurai foo orden hodi halo tuir liafuan nee. Ema foo sai orden nee iha Susan no sira tara mate Haman nia oan mane nain sanulu.
verses.15: Ema Judeu sira nebee iha Susan halibur hamutuk mos iha loron ba dala sanulu resin haat, iha fulan Adar, no oho ema nain atus tolu iha Susan. Maibee sira la hadau ema sira nee nia riku-soin.
verses.16: Ema Judeu sira nebee iha liurai nia distritu sira seluk halibur hamutuk no hamriik hodi defende sira nia moris. Sira hetan deskansa hosi sira nia inimigu sira. Sira oho inimigu nain rihun hitu-nulu resin lima (75.000), maibee sira la hadau ema nee nia riku-soin.
verses.17: Sira halo nunee iha loron sanulu resin tolu, iha fulan Adar, no iha loron sanulu resin haat sira deskansa no halo loron nee sai nudar loron festa no haksolok nian.
verses.18: Maibee ema Judeu sira nebee iha Susan halibur hamutuk iha loron ba dala sanulu resin tolu no sanulu resin haat. Depois iha loron ba dala sanulu resin lima sira deskansa no halo loron nee sai nudar loron festa no haksolok nian.
verses.19: Nunee ema Judeu iha aldeia sira, nebee hela iha fatin nebee moru la iha, halo loron haksolok no festa nian iha loron ba dala sanulu resin haat iha fulan Adar, no loron nee diak nebee bele haruka prezenti ba malu.
verses.20: Mordekai hakerek buat nebee akontese nee no haruka surat sira ba ema Judeu sira hotu nebee iha liurai Asueru nia distritu hotu, inklui distritu besik no dook.
verses.21: Nia haruka sira selebra loron nee iha sira nia leet. No tinan-tinan sira bele halo loron boot iha loron ba dala sanulu resin haat iha fulan Adar, no mos iha loron ba dala sanulu resin lima.
verses.22: Sira bele halo nunee tanba loron nebee sira deskansa hosi sira nia inimigu sira. Tanba iha fulan nee, sira troka hosi laran tristi ba laran haksolok, no loron tanis ba loron diak. Sira bele halo loron nee sai loron festa no haksolok nian, hodi haruka hahaan ba malu no foo prezenti ba ema kiak sira.
verses.23: No ema Judeu sira hataan atu kontinua halo buat nebee sira hahuu nee, nebee Mordekai hakerek ba sira.
verses.24: Tanba Haman, oan hosi Hamedata, ema Agag, no inimigu ba ema Judeu hotu, halo planu hasoru ema Judeu sira atu halakon sira. No sira soe Pur, nebee dada rifa, hodi duni sira no halakon sira.
verses.25: Maibee bainhira liurai hatene kona ba planu nee, nia foo orden liu hosi surat sira katak Haman nia planu aat nebee nia halo hodi hasoru ema Judeu sira, sei fila fali ba ninia ulun. Nunee sira tara mate Haman no ninia oan mane sira iha ai riin aas.
verses.26: Tanba nee sira hanaran loron sira nee ‘Purim’ hosi naran ‘Pur’. Nunee, tanba liafuan hotu nebee Mordekai hakerek iha surat nee, no buat hotu nebee sira hasoru kona ba asuntu nee, nebee akontese ba sira,
verses.27: ema Judeu sira desidi metin katak sira, no sira nia oan sira, no ema hotu nebee liga aan ba sira, la bele falta atu halao loron rua nee tinan-tinan. Sira sei tuir liafuan nebee sira hakerek no tuir tempu komemora nee.
verses.28: No sira tenki hanoin no halo tuir loron sira nee iha jerasaun ida-idak, família ida-idak, distritu ida-idak no sidade ida-idak. Loron Purim sira nee la bele para iha ema Judeu sira nia leet, no sira nia bei-oan sira la bele haluha tempu nee.
verses.29: Depois liurai feto Ester, oan feto hosi Abihail, no Mordekai nebee ema Judeu, hakerek ho autoridade kompletu hodi konfirma surat segundu nee kona ba Purim.
verses.30: Nia haruka surat sira ba ema Judeu hotu, nebee iha distritu atus ida rua-nulu resin hitu iha reinu Asueru nian, ho liafuan dame no lia loos.
verses.31: Nia konfirma loron Purim sira tuir sira nia tempu, no tuir orden hosi Mordekai, ema Judeu nee, no liurai feto Ester. Sira halo orden nee ba ema Judeu sira no sira nia bei-oan sira kona ba sira nia jejún no lamentasaun.
verses.32: Ester konfirma asuntu Purim nian no ema hakerek iha livru.

verses.1: Liurai Asueru obriga ema selu impostu iha rai nee no iha rai nebee besik tasi.
verses.2: No ninia hahalok hotu tanba ninia podér no forsa, no istória kona ba oinsaa Mordekai sai ema ho onra boot, no oinsaa liurai foti sae nia, laos buat sira nee hakerek ona iha Livru Krónikas ba liurai Media no Persia sira?
verses.3: Tanba Mordekai, ema Judeu nee, tuur iha liurai Asueru nia sorin nudar ema segundu no nia sai ema boot iha ema Judeu sira nia leet. Ninia maluk respeita nia nudar ema ida nebee buka susesu ba ninia povu no foo sai dame ba ninia ema hotu.

verses.1: Iha mane ida nebee iha rai Uz. Nia naran Job. Job mak perfeitu no ema loos. Nia hamtauk Maromak no lakohi hahalok aat.
verses.2: Job iha oan mane nain hitu no oan feto nain tolu.
verses.3: Nia iha riku-soin nebee bibi malae rihun hitu (7.000), kuda kamelu rihun tolu (3.000), karau aman pár atus lima hodi servisu (500 x 2), kuda buru inan atus lima (500) no atan bar-barak. Nunee ema ida nee mak boot liu duké ema hotu iha rai lorosae.
verses.4: Ninia oan mane sira halo festa iha sira nia uma, ema ida-idak tuir ninia loron. Sira haruka ema bolu sira nia alin feto nain tolu hodi haan-hemu hamutuk.
verses.5: No bainhira sira nia loron festa nee hotu ona, Job bolu no konsagra sira. Nia hadeer dadeer-saan nakukun no oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk tuir ninia oan nain hira. Tanba Job dehan, “Karik hau nia oan mane sira halo sala no koalia aat ba Maromak iha sira nia fuan laran.” Nunee Job halo hanesan nee nafatin.
verses.6: Iha loron ida, Maromak nia oan mane sira mai iha Nai nia oin, no Satanás mos mai iha sira nia leet.
verses.7: Nai dehan ba Satanás, “O mai hosi nebee?” No Satanás hataan ba Nai, “Hau lao ba-mai iha mundu, no lao tuun-sae iha nebaa.”
verses.8: Nai dehan ba Satanás, “O hanoin ona kona ba Hau nia atan Job ka? La iha ida hanesan nia iha mundu. Nia mak perfeitu no ema loos. Nia hamtauk Maromak no lakohi hahalok aat.”
verses.9: Depois Satanás hataan ba Nai, no dehan, “Job hamtauk Maromak saugati deit ka?
verses.10: Laos O haleu nia iha sor-sorin no ninia uma no buat hotu nebee ninian? O foo bensaun ona ba ninia serbisu no ninia riku-soin aumenta iha rai nee.
verses.11: Maibee agora, lolo O nia liman no kona buat hotu nebee nia iha, no nia sei koalia aat kedas ba O nia oin.”
verses.12: Nunee Nai dehan ba Satanás, “Tebes, buat hotu nebee nia iha mak iha o nia liman. Só deit keta book nia ho o nia liman.” Entaun Satanás sai hosi Nai nia oin.
verses.13: Depois, iha loron ida, Job nia oan mane no oan feto sira haan-hemu hamutuk iha sira nia maun boot nia uma.
verses.14: No manu-ain mai ba Job no dehan, “Karau aman sira fila rai no kuda buru sira haan iha sira nia sorin,
verses.15: no ema Sabe sira ataka no hadau animál sira nee. Sira oho ita boot nia atan sira ho surik. Só hau mesak deit halai sai hodi foo hatene ba ita boot.”
verses.16: Bainhira ema nee koalia hela, ema ida fali mos mai, no dehan, “Ahi Maromak nian monu ona hosi lalehan no sunu bibi no atan sira hotu. Só hau mesak deit halai sai hodi foo hatene ba ita boot.”
verses.17: Bainhira ema nee koalia hela, ema ida fali mai, no dehan, “Ema Kaldi halo grupu tolu no ataka kuda kamelu no lori sira sai. Sira oho atan sira ho surik. Só hau mesak deit halai sai hodi foo hatene ba ita boot.”
verses.18: Bainhira ema nee koalia hela, ema ida tan mai, no dehan, “Ita boot nia oan mane no oan feto sira haan-hemu hamutuk ho tua uvas iha sira nia maun boot sira nia uma.
verses.19: No tebes, anin boot mai hosi rai fuik no kona lidun haat iha uma nee no uma nee monu ba joven sira nee no sira mate ona. Só hau mesak deit halai sai hodi foo hatene ba ita boot.”
verses.20: Depois Job hamriik no lees ninia manta. Nia halo molik ninia ulun fatuk no monu tuun ba rai no adora.
verses.21: Nia dehan, “Molik hau sai hosi hau nia inan nia kabun laran, no molik hau sei fila fali ba. Nai mak foo, no Nai mak foti fali. Hahii ba Nai nia naran.”
verses.22: Iha buat hotu nee, Job la sala no nia la akuza Maromak ho sala.

verses.1: Iha loron ida fali, Maromak nia oan mane sira mai hatudu aan iha Nai nia oin. Satanás mos mai iha sira nia leet hodi hatudu aan iha Nai nia oin.
verses.2: Nai dehan ba Satanás, “O mai hosi nebee?” No Satanás hataan ba Nai, “Hau lao ba-mai iha mundu, no hau lao tuun-sae iha nebaa.”
verses.3: Nai dehan ba Satanás, “O hanoin ona kona ba Hau nia atan Job ka? La iha ida hanesan nia iha mundu. Nia mak perfeitu no ema nebee loos. Nia hamtauk Maromak no lakohi hahalok aat. No nia kaer metin hela ba ninia hahalok perfeitu, maski o hasoru nia hodi estraga nia ho razaun la iha.
verses.4: Depois Satanás hataan ba Nai, no dehan, “Kulit troka kulit! Ema ida sei foo buat hotu hodi salva ninia vida rasik.
verses.5: Maibee agora, lolo O nia liman no kona ninia ruin no isin rasik, no nia sei koalia aat kedas ba O nia oin.”
verses.6: Nunee Nai dehan ba Satanás, “Tebes, nia mak iha o nia liman. Só deit husik nia moris hela.”
verses.7: Entaun Satanás sai hosi Nai nia oin, no nia halo Job moras ho fisur aat hosi nia ain okos too nia ulun leten.
verses.8: No Job foti sanan rai rohan ida hodi koi fuuk hosi ninia isin. No nia tuur iha ahi kdesan.
verses.9: Depois ninia feen dehan ba nia, “Ita sei kaer metin hela ba ita nia hahalok perfeitu ka? Koalia aat ba Maromak no mate deit ba.”
verses.10: Maibee Job dehan ba ninia feen, “O koalia nudar feto beik ida. Ita sei simu buat diak hosi Maromak no la simu buat aat ka?” Iha buat hotu nee, Job la halo sala ho ninia ibun.
verses.11: Bainhira Job nia kolega nain tolu rona ona kona ba buat aat hotu nebee hasoru nia, sira ida-idak mai hosi sira nia fatin: Elifaz, ema Teman, no Bildad, ema Suá, no Zofar, ema Naamat. Tanba sira hili tempu ida hodi mai hamutuk no tanis ho nia no hamaus nia.
verses.12: Bainhira sira haree nia hosi dook, sira la konhese nia. Nunee sira tanis ho lian boot. Ema ida-idak lees ninia manta no soe rai rahun ba sira nia ulun leten.
verses.13: Depois sira tuur iha rai ho nia too loron hitu no kalan hitu. Ema la koalia liafuan ida ba nia tanba sira haree katak ninia terus boot tebes.

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, Job loke ninia ibun, no nia koalia aat kona ba ninia loron moris nian.
verses.2: Job koalia, no dehan,
verses.3: “Husik loron ida nebee hau moris nee bele lakon,
verses.4: Husik loron nee sai nakukun!
verses.5: Husik nakukun hosi rate laran hola nia,
verses.6: No kalan nee - husik buat nakukun liu kaer nia,
verses.7: Tebes, husik kalan nee la hetan oan ida,
verses.8: Husik ema nebee koalia aat bele koalia aat kona ba loron nee,
verses.9: Husik ninia fitun iha dadeer-saan nakukun sai nakukun,
verses.10: Tanba nia la taka odamatan ba hau nia inan nia kabun laran,
verses.11: Tanba saa mak hau la mate kedas bainhira hau sai hosi oan fatin?
verses.12: Tanba saa mak hitin nee simu hau?
verses.13: Nunee hau bele toba nonook,
verses.14: ho liurai no konselheiru sira hosi mundu nee,
verses.15: no ho xefi sira nebee iha osan mean,
verses.16: Ou tanba saa mak sira la subar hau nudar bebee nebee mate ona iha kabun laran,
verses.17: Iha nebaa ema aat la kria problema tan,
verses.18: Ema kastigu sira bele mos deskansa,
verses.19: Ema kiik no ema boot sei iha nebaa,
verses.20: Tanba saa mak ema nebee iha terus hetan naroman,
verses.21: nebee buka atu mate maibee la hetan,
verses.22: nebee sai kontenti liu no haksolok,
verses.23: Tanba saa mak ema nebee iha dalan subar hetan naroman,
verses.24: Tanba hau nia lian tristi sai nudar hau nia ai haan,
verses.25: Tanba buat nebee halo hau nakdedar mak hasoru ona hau,
verses.26: Hau la hakmatek, no hau la nonook,

4.title: Elifaz Koalia: Ema Inosenti Hetan Susesu

verses.1: Depois Elifaz, ema Teman, koalia no nia dehan:
verses.2: “Se ema ruma koko koalia ho ita, nunee ita la iha pasiénsia ka?
verses.3: Tebes, ita hanorin ema barak,
verses.4: Ita nia liafuan foo suporta ba nia nebee sidi,
verses.5: Maibee susar nee akontese fali ba ita, no ita la iha pasiénsia,
verses.6: Laos ita nia laran hamtauk nee foo konfiansa ba ita,
verses.7: Favór ida, hanoin hetan ba, see mak lakon bainhira nia sei inosenti?
verses.8: Tuir buat nebee hau haree ona, sira nebee fila rai saugati
verses.9: Maromak huu makaas no sira lakon,
verses.10: Liaun nia lian makaas, no lian hosi liaun siak nee,
verses.11: Liaun forti lakon tanba la hetan animál atu haan,
verses.12: Hau rona ona liafuan sub-subar,
verses.13: Hau hanoin iha vizaun kalan nian,
verses.14: Hau sai tauk no nakdedar,
verses.15: Depois espíritu ida semo liu hosi hau nia oin,
verses.16: Nia hamriik no la book aan,
verses.17: ‘Ema baibain bele sai loos liu fali Maromak ka?
verses.18: Tebes, Nia la fiar ba Ninia atan sira,
verses.19: saa tan sira nebee hela iha uma rai mean,
verses.20: Hosi dadeer too kalan sira sai rahun tiha,
verses.21: Laos sira hanesan tenda nebee tali kotu tiha ona,

5.title: Hosi sira nebee santu nee, ita sei buka ida nebee?

verses.1: Agora bolu ba; see mak hataan ba ita?
verses.2: Tanba laran hirus sei oho ema beik,
verses.3: Hau haree ema beik komesa tubun ba,
verses.4: Ninia oan sira sei dook hosi fatin seguru,
verses.5: Ema hamlaha haan hotu sira nia rezultadu,
verses.6: Terus la mosu hosi rai rahun,
verses.7: maibee tempu susar sei hasoru ema nebee moris mai,
verses.8: Hau sei buka Maromak,
verses.9: Nia halo buat boot nebee ita la bele kompriende;
verses.10: Nia haraik udan ba mundu,
verses.11: Nia foti ema kiik no tau iha fatin aas;
verses.12: Nia estraga ema matenek nia planu aat,
verses.13: Nia hadau ema matenek nebee halo hela planu aat,
verses.14: Sira hasoru nakukun iha loron,
verses.15: Maibee Nia salva ema kiak hosi surik nebee sai hosi ema sira nee nia ibun,
verses.16: Nunee ema kiak iha esperansa,
verses.17: Tebes, haksolok ba ema nebee Maromak koriji,
verses.18: Tanba Nia halo moras, maibee Nia bobar fali ho ligadura;
verses.19: Nia sei salva ita hosi problema neen,
verses.20: Iha rai hamlaha, Nia sei salva ita hosi mate,
verses.21: Nia sei subar ita hosi nanaal nebee baku hanesan xikoti,
verses.22: Iha tempu nebee estraga no rai hamlaha ita sei hamnasa hela,
verses.23: Tanba ita iha ligasaun ho fatuk iha rai luan,
verses.24: Ita sei hatene katak ita nia tenda hakmatek hela,
verses.25: Ita hatene mos katak ita nia oan sira sei sai barak,
verses.26: Ita sei tama ita nia rate ho idade boot nebee natoon,
verses.27: Tebes, ami buka hatene ona buat nee, no liafuan nee mak loos duni,

6.title: Job Koalia: Hau Nia Kazu Sei Justu

verses.1: Job koalia no dehan,
verses.2: “Oh katak ema bele tetu hau nia terus,
verses.3: Tanba susar nee sei todan liu rai henek iha tasi,
verses.4: Tanba rama oan hosi Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas sona hau,
verses.5: Kuda buru fuik halo lian boot bainhira nia iha duut ka?
verses.6: Ita bele haan hahaan nebee la gostu bainhira masin la iha ka?
verses.7: Hau lakohi koko haan buat sira nee,
verses.8: Oh katak hau bele simu hau nia pedidu,
verses.9: katak Maromak kontenti atu harahun hau,
verses.10: Nunee hau sei sai hakmatek,
verses.11: Saida mak hau nia kbiit, hodi nunee hau tenki hein?
verses.12: Hau nia kbiit hanesan ho fatuk nia kbiit ka?
verses.13: Hau bele ajuda hau nia aan rasik,
verses.14: Nia nebee la hatudu domin metin ba ninia maluk,
verses.15: Hau nia maluk sira bosok hau hanesan mota oan,
verses.16: Sira metan tanba sira mai ho jelu,
verses.17: Bainhira sira nabeen sira lakon tiha,
verses.18: Grupu nebee halo viajen fila hosi dalan,
verses.19: Grupu nebee halo viajen hosi Tema buka took,
verses.20: Sira hetan konfuzaun tanba sira iha esperansa,
verses.21: Tanba agora imi sai mamuk,
verses.22: Hau dehan, ‘Foo prezenti mai hau’ ka?
verses.23: Ou, ‘Salva hau hosi hau nia inimigu nia liman’ ka?
verses.24: Hanorin hau lai, no hau sei nonook;
verses.25: Oinsaa liafuan loos iha forsa makaas!
verses.26: Imi hanoin atu justifika liafuan nee ka,
verses.27: Imi dada rifa hodi manaan oan kiak,
verses.28: Agora, sai kontenti deit hodi haree hau,
verses.29: Fila ba, no keta halo buat nebee aat,
verses.30: Hau iha hahalok aat iha hau nia nanaal ka?

verses.1: Laos ema hetan servisu todan iha mundu?
verses.2: Hanesan atan nebee buka fatin mahon,
verses.3: nunee hau hetan deit fulan sira nebee saugati deit,
verses.4: Bainhira hau toba hau dehan, ‘Bainhira mak hau hadeer?’
verses.5: Hau nia isin hatais ular no rai mean,
verses.6: Hau nia loron baa lalais liu ai soru nian;
verses.7: Hanoin hetan katak hau nia vida mak hanesan anin,
verses.8: Ema nia matan nebee haree hau sei la haree tan hau;
verses.9: Hanesan kalohan nebee sai kiik too la iha,
verses.10: Nia sei la fila fali ba ninia uma,
verses.11: Nunee hau la taka hau nia ibun,
verses.12: Hau mak tasi ou animál boot iha tasi ka,
verses.13: Bainhira hau dehan, ‘Hau nia kama sei foo kamaan mai hau,
verses.14: maibee O halo hau hakfodak ho mehi,
verses.15: Nunee hau nia klamar hakarak iis kotu,
verses.16: Hau odi hau nia moris,
verses.17: Saida mak ema, katak O foti sae nia,
verses.18: Nusaa mak O vizita nia dadeer-dadeer,
verses.19: Bainhira mak O la hateke mai hau,
verses.20: Oh Maromak nebee hein ema,
verses.21: Tanba saa mak O la foo perdua ba hau nia sala aat,

verses.1: Depois Bildad, ema Suá, hataan dehan,
verses.2: “Too bainhira mak ita koalia hanesan nee?
verses.3: Maromak sei estraga justisa ka?
verses.4: Se ita nia oan sira halo ona sala hasoru Nia,
verses.5: Se ita buka tuir Maromak,
verses.6: se ita mak moos no iha laran loos,
verses.7: Mezmu ita hahuu hosi buat kiik,
verses.8: Favór ida, husu took, iha tempu uluk,
verses.9: Tanba foin horiseik mak ita mai, no ita la hatene buat ida,
verses.10: Laos sira bele hanorin ita, no konta ba ita,
verses.11: Duut bele sai aas bainhira bee lihun la iha ka?
verses.12: Bainhira sira iha funan hela no ema seidauk koa sira,
verses.13: Nunee mak dalan ba ema nebee haluha Maromak,
verses.14: Ninia konfiansa sei kotu,
verses.15: Nia sei sadere ba ninia uma,
verses.16: Nia iha tahan matak iha loro matan nia oin,
verses.17: Ninia abut bobar ba fatuk laran,
verses.18: Se nia lakon hosi ninia fatin,
verses.19: Tebes, ho dalan ida nee nia haksolok,
verses.20: Tebes, Maromak la soe ema perfeitu,
verses.21: Nia sei halo ita nia ibun nakonu ho hamnasa,
verses.22: Sira nebee odi ita sei hatais oin moe,

9.title: Job Koalia: See Mak Tesi Lia?

verses.1: Depois Job hataan, no nia dehan,
verses.2: “Hau hatene ida nee mak lia loos:
verses.3: Se ema hakarak diskuti malu ho Nia,
verses.4: Maromak iha fuan laran nebee matenek klean no Nia iha kbiit makaas,
verses.5: Maromak nebee bele hasai foho no sira la hatene,
verses.6: Nia doko mundu sai hosi mundu nia fatin,
verses.7: Nia manda loro matan no loro matan nee la hadeer,
verses.8: Nia mesak nahe lalehan sira;
verses.9: Nia kria Ursu no Órion,
verses.10: Nia halo buat makaas nebee ita la bele hatene;
verses.11: Tebes, Nia lao liu hau maibee hau la haree Nia;
verses.12: Tebes, Nia foti sai no see mak bele hapara Nia?
verses.13: Maromak sei la haruka Ninia laran hirus fila fali,
verses.14: Nunee oinsaa hau bele hataan ba Nia,
verses.15: Maski hau mak loos, hau sei la hataan Nia,
verses.16: Se hau bolu ba Nia no Nia hataan hau,
verses.17: Tanba Nia harahun hau ho anin fuik,
verses.18: Nia la husik hau atu dada iis,
