verses.19: Se hau koalia kona ba kbiit, tebes Nia mak forti liu;
verses.20: Maski hau mak loos, hau nia ibun sei kondena fali hau;
verses.21: Hau mak perfeitu; hau la hanoin hau nia klamar;
verses.22: Buat nee hanesan deit, nunee hau dehan,
verses.23: Bainhira sikote baku mate derepenti deit,
verses.24: Ema aat sira sei hetan mundu,
verses.25: Hau nia loron sira baa lalais liu ema nebee halai,
verses.26: Hau nia loron sira halai liu hanesan roo nebee halo hosi duut kain,
verses.27: Se hau dehan, ‘Hau sei husik hau nia keixa;
verses.28: nunee hau sai tauk kona ba hau nia terus,
verses.29: Nia sei kondena hau,
verses.30: Se hau hariis iha bee hosi neve,
verses.31: maibee O sei soe hau ba rai kuak,
verses.32: Tanba Nia laos ema ida hanesan ho hau hodi hau bele hataan ba Nia,
verses.33: La iha ema ida nebee bele tesi lia entre Nia no hau,
verses.34: Husik Nia hasai Ninia ai tonka hosi hau,
verses.35: Nunee hau bele koalia no hau la tauk Nia,

verses.1: “Hau odi hau nia moris;
verses.2: Hau sei dehan ba Maromak, La bele kondena hau;
verses.3: O hanoin katak buat nee diak, atu hanehan hau,
verses.4: O iha matan hanesan ema nian ka?
verses.5: O nia loron sira hanesan ema nia loron sira ka?
verses.6: No nunee O husu kona ba hau nia hahalok aat,
verses.7: Maski O hatene katak hau la aat,
verses.8: O nia liman rasik mak halo no forma hau,
verses.9: Favór ida, hanoin hetan katak O halo hau hanesan rai mean,
verses.10: Laos O fui sai ona hau hanesan susu been,
verses.11: O foo hatais hau ho kulit no isin,
verses.12: O foo ona moris no domin metin mai hau,
verses.13: Maibee O subar buat sira nee iha O nia fuan laran;
verses.14: Se hau sala, entaun O haree hau,
verses.15: Se hau mak aat, susar mai hau!
verses.16: No se hau foti sae hau nia ulun, O sei kasa hau hanesan liaun,
verses.17: O foo fali O nia testemunha hasoru hau,
verses.18: Nusaa mak O lori hau sai hosi oan fatin?
verses.19: Loloos diak liu hau la iha,
verses.20: Laos hau nia loron sira nee uitoan deit?
verses.21: molok hau baa, no nunka mai fali,
verses.22: rai nebee nakukun liu,

11.title: Zofar Koalia: Ita Merese Susar Tan

verses.1: Depois Zofar, ema Naamat, hataan no nia dehan:
verses.2: “Ema bele foo resposta ba liafuan barak nee ka lae?
verses.3: Bosok-teen nee obriga ema sai nonook ka?
verses.4: Ita dehan, ‘Hau nia hanoin mak moos,
verses.5: Oh oinsaa Maromak rasik bele koalia
verses.6: no Nia bele foo sai Ninia matenek klean nebee segredu ba ita!
verses.7: Ita bele buka hodi konhese Maromak ka?
verses.8: Buat nee aas liu lalehan - nunee ita bele halo saida?
verses.9: Buat nee naruk liu mundu,
verses.10: Se Nia lao liu, no kastigu ema, no lori sira ba tribunál,
verses.11: Tanba Nia hatene ema saugati
verses.12: Ema beik bele sai matenek
verses.13: Se ita prepara ita nia fuan laran,
verses.14: Se ita nia liman iha sala, entaun hadook aan hosi sala nee,
verses.15: Depois ita bele foti sae ita nia oin nebee la iha buat aat,
verses.16: Tanba ita sei haluha tempu susar,
verses.17: No ita nia moris sei naroman liu meiudia,
verses.18: Ita sei fiar tanba ita iha esperansa,
verses.19: Ita sei toba, no la iha ema ida nebee halo ita sai tauk;
verses.20: Maibee ema aat nia matan sei sai aat,

12.title: Job Koalia: Nai Mak Halo Buat Nee

verses.1: Job hataan no nia dehan,
verses.2: “Loos duni, imi mak povu nee,
verses.3: Maibee hau iha laran ida nebee hanesan imi;
verses.4: Hau nia kolega sira goza hau -
verses.5: Ema nebee iha moris kontenti mak foti aan
verses.6: Naok-teen sira hela hakmatek iha sira nia tenda,
verses.7: Maibee agora, husu took ba animál,
verses.8: Koalia ba rai,
verses.9: Iha buat hotu nee, see mak la hatene
verses.10: Buat hotu nia moris mak iha Ninia liman,
verses.11: Laos tilun koko liafuan
verses.12: Ema katuas iha matenek klean,
verses.13: Maromak iha matenek klean no podér,
verses.14: Tebes, se Nia baku tuun, ita la bele harii fali;
verses.15: Tebes, se Nia tahan bee, rai sei sai maran,
verses.16: Nia iha podér no matenek klean,
verses.17: Nia lori konselheiru sira sai ho ain tanan,
verses.18: Nia kore buat nebee kesi liurai,
verses.19: Nia lori saserdote sira sai ho ain tanan,
verses.20: Nia hasai liafuan hosi sira nebee ema fiar,
verses.21: Nia hamoe ema boot sira,
verses.22: Nia deskobre fatin klean nebee nakukun,
verses.23: Nia halo nasaun sira sai boot, no Nia harahun sira,
verses.24: Nia foti xefi nia fuan laran hosi povu iha mundu nee,
verses.25: Sira lamas ba-mai iha fatin nakukun nebee naroman la iha,

13.title: Job Kontinua: Hau Espera ba Maromak

verses.1: “Tebes, hau nia matan haree buat hotu nee,
verses.2: Buat nebee imi hatene, hau mos hatene;
verses.3: Maibee hau sei koalia ba Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas,
verses.4: Maibee imi taka hau ho liafuan bosok,
verses.5: Oh katak imi bele nonook ba,
verses.6: Rona tuir hau nia kazu,
verses.7: Imi sei koalia la loos hodi suporta Maromak,
verses.8: Imi sei sadere ba Maromak,
verses.9: Se Nia buka hatene imi, nunee imi sei hetan buat diak ka?
verses.10: Tebes Nia sei hasee imi,
verses.11: Laos Ninia hahalok makaas halo imi tauk?
verses.12: Imi nia liafuan matenek mak hanesan ahi kdesan,
verses.13: Nonook lai, nunee hau bele koalia,
verses.14: Nusaa mak hau tenki kaer hau nia isin ho hau nia nehan
verses.15: Maski Maromak oho hau, hau sei espera ba Nia;
verses.16: Buat nee mak hau nia salvasaun,
verses.17: Rona di-diak hau nia liafuan,
verses.18: Tebes, agora hau prepara ona hau nia kazu,
verses.19: See mak diskuti malu ho hau?
verses.20: Só deit, foo buat rua mai hau,
verses.21: hadook O nia liman hosi hau,
verses.22: Depois bolu hau no hau sei hataan O,
verses.23: Hau iha hahalok aat oinsaa no hau sala dala hira ona?
verses.24: Tanba saa mak O subar O nia oin
verses.25: O sei halo tauk ai tahan nebee anin huu ba-mai ka?
verses.26: Tanba O hakerek buat susar nebee hasoru hau,
verses.27: O kastigu hau nia ain iha ai kabelak kuak,
verses.28: Ema mak hanesan buat nebee sai dodok too lakon,

verses.1: “Mane nebee moris mai hosi feto,
verses.2: Nia mosu mai hanesan ai funan, no ema tesi nia;
verses.3: No O sei loke O nia matan no haree ema nee ka?
verses.4: See mak bele lori buat moos hosi buat nebee la moos?
verses.5: O desidi ona ema nia loron sira,
verses.6: Fila hosi nia hodi nia bele deskansa,
verses.7: Tanba ai horis iha esperansa,
verses.8: Maski ninia abut tuan ona iha rai okos,
verses.9: maibee bainhira nia horon bee, nia dikin fali,
verses.10: Maibee ema mate no lakon deit,
verses.11: Hanesan bee lakon iha bee lihun,
verses.12: nunee ema toba no la hamriik fali,
verses.13: Oh katak O bele subar hau iha rate laran,
verses.14: Se ema ida mate, nia bele moris fali ka?
verses.15: O sei bolu, no hau sei hataan,
verses.16: Maibee agora O sura hau nia ain fatin.
verses.17: O tau hau nia hahalok nebee kontra iha bornál ida,
verses.18: Maibee foho monu tuun too lakon,
verses.19: Bee sei halo fatuk sai mihis,
verses.20: O hanehan nia nafatin too nia lakon tiha.
verses.21: Ninia oan sira hetan onra, maibee nia la hatene.
verses.22: Maibee nia senti deit katak ninia isin sei moras,

15.title: Elifaz Koalia: Job La Fiar Maromak

verses.1: Depois Elifaz, ema Teman, hataan no nia dehan:
verses.2: “Ema matenek klean bele foo sai matenek nebee anin deit
verses.3: Nia koriji ho liafuan saugati deit ka?
verses.4: Maibee ita soe laran nebee hamtauk Maromak,
verses.5: Tanba ita nia hahalok aat mak hanorin ita nia ibun,
verses.6: Ita nia ibun rasik mak kondena ita, laos hau,
verses.7: Ita mak ema primeiru nebee moris mai ka?
verses.8: Ita rona ona segredu Maromak nian ka?
verses.9: Saida mak ita hatene, nebee ami la hatene?
verses.10: Ami iha ema nebee fuuk mutin no ema katuas iha ami nia leet,
verses.11: Maromak nia liafuan kamaan la too ba ita ka?
verses.12: Tanba saa mak ita nia fuan laran lori ita sai ba?
verses.13: no ita fila ita nia espíritu hodi hasoru Maromak,
verses.14: Saida mak ema, katak nia bele moos?
verses.15: Tebes, Maromak la tau fiar ba Ninia santu sira,
verses.16: saa tan ema nebee aat no foer liu,
verses.17: Hau sei hatudu ba ita, nunee rona lai,
verses.18: (buat nebee katuas sira konta,
verses.19: ema sira nee deit mak simu rai,
verses.20: Ema aat iha terus boot durante ninia moris tomak,
verses.21: Ninia tilun sei rona lian nebee halo nia hakfodak,
verses.22: Nia la fiar katak nia mai fali hosi fatin nakukun,
verses.23: Nia lao ba-mai hodi buka paun, no dehan, ‘Paun iha nebee?’
verses.24: Laran susar no terus sei halo nia tauk,
verses.25: Tanba nia lolo ninia liman hasoru Maromak,
verses.26: Nia halai ho ulun toos hodi hasoru Maromak,
verses.27: Tanba nia taka ninia oin ho ninia bokur,
verses.28: Nia hela iha sidade sira nebee mamuk,
verses.29: Nia sei la sai riku, no ninia riku-soin sei la dura,
verses.30: Nia sei la sai hosi fatin nakukun;
verses.31: Keta husik nia fiar buat nebee la iha folin no bosok aan,
verses.32: Buat nee sei akontese molok ninia tempu ikus,
verses.33: Nia sei husik ninia uvas fuan nurak monu hanesan ai uvas,
verses.34: Tanba ema foer nia sorumutu sei la iha oan,
verses.35: Sira sai isin rua ho problema, no tuur ahi hodi hahoris buat aat,

16.title: Job Koalia: Imi La Foo Kamaan

verses.1: Depois Job hataan no nia dehan:
verses.2: “Hau rona ona buat barak hanesan nee;
verses.3: Liafuan mamuk nee la iha rohan ka?
verses.4: Hau mos bele koalia hanesan imi,
verses.5: Hau bele haforsa imi ho hau nia ibun,
verses.6: Se hau koalia, hau nia terus la sai kamaan;
verses.7: Maibee agora Maromak halo hau kole,
verses.8: O halo hau namlaik ona,
verses.9: Nia odi hau no lees hau ho Ninia laran hirus,
verses.10: Sira hateke ba hau ho ibun loke,
verses.11: Maromak entrega ona hau ba ema foer,
verses.12: Uluk hau hakmatek, maibee agora Nia halo hau tohar.
verses.13: ninia ramadór sira haleu hau.
verses.14: Nia ataka hau, no nia estraga no estraga tan,
verses.15: Hau suku hena karoon hodi taka hau nia kulit,
verses.16: Hau nia oin sai mean tanba hau tanis,
verses.17: Hau nia liman la halo violénsia,
verses.18: Oh rai, la bele taka hau nia raan,
verses.19: Tebes agora mos, hau nia sasin mak iha lalehan,
verses.20: Hau nia kolega sira goza hau,
verses.21: Oh oinsaa ema ida bele lori hau nia kazu ba Maromak,
verses.22: Iha tinan balu ba oin,

verses.1: “Hau nia espíritu tohar tiha, hau nia loron sira remata ona,
verses.2: Goza door sira haleu hau,
verses.3: Rai buat ruma hodi halo kontratu ho hau,
verses.4: Tanba O subar kompriensaun hosi sira nia fuan laran,
verses.5: Nia nebee nega ninia kolega hodi hetan riku-soin -
verses.6: Nia halo hau sai nudar liafuan aat ba povu,
verses.7: Hau nia matan sai kole tanba laran susar,
verses.8: Ema loos sei hakfodak tanba buat nee,
verses.9: Ema moris loos kontinua tuir ninia dalan,
verses.10: Maibee ba imi hotu nee, fila fali mai,
verses.11: Hau nia loron sira liu ona, no hau nia planu sira kotu ona,
verses.12: Sira halo kalan troka loron,
verses.13: Se hau hein rate nudar hau nia uma,
verses.14: se hau dehan ba rai kuak, ‘Ita mak hau nia apaa,
verses.15: nunee hau nia esperansa iha nebee?
verses.16: Esperansa nee sei tuun ba rate nia portaun ka?

18.title: Bildad Koalia: Maromak Kastigu Ema Mate Sira

verses.1: Depois Bildad, ema Suá, hataan no nia dehan:
verses.2: “Too bainhira mak ita nia liafuan nee remata ona?
verses.3: Tanba saa mak ita hanoin ami mak animál deit?
verses.4: Ita lees aan tanba ita hirus,
verses.5: Loos duni, ema aat nia naroman sei mate,
verses.6: Naroman nee sei sai nakukun iha ninia tenda,
verses.7: Uluk nia hakat ho podér, maibee agora nia lao iha dalan kloot,
verses.8: Tanba ninia ain rasik mak soe nia ba redi ida,
verses.9: Lasu sei kaer ninia ain tuban,
verses.10: Sira subar tali hodi kaer nia iha rai nee,
verses.11: Terus sei halo nia tauk iha sor-sorin,
verses.12: Ninia forsa sei sai fraku,
verses.13: Buat nee sei haan ninia kulit balu,
verses.14: no lees nia sai hosi ninia tenda nebee nia hanoin seguru,
verses.15: Buat nebee laos ninian sei hela iha ninia tenda,
verses.16: Ninia abut sai maran iha okos,
verses.17: Iha mundu nee, ema la hanoin hetan fali nia,
verses.18: Sira dudu nia hosi fatin naroman baa iha fatin nakukun,
verses.19: Nia la iha oan ka bei-oan iha ninia povu nia leet,
verses.20: Iha parte loromonu, sira sei hakfodak kona ba ninia tempu,
verses.21: Tebes, buat nee akontese ba ema nebee hahalok aat,

19.title: Job Koalia: Hau Nia Hola-Nain Sei Moris

verses.1: Depois Job hataan, no nia dehan:
verses.2: “Too bainhira mak imi foo terus mai hau,
verses.3: Dala sanulu ona imi despreza hau;
verses.4: Se loos duni katak hau sala ona,
verses.5: Se loos duni katak imi sei foti aan hasoru hau,
verses.6: entaun hatene katak Maromak mak temi sala ba hau,
verses.7: Tebes, hau hakilar, ‘Violénsia!’ maibee ema la rona;
verses.8: Nia hada moru iha hau nia dalan hodi hau la bele liu,
verses.9: Nia hasai tiha hau nia glória,
verses.10: Nia harahun hau iha sor-sorin, no hau lakon ona,
verses.11: Nia halakan Ninia laran hirus hasoru hau,
verses.12: Ninia tropas sira mai hamutuk,
verses.13: Nia hadook hau nia maluk sira hosi hau,
verses.14: Hau nia família husik hela hau,
verses.15: Sira nebee hela iha hau nia uma, no hau nia atan feto sira, haree hau nudar estranjeiru;
verses.16: Hau bolu hau nia atan no nia la hataan hau;
verses.17: Hau nia feen la hatene hau nia iis,
verses.18: Sin, labarik sira hamoe hau,
verses.19: Hau nia belun diak sira hotu odi hau,
verses.20: Hau nia ruin belit ba hau nia kulit no hau nia isin,
verses.21: Hatudu grasa mai hau, hatudu grasa mai hau, Oh hau nia kolega sira,
verses.22: Nusaa mak imi duni hau hanesan Maromak?
verses.23: Oh katak ema hakerek hau nia liafuan!
verses.24: Oh katak ema uza lapizeira besi no makdadi,
verses.25: Tanba hau hatene katak hau nia Hola-nain sei moris hela,
verses.26: No bainhira hau nia kulit sai aat ona,
verses.27: Hau rasik sei haree Nia,
verses.28: Se imi dehan, ‘Oinsaa ami bele duni nia?’
verses.29: entaun imi tenki hamtauk surik,

20.title: Zofar Koalia: Ema Aat Hetan Terus

verses.1: Depois Zofar, ema Naamat, hataan no nia dehan:
verses.2: “Nunee hau nia hanoin hataan hau,
verses.3: Hau rona liafuan nebee hamoe hau,
verses.4: Laos ita hatene buat ida nee hosi tempu antigu,
verses.5: katak ema aat iha susesu too tempu badak deit,
verses.6: Maski nia sae aas too lalehan,
verses.7: maibee nia sei lakon too rohan laek hanesan ninia teen;
verses.8: Nia sei semo sai hanesan mehi ida, no ema la hetan nia;
verses.9: Matan ida nebee haree ona nia sei la haree tan nia;
verses.10: Ninia oan sira sei buka favór hosi ema kiak,
verses.11: Ninia ruin nakonu ho forsa joven nian,
verses.12: Maski hahalok aat sei midar iha ninia ibun,
verses.13: maski nia lakohi husik hahalok nee,
verses.14: maibee ninia hahaan nee sei fila iha nia kabun laran,
verses.15: Nia tolan riku-soin depois nia muta fali buat sira nee;
verses.16: Nia sei supa veneno samea nian,
verses.17: Nia sei la haree mota boot,
verses.18: Nia tenki foo fali produsaun hosi ninia servisu,
verses.19: Tanba nia hanehan no husik ema kiak,
verses.20: Ninia kabun la hakmatek,
verses.21: Bainhira nia haan tiha, hahaan restu la iha,
verses.22: Bainhira nia nakonu ho riku-soin, nia sei iha terus;
verses.23: Bainhira nia atu halo nakonu ninia kabun,
verses.24: Nia sei halai hosi alat besi funu nian,
verses.25: Ema sei dada sai rama oan nee hosi ninia isin,
verses.26: Nia simu fatin nakukun liu nudar ninia riku-soin,
verses.27: Lalehan sei foo sai ninia hahalok aat,
verses.28: Ninia riku-soin iha ninia uma nee, ema sei lori sai,
verses.29: Ema aat sei hetan rezultadu nee hosi Maromak,

21.title: Job Koalia: Ema Aat Hetan Susesu

verses.1: Job hataan no nia dehan,
verses.2: “Rona di-diak hau nia liafuan,
verses.3: Husik hau bele koalia,
verses.4: Ba hau nee, hau koalia hasoru ema ka?
verses.5: Haree hau no hakfodak ba,
verses.6: Bainhira hau hanoin hetan, hau sai tauk,
verses.7: Tanba saa mak ema aat sei moris hela,
verses.8: Sira nia jerasaun sai metin iha sira nia prezensa,
verses.9: Sira nia uma mak seguru no sira la tauk,
verses.10: Sira nia karau aman iha oan nafatin,
verses.11: Sira haruka sira nia kiik-oan sira sai hanesan bibi lubun ida,
verses.12: Sira kanta ho tamborin no harpa,
verses.13: Sira gasta sira nia tempu ho riku-soin,
verses.14: Nunee sira dehan ba Maromak, ‘Sees tiha hosi ami!
verses.15: See mak Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas, katak ami tenki serví Nia?
verses.16: Tebes, laos sira iha buat diak iha sira nia liman?
verses.17: Dala hira mak ema aat nia lampu mate?
verses.18: Bainhira mak sira sai hanesan duut kain iha anin nia oin,
verses.19: Imi dehan, ‘Maromak sei rai sira nia sala ba sira nia oan sira.’
verses.20: Husik ninia matan rasik haree ninia terus,
verses.21: Tanba sira la hanoin kona ba sira nia uma kain nebee tuir mai,
verses.22: Ema bele hanorin liafuan matenek ba Maromak ka?
verses.23: Ema ida mate bainhira nia forti hela,
verses.24: Nia nakonu ho susu been,
verses.25: Ema seluk mate ho terus iha nia klamar,
verses.26: Sira toba hamutuk iha rai laran,
verses.27: Tebes, hau hatene imi nia hanoin,
verses.28: Tanba imi dehan, ‘Ema boot nia uma iha nebee?
verses.29: Laos imi husu ona sira nebee lao iha dalan?
verses.30: Katak ema aat la mate iha loron susar,
verses.31: See mak deklara ninia hahalok iha ninia oin,
verses.32: Maibee nia sei tama ba rai kuak,
verses.33: Rai mean iha rai tetuk sei midar ba nia,
verses.34: Nunee oinsaa imi foo kamaan mai hau ho liafuan saugati deit,

22.title: Elifaz Koalia: Job Iha Hahalok Aat tebes

verses.1: Elifaz, ema Teman, hataan no nia dehan,
verses.2: “Ema ida bele foo benefísiu ba Maromak ka lae?
verses.3: Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas sei sai kontenti tanba ita iha hahalok loos ka?
verses.4: Nia sei koriji ita hodi halo ita hamtauk Nia ka?
verses.5: Laos ita nia hahalok aat mak aat liu?
verses.6: Tanba ita foti garantia hosi ita nia alin ho razaun la iha,
verses.7: Ita la foo bee hodi ema kole bele hemu,
verses.8: Ema nebee iha podér mak hadau rai,
verses.9: Ita haruka feto faluk sai ho liman mamuk,
verses.10: Nunee lasu sira haleu ita,
verses.11: ou nakukun nebee halo hodi ita la bele haree,
verses.12: Laos Maromak iha lalehan nebee aas?
verses.13: No ita dehan, ‘Maromak hatene saida?
verses.14: Kalohan mahar nee taka Nia, nunee Nia la haree,
verses.15: Ita sei lao tuir dalan tuan
verses.16: Ema hasai tiha ona sira molok sira nia tempu,
verses.17: Sira dehan ba Maromak, ‘Sai hosi ami,’
verses.18: Maibee Nia halo sira nia uma nakonu ho buat diak.
verses.19: Ema moris loos haree buat nee no sai kontenti,
verses.20: no dehan, ‘Ami nia inimigu lakon ona,
verses.21: Sai belun ho Maromak no hetan dame,
verses.22: Simu lei hosi Ninia ibun,
verses.23: Se ita fila fali ba Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas, Nia sei harii ita;
verses.24: se ita rai osan mean iha rai rahun,
verses.25: nunee Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas sei sai ita nia osan mean,
verses.26: Depois ita sei sai kontenti ho Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas,
verses.27: Ita sei halo orasaun ba Nia, no Nia sei rona ita,
verses.28: Ita sei desidi buat ida, no buat nee sei sai metin,
verses.29: Tanba bainhira ema tuun, ita dehan, ‘Nee tanba sira gaba aan’;
verses.30: Nia sei salva ema nebee laos inosenti,

verses.1: Depois Job hataan no nia dehan,
verses.2: “Ohin loron mos, hau nia keixa sei moruk,
verses.3: Oh katak hau bele hatene iha nebee hau bele hetan Nia,
verses.4: Nunee hau bele rai hau nia kazu iha Ninia oin,
verses.5: Depois hau sei hatene liafuan nebee Nia hataan hau,
verses.6: Nia sei koalia hasoru hau ho Ninia podér makaas ka?
verses.7: Iha nebaa ema hahalok loos bele diskuti malu ho Nia,
verses.8: Tebes, hau lao ba oin, maibee Nia la iha,
verses.9: iha sorin karuk, bainhira Nia servisu hela, hau la haree Nia,
verses.10: Maibee Nia hatene dalan ida nebee hau lao liu,
verses.11: Hau nia ain lao metin tuir Ninia ain fatin,
verses.12: Hau la sees hosi ukun fuan sira nebee mai hosi Ninia ibun tutun;
verses.13: Maibee Nia iha hanoin ida deit, nunee see mak bele halo Nia fila fali?
verses.14: Tanba Nia sei halao buat nebee Nia desidi kona ba hau,
verses.15: Nunee hau iha laran susar iha Ninia prezensa,
verses.16: Tanba Maromak halo hau nia fuan laran sai fraku,
verses.17: Maibee hau la sai nonook tanba nakukun nee,

24.title: no tanba saa mak sira nebee konhese Nia nunka haree Ninia loron?

verses.1: Tanba saa mak Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas la marka tempu atu tesi lia,
verses.2: Sira muda marka baliza nian,
verses.3: Sira duni sai oan kiak nia kuda buru,
verses.4: Sira duni sai ema mukit hosi dalan,
verses.5: Tebes, hanesan kuda buru fuik iha rai fuik,
verses.6: Sira silu batar hosi ema nia toos,
verses.7: Sira toba ho isin molik tanba ropa la iha,
verses.8: Sira sai bokon ho udan foho nian,
verses.9: (Ema aat foti oan kiak hosi susu,
verses.10: Sira lao ba-mai ho isin molik tanba ropa la iha,
verses.11: Iha ema aat nia toos oliveira sira halo mina,
verses.12: Ema nebee besik mate foo sai lian tristi iha sidade laran,
verses.13: Ema balu kontra hasoru naroman,
verses.14: Oho door hadeer dadeer-saan nakukun,
verses.15: Ema nebee halo sala seksuál mos hein too rai nakaras,
verses.16: Iha tempu nakukun sira kee liu hosi uma nia didin,
verses.17: Tanba ba sira, fatin nakukun liu mak hanesan dadeer-saan,
verses.18: Ita dehan, ‘Sira halai lalais iha bee leten,
verses.19: Bailoro naruk no loron manas halakon bee nebee suli hosi neve,
verses.20: Oan fatin sei haluha sira,
verses.21: Sira halo sala ba feto nebee oan la iha,
verses.22: Maibee Maromak aumenta ema podér nia moris ho Ninia kbiit,
verses.23: Ema nee hela seguru no hetan suporta,
verses.24: Sira sai boot too tempu uitoan depois sira lakon,
verses.25: Se laos hanesan nee, see mak hatudu katak hau bosok,

25.title: Bildad Koalia: Ema La bele Iha Moris Loos

verses.1: Depois Bildad, ema Suá, hataan no nia dehan,
verses.2: “Reinu mak Maromak nian no ita hamtauk Nia,
verses.3: Ita bele sura Ninia forsa sira ka?
verses.4: Oinsaa ema bele hamriik iha Maromak nia oin nudar ema loos?
verses.5: Tebes, fulan nee laos naroman ba Nia,
verses.6: Saa tan ba ema nebee ular oan deit,

verses.1: Job koalia no nia dehan,
verses.2: “Oinsaa ita ajuda nia nebee podér la iha!
verses.3: Oinsaa ita foo konselhu ba nia nebee matenek klean la iha,
verses.4: See mak ajuda ita hodi koalia nunee?
verses.5: Ema mate nakdedar iha bee okos
verses.6: Fatin Mate sei molik iha Ninia oin,
verses.7: Nia nahe parte norte iha fatin mamuk,
verses.8: Nia falun bee iha Ninia kalohan mahar,
verses.9: Nia taka fulan nia oin,
verses.10: Nia marka linha kabuar hodi haleu bee,
verses.11: Riin boot iha lalehan nakdedar,
verses.12: Nia siak tasi ho Ninia podér,
verses.13: Liu hosi Ninia Espíritu Nia halo lalehan furak,
verses.14: Tebes, nee mak Ninia hahalok balu deit.

27.title: Job Kontinua: Hau Sei Iha Laran Loos

verses.1: Job kontinua foo sai ninia provérbiu, no nia dehan,
verses.2: “Hanesan Maromak nebee moris, nebee hasai ona hau nia direitu,
verses.3: bainhira hau nia iis sei iha,
verses.4: nunee hau nia ibun tutun sei la koalia aat,
verses.5: Keta halo be hau dehan imi mak loos;
verses.6: Hau kaer metin hau nia hahalok loos, no hau sei la husik buat nee.
verses.7: Husik hau nia inimigu sai hanesan ema aat,
verses.8: Saida mak ema foer nia esperansa bainhira nia iis kotu,
verses.9: Maromak sei rona ninia lian hakilar
verses.10: Nia sei kontenti ho Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas ka?
verses.11: Hau sei hanorin imi kona ba Maromak nia liman,
verses.12: Tebes, imi hotu haree ona buat nee;
verses.13: Ema hahalok aat hetan fatin nee hosi Maromak,
verses.14: Se ninia oan aumenta barak, surik sei haan sira,
verses.15: Sira nebee moris hela sei mate liu hosi moras todan,
verses.16: Maski nia halibur osan mutin hanesan rai rahun,
verses.17: maski nia halibur sasaan nee, maibee ema moris loos sei hatais ropa nee,
verses.18: Nia harii ninia uma hanesan borboleta ida,
verses.19: Nia toba nudar ema riku, maibee nia sei la toba fali hanesan nee,
verses.20: Terus sei kaer nia hanesan bee sae,
verses.21: Anin hosi parte lorosae foti nia no nia lakon,
verses.22: Anin nee sei soe nia, no la hanoin nia,
verses.23: Anin sei basa liman tanba nia,

28.title: Job Kontinua: Matenek Klean Iha Nebee?

verses.1: “Tebes, ema iha rai kuak nebee hetan osan mutin,
verses.2: Sira foti besi hosi rai laran,
verses.3: Ema leno lampu iha fatin nakukun,
verses.4: Nia loke rai kuak nebee dook hosi fatin nebee ema hela,
verses.5: Paun mai hosi rai laran,
verses.6: Iha fatuk sira iha nebaa sira bele hetan safira,
verses.7: La iha manu ida nebee hatene dalan nee,
verses.8: Animál fuik nebee aman seidauk sama iha nebaa,
verses.9: Ema lolo ninia liman ba fatuk toos nee,
verses.10: Nia kee bee dalan iha fatuk laran,
verses.11: Nia taka mota sira hodi bee la bele liu,
verses.12: Maibee ita bele hetan matenek klean iha nebee?
verses.13: Ema la hatene buat sira nee nia folin,
verses.14: Fatin klean dehan, ‘Buat sira nee laos iha hau,’
verses.15: Ita la sosa ho osan mean,
verses.16: Ita la bele foo folin ho osan mean hosi Ofir,
verses.17: Osan mean no fatuk murak la bele iha folin hanesan nee,
verses.18: Ema la koalia kona ba ahu ruin ka fatuk kristál,
verses.19: Fatuk topaziu hosi Etiópia nia folin la hanesan nee,
verses.20: Entaun matenek klean mai hosi nebee?
verses.21: Matenek klean nee mak subar hosi buat hotu nebee moris,
verses.22: Fatin Lakon no Fatin Mate dehan,
verses.23: Maromak mak kompriende dalan ba nebaa,
verses.24: Tanba Nia hateke ba mundu nia rohan,
verses.25: Nia bele tetu anin sira,
verses.26: Nia foo estatutu ba udan,
verses.27: Nunee Nia haree no deklara ona,
verses.28: No ba ema Nia dehan,

verses.1: Job kontinua foo sai ninia provérbiu, no nia dehan,
verses.2: “Oh katak hau hanesan uluk, iha fulan hirak liu ba,
verses.3: bainhira Ninia lampu leno ba hau nia ulun,
verses.4: iha tempu nebee hau sei iha forsa,
verses.5: bainhira Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas sei hamutuk ho hau,
verses.6: bainhira sira fasi hau nia sama fatin ho manteiga,
verses.7: Bainhira hau sai ba sidade nia portaun,
verses.8: joven mane haree hau no subar aan,
verses.9: Xefi sira la koalia,
verses.10: Ema boot sira nonook,
verses.11: Bainhira tilun rona, nia foo bensaun mai hau,
verses.12: Tanba hau salva ema kiak nebee husu ajuda,
verses.13: Ema besik atu mate foo bensaun mai hau,
verses.14: Hau hatais hahalok loos nudar hau nia ropa,
verses.15: Hau sai matan ba ema delek,
verses.16: Hau sai apaa ba ema kiak,
verses.17: Hau halo tohar ema aat nia hasan ruin,
verses.18: Depois hau dehan, ‘Hau sei mate iha hau nia knuuk,
verses.19: hau nia abut sira nani ba too besik bee,
verses.20: Hau nia glória nebee nurak sei hela ho hau,
verses.21: Ema rona no hein hau,
verses.22: Bainhira hau koalia ona, ema sira nee la koalia fali,
verses.23: Sira hein hau nudar udan been,
verses.24: Hau foo oin midar ba sira bainhira la iha konfiansa,
verses.25: Hau hili sira nia dalan no tuur nudar xefi,

30.title: sira nebee idade kiik liu hau,

verses.1: Maibee agora sira hamnasa hau,
verses.2: Hau bele manaan saida hosi sira nia liman nia forsa,
verses.3: Sira kiak no hamlaha loos;
verses.4: Sira kuu ai tahan meer hosi ai badak,
verses.5: Ema duni sira sai hosi komunidade nia leet,
verses.6: hodi sira baa hela iha foho lolon nia leet,
verses.7: Iha ai badak nia leet sira foo sai lian fuik,
verses.8: Sira mak beik-teen nia oan sira nebee onra la iha,
verses.9: No agora sira kanta kona ba hau,
verses.10: Sira hakribi hau no hadook aan hosi hau,
verses.11: Tanba Maromak losu hau nia tali rohan no hanehan hau,
verses.12: Iha hau nia sorin loos joven nakar sira mai,
verses.13: Sira estraga hau nia dalan,
verses.14: Sira tama mai liu hosi fatin luan,
verses.15: Terus fila fali mai hau,
verses.16: Agora hau fui sai hau nia moris,
verses.17: Iha kalan, moras sona hau nia ruin,
verses.18: Forsa boot estraga hau nia ropa,
verses.19: Nia soe hau ba rai tahu,
verses.20: Hau hakilar hodi husu ajuda ba O, maibee O la hataan hau,
verses.21: O sai nudar ida nebee halo violénsia mai hau,
verses.22: O foti sae hau ho anin; O halo hau sae anin nee,
verses.23: Tanba hau hatene katak O sei lori hau ba mate,
verses.24: Maibee laos ema nebee iha fatin aat sei lolo ninia liman?
verses.25: Laos hau tanis ona kona ba ema seluk nebee iha susar?
verses.26: Bainhira hau buka buat diak, buat aat mai deit,
verses.27: Hau nia laran tuun-sae no la deskansa,
verses.28: Hau lao ba-mai ho oin nakukun maibee laos tanba loro matan,
verses.29: Hau sai maluk ida ba animál fuik,
verses.30: Hau nia kulit sai metan iha hau nia isin,
verses.31: Hau nia harpa foo sai tanis lelir,

verses.1: Hau halo aliansa ida ho hau nia matan;
verses.2: Tanba hau sei hetan saida hosi Maromak iha leten?
verses.3: Laos ema hahalok aat hetan dezastre,
verses.4: Laos Nia haree hau nia dalan hotu,
verses.5: Se karik hau lao nudar lohi door,
verses.6: (husik Nia tetu hau iha dasin justu,
verses.7: se hau lao sees hosi dalan loos,
verses.8: nunee husik hau kuda, maibee ema seluk haan,
verses.9: Se hau nia fuan laran monu ba feto ida,
verses.10: nunee husik hau nia feen fai ema seluk nia batar,
verses.11: Tanba ida nee mak sala aat tebes,
verses.12: No sala nee hanesan ahi nebee haan mohu too lakon,
verses.13: Se hau rejeita hau nia atan mane ka atan feto nia kazu,
verses.14: entaun hau bele halo saida bainhira Maromak mak hamriik?
verses.15: Laos Nia nebee halo hau iha kabun laran, halo mos ema nee?
verses.16: Se hau la foo ba ema kiak buat nebee sira hakarak,
verses.17: ou se hau haan hau nia hahaan mesak deit,
verses.18: (tanba hosi tempu nebee hau sei joven nia hela ho hau hanesan ho apaa,
verses.19: se hau haree ema ida deit mate tanba ropa la iha,
verses.20: se ninia isin la foo bensaun mai hau,
verses.21: se hau foti sae hau nia liman hodi hasoru oan kiak,
verses.22: nunee husik hau nia liman monu hosi hau nia kabaas,
verses.23: Tanba hau tauk loos terus hosi Maromak,
verses.24: Se hau espera ba osan mean,
verses.25: se hau haksolok tanba hau iha riku-soin boot,
verses.26: se hau haree loro matan bainhira nia leno,
verses.27: no buat segredu dada hau nia fuan laran,
verses.28: buat nee mos sai hahalok aat nebee juis tenki foo kastigu ba,
verses.29: Se hau haksolok tanba ida nebee odi hau hetan tempu susar,
verses.30: (hau la husik hau nia ibun koalia sala,
verses.31: se ema nebee hela iha hau nia tenda nunka dehan,
verses.32: (ema estranjieru la toba iha dalan,
verses.33: se hau taka hau nia sala hanesan Adão,
verses.34: tanba hau tauk lubun boot nee,
verses.35: Oh katak ema ida bele rona hau!
verses.36: Tebes hau sei lori surat nee iha hau nia kabaas,
verses.37: Hau sei konta hau nia hakat hotu ba Nia,
verses.38: Se hau nia rai hakilar hasoru hau,
verses.39: se hau haan produsaun nee no la selu,
verses.40: husik duut tarak moris mai troka trigu,

32.title: Eliú Hasee Job Nia Kolega Tolu

verses.1: Entaun ema nain tolu nee la foo resposta tan ba Job. Tanba tuir Job nia hanoin, nia mak loos hela.
verses.2: Depois Eliú, oan hosi Barakel, ema Buz, hosi família Ram nian, sai hirus manas. Nia sai hirus manas hasoru Job tanba nia justifika aan no laos Maromak.
verses.3: Eliú sai hirus manas hasoru Job nia kolega nain tolu tanba sira la iha resposta, maski sira kondena Job.
verses.4: Eliú hein too Job koalia ona tanba Job mak idade boot liu nia.
verses.5: Bainhira Eliú haree katak ema nain tolu nee la foo resposta nia sai hirus manas.
verses.6: No Eliú, oan hosi Barakel, ema Buz, hataan no nia dehan,
verses.7: Hau dehan, ‘Husik loron sira nee koalia,
verses.8: Maibee ema iha espíritu iha laran,
verses.9: Laos ema idade boot mak iha matenek klean,
verses.10: Nunee hau dehan, ‘Rona hau lai,
verses.11: Tebes hau hein imi nia liafuan,
verses.12: Hau foo atensaun ba imi,
verses.13: Kuidadu katak imi la bele dehan, ‘Ami hetan ona matenek klean,
verses.14: Nia la koalia ba hau ho ninia liafuan,
verses.15: Sira hakfodak no la hataan fali,
verses.16: Hau sei hein hela bainhira sira la koalia ka,
verses.17: Hau sei hataan tuir hau nia hanoin,
verses.18: Tanba hau nakonu ho liafuan,
verses.19: Tebes, hau nia kabun hanesan tua uvas nebee la iha kuak,
verses.20: Hau tenki koalia hodi hau bele dada iis fali;
verses.21: Hau sei la fihir mane ida,
verses.22: Tanba hau la hatene oinsaa atu gaba ema,

verses.1: Nunee Oh Job, favór ida, rona buat nebee hau hatete,
verses.2: Tebes, hau loke hau nia ibun,
verses.3: Hau nia liafuan foo sai hahalok loos hosi hau nia fuan laran,
verses.4: Maromak nia Espíritu kria hau,
verses.5: Se ita bele, hataan hau,
verses.6: Tebes, hau mak hanesan ita iha Maromak nia oin,
verses.7: Tebes, lalika tauk katak terus ruma atu mai hosi hau,
verses.8: Loos duni ita koalia no hau rona ona,
verses.9: Ita dehan, ‘Hau mak moos, no la iha sala ida,
verses.10: Tebes, Maromak buka razaun ruma hodi hasoru hau,
verses.11: Nia tau hau nia ain iha kastigu fatin,
verses.12: Tebes, iha buat nee ita la loos,
verses.13: Nusaa mak ita diskuti malu ho Nia?
verses.14: Tanba Maromak koalia dala ida,
verses.15: Iha mehi ida, iha vizaun ida iha kalan,
verses.16: Depois Nia loke ema sira nia tilun,
verses.17: hodi Nia bele fila ema hosi sira nia hahalok,
verses.18: Nia kaer ema nia klamar hodi la tama rai kuak,
verses.19: Ema hetan disiplina iha kama bainhira nia moras,
verses.20: Nunee ninia moris odi paun,
verses.21: Ninia isin sai krekas maran too la bele haree isin nee,
verses.22: Ninia klamar hakbesik ba rate,
verses.23: Se iha anju ida nebee tuun ba nia,
verses.24: no mediadór nee hatudu grasa ba nia, no dehan,
verses.25: Husik ninia isin sai nurak hanesan joven nian,
verses.26: Depois nia halo orasaun no Maromak sei simu nia,
verses.27: Nia kanta ba ema seluk no nia dehan,
verses.28: Nia hola fali hau nia klamar hodi la tuun ba rai kuak,
verses.29: Tebes, Maromak halo buat hotu nee,
verses.30: hodi lori fali mai ninia klamar hosi rai kuak,
verses.31: See tilun ba, Oh Job, no rona tuir hau;
verses.32: Se ita iha liafuan ruma atu hatete, entaun hataan ba;
verses.33: Se lae, rona tuir hau,

34.title: Eliú Foo Sai Maromak Nia Justisa

verses.1: Depois Eliú hataan no dehan:
verses.2: “Rona tuir hau nia liafuan, Oh imi nebee ema matenek klean,
verses.3: Tanba tilun koko liafuan,
verses.4: Mai ita hili buat nebee loos,
verses.5: Tanba Job dehan ona, ‘Hau mak loos,
verses.6: Hau tenki bosok hasoru hau nia direitu ka?
verses.7: See mak hanesan Job,
verses.8: nebee halo viajen ho ema nebee halo buat aat,
verses.9: Tanba nia dehan, ‘Ema la manaan buat ida
verses.10: Nunee rona tuir hau, imi nebee iha kompriensaun,
verses.11: Tanba Maromak sei selu ema tuir buat nebee ema halo,
verses.12: Loos duni, Maromak sei la halo buat nebee aat,
verses.13: See mak foo knaar ba Maromak hodi lori rai nee?
verses.14: Se karik Nia desidi iha Ninia fuan laran,
verses.15: isin hotu sei lakon hamutuk,
verses.16: Se ita iha kompriensaun, rona liafuan nee lai,
verses.17: Ida nebee odi justisa sei ukun ka?
verses.18: Nia dehan ba liurai, ‘Ita la iha folin!’,
verses.19: Nia la simu ema tanba sira mak xefi,
verses.20: Iha momentu ida deit sira mate,
verses.21: Tanba Maromak nia matan hateke ba ema nia hahalok,
verses.22: La iha lalatak ruma ka fatin nakukun liu,
verses.23: Tanba Maromak la presiza husu tan ba ema,
verses.24: Nia harahun ema boot sira maski Nia la buka hatene sira,
verses.25: Tanba Nia hatene sira nia hahalok,
verses.26: Nia baku sira tanba sira nia hahalok aat,
verses.27: Tanba sira fila hosi Nia,
verses.28: Nunee sira halo hodi ema kiak hakilar ba Nia,
verses.29: Bainhira Nia nonook, see mak bele foo sala ba Nia?
verses.30: Nunee ema foer la bele ukun,
verses.31: Tanba see mak dehan ona ba Maromak,
verses.32: hanorin mai hau buat nebee hau la haree,
verses.33: Nunee Nia sei halo tuir ita nia hanoin,
verses.34: Ema nebee iha kompriensaun sei dehan mai hau,
verses.35: ‘Job koalia maibee nia la hatene,
verses.36: Diak liu, koko Job too ninia rohan,
verses.37: Nia aumenta hahalok nebee kontra ba ninia sala,

verses.1: Eliú hataan no nia dehan:
verses.2: “Ita hanoin ida nee mak justisa ka?
verses.3: Ita husu, ‘Hau hetan benefísiu saida?
verses.4: Hau sei hataan ba ita,
verses.5: Hateke ba lalehan no haree took,
verses.6: Se ita sala, ita halo saida hasoru Nia?
verses.7: Se ita iha hahalok loos, ita foo saida ba Nia?
verses.8: Ita nia hahalok aat nee mak impaktu ema hanesan ho ita,
verses.9: Tanba terus barak, povu hakilar,
verses.10: Maibee la iha ema ida nebee dehan, ‘Maromak, hau nia Kriadór nee, iha nebee,
verses.11: nebee hanorin ita barak liu fali animál sira iha mundu,
verses.12: Sira hakilar iha nebaa, maibee Nia la hataan,
verses.13: Loos duni, Maromak la rona lian mamuk,
verses.14: Saa tan bainhira ita dehan katak ita la haree Nia,
verses.15: No agora, tanba Nia la kastigu ho Ninia laran hirus,
verses.16: nunee Job loke ninia ibun ho lian mamuk,

verses.1: Eliú kontinua no nia dehan,
verses.2: “Pasiénsia uitoan tan, no hau sei hatudu ba ita,
verses.3: Hau sei lori hau nia matenek hosi fatin dook,
verses.4: Loos duni hau nia liafuan nee la bosok,
verses.5: Tebes, Maromak mak boot loos, no Nia la rejeita ema ida,
verses.6: Nia la proteje ema aat nia moris,

verses.19: hodi salva sira nia klamar hosi mate,

verses.21: Tanba ita nia fuan laran sei haksolok iha Nia,
verses.22: Haraik O nia domin metin mai ami, Oh Nai,

verses.1: Hau sei adora Nai iha tempu hotu,
verses.2: Hau nia klamar sei gaba Nai,
verses.3: Oh foti aas Nai hamutuk ho hau,
verses.4: Hau buka Nai, no Nia hataan hau,
verses.5: Sira nebee haree ba Nia iha oin kontenti,
verses.6: Ema kiak ida nee tanis, no Nai rona nia,
verses.7: Nai nia anju halo akampamentu haleu sira nebee fiar Nia,
verses.8: Oh koko took, no haree katak Nai nee diak,
verses.9: Oh santu sira, hamtauk Nai ba,
verses.10: Liaun aman sei falta no sai hamlaha,
verses.11: Mai lai, oan sira, rona mai hau,
verses.12: See mak buka atu moris,
verses.13: Kontrola o nia nanaal hosi liafuan aat,
verses.14: Sees hosi buat aat no halo buat nebee diak,
verses.15: Nai sei tau matan ba ema nebee moris loos,
verses.16: Nai nia oin hasoru sira nebee halo aat,
verses.17: Bainhira ema moris loos hakilar, Nai sei rona,
verses.18: Nai besik hela ba ema sira nebee laran tohar,
verses.19: Ema moris loos hetan terus barak,
verses.20: Nai proteje ninia ruin hotu,
verses.21: Buat aat sei oho ema aat,
verses.22: Nai hola fali Ninia atan sira nia klamar,

verses.1: Defende hau nia kazu, Oh Nai, hosi sira nebee hasoru hau,
verses.2: Foti eskudu kabuar no eskudu luan,
verses.3: Foti dima hodi hapara sira nebee duni hau,
verses.4: Husik sira hetan moe no kona foer, ema nebee buka atu oho hau;
verses.5: Husik sira sai hanesan hare kulit iha anin nia oin,
verses.6: Husik sira nia dalan sai nakukun no namdoras,
verses.7: Tanba ho razaun la iha sira subar redi iha kuak hodi kastigu hau;
verses.8: Husik nia lakon derepenti,
verses.9: Depois hau nia klamar sei haksolok iha Nai,
verses.10: Hau nia ruin hotu sei dehan,
verses.11: Sasin falsu hamriik,
verses.12: Sira selu hau nia hahalok diak ho buat aat,
verses.13: Maibee hau, bainhira sira moras,
verses.14: Hau lao ba-mai
verses.15: Maibee bainhira hau monu sira haksolok no halibur aan,
verses.16: Hanesan goza door sira iha festa,
verses.17: Too bainhira, Oh Nai, mak O sei haree deit?
verses.18: Hau sei foo agradese ba O iha sorumutu boot,
verses.19: Keta husik ema sira nebee sai hau nia inimigu ho razaun sala
verses.20: Tanba sira la koalia ho dame,
verses.21: Sira loke luan sira nia ibun hodi hasoru hau,
verses.22: O haree ona, Oh Nai - keta nonook,
verses.23: Fanu aan, no hadeer hodi lori hau nia justisa,
verses.24: Foo justisa mai hau, Oh Nai, hau nia Maromak,
verses.25: Keta husik sira dehan iha sira nia fuan laran,
verses.26: Husik sira nebee haksolok kona ba hau nia kanek
verses.27: Husik sira nebee kontenti ho hau nia hahalok loos
verses.28: Hau nia nanaal sei konta kona ba O nia hahalok loos,

36.title: O Nia Domin Metin Mak Furak Loos

verses.1: Ema aat nia sala foo hatene mai hau nia fuan laran,
verses.2: Tanba ninia matan gaba ninia aan rasik,
verses.3: Ninia liafuan iha nia ibun kria problema no bosok,
verses.4: Nia halo planu aat iha nia kama,
verses.5: O nia domin metin, Oh Nai, mak aas too lalehan sira,
verses.6: O nia hahalok loos mak hanesan foho nebee aas tebes,
verses.7: Tebes O nia domin metin nee furak loos, Oh Maromak!
verses.8: Sira sei bosu ho hahaan bokur hosi O nia uma,
verses.9: Tanba ho O mak bee matan moris nian,
verses.10: Oh kontinua O nia domin metin ba sira nebee konhese O,
verses.11: Keta husik ema nebee gaba aan nia ain mai hasoru hau,
verses.12: Ema nebee iha hahalok aat sei monu iha nebaa,

37.title: Nia Sei La Husik Santu Sira

verses.1: La bele hirus tanba ema nebee halo aat;
verses.2: Tanba la kleur, sira lakon hanesan duut,
verses.3: Fiar ba Nai, no halo buat nebee diak;
verses.4: Sai kontenti iha Nai,
verses.5: Entrega o nia moris ba Nai,
verses.6: Nia sei foo sai o nia hahalok loos hanesan naroman,
verses.7: Nonook iha Nai nia oin, no hein Nia ho pasiénsia;
verses.8: Hapara ita nia hirus, no husik ita nia fuan manas nee!
verses.9: Tanba ema sira nebee halo aat sei lakon,
verses.10: Tanba iha tempu uitoan deit, ema aat nee sei la iha,
verses.11: Maibee ema nebee laran maus sei hetan rai,
verses.12: Ema aat halo planu hasoru ema loos,
verses.13: Maibee Nai hamnasa ba ema aat nee,
verses.14: Ema aat losu ona sira nia surik no hana sira nia rama,
verses.15: Maibee sira nia surik sei tama fali sira nia fuan rasik,
verses.16: Ema moris loos nia sasaan uitoan
verses.17: Ema aat tebes sira nia liman sei tohar,
verses.18: Nai hatene ema perfeitu nia loron sira,
verses.19: Sira la moe iha tempu aat,
verses.20: Maibee ema aat sira sei lakon,
verses.21: Ema aat debe maibee la selu fali,
verses.22: Ema nebee hetan bensaun sei simu mundu,
verses.23: Nai sei diriji ema nia hakat sira,
verses.24: maski ema nee monu, nia sei la monu too lakon,
verses.25: Uluk hau joven no agora hau katuas ona,
verses.26: Loron ba loron nia hatudu laran luak no foo empresta,
verses.27: Hadook aan hosi buat aat, no halo buat nebee diak,
verses.28: Tanba Nai hadomi justisa,
verses.29: Ema moris loos sei hetan rai,
verses.30: Ema moris loos nia ibun foo sai matenek klean,
verses.31: Ninia Maromak nia lei iha ninia fuan laran,
verses.32: Ema aat fihir ba ema moris loos,
verses.33: Nai sei la husik ema moris loos ba ema aat nia liman,
verses.34: Hein iha Nai, no lao tuir Ninia dalan,
verses.35: Hau haree ona ema aat tebes ho podér makaas,
verses.36: Maibee nia lakon, no tebes, la iha,
verses.37: Atensaun tu-tuir ema nebee loos no haree ema nebee justu,
verses.38: Maibee sira nebee sala sei lakon hamutuk,
verses.39: Ema moris loos sira nia salvasaun mai hosi Nai,
verses.40: Nai sei ajuda sira no salva sira,

verses.1: Oh Nai, keta koriji hau bainhira O iha laran hirus,
verses.2: Tanba O nia rama oan sira sona borus ona hau,
verses.3: La iha buat ida diak iha hau nia isin
verses.4: Tanba hau nia hahalok aat mak aas liu hau nia ulun,
verses.5: Hau nia kanek sira sai dois no dodok
verses.6: Hau hakruuk no tuun too iha rai,
verses.7: Tanba hau nia kanotak sai krekas maran liu,
verses.8: Hau fraku no tohar aat hotu,
verses.9: Nai, buat hotu nebee hau hakarak mak iha O nia oin,
verses.10: Hau nia fuan tuku-tuku, hau nia forsa lakon,
verses.11: Hau nia belun no kolega sira hamriik dook tanba hau moras,
verses.12: Ema nebee buka atu oho hau prepara sira nia lasu;
verses.13: Maibee hau hanesan ema tilun diuk no la rona,
verses.14: Nunee hau hanesan ema ida nebee la rona,
verses.15: Tanba ba O, Oh Nai, hau espera;
verses.16: Tanba hau dehan, “La bele husik sira haksolok tanba hau,
verses.17: Tanba hau besik atu monu,
verses.18: Tanba hau sei foo sai hau nia hahalok aat,
verses.19: Maibee hau nia inimigu sira sei forti no iha podér,
verses.20: Sira nebee selu fali hau nia hahalok diak ho buat aat
verses.21: Keta husik hau, Oh Nai!
verses.22: Mai lalais hodi ajuda hau,

verses.1: Hau dehan, “Hau sei kuidadu hau nia dalan sira,
verses.2: Hau monok no nonook,
verses.3: Hau nia fuan sai manas iha hau nia laran,
verses.4: “Oh Nai, hatudu hau nia moris rohan,
verses.5: Tebes, O halo hau nia loron sira nee badak too bele sukat ho liman,
verses.6: Tebes, ema ida-idak lao ba-mai hanesan lalatak!
verses.7: Agora, Oh Nai, tanba saa mak hau sei hein?
verses.8: Salva tiha hau hosi hau nia sala hotu,
verses.9: Hau monok no hau la loke hau nia ibun,
verses.10: Hasai tiha O nia sikote hosi hau,
verses.11: Bainhira O disiplina ema ida
verses.12: Rona hau nia orasaun, Oh Nai,
verses.13: Keta fihir hau, hodi hau bele kontenti fali,

verses.1: Hau hein ho pasiénsia ba Nai,
verses.2: Nia foti sae hau hosi rai kuak nebee estraga,
verses.3: Nia foo kanta foun iha hau nia ibun laran,
verses.4: Haksolok ba ema nebee tau ninia fiar ba Nai,
verses.5: Oh Nai, hau nia Maromak,
verses.6: O lakohi sakrifísiu ka oferta,
verses.7: Depois hau dehan, “Tebes, hau mai ona,
verses.8: Hau gosta halo tuir O nia hakarak, Oh hau nia Maromak,
verses.9: Hau haklaken kona ba moris loos iha sorumutu boot,
verses.10: Hau la subar O nia moris loos iha hau nia fuan laran,
verses.11: La bele kaer metin O nia laran luak hosi hau, Oh Nai;
verses.12: Tanba buat aat barak loos
verses.13: Oh Nai, mai salva tiha hau,
verses.14: Husik sira nebee buka atu oho hau bele sai moe no hetan konfuzaun,
verses.15: Husik sira hakfodak tanba sira nia moe,
verses.16: Husik sira nebee buka O
verses.17: Hau sei kiak no mukit,

verses.1: Haksolok ba ema nebee tau matan ba ema kiak sira!
verses.2: Nai sei proteje nia hodi nia sei moris nafatin;
verses.3: Nai sei tulun nia bainhira nia toba moras,
verses.4: Hau dehan, “Oh Nai, hadomi hau lai,
verses.5: Hau nia inimigu sira hatete aat kona ba hau,
verses.6: Ema sira nebee mai vizita hau
verses.7: Sira hotu nebee odi hau bis-bisu hamutuk kona ba hau.
verses.8: Sira dehan, “Nia moras todan,
verses.9: No mos, hau nia belun diak nebee hau konfia,
verses.10: Oh Nai, hatudu laran luak ba hau no halo hau hamriik metin,
verses.11: Liu hosi buat nee hau sei hatene katak O simu ona hau:
verses.12: O tulun hau tanba hau halo buat nebee loos,
verses.13: Adora ba Nai, Israel nia Maromak,

verses.1: Hanesan bibi rusa hakarak bee suli,
verses.2: Hau nia klamar hamrook ba Maromak,
verses.3: Hau nia matan been sira nee
verses.4: Hau hanoin hetan buat sira nee,
verses.5: Nusaa mak o tristi, Oh hau nia klamar?
verses.6: no hau nia Maromak.
verses.7: Fatin klean bolu ba fatin klean bainhira sira rona lian
verses.8: Maibee Nai sei haruka nia domin metin iha loron,
verses.9: Hau sei hatete ba Maromak, hau nia Fatuk,
verses.10: Hanesan kanek todan iha hau nia ruin,
verses.11: Nusaa mak o tristi, Oh hau nia klamar?

verses.1: Tesi lia, Oh Maromak, defende hau nia kazu
verses.2: Tanba O mak Maromak ida nebee hau nia fatin seguru,
verses.3: Haruka O nia naroman no O nia lia loos,
verses.4: Nunee hau sei baa iha Maromak nia altár,
verses.5: Nusaa mak o tristi, Oh hau nia klamar?

verses.1: Oh Maromak, ami rona ona ho ami nia tilun,
verses.2: Oinsaa ho O nia liman O duni sai nasaun sira seluk,
verses.3: Tanba laos sira rasik hadau rai nee liu hosi sira nia surik,
verses.4: O mak hau nia Liurai, Oh Maromak,
verses.5: Liu hosi O ami sei hatuun ami nia inimigu sira,
verses.6: Tanba hau la fiar ba hau nia rama,
verses.7: Maibee O salva ona ami hosi ami nia inimigu sira,
verses.8: Ami gaba Maromak durante loron tomak,
verses.9: Maibee O husik ona ami no hamoe ona ami,
verses.10: O halo ami hakiduk hosi inimigu nee,
verses.11: O halo ami hanesan bibi nebee ema atu oho,
verses.12: O faan ami ho folin kiik deit,
verses.13: O hamoe ami iha ami nia vizinhu sira nia oin,
verses.14: O halo ami hanesan liafuan aat iha ema liur nia leet,
verses.15: Hau nia moe boot sei iha hau nia oin nafatin,
verses.16: tanba hau rona lian hosi nia nebee hamnasa no koalia aat ba hau,
verses.17: Buat hotu nee hasoru tiha ami, maibee ami la haluha O,
verses.18: Ami nia fuan laran la fila fali,
verses.19: Maibee O hatuun ami iha samea naga nia fatin,
verses.20: Se ami haluha ami nia Maromak nia naran,
verses.21: laos Maromak sei hatene?
verses.22: Maibee tanba O, sira oho ami durante loron tomak,
verses.23: Hadeer lai! Nusaa mak O toba, Oh Nai?
verses.24: Nusaa mak O subar O nia oin?
verses.25: Tanba ami nia klamar tuun too iha rai rahun,
verses.26: Hamriik lai, mai ajuda ami!

verses.1: Hau nia fuan nakonu ho buat nebee diak;
verses.2: O mak furak liu ema nia oan mane sira seluk,
verses.3: Tara O nia surik iha O nia kanotak, Oh Asuwain,
verses.4: Iha O nia majestade lori kuda ba ho vitória
verses.5: O nia rama oan sira sei kroat
verses.6: O nia kadunan, Oh Maromak,
verses.7: O hadomi hahalok loos, no O odi hahalok aat.
verses.8: O nia ropa hotu morin hanesan mira, ai aloés no ai kameli.
verses.9: Liurai sira nia oan feto sira hela iha O nia feto boot sira nia leet,
verses.10: Rona lai, Oh oan feto, hanoin diak no see ita nia tilun,
verses.11: tanba Liurai nee gosta tebe-tebes ita nia oin bonita,
verses.12: No oan feto hosi Tiro sei mai ho prezenti sira,
verses.13: Oan feto liurai nian nee nakonu ho glória iha ninia kuartu,
verses.14: Sira lori nia ba Liurai ho ropa nebee iha kór oi-oin,
verses.15: Sira baa ho kontenti no haksolok,
verses.16: Ita nia oan sira sei troka ita nia aman sira,
verses.17: Hau sei halo ita nia naran sai konhesidu iha jerasaun hotu,

46.title: Maromak Mak Ita Nia Fatin Aas

verses.1: Maromak mak ita nia subar fatin no ita nia forsa,
verses.2: Nunee ita sei la tauk, maski rai lakon,
verses.3: no tasi nee halo barulhu no sai boot,
verses.4: Bee suli iha mota ida nebee halo kontenti Maromak nia sidade,
verses.5: Maromak hela iha ninia leet, nunee nia la monu;
verses.6: Ema liur sira sai hirus loos, reinu sira nakdedar,
verses.7: Nai Forsa Nain sei hamutuk ho ita,
verses.8: Mai, haree servisu Nai nian,
verses.9: Nia hapara funu sira iha mundu tomak,
verses.10: “Para lai, no hatene katak Hau mak Maromak,
verses.11: Nai Forsa Nain sei hamutuk ho ita,

verses.1: Hai nasaun hotu, basa liman ba!
verses.2: Hamtauk ba Nai Nebee Aas Liu,
verses.3: Nia tau povu sira iha ita nia ukun okos,
verses.4: Nia hili ita nia liman rohan no foo ba ita,
verses.5: Maromak sae ona ho lian hakilar,
verses.6: Kanta hahii ba Maromak, kanta hahii ba!
verses.7: Tanba Maromak mak Liurai ba mundu tomak,
verses.8: Maromak ukun nasaun sira.
verses.9: Ema boot sira hosi povu nee halibur hamutuk,

verses.1: Nai mak boot liu, hahii makaas Nia
verses.2: Nia iha fatin aas nebee furak,
verses.3: Maromak hatudu aan nudar fatin aas nebee seguru,
verses.4: Tanba nunee, liurai sira mai halibur hamutuk,
verses.5: Sira haree no sira hakfodak kedas,
verses.6: Laran tauk kaer sira,
verses.7: O harahun roo boot sira hosi Tarsis,
verses.8: Hanesan ita rona, nunee ita mos haree
verses.9: Ami hanoin kona ba O nia domin metin,
verses.10: Hanesan O nia naran, Oh Maromak,
verses.11: Husik Foho Zion haksolok ba!
verses.12: Lao liu Zion, lao haleu nia,
verses.13: Haree di-diak ninia moru metin sira nee,
verses.14: Tebes nee mak Maromak,

49.title: Nusaa Hau Tauk Iha Loron Susar?

verses.1: Rona lai, povu hotu!
verses.2: ema boot no ema kiik,
verses.3: Hau nia ibun sei foo sai matenek,
verses.4: Hau see hau nia tilun ba provérbiu ida,
verses.5: Nusaa mak hau tauk iha loron susar,
verses.6: no sira nebee fiar ba sira nia riku-soin,
verses.7: Tebes, ema ida la bele hola fali ninia maluk,
verses.8: tanba folin atu hola fali ninia moris nee karun,
verses.9: hodi nia bele moris ba nafatin,
verses.10: Tanba nia haree katak ema matenek sai mate,
verses.11: Sira nia rate mak sira nia uma too tinan ba tinan,
verses.12: Maski ema hanoin katak nia boot, maibee nia sei la hela ba nafatin,
verses.13: Ida nee mak dalan ba sira nebee iha hanoin beik,
verses.14: Hanesan bibi, ema sira nee tuun ba Fatin Mate,
verses.15: Maibee Maromak sei hola fali hau nia klamar hosi Fatin Mate nia podér,
verses.16: Keta tauk bainhira ema ida sai riku,
verses.17: Tanba bainhira nia mate nia sei la lori buat ida,
verses.18: Maski bainhira nia moris nia foo bensaun ba nia aan -
verses.19: maibee nia sei tuir ninia bei-ala sira,
verses.20: Ema nee iha buat hotu maibee kompriensaun la iha,

verses.1: Maromak nebee forti, Nai Maromak,
verses.2: Maromak leno hela hosi Zion,
verses.3: Ita nia Maromak sei mai,
verses.4: Nia bolu ba lalehan iha leten no ba mundu nee,
verses.5: “Halibur hamutuk mai Hau ema sira nebee laran diak,
verses.6: Lalehan sira sei foo sai Ninia hahalok loos,
verses.7: “Rona lai, Oh Hau nia povu, no Hau sei koalia,
verses.8: Hau la koriji imi tanba imi nia sakrifísiu sira
verses.9: Hau la simu karau aman ida hosi imi nia uma,
verses.10: Tanba animál hotu iha ai laran mak Hau nian,
verses.11: Hau konhese manu hotu iha foho,
verses.12: Se karik Hau hamlaha Hau la foo hatene ba imi,
verses.13: Hau atu haan naan karau
verses.14: Foo agradese ba Maromak,
verses.15: bolu ba Hau iha loron nebee imi hetan terus,
verses.16: Maibee ba ema aat, Maromak dehan,
verses.17: Tanba imi odi disiplina,
verses.18: Bainhira imi haree naok-teen imi kontenti ho nia,
verses.19: Imi koalia arbiru deit kona ba buat nebee aat,
verses.20: Imi tuur no koalia aat hasoru imi nia maluk,
verses.21: Imi halo buat sira nee, no Hau nonook hela,
verses.22: Atensaun ba, imi nebee haluha Maromak,
verses.23: See-see deit nebee foo agradese mai Hau,

51.title: Kria Fuan Laran Moos Iha Hau

verses.1: Oh Maromak, hatudu grasa mai hau,
verses.2: Fasi hau hosi hau nia hahalok aat hotu,
verses.3: Tanba hau rasik hatene hau nia sala aat,
verses.4: Hau kontra O, O deit, ho hau nia sala,
verses.5: Tebes, hau mak ema aat dezde hau moris mai,
verses.6: Tebes, O kontenti ho lia loos iha ema nia laran,
verses.7: Hamoos hau ho isope, no hau sei sai moos,
verses.8: Halo hau rona lian haksolok no kontenti,
verses.9: Subar O nia oin hosi hau nia sala,
verses.10: Kria fuan laran ida nebee moos iha hau, Oh Maromak,
verses.11: Keta soe hau hosi O nia oin,
verses.12: Halo hau haksolok fali tanba O nia salvasaun,
verses.13: Nunee hau sei hanorin O nia dalan ba ema sira nebee kontra O,
verses.14: Hasai hau hosi sala raan nian, Oh Maromak,
verses.15: Oh Nai, loke hau nia ibun tutun,
verses.16: Tanba O lakohi sakrifísiu, se lae karik, hau bele foo duni,
verses.17: Sakrifísiu ba Maromak mak espíritu ida nebee tohar,
verses.18: Halo diak ba Zion tuir O nia laran diak,
verses.19: Depois O sei kontenti ho sakrifísiu nebee loos,

verses.1: Tanba saa mak o gaba aan kona ba hahalok aat, Oh asuwain?
verses.2: O nia nanaal halo hela planu hodi harahun,
verses.3: O hadomi hahalok aat liu fali hahalok diak,
verses.4: O hadomi liafuan nebee tolan ema,
verses.5: Maibee Maromak sei halakon o too rohan laek,

verses.17: Nia hadomi malisan,
verses.18: Nia hatais malisan hanesan ninia faru,

verses.28: Husik sira foo malisan,
verses.29: Husik hau nia akuzadór sira hatais moe,
verses.30: Hau sei foo agradese boot ba Nai ho hau nia ibun,
verses.31: Tanba Nia hamriik iha ema mukit nia sorin loos,

110.title: Nia Iha O Nia Liman Loos

verses.1: Nai dehan ba hau nia Nai,
verses.2: Nai sei haruka o nia rota forti hosi Zion.
verses.3: O nia povu sei prontu iha loron nebee o hatudu o nia podér,
verses.4: Nai jura tiha ona,
verses.5: Nai mak iha o nia liman loos;
verses.6: Nia sei tesi lia iha nasaun sira nia leet,
verses.7: Nia sei hemu hosi mota kiik iha dalan ninin,

verses.1: Aleluia!
verses.2: Nai halo buat nebee boot,
verses.3: Ninia servisu nee furak no naroman,
verses.4: Nia halo Ninia milagre boot sira hodi ema hanoin hetan nafatin;
verses.5: Nia foo haan ba ema sira nebee hamtauk Nia.
verses.6: Nia hatudu ona Ninia forsa ba Ninia povu,

verses.8: Nia estabelese sira too tinan ba tinan,
verses.9: Nia haruka liberdade ba Ninia povu,
verses.10: Hamtauk ba Nai mak huun ba matenek klean,

verses.1: Aleluia!
verses.2: Ninia bei-oan sira sei iha podér iha mundu,
verses.3: Ninia uma iha riku-soin barak,
verses.4: Ba ema loos, naroman leno iha fatin nakukun.
verses.5: Haksolok ba ema nebee iha grasa no bele foo impresta,
verses.6: Ema moris loos sei nunka monu,
verses.7: Nia la tauk bainhira nia simu lia menon nebee aat,
verses.8: Ninia fuan laran sei metin nafatin; nia sei la tauk,
verses.9: Nia fahe ho karidade no nia foo ba ema mukit sira;
verses.10: Ema aat sei haree nunee no sai laran manas;

113.title: Nai Foti Aas Ema Nebee Laran Kiik.

verses.1: Aleluia!
verses.2: Adora Nai nia naran,
verses.3: Hosi lorosae too loromonu,
verses.4: Nai mak aas liu nasaun hotu-hotu,
verses.5: See mak hanesan Nai, ami nia Maromak,
verses.6: nebee hateke tuun
verses.7: Nia foti ema fraku hosi rai rahun
verses.8: hodi hatuur nia ho ema boot sira,
verses.9: Nia foo uma kain ida ba feto ida nebee la iha oan,

verses.1: Iha tempu nebee ema Israel sira sai hosi Ejitu,

verses.3: Tasi haree nunee no halai,
verses.4: Foho boot haksoit hanesan bibi aman,

verses.6: Foho boot sira nee, tanba saa mak imi haksoit hanesan bibi aman?
verses.7: Mundu nakdoko iha Nai nia oin,
verses.8: nebee halo fatuk boot sai fali bee lihun,

verses.1: Laos ba ami, Oh Nai, laos ba ami, maibee foo glória ba O nia naran,

verses.3: Ami nia Maromak mak iha lalehan,

verses.10: Hai, jerasaun Arão nian, fiar ba Nai!
verses.11: Hai, ema sira nebee hamtauk ba Nai, fiar ba Nai!
verses.12: Nai hanoin hetan ita; Nia sei haraik bensaun,

verses.15: Nai sei haraik bensaun ba imi,
verses.16: Lalehan nee mak Nai nia lalehan,

verses.12: Oinsaa hau bele selu fali Nai

verses.14: Hau sei kumpri hau nia juramentu sira ba Nai,

verses.16: Oh Nai, hau mak O nia atan!
verses.17: Hau sei halo sakrifísiu agradese ba O,
verses.18: Hau sei kumpri hau nia juramentu ba Nai,
verses.19: iha Nai nia uma fatin,

verses.27: Nai mak Maromak,

verses.29: Oh foo agradese ba Nai tanba Nia mak diak,

verses.62: Iha kalan boot hau hadeer hodi foo agradese ba O,

verses.85: Ema sira nebee foti aan kee ona rai kuak ba hau,

verses.114: O mak hau nia subar fatin no eskudu;

verses.7: Ema aat mak lakon, no sira la iha,
verses.8: Ema ida sei simu liafuan diak tuir ninia matenek rasik,
verses.9: Diak liu ema nebee iha naran kiik maibee nia iha mos atan,
verses.10: Ema moris loos foo atensaun mos ba ninia animál nia moris,
verses.11: See-see deit nebee fila rai iha ninia toos sei sai bosu ho ninia ai haan,
verses.12: Ema ho hahalok aat hakarak hetan buat nebee ema aat hadau,
verses.13: Ema aat tama lasu tanba sala hosi ninia ibun tutun,
verses.14: Liafuan hosi ema nia ibun sei halo nia sai nakonu ho buat diak,
verses.15: Ema beik hanoin katak ninia dalan nee loos,
verses.16: Ema beik sai hirus kedas,
verses.17: Nia nebee koalia lia loos sei foo sai testemunha onestu,
verses.18: Liafuan arbiru bele sona hanesan surik ida,
verses.19: Ibun tutun nebee koalia lia loos sei metin too rohan laek,
verses.20: Liafuan bosok mak iha sira nebee halo planu aat nia fuan laran,
verses.21: Buat aat sei la kona ema moris loos,
verses.22: Ibun tutun nebee bosok mak foer loos ba Nai,
verses.23: Ema nebee hanoin ho matenek mak subar ninia matenek,
verses.24: Ema badinas nia liman sei kaer ukun,
verses.25: Hanoin barak iha fuan laran sei foo todan ba ema,
verses.26: Ema moris loos sei sai matadalan ba ninia maluk,
verses.27: Ema baruk la tunu buat nebee nia kasa,
verses.28: Iha dalan nebee mak loos iha moris,

13.title: maibee goza door la rona ema nebee hasee nia.

verses.1: Oan nebee iha matenek klean sei rona ninia apaa nia hanorin,
verses.2: Ema sei haan diak tanba liafuan hosi ninia ibun,
verses.3: Nia nebee kuidadu ninia ibun sei kuidadu ninia moris,
verses.4: Ema baruk-teen sei kaan no la hetan buat ida,
verses.5: Ema nebee moris loos odi liafuan bosok,
verses.6: Hahalok loos sei proteje nia nebee lao loos,
verses.7: Iha ema ida nebee finji riku maibee nia la iha buat ida,
verses.8: Ema ida hasai nia aan hosi problema liu hosi ninia riku-soin,
verses.9: Ema nebee moris loos nia lampu sei naroman,
verses.10: Ema nebee gaba aan sei haksesuk malu ho ema seluk,
verses.11: Riku-soin nebee hetan lalais deit sei sai menus,
verses.12: Esperansa nebee tenki hein kleur sei halo fuan laran sai moras,
verses.13: Ema nebee despreza liafuan nee sei estraga ninia aan rasik,
verses.14: Hanorin hosi ema matenek klean mak bee matan moris nian,
verses.15: Hanoin diak sei foo grasa ba o,
verses.16: Ema nebee hanoin ho matenek mak halo buat hotu ho matenek,
verses.17: Mensajeiru aat sei monu ba problema,
verses.18: Nia nebee lakohi simu hanorin sei sai kiak no moe,
verses.19: Buat nebee o buka no hetan sei midar ba o nia klamar,
verses.20: Nia nebee lao ho ema matanek klean sei hetan mos matenek klean,
verses.21: Buat aat sei duni sala nain sira,
verses.22: Ema diak sei rai liman rohan ba ninia bei-oan sira,
verses.23: Ema kiak nia toos bele foo rezultadu barak,
verses.24: Nia nebee lakohi foo disiplina sei odi ninia oan,
verses.25: Ema moris loos nia klamar sei haan too bosu,

14.title: maibee beik-teen mak sobu ninian ho ninia liman rasik.

verses.1: Feto nebee matenek liu mak harii ninia uma,
verses.2: Nia nebee lao ho laran loos hamtauk ba Nai,
verses.3: Beik-teen nia ibun mak ai tonka nebee baku nia,
verses.4: Iha fatin nebee karau la iha, karau nia haan fatin mos mamuk,
verses.5: Sasin fiel sei la bosok,
verses.6: Goza door ida buka matenek klean, no nia la hetan,
verses.7: Hadook aan hosi beik-teen nia prezensa,
verses.8: Ema matenek klean hanoin di-diak hodi kompriende ninia dalan,
verses.9: Beik-teen sira goza oferta multa nian,
verses.10: Fuan laran ida-idak hatene ninia difikuldade,
verses.11: Ema aat nia uma sei lakon,
verses.12: Iha dalan ida nebee ema hanoin katak loos,
verses.13: Fuan laran bele hamnasa maibee nia sei tristi hela,
verses.14: Ema nebee fila kotuk iha nia laran sei sai nakonu hosi ninia hahalok nee nia rezultadu,
verses.15: Ema nebee la iha esperiénsia fiar ba liafuan hotu,
verses.16: Ema matenek klean sei hamtauk no nia hadook aan hosi buat aat,
verses.17: Nia nebee hirus lalais halo buat beik,
verses.18: Ema nebee la iha esperiénsia sei hetan buat beik,
verses.19: Ema aat hakruuk ba ema diak,
verses.20: Ema kiak nia maluk mos odi nia,
verses.21: Nia nebee despreza ninia maluk mak halo sala,
verses.22: Laos sira nebee halo planu aat mak sala?
verses.23: Iha servisu badinas hotu o hetan rezultadu diak,
verses.24: Ema matenek klean nia koroa mak ninia riku-soin,
verses.25: Sasin nebee loos sei salva ema sira nia moris,
verses.26: Ema nebee hamtauk ba Nai iha konfiansa forti,
verses.27: Hahalok nebee hamtauk ba Nai mak hanesan bee matan moris nian,
verses.28: Liurai hetan onra liu hosi ema barak,
verses.29: Ema nebee pasiénsia iha kompriensaun luan,
verses.30: Fuan laran nebee hakmatek sei foo moris ba isin lolon,
verses.31: Ema nebee hanehan ema fraku despreza ninia Kriadór,
verses.32: Ema aat sei monu liu hosi ninia hahalok aat,
verses.33: Matenek klean hela iha ema nia laran nebee iha kompriensaun,
verses.34: Hahalok loos sei hasae nasaun ida,
verses.35: Liurai sei simu diak ninia atan nebee iha matenek klean,

15.title: maibee liafuan todan sei provoka laran hirus.

verses.1: Hataan ho laran maus sei hatuun laran hirus,
verses.2: Ema matenek klean nia nanaal sei foo sai matenek diak,
verses.3: Nai nia matan iha fatin hotu-hotu,
verses.4: Nanaal nebee kura mak hanesan ai horis nebee foo moris,
verses.5: Beik-teen ida despreza ninia apaa nia hanorin,
verses.6: Ema nebee moris loos nia uma iha riku-soin barak,
verses.7: Ema matenek klean nia ibun tutun sei fahe liafuan matenek,
verses.8: Ema aat nia sakrifísiu mak foer loos ba Nai,
verses.9: Ema aat nia dalan mak foer loos ba Nai,
verses.10: Disiplina makaas sei hasoru nia nebee lao sees hosi dalan loos,
verses.11: Fatin Mate no Infernu mak iha Nai nia oin,
verses.12: Goza door ida lakohi ema nebee atu koriji nia,
verses.13: Fuan laran nebee ksolok sei halo oin kontenti,
verses.14: Ema nia fuan laran nebee iha kompriensaun buka matenek,
verses.15: Loron hotu mak aat ba ema nebee iha moris susar,
verses.16: Diak liu o iha sasaan uitoan deit ho hamtauk ba Nai,
verses.17: Diak liu o haan modo simples ho domin,
verses.18: Ema ho laran hirus aumenta problema,
verses.19: Ema baruk nia dalan sei nakonu ho ai tarak,
verses.20: Oan nebee iha matenek klean halo ninia apaa kontenti,
verses.21: Hahalok beik halo ema ksolok nebee la iha matenek klean,
verses.22: Se o la iha konselhu nunee o nia planu sira la lao,
verses.23: Resposta diak halo ema ida haksolok,
verses.24: Ema matenek klean nia dalan moris sei sae ba leten,
verses.25: Nai sei destrui ema nebee foti aan nia uma,
verses.26: Ema aat nia hanoin mak foer loos ba Nai,
verses.27: Nia nebee buka manaan liu hosi korupsaun sei kria problema ba ninia uma,
verses.28: Ema moris loos nia fuan laran hanoin oinsaa foo resposta,
verses.29: Nai sei dook hosi ema aat tebes,
verses.30: Naroman iha matan sei halo laran haksolok,
verses.31: Tilun sira nebee rona liafuan moris nian nebee hasee nia
verses.32: Ema nebee lakohi simu hanorin sei despreza ninia aan rasik,
verses.33: Hahalok nebee hamtauk ba Nai sei hanorin matenek klean,

16.title: maibee desizaun sei mai hosi Nai nia nanaal.

verses.1: Ema bele halo planu iha ninia fuan laran,
verses.2: Tuir nia haree rasik, ema nia dalan hotu nee moos,
verses.3: Entrega o nia servisu ba Nai,
verses.4: Nai halo buat hotu tuir Ninia planu,
verses.5: Ema hotu nebee foti aan iha sira nia fuan laran mak foer loos ba Nai,
verses.6: Liu hosi domin metin no fidelidade ema bele hamoos sala,
verses.7: Bainhira Nai kontenti ho ema ida nia dalan,
verses.8: Diak liu o iha uitoan deit ho moris nebee loos,
verses.9: Ema ida nia fuan laran halo planu kona ba ninia dalan,
verses.10: Liurai nia ibun tutun sei foo sai desizaun Maromak nian,
verses.11: Dasin no nia besi nebee tetu loos mak Nai nian,
verses.12: Bainhira liurai sira halo buat aat, nee mak foer loos,
verses.13: Ibun tutun loos halo liurai kontenti,
verses.14: Liurai nia hirus mak hanesan ema nebee lori mensajen mate nian,
verses.15: Iha liurai nia oin nebee naroman, ema hetan moris,
verses.16: Oinsaa, diak liu o hetan matenek klean duké osan mean!
verses.17: Dalan diak ba ema onestu mak hahalok nebee sees hosi buat aat,
verses.18: Hahalok nebee gaba aan mak uluk tempu nebee lakon hotu,
verses.19: Diak liu o iha espíritu nebee tuun hamutuk ho ema nebee haraik aan,
verses.20: Nia nebee foo atensaun ba liafuan nee sei hetan diak,
verses.21: Ema nebee iha laran matenek klean sei kompriende diak,
verses.22: Kompriensaun mak bee matan moris ba nia nebee iha kompriensaun,
verses.23: Ema matenek klean nia fuan laran mak hanorin ninia ibun,
verses.24: Liafuan furak mak hanesan bani been,
verses.25: Ema ida hanoin dalan ida sei loos,
verses.26: Ema nia kabun haruka nia ba servisu,
verses.27: Ema nebee la iha folin halo planu aat,
verses.28: Ema nebee la koalia onestu kria problema,
verses.29: Ema nebee halo violénsia sei dada ninia maluk,
verses.30: Nia nebee piska matan mak halo planu nebee la onestu,
verses.31: Fuuk mutin mak koroa glória nian,
verses.32: Nia nebee iha pasiénsia mak forti liu asuwain,
verses.33: Ema dada rifa,

17.title: duké uma nakonu ho festa nebee iha problema.

verses.1: Diak liu ai haan maran uitoan ho hakmatek,
verses.2: Atan nebee iha matenek klean sei ukun oan mane nebee halo moe,
verses.3: Bikan ahi hamoos osan mutin, no fugaun hamoos osan mean,
verses.4: Ema nebee halo aat sei tuir ibun tutun aat,
verses.5: See-see deit nebee goza ema kiak koalia aat ba ninia Kriadór,
verses.6: Bei-oan sira mak koroa ba ema katuas,
verses.7: Baibain liafuan furak la mai hosi ema beik-teen,
verses.8: Prezenti ida mak hanesan fatuk murak ba nia nebee foo prezenti nee,
verses.9: Nia nebee taka sala buka domin,
verses.10: Liafuan disiplina nian impaktu ema matenek klean,
verses.11: Ema aat buka deit atu kontra,
verses.12: Diak liu ema ida hasoru ursu nebee lakon tiha ninia oan sira,
verses.13: Ema nebee selu hahalok diak ho buat aat,
verses.14: Bainhira ema hahuu istori malu nee mak hanesan foin loke bee,
verses.15: Nia nebee justifika ema aat, no nia nebee kondena ema moris loos,
verses.16: Nusaa mak ema beik-teen iha osan iha nia liman hodi sosa matenek klean,
verses.17: Belun ida hadomi nafatin hela deit,
verses.18: Ema ida nebee la iha kompriensaun sei kaer liman,
verses.19: Nia nebee hadomi sala aat mak hadomi problema,
verses.20: Nia nebee iha fuan laran falsu sei la hetan buat diak,
verses.21: Nia nebee hetan oan beik hetan mos laran tristi,
verses.22: Fuan laran kontenti mak aimoruk nebee diak,
verses.23: Ema aat simu prezenti subar hosi ema nia lipa
verses.24: Nia nebee iha kompriensaun haree ba matenek klean,
verses.25: Oan ida nebee beik halo ninia apaa laran tristi,
verses.26: La diak atu kastigu ema moris loos,
verses.27: Nia nebee matenek sei kuidadu ninia liafuan,
verses.28: Ema hanoin katak beik-teen iha matenek klean bainhira nia nonook,

verses.1: Ema nebee hakarak lao mesak buka ninia hakarak deit,
verses.2: Beik-teen ida la gosta atu kompriende,
verses.3: Bainhira ema aat mai, nunee respeitu mak lakon,
verses.4: Liafuan hosi ema nia ibun mak hanesan bee klean,
verses.5: La diak atu defende ema aat,
verses.6: Beik-teen nia ibun tutun hakarak diskuti malu,
verses.7: Beik-teen nia ibun sei destrui nia,
verses.8: Liafuan hosi lori lia door mak halo kanek ba nia,
verses.9: Nia nebee servisu ho hahalok baruk
verses.10: Nai nia naran mak uma aas nebee forti,
verses.11: Ema riku nia riku-soin mak ninia sidade forti,
verses.12: Molok nia lakon, ema nia fuan laran gaba aan,
verses.13: Nia nebee foo resposta molok nia rona,
verses.14: Ema nia espíritu bele tahan ninia isin nebee moras,
verses.15: Ema nebee kompriende iha nia laran sei hetan matenek,
verses.16: Ema nia prezenti loke oportunidade ba nia,
verses.17: Ita hanoin katak nia nebee konta uluk ninia kazu mak loos,
verses.18: Dada rifa sei hapara diskuti malu,
verses.19: Maluk ida nebee fahe malu ho o mak susar liu atu manaan fali
verses.20: Ema nia kabun sai bosu liu hosi ninia ibun nia fuan,
verses.21: Nanaal iha podér hodi halo mate ka moris,
verses.22: Nia nebee hetan feen, hetan buat diak,
verses.23: Ema kiak husu ho haraik aan,
verses.24: Ema nebee iha kolega barak bele estraga aan,

19.title: duké nia nebee foo sai liafuan kleuk no nia beik-teen.

verses.1: Diak liu ema kiak nebee lao loos,
verses.2: Moris ida nebee la iha matenek mak la diak,
verses.3: Ema nia hahalok beik sei halo nia dalan sai kleuk,
verses.4: Riku-soin sei aumenta kolega barak,
verses.5: Sasin falsu sei la sees hosi kastigu,
verses.6: Ema barak buka atu halo xefi kontenti ho sira,
verses.7: Ema kiak nia maun-alin sira odi nia,
verses.8: Nia nebee hetan matenek klean mak hadomi ninia aan rasik,
verses.9: Sasin falsu sei la sees hosi kastigu,
verses.10: Vida riku laduun loos ba beik-teen ida,
verses.11: Ema nebee hanoin ho matenek sei neineik atu sai hirus,
verses.12: Liurai nia laran hirus mak hanesan liaun ida nebee halo lian makaas,
verses.13: Oan ida nebee beik-teen mak estraga ninia apaa,
verses.14: Uma no riku-soin mak liman rohan hosi apaa sira,
verses.15: Hahalok baruk halo o matan dukur haluha rai,
verses.16: Nia nebee proteje ukun fuan proteje ninia moris rasik,
verses.17: Ema nebee hatudu laran diak ba ema kiak mak foo empresta ba Nai,
verses.18: Disiplina o nia oan bainhira esperansa sei iha,
verses.19: Ema nebee sai hirus makaas sei selu multa,
verses.20: Rona konselhu, no simu hanorin,
verses.21: Ema ida iha ideia barak iha nia fuan laran,
verses.22: Ita hakarak hetan domin metin hosi ema,
verses.23: Hamtauk ba Nai sei foo moris;
verses.24: Baruk-teen hatuun ninia liman ba ninia bikan,
verses.25: Baku goza door ida, no ema beik-teen sei aprende diak,
verses.26: Nia nebee halo violénsia ba ninia apaa, no duni sai ninia amaa,
verses.27: Se o la rona instrusaun, Oh hau nia oan,
verses.28: Sasin ida nebee la iha folin mak goza justisa,
verses.29: Ema prepara kastigu ba goza door sira,

20.title: no ema nebee simu bosok hosi buat sira nee la iha matenek klean.

verses.1: Tua uvas mak goza door, no tua manas halo barulhu,
verses.2: Liurai halo ita tauk hanesan liaun nia lian makaas,
verses.3: Ema ida hetan onra bainhira nia husik akuzasaun,
verses.4: Baruk-teen sei la fila rai tanba malirin liu,
verses.5: Ema nia planu iha nia fuan laran hanesan bee klean,
verses.6: Ema barak foo sai katak nia iha domin metin,
verses.7: Ema moris loos lao ho laran loos -
verses.8: Liurai ida nebee tuur iha kadunan julgamentu nian
verses.9: See mak dehan, “Hau hamoos ona hau nia fuan laran;
verses.10: Dasin falsu no buat sukat nebee falsu,
verses.11: Ita konhese labarik liu hosi ninia hahalok,
verses.12: Tilun nebee rona, no matan nebee haree,
verses.13: Keta gosta toba dukur deit, hodi o la sai kiak,
verses.14: “La diak, la diak,” dehan nia nebee sosa,
verses.15: Osan mean sei iha, no rubi sira sei barak,
verses.16: Foti ema nia manta bainhira nia foo garantia kona ba ema rai liur,
verses.17: Paun bosok nian sei midar ba ema ida,
verses.18: O bele estabelese planu hotu liu hosi konselhu,
verses.19: Nia nebee lao ba-mai hanesan lori lia door sei foo sai segredu,
verses.20: See-see deit nebee foo malisan ba ninia apaa ka ninia amaa,
verses.21: Fo-foun o bele hetan liman rohan lalais,
verses.22: Keta dehan, “Hau sei selu fali ema nebee halo aat,”
verses.23: Besi nebee sukat sala mak foer loos ba Nai,
verses.24: Nai mak diriji ema nia hakat sira,
verses.25: Ida nee mak lasu ida, bainhira ema dehan ho ansi, “Buat nee santu,”
verses.26: Liurai ida nebee iha hahalok matenek haliri sai ema aat,
verses.27: Ema nia espíritu mak lampu Nai nian,
verses.28: Domin metin no fidelidade sei proteje liurai,
verses.29: Joven mane sira nia glória mak sira nia isin forti,
verses.30: Kanek todan sei hamoos hahalok aat,

21.title: Nia bele diriji liurai nee tuir Ninia hakarak.

verses.1: Liurai nia laran mak iha Nai nia liman hanesan mota ida,
verses.2: Ema nia dalan hotu mak loos tuir ninia matan rasik,
verses.3: Ba Nai, hahalok loos no justisa
verses.4: Matan sira nebee foti aan, no fuan laran nebee gaba aan,
verses.5: Ema badinas nia planu sei foo rezultadu diak,
verses.6: Riku-soin nebee hetan liu hosi nanaal nebee bosok,
verses.7: Ema aat sira nia violénsia sei halakon sira,
verses.8: Sala nain nia dalan mak kleuk,
verses.9: Diak liu o hela iha uma leten nia ninin,
verses.10: Ema aat nia klamar hakarak buat aat,
verses.11: Bainhira goza door hetan disiplina,
verses.12: Ida Nebee Moris Loos haree di-diak ba ema aat nia uma,
verses.13: See-see deit nebee lakohi rona ema kiak nebee hakilar,
verses.14: Prezenti nebee foo ho segredu sei hatuun laran hirus,
verses.15: Bainhira justisa lao, ema moris loos sei haksolok,
verses.16: Ema nebee lao sees hosi dalan kompriensaun nian
verses.17: Nia nebee gosta halimar deit sei sai kiak,
verses.18: Povu sei husik ema aat hodi hola fali ema moris loos,
verses.19: Diak liu o hela iha rai fuik,
verses.20: Riku-soin karun no mina mak iha ema matenek klean nia uma,
verses.21: Nia nebee duni tuir hahalok loos no domin metin
verses.22: Ema matenek klean bele ataka funu nain nia sidade,
verses.23: See-see deit nebee proteje ninia ibun no ninia nanaal
verses.24: Ema nebee foti aan no gaba aan mak hetan naran ‘Goza Door’,
verses.25: Baruk-teen nia hakarak mak oho nia,
verses.26: Loron tomak nia kaan hela deit,
verses.27: Ema aat nia sakrifísiu mak foer loos,
verses.28: Sasin falsu sei lakon,
verses.29: Ema aat hatudu oin brani,
verses.30: La iha matenek klean, kompriensaun ka konselhu
verses.31: Ema prepara kuda hodi halo funu,

22.title: no grasa duké osan mutin no osan mean.

verses.1: Diak liu o hetan naran diak duké riku-soin boot,
verses.2: Ema riku hamutuk ho ema kiak:
verses.3: Ema nebee matenek haree buat aat nebee atu mai no nia subar aan,
verses.4: Liu hosi haraik aan no hamtauk ba Nai
verses.5: Ema falsu nia dalan iha ai tarak no lasu sira,
verses.6: Foo treinu ba labarik ida atu lao tuir dalan nebee loos,
verses.7: Ema riku ukun ema kiak,
verses.8: Nia nebee kuda hahalok aat sei hetan problema,
verses.9: Nia nebee laran luak sei hetan bensaun,
verses.10: Duni sai goza door, no diskuti malu mos sai,
verses.11: Nia nebee hadomi fuan laran nebee moos,
verses.12: Nai sei tau matan ba matenek,
verses.13: Baruk-teen dehan, “Liaun lao iha liur!
verses.14: Feto estranjeiru nia ibun mak rai kuak klean,
verses.15: Hahalok beik sei metin iha labarik nia fuan laran,
verses.16: Ema nebee hanehan ema kiak hodi aumenta ninia riku-soin,
verses.17: See o nia tilun, no rona liafuan hosi ema matenek klean,
verses.18: Tanba nee diak se o proteje liafuan nee iha o nia laran,
verses.19: Hodi o sei tau fiar iha Nai,

2.title: Halo Aan Kontenti Mos Saugati Deit

verses.1: Hau dehan iha hau nia fuan laran, “Agora koko took - hau sei koko aan ho haksolok. Nunee halo aan kontenti ba.” Maibee tebes, buat nee mos saugati deit.
verses.2: Hau dehan kona ba laran hamnasa, “Ida nee bulak,” no kona ba laran kontenti, “Ida nee folin saida?”
verses.3: Hau buka iha nia fuan laran oinsaa atu halo aan kontenti ho tua uvas - no hau nia fuan laran lori hau nafatin ho matenek klean. No hau koko atu halao buat beik. Hau koko halo hanesan nee hodi hatene saida mak diak ba ema atu halo iha lalehan okos durante ema nia moris nebee badak.
verses.4: Hau halo buat boot. Hau harii uma no kuda toos uvas sira.
verses.5: Hau halo jardin no toos ai nian. No hau kuda ai horis sira nebee iha fuan oi-oin.
verses.6: Hau halo bee lihun nebee iha bee, hodi rega fatin nebee kuda ai horis sira nee.
verses.7: Hau hetan atan mane no atan feto sira. No hau hetan atan sira nebee moris iha hau nia uma. No mos hau hetan riku-soin boot ho bibi lubun no karau lubun sira. Hau hetan buat barak liu fali ema hotu nebee uluk hau iha Jerusalém.
verses.8: Hau halibur mos osan mutin no osan mean, no riku-soin hosi liurai sira no distritu sira. Hau hetan kantadór no kantadora sira, no feto bar-barak, buat nebee halo ema kontenti.
verses.9: Nunee hau sai boot. Hau sai boot liu fali ema hotu nebee iha Jerusalém uluk hau. No hau nia matenek klean mak hamutuk hela ho hau.
verses.10: Saida deit nebee hau nia matan hakarak hetan, buat nee hau hetan. Hau la taka netik hau nia fuan laran hosi buat saida deit nebee halo hau haksolok. Tanba hau nia fuan laran sai haksolok iha hau nia servisu. No nee mak hau nia kolen tanba hau nia servisu hotu.
verses.11: Depois hau haree ba buat hotu nebee hau nia liman halo ona. Hau haree ba hau nia servisu todan nebee hau halo ona. No tebes, buat hotu saugati deit no hahalok nebee duni anin. Ita la bele manaan buat ida iha loro matan okos.
verses.12: Depois hau fila hodi hanoin matenek klean no hahalok bulak no beik. Tanba saida mak ema nebee tuir liurai nee bele halo? Só deit buat nebee akontese ona.
verses.13: Depois hau haree katak matenek klean mak diak liu hahalok beik, hanesan naroman mak diak liu nakukun.
verses.14: Ema matenek klean iha matan iha ninia ulun maibee beik-teen lao iha fatin nakukun. Maibee hau haree katak ema hotu nee simu hanesan deit.
verses.15: Depois hau dehan iha hau nia fuan laran, “Buat nebee akontese ba beik tein, sei akontese mos mai hau. Nunee tanba saa mak hau aumenta hau nia matenek klean nee?” No hau dehan iha hau nia fuan laran katak buat nee mos saugati deit.
verses.16: Tanba ema la hanoin hetan ema matenek klean liu fali ema beik. Tanba iha tempu tuir mai, ema sei haluha buat hotu nee. No ema matenek klean mate deit hanesan ema beik!
verses.17: Nunee hau odi moris. Tanba buat nebee akontese iha mundu halo hau nia laran susar. Tanba buat hotu saugati deit, hanesan duni anin deit.
verses.18: Hau odi hau nia servisu hotu nebee hau halo iha loro matan okos. Tanba hau sei husik buat nee ba ema nebee tuir hau.
verses.19: No see mak hatene ema nee mak ema matenek klean ka ema beik? Maibee ema nee sei sai nain ba hau nia servisu hotu nebee hau halo ona, no buat hotu nebee hatudu hau nia matenek klean iha loro matan okos. Buat nee mos saugati deit.
verses.20: Entaun hau fila fali no hau iha laran tristi liu kona ba servisu hotu nebee hau halo ona iha loro matan okos.
verses.21: Tanba ema nebee servisu ho matenek klean, konhesimentu no susesu tenki husik buat hotu nee ba ema nebee la servisu hodi hetan buat sira nee. Ida nee mos saugati deit no aat tebes.
verses.22: Tanba ema manaan saida hosi ninia servisu hotu no laran susar nebee nia halao iha loro matan okos?
