verses.23: Ninia loron sira hotu mak susar, no ninia servisu nee foo terus. No ninia fuan laran la hetan deskansa iha kalan. Ida nee mos saugati deit.
verses.24: Entaun diak liu ema haan hemu deit, no sai kontenti iha ninia servisu. Hau haree mos katak ida nee mai hosi Maromak nia liman.
verses.25: Tanba ketak hosi Nia, see mak bele haan no sai kontenti?
verses.26: Tanba Maromak foo matenek klean, konhesimentu no haksolok ba ema nebee halo Nia kontenti. Maibee ba sala nain, Nia foo servisu atu halibur riku-soin hodi foo fali ba ema nebee diak iha Maromak nia oin. Ida nee mos saugati deit, hanesan duni anin deit.

verses.1: Buat hotu iha ninia tempu, no atividade hotu iha lalehan okos iha ninia tempu:
verses.2: Tempu ida atu moris mai, tempu ida atu mate;
verses.3: tempu ida atu oho, tempu ida atu kura;
verses.4: tempu ida atu tanis, tempu ida atu hamnasa;
verses.5: tempu ida atu soe fatuk, tempu ida atu halibur fatuk hamutuk;
verses.6: tempu ida atu hetan, tempu ida atu lakon;
verses.7: tempu ida atu lees, tempu ida atu suku;
verses.8: tempu ida atu hadomi, tempu ida atu odi;
verses.9: Ema manaan saida hosi ninia servisu nebee nia halo?
verses.10: Hau haree tiha ona servisu nebee Maromak foo ona ba povu hodi halo.
verses.11: Maromak halo buat hotu furak tuir ninia tempu. No mos, Nia tau tempu rohan laek iha ema nia fuan laran. Maibee ema la bele deskobre Maromak nia servisu nebee Nia halao hosi hahuu too ikus.
verses.12: Hau haree katak la iha buat ida nebee diak liu ba sira duké sira haksolok no halo buat diak durante sira nia moris tomak.
verses.13: No mos ema tenki haan hemu no sai kontenti ho ninia servisu hotu. Ida nee mak prezenti hosi Maromak.
verses.14: Hau hatene katak buat saida deit nebee Maromak halo, buat nee sei dura too tinan ba tinan. La bele aumenta no la bele hamenus buat nee. Maromak halo nunee hodi ema bele hamtauk ba Nia.
verses.15: Buat nebee sei iha nee mak akontese tiha ona, no buat nebee atu mai mak liu tiha ona. No Maromak buka buat nebee ema duni ona.
verses.16: No mos, hau haree iha loro matan okos, fatin ida hodi tesi lia, no hahalok aat mak iha nebaa. No hau haree fatin ida nebee iha hahalok loos, no hahalok aat mak iha nebaa.
verses.17: Hau dehan iha hau nia fuan laran, Maromak sei tesi lia ba ema moris loos no ema hahalok aat. Tanba atividade hotu no servisu hotu iha sira nia tempu.
verses.18: Hau dehan iha hau nia fuan laran kona ba povu nia situasaun katak Maromak mak koko sira hodi sira bele haree katak sira rasik mak animál deit.
verses.19: Tanba buat nebee akontese ba povu no buat nebee akontese ba animál sira mak hanesan deit. Ida mak mate, no ida seluk mos mate. Sira hotu dada iis hanesan deit. Nunee ema la aas liu animál. Buat hotu saugati deit.
verses.20: Sira hotu tama ba fatin ida. Sira hotu mai hosi rai rahun, no sira hotu nee fila fali ba rai rahun.
verses.21: See mak hatene se ema nia espíritu sae ba leten, no animál nia espíritu tuun ba rai?
verses.22: Nunee hau haree katak la iha buat ida nebee diak liu, só ema bele haksolok iha ninia servisu, tanba buat nee mak ninian. Tanba see mak bele lori nia hodi nia bele haree buat nebee tuir nia?

4.title: Buat Aat Iha Loro Matan Okos

verses.1: Hau haree fali terus hotu nebee akontese iha loro matan okos. Tebes, matan been suli hosi sira nebee hetan terus, tanba la iha ema ida atu hamaus sira. No ema nebee foo terus nee iha kbiit, maibee ema nee mos la iha ema ida atu hamaus nia.
verses.2: Nunee hau deklara katak ema nebee mate ona mak sorti liu ema nebee sei moris hela.
verses.3: No ida nebee sorti liu sira nain rua mak ema nebee seidauk moris mai. Tanba nia seidauk haree hahalok aat nebee ema halao iha loro matan okos.
verses.4: Depois hau haree servisu todan no servisu matenek hotu. Hau haree katak ema halo hanesan nee tanba nia laran moras hodi sai diak liu ninia maluk. Buat nee mos saugati deit no duni anin.
verses.5: Beik-teen hikar ninia liman hamutuk, no nia haan ninia isin rasik.
verses.6: Diak liu liman ida nebee nakonu ho moris hakmatek, duké liman rua nebee nakonu ho servisu kole no duni anin.
verses.7: Hau haree buat seluk nebee saugati deit iha loro matan okos:
verses.8: ema mesak ida nebee la iha ema seluk. Nia la iha oan ka maun-alin. Maibee ninia servisu la para. No ninia matan nunka bosu ho riku-soin. No nia la husu, “Hau servisu ba see, no tanba saa mak hau la halo aan kontenti?” Buat nee mos saugati deit no servisu nebee aat.
verses.9: Ema nain rua mak diak liu ema nain ida, tanba sira manaan diak hosi sira nia servisu.
verses.10: Tanba se ida monu, ema ida fali bele hiit sae ninia maluk. Maibee susar ba ema nebee mesak deit bainhira nia monu. Tanba nia la iha ema seluk hodi ajuda nia.
verses.11: No mos, se ema nain rua toba hamutuk, sira bele senti manas hela. Maibee oinsaa ema ida nebee mesak deit bele senti manas?
verses.12: Ema ida bele hadau nia nebee mesak, maibee ema rua bele kontra ema nee. No tali tolu nebee bobar hamutuk sei la kotu lalais.
verses.13: Labarik ida nebee kiak no matenek klean mak diak liu liurai ida nebee idade boot no beik, nebee la simu tan konselhu.
verses.14: Tanba nia sai hosi komarka hodi ukun, maski nia kiak bainhira nia moris mai iha reinu nee.
verses.15: Hau haree ona ema hotu nebee moris no lao iha loro matan okos, no sira tuir labarik nee nebee atu hamriik no troka liurai.
verses.16: Ema barak demais lao tuir nia. Maibee sira nebee tuir mai sei la haksolok ho nia. Loos duni, ida nee mos saugati deit no duni anin.

verses.1: Hakat ho kuidadu bainhira o baa Maromak nia uma. Baa ho laran prontu liu atu rona duké foo sakrifísiu beik-teen nian. Sira la hanoin katak buat nebee sira halo mak aat.
verses.2: Keta ansi ho o nia ibun, no la bele husik o nia fuan laran koalia lalais iha Maromak nia oin. Tanba Maromak mak iha lalehan, no o hela iha mundu; nunee foo sai liafuan badak deit.
verses.3: Tanba mehi ida mai bainhira ema servisu barak demais, no beik-teen nia lian mai bainhira liafuan barak demais.
verses.4: Bainhira o jura ba Maromak, la bele demora atu kumpri juramentu nee. Tanba Nia la kontenti ho beik-teen sira. Kumpri buat nebee o jura.
verses.5: Diak liu o la jura, duké o jura no la kumpri.
verses.6: Keta husik o nia ibun lori o ba sala. Lalika dehan iha mensajeiru nia oin katak nee mak sala. Nusaa mak o halo Maromak hirus ho o nia lian no estraga o nia liman nia servisu?
verses.7: Tanba bainhira mehi aumenta no liafuan sai barak nee mak saugati deit. Maibee o tenki hamtauk Maromak.
verses.8: Se o haree ema boot hanehan ema kiak, no ema violénsia estraga justisa no hahalok loos iha distritu ida, lalika hakfodak kona ba hahalok nee. Tanba funsionáriu boot liu mak haree ba ema boot nee. No ida boot liu nee iha funsionáriu ida nebee aas liu fali nia.
verses.9: Rezultadu hosi rai nee mak ema hotu nian; no liurai rasik mos hetan benefísiu hosi rai.
verses.10: Nia nebee hadomi osan mutin sei la kontenti ho osan mutin, no nia nebee hadomi riku-soin sei la kontenti ho ninia kolen. Nee mos saugati deit.
verses.11: Bainhira sasaan aumenta, ema nebee presiza uza sasaan nee mos aumenta. Sasaan nia nain hetan benefísiu saida? Só atu haree deit ho ninia matan.
verses.12: Ema nebee servisu sei toba dukur diak, maski nia haan uitoan ka barak. Maibee ema riku nia riku-soin barak nee la husik nia atu toba dukur.
verses.13: Iha buat ida nebee aat liu iha loro matan okos: ema nebee tau matan ba ninia riku-soin hetan buat aat.
verses.14: Riku-soin nee sei lakon tanba buat aat akontese. Nia mak aman ba oan mane ida, maibee nia la iha buat ida iha ninia liman.
verses.15: Ema sai hosi inan nia kabun laran ho isin molik, nunee nia sei fila fali hanesan nee. Nia la bele foti buat ida hosi ninia servisu hodi lori baa iha ninia liman.
verses.16: Ida nee mos aat tebes: hanesan nia mai, nia sei baa. No nia manaan saida ho ninia servisu todan nebee nia halo hodi hetan anin?
verses.17: Durante nia loron hotu nia haan iha fatin nakukun, no nia iha laran susar no laran hirus no isin moras barak.
verses.18: Tebes, hau haree ona buat nebee diak no loos, katak ema haan hemu ho haksolok ho servisu hotu nebee nia halao iha loro matan okos durante ninia moris tomak nebee Maromak foo ba nia. Tanba nee mak ninia liman rohan.
verses.19: No ba ema hotu nebee Maromak foo riku-soin no sasaan barak, no foo lisensa atu uza riku-soin nee, no ema nebee bele foti ninia liman rohan, no sai haksolok iha ninia servisu - buat nee mak prezenti hosi Maromak.
verses.20: Nia laduun hanoin hetan ninia loron sira iha ninia moris, tanba Maromak halo ninia fuan laran sai haksolok.

verses.1: Hau haree buat aat iha loro matan okos, no buat nee akontese beibeik iha ema nia leet.
verses.2: Maromak foo riku-soin, sasaan barak no onra ba ema ida, no ninia moris la falta buat ida nebee nia hakarak hetan. Maibee Maromak la foo lisensa hodi uza buat sira nee, só ema seluk mak uza. Buat nee saugati deit, no terus nebee aat.
verses.3: Se ema ida hetan oan nain atus ida, no nia moris ba tinan barak too idade boot, maibee ninia moris la nakonu ho buat diak, no nia la hetan lia mate, nunee hau dehan katak diak liu bebee nebee mate molok nia moris mai duké ema ida nee.
verses.4: Tanba bebee nee mai saugati deit no sai fali iha nakukun. No nakukun mak falun ninia naran.
verses.5: Nia la haree loro matan ka hatene buat ida. Nunee nia hakmatek liu ema katuas nee.
verses.6: Maski nia moris too tinan rihun ida dala rua, maibee nia la haree buat diak - laos ema hotu tama ba fatin ida deit?
verses.7: Ema hotu servisu tanba sira nia ibun, maibee kabun nunka bosu.
verses.8: Tanba ema matenek klean iha vantajen saida nebee diak liu fali ema beik? Ou ema kiak manaan saida bainhira nia hatene oinsaa atu lao iha ema moris nia oin?
verses.9: Buat nebee ita haree ho matan mak diak liu buat nebee ita hakarak hetan. Buat nee mos saugati deit no duni anin.
verses.10: Buat nebee mai mak hetan ona ninia naran. Ita hatene saida mak ema nee. No ema la bele diskuti malu ho ida nebee forti liu nia.
verses.11: Ita haree katak liafuan barak mak habarak buat nebee saugati deit. No buat nee foo benefísiu saida ba ema?
verses.12: Tanba see mak hatene buat nebee diak ba ema? Nia gasta loron hotu hosi ninia moris nebee saugati nee nudar lalatak ida. See mak bele foo hatene ba mane ida kona ba buat nebee sei tuir nia iha loro matan okos?

7.title: Kompara Matenek Klean no Hahalok Beik

verses.1: Naran ida nebee iha onra mak diak liu mina morin diak,
verses.2: Diak liu ita baa uma nebee ema tanis lelir,
verses.3: Laran susar mak diak liu laran nebee hamnasa,
verses.4: Ema matenek klean nia fuan laran mak iha uma tanis nian,
verses.5: Diak liu ita rona ema matenek klean nebee hasee ita,
verses.6: Tanba hanesan lian hosi ai tarak nebee lakan iha sanan okos,
verses.7: Tebes, terus halo ema matenek klean sai bulak,
verses.8: Buat ida nia rohan mak diak liu tempu nia hahuu.
verses.9: Keta ansi hodi sai hirus iha ita nia espíritu,
verses.10: La bele dehan, “Tanba saa mak loron uluk nian mak diak liu loron agora nian?”
verses.11: Matenek klean mak diak ho liman rohan,
verses.12: Matenek klean mak mahon,
verses.13: Hanoin di-diak Maromak nia servisu:
verses.14: Sai haksolok iha loron diak, maibee iha loron aat hanoin di-diak: Maromak halo loron ida hanesan Nia halo loron seluk nee. Nunee ema la bele hatene buat ida nebee atu tuir mai.
verses.15: Iha hau nia moris nebee saugati deit, hau haree ona buat hotu. Hau haree ema moris loos nebee mate ho ninia moris loos, no ema aat nebee hetan moris naruk ho ninia hahalok aat.
verses.16: Lalika iha moris nebee loos liu, no lalika sai matenek klean liu. Nusaa o tenki estraga aan?
verses.17: Lalika sai aat liu, no lalika sai beik. Nusaa mak o tenki mate molok o nia tempu?
verses.18: Diak liu o kaer liafuan ida nee, no keta taka o nia liman hosi liafuan seluk nee. Tanba ema nebee hamtauk Maromak sei sai hosi hahalok rua nee.
verses.19: Matenek klean sei halo ema matenek sai forti liu ema podér nain sanulu iha sidade laran.
verses.20: La iha ema moris loos iha mundu laran, nebee halo diak no nunka sala.
verses.21: Lalika rai iha o nia laran liafuan hotu nebee ema koalia; keta halo be o rona o nia atan foo malisan ba o.
verses.22: Tanba o hatene katak dala barak o rasik foo malisan hanesan nee ba ema sira seluk.
verses.23: Buat hotu nee hau prova liu hosi matenek klean. Hau dehan, “Hau sei sai ema matenek klean.” Maibee matenek klean nee sei dook hosi hau.
verses.24: Buat nebee liu tiha mak dook loos no klean liu, see mak bele deskobre buat nee?
verses.25: Hau aplika hau nia fuan laran hodi hatene, hodi buka no duni tuir matenek klean, hodi hatene tanba saa mak, hodi hatene hahalok aat nebee beik no hahalok beik nebee bulak.
verses.26: Hau hetan buat ida nebee moruk liu mate: feto ida ho fuan laran hanesan lasu no redi, no liman hanesan korenti kastigu nian. See-see deit nebee halo Maromak kontenti sei halai sai hosi nia, maibee nia sei kastigu sala nain.
verses.27: Tebes, hau hetan matenek nee, dehan Mestri, bainhira hau tutan buat ida ba buat seluk hodi hatene buat sira nee oinsaa.
verses.28: Hau nia klamar buka hela, maibee la hetan. Hau hetan mane ida iha mane nain rihun ida nia leet, maibee hau la hetan feto ida iha ema hotu nee nia leet.
verses.29: Haree lai, só buat nee deit mak hau hetan, katak Maromak halo ema loos, maibee sira buka atu halo tuir buat barak.

verses.1: See mak hanesan ema matenek klean?
verses.2: Hau dehan: halo tuir liurai nia orden, tanba o jura ona ba Maromak.
verses.3: La bele ansi atu sai hosi ninia oin. La bele hamriik hodi foo apoiu ba kazu nebee aat. Tanba nia halo saida deit nebee nia hakarak halo.
verses.4: Tanba liurai nia liafuan iha podér. See mak dehan ba nia, “Ita boot halo saida?”
verses.5: Ema nebee halo tuir ninia ukun fuan sei la simu buat aat. Ema matenek klean nia fuan laran bele hatene tempu diak no regulamentu loos.
verses.6: Tanba ba buat hotu iha tempu no regulamentu nebee loos. Maibee terus sei foo todan ba ema.
verses.7: Tanba ema la hatene saida mak atu akontese. Nunee see mak bele foo hatene ba nia kona ba saida mak atu akontese?
verses.8: Ema la iha podér hodi kontrola espíritu. Nunee ema la iha podér iha loron mate nian. Ema la bele sai hosi funu. No hahalok aat sei la husik ema nebee entrega aan ba hahalok nee.
verses.9: Hau haree ona buat hotu nee, no aplika hau nia fuan laran ba atividade hotu nebee ema halao iha loro matan okos. Iha tempu nee, ema ida ukun ema seluk too nia hetan susar.
verses.10: Depois hau haree sira hakoi ema moris aat. Uluk sira tama no sai hosi Fatin Santu. Maibee ema haluha sira iha sidade nebee sira halao sira nia atividade. Buat nee mos saugati deit.
verses.11: Tanba kastigu la hasoru lalais hahalok aat, nunee ema nia fuan laran hanoin deit atu halo buat aat.
verses.12: Maski sala nain halo buat aat dala atus ida no nia sei hetan vida naruk, maibee hau hatene katak ema nebee hamtauk Maromak sei hetan buat diak, tanba sira hamtauk iha Ninia oin.
verses.13: Maibee ema moris aat sei la hetan buat diak, no nia sei la hetan vida naruk. Ninia loron sira sai hanesan mahon, tanba nia la hamtauk iha Maromak nia oin.
verses.14: Iha buat saugati deit nebee akontese iha mundu: ema moris loos hetan rezultadu nebee tuir ema moris aat nia hahalok; no mos, ema moris aat hetan rezultadu nebee tuir ema moris loos nia hahalok. Hau dehan katak buat nee mos saugati deit.
verses.15: Entaun hau dehan diak liu haksolok ba. Tanba la iha atividade nebee diak liu, só atu haan hemu no sai haksolok. Tanba ida nee sei kontinua ho ema iha ninia servisu durante loron sira nebee nia moris, nebee Maromak foo ba nia iha loro matan okos.
verses.16: Bainhira hau aplika hau nia fuan laran hodi hatene matenek klean no hodi haree atividade nebee lao iha mundu, no oinsaa loron-kalan ema la matan dukur,
verses.17: nunee hau haree buat hotu nebee Maromak halo. Hau haree katak ema la bele deskobre buat hotu nebee lao iha loro matan okos. Maski ema servisu todan hodi buka hatene ida nee, nia sei la deskobre ida nee. No moos maski ema matenek klean hanoin katak nia bele hatene, nia sei la bele deskobre buat ida nee.

verses.1: Maibee hau konsidera buat hotu nee iha hau nia fuan laran. No hau foo sai oinsaa ema moris loos, no ema matenek klean, no sira nia hahalok mak iha Maromak nia liman. Ema la hatene - domin ka ódiu atu hasoru nia?
verses.2: Ema hotu hetan hanesan. Buat ida deit akontese ba ema moris loos no ema hahalok aat, ba ema diak no ema aat, ba ema moos no ema nebee la moos, ba nia nebee foo sakrifísiu no nia nebee la foo sakrifísiu. Ema diak no mos sala nain hetan hanesan, no nia nebee jura no nia nebee tauk juramentu.
verses.3: Kona ba buat hotu nebee akontese iha loro matan okos, buat nee mak aat - katak ikus mai, buat ida deit akontese ba ema hotu. No mos, ema sira nia fuan laran mak nakonu ho hahalok aat, no sira nia fuan laran mak bulak durante sira nia moris. No tuir mai, sira mate.
verses.4: Maibee nia nebee sei hamutuk ho ema hotu nebee moris sei iha esperansa. Tanba asu nebee sei moris mak diak liu liaun nebee mate ona.
verses.5: Tanba ema moris sei hatene katak sira sei mate, maibee ema mate la hatene buat ida. No ema mate sei la manaan tan buat ida. No ema la hanoin hetan fali sira.
verses.6: No sira nia domin no ódiu no laran moras mak lakon ona. No too tinan ba tinan, sira la iha tan parte ida iha buat saida deit nebee ema halo iha loro matan okos.
verses.7: Baa deit no haan paun ho haksolok. Hemu o nia tua uvas ho laran kontenti. Tanba Maromak simu ona buat nebee o halo.
verses.8: Hatais nafatin ropa mutin, no o nia ulun lalika falta mina.
verses.9: O bele moris hodi haree o nia kaben nebee o hadomi durante o nia moris tomak. Moris nebee Maromak foo ba o iha loro matan okos mak saugati deit. O nia loron hotu mak saugati deit. Tanba ida nee mak o nia liman rohan iha moris nee, no o nia servisu nebee o hetan iha loro matan okos.
verses.10: Buat saida deit nebee o nia liman hetan hodi halo, halo ba ho o nia kbiit. Tanba la iha servisu, ka planu, ka konhesimentu, ka matenek klean iha rate, iha fatin nebee o atu baa.
verses.11: Hau haree fali iha loro matan nia okos katak ema nebee lalais la manaan bainhira nia halai taru, no ema nebee iha podér la manaan iha funu, no ema matenek klean la hetan paun, no ema nebee kompriende la hetan riku-soin, no ema nebee hatene barak la hetan grasa, maibee tempu no sorti deit mak hasoru sira hotu.
verses.12: Tanba ema la hatene ninia tempu. Hanesan ikan nebee ema kaer iha redi aat, no hanesan manu nebee ema kaer iha lasu, nunee ema tama lasu iha tempu aat, bainhira lasu nee monu ba sira derepenti deit.
verses.13: Hau haree mos ezemplu ida nee kona ba matenek klean iha loro matan nia okos, no hau hanoin ezemplu nee mak boot tebes.
verses.14: Iha sidade kiik ida ho ema uitoan iha laran, no liurai boot mai atu funu hasoru sidade nee no haleu nia. Liurai harii alat boot sira hodi hasoru sidade nee.
verses.15: Maibee sira hetan ema kiak nebee iha matenek klean iha sidade laran nee. No ema nee salva sidade liu hosi ninia matenek klean. Maibee la iha ema ida nebee hanoin hetan ema kiak nee.
verses.16: Maibee hau dehan katak matenek klean mak diak liu fali podér, maski sira hakribi ema kiak nia matenek klean no sira la rona tuir ninia liafuan.
verses.17: Liafuan hosi ema matenek klean nebee ita rona iha fatin hakmatek mak diak liu fali liafuan hosi ukun nain nebee nia hakilar iha beik-teen sira nia leet.
verses.18: Matenek klean mak diak liu armas funu nian, maibee sala nain ida bele estraga buat barak nebee diak.

verses.1: Lalar nebee mate sei halo mina morin sai dois,
verses.2: Ema matenek klean nia fuan laran sadere ba sorin loos,
verses.3: No mos, bainhira beik-teen lao iha dalan, ninia laran matenek la iha,
verses.4: Se karik ukun nain nia espíritu sai hirus hasoru o,
verses.5: Hau haree buat ida nebee aat iha loro matan okos, no sala ida nebee mosu hosi ukun nain:
verses.6: ema beik tuur iha fatin aas liu, no ema riku tuur iha fatin simples.
verses.7: Hau haree ona atan sira nebee sae kuda, no xefi sira nebee lao ain hanesan atan sira iha rai.
verses.8: Nia nebee kee rai kuak sei monu iha kuak laran nee,
verses.9: Ema nebee muda fatuk sei hetan kanek hosi fatuk nee,
verses.10: Se besi la kroat no ema la kadi besi ninin nee,
verses.11: Se samea tata molok ema kanta,
verses.12: Liafuan hosi ema matenek klean nia ibun iha grasa,
verses.13: Liafuan nebee hahuu hosi ninia ibun mak beik,
verses.14: Beik-teen mak nakonu ho liafuan,
verses.15: Beik-teen nia servisu halo nia kole,
verses.16: Susar ba ita, Oh rai, bainhira ita nia liurai mak labarik,
verses.17: Bensaun ba ita, Oh rai, bainhira ita nia liurai
verses.18: Liu hosi hahalok baruk, uma sei sai aat,
verses.19: Paun halo ema hamnasa,
verses.20: La bele foo malisan ba liurai, inklui mos iha o nia hanoin,

11.title: Soe O Nia Paun Iha Bee Leten

verses.1: Soe o nia paun iha bee leten,
verses.2: Fahe ba ema nain hitu, no ba ema nain ualu,
verses.3: Se kalohan nakonu ho udan,
verses.4: Nia nebee hateke hela ba anin sei la kuda,
verses.5: Hanesan o la hatene oinsaa espíritu tama ba ruin iha inan isin rua nia kabun laran, nunee o la hatene Maromak nia servisu nebee kria buat hotu.
verses.6: Kari ita nia fini iha dadeer-saan, no iha rai nakaras lalika husik ita nia liman deskansa. Tanba o la hatene saida mak iha susesu, karik buat iha nee ka buat iha nebaa. Karik buat rua nee sei lao diak hanesan.
verses.7: Tebes naroman mak midar, no ema nia matan kontenti bainhira nia haree loro matan.
verses.8: Se ema moris too tinan barak, husik nia haksolok durante tinan hotu nee. Maibee husik nia mos hanoin hetan katak loron nakukun sei barak. Buat hotu nebee mai mak saugati deit.
verses.9: Haksolok ba, Oh joven, iha o nia tempu joven nian. Husik o nia laran halo o kontenti iha loron nebee o sei joven. Lao tuir o nia fuan laran, no tuir o nia matan. Maibee hatene di-diak katak Maromak sei tesi lia ba o kona ba buat hotu nee.
verses.10: Nunee hasai tiha buat nebee halo o nia laran tristi. No hadook tiha buat aat hosi o nia isin. Tanba tempu labarik nian no tempu foin sae mak saugati deit.

verses.1: Agora, hanoin hetan o nia Kriadór iha o nia tempu joven, molok loron susar mai, no molok tempu hakbesik bainhira o dehan, “Hau la kontenti ho loron sira nee;”
verses.2: no molok loro matan, naroman, fulan no fitun sai nakukun, no kalohan sira mai fali tuir tempu udan;
verses.3: iha loron sira nebee ema nebee tau matan ba uma sei nakdedar, no ema forti hakruuk ba, no ema nebee dulas trigu para tanba sira la too, no sira nebee hateke hosi janela sai nakukun;
verses.4: no odamatan iha dalan taka, no lian fai batar sai nonook, no ema hadeer tanba manu nia lian deit, no oan feto hotu nebee halo múzika sei hatuun -
verses.5: sira tauk mos kona ba buat nebee aas, no sira tauk terus iha dalan; ai amendueira funan sai buras no gafanhotu nee sai todan, no ema la hakarak buat ida, tanba ema baa ninia uma rohan laek nian, no ema nebee tanis lelir lao ba-mai iha dalan -
verses.6: molok tali osan mutin kotu, ka manko osan mean nakfera, ka sanan rai mak rahun iha bee matan, ka roda sai aat iha bee posu;
verses.7: no rai rahun fila fali ba rai hanesan uluk, no espíritu fila fali ba Maromak nebee foo buat nee.
verses.8: Saugati, saugati deit, dehan Mestri. Buat hotu saugati deit.
verses.9: No mos, tanba Mestri iha matenek klean, nia hanorin mos matenek nee ba povu. Nia rona diak no tetu no halibur ai sasiik barak.
verses.10: Mestri nee buka di-diak hodi hetan liafuan nebee iha folin. Nia hakerek lia loos ho laran onestu.
verses.11: Liafuan hosi ema matenek klean mak hanesan ai kroat nebee dudu ita. No liafuan nebee halibur ona nee mak hanesan pregu nebee metin loos, nebee mai hosi Bibi Atan ida deit.
verses.12: Kuidadu aan, hau nia oan, kona ba liafuan seluk nebee hatutan ba liafuan nee. Ema sei la para atu hakerek livru barak, no ema nebee estuda barak sei hetan isin kole.
verses.13: Mai ita rona sumáriu ba buat hotu nee: Hamtauk Maromak, no halo tuir Ninia ukun fuan. Tanba ida nee deit mak ita nia obrigasaun.
verses.14: Tanba Maromak sei tesi lia kona ba buat hotu nebee ema halo, no kona ba segredu hotu, se hahalok nee diak ka aat.

verses.1: Kanta hosi kanta sira, nebee Salomão nian.
verses.2: Husik nia rei hau ho rei sira hosi ninia ibun!
verses.3: no o nia mina diak mak morin tebes;
verses.4: Dada hau tuir o, no ita sei halai ba.
verses.5: Hau isin metan, maibee bonita,
verses.6: Keta fihir hau tanba hau isin metan,
verses.7: O nebee hau nia klamar hadomi, foo hatene mai hau,
verses.8: Se o la hatene,
verses.9: Hau kompara o, oh hau nia doben,
verses.10: O nia hasan mak bonita ho sasaan furak,
verses.11: Ami sei halo ba o buat furak hosi osan mean,
verses.12: Bainhira liurai tuur hela iha ninia sofá,
verses.13: Hau nia doben mak hanesan mira iha bornál kiik laran,
verses.14: Hau nia doben mak hanesan ai henna nia funan,
verses.15: Oh hau nia doben, o mak bonita tebes;
verses.16: Oh hau nia doben, o mak bonita tebes,
verses.17: ita nia uma nia ai lolon mak ai teka,

2.title: hanesan ai funan líriu iha rai tetuk.

verses.1: Hau hanesan ai funan narsisu iha Saron,
verses.2: Hanesan ai funan líriu nebee iha ai tarak laran,
verses.3: Hanesan ai masaan nebee iha ai laran,
verses.4: Nia lori hau ba uma festa nian,
verses.5: Sustenta hau ho uvas fuan maran,
verses.6: Ninia liman karuk mak iha hau nia ulun okos,
verses.7: Hau manda imi, Oh oan feto sira hosi Jerusalém,
verses.8: Hau nia doben nia lian!
verses.9: Hau nia doben mak hanesan gazela,
verses.10: Hau nia doben koalia no dehan mai hau,
verses.11: Tanba tebes, tempu malirin liu ona,
verses.12: Ai funan sira mosu mai iha rai,
verses.13: Ai figeira halo ninia fuan sai tasak,
verses.14: Oh hau nia manu pombu iha fatuk kuak,
verses.15: Kaer asu fuik sira ba ami,
verses.16: Hau nia doben mak hau nian, no hau mak ninian,
verses.17: Too dadeer-saan foin huu mai,

verses.1: Iha tempu kalan iha hau nia kama,
verses.2: Agora, hau sei hadeer, no lao ba-mai iha sidade,
verses.3: Ema seguransa hetan hau,
verses.4: Hau foin lao liu sira
verses.5: Hau manda imi, Oh oan feto sira hosi Jerusalém,
verses.6: See mak nee, nebee sai mai hosi rai fuik,
verses.7: Tebes, nee mak kama Salomão nian!
verses.8: Sira hotu kaer surik,
verses.9: Liurai Salomão halo kadeira ida nebee ema lori,
verses.10: Nia halo kadeira nia ai riin ho osan mutin,
verses.11: Lao ba oin, Oh oan feto sira hosi Zion,

verses.1: Tebes, o mak bonita, hau nia doben,
verses.2: O nia nehan hanesan bibi malae lubun nebee ema foin tesi fuuk,
verses.3: O nia ibun tutun hanesan kabas mean,
verses.4: O nia kakorok hanesan uma aas David nian,
verses.5: O nia susun rua hanesan gazela oan kaduak,
verses.6: Too dadeer-saan foin huu mai,
verses.7: O mak bonita liu, hau nia doben,
verses.8: Mai ho hau hosi Líbanon, hau nia kaben,
verses.9: O naok tiha ona hau nia fuan laran,
verses.10: Furak liu mak o nia domin,
verses.11: Hau nia noiva, o nia ibun tutun turu ho bani been,
verses.12: Jardin nebee taka metin mak hau nia alin, hau nia noiva,
verses.13: O nia ai horis mak plantasaun ai rumaun,
verses.14: ai nardu, ai funan asafraun, duut morin no ai kanela,
verses.15: nee mak bee matan iha jardin, bee posu nebee iha bee moris nian,
verses.16: Hadeer ba, Oh anin hosi parte norte,

verses.1: Hau tama tiha ba hau nia jardin,
verses.2: Hau toba dukur maibee hau nia fuan laran hadeer hela,
verses.3: Hau hasai ona hau nia ropa,
verses.4: Hau nia doben nee hatama ninia liman liu hosi kuak,
verses.5: Hau hadeer hodi loke odamatan ba hau nia doben,
verses.6: Hau loke odamatan ba hau nia doben,
verses.7: Ema seguransa nebee lao ba-mai iha sidade hetan hau,
verses.8: Hau manda imi, Oh oan feto sira hosi Jerusalém,
verses.9: Oinsaa o nia doben mak diak liu doben seluk,
verses.10: Hau nia doben mak nabilan no bonitu,
verses.11: Ninia ulun hanesan osan mean nebee moos,
verses.12: Ninia matan hanesan manu pombu iha mota ninin,
verses.13: Ninia hasan hanesan kantadeiru nebee iha mina morin,
verses.14: Ninia liman hanesan osan mean
verses.15: Ninia ain hanesan riin fatuk marmore,
verses.16: Ninia ibun leten mak midar loos,

verses.1: O nia doben baa nebee,
verses.2: Hau nia doben tuun ona ba ninia jardin,
verses.3: Hau mak hau nia doben nian,
verses.4: Hau nia doben, o mak bonita hanesan Tirza,
verses.5: See o nia matan hosi hau,
verses.6: O nia nehan hanesan bibi malae lubun nebee sae mai hosi fatin hariis,
verses.7: O nia hasan hanesan ai fuan rumaun sorin ida
verses.8: Sira bele iha liurai feto nain neen-nulu no feen kiik nain ualu-nulu,
verses.9: Maibee hau nia manu pombu perfeitu mak ida deit,
verses.10: “See mak nee nebee hateke mai hanesan dadeer-saan,
verses.11: Hau tuun ba ai nogeira sira,
verses.12: Molok hau hatene, hau hakarak baa
verses.13: Fila fali mai, Oh feto hosi Sulam,

7.title: Oh oan feto hosi ema boot!

verses.1: O nia ain bonita loos iha sandálias,
verses.2: O nia husar hanesan manko kabuar,
verses.3: O nia susun rua hanesan gazela nia oan rua,
verses.4: O nia kakorok hanesan uma aas nebee halo ho marfín.
verses.5: O nia ulun fatuk hanesan Karmel,
verses.6: O bonita no furak liu,
verses.7: O mak aas hanesan ai palma,
verses.8: Hau dehan hau sei sae ai palma nee,
verses.9: O nia ibun leten hanesan tua uvas nebee diak liu.
verses.10: Hau mak hau nia doben nian,
verses.11: Mai lai, hau nia doben,
verses.12: Mai ita hadeer dadeer-saan no tama ba toos uvas,
verses.13: Ai mandrágora foo morin ba,

verses.1: Oh katak o mak hau nia maun rasik,
verses.2: Hau bele diriji no lori o
verses.3: Ninia liman karuk sei iha hau nia ulun okos,
verses.4: Hau manda imi, Oh oan feto sira hosi Jerusalém,
verses.5: See mak nee nebee sai mai hosi rai fuik,
verses.6: Tau hau nudar sinál ida nebee taka ba o nia fuan laran,
verses.7: Bee barak la bele hamate domin,
verses.8: Ami iha alin feto kiik,
verses.9: Se nia hanesan moru ida,
verses.10: Hau mak moru ida,
verses.11: Salomão iha toos uvas ida iha Baal-Hamon;
verses.12: Hau nia toos uvas, nebee hau nian rasik, mak iha hau nia oin;
verses.13: O nebee hela iha jardin,
verses.14: Mai lalais, hau nia doben,

verses.1: Vizaun hosi Isaias, Amoz nia oan, nebee nia haree kona ba Judá no Jerusalém durante tempu Uzias, Jotão, Akaz no Ezekias, nebee Judá nia liurai sira.
verses.2: Rona ba, oh lalehan,
verses.3: Karau ida konhese ninia nain,
verses.4: Ah nasaun nebee nakonu ho sala,
verses.5: Nusaa mak imi simu kastigu nafatin?
verses.6: Hosi ain okos too iha ulun,
verses.7: Imi nia rai nee mamuk ona,
verses.8: Zion nia oan feto hela mesak deit
verses.9: Se Nai Forsa Nain
verses.10: Rona Nai nia liafuan,
verses.11: “Hau hetan benefísiu saida hosi imi nia sakrifísiu barak nee?”
verses.12: Kuandu imi mai hodi hamriik iha Hau nia oin,
verses.13: Keta lori tan imi nia oferta nebee la iha folin;
verses.14: Hau nia klamar odi
verses.15: Kuandu imi loke imi nia liman,
verses.16: Hariis lai, hamoos aan ba,
verses.17: Aprende hahalok diak,
verses.18: Agora mai, no koalia ho Hau,” hatete Nai,
verses.19: Se karik imi prontu atu halo tuir,
verses.20: Maibee se karik imi lakohi atu halo tuir,
verses.21: Sidade nebee uluk fiar metin
verses.22: Imi nia osan mutin sai foer ona,
verses.23: Imi nia ukun nain sira fila ba kotuk,
verses.24: Entaun Nai hatete,
verses.25: Hau sei foti Hau nia liman hodi kontra imi,
verses.26: No Hau sei foo fali knaar ba imi nia juis sira hanesan iha tempu uluk,
verses.27: Hau sei hola fali Zion ho justisa,
verses.28: Maibee sira nebee iha hahalok aat no sala nain sira sei sai rahun hamutuk;
verses.29: Sira sei sai moe tanba ai huun boot nebee sira hakarak,
verses.30: Imi sei sai hanesan ai huun boot ida nebee ninia tahan namlaik,
verses.31: No sira nebee forti sei sai hanesan duut maran,

verses.1: Liafuan nebee Isaias, Amoz nia oan, haree kona ba Judá no Jerusalém.
verses.2: Ida nee sei akontese iha tempu ikus,
verses.3: Ema barak sei baa no hatete,
verses.4: Nia sei tesi lia iha nasaun sira nia leet,
verses.5: Oh Jacó nia família, mai,
verses.6: O husik ona Jacó nia família,
verses.7: Sira nia rai mos nakonu ho osan mutin no osan mean,
verses.8: Sira nia rai mos nakonu ho ídulu sira;
verses.9: Ema nee haraik aan,
verses.10: Tama ba fatuk kuak,
verses.11: Sira nebee hateke hanesan ema boot sei sai ema kiik,
verses.12: Tanba Nai Forsa Nain nia loron
verses.13: no hasoru ai teka hotu iha Líbanon,
verses.14: no hasoru foho boot hotu nebee aas,
verses.15: no hasoru uma aas hotu,
verses.16: no hasoru roo boot hotu hosi Tarsis,
verses.17: Sira nebee gaba aan sei hakneak,
verses.18: Ídulu hotu sei lakon mohu.
verses.19: No ema sei tama fatuk kuak,
verses.20: Iha loron nee ema sira sei soe
verses.21: hodi tama ba fatuk kuak,
verses.22: Lalika hanoin tan ema,

verses.1: Tebes, Nai, Nai Forsa Nain,
verses.2: asuwain no funu nain,
verses.3: komandante ba ema nain lima-nulu,
verses.4: No hau sei halo labarik sira sai sira nia xefi,
verses.5: Povu sei haterus malu,
verses.6: Mane ida sei kaer ninia maluk
verses.7: Iha loron nee mane ida nee sei jura, hatete,
verses.8: Tanba Jerusalém sidi ona,
verses.9: Sira nia oin sai sasin hodi hasoru fali sira,
verses.10: Hatete ba ema loos katak sira sei hetan buat diak,
verses.11: Aii, susar ba ema aat! Sira sei hetan buat aat,
verses.12: Hau nia povu - labarik sira mak haterus povu nee,
verses.13: Nai hamriik hodi diskuti malu ho povu nee,
verses.14: Nai sei halao julgamentu
verses.15: Nusaa mak imi baku rahun Hau nia povu?
verses.16: Nai hatete mos,
verses.17: Entaun Nai sei foo kanek
verses.18: Iha loron nee Nai sei foti sira nia sasaan furak nebee pulseira, bandalete no ulsuku sira;
verses.19: korenti, kelu no tais sira;
verses.20: tiara, korenti ain, sintu, botir ho mina morin no brinkus sira;
verses.21: kadeli no kadeli inus sira;
verses.22: ropa festa nian, manta, unuk no pasta feto nian;
verses.23: espelhu, ropa linhu, hena ulun no veo sira.
verses.24: Tuir mai, mina morin troka fali ho iis dois;
verses.25: Imi nia mane sira sei monu tanba surik,
verses.26: Ninia portaun sira sei tanis no halerik,

verses.1: Iha loron nebaa, feto nain hitu sei kaer mane ida no hatete, “Ami sei haan ami nia paun rasik no hatais ami nia ropa rasik, maibee husik ami lori ita nia naran hodi taka ami nia moe.”
verses.2: Iha loron nebaa Nai nia Sanak sei bonitu no iha glória. Ema sei gaba no foo onra ba sira nebee sei moris hela iha Israel tanba ai fuan hosi rai nee.
verses.3: Ema sei bolu sira nebee sei hela iha Zion no sira nebee sei hela iha Jerusalém nudar ema santu. Sira nia naran sei hakerek iha lista moris nian iha Jerusalém.
verses.4: Tanba Nai sei hamoos Zion nia oan feto sira hosi buat foer. Nia sei fasi Jerusalém too noda hosi raan la iha. Nia sei halo ida nee ho espíritu julgamentu nian no espíritu sunu nian.
verses.5: No iha uma fatin hotu iha foho Zion no iha komunidade sira, Nai sei halo kalohan nebee suar iha loron no ahi nebee nabilan no lakan iha kalan. Tanba buat nee sei taka glória hotu.
verses.6: Sira sei iha tenda ida atu foo mahon iha loron manas no atu sai fatin seguru no proteje sira hosi anin fuik no udan boot.

5.title: Nai Nia Toos Uvas Sai Aat

verses.1: Husik hau kanta ba hau nia doben,
verses.2: Nia fila rai no hasai fatuk sira,
verses.3: Agora, Oh ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém,
verses.4: Hau bele halo saida tan ba hau nia toos uvas,
verses.5: Agora, hau sei foo hatene ba imi
verses.6: Hau sei estraga fatin nee,
verses.7: Tanba Nai Forsa Nain nia toos uvas
verses.8: Aii, susar ba sira nebee hatutan uma ba uma,
verses.9: Hau rona Nai Forsa Nain jura:
verses.10: Tanba toos uvas ektare sanulu sei foo rezultadu baldi ida,
verses.11: Aii, susar ba sira nebee hadeer sedu iha dadeer-saan
verses.12: No sira iha viola no arpa,
verses.13: Tanba nee hau nia povu tama ba kastigu,
verses.14: Entaun infernu aumenta boot tan,
verses.15: Ema sei hakruuk, no ida-idak sei tuun,
verses.16: Maibee Nai Forsa Nain sei sae ho justisa
verses.17: Depois bibi malae oan sei haan iha sira nia duut fatin,
verses.18: Aii, susar ba sira nebee dada hahalok aat ho tali bosok nian,
verses.19: sira hatete, “Lalais lai,
verses.20: Aii, susar ba sira nebee dehan buat aat mak diak,
verses.21: Aii, susar ba sira nebee matenek tuir sira nia hanoin rasik,
verses.22: Aii, susar ba sira nebee hanoin katak sira forti atu hemu tua,
verses.23: Sira dehan ema aat mak diak hodi simu prezenti subar,
verses.24: Tanba nee, hanesan ahi haan duut maran,
verses.25: Entaun Nai nia hirus sai manas hasoru Ninia povu,
verses.26: Nia sei foo avizu ida ba nasaun sira nebee dook,
verses.27: La iha ema ida iha sira nia leet nebee kole ka monu,
verses.28: Sira nia rama oan nee kroat,
verses.29: Sira nia lian hanesan liaun,
verses.30: Iha loron nee sira sei hakilar

verses.1: Iha tinan nebee liurai Uzias mate, hau haree Nai tuur iha kadunan ida, iha fatin aas tebes, no Ninia unuk ninin halo nakonu Templu.
verses.2: Serafim sira hamriik iha Ninia leten. Ida-idak iha liras neen – ho liras rua sira taka sira nia oin, ho liras rua sira taka sira nia ain, no ho liras rua sira semo.
verses.3: No serafin ida hakilar ba ida seluk, dehan: “Santu, santu, santu mak Nai Forsa Nain;
verses.4: No portaun sira nia fundasaun sira nakdoko tanba lian hosi nia nebee hakilar, no uma nee sai nakonu ho suar.
verses.5: Depois hau hatete, “Aii, susar mai hau! Hau sei lakon duni, tanba hau mak mane ida ho ibun tutun foer no hau hela ho povu nebee iha ibun tutun foer, no hau nia matan haree ona Liurai nee, Nai Forsa Nain!”
verses.6: Depois serafim ida semo mai hau. Nia lori ahi klaak ida iha ninia liman nebee nia foti ho pinsa hosi altár.
verses.7: Nia kona hau nia ibun ho ahi klaak nee, no nia hatete, “Haree lai, ida nee kona ona o nia ibun tutun, no hasai ona o nia hahalok aat, no hamoos ona o nia sala.”
verses.8: No hau rona Nai nia lian, dehan, “Hau bele haruka see? No see mak bele baa?” Depois hau hatete, “Hau mak nee, haruka hau ba!”
verses.9: Depois Nia hatete, “Baa, no hatete ba povu nee:
verses.10: Halo povu nee nia fuan laran sai toos,
verses.11: Depois hau hatete, “Nai, too loron hira?”
verses.12: too Nai lori ema sira nee dook loos,
verses.13: Maski ida hosi sanulu sei hela iha rai nee,

verses.1: Iha Ahaz nia tempu, nebee oan hosi Jotão, oan hosi Uzias, nebee liurai hosi Judá, liurai Rezim hosi Síria no mos liurai Peka, oan hosi Remalias iha Israel, sae ba too Jerusalém hodi halo funu hasoru sira. Maibee liurai rua nee seidauk bele ataka sira.
verses.2: David nia uma kain rona nunee, “Síria halo ligasaun ho Efraim.” Ahaz nia fuan laran no ninia povu nia fuan laran nakdedar hanesan ai huun iha ai laran nakdoko bainhira anin huu.
verses.3: Depois Nai hatete ba Isaias, “Agora, o ho o nia oan mane, Sear-Jasube, baa hasoru Ahaz. Baa too iha bee kanu nia rohan nebee mai hosi bee lihun iha leten, iha dalan ba fatin fase ropa.
verses.4: No hatete ba nia, ‘Kuidadu, kalma lai no keta tauk. Lalika fuan kii tanba Rezin hosi Síria no Remalias nia oan, sira nebee hirus makaas hanesan ai sunu rohan nebee suar deit.
verses.5: Tanba Síria ho Efraim no Remalias nia oan halo planu aat hasoru o no hatete,
verses.6: “Mai, ita sae ba Judá no haterus nia. Mai ita hadau nia no tau Tabeal nia oan nudar liurai foun iha sira nia leet.”
verses.7: Nai Maromak hatete hanesan nee,
verses.8: Tanba Síria nia ulun mak Damasku,
verses.9: No Efraim nia ulun mak Samaria,
verses.10: Tuir mai, Nai koalia fali ho Ahaz,
verses.11: “Husu sinál ida hosi Nai, o nia Maromak. Bele klean too hanesan fatin mate ka aas too hanesan lalehan.”
verses.12: Maibee Ahaz hatete, “Hau sei la husu, no hau sei la koko Nai.”
verses.13: Depois Nai dehan, “Rona lai, Oh David nia uma kain! Imi hanoin la too atu halo kole ema sira ka, atu nunee imi tenki halo kole mos hau nia Maromak?
verses.14: Entaun, Nai rasik sei foo sinál ida ba imi: Tebes, feto klosan ida sei sai isin rua no tuur ahi Oan Mane ida no hanaran nia Emanuel.
verses.15: Bainhira Nia hatene ona atu haan sasoru ho bani been, Nia mos hatene ona atu rejeita buat aat no hili buat diak.
verses.16: Tanba molok labarik nee hatene atu rejeita buat aat no hili buat diak, rai iha nebaa nebee imi odi sei lakon sira nia liurai rua.
verses.17: Nai sei haruka ba imi, no imi nia povu, no imi nia aman nia uma kain, loron sira nebee seidauk akontese, hosi loron nebee Efraim sees hosi Judá. Iha loron nebaa, liurai Asíria sei mai.”
verses.18: Iha loron nebaa, Nai sei hakfuik hodi bolu lalar hosi Ejitu nia mota sira nia sorin baa, no bani hosi rai Asíria.
verses.19: Depois sira sei mai, no sira hotu sei hela iha rai fuik, iha fatuk kuak sira, iha ai tarak sira no ai badak sira hotu.
verses.20: Iha loron nebaa, Nai sei koi sira nia fuuk ho tudik ida nebee Nia aluga hosi mota sorin baa, nebee liurai Asíria. Nia sei koi sira nia fuuk hosi ulun too fuuk iha ain, inklui mos hasan rahun.
verses.21: Iha loron nebaa, mane ida sei foo haan diak ba karau inan ida no bibi malae rua.
verses.22: Animál sira nee sei foo susu been barak too mane ida nee bele haan keiju. Nunee ema sira hotu nebee sei hela iha rai nebaa sei haan keiju no bani been.
verses.23: Iha loron nebaa, iha fatin hotu nebee uluk iha uvas huun rihun ida, nebee folin osan mutin rihun ida, sei sai deit duut maran no ai tarak.
verses.24: Ema sei mai ho rama inan no rama oan tanba rai hotu sai duut maran no ai tarak.
verses.25: Iha foho hotu nebee uluk sira kee rai ho enxada, sira sei lakohi halo fali tanba tauk duut maran no ai tarak. Sira husik deit karau sira no bibi bele baa haan deit.

verses.1: Depois Nai hatete mai hau, “Foti ai kabelak boot ida no hakerek tuir letra baibain, ‘Nee mak Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz nian.’
verses.2: Depois hau buka sasin sira nebee hau fiar hodi hakerek liafuan nee – saserdote Urias no Zakarias, Jeberekias nia oan mane.
verses.3: Depois hau tama ba hau nia feen, nebee profetisa, no nia sai isin rua no tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida. Nai hatete mai hau, “Hanaran nia Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
verses.4: Tanba molok labarik nee hatene atu bolu, ‘Apaa! Amaa!’, riku-soin hosi Damasku no rikeza funu nian hosi Samaria sei lakon ba liurai Asíria.”
verses.5: Nai hatete fali mai hau, dehan,
verses.6: “Tanba povu nee rejeita bee Siloe nebee suli neineik, no sira haksolok fali ho Rezin no Remalias nia oan mane.
verses.7: Nunee haree ba, Nai atu haruka bee hosi Mota Boot atu hasoru sira. Bee nee makaas no boot. Nee mak liurai Asíria no ninia glória hotu. Nia sei suli sae aas liu mota dalan nee no sae aas liu mota ninin.
verses.8: Nia sei tama mos rai Judá, nia sei suli sae mai hodi taka rai no sae aas too kakorok. Nia sei lolo ninia liras too nia taka ita nia rai tomak, Oh Imanuel.”
verses.9: Sai aat, povu sira, no hetan dezastre.
verses.10: Halo enkontru hamutuk maibee planu nee sei sai saugati deit.
verses.11: Tanba Nai koalia hanesan nee hamutuk ho hau ho Ninia liman forti. Nia hanorin hau katak hau la bele lao tuir povu nee nia dalan. Nia dehan,
verses.12: “Keta dehan, ‘Konspirisaun!’ Hanesan povu nee dehan ‘Konspirisaun!’ Ketak tauk kona ba buat nebee halo povu nee sai tauk, no keta nakdedar.
verses.13: Maibee Nai Forsa Nain nee, foo onra ba Nia nudar santu, no hamtauk Nia, no nakdedar tanba Nia.
verses.14: Nia mak uma santu. Nia mos fatuk ida nebee halo ema sidi. No Nia mos fatuk boot ida nebee halo uma kain rua iha Israel atu monu. Nia hanesan redi ida ka lasu ida ba sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém.
verses.15: Ema barak sidi tanba fatuk nee. Sira sei monu tuun no rahun. Ema sei kasa no kastigu sira.
verses.16: Kesi testemunha nee, taka tiha hanorin nee iha hau nia disípulu sira nia leet.
verses.17: Hau sei hein Nai nebee subar Ninia oin hosi Jacó nia uma kain, no hau sei tau esperansa iha Nia.
verses.18: Haree ba, hau hamutuk ho oan sira nebee Nai foo ona mai hau. Ami mak avizu no sinál iha Israel hosi Nai Forsa Nain, nebee hela iha foho Zion.
verses.19: Bainhira sira dehan ba imi, “Ba husu buan no matan-dook nebee bis-bisu no murmura.” Nusaa mak sira la husu sira nia Maromak? Nusaa mak sira husu buat nebee mate kona ba buat nebee moris?
verses.20: Fila ba hanorin no testemunha! Se karik sira lakohi koalia tuir liafuan nee, entaun ida nee tanba sira la iha loro sae.
verses.21: Sira sei lao haleu rai nee ho terus no hamlaha. Tuir mai, bainhira sira hamlaha, sira sei sai hirus no koalia aat sira nia liurai no sira nia Maromak, no sira sei hateke ba lalehan.
verses.22: Depois sira sei hateke ba rai, no tebes, iha terus no nakukun. Tempu susar sei taka sira no sira sei tama ba nakukun laran.

verses.1: Maibee tempu susar sei la taka fali nia nebee uluk iha terus. Uluk Nai hamoe rai Zebulón no rai Naftali, maibee iha tempu ikus Nia foo glória ba dalan tasi nian, ba rai Jordaun iha fatin Galiléia iha nasaun sira nia leet.
verses.2: Povu nebee lao iha nakukun laran
verses.3: O mak aumenta nasaun nee,
verses.4: Tanba O mak silu tiha nia ai leba nebee todan,
verses.5: Soldadu sira nia botas hotu nebee sama rai atu halo funu,
verses.6: Tanba Labarik ida moris mai ba ita,
verses.7: Ninia governu no dame
verses.8: Nai haruka ona liafuan ba Jacó,
verses.9: no povu hotu sei hatene,
verses.10: “Blok sira nee monu ona,
verses.11: Maibee Nai sei haruka ema atu kontra hasoru Rezin,
verses.12: Síria sira iha lorosae no Filisteu sira iha loromonu
verses.13: Tanba povu seidauk fila fali ba Nia nebee kastigu sira,
verses.14: Entaun Nai sei hakotu Israel nia ulun no ikun,
verses.15: Katuas ho ema nebee iha onra mak ulun;
verses.16: Tanba povu nee nia matadalan sira mak lori povu ba dalan sala,
verses.17: Tanba nee Nai sei la haksolok ho joventude sira,
verses.18: Tanba hahalok aat sunu hanesan ahi,
verses.19: Nai Forsa Nain nia laran nakali
verses.20: Sira sei koa ai haan iha sorin loos, maibee sira hamlaha hela;
verses.21: Manasés haan Efraim, no Efraim haan Manasés;

10.title: no sira nebee hakerek liafuan nebee hanehan ema;

verses.1: Aii, susar ba sira nebee foo lei nebee tuir hahalok aat,
verses.2: hodi fila ema fraku hosi justisa,
verses.3: Imi sei halo saida iha loron kastigu,
verses.4: Imi la bele halo buat ida, só deit, atu hakneak iha ema dadur nia leet,
verses.5: Oh Asíria, rota nebee hatudu Hau nia laran hirus,
verses.6: Hau sei haruka nia baa hasoru nasaun ida nebee laran makerek,
verses.7: Maibee nia la hatene,
verses.8: Tanba nia hatete,
verses.9: Kalno nee laos hanesan Karkemis?
verses.10: Hanesan hau nia liman lolo too ona reinu sira nebee iha ídulu sira,
verses.11: laos hau bele halo ba Jerusalém no ninia ídulu sira
verses.12: Bainhira Nai halao ona Ninia servísu hotu iha foho Zion no iha Jerusalém, Nia sei foo kastigu ba liurai Asíria tanba ninia liafuan hosi ninia fuan laran nebee gaba aan no ninia matan nebee loko aan.
verses.13: Tanba liurai nee hatete,
verses.14: No hau nia liman hetan povu nia riku-soin
verses.15: Baliun bele gaba aan hasoru ema nebee taa ka?
verses.16: Tanba nee, Nai, Nai Forsa Nain,
verses.17: No Naroman hosi Israel sei sai ahi,
verses.18: no sei haan ninia ai laran no rai bokur nia glória,
verses.19: Hela ai uitoan deit iha ninia ai laran,
verses.20: Iha loron nebaa, ema restu hosi Israel no sira nebee sei moris hosi Jacó nia uma kain sei la sadere tan ba nia nebee baku sira maibee sira sei sadere ba Nai, Ida Nebee Santu iha Israel.
verses.21: Ema restu sei fila fali mai, ema restu hosi Jacó sei fila fali ba Maromak Kbiit Nain.
verses.22: Maski imi nia povu Israel hanesan rai henek iha tasi, maibee sei hela ema uitoan deit nebee fila fali mai. Dezastre nebee desidi ona nee mak nakonu liu ho hahalok loos.
verses.23: Tanba Nai Maromak Forsa Nain sei haruka dezastre. Ida nee desidi ona no hasoru rai tomak.
verses.24: Tanba nee Nai Maromak Forsa Nain hatete, “Oh Hau nia povu nebee hela iha Zion, keta tauk ema Asíria; nia nebee baku ho rota, no hiit nia ai tonka hodi soke imi hanesan Ejitu.
verses.25: La kleur tan, Hau nia laran hirus nakali sei para, no Hau nia oin hirus sei foo dezastre ba sira.
verses.26: No Nai Forsa Nain sei foti sikote hodi hasoru sira, hanesan bainhira Nia baku Midian iha fatuk Oreb. Ninia rota sei kona tasi, no Nia sei hiit sae rota nee hanesan Nia halo iha Ejitu.
verses.27: Iha loron nebaa, Nia sei foti sai todan hosi imi nia kabaas, no Ninia ai leba nebee kona imi nia kakorok; no ai leba nee sei tohar tanba buat bokur.
verses.28: Nia mai ona too iha Aiate,
verses.29: Sira lao liu ona dalan foho nian,
verses.30: Hakilar makaas,
verses.31: Madmena halai tiha ona,
verses.32: Nia sei para iha Nobe iha loron nee,
verses.33: Tebes, Nai, Nai Forsa Nain,
verses.34: No Nia sei taa ai laran ho baliu,

11.title: Sanak Sei Ukun Ho Hahalok Loos

verses.1: Ai dikin sei mosu mai hosi Jessé nia ai huun,
verses.2: Nai nia Espíritu sei tuun ba Nia,
verses.3: Nia gosta atu hamtauk Nai.
verses.4: Maibee Nia sei tesi lia ba ema kiak tuir hahalok loos,
verses.5: Ninia sintu iha Ninia kabun mak hahalok loos,
verses.6: Asu fuik sei hela hamutuk ho bibi malae oan,
verses.7: No karau no ursu sei haan duut,
verses.8: No bebee nebee susu hela sei halimar iha samea kobra nia rai kuak nia leten,
verses.9: Sira sei la halo moras ka oho
verses.10: Iha loron nebaa, Jessé nia abut sei hamriik nudar sinál ida ba povu. Nasaun sira sei buka atu husu Nia, no Ninia fatin deskansa sei iha glória.
verses.11: Iha loron nebaa, Nai sei lolo Ninia liman dala ida tan hodi halibur fali Ninia povu restu nebee Nia sei hela iha Asíria, Ejitu, Patros, Etiópia, Elão, Sinear, Hamát no hosi ilha sira iha tasi.
verses.12: No Nia sei foti sae sinál ida ba nasaun sira,
verses.13: Laran moras iha Efraim sei sai,
verses.14: Maibee sira sei semo tuun ba ema Filisteu sira nia kabaas iha rai loromonu,
verses.15: No Nai sei halakon mohu
verses.16: No Ninia povu restu sei lao liu hosi dalan boot

12.title: Nai Mak Hau Nia Forsa no Kanta

verses.1: Iha loron nebaa, o sei dehan, “Oh Nai, hau sei foo agradese ba O,
verses.2: Rona lai, Maromak mak hau nia salvasaun,
verses.3: Nunee ho haksolok ita sei kuru bee hosi bee posu salvasaun nian.
verses.4: Iha loron nebaa, o sei dehan,
verses.5: Hananu ba Nai, tanba Nia halo ona buat nebee furak,
verses.6: Hakilar ba, no kanta ho haksolok, ema nebee hela iha Zion,

verses.1: Vizaun todan kona ba Babilónia nebee Isaias, Amoz nia oan mane, mak haree ona.
verses.2: Harii bandeira ida iha foho fatuk nian,
verses.3: Hau rasik haruka ona Hau nia ema nebee santu,
verses.4: Rona lian boot hosi barulhu iha foho,
verses.5: Sira mai hosi rai dook,
verses.6: Hakilar ba, tanba Nai nia loron besik ona,
verses.7: Nunee liman hotu-hotu sei sai fraku,
verses.8: Sira sei sai tauk,
verses.9: Tebes, Nai nia loron mai dadaun,
verses.10: Tanba fitun sira iha lalehan,
verses.11: Hau sei kastigu mundu nee nia aat,
verses.12: Hau sei halo ema uitoan liu fali osan mean nebee moos,
verses.13: Nunee Hau sei halo lalehan nakdedar,
verses.14: Hanesan bibi rusa nebee ema duni,
verses.15: Se ema hetan sira,
verses.16: Ema sei baku rahun mos sira nia oan sira
verses.17: Tebes, Hau sei provoka ema Mede sira atu mai hasoru sira,
verses.18: Sira nia rama sira sei harahun joven mane sira,
verses.19: Babilónia, nebee reinu sira nia glória,
verses.20: Ema sei nunka hela fali iha nebaa,
verses.21: Só deit animál fuik sei toba iha nebaa,
verses.22: No animál fuik sei hakilar iha sira nia uma mamuk nee,

verses.1: Nai sei hatudu laran luak ba Jacó, no Nia sei hili Israel, no harii fali sira iha sira nia rai rasik. Ema rai liur sei mai hamutuk ho sira, no ema rai liur nee sei hela hamutuk ho jerasaun Jacó.
verses.2: Ema rai liur sira sei lori povu nee ba sira nia fatin. Israel nia uma kain sei hetan sira iha Nai nia rai nudar atan mane no atan feto sira. Sira sei foti ema dadur sira nebee uluk halo povu Israel sai ema dadur, sira sei ukun sira nebee uluk hanehan sira.
verses.3: Tuir mai, bainhira Nai sei foo deskansa ba imi hosi imi nia terus, no imi nia problema no imi nia kastigu todan nebee imi tenki simu,
verses.4: imi sei foo sai liafuan nee hodi kontra liurai Babilónia:
verses.5: Nai halo tohar ona ema hahalok aat nia ai tonka,
verses.6: Ida nebee baku povu ho laran nakali,
verses.7: Mundu tomak hakmatek no nonook;
verses.8: Ai sanobar sira haksolok tanba ita,
verses.9: Infernu iha rai okos book aan
verses.10: Sira hotu koalia
verses.11: Ita nia glória tuun ona ba infernu,
verses.12: Oinsaa ita monu tuun ona hosi lalehan,
verses.13: Tanba ita dehan iha ita nia fuan laran,
verses.14: Hau sei sae aas liu kalohan sira iha leten,
verses.15: Maibee ita sei tuun too iha infernu,
verses.16: Sira nebee haree sei fihir maran ba ita,
verses.17: Nia halo mundu sai rai fuik
verses.18: Liurai hotu hosi nasaun sira, liurai sira hotu,
verses.19: Maibee sira soe ona ita hosi ita nia rate,
verses.20: Ita sei la hamutuk ho sira iha rate laran
verses.21: Prepara atu oho ninia oan sira
verses.22: “Hau sei hamriik hasoru sira,” hatete Nai Forsa Nain, “no halakon sira nia naran, no ema nia naran nebee sei hela iha Babilónia, no ema restu, sira nia bei-oan no jerasaun hotu,” hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.23: “Hau sei halo fatin nee sai hanesan orisu nia hela fatin no hanesan bee lihun sira. Hau sei dasa fatin nee ho ai saar nebee halakon nia,” hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.24: Nai Forsa Nain jura dehan,
verses.25: Hau sei harahun ema Asíria iha Hau nia rai,
verses.26: Planu nee mak planu ba mundu tomak,
verses.27: Tanba Nai Forsa Nain halo planu ona,
verses.28: Iha tinan ida nebee liurai Ahaz mate, liafuan todan nee mai:
verses.29: Keta haksolok, Oh rai Filistia, imi hotu iha nebaa,
verses.30: Ema kiak sira nia oan primeiru sei haan,
verses.31: Hakilar ba, Oh portaun; tanis ba, Oh sidade;
verses.32: Oinsaa mak ita foo resposta ba manu-ain sira hosi nasaun nee?

verses.1: Liafuan todan kona ba Moab.
verses.2: Nia sae ba templu, no baa too iha Dibon,
verses.3: Sira sei hatais hena karoon iha dalan,
verses.4: Hesbon no Eleale sei hakilar,
verses.5: Hau nia fuan laran hakilar tanba Moab,
verses.6: Bee lihun sira iha Nimrim sei sai maran ona,
verses.7: Nunee sira nia riku-soin,
verses.8: Tanba lian hakilar nee sei tutan
verses.9: Tanba bee lihun sira iha Dimon sei nakonu ho raan,

16.title: hosi Sela, liu hosi dalan rai fuik maran,

verses.1: Haruka bibi malae oan ba ukun nain iha rai nebaa,
verses.2: Hanesan manu nebee semo sai
verses.3: “Foo konselhu lai,
verses.4: Husik sira nebee halai hosi Moab
verses.5: nunee kadunan sei harii iha domin metin,
verses.6: Ita rona ona katak Moab foti aan –
verses.7: Nunee husik ema Moab tanis halerik tanba Moab,
verses.8: Tanba Hesbon nia toos namlaik,
verses.9: Nunee hau sei tanis lelir ho tanis Jazer nian
verses.10: Tempu kontenti lakon tiha,
verses.11: Nunee hau nia kabun tanis hanesan harpa tanba Moab,
verses.12: Tuir mai, bainhira ita haree Moab hatudu aan, no sai kole iha fatin aas, no bainhira nia baa ninia fatin lulik hodi halo orasaun, nunee nia sei la hetan rezultadu diak.
verses.13: Ida nee mak liafuan nebee Nai hatete ona kona ba Moab iha tempu uluk.
verses.14: Maibee agora Nai hatete, no Nia dehan, “Iha tinan tolu nia laran, tuir ema servisu nia tinan, Moab nia glória sei sai moe, mezmu ema barak loos. Ikus liu sira nebee sei hela sei sai ema uitoan deit no fraku.

verses.1: Liafuan todan kona ba Damasku.
verses.2: Ema husik tiha ona Aroer nia sidade sira,
verses.3: Efraim sei lakon ninia uma seguransa,
verses.4: Iha loron nebaa, Jacó nia glória mak tuun
verses.5: Tempu nee sei hanesan tempu nebee toos nain halibur hare,
verses.6: Maibee sira sei husik ai haan restu iha nebaa,
verses.7: Iha loron nebaa, ema sei haree ba ninia Kriadór, no ninia matan sei foo respeitu ba Ida Nebee Santu iha Israel.
verses.8: Nia sei la haree ba altár sira, buat nebee ninia liman rasik mak halo. No nia sei la foo respeitu ba buat nebee ninia liman fuan mak halo, hanesan Aserá ka ídulu sira.
verses.9: Iha loron nebaa, sira nia sidade seguru sei sai fatin mamuk iha ai laran iha foho leten, nebee sira husik tanba ema Israel sira, no fatin nee mak aat tebes.
verses.10: Tanba imi haluha ona imi nia Maromak nebee salva imi,
verses.11: maski imi halo sira moris mai,
verses.12: Aii, ema lubun boot barak halo barulhu,
verses.13: Nasaun sira nee sei halai hanesan mota boot halai,
verses.14: Tebes, iha rai nakaras tempu susar sei mai,

verses.1: Aii, susar ba rai nebee baku liras,
verses.2: nebee haruka embaixadór sira liu hosi tasi,
verses.3: Ema hotu nebee hela iha mundu,
verses.4: Tanba Nai hatete mai hau:
verses.5: Tanba molok tempu kolheta, bainhira ai funan liu tiha ona,
verses.6: No Nia husik sira ba makikit hosi foho,
verses.7: Iha tempu nebaa, ema sei lori oferta ba Nai Forsa Nain,

verses.1: Liafuan todan kona ba Ejitu.
verses.2: Hau sei sadik ema Ejitu sira hodi hasoru malu,
verses.3: No espíritu nebee iha ema Ejitu nia laran sei lakon,
verses.4: Hau sei entrega ema Ejitu ba nain ida nebee hanehan sira,
verses.5: Bee sei lakon hosi tasi,
verses.6: no bee kanu sira sei sai dois,
verses.7: Natar balu besik Mota Nilu sei sai maran,
verses.8: Peskadór sira mos tanis no halerik,
verses.9: Sira nebee prepara kabas,
verses.10: Sira hotu nebee metin iha rai nee sei sai fraku,
verses.11: Loos duni, Zoan nia xefi sira mak beik,
verses.12: Imi nia ema matenek agora iha nebee?
verses.13: Zoan nia xefi sira sai beik ona,
verses.14: Nai kahur espíritu
verses.15: Ejitu la bele halo buat ida,
verses.16: Iha loron nebaa, Ejitu sei sai hanesan feto, sira sei tauk no nakdedar tanba Nai Forsa Nain nia liman, nebee Nia doko ba sira.
verses.17: Rai Judá sei halo ema Ejitu sai tauk. Ema hotu nebee rona ida nee sei sai tauk tanba Nai Forsa Nain nia planu nebee Nia desidi ona hodi hasoru sira.
verses.18: Iha loron nebaa, sidade lima iha rai Ejitu sei koalia lian Kanaan nian, no sira sei jura atu tuir Nai Forsa Nain. Sidade ida sei iha naran Sidade Rahun.
verses.19: Iha loron nebaa, sira iha altár ida ba Nai iha rai Ejitu nia leet, no monumentu ba Nai iha sira nia baliza.
verses.20: No buat sira nee sei sai sinál no sasin ida ba Nai Forsa Nain iha rai Ejitu. Bainhira sira bolu ba Nai tanba ema hanehan sira, Nai sei haruka salvadór ida ba sira, asuwain ida nebee salva sira.
verses.21: Nai sei foo konhesimentu ba ema Ejitu, no ema Ejitu sei konhese Nai iha loron nebaa. Sira sei foo sakrifísiu no oferta, no sira sei jura ba Nai no kumpri juramentu sira nee.
verses.22: Nai sei baku Ejitu, Nia sei baku no kura sira. Sira sei fila fali ba Nai, no Nia sei rona sira nia pedidu no kura sira.
verses.23: Iha loron nebaa, rai sei iha dalan boot hosi Ejitu too iha Asíria, no ema Asíria sei tama ba Ejitu, no ema Ejitu sei tama ba Asíria, no ema Ejitu sira sei serví hamutuk ho ema Asíria sira.
verses.24: Iha loron nebaa, Israel mos inklui ho Ejitu no Asíria hodi halo nain tolu, no sira sei sai bensaun ida iha rai klaran.
verses.25: Nai Forsa Nain sei foo bensaun ba sira, no dehan, “Bensaun ba Ejitu nebee Hau nia povu, no ba Asíria nebee Hau nia liman mak halo, no Israel nebee Hau nia liman rohan.”

20.title: Sinál Ida Hasoru Ejitu No Etiópia

verses.1: Iha tinan ida nebee Sargon, liurai hosi Asíria, haruka xefi komandante ba Asdode no nia mai ataka no hadau sidade nee -
verses.2: iha tempu nebaa, Nai koalia liu hosi Isaias, Amoz nia oan, no Nia dehan, “Baa no kore tiha o nia ropa karoon iha o nia kanotak no hasai tiha o nia sandálias hosi o nia ain.” Isaias halo tuir, no nia lao isin molik no ain tanan.
verses.3: Nai hatete, “Hau nia atan Isaias sei lao isin molik no ain tanan too tinan tolu hodi hatudu sinál ida no milagre ida ba Ejitu no Etiópia.
verses.4: Hanesan nee mos, liurai iha Asíria sei lori sai ema Ejitu nudar ema dadur, no ema Etiópia nudar ema kastigu, joven no katuas, isin molik no ain tanan, ho sira nia kidun tahan molik, nunee Ejitu sei molik.
verses.5: Ema sei sai tauk no moe tanba sira espera iha Etiópia, no sira foti aan iha Ejitu.
verses.6: No ema nebee hela besik tasi nee sei hatete iha loron nebaa, ‘Tebes, buat nee akontese ba sira nebee ami nia esperansa no ba sira nebee ami halai baa hodi salva ami hosi liurai iha Asíria! Agora, oinsaa mak ami bele halai hosi sira?’”

verses.1: Liafuan todan kona ba rai fuik maran besik tasi.
verses.2: Hau simu vizaun susar,
verses.3: Nunee hau nia kabun nakonu ho moras;
verses.4: Hau nia fuan moras,
verses.5: Sira prepara meza ida,
verses.6: Nunee Nai hatete mai hau,
verses.7: Bainhira nia haree kuda kareta,
verses.8: Depois ema nebee haree nee hakilar makaas,
verses.9: Tebes, hau haree ema mai ho kuda kareta,
verses.10: Oh ida nebee ema baku ona hanesan hare,
verses.11: Liafuan todan kona ba Duma.
verses.12: Ema seguransa hataan,
verses.13: Liafuan todan kona ba Arábia.
verses.14: Lori bee ba ema nebee hamrook,
verses.15: Tanba sira halai hosi surik sira,
verses.16: Tanba nunee Nai hatete mai hau, “Iha tinan ida nia laran, tuir tinan nebee ema servisu, Kedar nia glória hotu sei lakon.
verses.17: No asuwain sira hosi Kedar, nebee hana rama, sei hela uitoan deit, tanba Nai, Israel nia Maromak, hatete nunee.”

verses.1: Liafuan todan kona ba Foho Leet Vizaun Nian.
verses.2: imi nebee hakilar hela deit,
verses.3: Imi nia xefi hotu halai hamutuk,
verses.4: Nunee hau dehan,
verses.5: Tanba Nai Maromak Forsa Nain iha loron ida
verses.6: Elam loke ninia rama oan nia fatin
verses.7: Imi nia foho leet sira nebee buras
verses.8: Nia hasai tiha Judá nia manta.
verses.9: no imi haree iha David Nia Sidade moru monu ona iha fatin barak. Imi kuru bee hosi kolan iha kraik.
verses.10: Imi sura uma iha Jerusalém no imi baku rahun uma sira nee hodi hametin moru.
verses.11: Imi halo kolan ida iha moru rua nia leet hodi simu bee hosi kolan tuan. Maibee imi la haree ba Ida nebee kria buat nee, no Nia nebee halo planu kona ba ida nee hosi tempu antigu.
verses.12: Iha loron nebaa, Nai Maromak Forsa Nain
verses.13: no tebes, ema kontenti no oin midar,
verses.14: Hau rona ho hau nia tilun hosi Nai Forsa Nain:
verses.15: Nai Maromak Forsa Nain hatete nunee, “Baa hasoru funsionáriu ida naran Sebna nebee toma konta ba palásiu, no dehan,
verses.16: ‘Ita halo saida iha nee? See mak ita nian iha nee, nebee ita mak kee fatuk kuak hodi halo rate iha nee? Nusaa mak ita halo tiha ona rate ida iha leten, fatin ida hodi ita bele hela iha fatuk laran?
verses.17: Tebes, Nai rasik sei soe ita ho violénsia, Oh mane ida nebee forti. Nia sei kaer metin ita
verses.18: no dulas ita, no dulas tan ita no soe ita hanesan bola ida ba rai nebee luan. Iha nebaa ita sei mate. No ita nia kuda kareta nebee iha glória sei iha nebaa, Oh mane ida nebee hamoe ita nia patraun nia uma.
verses.19: Hau sei duni ita hosi ita nia fatin, no ema sei dada ita tuun hosi ita nia pozisaun.
verses.20: Iha loron nebaa, Hau sei bolu Hau nia atan Eliakim, Hilkias nia oan.
verses.21: Hau sei foo ita nia ropa ba nia hodi hatais. No Hau sei hametin nia ho ita nia sintu. No Hau sei foo ita nia autoridade ba ninia liman. Nia sei sai aman ba ema nebee hela iha Jerusalém, no ba uma Judá nian.
verses.22: Hau sei tau xave ba David nia uma iha ninia kabas. Nia sei loke, no la iha ema ida nebee bele taka; nia sei taka, no la iha ema ida nebee bele loke.
verses.23: Hau sei halo nia metin hanesan pregu ida iha fatin metin, no nia sei sai hanesan kadunan ida nebee foo glória ba ninia aman nia uma.
verses.24: Ema sira sei tara ba nia onra hotu hosi ninia aman nia uma, buat hotu hosi nia, bikan hotu, hosi kopu too baldi boot hotu.
verses.25: Iha loron nebaa, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, estaka ida nebee tau iha fatin metin nee sei sai. Ema sei tesi tuun no hamonu nia. No ema sei tesi sai todan nebee nia kaer nee, tanba Nai mak koalia tiha ona nunee.”

23.title: Profesia Kona Ba Tiro No Sidon

verses.1: Liafuan todan kona ba Tiro.
verses.2: Nonook lai, Oh ema sira
verses.3: Liu hosi tasi sira nee
verses.4: Sai moe, Oh Sidon, tanba tasi mak koalia tiha ona,
verses.5: Bainhira sira rona iha Ejitu,
verses.6: Hakur tasi too iha Tarsis,
verses.7: Ida nee mak ita nia sidade haksolok hosi tempu antigu ka?
verses.8: See mak halo planu hanesan nee hodi hasoru Tiro,
verses.9: Nai Forsa Nain mak halo planu nee,
verses.10: Hakur imi nia rai hanesan Mota Nilu,
verses.11: Nia lolo ona Ninia liman iha tasi leten,
verses.12: Nia dehan, “O sei la haksolok tan,
verses.13: Haree ema Kaldeia sira nia rai! Povu nee atu lakon. Asíria hanoin atu halo sira nia fatin sai rai fuik. Sira hadau fatin nee ho sira nia tanki de gera sira, no sira sobu palásiu sira iha nebaa, no estraga fatin nee too aat liu.
verses.14: Hakilar ba, Oh roo boot sira hosi Tarsis,
verses.15: Tuir mai, iha loron nebaa, ema haluha Tiro too tinan hitu-nulu, tuir tempu ba liurai ida nian. Bainhira tinan hitu-nulu hotu ona, Tiro sei sai hanesan feto aat nia kanta:
verses.16: “Foti harpa ida, no lao ba-mai iha sidade nee,
verses.17: Tuir mai, bainhira tinan hitu-nulu hotu ona, Nai sei vizita Tiro, no Tiro sei fila fali ba ninia hahalok nebee faan aan, no nia sei halo sala seksuál ho reinu hotu iha mundu tomak.
verses.18: Tiro nia sasaan no osan nebee nia hetan sei sai santu ba Nai. Nia sei la haloot ka rai riku-soin nee, maibee ninia riku-soin nee sei foo ai haan barak no ropa furak ba sira nebee hela iha Nai nia oin.

verses.1: Tebes, Nai sei halo rai sai mamuk no halakon buat hotu,
verses.2: Buat nee sei akontese ba povu, no hanesan mos ho saserdote;
verses.3: Rai nee sei sai mamuk duni, no aat tebes,
verses.4: Rai nee tanis no namlaik,
verses.5: Rai nee sai foer
verses.6: Nunee malisan ida mak haan rai nee,
verses.7: Tua uvas sei sai tristi,
verses.8: Haksolok ho tamborin nee para tiha ona,
verses.9: Sira sei la hemu tua uvas ho kanta,
verses.10: Sidade ho konfuzaun nee mak monu,
verses.11: Ema tanis hakilar iha dalan tanba tua uvas la iha,
verses.12: Sira sei husik sidade nee sai aat,
verses.13: Bainhira buat nee akontese iha rai nee
verses.14: Sira sei foti sira nia lian,
verses.15: Nunee imi hosi parte lorosae
verses.16: Hosi mundu nia rohan ita rona hananu sira,
verses.17: Buat tauk, no rai kuak no lasu mak hetan ita,
verses.18: Tuir mai, ida nebee halai hosi lian nebee halo nia tauk,
verses.19: Mundu mak rahun hotu ona,
verses.20: Mundu sei haliis ba-mai hanesan ema nebee lanu,
verses.21: Iha loron nebaa, Nai sei foo kastigu
verses.22: No sira sei halibur hamutuk
verses.23: Depois fulan sei hetan konfuzaun,

verses.1: Oh Nai, O mak hau nia Maromak,
verses.2: Tanba O mak halo sidade ida sai hanesan bou ida,
verses.3: Nunee povu sira nebee forti sei foo glória ba O,
verses.4: Tanba O mak fatin forti ba ema kiak,
verses.5: hanesan loron manas iha rai maran.
verses.6: Iha foho nee, Nai Forsa Nain sei prepara
verses.7: Iha foho nee, Nia sei tolan buat nebee taka povu hotu,
verses.8: Nia sei tolan mate ho vitória,
verses.9: Iha loron nebaa, ema dehan,
verses.10: Tanba iha foho nee, Nai nia liman sei deskansa,
verses.11: No Nia sei lolo Nia liman
verses.12: No Nia sei hamonu moru aas nebee proteje sira,

26.title: O Proteje Nia Ema Iha Dame Perfeitu

verses.1: Iha loron nebaa, sira sei kanta hanesan nee iha rai Judá:
verses.2: Loke portaun sira,
verses.3: O sei proteje no foo dame nebee perfeitu
verses.4: Fiar ba Nai nafatin ba nafatin,
verses.5: Tanba Nia hatuun ona sira nebee hela iha fatin aas,
verses.6: Ain sei sama fatin nee,
verses.7: Ema loos nia dalan mak tetuk,
verses.8: Iha dalan nebee tuir O nia julgamentu,
verses.9: Iha kalan, hau nia klamar hakarak tebes O,
verses.10: Maski O hatudu grasa ba ema aat,
verses.11: Nai, O hiit sae O nia liman,
verses.12: Oh Nai, O sei prepara dame mai ami,
verses.13: Oh Nai, ami nia Maromak,
verses.14: Sira mate ona, sira la moris fali;
verses.15: Maibee O aumenta ona nasaun ida nee, Oh Nai,
verses.16: Oh Nai, iha sira nia terus sira buka O,
verses.17: Hanesan feto isin rua,
verses.18: Ami moos isin rua,
verses.19: O nia ema mate sira sei moris fali,
verses.20: Mai, hau nia povu, tama lai ba imi nia uma laran,
verses.21: Tanba tebes, Nai sei sai hosi Ninia hela fatin

verses.1: Iha loron nebaa, Nai sei uza Ninia surik nebee toos no boot no forti loos hodi kastigu Leviatán, samea nebee koko halai. Leviatán nee mak samea nebee bobar aan. Nai sei oho samea naga nee, nebee iha tasi.
verses.2: Iha loron nebaa,
verses.3: Hau, Nai, mak hein nia.
verses.4: Hau la hirus.
verses.5: Ka husik sira mai hasoru Hau nia fortaleza,
verses.6: Iha tempu tuir mai, Jacó nia abut sei sai metin,
verses.7: Nia baku sira hanesan Nia baku ema nebee baku sira ka?
verses.8: Sukat lo-loos, Nia hasai sira liu hosi kastigu;
verses.9: Nunee, liu hosi dalan nee Nia sei hamoos Jacó nia hahalok aat,
verses.10: Tanba sidade ho moru aas sei sai mamuk,
verses.11: Bainhira ai sanak sai maran, sira sei tohar,
verses.12: Tuir mai, iha loron nebaa, hosi Mota Eufrates too iha mota kiik Ejitu nian, Nai sei baku trigu, no Nia sei halibur imi ida-idak, Oh povu Israel.
verses.13: Iha loron nebaa, ema sei huu bibi aman dikur boot, no sira nebee lakon iha rai Asíria no refujiadu sira nebee halai ba rai Ejitu sei mai no adora Nai iha foho santu iha Jerusalém.

verses.1: Aii susar ba Efraim nia lanu-teen sira nia koroa nebee gaba aan,
verses.2: Tebes, Nai iha ema ida nebee iha podér no forti,
verses.3: Ain ida sei sama tuun koroa nebee gaba aan nee,
verses.4: no ninia oin bonitu ho glória hanesan funan nebee namlaik,
verses.5: Iha loron nebaa, Nai Forsa Nain sei sai hanesan koroa ho glória,
verses.6: Nia sei sai espíritu justisa ba ida nebee tuur iha fatin julgamentu,
verses.7: Ema sira nee mos lanu ho tua uvas no lao abiru tanba tua forti;
verses.8: Tanba meza hotu nakonu ho muta foer,
verses.9: “Nia bele hanorin buat matenek ba see?
verses.10: Tanba orden tuir orden, no orden tuir orden,
verses.11: Tanba liu hosi estranjeiru nia ibun
verses.12: nebee Nia dehan ona,
verses.13: Nunee Nai nia liafuan ba sira mak
verses.14: Nunee rona Nai nia liafuan, imi nebee halo trosa,
verses.15: Tanba imi dehan, “Ami halo ona aliansa ho mate,
verses.16: nunee Nai Maromak hatete,
verses.17: Hau sei halo justisa sai hanesan tali loos,
verses.18: Imi nia aliansa ho mate sei kotu,
verses.19: Dala ida-idak nebee nia mai liu nia sei foti imi,
verses.20: Tanba kama badak liu hodi halolo aan,
verses.21: Tanba Nai sei hamriik hanesan iha Foho Perazim,
verses.22: Nunee la bele halo trosa,
verses.23: See imi nia tilun mai no rona hau nia lian;
verses.24: Toos nain fila rai loron tomak hodi kari fini ka?
verses.25: Bainhira nia halo ona rai tetuk,
verses.26: Tanba nia simu hanorin nebee loos;
verses.27: Ita la hamoos endru ho alat hamoos nian,
verses.28: Ita harahun trigu hodi halo paun ka?
verses.29: Buat nee mos mai hosi Nai Forsa Nain;

verses.1: Aii susar ba Ariel, Ariel, sidade ida nebee David halo akampamentu;
verses.2: Maibee Hau sei foo terus ba Ariel,
verses.3: No Hau sei haleu ita ho akampamentu ida,
verses.4: O sei tuun no koalia hosi rai,
verses.5: Maibee ema rai liur barak loos hanesan rai uut sei hasoru ita,
verses.6: Nai Forsa Nain sei vizita o
verses.7: Ema lubun boot hosi nasaun hotu nebee funu hasoru Ariel,
verses.8: Hanesan bainhira ema hamlaha mehi katak nia haan,
verses.9: Hein took no hakfodak ba,
verses.10: Tanba Nai mak enxe ba imi espíritu ida nebee toba haluha rai,
verses.11: Vizaun tomak nee sai hanesan livru nebee taka metin ba imi. Bainhira ema lori livru nee ba ema matenek no dehan, “Lee ida nee,” no nia dehan, “Hau la bele, tanba livru nee sei taka metin.”
verses.12: No bainhira ema foo livru nee ba ema la hatene lee, no dehan, “Lee ida nee,” nia dehan, “Hau la hatene lee.”
verses.13: Nunee Nai hatete,
verses.14: nunee, tebes, Hau sei halo buat sira nebee furak iha povu nee nia leet,
verses.15: Aii susar ba sira nebee buka atu subar sira nia planu
verses.16: Tebes imi fila buat loos ulun tuun ain sae!
verses.17: Laos la kleur tan,
verses.18: Iha loron nebaa, ema tilun diuk
verses.19: Ema laran maus sei hetan ksolok foun iha Nai,
verses.20: Tanba sira nebee domina ho hahalok aat sei lakon,
verses.21: tanba sira uza liafuan ida hodi halo ema seluk hetan naran aat,
verses.22: Tanba nee Nai, nebee hola fali Abraão, hatete kona ba Jacó nia família:
verses.23: Tanba bainhira nia haree ninia oan sira,
verses.24: No mos sira nebee lao sala iha sira nia espíritu sei hetan kompriensaun,

verses.1: “Aii susar ba oan sira nebee ulun toos,” hatete Nai,
verses.2: ba sira nebee lao tuun ba Ejitu,
verses.3: Nunee Faraó nia protesaun sei halo imi sai moe,
verses.4: Tanba maski ninia xefi sira hela iha Zoan,
verses.5: ema hotu sei sai moe
verses.6: Liafuan todan kona ba animál fuik iha parte súl:
verses.7: Tanba Ejitu nia ajuda la iha folin no sei mamuk,
verses.8: Agora, baa, no hakerek buat nee iha fatuk belar ida iha sira nia oin,
verses.9: Tanba povu nee mak nasaun nebee kontradór,
verses.10: sira dehan ba ema nebee bele haree,
verses.11: Sees hosi dalan nee,
verses.12: Nunee, Ida Nebee Santu iha Israel hatete,
verses.13: Nunee hahalok aat nee sei sai hanesan moru nebee nakfera ba imi,
verses.14: No nia sei rahun hanesan badaen rai mean harahun sanan rai,
verses.15: Tanba Nai Maromak, Ida Nebee Santu iha Israel, hatete,
verses.16: No imi dehan, “Lae! Ami sei sae kuda no halai.”
verses.17: Ema nain rihun ida sei halai hosi ema ida nebee hasee sira;
verses.18: Nunee Nai hein
verses.19: Tanba povu sei hela iha Zion, iha Jerusalém; no imi sei la tanis tan. Nia sei hatudu grasa boot ba imi bainhira Nia rona imi nia lian tanis. Bainhira Nia rona lian nee, Nia sei hataan kedas ba imi.
verses.20: Maski Nai foo paun susar nian, no bee terus nian, maibee imi nia Mestri nee sei la subar tan Ninia aan, maibee imi nia matan sei haree imi nia Mestri.
verses.21: No imi nia tilun sei rona liafuan ida iha imi nia kotuk nebee dehan, “Dalan mak nee, lao ba,” bainhira imi fila ba liman loos, ka bainhira imi fila ba liman karuk.
verses.22: Imi sei hafoer imi nia estátua lulik sira nebee taka ho osan mutin, no imi nia ídulu sira nebee taka ho osan mean. Imi sei soe sira hanesan hena mens nian, no dehan ba buat sira nee, “Baa ona!”
verses.23: Nunee Nia sei foo udan ba imi nia fini nebee imi kuda iha rai, no paun nebee hetan hosi rai nia produsaun sei diak liu no barak. Iha loron nebaa, imi nia animál sira sei hetan duut fatin nebee luan.
verses.24: Karau sira no kuda buru sira nebee fila rai sei haan batar diak, nebee haliri ona ho kanuru no garfu boot.
verses.25: No iha foho aas hotu nia leten no iha foho oan hotu nia leten sira sei hetan mota nebee suli ho bee, iha loron nebee ema barak mate, bainhira uma aas sira monu.
verses.26: No mos fulan nia naroman sei sai hanesan naroman loro matan nian, no naroman loro matan nian sei makaas liu tan ba dala hitu, hanesan naroman hosi loron hitu, iha loron nebee Nai kurtiva buat tohar iha Ninia povu, no kura kanek nebee sira simu.
verses.27: Tebes, Nai nia Naran mai hosi fatin dook,
verses.28: no Ninia iis mak hanesan mota boot,
verses.29: Imi sei iha kanta ida, hanesan bainhira ema halo festa santu iha kalan; no imi sei iha fuan laran nebee kontenti, hanesan bainhira ema lao ba ho flauta hodi sae Nai nia foho, ba Israel nia Fatuk.
verses.30: No Nai sei halo hodi ema bele rona Ninia lian nebee iha glória, no Nia sei hatudu Ninia liman nebee tuun mai, ho Ninia hirus manas, no ho ahi lakan nebee haan mohu, ho namkari, no anin fuik, no udan jelu fatuk.
verses.31: Tanba Nai nia lian sei halo ema Asíria sira sai tauk, bainhira Nia baku ho Ninia ai tonka.
verses.32: No iha fatin hotu nebee ai tonka ukun nee sei akontese, iha fatin nebee Nai kona, ita sei rona tamborin sira no harpa sira; no Nia sei funu hasoru sira ho Ninia liman rasik.
verses.33: Tanba Nia prepara ona fatin sunu hosi tempu antigu. Tebes, Nia prepara ona fatin nee ba liurai. Nia halo fatin nee klean no luan nebee iha ahi boot ho ai barak, no Nai nia iis halakan ahi nee hanesan mota nebee suli ho mina nebee lakan.

31.title: Susar ba Sira Nebee Tuun ba Ejitu

verses.1: Aii susar ba sira nebee tuun ba Ejitu hodi hetan ajuda;
verses.2: Maibee Nia mak matenek, no Nia sei haruka buat aat,
verses.3: Ema Ejitu sira mak ema deit, no sira laos Maromak;
verses.4: Tanba Nai mak koalia ona ba hau,
verses.5: Hanesan manu semo,
verses.6: Fila ba Nia, povu nebee kontra ona Nia ho sala boot, Oh ema Israel sira.
verses.7: Tanba iha loron nebaa, ema hotu sei soe sira nia ídulu osan mutin, no sira nia ídulu osan mean sira, nebee sira nia liman rasik mak halo ho sala.
verses.8: “No ema Asíria sei monu ho surik ida nebee laos mane nian,
verses.9: No ninia fatuk seguru sei lakon tanba nia tauk loos,

32.title: Liurai Ida Sei Ukun ho Hahalok Loos

verses.1: Tebes, liurai ida sei ukun ho hahalok loos,
verses.2: Xefi Ida-idak sei sai hanesan fatin subar hosi anin,
verses.3: No ema nebee bele haree sei la taka sira nia matan,
verses.4: No ema nia fuan laran nebee halai arbiru sei kompriende no hatene,
verses.5: No ema sei la dehan tan katak ema beik mak ema boot,
verses.6: Tanba ema beik sei koalia liafuan nebee beik,
verses.7: No ba beik-teen nee - ninia hanoin mak aat.
verses.8: Maibee ema onradu halo planu ho onra,
verses.9: Hamriik ba, feto sira nebee hela hakmatek;
verses.10: Iha tinan ida ba oin, imi sei hetan terus,
verses.11: Nakdedar ba, feto sira nebee hela hakmatek;
verses.12: Tuku imi nia hirus matan,
verses.13: tanba ai tarak no duut tarak iha Hau nia povu nia rai,
verses.14: Tanba palásiu nee mamuk,
verses.15: too Espíritu sei fui hosi lalehan ba ami,
verses.16: Depois justisa sei hela iha rai fuik,
verses.17: No hahalok loos sei lori dame mai,
verses.18: No hau nia povu sei hela iha fatin dame,
verses.19: No bainhira ai laran nee monu, sira sei hetan udan jelu fatuk;
verses.20: Haksolok ba imi nebee kuda fini iha bee fatin nia sorin,

verses.1: Aii susar ba ita nebee estragadór,
verses.2: Oh Nai, hatudu grasa mai ami;
verses.3: Bainhira povu nee rona barulhu sira halai,
verses.4: no O halibur O nia riku-soin,
verses.5: Nai mak sae; tanba Nia hela iha leten.
verses.6: no Nia sei halo imi metin iha imi nia tempu,
verses.7: Tebes, sira nia eroi sira sei hakilar iha liur,
verses.8: Dalan boot sira sai mamuk,
verses.9: Rai tanis halerik no sai fraku.
verses.10: “Agora, Hau sei hamriik,” hatete Nai,
verses.11: Imi kous ai rahun, imi partu maibee hetan duut maran.
verses.12: No povu nee sei sai hanesan fatuk mutin nebee tunu,
verses.13: Rona ba, imi nebee sei dook, kona ba buat nebee Hau halo tiha ona;
verses.14: Sala nain sira iha Zion sei tauk.
verses.15: Nia nebee lao ho hahalok loos, no koalia loos;
verses.16: nia sei hela iha fatin aas,
verses.17: Imi nia matan sei haree liurai ho oin bonitu,
verses.18: Imi nia fuan laran sei hanoin kona ba buat terus.
verses.19: Ita sei la haree tan povu aat nee,
verses.20: Haree Zion nee, sidade nebee halo festa loron boot nian!
verses.21: Ita nia Nai nebee iha majestade mak iha nebaa,
verses.22: Tanba Nai mak ita nia Juis,
verses.23: Imi nia tali naklosu;
verses.24: No ema nebee hela iha nebaa nunka dehan, “Hau moras.”

verses.1: Mai besik, Oh nasaun sira, hodi rona;
verses.2: Tanba Nai nia laran hirus hasoru nasaun hotu,
verses.3: Sira soe ema sira nebee mate,
verses.4: No forsa hotu iha lalehan sei dodok too lakon,
verses.5: Tanba Hau nia surik sei haan too bosu iha lalehan;
verses.6: Nai iha surik ida; no surik nee nakonu ho raan;
verses.7: Karau fuik sei monu ho sira,
verses.8: Tanba Nai iha loron vingansa nian,
verses.9: No Edom nia mota sei suli ho alkatraun,
verses.10: Ahi nee sei lakan loron-kalan;
verses.11: Maibee pelikanu no orisu sei hetan fatin nee;
verses.12: Sira nia xefi sira la iha atu dehan reinu mak nee,
verses.13: Duut tarak sei taka ninia palásiu sira,
verses.14: Animál fuik sei hasoru asu fuik,
verses.15: Iha nebaa, kakuuk boot sei halo ninia knuuk,
verses.16: Buka took no lee iha livru Nai nian:
verses.17: No Nia dada rifa ona ba sira,

verses.1: Rai fuik no rai maran sei haksolok;
verses.2: Fatin nee sei iha funan barak,
verses.3: Haforsa liman fraku,
verses.4: Dehan ba sira nebee iha laran tauk,
verses.5: Nunee ema matan delek nia matan sei loke,
verses.6: Nunee ema ain aat sei haksoit hanesan bibi rusa,
verses.7: No rai manas sei sai bee lihun,
verses.8: No dalan boot sei iha nebaa,
verses.9: Iha dala nee liaun la iha,
verses.10: Sira nebee Nai salva ona sei fila fali,

verses.1: Iha tinan sanulu resin haat iha liurai Ezekias nia tempu, Senakerib liurai hosi Asíria, sae baa no ataka sidade hotu iha Judá nebee iha moru, no nia manaan sira.
