verses.2: Depois liurai hosi Asíria haruka Rabsake hosi Lakis lao ho forsa boot ba liurai Ezekias iha Jerusalém. No sira baa okupa fatin nebee besik bee kanu hosi tanke leten iha dalan ba fasi ropa fatin.
verses.3: No ema nebee baa hasoru sira mak Eliakim, Hilkias nia oan, nia mak toma konta ba palásiu, Sebna nebee sekretaris, no Joa, Asafe nia oan, nebee hakerek liurai nia liafuan.
verses.4: Rabsake dehan ba sira nunee, “Dehan ba Ezekias, liurai iha Asíria, liurai boot, hatete nunee ‘Ita nia fiar bazeia ba saida?
verses.5: Ita hanoin katak liafuan deit mak sai stratejia no podér hodi halo funu ka? Ita laran metin ba see, atu nunee ita bele kontra hasoru hau?
verses.6: Tebes, ita laran metin ba Ejitu, ai tonka nee mak duut kain nebee tohar ona. Nia sei sona ema see deit nia liman nebee sadere ba nia. Nunee ho Faraó, liurai hosi Ejitu, ba ema hotu nebee fiar ba nia.
verses.7: Maibee, se ita dehan mai hau, “Ami fiar ba Nai, ami nia Maromak,” maibee laos Ezekias mak hasai tiha Nai nia fatin aas no altár sira, no dehan ba ema iha Judá no Jerusalém, “Adora deit iha altár ida nee”?
verses.8: Agora, mai halo akordu lai ho hau nia liurai iha Asíria, no hau sei foo kuda rihun rua ba ita se karik ita iha ema natoon hodi sae kuda hirak nee.
verses.9: Nunee oinsaa ita bele duni fila komandante ida nebee kiik liu hosi ami nia Nai nia atan sira. Maski ita laran metin ba Ejitu hodi sira haruka kuda kareta no ema sira nebee lori kuda nee.
verses.10: Ita hanoin katak Nai la tulun ami atu mai ataka no destrui rai nee ka? Nai mak dehan mai hau, “Sae ba, no hasoru rai nee, no destrui sira.”’”
verses.11: Depois Eliakim, Sebna no Joa dehan ba Rabsake, “Favór ida, koalia deit ho lian Aramaiku ho ami, tanba ami kompriende. La bele koalia lian Judeu nian hodi ema sira iha moru leten bele rona.”
verses.12: Maibee Rabsake hataan, “Imi hanoin katak hau nia nai haruka hau ba imi nia nai no imi deit hodi koalia liafuan nee ka? Laos hau koalia mos ba sira nebee tuur iha moru leten, nebee sei haan sira nia teen rasik no hemu sira nia mii rasik hamutuk ho imi?”
verses.13: Nunee Rabsake hamriik no hakilar ho lian boot iha lian Judeu nian, “Rona mai saida mak liurai boot, liurai hosi Asíria dehan.
verses.14: Liurai dehan hanesan nee, ‘Keta husik Ezekias bosok imi, tanba nia la bele salva imi.
verses.15: Keta husik Ezekias halo imi fiar ba Nai no dehan, “Nai sei salva ita. Nia sei la entrega sidade nee ba liurai Asíria nia liman.”
verses.16: Keta rona ba Ezekias.’ Liurai hosi Asíria dehan, ‘Halo dame ho hau, no sai mai hau, no ema ida-idak sei haan hosi ninia ai uvas rasik, no hosi ninia ai figeira rasik, no hemu bee hosi ninia bee posu rasik,
verses.17: too hau mai no lori imi ba hela iha rai ida nebee hanesan ho imi nia rai, nebee iha batar no tua uvas, rai nebee iha paun no toos uvas.
verses.18: Keta husik Ezekias bosok imi no dehan, “Nai sei salva ami.” Iha maromak ida hosi nasaun sira seluk nebee salva tiha ninia nasaun hosi liurai iha Asíria ka?
verses.19: Hamate ho Arpade sira nia maromak agora iha nebee? Sefarvaim, Ena no Iva sira nia maromak iha nebee? Sira salva tiha Samaria hosi hau nia liman ka lae?
verses.20: La iha maromak ida hosi nasaun sira seluk nebee bele salva sira hosi ami nia liurai nia liman, nunee nusaa mak imi hanoin katak Nai bele salva Jerusalém hosi nia liman?’”
verses.21: Maibee povu iha Jerusalém sei nonook, no la hataan liafuan ida, tanba liurai Ezekias foo orden ona no dehan, “La bele hataan ba nia.”
verses.22: Entaun Eliakim, Hilkias nia oan, nebee toma konta iha palásiu, Sebna nebee sekretaris no Joa, Asafe nia oan, nebee liurai nia konselheiru, sira nain tolu nee fila ba no lees tiha sira nia ropa no konta ba Ezekias saida mak Rabsake dehan tiha ona.

verses.1: Bainhira liurai Ezekias rona liafuan nee, nia lees tiha ninia ropa no hatais fali hena karoon no nia baa kedas Nai nia uma.
verses.2: Depois nia haruka Eliakim nebee toma konta iha palásiu, sekretaris Sebna, no saserdote sira nebee katuas ona atu baa koalia ho profeta Isaias, Amoz nia oan. Sira mos hatais hena karoon.
verses.3: No sira konta ba Isaias, “Ezekias hatete hanesan nee, ‘Loron ohin, loron tristi! Ita hetan kastigu no ema hamoe ita. Ita hanesan feto nebee atu tuur ahi, maibee la iha forsa.
verses.4: Karik Nai, ita nia Maromak, sei rona liafuan hosi Rabsake, nebee liurai hosi Asíria haruka ona hodi hamoe Maromak nebee moris. Atu Nai, ita nia Maromak, bele hasee liafuan nee, nebee Nia rona. Nunee foti sae orasaun ba Nai kona ba povu restu nebee sei morishela.”
verses.5: Entaun, liurai Ezekias nia atan sira baa hasoru Isaias.
verses.6: Isaias haruka Ezekias nia atan sira hatoo resposta nunee, “Nai hatete hanesan nee, ‘Keta tauk ba liafuan nebee ita rona tiha ona nee, nebee liurai Asíria nia atan sira foo sai tiha ona hodi koalia aat mai Hau.
verses.7: Tebes, Hau sei haruka espíritu tama nia, depois nia sei rona istória ruma nebee halo nia fila ba ninia rai. Iha nebaa, Hau sei halo nia sai mate liu hosi surik iha ninia rai.’”
verses.8: Entaun Rabsake fila no rona katak liurai hosi Asíria husik tiha ona Lakis no nia hetan liurai nee funu hela hasoru sidade Libna.
verses.9: Bainhira liurai hosi Asíria rona liafuan katak Tiraka, liurai hosi Etiópia, mai atu ataka nia, nunee nia haruka manu-ain sira ba Ezekias, no dehan,
verses.10: “Foo hatene ba Ezekias, liurai hosi Judá, no dehan, ‘Keta husik ita nia Maromak bosok ita no dehan katak Jerusalém la tama ba liurai Asíria nia liman.
verses.11: Tebes ita rona ona katak nasaun see-see deit nebee liurai Asíria ataka, nasaun nee agora rahun aat liu. Nunee ita hanoin atu hetan salvasaun ka?
verses.12: Iha tempu nebee ami nia bei-ala sira harahun sidade Gozan, Haran, no Rejefe no oho ema Eden sira nebee hela iha Telasar, sira nia maromak sira la salva sira.
verses.13: Liurai sira hosi sidade Hamate, Arpade, Sefarvaim, Ena no Iva agora iha nebee?’”
verses.14: Liurai Ezekias simu surat nee hosi manu-ain sira, no nia lee. No nia baa kedas Nai nia uma no tau surat nee iha Nai nia oin.
verses.15: Depois nia halo orasaun ba Nai no dehan,
verses.16: “Oh Nai Forsa Nain, Israel nia Maromak, nebee tuur iha O nia kadunan, iha kerubim sira nia leten. O mak Maromak, O mesak deit, no O mak ukun reinu hotu iha mundu nee. O mak halo lalehan ho rai.
verses.17: Oh Nai, see O nia tilun mai no rona. Oh Nai, loke O nia matan no haree. Rona liafuan hotu nebee Senakerib hatete ona hodi hamoe O, Maromak nebee moris.
verses.18: Tebes, Oh Nai, liurai Asíria sira mak harahun tiha nasaun hotu no nasaun sira nia rai,
verses.19: no soe sira nia maromak sira ba ahi laran, tanba sira laos maromak sira, maibee buat nebee ema mak halo deit hosi ai no fatuk. Nunee sira halakon maromak sira nee.
verses.20: Agora, tanba nee, Oh Nai, ami nia Maromak, salva tiha ami hosi liurai Asíria nia liman, hodi nasaun hotu iha mundu bele hatene katak O deit mak Nai Maromak.”
verses.21: Tuir mai, Isaias, Amoz nia oan, haruka lia menon ba liurai Ezekias no dehan, “Nai, Israel nia Maromak, hatete nunee: Tanba ita halo ona orasaun ba Hau kona ba Senakerib, liurai hosi Asíria,
verses.22: ida nee mak liafuan nebee Nai koalia kona ba nia:
verses.23: O koalia aat no goza see?
verses.24: O haruka o nia manu-ain mai hodi hamoe Nai,
verses.25: Hau kee tiha bee posu
verses.26: O la rona ona
verses.27: Ema sira nebee hela iha nebaa sai fraku,
verses.28: Maibee Hau hatene fatin nebee o tuur,
verses.29: Tanba o hirus tebe-tebes Hau,
verses.30: “Ida nee sei sai sinál ba o: Tinan ida nee o sei haan ai haan nebee mesak moris, no tinan oin mai o sei haan buat nebee moris hosi tinan nee, maibee iha tinan terseiru kuda ba no hetan rezultadu, kuda ai uvas no haan nia fuan nee.
verses.31: Ema restu nebee sei moris hela hosi jerasaun Judá nian sei hatuun abut no foo fuan nebee sae.
verses.32: Tanba hosi Jerusalém ema sira nebee sei hela nee sei sai, no hosi Foho Zion ema sira nebee sei moris nee sei sai. Nai Forsa Nain nia laran manas sei halao buat nee.”
verses.33: “Nai hatete nunee kona ba liurai hosi Asíria: ‘Nia sei la tama iha sidade nee ka hana rama iha nee ka hasoru fatin nee ho eskudu ka harii rai hodi sae moru nee.
verses.34: Liurai hosi Asíria sei fila fali liu hosi dalan nebee uluk nia lao mai nee, no nia sei la tama iha sidade nee,’ hatete Nai.
verses.35: ‘Tanba Hau sei defende sidade nee, no salva nia, tanba Hau nia aan rasik no tanba Hau nia atan David.’”
verses.36: Depois Nai nia Anju tama ba akampamentu ema Asíria sira nian no oho soldadu nain rihun atus ida ualu-nulu resin lima (185.000). Iha aban dadeer-saan, ema haree mate isin barak iha nebaa.
verses.37: Entaun Senakerib, liurai hosi Asíria, hakiduk no fila ba Nínive no hela iha nebaa.
verses.38: Iha loron ida, bainhira nia adora hela ninia maromak Nisroke iha fatin lulik, ninia oan mane Adrameleke no Sarezer oho nia ho surik, depois sira halai tiha ba rai Ararate. Nia oan ida seluk naran Esar-Hadon, sai liurai troka nia.

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, Ezekias sai moras no besik mate. Depois profeta Isaias, Amoz nia oan, mai no dehan ba nia, “Nai hatete nunee, ‘Hatoo liafuan ikus ba o nia família, tanba o sei mate no la moris tan.’”
verses.2: Nunee Ezekias fila nia oin ba didin no nia halo orasaun ba Nai,
verses.3: “Favór ida, Oh Nai, hanoin hau tanba hau lao ona iha O nia oin ho fidelidade no laran tomak no hau halo ona buat nebee diak iha O Nia oin.” Depois Ezekias tanis ho lian makaas.
verses.4: Depois Nai nia liafuan mai ba Isaias, no Nai dehan,
verses.5: “Baa fali no dehan ba Ezekias: Ida nee mak Nai, o nia bei-ala David nia Maromak, nebee hatete, ‘Hau rona tiha ona o nia orasaun no Hau haree tiha ona o nia matan been sira; tebes Hau sei aumenta tinan sanulu resin lima ba o nia moris.
verses.6: Hau sei hasai o no sidade nee hosi liurai Asíria nia liman, no Hau sei defende sidade nee.
verses.7: No ida nee mak sinál ba o hosi Nai, katak Nai sei halo tuir buat nebee Nia koalia nunee:
verses.8: Tebes, Hau sei lori fali lalatak nebee sura oras nee, ida nebee tuun iha Ahaz nia oras loro matan nian, no lalatak nee sei hakat ba kotuk dala sanulu.’” Nunee loro matan hakat ba kotuk dala sanulu, tuir fatin nebee foin tuun nee.
verses.9: Buat nebee Ezekias, liurai hosi Judá, mak hakerek bainhira nia moras no sai diak fali hosi ninia moras nee:
verses.10: Hau dehan, hau nia iis kotu iha hau nia moris klaran,
verses.11: Hau dehan, hau sei la haree Nai,
verses.12: Hau nia fatin mak lakon no sai hosi hau,
verses.13: Hau hein ho pasiénsia too dadeer fali,
verses.14: Hanesan manu liin ka manu kiik ida hau mak halo lian,
verses.15: Hau koalia oinsaa? Nia mak koalia ona ba hau,
verses.16: Oh Nai, liu hosi buat sira nee ema sei moris,
verses.17: Oinsaa, hau hetan tempu susar boot
verses.18: Tanba infernu la bele hahii O,
verses.19: Ema nebee moris, ema nebee moris,
verses.20: Nai sei salva tiha hau:
verses.21: Tanba Isaias dehan ona, “Haruka sira foti figeira fuan sira, no tau hanesan aimoruk ba ninia moras nee, no nia sei sai diak fali.”
verses.22: No Ezekias mos husu ona, “Saida mak sinál hodi hatudu katak hau sei sae ba Nai nia uma?”

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, Merodake-Balada, Balada nia oan, liurai hosi Babilónia, haruka ema lori karta no prezenti ida hodi foo ba liurai Ezekias, tanba nia rona Ezekias moras no diak fali.
verses.2: Ezekias haksolok tebes bainhira sira mai, no nia hatudu ba sira buat nebee iha folin iha nia uma, osan mutin no osan mean, ai morin no mina morin, armazén nebee iha sasaan funu no buat hotu nebee iha nia tezourária nia laran nee. La iha buat ida nebee iha nia uma laran ka iha nia reinu nebee Ezekias la hatudu ba sira.
verses.3: Depois profeta Isaias mai too iha liurai Ezekias no husu ba nia, “Ema sira nee hatete saida? No sira mai hosi nebee?” Ezekias hataan, “Sira mai hosi rai Babilónia nebee dook!”
verses.4: Depois nia husu tan, “Saida mak sira haree tiha ona iha ita nia uma?” Ezekias hataan ba nia, “Buat hotu nebee iha hau nia uma, sira haree hotu ona. La iha buat ida nebee iha hau nia tezourária nia laran nebee hau la hatudu ona ba sira.”
verses.5: Depois Isaias hatete ba Ezekias, “Rona liafuan hosi Nai Forsa Nain:
verses.6: ‘Tebes, tempu ida sei mai, kuandu buat hotu nebee iha ita nia uma no buat nebee ita nia bei-ala sira rai hela too ohin loron sei lori baa Babilónia. La iha buat ida nebee husik iha nee,’ hatete Nai.
verses.7: ‘No hosi ita nia bei-oan sira nebee mai hosi ita, nebee ita hetan, sira sei lori ema nee baa hodi servisu hanesan funsionáriu sira iha liurai Babilónia nia palásiu.’”
verses.8: Ezekias hataan ba Isaias, “Nai nia liafuan mak diak nebee ita koalia ona nee!” Tanba nia hanoin, “Tanba tempu hakmatek no metin sei iha durante hau nia moris!”

40.title: Foo Kamaan ba Maromak Nia Povu

verses.1: “Foo kamaan ba, foo kamaan ba Hau nia povu,”
verses.2: Koalia ho laran diak ba Jerusalém,
verses.3: Lian ida hakilar:
verses.4: Foti sae foho leet hotu,
verses.5: No Nai nia glória sei mai,
verses.6: Lian ida dehan, “Hakilar ba!”
verses.7: Duut namlaik, no funan lakon,
verses.8: Duut namlaik, no funan mos lakon,
verses.9: Oh Zion, nebee lori liafuan diak, sae ba foho aas;
verses.10: Tebes, Nai Maromak sei mai ho liman forti,
verses.11: Nia sei hein Ninia bibi hanesan bibi atan ida,
verses.12: See mak sukat bee hotu iha ninia liman,
verses.13: See mak tetu Nai nia Espíritu,
verses.14: See mak foo konselhu ba Nia,
verses.15: Tebes, nasaun sira mak hanesan bee turu ida iha baldi,
verses.16: Líbanon la too atu sunu,
verses.17: Nasaun hotu sei la iha buat ida iha Ninia oin;
verses.18: Nunee see mak hanesan Maromak?
verses.19: Badaen halo estátua lulik,
verses.20: Ema nebee kiak liu, nebee la iha oferta ida,
verses.21: Imi la hatene ka?
verses.22: Maromak mak tuur iha mundu kabuar nia leten,
verses.23: Nia mak hatuun xefi sira too sira la iha buat ida,
verses.24: Sira foin kuda, no foin tama rai,
verses.25: Nunee see mak bele kompara ho Hau?
verses.26: Foti sae imi nia matan ba leten,
verses.27: Nusaa mak ita dehan, Oh Jacó,
verses.28: Ita seidauk hatene ka?
verses.29: Nia foo forsa ba sira nebee fraku,
verses.30: Joven sira mos sai fraku no kole,
verses.31: maibee sira nebee hein Nai sei hetan forsa foun,

verses.1: Rona Hau ho nonook, Oh ilha sira;
verses.2: See mak fanu ema ida hosi lorosae,
verses.3: Nia duni sira, depois nia kontinua ho diak,
verses.4: See mak halo buat nee?
verses.5: Ilha sira haree ona no sira tauk;
verses.6: Ida-idak ajuda ninia maluk;
verses.7: Nunee badaen ai foo korajen ba badaen osan mean,
verses.8: Maibee ita mak Israel, Hau nia atan,
verses.9: Ita mak ida nebee Hau foti ona hosi mundu nia rohan,
verses.10: Keta tauk, tanba Hau hamutuk ho ita;
verses.11: Tebes, ema hotu nebee hirus makaas hasoru ita
verses.12: Ita sei buka sira nebee hasoru ita,
verses.13: Tanba Hau, Nai, imi nia Maromak,
verses.14: Keta tauk, Jacó nebee hanesan ular,
verses.15: Tebes, Hau sei halo ita hanesan kareta nebee baku trigu no iha nehan,
verses.16: Ita sei haliri sira, no anin sei lori sira lakon,
verses.17: Bainhira ema kiak no ema mukit buka bee,
verses.18: Hau sei loke mota iha fatin aas,
verses.19: Hau sei kuda ai teka iha rai fuik,
verses.20: hodi sira bele haree, no hatene,
verses.21: “Foo sai ita nia kazu,” hatete Nai,
verses.22: Husik sira bele lori liafuan nee mai,
verses.23: Foo hatene kona buat sira nebee atu tuir mai,
verses.24: Tebes, imi laos buat ida,
verses.25: Hau fanu ema ida hosi parte norte, no nia sei mai.
verses.26: See mak deklara hosi tempu hahuu,
verses.27: Iha tempu primeiru, Hau dehan ba Zion, “Tebes, sira mak nee!”
verses.28: Tanba bainhira hau buka, hau la hetan ida,
verses.29: Tebes, sira hotu mamuk deit;

42.title: Nai Nia Atan Nebee Nia Hili Ona

verses.1: Tebes hau nia atan, nebee Hau suporta;
verses.2: Nia sei la hakilar, ka foti sae nia lian,
verses.3: Tahan dodok ida hosi duut iha bee lihun nia sei la halo tohar,
verses.4: Nia sei la falta ou sai fraku,
verses.5: Maromak, Nia mak Nai,
verses.6: “Hau mak Nai, Hau mak bolu ona ita iha hahalok loos,
verses.7: hodi loke ema matan delek nia matan,
verses.8: Hau mak Nai, no Hau nia naran mak nee,
verses.9: Tebes, buat uluk nee akontese ona,
verses.10: Kanta ba Nai kanta ida nebee foun,
verses.11: Husik rai fuik no sidade sira iha nebaa bele foti sae sira nia lian,
verses.12: Husik sira foo glória ba Nai,
verses.13: Nai sei lao ba oin hanesan asuwain ida,
verses.14: Kleur ona Hau hela nonook,
verses.15: Hau sei estraga foho no foho oan,
verses.16: No Hau sei lori ema matan delek liu
verses.17: Sira nebee fiar ba estátua lulik sei fila fali ba,
verses.18: Rona ba, imi nebee tilun diuk;
verses.19: See mak matan delek hanesan Hau nia atan,
verses.20: Nia haree buat barak, maibee nia la kompriende;
verses.21: Nai mak hakarak, tanba Ninia hahalok loos,
verses.22: Maibee ema hadau povu nee no naok hosi sira;
verses.23: See mak iha imi nia leet nebee bele foo tilun ba buat sira nee?
verses.24: See mak husik Jacó hodi ema bele hadau,
verses.25: Tanba nee Nai mak fakar Ninia hirus manas ba Jacó,

verses.1: Maibee agora Nai hatete, Nia nebee kria ona o, Oh Jacó,
verses.2: Bainhira o lao liu hosi tasi, Hau sei hamutuk ho o;
verses.3: Tanba Hau mak Nai, o nia Maromak,
verses.4: Tanba o iha folin iha Hau nia matan,
verses.5: Keta tauk, tanba Hau hamutuk ho o.
verses.6: Hau sei dehan ba parte norte, ‘Foo ba’ ;
verses.7: ema ida-idak nebee iha ona Hau nia naran,
verses.8: Lori mai povu nebee matan delek maibee sira sei iha matan,
verses.9: Husik nasaun hotu halibur hamutuk,
verses.10: “Imi mak Hau nia sasin sira,” hatete Nai,
verses.11: Hau, Hau duni, mak Nai;
verses.12: Hau deklara ona, no salva ona no hatudu ona,
verses.13: Iha loron sira nebee tuir mai, Hau mak Nia.
verses.14: Nai hatete nunee, imi nia Hola-nain,
verses.15: Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak Santu,
verses.16: Nai hatete nunee, nebee halo dalan liu hosi tasi,
verses.17: Nia nebee lori mai kuda kareta no kuda,
verses.18: Lalika hanoin buat uluk sira nee,
verses.19: Tebes, Hau sei halo buat foun;
verses.20: Animál sira iha ai laran sei foo onra ba Hau,
verses.21: povu nebee Hau kria ba Hau nia aan rasik;
verses.22: Maibee imi la bolu ba Hau, Oh Jacó;
verses.23: Imi la lori mai Hau imi nia bibi hodi halo oferta tunu motuk.
verses.24: Imi la lori mai Hau ai midar ka osan,
verses.25: Hau, Hau duni, mak Nia
verses.26: Hanoin kona ba Hau, mai ita diskuti malu;
verses.27: Imi nia bei-ala primeiru mak sala,
verses.28: Tanba nee Hau halo foer xefi sira iha Fatin Santu,

verses.1: “Maibee rona agora, Oh Jacó, hau nia atan;
verses.2: Nai hatete nunee, Nia nebee halo ita,
verses.3: Tanba Hau sei fui bee ba nia nebee hamrook,
verses.4: No sira sei mosu mai iha duut fatin,
verses.5: Ema ida sei dehan, ‘Hau mak Nai nian,’
verses.6: Nai hatete nunee, Liurai iha Israel,
verses.7: See mak hanesan Hau? Husik nia bele hatete nunee.
verses.8: Keta tauk, no lalika hakfodak.
verses.9: Sira nebee halo estátua lulik la iha folin; no buat nebee sira adora la foo rezultadu diak; no sira nia sasin sira la haree ka hatene, nunee sira sai moe.
verses.10: See mak kria maromak ida ka halo estátua lulik nebee la halo buat ida?
verses.11: Tebes, ninia maluk sira hotu sei sai moe; no badaen sira nee mak ema deit. Husik sira mai hamutuk, husik sira hamriik ba. Sira hotu hakfodak no sai moe hamutuk.
verses.12: Badaen besi foti besi ruma hodi halo iha ahi klaak sira, no nia tuku ho martelu, no halo ninia servisu nee ho liman forti. Nia sai hamlaha, no nia sai kole, nia la hemu bee nunee nia sai fraku.
verses.13: Karpinteiru sukat ho nia metru, nia riska buat nee no halo linha. Nia supila buat nee ho ninia supila, nia tau linha ho alat kabuar, no halo buat nee tuir modelu ema nian, hanesan ema ida nebee bonitu hodi bele hamriik iha uma laran.
verses.14: Nia tesi tuun ai teka sira, no foti ai nebee aas no ai huun nebee boot, nebee nia kuda metin iha ahi laran hodi nia bele uza. Nia kuda ai nebee forti, no udan foo hemu ba ai nee.
verses.15: Ai balu nia rai hodi ema bele sunu. Nia foti ai balu hodi halo nia aan manas, nia aumenta ai hodi tunu paun. Depois nia halo mos maromak ida no adora buat nee. Nia halo estátua lulik, no hakneak ba estátua nee.
verses.16: Nunee balu nia sunu iha ahi, nia tein naan, nia tunu naan no haan too bosu, nia hamanas nia aan no dehan, “Aha, agora hau manas, no hau bele haree ahi nee!”
verses.17: No ho ai restu nee nia halo maromak ida, ninia estátua lulik. Nia hakneak ba estátua nee, no adora nia, no halo orasaun ba nia, no hatete, “Salva tiha hau, tanba ita mak hau nia maromak!”
verses.18: Sira la hatene no sira la kompriende. Tanba Nia mak taka sira nia matan, hodi sira la bele haree; no Nia mak taka sira nia fuan laran sira, hodi sira la bele kompriende.
verses.19: La iha ema ida nebee hanoin iha ninia fuan laran, la iha matenek ka kompriensaun hodi dehan, “Hau sunu tiha sorin ho ahi, no hau tunu tiha paun ho ahi klaak sira nee, hau tunu tiha naan no haan ona; depois hau sei halo buat nebee foer ho ai restu nee? Hau sei hakneak ba ai rohan nee ka?”
verses.20: Nia haan ahi klaak deit, nia fuan laran bosok nia no lori nia ba dalan sala, hodi nia la bele salva nia aan, ka dehan, “Laos buat nebee iha hau nia liman loos mak buat nebee bosok hau?”
verses.21: “Hanoin hetan buat sira nee, Oh Jacó;
verses.22: Hau hamoos tiha ona o nia sala nebee kontra Hau,
verses.23: Kanta ba, Oh lalehan, tanba Nai halo tiha ona ida nee.
verses.24: Nai hatete nunee, o nia Hola-nain,
verses.25: Hau kria konfuzaun ba bosok-teen sira nia sinál,
verses.26: Hau hametin Hau nia atan nia liafuan,
verses.27: Hau dehan ba tasi klean, ‘Sai maran lai.’
verses.28: Hau dehan kona ba Sirus, ‘Nia mak Hau nia bibi atan,

verses.1: Nai hatete nunee ba Ninia unjidu,
verses.2: “Hau sei baa iha ita nia oin,
verses.3: No Hau sei foo riku-soin ba ita hosi fatin nakukun,
verses.4: Tanba Jacó nebee Hau nia atan,
verses.5: Hau mak Nai. La iha ida seluk,
verses.6: hodi sira bele hatene hosi lorosae,
verses.7: Hau forma naroman, no kria nakukun.
verses.8: Hatuun hosi leten, Oh lalehan sira,
verses.9: Aii susar ba nia nebee kontra Ida Nebee forma nia,
verses.10: Aii susar ba nia nebee hatete ba ninia aman,
verses.11: Nai hatete nunee,
verses.12: Hau halo ona mundu, no Hau kria ema iha nebaa.
verses.13: Hau mak hakiak nia iha hahalok loos,
verses.14: Nai hatete nunee,
verses.15: Tebes, O mak Maromak nebee subar aan,
verses.16: Sira sei sai moe, no sira hotu hetan konfuzaun,
verses.17: Maibee Nai sei salva Israel ho salvasaun too tinan ba tinan.
verses.18: Tanba Nai hatete nunee, Nia nebee kria lalehan sira,
verses.19: Hau la koalia nonook,
verses.20: Halibur aan no mai,
verses.21: Koalia ba, no foo sai ita nia liafuan,
verses.22: Hateke ba Hau, no hetan salvasaun,
verses.23: Hau jura ona liu hosi Hau nia aan,
verses.24: Tebes, ita sei dehan, ‘Iha Nai deit mak iha hahalok loos no podér.
verses.25: Jerasaun hotu iha Israel sei sai loos iha Nai,

verses.1: Bel mak hakneak, Nebo mak hakruuk.
verses.2: Sira hakruuk, sira hakneak hamutuk;
verses.3: Rona Hau ba, Oh jerasaun hosi Jacó,
verses.4: no bainhira ita katuas ona, Hau mak nee hela;
verses.5: Ita kompara Hau ho see
verses.6: Sira foti osan mean barak hosi sira nia bolsu,
verses.7: Sira foti nia ba sira nia kabaas, no tula nia,
verses.8: Hanoin hela buat nee no hamriik metin.
verses.9: Hanoin hetan buat tempu antigu nian,
verses.10: nebee deklara buat ikun hosi tempu hahuu,
verses.11: Hau bolu manu nebee hamlaha loos hosi sorin lorosae,
verses.12: Rona Hau ba, imi nebee laran toos,
verses.13: Hau lori Hau nia hahalok loos mai besik, nia laos iha fatin dook,

verses.1: Tuun mai, no tuur iha rai rahun, Oh feto raan nebee oan hosi Babilónia,
verses.2: Foti fatuk kabuar hodi halo batar uut,
verses.3: Ita sei hatudu ita nia isin molik,
verses.4: Ami nia Hola-nain, Nai Forsa Nain mak Ninia naran,
verses.5: Tuur nonook deit, no tama ba fatin nakukun,
verses.6: Hau mak hirus ona ho Hau nia povu,
verses.7: No ita dehan, “Hau mak feto boot too tinan ba tinan.”
verses.8: Tanba nee rona lai, ita nebee buka deit tempu diak,
verses.9: Maibee buat rua nee sei akontese ba ita
verses.10: Tanba ita fiar ba ita nia hahalok aat,
verses.11: Tanba nee, buat aat sei kona ita;
verses.12: Hamriik lai ho ita nia hahalok nebee fekit,
verses.13: Ita kole ona ho ita nia liafuan barak.
verses.14: Tebes, sira sei sai hanesan duut kain, no ahi sei sunu sira;
verses.15: Nunee mak sira nebee uluk servisu ho ita,

verses.1: Rona ba, Oh jerasaun hosi Jacó, nebee bolu ho naran Israel,
verses.2: Tanba sira foti naran hosi sidade santu,
verses.3: “Hau deklara ona buat uluk nian
verses.4: Tanba Hau hatene katak ita mak ulun fatuk toos,
verses.5: Hau deklara buat sira nee ba ita hosi tempu hahuu,
verses.6: Tanba ita rona ona, no ita haree ona;
verses.7: Sira foin mai, foin dadauk sira mosu,
verses.8: Ita nunka rona kona ba buat nee, ita nunka hatene;
verses.9: Tanba Hau nia naran Hau nia laran hirus sei hein,
verses.10: Tebes, Hau hamoos ona ita, maibee laos hanesan osan mutin;
verses.11: Tanba Hau nia naran, tanba Hau nia naran, Hau sei halo buat nee.
verses.12: Rona lai, Oh Jacó,
verses.13: Hau nia liman mak hada fundasaun mundu nian,
verses.14: “Imi hotu, halibur hamutuk no rona;
verses.15: Hau, Hau duni mak koalia no Hau mak bolu ona nia.
verses.16: Mai, imi hakbesik Hau, no rona lai;
verses.17: Nai hatete nunee, imi nia Hola-nain,
verses.18: Oh katak imi rona Hau nia ukun fuan sira!
verses.19: Imi nia jerasaun mos hanesan rai henek,
verses.20: Sai hosi Babilónia, halai hosi ema Kaldeia sira,
verses.21: Sira la hamrook bainhira Nia lori sira liu hosi rai maran;
verses.22: “La iha dame,” hatete Nai,

verses.1: Rona hau, Oh ilha sira, no simu liafuan nee,
verses.2: No Nia halo hau nia ibun hanesan surik kroat;
verses.3: No Nia dehan mai hau, “Ita mak Hau nia atan, Oh Israel,
verses.4: Maibee hau hataan, “Hau servisu ho saugati deit,
verses.5: Agora Nai hatete,
verses.6: nunee Nia dehan, “Ida nee sei kamaan liu,
verses.7: Nai hatete nunee, Nia nebee Hola-nain iha Israel,
verses.8: Nai hatete nunee, “Iha tempu nebee loos Hau rona ita,
verses.9: hodi ita bele dehan ba ema kastigu sira, ‘Sai ba’,
verses.10: Sira sei la sai hamlaha ka hamrook,
verses.11: No Hau sei halo Hau nia foho hotu sai hanesan dalan,
verses.12: Tebes, ema sira sei mai hosi fatin dook,
verses.13: Kanta ba, Oh lalehan sira;
verses.14: Maibee Zion dehan, “Nai mak husik ona hau,
verses.15: “Inan bele haluha ninia bebee nebee sei susu ka?
verses.16: Tebes, Hau mak hakerek ita iha Hau nia liman;
verses.17: Ita nia oan sira mai lalais;
verses.18: Foti ita nia matan no haree ba;
verses.19: Maski uluk ita nia fatin sai aat, no ita nia rai la iha ema,
verses.20: No ita nia oan sira nebee ita hetan sei tuir oan sira nebee lakon nee,
verses.21: Depois ita sei dehan iha ita nia fuan laran,
verses.22: Nai Maromak hatete nunee,
verses.23: No liurai sira sei sai ita nia aman hakiak sira,
verses.24: Ita bele hadau ai haan hosi ema podér ka?
verses.25: Maibee Nai hatete nunee,
verses.26: No Hau sei halo ema nebee hanehan ita hodi sira haan fali sira nia isin rasik;

verses.1: Nai hatete nunee,
verses.2: Tanba saa mak bainhira Hau mai, mane la iha?
verses.3: Hau mak foo hatais lalehan sira ho metan,
verses.4: Nai Maromak mak foo nanaal matenek ba hau,
verses.5: Nai Maromak mak loke ona hau nia tilun,
verses.6: Hau foo hau nia kotuk ba sira nebee baku,
verses.7: Tanba Nai Maromak sei ajuda hau;

verses.13: no ita haluha katak Nai mak Ida nebee kria ita,

verses.19: Buat rua sira nee hasoru ona ita,

verses.1: Hadeer, hadeer ba, no hatais ita nia podér, Oh Zion;

verses.5: Agora tanba nee, Hau iha saida iha nee,” hatete Nai, “nebee Hau nia povu mak lakon saugati deit? Sira nia xefi sira tanis hakilar.” hatete Nai, “no ema halo trosa Hau nia naran loro-loron nafatin deit.
verses.6: Tanba nee Hau nia povu sei hatene Hau nia naran. Tanba nee sira sei hatene iha loron nebaa, katak Hau mak Nia nebee koalia. Tebes, Hau mak nee.”
verses.7: Furak loos iha foho
verses.8: Seguransa sira nee mak hakilar,
verses.9: Haklalak hamutuk ho hananu,

verses.11: Sai ba, sai ba, sai hosi fatin nee.

verses.1: “Mai lai, ema hotu nebee hamrook,

verses.1: Nai hatete nunee,

verses.1: Ema nebee moris loos sei lakon,

verses.9: No ita baa ona ba liurai ho mina,

verses.1: “Hakilar ba, keta nonook! Foti ita nia lian hanesan bibi aman dikur,
verses.2: Maibee sira buka Hau loro-loron,
verses.3: ‘Nusaa mak ami jejún, maibee O la haree?
verses.4: Tebes, imi jejún ho hirus malu no haan malu,
verses.5: Buat nee mak jejún nebee Hau hakarak ka?
verses.6: Laos buat nee mak jejún nebee Hau hakarak?
verses.7: Laos imi fahe imi nia paun ba ema hamlaha,
verses.8: Nunee imi nia lampu sei leno ba hanesan dadeer-saan,
verses.9: Nunee imi sei bolu, no Nai sei hataan;
verses.10: No se imi fui imi nia moris hodi ajuda ema hamlaha,
verses.11: No Nai sei hatudu dalan nafatin ba ita,
verses.12: No imi sei hadia fali imi nia fatin antigu nebee aat,
verses.13: Se imi la lao sala iha loron Sabdu,
verses.14: nunee imi sei kontenti iha Nai;

verses.1: Tebes, Nai nia liman la badak hodi Nia la bele salva,
verses.2: Maibee imi nia hahalok aat
verses.3: Tanba imi nia liman mak foer ho raan,
verses.4: La iha ema ida nebee koalia ho justisa,
verses.5: Sira fera samea nia tolun sira,
verses.6: Sira nia labadain nia talin fatin sei la sai ropa,
verses.7: Sira nia ain halai ba buat aat,
verses.8: Sira la hatene dalan dame nian,
verses.9: Tanba nee justisa mak dook hosi ami,
verses.10: Ami lolo liman hodi buka moru hanesan ema matan delek,
verses.11: Ami hakilar hanesan ursu sira,
verses.12: Tanba ami nia sala sira nebee kontra O mak habarak iha O nia oin,
verses.13: Ami halo sala no bosok hasoru Nai,
verses.14: Nunee justisa fila fali,
verses.15: Tebes lia loos sei falta,
verses.16: No Nia haree katak la iha ema ida,
verses.17: Nia hatais hahalok loos hanesan eskudu iha Ninia hirus matan,
verses.18: Tuir sira nia hahalok, nunee Nia sei selu;
verses.19: Nunee sira sei hamtauk Nai nia naran hosi loromonu,
verses.20: “Hola-nain ida sei mai too iha Zion,
verses.21: “No ba Hau, ida nee mak Hau nia aliansa ho sira,” hatete Nai, “Hau nia Espíritu nebee Hau foo ba ita, no Hau nia liafuan nebee Hau tau iha ita nia ibun, sei la sai hosi ita nia ibun, ka imi nia oan sira nia ibun, ka imi nia bei-oan sira nia ibun,” hatete Nai, “hosi tempu nee too tinan ba tinan.”

verses.1: Hamriik no leno ba, tanba ita nia naroman mai ona,
verses.2: Tanba, tebes, tempu nakukun sei taka mundu,
verses.3: No nasaun sira sei mai ba ita nia naroman,
verses.4: Foti sae ita nia matan no haree ba,
verses.5: Nunee ita sei haree no haksolok,
verses.6: Kuda kamelu barak sei taka ita nia rai,
verses.7: Bibi hotu hosi Kedar sei halibur hamutuk ba ita,
verses.8: See mak sira nebee semo hanesan kalohan,
verses.9: Tebes ilha sira sei hein Hau,
verses.10: No ema rai liur sira nia oan sira sei harii ita nia moru sira,
verses.11: Tanba nee ita nia portaun sira sei loke nafatin,
verses.12: Tanba nasaun no reinu nebee sei la serví ita sei sai lakon;
verses.13: Líbanon nia glória sei mai ba ita,
verses.14: Oan mane sira hosi sira nebee hanehan ita
verses.15: Uluk sira husik ita no odi ita,
verses.16: No mos ita sei susu nasaun sira nia susubeen,
verses.17: Hau sei lori osan mean troka riti,
verses.18: Ita sei la rona violénsia iha ita nia rai,
verses.19: Loro matan sei laos ita nia naroman iha loron,
verses.20: Ita nia loro matan sei la tuun fali;
verses.21: Ita nia povu hotu sei iha hahalok loos,
verses.22: Ida nebee uitoan sei sai rihun ida,

verses.1: Espíritu hosi Nai Maromak mak tama hau;
verses.2: hodi foo sai katak tinan nee mak tinan diak ba Nai,
verses.3: hodi foo ba sira nebee tanis halerik iha Zion –
verses.4: No sira sei harii fatin tuan nebee aat,
verses.5: No ema rai liur sei hein imi nia bibi sira hodi foo haan ba sira,
verses.6: Maibee imi sei hetan naran Saserdote Nai Nian,
verses.7: Tanba bensaun dala rua sei troka imi nia moe,
verses.8: Tanba Hau, Nai, hadomi justisa,
verses.9: No sira nia jerasaun sira sei sai konhesidu iha nasaun sira nia leet,
verses.10: Hau sei haksolok liu iha Nai,
verses.11: Tanba hanesan rai foo ai dikin,

verses.1: Tanba Zion, hau sei la nonook, no tanba Jerusalém hau sei la deskansa,
verses.2: No nasaun sira sei haree ita nia hahalok loos,
verses.3: Ita sai hanesan koroa glória nian iha Nai nia liman,
verses.4: Sira sei la temi naran ‘Husik Ona’,
verses.5: Tanba hanesan joven mane kaben ho joven feto,
verses.6: Hau tau ema seguransa iha ita nia moru sira, Oh Jerusalém,
verses.7: La foo deskansa ba Nia,
verses.8: Nai mak jura tiha ona ho Ninia liman loos,
verses.9: Maibee sira nebee haloot ai haan sei haan buat nee,
verses.10: Lao liu, lao liu portaun sira nee;
verses.11: Tebes, Nai mak deklara
verses.12: No ema sei bolu sira, “Povu Nebee Santu”,

verses.1: See mak nee nebee mai hosi Edom,
verses.2: Tanba saa mak O nia ropa nee kór mean,
verses.3: “Hau mak sama mesak iha tanki uvas;
verses.4: Tanba loron vingansa mak iha Hau nia fuan laran,
verses.5: Hau buka ona, maibee la iha ema ida hodi ajuda;
verses.6: Hau sei sama tuun ona povu nee ho Hau nia laran hirus,
verses.7: Hau sei konta kona ba Nai nia domin metin,
verses.8: Tanba Nia dehan, “Tebes sira mak Hau nia povu,
verses.9: Iha sira nia terus hotu Nia mos hetan terus,
verses.10: Maibee sira kontra Nia,
verses.11: Depois Nia hanoin hetan tempu uluk,
verses.12: Nia nebee lori sira ho Ninia liman bonitu,
verses.13: Nia nebee lori sira liu hosi fatin klean?
verses.14: Hanesan animál ida iha foho leet,
verses.15: Hateke tuun hosi lalehan,
verses.16: O mak ami nia Aman,
verses.17: Oh Nai, nusaa mak O halo ami lao sala hosi O nia dalan sira,
verses.18: O nia povu santu mak hela iha fatin nee too tempu uitoan deit,
verses.19: Ami sai hanesan ema sira nebee O nunka ukun,

64.title: favór ida tuun mai lai, hodi foho nakdoko iha O nia prezensa -

verses.1: Oh, favór ida, halees tiha lalehan sira,
verses.2: hanesan ahi sunu ai maran,
verses.3: Hori bainhira O halo buat sira nebee halo ami hamtauk,
verses.4: Tanba hosi mundu hahuu, ema la rona,
verses.5: O hasoru nia nebee haksolok hodi halao hahalok loos,
verses.6: Ami hotu sai hanesan buat ida nebee foer,
verses.7: La iha ida nebee bolu ba O nia naran,
verses.8: Maibee agora, Oh Nai, O mak ami nia Aman;
verses.9: Keta raan nakali, Oh Nai,
verses.10: O nia sidade santu sira nee sai ona rai fuik,
verses.11: Ami nia uma nebee santu no furak,
verses.12: Maski nunee, O sei hein hela ka, Oh Nai?

verses.1: “Hau hatudu aan ba sira nebee la husu kona ba Hau,
verses.2: Loron tomak Hau lolo Hau nia liman ba povu ida nebee ulun toos,
verses.3: povu ida nebee provoka nafatin Hau,
verses.4: sira tuur iha rate sira nia leet,
verses.5: no sira dehan, ‘Hamriik ketak, la bele hakbesik hau,
verses.6: Tebes, hau haree liafuan
verses.7: tanba imi nia hahalok aat,
verses.8: Nai hatete nunee,
verses.9: Hau sei lori oan sira hosi Jacó,
verses.10: Saron sei iha bibi sira,
verses.11: Maibee imi nebee husik Nai,
verses.12: Tanba nee surik sei hasoru imi nia futuru,
verses.13: Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee,
verses.14: tebes, hau nia atan sira sei kanta haksolok ho fuan laran,
verses.15: No imi sei husik imi nia naran
verses.16: Nunee nia nebee foo bensaun iha rai nee
verses.17: Tanba, tebes, Hau kria lalehan foun sira no mundu foun ida.
verses.18: Maibee kontenti no haksolok ba too rohan laek
verses.19: No Hau sei haksolok iha Jerusalém,
verses.20: Iha fatin nee sei la iha bebee ida nebee moris too loron balu deit,
verses.21: No sira sei harii uma sira,
verses.22: Sira sei la harii uma, no ema seluk hela iha nebaa;
verses.23: Sira sei la servisu no la hetan buat ida,
verses.24: No molok sira bolu,
verses.25: Asu fuik no bibi malae oan sei haan hamutuk,

verses.1: Nai hatete nunee,
verses.2: Tanba Hau nia liman halo buat hotu nee,
verses.3: Nia nebee oho karau
verses.4: Hau mos sei hili buat susar ba sira,
verses.5: Rona Nai nia liafuan,
verses.6: Lian barulhu hosi sidade!
verses.7: Molok nia hetan kanotak moras,
verses.8: See mak rona buat sira nee?
verses.9: Hau sei halo kanotak moras
verses.10: Haksolok ba ho Jerusalém, no kontenti ba ho nia,
verses.11: tanba imi sei susu too bosu iha ninia susun nebee hamaus imi,
verses.12: Tanba Nai hatete nunee,
verses.13: Hanesan inan hamaus ninia oan,
verses.14: No bainhira imi sei haree buat nee,
verses.15: “Tanba, tebes, Nai sei mai ho ahi,
verses.16: Tanba Nai sei halao julgamentu liu hosi ahi,
verses.17: Sira nebee hamoos aan, no sai moos hodi tama jardin sira no tuir ema ida iha sira nia leet, no haan naan fahi no buat foer no laho sira nee, sira sei lakon hamutuk,” hatete Nai.
verses.18: “Tanba Hau hatene sira nia hahalok no sira nia hanoin sira; no tempu sei mai atu halibur nasaun hotu no lian hotu; no sira sei mai, no sira sei haree Hau nia glória.
verses.19: No Hau sei tau sinál ida iha sira nia leet. No hosi ema sira nee Hau sei haruka sira nebee sei moris ba nasaun sira, ba Tarsis, Pul, no Lud, nebee dada rama, ba Tubal, no Javan, ba ilha sira nebee dook loos, ba sira nebee seidauk rona kona ba Hau nia naran nebee boot, no seidauk haree Hau nia glória; no sira sei deklara Hau nia glória iha nasaun sira nia leet.
verses.20: No sira sei lori imi nia maluk sira hosi nasaun hotu hodi sai oferta ida ba Nai, no sira sei mai ho kuda, no iha kuda kareta, no iha tuur fatin nebee ema lori, no ho mula sira, no animál sira nebee lalais, ba hau nia Foho Santu Jerusalém,” hatete Nai, “hanesan oan sira iha Israel lori oferta iha bikan moos ba uma Nai nian.
verses.21: No Hau mos sei foti balu hosi sira hodi sai saserdote sira no sai ema Levi sira,” hatete Nai.
verses.22: Tanba hanesan lalehan foun sira no mundu foun,
verses.23: Hosi fulan ida ba fulan nebee tuir,
verses.24: No sira sei sai ba, no haree mate isin sira hosi ema nebee sala hasoru Hau. Sira nia ular sei la mate, no sira nia ahi sei la mate, no buat hotu nebee moris sei hakribi sira.”

verses.1: Ida nee mak Jeremias, Hilkias nia oan mane, nia liafuan. Jeremias mai hosi jerasaun saserdote nian nebee iha Anatote, iha rai Benjamin.
verses.2: Nai nia liafuan mai iha tempu Josias, oan mane hosi Amon, nebee liurai iha Judá, iha nia ukun nia tinan ba dala sanulu resin tolu.
verses.3: Liafuan nee mos mai iha tempu Jeoakim, oan mane hosi Josias, nebee liurai iha Judá, too Zedekias nia ukun remata iha nia ukun nia tinan ba dala sanulu resin ida, too ema Jerusalém sai ema dadur iha fulan lima.
verses.4: Nai koalia mai hau, no dehan,
verses.5: “Molok Hau forma o iha kabun laran, Hau hatene ona o,
verses.6: Maibee hau hataan, “Oh Nai Maromak! Tebes, hau la hatene oinsaa atu koalia, tanba hau sei joven hela.”
verses.7: Maibee Nai dehan mai hau,
verses.8: Keta tauk ba sira,
verses.9: Depois Nai lolo Ninia liman no kona hau nia ibun. Nai dehan mai hau,
verses.10: Haree ba, iha loron ida nee Hau foti o hodi ukun nasaun no reinu sira,
verses.11: Liu tiha nee Nai nia liafuan mai hau no dehan, “Jeremias, saida mak o haree?” Hau hatete, “Hau haree ai amendueira nia sanak.”
verses.12: Depois Nai dehan mai hau, “O nia matan haree diak, tanba Hau hakaas aan atu halo tuir Hau nia liafuan.”
verses.13: Nai nia liafuan mai hau ba dala rua, no dehan, “Saida mak o haree?” Hau hataan, “Hau haree sanan ida nebee ho bee nakali makaas, no sanan nee nia ibun hateke mai hela hosi parte norte.”
verses.14: Depois Nai dehan mai hau, “Hosi parte norte buat aat sei mai hodi foo terus ba ema hotu nebee hela iha rai nee.
verses.15: Tanba nee, tebes Hau bolu jerasaun hotu hosi reinu sira iha parte norte, hatete Nai. Sira sei mai, no ida-idak sei harii sira ninia reinu iha Jerusalém nia portaun sira. Sira sei hasoru moru hotu nebee haleu Jerusalém. Sira sei hasoru sidade hotu iha Judá.
verses.16: Hau sei foo sai Hau nia julgamentu nebee hasoru sira tanba sira nia hahalok aat hotu. Tanba sira husik ona Hau. Sira sunu insensu ba maromak sira seluk. No sira hakneak hodi adora ba buat nebee sira halo ho sira nia liman rasik.
verses.17: Maibee o nee, diak liu o prepara aan, hamriik no hatoo ba sira liafuan hotu nebee Hau foo orden ba o. La bele tauk ba sira, nunee Hau la halo o nakdedar iha sira nia oin!
verses.18: Tebes, loron ohin Hau halo o sai sidade nebee abrigu, no besi riin, no moru riti nebee kontra rai nee hotu. O sei kontra liurai Judá sira, xefi sira, saserdote sira no povu iha rai nee.
verses.19: Sira sei funu hasoru o, maibee sira sei la manaan o, tanba Hau hamutuk ho o hodi salva o, hatete Nai.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau, no Nia dehan,
verses.2: “Baa hatoo ba povu Jerusalém hodi sira bele rona, Nai hatete nunee,
verses.3: Iha tempu nebaa Israel mak santu ba Nai,
verses.4: Rona Nai nia liafuan, Oh jerasaun hosi Jacó, no família hotu hosi jerasaun Israel.
verses.5: Nai hatete nunee:
verses.6: Sira la husu, ‘Nai iha nebee,
verses.7: Hau lori ona imi ba rai nebee buras
verses.8: Saserdote sira la husu, ‘Nai iha nebee?’
verses.9: Nunee Hau sei diskuti malu ho imi,
verses.10: Lao deit ba ema Kitim sira nia ilha no haree ba;
verses.11: Iha nasaun ida nebee troka sira nia maromak sira,
verses.12: Admira ba, Oh lalehan sira,
verses.13: tanba Hau nia povu halo aat dala rua,
verses.14: Israel nee mak atan ida ka? Ou atan nia oan ka?
verses.15: Liaun foin sae hasai lian hasoru nia,
verses.16: Ema Menfis no ema Tapanes sira
verses.17: Laos imi rasik mak halo ba imi nia aan,
verses.18: No agora, imi manaan saida bainhira imi baa Ejitu,
verses.19: O nia hahalok aat mak kastigu imi,
verses.20: ‘Tanba iha tempu antigu Hau halo tohar imi nia ai leba,
verses.21: Maibee Hau kuda imi hanesan uvas diak,
verses.22: Mezmu o fasi o nia aan ho ahu kdesan,
verses.23: Oinsaa mak o iha brani hodi hatete, ‘Hau laos foer,
verses.24: hanesan kuda buru nebee toman iha rai fuik,
verses.25: Kuidadu o nia ain hodi la bele lao ain tanan,
verses.26: Hanesan naok-teen sai moe bainhira ema kaer toman nia,
verses.27: nebee hatete ba ai rohan ida, ‘O mak hau nia aman!’
verses.28: Maibee o nia maromak sira iha nebee,
verses.29: Tanba saa mak imi hakarak diskuti malu ho Hau? Imi hotu kontra hasoru Hau,
verses.30: Hau baku ona imi nia oan sira, maibee saugati deit,
verses.31: Oh jerasaun nee, rona lai
verses.32: Feto raan ida bele haluha ninia sasaan diak nebee nia hatais ka?
verses.33: Nusaa mak o halo aan diak
verses.34: O nia roupa mos iha raan
verses.35: o dehan hela, ‘Hau inosenti!
verses.36: Oinsaa o lao ba-mai arbiru deit,
verses.37: Hosi nebaa mos o sei sai

verses.1: “Se mane ida soe ninia feen,
verses.2: Foti o nia matan ba foho nebee molik no haree ba!
verses.3: Tanba nee udan boot la tuun
verses.4: Laos foin dadauk o bolu Hau,
verses.5: Nia sei rai odi too tinan ba tinan ka?
verses.6: Nai dehan mai hau iha tempu liurai Josias nian, “O haree ona buat nebee Israel halo hodi fila ba kotuk? No o haree oinsaa nia sae ba foho aas ida-idak no nia ba iha ai huun boot ida-idak nia okos, no iha nebaa nia halo sala seksuál?
verses.7: Hau hanoin, ‘Bainhira nia halo buat nee hotu tiha ona, nia sei fila fali mai Hau,’ maibee nia la fila. No ninia biin rasik Judá nebee traidór haree ninia hahalok nee.
verses.8: Judá haree katak Hau hakotu ona Israel tanba Israel nia sala seksuál. Feto Israel nee fila ba kotuk, no Hau foo ona surat fahe malu ba nia. Maski nunee, Israel nia biin Judá nebee traidór la sai tauk, maibee nia mos baa halo sala seksuál.
verses.9: Nia halo sala seksuál arbiru deit nunee nia hafoer rai nee. Nia halo sala seksuál ho fatuk no ai.
verses.10: Maski buat sira nee hotu, Israel nia biin Judá nebee traidór la fila fali mai Hau ho ninia laran tomak. Maibee nia iha laran bosok, hatete Nai.”
verses.11: No Nai dehan mai hau, “Israel, nebee fila ba kotuk, hatudu katak nia iha hahalok loos liu traidór Judá.
verses.12: Baa foo sai liafuan nee ba parte norte, no dehan,
verses.13: Diak liu mak o rekonhese o nia hahalok aat,
verses.14: “Fila fali mai, Oh oan sira nebee fila ba kotuk,
verses.15: Hau sei foo ba imi bibi atan sira nebee tuir Hau nia fuan laran; sira sei tau matan ba imi ho matenek no kompriensaun.
verses.16: Nai hatete nunee, bainhira imi aumenta barak no imi iha bei-oan sira iha rai nee, iha tempu nebaa ema sei la dehan tan, ‘Nai nia Arka Aliansa nee.’ Ida nee sei la mosu iha sira nia kakutak, no sira sei la hanoin hetan buat nee, no ema sei la buka ou halo fali Arka nee.
verses.17: Iha tempu nebaa, sira sei bolu Jerusalém ‘Nai nia kadunan’. No nasaun hotu sei halibur ba Jerusalém, ba Nai nia prezensa, no sira sei la lao tuir sira nia fuan laran nebee aat.
verses.18: Iha tempu nebaa, jerasaun Judá sei lao ho jerasaun Israel, no sira sei mai hamutuk hosi rai iha parte norte ba rai nebee Hau fahe ona nudar liman rohan ba sira nia bei-ala sira.
verses.19: Hau dehan,
verses.20: Maibee tebes duni, hanesan feen ida nebee bosok no husik ninia laen,
verses.21: Rona ba! Iha foho molik sira nia leten,
verses.22: Fila fali mai, Oh oan sira nebee fila ba kotuk!
verses.23: Tebes duni, foho sira nee mak fatin bosok,
verses.24: Maibee dezde ami sei joven, ami nia hahalok moe mak estraga ona riku-soin hosi ami nia bei-ala sira nia servisu, inklui sira nia bibi malae no karau sira, oan mane no oan feto sira.
verses.25: Nunee husik ami toba ho moe, no ami nia foer nee mak falun ami. Tanba ami halo sala hasoru ona Nai, ami nia Maromak, ami no ami nia bei-ala sira hosi tempu nebee ami sei joven too loron ohin. No ami la halo tuir Nai, ami nia Maromak, nia lian.”

verses.1: Nai hatete nunee,
verses.2: no se o jura, ‘Hodi Nai nebee moris!’
verses.3: Tanba Nai hatete nunee ba ema Judá sira no povu Jerusalém:
verses.4: Halo sirkunsizaun ba imi nia aan ba Nai,
verses.5: Deklara iha Judá no foo sai iha Jerusalém, no dehan,
verses.6: Foti bandeira ba Foho Zion!
verses.7: Liaun nee hadeer ona hosi ai laran,
verses.8: Tanba nee hatais hena karoon,
verses.9: “Iha loron nebaa, hatete Nai, liurai no xefi sira nia fuan laran sei lakon, saserdote sira sei hakfodak, no profeta sira sei admira.”
verses.10: Depois hau dehan, “Ah, Nai Maromak, tebes O bosok ona povu nee no povu iha Jerusalém, tanba O dehan, ‘Salóm ba imi,’ maibee tuir loloos surik too ona ba sira nia moris!”
verses.11: Iha tempu nee, liafuan ida sei too ba povu nee no povu iha Jerusalém, “Anin manas hosi foho iha rai fuik maran sei huu ba Hau nia povu sira; laos atu haliri ka hamoos,
verses.12: maibee anin boot nee sei huu mai Hau. Agora Hau rasik foo kastigu ba sira.”
verses.13: Tebes, nia sae mai hanesan kalohan sira,
verses.14: Oh Jerusalém, hamoos tiha hahalok aat hosi o nia fuan laran,
verses.15: Lian ida deklara hosi Dan,
verses.16: Foo hanoin ba nasaun sira katak nia atu mai;
verses.17: Hanesan ema nebee hein toos,
verses.18: Imi nia maneira no imi nia hahalok
verses.19: Hau nia hirus matan, hau nia hirus matan! Hau senti moras!
verses.20: Ita rona lian baku rahun ba baku rahun fali,
verses.21: Too bainhira mak hau haree bandeira sira nee,
verses.22: “Tebes, Hau nia povu nee mak beik,
verses.23: Hau haree ba mundu, no tebes, nia molik no mamuk;
verses.24: Hau haree ba foho, no tebes, sira nakdoko;
verses.25: Hau haree, no tebes, ema la iha,
verses.26: Hau haree, no tebes, rai bokur sai ona rai fuik,
verses.27: Tanba Nai hatete, “Rai tomak nee sei sai mamuk, maibee Hau sei la halo rai lakon hotu.
verses.28: Tanba nee mundu sei tanis lelir,
verses.29: Sidade hotu halai ba,
verses.30: No o, Oh ida nebee lakon ona,
verses.31: Tanba hau rona lian hanesan feto ida nebee atu tuur ahi,

verses.1: Halai ba-mai iha dalan sira iha Jerusalém,
verses.2: Mezmu sira hatete, “Hodi Nai nebee moris,”
verses.3: Oh Nai, laos O nia matan buka lia loos?
verses.4: Depois hau hanoin, “Ida nee mak ema kiik sira deit,
verses.5: Diak liu hau baa ema boot sira,
verses.6: Tanba nee liaun ida hosi ai laran sei baku mate sira,
verses.7: “Oinsaa Hau bele foo perdaun ba o?
verses.8: Sira mak kuda aman sira nebee bokur no lao ho laran kaan,
verses.9: Laos Hau sei kastigu sira tanba sira nia hahalok nee ka?
verses.10: Sae ba ninia lutu no estraga ba,
verses.11: Tanba uma kain Israel no uma kain Judá
verses.12: Sira koalia la loos kona ba Nai no dehan,
verses.13: Profeta sira sei sai hanesan anin,
verses.14: Nunee Nai Maromak Forsa Nain mak hatete:
verses.15: Tebes, Hau haruka nasaun ida hosi rai dook
verses.16: Ninia rama oan fatin hanesan rate nebee nakloke hela,
verses.17: Sira sei haan hotu o nia toos nia rezultadu no o nia ai haan,
verses.18: Maibee iha tempu nee mos, hatete Nai, Hau la halakon mohu imi.
verses.19: No bainhira sira husu, ‘Tanba saa mak Nai, ita nia Maromak, halo buat hotu nee ba ita?’ Nunee o hataan ba sira, ‘Hanesan o husik hela Hau no serví ba maromak seluk iha o nia rai, nunee o sei serví ba ema estranjeiru sira iha rai ida nebee laos o nia rai.’”
verses.20: Deklara liafuan nee ba uma kain Jacó nian,
verses.21: “Rona mai, Oh povu nebee beik no la kompriende,
verses.22: Imi la hamtauk mai Hau ka? hatete Nai.
verses.23: Maibee ema nee iha fuan laran nebee sempre kontra no la simu;
verses.24: Sira la hatete iha sira nia fuan laran,
verses.25: Imi nia hahalok aat teri netik buat ida nee,
verses.26: Tebes, ema aat sira mak iha Hau nia povu nia leet,
verses.27: Hanesan luhan sai nakonu ho manu sira,
verses.28: sira sai ema bokur no isin diak.
verses.29: Oinsaa, Hau la kastigu sira tanba buat hotu nee ka?
verses.30: Perigu no susar boot
verses.31: profeta sira foo sai profesia falsu,

verses.1: Halai ba fatin seguru, Oh ema Benjamin sira,
verses.2: Hau sei estraga feto nebee bonita no isin mamar,
verses.3: Nunee bibi atan sira mai hamutuk ho sira nia bibi,
verses.4: Prepara aan hodi funu hasoru nia;
verses.5: Hamriik ba, mai ita ataka iha tempu kalan,
verses.6: Tanba Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee:
verses.7: Hanesan bee matan nebee suli sai ho bee,
verses.8: Simu ba hanorin nee, Oh Jerusalém,
verses.9: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee:
verses.10: Hau bele koalia foo sasin ba see,
verses.11: Maibee hau nakonu ho Nai nia hirus manas,
verses.12: Ema seluk sei hetan sira nia uma,
verses.13: Hosi ema boot too ema kiik iha sira nia leet,
verses.14: Sira kura bosok Hau nia povu nia kanek,
verses.15: Tuir loloos sira senti moe, tanba sira halo buat nebee aat tebes;
verses.16: Nai hatete nunee:
verses.17: No mos hau tau ema hodi hein imi, no Hau dehan,
verses.18: Nunee rona ba, Oh nasaun sira,
verses.19: Rona ba, Oh mundu! Tebes, Hau sei haruka susar ba povu nee,
verses.20: Insensu hosi Seba iha folin saida mai Hau,
verses.21: Tanba nee Nai hatete:
verses.22: Nai hatete nunee:
verses.23: Sira uza rama no dima;
verses.24: Ami rona ona ninia notísia,
verses.25: “La bele sai ba rai luan,
verses.26: Oh oan feto hosi hau nia povu, hatais hena karoon,
verses.27: Hau foti ona o nudar ema nebee koko besi iha Hau nia povu nia leet,
verses.28: Sira hotu la tuir ona,
verses.29: Anin huu ahi ona,
verses.30: Hanaran sira osan mutin nebee ema rejeita,

verses.1: Liafuan nebee mai ba Jeremias hosi Nai, hanesan nee:
verses.2: “Hamriik ba iha portaun uma Nai nian, no foo sai liafuan nee, no dehan, Rona Nai nia liafuan, ema Judá sira hotu nebee tama liu hosi portaun nee hodi hakneak adora ba Nai!
verses.3: Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: Hadia imi nia maneira no hahalok, nunee Hau husik imi bele hela iha fatin ida nee.
verses.4: Keta fiar ba liafuan bosok nebee dehan, ‘Ida nee mak Templu Nai nian, Templu Nai nian, Templu Nai nian.’
verses.5: Tanba se imi hadia duni imi nia maneira no hahalok, se imi halao duni justisa entre ema ida no ninia maluk,
verses.6: se imi la hanehan ema lao rai, ka oan kiak, ka feto faluk, no la fakar raan inosenti iha fatin nee, no la tuir maromak seluk nebee halo kanek ba imi nia aan rasik,
verses.7: nunee Hau sei husik imi bele hela iha fatin ida nee, iha rai nebee Hau foo ona ba imi nia bei-ala sira, too tinan ba tinan.
verses.8: Tebes duni, imi fiar ba liafuan bosok nebee la iha folin.
verses.9: Imi naok, oho, halo sala foer, jura falsu, sunu insensu ba Baal no lao tuir maromak sira seluk nebee imi la konhese.
verses.10: Depois imi mai hamriik iha Hau nia oin, iha uma nebee temi Hau nia naran, hodi dehan, “Ita hetan ona salvasaun!” - no imi halo buat hotu nebee aat tebes nee!
verses.11: Uma ida nee, fatin nebee uza hodi bolu Hau nia naran, sai ona naok-teen sira nia fatuk kuak ka? Tebes, Hau rasik mak haree ona ida nee, hatete Nai.
verses.12: Agora, baa Hau nia fatin nebee iha Silo, iha fatin nebee uluk Hau tau Hau nia naran, no haree saida mak Hau halo ona ba fatin nee tanba Hau nia povu Israel nia hahalok aat!
verses.13: Nunee agora, tanba imi halo ona buat hotu nee, hatete Nai, no tanba imi la rona mezmu Hau koalia beibeik ba imi, no imi lakohi resposta, mezmu Hau bolu ba imi,
verses.14: tanba nee, uma nebee temi Hau nia naran, fatin nebee imi laran metin ba, fatin nebee Hau foo ona ba imi no imi nia bei-ala sira, Hau sei halo ba uma nee hanesan Hau halo ona ba Silo.
verses.15: Hau sei soe imi hosi Hau nia oin, hanesan Hau soe ona imi nia maun-alin sira, katak uma kain Efraim nian hotu.”
verses.16: “Nunee o la bele halo orasaun ba povu nee. La bele husu hodi ajuda ka husu pedidu kona ba sira. La bele obriga Hau, tanba Hau sei la rona o.
verses.17: O la haree saida mak sira halo iha sidade Judá sira no iha dalan Jerusalém ka?
verses.18: Labarik sira halibur ai sunu, aman sira sunu ahi no feto sira kumu masa hodi halo dosi ba liurai feto iha lalehan. No sira fui sakrifísiu hemu nian ba maromak sira seluk, hodi provoka Hau sai hirus.
verses.19: Sira provoka Hau ka? hatete Nai. Laos sira provoka sira nia aan rasik, nunee sira sai moe?
verses.20: Tanba nee Nai Maromak hatete: Tebes, Hau sei fui sai Hau nia hirus no Hau nia laran manas ba fatin nee, ba ema, animál, ai horis iha rai luan no ba rezultadu rai nian. Hau nia laran hirus nee sei lakan no la mate.”
verses.21: Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: “Aumenta sakrifísiu tunu motuk ba imi nia sakrifísiu oho, no haan ninia naan.
verses.22: Iha loron nebee Hau lori sai imi nia bei-ala sira hosi rai Ejitu, Hau la hatete ka foo orden ba sira kona ba sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu oho.
verses.23: Maibee Hau foo orden ida nee ba sira: ‘Rona Hau nia lian ba, nunee Hau sai imi nia Maromak no imi sai Hau nia povu. Tuir dalan hotu nebee Hau foo orden ona ba imi, nunee imi iha moris diak!
verses.24: Maibee sira lakohi rona no lakohi foo atensaun, maibee sira lao tuir sira nia planu no tuir hanoin hosi no sira nia fuan aat. Sira lao ba kotuk, no sira la lao ba oin.
verses.25: Hosi loron nebee o nia bei-ala sira sai hosi rai Ejitu too ohin loron, Hau haruka ba imi Hau nia atan profeta sira. Loro-loron Hau haruka sira.
verses.26: Maibee ema sira nee lakohi rona Hau ka foo atensaun. Sira nia kakorok toos no sira halo aat liu fali sira nia bei-ala sira.
verses.27: O tenki koalia liafuan hotu nee ba sira, maibee sira sei la rona o nia liafuan. O tenki bolu sira, maibee sira sei la hataan ba o.
verses.28: O tenki hatete ba sira, ‘Ida nee mak nasaun ida nebee lakohi rona Nai, sira nia Maromak, nia lian; no lakohi simu disiplina! Lia loos mak lakon ona, no hakotu ona hosi sira nia ibun.”
verses.29: Tesi tiha imi nia fuuk no soe ba!
verses.30: Tanba ema Judá sira halo ona buat nebee aat iha Hau nia oin, hatete Nai. Sira tau ona buat sira nebee foer loos iha uma nebee temi Hau nia naran, hodi halo fatin nee sai foer.
verses.31: Sira harii ona fatin aas ba Tofete, nebee iha Foho Leet Ben-Hinom hodi sunu sira nia oan mane no oan feto sira. Hau la haruka sira halo hanesan nee, no buat nee la mosu hosi Hau nia fuan.
verses.32: Tanba nee, tebes, tempu sei mai, hatete Nai, katak ema la hatete tan ‘Tofete’ no ‘Foho Leet Ben-Hinom,’ maibee ‘Foho Leet Oho Nian’. Tanba sira sei hakoi mate isin iha Tofete too fatin la too.
verses.33: Mate isin sira hosi povu nee sei sai hahaan ba manu sira iha loro leten no animál sira iha mundu, no la iha ema ida atu duni sees animál sira nee.
verses.34: Iha sidade Judá nian no iha Jerusalém nia dalan, Hau sei hapara lian nebee haksolok no lian nebee kontenti, lian hosi noivu no lian hosi noiva, tanba rai nee sei sai mamuk.

verses.1: “Iha tempu nebaa, hatete Nai, liurai Judá sira nia ruin, ema boot sira nia ruin, saserdote sira nia ruin, profeta sira nia ruin no povu Israel tomak sira nia ruin sei sai hosi sira nia rate.
verses.2: Ema sei habai ruin nee iha loron matan nia oin, iha fulan nia oin, no iha forsa tomak hosi lalehan nia oin, nebee sira hadomi, serví, lao tuir, husu pedidu no adora. Ema sei la halibur ka hakoi sira. Ruin sira nee sei sai hanesan teen iha rai leten.
verses.3: Maibee ema hotu hosi jerasaun aat nebee sei moris nee, sira hakarak liu sai mate duké moris hela iha rai nebee Hau duni sira ba, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.4: O tenki dehan ba sira, hatete Nai:
verses.5: Nusaa mak povu Jerusalém fila kotuk
verses.6: Hau foo atensaun ona no rona,
verses.7: Manu ain-aas iha loro leten
verses.8: Oinsaa imi brani atu hatete, ‘Ami matenek klean,
verses.9: Ema matenek klean sai moe,
verses.10: Nunee Hau sei foo sira nia feen sira ba ema seluk,
verses.11: Sira kura bosok Hau nia povu nebee kanek,
verses.12: Sira sai moe bainhira sira halo buat foer loos ka?
verses.13: Bainhira Hau hakarak halibur sira nia rezultadu, hatete Nai, sira la iha fuan iha ai uvas nee, no la iha fuan iha ai figeira nee; ai tahan sira namlaek ona,
verses.14: Tanba saa mak ita tuur deit?
verses.15: Ita buka dame, maibee la iha buat diak ida diak nebee mak mai,
verses.16: “Imi rona ona lian kuda nian hosi Dan;
verses.17: Tebes, Hau sei haruka samea sira ba iha imi nia leet,
verses.18: Hau nia laran haksolok lakon ona, no laran tristi kona fali hau,
verses.19: Rona lai! Lian tanis hosi hau nia povu nia oan feto,
verses.20: “Tempu kuu hotu ona, tempu udan remata ona,
verses.21: Tanba hau nia povu nia oan feto sira hetan kanek,
verses.22: Aimoruk iha Gilead la iha ka?

9.title: no hau nia matan bele sai bee matan nebee suli ho matan been,

verses.1: Oh, katak hau nia ulun bele sai nakonu ho bee,
verses.2: Oh, se karik hau iha fatin toba hanesan ema lao rai nian nebee iha rai fuik,
verses.3: Sira halo kleuk sira nia nanaal hanesan rama inan;
verses.4: Diak liu ida-idak kuidadu ninia maluk,
verses.5: Ema ida-idak bosok ninia maluk,
verses.6: O hela iha fatin nebee bosok taka fali bosok,
verses.7: Tanba nee, hatete Nai Forsa Nain:
verses.8: Sira nian nanal mak rama oan,
verses.9: Oinsaa Hau la bele kastigu sira tanba sira nia hahalok ka? hatete Nai.
verses.10: “Hau sei tanis no halerik ba tanba foho,
verses.11: Hau sei halo Jerusalém sai hanesan fatin foer,
verses.12: See mak ema nebee iha matenek klean, nunee nia bele hatene? Nai nia ibun koalia ona ho see, nunee nia bele foo sai liafuan nee? Tanba saa mak rai nee lakon no ahi haan rai nee hodi sai hanesan rai fuik, no la iha ema lao liu hosi nee?
verses.13: Nai dehan, “Tanba sira husik hela Hau nia lei nebee Hau foo ona ba sira. No sira la rona tuir Hau nia lian no la halo tuir liafuan nee.
verses.14: Maibee sira tuir sira nia fuan toos, no tuir fali Baal sira, hanesan sira nia bei-ala sira nebee hanorin sira.
verses.15: Tanba nee Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete: Tebes, Hau sei foo ema nee atu haan aimoruk todan no hemu veneno.
verses.16: Hau halo sira namkari iha rai liur, ba nasaun nebee sira no sira nia bei-ala sira la konhese, no hau sei haruka surik hodi duni sira too Hau halakon sira.”
verses.17: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee:
verses.18: Husik sira mai lalais no tanis lelir tanba ita,
verses.19: Tanba rona tanis lelir hosi Zion:
verses.20: Nunee rona Nai nia liafuan, Oh feto sira,
verses.21: Mate tama ona ba ita nia janela sira,
verses.22: Koalia, “Nai hatete nunee, ‘Ema nia mate isin sira monu namkari
verses.23: Nai hatete nunee, “Ema matenek klean la bele gaba aan tanba ninia matenek klean, no ema nebee iha podér la bele gaba aan tanba ninia podér, no ema riku la bele gaba aan tanba ninia riku-soin.
verses.24: Maibee ema nebee gaba aan nee, husik nia gaba aan tanba nee, katak nia kompriende no konhese Hau, katak Hau mak Nai nebee halao domin metin, justisa no hahalok loos iha mundu; tebes, buat sira nee Hau gosta, hatete Nai.”
verses.25: Tebes, tempu sei mai, hatete Nai, nebee Hau kastigu ema sira nebee hetan ona sirkunsizaun iha sira nia isin:
verses.26: ema Ejitu, ema Judá, ema Edom, jerasaun Amon, ema Moab, ema hotu nebee tesi fuuk rohan, no ema sira nebee hela iha rai fuik; tanba nasaun hotu nee la halo sirkunsizaun no ema Israel tomak la hetan sirkunsizaun iha sira nia fuan laran.”

verses.1: Rona ba liafuan nebee Nai hatoo ba imi, Oh jerasaun Israel!
verses.2: Nai hatete nunee:
verses.3: Tanba povu nee nia regulamentu sira la iha folin.
verses.4: Ema pinta ho osan mean no osan mutin;
verses.5: Lulik nee hamriik hanesan estátua nebee monta iha toos pepinu nian,
verses.6: La iha ida hanesan O, Oh Nai!
verses.7: See mak la tauk ba O, Oh Liurai ba nasaun sira?
verses.8: Lulik sira nee beik no diuk;
verses.9: Osan mutin kabelak lori hosi Tarsis,
verses.10: Maibee Nai mak Maromak nebee loos,
verses.11: Hatete ba sira hanesan nee: “Maromak sira nebee la halo lalehan no rai sei lakon hosi rai nee no hosi lalehan nia okos.”
verses.12: Nai halo mundu nee ho Ninia kbiit,
verses.13: Bainhira Nia foo sai ho Ninia lian, nee iha lian hanesan bee boot nebee suli iha lalehan,
verses.14: Ema hotu beik no la iha matenek;
verses.15: Estátua sira nee la iha folin, sira bosok deit,
verses.16: Maibee Jacó nia parte la hanesan nee,
verses.17: Halibur o nia sasaan hosi rai nee,
verses.18: Tanba Nai hatete nunee:
verses.19: Aii susar boot ba hau tanba hau nia moras!
verses.20: Hau nia tenda aat ona,
verses.21: Tanba bibi atan sira sai beik ona,
verses.22: Tebes, lian ida! Avizu mai ona!
verses.23: Hau hatene, Oh Nai, katak ema nia dalan laos iha nia laran,
verses.24: Koriji hau ba, Oh Nai, maibee ho justisa,
verses.25: Fakar O nia hirus ba nasaun sira nebee la konhese O,

verses.1: Liafuan mai ba Jeremias hosi Nai, katak:
verses.2: “Rona ba liafuan hosi aliansa nee no foo hatene ba ema Judeu sira, no ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém!
verses.3: Hatete ba sira, Nai, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: Malisan ba ema nebee la rona liafuan hosi aliansa nee,
verses.4: nebee Hau foo ona ba imi nia bei-ala sira iha tempu nebee Hau lori sira sai hosi rai Ejitu, hosi fornu besi, no dehan ba sira: Rona tuir Hau nia lian, no halo tuir ukun fuan hotu nebee mak Hau foo ona ba imi, nunee imi sai Hau nia povu no Hau sai imi nia Maromak.
verses.5: Nunee Hau bele kumpri juramentu nebee Hau jura ona ba imi nia bei-ala sira, hodi foo rai nebee suli ho susu been no bani been, hanesan tempu agora.” Depois hau hataan: “Amén, Oh Nai!”
verses.6: Nai dehan mai hau, “Foo sai liafuan nee ba sidade Judá sira no dalan sira iha Jerusalém: Rona ba liafuan hosi aliansa nee no halo tuir ba!
verses.7: Tanba tebes duni Hau foo hanoin ba imi nia bei-ala sira, iha tempu nebee Hau lori sira sai hosi rai Ejitu, too ohin loron. Hau foo hanoin ba sira nafatin no dehan, ‘Rona tuir Hau nia lian!’
verses.8: Maibee sira la rona tuir, no la foo atensaun. Sira ida-idak tuir sira nia hanoin iha sira nia fuan laran nebee aat. Nunee Hau foo ona liafuan hotu hosi aliansa nee, nebee Hau haruka sira halo tuir, maibee sira la halo tuir.”
verses.9: Nai dehan mai hau, “Hau hetan konspirisaun iha ema Judá nia leet, no iha povu nebee hela iha Jerusalém nia leet.
verses.10: Sira monu fali ona ba hahalok aat hosi sira nia bei-ala sira, nebee uluk sira lakohi rona tuir Hau nia liafuan. Sira tuir maromak sira seluk no serví ba sira. Jerasaun Israel no jerasaun Judá hakotu ona Hau nia aliansa nebee Hau halo ho sira nia bei-ala sira.
verses.11: Tanba nee mak Nai dehan, Tebes, Hau foo buat aat ba sira, nebee sira la bele halai sees. No bainhira sira bolu Hau, nunee Hau sei la rona sira.
verses.12: Depois sidade Judá sira no ema nebee hela iha Jerusalém sei baa no bolu maromak sira nebee sira adora no foo oferta. Maibee maromak sira nee sei la ajuda sira bainhira tempu aat nee kona sira.
verses.13: Tanba hanesan imi iha sidade barak nunee imi iha mos maromak barak, Oh Judá. Hanesan dalan barak iha Jerusalém, nunee imi harii altár barak nebee hamoe imi, altár hodi foo oferta ba Baal.
verses.14: Nunee o la bele halo orasaun ba povu nee no la bele hasae o nia lian no foo pedidu kona ba sira, tanba Hau sei la rona bainhira sira bolu Hau tanba sira nia susar.
verses.15: Nusaa mak Hau nia doben iha direitu atu hela iha Hau nia uma bainhira nia halo ona buat aat barak? Naan santu bele salva o ka, nunee o bele haksolok?
verses.16: Nai bolu imi nia naran, ‘ai oliveira nebee tahan matak no fuan nebee diak.’ Maibee ho lian nebee makaas Nia sei halo lakan ai nee ho ahi, nunee ahi haan ai sanak sira hotu.
verses.17: Nai Forsa Nain, nebee kuda o, Nia mak determina ona katak susar nee sei hasoru o, tanba hahalok aat nebee jerasaun Israel no jerasaun Judá halo ona no provoka Hau sai hirus tanba imi sunu sakrifísiu ba Baal.”
verses.18: Nai foo hatene liafuan nee ba hau, nunee hau hatene;
verses.19: Maibee hau hanesan bibi malae oan nebee maus,
verses.20: Maibee, Oh Nai Forsa Nain, nebee tesi lia ho justisa,
verses.21: Tanba nee mak Nai koalia kona ba ema Anatot sira nebee hakarak oho hau, no sira dehan, “La bele foo sai profesia hodi Nai nia naran, nunee o la mate liu hosi ami nia liman!”
verses.22: Tanba nee mak Nai Forsa Nain hatete, “Tebes, Hau sei kastigu sira. Sira nia joven sira sei mate liu hosi surik. Sira nia oan mane no oan feto sei mate tanba rai hamlaha;
verses.23: no la iha ema ida nebee moris tan iha sira nia leet. Tanba Hau sei haruka tempu susar ba ema Anatot sira iha sira nia tinan kastigu.”

verses.1: O mak iha hahalok loos, Oh Nai, bainhira hau hatoo keixa ba O!
verses.2: O mak kuda sira, no sira mos iha abut,
verses.3: Maibee O, Oh Nai, konhese hau,
verses.4: Too bainhira mak rai nee tanis,
verses.5: “Se o halai ona ho ema lao ain, no sira halo o sai kole,
verses.6: Tanba o nia maun-alin sira mos, no o nia uma kain,
verses.7: “Hau husik ona Hau nia hela fatin,
verses.8: Hau nia liman rohan sai ona ba Hau
verses.9: Hau nia liman rohan sai ona hanesan makikit makerek ba Hau;
verses.10: Bibi atan barak estraga ona Hau nia toos uvas,
verses.11: Sira halo rai nee mamuk,
verses.12: Estragadór sira nee mai lao liu ona
verses.13: Sira kuda ona hare, maibee sira sei kuu ai tarak;
verses.14: Nai hatete nunee kona ba Hau nia vizinhu hotu nebee aat, nebee kona ona liman rohan nebee Hau foo ona ba Hau nia povu Israel nudar sira nian liman rohan. Tebes, Hau sei hasai sira hosi sira nia rai, no Hau sei hasai jerasaun Judá hosi sira nia leet.
verses.15: Tuir mai, bainhira Hau hasai ona sira, Hau sei hatudu fali laran luak ba sira. Hau sei lori fila fali sira. Ema ida-idak sei fila fali ba ninia liman rohan, no ema ida-idak sei fila fali ba ninia rai.
verses.16: Tuir mai, se sira aprende di-diak oinsaa moris hanesan Hau nia povu, no sira jura hodi Hau nia naran, ‘Hodi Nai nebee moris,’ hanesan sira hanorin Hau nia povu jura ba Baal, nunee Hau sei harii sira iha Hau nia povu nia leet.
verses.17: Maibee se sira lakohi rona, tebes Hau sei hasai sira no estraga nasaun nee, hatete Nai.”

verses.1: Nai hatete nunee mai hau, “Baa sosa hena linhu ida, no kesi hena nee ba iha o nia kanotak, maibee o la bele tau iha bee.”
verses.2: Nunee hau sosa hena ida tuir saida mak Nai dehan. Depois hau hatais iha hau nia kanotak.
verses.3: Nai koalia mai hau ba dala rua, no dehan,
verses.4: “Foti hena nebee o sosa ona, no agora kesi iha o nia kanotak nee. Hamriik no baa iha Mota Eufrates hodi subar iha nebaa iha fatuk kuak.”
verses.5: Nunee hau baa, no subar iha Mota Eufrates nia ninin hanesan Nai manda ba hau.
verses.6: Liu tiha loron barak, Nai dehan mai hau, “Hamriik no baa Eufrates hodi foti fali hena nebee Hau haruka o ba subar iha nebaa.”
verses.7: Nunee hau baa Eufrates, no hau kee, no foti fali sintu nee hosi fatin nebee hau subar nia. No tebes, sintu sai aat ona. La bele uza ona ba saida deit.
verses.8: Depois Nai dehan mai hau:
verses.9: “Nai hatete nunee: Tuir maneira nee mos Hau sei halo aat ema Judá no ema Jerusalém nebee loko aan makaas.
verses.10: Ema nebee aat nee, nebee lakohi rona Hau nia liafuan. Sira lao tuir sira nia laran aat. Sira lao tuir maromak sira seluk hodi serví no adora ba sira. Ema nee sei hanesan hena ida nee, nebee la iha folin ona ba saida deit.
verses.11: Tanba hanesan hena nebee belit ba iha ema nia kanotak, nunee mos ba jerasaun Israel no Judá tomak, nebee Hau tau besik mai Hau, hatete Nai, hodi sira sai povu, nebee iha naran konhesidu, gaba no respeitu ba Hau. Maibee sira lakohi rona.”
verses.12: “Hatete ba sira liafuan nee: ‘Nai, Maromak hosi Israel, hatete nunee: Botir hotu tenki enxe ho tua uvas too nakonu.’ No sira sei dehan ba o, ‘Tebes, laos ami hatene ona botir hotu tenki enxe nakonu ho tua uvas?’
verses.13: Nunee dehan ba sira, ‘Nai hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei halo povu tomak iha rai nee atu lanu - liurai sira nebee tuur iha David nia kadunan, saserdote sira, profeta sira no povu tomak iha Jerusalém.
verses.14: Hau sei soe ema ida ba ema seluk hodi harahun sira, aman sira kona malu ho oan sira, hatete Nai. Hau sei estraga sira, no Hau sei la hanoin sira ka hatudu domin ka laran luak.’”
verses.15: Rona ba, see imi nia tilun mai, imi la bele foti aan,
verses.16: Foo glória ba Nai, imi nia Maromak,
verses.17: Se imi lakohi rona,
verses.18: Hatete ba liurai no liurai feto:
verses.19: Sidade sira iha rai Negeb taka ona sira nia portaun,
verses.20: Foti o nia matan no haree,
verses.21: Saida mak o hatete, bainhira sira hili xefi ida hodi ukun imi
verses.22: No se o dehan iha o nia fuan,
verses.23: Ema Etiópia bele troka sira nia kulit
verses.24: Hau sei halo sira namkari
verses.25: Ida nee mak buat nebee imi hetan,
verses.26: Nunee Hau sei foti sai o nia saia too o nia oin,
verses.27: Hau haree ona o nia sala foer,

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan nebee mai ba Jeremias kona ba tempu rai hamlaha:
verses.2: “Judá tristi,
verses.3: Ema boot haruka sira nia atan sira baa buka bee,
verses.4: Rai sai ona maran dekor,
verses.5: Bibi rusa inan husik hela ninia oan nebee foin moris iha rai luan,
verses.6: Kuda buru fuik sira hamriik iha foho molik,
verses.7: Mezmu ami nia sala sira halo testemunha hasoru ami,
verses.8: Oh Israel nia Esperansa,
verses.9: Nusaa mak O hanesan ema nebee iha konfusaun,
verses.10: Nai hatete nunee kona ba povu nee:
verses.11: Nai dehan ba hau: “O la bele halo orasaun ba povu nee hodi halo diak ba sira!
verses.12: Mezmu sira halo jejún, Hau sei la rona sira nia lian hakilar. Mezmu sira halo sakrifísiu tunu motuk no oferta hahaan nian, Hau sei la kontenti ho sira. Maibee Hau sei halakon sira ho surik, rai hamlaha no moras peste.”
verses.13: Depois hau dehan, “Aii, Nai Maromak! Tebes, profeta sira koalia ona ba ema sira nee, ‘Imi sei la haree surik, no rai hamlaha sei la kona imi, maibee Hau sei foo dame nebee metin iha rai nee!’”
verses.14: Nai hataan ba hau, “Profeta sira halo profesia hodi Hau nia naran nebee bosok! Hau la haruka sira, no Hau la manda ka koalia ba sira. Sira foo sai vizaun no liafuan nebee falsu, no buat nebee mamuk. Sira bosok hosi sira nia fuan laran.
verses.15: Tanba nee Nai koalia kona ba profeta sira nebee foo sai profesia falsu hodi Hau nia naran, no Hau la haruka sira, nebee hatete, ‘Surik no rai hamlaha sei la kona rai nee,’ - profeta sira nee sei mate hotu liu hosi surik no rai hamlaha!
verses.16: No povu nebee sira foo profesia nee sei mate namkari iha dalan sira iha Jerusalém, tanba rai hamlaha no surik, no la iha ema ruma hodi hakoi sira – inklui sira rasik, no sira nia feen, oan mane no oan feto sira. Nunee Hau sei fakar sira nia hahalok aat nee iha sira nia leten.
verses.17: Hatete liafuan nee ba sira:
verses.18: Se hau sai ba rai luan,
verses.19: O la simu ona ema Judá sira ka?
verses.20: Oh Nai, ami hatene ami nia sala aat,
verses.21: Keta hakribi ami, tanba O nia naran,
verses.22: Iha maromak falsu iha nasaun sira nia leet nebee bele foo udan?

verses.1: Nai dehan mai hau, “Mezmu Moisés no Samuel hamriik iha Hau nia oin, Hau nia fuan sei la fila ba povu nee. Duni sira hosi Hau nia oin, husik sira sai ba!
verses.2: No bainhira sira husu ba o, ‘Ami tenki baa nebee?’ Nunee o sei hataan, ‘Nai hatete nunee:
verses.3: Hau sei foo kastigu haat ba sira, hatete Nai: surik hodi oho, asu hodi rasta, manu hosi loro leten no animál sira iha mundu hodi haan no destrui.
verses.4: Nunee Hau sei halo sira sai susar boot ba reinu sira hotu iha mundu, tanba buat hotu nebee Manasés, oan hosi Hezekias, liurai iha Judá, halo iha Jerusalém.”
verses.5: “See mak hanoin imi, Oh Jerusalém,
verses.6: Imi rasik husik ona Hau, hatete Nai,
verses.7: Hau haliri sira ho garfu boot
verses.8: Hau halo sira nia feto faluk sira sai barak liu fali
verses.9: Nunee feto nebee hetan oan hitu ona sai fraku,
verses.10: Aii, susar ba hau, hau nia amaa, katak ita tuur ahi hetan hau. Hau sai ema nebee diskuti malu no huun ba problema iha rai tomak nee! Hau la debe buat ruma, no hau la foo debe ba ema seluk, maibee sira hotu foo malisan ba hau.
verses.11: Nai dehan, “Laos Hau husik o hodi sira hetan buat diak? No laos Hau defende o iha inimigu nia oin iha tempu susar no iha tempu terus?
verses.12: Ema bele halo tohar besi ka, besi hosi parte norte, no riti?
verses.13: O nia riku-soin no o nia sasaan folin sira nee Hau sei foo ba ema hodi hadau no la selu, tanba o nia sala hotu nebee o halo iha o nia rai tomak.
verses.14: Hau sei halo o sai atan ba o nia inimigu sira iha rai nebee o la hatene. Tanba Hau nia hirus sai ona hanesan ahi lakan nebee sei sunu too tinan ba tinan.”
verses.15: O hatene, Oh Nai,
verses.16: Hau hetan O nia liafuan no hau haan liafuan nee,
verses.17: Hau la tuur hamutuk ho ema sira nebee halo komik,
verses.18: Tanba saa mak hau nia moras nee kontinua,
verses.19: Tanba nunee Nai hatete:
verses.20: Ba povu nee, Hau sei halo o
verses.21: Hau sei hasai o hosi ema aat nia liman

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai ba hau, no dehan:
verses.2: “La bele hola feto no la bele iha oan mane no oan feto sira iha rai nee.
verses.3: Tanba Nai hatete nunee kona ba oan mane no oan feto sira nebee moris iha rai nee, no kona ba sira nia inan nebee tuur ahi hetan sira, no kona ba sira nia aman nebee hetan oan sira iha rai nee:
verses.4: Sira sei mate tanba moras aat nebee lori mate. Ema sei la tanis lelir ba sira no la hakoi sira. Sira sei sai tee iha rai leten. Surik sei haan sira no sira sei mate tanba rai hamlaha. Sira nia mate isin sei sai hahaan ba manu iha lalehan no animál iha mundu.
verses.5: Tebes, Nai hatete nunee: La bele tama ba uma tristi sira, la bele baa hodi tanis no sai tristi ho sira. Tanba Hau foti ona Hau nia dame hosi povu nee, hatete Nai, no mos Hau nia domin metin no laran luak.
verses.6: Ema boot no ema kiik sei mate hotu iha rai nee; no ema sei la hakoi sira. La iha ema ruma nebee tanis lelir ba sira. La iha ema ida nebee hakanek aan ka koi molik sira nia ulun tanba sira.
verses.7: La iha ema nebee silu paun no fahe ba ema nebee tristi hodi foo korajen tanba ema mate nee. La iha ema nebee foo nia hemu hosi kopu nebee foo korajen tanba ninia apaa ou amaa nebee mate.
verses.8: O la bele tama ema nia uma nebee halo festa hodi tuur haan hemu hamutuk ho sira.
verses.9: Tanba Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: Tebes, iha fatin nee, iha o nia oin no iha o nia tempu, Hau sei hapara lian haksolok no lian kontenti, lian noivu no lian noiva.
verses.10: Tuir mai, bainhira o foo hatene ba povu nee kona ba liafuan hotu nee no sira dehan ba o, ‘Tanba saa mak Nai ameasa ami ho susar boot nee? Saida mak ami nia hahalok aat no sala saida mak ami halo hasoru ona ba Nai, ami nia Maromak?’
verses.11: No o sei hataan ba sira: ‘Tanba imi nia bei-ala sira husik ona Hau, hatete Nai. Sira tuir maromak sira seluk no sira serví no hakneak adora ba sira. Sira husik Hau no la halo tuir Hau nia lei.
verses.12: No imi rasik halo hahalok nebee aat liu fali imi nia bei-ala sira! Haree imi hotu tuir imi nia laran aat nia hanoin rasik no lakohi rona tuir Hau.
verses.13: Nunee Hau sei soe imi hosi rai nee ba rai nebee imi no imi nia bei-ala sira la hatene. Iha nebaa imi sei serví ba maromak sira seluk loron-kalan. No iha nebaa, Hau la hatudu grasa ba imi.’”
verses.14: “Nunee tebes, hatete Nai, tempu sei mai bainhira ema la hatete tan, ‘Hodi Nai nebee moris, nebee lori ema Israel sai hosi rai Ejitu,’
verses.15: maibee, ‘Hodi Nai nebee moris, nebee lori ema Israel sai hosi rai iha parte norte no hosi rai hotu nebee Nia duni sira namkari ona.’ Tanba Hau sei lori sira fila fali mai rai nebee Hau foo ona ba sira nia bei-ala sira.
verses.16: Tebes, Hau sei bolu ema barak nebee kaer ikan, hatete Nai, no sira sei kaer sira. Liu tiha nee, Hau sei bolu kasa door barak nebee sei duni sira hosi foho boot no foho kiik sira, no hosi fatuk kuak sira.
verses.17: Tanba Hau observa hela sira nia hahalok hotu. Sira la bele subar hosi Hau. No sira la bele subar sira nia hahalok aat hosi Hau nia oin.
verses.18: Hau sei selu ba sira dala rua tanba sira nia hahalok aat no sala. Tanba sira halo foer ona Hau nia rai ho estátua lulik sira nia isin mate nebee Hau despreza no halo nakonu Hau nia liman rohan ho sira nia hahalok nebee foer loos.”
verses.19: Oh Nai, hau nia forsa no hau nia fortaleza,
verses.20: Ema bele halo maromak sira ba ninia aan rasik ka?
verses.21: “Nunee tebes, Hau sei foo hatene ba sira, dala ida nee Hau sei foo hatene ba sira kona ba Hau nia liman no Hau nia podér. Nunee sira sei hatene katak Hau nia naran mak Nai.”

verses.1: “Judá nia sala hakerek ona ho besi, nebee iha matan hosi diamante, hakerek iha sira nia fuan laran, no iha sira nia altár sira nia dikur.
verses.2: Nunee sira nia oan sira bele hanoin hetan sira nia altár sira no Aserá sira iha ai huun boot nia sorin no iha foho leten nebee molik,
verses.3: no iha foho iha rai fuik. Imi nia riku-soin no imi nia sasaan riku nian Hau sei foo ema hadau tanba imi nia sala iha imi nia fatin aas iha imi nia rai tomak.
verses.4: No imi rasik tenki husik imi nia liman rohan nebee Hau foo ona ba imi. Hau sei halo imi sai atan ba imi nia inimigu iha rai nebee imi la hatene. Tanba Hau nia hirus sai ona hanesan ahi lakan nebee sei sunu too tinan ba tinan.”
verses.5: Nai hatete nunee:
verses.6: Nia hanesan ai badak iha rai fuik maran,
verses.7: Bensaun ba ema nebee fiar ba Nai,
verses.8: Nia sei hanesan ai nebee kuda besik bee ninin,
verses.9: Fuan laran mak bosok liu fali buat hotu,
verses.10: Hau, Nai, buka hatene ema nia fuan laran,
verses.11: Hanesan manu kiukai nebee koko luut tolun nebee laos ninia tolun,
verses.12: Kadunan nebee iha glória sei iha fatin aas hosi tempu hahuu,
verses.13: Oh Nai, Israel nia esperansa,
verses.14: Kura hau ba, Oh Nai, nunee hau hetan isin diak;
verses.15: Tebes, sira hatete mai hau,
verses.16: Maibee hau la halai hosi servisu nudar O nia bibi atan,
verses.17: La bele sai susar boot ba hau;
verses.18: Husik ema sira nebee duni hau sai moe,
verses.19: Nai hatete nunee mai hau: “O baa no hamriik iha portaun ba Hau nia povu, nebee liurai Judá sira uza hodi tama sai, no iha portaun hotu iha Jerusalém.
verses.20: Hatete ba sira: ‘Rona Nai nia liafuan, hai liurai Judá sira, no Judá tomak, no ema hotu nebee hela iha Jerusalém, nebee tama liu hosi portaun sira nee!
verses.21: Nai hatete nunee: Kuidadu ba imi nia moris, la bele tula sasaan iha loron Sabdu, no lori sasaan tama liu hosi portaun Jerusalém sira.
verses.22: La bele tula sasaan sai hosi o nia uma iha loron Sabdu, no la bele halo servisu ruma, maibee halo santu loron Sabdu, hanesan Hau manda o nia bei-ala sira.
verses.23: Maibee sira lakohi rona tuir no lakohi see sira nia tilun, maibee sira sai ulun toos, hodi sira la bele rona no lakohi simu disiplina.
verses.24: Maibee se imi rona tuir Hau, hatete Nai, no la tula sasaan tama liu hosi portaun sidade nee iha loron Sabdu, maibee imi halo santu loron Sabdu no la halo servisu ruma iha loron nee,
verses.25: nunee liu hosi portaun sira iha sidade nee liurai no xefi sira sei tama, no sira sei tuur iha kadunan David nian, no sae kuda kareta no kuda. Liurai sira nee no sira nia xefi sira, ema hosi Judá, no ema hotu nebee hela iha Jerusalém sei hela iha sidade nee too tinan ba tinan.
