verses.17: Depois Jeremias hatete ba Zedekias, “Nai, Maromak Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: Se o rende ba xefi sira hosi liurai Babilónia, o sei moris no sira sei la sunu motuk sidade nee ho ahi; o ho o nia uma kain sei moris nafatin.
verses.18: Maibee sei o la rende ba xefi sira hosi liurai Babilónia, entaun sidade nee sei tama ba ema Kaldeia sira nia liman, no sira sei sunu motuk sidade nee ho ahi; no o rasik sei la halai sai hosi sira nia liman.”
verses.19: Depois liurai Zedekias hatete ba Jeremias, “Hau tauk ba ema Judeu sira nebee halai ona ba ema Kaldeia sira. Karik orasida ema Kaldeia entrega hau ba sira nia liman nunee sira sei halimar aat fali ho hau.”
verses.20: Jeremias hataan, “Ema Kaldeia sei la entrega ita ba sira. Halo tuir Nai nia lian nebee hau foo sai ba ita, no ita nia situasaun sei diak no ita sei kontinua moris.
verses.21: Maibee se ita lakohi rende ita nia aan, ida nee mak vizaun nebee Nai hatudu ona mai hau:
verses.22: Tebes, ema lori sai feto sira hotu nebee sei hela iha liurai Judá nia uma baa hasoru xefi hosi liurai Babilónia, no sira dehan,
verses.23: Ema sei lori sai ita nia kaben sira hotu no ita nia oan sira hotu baa ema Kaldeia sira. No ita rasik sei la halai sai hosi sira nia liman. Maibee liurai Babilónia sei kaer ita. No nia sei sunu motuk sidade nee ho ahi.”
verses.24: Depois Zedekias hatete ba Jeremias, “Keta husik ema ida hatene kona ba liafuan nee, nunee o sei la mate.
verses.25: Se xefi sira rona katak hau koalia ona ho o, no sira mai husu ba o, ‘Foo hatene ba ami kona saida mak o hatete ba liurai no saida mak liurai hatete ba o; la bele subar buat ida hosi ami, nunee ami sei la oho o!’
verses.26: nunee o tenki dehan ba sira, ‘Hau hatoo hau nia pedidu ba liurai, hodi husu nia la bele haruka fali hau ba Jonatas nia uma hodi mate iha nebaa.’”
verses.27: Depois xefi sira hotu mai husu ba Jeremias, maibee nia foo resposta ba sira tuir saida mak liurai hatete ba nia. Nunee sira husik nia tanba la iha ema ida nebee rona sira nia lian nee.
verses.28: Jeremias hela iha Pátiu Guarda too loron nebee ema hadau Jerusalém.

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala sia iha Zedekias, liurai hosi Judá, nia ukun, iha fulan ba dala sanulu, Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, hamutuk ho ninia forsa tomak mai hasoru Jerusalém no serka sidade nee.
verses.2: Iha tinan ba dala sanulu resin ida iha Zedekias nia ukun, iha fulan haat, iha loron sia iha fulan nee, moru sidade nee nakfera.
verses.3: Depois xefi sira hotu hosi liurai Babilónia mai no tuur iha Portaun Klaran. Ema sira nee mak: Nergal-Sar-Ezer nebee Samgar, Nebu-Sar-Sekim nebee Rab-Saris no Nergal-Sar-Ezer nebee Rab-Mag, no xefi sira seluk hotu hosi liurai Babilónia.
verses.4: Bainhira Zedekias, liurai hosi Judá, ho ninia soldadu sira hotu haree ema Kaldeia nunee sira halai husik hela sidade nee. Sira halai sai iha tempu kalan liu hosi jardin liurai nian, liu hosi portaun entre moru rua. Sira lao ba diresaun nebee tama ba Araba.
verses.5: Maibee ema Kaldeia nia forsa militár duni sira no toman Zedekias iha rai tetuk iha Jerikó. Sira kaer nia no lori nia sae ba liurai hosi Babilónia iha Ribla, nebee iha rai Hamat. No liurai Babilónia tesi lia ba nia.
verses.6: Liurai Babilónia oho Zedekias nia oan mane sira iha Zedekias nia oin iha Ribla. Liurai Babilónia oho mos ema boot hotu hosi Judá.
verses.7: Depois Nia fokit sai Zedekias nia matan, no kesi nia ho korenti hodi lori nia ba Babilónia.
verses.8: Ema Kaldeia sira sunu liurai nia uma no povu nia uma ho ahi no sira baku rahun Jerusalém nia moru sira.
verses.9: Depois Nebuzaradan, komandante ba guarda lori ema restu nudar ema dadur nebee sei hela iha sidade nee - ema sira nebee halai ona ba sorin Nebuzaradan nian no ema nebee sei hela iha sidade laran.
verses.10: Maibee Nebuzaradan, komandante ba guarda, husik ema kiak balun iha rai Judá. Ema nee la iha buat ida no iha tempu nebaa Nebuzaradan foo ba sira toos uvas no toos seluk.
verses.11: Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, foo tiha orden kona ba Jeremias liu hosi Nebuzaradan, komandante ba guarda. Nia dehan,
verses.12: “Lori nia ba no tau matan di-diak ba nia. La bele halo aat ba nia maibee halo ba nia tuir saida mak nia husu ba o.”
verses.13: Nunee Nebuzaradan, komandante ba guarda, hamutuk ho Nebu-Sazban nebee Rab-Saris no Nergal-Sar-Ezer nebee Rab-Mag no xefe boot sira hotu hosi liurai Babilónia
verses.14: haruka ema baa foti Jeremias hosi Pátiu Guarda. Sira entrega nia ba Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, oan hosi Safan hodi lori nia atu fila ba uma. Nunee Jeremias hela iha povu sira nia leet.
verses.15: Nai nia liafuan nebee mai ba Jeremias bainhira nia sei iha kastigu iha Pátiu Guarda:
verses.16: “Baa no hatete ba Ebed-Melek, ema Etiópia nee, ‘Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei kumpri Hau nia liafuan nebee hasoru sidade, nunee sira sei hetan buat aat, laos buat nebee diak. Buat sira nee sei akontese iha o nia oin iha loron nebaa.
verses.17: Maibee Hau sei hasai o iha loron nebaa, hatete Nai. O sei la tama ba ema sira nee nia liman, nebee halo o tauk.
verses.18: Tanba Hau sei salva duni o. O sei la monu tanba surik. O sei manaan o nia moris tanba o tau o nia fiar ba Hau, hatete Nai.”

verses.1: Liafuan nebee mai hosi Nai ba Jeremias, hafoin Nebuzaradan, komandante ba guarda, husik nia sai livre hosi Ramá. Tanba nia lori Jeremias ho korenti kesi ninia liman, hamutuk ho ema dadur sira seluk nebee sai hosi Jerusalém no Judá atu baa Babilónia.
verses.2: Bainhira komandante nee foti Jeremias, nia dehan, “Nai, o nia Maromak, mak koalia foo sai terus ba fatin nee.
verses.3: Agora Nai kumpri ona buat nebee Nia promete, tuir Ninia liafuan. Buat sira nee hotu akontese ba imi tanba imi sala kontra Nai no lakohi halo tuir Ninia liafuan.
verses.4: Maibee, ohin hau foo liberdade ba o hosi korenti sira nebee kesi o nia liman. Se o hakarak karik, mai hamutuk ho hau ba Babilónia, no hau sei tau matan ba o; maibee, se karik o lakohi, bele hela deit. Haree ba! Rai tomak nee iha o nia oin; baa iha nebee deit mak o hanoin diak liu.”
verses.5: Maibee, molok Jeremias fila kotuk atu baa ona, Nebuzaradan dehan tan, “Fila fali ba Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, bei-oan hosi Safan, ida nebee liurai Babilónia foti hodi sai governadór ba sidade sira iha Judá. Hela hamutuk ho nia, iha povu nia leet, ka baa fatin nebee deit mak o hanoin diak atu baa.” Entaun, komandante nee foo ba nia bukae no prezenti ida, no husik nia baa tiha.
verses.6: Entaun Jeremias baa too iha Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, iha Mizpá, no hela hamutuk no nia iha povu sira nia leet, sira nebee hela nafatin iha rai.
verses.7: Iha komandante forsa nian nebee sei hamutuk nafatin ho sira nia tropas iha rai luan. Sira rona katak liurai hosi Babilónia foti Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, nudar governadór ba Judá, hodi nia tau matan ba mane sira, feto sira, labarik sira no sira nebee kiak liu iha rai nebee tropas sira la lori ba Babilónia.
verses.8: Entaun sira baa too iha Gedalias, iha Mizpá: Ismael, oan hosi Netanias, no Joanan, oan hosi Kareas, no Seraias, oan hosi Tanumete, no oan mane sira hosi Efai, ema Netofate, no Jezanias, oan hosi ema Maakatita, hamutuk mos ho sira nia tropas sira.
verses.9: Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, bei-oan hosi Safan, halo promesa ida ba sira no sira nia tropas sira, “Imi keta tauk atu serví ba ema Babilónia sira, no buat hotu-hotu sei sai diak.
verses.10: Hau rasik sei hela iha Mizpá atu reprezenta imi ba ema Babilónia sira nebee sei mai hasoru ita. Maibee, imi servisu hodi kuu uvas hodi halo tua uvas, kuu ai fuan bailoron nian no oliveira sira atu halo mina. Rai hotu iha imi nia sanan rai sira, no hela deit iha sidade sira nebee imi hadau ona.”
verses.11: Ema Judeu sira hotu nebee iha Moab, iha Amon, no iha Edom, no iha rai sira seluk, rona katak liurai hosi Babilónia husik povu balun iha rai Judá. No sira rona katak nia foti Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, bei-oan hosi Safan, nudar governadór ba povu.
verses.12: Entaun sira fila fali hosi rai sira hotu nebee sira halai namkari. Sira fila fali ba rai Judá no baa hasoru malu ho Gedalias iha Mizpá. No sira halibur uvas barak atu halo tua uvas no ai fuan hosi tempu bailoron nebee barak tebes.
verses.13: Joanan, oan hosi Karea, no komandante forsa sira hotu nebee sei nafatin iha rai luan, sira baa too iha Gedalias, iha Mizpá.
verses.14: No sira hatete ba nia, “Ita boot hatene ka lae katak Baalis, liurai hosi ema Amonita sira, haruka Ismael, oan hosi Netanias, atu mai oho ita?” Maibee Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, la fiar sira nia liafuan.
verses.15: Entaun Joanan, oan hosi Karea, koalia sub-subar ba Gedalias iha Mizpá, “Husik hau baa agora no hau sei oho Ismael, oan hosi Netanias, no ema ida sei la hatene. Tanba saa mak nia tenki mai oho ita boot, hodi halo fali ema Judeu sira nebee halibur hamutuk ho ita boot namkari fila fali, no ema Judá sira restu nee lakon fali?”
verses.16: Maibee Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, hatete ba Joanan, oan hosi Karea, “Keta halo nunee. Buat nebee ita koalia nee kona ba Ismael la loos.”

verses.1: Iha fulan hitu, Ismael, oan hosi Netanias, oan hosi Elisama, nebee moris hosi liurai nia jerasaun no uluk sai liurai nia ema boot ida, nia baa too iha Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, iha Mizpá, hamutuk ho mane nain sanulu tan. Bainhira sira haan hamutuk,
verses.2: Ismael no mane nain sanulu sira nee hamriik no ataka Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, bei-oan hosi Safan, ho surik. Sira oho nia nebee liurai hosi Babilónia foti nudar governadór ba rai Judá.
verses.3: Ismael mos oho ema Judeu sira hotu nebee iha nebaa hamutuk ho Gedalias iha Mizpá, hamutuk mos ho soldadu sira hosi Babilónia nebee iha nebaa.
verses.4: Iha loron tuir mai, molok ema seluk rona katak Gedalias mate tiha ona,
verses.5: mane nain ualu-nulu, nebee koi tiha sira nia hasan rahun, lees tiha sira nia ropa, no halo kanek iha sira nia isin, mai hosi Sikém, hosi Siló, no hosi Samaria. Sira lori oferta trigu nian, no mos insensu, atu oferese iha Nai nia templu.
verses.6: Ismael, oan hosi Netanias, sai hosi Mizpá atu baa hasoru sira. Nia lao ba ho tanis. Bainhira nia hasoru ho sira, nia hatete, “Mai too iha Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam.”
verses.7: Bainhira sira tama iha sidade, Ismael, oan hosi Natanias, no mane sira seluk nebee hamutuk ho nia, oho mane sira nee, no soe sira nia mate isin iha posu kuak.
verses.8: Maibee, iha ema nain sanulu nebee dehan, “Keta oho ami! Tanba ami iha trigu, trigu boot, mina no bani been, nebee ami subar iha rai luan.” Rona tiha ida nee, nia la oho sira.
verses.9: Posu kuak ida nebee Ismael soe mane sira nia mate isin, no Gedalias nia mate isin, mak ida nebee liurai Asa kee, hodi defende sidade hosi Baasa, liurai hosi Israel. Ismael, oan hosi Netanias, enxe nakonu bee posu kuak nee ho mate isin.
verses.10: Ismael halo dadur ema sira seluk hotu nebee hela Mizpá, inklui mos liurai nia oan feto sira, ema sira nebee Nebuzaradan, komandante ba guarda, tau iha Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, nia ukun okos. Ismael, oan hosi Netanias, lori sira nudar ema dadur ba rai Amon.
verses.11: Bainhira Joanan, oan hosi Karea, no komandante forsa hotu nebee hamutuk ho nia, rona kona ba buat aat nee nebee Ismael halo,
verses.12: sira prepara sira nia tropas hotu atu baa funu hasoru Ismael, oan hosi Netanias. Sira hetan nia iha fatin besik ba kolan boot iha Gibeon.
verses.13: Bainhira povu nebee Ismael lori nudar ema dadur, haree Joanan, oan hosi Karea, no komandante forsa sira nebee mai hamutuk ho nia, sira haksolok.
verses.14: Entaun povu tomak nebee Ismael lori nudar ema dadur hosi Mizpá, sira mai fali ba Joanan, oan hosi Karea.
verses.15: Maibee Ismael, oan hosi Netanias, no mane nain ualu nebee hamutuk ho nia, sira halai hosi Joanan no baa iha rai Amon.
verses.16: Entaun Joanan, oan hosi Karea, no komandante forsa sira hotu nebee hamutuk ho nia, lori ema sira hotu nebee sira salva hosi Ismael, oan hosi Karea, nia liman, nebee povu restu hosi Mizpá. Tanba Ismael foti ema sira nee bainhira nia oho tiha Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam. Ema sira nee mak soldadu sira, feto sira, labarik sira no funsionáriu sira.
verses.17: Entaun sira lao too iha Gerute-Kimam, besik ba Belém, iha dalan nebee baa Ejitu.
verses.18: Sira hakarak hadook aan hosi ema Babilónia sira. Sira tauk tanba Ismael, oan hosi Netanias, oho tiha Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, ida nebee liurai hosi Babilónia foti nudar governadór ba rai Judá.

verses.1: Entaun, komandante forsa hotu, inklui mos Joanan, oan hosi Karea, no Jezanias, oan hosi Hosaias, hamutuk ho povu tomak, hosi kiik too boot, mai hakbesik ba
verses.2: ba profeta Jeremias hodi hatete, “Favór ida, rona lai ami nia pedidu no harohan ba Nai, ita nia Maromak, hodi husu tulun ba ami no ba povu restu sira nee hotu. Ita bele haree katak uluk ami barak, maibee agora ami uitoan deit.
verses.3: Halo orasaun, husu ba ita nia Maromak, saida mak ami tenki halo no fatin ida nebee mak ami tenki baa.”
verses.4: Profeta Jeremias hataan ba sira, no dehan, “Hau sei halo buat nebee imi husu. Hau sei halo orasaun ba Nai, imi nia Maromak. No buat hotu nebee Nai hataan, hau sei hatoo ba imi. Hau sei la subar buat ida hosi imi.”
verses.5: Entaun sira dehan ba Jeremias, “Nai bele sai sasin nebee loos no fiel hasoru ami, se karik ami la halo tuir buat hotu-hotu nebee Nai, ita nia Maromak, haruka ami halo liu hosi ita.
verses.6: Maski buat diak ka aat, ami sei halo tuir lian hosi Nai, ami nia Maromak, nebee ami haruka ita atu ba too iha Nia. Hodi nunee buat hotu sei sai diak ba ami, tanba ami sei halo tuir lian hosi Nai, ami nia Maromak.”
verses.7: Liu tiha loron sanulu, Nai hatoo nia liafuan ba Jeremias.
verses.8: Entaun Jeremias bolu Joanan, oan hosi Karea, hamutuk ho komandante forsa hotu nebee sei hamutuk ho nia, no povu tomak, hosi kiik too boot.
verses.9: Nia hatete ba sira, “Nai, Maromak iha Israel hatete nunee, Nia nebee imi haruka hau atu baa too iha Nia hodi lori imi nia pedidu:
verses.10: ‘Se imi hela nafatin iha rai nee, entaun Hau sei harii imi, laos sobu imi; Hau sei kuda imi, laos fokit sai imi, tanba Hau senti todan tebes tanba terus nebee Hau haraik tiha ba imi.
verses.11: Keta tauk liurai hosi Babilónia, ida nebee agora dadaun imi tauk hela. Keta tauk nia’, hatete Nai, ‘tanba Hau sei hamutuk ho imi, no Hau sei salva imi no hasai imi hosi ninia liman.
verses.12: Hau sei hanoin imi, hodi halo nia mos hanoin imi, no husik imi fila ba imi nia rai rasik.
verses.13: Maibee, se imi hatete, ‘Ami sei la hela iha rai nee’, hodi nunee imi la halo tuir Nai, imi nia Maromak, nia liafuan,
verses.14: no se imi hatete, ‘Lae, ami sei baa Ejitu. Iha nebaa ami sei la haree tan funu, ami sei la rona tan bibi aman dikur nia lian, ami sei la terus hamlaha, no ami sei hela iha nebaa,’
verses.15: entaun rona Nai nia liafuan, Oh povu restu hosi Judá. Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: ‘Se imi foti desizaun metin ona atu baa Ejitu, hodi hela iha nebaa,
verses.16: funu nebee imi tauk dadaun, sei hasoru imi; hamlaha nebee imi tauk, sei tuir imi too iha Ejitu, no imi sei mate iha nebaa.
verses.17: Sira hotu nebee desizaun metin ona atu ba Ejitu, sei mate liu hosi funu, hamlaha boot no moras peste. Sei la iha ida nebee sei moris ka bele halai sees hosi terus nebee Hau sei haraik ba sira.’
verses.18: Tanba Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: ‘Hanesan Hau nia hirus no Hau nia laran nakali fakar ona ba ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém, hanesan nee mos Hau nia laran nakali sei haraik ba imi, bainhira imi baa iha Ejitu. Imi sei sai povu ho malisan, ho tauk boot, no ema sei despreza no hamoe imi. No imi sei la haree tan fatin nee.’
verses.19: Imi restu hosi Judá, Nai dehan tiha ona ba imi: ‘La bele baa iha Ejitu.’ Hatene ho loloos katak iha loron ida nee hau foo tiha ona avizu ba imi
verses.20: katak imi halo perigu boot bainhira imi lao sees nee. Tanba imi haruka ona hau baa too iha Nai, imi nia Maromak, no dehan, ‘Halo orasaun ba Nai, ami nia Maromak, hodi husu tulun mai ami. Foo sai ba ami buat hotu-hotu nebee Nai sei hatete ba o, no ami sei halo tuir.’
verses.21: Ohin loron hau foo sai tiha ona liafuan nee ba imi, tuir saida mak Nai, imi nia Maromak, haruka hau atu koalia, maibee imi lakohi halo tuir buat ida deit.
verses.22: Nee duni, hatene ba katak imi sei mate liu husu funu, liu hosi hamlaha boot no liu hosi moras peste, iha fatin nebee imi hakarak baa hodi hela.”

verses.1: Jeremias hatoo ba povu liafuan hotu hosi Nai, sira nia Maromak, nebee Nai, sira nia Maromak, haruka nia hatoo ba sira.
verses.2: Depois Azarias, oan hosi Hosaias, no Joanan, oan hosi Karea, hamutuk ho mane sira nebee foti aan, hatete ba Jeremias, “O koalia bosok! Nai, ami nia Maromak, la koalia ba o atu hatoo mai ami katak ami la bele baa hela iha Ejitu.
verses.3: Maibee, Baruke, oan hosi Nerias, mak tau lia ba o hodi kontra ami, hodi ami bele monu ba ema Babilónia sira nia liman, hodi sira oho ami, ka lori ami ba rai Babilónia.”
verses.4: Entaun Joanan, oan hosi Karea, no komandante forsa sira hotu, hamutuk ho povu tomak, la halo tuir Nai nia lian hodi sira hela nafatin iha rai Judá.
verses.5: Joanan, oan hosi Karea, no komandante forsa sira hotu, lori ema restu hotu hosi Judá - sira nebee fila fali hosi nasaun sira seluk ba iha nebee sira halai namkari, atu mai hela iha Judá:
verses.6: mane, feto no labarik sira, liurai nia oan feto sira, ema sira hotu nebee Nebuzaradan, komandante ba guarda, husik ho Gedalias, oan hosi Aikam, bei-oan hosi Safan; inklui mos profeta Jeremias, no Baruke, oan hosi Nerias.
verses.7: Sira baa iha Ejitu, tanba sira lakohi halo tuir Nai nia liafuan. Sira baa too iha Tafnes.
verses.8: Iha Tafnes, Nai hatoo Ninia liafuan ba Jeremias, hodi dehan:
verses.9: “Foti fatuk boot balun, iha mane hosi Judá sira nia oin, no subar fatuk sira nee iha rai nebee iha liurai Faraó nia palásiu nia odamatan oin, iha Tafnes.
verses.10: Depois hatete ba sira, ‘Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei haruka bolu mai Hau nia atan Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, no Hau sei tau ninia kadunan iha fatuk sira nee nia leten, fatuk sira nebee hau subar iha nee. No nia sei loke ninia tenda liurai nian iha fatuk sira nia leten nee.
verses.11: Nia sei mai no nia sei ataka Ejitu. Sira nebee iha destinu atu mate ho moras peste, sei mate ho moras peste; sira nebee iha destinu atu sai ema dadur, nia sei lori nudar ema dadur; no sira nebee iha destinu atu mate ho surik, ema sei oho ho surik.
verses.12: Hau sei halakan ahi ida iha Ejitu nia maromak sira nia templu sira. Nia sei sunu templu sira nee, no sei lori ba sira nia maromak sira hanesan dadur. Hanesan bibi atan ida hasai utu sira hosi ninia unuk, hanesan nee mos nia sei hamoos rai Ejitu, no nia sei sai hosi rai nee ho dame.
verses.13: Nia sei halo rahun fatuk riin lulik sira hosi Bete Semes iha Ejitu, no nia sei sunu Ejitu nia maromak sira nia templu sira.

verses.1: Nee mak liafuan nebee mai ba Jeremias hodi nia hatoo ba ema Judeu sira hotu nebee hela iha Ejitu no moris iha Migdol, Tafnes, Menfis, no iha rai Patros:
verses.2: “Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: Imi haree terus hotu nebee Hau haraik ba Jerusalém no ba sidade hotu iha Judá. Tebes, too ohin loron sira sobu hela no la iha ema ida nebee hela iha sidade sira nee.
verses.3: Ida nee akontese tanba buat aat nebee povu halo. Sira provoka Hau sai hirus, bainhira sira sunu insensu no serví ba maromak sira seluk, nebee sira no sira nia bei-ala sira la konhese.
verses.4: Maibee beibeik Hau haruka Hau nia atan profeta sira, hodi dehan, ‘Aii, keta halo buat aat nee nebee Hau odi!’
verses.5: Maibee sira lakohi rona ka see tilun. Sira la hasees aan hosi sira nia hahalok aat, sira mos la para hodi sunu insensu ba maromak sira seluk.
verses.6: Tanba nunee mak Hau fakar Hau nia laran hirus no Hau nia laran nakali ba sira, nebee Hau halakan iha sidade sira iha Judá, no iha dalan sira iha Jerusalém. No fatin sira nee sai mamuk no aat too ohin loron.”
verses.7: Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: “Tanba saa mak imi lori terus boot nee ba imi nia aan rasik, bainhira imi hakotu hosi Judá mane no feto sira, labarik no kiik-oan sira, no la husik povu restu iha nebaa?
verses.8: Tanba saa mak imi provoka Hau sai hirus ho imi nia liman nia hahalok nee, hodi sunu insensu ba maromak sira seluk iha rai Ejitu nee, iha fatin nebee imi mai hodi hela? Imi sei sobu imi nia aan rasik, no nasaun sira seluk iha mundu sei despreza no hamoe imi.
verses.9: Keta imi haluha tiha ona karik hahalok aat nebee imi nia bei-ala sira, Judá nia liurai sira, no sira nia feen sira halo, no hahalok aat nebee imi rasik no imi nia feen sira halo iha rai Judá, no iha Jerusalém nia dalan sira?
verses.10: Too ohin loron imi la haraik aan, no la hatudu hamtauk, no la halo tuir Hau nia lei no ukun fuan sira nebee Hau foo ba imi no ba imi nia bei-ala sira.”
verses.11: Nee duni, Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: “Hau foti ona desizaun atu foo terus ba imi no sobu Judá tomak.
verses.12: Hau sei foti povu restu hosi Judá, sira nebee foti desizaun atu baa hela iha Ejitu, no sira hotu sei mate iha Ejitu. Sira sei mate liu hosi surik ka liu hosi hamlaha boot. Hosi sira nebee kiik too sira nebee boot, sira sei mate liu hosi surik ka liu hosi hamlaha boot. Ema sei hatuun sira no sai tauk tanba sira. Sira sei sai malisan no ema sei despreza sira.
verses.13: Hau sei kastigu sira nebee hela iha Ejitu ho funu, ho hamlaha boot, no ho moras peste, hanesan Hau kastigu Jerusalém.
verses.14: La iha ema ida hosi ema restu sira hosi Judá nebee mai hela iha Ejitu, nebee sei konsege halai sees no moris, hodi mai fila fali atu hela iha rai Judá, rai nebee sira hakarak tebe-tebes fila fali ba hodi hela. Sira sei la fila. Só deit ema balun sei konsege halai.”
verses.15: Entaun, mane sira hotu nebee hatene katak sira nia kaben sunu insensu ba maromak sira seluk, no feto sira hotu nebee iha nebaa, ema barak tebe-tebes, ema hotu nebee hela iha Patros, sira hatete ba Jeremias:
verses.16: “Ami sei la foo tilun ba lia menon nebee o hatoo iha Nai nia naran!
verses.17: Maibee, tebes katak ami sei halo tuir buat hotu-hotu nebee ami jura ona - ami sei sunu insensu ba liurai feto lalehan nian, no ami sei fui oferta hemu nian ba nia, hanesan ami, ami nia bei-ala sira, ami nia liurai no funsionáriu sira halo tiha ona iha tempu uluk. Sira halo iha sidade sira iha Judá, no iha dalan sira iha Jerusalém. Iha tempu nebaa, ami iha hahaan barak too resin, ami nia moris diak tebes, no ami la hetan terus ida.
verses.18: Maibee, hafoin ami para hosi sunu insensu ba liurai feto lalehan nian, no la fui oferta hemu nian ba nia, ami la hetan diak ida, no ami mate liu hosi surik no liu hosi hamlaha boot.”
verses.19: Entaun, feto sira dehan, “Ami sunu insensu ba liurai feto lalehan nian no fui oferta hemu nian ba nia. No laos ami nia laen sira mak foo lisensa ba ami atu halo dosi ho modelo tuir imajen liurai feto nee no ami fui oferta hemu nian?”
verses.20: Entaun Jeremias hatete ba povu tomak, ba mane sira no ba feto sira nebee hataan dadauk ba nia. Nia dehan,
verses.21: “Kona ba insensu nebee imi sunu iha sidade sira iha Judá, no iha dalan sira iha Jerusalém, hanesan imi nia bei-ala sira mos halo, imi nia liurai sira no funsionáriu sira, no povu sira iha rai nebaa, laos Nai hanoin hetan ida nee? No laos Nia haree hahalok nee?
verses.22: Uluk nee, Nai la bele tahan tan imi nia hahalok aat no buat foer tebes nebee imi halo. Nunee imi nia rai sai fuik no aat, no sai fatin ida nebee hetan malisan no la iha ema ida nebee hela iha nebaa, no rai sei hanesan nee too ohin loron.
verses.23: Ida nee akontese tanba imi sunu insensu no halo sala kontra Nai. Imi lakohi halo tuir Nai nia lian ka lao tuir Ninia lei, Ninia estatutu sira no Ninia testemunha sira. Entaun susar boot monu ba imi, hanesan imi hetan too ohin loron.”
verses.24: Jeremias hatete tan ba povu tomak, inklui mos feto sira, “Rona ba, imi hotu, Nai nia liafuan, imi nebee ema Judá sira nebee hela iha Ejitu.
verses.25: Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: Imi no imi nia feen sira kumpri ona imi nia liafuan bainhira imi dehan, ‘Tebes katak ami sei halo tuir ami nia juramentu, hodi sunu insensu no fui oferta hemu nian ba liurai feto lalehan nian.’ Kontinua bá! Halo ba buat nebee imi jura! Kumpri imi nia juramentu sira!
verses.26: Maibee, rona ba Nai nia liafuan, imi hotu, ema Judá sira nebee hela iha Ejitu: Tebes, Hau jura hodi Hau nia naran nebee boot, hatete Nai, katak iha Ejitu tomak, sei la iha tan ema hosi Judá nebee sei bolu Hau nia naran, ka sei jura hodi dehan, ‘Hodi Nai Maromak nia moris.’
verses.27: Hau sei hein sira atu foo terus, laos atu halo diak ba sira. Ema Judá sira iha Ejitu sei mate liu hosi surik no liu hosi hamlaha boot, too sira lakon hotu.
verses.28: Ema uitoan deit sei konsege halai hosi surik no sei fila hosi Ejitu ba rai Judá. Entaun, ema restu hotu hosi Judá nebee mai hela iha Ejitu sei hatene see nia liafuan mak sai loos: Hau nian ka sira nian.
verses.29: Ida nee mak sei sai sinál ba imi, hatete Nai, katak Hau sei kastigu imi iha fatin nee. Nunee imi sei hatene katak Hau nia liafuan hodi foo terus ba imi sei sai loos duni.
verses.30: Nai hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei entrega Faraó Hofra, liurai hosi Ejitu, iha ninia inimigu sira nia liman, inimigu sira nebee hakarak oho nia. Ida nee sei akontese hanesan mos Hau entrega ona Zedekias, liurai hosi Judá, ba iha Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, nia liman, nebee Zedekias nia inimigu nebee hakarak atu oho nia.”

verses.1: Liafuan nebee profeta Jeremias hatoo ba Baruke, oan hosi Nerias. Baruke hakerek iha surat tahan liafuan nebee Jeremias koalia, iha tinan ba dala haat iha Jeoakim, liurai hosi Judá, nia ukun. Nia hatete:
verses.2: “Nai, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee ba o, Oh Baruke:
verses.3: O dehan: ‘Susar ba hau! Tanba Nai aumenta tan tristi ba hau nia terus. Hau kole liu ona ho hau nia halerik, maibee hau la hetan deskansa.’
verses.4: Maibee hatete ba nia, Nai hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei sobu buat nebee Hau harii ona, no Hau sei fokit sai buat nebee Hau kuda ona, iha rai nee tomak.
verses.5: O hakarak buka buat boot ba o nia aan? Keta buka buat sira nee, tanba Hau sei lori terus ba ema hotu iha mundu tomak, hatete Nai, maibee Hau sei proteje o nia moris iha nebee deit mak o baa.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan nebee mai ba profeta Jeremias kona ba nasaun sira.
verses.2: Liafuan nee kona ba Ejitu, no Faraó Neko, liurai hosi Ejitu, nia forsa militár nebee iha Mota Eufrates ninin iha Karkemis. Liurai Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, manaan sira iha tinan ba dala haat iha reinu Jeoakim, oan hosi Josias, liurai hosi Judá.
verses.3: “Prepara eskudu kiik no eskudu boot,
verses.4: Kesi kuda ba kareta,
verses.5: Tanba saa mak hau haree ida nee?
verses.6: Ema nebee bele halai lalais la konsege halai sai,
verses.7: See mak nee, nebee sae hanesan Nilu,
verses.8: Ejitu mak sae, hanesan Nilu,
verses.9: Avansa ba, Oh kuda,
verses.10: Loron nee mak Nai Maromak Forsa Nain nia loron,
verses.11: Sae ba Gilead, no lori mina morin,
verses.12: Nasaun sira rona ona kona ba o nia moe,
verses.13: Liafuan nebee Nai koalia ba profeta Jeremias kona ba Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia. Liurai nee mai hodi ataka rai Ejitu.
verses.14: “Deklara iha Ejitu, no foo sai iha Migdol;
verses.15: Tanba saa mak imi nia funu nain sira taka rabat ba rai?
verses.16: Nia halo ema barak sidi no sira monu.
verses.17: Hanaran Faraó, liurai hosi Ejitu,
verses.18: Hanesan Hau moris, deklara Liurai,
verses.19: Prepara imi nia pasta atu lao ba kastigu,
verses.20: Ejitu mak hanesan karau oan feto nebee furak tebes,
verses.21: Ninia soldadu sira nebee nia selu,
verses.22: Nia halo lian hanesan samea nebee dolar ba,
verses.23: Sira sei tesi tuun ninia ai laran,
verses.24: Ejitu nia oan feto sei sai moe,
verses.25: Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, dehan, “Tebes, Hau sei foo kastigu ba Amon hosi sidade Nó. Hau sei foo kastigu ba Faraó, Ejitu, ninia maromak sira no ninia liurai sira. Hau foo kastigu ba Faraó no sira nebee fiar ba Faraó.
verses.26: Hau sei entrega sira ba ema sira nebee buka atu oho sira. Hau sei entrega sira ba Nabukodonozor nia liman, liurai hosi Babilónia, no ninia atan sira. Tuir mai, ema sei hela fali iha Ejitu hanesan iha tempu uluk, hatete Nai.
verses.27: Maibee keta tauk, Oh Hau nia atan Jacó,
verses.28: Keta tauk, Oh Hau nia atan Jacó,

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan nebee mai ba profeta Jeremias hasoru ema Filisteu sira molok Faraó ataka Gaza.
verses.2: “Nai hatete nunee:
verses.3: Sira rona lian hosi kuda aman sira nia ain nebee sama rai,
verses.4: Tanba loron ida sei mai
verses.5: Gaza hetan ulun botak,
verses.6: Oh surik hosi Nai!
verses.7: Oinsaa nia bele nonook?

verses.1: Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee kona ba Moab:
verses.2: Moab nia fatin konhesidu nee, agora la iha.
verses.3: Lian ida! Lian nebee hakilar hosi Horonaim,
verses.4: Ema halakon tiha Moab,
verses.5: Tanba iha dalan nebee sae ba Luhit,
verses.6: Halai ba! Salva aan ba!
verses.7: Tanba imi fiar ba imi nia hahalok no riku-soin,
verses.8: Ida nebee halakon sei hasoru sidade ida-idak,
verses.9: Foo liras ba Moab,
verses.10: Malisan ba nia nebee baruk atu halo Nai nia servisu nee,
verses.11: Moab hela hakmatek dezde nia sei joven.
verses.12: Nunee tebes, loron sira sei mai, hatete Nai, kuandu Hau sei haruka ema fui nia. Sira sei fui sai ninia botir sira too mamuk no harahun ninia sanan rai sira.
verses.13: Depois Moab sei sai moe tanba Kemos, hanesan uma kain Israel sai ona moe kona ba Betél nebee uluk sira tau fiar.
verses.14: Oinsaa imi bele dehan, ‘Ami mak funu nain sira
verses.15: Ida nebee harahun Moab no ninia sidade sira mak sae mai ona,
verses.16: Moab nia terus nee besik ona,
verses.17: Ema hotu nebee haleu nia, tanis ba,
verses.18: Tuun mai hosi o nia fatin nebee iha glória,
verses.19: Hamriik iha dalan ninin no hateke ba,
verses.20: Moab sai moe tanba ema harahun ona nia,
verses.21: Julgamentu hasoru ona rai tetuk iha foho, iha Holon, Jaza no, Mefat;
verses.22: iha Dibon, Nebo no Bet-Diblataim;
verses.23: iha Kiriataim, Bet-Gamul no Bet-Meon;
verses.24: iha Keriot, Bozra no sidade hotu nebee dook no besik iha rai Moab.
verses.25: Ema tesi sai ona Moab nia dikur, no nia liman tohar ona, hatete Nai.
verses.26: Halo nia lanu, tanba nia gaba aan hasoru Nai. Nunee Moab sei duir iha ninia muta laran. Ema sei goza nia.
verses.27: Laos imi goza Israel? Imi hetan nia iha naok-teen sira nia leet ka? Tanba nee imi doko ulun bainhira imi koalia kona ba nia ka?
verses.28: Husik sidade sira no baa hela iha fatuk lolon,
verses.29: Ami rona ona kona ba oinsaa Moab foti aan -
verses.30: Hau hatene ninia laran hirus, hatete Nai,
verses.31: Nunee hau tanis tanba Moab,
verses.32: Hau tanis kona ba o liu fali Jazer,
verses.33: Laran kontenti no ksolok lakon tiha
verses.34: Ema hakilar hosi Hesbon too Eleale. Sira foo sai sira nia lian too iha Jaaz, no hosi Zoar too Horonaim no Eglat-Selisia. Tanba bee hosi Nimrim mos lakon tiha.
verses.35: Iha Moab, Hau sei hapara, hatete Nai, nia nebee oferese sakrifísiu iha fatin aas no halo oferta ba ninia maromak.
verses.36: Nunee Hau nia fuan tanis ba Moab hanesan flauta. Hau nia fuan tanis ba ema hosi Kir-Hareset hanesan flauta. Nunee riku-soin nebee sira hetan mak lakon tiha ona.
verses.37: Tanba ulun hotu sei koi molik, no hasan rahun hotu sei tesi tiha. Liman hotu iha kanek, no sira hatais hena karoon iha sira nia kanotak.
verses.38: Ema tanis halerik iha uma leten no iha merkadu hotu iha Moab. Tanba Hau halo Moab tohar hanesan roo nebee ema la uza ona, hatete Nai.
verses.39: Oinsaa nia tohar tiha! Oinsaa sira tanis hela! Oinsaa Moab fila kotuk ho moe! Ema hotu nebee haleu nia goza nia no hakfodak tanba nia.”
verses.40: Tanba Nai hatete nunee:
verses.41: Nia sei manaan sidade sira,
verses.42: Moab sei lakon no povu nee sei la iha tan,
verses.43: Terus, rai kuak no lasu
verses.44: Nia nebee halai hosi terus nee,
verses.45: Iha Hesbon nia mahon
verses.46: Susar ba o, Oh Moab!
verses.47: Maibee Hau sei halo diak fali ema Moab sira nia moris

verses.1: Nai hatete nunee kona ba ema Amon sira:
verses.2: Nunee tebes, tempu atu mai,
verses.3: Tanis ba, Oh Hesbon, tanba sidade Ai lakon tiha ona!
verses.4: Tanba saa mak o loko aan tanba o nia foho leet sira,
verses.5: Tebes, Hau sei haruka terus hasoru o,
verses.6: Maibee tuir mai, Hau sei halo diak fali ema Amon sira nia moris, hatete Nai.”
verses.7: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee kona ba Edom:
verses.8: Halai ba, hakiduk ba, hela iha fatin klean,
verses.9: Se ema mai hodi kuu o nia uvas fuan,
verses.10: Maibee Hau mak foti hotu hosi Esau;
verses.11: Husik o nia oan kiak sira, tanba Hau sei tau matan ba sira nia moris.
verses.12: Tanba Nai hatete nunee: “Se karik sira nebee la merese atu hemu hosi kopu nee tenki hemu, oinsaa o sei la simu kastigu nee? O sei la sees hosi kastigu nee, maibee o tenki hemu duni.
verses.13: Tanba Hau jura liu hosi Hau nia aan rasik, hatete Nai, katak Bozra sei sai rahun, liafuan aat, fatin fuik no malisan ida. No ninia sidade hotu sei sai fuik ba nafatin.”
verses.14: Hau rona mensajen hosi Nai,
verses.15: Tanba tebes, Hau sei halo o sai kiik iha nasaun sira nia leet,
verses.16: Terus nebee o halo sei bosok fali o,
verses.17: Edom sei sai rahun. Ema hotu nebee lao liu hosi fatin nee sei hakfodak no sira sei hakfuik tanba terus hotu nebee kona Edom.
verses.18: Hanesan Sodoma, Gomora no sidade sira nebee iha sira nia sor-sorin mak lakon ona, hatete Nai, nunee la iha ema ida nebee hela iha Edom. No la iha ema ida nebee toba iha nebaa.
verses.19: Tebes, hanesan liaun nebee sae mai hosi ai laran iha Jordaun hodi tama ba kampu duut, nunee Hau sei halo sira halai hosi nia. Hau mak hili ema hodi ukun sira. Tanba see mak hanesan Hau? See mak bele bolu Hau mai? Bibi atan ida nebee bele hamriik iha Hau nia oin?
verses.20: Nunee rona planu nebee Nai halo ona hodi hasoru Edom. Rona Ninia desizaun nebee nia foti tiha ona hodi hasoru ema nebee hela iha Teman. Ema sei rasta sai kiik-oan sira hosi bibi lubun nee. Tebes bibi lubun sei hakfodak kona saida mak akontese ba sira.
verses.21: Rai sei nakdoko tanba lian makaas bainhira sira monu. Ema iha Tasi Mean sei rona bainhira sira tanis hakilar.
verses.22: Tebes ema ida sei sae ba no semo lalais hanesan makikit. Nia sei lolo ninia liras hodi hasoru Bozra. Iha loron nebaa, Edom nia funu nain sira nia fuan laran sei sai hanesan feto nia fuan laran nebee kanotak moras.”
verses.23: Kona ba Damasku:
verses.24: Damasku sai fraku ona, nia fila hodi halai,
verses.25: Tanba saa mak ema la husik sidade konhesidu nee,
verses.26: Nunee ninia joven mane sira sei monu iha ninia merkadu sira,
verses.27: Hau sei halakan ahi iha moru Damasku,
verses.28: Kona ba Kedar no Hazor nia reinu nebee Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, baku tuun ona.
verses.29: Foti sira nia tenda no bibi lubun sira,
verses.30: Halai ba, lao ba rai dook, baa hela iha fatin klean,
verses.31: Hamriik ba, avansa hasoru nasaun ida nebee hela hakmatek,
verses.32: Ema sei hadau sira nia kuda kamelu sira,
verses.33: Hazor sei sai fatin nebee samea naga mak hela,
verses.34: Nai nia liafuan nebee mai ba profeta Jeremias kona ba Elam, iha tempu nebee Zedekias, liurai hosi Judá, nia reinu hahuu.
verses.35: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: “Tebes, Hau sei halo tohar Elam nia rama inan, nebee huun ba sira nia forsa.
verses.36: Hau sei haruka ba Elam anin haat hosi parte haat iha lalehan. No Hau sei namkari sira ba anin hotu nebaa. La iha nasaun ida nebee la hetan ema nebee sai hosi Elam.
verses.37: Hau sei foo terus ba Elam iha sira nia inimigu sira nia oin no iha ema nia oin nebee buka atu oho sira. Hau sei haruka dezastre hasoru sira, nebee Hau nia laran hirus makaas, hatete Nai. Hau sei haruka Hau nia surik hodi duni sira, too Hau halakon mohu sira.
verses.38: Hau sei harii Hau nia kadunan iha Elam no halakon sira nia liurai no xefi sira, hatete Nai.
verses.39: Maibee iha tempu ikus Hau sei halo diak fali ema Elam nia moris, hatete Nai.”

verses.1: Liafuan nebee Nai koalia liu hosi profeta Jeremias kona ba Babilónia, kona ba rai Kaldeia:
verses.2: “Deklara iha nasaun sira nia leet no foo sai liafuan nee.
verses.3: Tanba liu hosi parte norte nasaun ida sae mai hodi hasoru nia. Nasaun nee sei halo ninia rai sai mamuk. La iha ema ida nebee hela iha nebaa. Ema no animál sei halai sai.
verses.4: Iha loron nebaa no iha tempu nebaa, hatete Nai, povu Israel no povu Judá sei mai hamutuk. Sira sei tanis hela bainhira sira mai. Sira sei buka Nai, sira nia Maromak.
verses.5: Sira sei husu dalan ba Zion. Sira sei hateke ba Zion no dehan, ‘Mai ita kaer metin ba Nai liu hosi aliansa rohan laek nebee ita nunka haluha.’
verses.6: Hau nia povu mak bibi malae nebee lakon dalan. Sira nia bibi atan sira lori sira ba dalan sala. Sira husik bibi nee iha foho. No sira lao hosi foho ba foho oan. Sira haluha sira nia bibi luhan.
verses.7: Animál hotu nebee hetan sira mak haan sira. No sira nia inimigu sira dehan, ‘Ami la sala tanba sira halo ona sala hasoru sira nia Nai, nebee sira nia huun ba moris loos. Sira halo ona sala hasoru Nai, nebee sira nia bei-ala sira nia esperansa.’
verses.8: Halai sai hosi Babilónia laran, no sai hosi rai Kaldeia. Sai hanesan bibi timor aman iha bibi lubun nia oin.
verses.9: Tanba tebes, Hau sei fanu sorumutu hosi nasaun boot sira hodi hasoru Babilónia. Sira sei mai hosi rai norte. Sira sei forma hodi hasoru Babilónia. Hosi fatin nee sira sei foti nia. Sira nia rama oan sira mak hanesan funu nain matenek nebee la fila mai ho liman mamuk.
verses.10: Ema sei hadau Kaldeia. No ema hotu nebee hadau nia sei sai bosu, hatete Nai.
verses.11: Maski imi haksolok, maski imi foti aan,
verses.12: maski nunee imi nia inan sei sai moe liu,
verses.13: Ema sei la hela iha Babilónia tanba Nai nia laran hirus,
verses.14: Forma hasoru Babilónia iha ninia sor-sorin,
verses.15: Hakilar ba nia iha sor-sorin,
verses.16: Hakotu Babilónia hosi ema nebee kari fini,
verses.17: Israel mak bibi malae ida nebee liaun sira kasa. Primeiru, liurai hosi Asíria haan nia. Agora, ikus mai, Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, tata ninia ruin.
verses.18: Entaun Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau lori kastigu ba liurai Babilónia no ninia rai, hanesan Hau foo kastigu ba liurai hosi Asíria.
verses.19: Hau sei lori Israel mai fali ba ninia kampu duut. No nia sei haan iha Karmel nia leten no iha Basan. Nia sei haan too bosu iha foho Efraim no iha Gilead.
verses.20: Iha loron nebaa no iha tempu nebaa, hatete Nai, ema buka Israel nia sala maibee sira la hetan. Sira sei buka Judá nia sala maibee sira la hetan. Tanba Hau sei foo perdua ba ema restu nebee Hau husik moris iha nebaa.
verses.21: Sae baa no hasoru rai Merataim,
verses.22: Lian hosi funu mak iha rai nee,
verses.23: Oinsaa mareta nebee baku mundu tomak
verses.24: Hau tau lasu ida nebee kaer o, Oh Babilónia,
verses.25: Nai loke ona Ninia armazén,
verses.26: Mai hasoru nia hosi sor-sorin,
verses.27: Oho ninia karau aman hotu,
verses.28: Lian ida! Sira sei halai no sai hosi rai Babilónia. Sira deklara iha Zion vingansa hosi Nai, ita nia Maromak, vingansa tanba Ninia Templu.
verses.29: Bolu hanadór hodi hasoru Babilónia, no ema hotu nebee dada rama inan. Halo akampamentu haleu nia, no keta husik ema ida bele halai sai. Selu fali ba nia tuir ninia hahalok. Halo ba nia tuir buat hotu nebee nia halo ona. Tanba, ho laran nebee foti aan, nia kontra hasoru Nai, Ida Nebee Santu iha Israel.
verses.30: Nunee ninia joven mane sira sei monu iha ninia merkadu sira. No ninia soldadu hotu sei lakon iha loron nebaa, hatete Nai.
verses.31: Tebes, Hau hasoru o, Oh ida nebee foti aan,
verses.32: Ida nebee foti aan sei sidi no monu,
verses.33: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Ema hanehan ona povu Israel hamutuk ho povu Judá. Ema hotu nebee lori sira ba kastigu mak kaer metin sira. Ema sira nee lakohi husik sira.
verses.34: Maibee sira nia Hola-Nain mak forti. Ninia naran mak Nai Forsa Nain. Tebes Nia sei defende sira nia kazu. Nunee Nia bele foo deskansa ba mundu, maibee Nia la foo deskansa ba ema nebee hela iha Babilónia.
verses.35: Surik ida hasoru ema Kaldeia sira, hatete Nai,
verses.36: Surik ida hasoru ninia matan dook sira,
verses.37: Surik ida hasoru ninia kuda no kuda kareta,
verses.38: Tempu bailoro naruk hasoru ninia bee hotu,
verses.39: Nunee animál fuik sei hela hamutuk ho asu fuik iha Babilónia. No kakuuk sira sei hela iha ninia laran. Nia nunka simu fali povu, no ema sei la hela iha ninia laran too jerasaun ba jerasaun.
verses.40: Hanesan tempu nebee Maromak halakon Sodoma no Gomora no aldeia sira nebee haleu sira, hatete Nai, nunee la iha ema ida nebee hela iha nia, no la iha oan mane ida nebee toba iha nia.
verses.41: Tebes, povu ida mai hosi parte norte,
verses.42: Sira kaer rama inan no dima,
verses.43: Liurai hosi Babilónia rona liafuan kona ba sira,
verses.44: Tebes, hanesan liaun nebee sae mai hosi ai laran iha Jordaun hodi tama ba kampu duut, nunee derepenti deit Hau sei halo sira halai sees hosi nia. Hau mak hili ema tuir Hau nia hakarak hodi ukun sira. Tanba see mak hanesan Hau? See mak bele bolu Hau mai? Bibi atan ida nebee bele hamriik iha Hau nia oin?
verses.45: Nunee rona planu nebee Nai halo ona hodi hasoru Babilónia. Rona Ninia desizaun nebee Nia foti tiha ona hodi hasoru ema Kaldeia sira nia rai. Ema sei rasta sai kiik-oan sira hosi bibi lubun nee. Tebes bibi lubun nee sei hakfodak kona saida mak akontese ba sira.
verses.46: Rai sei nakdoko tanba lian makaas bainhira ema kastigu Babilónia. Nasaun sira sei rona bainhira nia tanis hakilar.”

verses.1: Nai hatete nunee:
verses.2: No Hau sei haruka ba Babilónia ema nebee haliri,
verses.3: Keta husik hanadór dada ninia rama inan,
verses.4: Sira sei monu mate iha ema Kaldeia sira nia rai,
verses.5: Tanba Israel no Judá nia Maromak,
verses.6: Halai sai hosi Babilónia laran;
verses.7: Babilónia uluk mak kalis osan mean iha Nai nia liman,
verses.8: Derepenti Babilónia monu no tohar,
verses.9: Ita hanoin atu kura nia,
verses.10: Nai halao ona justisa mai ita,
verses.11: Kadi ita nia rama oan sira!
verses.12: Monta bandeira iha Babilónia nia moru leten,
verses.13: Oh ida nebee hela besik bee barak,
verses.14: Nai Forsa Nain jura tiha ona liu hosi Ninia aan rasik:
verses.15: Nai halo mundu liu hosi Ninia kbiit,
verses.16: Bainhira Nia foo sai Ninia lian
verses.17: Ema hotu beik no la hatene,
verses.18: Sira la iha folin, no mosu liu hosi hahalok bosok.
verses.19: Jacó nian la hanesan buat sira nee,
verses.20: O mak hau nia mareta no armas funu nian.
verses.21: Hau harahun kuda no nia nebee lori kuda ho o.
verses.22: Hau harahun mane no feto ho o.
verses.23: Hau harahun bibi atan no bibi lubun ho o.
verses.24: Hau sei selu fali Babilónia no ema hotu nebee hela iha Kaldeia iha imi nia oin tanba buat aat hotu nebee sira halo ona iha Zion, hatete Nai.
verses.25: Tebes, Hau kontra hasoru o, Oh foho nebee estraga,
verses.26: Ema sei la foti fatuk hosi o hodi halo moru lidun,
verses.27: Monta bandeira iha mundu,
verses.28: Prepara nasaun sira hodi halo funu hasoru nia,
verses.29: Rai nee nakdoko no nakdedar,
verses.30: Funu nain sira hosi Babilónia la funu tan,
verses.31: Ema halai hodi hasoru ema seluk,
verses.32: Ema kaer ona fatin nebee hakur mota,
verses.33: Tanba Nai Forsa Nain, Maromak iha Israel, hatete nunee:
verses.34: “Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, haan tiha ona hau.
verses.35: Hau hein katak Babilónia simu fali violénsia nebee kona hau no hau nia maluk sira,”
verses.36: Nai hatete nunee:
verses.37: Babilónia sei sai fatuk bou boot deit,
verses.38: Sira sei hakilar hamutuk hanesan liaun sira,
verses.39: Bainhira sira hirus manas Hau sei prepara festa ida
verses.40: Hau sei lori sira tuun hanesan bibi oan nebee atu oho,
verses.41: Oinsaa ema foti ona Babilónia,
verses.42: Tasi sae iha Babilónia,
verses.43: Ema hakfodak kona ba ninia sidade sira,
verses.44: Hau sei kastigu Bel iha Babilónia,
verses.45: Sai hosi ninia laran, Oh Hau nia povu!
verses.46: Keta husik o nia fuan laran sai fraku no keta tauk
verses.47: Nunee tebes, tempu sei too mai
verses.48: Depois lalehan no mundu,
verses.49: Babilónia tenki monu tanba ema nebee mate iha Israel,
verses.50: Imi nebee konsege halai sai hosi surik,
verses.51: ‘Ami sai moe, tanba ema despreza ami,
verses.52: Nunee tebes, tempu sei mai, hatete Nai,
verses.53: Maski Babilónia sei sae too lalehan,
verses.54: Lian ida! Ema hakilar hosi Babilónia!
verses.55: Tanba Nai halakon hela Babilónia,
verses.56: Tanba estragadór ida mai hasoru nia,
verses.57: Hau sei halo ninia xefi no ema matenek sira lanu,
verses.58: Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.59: Nee mak liafuan hotu nebee profeta Jeremias manda ba Seraias, oan mane hosi Nerias, oan mane hosi Maseias, bainhira nia baa ho liurai Zedekias hosi Judá ba Babilónia. Ida nee akontese iha tinan ba dala haat iha liurai Zedekias nia reinu. Seraias mak xefi toma konta ba sasaan.
verses.60: Jeremias hakerek iha livru ida kona ba dezastre hotu nebee sei hasoru Babilónia, no liafuan hotu nebee nia hakerek kona ba Babilónia.
verses.61: No Jeremias dehan ba Seraias, “Bainhira ita too ona iha Babilónia, ita tenki lee liafuan hotu nee.
verses.62: No ita tenki dehan, ‘Oh Nai, O hatete ona kona ba fatin nee katak O sei hakotu nia hodi la iha buat ida nebee bele hela iha nia. Nunee ema ka animál sei la hela iha nia, no Babilónia sei sai mamuk too rohan laek.’
verses.63: Bainhira ita lee hotu tiha livru nee, kesi fatuk ida ba livru nee no soe nia ba Mota Eufrates laran.
verses.64: No ita sei hatete, ‘Nunee Babilónia sei mout no la bele sae fali. Tanba Hau sei lori dezastre ba nia, no sira sei sai kole.’” Too iha nee mak liafuan hosi Jeremias.

verses.1: Zedekias tinan rua-nulu resin ida bainhira nia sai liurai. No nia ukun tinan sanulu resin ida iha Jerusalém. Ninia inan nia naran Hamutal, oan feto hosi Jeremias hosi Libna.
verses.2: Nia halo buat nebee aat iha Nai nia oin, tuir buat hotu nebee Jeoakim mak halo.
verses.3: Tanba Nai iha laran hirus hasoru sira. No tempu too ona iha Jerusalém no Judá katak Nai soe sira hosi Ninia prezensa. No Zedekias kontra liurai hosi Babilónia.
verses.4: Iha ninia reinu nia tinan ba dala sia, iha fulan sanulu, iha loron sanulu iha fulan nee, Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia mai ho ninia forsa tomak hodi ataka Jerusalém, no serka haleu sidade nee. Sira harii alat funu nian nebee haleu sidade nee.
verses.5: Sira serka haleu sidade nee too liurai Zedekias nia tinan ba dala sanulu resin ida.
verses.6: Iha loron sia, iha fulan haat, rai hamlaha makaas liu iha sidade laran too ema iha rai nee la iha ai haan.
verses.7: Depois sidade nia moru nakfera no funu nain hotu halai no sai hosi sidade iha kalan ida. Sira sai liu hosi dalan hosi portaun entre moru rua, nebee liu hosi liurai nia jardin. Ema Kaldeia sira sei haleu hela sidade. Funu nain sira nee halai iha diresaun nebee tama ba Araba.
verses.8: Maibee ema Kaldeia nia forsa militár duni liurai nee no sira toman Zedekias iha rai tetuk iha Jerikó. No Zedekias nia forsa tomak namkari hosi nia.
verses.9: Sira kastigu liurai nee no lori nia sae ba liurai hosi Babilónia iha Ribla, nebee iha rai Hamat. No liurai Babilónia tesi lia ba nia.
verses.10: Liurai Babilónia oho Zedekias nia oan mane sira iha Zedekias nia oin. No iha Ribla nia oho mos xefi hotu hosi Judá.
verses.11: Nia fokit sai Zedekias nia matan, no kesi nia ho korenti. Depois liurai Babilónia lori Zedekias ba Babilónia no tau nia iha komarka too nia mate.
verses.12: Iha fulan lima, iha loron sanulu iha fulan nee - nebee tinan ba dala sanulu resin sia ba liurai Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia - Nebuzaradan, komandante seguransa nebee serví liurai Babilónia, tama ba Jerusalém.
verses.13: Nia sunu Nai nia uma, no liurai nia uma no uma hotu iha Jerusalém. Uma ida-idak nia sunu mohu tiha.
verses.14: No tropas Kaldeia hotu nebee hamutuk ho komandante seguransa nee baku rahun moru hotu nebee haleu Jerusalém.
verses.15: Nebuzaradan, komandante seguransa, lori sai ba kastigu ema balu nebee kiak liu no ema restu nebee hela iha sidade nee. Nia lori mos sira nebee halai ona ba sorin liurai Babilónia nian, hamutuk ho badaen sira nebee sei iha nebaa.
verses.16: Maibee Nebuzaradan, komandante seguransa, husik ema balu nebee kiak liu iha rai nee hodi tau matan ba toos uvas no hodi fila rai.
verses.17: Ema Kaldeia sira baku rahun ai riin riti nebee iha Nai nia uma, no kareta oan riti no tanki tasi riti. No sira lori riti hotu nee ba Babilónia.
verses.18: No sira lori sai tasu sira, kanuru sira, pinsa kiik sira, kanedok sira no sasaan riti hotu nebee uza hodi halao serimónia;
verses.19: no mos basia sira, bikan ahi sira, manko sira, tasu sira, kandelabru sira, kanuru sira no kopu sira. Xefi seguransa nee lori sasaan osan mean nian no sasaan osan mutin nian.
verses.20: Riin boot rua, tanki tasi ida, karau aman riti sanulu resin rua nebee iha tanki okos no kareta oan sira nebee liurai Salomão halo ba uma Nai nian - riti hosi sasaan hotu nee sira la bele tetu.
verses.21: Riin boot riti ida nee aas metro ualu, no nia kabuar nee metro lima ho balu, no nia mahar nee hanesan liman fuan haat. No riin boot nee mamuk iha laran.
verses.22: No iha riin boot nee nia leten iha nia ulun nebee halo ho riti. Ulun nee iha redi ho dezenhu ai fuan delima nebee haleu riin boot nia ulun nee - buat hotu halo ho riti. Iha riin boot seluk nee mos hanesan no iha dezenhu ai fuan delima.
verses.23: Sira iha ai fuan delima sia-nulu resin neen iha sira nia sor-sorin. Ai fuan delima hotu mak atus ida nebee iha redi nebee haleu riin boot sira nee.
verses.24: Depois komandante seguransa kaer Seraias, xefi saserdote, no Zefanias, saserdote segundu no ema nain tolu nebee hein odamatan.
verses.25: Hosi sidade nee, sira kaer funsionáriu ida nebee diriji soldadu sira, no ema nain hitu nebee uluk serví ba liurai, no xefi sekretaris ba forsa nebee hakerek povu nebee sai soldadu, no ema nain neen-nulu hosi povu iha rai nee nebee sira hetan iha sidade laran nee.
verses.26: Depois Nebuzaradan, komandante seguransa, kaer sira no lori sira baa liurai hosi Babilónia, too iha Ribla.
verses.27: Depois liurai Babilónia oho sira iha Ribla, iha rai Hamat. Nunee sira lori ema Judá sira sai hosi sira nia rai.
verses.28: Nee mak ema nain hira nebee Nabukodonozor lori sai ba kastigu: iha tinan ba dala hitu, ema Judeu nain rihun tolu rua-nulu resin tolu (3.023);
verses.29: iha Nabukodonozor nia tinan ba dala sanulu resin ualu nia lori ba kastigu hosi Jerusalém ema nain atus ualu tolu-nulu resin rua (832);
verses.30: iha Nabukodonozor nia tinan ba dala rua-nulu resin tolu, Nebuzaradan, xefi seguransa, lori ba kastigu ema Judeu nain atus hitu haat-nulu resin lima (745). Hamutuk ema hotu nee nain rihun haat atus neen (4.600).
verses.31: Tuir mai, iha tinan tolu-nulu resin hitu iha Joakim, liurai hosi Judá, nia kastigu, iha fulan sanulu resin rua, iha loron rua-nulu resin lima iha fulan nee, Evil-Merodake, liurai hosi Babilónia, iha ninia tinan primeiru nebee nia sai liurai, nia hatudu nia laran diak ba Joakim liurai hosi Judá nee, no hasai nia hosi komarka.
verses.32: Evil-Merodake koalia di-diak ho nia no foo kadunan ida ba nia nebee aas liu fali liurai sira seluk nia kadunan sira nebee hamutuk ho nia iha Babilónia.
verses.33: Joakim troka nia ropa komarka nian no nia bele haan hamutuk ho liurai durante nia moris tomak.
verses.34: Liurai mos foo hahaan ba nia tuir buat nebee nia presiza loro-loron too loron nebee nia mate, durante nia moris tomak.

verses.1: Osan mean nee agora laduun nabilan,
verses.2: Oan mane sira hosi Zion uluk iha folin,
verses.3: Asu fuik oferese sira nia susun;
verses.4: Bebee nia nanaal nebee sei susu
verses.5: Sira nebee uluk haan diak
verses.6: Kastigu nebee Hau nia povu hetan tanba sira nia hahalok aat
verses.7: Ninia ema Nazireu sira uluk moos liu neve,
verses.8: Agora sira nia oin metan liu ahi anar;
verses.9: Ema nebee haan surik mak kontenti liu
verses.10: Feto sira nebee laran luak
verses.11: Nai sai laran manas tebes;

verses.1: Hanoin hetan, Oh Nai, saida mak akontese ona mai ami;
verses.2: Ami nia liman rohan sai ona estranjeiru sira nian,
verses.3: Ami sai oan kiak nebee aman la iha;
verses.4: Ami tenki sosa bee hodi hemu;
verses.5: Sira duni ami too ona ami nia kakorok;
verses.6: Ami tane liman ba Ejitu no Asíria,
verses.7: Ami nia aman sira sala no sira la iha ona;
verses.8: Atan sira ukun ami;
verses.9: Hodi hetan deit paun ami hasoru perigu atu lakon ami nia moris,
verses.10: Ami nia kulit nee sai manas hanesan fugaun

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala tolu-nulu, iha fulan ba dala haat, iha loron ba dala lima, hau iha ema kastigu nia leet iha Mota Kebar nia ninin. Iha loron nebaa, lalehan nakloke ba no hau haree vizaun sira hosi Maromak.
verses.2: Iha loron ba dala lima iha fulan nee, iha tinan ba dala lima nebee liurai Jeoakim tama ba kastigu,
verses.3: Nai nia liafuan mai deit ba saserdote Ezekiel, oan hosi Buzi, iha ema Kaldeia sira nia rai, iha Mota Kebar nia ninin. Nai nia liman kona nia iha nebaa.
verses.4: Hau hateke ba, no tebes, anin fuik mai hosi parte norte, no kalohan boot nebee iha ahi lakan nebee mosu mai, ho naroman nebee haleu nia. Hosi kalohan laran nee, buat ida nebee nabilan hanesan besi naroman, leno mai hosi ahi laran.
verses.5: No mos, hosi ahi laran nee, buat ida nebee iha oin hanesan kriatura moris nain haat. No sira iha oin hanesan nee: sira iha oin hanesan ema ida.
verses.6: Ida-idak iha oin haat no ida-idak iha liras haat.
verses.7: Sira iha ain nebee loos. No sira nia ain okos nee mak hanesan karau oan nia ain. No sira nia ain nabilan hanesan besi riti nebee nabilan.
verses.8: No sira iha liman hanesan ema nian iha sira nia liras okos nebee iha sorin haat. No sira nain haat nee iha sira nia oin no sira nia liras hanesan nee:
verses.9: Sira nia liras kona malu. Ida-idak baa oin loos deit, no sira la fila bainhira sira baa.
verses.10: Kona ba sira nia oin nee, ida-idak iha oin ida hanesan ema; no nain haat nee iha oin ida hanesan liaun iha sorin loos; no nain haat nee iha oin ida hanesan karau iha sorin karuk; no nain haat nee iha mos oin ida hanesan makikit.
verses.11: Sira iha oin hanesan nee. No sira lolo sira nia liras iha leten. Liras rua kona malu no sira falun sira nia isin lolon ho liras rua.
verses.12: Ida-idak baa oin loos deit. Iha fatin nebee deit mak espíritu atu baa, sira mos baa. No sira la fila bainhira sira baa.
verses.13: Kona ba kriatura moris sira nia oin, sira iha oin hanesan ahi klaak nebee lakan. Sira iha buat nebee hanesan ahi oan lakan sira nebee muda ba-mai iha kriatura moris sira nia leet. Ahi nee naroman loos, no rai lakan mosu mai hosi ahi laran nee.
verses.14: No kriatura moris sira halai ba-mai hanesan rai lakan.
verses.15: Bainhira hau haree kriatura moris sira nebee iha oin haat nee, tebes hau haree roda ida iha rai nebee iha kriatura moris ida-idak nia sorin.
verses.16: Roda sira iha oin no dezenhu hanesan ho krisolitu nebee naroman. Roda haat nee iha oin hanesan deit. No sira nia modelu iha oin hanesan roda ida nebee iha roda seluk nia laran.
verses.17: Bainhira sira baa, sira bele baa deit ba sorin haat, no sira la fila bainhira sira baa.
verses.18: No roda sira nee mak aas tebes too hau tauk. No roda nia ninin nakonu ho matan nebee haleu roda haat nee.
verses.19: Bainhira kriatura moris sira baa, roda sira mos baa ho sira. Bainhira kriatura moris sira sae hosi rai, roda sira sae.
verses.20: Iha fatin nebee deit espíritu baa, sira baa tuir espíritu. No roda sira mos sae ba hamutuk ho sira tanba espíritu hosi kriatura moris nee mak iha roda sira nia laran.
verses.21: Bainhira sira baa, roda sira baa. Bainhira sira hamriik, roda sira hamriik. Bainhira sira sae hosi rai, roda sira sae hamutuk ho sira tanba kriatura moris nia espíritu mak iha roda sira nia laran.
verses.22: Iha kriatura moris sira nia leten mak iha fatin luan nebee naroman hanesan jelu fatuk nebee halo hau tauk. No fatin luan nee nahe ba iha sira nia ulun leten.
verses.23: No sira lolo sira nia liras loos ba malu iha buat luan nee nia okos. No ida-idak falun sira nia isin lolon ho liras rua.
verses.24: Bainhira sira baa hau rona lian hosi sira nia liras. Lian nee hanesan lian hosi bee boot, hanesan lian hosi Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas. Lian nee hanesan barulhu hosi akampamentu militár. Bainhira sira hamriik deit, sira hatuun sira nia liras.
verses.25: No lian ida mosu mai hosi fatin luan nebee iha sira nia ulun leten bainhira sira hamriik no hatuun sira nia liras.
verses.26: Iha fatin luan nia leten nebee iha sira nia ulun leten mak iha buat ida nebee iha oin hanesan kadunan ida. No ida nee iha oin hanesan fatuk safira. No buat ida nebee iha oin hanesan ema ida mak iha buat nebee iha oin hanesan kadunan ida nia leten.
verses.27: Hosi buat nebee hanesan ninia kanotak ba leten, hau haree nia iha oin hanesan besi naroman, ho oin hanesan ahi nebee haleu iha laran. No hosi buat nebee hanesan ninia kanotak ba kraik hau haree oin hanesan ahi. No naroman haleu nia.
verses.28: Hanesan arkuiris nia oin nebee iha kalohan iha loron nebee udan, nunee mak naroman nia oin nebee haleu buat hotu. Ida nee mak oin hanesan glória Nai nian. Bainhira hau haree ida nee, hau monu ho oin ba rai. No hau rona lian ida hosi ida nebee koalia.

verses.1: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, hamriik iha o nia ain no Hau sei koalia ba o.”
verses.2: No bainhira Nia koalia hela ho hau, Espíritu tama mai hau no tau hau iha hau nia ain. No hau rona Nia koalia mai hau.
verses.3: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, Hau haruka o ba ema Israel sira, ba nasaun kontradór ida, tanba sira kontra hasoru Hau. Sira no sira nia bei-ala sira halo sala hasoru Hau too ohin loron.
verses.4: Sira mak ulun toos no laran toos. Hau haruka o ba sira no o sei dehan ba sira, ‘Nai Maromak hatete nunee.’
verses.5: Maski sira rona tuir ka lakohi (tanba sira mak uma kain kontradór) sira sei hatene katak profeta ida mak koalia iha sira nia leet.
verses.6: No o, ema nia oan, keta tauk sira, no keta tauk sira nia liafuan, maski ai katar no ai tarak hasoru o, no o tuur iha sakunar nia leten. Keta tauk sira nia liafuan ka hakfodak bainhira sira hateke ba o, tanba sira mak uma kain kontradór.
verses.7: O sei koalia Hau nia liafuan ba sira, se sira rona tuir ou se sira lakohi. Tanba sira mak uma kain kontradór.
verses.8: Maibee o, ema nia oan, rona tuir liafuan nebee Hau koalia ba o. La bele kontra Hau hanesan uma kain kontradór nee. Loke o nia ibun no haan buat nebee Hau foo ba o.”
verses.9: Bainhira hau haree, tebes, liman ida lolo mai hau. No tebes, liman nee kaer surat tahan lulun ida.
verses.10: Nia loke surat tahan iha hau nia oin, no surat tahan nee iha liafuan iha laran no iha liur. No liafuan nee iha lamentasaun, tanis lelir no susar.

verses.1: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, haan buat nebee o hetan nee. Nebee haan surat tahan lulun nee no baa koalia ba uma kain Israel.”
verses.2: Entaun hau loke hau nia ibun, no Nia foo surat tahan lulun nee hodi haan.
verses.3: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, haan surat tahan lulun ida nee nebee Hau foo, no haan too o nia kabun bosu.” Depois hau haan surat nee no surat nee mak midar iha hau nia ibun hanesan bani been.
verses.4: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, baa uma kain Israel no foo sai Hau nia liafuan ba sira.
verses.5: Tanba Hau la haruka o ba povu nebee iha lian hosi rai liur nebee lingua susar, maibee ba uma kain Israel -
verses.6: laos ba ema barak nebee iha lian hosi rai liur nebee iha lingua susar, nebee koalia lian nebee o la bele kompriende. Tebes, se Hau haruka o ba ema hanesan nee, nunee sira sei rona ba o.
verses.7: Maibee uma kain Israel sei lakohi rona tuir o, tanba sira lakohi rona tuir Hau. Tanba uma kain tomak hosi Israel iha reen toos nebee toos duni no laran toos.
verses.8: Tebes, Hau halo ona o nia oin toos hanesan sira nia oin. Hau halo o nia reen toos sai toos hanesan sira nia reen toos.
verses.9: Hanesan diamante nebee toos liu fatuk ahi, nunee hau halo o nia reen toos. Keta tauk sira no keta nakdedar bainhira sira hateke ba o, tanba sira mak uma kain kontradór.”
verses.10: No mos, Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, simu Hau nia liafuan hotu nebee Hau koalia ba o iha o nia fuan laran, no rona ho o nia tilun.
verses.11: Baa ema kastigu sira, ba o nia povu, no koalia ba sira no dehan ba sira, ‘Nai Maromak hatete nunee,’ maski sira rona tuir ka lakohi rona tuir.”
verses.12: Depois Espíritu foti sae hau, no hau rona iha hau nia kotuk lian hosi rai nakdoko makaas: “Bensaun ba Nai nia glória nebee mai hosi ninia fatin!”
verses.13: Nee mak lian hosi kriatura nia liras nebee kona malu, no lian hosi roda nebee iha sira nia sorin, no lian hosi rai nakdoko makaas.
verses.14: Nunee Espíritu foti sae hau no lori hau sai ba. No hau sai ho laran susar no espíritu manas tanba Nai nia liman kona hau ho forsa.
verses.15: Depois hau baa ema kastigu sira iha Tel-Abib, nebee hela iha Mota Kebar nia ninin. Hau tuur iha fatin nebee sira hela. Hau tuur bilaan iha sira nia leet durante loron hitu.
verses.16: Bainhira loron hitu remata ona, Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.17: “Ema nia oan, Hau hili o nudar ema seguransa ba uma kain Israel. Bainhira o rona liafuan hosi hau nia ibun, o sei foo avizu ba sira kona ba perigu nee.
verses.18: Se Hau dehan ba ema aat, ‘O sei mate duni,’ no o la foo avizu kona ba perigu nee, no o la koalia atu haruka ema aat tenki kuidadu tanba ninia hahalok aat, hodi salva ninia moris, ema aat nee sei mate tanba ninia hahalok aat, maibee o tenki selu kona ba ninia raan.
verses.19: Maibee se o foo avizu ba ema aat, no nia la fila hosi ninia hahalok aat, ka ninia dalan aat, nunee nia sei mate tanba ninia hahalok aat, maibee o sei salva ona o nia moris rasik.
verses.20: No mos, se ema moris loos fila hosi ninia moris loos no halao hahalok aat, no Hau tau fatuk sidi iha ninia oin, nunee nia sei mate tanba ninia sala. No tanba o la foo avizu ba nia, nunee nia sei mate tanba ninia sala, no ema sei la hanoin ninia hahalok loos nebee nia halo tiha ona, maibee o tenki selu kona ba ninia raan.
verses.21: Maibee se o foo avizu ba ema moris loos nee atu la sala, no nia la halo sala duni, entaun nia sei moris hela, tanba nia simu tiha o nia avizu, no o sei salva o nia moris.”
verses.22: No Nai nia liman kona hau iha nebaa. Nia dehan mai hau, “Hamriik ba, no sai ba rai tetuk iha nebaa, no Hau sei koalia ho o.”
verses.23: Entaun hau hamriik no sai ba rai tetuk. No tebes, Nai nia glória hamriik iha nebaa, hanesan glória nebaa hau haree ona iha Mota Kebar. No hau monu ho oin ba rai.
verses.24: Maibee Espíritu tama hau no tau hau iha hau nia ain. Nia koalia ho hau no dehan mai hau, “Baa, no tama ba o nia uma no taka uma nee.
verses.25: No o, Oh ema nia oan, tebes, tali sei kona o, no ema sei kesi o ho tali nee. Nunee o la bele sai ba iha povu nia leet.
verses.26: Hau sei halo o nia nanaal belit ba o nia ibun leten. Nunee o sei sai monok no la bele koriji sira, tanba sira mak uma kain kontradór.
verses.27: Maibee bainhira Hau koalia ho o, hau sei loke o nia ibun, no o sei dehan ba sira, ‘Nai Maromak hatete nunee.’ Nia nebee rona, husik nia rona. No nia nebee lakohi rona, husik nia lakohi. Tanba sira mak uma kain kontradór.

4.title: Drama Kona Ba Inimigu Haleu Jerusalém

verses.1: “No o, ema nia oan, foti blok ida no rai iha o nia oin. Halo dezenhu iha blok nee tuir sidade ida, nebee Jerusalém.
verses.2: Haleu modelu sidade nee ho inimigu. Monta uma aas funu nian hasoru nia, halibur rai bou ida iha ninia sorin, halo akampamentu ida nebee serka nia no tau alat baku moru hasoru nia iha sor-sorin.
verses.3: No o, foti besi kabelak tunu nian no tau nudar moru besi entre o no sidade nee. Fila o nia oin hasoru sidade no husik sidade nee hetan inimigu nebee haleu sira. No hanehan sidade nee ho forsa nebee haleu sira. Ida nee mak sinál ba uma kain Israel.
verses.4: “Depois toba iha o nia sorin karuk no tau uma kain Israel nia kastigu hahalok aat nian iha fatin nee. No o sei simu kastigu hahalok aat nian tuir loron sira nebee o toba hanesan nee.
verses.5: Hau foo loron atus tolu sia-nulu (390) ba o, nebee tuir tinan sira nebee sira simu kastigu hahalok aat nian. Too tempu hanesan nee o sei lori kastigu hahalok aat nebee uma kain Israel nian.
verses.6: No bainhira o halo hotu ona, o sei toba ba dala rua, maibee iha o nia sorin loos, no o sei lori kastigu hahalok aat hosi uma kain Judá nian. Hau foo loron haat-nulu ba o, nebee loron ida ba tinan ida.
verses.7: O sei fila o nia oin ba funu nebee haleu Jerusalém, ho o nia liman molik, no o sei profesia hasoru sidade nee.
verses.8: Tebes, Hau sei tau tali ba o hodi o la bele fila hosi sorin ida ba sorin seluk, too halo hotu ona loron sira nebee serka sidade nee.
verses.9: “No o, foti trigu, trigu boot, koto, koto kiik, tunis no trigu kiik, no tau iha fatin ida deit nia laran. O bele uza ai haan sira nee hodi halo paun. Durante loron sira nebee o toba iha o nia sorin, nebee loron atus tolu sia-nulu, o bele haan ai haan nee.
verses.10: O nia ai haan nebee o haan tenki tuir todan, nebee grama atus rua haat-nulu (240) kada loron ida. Loro-loron o bele haan ai haan nee.
verses.11: No o tenki hemu bee nebee o sukat. O sei sukat kopu rua no hemu loro-loron.
verses.12: No o sei haan hanesan dosi hosi trigu boot, no iha sira nia oin o sei sunu ema nia teen hodi tunu dosi nee.”
verses.13: No Nai dehan, “Nunee povu Israel sei haan sira nia paun nebee foer iha nasaun sira nia leet nebee Hau sei duni sira.”
verses.14: Depois hau dehan, “Aii, Nai Maromak! Tebes, hau nunka hafoer hau nia klamar. Dezde hau joven too agora, hau nunka haan buat nebee mate rasik ka buat nebee animál lees tiha. No hau nunka hatama naan foer iha hau nia ibun.”
verses.15: Depois Nia dehan mai hau, “Haree lai, Hau foo ba o karau teen hodi troka ema nia teen, nebee o bele uza hodi prepara o nia paun.”
verses.16: No mos, Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, tebes, Hau sei hakotu paun hosi Jerusalém. Sira tenki haan paun nebee sira tetu no sira sei hanoin barak. Sira sei hemu bee nebee sira sukat no sira sei hakfodak.
verses.17: Hau sei halo hanesan nee hodi sira la iha paun no bee. Sira sei hateke ba malu no hakfodak. Sira sei lakon neineik neineik tanba sira nia hahalok aat.”

verses.1: “Agora, Oh ema nia oan, foti surik kroat ida. Uza buat nee nudar salon nia lámina no koi ita nia ulun fatuk no hasan rahun. Depois foti dasin hodi tetu no fahe fuuk.
verses.2: Parte ida hosi tolu o sei sunu iha sidade laran bainhira tempu serka sidade nee hotu ona. No parte ida hosi tolu o sei foti no tesi ho surik ida iha sidade nia sor-sorin. No parte ida hosi tolu o sei namkari ba iha anin. No Hau sei losu surik nebee tuir sira.
verses.3: O sei foti uitoan hosi fuuk nee no falun iha o nia ropa.
verses.4: No o sei foti balun hosi fuuk nee no soe ba ahi laran no sunu iha ahi laran. Hosi nee ahi sei sai ba no tama uma kain Israel tomak.
verses.5: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Nee mak Jerusalém. Hau tau nia iha nasaun sira nia klaran ho rai sira nebee haleu nia.
verses.6: Nia mak kontra hasoru Hau nia regulamentu sira no halo buat nebee aat liu nasaun sira. Nia kontra Hau nia estatutu sira liu fali rai nebee haleu nia. Tanba sira rejeita hau nia regulamentu no la lao tuir Hau nia estatutu sira.
verses.7: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tanba imi halo barulhu liu fali nasaun sira nebee haleu imi, no la lao tuir Hau nia estatutu sira ka halo tuir Hau nia regulamentu sira, no imi mos la halo tuir regulamentu sira hosi nasaun sira nebee haleu imi,
verses.8: nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tebes, Hau, Hau rasik mak hasoru imi. No Hau sei halao julgamentu sira nee iha imi nia leet no iha nasaun sira nia oin.
verses.9: No tanba imi nia hahalok foer hotu Hau sei halo ho o buat nebee Hau nunka halo too agora, no Hau sei nunka halo fali hanesan nee iha futuru.
verses.10: Nunee aman sira sei haan sira nia oan mane sira iha imi nia leet, no oan mane sira sei haan sira nia aman sira. Hau sei halao julgamentu sira ba imi. No ema nebee sei moris nee, Hau sei namkari ba anin hotu.
verses.11: Nunee, hanesan Hau sei moris, hatete Nai Maromak, tebes, tanba imi halo foer Hau nia Fatin Santu ho imi nia sasaan hotu nebee aat no buat hotu nebee foer tebes, nunee Hau sei sai hosi imi. Hau nia matan sei la husik no Hau sei la hatudu grasa.
verses.12: Parte ida hosi tolu hosi imi sei mate tanba moras peste, no rai hamlaha iha imi nia leet sei halakon imi. Parte ida hosi tolu sei monu tanba surik nebee haleu imi. No parte ida hosi tolu Hau sei namkari ba anin hotu no Hau sei losu Hau nia surik hodi tuir sira.
verses.13: “Nunee Hau halao hotu tuir Hau nia laran hirus, no Hau sei husik Hau nia hirus manas ba sira, depois Hau sei dada iis. No sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai no Hau koalia tiha ona ho Hau nia laran moras - bainhira Hau halao hotu tiha Hau nia hirus manas ba sira.
verses.14: No mos, Hau sei halo imi sai rai maran no nasaun sira nebee haleu imi iha sor-sorin no ema hotu nebee lao liu imi sei hakribi imi.
verses.15: Imi sei sai liafuan aat no liafuan goza, liafuan nebee foo kuidadu no liafuan nebee halo ema tauk. No nasaun sira nebee haleu imi iha sor-sorin sei hatene liafuan nee bainhira Hau halao julgamentu sira ba imi ho laran hirus nebee manas, no ho liafuan manas nebee hasee imi. Hau mak Nai. Hau koalia tiha ona.
verses.16: Hau sei haruka rama oan aat nebee rai hamlaha hodi hasoru imi. No Hau sei haruka rama oan sira nebee estraga imi hodi destrui imi. No Hau sei haruka rai hamlaha makaas liu tan no hakotu imi nia paun.
verses.17: Hau sei haruka rai hamlaha no animál fuik hodi hasoru imi. Sira sei naok imi nia oan sira. Moras peste no raan sei lao liu hosi imi. No hau sei lori surik hasoru imi. Hau mak Nai. Hau koalia tiha ona.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, fila o nia oin hodi hasoru foho iha Israel no foo sai profesia hasoru sira,
verses.3: no dehan, Imi nebee foho iha Israel, rona lai liafuan hosi Nai Maromak! Nai Maromak hatete nunee ba foho aas no foho oan, ba foho nia leet no rai tetuk: Tebes, Hau, Hau rasik sei lori surik hodi hasoru imi, no Hau sei halakon imi nia fatin aas.
verses.4: Imi nia altár sira sei sai mamuk, no Hau sei halo tohar imi nia altár insensu sira. Hau sei soe ema mate iha imi nia ai riin lulik sira nia oin.
verses.5: Hau sei rai povu Israel sira nia mate isin iha sira nia ai riin lulik sira nia oin no Hau sei namkari ruin haleu imi nia altár sira.
verses.6: Iha fatin hotu nebee imi hela, sidade sira nee sei lakon no fatin aas sei sai aat. Imi nia altár sira sei lakon no hetan kastigu. Ema sei sobu no estraga imi nia ai riin lulik no tesi tuun imi nia altár insensu. No sira sei halakon buat nebee imi halo tiha ona.
verses.7: Sira sei oho tuun imi nia ema iha imi nia leet, no imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.8: “Maibee Hau sei husik ema balu moris. Imi sei iha ema balu iha nasaun sira nia leet nebee konsege halai sai hosi surik, no namkari ba iha nasaun sira.
verses.9: No imi nebee konsege halai sai iha nasaun sira nia leet nebee lori imi tama ba kastigu sei hanoin hetan Hau. Imi sei hanoin hetan oinsaa Hau nia laran tohar tiha tanba sira nia fuan laran nebee halo sala foer nebee husik Hau no tanba sira nia matan nebee kaan sala foer hodi tuir sira nia ai riin lulik sira. No sira sei hakribi sira nia aan rasik tanba sira nia hahalok aat nebee sira halao tiha ona no tanba sira nia hahalok foer tebes hotu.
verses.10: No sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai. Hau la koalia ho liafuan saugati katak Hau sei halo buat aat nee ba sira.”
verses.11: Nai Maromak hatete nunee: “Basa liman no tebe rai no dehan, Susar, tanba buat hotu nebee foer tebes no aat iha uma kain Israel. Tanba sira sei monu liu hosi surik, rai hamlaha no moras peste.
verses.12: Nia nebee hela dook sei mate tanba moras peste, no nia nebee besik sei monu liu hosi surik, no nia nebee sei moris hela sei mate tanba rai hamlaha. Nunee Hau sei husik Hau nia laran hirus manas ba sira.
verses.13: No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira ema oho sira no mate isin sira nee latan deit iha sira nia ai riin lulik sira nia leet, no latan haleu sira nia altár sira, iha fatin aas hotu no iha foho tutun hotu, no iha ai horis hotu nia okos, no iha ai boot hotu nia okos, iha fatin nebee deit sira oferese suar morin ba sira nia ai riin lulik hotu.
verses.14: Hau sei lolo Hau nia liman hasoru sira no halo rai nee mamuk no maran. Ida nee sei akontese iha sira nia hela fatin hotu, hosi rai fuik too iha Ribla. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “No o, Oh ema nia oan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee ba rai Israel: Loron ikus ona! Loron ikus mai ona ba lidun haat iha rai nee.
verses.3: Agora, loron ikus mak hasoru imi no Hau sei haruka Hau nia laran hirus hasoru imi. Hau sei tesi lia ba imi tuir imi nia hahalok. Hau sei kastigu imi tanba imi nia hahalok foer hotu.
verses.4: Hau nia matan sei la husik imi no Hau sei la hatudu grasa. Maibee Hau sei selu fali imi kona ba imi nia hahalok bainhira imi nia hahalok foer tebes sei iha imi nia leet. Depois imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.5: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Dezastre tuir dezastre! Tebes, ida nee mai.
verses.6: Loron ikus mai ona. Loron ikus mai ona! Tempu nee hadeer ona hodi hasoru imi. Tebes, ida nee mai.
verses.7: Imi nia tempu susar mai ona ba imi, Oh ema nebee hela iha rai nee. Tempu nee mai ona. Loron nee besik ona - loron barulhu nian, nebee laos haklalak haksolok iha foho.
verses.8: Agora, Hau besik atu fui Hau nia hirus manas ba imi, no husik Hau nia laran hirus hasoru imi. Hau sei tesi lia ba imi tuir imi nia hahalok no Hau sei kastigu imi tanba imi nia hahalok foer tebes.
verses.9: Hau nia matan sei la husik no Hau sei la iha grasa. Hau sei kastigu imi tuir imi nia hahalok bainhira imi nia hahalok foer sei iha imi nia leet. Depois imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, nebee baku.
verses.10: “Tebes, loron nee! Tebes, loron nee mai! Tempu susar mai ona; funan mosu mai iha ai tonka; hahalok nebee foti aan dikin ona.
verses.11: Violénsia sai boot ona no sai ai tonka nebee iha hahalok aat. La iha ema ida nebee moris hela, no sira nia sasaan barak no riku-soin la iha. La iha buat ida nebee boot iha sira nia leet.
verses.12: Tempu too ona. Loron nee mai ona. Ema nebee sosa la bele haksolok, no ema nebee faan la bele tristi, tanba laran hirus manas nee hasoru ema lubun tomak.
verses.13: Faan nain sei la fila ba buat nebee nia faan tiha ona durante ninia moris. Tanba vizaun nee mak kona ba ema lubun tomak. No vizaun nee sei la fila fali ba. No tanba ema nia hahalok aat, la iha ema ida nebee bele salva ninia moris.
verses.14: “Sira huu trombeta no prepara tiha ona. Maibee la iha ida nebee baa halo funu tanba Hau nia laran hirus hasoru ema lubun tomak nee.
verses.15: Surik iha liur, no moras peste no rai hamlaha iha laran. Nia nebee iha rai luan mate liu hosi surik, no rai hamlaha no moras peste haan nia nebee iha sidade laran.
verses.16: Se ema balu konsege halai sai, sira sei hela iha foho. Sira sei sai hanesan manu pombu, no sira hotu tanis. Ida-idak tanis tanba ninia hahalok aat.
verses.17: Liman hotu sai fraku, no ain tuur hotu nabeen.
verses.18: Sira hatais ropa karoon, no laran tauk taka sira. Sira hotu iha oin moe, no sira koi molik sira nia ulun hotu.
verses.19: Sira soe sira nia osan mutin ba iha dalan, no osan mean sai buat nebee la moos. Sira nia osan mutin no osan mean sei la salva sira iha loron nebee Nai nia laran nakali. Sira la bele haan osan nee hodi la hamlaha no sira la bele haan buat nee too kabun bosu. Tanba osan nee sai fatuk nebee sira sidi tanba sira nia hahalok aat.
verses.20: Sira foti aan ho Ninia sasaan furak, no sira uza sasaan nee hodi halo imajen foer tebes no buat seluk nebee aat tebes. Nunee Hau halo buat nee sai buat nebee la moos ba sira.
verses.21: No Hau sei foo buat nee ba estranjeiru sira hodi sira bele hadau. Hau sei foo buat nee ba ema aat hosi mundu hodi sai sira nia riku-soin, no sira sei hafoer buat nee.
verses.22: Hau sei fila Hau nia oin hosi sira no sira sei halo foer Hau nia fatin segredu. Naok-teen sira sei tama no halo fatin nee sai foer.
verses.23: “Halo korenti kastigu ba! Tanba rai nee nakonu ho sala nebee iha raan no sidade nee nakonu ho violénsia.
verses.24: Hau sei lori ema aat liu hosi nasaun sira ba hodi hadau sira nia uma. Hau sei hapara ema forti nebee foti aan no sira nia fatin santu sei sai foer.
verses.25: Bainhira terus mai sira sei buka dame, maibee sira sei la hetan.
verses.26: Dezastre tuir dezastre, lia anin tuir lia anin. Sira buka vizaun ida hosi profeta bainhira lei mak lakon hosi saserdote no konselhu lakon hosi katuas sira.
verses.27: Liurai tanis, no laran susar falun ema boot. Povu nia liman iha rai nee nakdedar deit. Hau sei halo ba sira tuir sira nia hahalok. Hau sei tesi lia ba sira tuir sira nia julgamentu, no sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala neen, iha fulan ba dala neen, iha loron ba dala lima iha fulan nee, bainhira hau tuur hela iha hau nia uma ho katuas Judá sira nebee tuur iha hau nia oin, Nai Maromak nia liman monu mai hau iha nebaa.
verses.2: Depois hau haree ba, no tebes, iha buat ida nebee iha oin hanesan ema ida. Hosi buat nebee iha oin hanesan ninia kanotak ba kraik, iha ahi. No hosi ninia kanotak ba leten iha buat nebee iha oin hanesan ho buat naroman, hanesan riti nebee nabilan.
verses.3: Nia lolo buat ida nebee iha oin hanesan liman ida no nia kaer hau nia fuuk iha hau nia ulun, no Espíritu hiit sae hau entre mundu no lalehan no lori hau liu hosi vizaun Maromak nian ba Jerusalém, ba fatin atu tama portaun ba Templu nia fatin iha sorin norte. Iha nebaa iha fatin nebee iha estátua laran moras, nebee provoka laran moras.
verses.4: No tebes, glória hosi Maromak iha Israel mak iha nebaa, hanesan vizaun nebee hau haree ona iha rai tetuk.
verses.5: Depois Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, agora, foti o nia matan no hateke ba parte norte.” Entaun hau foti hau nia matan hodi hateke ba parte norte, no tebes, iha Portaun Altár nia sorin norte, iha fatin atu tama, hau haree estátua laran moras.
verses.6: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, o haree ona buat nebee sira halo ka? O haree ona buat foer tebes nebee uma kain Israel halao iha nee, hodi duni Hau dook hosi Hau nia fatin santu? Maibee o sei haree buat foer liu tan.”
verses.7: Depois Nia lori hau ba portaun atu tama ba pátiu, no bainhira hau haree, tebes, iha kuak iha moru.
verses.8: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, kee iha moru nee.” Entaun hau kee iha moru, no tebes, hau hetan fatin hodi tama.
verses.9: Nia dehan mai hau, “Tama ba, no haree buat foer tebes nebee sira halao iha nee.”
verses.10: Entaun hau tama ba no hau haree. No iha nebaa, sira halo dezenhu iha didin iha sor-sorin, nebee sira bahat imajen oi-oin nebee dolar iha rai no animál foer tebes no ídulu hotu hosi uma kain Israel.
verses.11: No iha imajen sira nee nia oin iha ema nain hitu-nulu nebee hamriik. Ema sira nee mak katuas sira hosi uma kain Israel. No Jazanias, oan hosi Safan, hamriik iha sira nia leet. Ema ida-idak iha ninia manko nebee sunu insensu iha ninia liman, no suar sae hosi insensu nee.
verses.12: Depois Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, o haree ona buat nebee katuas sira hosi uma kain Israel halo iha fatin nakukun ka? Ida-idak iha ninia kuartu nebee iha dezenhu sira nee. Tanba sira dehan, ‘Nai la haree ami, Nai husik ona rai nee.’”
verses.13: Nia dehan mos mai hau, “O sei haree buat foer liu tan nebee sira halo.”
verses.14: Depois Nia lori hau ba fatin atu tama Portaun Norte iha uma Nai nian, no tebes, feto tuur iha nebaa no tanis kona ba Tamuz.
verses.15: Depois Nia dehan mai hau, “O haree tiha buat nee ka, Oh ema nia oan? O sei haree buat foer liu tan duké buat sira nee.”
verses.16: No Nia lori hau tama ba pátiu iha laran, nebee iha Nai nia uma. No tebes, fatin atu tama ba Nai nia Templu, entre varanda no altár, iha ema kala rua-nulu resin lima, nebee fila kotuk ba Nai nia Templu. Sira fila oin ba parte lorosae no sira adora loro matan iha parte lorosae.
verses.17: Depois Nia dehan mai hau, “O haree ona buat nee ka, Oh ema nia oan? Buat nee kamaan liu ba uma kain Judá atu halao buat foer tebes nebee sira halao iha nee ka, hodi nunee sira halo rai nakonu ho violénsia no provoka hela Hau atu sai hirus ka? Tebes, sira tau sanak ida ba sira nia inus.
