verses.18: Nunee Hau resposta ho laran hirus manas. Hau nia matan sei la husik, no Hau sei la hanoin sira. No maski sira tanis iha hau nia tilun ho lian makaas, Hau sei la rona sira.”

9.title: Ema Nebee Adora Sala Sei Mate

verses.1: Depois Nia hakilar ho lian makaas, no dehan, “Lori mai ema nebee halo kastigu mate iha sidade, ida-idak nebee lori ninia alat hodi halakon iha ninia liman.”
verses.2: No tebes, ema nain neen mai hosi diresaun ba Portaun Leten, nebee hateke ba parte norte. Ida-idak lori ninia alat hodi oho iha ninia liman. Hamutuk ho sira iha ema ida nebee hatais hena linhu, nebee lori kaixa hakerek nian iha ninia kanotak. No sira tama ba no hamriik besik altár riti.
verses.3: No glória hosi Maromak iha Israel mak sae ona hosi kerubim, nebee Nia iha uluk, no Nia baa odamatan ba uma. Nia bolu ba ema ida nebee hatais ho hena linhu nebee iha kaixa hakerek nian iha ninia kanotak.
verses.4: No Nai dehan ba nia, “Lao liu hosi sidade, liu hosi Jerusalém, no tau sinál ida iha ema nia reen toos nebee tristi no halerik kona ba buat aat hotu nebee ema halo iha sidade nee.”
verses.5: No ba sira seluk nee nia koalia hodi hau bele rona, “Lao liu hosi sidade tuir ema uluk nee no oho ba. Imi nia matan sei la husik, no imi sei la hanoin.
verses.6: Oho deit katuas, joven mane, joven feto, kiik-oan no inan sira. Maibee keta book ema nebee iha sinál. Hahuu iha Hau nia Fatin Santu.” Entaun sira hahuu ho katuas sira nebee iha uma nee nia oin.
verses.7: Depois Nia dehan ba sira, “Halo foer uma nee. Halo nakonu pátiu sira ho ema mate. Sai ba.” Entaun sira sai ba no oho ema iha sidade nee.
verses.8: No bainhira sira oho dadaun, hau hamriik mesak. Hau monu ho oin ba rai, no hau hakilar, “Aii, Nai Maromak! O sei destrui ema restu hosi Israel bainhira O fakar sai O nia hirus manas ba Jerusalém ka?”
verses.9: Depois Nia dehan mai hau, “Sala nebee uma kain Israel no Judá halo ona mak boot tebes. Rai nee nakonu ho raan no sidade nee nakonu ho hahalok aat. Tanba sira dehan, ‘Nai husik ona rai nee, no Nai la haree.’
verses.10: Nunee ba Hau, Hau nia matan sei la husik, no Hau sei la hanoin. Hau sei selu fali sira nia hahalok ba sira nia ulun.”
verses.11: No tebes, ema nebee hatais hena linhu, nebee iha kaixa hakerek nian iha ninia kanotak, lori mai liafuan, no dehan, “Hau halo tiha ona tuir O nia orden mai hau.”

verses.1: Depois hau haree ba, no tebes, iha fatin luan nebee iha kerubim nia leten buat ida mosu mai nebee iha oin hanesan ho safira, nebee hanesan kadunan ida.
verses.2: No Nia dehan ba ema nebee hatais hena linhu, “Tama ba iha roda nebee dulas nia leet, nebee iha kerubim nia okos. Halo o nia liman nakonu ho ahi klaak nebee lakan hela hosi kerubim nia klaran. Depois kari ahi klaak nee iha sidade leten.” No ema nee tama ba iha hau nia oin.
verses.3: Agora, kerubim hamriik hela iha uma nia sorin súl bainhira ema nee tama ba. No pátiu iha laran sai nakonu ho kalohan.
verses.4: No Nai nia glória sai hosi kerubim ba varanda ba uma, no uma nee sai nakonu ho kalohan. No pátiu sai nakonu ho naroman hosi Nai nia glória.
verses.5: Ema bele rona lian hosi liras kerubim nian iha pátiu iha liur. Lian nee hanesan lian hosi Maromak Ida Nebee Kbiit Makaas bainhira Nia koalia.
verses.6: Nia foo orden ba ema ida nebee hatais linhu, “Foti ahi hosi roda dulas nia leet, nebee hosi kerubim nia klaran.” Nunee ema nee tama ba no hamriik besik roda ida.
verses.7: No kerubim ida lolo ninia liman hosi kerubim nia klaran no foti ahi balu no tau iha ema nia liman nebee hatais hena linhu. Ema nee foti ahi nee no sai ba.
verses.8: Hau haree kerubim iha liman ho oin hanesan ema nian iha sira nia liras okos.
verses.9: No hau haree, no tebes, iha roda haat iha kerubim nia sorin. Kerubim ida-idak iha roda ida iha ninia sorin. No roda sira nee iha oin hanesan ho krisolitu nebee nabilan.
verses.10: No kona ba roda sira nia oin, nain haat nee iha oin hanesan deit, nebee hanesan roda ida iha roda seluk nia laran.
verses.11: Bainhira sira baa, sira bele baa sorin haat no la presiza fila bainhira sira baa. Maibee iha diresaun saida nebee roda iha oin baa, roda sira seluk tuir, no sira la fila bainhira sira baa.
verses.12: Sira nia isin tomak, sira nia ninin, sira nia raius, sira nia liras, no roda nee nakonu ho matan nebee haleu roda nebee kerubim haat mak iha.
verses.13: No kona ba roda sira nee, ema bolu ‘roda dulas’ bainhira hau rona hela.
verses.14: Kerubim ida-idak iha oin haat: oin ba dala ida mak kerubim nia oin, oin ba dala rua mak ema nia oin, oin ba dala tolu mak liaun nia oin, no oin ba dala haat mak makikit nia oin.
verses.15: Depois kerubim sae ba. Buat sira nee mak kriatura moris nebee hau haree tiha ona iha Mota Kebar nia ninin.
verses.16: Bainhira kerubim baa, roda sira nee mos baa iha sira nia sorin. Bainhira kerubim hiit sae sira nia liras hodi sae hosi rai, roda sira nee la fila hosi sira nia sorin.
verses.17: Bainhira sira hamriik metin, roda sira mos hamriik metin. No bainhira sira sae ba, roda sira mos sae ba ho sira. Tanba kriatura moris nia espíritu mak iha roda nia laran.
verses.18: Depois Nai nia glória sai hosi uma nia varanda no hamriik iha kerubim nia leten.
verses.19: No kerubim nee hiit sae sira nia liras no sae hosi rai. Bainhira hau haree hela, sira sai ba, no roda sira sei iha sira nia sorin. No sira hamriik iha fatin nebee tama Portaun Lorosae iha Nai nia uma. No Israel nia Maromak nia glória mak iha sira nia leten.
verses.20: Buat sira nee mak kriatura moris sira nebee hau haree iha Israel nia Maromak nia okos iha Mota Kebar nia ninin. No hau hatene katak sira mak kerubim.
verses.21: Ida-idak iha oin haat, ida-idak iha liras haat, no iha sira nia liras okos sira iha liman hanesan ema nian.
verses.22: No kona ba sira nia oin nee, sira iha oin hanesan ho buat nebee hau haree iha Mota Kebar nia ninin. Ida-idak baa oin loos deit.

verses.1: Espíritu foti sae hau no lori hau ba Portaun Lorosae iha Nai nia uma, nebee hateke ba parte lorosae. No tebes, iha fatin nebee tama portaun nee, iha mane nain rua-nulu resin lima. No hau haree iha sira nia leet mak Jazanias, oan mane hosi Azúl, no Pelatias, oan mane hosi Benaias, nebee xefi ba povu.
verses.2: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, mane sira nee halo planu aat no sira foo konselhu aat iha sidade nee.
verses.3: Sira dehan, ‘Tempu seidauk mai atu harii uma. Sidade nee mak sanan boot, no ita mak naan.’
verses.4: Nunee foo sai profesia hasoru sira; profesia ba, Oh ema nia oan.”
verses.5: Nai nia Espíritu monu mai hau, no Nia dehan mai hau, “Dehan, Nai hatete nunee: Imi hanoin hanesan nee, Oh uma kain Israel. Tanba Hau hatene buat sira nebee tama imi nia hanoin.
verses.6: Imi oho ema barak iha sidade nee no imi halo dalan sira nakonu ho mate isin.
verses.7: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Imi nia povu nia mate isin sira nebee imi rai iha sidade laran nee, sira mak naan no sidade nee mak sanan boot. Maibee ema sei lori imi sai hosi sidade nee.
verses.8: Imi tauk surik, no Hau sei lori surik mai hasoru imi, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.9: No Hau sei lori imi sai hosi sidade laran, no foo imi ba ema rai liur, no halao julgamentu ba imi.
verses.10: Imi sei monu liu hosi surik. Hau sei tesi lia ba imi iha baliza Israel, no imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.11: Sidade nee sei la sai imi nia sanan boot, no imi sei la sai naan iha sidade laran nee. Hau sei tesi lia ba imi iha baliza Israel,
verses.12: no imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai. Tanba imi la lao tuir Hau nia estatutu sira, no imi la halo tuir Hau nia regulamentu sira, maibee imi halo tuir regulamentu sira hosi nasaun sira nebee iha imi nia sor-sorin.”
verses.13: No bainhira hau foo sai hela profesia, Pelatias, oan mane hosi Benaias, mate kedas. Depois hau monu ho oin ba rai no hakilar ho lian boot no dehan, “Aii, Nai Maromak! O sei halakon hotu ema restu iha Israel ka?”
verses.14: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.15: “Ema nia oan, ema nebee hela iha Jerusalém dehan kona ba o nia maun-alin rasik, nebee o nia maluk sira, nebee uma kain tomak hosi Israel, ‘Hadook tiha hosi Nai. Ami hetan rai nee nudar ami nia liman rohan.’
verses.16: Nunee dehan, ‘Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Mezmu Hau hasai tiha sira ba fatin dook iha nasaun sira nia leet, no mezmu Hau halo sira namkari iha rai liur, maibee Hau sai fatin santu uitoan ba sira iha rai liur nebee sira baa ona.’
verses.17: Nunee dehan, ‘Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Hau sei halibur imi hosi povu sira no Hau sei forma imi hosi nasaun sira nebee imi namkari ba. No Hau sei foo rai Israel ba imi.’
verses.18: No bainhira sira baa nebaa, sira sei hasai buat hotu nebee aat tebes no buat hotu nebee foer tebes.
verses.19: No Hau sei foo fuan laran ida deit ba sira, no Hau sei tau espíritu foun iha sira nia laran. Hau sei hasai fuan laran fatuk nian hosi sira nia isin no foo fuan laran isin nian ba sira.
verses.20: Hodi nunee sira bele lao tuir Hau nia estatutu sira no halo tuir Hau nia regulamentu sira no kumpri buat sira nee. No sira sei sai Hau nia povu, no Hau sei sai sira nia Maromak.
verses.21: Maibee ba sira nebee iha fuan laran nebee lao tuir buat aat tebes no buat foer tebes, Hau sei selu sira nia hahalok nee ba sira nia ulun rasik, hatete Nai Maromak.”
verses.22: Depois kerubim hiit sae sira nia liras, ho roda sira iha sira nia sorin, no glória hosi Israel nia Maromak mak iha sira nia leten.
verses.23: No Nai nia glória sae ba hosi sidade laran no hamriik iha foho nebee iha sidade nia parte lorosae.
verses.24: No Espíritu foti sae hau no lori hau iha vizaun liu hosi Maromak nia Espíritu ba Kaldeia, nebee ba ema kastigu sira. Depois vizaun nebee hau haree tiha sae hosi hau.
verses.25: No hau foo hatene ba ema kastigu sira kona ba buat hotu nebee Nai foin hatudu mai hau.

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, o hela iha uma kain kontradór nia leet, nebee sira iha matan hodi haree, maibee sira la haree, no sira iha tilun hodi rona, maibee sira la rona, tanba sira mak uma kain kontradór.
verses.3: Maibee o, ema nia oan, prepara aan ho pasta hanesan ema kastigu nian, no tama ba kastigu iha loron hodi sira bele haree. O sei baa nudar ema kastigu ida hosi o nia fatin ba fatin seluk hodi sira bele haree. Karik sira bele kompriende, mezmu sira mak uma kain kontradór.
verses.4: O sei lori sai o nia pasta iha loron hodi sira haree, hanesan pasta ema kastigu nian, no o rasik sei sai iha rai nakaras hodi sira haree, hanesan sira nebee tenki tama ba kastigu.
verses.5: Bainhira sira haree hela, kee kuak iha moru, no lori o nia pasta liu hosi kuak.
verses.6: Bainhira sira haree hela, o sei hiit o nia pasta no hasaan iha o nia kabaas no lori pasta sai iha rai nakaras. O sei taka o nia oin hodi o la bele haree rai nee, tanba Hau halo o sai sinál ba uma kain Israel.”
verses.7: No hau halo tuir orden nebee hau hetan nee. Hau lori sai hau nia pasta iha loron, hanesan pasta kastigu nian. No iha rai nakaras hau kee kuak iha moru ho hau nia liman rasik. Hau lori sai hau nia pasta iha rai nakaras, no hasaan iha hau nia kabaas bainhira sira haree hela.
verses.8: Iha dadeer-saan, Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.9: “Ema nia oan, laos uma kain Israel, nebee uma kain kontradór, dehan ba o, ‘O halo saida?’
verses.10: Dehan ba sira, ‘Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Liafuan todan nee kona ba nai ulun iha Jerusalém no uma kain Israel tomak nebee iha laran.’
verses.11: Dehan, ‘Hau mak sinál ba imi. Hanesan hau halo tiha ona nee, buat nee sei akontese ba sira. Sira sei tama kastigu, no sai ema dadur.’
verses.12: No nai ulun nebee iha sira nia leet sei hiit ninia pasta ba ninia kabaas iha rai nakaras no nia sei sai ba. Sira sei kee kuak liu hosi didin no lori nia liu hosi kuak nee. Nia sei taka ninia oin hodi nia la bele haree rai ho ninia matan.
verses.13: No Hau sei soe Hau nia redi ba nia, no nia sei tama Hau nia lasu. Hau sei lori nia ba Babilónia, ema Kaldeia sira nia rai, maibee nia la haree buat nee, no nia sei mate iha nebaa.
verses.14: Hau sei namkari ema hotu nebee iha ninia sor-sorin ba anin hotu, nebee ninia ajudante sira no ninia tropas hotu. Hau sei losu hau nia surik hodi duni sira.
verses.15: No sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau fahe sira iha nasaun sira nia leet no namkari sira iha rai sira seluk nia leet.
verses.16: Maibee Hau sei husik ema balu nebee bele halai sai hosi surik, hosi rai hamlaha, no hosi moras peste. Nunee sira sei foo sai sira nia hahalok foer tebes hotu iha nasaun sira nia leet nebee sira baa. No sira bele hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”
verses.17: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.18: “Ema nia oan, haan o nia paun ho isin nakdedar, no hemu bee ho laran tauk no ho hanoin barak.
verses.19: No dehan ba povu iha rai, Nai Maromak hatete nunee kona ba ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém iha rai Israel: Sira sei haan sira nia paun ho hanoin barak, no hemu bee ho hakfodak. Liu hosi hahalok nee, ema sei hasai buat hotu iha rai nee, tanba violénsia hosi sira nebee hela iha nebaa.
verses.20: No ema sei estraga sidade sira nebee ema hela, no rai nee sei sai aat tebes. No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”
verses.21: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.22: “Ema nia oan, saida mak provérbiu nee nebee imi iha kona ba rai Israel, nebee dehan, ‘Loron sira nee dada tempu, no vizaun hotu sai mamuk deit’?
verses.23: Nunee hatete ba sira, ‘Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Hau sei hapara provérbiu nee, no sira sei la uza tan provérbiu nee iha Israel.’ Maibee dehan ba sira, Loron sira nee besik ona, no mos liafuan hosi vizaun hotu.
verses.24: Tanba la iha tan vizaun falsu ka liafuan siik nebee gaba uma kain Israel.
verses.25: Tanba Hau mak Nai. Hau sei koalia liafuan nebee Hau sei koalia. No Hau sei kumpri liafuan nee. Liafuan nee sei la demora tan, maibee iha imi nia loron sira, Oh uma kain kontradór, Hau sei koalia liafuan no kumpri buat nee, hatete Nai Maromak.”
verses.26: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.27: “Ema nia oan, tebes, ema sira hosi uma kain Israel dehan, ‘Vizaun nebee nia haree nee sei iha loron barak ba oin, no nia foo sai profesia kona ba tempu iha futuru liu.’
verses.28: Nunee dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: La iha liafuan ida hosi Hau nebee sei demora tan, maibee liafuan nebee Hau koalia nee, Hau sei kumpri, hatete Nai Maromak.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, foo sai profesia hasoru profeta sira hosi Israel, ba sira nebee foo sai profesia. No dehan ba sira nebee foo sai profesia hosi sira nia fuan laran rasik: ‘Rona liafuan hosi Nai!’
verses.3: Nai Maromak hatete nunee, Susar ba profeta beik sira nebee tuir sira nia espíritu rasik, nebee la haree buat ida!
verses.4: Imi nia profeta sira mak hanesan asu fuik iha fatin nebee rahun tiha, Oh Israel.
verses.5: Imi la sae ba hodi hamriik iha moru nia kuak, no imi la harii moru ba uma kain Israel, hodi moru nee bele metin iha funu iha loron Nai nian.
verses.6: Sira haree vizaun falsu no liafuan siik nebee bosok. Sira dehan, ‘Nai mak hatete,’ bainhira Nai la haruka sira, depois sira hanoin katak Nia sei kumpri sira nia liafuan.
verses.7: Laos imi foo sai vizaun falsu no konta liafuan siik nebee bosok, bainhira imi dehan, ‘Nai mak hatete,’ maski Hau la hatete?”
verses.8: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: “Tanba imi konta buat falsu no haree vizaun bosok, nunee tebes, Hau mak kontra imi, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.9: Hau nia liman sei hasoru profeta sira nebee haree vizaun falsu no foo sai liafuan siik nebee bosok. Sira sei la tama iha Hau nia povu nia konselhu, no sira sei la rejistu naran iha uma kain Israel, no sira sei la tama rai Israel. No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai Maromak.
verses.10: Tanba nee deit, katak sira bosok Hau nia povu no dehan, ‘Dame,’ bainhira dame la iha. No tanba bainhira povu harii moru ida, profeta sira nee taka ho plamir mutin deit.
verses.11: Nunee dehan ba sira nebee taka moru nee ho plamir mutin deit katak moru nee sei monu! Udan boot loos sei mai, no imi, Oh udan jelu fatuk boot, sei monu, no anin fuik sei mosu mai.
verses.12: No bainhira moru nee monu, laos ema sei dehan ba imi, ‘Plamir mutin nebee imi taka moru nee ba nebee?’
verses.13: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Hau sei halo anin fuik mosu mai hosi Hau nia laran hirus manas, no imi sei hetan udan boot loos tanba Hau hirus, no udan jelu fatuk boot sei mai ho laran hirus manas no hapara buat hotu.
verses.14: No Hau sei baku tuun moru nebee imi taka ho plamir mutin. Hau sei hatuun moru nee ba rai, nunee ema bele haree ninia fundasaun. Bainhira moru nee monu, imi sei lakon iha laran, no imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.15: Nunee Hau sei foo sai Hau nia laran hirus manas ba moru nee no ba sira nebee taka moru ho plamir mutin. Hau sei dehan ba imi, Moru nee la iha ona, no sira nebee taka moru ho plamir mutin la iha.
verses.16: Ema sira nee mak profeta sira nebee foo sai profesia kona ba Jerusalém no sira konta vizaun dame kona ba Jerusalém bainhira vizaun dame la iha, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.17: “No o, ema nia oan, see o nia oin hodi hasoru oan feto sira hosi o nia povu nebee foo sai profesia hosi sira nia fuan laran rasik. Foo sai profesia hasoru sira
verses.18: no dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Susar ba feto sira nebee suku fita lulik iha ema hotu nia liman, no halo veo ba ulun hotu iha povu boot no kiik, hodi kasa klamar sira nee! Imi sei kasa klamar sira hosi hau nia povu maibee husik imi nia klamar moris hela ka?
verses.19: Imi hakanek Hau iha Hau nia povu nia leet hodi hetan trigu boot uitoan no paun pedasuk balu. Imi hamate klamar sira nebee loloos la merese mate, no imi husik moris klamar sira nebee loloos la merese moris hela. Imi halo hanesan nee liu hosi imi nia liafuan bosok ba Hau nia povu nebee rona tuir ba liafuan bosok nee.
verses.20: “Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tebes, Hau kontra hasoru imi nia fita lulik nebee imi uza hodi kasa klamar sira hanesan manu. Hau sei lees buat sira nee hosi imi nia liman, no Hau sei husik livre klamar sira nebee imi kasa tiha hanesan manu.
verses.21: Hau sei lees sai imi nia veo sira no salva Hau nia povu hosi imi nia liman. Sira sei la hela tan iha imi nia liman hanesan animál nebee imi hadau tiha, no imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.22: Tanba imi halo ema moris loos nia fuan laran sai tristi, mezmu Hau la halo sira tristi. No imi foo korajen ona ba ema aat, hodi nia sei la fila hosi ninia hahalok aat hodi salva ninia moris.
verses.23: Nunee imi sei la haree tan vizaun falsu ka halao buat siik nian. Hau sei salva Hau nia povu hosi imi nia liman. No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”

verses.1: Depois ema balu hosi katuas Israel sira mai hau no tuur iha hau nia oin.
verses.2: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.3: “Ema nia oan, ema sira nee harii ona sira nia ai riin lulik sira iha sira nia fuan laran, no sira rai sira nia hahalok aat nudar fatuk sidi nian iha sira nia oin. Entaun Hau tenki husik sira atu husu tuir Hau nia liafuan ka?
verses.4: Nunee koalia ba sira no dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Ba ema naran deit hosi uma kain Israel nebee harii ninia ai riin lulik iha ninia fuan laran no rai ninia hahalok aat nudar fatuk sidi nian iha ninia oin, no nia mai hasoru profeta, ba ema nee, Hau, Nai, sei hataan nia bainhira nia mai ho ninia ai riin lulik barak.
verses.5: Nunee Hau sei kaer uma kain Israel iha sira nia fuan laran, nebee hadook aan hosi Hau liu hosi sira nia ai riin lulik sira.
verses.6: “Nunee dehan ba uma kain Israel, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Arepende no fila fali mai hosi imi nia ai riin lulik sira, no fila imi nia oin hosi imi nia hahalok foer hotu.
verses.7: Tanba ema ida-idak hosi uma kain Israel, ka estranjeiru sira nebee hela iha Israel, nebee haketak aan hosi Hau, no harii ai riin lulik iha ninia fuan laran no rai ninia hahalok aat nudar fatuk sidi nian iha ninia oin, no nia mai ba profeta ida hodi husu tuir Hau nia liafuan liu hosi profeta nee, Hau rasik, nebee Nai, sei hataan nia.
verses.8: Hau sei fila Hau nia oin hodi kontra hasoru ema nee. Hau sei halo nia sai sinál no liafuan aat. Hau sei hakotu nia hosi ninia povu nia leet. No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.9: Se profeta nee simu liafuan bosok no nia koalia liafuan nee, Hau, nebee Nai, mak bosok profeta nee, no Hau sei lolo Hau nia liman hasoru nia no Hau sei halakon nia hosi Hau nia povu nia leet.
verses.10: No sira sei simu tuir sira nia hahalok aat – profeta nia hahalok aat no hahalok aat hosi nia nebee husu sei simu hanesan -
verses.11: nunee uma kain Israel sei la fila tan hosi Hau, no sira sei la hafoer aan tan ho sira nia sala aat. Maibee sira bele sai Hau nia povu no Hau sei sai sira nia Maromak, hatete Nai Maromak.”
verses.12: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.13: “Ema nia oan, bainhira rai ida sala hasoru Hau no la hatudu laran metin, no Hau lolo Hau nia liman hasoru sira no hakotu sira nia paun no haruka rai hamlaha, no halakon ema no animál,
verses.14: maski ema nain tolu Noé, Daniel no Job, mak iha rai nee, sira la bele salva rai nee maibee sira salva deit sira nia moris rasik liu hosi sira nia hahalok loos, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.15: “Se Hau haruka animál fuik hodi lao liu hosi rai nee, no sira estraga rai nee, no rai nee sai mamuk, hodi la iha ema ida nebee bele lao liu tanba animál sira nee,
verses.16: se ema nain tolu nee mak hela iha nebaa, tebes hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, sira sei la bele salva mos sira nia oan mane ka oan feto sira. Sira mesak deit bele hetan salvasaun, maibee rai nee sei sai mamuk.
verses.17: “Ou se Hau lori surik mai ba rai nee no dehan, Husik surik lao liu hosi rai nee, no Hau hakotu ema no animál hosi rai nee,
verses.18: maski ema nain tolu nee hela iha rai nee, tebes hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, sira sei la bele salva oan mane ka oan feto sira. Sira mesak deit bele hetan salvasaun.
verses.19: “Ou se Hau haruka moras peste ba rai nee no fui Hau nia laran hirus manas ba rai nee ho raan, hodi hakotu ema no animál,
verses.20: maski Noé, Daniel, no Job mak iha rai nee, tebes hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, sira sei la salva oan mane ka oan feto. Maibee sira salva deit sira nia moris rasik liu hosi sira nia hahalok loos.
verses.21: “Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Oinsaa liu tan bainhira Hau haruka ba Jerusalém dezastre haat nebee Hau halo tanba julgamentu – surik, rai hamlaha, animál fuik no moras peste, hodi halakon ema no animál hosi rai nee!
verses.22: Maibee tebes, Hau sei husik moris ema balu iha nebaa, oan mane no oan feto sira nebee ema sei lori sai. Tebes, bainhira sira sai mai ba imi, no imi haree sira nia hahalok no buat nebee sira halo, imi se hetan laran kamaan kona ba dezastre nebee Hau lori ba Jerusalém, kona ba buat hotu nebee Hau lori ba fatin nee.
verses.23: Sira sei foo laran kamaan ba imi bainhira imi haree sira nia hahalok aat no buat nebee sira halo. Depois imi sei hatene katak Hau la halo buat hotu nebee Hau halo ona nee ho razaun la iha, hatete Nai Maromak.”

verses.1: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, oinsaa ai hosi uvas huun diak liu ai seluk? Oinsaa uvas sanak diak liu ai horis sira iha ai laran?
verses.3: Ita bele foti ai hosi uvas huun hodi halo buat ida ka? Ema bele uza ai uvas nudar pregu hodi tara sasaan ka?
verses.4: Tebes, ai uvas nee tama ahi hodi sunu. Bainhira ahi haan motuk ninia rohan rua, no ninia klaran, ema bele uza ai nee hodi halo buat ida ka?
verses.5: Tebes, bainhira ai nee tomak, ema la bele uza nia. Nunee liu tan bainhira ahi haan motuk nia no ninia klaran, ema la bele uza nia hodi halo buat ida!
verses.6: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Hanesan ai uvas iha ai horis nia leet nebee iha ai laran, nebee Hau foo ba ahi hodi sunu, nunee Hau husik tiha ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém.
verses.7: No Hau sei fila Hau nia oin hodi kontra hasoru sira. Maski sira halai sai hosi ahi, ahi nee sei haan sira. No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau fila Hau nia oin hodi kontra hasoru sira.
verses.8: No Hau sei halo rai sai mamuk, tanba sira la hatudu laran metin, hatete Nai Maromak.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai fali hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, foo hatene ba Jerusalém kona ba ninia hahalok foer.
verses.3: No dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee ba Jerusalém: O nia huun no o nia moris fatin mak iha rai Kanaan. O nia aman mak ema Amoreu no o nia inan mak ema Hiti.
verses.4: No kona ba tempu nebee o moris, iha loron nebee o moris mai, sira la tesi o nia husar tali, no sira la fasi o ho bee ka hamoos o, ka kose o ho masin, ka falun o ho hena.
verses.5: La iha matan ida nebee hanoin o ka halo buat ida hanesan nee ho laran luak ba o. Maibee sira soe o iha rai luan, tanba sira hakribi o iha loron nebee o moris mai.
verses.6: “No bainhira Hau lao liu o no Hau haree o tebe aan hela iha o nia raan, Hau dehan ba o nebee iha o nia raan hela, ‘Viva!’ Hau dehan ba o nebee iha o nia raan hela, ‘Viva!’
verses.7: Hau halo o sai buras hanesan ai horis iha rai luan. No o sai boot no aas no o hetan buat furak. O nia susun moris mai, no o nia fuuk sai naruk. Maibee o sei molik no isin luan hela.
verses.8: “Bainhira Hau lao liu fali o no Hau haree o, tebes, o too ona idade namora nian. Hau falun o ho Hau nia manta ninin hodi taka o nia isin luan. Hau halo Hau nia juramentu ba o no tama aliansa ho o, hatete Nai Maromak, no o sai Hau nian.
verses.9: Depois Hau fasi o ho bee, no Hau hamoos raan hosi o no kose mina ba o.
verses.10: Hau foo hatais o ho hena nebee borda ona no hau foo sapatu kulit diak. Hau falun o ho hena linhu diak no taka o ho ropa karun.
verses.11: No Hau foo hatais o ho sasaan furak no tau kelu iha o nia liman no korenti iha o nia kakorok.
verses.12: Hau tau brinkus iha o nia inus no iha o nia tilun no koroa furak iha o nia ulun.
verses.13: Nunee o simu tiha osan mean no osan mutin, no o nia ropa nee halo hosi hena linhu diak no hena karun no hena nebee borda. O haan trigu diak, bani been no mina. O sai bonita loos no o sai nudar liurai feto.
verses.14: O hetan konhesidu iha nasaun sira nia leet tanba o mak bonita nebee kompletu ho buat furak nebee Hau foo ba o, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.15: “Maibee o fiar ba o nia isin bonita no o sai feto luroon tanba o nia konhesidu. O fui sai sala aat ba ema naran deit nebee lao liu. O nia isin bonita sai sira nian.
verses.16: O foti o nia ropa balu no foo hatais fatin aas ho kór oi-oin. O halo sala aat iha nebaa nebee ema nunka halo iha tempu uluk no ema sei la halo iha tempu tuir mai.
verses.17: O foti mos o nia fatuk murak nebee furak ho Hau nia osan mean no Hau nia osan mutin, no o halo estátua mane nian no o halo sala aat ho sira.
verses.18: No o foti ropa nebee ema borda ona no o taka estátua sira nee, no tau Hau nia mina no Hau nia insensu iha sira nia oin.
verses.19: No mos Hau nia paun nebee Hau foo ba o - tanba Hau foo haan ba o ho trigu diak, mina no bani been - o tau hahaan nee iha sira nia oin nudar buat morin. O halo ona nunee duni, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.20: O foti o nia oan mane sira no o nia oan feto sira, nebee o hetan ba Hau, no o oho sira nudar sakrifísiu hodi haan. O nia sala aat nee asuntu kiik
verses.21: katak o oho Hau nia oan sira no oferese oan sira nee nudar sakrifísiu nebee sunu ho ahi ba estátua sira nee ka?
verses.22: No iha o nia hahalok foer hotu no sala aat sira nee o la hanoin o nia tempu joven, bainhira o molik no isin luan, no tebe aan iha o nia raan.
verses.23: “Liu tiha o nia hahalok aat hotu (susar, susar ba o! hatete Nai Maromak),
verses.24: O harii ona tenda aas ba o nia aan no o halo fatin aas iha dalan boot hotu.
verses.25: Iha kruzamentu hotu o halo o nia fatin aas no halo o nia isin bonita sai foer tebes. Tanba o oferese aan ba ema naran deit nebee lao liu no o habarak o nia sala aat.
verses.26: No mos o halo sala aat ho ema Ejitu sira, o nia vizinhu nebee kaan buat aat, no o habarak o nia sala aat hodi provoka Hau sai hirus.
verses.27: Nunee tebes, Hau lolo tiha ona Hau nia liman hasoru o no hatuun buat nebee o hetan baibain. Hau entrega o ba sira nebee odi o, ba oan feto sira hosi ema Filisteu sira nebee moe tanba o nia hahalok aat.
verses.28: O halo mos sala aat ho ema Asíria sira tanba o seidauk kontenti. Sin, o halo sala aat ho sira no o sei la kontenti.
verses.29: No mos, o habarak o nia sala aat iha fatin negósiu iha rai Kaldeia. No ho hahalok nee mos o la kontenti.
verses.30: “Oinsaa o nia fuan laran moras liu, hatete Nai Maromak, tanba o halo tiha ona buat hotu nee, nebee hahalok hosi feto luroon nebee la moe.
verses.31: O harii ona o nia tenda iha kruzamentu hotu, no o halo o nia fatin aas iha dalan boot hotu. Maibee o la hanesan feto luroon tanba o lakohi simu osan.
verses.32: O mak feen nebee halo sala seksuál, nebee simu estranjeiru sira troka o nia laen!
verses.33: Baibain mane foo prezenti ba feto luroon hotu. Maibee o foo ona o nia prezenti ba o nia doben sira hotu. O selu sira ho o nia sala aat hodi sira mai ba o hosi sor-sorin.
verses.34: Nunee o la hanesan ho feto sira seluk ho o nia sala aat. La iha ema ida nebee duni o hodi halo sala aat. O mak selu ema, no ema la selu o. Nunee o la hanesan ho sira.
verses.35: “Nunee, Oh feto luroon, rona liafuan hosi Nai:
verses.36: Nai Maromak hatete nunee, Tanba o fui sai o nia laran kaan no hatudu o nia isin molik liu hosi sala aat ho o nia doben sira, no ho o nia ai riin lulik nebee foer tebes, no tanba o nia oan sira nia raan nebee o oferese ba sira,
verses.37: nunee tebes, Hau sei halibur o nia doben sira hotu nebee o hetan tempu kontenti, ema hotu nebee o hadomi no ema hotu nebee o odi. Hau sei halibur sira hodi hasoru o hosi sor-sorin. Hau sei hatudu o nia isin molik ba sira hodi sira bele haree o nia isin molik tomak.
verses.38: No Hau sei tesi lia ba o nudar feto nebee halo sala seksuál no fakar raan. No Hau sei selu o ho raan hosi laran hirus no laran moras.
verses.39: No Hau sei entrega o ba sira nia liman, no sira sei soe tuun o nia tenda no baku tuun o nia fatin aas. Sira sei kolu o nia ropa no o nia fatuk murak nebee furak no sira sei husik o ho isin molik no isin luan.
verses.40: Sira sei lori sae ema lubun ida hodi hasoru o, no sira sei tuda mate o no tesi o ba pedasuk sira ho sira nia surik.
verses.41: No sira sei sunu o nia uma sira no halao julgamentu ba o iha feto barak nia oin. Hau sei hapara o hodi o la sai tan hanesan feto luroon, no o sei la selu tan ema.
verses.42: Nunee Hau sei halao too kompletu Hau nia laran hirus ba o, no Hau nia laran moras sei sai hosi o. Hau sei sai kalma no Hau sei la sai hirus tan.
verses.43: Tanba o la hanoin hetan o nia tempu joven. Maibee o halo Hau sai hirus tebes ona ho hahalok hotu nee. Nunee tebes, Hau selu fali o nia hahalok ba o nia ulun, hatete Nai Maromak. Laos o halo sala aat nee nebee o hatutan ba o nia hahalok foer hotu?
verses.44: “Tebes, ema hotu nebee uza provérbiu sira sei uza provérbiu nee kona ba o: ‘Hanesan inan, hanesan oan feto.’
verses.45: O mak oan feto hosi o nia inan, nebee hakribi ninia laen no ninia oan sira. No o mak hanesan o nia feton sira, nebee odi sira nia laen sira no sira nia oan sira. O nia inan mak ema Hiti no o nia aman mak ema Amoreu.
verses.46: No o nia biin mak Samaria, nebee hela ho ninia oan feto sira iha o nia parte norte. No o nia alin feto nebee hela iha o nia parte súl mak Sodoma ho ninia oan feto sira.
verses.47: O la lao tuir sira nia hahalok deit no o la halo tuir sira nia hahalok foer deit, maibee liu tiha tempu uitoan deit o sai aat liu sira ho o nia hahalok hotu.
verses.48: Tebes hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, o nia alin feto Sodoma no ninia oan feto sira la halo hanesan o no o nia oan feto sira mak halo ona.
verses.49: Tebes, hahalok nee mak o nia alin feto Sodoma nia sala: nia no ninia oan feto sira foti aan no sira iha hahaan resin no hela riku no hakmatek, maibee sira la ajuda ema kiak ka ema mukit.
verses.50: Sira foti aan no halo sala foer iha Hau nia oin. Entaun Hau halakon ona sira bainhira Hau haree hahalok nee.
verses.51: Samaria la halo sala too o nia sala sorin nee. O mak halao hahalok foer barak liu buat nebee sira halo. No o halo hodi o nia feton sira iha oin hanesan hahalok loos kompara ho hahalok foer hotu nebee o halao ona.
verses.52: No o mos, simu lai o nia moe tanba o mak defende o no feton sira. Tanba o nia sala sira nebee o halao ho hahalok foer liu duké sira, nunee sira mak loos liu o. Entaun sai moe ba, o mos, no simu o nia moe, tanba o halo o nia feto iha oin moris loos.
verses.53: “Hau sei halo diak fali sira nia moris, inklui ema Sodoma no ninia oan feto sira, no ema Samaria no ninia oan feto sira nian. No Hau sei halo diak fali o nia ema dadur nia moris.
verses.54: Nunee o sei simu o nia moe no o sei sai moe kona ba buat hotu nebee o halo tiha ona, no o sei konsola sira.
verses.55: Kona ba o nia feton sira nee, Sodoma no ninia oan feto sira sei fila fali ba sira nia fatin uluk nian. No Samaria no ninia oan feto sira sei fila fali ba sira nia fatin uluk nian. No o no o nia oan feto sira sei fila fali ba o nia fatin uluk nian.
verses.56: Laos o nia alin feto Sodoma mak liafuan aat iha o nia ibun iha tempu nebee o foti aan
verses.57: molok ema hatene o nia hahalok aat? Agora o sai buat foer ba oan feto sira hosi Síria no ema hotu nebee iha ninia sor-sorin. No mos oan feto sira hosi ema Filisteu sira, sira nebee iha o nia sor-sorin hakribi o.
verses.58: O simu kastigu tanba o nia hahalok isin molik nian no o nia hahlok foer, hatete Nai.
verses.59: “Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Hau sei halo ba o tuir buat nebee o halo ona, ba o nebee hakribi juramentu tanba o hakotu aliansa nee.
verses.60: Maibee Hau sei hanoin hetan Hau nia aliansa ho o iha o nia tempu joven. No Hau sei estabelese aliansa rohan laek ho o.
verses.61: Depois imi sei hanoin hetan o nia hahalok no sai moe bainhira o simu o nia feton sira, inklui o nia biin no o nia alin feto sira. Hau sei foo sira nudar o nia oan feto sira maibee laos tanba aliansa nee ho o.
verses.62: Hau sei estabelese Hau nia aliansa ho o, no o sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.63: Nunee o bele hanoin hetan no sai hakfodak. No o sei nunka loke fali o nia ibun tanba o nia moe, bainhira Hau taka o nia sala hotu kona ba buat hotu nebee o halo ona, hatete Nai Maromak.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, foo sai ai sasiik ida, no konta provérbiu ida ba uma kain Israel;
verses.3: dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Iha makikit boot ida ho liras boot no liman naruk, nebee iha fulun furak ho kór oi-oin. Nia mai Lebanón no foti ai teka nia tutun.
verses.4: Nia silu sai ai nia dikin iha leten liu no lori ba rai negósiu no tau iha sidade faan nain nian.
verses.5: Depois nia foti fini hosi rai nee no kuda iha rai buras. Nia kuda ai horis nee besik bee boot. Nia kuda ai nee hanesan ai sanak kiik ida,
verses.6: no ai nee dikin no sai ai tali nebee nani besik rai. Ai tali nee fila ninia sanak sira ba makikit no ninia abut hela metin iha ninia fatin. Nunee nia sai ai tali ida nebee iha sanak sira nebee nani ba.
verses.7: “No iha makikit boot seluk nebee iha liras boot no fulun barak, no tebes, ai tali nee see ninia abut sira ba nia no ai tali nia sanak sira dikin ba nia hosi fatin nebee ai tali hela hodi makikit nee bele foo bee ba ai tali.
verses.8: Ai tali kuda ona iha rai buras besik bee barak hodi nia bele kuda sanak sira no foo fuan no sai ai tali boot.
verses.9: “Dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Ai tali nee sei sai buras ka? Laos makikit uluk sei fokit sai ai tali nia abut, hodi nia namlaik no hodi ninia tahan nurak nee namlaik? Nee la presiza liman foti ka ema barak hodi fokit sai ninia abut sira.
verses.10: Tebes, nia kuda ona maibee nia sei sai buras ka? Laos nia sei namlaik tebes bainhira anin lorosae kona nia - no nia sei namlaik iha fatin nebee nia dikin mai?”
verses.11: Depois Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.12: “Agora, dehan ba uma kain kontradór nee, Imi la hatene liafuan nee nia signifikadu ka? Tebes, dehan ba sira, liurai hosi Babilónia mai Jerusalém, no foti Jerusalém nia liurai no ninia xefi sira no lori sira ba liurai iha Babilónia.
verses.13: No liurai hosi Babilónia foti liurai nia oan ida no halo aliansa ho nia. Liurai hosi Babilónia halo nia jura (tanba nia lori sai tiha xefi sira)
verses.14: katak reinu nee sei haraik aan no la foti aan, no halo tuir ninia aliansa hodi liafuan nee bele metin.
verses.15: Maibee liurai nia oan nee kontra hasoru liurai hosi Babilónia tanba nia haruka ninia embaixadór sira ba Ejitu hodi husu sira bele foo kuda no militár boot. Nunee nia sei sai buras ka? Ema ida nebee halo hanesan nee bele halai livre ka? Nia bele hakotu aliansa no halai livre ka?
verses.16: “Hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, tebes iha fatin nebee liurai hosi Babilónia hela nebee halo nia sai liurai, iha rai Babilónia nia sei mate. Tanba nia despreza liurai Babilónia nia juramentu, no hakotu liurai nee nia aliansa.
verses.17: Faráo ho ninia militár boot no kompanhia boot sei la ajuda nia iha funu laran bainhira inimigu halo rai bou sae ba sidade nee no harii uma aas funu nian no oho ema barak.
verses.18: Tanba nia despreza juramentu no nia hakotu aliansa. Tebes, nia foo nia liman hodi halo buat hotu nee. Nunee nia sei la halai livre.
verses.19: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Hanesan Hau moris hela, tebes nee mak Hau nia juramentu nebee nia despreza ona, no Hau nia aliansa nebee nia hakotu ona. Hau sei selu ida nee ba ninia ulun.
verses.20: Hau sei soe Hau nia redi ba nia, no nia sei tama kastigu iha Hau nia lasu. Hau sei lori nia ba Babilónia no tesi lia ba nia tanba ninia hahalok nebee nia bosok Hau.
verses.21: No soldadu diak hotu hosi ninia tropas sira sei monu liu hosi surik, no ema restu sei namkari ba anin hotu, no imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai; nunee Hau koalia tiha ona.”
verses.22: Nai Maromak hatete nunee: “Hau rasik sei foti dikin ida hosi ai teka nia tutun aas nee. No Hau sei rai ai dikin nee. Hau sei silu dikin nurak hosi ninia sanak foun iha leten liu. Hau rasik sei kuda nia iha foho aas liu nia leten.
verses.23: Hau sei kuda nia iha foho aas iha Israel hodi nia bele kuda ninia sanak sira no foo fuan no sai ai teka boot. Manu oi-oin sei hela iha ai horis nee nia okos. No manu oi-oin sei halo ninia knuuk iha ai horis nee nia sanak sira.
verses.24: No ai horis hotu iha rai luan sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai. Hau sei hatuun ai horis nebee aas, no Hau sei hasae ai horis nebee tuun. Hau sei hamaran ai matak, no halo ai maran sai buras. Hau mak Nai; Hau koalia tiha ona, no Hau sei halo tuir liafuan nee.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Imi nia liafuan iha sentidu saida bainhira imi repete provérbiu ida nee kona ba rai Israel, ‘Aman sira haan uvas fuan nebee siin, no oan sira nia nehan sai’?
verses.3: Hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, imi sei la uza tan provérbiu ida nee iha Israel.
verses.4: Tebes, klamar hotu mak Hau nian; aman nia klamar hanesan ho oan nia klamar. No klamar ida nebee sala mak mate.
verses.5: “Se ema ida iha moris loos no nia halo buat justu no loos -
verses.6: se nia la haan iha foho ka foti sae ninia matan ba ai riin lulik iha uma kain Israel, no nia la halo sala ho ninia maluk nia feen ka tama ba feto nebee fulan mai,
verses.7: nia la hanehan ema ida, maibee nia foo fali pinoor ba ema nebee rai nudar garantia, nia la naok, no foo ninia paun ba ema hamlaha no taka ema molik ho manta,
verses.8: nia la foo impresta ho funan no la foti lukru ida, nia la tau liman ba buat nebee la justu, nia halao justisa loos entre ema ida no ema seluk,
verses.9: nia lao tuir Hau nia estatutu sira, no halo tuir Hau nia regulamentu sira ho hahalok fiel - nia mak ema moris loos. Nunee tebes nia bele moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.10: “Se nia iha oan mane ida nebee halao violénsia, fakar raan, no halo saida deit hanesan buat sira nee
verses.11: (maski nia rasik la halo buat ida hanesan buat sira nee), no oan nee haan iha foho leten, halo foer ninia maluk nia feen,
verses.12: hanehan ema kiak no mukit, naok sasaan, la foo fali pinoor, foti sae ninia matan ba ai riin lulik sira, halao buat foer tebes,
verses.13: foo impresta hodi hetan funan no foti lukru; nunee nia bele moris hela ka? Nia sei la bele moris hela. Nia halo buat hotu nee nebee foer tebes. Nunee tebes nia sei mate, no ninia raan nee lakon tanba nia rasik.
verses.14: “Tebes, se ema nee iha oan mane fali nebee haree ninia aman nia sala hotu nebee aman nee halao; nia haree no nia la halo hanesan:
verses.15: nia la haan iha foho leten ka foti sae ninia matan ba ai riin lulik hosi uma kain Israel, la halo foer ninia maluk nia feen,
verses.16: la hanehan ema ida, la kaer metin pinoor, la naok, maibee foo ninia paun ba ema hamlaha no taka ema molik ho manta ida,
verses.17: no nia la tau ninia liman ba hahalok aat, nia la foti osan funan ka lukru, nia halo tuir Hau nia regulamentu sira, no lao tuir Hau nia estatutu sira; nia sei la mate tanba ninia aman nia hahalok aat; tebes, nia bele moris hela.
verses.18: Maibee kona ba ninia aman nee, tanba nia hanehan ema hodi manaan, naok hosi ninia maluk, no halo buat nebee la diak iha ninia povu nia leet, tebes, nia sei mate tanba ninia hahalok aat.
verses.19: “Maibee imi dehan, ‘Tanba saa mak oan mane la simu todan tanba ninia aman nia hahalok aat?’ Bainhira oan mane nee halo buat nebee justu no loos, no nia kuidadu atu halo tuir Hau nia estatutu hotu, tebes nia bele moris hela.
verses.20: Klamar ida nebee sala mak mate. Oan mane sei la simu todan tanba ninia aman nia hahalok aat. No aman sei la simu todan tanba ninia oan mane nia hahalok aat. Moris loos hosi ema moris loos mak hela ho nia rasik, no hahalok aat hosi ema aat mak hela ho nia rasik.
verses.21: “Maibee se ema aat fila hosi ninia sala sira nebee nia halao no nia halo tuir Hau nia estatutu hotu no nia halo buat nebee justu no loos, tebes nia bele moris hela; nia sei la mate.
verses.22: Hau sei la hanoin hetan ninia sala aat nebee nia halo tiha ona hodi hasoru nia. Nia bele moris hela tanba ninia hahalok loos nebee nia halo ona nee.
verses.23: Hau sei sai kontenti tanba ema aat mak mate ka? hatete Nai Maromak. Diak liu nia fila hosi ninia hahalok no nia bele moris hela.
verses.24: Maibee bainhira ema moris loos fila hosi ninia moris loos no halo buat nebee la justu no halo buat foer tebes nebee ema aat mak halo, nia bele moris hela ka? Hau sei la hanoin hetan buat loos ida nebee nia halo tiha ona. Nia sei mate tanba ninia hahalok bosok nebee nia halo no ninia sala nebee nia halo.
verses.25: “Maibee imi dehan, ‘Nai nia dalan la justu.’ Rona lai, Oh uma kain Israel: Hau nia dalan la justu ka? Laos imi nia dalan la justu?
verses.26: Bainhira ema moris loos fila hosi ninia moris loos no halo buat nebee la justu, nia sei mate tanba buat nee. Tanba buat nebee la justu nebee nia halo nunee nia sei mate.
verses.27: No mos, bainhira ema aat fila hosi ninia hahalok aat nebee nia halo tiha ona no nia halo buat nebee justu no loos, nia sei salva ninia moris.
verses.28: Tanba nia hanoin fali no nia fila hosi sala aat hotu nebee nia halo tiha ona, no tebes, nia bele moris hela; nia sei la mate.
verses.29: Maibee uma kain Israel dehan, ‘Nai nia dalan la justu.’ Oh uma kain Israel, Hau nia dalan sira la justu ka? Laos imi nia dalan sira la justu?
verses.30: “Nunee Hau sei tesi lia ba imi, Oh uma kain Israel, ema ida-idak tuir ninia hahalok, hatete Nai Maromak. Arepende no fila hosi imi nia sala aat hotu, keta halo be hahalok aat sai fatuk nebee imi sidi no monu.
verses.31: Soe tiha hosi imi sala aat hotu nebee imi halo tiha, no halo fuan laran foun no espíritu foun ba imi nia aan! Tanba saa mak imi sei mate, Oh uma kain Israel?
verses.32: Tanba Hau la sai kontenti bainhira ema ida mate, hatete Nai Maromak; nunee fila lai, no moris ba.”

19.title: Lamentasaun Ba Xefi Sira Hosi Israel

verses.1: No o, foo sai lamentasaun kona ba xefi sira hosi Israel,
verses.2: no dehan:
verses.3: No nia hakiak oan ida nebee ninian;
verses.4: Nasaun sira rona kona ba nia;
verses.5: Bainhira inan haree katak nia hein saugati deit,
verses.6: Nia lao ba-mai iha liaun sira nia leet;
verses.7: no hadau sira nia feto faluk sira.
verses.8: Depois nasaun sira mai hasoru nia
verses.9: Sira uza kait sira hodi tau nia iha fatin kastigu nian,
verses.10: O nia inan mak hanesan ai uvas iha toos uvas
verses.11: Ninia kain forti nee
verses.12: Maibee sira fokit sai ai uvas nee ho laran hirus manas,
verses.13: Agora sira kuda nia iha rai fuik,
verses.14: No ahi mak sai hosi ninia sanak sira,

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala hitu, iha fulan ba dala lima, iha loron ba dala sanulu iha fulan nee, katuas balu hosi Israel mai hodi husu hosi Nai. Sira tuur iha hau nia oin.
verses.2: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.3: “Ema nia oan, koalia ba katuas sira hosi Israel, no dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee, Imi mai hodi husu Hau ka? Hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, Hau sei la husik imi atu husu mai Hau.
verses.4: O sei tesi lia ba sira ka? Ema nia oan, o sei tesi lia ba sira ka? Husik sira hatene sira nia bei-ala sira nia hahalok foer.
verses.5: No dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Iha loron nebee Hau hili Israel, Hau jura ba bei-oan hosi uma kain Jacó nian, no iha rai Ejitu, Hau halo hodi sira bele konhese Hau. Hau jura ba sira no dehan, Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak.
verses.6: Iha loron nebee Hau jura ba sira katak Hau sei lori sira sai hosi rai Ejitu no tama ba rai nebee Hau buka hodi hetan ba sira, rai nebee suli ho susu been no bani been, rai nebee furak liu rai hotu.
verses.7: No Hau dehan ba sira, ‘Ema ida-idak tenki soe tiha buat sira nebee foer iha imi nia oin. La bele halo imi nia aan foer ho ai riin lulik sira hosi Ejitu; Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak.’
verses.8: Maibee sira kontra hasoru Hau no sira lakohi rona tuir Hau. La iha ema ida hosi sira nebee soe buat sira nebee foer hosi sira nia oin. Sira la husik ai riin lulik hosi Ejitu. “Depois Hau dehan katak Hau sei fui sai Hau nia laran hirus manas ba sira no gasta Hau nia laran hirus hodi hasoru sira iha rai Ejitu.
verses.9: Maibee Hau defende Hau nia naran, hodi ema la koalia aat kona ba Hau nia naran iha nasaun sira nia oin. Tanba ema Israel sira hela iha nasaun sira nia leet. No Hau hatudu aan iha nasaun sira nia oin bainhira Hau lori sai ema Israel sira hosi rai Ejitu.
verses.10: Nunee Hau lori sira sai hosi rai Ejitu no lori sira ba rai fuik.
verses.11: Hau foo Hau nia estatutu ba ema Israel sira. Hau foo hatene ba sira kona ba Hau nia regulamentu nebee, sei ema ida halo tuir buat sira nee, nia bele moris.
verses.12: No mos, Hau foo ba sira Hau nia loron Sabdu nudar sinál entre Hau no sira. Hodi nunee sira bele hatene katak Hau mak Nai nebee konsagra sira.
verses.13: Maibee uma kain Israel kontra hasoru Hau iha rai fuik. Sira la lao tuir Hau nia estatutu maibee rejeita Hau nia regulamentu, nebee, sei ema ida halo tuir regulamentu sira nee nia bele moris. No sira halo foer tebes Hau nia loron Sabdu sira nee. “Depois Hau dehan, Hau sei fui sai Hau nia laran hirus ba sira iha rai fuik, hodi halakon sira hotu.
verses.14: Maibee Hau halo hodi defende Hau nia naran, hodi ema la koalia aat kona ba Hau nia naran iha nasaun sira nia oin. Tanba Hau lori sira sai iha nasaun sira nia oin.
verses.15: No mos, Hau jura ba sira iha rai fuik katak Hau sei la lori sira tama ba rai nebee Hau foo ba sira, rai ida nebee suli ho susu been no bani been, rai ida nebee furak liu rai sira seluk.
verses.16: Tanba sira rejeita Hau nia regulamentu no la lao tuir Hau nia estatutu, no hafoer Hau nia loron Sabdu sira nee. Tanba sira nia fuan laran duni tuir sira nia ai riin lulik sira.
verses.17: Maski nunee, Hau nia matan husik hela sira hodi la destrui sira ka halakon sira hotu iha rai fuik.
verses.18: “No Hau dehan ba sira nia oan sira iha rai fuik, ‘La bele lao tuir estatutu hosi imi nia bei-ala sira, la bele halo tuir sira nia regulamentu, ka hafoer imi nia aan ho sira nia ai riin lulik sira.
verses.19: Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak; lao tuir Hau nia estatutu, no kuidadu atu halo tuir Hau nia regulamentu,
verses.20: no halo santu Hau nia loron Sabdu hodi loron sira nee bele sai sinál ida entre Hau no imi. Nunee imi bele hatene katak Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak.’
verses.21: Maibee bei-oan sira nee kontra hasoru Hau. Sira la lao tuir Hau nia estatutu no sira la kuidadu atu halo tuir Hau nia regulamentu. Tanba se ema ida halo tuir regulamentu sira nee, nia bele moris hela. Maibee sira hafoer Hau nia loron Sabdu sira nee. “Depois Hau dehan, Hau sei fui sai Hau nia laran hirus manas ba sira no haruka Hau nia laran hirus hasoru sira iha rai fuik.
verses.22: Maibee Hau la husik Hau nia liman hodi halo hanesan nee no Hau halo hodi defende Hau nia naran, hodi sira la bele hafoer Hau nia naran iha nasaun sira nia oin. Tanba Hau lori sira sai iha nasaun sira nia oin.
verses.23: No mos, Hau jura ona ba sira iha rai fuik katak Hau sei namkari sira iha nasaun sira nia leet no fahe sira ba rai sira seluk.
verses.24: Tanba sira la halo tuir Hau nia regulamentu, maibee rejeita ona Hau nia estatutu no hafoer Hau nia loron Sabdu sira nee. No sira haree deit ba sira nia bei-ala sira nia ai riin lulik sira.
verses.25: No mos, Hau foo estatutu ba ema sira nee nebee la diak no regulamentu nebee la foo moris ba sira.
verses.26: Hau hafoer sira liu hosi sira nia oferta, nebee sira oferese sira nia oan primeiru hotu. Nunee Hau bele estraga sira. Hau halo hanesan nee hodi sira bele hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.27: “Nunee, ema nia oan, koalia ba uma kain Israel no dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Liu hosi nee mos imi nia bei-ala sira koalia aat kona ba Hau, no sira la hatudu laran metin ba Hau.
verses.28: Tanba bainhira Hau lori sira tama ba rai nebee Hau jura ona atu ba foo sira, depois bainhira sira haree foho aas ida ka ai huun boot ida, sira oferese sira nia sakrifísiu iha nebaa no sira foo oferta nebee provoka Hau. Sira haruka sae sira nia suar morin no fui sai sira nia oferta hemu nian iha nebaa.
verses.29: (Hau dehan ba sira, ‘Saida mak fatin aas nebee imi baa nee?’ Entaun fatin nee nia naran mak Bama too ohin loron.)
verses.30: “Nunee dehan ba uma kain Israel, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Imi sei hafoer aan tuir imi nia bei-ala sira nia maneira ka? No imi sei halo sala aat nebee tuir buat sira nebee aat tebes ka?
verses.31: Bainhira imi oferese imi nia prezenti no oferese sae imi nia oan sira iha ahi, imi hafoer aan ho imi nia ai riin lulik sira hotu too ohin loron. No imi bele husu hatene hosi Hau ka, Oh uma kain Israel? Hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, imi sei la bele husu hatene hosi Hau.
verses.32: “Buat nebee iha imi nia hanoin sei la akontese, katak imi hanoin, ‘Mai ita sai hanesan nasaun sira seluk, no hanesan uma kain sira iha rai seluk, nebee serví ai no fatuk.’
verses.33: “Hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, tebes ho liman forsa no liman nebee Hau lolo ba no ho laran hirus manas nebee fui sai, Hau sei sai liurai nebee ukun imi.
verses.34: Hau sei lori imi sai hosi povu sira seluk no halibur imi hosi rai nebee imi namkari ba ona. No Hau sei halo hanesan nee ho liman forsa no liman nebee Hau lolo ba no ho laran hirus manas nebee fui sai.
verses.35: No Hau sei lori imi tama ba povu nia rai fuik. Iha nebaa Hau sei tesi lia ba imi, oin ho oin.
verses.36: Hanesan Hau tesi lia ona ba imi nia bei-ala sira iha rai fuik nebee iha rai Ejitu, nunee Hau sei tesi lia ba imi, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.37: Hau sei halo imi lao liu hosi ai tonka okos, no Hau sei kesi imi ba aliansa.
verses.38: Hau sei hasai ema sira nebee kontra Hau hosi imi nia leet, no sira nebee halo sala nebee kontra hasoru Hau. Hau sei lori sira sai ba rai nebee sira halo viajen, maibee sira sei la tama ba rai Israel. Depois imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.39: “Kona ba imi, Oh uma kain Israel, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Baa deit no ema ida-idak baa no serví ninia ai riin lulik sira, agora no iha tempu tuir mai, se imi lakohi rona tuir Hau. Maibee la bele halo foer Hau nia naran santu ho imi nia oferta sira no imi nia ai riin lulik sira.
verses.40: “Tanba iha Hau nia Foho Santu, nebee foho aas iha Israel, hatete Nai Maromak, iha nebaa uma kain tomak iha Israel, ema hotu nee, sei serví Hau iha rai nebaa. Iha nebaa Hau sei simu sira, no iha nebaa Hau sei husu imi nia oferta no imi nia prezenti nebee diak liu, ho buat santu hotu nebee imi oferese.
verses.41: Hau sei simu imi nudar morin diak. Hau sei lori imi sai hosi povu nee no halibur imi hosi nasaun sira nebee imi namkari ona. No Hau sei hatudu Hau nia santidade iha imi nia leet nebee iha nasaun sira nia oin.
verses.42: No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau lori imi tama ba rai Israel, rai nebee Hau jura ona atu foo ba imi nia bei-ala sira.
verses.43: No iha nebaa imi sei hanoin imi nia hahalok no buat hotu nebee imi halo ona. Imi sei hanoin oinsaa imi hafoer aan. No imi sei hakribi aan tanba buat aat hotu nebee imi halo ona.
verses.44: No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau halo buat ruma ba imi tuir Hau nia naran, no laos tuir ba imi nia hahalok aat, no laos tuir buat aat tebes nebee imi halo ona, Oh uma kain Israel, hatete Nai Maromak.”
verses.45: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.46: “Ema nia oan, fila o nia oin hodi hateke ba rai iha parte súl. Haklaken ba ho liafuan nebee hasoru parte súl, no foo profesia hasoru ai laran iha rai Negeb.
verses.47: Dehan ba ai laran iha rai Negeb, Rona lai Nai nia liafuan: Nai Maromak hatete nunee, Tebes, Hau sei halakan ahi iha imi, no ahi nee sei haan ai matak hotu no ai maran hotu. Ema la bele hamate ahi boot nee. No ahi nee sei kona ema hotu nia oin hosi parte súl ba parte norte.
verses.48: Ema hotu sei haree katak Hau, Nai, mak halakan ahi nee. No ema sei la hamate ahi nee.”
verses.49: Depois hau dehan, “Aii, Nai Maromak! Sira koalia hela kona ba hau, ‘Laos nia konta provérbiu deit?’”

21.title: Nai Mak Losu Ona Ninia Surik

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, fila o nia oin hodi hateke ba Jerusalém no haklaken hasoru fatin santu sira. Foo sai profesia hasoru rai Israel
verses.3: no dehan ba rai Israel, Nai hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau kontra hasoru imi no Hau sei losu Hau nia surik hosi ninia fatin. Hau sei halakon ema moris loos no ema aat hosi imi.
verses.4: Tanba Hau sei halakon ema moris loos no ema aat hosi imi, nunee mak Hau losu Hau nia surik hosi ninia fatin no hasoru ema hotu hosi parte súl ba parte norte.
verses.5: No ema hotu sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai. Hau losu ona Hau nia surik hosi ninia fatin. No Hau sei la hatama fali surik nee.
verses.6: “Kona ba o, ema nia oan, tanis ba. Tanis iha sira nia oin ho fuan laran nebee tohar no laran susar.
verses.7: No bainhira sira dehan ba o, ‘Tanba saa mak o tanis?’ imi sei dehan, ‘Tanba liafuan nebee sei mai. Fuan laran hotu sei nabeen, no liman hotu sei sai mamar. Espíritu hotu sei sai fraku. Ain tuur hotu sei sai fraku hanesan bee. Tebes, buat nee sei mai no buat nee sei kumpri,’” hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.8: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.9: “Ema nia oan, foo sai profesia no dehan, Nai hatete nunee, no dehan:
verses.10: sira kadi hodi oho makaas,
verses.11: Entaun sira sei kose surik nee, hodi liman ida bele kaer nia. Sira kadi no kose nabilan hodi foo ba ema nia liman nebee foo kastigu mate.
verses.12: Hakilar no tanis ba, ema nia oan, tanba buat ida nee sei hasoru Hau nia povu. Buat ida nee sei hasoru Hau nia xefi hotu iha Israel. Sira mos hasoru surik nee ho Hau nia povu. Nunee basa o nia kelen.
verses.13: Buat ida nee sei koko imi. Tanba oinsaa, se imi hakribi ona ai tonka?” hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.14: “Kona ba o, ema nia oan, profesia ba. Basa o nia liman no husik surik monu dala rua, sin, ba dala tolu, surik ba sira nebee atu mate. Nee mak surik ba tempu nebee ema barak mate, nebee haleu sira.
verses.15: Nunee sira nia fuan laran sei nabeen, no ema barak sei sidi no monu. Iha portaun hotu Hau haruka ona surik nabilan. Aii, surik nee mak hanesan rai lakan, no sira kaer surik nee hodi oho.
verses.16: Taa ba liman loos, fila ba liman karuk, iha fatin nebee deit imi haree.
verses.17: Hau mos sei basa Hau nia liman, no Hau sei halao Hau nia laran hirus manas too hirus nee bele deskansa. Hau mak Nai, nebee koalia tiha ona.”
verses.18: Nai nia liafuan mai fali ba hau:
verses.19: “Kona ba o, ema nia oan, marka dalan rua hodi surik hosi liurai Babilónia bele mai. Dalan rua nee sei mai hosi rai ida deit. Halo sinál ida no tau iha kruzamentu atu tama ba dalan nebee baa sidade nee.
verses.20: Marka dalan ida hodi surik bele baa Raba iha ema Amon sira nia rai. No marka ida fali atu baa Judá, hodi tama ba Jerusalém nebee ema halo seguru ona.
verses.21: Tanba liurai hosi Babilónia hamriik iha kruzamentu nee, iha fatin nebee dalan fahe ba rua. Nia hamriik hodi siik futuru: Nia doko rama oan sira, nia husu ba estátua lulik, nia fihir ba aten.
verses.22: Rezultadu siik nian kona ba Jerusalém tama ba ninia liman loos atu tau alat baku moru, no loke ibun atu oho, no hakilar ho lian makaas, no tau alat nebee baku hasoru portaun sira, no halo rai bou sae moru, no halo uma aas funu nian.
verses.23: Maibee sira hanoin nee mak siik falsu nian. Sira jura metin ona, maibee nia hanoin hetan sira nia hahalok aat. Nunee sira sei hadau sidade nee.
verses.24: “Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tanba imi halo Hau hanoin hetan imi nia sala, tanba imi la taka imi nia sala aat sira nee. Nunee Hau bele haree imi nia sala iha buat hotu nebee imi halo. No tanba Hau hanoin hetan ona imi nia sala sira nee, nunee ema sei hadau imi.
verses.25: No o, Oh ukun nain hosi Israel, nebee iha hahalok aat no kanek todan, loron mai ona hodi o simu kastigu ikus nian.
verses.26: Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Hasai tiha hena xapeu nebee bobar ba ulun no foti sai koroa. Buat sira nee sei halao nafatin. Foti sae buat nebee iha kraik, no hatuun buat nebee iha leten.
verses.27: Hau sei halo fatin nee sai aat, aat, aat. Ida nee sei akontese, too nia mai nebee tesi lia. No Hau sei foo ida nee ba nia.
verses.28: “No o, ema nia oan, profesia ba, no dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee kona ba ema Amon sira no kona ba sira nia hahalok aat; dehan, Surik ida, surik ida losu ona hodi oho. Sira kose surik hodi sai nabilan hanesan rai lakan hodi haan.
verses.29: Sira sei mai haree hela o hodi hetan vizaun falsu, no sira siik hela liafuan hodi bosok o. Tau surik nee ba iha ema aat nia kakorok nebee simu ona kanek todan. Sira nia loron mai ona nebee sira nia tempu atu simu kastigu ikus nian.
verses.30: Hatama fali surik nee ba ninia knuuk. Hau sei tesi lia ba o iha fatin nebee ema kria o, iha rai nebee iha o nia knua.
verses.31: No Hau sei fui sai Hau nia laran hirus makaas ba o. Hau sei huu ahi ba o hosi Hau nia laran nakali, no Hau sei entrega o ba ema nebee sunu no matenek atu estraga.
verses.32: O sei sai ai maran ba ahi. O nia raan sei suli iha rai laran. Ema sei la hanoin hetan fali o. Tanba Hau mak Nai, nebee koalia tiha ona.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau, no dehan,
verses.2: “No o, ema nia oan, o sei tesi lia ka, o sei tesi lia ba sidade nebee fakar raan ka? Entaun foo sai ba sira kona ba sira nia hahalok foer hotu.
verses.3: O tenki dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Sidade ida nebee fakar raan iha ninia laran, hodi ninia tempu bele mai, no nia halo ai riin lulik sira hodi hafoer ninia aan rasik!
verses.4: Imi sala ona liu hosi raan nebee imi fakar ona, no imi sai foer ona liu hosi ai riin lulik sira nebee imi halo ona, no imi lori mai besik ona imi nia tempu. Tempu nee kona ba imi nia tinan ikus nebee too ona. Nunee Hau hamoe imi iha nasaun sira nia oin, no Hau halo imi sai liafuan goza ba rai hotu.
verses.5: Sira nebee besik no sira nebee dook sei goza imi; imi nia naran sai foer ona. Imi nakonu ho konfuzaun.
verses.6: “Tebes, xefi Israel ida-idak iha sidade laran nee kontinua fakar raan, tuir ida-idak nia forsa.
verses.7: Imi hatuun inan-aman sira. Imi hamatak ema lao rai iha imi nia leet. Imi halo aat ba oan kiak no feto faluk.
verses.8: Imi despreza ona Hau nia sasaan santu no hafoer Hau nia loron Sabdu sira.
verses.9: Imi iha ema iha imi nia leet nebee tau lia bosok hodi fakar raan, no povu iha imi nia leet nebee haan iha foho leten, no sira halo planu aat iha imi nia leet.
verses.10: Iha imi nia leet mane sira toba ho sira nia aman nia feen. Iha imi nia leet, sira obriga feto sira nebee la moos tanba sira nia fulan mai.
verses.11: Ema ida halo buat foer tebes ho ninia maluk nia feen. Ema seluk halo planu foer ho ninia feto foun. Iha imi nia leet, ida fali obriga ninia alin feto rasik, nebee ninia aman nia oan feto.
verses.12: Iha imi nia leet sira simu prezenti subar hodi fakar raan. Imi foti osan funan no lukru, no imi manaan hosi imi nia maluk tanba imi hamatak sira. Maibee imi haluha tiha Hau, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.13: “Tebes, Hau baku Hau nia liman tanba imi manaan ho hahalok nebee hadau ema seluk nia riku-soin, no tanba raan nebee iha imi nia leet.
verses.14: Imi nia brani sei kontinua ka, ou imi nia liman bele forti hela deit ka, iha loron nebee Hau hasoru imi? Hau mak Nai, nebee koalia tiha ona, no Hau sei halo ida nee.
verses.15: Hau sei namkari imi iha nasaun sira nia leet no fahe imi ba rai sira seluk, no Hau sei halakon imi nia hahalok foer hosi imi.
verses.16: No imi sei simu imi nia kanek todan iha nasaun sira nia oin, no imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”
verses.17: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.18: “Ema nia oan, uma kain Israel sai ona besi teen ba Hau. Sira hotu sai ona riti, kalen, besi no makdadi iha fugaun manas. Sira mak osan mutin nia teen.
verses.19: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tanba imi hotu sai ona buat nebee foer. Nunee tebes, Hau sei halibur imi iha Jerusalém laran.
verses.20: Hanesan ema ida halibur osan mutin, riti, besi, makdadi no kalen iha fugaun manas, no huu ahi hodi halo buat sira nee nabeen, nunee Hau sei halibur imi ho Hau nia laran hirus no ho Hau nia laran hirus manas, no Hau sei hatama imi no halo imi nabeen.
verses.21: Hau sei halibur imi no huu ba imi ho ahi hosi Hau nia laran nakali, no imi sei nabeen iha ahi laran.
verses.22: Hanesan osan mutin nabeen iha fugaun manas, nunee imi sei nabeen iha ahi laran, no imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai; Hau mak fui sai Hau nia laran hirus manas ba imi.”
verses.23: No Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.24: “Ema nia oan, dehan ba nia, O mak rai nebee la moos ka hetan udan iha loron hirus makaas.
verses.25: Sira nia profeta sira futu lia iha sira nia leet hanesan liaun boot nebee lees mate animál nebee nia hetan. Sira haan ona ema sira nia moris. Sira hadau tiha riku-soin no sasaan nebee folin boot. Sira halo feto faluk barak iha sira nia leet.
verses.26: Sira nia saserdote sira halo violénsia ba Hau nia lei no hafoer Hau nia sasaan santu. Sira la haketak buat nebee santu hosi buat nebee baibain. No sira la hanorin oinsaa buat nebee la moos la hanesan buat nebee moos. No sira la tuir Hau nia loron Sabdu sira. Nunee ema haree Hau nudar ida nebee foer iha sira nia leet.
verses.27: Sira nia xefi sira iha sira nia leet mak hanesan asu fuik sira nebee lees animál nebee sira hadau. Sira fakar raan no estraga ema sira nia moris hodi hadau riku-soin.
verses.28: No sira nia profeta sira tau plamir mutin deit ba sira. Profeta sira nee haree vizaun falsu no siik bosok ba sira, no dehan, ‘Nai Maromak hatete nunee,’ bainhira Nai la hatete nunee.
verses.29: Povu iha rai hamatak ema no naok sasaan. Sira hanehan ema kiak no ema mukit. Sira hamatak ema lao rai no justisa la iha.
verses.30: Hau buka ema ida iha sira nia leet hodi harii moru nee no hamriik iha moru nia fatin nebee rahun iha rai nee iha Hau nia oin, hodi Hau la halakon sira. Maibee Hau la hetan ema ida.
verses.31: Nunee Hau fui sai Hau nia laran hirus makaas ba sira. Hau nia ahi hosi Hau nia laran nakali mak haan ona sira. Hau selu fali sira nia hahalok ba sira nia ulun, hatete Nai Maromak.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, iha feto rua, nebee oan feto sira hosi inan ida.
verses.3: Sira sai feto luroon iha Ejitu. Sira sai feto luroon bainhira sira sei joven. Ema book sira nia susun no kaer sira nia susun matan virjen nian.
verses.4: Biin nia naran mak Ohola no ninia alin feto nia naran mak Oholiba. Sira sai Hau nian, no sira hetan oan mane no oan feto sira. Kona ba sira nia naran nee, Ohola mak Samaria, no Oholiba mak Jerusalém.
verses.5: “Ohola sai feto luroon bainhira nia sei Hau nian. Nia kaan ninia doben sira nebee ema Asíria sira. Sira mak funu nain sira
verses.6: nebee hatais hena kór uvas, no xefi sira no komandante sira. Ema hotu nee mak klosan bonitu nebee sae kuda.
verses.7: Nia halo sala aat ho mane hotu nee, mane nebee kapaas liu hosi Asíria. Nia hafoer aan ho ai riin lulik hotu hosi ema hotu nebee nia kaan.
verses.8: Nia la husik ninia hahalok aat nian nebee nia hahuu iha Ejitu. Tanba bainhira nia sei joven, joven mane mak toba ho nia no kaer ninia susun matan virjen nian. No sira fui sai sira nia sala aat ba nia.
verses.9: Nunee Hau entrega nia ba ninia doben sira nia liman, ba ema Asíria sira nia liman, tanba nia kaan sira.
verses.10: Ema sira nee kolu nia ropa hodi haree ninia isin molik. Sira kaer ninia oan mane sira no ninia oan feto sira. No kona ba nia, sira oho nia ho surik. Bainhira nia hetan ona kastigu nee, nia sai liafuan aat iha feto sira nia leet.
verses.11: “Ninia alin feto Oholiba haree buat nee, no Oholiba sai aat liu ninia biin. Tanba nia kaan mane no halo sala aat nebee aat liu ninia biin.
verses.12: Nia kaan ema Asíria sira, xefi sira, komandante sira, funu nain sira nebee hatais ropa funu nian nebee kompletu, ema sira nebee sae kuda. Mane hotu nee mak bonitu.
verses.13: No Hau haree katak nia sae foer. Feto nain rua nee tuir hahalok hanesan deit.
verses.14: Maibee nia hatutan ninia sala aat. Nia haree mane sira iha dezenhu iha didin, figura sira hosi ema Kaldeia sira nebee pinta ho kór mean.
verses.15: Sira hatais sintu iha sira nia kanotak, ho hena naruk nebee bobar iha ulun nudar xapeu. Ema hotu nee iha oin hanesan komandante sira, nebee iha oin hanesan ema Babilónia sira hosi sira nia rai Kaldeia.
verses.16: Bainhira feto nee haree sira, nia kaan sira no nia haruka manu-ain ba sira iha Kaldeia.
verses.17: No ema Babilónia sira tama ba nia iha ninia kama namora nian. Sira hafoer nia ho sira nia sala aat. No bainhira nia sai foer ona liu hosi sira, nia hadook aan hosi sira.
verses.18: Bainhira nia halo sala aat malorek deit no hatudu ninia isin molik, Hau hadook aan hosi nia hanesan Hau hadook aan ona hosi ninia biin.
verses.19: Maibee nia aumenta ninia sala aat. Nia hanoin ninia tempu joven, bainhira nia halo sala aat iha rai Ejitu
verses.20: no nia kaan ninia doben sira iha nebaa. Sira nia oin lulik nee hanesan kuda buru nian no sira nia been nee hanesan kuda nian.
verses.21: Nunee o hanoin hetan o nia hahalok aat hosi o nia tempu joven nian, bainhira ema Ejitu sira kaer o nia susun matan no book o nia susun joven nian.”
verses.22: Entaun, Oh Oholiba, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: “Tebes, Hau sei sadik o nia doben sira hodi hasoru o, ema nebee o hadook aan hosi sira. Hau sei lori sira hasoru o hosi sor-sorin:
verses.23: ema Babilónia sira no ema Kaldeia sira hotu, inklui Pekod, Soa no Koa, no ema Asíria sira hotu hamutuk ho sira. Ema sira hotu nee mak ema bonitu, xefi sira, komandante sira, ema boot sira no ema konhesidu sira. No ema hotu nee sae kuda.
verses.24: No sira sei mai hasoru o hosi parte norte ho kuda kareta, kareta seluk no ema lubun boot. Sira sei forma hodi hasoru o iha sor-sorin ho eskudu kiik no boot, no ho kapaseti militár. Hau sei foo knaar ba sira hodi tesi lia, no sira sei tesi lia ba o tuir sira nia regulamentu.
verses.25: No Hau sei hatudu Hau nia laran moras hasoru o, hodi sira sei kastigu o ho laran manas. Sira sei tesi sai o nia inus no o nia tilun. No ema restu nebee sei moris hela sei monu liu hosi surik. Sira sei kaer o nia oan mane sira no o nia oan feto sira, no ahi sei haan ema restu hosi o.
verses.26: Sira sei kolu o nia ropa no hasai o nia fatuk murak.
verses.27: Nunee Hau sei hapara o nia hahalok aat no o nia sala aat nebee mosu iha rai Ejitu, hodi o sei la foti sae o nia matan ba sira ka hanoin hetan fali Ejitu.
verses.28: “Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei entrega o ba ema sira nia liman nebee o odi, ba ema sira nia liman nebee uluk o hadook aan hosi sira.
verses.29: Sira sei lori o ho laran nebee odi o, no sira sei hasai o nia produsaun hotu nebee o servisu ona hodi hetan. Sira sei husik o nia isin molik no luan. No ema sei kolu ropa hosi o nia isin molik nebee halao o nia sala aat. O nia hahalok aat no o nia sala aat
verses.30: mak lori kastigu nee ba o, tanba o halo sala aat ho nasaun sira no hafoer aan ho sira nia ai riin lulik sira.
verses.31: O sei lao tuir o nia biin. Nunee Hau sei foo ninia kopu kastigu nian ba o nia liman.
verses.32: Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.33: o sei sai nakonu ho laran nebee lanu no laran susar.
verses.34: O sei hemu hosi kopu nee too hotu,
verses.35: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tanba o haluha ona Hau no soe Hau ba o nia kotuk. O rasik tenki simu kastigu kona ba o nia hahalok aat no sala aat.”
verses.36: Nai dehan ba hau: “Ema nia oan, o sei tesi lia ba Ohola no Oholiba ka? Foo sai ba sira kona ba sira nia sala foer.
verses.37: Tanba sira halo ona sala aat. Sira iha raan iha sira nia liman. Sira halo ona sala aat ho sira nia ai riin lulik sira. Sira oferese sira nia oan sira nudar sakrifísiu ba ai riin lulik sira hodi haan oan sira nebee sira hetan ba Hau.
verses.38: No mos, sira halo ida nee ba Hau: sira hafoer ona Hau nia Fatin Santu iha loron ida nee no sira hafoer Hau nia loron Sabdu sira.
verses.39: Tanba bainhira sira oho tiha sira nia oan sira nudar sakrifísiu ba sira nia ai riin lulik sira, iha loron hanesan sira tama ba Hau nia Fatin Santu hodi hafoer fatin nee. No tebes, sira halo ida nee iha Hau nia uma.
verses.40: Sira mos haruka ema bolu mane sira hosi fatin dook. Sira haruka manu-ain ba mane sira nee. No tebes, mane sira nee mai. Tanba mane sira nee mak o hariis, o pinta matan, no o hatais buat furak.
verses.41: O tuur iha sofá boot no o prepara meza iha sofá nia oin. O tau Hau nia insensu no Hau nia mina iha meza nee.
verses.42: Lian hosi ema lubun nebee halimar mak hamutuk ho nia. Nia hamutuk ho ema baibain sira, nebee lanu-teen sira hosi rai fuik. Sira tau kelu sira iha feto nia liman, no sira tau koroa furak iha sira nia ulun.
verses.43: Depois Hau dehan kona ba nia nebee kole tanba ninia sala foer, ‘Agora sira sei uza hela nia nudar feto luroon. Sira uza nia deit!’
verses.44: Tanba sira tama ona ba nia, nudar mane sira nebee tama ba feto luroon. Nunee sira tama ba Ohola no ba Oholiba, feto aat sira nee!
verses.45: Maibee ema moris loos sei tesi lia ba sira ho kastigu nebee feto luroon nian, no ho kastigu nebee ba feto nebee fakar raan. Tanba sira mak feto luroon no raan mak iha sira nia liman.”
verses.46: Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee: “Lori mai forsa boot hodi hasoru sira, no foo terus ba sira no hadau sira.
verses.47: Forsa nee sei tuda fatuk ba sira no taa sira tuun ho surik. Forsa nee sei oho sira nia oan mane sira no sira nia oan feto sira, no sunu sira nia uma sira nee.
verses.48: Nunee Hau sei hapara hahalok aat iha rai nee. Feto hotu sei aprende hosi kastigu nee no la halo buat aat hanesan imi halo ona.
verses.49: Forsa nee sei selu fali ba imi tuir imi nia hahalok aat. Imi sei simu kastigu tanba imi nia sala ho ai riin lulik sira. No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai Maromak.”

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala sia, iha fulan ba dala sanulu, iha loron sanulu iha fulan nee, Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, hakerek loron nee nia naran, loron ida nee duni. Liurai Babilónia mak serka Jerusalém iha loron nee duni.
verses.3: No foo sai provérbiu ba uma nebee kontra Hau nee. Dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.4: hatama naan pedasuk sira,
verses.5: Foti bibi ida nebee diak liu;
verses.6: “Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Susar ba sidade raan nee, ba sanan nebee foer ona, ba sanan nebee foer hela deit! Foti sai pedasuk ba pedasuk, no lalika hili ida nebee diak.
verses.7: Tanba sira fakar ona raan iha sidade laran nee. Sira fakar ona raan iha fatuk leten. Sira la fui raan ba rai hodi taka ho rai rahun.
verses.8: Nunee sira sadik Hau nia laran manas hodi selu fali sira. Hau sei tau sira nia raan iha fatuk leten hodi ema la bele taka.
verses.9: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Susar ba sidade raan nee! Hau sei halo mos bou nee sai boot.
verses.10: Tau tan ai maran sira nee, halakan ahi, daan naan nee di-diak, kahur bumbu ba no tunu naan ruin nee.
verses.11: Depois tau sanan mamuk nee iha ahi klaak hodi bele hamanas nia. Sunu sanan nia riti hodi bele hasai buat nebee la moos no buat nebee foer.
verses.12: Sira halo kole sira nia aan rasik ho servisu. Buat foer nee la sai hosi sanan nee. Hatama nia ba ahi ho ninia foer!
verses.13: Tanba imi nia hahalok aat nee mak foer. Tanba Hau bele hamoos imi, maibee imi la sai moos hosi imi nia foer. Nunee Hau sei la hamoos tan imi too Hau fui sai Hau nia laran manas ba imi.
verses.14: Hau mak Nai. Hau koalia tiha ona. Ida nee sei akontese duni. Hau sei halo ida nee. Hau sei la husik. Hau sei la hatudu grasa. Hau sei la fila fali. Hau sei tesi lia ba imi tuir imi nia hahalok, no buat nebee imi halo ona, hatete Nai Maromak.”
verses.15: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.16: “Ema nia oan, tebes, Hau atu foti sai buat nebee furak iha o nia oin iha momentu ida deit. Maibee o sei la tristi ka tanis. O sei la husik matan been tuun ba.
verses.17: Bele tristi nonook deit. La bele tanis lelir ba mate isin nee. Hatais o nia hena naruk nudar xapeu, no tau sapatu ba o nia ain. La bele taka o nia ibun ka haan paun hosi ema.”
verses.18: Hau foo sai liafuan nee iha dadeer, no iha loraik hau nia feen mate. Aban dadeer hau halo tuir orden nebee hau hetan.
verses.19: No povu dehan mai hau, “Ita sei la foo hatene signifika kona ba buat sira nee ka? Tanba saa mak ita halo hanesan nee?”
verses.20: Depois hau dehan ba sira, “Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.21: ‘Dehan ba uma kain Israel, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei halo foer Hau nia Fatin Santu, fatin nebee imi foti sai nudar imi nia podér, buat nebee furak iha imi nia oin, buat nebee imi kaan iha imi nia klamar. No imi nia oan mane sira no imi nia oan feto sira nebee imi husik bainhira imi sai sei monu liu hosi surik.
verses.22: No imi sei halo hanesan hau mak halo. Imi sei la taka imi nia ibun, no imi sei la haan paun hosi ema.
verses.23: Imi sei hatais hela hena naruk nudar xapeu no hatais hela imi nia sapatu iha imi nia ain. Imi sei la tristi ka tanis. Maibee imi sei lakon ho imi nia hahalok aat no imi sei tristi ba malu deit.
verses.24: Nunee Ezekiel sei sai sinál ba imi. Tuir buat hotu nebee nia halo, imi sei halo. Bainhira buat nee akontese mai, depois imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai Maromak.’
verses.25: “Kona ba o, ema nia oan, tebes iha loron nebee Hau foti sira hosi sira nia abrigu, fatin nebee foo haksolok no glória ba sira, fatin nebee sira gosta haree no sira nia klamar hakarak, no Hau foti mos sira nia oan mane no oan feto sira,
verses.26: iha loron nebaa, ema sei halai ba o hodi foo hatene kona ba buat nebee akontese nee.
verses.27: Iha loron nebaa, o nia ibun sei loke no o sei koalia ba ema nebee halai nee, no o laos monok tan. Nunee o sei sai sinál ba sira, no sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, see o nia oin ba ema Amon sira no profesia hasoru sira.
verses.3: Dehan ba ema Amon sira, Rona liafuan hosi Nai Maromak: Nai Maromak hatete nunee, Tanba imi dehan, ‘Aha!’ kona ba Hau nia Fatin Santu bainhira fatin nee sai foer, no kona ba rai Israel bainhira fatin nee hetan dezastre, no kona ba uma kain Judá bainhira sira lao sai ba fatin kastigu,
verses.4: nunee tebes, Hau sei entrega imi ba povu hosi rai lorosae hodi sira ukun imi. Sira sei mai halo akampamentu militár iha imi nia leet no sira sei mai halo uma hodi hela iha imi nia rai. Sira sei haan imi nia ai fuan, no sira sei hemu imi nia susu been.
verses.5: Hau sei halo Rabá sai fatin duut hodi foo haan ba kuda kamelu sira. No Amon sei sai fatin ba bibi lubun sira. Depois imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.6: Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tanba imi basa ona imi nia liman no tebe imi nia ain no haksolok ho odiu hotu nebee iha imi nia klamar hodi hasoru rai Israel,
verses.7: nunee, tebes, Hau lolo Hau nia liman hasoru imi, no Hau sei entrega imi nudar riku-soin ba nasaun sira seluk. No Hau sei hakotu imi hosi povu sira nee. Hau sei halakon imi hosi nasaun sira. Hau sei destrui imi. Depois imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.8: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tanba Moab no Seir dehan, ‘Tebes, uma kain Judá mak hanesan nasaun sira seluk,’
verses.9: nunee Hau sei loke Moab nia sidade sira nebee iha ninia baliza sorin ida. Hau sei loke sidade sira nebee foo glória ba rai Moab, nebee Bet-Jesimot, Baal-Meon, no Kiriataim.
verses.10: Hau sei entrega fatin nee hamutuk ho ema Amon sira ba povu hosi rai lorosae hodi ema iha nebaa bele ukun sira. Nunee ema sei la hanoin hetan tan ema Amon sira iha nasaun sira nia leet,
verses.11: no Hau sei tesi lia ba Moab. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.12: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tanba Edom selu aat fali ba uma kain Judá no hamoe makaas sira, no selu fali buat aat ba sira,
verses.13: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete, Hau sei lolo Hau nia liman hasoru Edom no hakotu fatin nee hosi ema no animál. Hau sei estraga fatin nee. No Teman too iha ema Dedan sira sei monu liu hosi surik.
verses.14: No Hau sei selu fali Edom ho Hau nia liman, nebee liu hosi Hau nia povu Israel nia liman. Hau sei halo iha Edom tuir Hau nia laran hirus no tuir Hau nia laran manas, no sira sei hatene katak Hau mak selu fali sira, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.15: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tanba ema Filisteu sira selu aat fali no ho odiu hosi sira nia klamar sira selu buat aat hodi estraga nudar inimigu too rohan laek,
verses.16: nunee Nai Maromak hatete, Tebes, Hau sei lolo Hau nia liman hasoru ema Filisteu sira, no Hau sei hakotu ema Keret no estraga rai seluk iha tasi ibun iha nebaa.
verses.17: Hau sei selu fali buat aat tebes ba sira no hasee sira ho laran manas. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau hatudu Hau nia hahalok nebee selu fali sira.”

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala sanulu resin ida, iha loron primeiru iha fulan nee, Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, tanba sidade Tiro dehan kona ba Jerusalém, ‘Aha, povu sira nia portaun nee rahun ona. Portaun nee loke ona ba hau. Hau sei sai riku tanba fatin nee sai aat ona.’
verses.3: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tebes, Hau mak kontra o, Oh Tiro, no sei haruka nasaun barak sae hasoru o, hanesan tasi haruka laloran sae.
verses.4: Sira sei harahun moru Tiro nian no baku rahun ninia uma aas sira. Hau sei koir ninia rai hosi nia no halo nia sai fatuk molik deit.
verses.5: Nia sei hela iha tasi laran deit no sai fatin hodi soe redi, tanba Hau mak koalia tiha ona, hatete Nai Maromak. No nia sei sai riku-soin nebee nasaun sira hadau.
verses.6: Ema sei oho ninia oan feto sira nebee iha rai maran liu hosi surik. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.7: “Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei lori Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia, nebee liurai ba liurai sira, hodi hasoru Tiro. Nia sei mai hosi parte norte ho kuda no kuda kareta, no ho ema sira nebee sae kuda no forsa nebee iha soldadu barak.
verses.8: Nia sei oho o nia oan feto sira ho surik iha rai maran. Nia sei harii uma aas funu nian hodi hasoru o. Nia sei halo bou rai ba o nia moru hodi hasoru o. Nia sei foti sae eskudu hodi hasoru o.
verses.9: Nia sei haruka ninia alat funu nian hodi hasoru o nia moru sira. Nia sei baku rahun o nia uma aas sira ho ninia baliu sira.
verses.10: Ninia kuda barak tebes sei mai too sira taka o ho rai rahun. O nia moru sira sei nakdoko tanba lian hosi ema nebee lori kuda, no kuda kareta boot, no kuda kareta funu nian. Moru sira nee sei nakdoko bainhira nia tama o nia portaun sira, hanesan ema nebee tama sidade nebee moru nakfera ona.
verses.11: Ho ninia kuda nia sapatu sira nia sei sama o nia dalan hotu. Nia sei oho o nia povu ho surik, no o nia riin fatuk boot sei monu tuun ba rai.
verses.12: Sira sei hadau o nia riku-soin no naok o nia sasaan faan nian. Sira sei baku tuun o nia moru sira no harahun o nia uma sira nebee furak. Sira sei soe o nia fatuk, ai no rai ba tasi laran.
