verses.13: No Hau sei hapara múzika hosi o nia kanta sira. Ema sei la rona tan o nia harpa sira.
verses.14: Hau sei halo o sai fatuk molik deit. O sei sai fatin nebee ema soe redi deit. Ema sei nunka harii fali o, tanba Hau mak Nai. Hau koalia tiha ona, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.15: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee ba Tiro: Laos ilha sira sei nakdoko tanba lian nebee mai bainhira o monu? Rai sira nee sei nakdoko bainhira ema tanis tanba kanek todan, no bainhira o nia ema barak mate iha o nia laran.
verses.16: Depois nai ulun hotu hosi tasi sei tuun hosi sira nia kadunan sira no hasai sira nia ropa liurai nian no kolu sira nia ropa furak. Sira sei hatais hanoin nebee nakdedar. Sira sei tuur iha rai no nakdedar hela deit. No sira sei hakfodak tebes tanba o.
verses.17: Sira sei foo sai lamentasaun kona ba o no dehan ba o,
verses.18: Agora ilha sira nakdedar
verses.19: “Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Bainhira Hau halo o sai sidade nebee rahun, hanesan sidade sira nebee ema la hela tan iha laran; bainhira Hau lori tasi klean sae iha o nia leten, no bee boot taka o;
verses.20: iha tempu nebaa, Hau sei halo o tuun ho sira nebee tuun ba rai kuak, ba povu antigu. Hau sei halo o hela iha mundu nebee iha rai okos, iha fatin nebee rahun ona hosi tempu antigu, ho sira nebee tuun ba rai kuak, hodi ema sei la hela fali iha o nia laran. Maibee Hau sei tau buat furak iha ema moris sira nia rai.
verses.21: Hau sei halo o nia tempu remata ho terus boot. Depois o sei la iha tan. Mezmu ema buka o, sira nunka hetan fali o, hatete Nai Maromak.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Agora o, ema nia oan, foti sae lamentasaun ida kona ba Tiro.
verses.3: Dehan ba Tiro, nebee hela iha fatin atu tama tasi, nebee hola sasaan hosi povu nebee hosi ilha barak, katak Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.4: O nia rai mak iha tasi laran;
verses.5: Sira halo o nia ai kabelak sira hotu
verses.6: Sira halo o nia ai kose sira nee
verses.7: Ema halo o nia laan
verses.8: Ema sira nebee hela iha Sidon no Arvad
verses.9: Ema katuas sira hosi Gebal no ninia ema matenek mak iha o nia laran,
verses.10: “Persia, Lud no Put mak iha o nia forsa militár nudar o nia soldadu sira. Sira tara eskudu no kapaseti iha o nia laran. Sira halo o sai furak.
verses.11: Mane sira hosi Arvad no Helek hamriik iha o nia moru nebee haleu o. Mane sira hosi Gamad mak iha o nia uma aas seguransa sira nee. Sira tara sira nia eskudu iha o nia moru nebee haleu o. Sira halo o nia oin bonita sai perfeitu.
verses.12: “Tarsis halo bisnis ho o tanba o iha riku-soin barak no oi-oin. Sira troka osan mutin, besi, kalen no makdadi hodi hetan o nia sasaan.
verses.13: Javan, Tubal, no Mesek halo bisnis ho o. Sira troka ema no sasaan hosi besi riti hodi hetan buat nebee o faan.
verses.14: Ema sira hosi Bet-Togarma troka kuda, kuda funu nian no kuda buru hodi hetan o nia sasaan.
verses.15: Mane sira hosi Dedan halo bisnis ho o. O iha merkadu espesiál sira iha ilha barak. Sira lori dikur marfín no ai ebanu hodi selu ba o.
verses.16: Síria halo bisnis ho o tanba o iha sasaan barak. Sira troka fatuk turkeza, hena kór uvas, hena nebee borda, hena linhu, ahu ruin no fatuk rubi hodi hetan o nia sasaan.
verses.17: Judá no rai Israel halo bisnis ho o. Sira troka trigu hosi Minit, ai haan diak, bani been, mina no mina nebee aimoruk hodi hetan o nia sasaan.
verses.18: Damasku halo bisnis ho o hodi hetan o nia sasaan nebee barak. Tanba o iha riku-soin oi-oin no barak. Sira troka tua uvas hosi Helbon no bibi malae fulun hosi Sahar
verses.19: no bidon nebee iha tua uvas hosi Uzal hodi hetan o nia sasaan. Sira troka besi naroman, kasia no duut kain midar hodi hetan o nia riku-soin.
verses.20: Dedan troka hena sela nian ho o, nebee uza bainhira sae kuda.
verses.21: Arábia no nai ulun hotu hosi Kedar lori mai bibi malae oan, bibi malae aman no bibi timor hodi faan ba o.
verses.22: Negosiante sira hosi Seba no Raama halo bisnis ho o. Sira troka bumbu oi-oin nebee kualidade diak liu, fatuk murak oi-oin no osan mean hodi hetan o nia sasaan.
verses.23: Haran, Kané, Eden, no negosiante sira hosi Seba, Asur, no Kilmad halo bisnis ho o.
verses.24: Iha o nia merkadu sira troka ropa furak nebee kór azúl no ema borda tiha, no tapeti ho kór oi-oin nebee kesi metin ho tali.
verses.25: Roo sira hosi Tarsis halo viajen dook hodi lori o nia sasaan. Nunee o nakonu no todan iha tasi laran.
verses.26: “O nia ema sira nebee hean roo nee
verses.27: O nia riku-soin, o nia sasaan, no buat nebee o faan,
verses.28: Bainhira o nia roo nain sira hakilar
verses.29: Ema hotu nebee kaer ai hean,
verses.30: Sira sei hakilar makaas kona ba o
verses.31: sira sei halo aan botak tanba o
verses.32: Bainhira sira tanis dadaun nee sira sei foo sai lamentasaun kona ba o,
verses.33: Bainhira o nia sasaan mai hosi tasi,
verses.34: Agora o rahun tiha liu hosi tasi,
verses.35: Ema sira hotu nebee hela iha ilha sira
verses.36: Negósiu sira iha povu sira nia leet despreza o.

28.title: Profesia Hasoru Nai Ulun Iha Tiro

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, dehan ba nai ulun iha Tiro, Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.3: Tebes o mak matenek liu Daniel;
verses.4: Liu hosi o nia matenek klean no o nia kompriensaun
verses.5: Liu hosi o nia matenek nebee klean loos kona ba halo negósiu
verses.6: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete:
verses.7: nunee, tebes, Hau sei lori ema hosi rai liur mai hasoru o,
verses.8: Sira hatuun o ba rai kuak,
verses.9: O bele dehan, ‘Hau mak maromak ida,’ ka?
verses.10: O sei sai mate nudar ema nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun
verses.11: No mos, Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.12: “Ema nia oan, foo sai lamentasaun kona ba liurai hosi Tiro, no dehan ba nia, Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.13: Uluk o mak iha Eden, iha jardin Maromak nian;
verses.14: O hetan unsaun nudar kerubim seguransa.
verses.15: O la halo sala ho o nia hahalok nee
verses.16: Bainhira o halo hela negósiu barak tebes
verses.17: O nia fuan laran foti aan tanba o nia oin bonitu;
verses.18: Liu hosi o nia hahalok aat bar-barak,
verses.19: Ema hotu nebee konhese o iha povu sira nia leet
verses.20: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.21: “Ema nia oan, see o nia oin ba Sidon, no foo sai profesia hasoru nia
verses.22: no dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.23: tanba Hau sei haruka moras peste nebee tama ba nia,
verses.24: “No ba uma kain Israel, sira sei la hetan tan ai tarak nebee sona sira ka duut tarak nebee foo kanek ba sira, nebee mai hosi sira nia vizinhu hotu nebee uluk despreza sira. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai Maromak.”
verses.25: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Bainhira Hau halibur uma kain Israel nebee namkari iha povu sira nia leet, no bainhira Hau hatudu Hau nia santidade iha sira hodi nasaun sira seluk bele haree, nunee sira sei hela iha sira nia rai rasik nebee uluk Hau foo ba Hau nia atan Jacó.
verses.26: No sira sei hela hakmatek iha rai nee, no sira sei harii uma no kuda toos uvas. Sira sei hela hakmatek bainhira Hau halao julgamentu ba sira nia vizinhu hotu nebee despreza ona sira. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai nebee sira nia Maromak.”

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala sanulu, iha fulan ba dala sanulu, iha loron ba dala sanulu resin rua iha fulan nee, Nai nia liafuan mai too hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, see o nia oin hodi hasoru Faraó, liurai hosi Ejitu, no foo sai profesia hasoru nia no hasoru Ejitu tomak.
verses.3: Koalia, no dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.4: Hau sei tau kait sira iha o nia hasaan ruin,
verses.5: No Hau sei soe o ba iha rai fuik,
verses.6: Depois ema sira hotu nebee hela iha Ejitu sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai. “Tanba imi sai ona ai tonka nebee halo hosi duut kain ba uma kain Israel.
verses.7: Bainhira sira kaer o ho liman, o tohar no lees sira nia kabaas hotu. No bainhira sira sadere ba o, o tohar no halo sira hotu nia ain nakdedar.
verses.8: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tebes, Hau sei lori surik ida hodi hasoru o, no hakotu ema no animál hosi o.
verses.9: Rai Ejitu sei sai mamuk no rahun. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai. “Tanba o dehan, ‘Nilu mak hau nian, no hau mak kria mota nee,’
verses.10: nunee, tebes, Hau kontra hasoru o no hasoru o nia mota sira. Hau sei halo rai Ejitu sai mamuk no rahun loos, hosi Migdol ba Siene, no too iha baliza ba Etiópia.
verses.11: La iha ema nia ain ida nebee lao liu, no la iha animál nia ain ida nebee lao liu rai nee. Rai nee sei sai mamuk too tinan haat-nulu.
verses.12: No Hau sei halo rai Ejitu sai rahun iha nasaun sira seluk nia leet nebee mos rahun. Ninia sidade sira sei hela rahun too tinan haat-nulu iha sidade sira seluk nia leet nebee mos rahun. Hau sei namkari ema Ejitu sira ba iha nasaun sira nia leet, no fahe sira ba rai sira seluk.
verses.13: “Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Bainhira tinan haat-nulu hotu ona, Hau sei halibur ema Ejitu sira hosi povu sira nia leet nebee Hau namkari sira ba.
verses.14: Hau sei halo diak fali ema Ejitu nia moris no lori sira mai fali ba rai Pathros, ba rai nebee sira nia knuuk. Iha nebaa sira sei sai nasaun nebee kiik deit.
verses.15: Reinu nee sei sai ida nebee kiik liu. Sira nunka foti fali aan iha nasaun sira seluk nia leten. Hau sei halo sira kiik liu hodi sira nunka ukun nasaun sira seluk.
verses.16: No nasaun nee sei nunka sai buat ida nebee uma kain Israel fiar ba. Israel sei hanoin nasaun nee nia hahalok aat, bainhira ema Israel fila ba ema Ejitu hodi hetan suporta. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai Maromak.”
verses.17: Iha tinan ba dala rua-nulu resin hitu, iha fulan primeiru, iha loron primeiru iha fulan nee, Nai nia liafuan mai too hau:
verses.18: “Ema nia oan, Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia haruka ninia forsa militár atu servisu makaas hodi hasoru Tiro. Ulun ida-idak sai botak, no kabaas ida-idak sai molik. Maibee nia no ninia forsa nee la hetan buat ida hosi Tiro hodi selu sira nia kolen kona ba sira nia servisu nebee sira halo hasoru Tiro.
verses.19: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tebes, Hau sei foo rai Ejitu ba Nabukodonozor, liurai hosi Babilónia; no nia sei lori sai Ejitu nia riku-soin no naok sira nia sasaan. No riku-soin nee sei selu fali ninia forsa militár.
verses.20: Hau foo ba nia rai Ejitu nudar ninia kolen nebee nia servisu hodi hetan. Tanba sira halo Hau nia servisu, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.21: “Iha loron nebaa, Hau sei halo dikur ida mosu mai ba uma kain Israel, no Hau sei loke o nia ibun tutun iha sira nia leet. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai too hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, foo sai profesia no dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.3: Tanba loron nee besik ona,
verses.4: Surik ida sei tuun ba Ejitu,
verses.5: Etiópia, Put, Lud, Arábia tomak, no Líbia, no povu iha rai nebaa nebee halo akordu, sira sei monu hamutuk ho ema sira nee liu hosi surik.
verses.6: “Nai hatete nunee:
verses.7: No sira sei sai rahun iha nasaun sira nia leet nebee rahun ona,
verses.8: Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai,
verses.9: “Iha loron nebaa, manu-ain sira sei sae roo no sai hosi Hau hodi foo terus ba povu Etiópia nebee senti problema la iha, no laran susar sei kona sira iha Ejitu nia loron susar. Tanba tebes, loron nee sei mai duni!
verses.10: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.11: Nia no ninia povu hamutuk ho nia, nebee halo terus liu nasaun sira seluk,
verses.12: Hau sei hamaran Nilu
verses.13: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.14: Hau sei halo Patros sai mamuk
verses.15: Hau sei fui sai Hau nia laran manas ba Pelúsiu,
verses.16: Hau sei sunu Ejitu ho ahi;
verses.17: Joven mane hosi On Pi-Beset sei monu liu hosi surik,
verses.18: Iha Tafnes loron sei sai nakukun,
verses.19: Nunee Hau sei halao julgamentu nee ba Ejitu.
verses.20: Iha tinan ba dala sanulu resin ida, iha fulan primeiru, iha loron ba dala hitu iha fulan nee, Nai nia liafuan mai too hau:
verses.21: “Ema nia oan, Hau halo tohar ona Faraó, liurai hosi Ejitu, nia liman. No tebes, sira seidauk falun liman nee, no seidauk bobar ligadura ba liman nee hodi kura nia, hodi liman nee bele sai forti fali hodi lori surik.
verses.22: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tebes, Hau mak kontra hasoru Faraó, liurai hosi Ejitu, no Hau sei halo tohar ninia liman, inklui liman nebee forti no liman nebee uluk tohar, no Hau sei halo surik nee monu hosi ninia liman.
verses.23: Hau sei namkari ema Ejitu sira iha nasaun sira nia leet no fahe sira iha rai sira seluk.
verses.24: Hau sei halo forti liurai Babilónia nia liman no tau Hau nia surik iha ninia liman. Maibee Hau sei halo tohar Faraó nia liman, no nia sei tanis iha liurai Babilónia nia oin nudar ema nebee iha kanek todan atu mate.
verses.25: Hau sei haforsa liurai Babilónia nia liman, maibee Faraó nia liman sei monu. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau tau Hau nia surik iha liurai Babilónia nia liman no nia lolo surik nee hodi hasoru rai Ejitu.
verses.26: No Hau sei halo ema Ejitu sira namkari iha nasaun sira nia leet no fahe sira iha rai seluk. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala sanulu resin ida, iha fulan ba dala tolu, iha loron ba dala ida iha fulan nee, Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, dehan ba Faraó, liurai hosi Ejitu, no ba ninia lubun boot nee:
verses.3: Tebes, Asíria mak ai teka ida iha Líbanon,
verses.4: Bee boot foo isin diak ba nia;
verses.5: Nunee nia sai aas loos,
verses.6: Manu hotu iha loro leten
verses.7: Nia mak bonita no boot tebes,
verses.8: Ai teka sira iha jardin Maromak nian la bele sai hanesan nia,
verses.9: Hau halo nia bonita
verses.10: “Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tanba nia sai aas tebes, no ninia tutun sae too kalohan, no ninia fuan laran foti aan tanba nia aas nee,
verses.11: Hau sei entrega nia ba ema forti nia liman hosi nasaun sira. Tebes, ema forti nee sei selu nia tuir ninia hahalok aat. Hau mak soe nia.
verses.12: Estranjeiru sira, nebee halo terus liu nasaun sira seluk, mak tesi tuun nia no husik nia. Ninia sanak sira monu iha foho no iha foho leet hotu. No ninia sanak sira tohar iha mota hotu iha rai nee. No povu hotu iha mundu sei sai hosi ninia mahon no husik nia.
verses.13: Manu hotu hosi loro leten hela iha ninia ai huun leten nebee monu tiha ona. No animál sira hotu hosi rai luan hela iha ninia ai sanak leten.
verses.14: Buat hotu nee akontese hodi ai horis sira nebee hela besik bee la bele kuda too aas tebes ka sae too sira nia tutun tama fali kalohan. Ai horis sira nebee hemu bee la bele sai aas hanesan nee. Tanba sira hotu sei mate, no tuun ba rai iha ema sira nia leet, hamutuk ho sira nebee tuun ba rai kuak.
verses.15: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Iha loron nebee ai teka nee tuun ba fatin mate, Hau halo ema tanis halerik. Hau taka nia iha fatin klean. Hau tahan ninia mota sira, no mota barak para ona. Hau foo hatais Líbanon ho laran tristi tanba nia, no ai horis hotu iha rai luan namlaik tanba nia.
verses.16: Hau halo nasaun sira nakdedar bainhira sira rona lian nebee mai bainhira ai teka nee monu, bainhira Hau soe nia tuun ba fatin mate nian hamutuk ho sira nebee tuun ba rai kuak. No ai horis hotu hosi Eden, no sira nebee diak liu iha Líbanon, ai horis hotu nebee presiza bee, sira hetan laran kamaan iha rai okos nee.
verses.17: Sira mos tuun ba fatin mate ho nia, ba sira nebee mate liu hosi surik; sin, sira nebee uluk hela nudar ninia liman, nebee hela iha ninia mahon okos iha nasaun sira nia leet.
verses.18: “See mak hanesan O nebee iha glória no boot tebes iha ai horis sira nia leet iha Eden? O sei tuun ba rai okos hamutuk ho ai horis sira hosi Eden. O sei toba ho ema nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun, ho sira nebee mate liu hosi surik. Nee mak Faraó no ninia lubun boot hotu, hatete Nai Maromak.”

32.title: Lamentasaun Kona ba Faraó no Ejitu

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala sanulu resin rua, iha fulan sanulu resin rua, iha loron primeiru iha fulan nee, Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, foo sai lamentasaun kona ba Faraó, liurai hosi Ejitu, no dehan ba nia:
verses.3: Nai Maromak hatete nunee:
verses.4: No Hau sei soe o ba rai;
verses.5: Hau sei lekar o nia isin ba foho
verses.6: Hau sei habokon rai ho o nia raan
verses.7: Bainhira Hau halakon o, Hau sei taka lalehan sira
verses.8: Ba naroman hotu iha lalehan,
verses.9: “Hau sei halo povu barak nia fuan laran hanoin, bainhira Hau halao o nia dezastre iha nasaun sira nia leet, ba nasaun sira nebee o la konhese.
verses.10: Hau sei halo povu barak hakfodak tanba o. Liurai sira nia fuuk sei nakrakat ho laran tauk tebes tanba o, bainhira Hau kaer Hau nia surik iha sira nia oin. Sira sei nakdedar iha momentu ida-idak. Ema ida-idak sei tauk kona ba ninia moris iha loron nebee o monu tuun.
verses.11: “Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Surik hosi liurai Babilónia sei tuun ba o.
verses.12: Hau sei halo o nia lubun nee monu liu hosi asuwain sira nia surik. Ema hotu nee sei foo terus liu fali nasaun sira seluk.
verses.13: Hau sei halakon sira nia animál sira hotu
verses.14: Depois Hau sei halo sira nia bee sai moos,
verses.15: Bainhira Hau halo rai Ejitu sai mamuk,
verses.16: Ida nee mak lamentasaun ida nebee ema sei kanta. Oan feto hosi nasaun sira sei kanta liafuan nee. Sira sei kanta liafuan nee ba Ejitu, no ba ninia lubun tomak, hatete Nai Maromak.”
verses.17: Iha tinan ba dala sanulu resin rua, iha fulan sanulu resin rua, iha loron sanulu resin lima iha fulan nee, Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.18: “Ema nia oan, tanis halerik kona ba Ejitu lubun nee, no haruka sira tuun. Haruka nia no oan feto sira hosi nasaun boot sira, ba mundu iha rai okos, ba sira nebee tuun ona ba rai kuak:
verses.19: ‘O mak bonita liu see?
verses.20: Sira sei monu iha ema nia leet nebee mate liu hosi surik. Nia entrega Ejitu ba surik. Dada nia sai hamutuk ho ninia lubun sira hotu.
verses.21: Xefi boot sira sei koalia kona ba sira, ho sira nia ajudante sira, hosi fatin mate nia laran: ‘Sira tuun mai ona, sira toba nonook deit, ema nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun nee, nebee mate liu hosi surik.’
verses.22: “Asíria mak iha nebaa, no ema hotu nebee hamutuk ho nia, ho ninia rate sira iha sor-sorin. Sira hotu mate no monu liu hosi surik.
verses.23: Sira nia rate mak iha fatin klean liu iha rai kuak nee. Ninia kompanhia mak haleu ninia rate. Sira hotu mate ona, sira monu liu hosi surik. Ema sira nee nebee uluk halo terus ba ema iha rai moris nian.
verses.24: “Elam mak iha nebaa, no ninia lubun tomak nebee haleu ninia rate. Sira hotu mate, no monu liu hosi surik. Sira tuun ona nudar ema nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun, ba mundu iha rai okos. Ema sira nee nebee uluk halo ema terus iha rai moris nian. No sira lori sira nia moe ho sira nebee tuun ba rai kuak.
verses.25: Sira halo ninia kama iha ema mate nia leet hamutuk ho ninia lubun tomak. Sira nia rate sira haleu nia. Ema hotu nee la hetan sirkunsizaun no mate liu hosi surik. Tanba sira halo ema tauk loos iha rai nebee ema moris mak hela. No sira sei lori tuun sira nia moe ho sira nebee tuun ba rai kuak. Sira hela hamutuk ho sira nebee mate.
verses.26: “Mesek-Tubal mak iha nebaa, no ninia lubun tomak. Ninia rate sira haleu fatin nee. Sira hotu la hetan sirkunsizaun, no sira mate liu hosi surik. Tanba sira halo terus ba ema iha rai moris nian.
verses.27: No sira la toba ho asuwain sira, nebee monu iha ema nia leet nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun, nebee tuun ba fatin mate ho sira nia armas funu nian, nebee tau sira nia surik iha sira nia ulun okos, nebee iha sira nia hahalok aat iha sira nia ruin leten. Tanba asuwain sira nee halo terus ba ema iha rai moris nian.
verses.28: Maibee kona ba o, o sei sai rahun no toba iha ema nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun nia leet, hamutuk ho sira nebee mate liu hosi surik.
verses.29: “Edom mak iha nebaa, no ninia liurai sira no ninia xefi hotu. Maski sira forti liu, sira sei toba ho sira nebee mate liu hosi surik. Sira toba ho ema nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun, ho sira nebee tuun ba rai kuak.
verses.30: “Xefi sira hosi parte norte mak iha nebaa, xefi sira hotu nee. No ema Sidon hotu, nebee tuun ona ho moe, ho ema mate. Tanba terus hotu nebee sira halo ho sira nia podér. Sira toba ho isin nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun, ho sira nebee mate liu hosi surik. Sira simu sira nia moe ho ema sira nebee tuun ba rai kuak.
verses.31: “Bainhira Faraó haree sira, nia sei hetan laran kamaan tanba ninia lubun tomak nee. Faraó no ninia forsa militár tomak nee, nebee mate liu hosi surik, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.32: Tanba Hau halo terus iha ema moris nia nee; no nia sei toba iha ema nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun nia leet, hamutuk ho sira nebee mate liu hosi surik, nebee Faraó no ninia lubun tomak, hatete Nai Maromak.”

33.title: Ezekiel Mak Ema Seguransa ba Israel

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, koalia ba o nia povu no dehan ba sira, Se Hau lori surik ba rai ida, no povu iha rai nee hili mane ida hosi sira nia leet hodi foo knaar ba nia nudar ema seguransa,
verses.3: no se nia haree surik nee mai dadaun too iha rai nee no nia huu dikur hodi foo avizu ba povu.
verses.4: Depois se iha ema nebee rona lian hosi dikur nee no la simu avizu, no surik nee mai no lori ema nee sai, nunee nia rasik sei lori responsabilidade kona ba ninia raan.
verses.5: Nia rona ona lian hosi dikur no nia la simu avizu nee, nunee nia sei lori responsabilidade kona ba ninia raan. Maibee se nia simu avizu, nia bele salva ninia moris.
verses.6: Maibee se ema seguransa haree surik mai dadaun no nia la huu dikur, hodi povu la hetan avizu, no surik nee mai duni no foti ema naran deit hosi sira, no surik lori ema nee sai tanba ninia hahalok aat, maibee Hau sei foo responsabilidade kona ba ninia raan ba ema seguransa nia liman.
verses.7: “Entaun ba o, ema nia oan, Hau hili ona o nudar ema seguransa ba uma kain Israel. Bainhira o rona liafuan ida hosi Hau nia ibun, o tenki foo avizu ba sira hosi Hau.
verses.8: Se Hau dehan ba ema aat, ‘Oh ema aat, o sei mate duni,’ no o la foo avizu ba ema aat hodi fila nia hosi ninia hahalok nee, nunee ema aat nee sei mate tanba ninia hahalok aat. Maibee Hau sei foo responsabilidade kona ba ninia raan ba o nia liman.
verses.9: Maibee se o foo avizu ba ema aat hodi fila nia hosi ninia hahalok nee, no nia la fila hosi ninia hahalok, nunee ema nee sei mate tanba ninia hahalok aat. Maibee o sei salva o nia klamar.
verses.10: “No o, ema nia oan, dehan ba uma kain Israel, Imi dehan nunee: ‘Tebes ami nia hahalok nebee kontra no ami nia sala mak kona fali ami, no ami sai laran dodok too lakon tanba sala sira nee. Nunee oinsaa ami bele moris hela?’
verses.11: Dehan ba sira, Hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, Hau lakohi ema aat mate, maibee Hau hakarak ema aat fila hosi ninia hahalok nee hodi nia bele moris hela. Fila fali mai, fila fali mai hosi imi nia hahalok aat. Nusaa mak imi tenki mate, Oh uma kain Israel?
verses.12: “No o, ema nia oan, dehan ba o nia povu, Ema loos nia hahalok loos sei la salva nia bainhira nia halo sala nebee kontra. No kona ba ema aat nia hahalok aat, nia sei la monu tanba hahalok nee bainhira nia fila hosi ninia hahalok aat. No ema loos sei la bele moris hela liu hosi ninia moris loos bainhira nia halo sala.
verses.13: Maski Hau dehan ba ema loos katak nia sei moris duni, maibee se nia fiar ba ninia hahalok loos no nia halo buat aat, nunee Hau sei la hanoin hetan buat loos ida nebee nia halo ona, maibee nia sei mate tanba buat aat nebee nia foin halo nee.
verses.14: No mos, maski Hau dehan ba ema aat, ‘O tenki mate duni,’ maibee se nia fila hosi ninia sala no nia halo buat nebee justu no loos,
verses.15: se ema aat nee foo fali pinoor, no foo fali buat nebee nia naok, no nia lao tuir estatutu moris nian, no nia la halo tuir buat nebee aat, nunee tebes nia sei moris hela; nia sei la mate.
verses.16: Hau sei la hanoin hetan sala ida nebee nia halo uluk hodi hasoru nia. Nia halo ona buat nebee justu no loos; no nia sei moris duni.
verses.17: “Maibee o nia povu dehan, ‘Nai nia hahalok nee la justu,’ bainhira sira nia hahalok mak la justu.
verses.18: Bainhira ema loos fila hosi ninia hahalok loos no halo buat aat, nia sei mate tanba hahalok nee.
verses.19: No bainhira ema aat fila hosi ninia hahalok aat no halo buat nebee justu no loos, nia sei moris hela liu hosi hahalok nee.
verses.20: Maibee imi dehan, ‘Nai nia hahalok nee la justu.’ Oh uma kain Israel, Hau sei tesi lia ba imi tuir ema ida-idak nia hahalok.”
verses.21: Iha tinan ba dala sanulu resin rua dezde ami tama ba kastigu, iha fulan sanulu, iha loron lima iha fulan nee, ema refujiadu ida hosi Jerusalém mai too hau no dehan, “Sidade nee monu tiha ona.”
verses.22: Iha kalan molok refujiadu nee mai, Nai nia liman kona ona hau, no Nia loke ona hau nia ibun molok mane ida nee mai iha dadeer. Entaun hau nia ibun loke ona, no hau laos ema monok.
verses.23: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.24: “Ema nia oan, ema sira nebee hela iha fatin maran iha rai Israel koalia hela, ‘Abraão mak ema ida deit, maibee nia konsege hetan rai nee. Entaun tanba ami mak ema barak, tebes ami sei hetan rai nee nudar ami nian.’
verses.25: Nunee dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Imi haan naan nebee sei iha raan, no foti imi nia matan ba imi nia ai riin lulik sira, no imi fakar raan; nunee imi bele hetan rai nee ka?
verses.26: Imi sadere ba surik, imi halo buat sira nebee foer tebes, no ema ida-idak hafoer ninia maluk nia feen; nunee imi bele hetan rai nee ka?
verses.27: Dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Hanesan Hau moris hela, tebes ema sira nebee hela iha fatin maran sei monu liu hosi surik. No see-see deit nebee iha rai luan nee, Hau sei foo ba animál fuik hodi haan sira. No sira nebee tama ba abrigu no fatuk kuak sira sei mate liu hosi moras peste.
verses.28: No Hau sei halo rai nee sai mamuk no fatin maran. Ninia podér nebee halo nia foti aan nee sei remata. No foho Israel nian sei sai mamuk liu too la iha ema ida nebee bele lao liu.
verses.29: Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau halo ona rai nee sai mamuk no maran tanba buat foer hotu nebee sira halo ona.
verses.30: “Kona ba o, ema nia oan, o nia povu nebee koalia hamutuk kona ba o iha moru sorin no iha uma sira nia odamatan. Sira dehan ba malu, ema ida-idak ba ninia maluk, ‘Favór ida, mai, no rona liafuan nebee mai hosi Nai.’
verses.31: No sira mai too o hanesan baibain povu mai. Sira tuur iha o nia oin nudar Hau nia povu, no sira rona buat nebee o dehan. Maibee sira sei la halo tuir. Tanba sira halo tuir sira nia liafuan nebee kaan. No sira nia fuan laran hakarak manaan deit.
verses.32: No tebes, o mak hanesan ema ida nebee kanta ba sira ho kanta namora nian ho lian furak no toka múzika diak. Tanba sira rona buat nebee o dehan, maibee sira sei la halo tuir.
verses.33: Bainhira ida nee mai, no ida nee sei mai duni, sira sei hatene katak profeta ida mak lao ona iha sira nia leet.”

34.title: Profesia Hasoru Israel Nia Bibi Atan Sira

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, foo sai profesia hasoru Israel nia bibi atan sira. Profesia ba, no dehan ba sira, ba bibi atan sira nee, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Aii, Israel nia bibi atan sira nebee foo haan ba imi nia aan rasik! Tuir lo-loos, bibi atan sira tenki foo haan ba bibi, loos ka lae?
verses.3: Imi haan naan bokur, imi hatais aan ho bibi nia fulun, no imi oho bibi bokur sira, maibee imi la foo haan ba bibi sira nee.
verses.4: Imi la haforsa sira nebee fraku, imi la kura sira nebee moras, imi la bobar ligadura ba sira nebee kanek, imi la lori fali sira nebee lao sala, imi la buka sira nebee lakon. Maibee imi ukun sira ho liman makaas no todan.
verses.5: Nunee sira lao namkari ona, tanba bibi atan la iha. Sira sai hahaan ba animál fuik hotu. Hau nia bibi sira lao namkari ona.
verses.6: Sira lao lemo rai iha foho hotu no iha fatin aas hotu. Hau nia bibi lao namkari iha mundu tomak, no la iha ema ida hodi haree no buka sira.
verses.7: “Nunee, imi nebee bibi atan sira, rona liafuan hosi Nai:
verses.8: Hanesan Hau moris hela, hatete Nai Maromak, tebes tanba Hau nia bibi mate, no Hau nia bibi sai ona hahaan ba animál fuik hotu, tanba bibi atan la iha, no tanba Hau nia bibi atan sira la buka hodi hetan Hau nia bibi, maibee bibi atan sira foo haan ba sira nia aan rasik, no sira la foo haan ba Hau nia bibi,
verses.9: nunee, imi nebee bibi atan sira, rona liafuan hosi Nai:
verses.10: Nai Maromak hatete nunee, Tebes, Hau mak hasoru bibi atan sira, no Hau sei presiza Hau nia bibi hosi sira nia liman no Hau hapara sira nia servisu nebee foo haan bibi. Bibi atan sira nee sei la foo tan hahaan ba sira nia aan rasik. Hau sei salva Hau nia bibi hosi sira nia ibun, hodi bibi sira nee sei la sai hahaan ba bibi atan sira.
verses.11: “Tanba Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau, Hau rasik sei lao ba no buka hodi hetan Hau nia bibi sira.
verses.12: Hanesan bibi atan nebee buka ninia bibi lubun bainhira nia iha bibi nebee lao namkari, nunee Hau sei buka Hau nia bibi. Hau sei salva sira hosi fatin hotu nebee sira lao namkari iha loron nebee iha kalohan no nakukun liu.
verses.13: No Hau sei lori sira sai hosi povu sira nia leet no Hau sei halibur sira hosi nasaun sira seluk, no Hau sei lori sira tama ba sira nia rai rasik. No Hau sei foo haan ba sira iha foho Israel, iha foho nia leet, no iha fatin hotu nebee ema hela iha rai nee.
verses.14: Hau sei foo haan sira ho duut diak, no sira bele hetan kampu duut nian iha foho Israel. Iha nebaa sira sei toba iha kampu duut nebee diak, no sira sei haan duut buras iha foho Israel.
verses.15: Hau rasik sei sai bibi atan ba Hau nia bibi, no Hau rasik sei halo sira toba, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.16: Hau sei buka sira nebee lakon, no Hau sei lori mai fali sira nebee lao sala, no Hau sei bobar ho ligadura ba sira nebee hetan kanek, no Hau sei foo forsa ba sira nebee fraku, no sira nebee bokur no forti Hau sei destrui. Hau sei foo haan ba sira ho justisa.
verses.17: “Kona ba o, Hau nia bibi lubun, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau tesi lia entre bibi ida no bibi seluk, entre bibi malae aman no bibi timor aman sira.
verses.18: Imi hanoin la too ka, atu haan duut diak, nunee imi tenki sama tuun ho imi nia ain imi nia duut restu nee ka? No la too atu hemu bee moos, nunee imi tenki halo bee merak ho imi nia ain ka?
verses.19: No Hau nia bibi tenki haan duut nebee imi sama ona ho imi nia ain ka? No sira tenki hemu bee nebee imi halo merak ho imi nia ain ka?
verses.20: “Nunee, Nai Maromak hatete ba sira: Tebes, Hau, Hau rasik sei tesi lia entre bibi bokur no bibi krekas.
verses.21: Tanba imi dudu ba-mai ho imi nia sorin no kabaas, no tuku bibi fraku hotu ho imi nia dikur, too imi halo sira namkari ba fatin seluk,
verses.22: nunee Hau sei salva Hau nia bibi lubun. No sira sei la sai tan hahaan ba ema seluk. Hau sei tesi lia entre bibi ida no bibi seluk.
verses.23: Hau sei tau bibi atan ida hodi ukun sira, nebee Hau nia atan David, no nia sei foo haan sira: nia sei foo haan sira no sai sira nia bibi atan.
verses.24: No Hau, Nai, sei sai sira nia Maromak, no Hau nia atan David sei sai sira nia ukun nain iha sira nia leet. Hau mak Nai; Hau koalia tiha ona.
verses.25: “Hau sei halo aliansa dame nian ho sira no halakon animál fuik sira hosi sira nia rai. Nunee sira bele hela hakmatek iha rai fuik no toba iha rai laran.
verses.26: No Hau sei halo sira no fatin nebee haleu Hau nia foho nee sai bensaun ida. Hau sei haraik udan tuir tempu. No udan nee sei sai udan bensaun nian.
verses.27: No ai horis iha rai luan sei foo sira nia fuan, no rai sei foo ninia rezultadu. No sira sei hela metin iha sira nia rai. Sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau halo tohar sira nia ai leba, no salva sira hosi ema nia liman nebee kastigu sira nudar atan.
verses.28: Sira sei la sai tan hahaan ba nasaun sira. No animál fuik sira iha rai nebaa sei la tolan sira. Sira sei hela hakmatek, no la iha ema ida nebee halo sira tauk.
verses.29: No Hau sei foo plantasaun konhesidu ba sira hodi sira la iha tan hamlaha boot iha rai nee. No nasaun seluk sei la hamoe tan sira.
verses.30: Sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, sira nia Maromak nebee hamutuk ho sira. No sira sei hatene katak sira, nebee uma kain Israel, mak Hau nia povu, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.31: No imi mak Hau nia bibi, imi mak ema hanesan bibi nebee haan iha Hau nia duut fatin, no Hau mak imi nia Maromak, hatete Nai Maromak.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, see o nia oin hodi hasoru Foho Seir, no foo sai profesia hasoru nia,
verses.3: no dehan ba nia, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau kontra hasoru o, Foho Seir. Hau sei lolo Hau nia liman hasoru o. Hau sei halo o sai mamuk no maran.
verses.4: Hau sei estraga o nia sidade sira, no o sei sai mamuk. No o sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.5: Tanba o hakarak odi nafatin no entrega povu Israel ba surik nia podér iha tempu nebee sira hetan dezastre, iha tempu nebee sira simu sira nia kastigu ikus nian.
verses.6: Nunee, hanesan Hau sei moris, hatete Nai Maromak, Hau sei prepara raan ba o, no raan nee sei duni o. Tanba o la odi hahalok nebee fakar raan, nunee raan sei duni o.
verses.7: Hau sei halo Foho Seir sai maran no mamuk, no Hau sei halakon ema hotu nebee tama no sai.
verses.8: No Hau sei halo ninia foho nakonu ho ema mate. Iha o nia foho no iha o nia foho leet no iha o nia mota hotu ema sei monu mate tanba surik.
verses.9: Hau sei halo o sai mamuk hela deit, no ema sei la hela fali iha o nia sidade sira. Depois o sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.10: “Tanba o dehan, ‘Nasaun rua nee no rai parte rua nee sei sai hau nian, no ami sei hadau fatin sira nee’ - maski Nai mak iha nebaa.
verses.11: Nunee, hanesan Hau sei moris, hatete Nai Maromak, Hau sei halo ba o tuir o nia laran hirus no laran moras nebee o hatudu tanba o nia ódiu nebee hasoru sira. No Hau sei halo hodi sira konhese Hau, bainhira Hau tesi lia ba o.
verses.12: No o sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai. “Hau rona ona liafuan aat nebee imi koalia tiha ona hodi hasoru foho Israel, no dehan, ‘Sira sai mamuk ona, ami bele hetan sira hodi tolan sira.’
verses.13: No imi foti aan hasoru Hau ho imi nia ibun. Imi habarak imi nia liafuan hasoru Hau. No Hau rona liafuan nee.
verses.14: Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Bainhira mundu tomak sai haksolok, Hau sei halo o sai mamuk.
verses.15: Hanesan imi haksolok kona ba liman rohan hosi uma kain Israel, tanba fatin nee sai mamuk, nunee Hau sei halo hanesan nee ba imi. Imi sei sai mamuk, Foho Seir, no Edom tomak, nebee rai tomak nee. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”

verses.1: “No o, ema nia oan, foo sai profesia ba foho iha Israel, no dehan, Oh foho Israel, rona liafuan hosi Nai.
verses.2: Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tanba inimigu dehan ona kona ba o, ‘Aha!’ no, ‘Foho antigu nee sai ona ami nian,’
verses.3: nunee profesia ba, no dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tanba nee duni katak sira halo imi mamuk no hanehan imi iha sor-sorin, too nasaun sira seluk hadau imi nudar sira nian, no imi sai liafuan aat nebee povu konta ba malu.
verses.4: Nunee, Oh foho Israel, rona liafuan hosi Nai Maromak: Nai Maromak hatete nunee ba foho aas no foho oan, ba mota no foho leet, rai maran nebee mamuk no sidade sira nebee ema la hela, nebee sai ona vítima no fatin nebee nasaun sira seluk iha sor-sorin mak goza,
verses.5: nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Tebes Hau koalia tiha ona ho Hau nia laran manas nebee lakan hodi hasoru nasaun sira seluk no hasoru Edom tomak, nebee entrega Hau nia rai ba sira nia aan rasik nudar sira nian ho fuan laran nakonu ho haksolok boot no la hanoin diak, hodi sira bele hadau fatin nee nia kampu duut sira.
verses.6: Nunee profesia kona ba rai Israel, no dehan ba foho aas no foho oan, ba mota no foho leet, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau koalia tiha ona ho Hau nia laran moras no Hau nia laran manas, tanba imi hetan ona moe hosi nasaun sira.
verses.7: Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Hau jura katak nasaun sira nebee haleu imi sei hetan moe nebee hasoru sira nia aan rasik.
verses.8: “Maibee imi, Oh foho Israel, sei dikin ba ho imi nia sanak sira no foo imi nia ai fuan ba Hau nia povu Israel. Tanba la kleur sira sei fila fali mai uma nee.
verses.9: Tanba tebes, Hau mak suporta imi, no Hau sei fila aan ba imi, no ema sei fila imi nia rai no kuda fini iha rai nee.
verses.10: No Hau sei habarak ema iha imi, nebee Israel nia uma kain tomak, nebee kompletu. Ema sei hela fali iha sidade sira nee no sira sei halo fali uma iha rai maran.
verses.11: No Hau sei habarak ema no animál iha imi, no sira sei sai barak no hetan oan sira. No Hau sei halo ema hela iha imi hanesan tempu uluk, no Hau sei halo ba imi buat nebee diak liu tempu uluk. Depois imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.12: Hau sei husik povu hodi lao iha imi, nebee Hau nia povu Israel. No sira sei hetan imi, no imi sei sai sira nia liman rohan, no imi sei la halo tan hodi sira abortu sira nia oan sira.
verses.13: Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tanba sira dehan ba imi, ‘Imi haan povu, no imi halo imi nia nasaun abortu sira nia oan sira,’
verses.14: nunee imi sei la haan tan povu no sei la abortu tan imi nia nasaun nia oan sira, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.15: No Hau sei la husik imi rona tan nasaun sira nebee goza imi, no imi sei la simu tan moe hosi povu sira no imi sei la halo tan imi nia nasaun nee sidi, hatete Nai Maromak.”
verses.16: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.17: “Ema nia oan, bainhira uma kain Israel uluk hela iha sira nia rai rasik, sira hafoer rai nee liu hosi sira nia hahalok no buat nebee sira halo. Sira nia hahalok nee mak iha Hau nia oin hanesan buat nebee la moos hosi feto bainhira nia fulan mai.
verses.18: Entaun Hau fui sai Hau nia laran manas ba sira tanba raan nebee sira fakar iha rai nee, no tanba ai riin lulik sira nebee hafoer rai nee.
verses.19: Hau namkari sira iha nasaun sira nia leet, no sira fahe ba nasaun sira seluk. Hau tesi lia ba sira tuir sira nia hahalok no buat nebee sira halo.
verses.20: Maibee bainhira sira baa nasaun sira, iha fatin nebee deit sira baa, sira hafoer Hau nia naran santu, tanba povu dehan kona ba sira, ‘Ema sira nee mak Nai nia povu, maibee sira tenki sai hosi Ninia rai.’
verses.21: Maibee Hau hanoin kona ba Hau nia naran santu, nebee uma kain Israel hafoer iha nasaun sira nia leet iha fatin nebee sira baa.
verses.22: “Nunee dehan ba uma kain Israel, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Ida nee laos tanba imi, Oh uma kain Israel, katak Hau atu halo tuir Hau nia hakarak, maibee tanba Hau nia naran santu, nebee imi hafoer ona iha nasaun sira nia leet, iha fatin nebee imi baa ona nee.
verses.23: No Hau sei konsagra Hau nia naran boot, nebee sai foer ona iha nasaun sira nia leet, nebee imi mak hafoer ona iha sira nia leet. No nasaun sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, hatete Nai Maromak, bainhira Hau konsagra Hau nia aan iha sira nia oin liu hosi imi.
verses.24: Hau sei foti imi hosi nasaun sira no halibur imi hosi rai hotu no lori imi ba imi nia rai rasik.
verses.25: Hau sei hisik imi ho bee moos, no imi sei sai moos hosi imi nia foer hotu, no Hau sei hamoos imi hosi imi nia ai riin lulik sira hotu.
verses.26: Hau sei foo fuan laran foun ba imi, no Hau sei tau espíritu foun iha imi nia laran. Hau sei hasai fuan fatuk nian hosi imi nia isin no foo fali fuan isin nian ba imi.
verses.27: Hau sei tau Hau nia Espíritu iha imi nia laran, no halo imi hodi lao tuir Hau nia estatutu sira no kuidadu atu halo tuir Hau nia regulamentu sira.
verses.28: Imi sei hela iha rai nee nebee uluk Hau foo ba imi nia bei-ala sira, no imi sei sai Hau nia povu, no Hau sei sai imi nia Maromak.
verses.29: No Hau sei salva imi hosi imi nia hahalok hotu nebee la moos. No Hau sei bolu mai rezultadu ai haan no habarak rezultadu nee. Hau sei la halo rai hamlaha ba imi.
verses.30: Hau sei habarak ai fuan hosi ai horis no rezultadu hosi toos, hodi imi nunka simu fali moe iha nasaun sira nia leet tanba rai hamlaha.
verses.31: Depois imi sei hanoin imi nia hahalok aat, no buat nebee imi halo ona nebee la diak. No imi sei hakribi aan tanba imi nia hahalok aat no imi nia hahalok foer.
verses.32: Hau la halao Hau nia hakarak tanba imi, hatete Nai Maromak. Husik imi hatene duni ida nee. Imi tenki sai moe no hakfodak tanba imi nia hahalok, Oh uma kain Israel.
verses.33: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Iha loron nebee Hau hamoos imi hosi imi nia hahalok aat hotu, Hau sei halo hodi ema bele hela iha sidade sira nee, no sira sei harii fali fatin sira nebee rahun.
verses.34: No ema sei fila rai nebee uluk sai mamuk, hodi rai nee la hela mamuk deit iha ema nia oin nebee lao liu.
verses.35: No sira sei dehan, ‘Rai nee nebee uluk mak mamuk, agora sai hanesan jardin Eden. No fatin maran no mamuk no sidade aat sira agora sai metin no ema hela iha nebaa.’
verses.36: Depois nasaun sira nebee sei hela iha imi nia sor-sorin sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai; Hau mak harii fali fatin nebee aat no kuda fali rai nebee mamuk. Hau mak Nai. Hau koalia tiha ona, no Hau sei halo ida nee.
verses.37: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: No mos, Hau sei husik uma kain Israel atu husu Hau hodi halo ida nee ba sira: hodi habarak sira nia povu nudar bibi lubun.
verses.38: Hanesan bibi lubun nebee santu, hanesan bibi lubun iha Jerusalém durante ninia festa regulamentu nian, nunee sidade mamuk sira sei sai nakonu ho povu. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”

37.title: Foho Leet Nebee Iha Mate Ruin

verses.1: Nai nia liman kona hau, no Nia lori hau sai iha Nai nia Espíritu. Nia tau hau iha rai tetuk nia klaran nebee iha foho leet. No fatin nee nakonu ho mate ruin.
verses.2: Nia lori hau lao ba-mai iha mate ruin nia leet. Tebes, rai iha foho leet nee iha mate ruin barak tebes, no mate ruin nee maran dekor ona.
verses.3: Nai husu mai hau, “Ema nia oan, mate ruin nee bele moris fali ka?” No hau hataan, “Oh Nai Maromak, O mak hatene.”
verses.4: Depois Nia dehan mai hau, “Profesia ba mate ruin nee, no dehan ba sira, Oh mate ruin nebee maran, rona liafuan hosi Nai.
verses.5: Nai Maromak hatete nunee ba mate ruin: Tebes, Hau sei halo iis tama ba imi, no imi sei moris fali.
verses.6: No Hau sei tau uat ba imi, no halo isin mosu ba imi, no taka imi ho kulit, no tau iis iha imi nia laran. Imi sei moris fali, no imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.”
verses.7: Entaun hau foo sai profesia tuir orden nebee hau hetan. No bainhira hau profesia hela, lian mosu mai, no tebes, rai nakdoko, no mate ruin nee tutan hamutuk, ruin kona ninia ruin.
verses.8: No hau haree, no tebes, uat mosu mai ba sira, no sira hetan isin, no kulit taka sira. Maibee sira nia iis la iha.
verses.9: Depois Nai dehan mai hau, “Profesia ba iis; profesia ba, ema nia oan, no dehan ba iis nee, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Mai lai hosi anin haat, Oh iis, no huu ba ema mate sira nee hodi sira bele moris fali.”
verses.10: Entaun hau foo sai profesia nee tuir Ninia orden mai hau. No iis tama ba sira, no sira moris fali no sira hamriik iha sira nia ain, forsa militár ida nebee boot tebes.
verses.11: Depois Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, mate ruin nee mak uma kain tomak hosi Israel. Tebes, sira dehan, ‘Ami nia mate ruin sai maran ona, no ami nia esperansa nee lakon ona. Loos duni ami nia iis kotu ona.’
verses.12: Nunee profesia ba, no dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei loke imi nia rate sira. Hau sei hasae imi hosi imi nia rate sira nee, Oh Hau nia povu. No Hau sei lori imi tama ba rai Israel.
verses.13: No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, bainhira Hau loke imi nia rate sira, no hasae imi hosi imi nia rate sira nee, Oh Hau nia povu.
verses.14: No Hau sei tau Hau nia Espíritu iha imi nia laran. Imi sei moris fali no Hau sei tau imi iha imi nia rai rasik. Depois imi sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai. Hau koalia tiha ona, no Hau sei halo ida nee, hatete Nai.”
verses.15: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.16: “Ema nia oan, foti ai ida no hakerek iha ai nee, ‘Ba Judá, no povu Israel nebee hamutuk ho nia.’ Depois foti ai ida fali no hakerek iha ai nee, ‘Ba José (ai Efraim nian) no uma kain tomak hosi Israel nebee hamutuk ho nia.’
verses.17: No hatutan ai ida ba ai seluk nee, hodi sira sai ida deit iha o nia liman.
verses.18: No bainhira o nia povu husu o, ‘O sei foo hatene ai sira nee nia signifikadu ka lae?’
verses.19: dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau atu foti ai José (nebee iha Efraim nia liman) no suku Israel nebee hamutuk ho nia. No Hau sei hatutan ai Judá ba nia, no halo sira sai ai ida deit, hodi sira bele sai ida deit iha Hau nia liman.
verses.20: Bainhira ai sira nee, nebee o hakerek, mak iha o nia liman ona, no o mak iha sira nia oin,
verses.21: depois dehan ba sira, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei foti povu Israel hosi nasaun sira nia leet nebee sira baa tiha ona, no Hau sei halibur sira hosi sor-sorin, no lori sira ba sira nia rai rasik.
verses.22: No Hau sei halo sira sai nasaun ida deit iha rai nee, iha foho Israel. No liurai ida sei sai liurai ba sira hotu, no sira sei la hela tan nudar nasaun rua, no sira sei la fahe tan ba reinu rua.
verses.23: Sira sei la halo tan sira nia aan sai foer ho sira nia ai riin lulik sira no sira nia alat aat tebes nee. Sira sei la hafoer aan ho sira nia sala oi-oin nebee kontra Hau. Maibee Hau sei salva sira hosi sira nia hahalok nebee fila ba kotuk nebee sira sala ona nee, no Hau sei hamoos sira. Sira sei sai Hau nia povu, no Hau sei sai sira nia Maromak.
verses.24: “Hau nia atan David sei sai liurai hodi ukun sira, no sira hotu sei iha bibi atan ida deit. Sira sei lao tuir Hau nia regulamentu sira no sira sei kuidadu atu halo tuir Hau nia estatutu sira.
verses.25: Sira sei hela iha rai nee nebee Hau foo ona ba Hau nia atan Jacó, iha fatin nebee uluk imi nia bei-ala sira hela. Sira no sira nia oan sira no sira nia bei-oan sira sei hela iha nebaa too tinan ba tinan. No David, Hau nia atan, sei hela nudar sira nia ukun nain too tinan ba tinan.
verses.26: Hau sei halo aliansa dame nian ho sira. Aliansa nee sei sai aliansa nebee metin ho sira too tinan ba tinan. No Hau sei rai sira no habarak sira, no Hau sei tau Hau nia Fatin Santu iha sira nia leet too tinan ba tinan.
verses.27: Hau nia hela fatin sei hamutuk ho sira. Hau sei sai sira nia Maromak no sira sei sai Hau nia povu.
verses.28: Depois nasaun sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai nebee konsagra Israel, bainhira Hau nia Fatin Santu mak iha sira nia leet too tinan ba tinan.”

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan mai hau:
verses.2: “Ema nia oan, see o nia oin ba Gog, iha rai Magog, ba xefi ukun nain hosi Mesek no Tubal. Foo sai profesia hasoru nia
verses.3: no dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau kontra hasoru o, Oh Gog, xefi ukun nain hosi Mesek no Tubal.
verses.4: No Hau sei halo o fila fali no tau besi kait iha o nia hasan ruin. Hau sei lori o sai, no o nia forsa militár tomak, kuda no ema nebee lori kuda, soldadu hotu nebee hatais kompletu, forsa ida nebee boot tebes, soldadu hotu nebee iha eskudu kiik no boot, no kaer surik.
verses.5: Persia, Etiópia, no Put mak hamutuk ho sira, no soldadu hotu nee iha eskudu no kapaseti;
verses.6: Gomer no ninia forsa hotu; Bet-Togarma hosi fatin dook iha parte norte liu ho ninia forsa hotu - povu barak nebee hamutuk ho o.
verses.7: “O tenki prontu, no hela prontu nafatin, o no o nia forsa sira hotu nebee forma haleu o. O tenki sai ema seguransa ba sira.
verses.8: Liu tiha loron barak, o tenki halibur hamutuk. Iha tempu ikus, o tenki baa hasoru rai nebee ema foin hadia hosi tempu funu, rai nebee iha povu nebee halibur hamutuk hosi povu barak iha foho Israel, nebee uluk rai maran hela deit. Rai nia povu nee sai hosi povu sira nebee agora hela hakmatek, ema hotu nee.
verses.9: O tenki avansa ba, no hasoru sira nudar anin boot. O sei sai hanesan kalohan nebee taka rai nee, o no o nia forsa sira hotu, no povu barak nebee hamutuk ho o.
verses.10: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Iha loron nebaa, ideia ruma sei tama o nia kakutak, no o sei halo planu aat
verses.11: no dehan, ‘Hau sei sae ba no hasoru rai nee nebee iha aldeia nebee moru la iha. Hau sei ataka povu nebee hakmatek no hela seguru. Ema hotu nee hela iha fatin nebee moru la iha, no sira la iha besi lolon ka portaun.’
verses.12: No o hakarak hadau sira nia sasaan no lori sai riku-soin. Fila o nia liman hodi hasoru fatin maran nebee agora ema hela, no povu nebee halibur hamutuk hosi nasaun sira, nebee hetan animál no sasaan, nebee hela iha mundu nia klaran.
verses.13: Seba, Dedan no negosiante sira hosi Tarsis no sira nia lideransa sira hotu sei dehan ba o, ‘O mai hodi hadau riku-soin ka? O halibur ona o nia forsa sira hodi lori sai sasaan ka, hodi lori sai osan mutin no osan mean, hodi foti sai animál hakiak sira no sasaan, hodi hadau riku-soin boot ka?’
verses.14: “Nunee, ema nia oan, profesia ba, no dehan ba Gog, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Iha loron nebaa, bainhira Hau nia povu Israel hela seguru, laos o hatene ka?
verses.15: O sei mai hosi o nia fatin dook iha parte norte liu, o no povu barak nebee hamutuk ho o, no sira hotu sae kuda, forsa boot no militár nebee forti.
verses.16: O sei sai mai hasoru Hau nia povu Israel, hanesan kalohan nebee taka rai. Iha tempu ikus, Hau sei lori o hasoru Hau nia rai, hodi nasaun sira bele konhese Hau, kuandu liu hosi o, Oh Gog, Hau bele hatudu katak Hau nia santidade mak loos iha sira nia oin.
verses.17: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: O mak nia nebee Hau koalia iha tempu uluk liu hosi Hau nia atan profeta sira hosi Israel ka? Iha tempu nebee sira foo sai profesia durante tinan barak, sira profesia katak Hau sei lori o baa hasoru sira ka?
verses.18: Maibee iha loron nebaa, iha loron nebee Gog sei mai hasoru rai Israel, hatete Nai Maromak, Hau nia laran manas sei aumenta iha Hau nia laran hirus.
verses.19: Tanba iha Hau nia laran moras no iha Hau nia laran manas tebes Hau foo sai katak iha loron nebaa rai sei nakdoko makaas iha Israel.
verses.20: Ikan iha tasi, manu iha loro leten, animál hotu iha rai luan, buat hotu nebee dolar iha rai, no povu hotu nebee iha mundu laran sei nakdedar iha Hau nia prezensa. Foho sei riba tuun, no fatuk lolon sei monu, no moru hotu sei monu rahun ba rai.
verses.21: Hau sei bolu surik ida hodi hasoru Gog iha Hau nia foho hotu, hatete Nai Maromak. Ema ida-idak nia surik sei hasoru ninia maluk.
verses.22: Hau sei tesi lia ba nia ho moras peste no raan nebee fakar, no Hau sei haraik udan ba nia no ninia forsa sira no povu barak nebee hamutuk ho nia. Udan boot, udan jelu fatuk, ahi no fatuk klaak sei tuun ba nia.
verses.23: Nunee Hau sei hatudu Hau nia glória no Hau nia santidade no halo hodi nasaun barak konhese Hau. Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.

verses.1: “No o, ema nia oan, profesia hasoru Gog no dehan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau kontra hasoru o, Oh Gog, xefi ukun nain hosi Mesek no Tubal.
verses.2: Hau sei fila o no dudu o ba oin. Hau sei lori o sae mai hosi fatin dook liu iha parte norte. Hau sei lori o hodi hasoru foho Israel.
verses.3: Depois Hau sei baku sai o nia rama inan hosi o nia liman karuk. No Hau sei halo o nia rama oan sira monu sai hosi o nia liman loos.
verses.4: O sei monu iha foho Israel, o no o nia forsa sira hotu no povu sira nebee hamutuk ho o. Hau sei foo o ba manu oi-oin nebee hanesan makikit no animál fuik iha rai luan hodi tolan o.
verses.5: O sei monu iha rai luan, tanba Hau koalia tiha ona, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.6: Hau sei haruka ahi tuun ba Magog no ba sira nebee hela seguru iha ilha sira. No sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai.
verses.7: “No Hau sei halo hodi Hau nia povu Israel hatene Hau nia naran santu, no Hau sei la husik ema atu hafoer tan Hau nia naran santu. Nasaun sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, Ida Nebee Santu iha Israel.
verses.8: Tebes, ida nee sei mai no ida nee sei halao duni, hatete Nai Maromak. Hau koalia tiha ona kona ba loron ida nee.
verses.9: “Depois sira nebee hela iha sidade sira iha Israel sei sai ba no halo ahi ho armas no sunu sasaan nee, eskudu boot no eskudu kiik, rama inan no rama oan sira, ai tonka no dima sira. Sira sei halo ahi hodi sunu buat sira nee too tinan hitu.
verses.10: Nunee sira sei la presiza baa hili ai hosi rai luan ka taa ai hosi ai laran, tanba sira sei uza armas nee hodi halo sira nia ahi. Sira sei foti riku-soin hosi sira nebee uluk foti riku-soin hosi sira. Sira sei hadau sasaan hosi sira nebee uluk hadau sasaan hosi sira, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.11: “Iha loron nebaa Hau sei foo rate fatin ba Gog iha Israel, nebee Foho Leet Ba Ema Lao Rai, nebee iha tasi nia sorin lorosae. Fatin nee sei taka netik dalan ba ema lao rai. Tanba iha nebaa sira sei hakoi Gog no ninia lubun tomak. Ema sei bolu fatin nee Foho Leet Hamon-Gog.
verses.12: Uma kain Israel sei hakoi sira too fulan hitu hodi hamoos rai nee.
verses.13: Povu hotu iha rai nee sei hakoi sira, no sira sei hetan konhesidu iha loron nebee Hau hatudu Hau nia glória, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.14: Sira sei haketak ema no foo knaar hodi sira bele lao ba-mai beibeik liu hosi rai nee. No sira sei hakoi ema lao rai sira nebee sei iha rai leten hodi hamoos rai nee. Sira sei buka mate isin too fulan hitu.
verses.15: No bainhira ema sira nee lao liu hosi rai nee no ema naran deit haree mate ruin ida, entaun nia sei tau sinál iha mate ruin nee too sira nebee iha knaar atu hakoi sei mai hodi hakoi mate ruin nee iha Foho Leet Hamon-Gog.
verses.16: (Sidade nia naran iha nebaa mos Hamona.) Nunee sira sei hamoos rai nee.
verses.17: “Kona ba o, ema nia oan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Koalia ba manu oi-oin no animál hotu iha rai luan: ‘Halibur hamutuk no mai hosi fatin hotu ba festa sakrifísiu nian nebee Hau sei prepara hela ba imi. Hau prepara festa boot sakrifísiu nian iha foho Israel, no imi sei haan naan no hemu raan.
verses.18: Imi sei haan asuwain sira nia isin, no hemu raan hosi mundu nia ukun nain sira - hosi bibi malae aman, bibi malae oan, bibi timor aman, karau aman no animál bokur hotu hosi Basan.
verses.19: No imi sei haan bokur too imi bosu, no hemu raan too imi lanu, iha festa sakrifísiu nian nebee Hau prepara hela ba imi.
verses.20: No imi sei sai bosu iha Hau nia meza ho kuda no ema sira nebee lori kuda, ho asuwain sira no funu nain oi-oin,’ hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.21: “No Hau sei tau Hau nia glória iha nasaun sira nia leet, no nasaun sira hotu sei haree Hau nia julgamentu nebee Hau halao, no Hau nia liman nebee Hau tau ba sira.
verses.22: Uma kain Israel sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, sira nia Maromak, hosi loron nee ba oin.
verses.23: No nasaun sira sei hatene katak uma kain Israel tama ba kastigu tanba sira nia hahalok aat, tanba sira bosok Hau too Hau subar Hau nia oin hosi sira no foo sira ba sira nia inimigu sira nia liman. Nunee sira hotu monu liu hosi surik.
verses.24: Hau halo ba sira tuir sira nia hahalok nebee la moos no tuir sira nia hahalok nebee kontra Hau. No Hau subar Hau nia oin hosi sira.
verses.25: “Nunee Nai Maromak hatete: Agora Hau sei halo diak fali ema Jacó nia moris. Hau sei hatudu laran luak ba uma kain tomak iha Israel. Hau sei hatudu laran manas ba Hau nia naran santu.
verses.26: Sira sei haluha sira nia moe no sira nia hahalok bosok hotu nebee uluk sira halo hodi kontra Hau. Sira sei hela seguru iha sira nia rai no la iha ema ida nebee halo sira tauk.
verses.27: Hau sei lori sira mai hosi povu sira no halibur sira hosi sira nia inimigu sira nia rai. No liu hosi sira, Hau sei hatudu iha nasaun barak nia oin katak Hau nia santidade mak loos.
verses.28: Depois sira sei hatene katak Hau mak Nai, sira nia Maromak, tanba Hau haruka sira tama kastigu iha nasaun sira nia leet no tuir mai Hau halibur sira ba sira nia rai rasik. Hau sei la husik ema ida hosi sira iha nasaun sira nia leet.
verses.29: No Hau sei la subar tan Hau nia oin hosi sira. Hau sei fui sai Hau nia Espíritu ba uma kain Israel, hatete Nai Maromak.”

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala rua-nulu resin lima iha ami nia fatin kastigu, bainhira tinan nee hahuu, iha loron sanulu iha fulan nee, nebee liu tiha tinan sanulu resin haat hosi tempu nebee sidade Jerusalém mak lakon, iha loron nee duni, Nai nia liman kona hau, no Nia lori hau ba fatin nee.
verses.2: Liu hosi vizaun Maromak nian Nia lori hau ba rai Israel, no tau hau iha foho aas tebes nebee iha fatin ida nebee hanesan sidade iha parte súl.
verses.3: Bainhira Nia lori hau too nebaa, tebes, hau haree mane ida nebee iha oin hanesan besi riti. Nia iha tali linhu no ai sukat iha ninia liman. No nia hamriik iha portaun.
verses.4: No mane ida nee dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, haree ba ho o nia matan, no rona ba ho o nia tilun, no see o nia fuan laran ba buat hotu nebee hau sei hatudu ba o. Tanba Nia lori o mai iha nee hodi hau bele hatudu buat sira nee ba o. Foo sai buat hotu nebee o haree ba uma kain Israel.”
verses.5: No tebes, hau haree moru nebee haleu Templu nia fatin. Ai sukat nebee iha mane nee nia liman mak naruk hanesan ema sukat ho liman dala neen. (Sukat ho liman dala ida nee naruk hanesan sukat baibain ho aumenta tan liman rohan ida.) Entaun nia sukat moru nee, mahar ai sukat ida; no moru nee aas ai sukat ida.
verses.6: Depois nia tama portaun iha sorin lorosae. Nia sae fatin nee nia eskada no sukat tama fatin iha portaun nee, nebee ai sukat ida. No iha fatin laran nee luan ai sukat ida.
verses.7: No kuartu iha sorin, naruk ai sukat ida no luan ai sukat ida. Fatin nebee entre kuartu sira iha sorin nee luan metru rua ho balu. No portaun nia tama fatin nebee iha portaun nia varanda iha laran nee luan ai sukat ida.
verses.8: Depois nia sukat mos portaun nia varanda iha laran nee, nebee ai sukat ida.
verses.9: Depois nia sukat portaun nia varanda nee mak metru haat. No riin iha sor-sorin nee metru ida. Portaun nia varanda nee mak iha laran.
verses.10: No Portaun Lorosae iha kuartu tolu iha sor-sorin. Kuartu tolu nee luan hanesan, no sira nia riin iha sor-sorin nee sukat hanesan.
verses.11: Depois nia sukat fatin nebee tama portaun nee, nebee metru lima. No portaun nee naruk metru neen ho balu.
verses.12: Molok kuartu sira nebee iha sor-sorin, fatin nee iha didin badak nebee luan sentímetru lima-nulu iha sor-sorin. No kuartu sira nebee iha sor-sorin nee luan metru tolu.
verses.13: Depois nia sukat portaun hosi kuartu nia leten iha sorin ida too iha kuartu nia leten iha sorin seluk. No fatin nee luan metru sanulu resin rua ho balu. No odamatan hateke ba malu.
verses.14: Nia sukat mos riin fatin nebee metru tolu-nulu, nebee too iha ai riin iha pátiu nebee iha portaun.
verses.15: Hosi portaun nia oin nebee tama primeiru too iha portaun nia oin nebee tama ba fatin iha laran liu nee mak metru rua-nulu resin lima.
verses.16: No portaun fatin nee iha janela sira iha sor-sorin nebee sai kloot liu iha laran, nebee iha kuartu laran, no sira nia riin sira. No hanesan nee varanda iha laran mos iha janela sira iha laran ho riin sira nebee halo dezenhu hanesan ai palma.
verses.17: Depois nia lori hau tama ba pátiu iha liur. No tebes, fatin nee iha kuartu sira no lao fatin nebee haleu pátiu nee iha sor-sorin. Kuartu tolu-nulu hateke ba lao fatin nee.
verses.18: No lao fatin nee tuir fatin iha portaun sira nia sorin nebee naruk hanesan portaun sira. Nee mak fatin lao nebee iha kraik.
verses.19: Depois nia sukat hosi portaun iha kraik nee nia laran too iha portaun nia oin nebee atu tama ba pátiu iha laran. Nia sukat metru lima-nulu iha sorin lorosae no iha sorin norte.
verses.20: Kona ba portaun nebee hateke ba parte norte, nebee iha Templu nia fatin liur, nia sukat portaun nee nia naruk no luan.
verses.21: Portaun nia kuartu sira, nebee iha tolu iha sor-sorin, no sira nia riin sira no varanda mak luan hanesan portaun primeiru. Nia naruk metru rua-nulu resin lima no luan metru sanulu resin rua ho balu.
verses.22: No portaun nia janela sira, varanda no ai palma nee sukat hanesan ho sasaan nee hosi portaun nebee hateke ba lorosae. No povu bele sae ba portaun nee liu hosi eskada nebee iha hakat hitu, no sira hetan varanda iha oin.
verses.23: No iha Portaun Norte nia oin iha portaun nebee tama ba pátiu iha laran, hanesan sorin lorosae nian. No nia sukat hosi portaun ba portaun no hetan metru lima-nulu.
verses.24: Depois nia lori hau ba parte súl, no tebes, parte súl nee iha portaun ida. Nia sukat portaun nia riin sira no varanda nebee luan hanesan portaun seluk.
verses.25: Portaun nee no ninia varanda iha janela iha sor-sorin, hanesan portaun seluk nia janela sira. Portaun nee naruk metru rua-nulu resin lima no luan metru sanulu resin rua ho balu.
verses.26: No fatin nee iha eskada ho hakat hitu hodi sae ba portaun nee no iha varanda iha oin. Fatin nee iha ai palma iha riin sira, nebee dezenhu ida iha sorin mai no dezenhu ida iha sorin ba.
verses.27: No fatin nee iha portaun iha sorin súl nebee tama ba pátiu iha laran. No nia sukat hosi portaun ba portaun iha sorin súl no hetan metru lima-nulu.
verses.28: Depois nia lori hau ba pátiu iha laran liu hosi Portaun Súl, no nia sukat Portaun Súl. Portaun nee luan hanesan sira seluk.
verses.29: Ninia kuartu iha sorin, riin sira no varanda nee luan hanesan sira seluk. No portaun no varanda iha janela sira nebee iha sor-sorin. Fatin nee naruk metru rua-nulu resin lima no luan metru sanulu resin rua ho balu.
verses.30: No varanda haleu fatin nee no naruk metru sanulu resin rua ho balu no luan metru rua ho balu.
verses.31: Varanda nee hateke ba pátiu iha liur, no riin nee iha dezenhu ai palma sira. Eskada nee iha hakat ualu.
verses.32: Depois nia lori hau ba pátiu iha laran iha sorin lorosae no nia sukat portaun iha nebaa. Portaun nee luan hanesan sira seluk.
verses.33: Ninia kuartu sira, no riin sira no varanda nee sukat hanesan ho sira seluk. Fatin nee no ninia varanda iha janela iha sor-sorin. Fatin nee naruk metru rua-nulu resin lima no nia luan metru sanulu resin rua ho balu.
verses.34: Ninia varanda hateke ba pátiu iha liur, no riin nee iha dezenhu ai palma sira. Eskada nee iha hakat ualu.
verses.35: Depois nia lori hau ba Portaun Norte no nia sukat fatin nee. Portaun nee luan hanesan sira seluk.
verses.36: Ninia kuartu sira, no riin sira no varanda nee sukat hanesan ho sira seluk. Fatin nee iha janela iha sor-sorin. Fatin nee naruk metru rua-nulu resin lima no nia luan metru sanulu resin rua ho balu.
verses.37: Varanda nee hateke ba pátiu iha liur, no riin nee iha dezenhu ai palma sira iha sor-sorin. Eskada nee iha hakat ualu.
verses.38: Fatin nee iha kuartu ida no ninia odamatan nebee tama ba varanda iha portaun. No iha nebaa sira fasi sakrifísiu tunu motuk.
verses.39: No varanda iha portaun nee iha meza rua iha sor-sorin. Iha meza sira nee ema bele oho sakrifísiu tunu motuk, sakrifísiu sala nian no sakrifísiu multa nian.
verses.40: No iha fatin nebee atu sae ba no tama ba Portaun Norte, nee mos iha meza rua. No iha portaun nia varanda nia sorin iha meza rua.
verses.41: Nunee meza nain haat iha portaun nia sor-sorin, hamutuk meza ualu, hodi oho sakrifísiu sira.
verses.42: No fatin nee iha meza haat nebee halo ho fatuk nebee halo siku hodi uza ba sakrifísiu tunu motuk. Meza sira nee naruk sentímetru hitu-nulu resin lima no luan sentímetru hitu-nulu resin lima no aas sentímetru lima-nulu. Sira bele rai sasaan iha meza nee hodi uza bainhira atu oho sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu sira seluk.
verses.43: No fatin nee iha besi kait sira nebee naruk hanesan liman ida nebee taka iha sor-sorin. No ema bele rai naan iha meza sira nebee mai hosi sakrifísiu.
verses.44: Iha portaun nebee tama ba iha laran, iha portaun nee nia sorin liu, iha kuartu rua nebee iha pátiu laran. Kuartu ida iha Portaun Norte nia sorin nebee hateke ba parte súl, no iha ida fali iha Portaun Súl nebee hateke ba parte norte.
verses.45: Nia dehan mai hau, “Saserdote sira nebee lori knaar hodi tau matan ba Templu bele uza kuartu ida nee, nebee hateke ba parte súl.
verses.46: No saserdote sira nebee iha knaar hodi tau matan ba altár bele uza kuartu nebee hateke ba parte norte. Ema sira nee mak Zadok nia oan mane sira, no ema sira nee hosi Levi nia oan mane sira bele hakbesik ba Nai hodi serví ba Nia.”
verses.47: No nia sukat pátiu nee, nebee fatin kuadradu naruk metru lima-nulu no luan metru lima-nulu. No altár mak iha Templu nia oin.
verses.48: Depois nia lori hau ba Templu nia varanda no nia sukat riin sira iha varanda nee, nebee metru rua ho balu iha sor-sorin. No portaun nee luan metru hitu, no didin iha portaun nia sorin mak metru ida ho balu iha sor-sorin.
verses.49: Varanda nee naruk metru sanulu no luan metru neen. No povu bele sae ba fatin nee liu hosi eskada nebee iha hakat sanulu. No fatin nee iha riin fatuk iha odamatan nia riin iha sor-sorin.

verses.1: Depois nia lori hau ba Templu no sukat fatin nee nia riin sira. Riin sira nee luan metru tolu.
verses.2: No fatin atu tama nee luan metru lima. Didin iha fatin tama nia sor-sorin nee luan metru rua ho balu. Nia sukat fatin nee nia naruk metru rua-nulu no luan metru sanulu.
verses.3: Depois nia tama ba fatin iha laran liu no sukat riin sira iha tama fatin nee luan metru ida. Tama fatin nee luan metru tolu, no didin iha sor-sorin iha tama fatin nee mak luan metru tolu ho balu.
verses.4: No nia sukat kuartu ida nee, iha Templu laran, nebee naruk metru sanulu no luan metru sanulu. Nia dehan mai hau, “Fatin nee mak Fatin Santu Liu.”
verses.5: Depois nia sukat Templu nia didin nebee mahar metru tolu. No kuartu iha sor-sorin nebee haleu Templu nee luan metru rua.
verses.6: No kuartu sira iha sorin nee iha andar tolu. Kuartu ida-idak mak iha kuartu iha kraik nia leten. Andar ida-idak iha kuartu tolu-nulu. Sira iha fatin nebee haleu Templu nia didin hodi foo suporta ba kuartu sira iha sorin nee. Ho nunee didin Templu nian la foo suporta ba kuartu sira nee.
verses.7: No andar iha leten nebee iha kuartu sira nee mak luan liu fali ninia andar iha okos. No sira taka Templu nia sor-sorin too iha leten. Nunee Templu iha fatin luan iha leten. Ema nebee sae hosi andar kraik ba andar leten tenki lao liu hosi andar iha klaran.
verses.8: Hau haree mos katak Templu iha fatin aas nebee haleu Templu. Kuartu iha sorin nee luan hanesan ai sukat ida nebee metru tolu.
verses.9: Kuartu iha sorin nia didin iha liur nee mahar metru rua ho balu. Fatin luan nebee entre Templu nia kuartu sira nebee iha sorin no
verses.10: kuartu seluk nee mak luan metru sanulu. No fatin luan nee haleu Templu iha sor-sorin.
verses.11: No odamatan ba kuartu iha sorin nee loke ba fatin luan. Odamatan ida loke ba parte norte no odamatan seluk loke ba parte súl. No fatin nee mak luan metru rua ho balu iha sor-sorin.
verses.12: Uma nebee hateke ba fatin luan iha sorin loromonu nee luan metru tolu-nulu resin lima. Didin ba uma nee mahar metru rua ho balu iha sor-sorin no nia naruk metru haat-nulu resin lima.
verses.13: Depois nia sukat Templu nebee naruk metru lima-nulu, no fatin luan nee ho uma no didin nee naruk metru lima-nulu.
verses.14: Iha Templu nia sorin lorosae no fatin luan nee luan metru lima-nulu.
verses.15: Depois nia sukat uma nebee hateke ba fatin luan nebee iha kotuk, no uma nee no ninia varanda iha sor-sorin nee hamutuk naruk metru lima-nulu. Sira taka ai iha fatin sira nee: iha fatin tama ba laran, iha varanda ba pátiu,
verses.16: odamatan, janela kloot, no varanda nebee haleu sorin tolu nebee iha fatin tama nia oin. Sira taka ai iha sor-sorin, hosi rai too iha janela. Sira taka mos janela sira.
verses.17: Sira taka fatin iha odamatan nia leten too iha kuartu iha laran no iha liur. No iha didin hotu iha sor-sorin. Iha laran no iha liur sira halo dezenhu nebee sukat lo-loos.
verses.18: Sira halo dezenhu nebee iha kerubim no ai palma sira. Nebee sira halo ai palma entre kerubim ida no kerubim seluk. Kerubim ida-idak iha oin rua:
verses.19: ema nia oin hateke ba ai palma iha sorin ida, no liaun aman nia oin hateke ba ai palma iha sorin seluk. Sira halo dezenhu nee iha Templu tomak iha sor-sorin.
verses.20: Hosi rai too iha odamatan nia leten sira halo kerubim no ai palma sira. No sira halo hanesan nee iha didin ba fatin tama.
verses.21: Sira halo riin siku iha fatin tama. No iha Fatin Santu nia oin iha buat ida nebee iha oin hanesan
verses.22: altár ida nebee halo ho ai, nebee aas metru ida ho balu, naruk metru ida no luan metru ida. Ninia lidun, okos no didin halo ho ai. Ema nee dehan mai hau, “Ida nee mak meza nebee iha Nai nia oin.”
verses.23: Fatin tama no Fatin Santu iha odamatan tahan rua.
verses.24: Odamatan ida-idak nee iha tahan rua nebee bele loke.
verses.25: No iha odamatan nebee iha fatin tama nee iha dezenhu ho kerubim no ai palma sira nebee hanesan ho dezenhu iha didin. No sira halo uma tatiis ho ai nebee iha fatin tama nia liur.
verses.26: No fatin nee iha janela kloot no ai palma sira iha sor-sorin. Sira halo janela nee iha didin iha fatin tama, iha Templu nia kuartu sira iha sorin no iha fatin tatiis sira nee.

verses.1: Depois nia lori hau sai ba pátiu iha liur, iha sorin norte. No nia lori hau ba kuartu sira nebee iha fatin ketak nee nia oin no iha uma norte nia oin.
verses.2: Uma nebee iha odamatan ba sorin norte nee naruk metru lima-nulu, no luan metru rua-nulu resin lima.
verses.3: Uma nee iha andar nebee iha andar leten fali too andar tolu. Uma andar nee iha parte ida nebee iha pátiu iha laran, no parte ida nebee hateke ba lao fatin iha pátiu iha liur.
verses.4: No iha kuartu sira nia oin iha lao fatin nebee tama ba laran nebee luan metru lima no naruk metru lima-nulu. Sira nia odamatan mak iha sorin norte.
verses.5: Kuartu sira iha leten mak kloot liu fali kuartu sira nebee iha andar klaran no iha andar kraik tanba varanda sira okupa fatin iha leten.
verses.6: Tanba kuartu sira nee iha andar tolu. Sira la iha ai riin sira hanesan ai riin sira nebee iha pátiu ohin sira nee. Nunee kuartu sira iha leten mak tama ba kotuk kompara ho kuartu sira iha kraik no iha klaran.
verses.7: No fatin nee iha moru iha liur nebee tuir kuartu sira nee. Moru nee iha pátiu iha liur, iha kuartu sira nia oin. No moru nee naruk metru rua-nulu resin lima.
verses.8: Tanba kuartu sira iha pátiu liur nebee naruk metru rua-nulu resin lima. Maibee kuartu sira nebee iha Templu oin mak naruk metru lima-nulu.
verses.9: Iha kuartu sira nee nia okos iha fatin tama nebee iha sorin lorosae, iha fatin nebee ema tama kuartu sira nee hosi pátiu iha liur.
verses.10: Iha pátiu nia moru nebee mahar nee, iha parte súl mos, no iha fatin luan nia oin no iha uma nee nia oin, fatin sira nee iha kuartu sira.
verses.11: Kuartu sira nee iha lao fatin iha sira nia oin. No kuartu sira nee mak hanesan ho kuartu sira nebee iha parte norte. Sira naruk no luan hanesan. Sira nia fatin atu sai odamatan nee iha modelu hanesan.
verses.12: No mos fatin atu tama ba kuartu sira iha parte súl nee mak hanesan. Sira iha fatin hodi tama ba lao fatin, nebee iha moru nia sorin, nebee iha sorin lorosae bainhira ema tama fatin nee.
verses.13: Depois Nia dehan mai hau, “Kuartu sira iha parte norte no parte súl nebee iha fatin luan nee nia oin mak kuartu sira nebee santu. Iha nebaa saserdote sira nebee hakbesik ba Nai sei haan oferta sira nebee santu liu - oferta trigu nian, sakrifísiu sala nian no sakrifísiu multa nian - tanba fatin nee mak santu.
verses.14: Bainhira saserdote sira tama Fatin Santu, sira sei la sai hosi fatin nee no tama kedas ba pátiu iha liur molok sira rai sira nia ropa iha nebaa nebee uza ba ministériu nee. Tanba ropa nee mak santu. Sira tenki hatais ropa seluk molok sira hakbesik ba fatin nebee iha povu.”
verses.15: Bainhira nia sukat tiha ona fatin iha Templu laran, nia lori hau sai liu hosi portaun nebee hateke ba parte lorosae. Depois nia sukat haleu Templu iha liur.
verses.16: Nia sukat sorin lorosae ho ai sukat, nebee metru atus rua lima-nulu tuir ai sukat nebee haleu fatin nee.
verses.17: Nia sukat sorin norte ho ai sukat, nebee metru atus rua lima-nulu tuir ai sukat nebee haleu fatin nee.
verses.18: Nia sukat sorin súl ho ai sukat, nebee metru atus rua lima-nulu tuir ai sukat.
verses.19: Depois nia fila ba sorin loromonu no sukat, metru atus rua lima-nulu tuir ai sukat.
verses.20: Nia sukat fatin nee iha sorin haat. No fatin nee iha moru nebee haleu nia, naruk metru atus rua lima-nulu no luan metru atus rua lima-nulu. Moru nee haketak buat nebee santu hosi buat nebee baibain.

verses.1: Depois nia lori hau ba portaun, portaun ida nebee hateke ba parte lorosae.
verses.2: No tebes, glória hosi Maromak iha Israel mai hosi parte lorosae. No lian hosi Nia bainhira Nia mai hela mak hanesan lian hosi bee boot, no rai nee sai nabilan ho Ninia glória.
verses.3: No vizaun nebee hau haree nee mak hanesan deit ho vizaun nebee hau haree uluk bainhira Nia mai hodi harahun sidade nee, no hanesan deit ho vizaun nebee hau haree uluk iha Mota Kebar nia ninin. No hau monu ho oin ba rai.
verses.4: Bainhira Nai nia glória tama Templu liu hosi portaun nebee hateke ba parte lorosae,
verses.5: Espíritu nee foti sae hau no lori hau tama ba pátiu iha laran; no tebes, Templu nee sai nakonu ho Nai nia glória.
verses.6: Bainhira ema nee hamriik hela iha hau nia sorin, hau rona lian ida nebee koalia mai hau hosi Templu laran.
verses.7: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, fatin nee mak Hau nia kadunan nia fatin no fatin nebee Hau nia ain sei lao. No iha nee Hau sei hela iha ema Israel sira nia leet too tinan ba tinan. No uma kain Israel sei la hafoer tan Hau nia naran santu, laos sira, no laos sira nia liurai sira, liu hosi sira nia adultériu ka liu hosi sira nia liurai sira nia mate isin nebee iha sira nia fatin aas.
verses.8: Uluk sira halo sira nia tama fatin besik Hau nia tama fatin, no sira nia odamatan nia riin sira besik Hau nia odamatan nia riin sira. No iha didin ida deit nebee haketak Hau no sira. Sira mak hafoer ona Hau nia naran santu liu hosi sira nia hahalok foer nebee sira halao ona. Nunee Hau halakon ona sira ho Hau nia laran hirus.
verses.9: Agora, husik sira hasai sira nia adultériu no sira nia liurai nia mate isin no hadook buat sira nee hosi Hau. No Hau sei hela iha sira nia leet too tinan ba tinan.
verses.10: “Kona ba o, ema nia oan, konta Templu nee ba uma kain Israel, hodi sira bele sai moe kona ba sira nia hahalok aat. No sira sei sukat tuir planu nee.
verses.11: No se sira moe kona ba buat hotu nebee sira halo ona, entaun foo hatene ba sira kona ba Templu nia dezenhu, oinsaa kona ba fatin nee, fatin tama no fatin sai, nebee ninia dezenhu tomak. Foo hatene mos ba sira kona ba fatin nee nia estatutu hotu no ninia dezenhu tomak no ninia lei hotu. Hakerek liafuan nee iha sira nia oin hodi sira sei halo tuir fatin nee nia lei hotu no estatutu hotu, no halo tuir liafuan nee.
verses.12: Ida nee mak lei Templu nian: área tomak iha foho leten, área hotu nebee haleu fatin nee, mak santu liu. Tebes, ida nee mak lei Templu nian.
verses.13: “Ida nee mak altár nia medida liu hosi sukat naruk (nebee sukat baibain no aumenta liman ida): ninia palku huun nee sae sentímetru lima-nulu no tama sentímetru lima-nulu, ho ninin iha leten nebee sukat liman ida. Altár nee aas hanesan nee:
verses.14: hosi palku huun iha rai sae too iha palku segundu nia leten nee, metru ida, no tama sentímetru lima-nulu fali. No hosi palku segunda sae too palku terseiru nia leten nee, metru rua, no tama sentímetru lima-nulu.
verses.15: Altár nia sunu fatin nee aas metru rua. No hosi altár nia leten dikur haat sae.
verses.16: Altár nia leten nee mak kuadradu. Nia naruk metru neen no luan metru neen.
verses.17: Ninia ninin mos kuadradu, nebee naruk metru hitu no luan metru hitu. No fatin nee iha didin badak nebee luan sentímetru rua-nulu resin lima. Nia iha huun nebee sentímetru lima-nulu nebee haleu fatin nee. No altár nia eskada mak hateke ba sorin lorosae.”
verses.18: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, Nai Maromak hatete nunee, Buat sira nee mak regulamentu kona ba altár: Iha loron nebee foin halo hotu altár hodi oferese sakrifísiu tunu motuk no hodi hisik raan ba altár leten,
verses.19: o tenki foo karau aman ba saserdote sira, nebee ema Levi sira hosi Zadok nia família, nebee hakbesik mai Hau hodi halao ministériu mai Hau, hatete Nai Maromak. O tenki foo karau aman ida hosi karau lubun hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian.
verses.20: No o tenki foti karau nia raan balu no kose ba altár nia dikur haat, no iha fatin nia lidun haat no iha ninin nebee haleu altár nee. Nunee o sei hamoos altár nee no taka sala kona ba altár.
verses.21: O tenki foti mos karau aman nebee sakrifísiu sala nian, no sira sei sunu nia iha fatin nebee ita hili, nebee fatin Templu nian, maibee iha liur hosi fatin santu nee.
verses.22: No iha loron segundu o sei oferese bibi timor aman nebee falta la iha nudar sakrifísiu sala nian. No o sei hamoos altár hanesan o hamoos tiha ona ho karau aman.
verses.23: Bainhira o hamoos hotu tiha fatin nee, o sei oferese karau aman ida nebee falta la iha hosi karau lubun, no bibi malae aman ida nebee falta la iha hosi bibi lubun.
verses.24: O sei aprezenta sira iha Nai nia oin, no saserdote sira sei fakar masin ba sira no oferese sira nudar sakrifísiu tunu motuk ba Nai.
verses.25: Durante loron hitu, sira sei foo loro-loron bibi timor aman nudar sakrifísiu sala nian, no karau aman hosi karau lubun, no bibi malae aman hosi bibi lubun, nebee falta la iha. Sira tenki foo buat sira nee.
verses.26: Durante loron hitu sira sei taka sala kona ba altár no hamoos altár nee. Nunee sira konsagra altár nee.
verses.27: No bainhira sira halo hotu iha loron sira nee, entaun hosi loron ualu ba oin, saserdote sira sei oferese imi nia sakrifísiu tunu motuk no oferta dame nian iha altár nee. No Hau sei simu imi, hatete Nai Maromak.”

verses.1: Depois nia lori fali hau ba Fatin Santu nia portaun iha liur, nebee hateke ba parte lorosae. No portaun nee taka ona.
verses.2: No Nai dehan mai hau, “Portaun nee sei taka nafatin. Ema sei la loke nia. Ema sei la tama liu hosi nia. Tanba Nai, Maromak iha Israel, mak tama ona liu hosi portaun nee. Nunee nia tenki taka nafatin.
verses.3: Só deit ukun nain bele tuur iha portaun laran hodi haan paun iha Nai nia oin. Nia sei tama liu hosi portaun nia varanda, no nia sei sai liu hosi fatin hanesan.”
verses.4: Depois nia lori hau liu hosi Portaun Norte nia dalan ba Templu nia oin, no hau haree, no tebes, Nai nia glória enxe nakonu Nai nia Templu. No hau monu ho oin ba rai.
verses.5: No Nai dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, foo atensaun diak, haree ho o nia matan, no rona ho o nia tilun ba buat hotu nebee Hau sei foo hatene ba o kona ba estatutu hotu hosi Nai nia Templu no Templu nia lei hotu. No foo atensaun diak ba fatin atu tama Templu no fatin hotu nebee bele sai hosi Fatin Santu nee.
verses.6: No dehan ba kontradór sira nee, ba uma kain Israel, Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Oh uma kain Israel, imi nia hahalok foer nee too ona.
verses.7: Imi husik estranjeiru sira bele tama, sira nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun iha fuan laran no iha isin, hodi tama ba Hau nia Fatin Santu. Imi hafoer Hau nia Templu, bainhira imi oferese Hau nia hahaan mai Hau, nebee bokur no raan. Imi hakotu Hau nia aliansa, no imi hatutan hahalok nee ba imi nia hahalok foer hotu.
verses.8: No imi la lori knaar kona ba Hau nia sasaan santu, maibee imi foo imi nia knaar nee ba ema seluk hodi tau matan ba Hau nia sasaan iha Hau nia Fatin Santu.
verses.9: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Ema estranjeiru, nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun iha fuan laran no isin, nebee mai hosi ema estranjeiru hotu nebee iha ema Israel sira nia leet, ema nee la bele tama Hau nia Fatin Santu.
verses.10: Maibee ema Levi sira nebee lao sai dook hosi Hau, no lao lakon hosi Hau hodi tuir sira nia ai riin lulik sira bainhira Israel lao lakon, sira sei simu sira nia kastigu tanba hahalok aat nee.
verses.11: Sira sei sai ema nebee serví iha Hau nia Fatin Santu. Sira sei hein iha Templu nia portaun sira no halao ministériu iha Templu. Sira sei oho sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu ba povu, no sira sei hamriik iha povu nia oin, hodi serví sira.
verses.12: Tanba ema Levi sira nee serví sira iha sira nia ai riin lulik sira nia oin no buat nee sai fatuk sidi nebee hahalok aat ba uma kain Israel, nunee Hau jura ona kona ba sira, hatete Nai Maromak, no sira sei lori sira nia kastigu tanba hahalok aat nee.
verses.13: Sira sei la hakbesik mai Hau hodi serví Hau nudar saserdote. Sira sei la hakbesik buat ida hosi Hau nia sasaan santu no sasaan nebee santu liu. Maibee sira sei lori sira nia moe no hahalok foer nebee sira halo tiha ona.
verses.14: Maibee Hau sei foo knaar ba sira hodi tau matan ba Templu, atu halo fatin nee nia ministériu no buat hotu nebee tenki halo iha fatin nee.”
verses.15: “Maibee saserdote sira hosi ema Levi, nebee oan mane sira hosi Zadok, nebee halo tuir knaar ba Hau nia Fatin Santu bainhira ema Israel sira lao sees hosi Hau, saserdote sira nee sei hakbesik mai Hau hodi serví Hau.
