No sira sei hamriik iha Hau nia oin hodi oferese bokur no raan ba Hau, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.16: Sira sei tama Hau nia Fatin Santu, no sira sei hakbesik mai Hau nia meza, hodi serví Hau, no sira sei halo tuir Hau nia knaar.
verses.17: Bainhira sira tama portaun ba pátiu iha laran, sira tenki hatais ropa linhu. Sira la bele hatais buat ida nebee halo ho bibi malae fulun bainhira sira serví iha portaun ba pátiu laran no iha laran nee.
verses.18: Sira tenki taka xapeu linhu ba sira nia ulun, no hatais kalsa laran linhu iha sira nia kanotak. Sira la bele hatais buat ida nebee halo sira kosar.
verses.19: No bainhira sira sai ba pátiu iha liur nebee ba povu, sira tenki hasai ropa nebee sira uza hodi serví. Sira tenki rai ropa nee iha kuartu nebee santu. No sira tenki hatais ropa seluk. Nunee sira la konsagra povu ho sira nia ropa.
verses.20: Sira la bele koi sira nia ulun ka husik sira nia fuuk sai naruk. Sira tenki tesi sira nia fuuk iha sira nia ulun.
verses.21: Saserdote la bele hemu tua uvas bainhira sira tama ba pátiu iha laran.
verses.22: Sira la bele kaben ho feto faluk ka feto nebee laen soe tiha ona. Só sira bele kaben ho feto raan sira nebee mai hosi uma kain Israel, ou feto faluk nebee saserdote nia feto faluk.
verses.23: Sira tenki hanorin Hau nia povu diferensia entre buat nebee santu no buat nebee baibain, no hatudu oinsaa haketak buat nebee la moos no buat nebee moos.
verses.24: Bainhira ema diskuti malu, saserdote sira sei tesi lia nudar juis sira, no sira tenki tesi lia tuir Hau nia julgamentu sira. Sira tenki halo tuir Hau nia lei no Hau nia estatutu kona ba Hau nia festa hotu. No sira tenki halo tuir Hau nia loron Sabdu nebee santu.
verses.25: Sira la bele hafoer sira nia aan liu hosi hakbesik ba ema ida nebee mate. Maibee ba inan-aman, ba oan mane no oan feto, ba maun no alin mane, no ba feton nebee seidauk kaben, sira bele hafoer aan.
verses.26: Bainhira saserdote nee sai moos fali, sira tenki sura loron hitu ba nia.
verses.27: No iha loron nebee nia tama ba Fatin Santu, ba pátiu iha laran, hodi serví iha Fatin Santu, nia tenki oferese ninia sakrifísiu sala nian, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.28: “Sira nia liman rohan mak nee: Hau mak sira nia liman rohan. La bele foo fatin ida ba sira iha Israel. Hau mak sira nia fatin.
verses.29: Sira sei haan oferta trigu nian, sakrifísiu sala nian no sakrifísiu multa. Buat hotu iha Israel nebee haketak ba Hau sei sai sira nian.
verses.30: No rezultadu primeiru oi-oin, no oferta oi-oin hosi imi nia oferta hotu sei sai saserdote sira nian. Imi tenki foo mos buat primeiru hosi imi nia masa paun nian ba saserdote, hodi bensaun bele hela iha imi nia uma.
verses.31: Saserdote sira la bele haan naan hosi manu ka animál nebee mate rasik ka animál fuik lees mate ona.

verses.1: “Bainhira imi fahe rai nudar liman rohan, imi tenki haketak rai ida ba Nai hodi sai distritu santu nebee naruk kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu no luan kilometru sanulu. Fatin hotu nee sei sai santu.
verses.2: Hosi rai nee, bele haketak fatin kuadradu nebee metru atus rua lima-nulu ba metru atus rua lima-nulu hodi halo Fatin Santu. No husik rai nebee luan metru rua-nulu resin lima hodi haleu fatin nee.
verses.3: No hosi distritu nebee sukat nee, o sei sukat parte ida nebee naruk kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu no luan kilometru lima. Iha fatin nee nia laran ita bele halo Fatin Santu, nebee Fatin Santu Liu.
verses.4: Nee mak parte ida nebee santu iha rai. Fatin nee mak saserdote nian nebee serví iha Fatin Santu no hakbesik ba Nai hodi serví Nia. Fatin nee mak fatin nebee sira bele iha uma no sai área nebee santu ba Fatin Santu nee.
verses.5: Parte ida fali nebee naruk kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu no luan kilometru lima, bele sai ema Levi sira nia fatin nebee serví iha Templu. Sira bele iha sidade sira iha nebaa hodi hela.
verses.6: “Iha distritu santu nia sorin imi tenki halo fatin ba sidade nebee luan kilometru rua ho balu no naruk kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu. Fatin nee sei sai Israel nia uma kain tomak nian.
verses.7: “Ukun nain sei hetan rai iha distritu santu nia sor-sorin. Nia hetan mos área sidade nian nebee iha distritu santu nia sorin, no área sidade nian iha sorin loromonu no sorin lorosae. Área nee mak naruk hanesan ho suku ida nia rai, no nia tuir hosi baliza iha sorin loromonu too iha sorin lorosae
verses.8: iha rai nebaa. Nee mak ninia rai iha Israel. No Hau nia ukun nain sira sei la hanehan tan imi. Maibee sira sei husik uma kain Israel hodi hetan rai nee tuir sira nia suku sira.
verses.9: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Too ona, Oh ukun nain sira iha Israel! Hasai tiha violénsia no hahalok nebee harahun. Halao justisa no hahalok loos. Hapara tiha imi nia hahalok nebee hadau rai hosi Hau nia povu, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.10: “Imi tenki uza dasin loos. Sukat loos ho kalen boot no baldi.
verses.11: Kalen boot no baldi tenki sukat hanesan. Baldi sanulu tenki sukat too bidon ida no kalen boot sanulu tenki sukat too bidon ida. No bidon nee tenki hanesan hotu.
verses.12: Osan mutin pedasuk ida tenki grama sanulu resin rua. Osan mutin rua-nulu ho osan mutin rua-nulu resin lima ho osan mutin sanulu resin lima tenki iha todan grama atus hitu rua-nulu.
verses.13: “Ida nee mak oferta nebee imi tenki halo: hosi trigu bidon ida tenki foo kilograma tolu ho balu, no hosi trigu boot bidon ida tenki foo kilograma tolu ho balu;
verses.14: no kona ba mina nia regulamentu, nebee sukat ho baldi, imi tenki foo litru rua ho balu hosi tanke ida (tanke nee hanesan ho bidon ida, no bele simu baldi sanulu).
verses.15: No bibi ida hosi bibi lubun nebee iha bibi atus rua, hosi bee posu sira iha Israel hodi foo ho oferta trigu nian, sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu dame nian hodi taka sira nia sala, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.16: Povu tomak iha rai nee tenki foo oferta nee ba ukun nain iha Israel.
verses.17: No ukun nain sei iha knaar hodi foo sakrifísiu tunu motuk, oferta trigu nian no oferta hemu nian iha festa sira, iha tempu fulan foun, loron Sabdu, no festa hotu iha uma kain Israel nia loron boot sira nee. Nia tenki foo sakrifísiu sala nian, oferta trigu, oferta tunu motuk no sakrifísiu dame nian hodi taka uma kain Israel nia sala.
verses.18: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Iha fulan primeiru, iha loron primeiru iha fulan nee, imi tenki foti karau aman ida hosi karau lubun nebee falta la iha, no hamoos Fatin Santu nee.
verses.19: Saserdote sei foti raan balu hosi oferta sala nian no kose ba Templu nia odamatan nia riin, ba lidun haat iha altár nia ninin, no riin iha portaun nebee tama ba pátiu iha laran.
verses.20: Imi tenki halo hanesan iha loron ba dala hitu iha fulan nee ba ema see-see deit nebee halo sala tanba nia lao sala ka la hatene. Nunee imi sei taka sala kona ba Templu.
verses.21: “Iha fulan primeiru, iha loron ba dala sanulu resin haat iha fulan nee, imi tenki selebra Festa Páskua. Durante loron hitu imi sei haan paun nebee fermentu la iha.
verses.22: Iha loron nebaa, ukun nain tenki foo karau oan nebee aman hodi halo sakrifísiu sala nian ba nia aan rasik no ba povu hotu iha rai nee.
verses.23: No durante loron hitu iha festa nee nia tenki prepara oferta tunu motuk ba Nai, nebee karau oan aman hitu no bibi malae aman hitu nebee falta la iha nudar sakrifísiu tunu motuk loro-loron durante loron hitu nee. No nia tenki foo bibi timor aman ida iha loron ida-idak nudar sakrifísiu sala nian.
verses.24: No nia tenki prepara oferta trigu nian nebee kalen boot ida kada karau aman ida, kalen boot ida kada bibi malae aman ida, no mina litru tolu ho balu kada kalen boot ida-idak nee.
verses.25: Iha fulan ba dala hitu, iha loron ba dala sanulu resin lima, durante loron hitu nebee iha festa, nia tenki prepara oferta hanesan nee ba sakrifísiu sala nian, sakrifísiu tunu motuk, oferta trigu nian no ba mina.

46.title: Ukun Nain no Festa Sira Nee

verses.1: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Tenki taka portaun ba pátiu iha laran nebee hateke ba parte lorosae durante loron neen nebee imi servisu. Maibee iha loron Sabdu imi sei loke portaun nee. No mos iha loron nebee fulan foun ita sei loke nia.
verses.2: Ukun nain sei tama liu hosi portaun nee nia varanda hosi liur. No nia sei hamriik iha portaun nia riin. Saserdote sira sei oferese ninia sakrifísiu tunu motuk no ninia oferta dame nian, no nia sei adora iha portaun nia tama fatin. Depois nia sei sai ba, maibee la bele taka portaun nee too rai nakaras.
verses.3: Povu iha rai nee sei adora iha portaun nia tama fatin iha Nai nia oin iha loron Sabdu no iha tempu fulan foun.
verses.4: Sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee ukun nain oferese ba Nai iha loron Sabdu mak bibi malae oan neen nebee falta la iha no bibi malae aman ida nebee falta la iha.
verses.5: No oferta trigu nian ho bibi malae aman nee tenki kalen boot ida, no oferta trigu nian ho bibi malae oan sira depende ba buat nebee ukun nain bele foo. No nia tenki foo mina litru tolu ho balu ho kalen boot ida-idak.
verses.6: Iha loron nebee fulan foun, nia tenki oferese karau aman ida hosi karau lubun, nebee falta la iha, no bibi malae oan sira no bibi malae aman, nebee falta la iha.
verses.7: No kona ba oferta trigu nian, nia tenki foo kalen boot ida ho karau aman nee no kalen boot ida ho bibi malae aman nee. Ho bibi malae oan sira nee, depende ba buat nebee ukun nain bele foo. No nia tenki foo mina litru tolu ho balu ho kalen boot ida-idak.
verses.8: Bainhira ukun nain tama, nia tenki tama liu hosi portaun nia varanda, no nia sei sai liu hosi fatin hanesan.
verses.9: “Bainhira povu iha rai nee mai iha Nai nia oin iha festa boot sira nee, ema nebee tama liu hosi Portaun Norte hodi adora tenki sai liu hosi Portaun Súl. No ema nebee tama liu hosi Portaun Súl tenki sai liu hosi Portaun Norte. Ema la bele fila fali liu hosi portaun ida nebee nia foin tama. Maibee ema ida-idak tenki baa loos deit hodi sai.
verses.10: Bainhira povu tama, ukun nain sei tama ho sira, no bainhira sira sai, nia sei sai.
verses.11: “Iha festa no loron boot sira, oferta trigu nian nebee foo ho karau aman oan tenki kalen boot ida, no ho bibi malae aman nee tenki foo kalen boot ida, no ho bibi malae oan sira nee depende ba buat nebee imi bele foo. No imi tenki foo mina litru tolu ho balu ho trigu kalen boot ida-idak nee.
verses.12: Bainhira ukun nain prepara oferta voluntáriu, nebee sakrifísiu tunu motuk ou oferta dame sira nudar oferta voluntáriu ba Nai, imi tenki loke ba nia portaun nebee hateke ba parte lorosae. No nia sei oferese ninia sakrifísiu tunu motuk ou ninia oferta dame sira hanesan nia halo iha loron Sabdu. Depois nia sei sai. Bainhira nia sai ona, imi tenki taka fali portaun nee.
verses.13: “Loro-loron imi tenki foo bibi malae oan nebee tinan ida, nebee falta la iha, nudar sakrifísiu tunu motuk ba Nai. Imi tenki oferese sakrifísiu nee dadeer-dadeer.
verses.14: No imi tenki foo oferta trigu nian ho sakrifísiu nee dadeer-dadeer nebee trigu kilo tolu ho balu. No imi tenki foo mina litru ida ho balu hodi habokon trigu nee. Buat nee sei sai oferta trigu nian ba Nai. Ida nee mak estatutu too tinan ba tinan.
verses.15: Nunee imi tenki foo bibi malae oan, oferta trigu nian no mina nee dadeer-dadeer nudar sakrifísiu tunu motuk nebee hasae beibeik.
verses.16: “Nai Maromak hatete nunee: Se ukun nain foo prezenti ida ba ninia oan mane naran deit nudar oan mane nee nia liman rohan, entaun rai nee sei sai ninia oan mane nian. Rai nee mak sira nian tanba sira hetan liman rohan.
verses.17: Maibee se nia foo prezenti hosi ninia liman rohan ba ninia atan ida, entaun rai nee sai atan nian too tinan liberdade nian. Depois rai nee sei fila fali ba ukun nain. Tebes rai nee mak ukun nain nia liman rohan, no tenki sai ninia oan mane sira nian.
verses.18: Ukun nain la bele foti liman rohan ida hosi povu. Nia la bele dudu sira sai hosi sira nia rai. Nia sei foo liman rohan ba ninia oan mane sira hosi ninia rai rasik hodi la iha ema ida hosi Hau nia povu nebee namkari sai hosi ninia rai.”
verses.19: Depois nia lori hau liu hosi odamatan nebee iha portaun nia sorin. Nia lori hau ba kuartu sira nebee santu iha sorin norte, nebee saserdote sira nian. No tebes, iha kuartu sira nia sorin loromonu nia rohan nee iha fatin ida.
verses.20: Nia dehan mai hau, “Fatin nee mak fatin nebee saserdote sira bele daan naan hosi oferta multa nian no oferta sala nian. Sira bele tunu oferta trigu nian iha nee mos. Nunee sira la lori oferta sira nee ba pátiu iha liur no la konsagra povu nee.”
verses.21: Depois nia lori hau sai ba pátiu iha liur no lori hau lao haleu pátiu nee nia lidun haat. No tebes, iha lidun ida-idak iha pátiu ida tan -
verses.22: iha lidun haat sira nee iha pátiu kiik sira nebee naruk metru rua-nulu no luan metru sanulu resin rua. No pátiu haat nee sukat hanesan.
verses.23: Iha pátiu laran, nebee haleu pátiu haat sira nee mak banku ida. No sira halo daan fatin iha banku kraik nebee haleu fatin nee.
verses.24: Depois Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema sira nebee halao ministériu iha Templu sei uza fatin nee hodi daan naan nebee mai hosi povu nia sakrifísiu sira.”

verses.1: Tuir mai nia lori hau fila fali ba Templu nia odamatan, no tebes, bee suli hosi Templu nia tama fatin nia okos. Bee nee suli ba parte lorosae (tanba Templu hateke ba parte lorosae). Bee nee suli tuun hosi Templu nia tama fatin nia okos iha sorin loos, nebee iha altár nia sorin súl.
verses.2: Depois nia lori hau sai liu hosi Portaun Norte no nia lori hau lao iha liur ba portaun iha liur nebee hateke ba parte lorosae. No tebes, bee uitoan suli sai iha sorin súl.
verses.3: Ema nee baa iha diresaun lorosae nian ho tali sukat iha ninia liman, no nia sukat metru atus lima. Depois nia lori hau hakur bee nee, nebee sae too ain fukun.
verses.4: Dala ida tan nia sukat metru atus lima, no nia lori hau hakur bee nee, no bee sae too ain tuur. Dala ida tan nia sukat metru atus lima, no nia lori hau hakur bee nee no bee sae too kanotak.
verses.5: Dala ida tan nia sukat metru atus lima no bee nee sai mota ida nebee hau la bele hakur, tanba bee sae ona. Bee nee sai klean hodi bele nani, no sai mota ida nebee la bele hakur.
verses.6: Nia dehan mai hau, “Ema nia oan, o haree ona mota nee ka?” Tuir mai nia lori hau fila ba mota nia ninin.
verses.7: Bainhira hau fila fali ba, hau haree ai horis barak loos iha mota ninin, nebee iha sorin mai no sorin ba.
verses.8: Nia dehan mai hau, “Bee nee suli ba área lorosae, no tuun ba rai maran, no tama ba tasi. Bainhira bee tama ba tasi nee, bee iha nebaa sei sai diak.
verses.9: No iha fatin nebee deit mota suli ba, animál hotu-hotu nebee bele habarak aan sei moris. No mota nee sei hetan ikan barak loos. Tanba bee nee baa iha nebaa hodi bee iha tasi nee bele sai diak. No hodi buat hotu bele moris iha fatin nebee mota suli ba.
verses.10: Peskadór sira sei hamriik iha tasi ibun. No sira sei soe redi hosi Engedi too iha Eneglaim. Tasi nee sei iha ikan barak no oi-oin, hanesan ikan nebee iha Tasi Boot.
verses.11: Maibee iha tasi nia rai bokon iha tasi ninin balu, bee iha nebaa sei la sai diak. Fatin nee sei meer hela hodi masin sei iha nebaa.
verses.12: No iha mota ninin, iha sor-sorin, ai horis oi-oin sei moris hodi foo ai haan. Sira nia tahan sei la namlaik, no sira nia fuan sei la falta. Sira sei foo fuan nurak ful-fulan, tanba bee sei suli ba sira hosi Fatin Santu. Sira nia fuan nee sei sai ai haan, no sira nia tahan nee sei sai aimoruk hodi kura.”
verses.13: Nai Maromak hatete nunee: “Ida nee mak baliza nebee imi sei fahe rai nudar liman rohan ba Israel nia suku sanulu resin rua. José sei hetan parte rua.
verses.14: No imi tenki fahe hanesan buat nebee Hau jura ona hodi foo ba imi nia bei-ala sira. Imi sei simu rai nee nudar imi nia liman rohan.
verses.15: “Rai nia baliza mak nee: Iha sorin norte, hosi Tasi Boot, no liu hosi dalan Hetlon ba Lebo-Hamat, no kontinua ba Zedad,
verses.16: Berota, Sibraim (nebee iha baliza entre Damasku no Hamat), no too iha Hazer-Hatikon, nebee iha baliza ba Hauran.
verses.17: Nunee baliza sei baa hosi tasi ba Hazar-Enan, nebee iha Damasku nia baliza iha sorin norte, ho baliza ba Hamat iha parte norte. Ida nee mak sorin norte.
verses.18: “Iha sorin lorosae, baliza sei lao iha Hauran no Damasku nia klaran; no tuir Jordaun entre Gilead no rai Israel; ba Tasi Lorosae no too iha Tamar. Imi tenki sukat too Tasi Lorosae. Ida nee mak sorin lorosae.
verses.19: “Iha sorin súl, baliza sei lao hosi Tamar too iha bee nebee iha Meribá-Kades; no hosi nee, baliza sei tuir Mota Kiik too iha Tasi Boot. Ida nee mak sorin súl.
verses.20: “Iha sorin loromonu, Tasi Boot mak baliza too fatin nebee iha Lebo-Hamat nia oin. Ida nee mak baliza iha sorin loromonu.
verses.21: “Nunee imi sei fahe rai nee tuir suku Israel sira.
verses.22: Imi tenki fahe rai nee ba imi no ba estranjeiru sira nebee hela iha imi nia leet no hetan oan sira iha imi nia leet. Sira sei sai nudar ema Israel sira nebee moris iha rai nee. Imi tenki inklui sira bainhira imi dada rifa hodi fahe rai ba suku Israel sira.
verses.23: Iha suku saida deit nebee ema estranjeiru hela, iha nebaa imi tenki foo liman rohan ba nia, hatete Nai Maromak.

verses.1: “Suku sira nia naran mak nee: Hahuu hosi parte norte liu, nebee iha dalan hosi Hetlon ba Lebo-Hamat, too iha Hazar-Enan (nebee iha Damasku nia baliza norte, iha Hamat nia oin), hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Dan.
verses.2: No hosi Dan nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Aser.
verses.3: No hosi Aser nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Naftali.
verses.4: No hosi Naftali nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Manasés.
verses.5: No hosi Manasés nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Efraim.
verses.6: No hosi Efraim nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Ruben.
verses.7: No hosi Ruben nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Judá.
verses.8: “No hosi Judá nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee sei sai rai nebee imi tenki haketak, nebee luan kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu, no naruk tuir suku ida nia rai, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, nebee iha Fatin Santu iha rai nia laran nee.
verses.9: Rai nebee imi sei haketak ba Nai nee tenki naruk kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu no luan kilometru sanulu.
verses.10: No ita tenki fahe rai nebee santu nee hanesan nee: saserdote sira sei hetan rai nebee luan kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu iha sorin norte, luan kilometru lima iha sorin loromonu, luan kilometru lima iha sorin lorosae, no naruk kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu iha sorin súl, ho Nai nia Fatin Santu iha laran.
verses.11: Rai nee mak foo ba saserdote sira nebee konsagra ona, nebee Zadok nia oan mane sira. Tanba sira halo tuir nafatin Hau nia knaar, no la lao sees bainhira ema Israel lao sees, hanesan ema Levi sira mos lao sees.
verses.12: No rai nee sei sai sira nian nudar rai espesiál hosi rai santu nee, nebee fatin santu liu, iha ema Levi sira nia rai nia sorin.
verses.13: No iha saserdote sira nia rai nia sorin nee, ema Levi sira sei hetan rai nebee naruk kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu no luan kilometru lima. Rai nee nia naruk kompletu mak kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu no luan kilometru lima.
verses.14: Sira sei la faan ka troka parte ida hosi rai nee. Sira sei la fahe rai diak nee, tanba rai nee santu ba Nai.
verses.15: “Rai restu nee, nebee luan kilometru rua ho balu no naruk kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu, sei sai rai nebee uza baibain ba sidade iha nebaa, no ba uma sira no ba rai luan. Iha rai laran nee imi sei iha sidade.
verses.16: No sidade nee nia medida mak nee: iha sorin norte kilometru rua metru atus rua lima-nulu, iha sorin súl kilometru rua metru atus rua lima-nulu, iha sorin lorosae kilometru rua metru atus rua lima-nulu, no iha sorin loromonu kilometru rua metru atus rua lima-nulu.
verses.17: No sidade nee iha rai luan: iha sorin norte metru atus ida rua-nulu resin lima, iha sorin súl metru atus ida rua-nulu resin lima, iha sorin lorosae metru atus ida rua-nulu resin lima, no iha sorin loromonu metru atus ida rua-nulu resin lima.
verses.18: Rai restu iha rai santu nia sorin mak kilometru lima ba iha sorin lorosae, no kilometru lima iha sorin loromonu, no rai nee mak iha rai santu nia sorin. Imi tenki foo rai nia produsaun nee ba ema nebee servisu iha sidade.
verses.19: No ema nebee servisu iha sidade nebee mai hosi suku hotu iha Israel sei halo toos iha rai nee.
verses.20: Rai tomak nebee imi haketak nee mak kuadradu ho sorin nebee naruk kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu. Nee mak rai santu hamutuk ho rai sidade nian.
verses.21: “Rai nebee sei hela iha rai santu no rai sidade nia sor-sorin nee sei sai ukun nain nian. No rai nebee ukun nain nian nee mak hahuu hosi rai santu nia rai nebee naruk kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu, hosi rai nee nia baliza iha sorin lorosae, no ba iha diresaun loromonu nian ba rai nebee kilometru sanulu resin rua ho balu iha baliza iha sorin loromonu, no tuir diresaun hanesan ho suku sira nia rai. No rai santu nebee iha Templu nia Fatin Santu sei iha rai nee nia klaran.
verses.22: Rai nee sei ketak hosi ema Levi sira nia rai no sidade nia rai, nebee iha ukun nain nia rai nia laran. Ukun nain nia rai mak iha rai Judá no rai Benjamin nia klaran.
verses.23: “Kona ba suku sira seluk: hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida ba Benjamin.
verses.24: No hosi Benjamin nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Simeão.
verses.25: No hosi Simeão nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Isakar.
verses.26: No hosi Isakar nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Zebulón.
verses.27: No hosi Zebulón nia baliza, hosi sorin lorosae too sorin loromonu, parte ida nee ba Gad.
verses.28: No hosi Gad ba parte súl, baliza sei baa hosi Tamar too iha Meribá-Kades nia bee. No hosi nee baliza kontinua tuir Mota Kiik too iha Tasi Boot.
verses.29: Nee mak rai nebee imi sei fahe nudar liman rohan ba suku Israel sira. Nee mak sira nia rai, hatete Nai Maromak.
verses.30: “Nee mak fatin sira nebee ema bele sai hosi sidade nee: Iha sorin norte, nebee naruk kilometru rua metru atus rua lima-nulu,
verses.31: iha portaun tolu, nebee Portaun Ruben, Portaun Judá, no Portaun Levi. Sidade nia portaun sira nee iha naran hanesan Israel nia suku sira.
verses.32: Iha sorin lorosae, nebee kilometru rua metru atus rua lima-nulu, iha portaun tolu, nebee Portaun José, Portaun Benjamin, no Portaun Dan.
verses.33: Iha sorin súl, nebee naruk kilometru rua metru atus rua lima-nulu, iha portaun tolu, nebee Portaun Simeão, Portaun Isakar, no Portaun Zebulón.
verses.34: Iha sorin loromonu, nebee kilometru rua metru atus rua lima-nulu, iha sira nia portaun tolu, nebee Portaun Gad, Portaun Aser, no Portaun Naftali.
verses.35: Distánsia nebee haleu sidade nee mak kilometru sia. No hosi tempu nee ba oin, sidade nee nia naran mak ‘Nai Iha Nebaa.’”

1.title: Daniel Ho Maluk Sira Iha Babilónia

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala tolu nian iha liurai Joakim nia reinu iha Judá, liurai Babilónia, Nabukodonozor, mai serka sidade Jerusalém.
verses.2: Nai entrega Joakim, liurai Judá, ba nia liman, hamutuk ho sasaan balu nebee iha Maromak nia uma. Buat hirak nee hotu nia lori baa rai Sinar iha nia maromak nia uma; no sasaan nee nia hatama iha tezourária iha nia maromak nia uma laran.
verses.3: Depois liurai Nabukodonozor foo orden ba Aspenaz, ulun boot iha funsionáriu sira atu hili joven sira balu hosi Israel, hosi jerasaun liurai no xefi sira.
verses.4: Joven sira nee la bele iha falta ruma. Sira tenki bonitu, kapasidade aas hodi aplika matenek, hatene buat barak no intelektual luan no mos iha kapasidade hodi servisu iha liurai nia palásiu laran, atu nunee bele hanorin sira hakerek no koalia lian Kaldeia nian.
verses.5: No liurai foo orden kona ba sira nia hahaan loro-loron nian, nebee hahaan no tua hanesan ho liurai nian. Ema tenki hanorin sira durante tinan tolu, no depois sira tenki halo servisu ba liurai.
verses.6: Entre joven sira nee iha mos ema Judá, nee mak Daniel, Hananias, Misael no Azarias.
verses.7: Xefi hosi funsionáriu sira foo naran foun ba sira: ba Daniel nia foo naran Beltesazar, ba Hananias nia foo naran Sadrake, ba Misael nia foo naran Mesake no ba Azarias nia foo naran Abednego.
verses.8: Daniel desidi ona katak nia lakohi halo nia aan sai foer ho liurai nia hahaan no tua nebee bai-bain liurai hemu. Entaun nia husu lisensa ba xefi funsionáriu nee atu nia la bele halo foer nia aan.
verses.9: Nunee mak Maromak tulun Daniel hodi halo xefi funsionáriu hatudu domin metin no hadomi tebes Daniel.
verses.10: Maibee xefi funsionáriu hatete ba Daniel, “Hau tauk hau nia nai liurai tanba nia rasik mak desidi ona kona ba imi nia hahaan no imi nia hemu. Se karik nia haree ita nia isin ladun saudavel kompara ho joven sira seluk, entaun nia bele oho hau.”
verses.11: Depois Daniel hatete ba ajudante nebee xefi funsionáriu foo ona orden atu tau matan ba Daniel, Hananias, Misael no Azarias, nia dehan,
verses.12: “Favór ida, koko ami, ita boot nia atan sira nee, durante loron sanulu; foo deit mai ami modo tahan atu haan no bee atu hemu.
verses.13: Depois mak ita bele halo komparasaun entre ami no joven sira seluk nebee haan hahaan hosi liurai. Depois, tuir buat nebee ita boot haree, ita boot bele halo saida deit ba ita boot nia atan sira.”
verses.14: Ajudante nee aseita no koko sira durante loron sanulu.
verses.15: Depois loron sanulu nee liu tiha, sira nain haat nia oin diak liu no bokur liu fali joven sira seluk nebee haan hosi liurai nia meza.
verses.16: Nunee ajudante nee la foo tan sira nia hahaan no tua hodi hemu maibee foo deit modo ba sira.
verses.17: Ba joven nain haat nee, Maromak haraik konhesimentu no matenek nebee aas liu no kompriensaun ba hakerek oi-oin. Ba Daniel, Maromak haraik mos kompriensaun kona ba vizaun no mehi.
verses.18: Depois, liu tiha tempu nebee liurai determina ona atu aprezenta sira, xefi funsionáriu aprezenta sira iha liurai Nabukodonozor nia oin.
verses.19: Liurai halo dialogu ho sira; no nunee liurai haree katak la iha ema seluk nebee kompara hanesan ho Daniel, Hananias, Misael no Azarias. Depois sira komesa ona serví iha liurai nia oin.
verses.20: Iha asuntu saida deit nebee presiza matenek no kompriensaun, liurai husu ba sira, no nia haree katak sira diak liu dala sanulu ema astrolojia no ema matan dook sira hotu iha nia reinu tomak.
verses.21: Daniel kontinua iha fatin nebaa too liurai Siro nia tinan primeiru.

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala rua nian iha Nabukodonozor nia reinu, Nabukodonozor hetan mehi; no mehi nee halo nia laran susar no nia toba mos la dukur.
verses.2: Nunee liurai bolu matan dook sira, astrolojia sira, buan sira no Kaldeia sira, atu sira bele esplika ba liurai kona ba liurai nia mehi nee. Nunee sira mai hamriik iha liurai nia oin.
verses.3: Liurai hatete ba sira, “Hau iha mehi ona, no hau nia espíritu sai tristi loos no hau hakarak hatene kona ba mehi nee.”
verses.4: Nunee ema Kaldeia sira nee koalia ba liurai ho lian Aramaiku, “Oh liurai, viva too tinan ba tinan! Konta mehi nee ba ita boot nia atan sira, mak ami sei foo nia signifikadu.”
verses.5: Maibee liurai hataan ba ema Kaldeia sira nee, “Hau desidi ona: se imi la foo hatene mehi nee, no nia signifikadu mak hau sei tesi imi nia isin halo ki-kiik no imi nia uma sei sai foer fatin.
verses.6: Maibee se ita foo hatene mehi nee no nia signifikadu, mak imi sei simu prezenti no riku-soin no onra boot hosi hau rasik. Entaun, hatudu ona mai hau mehi nee no nia signifikadu!”
verses.7: Sira hataan ba liurai, “Liurai bele konta mehi nee ba ita boot nia atan sira nee, nunee mak ami bele foo hatene nia signifikadu.”
verses.8: Liurai hataan, “Hau hatene loos katak imi koko dada oras, tanba ita haree katak hau foti ona desizaun.
verses.9: Se karik imi la foo hatene mai hau mehi nee, entaun hela orden ida deit ba imi. Hau hatene katak imi komesa bosok no koalia aat mai hau, too tempu nee muda. Konta mehi nee mai hau ona, hodi hau bele hatene katak imi mos bele hatudu nia signifikadu.”
verses.10: Ema Kaldeia sira nee hataan ba liurai, “La iha ema ida iha mundu nee nebee bele hatudu saida mak liurai husu nee! Nunka iha liurai ida mak husu hanesan nee, mezmu nia reinu aas no boot liu, nebee husu ona hanesan nee ba ema matan dook ka astrolojia ka ema Kaldeia ida.
verses.11: Saida mak liurai husu nee difisil tebes, no la iha ema ida mak bele hatudu ida nee ba liurai, só deit maromak sira nebee la hela ho ema.”
verses.12: Entaun liurai sai hirus tebe-tebes tanba liafuan nee; nunee nia foo orden atu oho hotu ema matenek sira iha Babilónia laran tomak.
verses.13: Entaun orden nee sai atu oho ema matenek hotu, no sira buka atu oho Daniel no nia kolega sira.
verses.14: Nunee Daniel ho matenek no liafuan diak hatete ba Arioke, komandante eskoltu liurai nian, nebee hetan orden atu ba oho ema matenek sira iha Babilónia,
verses.15: Daniel hatete ba komandante Arioke, liurai nia komandante, “Tanba saa mak liurai foo orden nebee makaas tebes hanesan nee?” Nunee Arioke hatete ba Daniel kona ba buat hirak nee hotu.
verses.16: Entaun Daniel baa hasoru liurai no husu ba nia, atu foo tempu ba Daniel hodi nia bele hatudu signifikadu ba liurai.
verses.17: Depois Daniel fila baa ninia uma no foo hatene ba ninia kolega Hananias, Misael, no Azarias,
verses.18: hodi sira bele husu ho haraik aan ba Maromak iha lalehan kona ba segredu nee, atu nunee Daniel ho ninia kolega sira la bele mate hamutuk ho ema matenek sira seluk iha Babilónia.
verses.19: Depois, iha kalan nee kedas, Daniel simu vizaun ida. Nunee Daniel hahii Maromak iha lalehan.
verses.20: Daniel hataan dehan,
verses.21: Nia muda tinan no tempu,
verses.22: Nia mak hatudu buat nebee klean no buat nebee subar hela,
verses.23: Oh hau nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak,
verses.24: Tanba nee Daniel ba hasoru Arioke nebee hetan orden hosi liurai atu oho ema matenek sira iha Babilónia. Daniel baa no hatete ba nia, “Keta oho ema matenek iha Babilónia! Lori hau baa hasoru liurai, mak hau sei hatudu ba liurai mehi nee nia signifikadu.”
verses.25: Arioke lori kedas Daniel ba hasoru liurai no dehan ba liurai nunee, “Hau hetan ona ema kastigu ida hosi ema Judá sira nebee bele foo hatene ba liurai kona ba mehi nee nia signifikadu.”
verses.26: Liurai husu ba Daniel nebee iha naran Beltsazar, nia dehan, “O bele foo hatene mai hau mehi nebee hau haree ona nee ho nia signifikadu ka?”
verses.27: Daniel hataan iha liurai nia oin, “Segredu nebee liurai husu nee, sei la iha ema matenek luan, astrolojia, ema matan dook, ka lia nain sira nebee bele hatudu ba liurai.
verses.28: Só deit Maromak nebee iha lalehan mak foo hatene segredu sira. Nia foo hatene ona ba liurai Nabukodonozor saida mak sei akontese iha futuru oin mai. Ita boot nia mehi no vizaun sira nebee ita boot nia kakutak hetan iha ita boot nia kama hanesan nee:
verses.29: Oh liurai, bainhira ita boot toba, mosu hanoin bar-barak kona ba buat nebee sei akontese iha futuru oin mai, no Nia nebee foo sai segredu sira nee, Nia foo hatene ona ba liurai saida mak sei mosu.
verses.30: Nia la foo hatene mai hau segredu nee tanba hau mak matenek liu ema moris hotu, maibee atu nunee liurai bele hatene nia signifikadu, no nunee liurai bele hatene liurai nia fuan laran nia hanoin sira nee.
verses.31: Ita boot, Oh liurai, haree vizaun ida, no vizaun nee hanesan estátua ida nebee boot tebes! Estátua nee aas liu, nia naroman makaas tebes, hamriik loos iha liurai nia oin, no halo tauk tebes.
verses.32: Estátua nee nia ulun halo hosi osan mean diak, nia hirus-matan no nia liman hosi osan mutin, nia kanotak no kelen sira hosi riti mean.
verses.33: Nia ain parte klaran hosi besi ho nia ain parte kraik hosi besi kahur ho rai mean.
verses.34: Bainhira liurai haree hela, buat ruma tesi sai fatuk ida, maibee laos ema nia liman; no fatuk ida nee soke estátua nee nia ain nebee hosi besi no rai mean nee, nunee sai rahun.
verses.35: No nunee besi, rai mean, riti mean, osan mutin no osan mean sira nee rahun no sai uut hanesan hare kulit iha tempu baku hare, bainhira anin huu hodi halakon sira hotu. Maibee fatuk nebee monu tuun ba estátua nee sai fali foho boot nebee taka mundu tomak.
verses.36: Mehi mak nee, no agora ami atu foo hatene nia signifikadu ba liurai.
verses.37: Ita boot, Oh liurai, mak liurai sira nia liurai, tanba Maromak nebee kria lalehan tomak haraik ona ba ita boot reinu, ukun, forsa no onra,
verses.38: Maromak tau ema hotu nebee moris iha fatin oi-oin iha liurai nia ukun okos, no animál sira iha rai leten, no manu sira iha loro leten. Maromak mak halo liurai nia ukun sai boot nunee. Liurai rasik mak estátua nia ulun hosi osan mean nee.
verses.39: Depois liurai nia ukun, iha reinu seluk sei mosu mai nebee laduun boot hanesan liurai nia reinu; depois iha reinu ba dala tolu nian hosi riti mean nebee sei ukun mundu tomak.
verses.40: Depois iha reinu ba dala haat nian, nebee toos hanesan besi, hodi harahun buat saida deit; no hanesan besi nebee bele harahun buat hotu, nunee nia halo buat hotu ki-kiik no aat.
verses.41: No hanesan ida nebee liurai haree ona ain parte balu hosi besi no parte balu hosi rai mean, ida nee signifika katak reinu nee sei fahe; maibee reinu nee sei toos hanesan besi, tuir saida mak ita boot haree ona besi nee kahur ho rai mean belit.
verses.42: Maibee hanesan estátua nee nia ain-fuan balu hosi rai mean no balu hosi besi, nunee reinu parte balu nee sei toos no parte balu sei fraku.
verses.43: Hanesan ita boot haree ona besi kahur ho rai mean belit, sira sei kahur malu liu hosi hola malu, maibee nunka sai unidade, hanesan besi nunka kahur ho rai mean.
verses.44: Durante tempu reinu liurai sira nee mai, Maromak iha lalehan sei harii reinu ida nebee nunka monu, no reinu nee la lakon ba nasaun seluk. Maibee reinu nee sei harahun no halakon reinu hotu seluk nee, no reinu nee sei hamriik too tinan ba tinan.
verses.45: Hanesan lo-loos liurai haree katak fatuk, ida nebee laos ema nia liman mak tesi sai hosi foho, harahun besi ki-kiik, riti mean, rai mean, osan mutin no osan mean nee. Maromak nebee boot liu mak foo hatene ona ba liurai saida mak sei mosu iha futuru oin mai; mehi nee metin duni no nia signifikadu nee mos loos atu fiar.”
verses.46: Nunee liurai Nabukodonozor hakneak taka rabat no hahii Daniel; no liurai foo orden atu halo sakrifísiu ba Daniel no sunu insensu ba nia.
verses.47: Liurai hataan ba Daniel, “Loos duni katak ita nia Maromak nee mak maromak sira nia Maromak, no liurai sira nia Nai, no ida nebee hatudu segredu sira, tanba ita bele hatudu ona segredu mak nee.”
verses.48: Depois liurai hasae Daniel. Liurai foo prezenti barak nebee boot ba Daniel, no halo Daniel sai ukun nain ba distritu Babilónia tomak no xefi governadór nebee ukun ema matenek hotu iha Babilónia laran tomak.
verses.49: Daniel husu ba liurai no liurai halo Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego sai administradór sira ba distritu Babilónia, maibee Daniel rasik hela nafatin iha liurai nia palásiu.

verses.1: Liurai Nabukodonozor halo estátua hosi osan mean nebee aas metro rua-nulu resin hitu (27m) no luan metru rua pontu hitu (2,7m) nebee nia harii iha rai tetuk Dura nian iha distritu Babilónia.
verses.2: Depois liurai Nabukodonozor haruka ema baa halibur lideransa sira, governadór sira, komandante sira, juis sira, tezoureiru sira, konselheiru sira, politika nain sira no xefi distritu sira hotu, atu mai partisipa iha inagurasaun ba estátua nebee liurai Nabukodonozor mak harii ona.
verses.3: Depois lideransa sira, governadór sira, komandante sira, juis sira, tezoureiru sira, konselheiru sira, politika nain sira no xefi distritu sira hotu mai halibur hamutuk hodi partisipa iha inagurasaun ba estátua nebee liurai Nabukodonozor mak harii ona. Sira hamriik iha estátua nia oin nebee Nabukodonozor mak harii ona.
verses.4: Nunee ema ida foo avizu, nia hakilar ho lian makaas, “Ida nee mak mandamentu ba imi, Oh povu, nasaun sira, no lian oi-oin sira:
verses.5: bainhira imi rona dikur, flauta, sítara, harpa, saltériu, gaita foles no instrumentu múzika sira oi-oin nia lian, entaun imi hotu tenki hakneak no adora estátua osan mean nebee liurai Nabukodonozor harii ona nee;
verses.6: see mak la hakneak hodi adora, mak ema sei soe kedas nia ba iha fornu boot nia laran!”
verses.7: Nunee bainhira ema hotu-hotu rona dikur lian, flauta, sítara, harpa, salteríu, no instrumentu múzika sira oi-oin nia lian, mak ema hotu-hotu, nasaun sira, no lian oi-oin sira nee hakneak kedas hodi adora estátua osan mean nebee liurai Nabukodonozor harii ona nee.
verses.8: No iha momentu nee ema Kaldeia balu mai hakbesik hodi kesar kona ba ema Judeu sira.
verses.9: Sira hatete ba liurai Nabukodonozor, “Oh liurai, viva too tinan ba tinan!
verses.10: Liurai hasai ona orden katak, bainhira ema see-see deit nebee rona dikur lian, flauta, sítara, harpa, salteríu, gaita foles no instrumentu múzika sira oi-oin nia lian sira nee mak nia tenki hakneak hodi adora estátua osan mean nee,
verses.11: no see ema la hakneak hodi adora estátua nee, mak iha oras nee kedas ema sei soe nia ba iha fornu boot laran.
verses.12: Maibee iha ema Judea balu nebee liurai foo ona servisu ba diretór distritu Babilónia: Sadrake, Mesake, no Abednego. Mane sira nee, Oh liurai, sira la halo tuir ita boot. Sira la serví ita boot nia maromak sira no sira la adora estátua osan mean nebee ita boot mak harii ona nee.”
verses.13: Nunee liurai Nabukodonozor ho hirus makaas tebes manda ema lori mai Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego. Entaun ema lori mane sira nee mai iha liurai nia oin.
verses.14: Nabukodonozor koalia no hatete ba sira, “Loos ka, Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego, imi la serví hau nia maromak sira no la adora estátua osan mean nebee hau harii ona nee?
verses.15: Agora, se imi pronto iha oras nebee imi rona dikur, flauta, sítara, harpa, salteríu, gaita foles no instrumentu múzika sira oi-oin nia lian hakneak ba hodi adora estátua nebee hau halo ona nee! Maibee se imi la adora, mak ema soe kedas imi tama ba iha fornu boot laran. No maromak ida nebee tan mak bele liberta imi hosi hau nia liman laran?”
verses.16: Depois Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego hataan ba liurai, “Oh Nabukodonozor, ami la hanoin kona ba resposta nebee ami foo ba ita boot kona ba asuntu ida nee.
verses.17: Se karik hanesan nee, ami nia Maromak nebee ami serví, Nia bele liberta ami hosi fornu boot nee, no Nia sei liberta ami hosi ita boot nia liman laran, Oh liurai.
verses.18: Maibee se karik lae, mak liurai hatene ba katak ami sei la adora ita boot nia maromak sira, no sei la adora estátua osan mean nebee ita boot harii ona nee.”
verses.19: Nunee Nabukodonozor sai hirus tebe-tebes, no nia oin muda aan hasoru Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego; depois nia foo orden ba ema sira atu hamanas fatin ahi makaas liu tan dala hitu kompara ho baibain.
verses.20: Nia foo orden ba nia soldadu sira nebee podér tebe-tebes hosi nia forsa militár atu kesi Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego hodi soe sira tama ba iha fornu boot laran.
verses.21: Depois ema sira nee kesi sira nain tolu, ho sira nia unuk, kalsa, xapeu, no sira nia ropa seluk tan, no soe sira tama ba iha fornu boot laran.
verses.22: Tanba liurai nia orden nee urjenti, no fornu boot nee sai manas loos, ho nunee ahi lakan nee haan motuk hotu ema sira nebee lori sae Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego.
verses.23: Maibee Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego sira nain tolu, monu tuun ba fornu boot laran ho liman ain kesi metin hotu.
verses.24: Depois liurai Nabukodonozor hakfodak no nia hamriik kedas; nia koalia no dehan ba nia konselheiru sira, “Laos ita kesi ema nain tolu soe tama baa ahi laran?” Sira hataan ba liurai, “Loos, Oh liurai!”
verses.25: Liurai hataan dehan, “Aii! Hau haree ema nain haat mak lao ba mai iha ahi laran nebaa; ahi la haan sira kanek, no ida seluk nee nia oin hanesan maromak nia oan ida!”
verses.26: Depois Nabukodonozor hakbesik aan ba fornu boot nia odamatan; nia koalia no dehan, “Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego, Maromak nebee aas liu nia atan sira, sai mai lai!” Depois Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego sai hosi ahi lakan laran.
verses.27: No liurai nia lideransa sira, governadór sira, komandante sira no konselheiru sira mai halibur hamutuk; sira haree katak ema sira nee nia isin nebee ahi la iha podér hodi kona, sira nia fuuk iha ulun la motuk, sira nia ropa la muda aan, no sira mos la dois ahi iis.
verses.28: Nabukodonozor koalia no dehan, “Hahii ba Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego sira nia Maromak! Nia haruka ona nia anju no liberta ona Nia atan sira, nebee tau fiar ba Nia, no nebee kontra liurai nia orden, no nebee oferese ona sira nia isin, tanba sira lakohi serví ka adora maromak seluk só deit sira nia Maromak.
verses.29: Tanba nee hau foo orden, katak povu, nasaun sira, no lian oi-oin sira hotu nebee hatete liafuan aat hasoru Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego sira nia Maromak, mak sei tesi nia isin halo ki-kiik no nia uma sei sai foer fatin, tanba la iha maromak seluk nebee bele liberta ema hanesan nee.”
verses.30: Depois liurai foo promosaun ba Sadrake, Mesake no Abednego iha distritu Babilónia.

verses.1: Hosi liurai Nabukodonozor ba povu sira, nasaun sira, no lian oi-oin sira hotu nebee hela iha mundu nee: bensaun barak ba imi hotu.
verses.2: Hau haksolok hodi konta sinál no milagre sira nebee Maromak Nebee Aas Liu halo ona mai hau.
verses.3: Nia sinál sira bo-boot!
verses.4: Hau Nabukodonozor, moris hakmatek iha hau nia uma laran no kontenti iha hau nia palásiu.
verses.5: Depois hau hetan mehi ida nebee halo hau hakfodak tebes, hau hetan hanoin iha hau nia kama no haree vizaun iha hau nia ulun nebee halo hau hanoin tristi loos.
verses.6: Entaun, hau foo orden katak tenki lori hotu ema matenek nain sira nebee iha Babilónia laran atu mai hasoru hau, atu sira bele foo hatene hau nia mehi nee nia signifikadu.
verses.7: Depois matan dook sira, astrolojia sira, ema Kaldeia sira no lia nain sira mai hasoru hau no hau konta mehi nee ba sira maibee la iha ida nebee bele esplika mehi nia signifikadu.
verses.8: Ikus liu, Daniel mai, nia nebee iha naran Beltesazar tuir hau nia maromak nia naran, no nia iha maromak santu sira nia espíritu, no nia mai hasoru hau. Depois hau konta ba nia hau nia mehi.
verses.9: “Oh Beltesazar, matan dook sira nia xefi, hau hatene katak ita iha espíritu maromak santu sira nian, no la iha segredu ida nebee susar ba ita! Tan nee, konta mai hau vizaun sira iha hau nia mehi nebee hau haree ona no esplika mai hau nia signifikadu.
verses.10: Hau nia vizaun sira nebee iha hau nia ulun bainhira hau toba iha hau nia kama hanesan nee: hau haree iha mundu nia klaran iha ai huun ida nebee aas tebes.
verses.11: Ai huun nee sai boot liu tan no metin loos; nia aas too iha lalehan, no iha mundu tomak bele haree.
verses.12: Nia tahan sira furak loos no nia fuan mos barak tebes, iha ai huun nee mos ai haan ba buat moris hotu. Iha nia okos iha animál sira nebee hetan mahon, no iha nia sanak sira manu sira bele hela, no buat moris hotu hetan ai haan hosi nia.
verses.13: Hau haree iha vizaun sira iha hau nia ulun bainhira hau toba iha hau nia kama no hau haree ema seguransa ida nebee santu, nia tuun hosi lalehan.
verses.14: Nia hakilar makaas no dehan hanesan nee, “Hamonu tiha ai huun nee no taa kotu nia sanak sira, doko sai nia tahan sira, no hasai hotu nia fuan sira. Husik animál sira halai sai hosi nia huun no manu sira sai hosi nia sanak sira.
verses.15: Maibee husik nia abut iha rai laran, kesi ho korenti no riti, iha fatin duut nurak; no husik mahobeen hosi lalehan habokon nia, no nia hela ho animál sira iha duut fatin.
verses.16: Husik nia fuan nebee hanesan ema nian nakfilak aan tiha no foo fali animál nian durante tempu hitu.
verses.17: Orden ida nee mai hosi seguransa sira no mandatu ida nee mai hosi santu sira nia liafuan atu nunee ema hotu nebee moris bele hatene katak Ida Nebee Aas Liu mak ukun reinu ema nian no Nia bele foo reinu ida nee ba ema nebee deit mak Nia laran hakarak, bele mos ba ema nebee kiik liu.
verses.18: Ida nee mak mehi nebee hau liurai Nabukodonozor, haree ona. Hau, nia mehi nebee hau haree ona. Agora, Oh Beltesazar, esplika mai mehi nee nia signifikadu tanba ema matenek sira hotu nebee iha hau nia reinu la hatene atu esplika mai hau signifikadu nee, maibee ita mak bele tanba ita iha maromak santu sira nia espíritu!
verses.19: Entaun Daniel, ida nebee iha mos naran Beltesazar, hakfodak minutu balu no nia hanoin halo nia preokupa. Liurai koalia no hatete, “Beltesazar, keta preokupa ba mehi nee no nia signifikadu.” Beltesazar hataan no hatete, “Hau nia nai, husik mehi nee aplika ba sira nebee odi nai, no signifikadu nee aplika ba ita boot nia inimigu sira!
verses.20: Ai huun nebee ita boot mak haree ona nee sai boot no metin, no nia aas too lalehan no mundu tomak bele haree.
verses.21: Nia tahan sira furak no nia fuan barak tebes. Nia iha ai haan ba buat moris hotu. Iha nia huun iha animál sira no iha nia sanak sira hela manu sira hosi lalehan.
verses.22: Ai huun nee mak ita boot, Oh liurai. Ita boot mak aumenta no sai boot ona no aas too lalehan no ita nia ukun too mundu nia rohan!
verses.23: Kona ba ida nebee liurai haree ona nee, nia mak seguransa, ida nebee santu, nia tuun hosi lalehan no hatete, ‘Hamonu tiha ai huun nee no estraga nia, maibee husik nia abut hela iha rai laran. Kesi ho korenti no riti iha fatin duut nurak no husik mahobeen hosi lalehan mak habokon nia no nia hela hamutuk ho animál sira durante tempu hitu.’
verses.24: Signifikadu hanesan nee, Oh liurai, no ida nee mak ida nebee Aas Liu nia desizaun ba hau nia nai liurai:
verses.25: Sira sei duni sai ita boot hosi ema sira nia leet no ba hela hamutuk ho animál sira iha rai fuik. Sira sei obriga ita tenki haan deit duut hanesan karau no sira sei habokon ita boot ho mahobeen hosi lalehan durante tempu hitu nia laran too ita boot hatene katak Ida Nebee Aas Liu mak ukun reinu ema nian, no Nia bele foo reinu nee ba ema see deit nebee Nia hili.
verses.26: No bainhira sira manda atu husik ai huun nia abut, nee signifika katak ita boot sei simu fali ita boot nia reinu bainhira ita boot rekonhese ona katak Lalehan mak ukun.
verses.27: Tanba nee, Oh liurai, diak liu ita boot halo tuir hau nia konselhu: husik ita boot nia sala liu hosi hahalok loos, husik ita boot nia hahalok aat liu hosi hatudu laran diak ba ema kiak sira, ho nunee mak ita boot sei aumenta tempu hakmatek.
verses.28: Buat hirak nee hotu akontese ba liurai Nabukodonozor.
verses.29: Liu tiha fulan sanulu resin rua, nia lao halimar iha uma leten iha palásiu Babilónia nian.
verses.30: Depois, liurai koalia no hatete, “Laos ida nee mak Babilónia nebee boot liu, buat nebee hau rasik mak halo liu hosi hau nia kbiit no podér, hodi hatudu hau nia glória nia onra?”
verses.31: Liurai seidauk remata nia liafuan, nia rona kedas lian ida hosi lalehan dehan, “Oh liurai Nabukodonozor, liafuan mak nee ba ita: ita nia reinu sai ona hosi ita,
verses.32: no sira sei duni ita sai hosi ema sira nia leet no ita nia hela fatin sei hamutuk ho animál sira iha rai fuik. Sira sei obriga ita tenki haan deit duut hanesan karau. Ida nee sei akontese ba ita durante tempu hitu, too ita rekonhese katak Ida Nebee Aas Liu mak ukun reinu ema nian, no Nia bele foo ba see deit nebee Nia laran hakarak!”
verses.33: Iha momentu nee kedas, buat hotu nee sai realidade ba Nabukodonozor. Sira duni nia hosi ema sira nia leet no nia haan duut hanesan karau no nia isin bokon hosi mahobeen hosi lalehan too nia fuuk sai naruk liu hanesan makikit nia fulun no nia liman no ain kukun sai hanesan manu nian.
verses.34: Bainhira liu tiha tempu nee ona, hau, Nabukodonozor, hateke ba lalehan no hau nia hanoin fila fali mai hau. Depois hau hahii ba Ida Nebee Aas Liu, no hau adora no foti aas Nia nebee moris rohan laek,
verses.35: Povu hotu iha mundu tomak la iha folin,
verses.36: Iha tempu nee kedas hau nia matenek fila fali mai hau, no tanba hau nia reinu nia glória, hau hetan fali hau nia onra no hau nia neon; no hau nia konselheiru sira no hau nia ukun nain sira mos mai buka hau. Hau hametin fali hau nia reinu, too hau nia ukun sai diak liu tan.
verses.37: Nunee agora hau, Nabukodonozor, hahii, hasae no foo onra ba Liurai Lalehan nian, buat hotu nebee Nia halo nee loos, no nia dalan sira justu, no Nia bele hatuun ema nebee foti aan.

verses.1: Liurai Belsazar halo festa boot tebes ba nia ukun nain sira. Sira hamutuk ema nain rihun ida; no liurai hemu tua iha ema sira nee nia oin.
verses.2: Bainhira Belsazar hemu tua hela nia haruka ema lori kalis osan mean no osan mutin sira nebee uluk nia aman Nabukodonozor foti hosi Templu iha Jerusalém, atu nunee liurai no ema boot sira, nia feen sira no nia feen kiik sira bele uza hodi hemu.
verses.3: Depois ema lori kalis osan mean sira nee mai, sasaan nebee foti hosi Templu, Maromak nia Uma iha Jerusalém. Nunee liurai no ema boot sira, nia feen sira no nia feen kiik sira uza hodi hemu.
verses.4: Sira hemu tua no hahii hela maromak sira hosi osan mean no osan mutin, riti, besi, ai, no fatuk.
verses.5: Iha momentu nee kedas mosu liman fuan ema nian hodi hakerek iha liurai nia palásiu nia didin lolon iha kandelabru nia oin ba iha plamir mutin, no liurai haree hela liman nebee hakerek nee.
verses.6: Nunee liurai nia oin fila aan tiha, no nia hanoin hakfodak; nia ain sai mamar no nia ain tuur nakdedar kona malu.
verses.7: Depois liurai hakilar makaas, atu nunee astrolojia sira, ema Kaldeia sira no lia nain sira hotu mai hasoru nia. Liurai koalia no hatete ba ema matenek sira nebee iha Babilónia nee, “Ema see-see deit nebee bele lee liafuan nee no hatudu nia signifikadu mai hau, mak hau sei foo hatais nia ho ropa kór uvas, no tara ba nia kakorok korenti osan mean, no nia sei hetan pozisaun terseiru iha reinu nee.”
verses.8: Entaun ema matenek sira hotu tama mai maibee la iha ida mak bele lee no foo hatene nia signifikadu ba liurai.
verses.9: Ho nunee liurai nia hanoin terus tebes no sai tauk liu tan; no nia ema boot sira mos sai tauk.
verses.10: Liurai feto rona liafuan nebee liurai no nia ema boot sira koalia. Tanba nee liurai feto tama ba iha salaun festa nian; liurai feto koalia no dehan, “Oh liurai, viva too tinan ba tinan! La bele husik liurai nia hanoin halo liurai laran tristi no la bele sai tauk.
verses.11: Iha ita boot nia reinu nee iha ema ida nebee iha maromak santu sira nia espíritu! Iha tempu liurai nia aman nian, ema nee nakonu ho naroman no kompriensaun no matenek luan hanesan ho matenek luan hosi maromak sira. Ita boot nia aman Nabukodonozor, ida nebee liurai, ita boot nia aman, nia mak foti ona ema nee sai ulun ba matan dook sira, astrolojia sira, ema Kaldeia sira no lia nain sira,
verses.12: tanba ema nee iha espíritu kapaas, matenek, no kompriensaun, ho nunee nia bele esplika mehi, nia bele foo sai buat segredu no bele rezolve buat nebee difisil. Nia mak Daniel nebee liurai foo naran Beltesazar. Agora, bolu Daniel mai atu nunee nia bele foo sai signifikadu nee.”
verses.13: Nunee ema lori Daniel mai hodi hasoru liurai. Liurai koalia no husu ba Daniel, “O mak Daniel ka, nebee refujiadu hosi rai Judá, nebee hau nia aman liurai lori mai hosi rai Judeu nian?
verses.14: Hau rona ona kona ba ita, katak ita iha maromak sira nia espíritu, no naroman, kompriensaun no matenek luan bele hetan iha ita.
verses.15: Ema sira lori ona mai hau ema matenek nain sira, astrolojia sira, atu sira bele lee liafuan nee no foo hatene mai hau nia signifikadu, maibee sira la bele hatudu buat nee nia signifikadu.
verses.16: Maibee hau rona ona kona ba ita, katak ita bele loke signifikadu sira no bele foo sai buat nebee segredu. Agora, se ita bele lee liafuan nee no foo hatene mai hau nia signifikadu, mak hau sei foo ba ita ropa kór uvas no hau sei tara korenti osan mean ba ita nia kakorok, no ita sei hetan pozisaun terseiru iha reinu nee.”
verses.17: Tuir mai Daniel hataan no dehan ba liurai, “Tahan lai liurai nia prezenti hirak nee, no foo prezenti sira nee ba ema seluk. Maibee hau sei lee liafuan nee ba liurai no foo hatene nia signifikadu ba liurai.
verses.18: Oh liurai! Maromak Nebee Aas Liu, foo tiha ona ba ita boot nia aman Nabukodonozor, reinu ida no pozisaun boot no glória no onra.
verses.19: No tanba pozisaun boot nebee nia hetan nee, mak povu sira, nasaun sira no lian oi-oin sira nakdedar no tauk ba nia. Se nia hakarak oho ema, nia oho kedas; no se nia hakarak husik ema moris, nia husik kedas; no se nia hakarak foti sae ema, nia hasae kedas; no se nia hakarak hatuun ema, nia hatuun kedas.
verses.20: Maibee bainhira nia foti sae nia fuan laran no nia espíritu sai toos tanba nia foti aan, mak nia monu kedas hosi nia pozisaun nudar liurai, no sira hasai nia glória hosi nia.
verses.21: Sira duni nia dook hosi nia ema sira no nia fuan sai hanesan fuan animál nian, no nia hela hamutuk ho kuda buru fuik sira; no nia haan duut hanesan karau sira, no nia isin sai bokon hosi mahobeen lalehan nian, too nia rekonhese katak Maromak Nebee Aas Liu, Nia mak ukun reinu ema nian no Nia hasae ema tuir Nia laran hakarak.
verses.22: Maibee ita boot, nia oan, Oh Belsazar, la haraik ita boot nia fuan laran, mezmu ita boot hatene hela buat hotu nee.
verses.23: Liurai foti aan hodi kontra hasoru Nai iha Lalehan. Sira lori mai kalis hosi Nia Uma hodi foo ba liurai, depois liurai ho liurai nia ema boot sira, no liurai nia feen sira no liurai nia feen kiik sira uza kalis nee hodi hemu tua; no liurai hahii maromak sira hosi osan mutin no osan mean, hosi riti, besi, ai no fatuk, nebee la bele haree no la bele rona ka kompriende, no liurai la foo glória ba Maromak, nebee kaer liurai nia iis no determina liurai nia dalan sira hotu.
verses.24: Tanba nee Nia haruka liman fuan nee hodi hakerek liafuan nee.
verses.25: Liafuan nebee hakerek nee maka: Mene, Mene, Tekel, Ufarsin.
verses.26: No nia signifikadu hanesan nee: Mene: Maromak konta ona liurai nia reinu no reinu nee remata ona;
verses.27: Tekel: Maromak tetu ona liurai ho dasin no liurai la too;
verses.28: Peres: Liurai nia reinu nakfera ona no fahe ona ba ema Media sira no ema Persia sira.”
verses.29: Ho nunee Belsazar foo orden hodi ema foo hatais Daniel ho ropa kór uvas no tara korenti osan mean ba nia kakorok, no nia proklama katak iha reinu laran Daniel sai hanesan ulun terseiru.
verses.30: Iha kalan nee kedas ema oho Belsazar, liurai hosi rai Kaldeia nee.
verses.31: Dario, ema Media, simu fali reinu nee bainhira nia tinan neen-nulu resin rua.

verses.1: Tuir mai Dario laran kamaan hodi hasae visi atus ida rua-nulu hodi toma konta ba nia reinu; no ema sira nee sei hetan pozisaun iha reinu tomak.
verses.2: Hosi visi atus ida rua-nulu nee, Dario hili tan ema nain tolu hodi toma konta ba sira hotu. Daniel mos inklui hosi sira nain tolu nee. Ba sira nain tolu nee mak visi sira bele hatoo sira nia relatóriu sira, atu nunee liurai la bele lakon buat ida.
verses.3: Daniel nee matenek liu funsionáriu boot sira seluk no liurai nia visi sira, tanba nia iha espíritu matenek nebee diak loos; no liurai iha planu atu foo pozisaun ba Daniel atu toma konta ba nia reinu tomak.
verses.4: Nunee funsionáriu boot sira nee no liurai nia visi sira komesa buka maneira atu foo sala ba Daniel liu hosi servisu iha reinu laran, maibee sira nunka hetan razaun ida ka sala ida hosi Daniel, tanba nia foo laran ba liurai no sira la hetan sala ida iha nia.
verses.5: Entaun ema sira nee komesa hatete ba malu, “Ita sei la hetan razaun ida hodi foo sala ba Daniel, só deit ita sei hasoru nia lei hosi nia Maromak!”
verses.6: Tuir mai, funsionáriu boot sira no liurai nia visi sira halibur hamutuk no baa hasoru liurai no hatete ba liurai, “Nai liurai Dario, viva too tinan ba tinan!
verses.7: Funsionáriu boot sira hotu iha reinu nee, ukun nain sira no liurai nia visi sira, ministru no administrador sira hotu iha ona liafuan ida, katak liurai bele foo sai orden reinu nian ida atu nunee ema hotu tenki halo tuir, se iha loron tolu-nulu nee nia laran mak iha ema ida nebee husu hamulak ba maromak ida ka ba ema ida nebee laos ba nai liurai, mak tenki soe ema nee ba iha fatuk kuak liaun nian.
verses.8: Tanba nee, nai liurai, publika tiha orden reinu nian nee no hakerek iha surat ida nebee ema ida la bele troka fali, tuir lei konstituisaun ema Media no Persia, nebee la bele atu hasai fila fali.”
verses.9: Ho nunee liurai Dario asina surat no orden nee.
verses.10: Bainhira Daniel rona katak surat regulamentu nee asina ona, entaun nia fila fali ba nia uma. Iha nia kuartu laran iha janela sira nebee nakloke no hateke ba rai Jerusalém; iha loron ida nia hakneak, halo orasaun no hahii ba nia Maromak dala tolu, hanesan bai-bain nebee nia sempre halo ona.
verses.11: Depois ema sira nee tama ba Daniel nia kuartu no haree katak Daniel halo hela orasaun no husu tulun hela ba nia Maromak.
verses.12: Tuir mai sira ba hasoru liurai no husu ba liurai kona ba liurai nia orden nee, “Laos nai liurai asina orden ida, atu nunee ema hotu iha reinu nee la bele husu harohan no husu tulun ba maromak nebee deit só deit husu ba nai liurai iha loron tolu-nulu nia laran, se kontra nai liurai, sei soe ema nee ba fatuk kuak liaun nian?” Liurai hataan, “Regulamentu nee foo sai ona no loos duni tuir lei konstituisaun ema Media no Persia sira nian, nebee la bele hasai fila fali.”
verses.13: Tuir mai sira hatete ba liurai, “Daniel, ema refujiadu hosi rai Judá nee la foo respeitu ba ita boot, Oh liurai, no la halo tuir nai liurai nia orden nebee liurai asina ona, maibee nia sempre harohan dala tolu iha loron ida nia laran.”
verses.14: Bainhira liurai rona buat nee, nia laran susar tebes, no nia buka dalan atu salva Daniel, too loron matan monu ona, mos nia nafatin hakaas aan atu salva Daniel.
verses.15: Depois ema sira nee mai fali hodi hasoru liurai no hatete ba liurai, “Hatene ba, nai liurai, katak tuir lei konstituisaun ema Media no Persia nian la iha orden ida ka estatutu ida nebee nai liurai foo sai ona no bele troka fali.”
verses.16: Depois nee hotu tiha liurai foo orden, no ema sira lori Daniel hodi soe ba iha fatuk kuak liaun nian. Liurai hatete ba Daniel, “O nia Maromak nebee ita serví nafatin nee, Nia mak sei salva ita!”
verses.17: Sira lori fatuk boot ida hodi taka tiha fatuk kuak liaun nian nee, nunee liurai marka kadeli karimbu liurai nian no ho ema boot sira nian, atu nunee ema ida la bele salva Daniel hosi problema nee.
verses.18: Depois liurai fila fali ba nia palásiu no halo jejún iha kalan nee kedas; nia la haruka ema ida atu ba hamaluk nia, no nia mos toba la dukur.
verses.19: Dadeer-saan deit rai atu naroman, liurai hadeer lalais no halai ba kedas iha fatuk kuak liaun nian nee.
verses.20: Bainhira nia besik ba fatuk kuak nee, nia komesa bolu Daniel ho laran taridu tebes. Nia koalia ba Daniel, “Daniel, Maromak moris nia atan, ita nia Maromak nebee ita serví nafatin nee, salva ona ita hosi liaun sira nee ka?”
verses.21: Tuir mai Daniel hatete ba liurai, “Oh liurai, viva too tinan ba tinan!
verses.22: Hau nia Maromak haruka ona nia anju mai hodi taka liaun sira nee nia ibun, nunee sira la halo buat ida mai hau, tanba hau la sala iha Nia prezensa; no ba nai liurai mos hau la halo sala ida hasoru nai liurai.”
verses.23: Nunee liurai haksolok tebes no nia foo orden, atu nunee ema sira dada sai fali Daniel hosi fatuk kuak nee. No nunee sira dada sai Daniel hosi fatuk kuak no sira la haree kanek ida iha Daniel nia isin tanba nia fiar ba Maromak.
verses.24: Liurai foo orden, atu nunee kaer fali ema sira nebee duun ona Daniel hodi soe fali sira ba fatuk kuak liaun sira nian nee, hamutuk ho sira nia oan sira no sira nia feen sira. Ema soe sira tuun ba fatuk kuak nee no sira seidauk too okos bainhira liaun sira nee simu hasoru sira no tata sira no harahun sira nia ruin hotu.
verses.25: Depois liurai Dario haruka surat ba ema hotu-hotu hosi nasaun oi-oin, jerasaun oi-oin no ho lian oi-oin, iha mundu tomak, iha surat nee hakerek, “Dame no ksolok ba imi hotu no aumenta diak liu tan!
verses.26: Ho ida nee hau foo orden katak iha reinu tomak nebee hau ukun, ema hotu-hotu tenki nakdedar no tauk ba Daniel nia Maromak,
verses.27: Nia salva no Nia ajuda,
verses.28: Entaun Daniel hetan tempu diak durante reinu Dario no reinu Siro, ema hosi Persia.

verses.1: Ba tinan primeiru bainhira Belsazar ukun iha Babilónia, Daniel mehi no haree vizaun sira iha nia neon iha nia kama. Depois nia hakerek mehi nee, no konta mehi nee hotu.
verses.2: Daniel hatete nunee, “Iha kalan ida hau haree iha vizaun, mosu mai anin haat hosi lalehan no huu makaas tasi boot.
verses.3: No animál boot haat sai mai hosi tasi laran, sira nain haat nee diferente entre ida seluk.
verses.4: Ida primeiru nee nia oin hanesan liaun, no iha liras makikit nian; hau haree ba nia too nia liras sira losu hotu hosi nia, no halo nia hamriik loos hanesan ema ho ain rua, no depois nia hetan fuan laran ema nian.
verses.5: No haree lai, animál ida fali, ida segundu nee mosu tan, nia oin hanesan ursu; nia hamriik iha nia sorin, no naan ruin tolu sei iha hela nia ibun laran no nia nehan tata metin hela. No depois lian ida hatete, ‘Hamriik ba, haan naan barak.’
verses.6: No tuir mai hau haree, ida tan mosu mai, nia oin hanesan leopardo. Nia iha manu nia liras haat iha nia kotuk, no nia iha mos ulun haat, no ba nia sira foo ukun.
verses.7: Tuir mai hau haree vizaun sira iha kalan nee, no haree lai, mosu mai tan animál ikus, nebee makaas no haree deit ba nia mos tauk no nia forsa tebes. Nia iha nehan besi nebee boot; nia tata no ruun makaas, no restu nebee monu hosi nia ibun nia ain mak sama too rahun. Nia diferente loos hosi animál sira hotu nebee uluk nee; tanba nia iha dikur sanulu.
verses.8: Hau haree hela ba nia dikur sanulu nee, no haree lai, moris tan dikur kiik ida hosi dikur sanulu sira nee nia leet. Nunee dikur tolu hosi sanulu sira nee losu tiha; no haree lai, iha dikur kiik nee mosu tan matan no matan nee hanesan matan ema nian no ibun nebee gaba aan.
verses.9: Bainhira hau kontinua haree,
verses.10: Mota ahi ida mosu
verses.11: Hau nafatin haree, tanba liafuan nebee dikur nee koalia hodi gaba aan; no hau kontinua haree nafatin, too sira oho animál nee, nia isin sai rahun no hatama ba iha ahi nebee sunu.
verses.12: No ukun nebee animál sira seluk nee iha mos hasai tiha hosi sira, maibee animál sira nee nia moris foo deit tempu tan.
verses.13: Hau haree hela iha hau nia vizaun sira nee,
verses.14: Depois Ema Nia Oan simu ukun
verses.15: Nunee hau, Daniel, mak tristi no iha laran susar tanba vizaun sira nee iha hau nia neon halo hau nia fuan moras.
verses.16: Tuir mai hau hakbesik aan ba ema ida nebee hamriik iha nebaa no husu kona ba saida mak akontese hela nee. No nunee nia hatete buat nebee akontese nee no nia signifikadu.
verses.17: Animál boot haat nee mak liurai nain haat nebee sei mosu mai hosi mundu.
verses.18: Maibee Ida Nebee Aas Liu nia santu sira sei foti reinu nee, no sira sei kaer reinu nee too tinan ba tinan, loos duni too tinan ba tinan.
verses.19: Depois hau hakarak hatene signifikadu hosi animál ida ikus liu nee, tanba nia diferente liu hosi sira seluk, nebee haree deit mos sai tauk makaas, ho nia nehan besi no nia liman kukun riti, nia uza hodi lees no halo rahun no mos uza nia ain hodi sama tan.
verses.20: No kona ba dikur sanulu nebee iha nia ulun leten, no mos kona ba ida seluk nebee mosu mai, dikur ida nebee iha matan no iha ibun hodi koalia foti aan, nia moris sae no halo dikur tolu seluk nee tohar, no nia forsa makaas liu dikur sira seluk.
verses.21: No hau haree dikur nee funu hasoru ema santu sira no manaan sira.
verses.22: Too Ida Hosi Tempu Antigu nee mai no Nia foo justisa ba Ida Nebee Aas Liu nia santu sira no tempu too mai nebee santu sira nee mak kaer reinu.
verses.23: No nunee nia hatete, ‘Animál ikus liu mak nee,
verses.24: Dikur sanulu nee signifika mak nee,
verses.25: Nia sei koalia liafuan makaas hodi kontra Ida Nebee Aas Liu,
verses.26: Maibee julgamentu nee sei tuur,
verses.27: Nunee mak reinu no ukun,
verses.28: Informasaun sira nee too iha nee deit. Ho nunee hau, Daniel sai tristi no laran taridu liu tan; no hau rai buat hirak nee hotu iha hau nia hanoin.”

8.title: Bibi Malae Aman No Bibi Timor Aman

verses.1: Iha tinan tolu bainhira liurai Belsazar ukun, hau, Daniel, haree tan vizaun ida nebee mosu mai tuir vizaun primeiru nee.
verses.2: Iha vizaun nee, hau haree hanesan hau iha palásiu iha sidade Susan, iha área Elam, no hau haree iha vizaun nee katak hau iha mota ibun Ulai.
verses.3: Hau foti oin no haree, hanesan iha bibi malae aman ida mak hamriik iha mota nee nia oin; nia iha dikur rua no nia dikur nee aas, maibee dikur ida naruk liu fali dikur ida seluk, maibee ida nebee sae aas liu nee moris ikus.
verses.4: Hau haree bibi malae aman nee tuku ba parte loromonu, no parte norte, no parte súl, nunee la iha animál ida nebee bele tahan hodi hasoru nia, no la iha ida mak bele salva aan hosi nia liman; nia halo tuir nia hakarak deit no nia sai boot.
verses.5: Maibee bainhira hau hanoin hela nee, hau haree fali bibi timor aman ida mosu mai hosi parte loromonu, nia semo haleu mundu tomak ho nunee nia ain la kona ba rai; no bibi timor aman nee iha dikur ida deit no oin seluk liu nebee moris entre matan rua nia klaran.
verses.6: Nia mai hodi hasoru bibi malae aman ho dikur rua nebee hamriik iha mota oin nee, no nia halai tuku ba bibi malae nee ho forsa makaas tebes.
verses.7: Hau haree nia hakbesik aan liu tan ba bibi malae aman nee no sai hirus tebe-tebes, depois nia tuku bibi malae aman nee no silu tohar bibi malae nia dikur rua, no bibi malae aman nee la iha tan forsa hodi hasoru nia; nia hamonu bibi malae aman nee ba rai no nia sama ho nia ain, no la iha ida mak bele salva bibi malae aman nee hosi nia.
verses.8: Bibi timor aman nee foti aan liu tan, maibee bainhira nia sei forti nia dikur boot nee tohar tiha, depois dikur haat oin seluk mak moris tan no sae ba anin haat hosi lalehan.
verses.9: No hosi dikur haat nee iha dikur kiik seluk tan nebee moris sae hosi dikur ida nia leten, nia sai boot liu tan ba iha parte súl, parte lorosae no ba rai nebee furak.
verses.10: Nia sai boot tan, too iha forsa sira iha lalehan, no nia hamonu forsa balu no fitun balu nee tuun mai mundu, depois nia sama sira ho nia ain.
verses.11: Mezmu nia hasoru Komandante forsa nian nee mos nia nafatin foti aan, no nia hadau tiha animál sira nebee atu foo sakrifísiu loro-loron nian hosi Komandante nia liman, no Nia fatin nebee santu mos nia harahun hotu.
verses.12: Hahalok hasae sakrifísiu animál nian nee nia halo ho maneira nebee aat, nia soe lia loos ba rai, no saida deit mak nia halo sai susesu.
verses.13: Tuir mai hau rona ema santu ida koalia, no santu ida seluk hatete ba ida nebee koalia nee, “Too bainhira mak vizaun hotu nee sei remata, ba sakrifísiu no hahalok aat, Fatin Santu nebee nia hadau ona no ba forsa sira nebee nia sama ho nia ain nee?”
verses.14: Nia hataan, “Too loron rihun rua atus tolu mak foin remata, depois Fatin Santu nee sei hamoos fali.”
verses.15: No hau, Daniel, haree hela vizaun nee ho hakaas aan atu kompriende. Nunee, haree lai, ida mosu mai hamriik iha hau nia oin, no nia oin hanesan ema mane ida.
verses.16: No hau rona lian ema nian ida hosi mota Ulai klaran hatete, “Gabriel, halo ema nee atu kompriende kona ba vizaun nee!”
verses.17: Depois ema nee hakbesik mai iha fatin nebee hau hamriik nee, no hau tauk no monu taka oin ba rai, maibee nia hatete mai hau, “Kompriende ba, Oh mane nia oan mane, tanba vizaun nee mak kona ba tempu nia rohan.”
verses.18: Bainhira nia koalia hela ho hau, hau toba haluha rai no monu taka oin ba rai; maibee nia liman kona hau no halo hau hadeer fila fali.
verses.19: Depois nia hatete, “Hau atu hatete ba ita kona ba saida mak sei akontese iha loron ikus nebee hetan hirus makaas, tanba buat nee hotu sei akontese laos agora maibee sei akontese bainhira mundu atu remata.
verses.20: Bibi malae aman ho dikur rua nebee ita haree nee mak liurai Media no Persia.
verses.21: No bibi timor nebee ho fulun kritin nee mak liurai nasaun Grésia, no dikur boot liu nebee hamriik entre matan rua nia klaran nee mak liurai primeiru.
verses.22: Dikur boot nee tohar no dikur haat seluk mak moris fali iha nia fatin iha signifika katak reinu haat mak sei mosu iha nasaun nee, maibee la forsa hanesan ho reinu ida primeiru nee.
verses.23: No depois besik too ona sira nia reinu nia rohan, bainhira ema aat moris barak liu tan, mak liurai ida sei hamriik ho oin siak no nia bele kompriende ai sasiik.
verses.24: Nia forsa sei sai diak liu, maibee la forsa hanesan ho liurai ida primeiru, no nia sei hamosu hahalok aat liu, no saida deit mak nia halo sei susesu; nia sei harahun no hamate ukun nain sira no ema santu sira.
verses.25: No tanba nia matenek ho bosok entaun saida deit mak nia halo sei susesu; iha nia laran nia sei koalia foti aan, no iha tempu hakmatek nia sei hamate ema barak; no mos nia sei hamriik hodi kontra hasoru Liurai ba liurai hotu ninian. Maibee ikus mai nia sei rahun liu hosi liman seluk.
verses.26: Nunee vizaun nebee mai ona iha lokraik no dadeer nee mak loos. Maibee ita tenki subar buat hirak nee hotu tanba buat sira nee sei akontese iha futuru nebee sei dook.”
verses.27: No depois hau, Daniel, kole no monu moras tiha liu loron balu; depois hau hamriik fila fali hodi halo servisu ba liurai. Maibee hau sei tristi nafatin tanba vizaun sira nebee hau la kompriende.

verses.1: Iha tinan primeiru bainhira Dario, Assuero nia oan, ukun, nia mai hosi jerasaun ema Media nebee sai ona liurai ba ema Kaldeia sira,
verses.2: iha tinan primeiru nebee nia ukun, hau Daniel, haree hetan iha livru sira tinan hira nebee Nai nia liafuan hatete ba profeta Jeremias kona ba tempu estraga Jerusalém, tempu nee lao too tinan hitu-nulu.
verses.3: No nunee hau foti oin ba Nai Maromak hodi harohan, no halo jejún, hatais deit karon no tau ahi kdesan iha ulun.
verses.4: Hau harohan no husu ba Nai hau nia Maromak, no konfesa hau nia sala, nunee, “Nai Maromak nebee aas liu no poderozu, ida nebee kaer metin aliansa no domin metin ba ema nebee hadomi O no mos halo tuir O nia orden,
verses.5: ami halo ona buat aat no sala, ami halo ona hahalok aat no kontra O, ami la halo tuir ona ita nia lei no orden sira,
verses.6: no ami la halo tuir ona O nia atan sira nia liafuan, hosi O nia profeta sira nebee koalia hodi O nia naran ba ami nia liurai sira, ba ami nia ukun nain sira, ba ami nia aman sira no ba povu hotu iha rai nee.
verses.7: Oh Nai, O mak loos, agora ami sai moe, ami ema Judá sira, ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém no povu Israel tomak, nebee besik no dook, no iha nasaun hotu nebee deit mak O soe ami tanba ami nia hahalok aat hasoru O.
verses.8: Oh Nai, ami moe, ami nia liurai sira, ami nia nai ulun sira no ami nia aman sira merese moe, tanba ami halo ona sala hasoru O.
verses.9: Iha ami nia Nai, ami nia Maromak, iha laran luak no perdaun, mezmu ami kontra hasoru Nia,
verses.10: no la halo tuir Nai, ami nia Maromak, nia liafuan. Nia haruka ami moris tuir lei nebee Nia foo ba ami liu hosi Nia atan profeta sira.
verses.11: Ema Israel tomak kontra O nia lei no la halo tuir tanba lakohi rona O nia liafuan. Tanba nee malisan kona ona ami, malisan ida nebee hakerek iha Moisés nia lei, tanba ami halo sala ona hasoru Nia.
verses.12: No Nia liafuan nebee Nia koalia nee sai loos duni ba ami no ba ami nia ukun nain sira nebee ukun ami, katak sei iha kastigu boot nebee nunka akontese iha mundu tomak, nebee sei akontese ba Jerusalém.
verses.13: Hanesan ida nebee hakerek iha Moisés nia lei, malisan sira hotu monu ona ba ami nia leten, no ami la husu harohan no ajuda ba Nai, ami nia Maromak, hodi arepende hosi ami nia sala sira hotu no fila fali ba O nia lia loos.
verses.14: Tanba nee Nai prepara malisan sira nee hotu hodi hamonu ba ami; tanba Nai, ami nia Maromak, Nia iha hahalok loos ba buat hotu nebee Nia halo, maibee ami la halo tuir Nia liafuan.
verses.15: Tanba nee, Oh Nai, ami nia Maromak, Ida nebee lori ona Nia povu hotu sai hosi rai Ejitu ho liman nebee forsa liu no foo glória ba O nia Naran, hanesan iha loron ida nee, ami halo ona sala ho ami nia hahalok nebee aat.
verses.16: Oh Nai, tuir O nia hahalok loos, hasai tiha O nia hirus hosi O nia sidade Jerusalém, O nia foho santu; tanba ami nia sala sira no ami nia avoo sira nia hahalok aat mak hamoe Jerusalém no O nia povu sira iha ema hotu nia oin nebee haleu ami.
verses.17: Tanba nee, rona ba, Oh ami nia Maromak, ba O nia atan oan nee nia orasaun no hamulak, halo naroman fila fali O nia Fatin Santu nee ho O nia oin, ba Nai O nia glória rasik, fatin nebee agora sei aat.
verses.18: Oh hau nia Maromak, see O nia tilun mai no rona ba, loke O nia matan no haree ba ami no ba ami nia sidade nebee besik lakon, ami hatoo ami nia orasaun ho laran haraik aan iha O nia oin laos tanba ami iha hahalok loos maibee tanba O nia laran luak nebee boot tebes.
verses.19: Oh Nai, rona ba! Oh Nai, perdua ba! Oh Nai, rona lai no halo ba! Lalika dada tempu tan, tanba nee hotu ba O nia Aan rasik, Oh hau nia Maromak, tanba O nia naran rasik mak iha sidade nee no povu nee nia leet!”
verses.20: Bainhira hau halo orasaun no konfesa hau nia sala no hau nia nasaun Israel nia sala, hodi hatoo ba iha Nai, hau nia Maromak, nia prezensa kona ba hau nia Maromak nia foho santu,
verses.21: hau sei halo orasaun hela, no derepenti deit Gabriel, nebee hau haree ona iha vizaun primeiru, nia semo lalais mai no book hau iha lokraik, iha tempu nebee sira hasae sakrifísiu.
verses.22: Depois nia foo hatene hau no koalia ho hau, “Daniel, hau mai nee atu foo matenek ba ita hodi ita bele kompriende.
verses.23: Bainhira ita komesa hatoo ita nia orasaun sira ho haraik aan mak hau hetan orden, nunee hau mai atu foo hatene fali ba ita, tanba Nai hadomi liu ita. Rona di-diak liafuan nee no kompriende vizaun nee.
verses.24: Tempu hitu-nulu dala hitu nee determina ona ba ita nia povu no mos ba ita nia sidade santu, atu hamate hahalok aat, atu halo remata tiha sala, atu hamoos ema nia sala sira, atu hamosu hahalok loos rohan laek, atu taka vizaun no profesia nee, no atu tau mina ba ida nebee santu liu.
verses.25: Tanba nee kompriende di-diak ba: bainhira mandamentu nee foo sai hodi hadia no harii fila fali Jerusalém, too tempu nebee liurai nebee hili ho mina mai, ida nee haan tempu semana hitu. Durante semana neen-nulu resin rua nee sira halo fali sidade nee nia dalan sira no moru sira, maibee tempu nee sei difisíl tebes.
verses.26: Depois liu tiha semana neen-nulu resin rua nee, ida nebee hili ho mina nee sei mate, ema sei oho nia maibee laos tanba nia. Depois povu hosi liurai nebee sei mai, sira sei harahun sidade no Fatin Santu nee, no tempu ikus nee sei mai ho rai nabeen no funu boot nebee sei estraga mak determina ona.
verses.27: Liurai nee sei konfirma akordu nee ho ema barak durante semana ida. Maibee iha semana ida nee nia klaran nia haruka hapara tiha sakrifísiu no oferta nee; no nia halo aat liu tan too tempu too mai nebee ema sei hamate no halakon tiha nia.”

10.title: Daniel Nia Vizaun Iha Mota Tigre

verses.1: Iha tinan tolu bainhira Siro ukun nudar liurai iha Persia, Daniel, nebee iha naran Belsazar, haree buat ida tan; liafuan nee loos no kona ba susar nebee sei akontese. Nunee nia hatene buat nee no nia kompriende vizaun nee.
verses.2: Iha tempu nee hau, Daniel, halo jejún durante semana tolu nia laran.
verses.3: Hau la haan buat midar, no hau la haan naan no mos hau la hemu tua uvas. Hau la tau mina morin too semana tolu nee remata.
verses.4: Iha loron rua-nulu resin haat, iha fulan primeiru, hau hamriik iha mota ibun Tigre nian.
verses.5: Hau foti oin no haree, derepenti hau haree ema ida hamriik iha hau nia oin no hatais unuk kabeer no nabilan loos no nia sintu ho osan mean hosi Ufaz.
verses.6: Nia isin lolon hanesan fatuk nabilan no nia oin naroman hanesan rai lakan, nia matan hanesan ahi nebee lakan, nia liman no ain hanesan besi riti nebee ema foin hamoos di-diak, no nia lian nebee koalia sai mai rona hanesan lian ema barak nian.
verses.7: Só deit hau Daniel mak bele haree vizaun nee, maibee ema sira nebee hamutuk ho hau sira la bele haree; maibee sira senti tauk tebe-tebes no sira halai buka fatin subar;
verses.8: no nunee hau mesak deit ona. Bainhira hau haree vizaun boot nee, hau nia forsa lakon kedas, no hau senti hau nia forsa la iha tan ona.
verses.9: Depois hau rona nia liafuan nebee nia koalia, no bainhira hau rona hau monu kedas ho oin taka rabat ba rai no toba haluha rai.
verses.10: Maibee iha liman ida nebee kaer hau no halo hau hadeer fila fali ba hau nia ain tuur no liman.
verses.11: Nia hatete mai hau, “Oh Daniel, ita mak ema nebee hetan domin boot, kaer metin liafuan nebee hau sei hatete ba ita, no hamriik ba, tanba Nai haruka hau baa ita.” Bainhira nia koalia liafuan nee hau hamriik maibee ho nakdedar.
verses.12: Depois nia hatete, “Keta tauk, Daniel, tanba hosi loron primeiru nebee ita hanoin atu kompriende no haraik aan iha ita nia Maromak nia prezensa nee, Nai rona hotu ona ita nia liafuan, nunee hau mai tanba liafuan nee.
verses.13: Nai ulun iha reinu Persia nian hamriik hasoru hau durante loron rua-nulu resin ida; maibee hotu tiha, Miguel nebee komandante xefi ida, mai no ajuda hau, tanba hau hela ho liurai sira iha Persia.
verses.14: Tanba nee hau mai atu halo ita kompriende saida mak sei akontese ba ita nia povu iha loron ikus mai, tanba vizaun nee mos koalia kona ba loron ikus.”
verses.15: Bainhira nia koalia liafuan nee mai hau, hau hakruuk no nonook deit hodi rona.
verses.16: Maibee iha ema ida nebee oin hanesan ho mane nia oan, nia hakbesik mai hau no nia liman kona mai hau nia ibun kulit; depois hau loke hau nia ibun no komesa koalia, hau koalia ba ema nebee hamriik hela iha hau nia oin nee, “Oh hau nia senhor, tanba vizaun nee hau sai moras no hau nia forsa mos lakon kedas.
verses.17: Oinsaa mak atan hau nee bele koalia fali ho senhor? Laos hau nia forsa no hau nia iis la iha ona?”
verses.18: Depois ema nee mos kaer tan hau nia isin no foo forsa mai hau,
verses.19: no dehan, “Hei, mane nebee simu domin boot, keta tauk, hakmatek lai. Sai forsa ba, sin, sai forsa tan!” Bainhira nia koalia hela nunee hau senti hau nia forsa fila fali no hatete, “Koalia ba, senhor, tanba agora hau senti ona forsa.”
verses.20: Depois nia hatete, “O hatene ka lae, tanba saa mak hau mai ba ita? La kleur tan hau atu fila fali hodi ba funu hasoru liurai Persia, no bainhira hau baa ona, mak liurai Grésia sei mai.
verses.21: Maibee hau sei foo hatene ba ita saida mak hakerek iha livru lia loos nia laran: la iha ida nebee hamriik forti hamutuk ho hau iha kazu nee, só deit Miguel nebee ita nia liurai, nia mak sei hamutuk ho hau,

verses.1: hanesan moos uluk hau mak hamriik iha nia sorin hodi suporta no habrani nia, iha tinan primeiru bainhira Dario ukun iha Media.”
verses.2: “Tanba nee hau sei foo hatene ba ita buat nebee loos. Haree lai, liurai nain tolu tan sei sae no ukun iha Persia, no liurai ba dala haat sei mai no hetan riku-soin barak liu duké sira nain tolu, no liu hosi nia forsa no riku-soin nia sei halibur sira hodi hasoru reinu Grésia.
verses.3: Depois iha liurai ida nebee iha forsa liu sei ukun, nia sei ukun ho reinu boot liu no sei halo buat hotu tuir nia hakarak.
verses.4: Maibee bainhira nia foin ukun, nia reinu komesa nakfera fahe ba anin haat hosi loro leten, no ukun nee mos la monu ba nia jerasaun no la tuir nia reinu nebee nia ukun, maibee reinu nee sei fokit sae no monu ba ema seluk fali.
verses.5: Liurai iha parte súl sei sai forsa liu; maibee nia komandante ida sei hamriik hasoru nia no sei hadau fali ukun nee hosi nia no reinu nee sei sai forsa liu tan.
verses.6: Liu tiha tinan balu tan sira sei halo aliansa, liurai hosi parte súl nia oan feto sei ba liurai hosi parte norte hodi halo akordu. Maibee ikus mai, feto nee lakon nia forsa, no mos liurai nee la dura. Feto nee sei rende, hamutuk ho nia atan feto sira nee, no nia aman no liurai nebee hetan nia iha tempu nee.
verses.7: Maibee ikus mai, sanak ida mosu mai hosi feto nee nia abut no hamriik iha nia fatin. Nia sei funu hasoru militár nee nunee nia tama too iha liurai iha reinu norte nia fatin seguru hodi manaan tiha sira nia reinu tomak.
verses.8: Nia foti hotu sira nia estátua maromak sira no lori ba Ejitu hamutuk ho sasaan osan mutin no osan mean; depois tinan balu tuir mai nia la ba tan ona hodi halo funu hasoru liurai iha reinu norte.
