verses.9: Depois liurai nee sei hamriik fali hodi ataka reinu súl no tama ba sira nia reinu, maibee la kleur deit nia fila fali ba nia reinu.
verses.10: Depois nia oan sira hamriik fali hodi prepara sira nia tropas rihun ba rihun hodi ba funu hasoru sira, iha ataka primeiru nian sira ataka makaas, no nia ba fali no iha ataka segundu nian mak sira tama too iha kapital iha reinu nee.
verses.11: Nunee liurai reinu súl sai hirus tebe-tebes, nia hamriik fali no ataka fali liurai reinu norte. Nia halibur forsa boot tebes maibee sira sei lakon ba liurai nee nia liman.
verses.12: Bainhira nia manaan tiha funu nee, nia komesa foti aan; mezmu nia manaan tropas rihun ba rihun nee maibee nia ukun sei la hamriik metin.
verses.13: Depois liurai reinu norte nee sei halibur fali nia tropas sira rihun ba rihun no tropas sira nee barak liu fali tropas primeiru nebee iha, no tinan balu tuir mai tan nia sei mai duni ho forsa boot tebes no riku-soin barak.
verses.14: Iha tempu nee ema barak sei hamriik hodi funu hasoru liurai reinu súl; no ema violénsia hosi ita nia povu see foti aan hodi hametin sira nia vizaun, maibee sira sei monu fali.
verses.15: Nunee liurai reinu norte nee sei mai, hodi harii dalan hodi sae moru no tama hodi manaan tiha sidade sira nebee iha moru, ho nunee tropas reinu súl no sira nia liurai la iha tan forsa hodi tahan hasoru sira.
verses.16: Nunee liurai nebee ataka ona nia sei halo saida deit tuir nia hakarak, no la iha tan ema ida nebee bele tahan hasoru nia; nia sei ukun fali rai furak nee no ema hotu iha nia ukun okos.
verses.17: Depois nia sei hakaas aan atu mai ho nia reinu nia forsa tomak, no nia sei halo akordu ida ho liurai nee, no nia sei foo feto nia oan feto ida hodi estraga tiha reinu nee, maibee buat nee la iha susesu no la foo vantajen ba nia aan.
verses.18: Depois nia fila fali nia oin ba sidade sira nebee iha tasi ibun sira hodi ataka no nia manaan sira barak; maibee nia komandante ida hamriik hodi hapara tiha ninia hahalok aat nee no nunee nia selu fali liurai nee nia hahalok aat nebee nia iha nee ba nia aan rasik.
verses.19: Nunee nia fila fali ba nia reinu; maibee bainhira nia fila too iha dalan klaran nia monu lakon tiha, la iha ema ida mak hetan nia.
verses.20: Depois mosu ema ida nebee hamriik hodi troka liurai nee. Nia haruka ema selu taxa ba nia reinu nia glória, maibee bainhira nia ukun iha reinu nee seidauk kleur, nia sei mate. No nia mate laos iha funu laran ka laos mate tanba ema odi nia.
verses.21: Depois iha ema ida nebee moris aat mak hamriik maibee nia la merese atu simu reinu nia onra. Maibee nia hamriik hodi hadau tiha ukun nudar liurai nee ho maneira dame no gaba bosok sira.
verses.22: Tropas sira hotu nebee mai hasoru nia, nia oho hotu kedas, too amu lulik aliansa mos nia oho hotu.
verses.23: No hosi tempu nebee halo akordu nee nia uza maneira lohi, no nia ukun sei sai forsa liu mezmu nia ukun ho ema nebee uitoan.
verses.24: No iha tempu hakmatek, nia ho ninia soldadu sira tama ba iha sidade furak liu nia reinu nee, no sira halo buat aat liu, buat nebee ninia aman sira no ninia bei-ala sira uluk la halo ida nee mak nia halo, nia hadau hotu ema nia riku-soin hodi foo ba ninia ema sira. Nia sei halo planu hasoru fatin seguru, maibee too tempu balu deit.
verses.25: Ho brani tebes nia hamriik hodi prepara nia tropas boot liu hodi ba funu hasoru liurai reinu súl, mezmu liurai reinu súl prepara tropas boot tebes nebee iha forsa atu funu hasoru nia maibee liurai nee la tahan tanba sira uza maneira foer hodi hasoru liurai reinu súl nee.
verses.26: Ema sira nebee besik liu ho liurai reinu súl nee mos sei hamriik hodi kontra hasoru fali sira nia liurai rasik: nia tropas sira balu sei husik tiha nia no barak sei monu mate.
verses.27: No liurai nain rua nee halo planu aat ba malu bainhira sira tuur hamutuk iha meza ida no bosok malu; maibee planu nee la susesu tanba tempu nee seidauk too nia rohan nebee determina ona.
verses.28: Depois liurai nee sei fila fali ba nia reinu ho riku-soin barak tebes, no iha nia laran hanoin atu kontra hasoru aliansa santu. Nia halo tuir ninia hakarak depois nia fila fali ba nia reinu.
verses.29: No tempu nebee determina ona nee too, nia prepara fali nia tropas sira hodi ataka tama fali ba reinu súl, maibee tempu ida nee la hanesan ho tempu primeiru nebee halao ona.
verses.30: Tanba roo sira hosi ema Kitim sira sei mai funu hasoru nia, nunee nia sei lakon nia brani. Depois nia sai tristi no fila fali maibee nia rai odi ba aliansa santu nee. Nia halo hanesan nee, nia sei fila fali baa no fahe matenek ho sira nebee mak husik ona aliansa santu.
verses.31: Depois nia soldadu sira sei mosu mai, no sira sei halo Fatin Santu no fatin seguru nee sai foer liu, sira sei hasai tiha sakrifísiu loro-loron nian no sei harii fali buat foer liu nebee estraga hotu.
verses.32: No ba ema nebee halo aat hasoru aliansa nee, liurai sei uza maneira foer hodi gaba bosok sira. Maibee ema nebee konhese sira nia Maromak, sira sei hamriik metin hodi hasoru nia.
verses.33: No ema matenek sira hosi povu nee sei hanorin ema barak, maibee la kleur deit sira monu fali tanba surik no ahi, no balu tanba tama kadeia no hetan terus.
verses.34: Bainhira sira monu sira sei hetan ajuda uitoan deit, no ema barak sei mai hodi hamutuk ho sira maibee ema barak nee gaba bosok deit.
verses.35: Ema balu hosi ema matenek sira nee sei monu, no tempu nee sei prova sira, no hamoos sira, no halo sira mutin too tempu nia rohan; tanba tempu nee seidauk too mai.
verses.36: Liurai nee sei halo tuir nia hakarak; nia sei gaba aan no foti aan aas liu maromak hotu. No nia sei konta liafuan makaas nebee hasoru Maromak nebee aas liu maromak sira seluk, no nia sei iha susesu too tempu hirus makaas nee hotu ona tuir buat hotu nebee determina ona.
verses.37: No nia mos sei la foo respeitu ba nia bei-ala sira nia maromak; no nia mos la iha deseju ba feto sira no nia la foo respeitu ba maromak nebee deit, tanba nia sei foti aan liu sira nee hotu.
verses.38: Maibee nia sei foo onra ba maromak hosi fatin seguru sira nebee nia bei-ala sira la konhese. Nia sei foo onra ho osan mean, osan mutin, fatuk nabilan no sasaan seluk nebee diak.
verses.39: Nia sei hamriik hodi ba ataka sidade sira nebee forsa liu, maibee ho ajuda hosi maromak foun nee. Ba ema nebee deit mak foo respeitu ba nia, nia sei foo onra ba sira. Nia halo sira sai ema boot hodi ukun ema barak no nia sei selu sira nia kolen ho rai.
verses.40: Maibee too tempu nia rohan too mai, liurai reinu súl sei hamriik hodi funu hasoru nia, no liurai reinu norte mos sei hamriik hodi hasoru nia hanesan anin fuik ho kuda kareta, ho ema sira nebee sae kuda no ho roo boot barak; no nia sei tama rai sira nee hanesan bee boot nebee taka rai tomak.
verses.41: Nia sei tama ba rai furak, no ema barak mak sei monu maibee sira nebee la monu ba nia liman mak rai Edom, rai Moab no rai balu hosi jerasaun Amon nian.
verses.42: Nia sei lolo liman hasoru nasaun sira nee, no rai Ejitu la bele halai sai.
verses.43: Nia sei foti hotu riku-soin hanesan osan mean, no osan mutin no sasaan saida deit mak iha folin hosi Ejitu, no ema hosi rai Libia no rai Etiópia sai mai hodi tuir nia.
verses.44: Maibee nia sei rona liafuan hosi parte lorosae no parte norte nebee sei halo nia nakdedar, nunee nia lao sai ho hirus makaas hodi estraga no oho ema barak.
verses.45: Nia sei harii tenda boot sira entre tasi no foho santu nebee furak, maibee nia sei mate no la iha ema ida mak ajuda nia.”

verses.1: “Iha tempu nee kedas Miguel sei hamriik, nia nebee komandante boot nebee hamriik hodi tau matan ba ita nia povu. No sei mosu terus boot liu, terus nee nunka akontese hosi tempu nasaun sira komesa too tempu nee. Maibee iha tempu nee ita nia povu sei hetan salvasaun, sira hotu nebee naran hakerek iha livru nee.
verses.2: No ema barak nebee iha rate laran nee sei hadeer, balu sei moris fali hodi simu moris rohan laek, maibee balu fali sei moris hodi simu terus no kastigu too rohan laek.
verses.3: No ema matenek sira sei sai naroman hanesan loro matan, no sira nebee fila ema barak ba hahalok loos sei sai naroman hanesan fitun sira too tinan ba tinan.
verses.4: Maibee ita, Daniel, taka liafuan nee, no tau karimbu ida ba livru nee too iha tempu nia rohan. Ema barak sei halai ba-mai, no matenek sei aumenta liu tan.”
verses.5: Tuir mai hau, Daniel, haree ema nain rua hamriik, ida hamriik iha mota sorin mai no ida seluk hamriik iha mota sorin ba.
verses.6: No ema ida husu ba ida nebee hamriik iha mota leten ho hatais unuk kaber, “Too bainhira loos mak tempu boot nee remata?”
verses.7: Depois hau rona ema ida nebee hamriik iha mota leten ho hatais unuk kaber nee foti nia liman rua hotu ba lalehan no jura hodi Nia nebee moris tinan ba tinan nia naran, “Liu tiha tempu ida, tempu sira tan no tempu balu tan, no bainhira nia remata nia planu atu harahun povu santu nia podér, buat hotu foin hotu!”
verses.8: Hau rona nunee maibee hau la kompriende, nunee hau husu, “Oh hau nia senhor, buat hirak nee hotu signifika saida?”
verses.9: Maibee nia hataan, “Baa ona ba, Daniel, tanba liafuan nee hotu sei rai hela no taka tiha ona ho karimbu too tempu nia rohan.
verses.10: Ema barak mak sei hasoru provasaun, no sai mutin no moris moos, maibee ema sala nain sei halo sala, no la iha ema sala nain ida mak bele kompriende buat nee, maibee ema nebee matenek mak sei kompriende.
verses.11: Hosi tempu nebee sira hasai sakrifísiu no harii fali buat foer liu nebee estraga hotu, sei sura too loron rihun ida atus rua sia-nulu.
verses.12: Haksolok ba ema nebee hein nafatin too loron rihun ida atus tolu tolu-nulu resin lima.
verses.13: Maibee ita baa ona ba too tempu nia rohan. O sei deskansa no ita sei hamriik iha ita nia fatin iha tempu nia rohan nia loron ikus.”

1.title: Oseias Nia Feen No Oan Sira

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan nebee mai ba Oseias, oan hosi Beeri, durante liurai Uzias, Jotam, Akaz no Ezekias sira nia ukun, iha Judá, no bainhira Jeroboão, oan hosi Jeoas, ukun iha Israel.
verses.2: Bainhira Nai komesa koalia liu hosi Oseias, Nia hatete: “Baa, hola feto aat ida, no ita sei hetan oan hosi sala foer, tanba nasaun nee halo sala foer boot, bainhira sira sees hosi Nai.”
verses.3: Nee duni nia baa no hola Gomer, oan feto hosi Diblaim. Feto nee isin rua no tuur ahi oan mane ida.
verses.4: Entaun Nai hatete ba Oseias, “Hanaran nia Jezreel, tanba la kleur tan Hau sei kastigu liurai Jeú nia jerasaun, tanba sira oho ema barak iha Jezreel, no Hau sei halo reinu Israel remata tiha.
verses.5: Iha loron nebaa Hau sei halo tohar Israel nia rama inan iha Rai Tetuk Jezreel.”
verses.6: Gomer isin rua fila fali no tuur ahi oan feto ida. Entaun Nai hatete ba Oseias, “Hanaran nia Lo-Ruhama, tanba Hau sei la hatudu tan laran luak ba nasaun Israel hodi foo perdaun ba sira.”
verses.7: Maibee, Hau sei hatudu domin ba nasaun Judá; no Hau sei salva sira liu hosi Nai, sira nia Maromak. Laos liu hosi rama inan, ka surik, ka funu, ka kuda no tropas sira nebee sae kuda, maibee liu hosi Nai, sira nia Maromak.”
verses.8: Hafoin Lo-Ruhama husik susu, Gomer tuur ahi oan mane ida tan.
verses.9: Entaun, Nai hatete, “Hanaran nia Lo-Ami, tanba imi laos Hau nia povu, no Hau laos imi nia Maromak.”
verses.10: Maski nunee, Israel nia oan sira sei nafatin barak hanesan rai henek iha tasi ibun, nebee la bele sukat no sura. Iha fatin nebee Maromak dehan ona ba sira, ‘Imi laos Hau nia povu,’ Nia sei bolu sira, ‘Maromak moris nia oan sira.’
verses.11: Povu Judá no povu Israel sei halibur hamutuk, no sira sei hili nai ulun ida deit ba sira. No sira sei sae baa hosi rai nee, tanba Jezreel nia loron sei sai boot.

verses.1: “Bolu imi nia maun-alin sira ‘Ami,’ no imi nia feton sira ‘Ruhama.’
verses.2: Foti kazu kontra imi nia inan, foti kazu ba,
verses.3: Se nia la halo nunee, Hau sei husik nia molik
verses.4: Hau sei la hatudu laran luak ba ninia oan sira,
verses.5: Sira nia inan halo sala foer;
verses.6: Tanba nunee mak Hau sei taka ninia dalan ho ai-tarak;
verses.7: Nia sei halai tuir ninia doben sira,
verses.8: Nia la rekonhese katak Hau mak foo
verses.9: Tanba nunee mak Hau sei foti fali
verses.10: Agora Hau sei hatudu sai ninia oin lulik
verses.11: Hau sei hapara ninia haksolok,
verses.12: Hau sei estraga ninia uvas huun no ai figeira sira,
verses.13: Hau sei kastigu nia tanba loron sira nebee nia oferese insensu ba Baal sira,
verses.14: “Nunee tebes, Hau sei dada ninia atensaun mai Hau,
verses.15: Iha nebaa Hau sei foo fila fali ninia toos uvas sira,
verses.16: “No iha loron nebaa,” hatete Nai, “o sei bolu Hau ‘Hau nia Laen.’ O sei la bolu tan Hau ‘Hau nia Baal.’
verses.17: Tanba Hau sei hasai hosi o nia ibun Baal sira nia naran sira, no o sei la hanoin tan naran sira nee.
verses.18: Iha loron nebaa, hau sei halo akordu ida ho animál fuik sira hosi ai laran no ho manu sira nebee semo iha lalehan, no mos ho animál sira nebee dolar iha rai. Hau sei halakon rama inan, surik no funu hosi rai nee, no Hau sei halo o toba hakmatek.
verses.19: Hau sei kaben ho o ba nafatin. Hau sei kaben ho o tuir buat loos no justu, ho domin metin no laran luak.
verses.20: Hau sei kaben ho o ho fidelidade, no o sei konhese Nai.
verses.21: “Iha loron nebaa, Hau sei hataan,” hatete Nai,
verses.22: no rai sei hataan ba batar, ba tua uvas no ba mina,
verses.23: Hau sei kuda nia ba Hau rasik iha rai nee.

verses.1: Nai hatete mai hau, “Baa, no dala ida tan hadomi feto ida nebee sai ona mane seluk nia doben no halo sala adultériu. Nee hanesan Nai hadomi ema Israel sira, maski sira fila ba maromak sira seluk no gosta dosi ho uvas maran.”
verses.2: Entaun hau hola nia ho osan mutin grama atus ida ualu-nulu no ho trigu boot bidon ida ho balu.
verses.3: Hau hatete ba nia, “O tenki hela hamutuk ho hau iha loron barak nia laran. O la bele sai feto aat no la bele sai mane seluk nian. No hau sei hela hamutuk ho o.”
verses.4: Tanba ema Israel sira sei la iha liurai ka nai ulun ruma iha loron barak nia laran, no sei la iha sakrifísiu ka ai riin lulik, no sei la iha batina saserdote nian, no sei la iha sasaan lulik uma laran nian.
verses.5: Hafoin tempu nee, ema Israel sira sei fila fali hodi buka Nai, sira nia Maromak, no David, sira nia liurai. Sira sei mai ho hamtauk ba Nai hodi buka Nai nia laran diak iha tempu ikus.

verses.1: Rona Nai nia liafuan, ema Israel sira,
verses.2: Buat nebee iha mak liafuan hotar,
verses.3: Rai nee halerik,
verses.4: Maibee, ema ida lalika istori malu ho ninia maluk,
verses.5: Imi sei sidi iha loron,
verses.6: Hau nia povu lakon ona tanba sira la matenek.
verses.7: Kuandu sira aumenta tan,
verses.8: Sira haan Hau nia povu nia sala,
verses.9: Entaun, Hau sei kastigu povu sira no saserdote sira
verses.10: Sira sei haan, maibee sira la bosu;
verses.11: ba prostituisaun, ba tua tuan no foun,
verses.12: Sira husu konselhu hosi ai pedasuk ida,
verses.13: Sira halo sakrifísiu iha foho tutun
verses.14: Hau sei la kastigu imi nia oan feto sira bainhira sira halo sala prostituisaun,
verses.15: Maski o halo sala adultériu, Oh Israel,
verses.16: Ema Israel sira ulun toos
verses.17: Efraim baa hamutuk ho ídulu sira;
verses.18: Bainhira tua hotu ona, sira halo sala prostituisaun;
verses.19: Anin boot sei falun sira ho ninia liras,

verses.1: “Rona ba, saserdote sira!
verses.2: Traidór sira oho ema barak.
verses.3: Hau hatene Efraim;
verses.4: Sira nia hahalok la foo dalan
verses.5: Sira nia hahalok foti aan nee sai sasin nebee kontra sira.
verses.6: Sira sei baa, ho sira nia animál sira no karau sira,
verses.7: Sira hatudu hahalok la fiel ba Nai;
verses.8: Huu korneta halo lia iha Gibea,
verses.9: Efraim sei sai rahun
verses.10: Nai ulun sira hosi Judá,
verses.11: Efraim sei hetan terus, no julgamentu hanehan nia,
verses.12: Hau sei sai hanesan borboleta ba Efraim,
verses.13: Bainhira Efraim haree nia moras,
verses.14: Hau sei sai hanesan liaun ida ba Efraim,
verses.15: Entaun Hau sei fila fali ba Hau nia fatin,

verses.1: “Mai, mai ita fila fali ba Nai.
verses.2: Liu tiha loron rua, Nia sei foo fali moris mai ita;
verses.3: Mai ita konhese Nai,
verses.4: Saida mak Hau sei halo ho o, Oh Efraim?
verses.5: Tanba nunee mak Hau fera imi liu hosi Hau nia profeta sira;
verses.6: Buat nebee Hau hakarak mak domin metin, laos sakrifísiu;
verses.7: Maibee, hanesan Adão, sira halo kotu aliansa,
verses.8: Gilead mak sidade ida hosi ema aat sira,
verses.9: Hanesan naok-teen sira subar hodi hein ema,
verses.10: Hau haree buat aat tebe-tebes iha Israel nia uma kain nia leet:
verses.11: Ba o, Oh Judá, sei iha kolheita ida,

7.title: Efraim nia sala aat mosu tiha, no Samaria nia hahalok aat.

verses.1: Bainhira Hau atu kura Israel,
verses.2: Maibee sira la hanoin katak
verses.3: Sira halo liurai haksolok ho sira nia hahalok aat,
verses.4: Sira hotu halo sala foer.
verses.5: Iha loron nebee ita nia liurai halo festa,
verses.6: Bainhira sira hakbesik malu hodi haksesuk malu,
verses.7: Sira hotu sai manas hanesan fornu ida,
verses.8: Efraim kahur malu ho nasaun sira.
verses.9: Ema estranjeiru sira supa ninia forsa,
verses.10: Israel nia hahalok nebee foti aan
verses.11: Efraim hanesan manu pombu ida,
verses.12: Bainhira sira baa, Hau sei kaer sira ho Hau nia redi;
verses.13: Susar ba sira, tanba sira hadook aan hosi Hau!
verses.14: Bainhira sira harohan halerik iha sira nia kama,
verses.15: Hau mak hanorin sira no haforsa sira nia liman,
verses.16: Sira fila, maibee laos ba Ida Nebee Aas Liu.

verses.1: Tau bibi aman dikur iha imi nia ibun!
verses.2: Israel bolu Hau,
verses.3: Maibee Israel rejeita buat nebee diak;
verses.4: Sira foti liurai, maibee laos liu hosi Hau.
verses.5: Samaria, soe tiha o nia karau oan ida nee!
verses.6: Karau oan nee halo iha Israel!
verses.7: Sira kuda anin,
verses.8: Ema tolan tiha Israel;
verses.9: Sira baa tiha Asíria.
verses.10: Maski sira selu nasaun sira hodi hetan ajuda,
verses.11: Maski Efraim harii altár barak hodi oferese sakrifísiu tanba sala,
verses.12: Hau hakerek ba sira Hau nia ukun fuan barak tebes,
verses.13: Sira halo sakrifísiu naan ba Hau,
verses.14: Israel haluha tiha ninia Kriadór, no sira harii palásiu.

verses.1: Israel, o keta haksolok!
verses.2: Fatin baku trigu no fatin sama uvas sei la too hodi halo povu bosu,
verses.3: Sira sei la hela permanente iha Nai nia rai,
verses.4: Sira sei la fui tua uvas nudar oferta hemu nian ba Nai,
verses.5: Imi sei halo saida iha imi nia festa nia loron,
verses.6: Haree ba! Sira halai hodi la sai lakon,
verses.7: Loron kastigu nian sei too mai,
verses.8: Profeta ida, nebee hela ho hau nia Maromak,
verses.9: Sira husik deit sira nia hahalok sai aat liu,
verses.10: Bainhira Hau hetan Israel,
verses.11: Efraim nia glória sei semo lakon hosi nia hanesan manu ida:
verses.12: Maski sira hakiak oan,
verses.13: Hau haree Efraim hanesan ai palma ida nebee kuda iha fatin furak.
verses.14: Foo ba sira, Oh Nai -
verses.15: Sira nia hahalok aat hotu hahuu iha Gilgal;
verses.16: Efraim hetan kanek,
verses.17: Hau nia Maromak sei rejeita sira,

verses.1: Israel mak uvas huun nebee buras tebes,
verses.2: Sira nia laran falsu,
verses.3: Entaun, sira sei dehan:
verses.4: Sira koalia liafuan mamuk,
verses.5: Povu nebee hela iha Samaria tauk nakdedar
verses.6: Sasaan nee ema sei lori ba rai Asíria
verses.7: Samaria nia liurai sei lakon hanesan ai sanak oan
verses.8: Altár sira iha fatin aas iha Aven, nebee Israel nia sala,
verses.9: Hosi tempu Gibea kedas mak o halo sala, Oh Israel,
verses.10: Bainhira Hau hakarak, Hau sei kastigu sira.
verses.11: Efraim mak hanesan karau inan oan ida nebee simu treinu,
verses.12: Kari hahalok loos ba imi rasik,
verses.13: Maibee imi kuda hahalok aat,
verses.14: nunee konfuzaun funu nian sei mai ba imi nia povu,
verses.15: Hanesan nee mos sei akontese ho o, Oh Betél,

verses.1: Bainhira Israel sei labarik, Hau hadomi nia,
verses.2: Maibee, bainhira Hau bolu tan sira,
verses.3: Hau mak hanorin Efraim atu lao,
verses.4: Hau lori sira ho tali nebee laran diak
verses.5: Sira sei la fila ba rai Ejitu,
verses.6: Surik sei nabilan iha sira nia sidade sira,
verses.7: Hau nia povu desidi ona atu hasees aan hosi Hau.
verses.8: Oinsaa mak Hau bele husik o, Oh Efraim?
verses.9: Hau sei la halo tuir Hau nia hirus makaas,
verses.10: Sira sei tuir Nai.
verses.11: Sira sei sai mai ho laran nakdedar hosi Ejitu hanesan manu,
verses.12: Efraim haleu Hau ho liafuan bosok.

12.title: Nia duni anin lorosae iha loron tomak nia laran.

verses.1: Efraim haan anin deit.
verses.2: Nai iha keixa ida kontra Judá.
verses.3: Iha inan nia kabun laran,
verses.4: Nia luta hasoru anju ida no manaan.
verses.5: Tebes, nee mak Nai rasik, Maromak Forsa Nain!
verses.6: Nee duni, fila fali ba o nia Maromak,
verses.7: Hanesan ema fila liman nebee kaer dasin la loos,
verses.8: Efraim hatete, “Hai, hau sai riku ona,
verses.9: Hau mak Nai, o nia Maromak,
verses.10: Hau mak koalia ho profeta sira,
verses.11: Se iha hahalok aat iha Gilead,
verses.12: Jacó halai ba rai Aram.
verses.13: Nai uza profeta ida hodi hasai Israel hosi Ejitu,
verses.14: Efraim, ho laran moruk tebes, provoka laran hirus.

verses.1: Uluk, bainhira Efraim koalia, ema sira nakdedar;
verses.2: Agora sira halo sala liu tan;
verses.3: Tanba nunee, sira sei sai hanesan abu-abu dader-saan nian,
verses.4: Nai hatete: “Hau mak Nai, imi nia Maromak,
verses.5: Hau hatene imi bainhira imi sei iha rai fuik,
verses.6: Konforme sira nia kampu duut, sira haan too bosu;
verses.7: Nee duni, Hau sei sai ba sira hanesan liaun ida;
verses.8: Hau sei ataka sira hanesan ursu inan siak ida nebee lakon ninia oan sira,
verses.9: O, Oh Israel, mak lakon,
verses.10: Agora, o nia liurai nebee tenki salva o iha o nia sidade sira hotu, nia iha nebee?
verses.11: Hau foo tiha liurai ida ba o bainhira Hau hirus hela;
verses.12: Efraim nia hahalok aat sei rejistu hela,
verses.13: Nia sei hetan moras hanesan feto nebee partus hela.
verses.14: Hau sei selu hodi hetan sira hosi Fatin Mate nia kbiit ka?
verses.15: Maski Efraim bele buras iha ninia maun-alin sira nia leet,
verses.16: Povu Samaria sei lori nia todan,

verses.1: Fila fali Israel, ba Nai, o nia Maromak.
verses.2: Prepara liafuan,
verses.3: Asíria sei la bele salva ami;
verses.4: Hau sei foo kura ba sira nia hahalok nebee halo sira sees hosi Hau,
verses.5: Hau sei sai hanesan mahobeen ba Israel;
verses.6: Ninia sanak sira sei sai boot.
verses.7: Sira nebee uluk hela iha ninia mahon sei fila fali.
verses.8: Oh Efraim, Hau iha relasaun saida ho ídulu sira?”
verses.9: See mak iha matenek klean,

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan nebee mai ba Joel, oan mane hosi Petuel:
verses.2: Rona lai, katuas sira;
verses.3: Konta kona ba ida nee ba imi nia oan sira,
verses.4: Buat nebee gafanhotu nebee hamlaha mak husik,
verses.5: Hadeer ba, lanu-teen sira, no tanis ba,
verses.6: Tanba nasaun ida sae mai hodi hasoru hau nia rai,
verses.7: Nia estraga ona hau nia ai uvas
verses.8: Halerik ba hanesan virjen ida nebee hatais hena karoon
verses.9: Oferta trigu no oferta hemu nian mak lakon
verses.10: Toos sira nee mak lakon ona,
verses.11: Sai moe ba, Oh imi nebee fila rai;
verses.12: Ai uvas sai maran;
verses.13: Hatais hena karoon no tanis ba, Oh saserdote sira;
verses.14: Konsagra tempu jejún;
verses.15: Aii, susar ba loron nee!
verses.16: Laos ai haan nee lakon ona
verses.17: Fini sai maran iha rai laran;
verses.18: Oinsaa animál sira tanis halerik!
verses.19: Hau bolu ba O, Oh Nai,
verses.20: Animál sira iha rai luan mos hamrook too sira buka O

verses.1: Huu bibi dikur ida iha Zion;
verses.2: loron ida nebee nakukun no nakaras,
verses.3: Ahi haan mohu iha sira nia oin,
verses.4: Sira iha oin hanesan kuda,
verses.5: Hanesan kuda kareta nebee halo lian tarutu,
verses.6: Povu sira iha laran taridu iha sira nia oin;
verses.7: Hanesan asuwain mak sira halai avansa hodi ataka;
verses.8: Sira la sasurut malu;
verses.9: Sira haksoit ba sidade nia leten,
verses.10: Rai nakdoko iha sira nia oin;
verses.11: Nai koalia hela
verses.12: “Maski nunee, agora kedas,” hatete Nai,
verses.13: no lees imi nia fuan laran, laos imi nia ropa.”
verses.14: See mak hatene karik Nia sei fila fali no husik Ninia planu,
verses.15: Huu bibi dikur iha Zion;
verses.16: halibur povu nee.
verses.17: Entre Templu nia tama fatin no altár
verses.18: Depois Nai sai laran moras ba Ninia rai
verses.19: Nai hataan no dehan ba Ninia povu,
verses.20: Hau sei hasai ema hosi parte norte hodi nia sai dook hosi imi,
verses.21: Keta tauk, Oh rai;
verses.22: Keta tauk, animál sira iha rai luan,
verses.23: Sai kontenti, Oh oan sira hosi Zion,
verses.24: Fatin nebee baku trigu sei sai nakonu ho trigu;
verses.25: Hau sei foo fali ba imi rezultadu hosi tinan sira
verses.26: Imi sei haan barak no sai bosu,
verses.27: Imi sei hatene katak Hau iha Israel nia leet,
verses.28: “No tuir mai ida nee sei akontese,
verses.29: Ba atan mane no atan feto mos,
verses.30: “Hau sei hatudu sinál iha lalehan no iha mundu, nebee raan, ahi no ahi suar.
verses.31: Loro matan sei sai nakukun, no fulan sei sai raan, molok Nai nia loron mai nebee boot no makaas tebes.
verses.32: Tuir mai, ema hotu nebee bolu ba Nai nia naran sei hetan salvasaun. Iha Foho Zion no iha Jerusalém sei iha ema nebee hetan salvasaun, tuir liafuan nebee Nai hatete ona. Tanba Nai sei bolu ema balu hosi ema nia leet nebee sei moris hela.

3.title: Nai Sei Tesi Lia ba Nasaun Sira

verses.1: “Tanba tebes, iha loron nebaa no iha tempu nebaa, bainhira Hau halo diak fali sira nia moris iha Judá no Jerusalém,
verses.2: Hau sei halibur nasaun hotu no lori sira tuun ba Foho Leet Jeosafat. No Hau sei tesi lia ba sira iha nebaa. Hau sei defende Hau nia povu no Hau nia liman rohan Israel. Tanba sira halo Hau nia povu lao namkari ona iha nasaun sira nia leet no sira fahe ona Hau nia rai.
verses.3: Sira dada rifa hodi hetan Hau nia povu. Sira troka labarik mane ida hodi hetan feto luroon. No sira faan labarik feto ida hodi hetan tua uvas nebee sira hemu tiha ona.
verses.4: “Saida mak imi ba Hau, Oh Tiro no Sidon, no distritu hotu iha Filistia? Imi selu fali Hau kona ba buat ruma ka? Se imi selu fali Hau, entaun Hau sei selu fali imi nia pagamentu nee ba imi nia ulun rasik, no selu lalais kedas.
verses.5: Tanba imi foti ona Hau nia osan mutin no osan mean, no imi lori ona Hau nia riku-soin furak ba imi nia templu sira.
verses.6: Imi faan ona povu Judá no Jerusalém ba ema Gregu hodi sira ba dook hosi sira nia rai.
verses.7: Tebes, Hau sei fanu sira hosi fatin nebee imi faan sira ba. No Hau sei selu fali imi nia pagamentu ba imi nia ulun rasik.

verses.5: Depois hau dehan,

verses.1: Iha loron ida Nai koalia ba Jonas, Amitai nia oan.
verses.2: Nia hatete, “Hamriik ba no baa iha sidade boot Nínive. Koalia makaas ba ema iha sidade nee, tanba Hau hatene ema sira nee aat tebe-tebes.”
verses.3: Maibee Jonas halai ba Tarsis fali hodi dook tiha hosi Nai nia prezensa. Nia tuun baa iha Jope. Iha nebaa nia hetan roo boot ida nebee atu baa Tarsis. Nia selu tiket roo boot nian no nia sae roo nee. Nia baa hamutuk ho sira atu baa Tarsis, hodi dook hosi Nai nia prezensa.
verses.4: Maibee Nai haruka anin boot ida ba tasi no halo laloran boot. Tasi boot nee baku roo ba-mai too atu nakfera. Depois roo nain sira tauk tebe-tebes.
verses.5: Ida-idak hakilar husu tulun hosi ninia maromak. Sira foti sasaan iha roo boot laran no soe ba tasi hodi halo roo kamaan. Maibee Jonas tuun tiha ona ba roo boot nia laran no toba haluha rai iha nebaa.
verses.6: Bainhira kapitaun tuun baa nia dehan ba Jonas, “O halo saida, dukur door nee? Hadeer ba, no bolu ba o nia Maromak! Se karik Maromak bele hanoin ita, nunee ita la mate.”
verses.7: Roo nain sira dehan ba malu, “Mai ita dada rifa atu ita hatene see mak halo sala too ita hetan perigu nunee.” Sira dada rifa monu ba Jonas.
verses.8: Entaun sira dehan ba Jonas, “Agora hatete mai ami. See nia sala mak halo perigu nee kona ita? O halo servisu saida? O mai hosi nebee? O nia rai iha nebee? See mak o nia povu?”
verses.9: Jonas hataan, “Hau ema Ebreu. Hau hamtauk ba Nai, Maromak iha lalehan, nebee halo tasi no rai maran.
verses.10: Depois roo nain sira nee tauk liu tan, no sira dehan ba nia, “Nusaa mak o halo hanesan nee!” Tanba sira hatene ona katak nia halai hosi Nai nia prezensa, tanba nia konta ona hahalok nee ba sira.
verses.11: Entaun roo nain sira husu ba nia, “Saida mak ami tenki halo ba o hodi tasi bele hakmatek fali ba ami?” Tanba tasi nee sai boot tan fali.
verses.12: Jonas hataan ba sira, “Foti hau no soe tiha hau ba tasi laran. Nunee tasi sei hakmatek fali ba imi. Tanba hau hatene katak laloran boot nee kona imi tanba hau.”
verses.13: Maibee ema sira nee hakaas aan tomak hodi hean roo ba rai maran. Maibee sira la konsege tanba tasi sai makaas liu tan hasoru sira.
verses.14: Entaun sira bolu ba Nai no dehan, “Oh Nai, keta husik ami mate tanba ema ida nee nia moris. Keta rai raan inosenti nee ba ami. Tanba O, Oh Nai, mak halo ona buat nee tuir O nia hakarak.”
verses.15: Tuir mai sira foti Jonas no soe nia ba tasi laran. No tasi nee hakmatek kedas.
verses.16: Nunee roo nain sira tauk atu mate ba Nai. No sira halo sakrifísiu ba Nai no halo juramentu.
verses.17: No Nai haruka ikan boot ida mai tolan tiha Jonas. No nia hela iha ikan nia kabun laran too kalan tolu, loron tolu.

verses.1: Iha ikan nia kabun laran, Jonas halo orasaun ba Nai nia Maromak.
verses.2: Nia dehan,
verses.3: Tanba O soe hau ba fatin nebee klean
verses.4: Hau dehan, ‘Nai duni sai ona hau hosi Ninia oin.
verses.5: Tasi been taka hau hodi halakon hau nia moris,
verses.6: Hau tuun too iha foho huun.
verses.7: Bainhira hau nia moris kamutis atu lakon,
verses.8: Sira nebee tuir buat bosok nebee la iha folin,
verses.9: Maibee ho lian agradese
verses.10: Depois Nai koalia ba ikan nee, no nia muta sai Jonas ba rai maran.

verses.1: Ba dala rua, Nai koalia ba Jonas, no Nia dehan,
verses.2: “Hamriik ba, no baa iha sidade boot Nínive. Koalia makaas ba sira ho mensajen nebee Hau foo ba o nee.”
verses.3: Entaun Jonas hamriik no baa Nínive, tuir Nai nia liafuan. Nínive mak sidade boot tebes no haan loron tolu hodi lao hosi sorin mai too sorin ba.
verses.4: Jonas komesa tama iha sidade, no nia lao loron tomak. Nia bolu ba sira, “Iha loron haat-nulu tan, Nínive sei lakon.”
verses.5: Entaun ema Nínive fiar ba Maromak. Povu tomak desidi atu halo jejún, no ema hotu-hotu, kiik no boot, hatais hena karoon.
verses.6: Bainhira liurai hosi Nínive rona liafuan nee, nia tuun hosi ninia kadunan. Nia hasai hena liurai nian no nia hatais fali hena karoon, no nia tuur iha ahi kdesan.
verses.7: Liurai mos foo orden hodi foo avizu ba povu hotu iha sidade nee nunee, “Ida nee mak orden hosi liurai no nia ministru sira: La bele iha ema ida nebee haan. Ema hotu no animál hotu, inklui karau lubun no bibi lubun, la bele haan buat ida. Sira la bele haan ka hemu.
verses.8: Ema no animál sira tenki hatais hena karoon, no sira tenki bolu makaas ba Maromak. Sira tenki husik sira nia hahalok aat no violénsia nebee iha sira nia liman.
verses.9: See mak hatene? Karik Maromak bele fila no muda Ninia hanoin no husik nia laran hirus. Nunee ita sei la mate.”
verses.10: Bainhira Maromak haree buat nebee sira halo, no oinsaa sira husik ona sira nia hahalok aat nee, nunee Nia muda Ninia hanoin. Nia husik planu atu haruka dezastre nebee Nia dehan katak Nia atu halo ba sira. No Nia la halo tuir ida nee.

verses.1: Tanba nunee, Jonas la kontenti no hirus tebe-tebes.
verses.2: Entaun nia halo orasaun ba Nai, no dehan, “Oh Nai, tanba nee mak hau dehan ona molok hau husik hau nia rai. Tanba nee mak hau halai ba Tarsis. Hau hatene ona katak O mak Maromak ida nebee iha grasa no laran luak. O neineik atu hirus, no iha domin metin nebee luan tebes. No O lakohi haruka dezastre.
verses.3: Agora, Oh Nai, favór ida, hasai tiha hau nia vida moris hosi hau. Tanba diak liu hau mate deit duké hau moris.”
verses.4: Nai hataan, “O halo diak bainhira o hirus hanesan nee ka?”
verses.5: Jonas sai hosi sidade no nia tuur iha parte lorosae hosi sidade nee. Nia halo baraka ida iha nebaa. Nia tuur iha mahon nee hodi hein saida mak sei akontese ba sidade nee.
verses.6: Tuir mai, Nai Maromak halo moris ai horis ida hodi foo mahon ba Jonas, nunee atu salva nia hosi terus. No Jonas haksolok tebe-tebes ho ai horis nee.
verses.7: Maibee iha aban dadeer-saan, Maromak haruka ular ida mai haan tiha ai horis nee nia abut. Nunee ai horis nee namlaik tiha.
verses.8: Bainhira loro matan sae ona, Maromak haruka anin fuik ida mai hosi loro sae. No loron manas sunu Jonas nia ulun. Nunee Jonas besik atu dezmaia. Depois nia husu atu mate. Nia dehan, “Diak liu hau mate deit duké hau moris!”
verses.9: Maibee Maromak dehan ba Jonas, “O halo diak bainhira o hirus tanba ai horis nee ka?” Jonas hataan, “Sin, hau halo diak bainhira hau hirus. Hau hirus atu mate.”
verses.10: Depois Nai dehan ba nia, “O hanoin tristi kona ba ai horis nee, nebee o la servisu hodi hetan no o la kuda nia. Ai horis nee moris iha kalan ida deit, no iha kalan ida tan nia namlaik tiha.

verses.12: Depois Zorobabel, oan hosi Sealtiel, no Josué, oan hosi Jeozadak, saserdote boot nee, no ema barak hosi nasaun nee rona tuir Nai, sira nia Maromak nia lian, no mos profeta Ageu nia liafuan, tanba Nai, sira nia Maromak, mak haruka nia. No povu nee hamtauk ba Nai.

No Nia book espíritu hosi ema restu iha nebaa. Nunee mak sira hotu mai no halo servisu hodi harii uma ba Nai Forsa Nain, sira nia Maromak.

verses.2: “Agora, koalia ba Zorobabel, oan hosi Sealtiel, governadór hosi Judá, no ba Josué, oan hosi Jeozadak, saserdote boot nee, no ba ema restu hosi povu nee, no dehan,
verses.3: ‘Iha imi nia leet, see mak haree ona uma nee nia glória uluk nian? No oinsaa imi haree nia kondisaun agora nee? Laos uma nee agora la iha folin liu tuir imi nia haree?
verses.4: Maibee agora, sai forti ba, Oh Zorobabel, hatete Nai. Sai forti ba, Oh Josué, oan hosi Jeozadak, saserdote boot nee. Sai forti ba, Oh povu hotu iha rai nee, hatete Nai. Servisu ba, tanba Hau nee hamutuk ho imi, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.5: Ida nee tuir promesa nebee mak Hau kesi ona ho imi bainhira imi sai hosi rai Ejitu. Hau nia Espíritu sei hela iha imi nia leet. La bele tauk!
verses.6: Tanba Nai Forsa Nain dehan nunee: Dala ida tan, iha tempu uitoan tan, Hau sei doko lalehan no mundu, tasi no rai maran.
verses.7: Hau sei doko nasaun hotu, nunee sasaan furak hosi nasaun hotu sei tama mai. Nunee mak Hau sei halo nakonu uma nee ho glória, dehan Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.8: Osan mutin no osan mean mak Hau nian, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.9: Uma nee nia glória sei sai furak liu uluk nian, dehan Nai Forsa Nain. No iha fatin nee Hau sei haraik dame, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.”
verses.10: Iha loron rua-nulu resin haat, iha fulan sia, nebee iha tinan segundu iha tempu Darius nian, Nai nia liafuan mai liu hosi profeta Ageu, no nia dehan,
verses.11: “Nai Forsa Nain dehan nunee: Husu ba saserdote sira kona ba lei.
verses.12: ‘Se iha ema ida nebee lori naan santu iha nia ropa laran, no ropa nee kona paun ka sasoro ka tua uvas ka mina ka hahaan naran deit, buat hirak nee sei sai santu ka lae?’” Saserdote sira nee hataan, no dehan, “Lae!”
verses.13: Depois Ageu dehan, “Se ema ida nebee la moos tanba nia kona ona mate isin no nia kona fali buat hirak nee, nunee buat sira nee sei sai la moos ka lae?” Saserdote sira nee hataan, no dehan, “Buat sira nee sai la moos.”
verses.14: Nunee Ageu koalia, no nia dehan, “Nunee mos ho povu nee, no ho nasaun nee iha Hau nia oin, hatete Nai. No mos ho buat hotu nebee sira nia liman mak halo. No buat nebee sira oferese iha nebaa nee la moos.”
verses.15: “Tanba nee agora, hanoin di-diak hosi loron nee ba oin! Molok ema hada fatuk ida iha fatuk seluk nia leten hodi harii Nai nia templu,
verses.16: oinsaa mak imi nia kondisaun? Bainhira ema ida baa haree trigu bou boot nebee tuir loloos iha bote rua-nulu, nia hetan deit sanulu. No bainhira ema baa iha tanki tua uvas nian hodi kuru tua uvas botir lima-nulu, nia hetan deit botir rua-nulu.
verses.17: Hau baku ona imi no imi nia produsaun hotu hosi imi nia liman nia servisu ho ai tahan namkurut, ai tahan kamutis no udan fatuk, maibee imi la fila mai Hau, hatete Nai.
verses.18: Hanoin di-diak hosi loron nee ba oin, hahuu hosi loron rua-nulu resin haat iha fulan sia nee. Hahuu hosi loron nebee imi harii fundasaun ba templu Nai nian nee, hanoin di-diak:
verses.19: imi haree katak fini tama ona armazén ka lae? Too agora ai uvas, ai figeira, ai rumaun no ai oliveira la foo buat ida. Maibee hahuu hosi loron nee kedas Hau sei foo bensaun ba imi!”
verses.20: Ba dala rua Nai nia liafuan mai ba Ageu iha loron rua-nulu resin haat iha fulan nebaa, no dehan:
verses.21: “Dehan ba Zorobabel, governadór hosi Judá, hanesan nee: Hau atu doko lalehan no mundu,
verses.22: no Hau atu hamonu reinu sira nia kadunan. Hau atu destrui nasaun sira nia reinu nia forsa, no hamonu sira nia kuda kareta no kuda nain sira. Kuda no sira nia nain sei monu, ida-idak liu hosi ninia maluk nia surik.
verses.23: Iha loron nebaa, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, Hau sei foti o, Oh Zorobabel, oan hosi Sealtiel, Hau nia atan, hatete Nai, no Hau sei halo o sai hanesan kadeli karimbu nian; tanba Hau hili ona o, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.”

verses.1: Iha fulan ualu, iha tinan ba dala rua, iha tempu Dariu nian, Nai nia liafuan hatoo ba profeta Zakarias, oan hosi Barakias, oan hosi Ido, no dehan,
verses.2: “Nai mak hirus makaas ho ita nia bei-ala sira.
verses.3: Nunee hatete ba sira, Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Fila fali mai Hau, nunee mak Hau sei fila fali ba imi, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.4: La bele sai hanesan imi nia bei-ala sira nebee profeta sira hakilar no dehan ona, ‘Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Fila fali hosi imi nia dalan aat no imi nia hahalok aat sira!’ Maibee sira lakohi rona no lakohi hanoin Hau, hatete Nai.
verses.5: Imi nia bei-ala sira iha nebee? No profeta sira moris too tinan ba tinan ka?
verses.6: Maibee Hau nia liafuan no estatutu hotu nebee Hau hatoo ona ba Hau nia atan sira, nebee profeta sira, laos liafuan nee hasoru ona ita nia bei-ala sira? Nunee sira arepende no hatete, ‘Tuir Nai Forsa Nain nia hanoin atu halo ba ita tuir ita nia dalan sira no hahalok sira, nunee mak Nia halo ona ba ita!’”
verses.7: Iha loron rua-nulu resin haat, iha fulan sanulu resin ida nian – nee mak fulan Sebat – iha tinan ba dala rua, iha tempu Dariu, Nai nia liafuan tuun mai ba profeta Zakarias, oan hosi Barakias, oan hosi Ido, no dehan,
verses.8: “Iha kalan, hau haree vizaun ida: Tebes, ema ida nebee sae kuda mean! Nia hamriik hela iha ai murtas sira nia leet nebee iha foho leet ida, no iha nia kotuk iha kuda nebee kór mean, xokolati no mutin.
verses.9: Nunee hau husu, ‘Oh hau nia nai, saida mak nee?’ Nunee anju nebee koalia hela ho hau nee hataan, ‘Hau sei hatudu ba ita kona ba sira.’
verses.10: Ema nebee hamriik iha ai murtas sira nia leet hataan dehan, ‘Ema sira nee mak Nai haruka atu lao ba-mai iha mundu!’
verses.11: Sira hataan ba Nai nia anju nebee hamriik iha ai murtas nia leet, no dehan, ‘Ami lao ba-mai ona iha mundu, no tebes mundu tomak nee hakmatek hela.’
verses.12: Depois Nai nia anju nee hataan dehan, ‘Oh Nai Forsa Nain, too bainhira tan mak O la hatudu laran luak ba Jerusalém, no sidade sira iha Juda, ba sira nebee O hirus hela too tinan hitu-nulu ona?’
verses.13: Nunee ba anju nebee koalia ho hau nee, Nai hataan ho liafuan diak no hamaus nian.
verses.14: Anju nebee koalia ho hau nee hatete, ‘Hakilar ba no dehan, Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Hau nia laran moras makaas kona ba Jerusalém no Zion.
verses.15: Maibee Hau hirus makaas ho nasaun sira nebee senti seguru; hori bainhira Hau hirus uitoan, maibee sira aumenta hahalok aat nee.
verses.16: Tanba nunee Nai hatete, Hau fila fali ba Jerusalém ho laran luak. Hau nia uma mos sei harii iha nebaa, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, no tali sukat sei dada fila fali iha Jerusalém nia leten.
verses.17: Hakilar tan, Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Hau nia sidade sira sei nakonu liu ho buat diak, no Nai sei hamaus Zion no Nia sei hili Jerusalém.’”
verses.18: Hau foti hau nia matan no haree: Tebes, dikur haat!
verses.19: Nunee hau husu ba anju nebee koalia hela ho hau nee, “Saida mak nee?” Depois nia hataan mai hau, “Buat sira nee mak dikur sira nebee lekar ona Judá, Israel no Jerusalém.”
verses.20: Depois Nai hatudu mai hau badaen nain haat nee.
verses.21: Depois hau husu, “Ema sira nee mai atu halo saida?” Nia hataan, “Buat dikur sira nee mak lekar ona Judá, nunee la iha tan ema ida nebee brani atu hasae nia ulun. No badaen sira nee mai atu halo sira hakfodak, no hamonu nasaun sira nia dikur sira nebee mak foti ona sira nia dikur hasoru rai Judá hodi lekar nia.”

2.title: Vizaun Datoluk: Ema Ho Tali Sukat

verses.1: Hau foti matan no haree, tebes ema ida nebee kaer hela tali sukat.
verses.2: Depois hau husu, “Ita baa nebee?” Nunee nia hataan, “Baa Jerusalém hodi sukat nia, atu haree nia medida luan nee hira no naruk hira.”
verses.3: No tebes, anju ida nebee koalia ho hau nee lao ba oin, no anju ida seluk lao ba hodi hasoru nia,
verses.4: no dehan ba nia, “Halai ba, koalia ho joven mane nee, no dehan, ‘Ema sei hela iha Jerusalém hanesan sira hela iha aldeia nebee moru la iha tanba iha ema barak no animál barak iha ninia laran.
verses.5: No Hau rasik sei sai moru ahi nian ba nia hodi haleu nia, hatete Nai, no Hau sei sai glória iha ninia laran.”
verses.6: Mai! Mai! halai sai hosi rai iha fatin norte, hatete Nai. Tanba Hau entrega ona ita ba anin matan haat, hatete Nai.
verses.7: Halai sai, Oh Zion, nebee hela ho ema Babilónia sira!
verses.8: Tanba Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee, bainhira Ninia glória haruka hau ba nasaun sira nebee hadau ona ita - tanba see deit nebee book ita, book Ninia matan musan:
verses.9: “Tebes, Hau sei doko Hau nia liman hasoru sira, no sira nia atan sira mak hadau sira.” Nunee ita sei hatene katak Nai Forsa Nain mak haruka hau mai.
verses.10: Hakilar no haksolok ba, Oh oan feto hosi Zion, tanba tebes, Hau mai no Hau sei hela iha imi nia leet, hatete Nai.
verses.11: No nasaun barak sei mai hamutuk ho Nai iha loron nebaa, no sira sei sai Hau nia povu. No Hau sei hela iha imi nia leet, no imi sei hatene katak Nai Forsa Nain mak haruka hau ba imi.
verses.12: No Nai sei hetan Judá nebee Ninia parte iha rai nebee santu, no Nia sei hili fali Jerusalém.
verses.13: Nonook ba, buat moris hotu, iha Nai nia oin, tanba Nia hamriik ona hosi Ninia fatin nebee santu.

verses.1: Depois nia hatudu mai hau Josué nebee saserdote boot, nebee hamriik iha Nai nia anju nia oin, maibee Satanás mos hamriik iha nia sorin loos hodi akuza nia.
verses.2: Depois Nai hatete ba Satanás nee, “Nai sei hasee ita, Oh Satanás! Nai, nebee hili ona Jerusalém, sei hasee ita! Laos ema ida nee mak ai sanak ida nebee mak foin hasai hosi ahi laran?”
verses.3: Bainhira Josué hamriik iha anju nee nia oin, nia hatais ropa nebee foer.
verses.4: No anju nee dehan ba sira nebee hamriik iha ninia oin, “Hasai tiha ropa foer hosi nia.” No ba Josué nia dehan, “Tebes, hau hadook ona ita nia sala hosi ita! Hau sei foo hatais ba ita ropa festa nian.”
verses.5: No hau dehan, “Husik sira tau koroa hena nian nebee moos ba nia ulun!” Nunee sira tau koroa hena nian nebee moos ba nia ulun no foo hatais ropa ba nia isin. No Nai nia Anju hamriik iha nebaa.
verses.6: Depois Nai nia anju nee foo promesa ba Josué, no dehan,
verses.7: “Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Se karik ita lao tuir Hau nia dalan sira no halo tuir Hau nia servisu, mak ita sei ukun Hau nia uma no toma konta Hau nia fatin, no Hau sei foo lisensa ba ita atu tama hamutuk ho sira nebee hamriik iha nee.
verses.8: Rona mai, Oh saserdote boot Josué, ita no ita nia kolega sira nebee tuur iha ita nia oin, tanba sira mak sinál ida: Tebes, Hau sei lori Hau nia atan nebee mak Sanak Matak.
verses.9: Tebes, iha fatuk ida nebee Hau tau ona iha Josué nia oin – nee fatuk nebee iha matan hitu - tebes Hau sei hakerek iha fatuk nee, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, no Hau sei hamoos rai nee nia sala iha loron ida deit.
verses.10: Iha loron nee, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, ema ida-idak sei konvida ninia maluk hodi mai tuur iha ninia uvas huun nia okos no nia ai figeira nia okos.”

verses.1: Anju nebee koalia ona ho hau nee fila fali mai, depois nia fanu hau hanesan fanu ema nebee toba dukur hela.
verses.2: Nunee nia hatete mai hau, “Saida mak ita haree?” Hau hataan, “Hau haree, no tebes, iha kandelabru nebee osan mean tomak, ho manko iha leten, no lampu hitu, no liman hitu ba lampu hitu nebee iha nia leten.
verses.3: No iha ai oliveira rua iha nia sorin, ida iha manko nia sorin loos no ida iha nia sorin karuk.”
verses.4: Depois hau koalia no hau husu ba anju nebee koalia hela ho hau nee, “Hau nia nai, saida mak nee?”
verses.5: Nunee anju nebee koalia ho hau nee hataan ba hau, “Ita la hatene saida mak nee ka?” Hau dehan, “Lae, hau nia nai!”
verses.6: Nunee nia hataan no koalia ho hau, no nia hatete, “Ida nee mak Nai nia liafuan nebee hatoo ba Zorobabel: Laos liu hosi kbiit no laos liu hosi podér, maibee liu hosi Hau nia Espíritu, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.7: See mak ita mak, Oh foho nebee aas? Iha Zorobabel nia oin ita sai hanesan rai tetuk. Nia sei lori mai fatuk prinsipál, no ema sei haklalak, ‘Grasa! Grasa ba nia!”
verses.8: Depois Nai nia liafuan mai iha hau, no dehan,
verses.9: “Zorobabel nia liman mak harii ona uma nee nia fundasaun, no nia liman sei halo mos remata. Nunee mak ita foin hatene katak Nai Forsa Nain mak haruka hau mai ba ita.
verses.10: Tanba see deit nebee despreza loron nebee buat kiik akontese sei haksolok, no nia sei haree fromu iha Zorobabel nia liman. Buat hitu nee mak Nai nia matan, nebee lao ba-mai iha mundu tomak.”
verses.11: Depois hau husu ba nia, “Signifika saida mak ai oliveira rua nee nebee iha kandelabru nia sorin loos no sorin karuk?”
verses.12: Ba dala rua hau husu tan ba nia, “Signifika saida mak ai oliveira sanak rua nee nebee foo sai osan mean been liu hosi pipa osan mean?”
verses.13: Nia hataan mai hau, “Ita la hatene sira nia signifikadu ka?” Hau dehan, “Lae, hau nia nai!”
verses.14: Depois nia hataan, “Nee mak ema nain rua nebee simu ona unsaun, nebee hamriik besik Nai ba mundu tomak nee!”

verses.1: Hau foti matan fali no haree, no tebes, iha surat ida nebee semo.
verses.2: Nunee anju nee hatete mai hau, “Ita haree saida?” Hau hataan, “Hau haree surat ida nebee semo. Nia naruk metru sia no luan metru haat ho balu.”
verses.3: Depois nia hatete mai hau, “Nee mak malisan nebee semo ba iha mundu tomak, hodi hasai ema hotu nebee naok tuir surat nia sorin ida, no hasai ema hotu nebee jura falsu tuir surat nia sorin seluk.
verses.4: Hau sei haruka nia sai, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, no buat nee sei tama ba iha naok-teen nia uma no tama ba iha ema nebee jura falsu nia uma. No buat nee sei hela iha sira nia uma no halakon hotu fatin nee, inklui ai no fatuk sira.”
verses.5: Anju nebee koalia ho hau nee lao mai, no nia hatete mai hau, “Foti matan no haree took, saida mak sai baa?”
verses.6: Nunee hau husu, “Saida mak nee?” Nia hataan, “Buat nee mak raga ida nebee sai baa.” Nia dehan tan, “Sira nia hahalok aat mak hanesan nee iha mundu tomak.”
verses.7: Tebes, sira hiit raga nee nia matan nebee halo ho riti mutin, no feto ida mak tuur iha laran!
verses.8: Depois nia hatete, “Ida nee mak Hahalok Aat!” depois nia dudu feto nee tama fali ba raga laran no taka fila fali raga matan nee ho nia matan riti mutin.
verses.9: Depois hau foti hau nia matan no hau haree: tebes, feto nain rua mak mosu mai ho liras nebee anin mak huu. Sira nia liras hanesan manu ain-aas nia liras. Sira lori raga nee no semo aas too iha lalehan no rai nia klaran.
verses.10: Hau husu ba anju nebee koalia hela ho hau nee, “Sira atu lori raga nee baa nebee?”
verses.11: Nia hataan mai hau, “Ba rai Sinear, atu harii uma ida ba feto nee. No bainhira sira estabelese ona uma nee, mak sira sei tau nia ba iha uma nee nia laran.”

verses.1: Hau foti hau nia matan fali no haree, no tebes, kuda kareta haat mosu mai hosi foho rua nia leet, no foho nee mak foho riti mean.
verses.2: Kuda kareta primeiru nee iha kuda mean sira, no kuda kareta segundu iha kuda metan sira.
verses.3: Kuda kareta terseiru iha kuda mutin sira, no kuda kareta ikus iha kuda makerek sira. No kuda hotu nee mak forti.
verses.4: Nunee hau koalia ba anju nebee koalia ho hau nee, “Saida mak nee, hau nia nai?”
verses.5: Anju nee hataan mai hau no dehan, “Sira atu sai baa anin matan haat, tanba sira hasoru ona Nai nebee mundu tomak nia Nain.
verses.6: Kuda kareta ho kuda metan sira sei baa rai iha parte norte; no sira nebee mutin baa iha parte loro-monu nian; no sira nebee makerek baa rai iha parte súl nian.
verses.7: No kuda mean nee sai mai, ansi loos atu baa, hodi lao ba-mai iha mundu. Nunee nia koalia, “Baa ona, lao ba-mai iha mundu!” Nunee sira lao ba-mai iha mundu.
verses.8: Depois nia hakilar mai hau, no dehan “Tebes, sira nebee baa rai iha parte norte mak halo hakmatek hau nia Espíritu iha nebaa.”
verses.9: Nai nia liafuan mai hau, no dehan:
verses.10: “Lori ema refujiadu sira nebee foin mai hosi Babilónia nebee Heldai, Tobias, no Jedaias, no baa kedas ba Josias, oan hosi Zafanias, nia uma.
verses.11: Depois foti osan mutin no osan mean, no halo koroa ida, no tau ba saserdote boot Josué nia ulun, nebee Jozadak nia oan;
verses.12: no hatete ba nia: ‘Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee, “Tebes, mane nee nia naran mak Sanak Matak. Ninia sanak oan nee sei lolo sai ba no nia sei harii Nai nia Templu.
verses.13: Nia sei harii Nai nia Templu, no nia sei simu glória no sei tuur hodi ukun iha nia kadunan leten. Iha mos saserdote ida nebee iha nia kadunan. No sira nain rua sei koalia ho dame.”’
verses.14: No koroa nee sei nafatin hela iha Nai nia Templu laran hanesan sinál ida ba Heldai, Tobias, Jedaias no mos ba Hen, nebee Zafanias nia oan.
verses.15: Sira nebee iha rai dook sei mai hodi harii Nai nia Templu; nunee mak ita sei hatene katak Nai Forsa Nain mak haruka hau mai ba ita. No buat nee sei akontese, se ita rona hodi halo tuir lian hosi Nai, ita nia Maromak.”

verses.1: Iha tinan ba dala haat iha tempu liurai Darius nia ukun, Nai nia liafuan mai ba Zakarias, iha loron haat iha fulan sia, nebee fulan Kislev.
verses.2: No ema Betél sira haruka ona Sarezer no Regem-Maleke no sira nia ema sira hodi halo orasaun hodi husu Nai nia laran diak,
verses.3: no hodi husu saserdote sira nebee iha Nai Forsa Nain nia uma, no mos ba profeta sira, hanesan nee, “Loos ka, ami tenki tanis no jejún iha fulan lima hanesan ami sempre halo too tinan barak ona nee?”
verses.4: Nunee Nai Forsa Nain nia liafuan mai iha hau, no dehan,
verses.5: “Hatete ba povu tomak iha rai nee, no saserdote sira, hanesan nee: Bainhira imi halo jejún no halerik iha fulan lima no fulan hitu iha tinan hitu-nulu nia laran nee, tebes imi ho laran tomak halo jejún mai Hau?
verses.6: No bainhira imi haan no imi hemu nee, laos imi haan no hemu ba imi nia aan rasik?
verses.7: Laos ida nee liafuan nebee hori uluk kedas Nai koalia liu hosi profeta sira, bainhira Jerusalém iha ema barak no hakmatek, no iha sidade sira nebee besik, no ema mos hela iha rai Negeb no iha foho?”
verses.8: Nai nia liafuan mai ba Zakarias, no dehan,
verses.9: “Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Halao justisa lo-loos, no hatudu domin metin no laran luak ba malu!
verses.10: La bele hanehan feto faluk no oan kiak sira, no ema lao rai no ema kiak sira, no la bele halo planu aat iha imi nia laran hodi hasoru malu.”
verses.11: Maibee sira lakohi rona, sira halo boot sira nia kabaas hodi kontra no taka sira nia tilun hodi la rona.
verses.12: Sira halo sira nia fuan sai toos hanesan fatuk nebee toos loos, atu nunee sira la bele rona lei no liafuan nebee Nai Forsa Nain haruka liu hosi Ninia Espíritu iha profeta uluk sira. Nunee mak Nai Forsa Nain haruka Ninia hirus makaas tuun ba sira.
verses.13: “Hanesan sira la rona bainhira Hau bolu sira, nunee mos Hau sei la rona sira bainhira sira bolu mai Hau,” hatete Nai Forsa Nain,
verses.14: “Tanba nunee mak Hau lekar sira ho anin fuik ida ba nasaun nebee sira la konhese. Nunee rai nee sai mamuk, no la iha ema ida nebee lao ba-mai liu hosi fatin nee; tanba sira halo rai furak nee sai fali fatin mamuk.”

verses.1: Nai Forsa Nain nia liafuan mai, no dehan,
verses.2: “Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Hau laran moras ba Zion ho laran moras makaas, no hau laran moras ba nia ho hirus manas makaas.
verses.3: Nai hatete nunee: Hau sei fila fali ba Zion no Hau sei hela iha Jerusalém nia leet. Ema sei hanaran Jerusalém, Sidade Fidelidade, no Nai Forsa Nain nia foho nee sira sei hanaran, Foho Santu.
verses.4: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Avoo mane no avoo feto sira sei tuur fali iha Jerusalém nia dalan ninin sira, no ida-idak sei kaer ninia ai tonka tanba sira nia tinan boot liu ona.
verses.5: No sidade nee nia dalan sira sei nakonu ho labarik mane no labarik feto sira nebee halimar iha dalan sira nebaa.
verses.6: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Se karik povu restu nebee sei hela nee mak hanoin buat nee furak loos, nunee mos Hau sei hanoin buat nee furak loos ka? hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.7: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Tebes, Hau sei salva Hau nia povu hosi rai lorosae too rai loromonu,
verses.8: no Hau sei lori sira fila fali mai, nunee sira sei hela iha Jerusalém. Nunee sira sei sai Hau nia povu no Hau sei sai sira nia Maromak, iha fidelidade no lia loos.”
verses.9: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee, “Haforsa imi nia liman, hei ema sira nebee rona liafuan nee durante loron sira nee, nebee hatoo hosi profeta sira nia ibun, iha loron nebee imi harii fundasaun ba Nai Forsa Nain nia uma, hodi harii Templu nee.
verses.10: Tanba molok loron sira nee, la iha pagamentu ba ema, no mos la iha pagamentu ba animál sira; no la iha seguransa hosi inimigu ba ema nebee sai no ba ema nebee tama, tanba Hau halo ema ida-idak baku malu ho nia maluk.
verses.11: Maibee agora, Hau la halo hanesan tempu uluk ba ema restu sira hosi nasaun nee, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.12: Maibee Hau sei kari dame. Nunee mak uvas sei foo fuan no rai sei foo nia rezultadu no mos lalehan sei foo nia mahobeen. Hau sei foo buat nee hotu ba ema restu hosi nasaun nee hodi sai sira nian rasik.
verses.13: No hanesan uluk ita sai ona malisan iha nasaun sira nia leet, Oh jerasaun Judá no jerasaun Israel, agora Hau sei salva fali ita, nunee ita sei sai bensaun. La bele tauk, haforsa ita nia liman!”
verses.14: Tanba Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee, “Hanesan uluk Hau hanoin atu estraga imi, bainhira imi nia bei-ala sira halo Hau hirus makaas, no Hau sei la fila hosi planu nee, hatete Nai Forsa Nain,
verses.15: nunee agora Hau hanoin fali atu halo buat diak ba Jerusalém no ba jerasaun Judá. La bele tauk!
verses.16: Ida nee mak buat sira nebee imi presiza halo: Koalia loos ba malu, no tesi lia loos, no lori dame iha imi nia portaun sira.
verses.17: La bele hanoin aat iha imi nia fuan nebee hasoru imi nia maluk no la bele hadomi jura falsu. Tanba buat hotu nee Hau odi, hatete Nai.”
verses.18: Nai Forsa Nain nia liafuan mai iha hau, no dehan,
verses.19: “Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee: Bainhira imi halo jejún iha fulan haat, iha fulan lima, iha fulan hitu no mos iha fulan sanulu, nunee tempu nee sei sai ksolok no kontenti no sei sai tempu selebrasaun nebee haksolok liu ba jerasaun Judá. Tanba nee hadomi lia loos no dame!”
verses.20: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee, “Povu sira sei mai, no mos ema sira hosi sidade barak.
verses.21: No ema sira hosi sidade ida sei ba sidade seluk, hodi hatete, ‘Mai ita baa hodi husu Nai nia laran diak no buka Nai Forsa Nain; hau mos sei baa!’
verses.22: Tanba povu barak no nasaun sira nebee forti sei mai hodi buka Nai Forsa Nain iha Jerusalém no husu Nai nia laran diak.”
verses.23: Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee, “Iha tempu nebaa, ema nain sanulu hosi nasaun oi-oin no lian oi-oin sei kaer metin loos ba ema Judá ida nia unuk tutun hodi hatete, ‘Ami sei baa ho ita, tanba ami rona ona katak Maromak mak hamutuk ho ita!’”

9.title: Profesia Ba Israel Nia Inimigu Sira

verses.1: Liafuan todan hosi Nai nebee hasoru rai Hadrake
verses.2: no mos ba Hamate nebee vizinhu ho sira,
verses.3: Tiro harii fatin seguru
verses.4: Maibee tebes, Nai sei hasai sira nia riku-soin
verses.5: Askelon sei haree ba nia, no sai tauk;
verses.6: Jerasaun nebee kahur sei hela iha Asdode,
verses.7: Hau sei hasai tiha raan nee hosi ninia ibun
verses.8: Hau hela iha tenda ida iha Hau nia uma oin hanesan seguransa,
verses.9: Haksolok makaas ba, Oh Zion nia oan feto,
verses.10: Nia sei halakon hotu kuda kareta hosi Efraim
verses.11: Kona ba ita, tanba Hau nia akordu nebee halo ho raan, nebee halo ona ho ita,
verses.12: Fila fali ba ita nia fatin seguru, Oh ema kastigu sira nebee iha esperansa!
verses.13: Tanba Hau dada Judá hanesan Hau nia rama inan,
verses.14: Nai sei hatudu aan ba sira,
verses.15: Nai Forsa Nain sei proteje sira,
verses.16: Nai, sira nia Maromak, sei salva sira iha tempu nebaa,
verses.17: Oinsaa, Ninia hahalok diak mak boot tebes, no Nia mak furak tebes!

verses.1: Husu udan ba Nai
verses.2: Tanba estátua lulik la hatete buat ida,
verses.3: “Hau nia hirus boot sei kona bibi nain sira,
verses.4: Fatuk lidun sei mai hosi Judá,
verses.5: Nunee mak sira sei sai hanesan eroi
verses.6: Hau sei halo jerasaun Judá sai forti liu,
verses.7: Efraim sei sai hanesan eroi ida,
verses.8: Hau sei hafuik ba sira no halibur sira mai hamutuk,
verses.9: Mezmu Hau entrega ona sira ba iha nasaun sira nia leet,
verses.10: Hau sei lori fila fali sira hosi rai Ejitu,
verses.11: Sira sei hakur tasi Ejitu no Nia sei baku laloran sira iha tasi,
verses.12: Hau sei haforsa sira iha Nai,

verses.1: Loke imi nia odamatan ba, Oh Líbanon,
verses.2: Tanis ba, Oh ai kakeu, tanba ai teka monu ona,
verses.3: Rona mai, bibi atan sira sei tanis hela!
verses.4: Nai, hau nia Maromak, hatete nunee, “Tau matan ba bibi malae sira nebee atu oho nee!
verses.5: Ema sira nebee hola bibi sira nee mak oho sira no la hetan kastigu, no ema sira nebee faan bibi sira nee dehan, ‘Hahii ba Nai! Hau sai riku ona!’ No bibi sira nia bibi atan sira sei la iha hanoin bibi sira nee.
verses.6: Tanba Hau la hadomi tan ema nebee hela iha rai nee, hatete Nai, tebes, Hau sei entrega ema ida-idak ba iha sira nia maluk nia liman, no ba iha sira nia liurai nia liman; sira nee sei harahun rai nee no Hau sei la hasai ema sira nee hosi sira nia liman.”
verses.7: Nunee hau sai bibi atan ba bibi sira nebee atu mate liu hosi ema sira nebee sosa bibi sira nee. Hau foti ai tonka rua, ida hau hanaran ‘Laran Diak’ no ida seluk hau hanaran ‘Unidade’; depois hau tau matan ba bibi malae sira nee.
verses.8: Iha fulan ida nia laran hau hasai bibi atan tolu nee. Depois hau la gosta bibi malae sira nee, no sira mos senti odiu mai hau.
verses.9: Depois hau dehan, “Hau lakohi tau matan ba imi; ida nebee atu mate, husik mate ba, no ida nebee atu lakon, husik lakon ba, no sira nebee sei hela nee, husik sira haan fali sira nia maluk sira!”
verses.10: Hau foti hau nia ai tonka Laran Diak, depois hau halo tohar nia atu nunee hau kansela tiha akordu nebee hau kesi ona ho povu sira.
verses.11: Tanba nee mak akordu nee kansela kedas iha tempu nee, nunee mak ema sira nebee sosa bibi no haree hela mai hau mak hatene katak nee mak Nai nia liafuan.
verses.12: Depois hau dehan ba sira, “Se imi senti diak, selu hau nia kolen, se lae, husik deit ba!” Nunee sira tetu osan mutin tolu-nulu hodi selu hau nia kolen.
verses.13: No Nai dehan mai hau, “Soe buat nee ba badaen sanan rai” – folin boot nebee sira konta mai hau. Depois hau foti osan mutin tolu-nulu nee no hau soe ba badaen sanan rai, ba iha Nai nia uma.
verses.14: Depois hau halo tohar tiha ai tonka segundu nee, nee mak ‘Unidade’, atu harahun tiha unidade entre Judá no Israel.
verses.15: Depois Nai dehan mai hau, “Foti tan sasaan bibi atan beik-teen nian!
verses.16: Tanba tebes, Hau sei hakiak bibi atan ida iha nasaun nee maibee nia sei la preokupa ida nebee lakon, no la buka ida nebee sei kiik, no la kura ida nebee kanek, no la hakiak ida nebee saudavel, maibee nia sei haan bibi nebee bokur no fokit sai sira nia ain kukun.
verses.17: Aii susar ba Hau nia bibi atan nebee beik,

verses.1: Nai nia liafuan todan kona ba Israel: Nai hatete nunee, Nia nebee nahe luan lalehan sira, no halo mundu nia fundasaun, no kria espíritu iha ema nia laran:
verses.2: “Tebes, Hau sei halo Jerusalém sai kopu nebee halo nasaun sira lanu, no mos Judá sei hasoru difikuldade bainhira ema serka Jerusalém.
verses.3: Iha tempu nebaa Hau sei halo Jerusalém sai fatuk todan ba nasaun hotu. Povu nebee deit mak hiit nia sei hetan kanek todan. Nasaun hotu iha mundu tomak sei halibur hamutuk hodi ataka hasoru nia.
verses.4: Iha tempu nebaa, hatete Nai, Hau sei halo kuda sai bilaan, no ema nebee sae kuda nee sei sai bulak. Tanba jerasaun Judá nia naran, Hau sei loke Hau nia matan, maibee kuda hotu nebee hosi nasaun seluk Hau sei halo sira hotu sai delek tiha.
verses.5: Depois jerasaun sira iha Judá sei hanoin iha laran, ‘Povu Jerusalém iha forsa tanba Nai Forsa Nain, sira nia Maromak.’
verses.6: Iha tempu nebaa, Hau sei halo jerasaun sira iha Judá sai hanesan ahi lakan iha ai butuk nia klaran no hanesan lampu lakan iha trigu futun sira nia leet; no sira sei haan nasaun hotu iha sorin loos no sorin karuk, maibee ema Jerusalém sira sei hela fali iha Jerusalém.
verses.7: Primeiru Nai sei salva tenda Judá nian, atu nunee família David nia glória no ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém nia glória la bele foti aan hasoru Judá.
verses.8: Iha tempu nee, Nai sei proteje ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém, no ema nebee fraku iha tempu nebaa sei sai hanesan David, no David nia família sei sai hanesan Maromak, hanesan Nai nia Anju, nebee lidera sira.
verses.9: Tuir mai iha tempu nebaa, Hau buka atu halakon nasaun hotu nebee ataka hasoru Jerusalém.”
verses.10: “Hau sei fui espíritu grasa no espíritu harohan nian ba iha família David no mos ba ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém, no sira sei hateke ba hau, ba ida nebee sira sona ona nee, no sira sei halerik ba nia hanesan halerik ba oan mesak, no sira sei tanis ba nia ho laran susar hanesan ema tanis ba oan primeiru.
verses.11: Iha tempu nebaa, halerik nebee iha Jerusalém sei sai boot hanesan halerik ba Hadade-Rimon iha rai tetuk Megido nian.
verses.12: Rai nee sei tanis halerik, família ida-idak sei tuur keta-ketak; família hosi jerasaun David nian mak ketak, no sira nia feen sira mak ketak; família hosi jerasaun Natan nian mak ketak, no sira nia feen sira mak ketak;
verses.13: família hosi jerasaun Levi nian mak ketak, no sira nia feen sira mak ketak; família hosi jerasaun Simei nian mak ketak, no sira nia feen sira mak ketak.
verses.14: No mos família sira seluk nebee sei hela, família ida-idak mak ketak, no sira nia feen sira mak ketak.

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa sei mosu bee matan ida ba família David no ba ema sira nebee hela iha Jerusalém atu hamoos sala no buat foer.”
verses.2: Iha tempu nebaa, Nai Forsa Nain hatete nunee, Hau sei halakon tiha ídulu nia naran sira iha rai nee, atu nunee ema sei la hanoin tan sira. No Hau sei hasai profeta sira no espíritu foer sira hosi rai nee.
verses.3: No se iha ema ida mak foo sai profesia, nunee nia aman no nia inan, nebee tuur ahi hetan nia, sira sei hatete ba nia, ‘O la bele moris tan, tanba o foo sai liafuan bosok hodi Nai nia Naran!’ Depois nia aman no inan, nebee tuur ahi hetan nia, sira sei sona mate nia bainhira nia profesia hela.
verses.4: Iha tempu nebaa, profeta ida-idak sei sai moe kona ba ninia vizaun, bainhira nia foo sai profesia. No sira sei la hatais manta nebee halo hosi fulun hodi bosok tan.
verses.5: Maibee ida-idak sei hatete, ‘Hau nee laos profeta ida, maibee hau servisu deit iha toos, tanba hau hetan rai nee hosi tempu nebee hau sei joven.’
verses.6: No se iha ema ida nebee husu, ‘Fitar saida mak iha ita nia hirus matan nee?’ Depois nia sei hataan, ‘Hau hetan kanek nee bainhira hau iha hau nia kolega sira nia uma!’”
verses.7: “Hadeer, Oh surik, hodi ataka hasoru Hau nia bibi atan,
verses.8: Nunee iha rai tomak, hatete Nai,
verses.9: Hau sei lori parte terseiru nee liu hosi ahi,

verses.1: Tebes, Nai nia loron sei mai, no ema sei hadau no fahe imi nia riku-soin iha imi nia leet.
verses.2: Hau sei halibur nasaun hotu hodi funu hasoru Jerusalém; sira sei hadau sidade nee, sira sei tama uma sira no naok sasaan no sira sei viola feto sira. No ema balun hosi sidade nee sei sai ema dadur no lao sai, maibee ema restu sei la lakon hosi sidade nee.
verses.3: Depois Nai sei lao ba oin hodi funu hasoru nasaun sira nee hanesan Nia ataka iha loron funu nian.
verses.4: Iha loron nebaa Nia sei hamriik iha Foho Oliveira nia tutun nebee iha Jerusalém nia oin iha parte lorosae nian. Foho Oliveira nee sei fahe ba rua iha nia klaran, hosi sorin lorosae ba sorin loromonu, nunee sei mosu mai rai tetuk ida nebee luan tebes; foho sorin ida sei muda ba parte norte no foho sorin seluk sei muda ba parte súl.
verses.5: No imi sei halai liu hosi rai tetuk iha foho nee, tanba rai tetuk nee sei too iha Azel. Imi sei halai sai hanesan imi halai iha tempu rai nakdoko iha reinu Uzias, liurai Judá nian. Depois Nai, hau nia Maromak, sei mai, no ema santu hotu sei hamutuk ho Nia.
verses.6: Iha loron nebaa, la iha tan naroman ka tempu rai malirin ka tempu es,
verses.7: maibee sei iha loron ida – loron nebee Nai hatene – nebee la iha tan loron ka kalan, no iha tempu rai nakaras sei iha naroman hela deit.
verses.8: Iha loron nebaa, bee matan moris nian sei suli hosi Jerusalém; bee balun sei suli ba tasi lorosae nian, no balun sei suli ba tasi loromonu nian. Buat nee sei lao nafatin durante tempu rai manas no durante tempu rai malirin.
verses.9: Nunee mak Nai sei sai Liurai ba mundu tomak. Iha loron nebaa, Nai sei ida deit no Nia naran sei ida deit.
verses.10: Rai hotu nee sei sai tetuk hosi Geba too Rimon iha Jerusalém nia sorin súl. Maibee Jerusalém sei aas hela iha nia fatin, hosi Portaun Benjamin too portaun uluk nian, nee mak Portaun Lidun, no hosi uma aas Hananel too iha fatin nebee ema sama uvas liurai nian.
verses.11: Ema sei hela iha sidade nee nia laran, tanba ema la estraga tan, no Jerusalém sei sai hakmatek nafatin.
verses.12: Nee mak moras aat nebee Nai sei haruka ba povu hotu nebee mai funu hasoru Jerusalém: sira nia isin sei sai dodok dois, maibee sira sei hamriik hela, sira nia matan musan sei sai dodok dois iha matan fatin, sira nia nanaal sei sai dodok dois iha ibun laran.
verses.13: Iha loron nebaa, sei akontese barulhu makaas hosi Nai iha sira nia leet, nunee ema ida-idak sei kaer sira nia maluk, no sira nia liman sei kontra hasoru sira nia maluk nia liman nee.
verses.14: No Judá sei funu iha Jerusalém; no sira sei halibur hamutuk riku-soin hosi nasaun sira iha sorin-sorin, inklui osan mean, osan mutin no ropa sira nebee barak tebe-tebes.
verses.15: Moras aat sira nee mos sei kona kuda, kuda mula, kuda kamelu, kuda buru no animál hotu nebee iha sira nia akampamentu sira.
verses.16: No ema hotu nebee sei hela iha nasaun hotu nebee hasoru ona Jerusalém, sei mai tinan-tinan hodi hakneak adora Liurai, Nai Forsa Nain, no hodi selebra Festa Baraka nian.
verses.17: Maibee ba see-see deit hosi jerasaun mundu nian nebee la mai iha Jerusalém hodi hakneak adora ba Liurai, Nai Forsa Nain, mak ema sira nebee la hetan udan.
verses.18: No karik jerasaun Ejitu la mai no tama hodi hasoru Nia, nunee sira sei la hetan udan; no Nai sei haruka malisan ba nasaun sira nebee la mai hodi selebra Festa Baraka nian.
verses.19: Nee mak kastigu ba Ejitu no kastigu ba nasaun sira nebee la mai hodi selebra Festa Baraka nian.
verses.20: Iha loron nebaa, ema sei hakerek iha kuda nia sinu, “Santu ba Nai!” no sanan rai iha Nai nia uma sei sai hanesan manko sakrifísiu nian iha altár oin.
verses.21: Nunee mak sanan rai hotu nebee iha Jerusalém no iha Judá sei sai santu ba Nai Forsa Nain; ema hotu nebee oferese sakrifísiu nee sei mai foti sanan rai sira nee no tein iha laran. No la iha tan negosiante iha Nai Forsa Nain nia uma iha loron nebaa.

verses.1: Liafuan todan hosi Nai ba Israel liu hosi Malakias.
verses.2: Nai dehan, “Hau hadomi ona imi.” Maibee imi hataan, “Ho maneira oinsaa mak O hadomi ami?” “Laos Esau mak Jacó nia maun ka?” hatete Nai, “Maibee Hau hadomi Jacó,
verses.3: no Hau odi Esau, no estraga ninia foho no ninia riku-soin hodi foo ba asu fuik iha rai fuik maran.”
verses.4: Se Edom hatete karik, “Ami rahun aat ona, maibee ami sei fila mai no harii fali iha rai maran nee.” Nai hatete, “Sira bele harii, maibee Hau sei baku tuun; no ema sira sei bolu Edom sira nee, ‘Nasaun nebee iha hahalok aat,’ no ‘Povu nebee Nai hasoru ho hirus too tinan ba tinan.’”
verses.5: Imi nia matan sei haree, no imi sei dehan, “Nai mak boot liu too iha Israel nia baliza sorin ba.”
verses.6: “Oan mane ida foo onra ba nia aman, no atan halo hanesan nee ba nia patraun. Entaun, se Hau mak aman, Hau nia onra iha nebee? no se Hau mak patraun, Hau nia respeitu iha nebee? hatete Nai Forsa Nain ba imi, Oh saserdote sira, nebee despreza Hau nia naran. No imi dehan, ‘Ho maneira oinsaa mak ami despreza ona O nia naran?’
verses.7: Imi foo oferta paun nebee foer iha hau nia altár. Maibee imi dehan, ‘Ho maneira oinsaa mak ami halo ona O foer?’ Tanba imi dehan, ‘Ami despreza Nai nia meza.’
verses.8: Bainhira imi foo sakrifísiu ida nebee matan delek, laos ida nee mak hahalok aat? No bainhira imi foo buat nebee ain aat no moras, laos ida nee mak hahalok aat? Foo buat nee ba imi nia ministru, nia sei kontenti ho imi ka? Nia sei aseita imi nia prezensa ka? Hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.9: ‘Agora, husu ba Maromak hodi nia bele hatudu grasa ba ami.’ Maibee liu hosi prezenti nee ka? Nia sei aseita imi ka? Hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.10: See mak iha imi nia leet nebee bele taka odamatan? Hodi imi la bele halakan ahi iha Hau nia altár no gasta tempu. Hau la kontenti ho imi, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, no Hau la simu oferta ida hosi imi nia liman.
verses.11: Tanba hosi fatin nebee loro matan sae too fatin nebee loro matan monu Hau nia naran sei boot iha nasaun sira nia leet; no iha fatin hotu sira sei sunu insensu ba Hau nia naran, no oferta moos. Tanba Hau nia naran sei sae boot iha Jentiu sira nia leet, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.12: Maibee imi estraga tiha Hau nia naran, tanba imi dehan, ‘Nai nia meza foer ona, no produsaun hosi nee, hanesan hahaan nee ami despreza.’
verses.13: Imi dehan mos, ‘Haree, ami baruk ho buat nee!’ no imi huu imi nia inus ba ida nee, hatete Nai Forsa Nain. Imi lori animál nebee lees ona, no animál nebee ain aat, no animál moras, imi lori oferta hanesan nee ona. Entaun Hau sei aseita sakrifísiu nee hosi imi nia liman ka? Hatete Nai.
verses.14: Malisan ba lohi door, nebee iha bibi aman diak nebee nia jura ona atu foo, no nia halo fali sakrifísiu ba Nai ho animál nebee aat. Tanba Hau nee mak Liurai nebee boot, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, no nasaun sira sei hamtauk ba Hau nia naran.

verses.1: Agora, Oh saserdote sira, mandamentu ida nee mak ba imi.
verses.2: Se imi la rona nunee, no se imi la rai ida nee ba imi nia fuan laran, hodi foo glória ba Hau nia naran, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, entaun Hau sei haruka malisan hasoru imi, Hau sei haraik malisan ba imi nia bensaun. Sin, Hau haraik ona malisan ba bensaun sira nee, tanba imi la rai mandamentu nee ba imi nia fuan laran.
verses.3: Haree lai, Hau sei estraga imi nia jerasaun, no taka imi nia oin sira ho teen, teen nebee mai hosi imi nia seremonia, no ema sei lori imi sai ho teen nee.
verses.4: No imi sei hatene katak Hau mak haruka mandamentu nee ba imi, hodi Hau nia aliansa sei hamutuk ho Levi, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.5: Hau nia aliansa ho nia mak moris no dame, no Hau foo buat nee tanba nia hamtauk ba Hau, no nia tauk iha Hau nia naran nia oin.
verses.6: Lei loos mak iha nia ibun, no ita la hetan hahalok aat iha nia ibun tutun. Nia lao ho Hau iha dame no igualdade, no nia fila ema barak hosi hahalok aat.
verses.7: Tanba saserdote nia ibun tutun tenki sér kaer matenek, no ema tenki buka lei hosi nia ibun, tanba nia mak manu-ain hosi Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.8: Maibee imi fila sai ona hosi dalan ida nee, imi mak halo ema barak monu ona iha lei nee, imi mak estraga ona aliansa ho Levi, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.9: Entaun Hau mos hamoe ona imi no hatuun ona imi iha povu hotu nia oin, tanba imi la halo tuir Hau nia dalan no la tuir instrusaun kompletu.
verses.10: Laos ita hotu iha aman ida ka? Laos Maromak ida deit mak kria ita ka? Tanba saa mak ema ida-idak tau lia ba nia maluk, no estraga tiha ita nia bei-ala sira nia aliansa?
verses.11: Judá mak tau lia nee, no buat aat duni akontese iha Israel no iha Jerusalém. Tanba Judá mak estraga tiha Nai nia fatin sagradu nebee Nia hadomi, no hola fali oan feto hosi maromak nebee hosi liur.
verses.12: Nai sei soe hosi Jacó nia tenda mane ida nebee halo buat nee no nia bei-oan sira, no ema nebee halo oferta ba Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.13: No imi halo mos hanesan nee, imi taka Nai nia altár ho matan been sira, imi tanis no hakilar, tanba Nia la haree imi nia oferta nee no Nia la simu imi nia prezenti hosi imi nia liman.
verses.14: Maibee imi dehan, “Tanba saa mak?” Tanba Nai mak sasin ba ita no ita nia feen hosi tempu nebee ita sei joven, feto nebee ita mak tau lia ba ona, maibee nia mak ita nia maluk, no nia mak feen hosi ita nia aliansa.
verses.15: Laos Maromak mak halo imi sai ida deit? Nia foo Ninia Espíritu ba ida nee. Tanba saa mak ida deit? Hodi Nia bele hetan oan santu. Nunee, hanoin di-diak ba ita nia espíritu no keta ema ida tau lia ba nia feen hosi tempu nebee nia sei joven.
verses.16: Tanba Nai, Maromak iha Israel, hatete katak Nia odi bainhira feen-laen soe malu, no ida subar violénsia ho nia kazaku, hatete Nai Forsa Nain. Entaun hanoin kuidadu iha ita nia espíritu hodi ita la tau lia ba ema.
verses.17: Imi halo Nai kolen ona ho imi nia liafuan. Maibee imi dehan, “Ho maneira oinsaa mak ami halo Nia kolen?” Bainhira imi dehan, “Ema hotu nebee halo sala mak diak iha Nai nia oin, no Nia kontenti ho sira.” Ou, “Maromak nebee lori justisa, nia iha nebee?”

verses.1: “Haree lai, Hau sei haruka Hau nia manu-ain, no nia sei prepara dalan uluk Hau. No Nai nebee imi buka sei mai derepenti Nia templu, ida nee mak manu-ain ba aliansa nee, ida nebee mak halo imi haksolok. Haree lai, Nia sei mai, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.2: Maibee see mak bele hela iha loron nebee Nia mai? No see mak bele hamriik bainhira Nia mosu mai? Tanba Nia hanesan ahi hosi ema nebee halo osan mean, no Nia hanesan sabaun hosi ema nebee fase ropa.
verses.3: Nia sei tuur hanesan ema nebee hamoos osan mutin no halo moos loos, no Nia sei halo Levi nia oan mane sira moos loos, no hasai buat foer hanesan ho osan mean no osan mutin, hodi sira bele foo oferta ba Nai liu hosi moris loos.
verses.4: Depois oferta nebee mai hosi Judá no Jerusalém sei diak ba Nai, hanesan tempu antigu, no hanesan tinan sira iha tempu uluk.
verses.5: No Hau sei hakbesik ba imi ho julgamentu, no Hau sei sai sasin lalais hodi kontra hasoru buan sira, no kontra sira nebee halo sala seksuál, no kontra bosok-teen sira, no kontra sira nebee hanehan ema servisu liu hosi saláriu no hanehan feto faluk no oan kiak, no sira nebee la simu ema liur, no la hamtauk ba Hau, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.6: Hau mak Nai, Hau la troka, entaun imi, Jacó nia oan sira, la simu kastigu.
verses.7: Nee duni, hosi tempu avoo sira imi hadook aan tiha hosi Hau nia estatutu sira, no la tuir buat sira nee. Fila mai Hau, no Hau sei fila ba imi, hatete Nai Forsa Nain. Maibee imi dehan, ‘Oinsaa mak ami fila fali baa?’
verses.8: Ema ida bele naok hosi Maromak ka? Loos duni, imi naok hela hosi Hau. Maibee imi dehan, ‘Oinsaa mak ami naok hosi O?’ Liu hosi parte sanulu no oferta sira nee.
verses.9: Imi hetan ona malisan duni, tanba imi naok hela hosi Hau, nasaun tomak nee mak naok.
verses.10: Hatama parte sorin sira hotu ba armazén, hodi Hau nia uma sei iha hahaan. Prova Hau lai, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, se Hau la loke ba imi lalehan nia janela sira, no fakar bensaun boot too fatin la iha atu simu hotu.
verses.11: No tanba imi, Hau sei siak buat nebee haan, hodi nia la estraga ai fuan sira hosi imi nia rai; no mos imi nia ai uvas iha toos sei la soe nia fuan molok tempu loos, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.12: No nasaun sira hotu sei konta katak imi hetan bensaun ona, tanba imi sei sai rai furak, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.13: Imi foo liafuan toos nebee kontra Hau, hatete Nai. Maibee imi dehan, ‘Oinsaa mak ami koalia kontra O?’
verses.14: Tanba imi dehan ona, ‘La iha folin atu serví Maromak. Ita hetan funan saida liu hosi kaer Nia liafuan metin, no ita lao tanis iha Nai Forsa Nain nia oin?’
verses.15: Agora, ita hatete, ‘Ema nebee foti aan mak hetan bensaun ona; loos duni ema nebee hahalok aat mak hetan susesu ona no sira nebee koko Maromak sai diak ona.’”
verses.16: Depois, sira nebee hamtauk ba Nai nee koalia hamutuk. No Nai tuir no rona sira. No sira hakerek livru ida iha Nia oin hodi hanoin; livru nee iha lista ho ema sira nebee hamtauk ba Nai no hanoin Nia naran.
verses.17: “Sira sei sai Hau nian,” hatete Nai Forsa Nain, “iha loron nebee Hau sei halibur Hau nia riku-soin, no Hau sei kuidadu sira, hanesan mane ida kuidadu nia oan mane rasik nebee serví nia.
verses.18: Depois imi sei fila mai, no bele haree diferensa entre ema loos no ema aat, no entre nia nebee serví Maromak no nia nebee la serví Maromak.”

verses.1: Nunee, haree lai, loron nee mai, loron nebee sei sunu hanesan fugaun ida, no ema hotu nebee foti aan, sin, no ema hotu nebee iha hahalok aat, sira sei hanesan duut maran, no loron nebee mai sei sunu sira hotu, hatete Nai Forsa Nain, too abut ho sanak buat rua nee la iha hotu.
verses.2: Maibee ba imi nebee hamtauk ba Hau nia naran, Loron Matan Hahalok Loos sei sae no Nia liras bele kura, no imi sei lao ba no haksoit hanesan karau oan nebee foin sai hosi luhan.
verses.3: No imi sei sama tuun sira nebee hahalok aat, tanba sira sai hanesan ahi kdesan iha imi nia ain okos iha loron nebee Hau sei halo hanesan nee, hatete Nai Forsa Nain.
verses.4: Imi hanoin tiha lei hosi Hau nia atan Moisés, no estatutu no regulamentu nebee Hau manda ona ba nia iha Horeb hodi foo ba Israel tomak.
verses.5: Haree lai, Hau sei haruka manu-ain Elias molok Nai nia loron boot no molok loron tauk nee mai.
verses.6: No nia sei fila aman sira nia fuan ba sira nia oan sira, no oan sira nia fuan ba sira nia aman sira. Se lae, Hau mai no kona rai ho malisan boot ida.

verses.1: Livru nee kona ba Jesus Kristu nia istória. Nia mak bei-oan hosi David, nebee bei-oan hosi Abraão.
verses.2: Abraão hetan Isak, no Isak hetan Jacó, no Jacó hetan Judá no ninia maun-alin sira,
verses.3: no Judá hetan Perez no Zera hosi Tamar, no Perez hetan Hezron, no Hezron hetan Ram,
verses.4: no Ram hetan Aminadab, no Aminadab hetan Naason, no Naason hetan Salmon,
verses.5: no Salmon hetan Boaz hosi Raab, no Boaz hetan Obed hosi Rut, no Obed hetan Jessé,
verses.6: no Jessé hetan David nebee liurai. No liurai David hetan Salomão hosi Urias nia feen,
verses.7: no Salomão hetan Roboão, no Roboão hetan Abias, no Abias hetan Asa,
verses.8: no Asa hetan Josafat, no Josafat hetan Jorão, no Jorão hetan Uzias,
verses.9: no Uzias hetan Jotão, no Jotão hetan Akaz, no Akaz hetan Ezekias,
verses.10: no Ezekias hetan Manasés, no Manasés hetan Amon, no Amon hetan Josias,
verses.11: no Josias hetan Jekonias no ninia maun-alin sira, iha tempu nebee ema lori sira sai ba Babilónia.
verses.12: Bainhira ema lori sira sai ona ba Babilónia, Jekonias hetan Salatiel, no Salatiel hetan Zorobabel,
verses.13: no Zorobabel hetan Abiud, no Abiud hetan Eliakim, no Eliakim hetan Azor,
verses.14: no Azor hetan Zadok, no Zadok hetan Akim, no Akim hetan Eliud,
verses.15: no Eliud hetan Eleazar, no Eleazar hetan Matán, no Matán hetan Jacó,
verses.16: no Jacó hetan José nebee Maria nia laen. Maria hetan Jesus, nebee ema bolu Kristu.
verses.17: Nunee, jerasaun hotu hosi Abraão too David hamutuk sanulu resin haat; no hosi David too sira lao sai ba Babilónia hamutuk jerasaun sanulu resin haat; no hosi tempu lao sai ba Babilónia too Kristu hamutuk jerasaun sanulu resin haat.
verses.18: Jesus Kristu moris hanesan nee: bainhira Ninia inan Maria promete ona hodi kaben ho José, molok sira mai hamutuk, Maria sai isin rua ho oan ida liu hosi Espíritu Santu.
verses.19: Maria nia laen José mak ema laran loos, no nia lakohi atu hamoe Maria iha ema nia oin. Nunee nia hanoin atu husik tiha Maria sub-subar deit.
