verses.20: Maibee bainhira nia hanoin kona ba buat sira nee, tebes, Nai nia anju mosu ba nia iha mehi ida, no dehan, “José, David nia oan, keta tauk atu foti Maria nudar o nia feen, tanba ida nebee nia hetan nee mai hosi Espíritu Santu.
verses.21: Nia sei tuur ahi hetan oan mane ida, no o sei hanaran Nia Jesus, tanba Nia sei salva Ninia povu hosi sira nia sala.”
verses.22: Buat hotu nee akontese hodi kumpri buat nebee Nai hatete ona liu hosi profeta, nebee dehan,
verses.23: “Tebes, feto raan ida sei sai isin rua no tuur ahi oan mane ida.
verses.24: Bainhira José hadeer tiha, nia halo tuir buat nebee Nai nia anju haruka no nia simu Maria nudar feen.
verses.25: Maibee nia la toba ho Maria too Maria tuur ahi oan mane primeiru. No nia hanaran oan nee Jesus.

verses.1: Bainhira Jesus moris ona iha Belém iha Judeia, iha liurai Herodes nia tempu, tebes, ema matenek klean sira mai hosi rai lorosae too Jerusalém.
verses.2: No sira husu, “Ema Judeu nia liurai nebee moris ona, nia iha nebee? Tanba ami haree Ninia fitun iha rai lorosae, no ami mai hodi adora Nia.”
verses.3: Bainhira liurai Herodes rona tiha liafuan nee, nia hanoin ho laran taridu, hamutuk ho ema Jerusalém hotu.
verses.4: Nia halibur saserdote boot no eskriba sira hotu hosi povu nee. Nia husu hatene hosi sira kona ba Kristu sei moris iha nebee.
verses.5: No sira dehan ba Herodes, “Iha Belém iha Judeia, tanba profeta hakerek nanis ona nunee:
verses.6: ‘No o, Belém, iha rai Judá,
verses.7: Entaun Herodes bolu sub-subar ema matenek klean sira nee. Nia husu tan ba sira kona ba hori bainhira loos mak fitun nee mosu.
verses.8: No nia haruka sira baa Belém, no dehan, “Baa no buka di-diak labarik kiik nee. No bainhira imi hetan ona Nia, foo hatene mai hau, atu nunee hau mos baa bele adora Nia.”
verses.9: Bainhira sira rona tiha liurai, sira sai ba. No tebes, fitun ida nebee sira haree ona iha rai lorosae baa iha sira nia oin. No fitun nee baa uluk sira no para iha fatin nebee labarik kiik nee hela.
verses.10: Bainhira sira haree fitun nee, sira haksolok no kontenti liu.
verses.11: Sira tama uma no sira haree labarik kiik ho Ninia inan Maria. No sira hakneak no adora Nia. Sira loke sira nia riku-soin no foo prezenti sira ba Nia: osan mean, mina morin, no mina mira.
verses.12: Sira iha mehi nebee foo hanoin ba sira atu la bele fila fali ba Herodes. Nunee sira sai hosi fatin nee no tama sira nia rai liu hosi dalan seluk.
verses.13: Bainhira ema matenek klean sira sai ona, tebes, Nai nia anju mosu ba José iha mehi ida, no dehan, “Hamriik ba, no lori labarik kiik nee no Ninia inan, no halai ba Ejitu. Hela iha nebaa too hau foo hatene fali liafuan ba o. Tanba Herodes sei buka labarik kiik nee hodi oho Nia.”
verses.14: Nunee José hamriik no lori labarik kiik ho nia inan iha tempu kalan, no sira baa Ejitu.
verses.15: Sira hela iha nebaa too Herodes mate ona. Ida nee akontese hodi kumpri buat nebee Nai hatete nanis ona liu hosi profeta, nebee Nia dehan, “Hosi Ejitu mak Hau bolu Hau nia Oan Mane.”
verses.16: Bainhira Herodes haree katak ema matenek klean sira hamoe nia, nunee nia sai hirus tebes. Nia haruka ema baa Belém, no área hotu iha nebaa, no oho oan mane hotu nebee tinan rua ba kraik, tuir tempu nebee nia husu lo-loos kona ba ida nee hosi ema matenek klean sira.
verses.17: Buat nee kumpri profeta Jeremias nia liafuan:
verses.18: “Iha Rama ema rona lian,
verses.19: Maibee bainhira Herodes mate ona, tebes, Nai nia anju ida mosu iha mehi ida ba José iha Ejitu.
verses.20: Anju nee dehan, “Hamriik ba, no lori labarik kiik ho nia inan, no baa rai Israel. Tanba sira nebee buka atu oho labarik kiik nee mate ona.”
verses.21: Depois nia hamriik no lori labarik kiik ho nia inan, no nia baa rai Israel.
verses.22: Maibee bainhira nia rona katak Arkelau mak ukun iha Judeia troka ninia aman Herodes, José tauk atu baa nebaa. Bainhira nia simu Maromak nia liafuan iha mehi ida, nia fila no tama ba área Galileia.
verses.23: No nia baa hela iha aldeia ida naran Nazaré, hodi kumpri liafuan hosi profeta sira: “Sira sei bolu Nia ema Nazaré.”

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, João Batista mai no haklaken iha rai fuik maran Judeia.
verses.2: Nia dehan, “Arepende ba, tanba reinu lalehan besik ona.”
verses.3: Tanba profeta Isaias koalia kona ba nia bainhira nia dehan,
verses.4: João hatais ropa nebee halo hosi kuda kamelu fulun. Nia iha sintu iha ninia kanotak nebee halo hosi animál kulit. No nia haan gafanhotu no bani been hosi ai laran.
verses.5: Ema hotu sai hosi Jerusalém, no rai tomak iha Judeia, no área tomak iha Jordaun, hodi baa haree nia.
verses.6: Sira baa hodi hetan batizmu hosi João iha mota Jordaun no konfesa sira nia sala.
verses.7: Maibee bainhira nia haree ema Farizeu no ema Saduseu barak mai atu hetan batizmu hosi nia, nia dehan ba sira, “Oh samea nia oan sira! Se mak foo avizu ba imi hodi halai hosi kastigu nebee atu mai?
verses.8: Hatudu hahalok nebee tuir laran nebee arepende.
verses.9: Keta hanoin atu dehan iha imi nia laran, ‘Ami nia aman mak Abraão.’ Tanba hau dehan ba imi katak Maromak bele halo fatuk sira nee sai Abraão nia oan sira.
verses.10: Agora, baliu tau ona iha ai huun sira nia abut. Nunee ai huun hotu nebee la foo fuan diak, sei tesi tuun no soe ba ahi laran.
verses.11: Hau bele foo batizmu arepende nian ba imi ho bee, maibee Nia nebee tuir hau mak forti liu hau. Hau la merese atu lori Ninia sandálias. Nia sei foo batizmu ba imi ho Espíritu Santu no ahi.
verses.12: Nia kaer Ninia garfu boot hodi haliri, no Nia sei hamoos Ninia haliri fatin, no halibur Ninia trigu iha armazén. Maibee Nia sei sunu trigu kain nee ho ahi nebee la bele hamate.”
verses.13: Depois Jesus mai hosi Galileia too iha Jordaun hodi simu batizmu hosi João.
verses.14: Maibee João koko hapara Nia no dehan, “Hau presiza simu batizmu hosi Ita Boot, no Ita Boot mai fali hau?”
verses.15: Jesus hataan ba nia, no dehan, “Husik hanesan nee agora, tanba diak liu ita kumpri hahalok loos hotu.” Nunee João hataan.
verses.16: Bainhira Jesus hetan batizmu, Nia sai kedas hosi bee laran. No tebes, lalehan nakloke ba Nia. No Nia haree Maromak nia Espíritu tuun mai hanesan manu pombu ida nebee tun ba Nia.
verses.17: No tebes, lian ida hosi lalehan dehan, “Ida nee mak Hau nia Oan Mane nebee Hau hadomi. Nia mak halo Hau kontenti liu.” Ema haliri trigu ho garfu boot hodi haketak trigu kain.

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, Espíritu lori Jesus ba rai fuik maran hodi Diabu bele tenta Nia.
verses.2: No bainhira Nia jejún ona too loron haat-nulu no kalan haat-nulu, ikus mai Nia hamlaha.
verses.3: Depois tentadór mai, no dehan ba Nia, “Se O Maromak nia Oan duni, haruka fatuk sira nee sai paun.”
verses.4: Maibee Nia hataan, “Profeta hakerek nanis ona,
verses.5: Depois Diabu lori Nia ba sidade santu, no tau Nia iha Templu nia tutun.
verses.6: Diabu dehan ba Nia, “Se O Maromak nia Oan duni, soe O nia aan tuun ba rai, tanba sira hakerek nanis ona,
verses.7: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Maibee sira mos hakerek nanis ona, ‘Keta koko Nai, imi nia Maromak.’”
verses.8: Depois Diabu lori Nia ba foho ida nebee aas liu, no hatudu reinu hotu iha mundu ba Nia, no reinu sira nee nia glória.
verses.9: Diabu dehan ba Nia, “Hau sei foo buat hotu nee ba O, se O hakneak no adora hau.”
verses.10: Maibee Jesus dehan ba nia, “Sees tiha, Satanás! Tanba sira hakerek nanis ona,
verses.11: Entaun Diabu husik Nia, no tebes, anju sira mai no serví Nia.
verses.12: Bainhira Jesus rona katak ema kastigu ona João, Nia fila ba Galileia.
verses.13: Nia sai hosi Nazaré, no Nia baa hela iha Kafarnaum, nebee iha tasi ibun, iha área Zebulón no Naftali.
verses.14: Ida nee kumpri liafuan nebee mai liu hosi profeta Isaias bainhira nia dehan,
verses.15: “Iha rai Zebulón no rai Naftali,
verses.16: povu nebee tuur iha nakukun laran
verses.17: Hosi tempu nee ba oin, Jesus komesa ba haklaken, no Nia dehan, “Arepende ba! Tanba reinu lalehan besik ona.”
verses.18: Bainhira Jesus lao dadaun iha tasi ibun iha Tasi Galileia, Nia haree ema nain rua nebee maun-alin: Simão nebee ema bolu Pedro, no ninia alin André. Sira nain rua soe hela dai iha tasi, tanba sira mak peskadór.
verses.19: No Jesus dehan ba sira, “Mai tuir Hau, no Hau sei halo imi sai peskadór ba ema.”
verses.20: Entaun sira husik kedas sira nia dai sira nee no tuir Nia.
verses.21: Jesus lao ba oin no Nia haree ema nain rua tan nebee maun-alin, Tiago, nebee Zebedeu nia oan mane, no ninia alin João. Sira sei iha roo laran hamutuk ho sira nia aman Zebedeu, no sira hadia hela sira nia dai. No Jesus bolu sira.
verses.22: Sira husik kedas roo no sira nia aman no tuir Nia.
verses.23: Jesus lao haleu rai Galileia tomak, no Nia hanorin iha sira nia sinagoga sira nee. Nia haklaken evanjelhu kona ba reinu. No Nia kura moras no isin fraku hotu-hotu iha povu nia leet.
verses.24: Nia hetan naran boot iha área Síria tomak. Sira lori ema hotu nebee iha moras no terus oi-oin ba Nia, inklui sira nebee diabu tama iha sira nia laran, sira nebee moras bibi maten no sira nebee ain aat, no Nia kura sira.
verses.25: No ema lubun boot tuir Nia, inklui povu hosi Galileia no Dekápolis, no hosi Jerusalém no Judeia, no hosi Jordaun nia sorin ba.

verses.1: Bainhira Jesus haree ema lubun boot nee, Nia sae ba foho ida. Depois Nia tuur no Ninia eskolante sira hakbesik ba Nia.
verses.2: Jesus hahuu koalia no hanorin sira, hodi dehan,
verses.3: “Haksolok ba sira nebee kiak iha espíritu, tanba reinu lalehan mak sira nian.
verses.4: Haksolok ba sira nebee laran tristi, tanba sira sei hetan kamaan.
verses.5: Haksolok ba sira nebee laran maus, tanba sira sei simu mundu nudar liman rohan.
verses.6: Haksolok ba sira nebee hamlaha no hamrook atu hetan moris loos, tanba sira sei sai bosu.
verses.7: Haksolok ba sira nebee hatudu laran luak, tanba sira sei hetan laran luak.
verses.8: Haksolok ba sira nebee laran moos, tanba sira sei haree Maromak.
verses.9: Haksolok ba sira nebee lori dame, tanba sira sei sai Maromak nia oan.
verses.10: Haksolok ba sira nebee hetan terus kona ba hahalok loos, tanba reinu lalehan mak sira nian.
verses.11: Haksolok ba imi bainhira ema koalia aat imi, foo terus ba imi no sira dehan buat aat oi-oin nebee bosok hasoru imi tanba Hau.
verses.12: Haksolok no sai kontenti ba! Tanba imi nia kolen sei boot tebes iha lalehan. Tanba sira foo terus hanesan nee ba profeta sira nebee uluk imi. Ema tau ahi oan iha ninia fatin hodi foo naroman
verses.13: Imi mak masin ba mundu nee. Maibee se masin lakon ninia meer, oinsaa masin nee bele sai meer fali? Nunee nia la iha folin, no ema sei soe nia ba liur no ema sei sama deit nia iha ain okos.
verses.14: Imi mak naroman ba mundu nee. Ita la bele subar sidade ida nebee iha foho leten.
verses.15: Ema la sunu ahi oan hodi taka iha baldi okos. Maibee nia tau iha ahi oan nia fatin, no ahi oan nee bele foo naroman ba ema hotu iha uma laran.
verses.16: Nunee husik imi nia naroman nabilan iha ema nia oin, atu sira bele haree imi nia hahalok diak, no foo glória ba imi nia Aman nebee iha lalehan.
verses.17: Keta hanoin katak Hau mai atu halakon Lei ka Profeta sira. Hau mai laos atu halakon, maibee atu kumpri.
verses.18: Tebes, Hau hatete ba imi, too lalehan no rai lakon, pontu ida ka asentu ida sei la lakon hosi Lei, too buat hotu sai loos ona.
verses.19: Nee duni, see deit nebee la halo tuir ukun fuan ida nebee kiik liu nee, no hanorin ema seluk atu la halo tuir, nia sei hetan naran kiik liu iha reinu lalehan. Maibee see deit nebee halo tuir ukun fuan no hanorin ema seluk atu halo tuir, ema nee sei hetan naran boot iha reinu lalehan.
verses.20: Tanba Hau dehan ba imi, se imi nia hahalok loos nee la loos liu karik ema eskriba no ema Farizeu nian, nunee imi la bele tama ba reinu lalehan.
verses.21: Imi rona ona katak ema dehan ba sira iha tempu antigu, ‘O keta oho, no ema nebee oho sei hataan iha tribunál.’
verses.22: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi, see deit nebee hirus ho ninia maun-alin, nia sei hataan iha tribunál. No see deit nebee dehan ba ninia maun-alin, ‘O la iha folin!’, nia sei hataan iha tribunál aas liu. No see deit nebee dehan ba ninia maun-alin, ‘O beik-teen!’ nia sei hataan iha ahi infernu nian!
verses.23: Nee duni, se o lori dadaun o nia oferta ba altár, no iha nebaa o hanoin hetan katak o nia maluk iha buat ruma nebee hasoru o,
verses.24: husik lai o nia oferta iha altár nia oin, no baa halo dame uluk ho o nia maluk, depois mai no oferese o nia oferta.
verses.25: Halo dame lalais ho nia nebee akuza o, bainhira o sei lao iha dalan ho nia. Keta halo be akuzadór nee entrega o ba juis, no juis entrega o ba guarda, no sira soe o ba komarka laran.
verses.26: Tebes, Hau dehan ba o katak o sei la sai hosi fatin nee too o selu osan hotu too sentavu ikus.
verses.27: Imi rona ona katak ema dehan, ‘O keta halo sala seksuál.’
verses.28: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi, see deit nebee fihir feto ida too kaan nia mak halo ona sala seksuál ho feto nee iha ninia fuan laran.
verses.29: Se o nia matan sorin loos halo o monu ba sala, losu tiha nia no soe ba. Tanba diak liu o lakon buat ida hosi o nia isin duké o nia isin tomak tama ba infernu.
verses.30: No se o nia liman sorin loos mak halo o monu ba sala, tesi sai nia, no soe nia ba; tanba diak liu o lakon buat ida hosi o nia isin duké o nia isin tomak tama ba infernu.
verses.31: Ema dehan ona, ‘See deit mak atu soe ninia feen, nia tenki foo surat soe-malu nian ba feto nee.’
verses.32: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi katak ema nebee soe ninia feen, laos tanba sala seksuál, mak halo feen nee monu ba sala seksuál. No ema nebee kaben ho feto nee mos halo sala seksuál.
verses.33: No mos, imi rona ona katak ema dehan ba sira iha tempu antigu, ‘O keta jura falsu, maibee o tenki kumpri buat nebee o jura ba Nai.’
verses.34: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi: la bele jura kona ba buat ida. Keta jura hodi lalehan, tanba nee mak Maromak nia kadunan.
verses.35: No keta jura hodi mundu, tanba nee mak fatin nebee Maromak tau Ninia ain. No keta jura hodi Jerusalém, tanba nee mak Liurai Boot nia sidade.
verses.36: No keta jura hodi o nia ulun, tanba o la bele halo fuuk lahan ida sai mutin ka metan.
verses.37: Maibee dehan deit ‘sin’ nebee sin, no ‘lae’ nebee lae. Buat nebee liu fali nee mai hosi buat nebee aat.
verses.38: Imi rona ona katak ema dehan, ‘Matan troka matan, no nehan troka nehan.’
verses.39: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi: Keta hapara ema nebee halo aat. Maibee se ema basa o nia hasan sorin loos, see tan o nia hasan sorin karuk ba nia.
verses.40: No se ema hakarak lori o ba tribunál, no foti o nia faru, husik nia bele hetan tan o nia kapa.
verses.41: No ema nebee obriga o lao kilómetru ida, lao kilómetru rua ho nia.
verses.42: Foo ba nia nebee husu, no keta fila kotuk ba nia nebee hakarak empresta hosi o.
verses.43: Imi rona ona katak ema dehan, ‘O tenki hadomi o nia maluk, no odi o nia inimigu.’
verses.44: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi: Hadomi imi nia inimigu no halo orasaun ba sira nebee foo terus ba imi.
verses.45: Nunee imi bele sai imi nia Aman iha lalehan nia oan. Tanba Nia halo Ninia loro matan sae hodi leno ba ema aat no ema diak, no Nia haruka udan ba ema nebee loos no ema nebee la loos.
verses.46: Tanba se imi hadomi sira nebee hadomi imi, nunee imi hetan kolen saida? Laos ema nebee foti taxa mos halo hanesan nee?
verses.47: No se imi kumprimenta deit imi nia maluk, saida mak imi halo nebee liu fali ema seluk? Laos ema Jentiu sira mos halo hanesan nee?
verses.48: Imi tenki sai perfeitu, hanesan imi nia Aman iha lalehan mos perfeitu.

verses.1: Kuidadu katak bainhira imi halo hahalok loos, imi la halo iha ema nia oin hodi sira bele haree. Se karik imi halo hanesan nee, imi sei la hetan kolen hosi imi nia Aman iha lalehan.
verses.2: Nunee bainhira o atu foo ba ema kiak, keta huu trombeta iha o nia oin, hanesan ema laran makerek halo iha sinagoga sira no iha estrada sira, hodi ema bele gaba sira. Tebes Hau dehan ba o katak sira simu ona sira nia kolen.
verses.3: Maibee bainhira o foo ba ema kiak, keta husik o nia liman karuk hatene buat nebee o nia liman loos mak halo.
verses.4: Nunee o bele foo sub-subar ba ema kiak. No o nia Aman nebee haree buat subar nee, Nia sei selu o nia kolen.
verses.5: No bainhira imi halo orasaun, la bele halo tuir ema laran makerek sira. Tanba sira gosta halo orasaun bainhira sira hamriik iha sinagoga no iha dalan nia kruzamentu sira, hodi ema bele haree sira. Tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, sira hetan ona sira nia kolen.
verses.6: Maibee kona ba o, bainhira o halo orasaun, tama iha o nia kuartu laran, no taka odamatan. Halo orasaun ba o nia Aman nebee iha fatin subar. No o nia Aman nebee haree iha fatin subar nee, Nia sei selu o nia kolen.
verses.7: Maibee bainhira o halo orasaun, keta repete beibeik liafuan mamuk, hanesan ema Jentiu sira mak halo. Tanba sira hanoin katak Maromak sei rona sira tanba sira nia liafuan bar-barak.
verses.8: La bele sai hanesan sira, tanba o nia Aman hatene ona buat nebee imi presiza molok imi husu ba Nia.
verses.9: Nunee, halo orasaun hanesan nee:
verses.10: Ita nia ukun mai.
verses.11: Foo mai ami ai haan loro-loron nian.
verses.12: Foo perdua mai ami nia sala,
verses.13: No keta lori ami ba tentasaun,
verses.14: Tanba se imi foo perdua ba ema sira nebee halo sala, imi nia Aman iha lalehan mos sei foo perdua ba imi.
verses.15: Maibee se imi la foo perdua ba ema sira nebee halo sala, imi nia Aman mos se la foo perdua ba imi nia sala.
verses.16: No bainhira imi jejún, keta oin tristi hanesan ema laran makerek sira. Tanba sira hatudu oin tristi hodi ema bele hatene katak sira halo jejún. Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, sira hetan ona sira nia kolen.
verses.17: Maibee ba o, bainhira o jejún, tau mina ba o nia ulun, no fase o nia oin.
verses.18: Hodi nunee ema la hatene katak o jejún hela, maibee o nia Aman nebee iha fatin subar mak haree. No o nia Aman, nebee haree buat subar nee, Nia sei selu o nia kolen.
verses.19: La bele haloot riku-soin ba o nia aan rasik iha mundu nee. Tanba ular no ferujen halo riku-soin nee sai aat, no naok-teen sira bele tama no naok.
verses.20: Maibee haloot riku-soin ba o nia aan rasik iha lalehan. Tanba iha lalehan ular no ferujen la halo aat, no naok-teen sira la bele tama no naok.
verses.21: Tanba iha fatin nebee o rai o nia riku-soin, o nia fuan laran mos iha nebaa.
verses.22: Matan mak ahi oan ba isin lolon. Nunee se o nia matan moos, o nia isin tomak sei nakonu ho naroman.
verses.23: Maibee se o nia matan aat, o nia isin tomak sei nakonu ho nakukun. Nee duni, se karik naroman iha o nia laran sai nakukun, entaun nakukun nee mak boot tebes!
verses.24: La iha ema ida nebee bele serví ba nain rua. Tanba nia sei odi ida no hadomi ida seluk; ka nia sei foo laran ba ida, no hakribi ida seluk. Imi la bele serví ba Maromak no Riku-soin.
verses.25: Nunee Hau dehan ba imi: keta preokupa kona ba imi nia moris, atu haan saida ka atu hemu saida; no kona ba imi nia isin, atu hatais saida. Laos imi nia moris iha folin liu fali ai haan, no imi nia isin iha folin liu fali ropa?
verses.26: Haree took ba manu sira iha loro leten. Sira la kuda, no sira la silu ka haloot iha armazén. Maibee imi nia Aman iha lalehan foo haan ba sira. Laos imi folin boot liu fali sira?
verses.27: See mak bele aumenta oras ida ba ninia moris rasik liu hosi preokupa?
verses.28: No tanba saa mak imi hanoin kona ba imi nia ropa? Haree ba ai funan iha rai luan, oinsaa sira moris: sira la servisu no sira la soru tais.
verses.29: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi katak Salomão iha ninia glória hotu la bele hatais furak hanesan ai funan sira nee ida.
verses.30: Entaun, se Maromak foo hatais ba duut iha rai luan hanesan nee, nebee loron ohin sira iha, depois loron aban ema soe sira ba ahi, laos Nia sei foo hatais mos ba imi, Oh imi nebee fiar kiik?
verses.31: Nunee keta preokupa no dehan, ‘Ita sei haan saida?’ ka, ‘Ita sei hemu saida?’ ka, ‘Ita sei hatais saida?’
verses.32: Tanba ema Jentiu sira buka buat hotu nee. Maibee imi nia Aman iha lalehan hatene ona katak imi presiza buat sira nee hotu.
verses.33: Maibee buka uluk Maromak nia reinu, no Ninia moris loos; no Nia sei aumenta buat seluk hotu ba imi.
verses.34: Keta preokupa kona ba loron aban, tanba loron aban sei preokupa kona ba nia aan rasik. Loron ohin nia terus sei too ona ba loron ohin nee.

verses.1: Keta foo sala ba ema, atu nunee ema la foo sala ba o.
verses.2: Tanba ema sei foo sala ba o tuir dalan nebee o foo sala ba sira. No ho sukat nebee o sukat ba ema seluk, nunee mos ema seluk sei sukat fali ba o.
verses.3: Tanba saa mak o haree duut lahan ida nebee iha o nia maluk nia matan, maibee o la haree ai kabelak nebee iha o nia matan rasik?
verses.4: Oinsaa o dehan ba o nia maluk, ‘Husik hau hasai duut lahan ida nee hosi o nia matan,’ bainhira o sei iha ai kabelak iha o nia matan rasik?
verses.5: O mak ema laran makerek, hasai uluk ai kabelak nee hosi o nia matan, depois o bele haree ho matan moos hodi hasai duut lahan hosi o nia maluk nia matan.
verses.6: La bele foo buat nebee santu ba asu sira, no keta soe imi nia pérola iha fahi sira nia oin. Keta halo be sira sama buat folin nee iha sira nia ain okos, no fila fali hodi ataka o.
verses.7: Husu ba, no o sei simu; buka ba, no o sei hetan; dere ba, no odamatan sei nakloke ba o.
verses.8: Tanba ema hotu nebee husu sei simu; no nia nebee buka sei hetan; no ba nia nebee dere, odamatan nee sei nakloke ba nia.
verses.9: Ema ida nebee, se karik ninia oan husu paun, nia foo fali fatuk?
verses.10: Ou se karik oan nee husu ikan ida, aman nee sei foo fali samea ka?
verses.11: Nunee, se karik imi, maski imi aat, maibee imi hatene oinsaa atu foo prezenti diak ba imi nia oan sira, saa tan imi nia Aman iha lalehan sei foo duni buat nebee diak ba sira nebee husu ba Nia?
verses.12: Nunee buat hotu nebee o hakarak ema seluk halo ba o, halo hanesan nee ba ema seluk. Tanba ida nee mak Lei no Profeta sira.
verses.13: Tama liu hosi odamatan kloot. Tanba odamatan luan no dalan boot sei lori ema ba mate, no ema barak tama liu hosi dalan ida nee.
verses.14: Maibee odamatan kloot no dalan kiik sei lori ema ba moris, no ema uitoan deit mak hetan dalan ida nee.
verses.15: Kuidadu ho profeta falsu, nebee mai ba imi no hatais hanesan bibi, maibee iha laran sira mak asu fuik nebee hamlaha loos.
verses.16: Imi sei hatene sira liu hosi sira nia fuan. Ema bele kuu uvas fuan hosi ai tarak ka? Ou ema bele kuu figeira fuan hosi duut tarak ka?
verses.17: Nee duni, ai horis ida-idak nebee diak sei foo fuan gostu, maibee ai horis dodok sei foo fuan aat.
verses.18: Ai horis diak la bele foo fuan aat, no ai horis dodok la bele foo fuan gostu.
verses.19: Ai horis hotu nebee la foo fuan gostu, ema sei tesi tuun no soe ba ahi laran.
verses.20: Entaun, liu hosi sira nia fuan mak imi sei hatene sira.
verses.21: Laos ema hotu nebee dehan mai Hau, ‘Nai, Nai,’ sei tama ba reinu lalehan, maibee nia deit nebee halo tuir Hau nia Aman iha lalehan nia hakarak.
verses.22: Ema barak sei dehan mai Hau iha loron nebaa, ‘Nai, Nai, laos ami foo sai profesia hodi O nia naran, no hodi O nia naran ami hasai ona diabu sira, no hodi O nia naran mos ami halo ona milagre barak?’
verses.23: Depois Hau sei hatete ba sira, ‘Hau nunka konhese imi. Hadook tiha hosi Hau, imi nebee halo aat!’
verses.24: Nee duni, ema nebee rona Hau nia liafuan, no halo tuir buat sira nee, nia mak hanesan ema matenek ida, nebee harii ninia uma iha fatuk leten.
verses.25: Depois udan tuun, mota sae, no anin huu no baku uma nee. Maibee uma nee la monu tanba ema harii uma nee iha fatuk leten.
verses.26: No ema hotu nebee rona Hau nia liafuan, no la halo tuir buat sira nee, nia mak hanesan ema beik ida, nebee harii ninia uma iha rai henek.
verses.27: Depois udan tuun, mota sae, no anin huu no baku uma nee. No uma nee monu tiha, no nia rahun hotu.
verses.28: No tuir mai, bainhira Jesus nia liafuan nee remata ona, ema lubun boot nee hakfodak tanba buat nebee Nia hanorin.
verses.29: Tanba Nia hanorin sira hanesan ema ida nebee iha kbiit, laos hanesan ema eskriba sira.

verses.1: Bainhira Jesus tuun hosi foho, ema lubun boot lao tuir Nia.
verses.2: No tebes, ema ida ho moras lepra mai no hakneak iha Nia oin, no dehan, “Nai, se O hakarak, O bele halo hau sai moos.”
verses.3: Jesus lolo liman no kaer ema ida nee, no dehan, “Hau hakarak, sai moos ba.” No mane nee sai moos kedas hosi moras lepra.
verses.4: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Keta koalia ho ema ida, maibee baa hatudu aan ba saserdote. Foo oferta nebee Moisés manda ona, hodi sai testemunha ba sira.”
verses.5: Bainhira Jesus tama tiha ba iha Kafarnaum, komandante ida mai hasoru Nia, no husu favór ida hosi Nia.
verses.6: Komandante nee dehan, “Nai, hau nia atan toba hela iha uma ho moras isin maten, no nia iha terus makaas.”
verses.7: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Hau sei baa no kura nia.”
verses.8: Komandante nee hataan dehan, “Nai, hau la merese katak Ita Boot tama mai iha hau nia uma. Maibee koalia deit, no hau nia atan sei sai diak.
verses.9: Tanba hau mak mane ida nebee tuir autoridade iha hau nia leten, no hau iha soldadu sira iha hau nia okos. Hau dehan ba ida, ‘Baa!’ no nia baa; no hau dehan ba ida seluk, ‘Mai!’ no nia mai. No ba hau nia atan, ‘Halo ida nee!’ no nia halo tuir.”
verses.10: Bainhira Jesus rona tiha liafuan nee, Nia admira, no dehan ba sira nebee lao tuir Nia, “Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, Hau seidauk hetan ema ho fiar nebee boot hanesan nee iha Israel.
verses.11: Hau dehan ba imi katak ema barak sei mai hosi parte lorosae no parte loromonu no sira sei tuur iha meza hamutuk ho Abraão, Isak, no Jacó, iha reinu lalehan.
verses.12: Maibee Maromak sei soe reinu nia oan sira ba liur iha fatin nakukun liu, iha fatin nebee ema tanis no ruun nehan.”
verses.13: No Jesus dehan ba komandante nee, “Lao ba, no o sei hetan tuir o nia fiar.” No komandante nia atan sai isin diak kedas iha oras nebaa.
verses.14: Bainhira Jesus tama iha Pedro nia uma, Nia haree katak Pedro nia banin feto toba ho moras isin manas.
verses.15: Jesus kaer nia liman, no isin manas sai kedas hosi nia. Feto nee hamriik no hahuu serví Jesus.
verses.16: Bainhira kalan mai, ema lori mai too Jesus ema barak nebee diabu domina. Nia duni sai espíritu sira nee ho liafuan ida. No Nia kura ema hotu nebee moras.
verses.17: Nunee Nia kumpri liafuan nebee mai liu hosi profeta Isaias, bainhira nia dehan nanis ona: “Nia rasik simu ita nia frakeza, no lori ita nia moras.”
verses.18: Bainhira Jesus haree ema lubun boot nebee haleu Nia, Nia foo orden atu baa tasi nia sorin ba.
verses.19: No ema eskriba ida mai, no dehan ba Nia, “Mestri, hau sei lao tuir Ita Boot ba fatin nebee deit Ita Boot baa.”
verses.20: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Asu fuik kiik iha rai kuak, no manu iha loro leten iha knuuk, maibee Ema Nia Oan la iha fatin ida hodi hatoba Ninia ulun.”
verses.21: Depois eskolante ida fali dehan ba Nia, “Nai, husik hau baa hakoi lai hau nia aman.”
verses.22: Maibee Jesus dehan ba nia, “Tuir Hau, no husik ema mate hakoi sira nia ema mate.”
verses.23: Tuir mai Jesus sae roo ida no Ninia eskolante sira tuir Nia.
verses.24: No tebes, tasi sai siak makaas too laloran halo bee tama ba roo. Maibee Jesus toba dukur hela.
verses.25: Ninia eskolante sira baa fanu Nia no dehan, “Nai, salva ami! Ami atu mate!”
verses.26: Nia dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi tauk, Oh imi nebee fiar kiik?” Depois Nia hamriik hodi siak anin no tasi. No buat hotu sai hakmatek.
verses.27: Maibee ema sira nee admira no dehan, “See mak ema ida nee, nebee anin no tasi halo tuir Nia?”
verses.28: Bainhira Jesus too tiha tasi sorin ba, iha rai Gadara, ema nain rua nebee diabu domina mai hasoru Nia. Ema nain rua nee sai hosi rate fatin. Sira siak tebes no ema la bele liu hosi dalan nee.
verses.29: No tebes, sira hakilar, no dehan, “Ami halo saida ba O, Oh Jesus, Maromak Nia Oan? O mai atu foo terus mai ami molok ami nia tempu ka?”
verses.30: Iha tempu nebaa, iha fahi lubun boot ida nebee haan hela iha fatin nebee dook hosi sira.
verses.31: Entaun diabu sira nee husu lisensa hosi Jesus no dehan, “Se O atu duni sai ami, entaun husik ami bele baa no tama iha fahi lubun boot nee.”
verses.32: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Baa!” No bainhira sira sai, sira tama ba iha fahi lubun nee. No tebes, fahi lubun tomak nee halai tuun liu hosi rai lolon no tama tasi. No sira mate iha bee laran.
verses.33: Ema sira nebee hein fahi nee halai, no tama ba iha sidade laran. No sira foo sai kona ba buat hotu nebee akontese inklui buat nebee akontese ba ema nebee iha diabu sira nee.
verses.34: No tebes, sidade tomak sai ba hodi hasoru Jesus. No bainhira sira haree Nia, sira husu Nia sai hosi sira nia rai.

9.title: Jesus Kura Ema Ho Ain Aat

verses.1: Entaun Jesus sae roo ida hodi hakur ba tasi sorin. No Nia mai too Ninia sidade rasik.
verses.2: No tebes, sira lori ba Nia ema ida nebee isin mate, nebee latan hela iha toba fatin. Bainhira Jesus haree sira nia fiar, Nia dehan ba ema isin mate nee, “Oan, aten brani ba! O nia sala sira hetan perdua ona.”
verses.3: No tebes, ema eskriba balu dehan iha sira nia laran, “Mane ida nee koalia aat Maromak.”
verses.4: Jesus hatene sira nia hanoin, no Nia dehan, “Tanba saa mak imi hanoin aat iha imi nia fuan laran?
verses.5: Ida nebee mak fasil liu, atu dehan, ‘O nia sala hetan perdua’, ka atu dehan, ‘Hamriik no lao ba’?
verses.6: Maibee hodi imi bele hatene katak Ema Nia Oan iha kbiit iha mundu atu foo perdua ba sala, (Nia dehan ba ema nebee moras ho isin mate) Hamriik ba, foti o nia toba fatin, no fila fali ba o nia uma.”
verses.7: Nunee ema nee hamriik, no fila fali ba ninia uma.
verses.8: Bainhira ema lubun boot nee haree ida nee, sira admira no foo glória ba Maromak nebee foo kbiit hanesan nee ba ema.
verses.9: Bainhira Jesus lao sai hosi fatin nee, Nia haree mane ida, naran Mateus, nebee tuur hela iha fatin nebee ema selu taxa. Jesus dehan ba nia, “Tuir Hau ba.” No nia hamriik kedas no tuir Jesus.
verses.10: Tuir mai, bainhira Jesus tuur hodi haan iha uma, tebes, kobradór impostu barak no sala nain sira mai no tuur hamutuk ho Nia no Ninia eskolante sira.
verses.11: No bainhira ema Farizeu sira haree ida nee, sira dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Tanba saa mak imi nia Mestri haan hamutuk ho kobradór impostu sira no sala nain sira?”
verses.12: Maibee bainhira Jesus rona liafuan nee, Nia dehan ba sira, “Ema nebee isin diak la presiza doutór, maibee sira nebee moras.
verses.13: Maibee baa no aprende liafuan nee katak saa, ‘Hau hakarak domin metin, laos sakrifísiu.’ Tanba Hau mai laos atu bolu ema nebee moris loos, maibee sala nain sira.”
verses.14: Depois João nia eskolante sira baa hasoru Jesus no sira husu, “Tanba saa mak ami no ema Farizeu sira halo jejún, maibee Ita Boot nia eskolante sira la halo jejún?”
verses.15: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Noivu nia belun sira bele tristi durante tempu kazamentu bainhira noivu sei hamutuk hela ho sira ka? Maibee tempu atu mai bainhira ema foti noivu nee hosi sira, depois sira sei halo jejún.
verses.16: Ema la taka kuak iha ropa tuan ho hena foun. Tanba hena foun bele lees fali ropa no halo kuak nee aat liu tan.
verses.17: No mos, ema la tau tua uvas foun iha tua kulit tuan, tanba se sira halo nunee tua kulit nee bele naklees no fakar tua uvas no tua kulit nee sai aat hotu. Maibee ema tau tua uvas foun iha tua kulit foun, no buat rua nee bele diak hela.”
verses.18: Bainhira Jesus koalia hela ho sira kona ba buat sira nee, tebes, ukun nain ida mai no hakneak iha Nia oin, no dehan, “Hau nia oan feto foin mate. Maibee mai tau liman ba nia, no nia bele moris fali.”
verses.19: Entaun Jesus hamriik, no Nia lao tuir ema ida nee, hamutuk ho Ninia eskolante sira.
verses.20: No tebes, iha feto ida nebee moras raan suli nebee la para durante tinan sanulu resin rua. Feto nee mai hakbesik iha Jesus nia kotuk hodi kona Jesus nia ropa ninin.
verses.21: Tanba feto hanoin iha ninia laran, “Se hau bele kona deit Ninia ropa, ida nee sei salva hau.”
verses.22: Maibee Jesus fila oin, no bainhira Nia haree feto nee, Nia dehan, “Oan feto, aten brani ba. O nia fiar mak salva o.” No feto nee sai diak fali hosi tempu nee kedas.
verses.23: Jesus mai too iha ukun nain nia uma. Nia haree ema huu flauta no ema lubun boot halo barulhu.
verses.24: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi sai tiha, tanba labarik feto nee la mate, nia toba deit.” No sira hamnasa Nia.
verses.25: Maibee bainhira ema haruka povu nee sai tiha ona, Jesus tama ba. Nia foti labarik feto nia liman, no feto nee hadeer.
verses.26: No ema fahe istória kona ba hahalok nee iha rai tomak iha nebaa.
verses.27: Bainhira Jesus sai hosi fatin nee, ema matan delek nain rua tuir Nia. Sira hakilar no dehan, “David Nia Oan Mane, hatudu laran luak mai ami.”
verses.28: Bainhira Nia tama uma, ema matan delek nain rua nee tama tuir Nia. No Jesus dehan ba sira, “Imi fiar katak Hau bele halo buat nee ka?” Sira dehan ba Nia, “Sin, Nai.”
verses.29: Depois Nia tau liman ba sira nia matan, no dehan, “Tuir imi nia fiar, nunee imi sei hetan.”
verses.30: Depois sira nia matan nee nakloke. Jesus bandu makaas sira, no dehan, “La bele foo hatene kona ba buat nee ba ema ida.”
verses.31: Maibee bainhira sira sai tiha, sira konta istória kona ba Nia iha rai tomak iha nebaa.
verses.32: Bainhira sira sai dadauk, tebes, ema seluk lori ba Nia ema monok ida nebee diabu domina.
verses.33: No bainhira Jesus duni sai tiha diabu, ema monok nee koalia. Ema lubun sira nee admira no dehan, “Ita nunka haree buat ida hanesan nee iha Israel.”
verses.34: Maibee ema Farizeu sira dehan, “Nia bele duni sai diabu sira liu hosi diabu sira nia nain.”
verses.35: Jesus lao ba sidade no aldeia hotu. Nia hanorin iha sira nia sinagoga sira, no haklaken evanjelhu kona ba reinu nee. No Nia kura moras hotu no isin fraku hotu.
verses.36: Maibee bainhira Nia haree ema lubun sira nee, Nia hanoin ho laran luak ba sira. Tanba sira fraku no lao arbiru deit, hanesan bibi nebee bibi atan la iha.
verses.37: No Nia dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Loos duni, servisu hodi halibur rezultadu nee sei barak loos, maibee ema hodi servisu mak uitoan deit.
verses.38: Nunee halo orasaun ba rezultadu nia Nain, hodi Nia bele haruka tan ema hodi servisu no halibur Ninia rezultadu nee.”

verses.1: Jesus bolu Ninia eskolante nain sanulu resin rua. Nia foo kbiit ba sira hodi duni sai espíritu aat sira, no hodi kura moras no isin fraku oi-oin.
verses.2: Apostolu nain sanulu resin rua nia naran mak nee: primeiru mak Simão, nebee iha naran Pedro, no ninia alin André; Tiago, nebee Zebedeu nia oan, no ninia alin João;
verses.3: Filipe no Bartolomeu; Tomé no Mateus, nebee kobradór impostu; Tiago, nebee Alfeu nia oan, no Tadeus;
verses.4: Simão, nebee ema Kanaan, no Judas Iskariotes, nebee sai traidór ba Jesus.
verses.5: Jesus haruka eskolante nain sanulu resin rua nee hodi lao ba oin. Nia foo orden ba sira no dehan, “La bele tama dalan ba ema Jentiu sira, no keta tama sidade ida hosi ema Samaria sira.
verses.6: Maibee baa bibi nebee lakon hosi uma kain Israel nian.
verses.7: No bainhira imi baa, haklaken no dehan, ‘Reinu lalehan besik ona.’
verses.8: Kura ema moras, hamoos ema nebee iha moras lepra, foo moris ba ema mate, no duni sai diabu sira. Imi simu gratis ona, nunee foo gratis deit.
verses.9: Keta buka osan mean, osan mutin ka osan riti atu rai iha imi nia bolsu.
verses.10: Keta lori pasta iha imi nia viajen. Keta lori faru rua, sandálias ka ai tonka. Tanba ema nebee servisu merese atu simu ninia hahaan.
verses.11: No sidade ka aldeia naran deit nebee imi tama, husu se mak merese iha nebaa, no hela iha nebaa too imi sai fali hodi lao ba fatin seluk.
verses.12: Bainhira imi tama uma ida, kumprimenta ba sira.
verses.13: No se uma nee merese duni, husik imi nia dame hela iha nebaa. Maibee se uma nee la merese, husik imi nia dame fila fali ba imi.
verses.14: No see deit nebee la simu imi ka la rona imi nia liafuan, bainhira imi husik uma ka sidade nee, liki tiha rai rahun hosi imi nia ain.
verses.15: Tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, iha loron tesi lia nian, rai Sodoma no Gomora nia kastigu sei kamaan liu fali sidade ida nee nia kastigu.
verses.16: Tebes, Hau haruka imi lao ba hanesan bibi iha asu fuik sira nia leet. Nunee imi tenki matenek klean hanesan samea, maibee inosenti hanesan manu pombu.
verses.17: Kuidadu ba, tanba ema sei lori imi ba tribunál no sira sei baku imi ho sikoti iha sira nia sinagoga sira.
verses.18: No sira sei lori imi ba governadór sira no liurai sira nia oin tanba Hau nia naran. No imi sei foo testemunha iha sira nia oin no iha ema Jentiu sira nia oin.
verses.19: Maibee bainhira sira entrega imi ba tribunál, keta preokupa kona ba oinsaa imi sei koalia ka buat nebee imi sei hatete. Tanba imi sei simu liafuan iha oras nebee imi atu koalia.
verses.20: Tanba laos imi rasik koalia, maibee imi nia Aman nia Espíritu sei koalia liu hosi imi.
verses.21: Maun ida sei entrega ninia alin ba kastigu mate, no aman ida sei entrega ninia oan. Oan sira sei hamriik hasoru sira nia inan-aman sira, no entrega sira ba ema hodi oho sira.
verses.22: No ema hotu sei odi imi tanba Hau nia naran. Maibee nia nebee hela metin too rohan sei hetan salvasaun.
verses.23: Bainhira sira hanehan imi iha sidade ida, halai ba sidade seluk. Tanba tebes Hau dehan ba imi, katak imi sei la liu sidade hotu iha Israel molok Ema Nia Oan mai.
verses.24: Eskolante ida la aas liu ninia mestri, no atan ida la aas liu ninia nain.
verses.25: Too ona katak eskolante ida mak hanesan ninia mestri, no atan ida mak hanesan ninia nain. Se sira temi naran Belzebu ba uma nain, oinsaa liu tan sira temi naran nee ba ema iha Ninia uma laran?
verses.26: Keta tauk sira. Tanba buat hotu nebee taka hela, sei nakloke; no buat hotu nebee subar hela, ema sei hatene.
verses.27: Buat nebee Hau dehan ba imi iha fatin nakukun, foo sai iha fatin naroman. No buat nebee imi rona bis-bisu, haklaken hosi uma leten.
verses.28: Keta tauk sira nebee bele oho isin lolon, maibee la bele oho klamar. Maibee hamtauk ba Nia nebee bele halakon klamar no isin hamutuk iha infernu.
verses.29: Laos manu liin rua faan ho folin sentavus lima-nulu? Maibee la iha manu liin ida nebee monu ba rai, se imi nia Aman la foo lisensa.
verses.30: Nia sura imi nia fuuk lahan hotu iha imi nia ulun.
verses.31: Nunee keta tauk, tanba imi nia folin nee boot liu manu liin barak.
verses.32: Nunee ema hotu nebee foo sai kona ba Hau iha ema nia oin, Hau mos sei foo sai kona ba nia iha Hau nia Aman iha lalehan nia oin.
verses.33: Maibee ema hotu nebee nega Hau iha ema nia oin, Hau mos sei nega nia iha Hau nia Aman iha lalehan nia oin.
verses.34: Keta hanoin katak Hau mai atu lori dame ba mundu: Hau la mai atu lori dame, maibee atu lori surik ida.
verses.35: Tanba Hau mai atu halo mane ida kontra ninia aman, no oan feto ida kontra ninia inan, no feto foun kontra ninia banin feto.
verses.36: No mane ida nia inimigu sira mak ema hosi ninia uma kain rasik.
verses.37: Ema nebee hadomi ninia aman ka inan liu fali Hau, nia la merese atu sai Hau nian. No ema nebee hadomi oan mane ka oan feto liu fali Hau, nia la merese atu sai Hau nian.
verses.38: Ema nebee la lori ninia krús no lao tuir Hau, nia la merese atu sai Hau nian.
verses.39: Nia nebee hetan ninia moris sei lakon fali ninia moris; no nia nebee lakon ninia moris tanba Hau nia naran sei hetan fali ninia moris.
verses.40: Ema nebee simu imi, nia simu mos Hau. No nia nebee simu Hau, nia simu mos Ida nebee haruka Hau.
verses.41: Ema nebee simu profeta ida tanba nia mak profeta duni, ema nee sei simu kolen profeta nian. Ema nebee simu ema moris loos tanba nia ema moris loos duni, ema nee sei simu kolen ema moris loos nian.
verses.42: No ema hotu nebee foo bee malirin kopu ida deit ba kiik-oan ida hodi hemu tanba kiik-oan nee mak eskolante ida, tebes Hau dehan ba imi, ema nee sei la lakon ninia kolen.”

verses.1: Tuir mai, bainhira Jesus manda ona Ninia eskolante nain sanulu resin rua, Nia sai hosi fatin nee no Nia baa hanorin no haklaken iha sira nia sidade sira.
verses.2: Bainhira João, nebee iha komarka laran, rona kona ba buat nebee Kristu halo ona, nia haruka ema nain rua hosi ninia eskolante sira,
verses.3: hodi husu Jesus, “O mak Nia nebee atu mai, ka ami tenki hein ema seluk?”
verses.4: Jesus hataan no dehan ba sira, “Fila fali baa no foo hatene ba João kona ba buat nebee imi rona no haree:
verses.5: ema matan delek sira haree, ema ain kudeik sira lao, ema moras lepra sira sai moos, ema tilun diuk sira rona, ema mate sira moris fali, no ema kiak sira rona evanjelhu.
verses.6: Haksolok ba nia nebee la hanoin sala tanba Hau.
verses.7: Bainhira ema nain rua nee baa tiha, Jesus komesa dehan ba ema lubun boot nee kona ba João, “Imi lao sai ba rai fuik hodi haree saida? Duut manulain nebee anin doko ka?
verses.8: Entaun imi lao ba hodi haree saida? Mane ida nebee hatais ropa furak ka? Tebes, sira nebee hatais ropa furak hela iha liurai sira nia uma.
verses.9: Entaun imi lao ba hodi haree saida? Profeta ida ka? Sin, no Hau dehan ba imi, ema ida nee boot liu fali profeta sira.
verses.10: Tanba sira hakerek nanis ona kona ba nia nunee,
verses.11: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, hosi ema nebee moris hosi feto, la iha ema ida nebee boot liu João Batista. Maski nunee, ema nebee kiik liu iha reinu lalehan mak boot liu fali nia.
verses.12: Hosi João Batista nia tempu too agora, ema hadau malu atu hetan reinu lalehan, no nia nebee hadau makaas liu mak hetan ida nee.
verses.13: Tanba profeta hotu no lei tomak foo sai profesia too João.
verses.14: No se imi bele simu liafuan nee, nia mak Elias, nebee atu mai.
verses.15: Nia nebee iha tilun hodi rona, husik nia rona ba.
verses.16: Maibee Hau kompara jerasaun nee ho see? Imi hanesan labarik sira nebee tuur iha merkadu, no bolu ba sira nia maluk sira,
verses.17: hodi dehan,
verses.18: Tanba João mai no nia la haan no la hemu, no ema dehan, ‘Nia iha diabu ida.’
verses.19: Ema Nia Oan mai no Nia haan no hemu, no sira dehan, ‘Tebes, mane nee mak ema kaan-teen no lanu-teen ida. Nia halo kolega ho kobradór impostu no sala nain sira.’ Maibee matenek klean sei hatudu aan loos liu hosi ninia hahalok.”
verses.20: Depois Jesus komesa hasee sidade sira nebee Nia halo ona milagre barak, tanba sira la arepende.
verses.21: “Susar ba o, Korazin! Susar ba o, Betsaida! Tanba se milagre sira nebee Hau halo ona iha imi, mak halo fali iha sidade Tiro no Sidon, sira sei arepende kleur ona ho hena karoon no ahi kdesan.
verses.22: Maibee, Hau dehan ba imi katak Tiro no Sidon nia kastigu sei kamaan liu fali imi nian iha loron tesi lia.
verses.23: No ba o, Kafarnaum, o sei sae ba lalehan ka? O sei tuun ba infernu! Tanba se milagre sira nebee Hau halo ona iha imi, mak halo fali iha Sodoma, nunee sidade nee sei iha too ohin loron.
verses.24: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi katak Sodoma nia kastigu sei kamaan liu fali imi nian iha loron tesi lia.”
verses.25: Iha tempu nebaa, Jesus foo sai, “Hau foo agradese ba O, Aman, nebee Nain ba lalehan no mundu, tanba O subar buat sira nee hosi ema matenek klean no ema nebee kompriende, no O hatudu fali buat sira nee ba kiik-oan sira.
verses.26: Loos duni, Aman, tanba O hanoin buat nee diak.
verses.27: Hau nia Aman entrega ona buat hotu mai Hau. La iha ema ida nebee konhese Oan Mane, só Aman deit. No mos, la iha ema ida nebee konhese Aman nee, só Oan Mane deit, no sira nebee Oan Mane hakarak hatudu Nia ba sira.
verses.28: Mai iha Hau, imi hotu nebee kole no lori naha todan, no Hau sei foo deskansa ba imi.
verses.29: Simu Hau nia servisu, no aprende hosi Hau. Tanba Hau laran maus no haraik aan; no imi nia klamar sei hetan deskansa.
verses.30: Tanba Hau nia servisu fasil, no Hau nia naha kamaan.”

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, Jesus lao liu hosi toos batar iha loron Sabdu. No Ninia eskolante sira hamlaha no sira komesa ba silu batar no haan.
verses.2: Maibee bainhira ema Farizeu sira haree buat nee, sira dehan ba Jesus, “Tebes, O nia eskolante sira halo buat nebee lei bandu iha loron Sabdu.”
verses.3: Maibee Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi seidauk lee buat nebee David halo bainhira nia no sira nebee hamutuk ho nia hamlaha?
verses.4: Nia tama ba uma Maromak nian, no nia haan paun santu, nebee Lei dehan nia no sira nebee hamutuk ho nia la bele haan paun nee. Só deit saserdote sira bele haan.
verses.5: Ou imi seidauk lee iha Lei ka, oinsaa iha loron Sabdu katak saserdote sira iha Templu halo foer loron Sabdu, no sira la sala?
verses.6: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi, katak iha fatin nee iha Ida nebee boot liu Templu.
verses.7: Maibee se imi hatene ona liafuan nee nia sentidu, ‘Hau hakarak laran luak, laos sakrifísiu,’ imi sei la kondena ema inosenti.
verses.8: Tanba Ema Nia Oan mos Nain ba loron Sabdu.”
verses.9: Bainhira Jesus sai ona hosi fatin nee, Nia tama ba sira nia sinagoga.
verses.10: No tebes, iha mane ida iha nebaa nebee iha liman sorin mate. No sira husu Jesus, “Tuir Lei, ita bele kura iha loron Sabdu ka lae?” Tanba sira buka razaun atu akuza Nia.
verses.11: Jesus dehan ba sira, “See deit mak iha bibi nebee monu ba rai kuak iha loron Sabdu, laos nia kaer bibi nee no foti sai nia ka?
verses.12: Oinsaa liu tan ema ida iha folin boot liu fali bibi ida! Nunee ita tuir Lei bainhira ita halo diak iha loron Sabdu.”
verses.13: Depois Jesus dehan ba mane nee, “Lolo o nia liman ba.” Mane nee lolo liman, no liman nee sai diak kedas, hanesan liman seluk.
verses.14: Depois ema Farizeu sira sai ba liur no futu lia hasoru Jesus, oinsaa sira bele halakon Nia.
verses.15: Jesus hatene kona ba planu nee, no Nia lao sai hosi fatin nee. Ema lubun boot tuir Nia, no Nia kura sira hotu.
verses.16: Nia foo orden ba sira katak sira la bele foo hatene ba ema seluk kona ba see mak Nia.
verses.17: Ida nee kumpri liafuan nebee koalia liu hosi profeta Isaias, nebee dehan:
verses.18: “Tebes Hau nia atan, nebee Hau hili ona;
verses.19: Nia sei la diskuti malu ka hakilar;
verses.20: Nia sei la halo tohar duut kain ida nebee kleuk ona,
verses.21: no iha Ninia naran ema Jentiu sira sei fiar.”
verses.22: Depois sira lori ema ida ba Jesus nebee diabu hadau ona. Ema ida nee matan delek, no nia monok. Jesus kura nia no nia bele koalia no haree.
verses.23: Povu hotu hakfodak no dehan, “Nia mak oan mane hosi David ka?”
verses.24: Maibee bainhira ema Farizeu sira rona tiha nunee, sira dehan, “Nia duni sai diabu sira liu hosi Belzebu deit, nebee diabu sira nia nain.”
verses.25: Jesus hatene sira nia hanoin, no Nia dehan ba sira, “Reinu nebee fahe hodi hasoru nia aan sei lakon mohu deit; no sidade ka uma nebee fahe hodi hasoru nia aan sei la dura.
verses.26: No se karik Satanás duni sai Satanás, nia fahe ona hodi hasoru nia aan. Nunee oinsaa ninia reinu bele dura?
verses.27: No se Hau duni sai diabu sira liu hosi Belzebu, entaun imi nia oan sira duni sai diabu sira liu hosi see? Nunee sira sei tesi lia ba imi.
verses.28: Maibee se Hau duni sai diabu sira liu hosi Maromak nia Espíritu, entaun Maromak nia reinu sei too mai ona ba imi.
verses.29: Oinsaa ema ida bele tama ba ema forti nia uma, no hadau ninia riku-soin? Laos nia tenki kesi lai ema forti nee? Depois nia bele hadau ema nee nia uma.
verses.30: Ema nebee la hamutuk ho Hau, nia kontra Hau. No ema nebee la halibur ho Hau, nia namkari deit.
verses.31: Nunee Hau dehan ba imi, ema hotu nebee sala no koalia aat hasoru Maromak bele hetan perdua, maibee ema nebee koalia aat hasoru Espíritu Santu sei la hetan perdua.
verses.32: No see deit nebee koalia hasoru Ema Nia Oan sei hetan perdua. Maibee see deit nebee koalia hasoru Espíritu Santu sei la hetan perdua, laos iha tempu nee ka iha tempu nebee tuir mai.
verses.33: Halo ai huun diak, no ninia fuan sei sai diak; ka halo ai huun aat, no ninia fuan sei sai aat. Tanba ita hatene ai huun liu hosi ninia fuan.
verses.34: Oh samea nia oan sira! Oinsaa imi nebee aat bele koalia buat nebee diak? Tanba ibun koalia hosi buat resin nebee sai hosi fuan laran.
verses.35: Ema diak sei foo sai buat sira nebee diak hosi ninia riku-soin diak iha nia fuan laran. Maibee ema aat sei foo sai buat aat hosi ninia riku-soin aat.
verses.36: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi, iha Loron Tesi Lia nian, ema tenki hataan kona ba liafuan folin laek ida-idak nebee sira koalia.
verses.37: Tanba liu hosi o nia liafuan o sei sai loos, no liu hosi o nia liafuan o sei hetan kastigu.”
verses.38: Depois ema eskriba no ema Farizeu balu hataan, no dehan, “Mestri, ami hakarak haree sinál ida hosi Ita Boot.”
verses.39: Maibee Nia hataan, no dehan ba sira, “Jerasaun nebee aat no halo sala foer buka sinál ida. No sira la hetan sinál ida, só deit sinál profeta Jonas nian.
verses.40: Tanba hanesan Jonas hela iha ikan boot nia kabun laran too loron tolu no kalan tolu, nunee mos Ema Nia Oan sei hela loron tolu no kalan tolu iha rai laran.
verses.41: Ema Nínive sei hamriik ho jerasaun nee iha tempu Tesi Lia nian, no sira sei kondena imi. Tanba sira arepende bainhira sira rona haklaken hosi Jonas. No tebes, iha ema ida iha nee nebee boot liu fali Jonas.
verses.42: Liurai feto hosi parte súl sei hamriik ho jerasaun nee iha tempu Tesi Lia nian, no nia sei kondena imi mos. Tanba nia mai hosi mundu rohan hodi rona matenek klean hosi Salomão. No tebes, iha ema ida iha nee nebee boot liu fali Salomão.
verses.43: Bainhira espíritu sai hosi ema ida, nia lao liu rai maran hodi buka fatin deskansa. Maibee bainhira nia la hetan,
verses.44: nia dehan, ‘Hau sei fila fali ba hau nia uma nebee hau husik tiha.’ Bainhira nia too, nia hetan uma nee mamuk, dasa tiha no moos.
verses.45: Entaun nia baa, no lori tan espíritu aat hitu nebee aat liu nia. Sira tama no hela iha nebaa. Ikus mai, ema ida nee sai aat liu fali uluk. Nunee mos ho jerasaun aat nee.”
verses.46: Bainhira Jesus koalia hela ho povu nee, tebes, Ninia inan no alin mane sira hamriik iha liur. No sira hakarak koalia ho Nia.
verses.47: Ema ida dehan ba Nia, “Tebes, Ita Boot nia inan no alin mane sira hamriik iha liur, no sira hakarak koalia ho Ita Boot.”
verses.48: Maibee Nia hataan ba ema nebee foo hatene ba Nia, “See mak Hau nia inan? No see mak Hau nia alin mane sira?”
verses.49: No Nia lolo liman ba Ninia eskolante sira, no dehan, “Tebes, nee mak Hau nia inan no Hau nia alin mane sira!
verses.50: Tanba see deit nebee halo tuir Hau nia Aman iha lalehan nia hakarak, nia mak Hau nia alin mane, alin feto no inan.”

verses.1: Iha loron nebaa, Jesus sai hosi uma, no tuur iha tasi ibun.
verses.2: Ema lubun boot mai halibur hamutuk ba Nia. Entaun Nia sae roo ida, no tuur. No ema lubun boot nee hamriik iha tasi ibun.
verses.3: Nia foo sai buat barak ba sira liu hosi ai knanoik sira. Nia dehan, “Tebes, toos nain ida baa hodi kari fini.
verses.4: Bainhira nia kuda fini nee, balu monu iha dalan ninin. No manu sira mai no haan sira hotu.
verses.5: Balu monu iha fatuk laran. No fini nee iha rai uitoan deit. Fini nee tubun lalais, tanba rai uitoan deit.
verses.6: Bainhira loro matan sae, sira sai maran, no namlaik too lakon tanba abut la iha.
verses.7: No fini balu monu iha ai tarak laran. Ai tarak nee sai boot, no hanehan sira.
verses.8: No fini balu tan monu iha rai diak, no foo produsaun diak. Balu foo fali too dala atus ida, balu too dala neen-nulu, no balu too dala tolu-nulu.
verses.9: Ema nebee iha tilun hodi rona, husik nia rona ba.”
verses.10: Eskolante sira mai, no dehan ba Nia, “Tanba saa mak Ita Boot koalia ba sira ho ai knanoik?”
verses.11: Nia hataan no dehan ba sira, “Tanba imi deit bele simu segredu kona ba reinu lalehan, maibee sira la hetan.
verses.12: Tanba nia nebee iha ona, nia sei hetan tan, nunee nia iha barak loos. Maibee ba nia nebee la iha, nia sei lakon mos buat ruma nebee nia iha.
verses.13: Tanba nee Hau koalia ba sira ho ai knanoik: maski sira haree maibee sira la haree, no maski sira rona maibee sira la rona, nunee sira la kompriende.
verses.14: Nee duni Isaias nia profesia kona ba sira sai loos ona, nebee nia dehan,
verses.15: Tanba povu nee nia fuan laran sai toos ona,
verses.16: Maibee haksolok ba imi nia matan, tanba sira haree; no imi nia tilun, tanba sira rona.
verses.17: Tanba Hau koalia lo-loos ba imi katak profeta barak no ema barak nebee moris loos hakarak tebes atu haree buat nebee imi haree, maibee sira la konsege haree; no rona buat nebee imi rona, maibee sira la konsege rona.
verses.18: “Entaun, rona kona ba ai knanoik ho toos nain:
verses.19: Bainhira ema ida rona liafuan kona ba reinu nee, no nia la kompriende liafuan nee, nunee buat aat mai, no foti sai buat nebee kuda ona iha ninia fuan laran. Nia mak ida nebee simu fini iha dalan ninin.
verses.20: Maibee ida nebee simu fini iha fatuk laran mak ema nebee rona liafuan nee, no nia simu kedas ho laran haksolok.
verses.21: Maibee liafuan nee la iha abut iha nia laran. Nia bele tahan too tempu uitoan deit. Bainhira tempu susar ka terus mosu mai tanba liafuan nee, nia monu kedas.
verses.22: Ida nebee simu fini iha ai tarak laran mak nia nebee rona liafuan nee, maibee nia preokupa kona ba moris iha mundu no riku-soin nebee dada bosok. Hanoin resin nee hanehan liafuan nee no nia la foo fuan.
verses.23: Maibee ida nebee simu fini iha rai diak mak nia nebee rona liafuan nee, no nia kompriende. Nia foo mos fuan, no balu foo fali too dala atus ida, balu too dala neen-nulu, no balu tan too dala tolu-nulu.”
verses.24: Jesus konta ai knanoik ida fali ba sira. Nia dehan, “Reinu lalehan nee hanesan ema ida nebee kari fini diak iha ninia toos.
verses.25: Maibee bainhira nia toba hela, ninia inimigu mai no kari fini hosi duut aat iha trigu nee nia leet. Depois inimigu baa tiha.
verses.26: Bainhira trigu nee moris mai, no foo fuan, duut aat mos mosu mai.
verses.27: Nunee toos nain nia atan sira mai no dehan ba nia, ‘Senhor, iha ita boot nia toos, ita boot kari fini nebee diak ka lae? Nunee duut aat nee mai hosi nebee?’
verses.28: Nia dehan ba sira, ‘Inimigu ida mak halo nunee.’ Ninia atan sira dehan ba nia, ‘Ita boot hakarak ami baa fokit duut aat nee?’
verses.29: Maibee nia dehan, “Lae, tanba bainhira imi fokit duut aat nee, karik imi fokit sai mos trigu hamutuk ho sira.
verses.30: Husik sira moris hamutuk too tempu kolheta, no iha tempu kolheta hau sei hatete ba sira nebee koa trigu, ‘Koa uluk duut aat, no futu hamutuk hodi sunu tiha. Maibee koa trigu hodi halibur ba iha hau nia armazén.’”
verses.31: Nia foo sai ai knanoik ida fali ba sira, Nia dehan, “Reinu lalehan mak hanesan mostarda musan ida, nebee ema ida foti no kuda iha ninia toos.
verses.32: Fini nee kiik liu fali fini hotu. Maibee bainhira fini nee moris, nia sai boot liu modo hotu. No nia sai hanesan ai huun ida. Nunee manu sira iha loro leten mai hela iha ninia sanak sira.”
verses.33: Ai knanoik seluk nebee Nia konta ba sira mak nee, “Reinu lalehan mak hanesan fermentu, nebee feto foti, no kahur ho trigu saku ida. Masa tomak nee sae tanba fermentu.”
verses.34: Buat hotu nebee Jesus dehan ba ema lubun nee, Nia dehan liu hosi ai knanoik. Nia la koalia ho sira ho liafuan oin seluk, só Nia uza deit ai knanoik.
verses.35: Ida nee sei kumpri buat nebee profeta ida hatete ona bainhira nia dehan,
verses.36: Depois Jesus husik ema lubun boot nee no Nia tama ba uma laran. Ninia eskolante sira hakbesik ba Nia, no dehan, “Esplika mai ami ai knanoik kona ba duut aat iha toos.”
verses.37: Nia hataan no dehan ba sira, “Ida nebee kari fini diak mak Ema Nia Oan.
verses.38: Toos nee mak mundu. Fini diak mak reinu nia oan sira maibee duut aat mak aat nain nia oan sira.
verses.39: Inimigu nebee kuda duut aat nee mak diabu. Tempu koa nian mak mundu nia rohan. No sira nebee koa trigu mak anju sira.
verses.40: Nunee tempu nebee sira koa duut aat no sunu iha ahi, buat nee sei akontese iha mundu nia rohan.
verses.41: Ema Nia Oan sei haruka Ninia anju sira, no sira sei koa sai hosi Ninia reinu buat hotu nebee halo ema monu ba sala, no sira nebee iha hahalok aat.
verses.42: Nia sei soe sira ba fornu nebee lakan, no sira sei tanis no ruun nehan.
verses.43: Depois ema nebee moris loos sei nabilan hanesan loro matan iha sira nia Aman nia reinu. Nia nebee iha tilun hodi rona, husik nia rona ba.
verses.44: “No mos, reinu lalehan mak hanesan riku-soin nebee subar iha toos. Bainhira ema hetan riku-soin nee, nia subar fali buat nee. No ho laran haksolok nia baa no faan buat hotu nebee nia iha hodi sosa toos nee.
verses.45: No mos, reinu lalehan mak hanesan loja nain ida nebee buka pérola nebee diak.
verses.46: Bainhira nia hetan pérola ida nebee folin boot, nia baa no faan buat hotu nebee nia iha, no sosa pérola nee.
verses.47: “No mos, reinu lalehan mak hanesan redi nebee ema soe ba tasi no hetan ikan oi-oin.
verses.48: Bainhira redi nee nakonu, sira dada ba tasi ibun. Depois ema tuur hodi halibur ikan diak iha raga sira, maibee ikan nebee aat sira soe tiha.
verses.49: Ida nee mak hanesan iha mundu nia rohan. Anju sira sei mai, no haketak ema aat sira hosi ema loos sira nia leet.
verses.50: No anju sira sei soe ema aat sira ba fornu nebee lakan. Iha nebaa, sira sei tanis no ruun nehan.”
verses.51: Jesus husu ba sira, “Imi kompriende buat nee hotu ka?” Sira hataan ba Nia, “Sin.”
verses.52: Nunee Nia dehan ba sira, “Entaun eskriba hotu nebee aprende ona kona ba reinu lalehan mak hanesan uma nain nebee hatudu buat sira nebee foun no tuan hosi ninia riku-soin.”
verses.53: Tuir mai, bainhira Jesus foo sai tiha ai knanoik sira nee, Nia sai hosi fatin nebaa.
verses.54: Bainhira Nia too Ninia rai, Nia hanorin sira iha sira nia sinagoga. Ema sira nee hakfodak, no dehan, “Ema ida nee hetan matenek no kbiit nee hosi nebee?
verses.55: Laos Nia mak badaen ai nia oan mane ka? Laos Ninia inan mak Maria? No Ninia alin mane sira mak, Tiago, José, Simão no Judas?
verses.56: No Ninia alin feto sira, laos sira hotu iha nee ho ita? Entaun mane ida nee hetan buat hirak nee hosi nebee?”
verses.57: No sira hanoin sala tanba Nia. Maibee Jesus dehan ba sira, “Profeta ida sempre hetan onra, só deit iha ninia rai rasik no ninia iha uma rasik mak nia la hetan onra.”
verses.58: No Nia la halo milagre barak ho kbiit iha nebaa tanba sira la fiar.

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, Herodes, nebee ukun nain iha área nebaa, rona kona ba Jesus nia konhesidu.
verses.2: Nia dehan ba ninia atan sira, “Ema nee mak João Batista. Nia moris hias ona hosi mate. Tanba nee nia iha kbiit hodi halo milagre sira.”
verses.3: Tanba Herodes kaer ona João, kesi nia, no tau nia iha komarka tanba Herodias nebee ninia alin mane Filipe nia feen.
verses.4: Tanba João dehan ba Herodes, “Tuir lo-loos, ita boot la bele kaben ho Herodias.”
verses.5: Mezmu Herodes hakarak oho João, nia tauk povu, tanba sira haree João nudar profeta.
verses.6: Maibee bainhira Herodes halo tinan, Herodias nia oan feto dansa iha sira nia oin, no Herodes sai kontenti.
verses.7: Nunee nia promete ho juramentu atu foo saida deit nebee oan feto nee husu.
verses.8: No feto nee simu liafuan hosi ninia inan, no dehan, “Foo kedas mai hau iha nee João Batista nia ulun iha bandeja ida.”
verses.9: Liurai tristi, maibee tanba ninia juramentu, no sira nebee tuur no haan hamutuk ho nia, entaun nia foo orden katak sira foo buat nebee feto nee husu.
verses.10: No Herodes haruka ema baa no tesi sai João nia ulun iha komarka.
verses.11: Depois sira lori mai ninia ulun iha bandeja ida, no foo ba labarik feto nee. No nia lori ulun nee ba ninia inan.
verses.12: Depois João nia eskolante sira mai, no foti mate isin nee, no hakoi nia. No sira baa no foo hatene ba Jesus.
verses.13: Bainhira Jesus rona tiha liafuan nee, Nia sai hosi fatin nee liu hosi roo, no tama ba rai fuik. Bainhira povu rona tiha ida nee, sira lao tuir Nia hosi sidade sira.
verses.14: Bainhira Jesus too rai maran, Nia haree ema lubun boot ida. Nia hanoin tebe-tebes sira, no Nia kura ema sira nebee moras.
verses.15: Bainhira rai nakaras besik mai, Ninia eskolante sira mai no dehan ba Nia, “Fatin nee rai fuik, no tempu liu ona. Haruka ema lubun boot nee fila ba, hodi sira bele tama ba aldeia sira, no sosa hahaan.
verses.16: Maibee Jesus dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Sira la presiza sai. Imi foo haan ba sira.”
verses.17: No eskolante sira dehan ba Nia, “Ami iha deit paun fuan lima no ikan rua.”
verses.18: Jesus dehan, “Lori hahaan sira nee mai Hau.”
verses.19: Depois Nia haruka ema lubun boot nee tuur iha duut leten. Nia foti paun fuan lima no ikan rua nee. Nia hateke ba lalehan no foo sai bensaun. Nia silu paun nee no fahe ba Ninia eskolante sira. Depois eskolante sira fahe hahaan ba ema lubun boot nee.
verses.20: Ema sira hotu haan too bosu. Depois sira halibur hahaan resin ba bote sanulu resin rua nakonu.
verses.21: Ema sira nebee haan ona nee maizoumenus mane nain rihun lima (5000), nebee la sura feto no labarik sira.
verses.22: Depois Jesus haruka kedas Ninia eskolante sira atu sae roo ida, no baa uluk Nia ba tasi sorin. No Jesus haruka ema lubun boot nee fila ba.
verses.23: Bainhira Nia haruka ona ema lubun boot nee fila ba, Nia mesak sae foho hodi halo orasaun. Bainhira kalan mai ona, Nia iha nebaa mes-mesak.
verses.24: Maibee iha tempu nebaa roo iha tasi klaran ona. Laloran baku makaas roo nee tanba anin hasoru sira.
verses.25: No iha dadeer-saan nakukun, Jesus baa sira, no Nia lao iha tasi leten.
verses.26: Bainhira eskolante sira haree Nia lao iha tasi leten, sira tauk tebes, no dehan, “Ida nee mak mate klamar!” No sira hakilar tanba tauk.
verses.27: Maibee Jesus koalia kedas ba sira, no dehan, “Aten brani ba! Nee mak Hau. Keta tauk.”
verses.28: Pedro hataan ba Jesus, no dehan, “Nai, se O mak nee duni, haruka hau lao iha bee leten ba O.”
verses.29: Jesus dehan, “Mai!” Pedro tuun hosi roo no nia lao iha bee leten atu baa too Jesus.
verses.30: Maibee bainhira nia haree anin boot, nia sai tauk. Nia komesa mout no nia hakilar dehan, “Nai, salva hau ba!”
verses.31: Jesus lolo kedas Nia liman no kaer Pedro. Jesus dehan ba nia, “O nebee iha fiar kiik-oan, nusaa mak o laran ru-rua?”
verses.32: No bainhira sira tama roo, anin nee para ona.
verses.33: Depois sira nebee iha roo laran adora Jesus, no dehan, “Loos duni, O mak Maromak nia Oan.”
verses.34: Bainhira sira too iha tasi sorin, sira baa too rai Genesaré.
verses.35: No bainhira ema hosi fatin nee hatene kona ba Nia, sira haruka lia-menon ba rai tomak iha nebaa. No sira lori ba Nia ema hotu nebee moras.
verses.36: Sira husu Nia atu sira bele kona deit Ninia ropa rohan. No ema hotu nebee kona Ninia ropa nee hetan duni isin diak.

verses.1: Depois ema eskriba no Farizeu sira mai hosi Jerusalém hodi hasoru Jesus. No sira dehan,
verses.2: “Tanba saa mak O nia eskolante sira la halo tuir lisan hosi bei-ala sira? Sira la fasi sira nia liman bainhira sira haan.”
verses.3: Maibee Jesus hataan, no dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi mos la halo tuir ukun fuan hosi Maromak tanba imi nia lisan?
verses.4: Tanba Maromak manda, no dehan, ‘Foo onra ba o nia inan-aman.’ No, ‘Nia nebee foo malisan ba ninia inan-aman, nia tenki mate.’
verses.5: Maibee imi dehan, ‘Ema nebee dehan ba ninia inan-aman, “Buat nebee imi atu hetan hosi hau, buat nee hau foo fali ba Maromak,”
verses.6: ema nee la presiza foo onra ba ninia inan-aman.’ Nunee, imi halo Maromak nia ukun fuan la iha folin tanba imi nia lisan.
verses.7: Laran makerek sira! Isaias foo sai profesia lo-loos kona ba imi, bainhira nia dehan:
verses.8: ‘Povu nee foo onra mai Hau ho sira nia ibun tutun;
verses.9: Sira adora Hau saugati deit,
verses.10: Nia bolu ema lubun boot nee mai, no dehan ba sira, “Rona ba, no kompriende:
verses.11: Laos buat nebee tama ibun mak halo ema ida foer maibee buat nebee sai hosi ibun, buat nee mak halo ema foer.”
verses.12: Depois Ninia eskolante sira mai, no dehan ba Nia, “Ita Boot hatene katak ema Farizeu sira hanoin hirus bainhira sira rona liafuan nee ka?”
verses.13: Maibee Nia hataan dehan, “Ai horis hotu nebee Hau nia Aman iha lalehan la kuda, sei fokit sai tiha.
verses.14: Husik ema sira nee. Tanba sira mak matadalan nebee matan delek. No se ema matan delek ida lori ema matan delek seluk, nain rua nee sei monu ba rai kuak!”
verses.15: Depois Pedro hataan no dehan ba Nia, “Esplika mai ami ai knanoik ida nee.”
verses.16: Jesus dehan, “Imi mos seidauk kompriende ka?
verses.17: Imi la haree ka, katak saida mak tama liu hosi ibun tuun ba kabun depois sai ba sintina?
verses.18: Maibee buat sira nebee sai hosi ibun mai hosi laran. No buat sira nee halo ema foer.
verses.19: Tanba hosi laran sai hanoin aat, oho ema, adultériu, sala seksuál, naok, bosok no koalia aat hasoru Maromak.
verses.20: Buat sira nee mak hafoer ema. Maibee atu haan ho liman nebee seidauk fasi, buat nee la hafoer ema.”
verses.21: Depois Jesus sai hosi fatin nee, no Nia tama ba distritu Tiro no Sidon.
verses.22: No tebes, feto Kanaan ida hosi área nebaa hakilar ba Nia, no dehan, “Hatudu laran luak mai hau, Oh Nai, David Nia Oan. Hau nia oan feto hetan terus boot tanba diabu ida.”
verses.23: Maibee Nia la hataan liafuan ida ba feto nee. Ninia eskolante sira hakbesik ba Nia, no husu dehan, “Haruka feto nee baa tiha; tanba nia tuir ita no hakilar beibeik.”
verses.24: Maibee Jesus hataan dehan, “Hau mai deit hodi buka bibi sira nebee lakon hosi Israel nia uma kain.”
verses.25: Depois feto nee hakbesik no hakneak ba Nia, no dehan, “Nai, ajuda hau lai.”
verses.26: Maibee Nia hataan, no dehan, “Maibee ida nee la diak atu foti oan sira nia paun no soe fali ba asu oan.”
verses.27: No feto nee dehan, “Loos duni, Nai. Maibee asu oan bele haan paun rahun nebee monu hosi sira nia nain nia meza.”
verses.28: Entaun Jesus hataan ba nia, “Oh feto, o nia fiar nee boot tebes! Husik o hetan tuir o nia hakarak.” No hosi oras nee kedas, ninia oan feto hetan isin diak.
verses.29: Jesus sai hosi fatin nee, no Nia lao iha tasi ibun iha Tasi Galileia. Depois Nia sae ba foho ida, no tuur iha nebaa.
verses.30: Ema lubun boot sira mai ba Nia. No sira lori ema nebee ain aat, matan delek, monok, liman aat, no sira seluk. Sira tau ema moras nee iha Jesus nia ain no Nia kura sira hotu.
verses.31: Ema lubun boot nee admira bainhira sira haree ema monok bele koalia, no ema ho liman aat sai diak fali, ema ain aat bele lao, no ema matan delek bele haree. No sira foo glória ba Israel nia Maromak.
verses.32: Jesus bolu Ninia eskolante sira mai, no dehan, “Hau hanoin tebes ba ema lubun nee, tanba sira lao hamutuk ho Hau too loron tolu ona. Sira la iha buat ida atu haan. No Hau lakohi haruka sira fila hamlaha. Keta halo be sira sai fraku no monu iha dalan.”
verses.33: Ninia eskolante sira dehan ba Nia, “Ita hetan paun hosi nebee iha rai fuik nee hodi foo haan ema lubun nebee boot nee?”
verses.34: No Jesus dehan ba sira, “Imi iha paun fuan hira?” Sira hataan, “Hitu, no ikan kiik balu.”
verses.35: Depois Jesus haruka ema lubun boot nee tuur iha rai.
verses.36: No Nia foti paun fuan hitu no ikan sira nee, foo agradese, no silu hodi fahe ba Ninia eskolante sira, no eskolante sira fahe fali ba ema lubun boot nee.
verses.37: Sira hotu haan too bosu. No sira halibur hahaan rahun nebee resin nee too bote boot hitu nakonu.
verses.38: Sira nebee haan mak ema nain rihun haat (4000), nebee seidauk sura feto no labarik sira.
verses.39: Jesus haruka ema lubun boot nee fila. Depois Nia sae roo no baa área Magadan.

16.title: Ema Farizeu No Saduseu Buka Sinál

verses.1: Ema Farizeu ho Saduseu sira mai atu koko Jesus. Sira husu Nia atu hatudu ba sira sinál ida hosi lalehan.
verses.2: Nia hataan no dehan ba sira, “Bainhira rai nakaras mai, imi dehan, ‘Tempu diak sei mai tanba loro leten mean hela.’
verses.3: No iha dadeer-saan, ‘Ohin tempu la diak, tanba loro leten sei mean no iha kalohan metan.’ Oh imi nebee laran makerek! Imi bele kompriende loro leten nee oinsaa, maibee imi la bele kompriende sinál iha tempu nee.
verses.4: Jerasaun ida nebee aat no laran foer buka sinál ida. Maibee sira sei la hetan sinál ida, só deit sinál hosi profeta Jonas.” Depois Nia husik sira no sai hosi fatin nee.
verses.5: Bainhira Ninia eskolante sira baa too tasi sorin, sira haluha atu lori paun.
verses.6: Depois Jesus dehan ba sira, “Matan moris ba no kuidadu kona ba fermentu hosi ema Farizeu no Saduseu sira.”
verses.7: Sira koalia ba malu, “Nee tanba ita la lori paun.”
verses.8: Bainhira Jesus hatene ida nee, Nia dehan ba sira, “Oh imi nebee fiar kiik, tanba saa mak imi koalia ba malu kona ba la lori paun?
verses.9: Imi seidauk kompriende ka? Imi haluha ona paun fuan lima ba ema nain rihun lima no imi halibur fali too bote hira?
verses.10: No mos paun fuan hitu ho ema nain rihun haat no imi halibur fali too bote boot hira?
verses.11: Oinsaa mak imi la kompriende katak Hau la koalia ba imi kona ba paun, maibee katak imi tenki kuidadu kona ba fermentu hosi ema Farizeu no Saduseu sira?”
verses.12: Depois sira kompriende katak Nia haruka sira laos atu kuidadu kona ba fermentu iha paun, maibee kona ba ema Farizeu no Saduseu sira nia hanorin.
verses.13: Bainhira Jesus tama ba área Sezareia Filipe, Nia husu Ninia eskolante sira, no dehan, “Ema dehan Ema Nia Oan mak see?”
verses.14: No sira dehan, “Balu dehan João Batista, balu dehan Elias, no ema seluk dehan Jeremias ka profeta ida.”
verses.15: Depois Nia dehan ba sira, “Maibee imi dehan see mak Hau nee?”
verses.16: No Simão Pedro hataan dehan, “O mak Kristu, Maromak Moris nia Oan Mane.”
verses.17: No Jesus hataan no dehan ba nia, “Bensaun ba o, Simão Bar-Jonas! Tanba isin no raan la foo sai buat nee ba o, maibee Hau nia Aman nebee iha lalehan.
verses.18: No Hau dehan mos ba o, katak o mak Pedro, no iha fatuk nee nia leten Hau sei harii Hau nia Igreja. No portaun infernu nian sei la manaan hasoru nia.
verses.19: No Hau sei foo ba o xave ba reinu lalehan. Saida mak o kesi iha mundu sei kesi mos iha lalehan, no saida mak o kore iha mundu sei kore mos iha lalehan.”
verses.20: Depois Jesus bandu Ninia eskolante sira atu la bele foo hatene ba ema ida katak Nia mak Kristu.
verses.21: Hosi tempu nee ba oin, Jesus komesa hatudu Ninia eskolante sira oinsaa Nia tenki baa Jerusalém, no hetan kastigu todan hosi katuas, xefi saserdote no eskriba sira, no Nia sei mate, no Nia sei moris hias iha loron terseiru.
verses.22: Depois Pedro lori Nia ba sorin no komesa siak Nia no dehan, “La bele hanesan nee ba O, Nai! Buat nee sei la kona O.”
verses.23: Maibee Nia fila, no dehan ba Pedro, “Sees ba Hau nia kotuk lai, Satanás! O mak lasu ida ba Hau. Tanba o la hanoin tuir buat nebee Maromak nian, maibee buat nebee ema nian.”
verses.24: Depois Jesus dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Se ema hakarak tuir Hau, nia tenki nega nia aan, lori nia krús no tuir Hau.
verses.25: Tanba ema nebee hakarak salva nia moris, sei lakon nia moris nee; no ema nebee lakon nia moris, tanba Hau nia naran, sei hetan fali nia moris nee.
verses.26: Tanba ida nee iha folin saida ba ema, se nia manaan mundu tomak maibee nia lakon nia moris? Ka ema bele foo saida hodi troka nia moris?
verses.27: Tanba Ema Nia Oan sei mai iha Ninia Aman nia glória hamutuk ho Ninia anju sira. Depois Nia sei selu fali ema ida-idak tuir ema nia hahalok.
verses.28: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, katak ema balu nebee hamriik iha nee sei la mate too sira haree Ema Nia Oan mai fali iha Ninia reinu.”

verses.1: Liu tiha loron neen, Jesus lori Pedro, Tiago no nia alin João, no sira sae foho aas ba fatin nebee ema la iha.
verses.2: No Jesus nakfilak aan iha sira nia oin. Ninia oin nabilan hanesan loro matan, no Ninia ropa sai mutin nebee naroman loos.
verses.3: No tebes, Moisés no Elias mosu iha sira nia oin no koalia ho Jesus.
verses.4: Depois Pedro dehan ba Jesus, “Nai, ida nee diak katak ita iha nee. Se O hakarak, husik ami harii tenda tolu, ida ba O, ida ba Moisés, no ida ba Elias.”
verses.5: Bainhira nia koalia hela, tebes, kalohan nabilan taka sira. No tebes, lian ida sai hosi kalohan nee no dehan, “Ida nee mak Hau nia Oan Mane nebee Hau hadomi. Hau kontenti liu ho Nia. Rona Nia ba.”
verses.6: Bainhira eskolante sira rona tiha lian nee, sira monu ho oin ba rai, no sira tauk tebe-tebes.
verses.7: Jesus hakbesik no kona sira, no dehan, “Hamriik ba, keta tauk!”
verses.8: No bainhira sira foti matan, sira la haree ema ida, só Jesus deit.
verses.9: Bainhira sira tuun dadaun hosi foho, Jesus bandu sira, no dehan, “La bele foo hatene kona ba vizaun nee ba ema ida too Ema Nia Oan moris hias hosi mate.”
verses.10: Depois Ninia eskolante sira husu ba Nia, “Tanba saa mak eskriba sira dehan katak Elias tenki mai uluk?”
verses.11: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Loos duni, Elias mai uluk, no nia hadia buat hotu.
verses.12: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi katak Elias mai ona, no sira la konhese nia. Maibee sira halo ona ba nia tuir sira nia hakarak hotu. Nunee mos Ema Nia Oan sei hetan terus hosi sira.”
verses.13: Depois Ninia eskolante sira kompriende katak Nia koalia ba sira kona ba João Batista.
verses.14: Bainhira sira fila ba ema lubun boot nee, ema ida hakbesik ba Jesus. Nia hakneak iha Jesus nia oin, no dehan,
verses.15: “Nai, hatudu laran luak ba hau nia oan mane, tanba nia moras bibi maten, no iha terus makaas. Dala barak nia monu ba ahi laran no monu ba bee laran.
verses.16: Hau lori ona nia ba O nia eskolante sira, maibee sira la bele kura nia.”
verses.17: Depois Jesus hataan dehan, “Oh jerasaun aat nebee la fiar. Too bainhira mak Hau tenki hamutuk ho imi? Too bainhira mak Hau tenki hatudu pasiénsia ba imi? Lori nia mai Hau lai.”
verses.18: Jesus siak diabu nee. No diabu sai hosi labarik no labarik nee sai diak kedas.
verses.19: Tuir mai, bainhira Jesus mesak ona, eskolante sira hakbesik ba Nia, no dehan, “Tanba saa mak ami la bele duni sai diabu nee?”
verses.20: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Tanba imi nia fiar menus. Tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, se imi nia fiar hanesan mostarda musan ida, imi bele dehan ba foho nee, ‘Muda aan ba nebaa,’ no foho sei muda aan. La iha buat ida nebee imi la bele halo.”
verses.22: Bainhira sira halibur iha Galileia, Jesus dehan ba sira, “Ema sei entrega Ema Nia Oan nee ba ema sira nia liman.
verses.23: Ema sei oho Nia, no iha loron terseiru Nia sei moris hias.” No sira sai tristi tebe-tebes.
verses.24: Bainhira sira too tiha Kafarnaum, ema nebee simu taxa hakbesik ba Pedro, no dehan, “Laos ita nia Mestri selu taxa ka?”
verses.25: Nia dehan, “Sin.” No bainhira Pedro fila ba uma, Jesus koalia kedas ba nia, no dehan, “O hanoin oinsaa, Simão? Liurai sira iha mundu foti impostu ka taxa hosi see? Hosi sira nia oan sira ka hosi ema seluk?”
verses.26: Pedro dehan ba Jesus, “Hosi ema seluk.” Jesus dehan ba nia, “Entaun oan sira mak livre.
verses.27: Maski nunee ita lalika halo sira atu hanoin sala. Entaun tuun ba tasi no soe kail ida no foti ikan primeiru nebee o hetan. Loke tiha ikan nee nia ibun, no o sei hetan osan mutin pedasuk ida. Lori osan nee no foo ba sira hodi selu kona ba Hau no o mos.”

verses.1: Iha tempu nee, eskolante sira hakbesik ba Jesus, no husu, “See mak boot liu iha reinu lalehan?”
verses.2: Jesus bolu labarik kiik ida mai Nia. Nia tau labarik nee iha sira nia klaran.
verses.3: Nia dehan, “Tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, se imi la troka, no sai hanesan kiik-oan sira, imi sei la tama ba reinu lalehan.
verses.4: Nunee see deit nebee haraik aan hanesan labarik kiik nee, nia mak boot liu iha reinu lalehan.
verses.5: No see deit nebee simu labarik kiik ida hodi Hau nia naran, nia simu mos Hau.
verses.6: Maibee kona ba kiik-oan ida nebee fiar Hau, ema see deit nebee halo nia monu ba sala, diak liu ema nee kesi fatuk boot dulas batar nian ba ninia kakorok no baa mout iha tasi laran.”
verses.7: “Susar ba mundu tanba lasu nebee halo ema monu ba sala! Tanba lasu nee tenki mai; maibee susar ba ema ida nebee lasu mai liu hosi nia!
verses.8: Nunee se o nia liman ka o nia ain halo o monu ba sala, tesi sai buat nee, no soe tiha. Diak liu o tama ba fatin moris nian ho liman ka ain sorin deit, duké o iha liman rua ka ain rua no sira soe o ba ahi rohan laek.
verses.9: No se o nia matan halo o monu ba sala, fokit sai no soe tiha. Diak liu o tama ba fatin moris nian ho matan ida deit, duké o iha matan rua no sira soe o ba ahi infernu nian.
verses.10: Kuidadu katak o la hakribi kiik-oan ida hosi labarik sira nee. Tanba Hau dehan ba imi, katak tebes sira nia anju sira iha lalehan sempre haree Hau nia Aman nia oin iha lalehan.
verses.12: Imi hanoin oinsaa? Se ema ida iha bibi atus ida, no bibi ida lao lakon hosi sira. Laos ema ida nee husik bibi sia-nulu resin sia iha foho, no baa buka ida nebee lao lakon?
verses.13: No se nia hetan bibi nee, tebes Hau dehan ba imi, nia haksolok tebes ho bibi ida nee, liu fali bibi sia-nulu resin sia nebee la lao lakon.
verses.14: Nunee imi nia Aman iha lalehan lakohi kiik-oan sira nee ida atu lakon.
verses.15: No mos se o nia maluk halo sala hasoru o, baa no foo hatene ba nia kona ba ninia sala. Koalia ho nia mes-mesak. Se nia rona ba o, entaun o hetan fali o nia maluk.
verses.16: Maibee se nia la rona ba o, entaun lori ema ida ka rua tan. Nunee liu hosi sasin nain rua ka tolu nia liafuan, ita bele estabelese asuntu hotu.
verses.17: No se nia lakohi rona sira, foo hatene ba igreja. Maibee se nia lakohi rona igreja, haree nia nudar ema Jentiu ida no kobradór impostu.
verses.18: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, buat hotu nebee imi kesi iha mundu, kesi ona iha lalehan. No buat hotu nebee imi kore iha mundu, kore ona iha lalehan.
verses.19: Hau dehan mos ba imi, se ema nain rua iha mundu nee husu buat saida deit ho lian ida, nunee Hau nia Aman iha lalehan sei halo buat nee.
verses.20: Tanba iha fatin naran deit nebee ema nain rua ka tolu halibur hamutuk hodi Hau nia naran, Hau mos iha sira nia leet.”
verses.21: Depois Pedro mai ba Jesus, no dehan, “Nai, too dala hira mak hau tenki perdua hau nia maluk nebee halo sala hasoru hau? Too dala hitu ka?”
verses.22: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Hau dehan ba o, laos too dala hitu, maibee too hitu-nulu dala hitu.
verses.23: Nunee reinu lalehan mak hanesan liurai ida nebee hakarak sura osan debe hosi ninia atan sira.
verses.24: No bainhira nia hahuu atu sura, sira lori atan ida ba nia nebee tenki selu fali osan talentu rihun sanulu (10.000).
verses.25: Maibee atan nee la bele selu fali. Entaun ninia nai haruka sira faan nia, no ninia feen no oan sira, no buat hotu nebee nia iha, hodi selu fali osan debe nee.
verses.26: Nunee atan nee monu ba rai, no hakruuk ba liurai, no dehan, ‘Nai, foo tempu mai hau, no hau sei selu fali buat hotu ba ita boot.’
verses.27: Depois atan nee nia nai hanoin tebes ninia atan. Nunee nia kansela atan nia osan debe nee.
verses.28: Maibee atan nee sai ba, no hetan ninia maluk atan ida nebee debe osan denáriu atus ida. Depois atan primeiru kaer nia, no buti metin ninia kakorok, no dehan, ‘Selu fali buat nebee o debe hosi hau!’
verses.29: No ninia maluk atan nee monu iha ninia ain, no husu ho laran, no dehan, ‘Foo tempu mai hau, no hau sei selu fali buat hotu ba ita.’
verses.30: Maibee nia lakohi. Nia lori ninia maluk atan nee no soe nia ba komarka too nia bele selu fali osan debe nee.
verses.31: Nunee bainhira ninia maluk atan sira seluk haree buat nebee nia halo, sira sai tristi tebes. Sira baa no foo hatene ba sira nia nai kona ba buat hotu nebee akontese.
verses.32: Depois atan nee nia nai bolu atan nee no dehan ba nia, ‘O mak atan aat! Hau kansela ona o nia osan debe hotu tanba o husu hau ho laran.
verses.33: Laos o tenki hatudu laran luak ba o nia maluk atan, hanesan hau hatudu ona laran luak ba o?’
verses.34: No atan nia nai sai hirus tebes, no entrega nia ba guarda nebee foo kastigu todan ba nia too nia bele selu fali osan hotu nebee nia debe hosi nai.
verses.35: Hanesan nee Hau nia Aman iha lalehan sei halo mos ba imi, se imi ida-idak la foo perdaun ba imi nia maluk sira ho imi nia fuan laran.”

verses.1: Tuir mai, bainhira Jesus koalia ona liafuan nee, Nia sai hosi Galileia no tama ba área Judeia, iha Jordaun nia sorin ba.
verses.2: Ema lubun boot sira tuir Nia. No Nia kura sira iha nebaa.
verses.3: Ema Farizeu sira mos mai ba Nia. Sira koko Nia no dehan ba Nia, “Tuir lo-loos, mane ida bele soe ninia feen tanba razaun naran deit ka lae?”
verses.4: Nia hataan ba sira, “Imi lee tiha ona ka lae, katak Nia nebee kria sira iha tempu hahuu, Nia kria sira mane no feto?
verses.5: No Maromak dehan, ‘Tanba nee mane ida sei husik ninia inan-aman, no nia sei hela hamutuk ho ninia feen. No sira nain rua sei sai isin ida deit.’
verses.6: Nunee sira laos ema nain rua ona, maibee ida deit. Nee duni, buat nebee Maromak tau hamutuk, ema la bele haketak.”
verses.7: Sira dehan ba Nia, “Entaun tanba saa mak Moisés foo orden ba ema atu foo surat soe malu nian no soe ninia feen?”
verses.8: Nia dehan ba sira, “Tanba imi nia fuan laran toos. Nunee Moisés foo lisensa ba imi atu soe imi nia feen. Maibee iha tempu hahuu laos hanesan nee.
verses.9: No Hau dehan ba imi: see deit nebee soe ninia feen, no kaben ho ema seluk, nia halo adultériu. Só deit tanba sala seksuál mak nia bele soe ninia feen.”
