verses.10: Jesus nia eskolante sira dehan ba Nia, “Se karik hanesan nee entre mane ho ninia feen, entaun diak liu lalika kaben.”
verses.11: Maibee Nia dehan ba sira, “Laos ema hotu bele simu liafuan nee, só deit ba ema nebee simu grasa nee.
verses.12: Tanba ema balu la kaben, tanba sira moris mai hanesan nee hosi sira nia inan nia oan fatin. No ema balu la kaben, tanba ema seluk halo sira hanesan nee. No ema balu la kaben, tanba sira rasik desidi hanesan nee tanba reinu lalehan. Nia nebee bele simu liafuan nee, husik nia simu ba.”
verses.13: Depois ema lori labarik kiik sira ba Jesus atu Nia bele tau liman ba sira no halo orasaun. No eskolante sira siak ema sira nee.
verses.14: Maibee Jesus dehan, “Husik labarik kiik sira nee hakbesik mai Hau, no keta bandu sira. Tanba ema hanesan labarik sira nee mak sai Maromak nia reinu.”
verses.15: No Nia tau liman ba sira. Depois Nia sai hosi fatin nebaa.
verses.16: Tebes, ema ida mai no dehan ba Jesus, “Mestri, hau tenki halo buat diak saida atu hau bele hetan moris rohan laek?”
verses.17: No Jesus dehan ba nia, “Tanba saa mak o husu Hau kona ba buat nebee diak? Iha Ida deit nebee diak. Maibee se o hakarak hetan moris, halo tuir ukun fuan sira.”
verses.18: Nia husu Jesus, “Ukun fuan ida nebee?” Jesus dehan, “Keta oho, keta halo sala seksuál, keta naok, keta foo sasin falsu,
verses.19: foo onra ba o nia inan-aman, no hadomi o nia maluk hanesan o nia aan rasik.”
verses.20: Joven mane nee dehan ba Jesus, “Hau halo tuir ona buat sira nee hotu. Saida tan mak hau sei falta?”
verses.21: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Se o hakarak sai perfeitu, baa faan o nia sasaan, no foo ba ema kiak, no o sei hetan riku-soin iha lalehan. No mai tuir Hau.”
verses.22: Maibee bainhira joven mane rona tiha liafuan nee, nia fila ho laran tristi, tanba nia iha riku-soin barak.
verses.23: Depois Jesus dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, katak susar duni ba ema riku atu tama ba reinu lalehan.
verses.24: Dala ida tan, Hau dehan ba imi, fasil liu ba kuda kamelu ida atu tama liu hosi daun kuak duké ema riku ida atu tama ba Maromak nia reinu.”
verses.25: Bainhira Ninia eskolante sira rona nunee, sira hakfodak tebes no dehan, “Entaun see loos mak bele hetan salvasaun?”
verses.26: Maibee Jesus hateke ba sira, no dehan, “Ba ema, la bele; maibee ba Maromak, buat hotu bele deit.”
verses.27: Depois Pedro hataan no dehan ba Nia, “Tebes, ami husik ona buat hotu, no tuir O; nunee ami sei hetan saida?”
verses.28: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Hau koalia lo-loos ba imi, iha mundu foun, bainhira Ema Nia Oan tuur iha Ninia kadunan iha glória, imi mos nebee tuir Hau sei tuur iha kadunan sanulu resin rua. No imi sei tesi lia ba Israel nia suku sanulu resin rua.
verses.29: No ema hotu nebee husik uma, ka maun-alin sira, ka inan-aman, ka feen, ka oan sira, ka rai tanba Hau nia naran, sira sei simu dala atus ida liu tan. No sira sei hetan moris rohan laek nudar liman rohan.
verses.30: Maibee ema barak nebee primeiru sei sai ikus, no sira nebee ikus sei sai primeiru.”

verses.1: “Tanba reinu lalehan hanesan uma nain ida nebee sai ba iha dadeer-saan hodi buka ema servisu iha ninia toos uvas.
verses.2: No bainhira nia koalia ona ho ema servisu atu foo osan denáriu ida kada loron ida, nia haruka sira baa ninia toos uvas.
verses.3: Depois nia sai ba maizoumenus tuku sia, no haree ema seluk hamriik halimar iha merkadu.
verses.4: Nia dehan ba sira, ‘Imi mos baa, no tama toos uvas, no hau sei selu imi buat nebee loos.’ No sira baa.
verses.5: Nia sai fali maizoumenus meiudia no tuku tolu lokraik, no halo hanesan uluk nee.
verses.6: Maizoumenus tuku lima lokraik nia sai ba, no nia hetan ema seluk nebee hamriik halimar hela. Nia dehan ba sira, ‘Tanba saa mak imi hamriik halimar iha nee loron tomak?’
verses.7: Sira dehan ba nia, ‘Tanba la iha ema nebee foo servisu mai ami.’ Nia dehan ba sira, ‘Imi mos baa tama toos uvas.’
verses.8: Entaun bainhira rai nakaras ona, toos nia nain dehan ba ninia atan, ‘Bolu sira nebee servisu, no selu sira nia kolen. Hahuu hosi ida nebee ikus too ida nebee uluk.’
verses.9: No bainhira sira mai nebee hetan servisu iha tuku lima lokraik, ida-idak simu osan denáriu ida.
verses.10: Maibee bainhira ema uluk mai, sira hanoin katak sira sei simu liu fali. Maibee ida-idak simu mos osan denáriu ida.
verses.11: Simu tiha osan nee, sira murmura hasoru uma nain nee.
verses.12: Sira dehan, ‘Sira nebee ikus nee servisu oras ida deit no ita boot selu sira hanesan ami. Maibee ami servisu todan durante loron manas.’
verses.13: Maibee nia hataan ba ema ida hosi sira, no dehan, ‘Kolega, hau la halo sala ida ba o. Laos o konkorda ona ho hau atu hetan osan denáriu ida?
verses.14: Foti buat nebee o nian no baa deit. Hau sei foo ba ida ikus hanesan hau foo ba o.
verses.15: Laos hau iha direitu atu halo buat nebee hau hakarak ho hau nia riku-soin? O laran moras tanba hau mak diak ka?’
verses.16: Nunee sira nebee ikus sei sai uluk, no sira nebee uluk sei sai ikus.”
verses.17: Bainhira Jesus lao sae dadaun ba Jerusalém, Nia bolu eskolante nain sanulu resin rua ba sorin, iha dalan klaran nee, no dehan ba sira,
verses.18: “Tebes, ita sae ba Jerusalém. No ema sei entrega Ema Nia Oan ba xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira. Depois sira sei tesi lia atu foo kastigu mate ba Nia.
verses.19: Sira sei entrega Nia ba ema Jentiu sira. No ema Jentiu sira sei hakribi Nia, no baku Nia ho sikoti no oho Nia iha kruz. Depois, iha loron terseiru, Nia sei moris hias.”
verses.20: Depois Zebedeu nia oan mane sira nia inan mai hamutuk ho ninia oan mane sira, no hakneak iha Jesus nia oin hodi husu buat ida hosi Nia.
verses.21: Nia dehan ba feto nee, “O hakarak saida?” Feto dehan ba Nia, “Hau husu O bele dehan katak hau nia oan mane nain rua nee bele tuur iha O nia liman loos no O nia liman karuk iha O nia reinu.”
verses.22: Maibee Jesus hataan, “Imi la hatene buat nebee imi husu. Imi bele hemu hosi kopu nebee Hau atu hemu ka?” Sira dehan ba Nia, “Ami bele.”
verses.23: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi sei hemu duni hosi Hau nia kopu, maibee atu tuur iha Hau nia liman loos no iha Hau nia liman karuk, nee laos Hau nian atu foo. Tanba Hau nia Aman prepara fatin nee hodi foo ba ema tuir Ninia hakarak.”
verses.24: No bainhira sira nain sanulu rona kona ba buat nee, sira sai hirus ho sira nia maluk nain rua nee.
verses.25: Maibee Jesus bolu sira mai Nia, no dehan, “Imi hatene katak ema Jentiu sira nia xefi sira domina sira. No sira nia ema boot sira hanehan sira.
verses.26: Maibee imi keta halo hanesan nee. Ema nebee sai boot iha imi nia leet tenki serví imi.
verses.27: No nia nebee hakarak sai xefi iha imi nia leet, nia tenki sai imi nia atan.
verses.28: Tanba Ema Nia Oan mos mai laos atu ema serví Nia, maibee atu serví ema, no foo Ninia moris hodi hola fali ema barak.”
verses.29: Bainhira sira sai hosi Jerikó, ema lubun boot lao tuir Nia.
verses.30: No tebes, ema matan delek nain rua tuur iha dalan ninin. Bainhira sira rona katak Jesus lao liu, sira hakilar no dehan, “Hatudu laran luak mai ami, Oh Nai, Oan Mane hosi David!”
verses.31: No ema lubun boot siak sira, no haruka sira nonook lai. Maibee sira hakilar makaas liu tan no dehan, “Hatudu laran luak mai ami, Oh Nai, Oan Mane hosi David!”
verses.32: Jesus para, no bolu sira, no dehan, “Imi hakarak Hau halo saida ba imi?”
verses.33: Sira dehan ba Nia, “Nai, loke ami nia matan.”
verses.34: Jesus hanoin tebes sira ho Ninia fuan laran. Nia tau liman ba sira nia matan no sira haree kedas. No sira lao tuir Nia.

verses.1: Bainhira sira too iha Betfage, iha Foho Oliveira nebee besik ba Jerusalém, Jesus haruka eskolante nain rua,
verses.2: no Nia dehan ba sira, “Tama ba aldeia iha imi nia oin nebaa. Imi sei hetan kuda buru inan ida nebee kesi hela. Ita hetan mos kuda buru oan ho inan nee. Kore sira no lori mai Hau.
verses.3: No se ema dehan buat ruma ba imi, imi sei dehan, ‘Nai mak presiza sira.’ Nunee nia sei haruka kedas kuda buru sira nee.”
verses.4: Buat nee akontese atu kumpri liafuan nebee profeta koalia tiha ona bainhira nia dehan nanis ona,
verses.5: “Hatete ba Zion nia oan feto,
verses.6: Eskolante sira nee baa, no halo tuir Jesus nia orden ba sira.
verses.7: Sira lori mai kuda buru inan ho ninia oan. Sira tau sira nia ropa iha kuda buru nia leten no Jesus sae kuda buru nee.
verses.8: Depois ema barak hosi ema lubun boot nee nahe sira nia ropa iha dalan. Ema seluk taa ai sanak sira no tau iha dalan.
verses.9: No ema lubun boot nebee lao iha oin, no sira nebee tuir, hakilar, “Hosana ba Oan Mane hosi David! Bensaun ba Nia nebee mai hodi Nai nia naran! Hosana iha fatin aas liu!”
verses.10: No bainhira Nia tama Jerusalém, sidade tomak hakfodak no husu ba malu, “See mak nee?”
verses.11: No ema lubun boot dehan, “Nee mak Jesus, profeta hosi Nazaré, nebee hosi Galileia.”
verses.12: Jesus tama ba Templu, no Nia duni sai ema hotu nebee faan no sosa iha Templu. Nia baku fila meza sira nebee ema uza hodi troka osan no banku nebee ema uza hodi faan manu pombu sira.
verses.13: Nia dehan ba ema sira nee, “Sira hakerek nanis ona, ‘Ema sei hanaran Hau nia uma nudar uma orasaun nian.’ Maibee imi halo fatin nee sai fali naok-teen sira nia knuuk.”
verses.14: Ema matan delek no ema ain aat hakbesik ba Jesus iha Templu, no Nia kura sira.
verses.15: Bainhira xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira haree milagre sira nebee Jesus halo, ho tan labarik sira hakilar iha Templu, no dehan, “Hosana ba Oan Mane hosi David!” sira sai hirus.
verses.16: Sira dehan ba Nia, “O rona ona buat nebee labarik sira dehan ka lae?” Jesus dehan ba sira, “Sin; imi nunka lee liafuan nee ka:
verses.17: Depois Jesus husik sira, no Nia sai hosi sidade no tama ba Betánia. No Nia toba kalan iha nebaa.
verses.18: Iha dadeer-saan, bainhira Jesus fila fali ba sidade, Nia hamlaha.
verses.19: Nia haree ai figeira huun ida iha dalan ninin. Bainhira Nia too iha ai huun nee, Nia la hetan ai fuan ida, só tahan deit. Nia dehan ba ai nee, “O sei nunka foo fuan tan too rohan laek.” No ai figeira nee sai maran kedas.
verses.20: Bainhira eskolante sira haree ida nee, sira admira, no dehan, “Oinsaa ai figeira nee sai maran kedas?”
verses.21: Jesus hataan no dehan ba sira, “Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, se imi fiar, no laran ru-rua la iha, imi bele halo liu fali buat nebee Hau halo ona ba ai figeira nee. Imi bele mos dehan ba foho, ‘Hiit aan lai, no soe aan ba tasi laran.’ No ida nee sei akontese duni.
verses.22: Buat hotu nebee imi husu iha orasaun, no se imi fiar, imi sei simu.”
verses.23: Tuir mai, Jesus tama ba Templu. Bainhira Nia hanorin hela, xefi saserdote sira no katuas sira hosi povu nee mai hasoru Nia. Sira dehan, “Liu hosi kbiit ida nebee mak O halo buat sira nee? See mak foo kbiit nee ba O?”
verses.24: No Jesus hataan no dehan ba sira, “Hau mos sei husu imi pergunta ida. Se imi hataan mai Hau, nunee Hau sei foo hatene ba imi liu hosi kbiit ida nebee mak Hau halo buat sira nee.
verses.25: João nia batizmu mai hosi nebee? Hosi lalehan, ka hosi ema?” No sira koalia ba malu no dehan, “Se ita dehan, ‘Hosi lalehan,’ Nia sei dehan ba ita, ‘Tanba saa mak imi la fiar nia?’
verses.26: Maibee se ita dehan, ‘Hosi ema,’ ita tauk povu nee. Tanba ema hotu haree João nudar profeta ida.”
verses.27: Sira hataan ba Jesus, “Ami la hatene.” Nia dehan ba sira, “Nunee Hau sei la foo hatene ba imi liu hosi kbiit ida nebee mak Hau halo buat sira nee.”
verses.28: “Maibee imi hanoin nusaa? Mane ida iha oan mane nain rua. No nia koalia ba oan primeiru, no dehan, ‘Oan, ohin o baa servisu iha hau nia toos uvas.’
verses.29: No nia hataan, ‘Hau lakohi baa.’ Maibee tuir mai nia arepende, no nia baa.
verses.30: Depois aman nee koalia ba oan ida seluk, no dehan hanesan. No oan nee hataan, ‘Hau sei baa, senhor.’ Maibee nia la baa.
verses.31: Hosi oan mane nain rua nee, ida nebee mak halo tuir ninia aman nia hakarak?” Sira dehan ba Nia, “Ida primeiru.” Jesus dehan ba sira, “Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, katak kobradór impostu no feto luroon sira tama ba Maromak nia reinu uluk imi.
verses.32: Tanba João mai ba imi liu hosi dalan moris loos nian, no imi la fiar nia. Maibee kobradór impostu no feto luroon sira fiar nia. Maski imi haree ona ida nee, imi la arepende no la fiar nia.”
verses.33: Rona ai knanoik ida fali. Iha uma nain ida nebee kuda uvas iha toos ida, no nia halo lutu haleu toos nee. Nia kee rai kuak hodi halo fatin sama uvas nian no nia halo uma seguru ida. Nia foo aluga ba ema hodi servisu iha toos nee no nia baa rai dook ida.
verses.34: No bainhira tempu atu kuu uvas fuan besik ona, nia haruka ninia atan sira ba ema nebee servisu iha toos, hodi atan sira bele simu ninia uvas fuan nee.
verses.35: No ema nebee servisu iha toos foti ninia atan sira. Sira baku ida, oho ida no tuda fatuk ba ida fali.
verses.36: Toos nain haruka fali atan sira seluk, nebee liu fali grupu uluk. Maibee sira nebee servisu iha toos halo hanesan.
verses.37: Ikus liu, nia haruka ninia oan mane ba sira, no dehan, ‘Sira sei respeita hau nia oan mane.’
verses.38: Maibee bainhira ema nebee servisu iha toos haree oan mane nee, sira dehan ba malu, ‘Nia mak sei simu toos nudar liman rohan. Mai ita oho nia, no ita bele hadau ninia liman rohan hodi sai ita nian.’
verses.39: No sira kaer nia, no soe nia ba toos liur, no oho nia.
verses.40: Bainhira toos uvas nia nain mai, nia sei halo saida ba sira nebee servisu iha toos nee?”
verses.41: Sira dehan ba Jesus, “Nia sei halakon duni ema aat sira nee. No nia sei foo ninia toos uvas ba ema seluk hodi servisu iha toos nee, nebee sei foo ninia uvas fuan tuir tempu kuu nian.”
verses.42: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Imi nunka lee Eskritura nee ka?
verses.43: Nunee Hau dehan ba imi, Maromak sei foti Ninia reinu hosi imi, no foo ba povu ida nebee foo fali fuan.
verses.44: No see deit nebee monu ba fatuk nee sei rahun. Maibee bainhira fatuk nee monu ba ema ida, fatuk nee sei harahun nia too uut.”
verses.45: No bainhira xefi saserdote sira no Farizeu sira rona tiha Ninia ai knanoik sira nee, sira hatene katak Nia koalia kona ba sira.
verses.46: Maski sira hakarak kaer Nia, sira tauk ema lubun boot nee, tanba ema lubun boot nee haree Nia nudar profeta ida.

22.title: Ai Knanoik Kona Ba Festa Kazamentu

verses.1: Jesus koalia fali ba sira liu hosi ai knanoik sira. No Nia dehan,
verses.2: “Reinu lalehan mak hanesan liurai ida nebee halo festa kazamentu ba ninia oan mane.
verses.3: Nia haruka ninia atan sira atu bolu sira nebee nia konvida ona hodi mai ona kazamentu nee. Maibee sira lakohi mai.
verses.4: Entaun nia haruka atan sira seluk, no dehan, ‘Foo hatene ba sira nebee hau konvida ona nee, “Tebes, hau prepara ona hau nia festa nee: hau oho ona hau nia karau aman no karau oan sira nebee bokur, no buat hotu prontu ona. Mai festa kazamentu lai.”’
verses.5: Maibee sira lakohi hanoin ida nee. Sira halo tuir sira nia hakarak. Ida ba ninia toos no ida seluk ba ninia bisnis.
verses.6: Sira seluk nee kaer ninia atan sira. Sira hamoe no oho atan sira nee.
verses.7: Bainhira liurai rona ona, nia sai hirus tebes. Nia haruka ninia tropas sira no halakon oho door sira nee, no sunu sira nia sidade.
verses.8: Depois liurai dehan ba ninia atan sira, ‘Festa kazamentu nee prontu ona, maibee sira nebee hau konvida ona la merese atu mai.
verses.9: Nunee tama ba dalan boot nia kruzamentu. No see deit nebee imi hetan, bolu sira mai festa kazamentu nee.’
verses.10: Entaun atan sira nee tama ba dalan boot sira, no halibur ema hotu nebee sira hetan, inklui ema aat no ema diak. No fatin kazamentu nian sai nakonu ho bainaka sira.
verses.11: Bainhira liurai mai hodi haree bainaka sira, nia haree mane ida nebee la hatais ropa festa kazamentu nian.
verses.12: Nia dehan ba mane nee, ‘Kolega, oinsaa mak o tama mai iha nee no o la hatais ropa festa kazamentu nian?’ No mane nee nonook deit.
verses.13: Entaun liurai dehan ba atan sira, ‘Kesi ninia liman no ain, no lori nia sai, no soe nia ba liur iha fatin nakukun. Iha nebaa sira tanis no ruun nehan.’
verses.14: Tanba Nai bolu ema barak, maibee Nia hili uitoan deit.”
verses.15: Depois ema Farizeu sira baa no halo enkontru kona ba oinsaa sira bele lasu Jesus liu hosi Ninia liafuan.
verses.16: Sira haruka sira nia eskolante sira ho ema Herodes sira ba Nia. No sira dehan, “Mestri, ami hatene katak Ita Boot mak loos no Ita Boot hanorin Maromak nia dalan ho lia loos. No Ita Boot la tauk ema ida no la fihir ba ema nia oin.
verses.17: Nunee foo hatene mai ami, Ita Boot hanoin oinsaa? Ida nee loos atu foo osan impostu ba César ka lae?”
verses.18: Maibee Jesus hatene sira nia hahalok aat, no dehan, “Ema laran makerek sira, tanba saa mak imi koko Hau?
verses.19: Hatudu mai Hau osan impostu nian.” No sira lori osan denáriu ida ba Nia.
verses.20: Nia dehan ba sira, “Figura nee see nian no naran nee see nian?”
verses.21: Sira dehan ba Nia, “César nian.” Depois Nia dehan ba sira, “Nunee foo ba César buat nebee César nian, no foo ba Maromak buat nebee Maromak nian.”
verses.22: Bainhira sira rona tiha liafuan nee, sira admira. Sira husik Nia no baa deit.
verses.23: Iha loron nee mos, ema Saduseu sira nebee dehan ema la moris hias, baa hasoru Jesus. No sira husu Nia,
verses.24: “Mestri, Moisés dehan, ‘Se mane ida mate, no nia la iha oan, nunee ninia maun ka alin mane tenki kaben ho ninia feen, no hetan oan ba nia.’
verses.25: Agora, ami iha maun-alin nain hitu iha ami nia leet. Mane ba dala ida hola feto ida, depois nia mate. No tanba oan la iha, nia husik ninia feen ba ninia alin mane.
verses.26: Nee hanesan ho alin ba dala rua, no alin ba dala tolu too alin ba dala hitu.
verses.27: Ikus mai, feto nee mos mate.
verses.28: Entaun, iha tempu nebee ema moris hias ona, feto ida nee sei sai feen ba mane ida nebee hosi nain hitu nee? Tanba sira hotu hola nia.”
verses.29: Jesus hataan no dehan ba sira, “Imi halo sala, tanba imi la hatene Eskritura ka Maromak nia kbiit.
verses.30: Tanba bainhira sira moris hias ona, sira la kaben, no sira la foo feto atu kaben. Maibee sira sai hanesan anju sira iha lalehan.
verses.31: Maibee kona ba moris hias hosi mate: imi seidauk lee liafuan nebee Maromak dehan ona ba imi ka? Nia dehan,
verses.32: ‘Hau mak Abraão nia Maromak, no Isak nia Maromak, no Jacó nia Maromak.’?  Nia laos Maromak ba ema mate, maibee Maromak ba ema moris.”
verses.33: No bainhira ema lubun rona ona liafuan nee, sira hakfodak ho Ninia hanorin.
verses.34: Maibee bainhira ema Farizeu sira rona tiha katak Jesus halo ema Saduseu sira sai nonook, ema Farizeu sira nee halibur hamutuk.
verses.35: Depois ema ida hosi sira, nebee hatene Lei, husu pergunta ba Nia hodi koko Nia. Ema Farizeu nee dehan,
verses.36: “Mestri, ukun fuan ida nebee mak boot liu iha Lei?”
verses.37: Jesus dehan ba nia, “‘O sei hadomi Nai, o nia Maromak, ho o nia laran tomak, o nia klamar tomak, no o nia neon tomak.’
verses.38: Ida nee mak ukun fuan uluk liu no boot liu.
verses.39: No ida segundu mak hanesan ida nee, ‘O sei hadomi o nia maluk hanesan o nia aan rasik.’
verses.40: Lei no Profeta sira hotu nia huun mak ukun fuan rua nee.”
verses.41: Bainhira ema Farizeu sira halibur hamutuk hela, Jesus husu pergunta ida ba sira.
verses.42: Nia dehan, “Imi hanoin saida kona ba Kristu? Nia mak oan mane hosi see?” Sira dehan ba Nia, “Nia mak oan mane hosi David.”
verses.43: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Entaun oinsaa David, liu hosi Espíritu, bolu Kristu nee Nai. Tanba David dehan,
verses.44: ‘Nai dehan ba hau nia Nai,
verses.45: Se David rasik bolu Nia Nai, oinsaa mak Nia David nia oan mane?”
verses.46: La iha ema ida nebee bele koalia liafuan ida hodi hataan ba Jesus. No hosi loron nee kedas, la iha ema ida nebee brani atu husu tan pergunta ida ba Nia.

23.title: Susar Ba Ema Eskriba No Farizeu Sira

verses.1: Depois Jesus koalia ba ema lubun nee, no ba Ninia eskolante sira.
verses.2: Nia dehan, “Ema eskriba no Farizeu sira tuur iha Moisés nia kadeira.
verses.3: Nunee halo tuir buat hotu nebee sira hatete ba imi. Maibee keta halo tuir buat nebee sira halo. Tanba sira koalia maibee sira rasik la halo tuir.
verses.4: Tanba sira futu naha todan nebee susar atu lori hodi tau iha ema nia kabaas. Maibee sira rasik lakohi hiit naha nee ho liman fuan ida.
verses.5: Sira halo buat hotu atu ema bele haree sira. Sira halo boot sira nia kaixa reen toos nian, no halo naruk sira nia ropa ninin.
verses.6: Sira gosta tuur iha fatin importante iha festa sira no kadeira nebee diak liu iha sinagoga sira.
verses.7: Sira gosta simu kumprimentus iha merkadu. No sira hakarak ema bolu sira, ‘Rabi! Rabi!’
verses.8: Maibee keta husik ema bolu imi ‘Rabi’. Tanba imi iha Mestri ida, nebee Kristu, no imi hotu mak maun-alin.
verses.9: No keta bolu ema ida iha mundu imi nia aman. Tanba imi iha Aman ida deit, nebee iha lalehan.
verses.10: No keta husik ema bolu imi mestri. Tanba imi iha Mestri ida deit, nee mak Kristu.
verses.11: Maibee nia nebee boot liu iha imi nia leet tenki sai imi nia atan.
verses.12: No ema nebee foti aan, Maromak sei hatuun nia. No nia nebee haraik aan, Maromak sei foti sae nia.
verses.13: Maibee susar ba imi, eskriba no Farizeu sira, ema laran makerek! Tanba imi taka reinu lalehan iha ema nia oin. Imi rasik la tama no imi la husik ema seluk nebee hakarak tama atu tama ba.
verses.15: Susar ba imi, eskriba no Farizeu sira, ema laran makerek! Tanba imi hakur tasi no lao lemo rai hodi hetan sarani foun ida. No bainhira nia fiar ona, imi halo nia sai infernu nia oan, nebee aat liu fali imi ba dala rua. Ema Farizeu hanoin aan ho kaixa kiik iha reen toos
verses.16: Susar ba imi, matadalan sira nebee matan delek! Imi dehan, ‘Se ema ruma jura hodi Templu, nee la buat ida; maibee se ema ruma jura hodi osan mean iha Templu, nia tenki kumpri duni.’
verses.17: Beik-teen sira nebee matan delek! Tanba saida mak importante liu, osan mean ka Templu nebee halo santu osan mean nee?
verses.18: No imi dehan, ‘Ema ruma nebee jura hodi altár, nee la buat ida; maibee ema ruma nebee jura liu hosi oferta nebee iha leten, nia tenki kumpri duni.’
verses.19: Beik-teen sira nebee matan delek! Tanba saida mak importante liu, oferta ka altár nebee halo santu oferta nee?
verses.20: Nunee ema nebee jura hodi altár, nia jura hodi altár no hodi buat hotu nebee iha altár leten nee.
verses.21: No ema nebee jura hodi Templu, nia jura hodi Templu no hodi Nia nebee hela iha Templu laran nee.
verses.22: No ema nebee jura hodi lalehan, nia jura hodi Maromak nia kadunan, no hodi Nia nebee tuur iha kadunan leten nee.
verses.23: Susar ba imi, eskriba no Farizeu sira, ema laran makerek! Tanba imi foo porsentu sanulu hosi ruku, endru no kominhu, maibee imi haluha buat todan liu hosi Lei, hanesan justisa, laran luak no fidelidade. Lo-loos imi tenki halo tuir buat importante nee no la husik buat seluk nee.
verses.24: Matadalan sira nebee matan delek! Imi taes susuk ida maibee imi tolan kuda kamelu ida!
verses.25: Susar ba imi, eskriba no Farizeu sira, ema laran makerek! Tanba imi hamoos kopu no bikan nia liur, maibee iha laran sira nakonu ho hahalok kaan-teen no la kontrola aan.
verses.26: Farizeu sira nebee matan delek! Hamoos uluk kopu no bikan nia laran, atu nunee iha liur mos bele sai moos.
verses.27: Susar ba imi, eskriba no Farizeu sira, ema laran makerek! Tanba imi hanesan rate nebee pinta mutin. Maski iha liur haree furak, maibee iha laran sira nakonu ho mate ruin no buat nebee la moos.
verses.28: Hanesan nee mos, ema haree imi hanesan ema moris loos iha liur, maibee iha laran imi nakonu ho laran makerek no hahalok aat.
verses.29: Susar ba imi, eskriba no Farizeu sira, ema laran makerek! Tanba imi hada rate ba profeta sira, no hafurak osuáriu ba ema moris loos,
verses.30: no imi dehan, ‘Se ami moris iha ami nia bei-ala sira nia tempu, ami se la hola parte ho sira iha sala nebee fakar profeta sira nia raan.’
verses.31: Nunee imi sai sasin hasoru imi nia aan rasik. Tanba imi mak oan hosi ema sira nebee oho profeta sira.
verses.32: Entaun halo too hotu, tuir imi nia bei-ala sira.
verses.33: Oh samea sira, no samea nia oan sira. Oinsaa imi bele halai sees hosi kastigu infernu nian?
verses.34: Nunee tebes, Hau haruka profeta sira, ema matenek klean sira no eskriba sira ba imi. No ema balu nee imi sei oho no prega ba krús. Ema balu nee imi sei baku ho sikoti iha imi nia sinagoga sira. No imi sei hanehan sira hosi sidade ba sidade.
verses.35: Nunee imi sei lori todan hosi ema moris loos hotu nia raan nebee fakar ona iha mundu - hosi ema moris loos Abel nia raan too iha Zakarias, oan mane hosi Barakias, nebee imi oho iha Templu no altár nia klaran.
verses.36: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, buat sira nee hotu sei kona jerasaun nee.
verses.37: Oh Jerusalém, Jerusalém, sidade nebee oho profeta sira, no tuda mate ho fatuk ema sira nebee Maromak haruka ba o! Dala hira ona mak Hau hakarak halibur hamutuk o nia oan sira hanesan manu inan halibur ninia oan sira iha ninia liras okos. Maibee o lakohi!
verses.38: Tebes, o nia uma sei sai mamuk.
verses.39: Tanba Hau dehan ba imi, katak imi sei la haree fali Hau, too imi dehan, ‘Bensaun ba Nia nebee mai hodi Nai nia naran.’”

verses.1: Bainhira Jesus sai dadaun hosi Templu, Ninia eskolante sira hakbesik Nia hodi hatudu Templu nia uma sira ba Nia.
verses.2: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Imi haree buat sira nee hotu ka? Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, aban-bainrua la iha fatuk ida nebee hela iha fatuk seluk nia leten. Ema sei sobu hotu.”
verses.3: Bainhira Nia tuur iha Foho Oliveira no ema seluk la iha, eskolante sira hakbesik ba Nia no husu, “Foo hatene mai ami, bainhira mak buat sira nee sei akontese? No sinál saida mak hatudu katak O atu mai fali, no hatudu mundu nia rohan?”
verses.4: Jesus hataan no dehan ba sira, “Kuidadu katak ema la lohi imi.
verses.5: Tanba ema barak sei mai hodi Hau nia naran, no dehan, ‘Hau mak Kristu,’ no sira sei lohi ema barak.
verses.6: Imi sei rona kona ba funu sira, no lia anin kona ba funu sira. Kuidadu katak imi la sai tauk. Tanba buat hotu nee tenki akontese, maibee tempu rohan seidauk too.
verses.7: Tanba nasaun ida sei hamriik hasoru nasaun seluk, no reinu ida sei hasoru reinu seluk. Rai hamlaha no rai nakdoko sei akontese iha fatin oi-oin.
verses.8: Buat hotu nee hatudu katak tempu susar foin hahuu.
verses.9: Depois sira sei entrega imi ba terus, no sira sei oho imi. No nasaun hotu sei odi imi tanba Hau nia naran.
verses.10: Ema barak sei monu ba sala. Sira sei faan malu no odi malu.
verses.11: Profeta falsu barak sei mosu, no sira sei lohi ema barak.
verses.12: Ema barak nia domin sei sai malirin tanba hahalok aat nebee aumenta ba beibeik.
verses.13: Maibee ema nebee tahan too rohan sei hetan salvasaun.
verses.14: Ema sei haklaken evanjelhu kona ba reinu iha mundu tomak nudar testemunha ba nasaun sira hotu. Depois mundu nia rohan sei mai.
verses.15: Nunee bainhira imi haree buat foer liu nebee estraga, nebee profeta Daniel foo sai nanis ona, nebee hamriik iha Fatin Santu (husik nia nebee lee bele kompriende),
verses.16: iha tempu nebaa, husik sira nebee iha Judeia halai ba foho.
verses.17: Ema nebee iha uma leten keta tuun hodi foti sasaan hosi ninia uma.
verses.18: Ema nebee iha toos laran keta fila fali hodi foti ninia ropa.
verses.19: Susar ba feto sira nebee isin rua, no ba sira nebee sei foo susu iha tempu nebaa!
verses.20: Halo orasaun katak imi la presiza halai iha tempu malirin ka loron Sabdu.
verses.21: Tanba iha tempu nebaa terus makaas sei mosu mai. Terus hanesan nee seidauk akontese dezde mundu hahuu, no sei la akontese fali iha tempu tuir mai.
verses.22: Se karik Maromak la halo badak tempu nee, la iha ema ida nebee bele hetan salvasaun. Maibee Nia sei halo badak tempu nee tanba sira nebee Nia hili tiha ona.
verses.23: Entaun se karik ema ida dehan ba imi, ‘Tebes, Kristu mak nee!’ ka ‘Nia iha nebaa!’ imi keta fiar.
verses.24: Tanba kristu falsu no profeta falsu sira sei mosu mai. Sira sei hatudu sinál boot no milagre sira, no koko, se bele karik, atu lohi mos ema nebee Maromak hili ona.
verses.25: Tebes, Hau foo hatene nanis ona ba imi.
verses.26: Entaun se sira dehan ba imi, ‘Tebes, Nia iha rai fuik maran,’ imi keta baa; ka se sira dehan ‘Tebes, Nia iha kuartu laran,’ imi keta fiar.
verses.27: Tanba hanesan rai lakan mosu mai hosi parte lorosae, no nabilan too iha parte loromonu, nunee mos bainhira Ema Nia Oan mai.
verses.28: Tanba iha fatin nebee iha mate isin, iha nebaa mos manu makikit sei halibur hamutuk.
verses.29: “Bainhira tempu terus nee foin liu tiha, loro matan sei sai nakukun, no fulan sei la foo ninia naroman, no fitun sira sei monu hosi lalehan, no kbiit iha lalehan sira sei nakdoko.
verses.30: Depois Ema Nia Oan nia sinál sei mosu iha lalehan. No nasaun hotu iha mundu sei tanis halerik. No sira sei haree Ema Nia Oan mai hosi lalehan iha kalohan nia leten ho kbiit no glória boot.
verses.31: Nia sei haruka Ninia anju sira ho trombeta nia lian makaas. No sira sei halibur hamutuk ema nebee Nia hili tiha ona hosi fatin hotu, hosi lalehan nia rohan ida too lalehan nia rohan seluk.
verses.32: Aprende lai kona ba ai knanoik ida hosi ai figeira nee: bainhira ninia sanak foin nurak, no tahan sira foin dikin, imi hatene katak tempu bailoron besik ona.
verses.33: Nunee mos, bainhira imi haree buat hotu nee, imi bele hatene katak Nia besik ona, no too ona iha portaun.
verses.34: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, jerasaun nee sei la lakon, too buat hotu nee akontese ona.
verses.35: Lalehan no mundu sei lakon, maibee Hau nia liafuan sei nunka lakon.
verses.36: “Maibee la iha ema ida nebee hatene loron ka oras nee, inklui mos anju sira iha lalehan no Ema Nia Oan. Só Aman deit mak hatene.
verses.37: Maibee hanesan iha Noé nia tempu, nunee mos ho tempu nebee Ema Nia Oan sei mai.
verses.38: Tanba iha tempu molok rai nabeen nee sira haan hemu, sira kaben no foo kaben, too loron nebee Noé tama ba roo boot laran.
verses.39: Sira la hatene too rai nabeen mai ona no halakon sira hotu. Hanesan nee mos ho tempu nebee Ema Nia Oan sei mai.
verses.40: Mane nain rua sei iha rai luan, no Maromak sei lori ida no husik ida seluk.
verses.41: Feto nain rua sei fai batar, no Maromak sei lori ida no husik ida seluk.
verses.42: Nunee matan moris ba, tanba imi la hatene oras nebee imi nia Nai sei mai.
verses.43: Maibee hatene ida nee: se uma nain hatene oras ida nebee naok-teen atu mai, nia sei hein hodi haree no la husik naok-teen tama ninia uma.
verses.44: Nunee imi mos tenki prontu. Tanba Ema Nia Oan sei mai iha oras nebee imi la hanoin.
verses.45: Se mak atan fiel ho matenek klean, nebee ninia nai hili hodi tau matan ba nai nia uma kain, no foo hahaan ba atan sira iha tempu loos?
verses.46: Haksolok ba atan nee, nebee ninia nai mai fali no hetan nia halo hela servisu nee.
verses.47: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, katak nai sei foo knaar ba atan nee hodi tau matan ba ninia sasaan hotu.
verses.48: Maibee se atan aat nee dehan iha ninia fuan laran, ‘Hau nia nai sei mai tardi,’
verses.49: no nia komesa baku ninia maluk atan seluk nee, no nia haan hemu ho lanu-teen sira,
verses.50: entaun atan nee nia nai sei mai iha loron nebee atan nee la hein, no iha oras ida nebee atan nee la hatene.
verses.51: No ninia nai sei foo kastigu todan ba nia, no tau nia iha fatin hamutuk ho ema laran makerek sira. Iha nebaa sira sei tanis no ruun nehan.

verses.1: “Reinu lalehan mak hanesan feto raan nain sanulu nebee foti sira nia ahi oan, no baa atu hasoru noivu ida.
verses.2: Feto raan nain lima beik no nain lima seluk matenek.
verses.3: Bainhira feto sira nebee beik lori sira nia ahi oan, sira la lori mina.
verses.4: Maibee sira nebee matenek lori mina iha botir ho sira nia ahi oan.
verses.5: Bainhira noivu demora, sira hotu matan dukur no toba.
verses.6: Iha kalan boot, ema hakilar, ‘Tebes, noivu mai ona! Mai hasoru nia.’
verses.7: Depois feto raan sira nee hotu hadeer no prepara sira nia ahi oan.
verses.8: No feto sira nebee beik dehan ba sira nebee matenek, ‘Foo imi nia mina balu mai ami, tanba ami nia ahi oan besik atu mate.’
verses.9: Maibee feto raan matenek hataan, ‘La bele, tanba karik ami nia mina la too ba ami no imi. Baa deit no sosa imi nian hosi sira nebee faan mina.’
verses.10: No bainhira sira sei baa hela hodi sosa, noivu too mai. No sira nebee prontu ona tama hamutuk ho noivu ba festa kazamentu nian. No ema taka tiha odamatan.
verses.11: Tuir mai feto raan sira seluk mai no dehan, ‘Nai, nai, loke odamatan mai ami.’
verses.12: Maibee nia hataan, ‘Tebes hau dehan ba imi katak hau la konhese imi.’
verses.13: Nunee matan moris ba, tanba imi la hatene loron ka oras nebee Ema Nia Oan atu mai.
verses.14: Tanba reinu lalehan mak hanesan ema ida nebee atu halo viajen ba rai dook. Nia bolu ninia atan sira no foo riku-soin ba sira hodi tau matan.
verses.15: Nia foo osan talentu lima ba atan ida, no talentu rua ba atan ida no talentu ida ba atan ida fali. Nia foo ba ida-idak tuir sira nia kbiit. Depois nia baa halo ninia viajen.
verses.16: Atan ida nebee simu talentu lima baa kedas no halo negósiu ho osan nee no nia manaan talentu lima tan.
verses.17: No mos nia nebee simu talentu rua manaan talentu rua tan.
verses.18: Maibee nia nebee simu talentu ida baa kee rai. No nia subar ninia nai nia osan mutin.
verses.19: Liu tiha tempu kleur, atan sira nee nia nai mai fali hodi husu kona ba osan nee.
verses.20: Atan nebee uluk simu talentu lima mai no nia lori talentu lima tan. Nia dehan, ‘Nai, ita boot foo talentu lima mai hau. Haree ba, hau manaan talentu lima tan.’
verses.21: Ninia nai nee dehan ba nia, ‘O halo diak! O mak atan diak no fiel. No tanba o hatudu fidelidade ho buat uitoan, hau sei foo knaar ba o kona ba buat barak. Tama ba o nia nai nia haksolok.’
verses.22: No mos nia nebee simu talentu rua mai no dehan, ‘Nai, ita boot foo talentu rua mai hau. Haree ba, hau manaan talentu rua tan.’
verses.23: Ninia nai nee dehan ba nia, ‘O halo diak! O mak atan diak no fiel. No tanba o hatudu fidelidade ho buat uitoan, hau sei foo knaar ba o kona ba buat barak. Tama ba o nia nai nia haksolok.’
verses.24: Depois nia nebee simu talentu ida mai no dehan, ‘Nai, hau hatene katak ita boot mak ema siak. Ita boot koa iha fatin nebee ita boot la kuda. No ita boot halibur iha fatin nebee ita boot la haliri.
verses.25: Tanba nee hau sai tauk, no hau baa no subar ita boot nia talentu iha rai kuak. Haree ba, iha nee mak buat nebee ita boot nian.’
verses.26: Ninia nai hataan no dehan ba nia, ‘O mak atan aat no baruk! O hatene ka, katak hau koa iha fatin nebee hau la kuda, no hau halibur iha fatin nebee hau la haliri?
verses.27: Entaun diak liu o rai hau nia osan iha banku, no bainhira hau fila fali mai, hau bele simu hau nia osan ho funan.
verses.28: Nunee foti talentu ida nee hosi nia, no foo ba atan nebee iha talentu sanulu.
verses.29: Tanba ba ema hotu nebee iha, hau sei foo tan, no nia sei hetan barak loos. Maibee hosi nia nebee la iha, hau sei foti buat uitoan nebee nia iha.
verses.30: No soe atan folin laek nee ba liur nebee nakukun tebes. Iha nebaa sira sei tanis no ruun nehan.’
verses.31: Bainhira Ema Nia Oan mai iha Ninia glória, hamutuk ho anju santu sira hotu, Nia sei tuur iha Ninia kadunan glória nian.
verses.32: Nasaun hotu sei halibur iha Ninia oin. Depois Nia sei haketak ema ida-idak, hanesan bibi atan haketak ninia bibi malae hosi bibi timor.
verses.33: Nia sei tau bibi malae iha Ninia liman loos, maibee Nia sei tau bibi timor iha Ninia liman karuk.
verses.34: Depois Liurai nee sei dehan ba sira nebee iha Ninia liman loos, ‘Mai, imi nebee simu ona bensaun hosi Hau nia Aman. Simu reinu nee nudar liman rohan nebee Nia prepara ona hosi mundu hahuu.
verses.35: Tanba bainhira Hau hamlaha, imi foo hahaan mai Hau. Bainhira Hau hamrook, imi foo hemu mai Hau. Bainhira Hau mak estranjeiru, imi simu Hau.
verses.36: Bainhira Hau isin molik, imi foo hatais Hau. Bainhira Hau moras, imi mai vizita Hau. Bainhira Hau iha komarka laran, imi mai haree Hau.’
verses.37: Depois ema moris loos sei hataan ba Nia, no sira dehan, ‘Nai, hori bainhira mak ami haree O hamlaha, no ami foo haan ba O; ka hamrook, no ami foo hemu ba O?
verses.38: Hori bainhira mak ami haree O nudar estranjeiru, no ami simu O; ka isin molik, no hatais O?
verses.39: No hori bainhira mak ami haree O moras, ka iha komarka laran, no ami baa vizita O?’
verses.40: No Liurai sei hataan no dehan ba sira, ‘Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, hanesan imi halo buat sira nee ba Hau nia alin kiik liu, imi halo mai Hau rasik.’
verses.41: Depois Nia sei dehan ba sira nebee iha liman karuk, ‘Sai tiha hosi Hau, imi nebee hetan malisan! Tama ba ahi rohan laek, nebee prepara ona ba diabu no ninia anju sira.
verses.42: Tanba Hau hamlaha, no imi la foo haan mai Hau. Hau hamrook, no imi la foo hemu mai Hau.
verses.43: Hau mak estranjeiru, no imi la simu Hau. Hau isin molik, no imi la foo hatais Hau. Hau moras no iha komarka laran, no imi la mai vizita Hau.’
verses.44: Depois sira sei hataan ba Nia, no dehan, ‘Nai, hori bainhira mak ami haree O hamlaha, ka hamrook, ka estranjeiru, ka isin molik, ka moras, ka iha komarka laran, no ami la ajuda O?’
verses.45: No Nia sei hataan ba sira, no dehan, ‘Tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, hanesan imi la halo ba Hau nia alin kiik liu nee, imi la halo mai Hau.’
verses.46: No ema sira nee sei sai hosi fatin nee no tama ba kastigu rohan laek. Maibee ema moris loos sei tama ba moris rohan laek.”

verses.1: Tuir mai, bainhira Jesus foo sai liafuan hotu nee, Nia dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira,
verses.2: “Imi hatene katak iha loron rua tan ita selebra Festa Páskua. No ema sei entrega Ema Nia Oan ba sira nebee prega Nia ba krús.”
verses.3: Depois xefi saserdote sira halibur hamutuk ho katuas sira hosi povu nee. Sira hasoru malu iha xefi saserdote boot Kaifas nia palásiu.
verses.4: Sira halo planu atu kaer Jesus sub-subar no oho Nia.
verses.5: Maibee sira dehan, “La bele halo ida nee iha loron festa nian, hodi povu la sai hirus.”
verses.6: Bainhira Jesus baa iha Betánia, iha Simão nebee ema moras lepra nia uma,
verses.7: feto ida hakbesik ba Nia ho botir alabastro nebee iha mina morin ho folin boot. Feto nee fui mina iha Jesus nia ulun bainhira Nia tuur haan hela.
verses.8: Bainhira Ninia eskolante sira haree ida nee, sira sai hirus, no dehan, “Tanba saa mak estraga deit mina?
verses.9: Ita bele faan mina morin nee hodi hetan osan boot no foo ba ema kiak.”
verses.10: Jesus hatene sira nia liafuan nee, no Nia dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi halo susar ba feto nee? Nia halo buat diak mai Hau.
verses.11: Imi sempre iha ema kiak iha imi nia leet, maibee imi sei la iha Hau nafatin.
verses.12: Tanba nia fui mina morin ba Hau nia isin, hodi prepara Hau ba rate.
verses.13: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, iha fatin naran deit iha mundu tomak nebee ema haklaken evanjelhu nee, sira mos konta buat nebee feto nee halo ona hodi hanoin fali nia.”
verses.14: Depois eskolante ida, naran Judas Iskariotes, hosi sira nain sanulu resin rua, baa hasoru xefi saserdote sira.
verses.15: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi sei foo saida mai hau hodi hau entrega Jesus ba imi?” No sira sura osan mutin tolu-nulu ba nia.
verses.16: Hahuu hosi tempu nee, nia buka oportunidade atu faan Jesus ba sira.
verses.17: Iha loron primeiru iha Festa Paun Fermentu Laek, eskolante sira husu ba Jesus, “O hakarak ami prepara fatin iha nebee hodi O bele haan Páskua?”
verses.18: No Nia dehan, “Tama ba sidade no imi sei hasoru mane ida. Dehan ba nia, ‘Mestri dehan, Hau nia tempu besik ona. Hau sei selebra Páskua iha o nia uma ho Hau nia eskolante sira.’”
verses.19: Depois eskolante sira halo tuir Jesus nia orden ba sira. No sira prepara Páskua.
verses.20: Bainhira kalan ona, Jesus tuur iha meza hamutuk ho sira nain sanulu resin rua nee.
verses.21: No bainhira sira haan hela, Nia dehan, “Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, katak ema ida hosi imi sei faan Hau.”
verses.22: Sira sai tristi tebe-tebes, no ida-idak komesa husu Nia, “Nai, laos hau ka?”
verses.23: No Nia hataan dehan, “Ema nebee hatama ninia liman iha bikan hamutuk ho Hau, nia mak sei faan Hau.
verses.24: Ema Nia Oan sei baa tuir liafuan nebee sira hakerek nanis ona kona ba Nia. Maibee susar ba ema ida nebee faan Ema Nia Oan! Diak liu ba ema ida nee se nia la moris mai.”
verses.25: Depois Judas, nebee sei faan Nia, hataan dehan, “Rabi, laos hau ka?” Nia hataan ba Judas, “O rasik mak dehan nunee.”
verses.26: Bainhira sira haan hela, Jesus foti paun no Nia foo bensaun. Depois Nia silu paun nee no foo ba eskolante sira. Nia dehan, “Simu no haan ba. Nee mak Hau nia isin.”
verses.27: Depois Nia foti kopu ida no foo agradese. Depois Nia foo kopu nee ba sira no dehan, “Imi hotu, hemu ba.
verses.28: Tanba nee mak Hau nia raan aliansa nian, nebee fakar hodi ema barak bele hetan perdua ba sala.
verses.29: Hau dehan ba imi, Hau sei la hemu tan hosi uvas fuan nee too loron nebee Hau hemu fali ho imi iha Hau nia Aman nia reinu.”
verses.30: Bainhira sira hananu tiha knananuk ida, sira sai ba Foho Oliveira.
verses.31: Depois Jesus dehan ba sira, “Imi hotu sei monu iha kalan ida nee tanba Hau. Tanba ema hakerek nanis ona, ‘Hau sei baku bibi atan, no bibi sira sei halai namkari.’
verses.32: Maibee bainhira Hau moris hias ona, Hau sei baa Galileia uluk liu imi.”
verses.33: Pedro hataan ba Nia, “Maski ema hotu monu tanba O, hau sei nunka monu.”
verses.34: Jesus dehan ba Pedro, “Tebes Hau dehan ba o, katak iha kalan nee, molok manu kokoreek, o sei nega Hau dala tolu.”
verses.35: Pedro dehan ba Nia, “Maski hau tenki mate ho O, hau sei nunka nega O.” No eskolante sira hotu dehan hanesan.
verses.36: Depois Jesus tama fatin ida naran Getsemani ho Ninia eskolante sira. No Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi tuur iha nee, no Hau sei baa halo orasaun iha nebaa.”
verses.37: Nia lori Pedro ho Zebedeu nia oan mane nain rua, no Nia hahuu sai tristi tebes no laran susar.
verses.38: Depois Nia dehan ba sira, “Hau nia laran tristi tebe-tebes, too atu mate. Hein iha nee, no hadeer nafatin ho Hau.”
verses.39: Nia baa tan uitoan, no Nia monu taka oin ba rai. Nia halo orasaun no dehan, “Oh Hau nia Aman, se bele karik, hasai tiha kopu nee hosi Hau. Maibee laos tuir Hau nia hakarak, maibee tuir O nia hakarak.”
verses.40: Depois Nia fila ba eskolante sira, no Nia hetan sira toba dukur hela. Nia dehan ba Pedro, “Nusaa, imi la bele hadeer ho Hau too oras ida deit ka?
verses.41: Matan moris ba no halo orasaun nafatin, hodi imi la monu ba tentasaun. Espíritu hakarak, maibee isin fraku.”
verses.42: Ba dala rua, Nia hadook aan no halo orasaun, “Oh Hau nia Aman, se karik la bele hasai kopu nee hosi Hau no Hau tenki hemu, entaun halo tuir O nia hakarak.”
verses.43: No Nia fila fali mai no hetan sira toba dukur fali. Tanba sira nia matan dukur loos.
verses.44: Nia husik sira, no hadook aan fali. Nia halo orasaun ba dala tolu, no koalia liafuan hanesan uluk nee.
verses.45: Tuir mai, Nia fila fali ba Ninia eskolante sira, no dehan ba sira, “Imi toba dukur no deskansa hela ka? Tebes, oras too ona, no ema atu faan Ema Nia Oan ba sala nain sira nia liman.
verses.46: Hamriik ba, no husik ita baa lai. Tebes, Hau nia traidór besik mai ona.”
verses.47: Bainhira Jesus koalia dadaun, Judas, nebee hosi sira nain sanulu resin rua, too mai. Nia mai ho ema lubun boot nebee lori surik no ai dona. Sira mai hosi xefi saserdote sira no povu nia katuas sira.
verses.48: Ema nebee atu faan Jesus foo ona sinál ida no dehan, “Ema ida nebee hau sei rei, Nia mak nee. Kaer Nia ba.”
verses.49: Nia hakbesik kedas ba Jesus, no dehan, “Salóm, Rabi!” No nia rei Jesus.
verses.50: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Belun, o mai hodi halo nunee ka?” Depois sira mai, kaer Jesus no foti Nia.
verses.51: No tebes, ema ida hosi sira nebee hamutuk ho Jesus lolo liman, losu nia surik, no taa saserdote boot nia atan no tesi sai atan nee nia tilun.
verses.52: Depois Jesus dehan ba nia, “Hatama fali o nia surik iha ninia fatin. Tanba ema hotu nebee kaer surik sei mate liu hosi surik.
verses.53: Ita hanoin katak Hau la bele halo orasaun ba Hau nia Aman, no Nia sei haruka kedas anju batalhaun sanulu resin rua ka?
verses.54: Maibee oinsaa kumpri Eskritura sira nebee dehan katak buat nee sei akontese?”
verses.55: Iha tempu nee, Jesus dehan ba ema lubun sira nee, “Imi sai mai atu hasoru naok-teen ka? Tanba nee imi mai ho surik no ai dona sira hodi kaer Hau ka? Hau tuur hanorin loro-loron ho imi iha Templu, no imi la kaer Hau.
verses.56: Maibee buat hotu nee akontese, hodi kumpri Eskritura hosi profeta sira.” Depois eskolante sira hotu husik Nia no halai lakon.
verses.57: No sira nebee kaer Jesus lori Nia ba saserdote boot Kaifas, iha fatin nebee ema eskriba no katuas sira halibur hamutuk ona.
verses.58: Maibee Pedro tuir Nia hosi dook too iha saserdote boot nia pátiu. Nia tama ba no tuur ho atan sira hodi haree oinsaa ida nee remata.
verses.59: Xefi saserdote sira, katuas sira no tribunál tomak buka sasin falsu atu hasoru Jesus hodi kastigu mate Nia.
verses.60: Maski sasin falsu barak mai, sira la hetan ida. Ikus mai, sasin nain rua mai
verses.61: nebee dehan, “Ema ida nee dehan, ‘Hau bele sobu Maromak nia Templu no harii fali iha loron tolu nia laran.’”
verses.62: Saserdote boot hamriik, no dehan ba Nia, “O la hataan buat ida ka? Saida mak nee, nebee sasin sira nee foo sai hasoru O?”
verses.63: Maibee Jesus nonook hela deit. Saserdote boot hataan no dehan ba Nia, “Hau haruka O jura hodi Maromak nebee moris, foo hatene mai ami se O mak Kristu, Maromak nia Oan, ka lae?”
verses.64: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Ita rasik mak hatete nunee. Maibee Hau dehan ba imi, hosi agora ba oin, imi sei haree Ema Nia Oan tuur iha Kbiit Nain nia liman loos, no Nia sei mai hosi lalehan iha kalohan leten.”
verses.65: Nunee saserdote boot lees ninia ropa, no dehan, “Nia koalia aat hasoru Maromak! Tanba saa mak ita presiza sasin tan? Tebes, agora imi rona ona katak Nia rasik koalia aat hasoru Maromak.
verses.66: Imi hanoin oinsaa?” Sira hataan, “Nia merese atu simu kastigu mate.”
verses.67: Depois sira tafui kabeen iha Ninia oin no tuku Nia. Ema balu basa Nia,
verses.68: no dehan, “Profesia ba ami, Oh Kristu, see mak tuku O?”
verses.69: Pedro tuur hela iha liur nebee iha pátiu. No atan feto ida hakbesik ba nia no dehan, “Ita mos hamutuk ho Jesus hosi Galileia nee.”
verses.70: Maibee nia nega liafuan nee iha sira hotu nia oin, no dehan, “Hau la hatene o koalia kona ba saida!”
verses.71: No bainhira nia sai ba portaun, atan feto seluk haree nia, no dehan ba sira nebee besik, “Ema ida nee mos hamutuk ho Jesus hosi Nazaré nee.”
verses.72: Nia nega fali ho juramentu ida, “Hau la konhese mane nee!”
verses.73: Tuir mai, ema sira nebee hamriik iha nebaa dehan ba Pedro, “Tebes ita mos ema ida hosi sira, tanba ita hatudu aan liu hosi ita nia lian.”
verses.74: Depois nia komesa koalia aat no jura, “Hau la konhese mane nee!” Iha momentu nee kedas, manu kokoreek.
verses.75: Pedro hanoin hetan fali liafuan hosi Jesus, nebee dehan ba nia, “Molok manu kokoreek, o sei nega Hau dala tolu.” No nia sai ba liur no tanis ho tristi makaas.

verses.1: Bainhira dadeer ona, xefi saserdote sira hotu no povu nia katuas sira hotu koalia hamutuk hodi foo kastigu mate ba Jesus.
verses.2: No bainhira sira kesi tiha Nia, sira lori Nia sai, no entrega Nia ba governadór Pilatos.
verses.3: Bainhira Judas, nebee faan ona Jesus, haree katak sira kondena Jesus, nia arepende. Nia lori fali osan mutin tolu-nulu nee ba xefi saserdote no katuas sira.
verses.4: Nia dehan, “Hau halo sala tanba hau faan raan inosenti.” No sira dehan, “Saida mak nee ba ami? Ida nee mak o nia problema.”
verses.5: Entaun nia soe osan mutin nee ba Templu laran, no sai ba. Depois nia baa tara aan.
verses.6: Xefi saserdote sira foti osan mutin nee, no sira dehan, “Tuir lei, ita la bele hatama osan nee ba tezourária tanba osan nee mak folin raan nian.”
verses.7: Sira koalia hamutuk, no uza osan nee hodi sosa toos hosi badaen rai mean hodi hakoi ema estranjeiru iha nebaa.
verses.8: Nunee ema hanaran toos nee Toos Raan Nian too ohin loron.
verses.9: Ida nee kumpri liafuan hosi profeta Jeremias, nebee dehan nanis ona, “Sira foti osan mutin tolu-nulu. Nee mak Ninia folin, nebee ema Israel desidi ona kona ba Nia.
verses.10: No sira foo osan nee hodi sosa rai hosi badaen rai mean, tuir Nai nia orden ba hau.”
verses.11: Jesus hamriik iha governadór nia oin. Governadór nee husu Nia, “O mak ema Judeu nia liurai ka?” Jesus dehan ba nia, “Ita rasik mak hatete nunee.”
verses.12: Bainhira xefi saserdote no katuas sira akuza Jesus, Nia la hataan buat ida.
verses.13: Entaun Pilatos dehan ba Nia, “O la rona liafuan barak nebee sira koalia hasoru O ka?”
verses.14: Nia la hataan no la koalia liafuan ida ba Pilatos. Nunee governadór admira.
verses.15: Baibain iha festa nee, governadór husik ema ida sai hosi kastigu ba ema lubun. Nia husik ema ida nebee sira hili.
verses.16: No sira iha ema dadur ida, naran Barabás, nebee naran boot.
verses.17: Nunee bainhira sira halibur hamutuk, Pilatos husu ba sira, “Imi hakarak hau husik ida nebee ba imi? Barabás ka Jesus nebee ema bolu Kristu?”
verses.18: Pilatos hatene katak sira entrega Jesus ba nia tanba sira laran moras.
verses.19: Liu tan nee, bainhira Pilatos tuur iha kadeira tesi lia nian, ninia feen haruka lia menon ba nia, “Keta halo buat ida ba Ema Loos nee. Tanba ohin hau hetan terus boot tebes tanba mehi ida kona ba Nia.”
verses.20: Maibee xefi saserdote sira no katuas sira soran ema lubun boot hodi husu Barabás no halakon Jesus.
verses.21: Governadór dehan ba sira, “Hosi ema nain rua nee, imi hakarak hau husik ida nebee ba imi?” Sira dehan, “Barabás.”
verses.22: Pilatos dehan ba sira, “Entaun hau sei halo saida ho Jesus nebee ema bolu Kristu?” Sira hotu hataan ba nia, “Prega Nia ba krús!”
verses.23: Governadór dehan, “Tanba saa mak, Nia halo aat saida?” Maibee sira hakilar makaas liu tan, “Prega Nia ba krús!”
verses.24: Pilatos haree katak nia la bele halo buat ida no ema lubun nee komesa hakilar makaas liu tan. Entaun nia foti bee no fasi ninia liman iha ema lubun nia oin, no dehan, “Hau la iha sala kona ba Ema nee nia raan. Buat ida nee mak imi nian.”
verses.25: Povu hotu hataan, no dehan, “Husik Ninia raan monu ba ami, no ami nia oan sira.”
verses.26: Entaun Pilatos husik Barabás ba sira. No nia haruka ema baku Jesus ho sikote. Depois nia entrega Jesus hodi soldadu prega Nia ba krús.
verses.27: Governadór nia soldadu sira lori Jesus ba Governadór nia postu no halibur tropas hotu hodi haleu Nia.
verses.28: Sira kolu ropa hosi Nia no tau manta mean ba Nia.
verses.29: Sira bobar ai tarak hodi halo koroa ida no tau iha Ninia ulun. Depois sira tau fafulu kain ida iha Ninia liman loos. No sira hakneak iha Nia oin hodi hamoe Nia, no dehan, “Viva, Liurai hosi ema Judeu sira!”
verses.30: No sira tafui ba Nia, no foti fafulu kain nee no baku Ninia ulun.
verses.31: Bainhira sira hamoe tiha Nia, sira kolu fali manta nee hosi Nia, no foo hatais fali Nia ho Ninia ropa rasik. Depois sira lori Nia sai atu prega Nia ba krús.
verses.32: No bainhira sira lao sai dadaun, sira hetan mane ida hosi Sirene, naran Simão. No sira obriga mane nee atu lori Jesus nia krús.
verses.33: No bainhira sira too iha fatin ida naran Golgota (katak ‘Fatin Ulun Ruin’),
verses.34: sira foo ba Nia tua siin nebee kahur ho buat moruk hodi Nia hemu. Maibee bainhira Nia koko tiha, Nia lakohi hemu.
verses.35: Depois sira prega Nia ba krús. No sira dada rifa hodi fahe Ninia ropa.
verses.36: Depois sira tuur hodi hein Nia.
verses.37: Sira tau avizu iha Ninia ulun leten nebee akuza Nia, “Nee mak Jesus, ema Judeu nia liurai.”
verses.38: Sira prega naok-teen nain rua ba krús ho Jesus. Ida iha Nia liman loos no ida seluk iha Nia liman karuk.
verses.39: Ema sira nebee lao liu fatin nee goza Nia. Sira doko sira nia ulun,
verses.40: no dehan, “O nebee bele harahun Templu, no harii fali iha loron tolu nia laran, salva O nia aan ba! Se O mak Maromak nia Oan, tuun mai hosi krús.”
verses.41: Hanesan nee mos xefi saserdote sira, ho eskriba no katuas sira, hamoe Nia, no dehan,
verses.42: “Nia salva ona ema seluk, maibee Nia la bele salva Nia aan rasik! Se Nia mak Liurai Israel nian, husik Nia tuun lai hosi krús, no ita sei fiar Nia.
verses.43: Nia fiar iha Maromak; entaun se Maromak hakarak Nia, husik Maromak salva Nia lai. Tanba Nia dehan, ‘Hau mak Maromak nia Oan.’”
verses.44: Naok-teen sira mos, nebee iha krús ho Nia, hatete hanesan hodi goza Nia.
verses.45: Hahuu hosi meiudia, nakukun taka rai tomak too tuku tolu lokraik.
verses.46: Iha tuku tolu lokraik, Jesus hakilar ho lian makaas, no dehan, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” katak, ‘Hau nia Maromak, Hau nia Maromak, tanba saa mak O husik Hau?’
verses.47: Bainhira sira rona tiha nunee, ema balu nebee hamriik iha nebaa dehan, “Mane ida nee bolu Elias.”
verses.48: Depois ema sira nee ida halai kedas, no foti esponza ida, habokon iha tua siin no tau iha fafulu kain ida hodi foo hemu ba Jesus.
verses.49: Ema sira seluk nee dehan, “Husik ba. Ita haree took, se Elias mai atu salva Nia ka lae.”
verses.50: Depois Jesus hakilar fali ho lian makaas, no Nia husik Ninia espíritu.
verses.51: No tebes, Templu nia veo naklees fahe ba rua hosi leten too kraik. Rai nakdoko no fatuk nakfera.
verses.52: Rate sira nakloke no ema santu barak nia mate isin moris hias.
verses.53: Bainhira Jesus moris hias ona, sira moris mai hosi rate no tama sidade santu, no hatudu aan ba ema barak.
verses.54: Bainhira komandante ho sira seluk nebee hein Jesus haree rai nakdoko no buat sira nebee akontese, sira tauk tebes no dehan, “Tebes, ema ida nee mak Maromak nia Oan duni.”
verses.55: No feto barak nebee lao tuir Jesus hosi Galileia hodi serví Nia hamriik dook hela.
verses.56: Iha sira nia leet mak Maria Madalena, no Maria nebee Tiago no José nia inan, no Zebedeu nia oan sira nia inan.
verses.57: Bainhira rai nakaras ona, ema riku ida mai. Nia ema Arimateia, naran José. Nia mos Jesus nia eskolante ida.
verses.58: Nia baa Pilatos no husu Jesus nia mate isin. Entaun Pilatos haruka sira foo mate isin nee ba nia.
verses.59: No bainhira José foti Jesus nia mate isin nia falun ho hena linhu nebee moos.
verses.60: Nia rai mate isin nee iha ninia rate foun nebee nia kee ona hosi fatuk. Nia duir fatuk boot ida hodi taka rate nia odamatan, depois nia sai ba.
verses.61: Maibee Maria Madalena no Maria ida seluk tuur iha rate nia oin.
verses.62: Loron tuir mai, nebee liu tiha loron Preparasaun, xefi saserdote sira no Farizeu sira baa hamutuk hodi hasoru Pilatos.
verses.63: No sira dehan, “Senhor, ami hanoin hetan lohi door nee nia liafuan bainhira Nia sei moris hela. Nia dehan, ‘Liu tiha loron tolu Hau sei moris hias.’
verses.64: Entaun haruka ema taka metin rate nee too loron tolu atu nunee Ninia eskolante sira la mai no naok Ninia mate isin. Depois sira sei dehan ba povu nee, ‘Nia moris hias ona hosi mate,’ no lia bosok ikus nee sei sai aat liu fali uluk nian.”
verses.65: Pilatos dehan ba sira, “Imi bele baa ho guarda ida. Baa deit no taka metin tuir imi nia hakarak.”
verses.66: Entaun sira baa no hametin rate nee. Sira taka fatuk ho selo no tau guarda hodi hein iha nebaa.

verses.1: Liu tiha loron Sabdu, bainhira loro matan atu sae iha loron primeiru ba semana nee, Maria Madalena no Maria ida seluk baa haree rate.
verses.2: No tebes, rai nakdoko makaas tanba Nai nia anju tuun mai hosi lalehan. Anju nee mai no duir fatuk sai hosi odamatan, no tuur iha fatuk leten.
verses.3: Nia iha oin hanesan rai lakan, no ninia ropa mutin hanesan neve.
verses.4: Guarda sira nee nakdedar tanba tauk, no sira sai hanesan ema mate.
verses.5: Maibee anju dehan ba feto sira nee, “Keta tauk. Tanba hau hatene katak imi buka Jesus, nebee ema prega tiha ona ba krús.
verses.6: Nia la iha nee. Tanba Nia moris hias ona, tuir Ninia liafuan. Mai, haree fatin nebee uluk Nia toba.
verses.7: Baa lalais no foo hatene ba Ninia eskolante sira katak Nia moris hias ona hosi mate. No tebes, Nia baa uluk imi too Galileia. Imi sei haree Nia iha nebaa. Tebes, hau foo hatene ona ba imi.”
verses.8: No sira sai lalais hosi rate nee. Sira tauk no haksolok tebe-tebes. Sira halai hodi foo hatene ba Jesus nia eskolante sira.
verses.9: No tebes, Jesus hasoru sira no dehan, “Salóm!” Sira hakbesik no kaer Ninia ain no adora Nia.
verses.10: Depois Jesus dehan ba sira, “Keta tauk. Baa foo hatene ba Hau nia maluk sira atu baa Galileia. No sira sei haree Hau iha nebaa.”
verses.11: Bainhira sira baa dadaun, tebes, guarda balu tama ba sidade. Sira foo hatene ba xefi saserdote sira kona ba buat hotu nebee akontese.
verses.12: No bainhira xefi saserdote sira halibur hamutuk ho katuas sira, no sira koalia hamutuk ona, sira foo osan boot ba soldadu sira.
verses.13: No sira dehan, “Imi tenki dehan, ‘Ninia eskolante sira mai iha kalan, no naok mate isin nee bainhira ami toba hela.’
verses.14: No se karik istória nee mai ba governadór nia tilun, ami sei koalia diak ho nia, hodi imi la presiza hanoin.”
verses.15: Entaun sira foti osan no halo tuir orden nee. No istória nee habelar iha ema Judeu sira nia leet too ohin loron.
verses.16: Tuir mai, eskolante nain sanulu resin ida baa Galileia. No sira baa too foho nebee Jesus foo hatene ona ba sira.
verses.17: No bainhira sira haree Nia, sira adora Nia. Maibee ema balu laran rua hela.
verses.18: Jesus hakbesik no koalia ba sira, no dehan, “Hau simu ona kbiit tomak iha lalehan no mundu.
verses.19: Nee duni, imi baa, no halo disípulu ba ema hosi nasaun hotu-hotu. Foo batizmu ba sira hodi Aman, hodi Oan, no hodi Espíritu Santu nia naran.
verses.20: Hanorin sira atu halo tuir buat hotu nebee Hau manda ona ba imi. No tebes, Hau sei hamutuk nafatin ho imi, too mundu nia rohan.”

verses.1: Evanjelhu kona ba Jesus Kristu, Maromak nia Oan, hahuu nunee.
verses.2: Tuir liafuan nebee profeta Isaias hakerek nanis ona,
verses.3: Lian hosi ema ida nebee hakilar iha rai fuik maran:
verses.4: João mai no foo batizmu iha rai fuik maran. Nia haklaken kona ba batizmu arepende nian hodi hetan perdua ba sala.
verses.5: No ema hotu hosi rai Judeia no Jerusalém baa hasoru nia. No nia foo batizmu ba sira iha mota Jordaun, no sira konfesa sira nia sala.
verses.6: João hatais ropa nebee halo hosi kuda kamelu nia fulun, no sintu nebee halo hosi animál nia kulit, no nia haan gafanhotu ho bani been hosi ai laran.
verses.7: Nia haklaken, no dehan, “Ema nebee iha podér liu fali hau sei mai tuir hau. No hau la merese atu hakruuk hodi kore Ninia sandálias nia tali.
verses.8: Hau foo batizmu ba imi ho bee, maibee Nia sei foo batizmu ba imi ho Espíritu Santu.
verses.9: Iha tempu nebaa, Jesus mai hosi Nazaré iha Galileia, no João foo batizmu ba Nia iha mota Jordaun.
verses.10: Bainhira Nia sai hosi bee laran nee, Nia haree lalehan nakloke kedas no Espíritu tuun ba Nia hanesan manu pombu ida.
verses.11: No lian ida mai hosi lalehan, “O mak Hau nia Oan Mane nebee Hau hadomi. O mak halo Hau kontenti liu.”
verses.12: Espíritu nee obriga Jesus tama kedas ba iha rai fuik maran.
verses.13: Nia hela iha rai fuik maran nee durante loron haat-nulu no Diabu koko Nia. Nia hela hamutuk ho animál fuik. No anju sira mai serví Nia.
verses.14: Tuir mai, bainhira ema kaer tiha João, Jesus baa Galileia no foo sai evanjelhu kona ba Maromak nia reinu.
verses.15: Nia hatete, “Tempu too ona, no Maromak nia reinu besik ona. Arepende ba, no fiar evanjelhu.”
verses.16: Bainhira Jesus lao tuir tasi ibun iha Tasi Galileia, Nia haree Simão ho nia alin André. Sira soe hela dai ba tasi tanba sira mak peskadór.
verses.17: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Mai tuir Hau, no Hau sei halo imi sai peskadór ba ema.”
verses.18: Nunee sira husik kedas sira nia dai sira nee hodi tuir Nia.
verses.19: Bainhira Nia lao ba oin uitoan, Nia haree Zebedeu nia oan Tiago no nia alin João. Sira iha sira nia roo laran no hadia hela sira nia dai.
verses.20: Jesus bolu kedas sira. Entaun sira husik hela sira nia aman Zebedeu iha roo laran hamutuk ho ema sira nebee servisu ho Zebedeu. Depois sira tuir Nia.
verses.21: Sira baa too Kafarnaum. Iha loron Sabdu, Jesus tama ba sinagoga no Nia hanorin.
verses.22: Sira hakfodak ho Ninia hanorin. Tanba Nia hanorin ho kbiit no la hanesan ema eskriba sira.
verses.23: Iha sinagoga nee, iha ema ida nebee iha espíritu foer no nia hakilar dehan,
verses.24: “Jesus, ema Nazaré, O halo saida ba ami? O mai atu halakon ami ka? Hau konhese O, Ida Nebee Santu Hosi Maromak.”
verses.25: Jesus siak nia no dehan, “Nonook lai, no sai hosi ema nee!”
verses.26: Depois espíritu foer doko ema nee no nia hakilar ho lian makaas. Depois espíritu nee sai hosi nia.
verses.27: Ema hotu iha nebaa hakfodak, no sira husu ba malu, “Saida mak nee? Hanorin nee foun! Tanba ho kbiit Nia foo orden mos ba espíritu foer no sira halo tuir.”
verses.28: No Jesus nia naran sai boot kedas iha fatin hotu-hotu iha área nebee haleu rai Galileia.
verses.29: Sira sai kedas hosi sinagoga no baa iha Simão no André nia uma, hamutuk ho Tiago no João.
verses.30: Simão nia banin feto toba hela tanba nia moras isin manas. No sira foo hatene ba Jesus.
verses.31: Entaun Nia baa no kaer feto nee nia liman no Nia ajuda feto nee hodi hamriik. Moras isin manas nee lakon kedas no feto nee hahuu serví sira.
verses.32: Iha lokraik, bainhira loro matan monu ona, ema sira iha nebaa lori ema hotu nebee moras no ema nebee diabu domina sira.
verses.33: Ema hotu iha sidade nee mai halibur iha odamatan oin.
verses.34: Jesus kura ema barak nebee iha moras oi-oin. Nia duni sai diabu barak hosi ema. Maibee Nia bandu diabu sira nee atu la bele koalia tanba sira konhese Nia.
verses.35: Iha dadeer-saan nakukun, Jesus sai ba liur no lao ba fatin nebee ema la iha. No Nia halo orasaun iha nebaa.
verses.36: Simão no sira nebee hamutuk ho nia baa buka Jesus.
verses.37: Bainhira sira hetan Jesus, sira dehan ba Nia, “Ema hotu buka O.”
verses.38: Nia hataan ba sira, “Mai ita baa sidade sira seluk nebee besik hodi Hau bele haklaken mos iha nebaa, tanba nee mak Hau mai.”
verses.39: No Nia haklaken iha sira nia sinagoga sira iha rai Galileia tomak, no Nia duni sai diabu sira.
verses.40: Depois ema moras lepra ida mai hasoru Jesus. Nia hakneak iha Jesus nia oin no husu ho laran, “Se O hakarak, O bele halo hau sai moos.”
verses.41: No Jesus, ho laran luak, lolo liman no kaer ema nee. Nia dehan ba ema nee, “Hau hakarak. Sai moos ba.”
verses.42: Derepenti moras lepra sai kedas hosi ema nee, no nia sai moos kedas.
verses.43: Depois Jesus foo orden ba nia no haruka nia baa kedas,
verses.44: no dehan ba nia, “Keta foo hatene ba ema ida, maibee baa hatudu aan ba saserdote. Foo oferta kona ba o nia isin moos nebee Moises manda, hodi sai testemunha ba sira.”
verses.45: Maibee nia lao ba no komesa foo sai no habelar istória nee. Nunee Jesus la bele lao deit hodi tama sidade maibee Nia tenki hela iha rai fuik. No povu hosi fat-fatin mai hasoru Nia.

verses.1: Liu tiha loron balu, Jesus tama fali ba Kafarnaum, no ema rona katak Nia mai iha uma ona.
verses.2: La kleur, ema barak halibur hamutuk too fatin la iha atu simu sira. Iha odamatan oin mos fatin la iha. No Nia foo sai liafuan ba sira.
verses.3: No ema nain haat lori ba Nia ema ida nebee isin mate.
verses.4: Sira la bele hakbesik ba Nia tanba ema barak. Entaun sira baa hodi sobu uma kakuluk iha fatin nebee Nia iha. Bainhira sira loke tiha uma leten nee, sira hatuun ema isin mate ho biti ida nebee nia uza hodi toba.
verses.5: Bainhira Jesus haree sira nia fiar, Nia hatete ba ema isin mate nee, “Oan, o nia sala hetan perdua ona.”
verses.6: Maibee iha fatin nee, eskriba sira tuur no hanoin iha sira nia fuan laran,
verses.7: “Tanba saa mak ema ida nee koalia hanesan nee? Nia koalia aat Maromak! See mak bele foo perdua? Só Maromak deit mak bele.”
verses.8: Jesus hatene kedas iha Ninia espíritu katak sira hanoin hanesan nee iha sira nia laran. Nunee Nia dehan, “Tanba saa mak imi hanoin hanesan nee iha imi nia laran?
verses.9: Ida nebee mak fasil liu, atu hatete ba ema isin mate, ‘O nia sala sira hetan perdua ona’ ka atu hatete, ‘Hamriik, foti o nia biti no lao ba’?
verses.10: Maibee hodi imi bele hatene katak Ema Nia Oan iha kbiit iha mundu hodi foo perdua, (Nia hatete ba ema isin mate nee)
verses.11: Hau dehan ba o, hamriik, foti o nia biti, no fila fali ba o nia uma.”
verses.12: No ema nee hamriik kedas, foti ninia biti, no nia lao sai liu hosi sira nia oin. Ema hotu nee hakfodak no foo glória ba Maromak. Sira hatete, “Ami nunka haree buat ida hanesan nee!”
verses.13: Jesus lao too iha tasi ibun, no ema barak baa hasoru Nia no Nia hanorin sira.
verses.14: Bainhira Nia lao dadaun, Nia haree Levi, Alfeu nia oan, nebee tuur hela iha fatin nebee ema selu taxa. Nia dehan ba Levi, “Tuir Hau!” No Levi hamriik no tuir Nia.
verses.15: Tuir mai, Jesus haan iha Levi nia uma. No kobradór impostu barak ho sala nain sira mai tuur no haan hamutuk ho Jesus no Ninia eskolante sira. Tanba ema barak tuir Nia.
verses.16: Bainhira ema eskriba no Farizeu sira haree Jesus haan hamutuk ho kobradór impostu no sala nain sira, nunee sira husu ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Tanba saa mak Nia haan hemu hamutuk ho kobradór impostu no sala nain sira?”
verses.17: Bainhira Jesus rona nunee, Nia dehan ba sira, “Ema nebee isin diak la presiza doutór, maibee sira nebee moras. Hau mai, laos atu bolu ema nebee moris loos, maibee atu bolu sala nain sira.”
verses.18: João ho ema Farizeu sira nia eskolante sira toman atu halo jejún. No sira mai no husu Jesus, “Tanba saa mak João ho ema Farizeu sira nia eskolante sira halo jejún, maibee Ita Boot nia eskolante sira la halo jejún?”
verses.19: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Oinsaa noivu nia belun sira bele halo jejún bainhira sira sei hamutuk ho noivu nee? Sira la halo jejún bainhira noivu hamutuk hela ho sira.
verses.20: Maibee loron sei too mai bainhira ema foti noivu hosi sira, depois sira sei halo jejún iha loron nebaa.
verses.21: La iha ema ida suku hena foun ba ropa tuan. Se hanesan nee, hena foun nee bele lees fali ropa tuan no halo kuak nee boot liu tan.
verses.22: No la iha ema ida tau tua uvas foun ba tua kulit tuan. Tanba se ema halo nunee, tua uvas foun bele lees fali tua kulit. Tua uvas nee sei nakfakar no tua kulit mos sei sai aat. Maibee ema tau tua uvas foun iha tua kulit foun.”
verses.23: Tuir mai, Jesus lao liu hosi toos batar nian iha loron Sabdu. No Ninia eskolante sira komesa silu batar.
verses.24: Ema Farizeu sira dehan ba Nia, “Haree lai, tanba saa mak sira halo buat nebee lei bandu iha loron Sabdu.”
verses.25: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Imi nunka lee buat nebee David halo bainhira nia presiza buat ruma no nia hamlaha ho sira nebee hamutuk ho nia ka?
verses.26: Nia tama ba iha uma Maromak nian iha tempu nebee Abiatar mak xefi saserdote. No nia haan paun santu, nebee ita la bele haan só saserdote sira deit mak bele haan. No nia foo mos paun nee ba sira nebee hamutuk ho nia.”
verses.27: Depois Nia hatete ba sira, “Maromak halo loron Sabdu ba ema, laos ema ba loron Sabdu.
verses.28: Tanba Ema Nia Oan mos Nain ba loron Sabdu.”

verses.1: Jesus tama fali ba sinagoga, no iha nebaa iha ema ida nebee iha liman sorin mate.
verses.2: Ema sira nee hateke ba Nia hodi haree se Nia atu kura ema nee iha loron Sabdu ka lae, atu nunee sira bele foo sala ba Nia.
verses.3: Nia hatete ba mane ida nebee liman sorin mate nee, “Mai, hamriik iha klaran!”
verses.4: Nunee Nia hatete ba sira, “Tuir ita nia lei, iha loron Sabdu ita bele halo buat diak ka buat aat? Ita bele salva ema nia moris ka oho ema?” Maibee sira nonook hela deit.
verses.5: Jesus hateke ho laran hirus ba sira nebee haleu Nia. Nia laran susar tanba sira nia fuan laran toos. Nia hatete ba mane ida nee, “Lolo o nia liman!” Depois mane nee lolo ninia liman, no ninia liman sai diak kedas hanesan ninia liman seluk.
verses.6: Nunee ema Farizeu sira sai ba liur no sira baa kedas atu koalia hamutuk ho Herodes nia ema kona ba Jesus no oinsaa sira bele oho Nia.
verses.7: Maibee Jesus hadook aan hosi fatin nee no lao ba tasi hamutuk ho Ninia eskolante sira. Ema lubun boot tuir Nia hosi Galileia no Judeia.
verses.8: Ema mos mai hosi Jerusalém, Idumeia no Jordaun sorin ba, no mos hosi área Tiro no Sidon. Ema lubun boot baa Jesus tanba sira rona kona ba buat barak nebee Nia halo.
verses.9: Nia koalia ho Ninia eskolante sira, no husu roo kiik ida hodi Nia bele sae roo tanba ema barak, atu nunee sira la bele sena Nia.
verses.10: Tanba Nia kura ona ema barak, nunee sira hadau malu hodi kona Nia. Tanba ema barak nee iha moras todan.
verses.11: No bainhira espíritu foer sira haree Nia, sira monu iha Ninia oin. Sira hakilar, “O mak Maromak nia Oan!”
verses.12: Maibee Nia bandu nafatin sira atu nunee sira la bele foo sai kona ba see mak Nia.
verses.13: Depois Jesus sae ba foho no bolu sira nebee Nia hakarak no sira hakbesik ba Nia.
verses.14: Nia hili ema nain sanulu resin rua hodi sira bele lao hamutuk ho Nia no Nia bele haruka sira atu lao ba no haklaken.
verses.15: Nia foo kbiit ba sira atu duni sai diabu sira.
verses.16: Ema nain sanulu resin rua nebee Nia hili mak nee: Simão, nebee Nia foo naran Pedro,
verses.17: no Tiago, Zebedeu nia oan, no João, Tiago nia alin. Ba sira nain rua nee Nia foo naran ‘Boanerjes’ nebee iha sentidu ‘rai tarutu nia oan sira,’
verses.18: no André, Filipe, Bartolomeu, Mateus, Tomé, no Tiago, Alfeu nia oan, no Tadeu, no Simão, ema Kanaan,
verses.19: no Judas Iskariotes, nebee sai traidór ba Jesus.
verses.20: Tuir mai, sira tama ba uma ida. No ema lubun boot mai halibur fali iha nebaa, too sira haan mos la bele.
verses.21: No bainhira Ninia família sira rona nunee, sira lao ba nebaa atu kaer Nia, tanba sira dehan, “Nia bulak ona.”
verses.22: Depois ema eskriba sira tuun mai hosi Jerusalém no dehan, “Nia iha Belzebu. Liu hosi diabu sira nia nain mak Nia duni sai diabu sira nee.”
verses.23: Entaun Jesus bolu sira no koalia ba sira liu hosi istória ida, “Oinsaa Satanás bele duni sai Satanás?
verses.24: Se karik reinu ida fahe malu hodi hasoru ninia aan rasik, nunee reinu nee sei la hamriik.
verses.25: No se karik uma kain ida fahe hodi hasoru ninia aan rasik, nunee uma kain nee sei la hamriik.
verses.26: No se karik Satanás book aan hodi hasoru ninia aan rasik, no nia fahe aan, nunee nia sei la hamriik, no nia atu lakon.
verses.27: La iha ema ida nebee bele tama iha ema forti nia uma hodi hadau ninia riku-soin se nia la kesi uluk ema forti nee. Depois nia bele hadau ema forti nia riku-soin nee.
verses.28: Loos duni, Hau hatete ba imi katak ema sira nia sala hotu sei hetan perdua, inklui mos sala hotu nebee sira koalia aat hasoru Maromak,
verses.29: maibee ema nebee koalia aat hasoru Espíritu Santu sei nunka hetan perdua. Ema nee sei hetan kastigu too rohan laek.”
verses.30: Tanba sira dehan, “Nia iha espíritu foer.”
verses.31: Depois Jesus nia alin sira no Ninia inan mai. Sira hamriik iha liur no haruka ema baa bolu Nia.
verses.32: Ema lubun boot tuur haleu Nia. No sira dehan ba Nia, “Tebes, O nia inan no alin sira iha liur, no sira buka O.”
verses.33: No Nia hataan ba sira, no dehan, “See mak Hau nia inan no Hau nia alin sira?”
verses.34: No Nia hateke ba sira nebee tuur haleu Nia, no dehan, “Tebes, ema iha nee mak Hau nia inan no Hau nia alin sira!
verses.35: Ema see deit nebee halo tuir Maromak nia hakarak, nia mak Hau nia alin mane no alin feto no inan.”

4.title: Ai Knanoik Kona Ba Toos Nain

verses.1: Jesus komesa hanorin fali ema iha tasi ibun. No ema lubun boot tebes halibur ba Nia. Nunee Nia sae roo ida, no tuur iha roo laran nee iha tasi. No ema hotu hamriik iha tasi ibun, iha rai maran.
verses.2: Nia hanorin sira buat barak liu hosi ai knanoik sira. No bainhira Nia hanorin sira, Nia dehan,
verses.3: “Rona ba! Toos nain ida baa atu kari fini.
verses.4: Tuir mai, bainhira nia kari fini, balu monu iha dalan. No manu sira iha loro leten mai no haan hotu.
verses.5: No fini balu monu iha fatuk laran, iha fatin nebee rai uitoan deit. Fini nee moris lalais, tanba rai mihis.
verses.6: Maibee, bainhira loro matan sae, sira namlaik no sai maran too lakon tanba abut la iha.
verses.7: No fini balu monu iha ai tarak laran. Ai tarak sira nee sai boot, no hanehan sira too sira la foo fuan.
verses.8: No fini balu tan monu iha rai diak. Sira moris mai, sai buras no foo fuan diak. Fini balu foo fuan too dala tolu-nulu, no balu foo fuan too dala neen-nulu, no balu foo fuan too dala atus ida.”
verses.9: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Ema nebee iha tilun hodi rona, husik nia rona ba.”
verses.10: Bainhira Jesus mesak, ema sira nebee hamutuk ho sira nain sanulu resin rua nee husu Nia kona ba ai knanoik.
verses.11: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi bele simu segredu kona ba Maromak nia reinu, maibee ba sira nebee iha liur, Hau konta buat sira nee hotu liu hosi ai knanoik sira,
verses.12: atu nunee
verses.13: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi la kompriende ai knanoik ida nee ka? Entaun oinsaa mak imi bele kompriende ai knanoik sira seluk?
verses.14: Fini nebee toos nain kari mak liafuan.
verses.15: No fini iha dalan mak ema nebee rona liafuan nee, maibee bainhira sira rona ona, Satanás mai kedas, no foti sai liafuan nebee kuda ona iha sira nia fuan laran.
verses.16: No fini monu ba fatuk laran mak ema nebee, bainhira sira rona liafuan nee, sira simu kedas ho laran haksolok.
verses.17: Maibee sira nia abut la iha, nunee sira bele tahan too tempu uitoan deit. Tuir mai, bainhira tempu susar ka terus mosu mai tanba liafuan nee, sira monu kedas.
verses.18: No fini nebee monu iha ai tarak laran mak ema nebee rona liafuan.
verses.19: Maibee sira preokupa kona ba moris iha mundu, riku-soin dada bosok sira, no sira kaan buat seluk. Buat sira nee tama no hanehan liafuan nee, no liafuan nee la foo fuan.
verses.20: No fini nebee monu iha rai diak mak ema nebee rona liafuan, no sira simu no foo fuan, balu foo fali fuan too dala tolu-nulu, balu too dala neen-nulu, no balu tan too dala atus ida.”
verses.21: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Ema tau ahi oan nebee lakan iha baldi okos ka iha kama okos? Laos ema tau ahi oan iha ahi oan nia fatin?
verses.22: Nunee la iha buat ida nebee subar, nebee sei la hatudu sai; no la iha buat ida nebee segredu, nebee sei la foo hatene.
verses.23: Ema nebee iha tilun hodi rona, husik nia rona ba.”
verses.24: Nia dehan mos ba sira, “Halo tuir buat nebee imi rona. Sasukat nebee imi uza, sei uza mos ba imi, no imi sei hetan liu tan fali.
verses.25: Tanba nia nebee iha ona, sei hetan tan; no nia nebee la iha, nia sei lakon mos buat ruma nebee nia iha.”
verses.26: Jesus dehan, “Maromak nia reinu mak hanesan ema ida nebee kari fini iha rai.
verses.27: Nia toba iha kalan no hadeer iha loron too loron barak. Maibee fini nee mosu mai no sai boot, mezmu nia la hatene oinsaa.
verses.28: Tanba rai nee rasik mak foo uluk dikin, depois fulin nurak, no tuir mai fulin nebee tasak.
verses.29: Maibee bainhira tasak ona, toos nain mai kedas ho sabit, tanba tempu koa nian too ona.”
verses.30: Nia dehan, “Ita bele kompara Maromak nia reinu ho saida? Ka ita uza ai knanoik ida nebee hodi esplika reinu nee?
verses.31: Reinu mak hanesan mostarda musan ida. Bainhira ema kuda musan nee iha toos, musan nee mak kiik liu musan sira seluk iha toos.
verses.32: Maibee bainhira kuda ona, nia moris no sai boot liu ai horis sira seluk no nia iha ai sanak nebee manu sira iha loro leten bele mai tuur iha ninia mahon.”
verses.33: Jesus konta ai knanoik barak hanesan nee hodi hanorin liafuan nee ba sira, tuir buat nebee sira bele kompriende.
verses.34: Nia sempre koalia ho sira liu hosi ai knanoik. Depois bainhira sira mesak fali, Nia esplika buat hotu ba Ninia eskolante sira.
verses.35: Iha loron nee, bainhira lokraik ona, Jesus dehan ba sira, “Mai ita hakur ba tasi sorin.”
verses.36: Sira husik tiha ema lubun boot nee. Depois sira lori Nia hanesan nee deit iha roo. No roo kiik sira seluk mos baa hamutuk ho sira.
verses.37: Tuir mai, anin boot mosu mai. Laloran baku makaas roo no roo nee sai nakonu ho bee.
verses.38: Maibee Jesus toba ho sumasu iha roo kotuk. Sira fanu Nia no dehan, “Mestri, O la haree ita besik atu mate ona nee?”
verses.39: Nunee Nia hamriik, no siak anin, no dehan ba tasi nee, “Nonook lai, hakmatek ba!” No anin nee para ona, no tasi mos hakmatek loos.
verses.40: No nia dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi tauk hanesan nee? Nusaa mak imi la fiar?”
verses.41: Nunee sira tauk makaas, no dehan ba malu, “See mak ema nee too anin no tasi mos rona tuir Nia?”

verses.1: Sira too iha tasi sorin ba, nebee iha rai Gerasa.
verses.2: No bainhira Nia tuun hosi roo, ema ida ho espíritu foer mai kedas hosi rate sira nia leet hodi hasoru Nia.
verses.3: Ema nee hela iha rate sira nia leet. No la iha ema ida nebee bele kesi nia, ho korenti mos la bele.
verses.4: Tanba dala barak ona ema kesi nia ho besi iha ain no ho korenti. Maibee nia hakotu korenti no harahun besi nebee kesi iha ninia ain. La iha ema ida nebee iha kbiit atu tahan nia.
verses.5: Loron-kalan nia hela nafatin deit iha foho no iha rate sira nia leet. No nia hakilar no hakanek aan ho fatuk.
verses.6: Maibee bainhira nia haree Jesus hosi dook, nia halai no hakneak iha Jesus nia oin.
verses.7: Nia hakilar ho lian makaas, no dehan, “O hakarak saida hosi hau, Jesus, Oan Mane hosi Maromak nebee aas liu? Hau husu O jura hodi Maromak katak O sei la haterus hau.”
verses.8: Tanba Jesus dehan ona ba nia, “Espíritu foer, sai hosi mane nee!”
verses.9: No Jesus husu nia, “O nia naran saida?” No nia hataan, “Hau nia naran Batalhaun, tanba ami barak.”
verses.10: No nia husu makaas ba Jesus atu nunee Jesus la bele haruka sira sai hosi rai nee.
verses.11: Iha nebaa, fahi lubun boot ida haan hela iha foho.
verses.12: No sira husu ba Jesus, no dehan, “Haruka ami baa tama iha fahi sira nee.”
verses.13: Jesus foo lisensa ba sira. No espíritu aat sira sai hosi ema nee, no baa tama iha fahi sira. Depois fahi lubun boot nee halai makaas, no tuun liu hosi foho lolon nebee tama iha tasi. No fahi sira nee mout iha tasi laran (maizoumenus fahi rihun rua).
verses.14: No sira nebee hein fahi sira nee halai no foo hatene ba ema iha sidade no iha rai nee. No ema sira nee sai ba atu haree saida mak akontese.
verses.15: Sira mai hasoru Jesus no haree ema ida nebee diabu domina, nebee iha Batalhaun. Ema ida nee tuur, hatais ropa no iha neon moos ona. No ema sira nee sai tauk.
verses.16: No sira nebee uluk haree buat nee, konta kona ba buat nebee akontese ba nia nebee diabu domina, no mos kona ba fahi, ba ema sira seluk nee.
verses.17: Depois ema sira nee komesa husu makaas ba Jesus atu sai hosi sira nia rai.
verses.18: No bainhira Jesus sae ba roo, ema ida nebee uluk diabu domina nee husu makaas ba Jesus katak nia bele baa hamutuk ho Jesus.
verses.19: Jesus la husik nia atu baa, maibee dehan ba nia, “O fila baa uma. Baa hasoru o nia maluk sira, no foo hatene ba sira kona ba buat hotu nebee Nai halo ona ba o, no oinsaa Nia hatudu laran luak ba o.”
verses.20: Entaun ema ida nee baa no nia komesa foo sai iha área Dekápolis kona ba buat hotu nebee Jesus halo ona ba nia. No ema hotu admira.
verses.21: Bainhira Jesus fila fali ba tasi sorin ho roo, ema lubun boot baa hobur Nia. No Nia hamriik iha tasi ibun.
verses.22: No tebes, ukun nain ida mai hosi sinagoga, nebee naran Jairo. Bainhira nia haree Jesus, nia monu iha Jesus nia ain.
verses.23: Nia husu makaas ba Jesus, no dehan, “Hau nia oan feto nebee kiik toba hela no besik atu mate. Hau husu favór ida, mai no tau liman ba nia, hodi kura nia. Nunee nia bele moris.”
verses.24: Jesus baa ho nia. No ema lubun boot tuir Jesus no sena Nia.
verses.25: Iha nebaa, iha feto ida nebee moras raan suli durante tinan sanulu resin rua.
verses.26: No feto nee hetan terus barak ona hosi doutór barak. Nia gasta buat hotu nebee nia iha. Maski nunee nia la hetan benefísiu ida, maibee nia sai aat liu tan.
verses.27: Nia rona ona kona ba Jesus, entaun nia mai hosi kotuk, iha ema lubun sira nia leet, no nia kona Jesus nia ropa.
verses.28: Tanba nia dehan, “Se hau kona deit Ninia ropa, ida nee mos sei salva hau.”
verses.29: Ho ida nee ninia raan suli nee sai maran kedas. No nia senti iha nia isin lolon katak nia sai diak ona hosi moras nee.
verses.30: Jesus hatene kedas iha Nia laran katak kbiit sai ona hosi Nia. Nia fila no hateke ba ema lubun no dehan, “See mak kona Hau nia ropa?”
verses.31: Jesus nia eskolante sira dehan ba Nia, “O haree ema lubun boot nebee sena O, no O husu, ‘See mak kona Hau?’”
verses.32: Maibee Jesus hateke haleu nafatin atu haree see mak halo ida nee.
verses.33: Feto nee sai tauk no nia nakdedar. Nia hatene buat nebee akontese iha ninia laran. Entaun nia mai no monu iha Jesus nia oin no konta lia loos kona ba buat hotu.
verses.34: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Oan feto, o nia fiar mak salva o. Baa ho dame, no sai diak hosi o nia moras nee.”
