verses.35: Bainhira Jesus koalia hela, ema balu mai hosi sinagoga nia nai ulun nia uma no dehan, “Ita boot nia oan feto mate ona. Tanba saa mak ita halo kole tan Mestri nee?”
verses.36: Bainhira Jesus rona tiha liafuan nebee sira koalia nee, Nia dehan kedas ba nai ulun hosi sinagoga, “Keta tauk. Fiar deit ba.”
verses.37: No Nia la husik ema ida atu tuir Nia, só deit Pedro, Tiago no Tiago nia alin João.
verses.38: Nia mai too sinagoga nia nai ulun nia uma, no Nia haree barulhu loos, no ema sira nee tanis no halerik makaas.
verses.39: Bainhira Nia tama, Nia dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi halo barulhu no tanis nee? Labarik feto nee la mate, maibee nia toba deit.”
verses.40: No sira hamnasa Nia. Maibee Nia haruka sira sai hotu. Depois Nia lori labarik feto nia inan-aman ho sira nebee hamutuk ho Nia. No Nia tama ba fatin nebee labarik feto nee toba hela.
verses.41: Jesus kaer labarik feto nia liman no dehan ba nia, “Talita kumi!” (Nee dehan katak, “Noi, hadeer ba!”)
verses.42: No labarik feto nee hadeer kedas no nia bele lao (tanba nia tinan sanulu resin rua ona). No sira admira no hakfodak makaas.
verses.43: Jesus bandu makaas ba sira atu sira la bele foo hatene ba ema ida. No Nia haruka sira foo hahaan ba labarik feto nee.

verses.1: Jesus sai hosi fatin nee, no Nia baa too Ninia rai. No Ninia eskolante sira tuir Nia.
verses.2: Iha loron Sabdu, Nia komesa hanorin iha sinagoga. Ema barak nebee rona Nia hakfodak, no dehan, “Ema ida nee hetan buat hirak nee hosi nebee? Saida mak matenek klean nebee Nia simu ona nee? No oinsaa Nia bele halo milagre boot ho Ninia liman?
verses.3: Laos ema ida nee mak badaen ai, nebee Maria nia oan, no Ninia alin sira mak Tiago, José, Judas no Simão? No laos Ninia alin feto sira iha nee ho ita?” No sira hanoin aat kona ba Nia.
verses.4: Maibee Jesus dehan ba sira, “Profeta ida sempre hetan onra. Só deit iha ninia rai rasik, no iha ninia família rasik, no iha ninia uma rasik mak nia la hetan onra.”
verses.5: Nia la halo milagre boot iha nebaa, só deit Nia tau liman ba ema balu nebee moras no kura sira.
verses.6: Nia hakfodak tanba sira la fiar. No Nia lao ba aldeia sira hodi hanorin.
verses.7: Jesus bolu sira nain sanulu resin rua. No Nia komesa haruka sira lao nain rua-rua. Nia foo kbiit ba sira atu duni sai espíritu aat sira.
verses.8: Nia manda sira katak sira la bele lori buat ida iha sira nia viajen, só ai tonka deit. Sira la bele lori pasta ka paun ka osan iha bolsu.
verses.9: Sira bele uza sandálias, maibee la bele hatais ropa tahan rua.
verses.10: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Iha uma nebee deit mak imi tama, hela iha uma nee too imi sai hosi fatin nebaa.
verses.11: Ba ema nebee la simu imi ka la rona imi, bainhira imi sai hosi fatin nee liki tiha rai rahun hosi imi nia ain hodi sai testemunha hasoru sira.”
verses.12: No sira lao ba no haklaken katak ema tenki arepende.
verses.13: Sira duni sai diabu barak, no kose mina ba ema barak nebee moras no kura sira.
verses.14: Liurai Herodes rona kona ba buat sira nee (tanba Jesus nia naran sai boot ona). Ema dehan, “João Batista moris hias ona hosi mate. Nunee nia bele halo milagre boot sira nee.”
verses.15: Ema seluk dehan, “Nia mak Elias.” No ema seluk tan dehan, “Nia mak profeta ida, hanesan profeta sira hosi tempu antigu.”
verses.16: Maibee bainhira Herodes rona tiha kona ba ida nee, nia dehan, “Nia mak João, nebee hau tesi ona ninia ulun. Nia moris hias ona hosi mate.”
verses.17: Tanba Herodes rasik haruka ona ema baa no kaer João, no kesi nia iha komarka laran tanba Herodias. Herodias mak ninia maluk Filipe nia feen, no nia kaben fali ho Herodias.
verses.18: Tanba João dehan nafatin ba Herodes, “Tuir lei, ita la bele kaben ho ita nia maluk nia feen.”
verses.19: Nunee Herodias rai odi hasoru João. Nia hakarak oho João, maibee nia la konsege.
verses.20: Tanba Herodes tauk João, tanba nia hatene katak João mak ema loos no santu. Nunee nia tau matan ba João. Bainhira nia rona João, nia hanoin barak, maibee nia sei kontenti atu rona João.
verses.21: Maibee oportunidade ida mosu mai. Herodes halo tinan no prepara festa ida ba ninia nain sira, komandante boot sira, no ema boot sira hosi Galileia.
verses.22: No Herodias nia oan feto tama mai no dansa. Labarik feto nee halo Herodes kontenti no mos sira nebee tuur hamutuk ho nia. Nunee liurai dehan ba labarik feto nee, “Husu mai hau buat saida deit nebee mak o hakarak, no hau sei foo ba o.”
verses.23: Herodes jura ba feto nee, “Saida deit mak o husu hosi hau, hau sei foo ba o, too hau nia reinu sorin.”
verses.24: No feto nee baa no husu ninia inan, “Hau sei husu saida?” Ninia inan dehan, “João Batista nia ulun.”
verses.25: Entaun feto nee halai kedas ba liurai no husu, “Hau hakarak ita boot foo kedas mai hau João Batista nia ulun iha bandeja ida.”
verses.26: Nunee liurai sai tristi tebes. Maibee tanba ninia juramentu, no tanba ema sira nebee tuur ho nia, mak nia halo tuir buat nebee feto nee husu.
verses.27: Liurai haruka kedas soldadu ida, no manda nia atu lori mai João nia ulun. Entaun soldadu baa no tesi sai João nia ulun iha komarka laran.
verses.28: Nia lori João nia ulun mai iha bandeja ida no foo ba labarik feto nee. No labarik feto foo fali ba ninia inan.
verses.29: Bainhira João nia eskolante sira rona kona ba ida nee, sira mai no foti João nia mate isin, no hakoi nia iha rate ida.
verses.30: Eskolante sira halibur hamutuk ho Jesus, no konta buat hotu ba Nia, inklui buat nebee sira halo no buat nebee sira hanorin.
verses.31: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Mai ita baa fatin mes-mesak iha rai fuik hodi bele deskansa uitoan.” Tanba ema barak ba-mai, no sira la bele deskansa too haan mos la bele.
verses.32: No sira sae roo atu baa rai fuik hodi bele mes-mesak.
verses.33: Ema barak haree sira sai no konhese sira. Entaun ema halai hosi sidade hotu no too uluk fatin nebee sira atu baa.
verses.34: Bainhira Jesus tuun hosi roo, Nia haree ema lubun boot no Nia hanoin tebes sira. Tanba sira hanesan bibi nebee bibi atan la iha. No Nia komesa hanorin buat barak ba sira.
verses.35: No bainhira besik kalan ona, Jesus nia eskolante sira hakbesik mai ba Nia, no dehan, “Fatin nee rai fuik, no atu kalan ona.
verses.36: Haruka sira fila ba atu sira bele baa área nebee haleu fatin nee, no tama ba aldeia sira no sosa paun. Tanba sira la iha buat ida atu haan.”
verses.37: Nia hataan no dehan ba sira, “Imi foo haan ba sira.” No sira dehan ba Nia, “Ami sei baa gasta osan denáriu atus rua hodi sosa paun no foo ba sira atu haan ka?”
verses.38: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi iha paun fuan hira? Baa haree took.” No bainhira sira baa buka hatene ona, sira dehan, “Iha paun fuan lima no ikan rua.”
verses.39: Jesus haruka ema hotu tuur iha grupu grupu iha duut matak nia leten nee.
verses.40: Nunee sira tuur iha grupu, balu nain atus ida, no balu nain lima-nulu.
verses.41: Bainhira Nia foti paun fuan lima no ikan rua, Nia hateke ba lalehan, no husu bensaun. Depois Nia silu paun no foo ba Ninia eskolante sira atu foo ba ema. No Nia fahe ikan rua nee ba sira hotu.
verses.42: No ema hotu haan too bosu.
verses.43: Tuir mai sira halibur hahaan resin no ikan resin too bote sanulu resin rua nakonu.
verses.44: Ema sira nebee haan paun nee maizoumenus ema nain rihun lima, foin sura mane deit.
verses.45: Jesus haruka kedas Ninia eskolante sira atu sae roo no baa tasi sorin too Betsaida, no Nia sei haruka ema lubun boot nee fila.
verses.46: Bainhira Jesus haruka ona sira fila, Nia sae ba foho hodi halo orasaun.
verses.47: Bainhira kalan ona, roo sei iha tasi laran, no Jesus mesak iha rai maran.
verses.48: No Nia haree sira servisu makaas atu hean roo, tanba anin huu hasoru sira. Iha tuku tolu dadeer-saan nakukun Jesus baa sira. Nia lao iha tasi leten, no Nia baa atu lao liu sira.
verses.49: Maibee bainhira sira haree Nia lao iha tasi leten, sira hanoin Nia mak mate klamar no sira hakilar.
verses.50: Tanba sira hotu haree Nia no sai tauk tebes. Nia koalia kedas ba sira, no dehan ba sira, “Aten brani ba! Nee mak Hau. Keta tauk.”
verses.51: Nia lao ba sira no sae roo. Depois anin para. No sira admira tebe-tebes.
verses.52: Sira la kompriende milagre ho paun tanba sira nia fuan laran sei toos.
verses.53: Bainhira sira hakur tasi, sira mai iha rai Genesaret, no sira hatuun ankor.
verses.54: No bainhira sira tuun hosi roo, povu konhese kedas Jesus.
verses.55: Ema sira nee halai ba área hotu nebee haleu fatin nee no komesa lori ema moras iha kama ba fatin nebee deit sira rona Nia hela ba.
verses.56: No iha fatin nebee deit Nia tama, nebee aldeia sira ka sidade sira ka rai luan, sira hatoba ema moras iha merkadu fatin, no husu Nia atu sira bele kona kois deit Ninia ropa ninin. No ema hotu nebee kona Ninia ropa hetan isin diak.

verses.1: Depois ema Farizeu sira halibur haleu Jesus, ho ema eskriba balu nebee mai hosi Jerusalém.
verses.2: No sira haree Jesus nia eskolante sira haan ho liman foer, nebee seidauk fasi liman.
verses.3: Tanba ema Farizeu sira, no ema Judeu hotu, tenki fasi liman molok sira haan. Ida nee tuir kostumi hosi katuas sira.
verses.4: No bainhira sira mai hosi merkadu, sira tenki fasi aan molok sira haan. No sira iha kostumi barak nebee sira halo tuir, hanesan fasi kopu, buli, bikan riti no meza.
verses.5: Nunee ema Farizeu no eskriba sira husu Jesus, “Tanba saa mak O nia eskolante sira la halo tuir kostumi hosi katuas sira, maibee sira haan ho liman foer?”
verses.6: Nia hataan no dehan ba sira, “Isaias foo sai profesia lo-loos kona ba imi nebee ema laran makerek sira. Nia hakerek nanis ona,
verses.7: Sira adora Hau saugati deit,
verses.8: Imi husik Maromak nia ukun fuan hodi kaer metin ba ema nia kostumi.”
verses.9: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi hatene atu husik Maromak nia ukun fuan hodi imi bele halo tuir imi nia kostumi.
verses.10: Tanba Moisés dehan, ‘Foo onra ba o nia inan-aman,’ no, ‘Ema nebee foo malisan ba ninia inan ka aman tenki mate.’
verses.11: Maibee imi dehan, ‘Se mane ida dehan ba ninia inan ka aman, “Buat nebee imi atu simu hosi hau mak Korban ona,” (nebee sai oferta) -
verses.12: entaun imi la husik mane ida nee atu halo buat ida ba ninia inan ka aman.
verses.13: Nunee imi kansela Maromak nia liafuan liu hosi imi nia kostumi nebee imi hanorin. No imi halo buat barak hanesan nee.”
verses.14: Jesus bolu povu mai fali, no Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi hotu, rona Hau no kompriende ba:
verses.15: La iha buat ida iha ema nia liur nebee bele tama no halo nia foer, maibee buat sira nebee sai hosi nia sei halo nia foer.
verses.16: Ema nebee iha tilun hodi rona, husik nia rona ba.”
verses.17: No bainhira Jesus husik povu nee no tama tiha ba uma, Ninia eskolante sira husu Nia kona ba ai knanoik nee.
verses.18: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi mos seidauk kompriende ka? Imi la haree ka, katak buat nebee tama ba ema hosi liur la bele halo nia foer?
verses.19: Tanba hahaan nee la tama ba ninia fuan laran, maibee tama ba kabun, no sai ba sintina.” (Ho ida nee Nia dehan ai haan hotu sei moos.)
verses.20: No Nia dehan, “Buat nebee sai hosi ema mak halo ema foer.
verses.21: Tanba hosi laran, nebee hosi ema nia fuan laran mak sai hanoin aat, sala seksuál, naok, oho ema, adultériu,
verses.22: kaan, hahalok aat, bosok, halimar aat, laran moras, koalia aat, loko aan no hahalok beik.
verses.23: Buat aat hotu nee sai hosi laran no halo ema foer.”
verses.24: Jesus hamriik no sai hosi fatin nee no tama rai Tiro no Sidon. Nia tama uma ida, no lakohi ema ida hatene. Maibee Nia la bele subar aan.
verses.25: Feto ida mai kedas nebee iha oan feto kiik ho espíritu foer. Feto nee rona kona ba Jesus no nia mai no monu iha Jesus nia ain.
verses.26: Feto nee mak ema Gregu, nebee ema Siro-Fenísia. Nia husu Jesus atu duni sai diabu hosi ninia oan feto.
verses.27: Maibee Jesus dehan ba nia, “Husik oan sira haan too bosu lai. Tanba ida nee la diak atu foti oan sira nia paun no soe fali ba asu oan.”
verses.28: Maibee feto nee hataan no dehan ba Jesus, “Sin, Nai, maibee asu oan iha meza okos bele haan paun rahun hosi oan sira nee.”
verses.29: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Tanba liafuan nee, o bele baa deit. Diabu sai ona hosi o nia oan feto.”
verses.30: No bainhira feto nee fila ba uma, nia haree katak diabu sai ona, no ninia oan feto toba iha kama.
verses.31: Jesus fila fali hosi rai Tiro, no lao liu hosi área Sidon, no Nia mai ba Tasi Galileia, iha área Dekápolis.
verses.32: No ema sira nee lori ba Nia ema ida nebee tilun diuk no monok. No sira husu Jesus atu tau liman ba nia.
verses.33: Jesus lori nia ba sorin hodi dook hosi ema lubun boot nee. Nia hatama Ninia liman fuan ba ema nee nia tilun, Nia tafui no kona ema nee nia nanaal.
verses.34: Nia hateke ba lalehan, dada iis no dehan ba ema nee, “Efata!” katak, “Nakloke ba!”
verses.35: No ema nee nia tilun rona kedas, no ninia nanaal sai mamar, no nia bele koalia moos.
verses.36: Jesus bandu sira atu la bele foo hatene ba ema ida. Maibee bainhira Nia bandu sira hanesan nee sira foo sai barak liu tan fali.
verses.37: No sira hakfodak tebe-tebes, no dehan, “Nia halo buat hotu diak. Nia bele halo mos ema tilun diuk rona no ema monok mos koalia.”

8.title: Jesus Foo Haan Ema Rihun Haat

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, ema lubun boot halibur hamutuk no sira la iha buat ida atu haan. Entaun Jesus bolu Ninia eskolante sira, no dehan ba sira,
verses.2: “Hau hanoin tebes ema lubun boot nee, tanba sira hela hamutuk ho Hau too loron tolu ona no la iha buat ida atu haan.
verses.3: No se Hau haruka sira fila ba uma bainhira hamlaha hela, sira nia oin sei nakukun iha dalan. Tanba ema balu nee mai hosi dook.”
verses.4: No Ninia eskolante sira hataan ba Nia, “Oinsaa mak ema bele foo paun ba povu nee iha rai mamuk nee?”
verses.5: No Nia husu sira, “Imi iha paun fuan hira?” No sira dehan, “Hitu.”
verses.6: Nia haruka povu nee atu tuur iha rai. Nia foti paun hitu nee no foo agradese. Depois Nia silu paun no foo ba Ninia eskolante sira atu fahe. No eskolante sira fahe ba ema lubun boot nee.
verses.7: No sira iha ikan kiik balu. Entaun Jesus foo bensaun no haruka sira fahe mos ikan ba ema lubun boot nee.
verses.8: Entaun sira haan too bosu. No sira halibur hahaan restu nebee resin nee too bote boot hitu.
verses.9: Sira nebee haan nee maizoumenus ema nain rihun haat (4000). No Nia haruka sira fila.
verses.10: Depois Nia sae kedas roo ida ho Ninia eskolante sira, no Nia tama ba área Dalmanuta.
verses.11: No ema Farizeu sira mai no hahuu haksesuk malu ho Jesus. Sira husu Nia hatudu sinál hosi lalehan, atu koko Nia.
verses.12: Jesus dada iis boot iha Ninia espíritu, no dehan, “Tanba saa mak jerasaun nee buka sinál ida? Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, jerasaun nee sei la hetan sinál ida.”
verses.13: No Nia husik sira, sae roo fali no baa tasi sorin.
verses.14: Eskolante sira haluha atu lori paun. Sira iha paun fuan ida deit iha roo laran.
verses.15: No Jesus foo hanoin ba sira, no dehan, “Matan moris ba; kuidadu kona ba fermentu hosi ema Farizeu sira, no fermentu hosi Herodes.”
verses.16: No sira diskuti malu, no dehan, “Ida nee tanba paun la iha.”
verses.17: Bainhira Jesus hatene ida nee, Nia dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi koalia kona ba paun la iha? Imi seidauk hatene ka kompriende? Imi nia fuan laran sei toos hela ka?
verses.18: Imi iha matan maibee imi la haree ka? No imi iha tilun maibee imi la rona ka? No imi haluha ona ka?
verses.19: Bainhira Hau silu paun fuan lima no fahe ba ema rihun lima (5000), imi halibur hahaan restu too bote nakonu hira?” Sira dehan ba Nia, “Sanulu resin rua.”
verses.20: “No bainhira paun fuan hitu ba ema rihun haat (4000), imi halibur hahaan restu too bote boot nakonu hira?” No sira dehan, “Hitu.”
verses.21: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi seidauk kompriende ka?”
verses.22: Jesus ho ninia eskolante sira mai too iha Betsaida. No ema sira nee lori ema matan delek ba Nia, no sira husu Nia atu tau liman ba ema nee.
verses.23: No Jesus kaer ema matan delek nee nia liman no lori nia ba aldeia liur. Jesus tafui ba ema nee nia matan, no tau liman ba nia. Jesus husu ema nee, “O bele haree ona buat ruma ka?”
verses.24: Ema nee hateke ba, no dehan, “Hau haree ema hanesan ai huun sira nebee lao ba-mai hela.”
verses.25: Depois Jesus tau liman fali ba ema nee nia matan. No ema nee loke ninia matan no nia bele haree fali, no nia bele haree buat hotu ho mo-moos.
verses.26: Jesus haruka nia fila ba ninia uma, no dehan, “La bele tama ba aldeia nee.”
verses.27: Jesus kontinua lao ho ninia Eskolante sira ba aldeia sira nebee iha área Sezareia Filipe. No bainhira sira lao hela, Nia husu Ninia eskolante sira, no dehan ba sira, “Ema dehan Hau nee see?”
verses.28: No sira hataan, “João Batista; maibee balu dehan Elias; no ema seluk dehan ema ida hosi profeta sira.”
verses.29: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Maibee imi dehan katak Hau nee see?” No Pedro hataan no dehan ba Nia, “O mak Kristu.”
verses.30: Jesus manda sira katak sira la bele foo hatene ba ema ida kona ba Nia.
verses.31: Jesus komesa hanorin sira katak Ema Nia Oan tenki hetan terus barak. Ema katuas sira, xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira sei rejeita Nia no oho Nia. No liu tiha loron tolu Nia sei moris hias.
verses.32: Nia koalia mo-moos deit. No Pedro lori Nia ba sorin no komesa siak Nia.
verses.33: Maibee bainhira Jesus fila oin no hateke ba Ninia eskolante sira, Nia siak Pedro, no dehan, “Sees ba Hau nia kotuk, Satanás! Tanba o la hanoin tuir buat nebee Maromak nian, maibee tuir buat nebee ema nian.”
verses.34: No bainhira Jesus bolu ema lubun boot nee ba Nia ho Ninia eskolante sira mos, Nia dehan ba sira, “Ema nebee hakarak tuir Hau, nia tenki nega nia aan, lori nia krús no tuir Hau.
verses.35: Tanba ema nebee hakarak salva ninia moris, sei lakon ninia moris nee; no ema nebee lakon ninia moris, tanba Hau no tanba evanjelhu, nia sei hetan fali ninia moris nee.
verses.36: Tanba ida nee iha folin saida ba ema ida, se nia manaan mundu tomak maibee nia lakon ninia moris?
verses.37: Ka ema bele foo saida hodi troka ninia moris?
verses.38: Entaun ema nebee moe kona ba Hau no Hau nia liafuan iha jerasaun nee, nebee laran foer no sala nafatin, Ema Nia Oan sei moe kona ba ema nee bainhira Nia mai iha Ninia Aman nia glória ho anju santu sira.

verses.1: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Tebes Hau dehan ba imi katak ema balu nebee hamriik iha nee, sira sei la mate too sira haree Maromak nia reinu mai ho kbiit.”
verses.2: Liu tiha loron neen Jesus lori Pedro, Tiago no João, no sira sae ba foho aas, iha fatin nebee ema la iha. Depois Nia nakfilak aan iha sira nia oin.
verses.3: Ninia ropa sai nabilan no mutin liu. La iha ema ida iha mundu nebee bele fasi ropa hodi sai mutin hanesan nee.
verses.4: Depois Moisés no Elias mosu ba sira. No sira koalia ho Jesus.
verses.5: Pedro dehan ba Jesus, “Rabi, fatin iha nee diak hodi hela. Husik ami harii tenda tolu, ida ba O, ida ba Moisés, no ida ba Elias.”
verses.6: Pedro la hatene atu dehan saida; tanba sira tauk tebes.
verses.7: Depois kalohan mai no taka sira; no lian ida sai mai hosi kalohan nee no dehan, “Ida nee mak Hau nia Oan Mane nebee Hau hadomi. Rona Nia ba.”
verses.8: No derepenti, bainhira sira hateke haleu fatin nee, sira la haree ema ida ho sira, só Jesus deit.
verses.9: Bainhira sira tuun dadaun hosi foho, Jesus bandu sira atu la bele foo hatene ba ema ida kona ba buat nebee sira haree ona nee too Ema Nia Oan moris hias hosi mate.
verses.10: Sira kaer metin liafuan nee. Maibee sira husu ba malu kona ba liafuan ‘moris hias hosi mate’ nee iha signífika saida.
verses.11: Sira husu Jesus, “Tanba saa mak ema eskriba sira dehan katak Elias tenki mai uluk?”
verses.12: Nia hataan ba sira, “Elias sei mai uluk duni, no nia sei hadia buat hotu. Maibee tanba saa mak sira hakerek nanis ona kona ba Ema Nia Oan, katak Nia tenki hetan terus barak, no ema sei halakon Nia?
verses.13: Maibee Hau dehan ba imi, katak Elias mai tiha ona, no sira halo ba nia tuir sira nia hakarak hotu, no tuir liafuan nebee ema hakerek ona kona ba nia.”
verses.14: Bainhira sira fila fali ba eskolante sira seluk, Jesus haree ema lubun boot haleu eskolante sira nee. Eskriba sira haksesuk malu ho sira.
verses.15: No bainhira povu haree Jesus, sira hakfodak tebes, no sira halai kedas atu hasoru Nia.
verses.16: Nia husu eskriba sira, “Imi haksesuk malu ho sira kona ba saida?”
verses.17: Ema ida hosi ema lubun boot nee hataan, “Mestri, hau lori hau nia oan mane ba O tanba nia iha espíritu nebee halo nia monok.
verses.18: No bainhira espíritu nee hadau nia, espíritu nee soe nia ba rai. Ninia kabeen nafurin sai, nia ruun nehan no nia sai isin toos. Hau husu ona ba O nia eskolante sira hodi sira bele duni sai espíritu nee maibee sira la bele.”
verses.19: Jesus hataan ba ema nee, no dehan, “Oh jerasaun nebee la fiar, too bainhira mak Hau tenki hamutuk ho imi? Too bainhira mak Hau tenki hatudu pasiénsia ba imi? Lori nia mai Hau.”
verses.20: No sira lori nia ba Jesus. Bainhira nia haree Jesus, espíritu nee doko makaas labarik nee. Nia monu ba rai, no nia duir ba-mai ho kabeen nafurin sai hosi ninia ibun.
verses.21: Depois Jesus husu labarik nia aman, “Hori bainhira mak ida nee akontese ba nia?” No aman nee dehan, “Dezde nia sei kiik.
verses.22: Dala barak espíritu nee soe nia ba ahi no tasi laran hodi halakon nia. Maibee se O bele halo buat ruma, hanoin ami no ajuda ami ba.”
verses.23: Jesus dehan ba nia, “‘Se O bele’ ka! Buat hotu bele deit ba ema nebee fiar.”
verses.24: No labarik nia aman hakilar kedas, no dehan ho matan been, “Nai, hau fiar ona; ajuda ba bainhira hau la fiar!”
verses.25: Bainhira Jesus haree katak povu halai mai dadaun, Nia siak espíritu foer nee, no dehan ba nia, “Espíritu nebee halo ema nee sai monok no diuk, Hau manda o, sai mai hosi labarik nee, no la bele tama tan ba nia.”
verses.26: No espíritu nee hakilar no doko makaas labarik nee, no sai hosi nia. Labarik nee toba hanesan ema mate. No ema barak dehan, “Nia mate ona.”
verses.27: Maibee Jesus kaer ninia liman, foti nia no nia hamriik.
verses.28: Bainhira Jesus tama ona ba uma, no sira mesak ona, Ninia eskolante sira husu Nia, “Tanba saa mak ami la bele duni sai espíritu aat nee?”
verses.29: Nia dehan ba sira, “Atu duni sai espíritu nee la bele, só liu hosi orasaun deit mak bele.”
verses.30: Jesus ho Ninia eskolante sira sai hosi fatin nee, no lao liu hosi Galileia. No Jesus lakohi foo hatene ba ema seluk.
verses.31: Tanba Nia hanorin hela Ninia eskolante sira. Nia dehan ba sira, “Ema sei entrega Ema Nia Oan ba ema sira nia liman. Sira sei oho Nia no Nia sei mate. Liu tiha loron tolu Nia sei moris hias.”
verses.32: Maibee sira la kompriende liafuan nee, no sira tauk atu husu Nia.
verses.33: Sira baa too iha Kafarnaum. Bainhira sira tama uma laran, Jesus husu sira, “Ohin imi diskuti malu kona ba saida iha dalan klaran?”
verses.34: Maibee sira nonook deit. Tanba iha dalan nebaa sira diskuti malu kona ba see mak boot liu.
verses.35: Entaun Jesus tuur no bolu sira nain sanulu resin rua. Nia dehan ba sira, “Se ema ida hakarak sai ema primeiru, nunee nia tenki sai ema ikus liu, no sai atan ba ema hotu.”
verses.36: No Nia foti labarik kiik ida, no tau labarik nee iha sira nia leet. Bainhira Nia foti ona labarik nee iha Ninia liman, Nia dehan ba sira,
verses.37: “See deit mak simu labarik ida hanesan nee hodi Hau nia naran, nia simu mos Hau. No see deit nebee simu Hau, nia la simu Hau deit maibee nia simu mos Ida nebee haruka Hau.”
verses.38: João dehan ba Jesus, “Mestri, ami haree ema ida duni sai diabu sira hodi O nia naran. Entaun ami haruka nia para tanba nia la tuir ita.”
verses.39: Maibee Jesus dehan, “La bele haruka nia para. Tanba ema ida nebee halo milagre hodi Hau nia naran, nia la bele fila kedas atu koalia aat kona ba Hau.
verses.40: Tanba ema nebee la kontra imi mak hamutuk ho imi.
verses.41: See deit mak foo bee hemu kopu ida ba imi hodi Hau nia naran, tanba imi mak Kristu nian, tebes Hau dehan ba imi katak ema nee sei la lakon ninia kolen.”
verses.42: See deit mak halo kiik-oan ida nebee fiar Hau atu halo sala, diak liu ema kesi fatuk boot nebee dulas ai haan ba ninia kakorok no soe nia ba tasi laran.
verses.43: No se o nia liman halo o monu ba sala, tesi sai tiha liman sorin nee. Diak liu o tama ba moris ho liman sorin deit, duké o iha liman rua no tama ba infernu, iha fatin nebee ahi nunka mate.
verses.45: No se o nia ain halo o monu ba sala, tesi sai tiha ain nee. Diak liu o tama ba moris ho ain aat, duké o iha ain rua no sira soe o ba infernu, ba ahi nebee nunka mate.
verses.47: No se o nia matan halo o monu ba sala, fokit sai tiha matan sorin nee. Diak liu o tama ba Maromak nia reinu ho matan ida, duké o iha matan rua no sira soe o ba ahi infernu nian.
verses.48: Iha fatin nebaa ular oan la mate no ahi la mate.
verses.49: Tanba ahi sei kona ema ida-idak hanesan ema tau masin.
verses.50: Masin mak diak. Maibee se masin nee la meer, oinsaa halo masin nee sai meer fali? Imi tenki iha masin iha imi nia laran, no lori dame ba malu.”

verses.1: Depois Jesus sai hosi fatin nebaa, no Nia baa too iha área Judeia nian iha Jordaun nia sorin ba. Ema lubun boot sira baa halibur fali ba Nia. No Nia hanorin fali sira hanesan baibain.
verses.2: No ema Farizeu sira hakbesik ba Jesus hodi koko Nia. Sira husu Nia, “Tuir lo-loos, mane ida bele soe ninia feen ka lae?”
verses.3: Nia hataan ba sira, “Moisés foo ona orden saida ba imi?”
verses.4: No sira dehan, “Moisés foo lisensa hodi ema bele hakerek surat soe malu nian, depois nia bele soe ninia feen.”
verses.5: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Moisés hakerek regulamentu nee tanba imi nia fuan toos.
verses.6: Maibee hosi tempu hahuu iha kriasaun nee, ‘Maromak kria sira, mane no feto.’
verses.7: ‘Tanba nee mak mane ida sei husik ninia inan-aman, no nia sei hela hamutuk ho ninia feen.
verses.8: No sira nain rua sei sai isin ida deit.’ Nee duni, sira laos ema nain rua maibee sai ona isin ida deit.
verses.9: Tanba nee, buat nebee Maromak tau hamutuk, keta husik ema haketak.”
verses.10: Bainhira sira tama uma laran, Jesus nia eskolante sira husu Nia fali kona ba asuntu ida nee.
verses.11: No Nia dehan ba sira, “See deit mak soe ninia feen, no kaben fali ho ema seluk, nia halo adultériu hasoru ninia feen.
verses.12: No se feto ida soe ninia laen, no kaben fali ho ema seluk, nia mos halo adultériu.”
verses.13: Tuir mai, ema lori labarik kiik-oan sira ba Jesus hodi Nia bele tau liman ba sira. No Ninia eskolante siak sira.
verses.14: Maibee bainhira Jesus haree ida nee, Nia la kontenti, no dehan ba sira, “Husik labarik kiik-oan sira hakbesik mai Hau, no keta bandu sira. Tanba reinu lalehan mak sira nian.
verses.15: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, see deit nebee la simu Maromak nia reinu nudar labarik kiik-oan, nia sei la tama ba reinu nee.”
verses.16: Depois Nia hakuak labarik sira nee. Nia tau liman ba sira no foo bensaun ba sira.
verses.17: Bainhira Jesus lao dadaun iha dalan, ema ida halai mai, no hakneak ba Nia, no husu Nia, “Mestri Diak, hau tenki halo saida atu hetan moris rohan laek?”
verses.18: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Tanba saa mak o bolu Hau diak? La iha ida nebee diak, só Maromak mesak deit mak diak.
verses.19: O hatene ukun fuan sira, ‘Keta oho, keta halo sala seksuál, keta naok, keta foo sasin falsu, keta han-matak ema, foo onra ba o nia inan-aman.’”
verses.20: No ema nee hataan ba Nia, “Mestri, hau halo tuir buat hotu nee dezde hau sei kiik.”
verses.21: Jesus haree ema nee no hadomi nia, no dehan ba nia, “Buat ida deit mak o sei falta: baa deit, faan buat hotu nebee o iha, no foo ba ema kiak, no o sei hetan riku-soin iha lalehan. No mai, tuir Hau.”
verses.22: Ema nee sai tristi tanba liafuan nee, no nia fila ho laran susar tanba nia iha riku-soin barak.
verses.23: No Jesus hateke haleu fatin nee, no dehan ba ninia eskolante sira, “Susar tebe-tebes ba sira nebee iha riku-soin atu tama ba Maromak nia reinu!”
verses.24: Eskolante sira hakfodak ho Ninia liafuan. Maibee Jesus hataan fali, no dehan ba sira, “Oan sira, susar liu atu tama ba Maromak nia reinu!
verses.25: Fasil liu ba kuda kamelu atu tama liu hosi daun kuak, duké ema ida nebee riku atu tama ba Maromak nia reinu.”
verses.26: No sira hakfodak liu tan, no dehan ba Nia, “Entaun, see mak bele hetan salvasaun?”
verses.27: Jesus haree ba sira no dehan, “Ba ema, la bele; maibee laos ba Maromak: tanba ba Maromak, buat hotu bele deit.”
verses.28: Depois Pedro hahuu koalia ho Nia, “Tebes, ami husik ona buat hotu, no tuir O.”
verses.29: No Jesus hataan, “Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, ema hotu nebee husik uma, ka maun-alin sira, ka inan-aman, ka feen, ka oan sira, ka rai, tanba Hau no tanba evanjelhu,
verses.30: sira sei hetan iha tempu nee dala atus ida liu fali. Sira sei hetan uma sira, maun-alin sira, inan no oan sira, no rai, hamutuk ho difikuldade. No iha tempu nebee atu mai, sira sei hetan moris rohan laek.
verses.31: Maibee ema barak nebee primeiru sei sai ikus; no ema ikus sei sai fali primeiru.”
verses.32: Sira lao dadaun iha dalan hodi sae ba Jerusalém. Jesus lao uluk sira. Sira hakfodak, no ema sira nebee tuir Nia sai tauk. Jesus halibur sira nain sanulu resin rua, no komesa foo hatene fali ba sira kona ba buat nebee atu akontese ba Nia.
verses.33: Nia dehan, “Tebes, ita sae dadaun ba Jerusalém. No ema sei entrega Ema Nia Oan ba xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira. Sira sei tesi lia atu foo kastigu mate ba Nia, no entrega Nia ba ema Jentiu sira.
verses.34: No sira sei hamoe Nia, no tafui kabeen ba Nia, no baku Nia ho sikoti, no oho Nia. No liu tiha loron tolu, Nia sei moris hias.”
verses.35: Tiago no João, nebee Zebedeu nia oan sira, hakbesik ba Jesus, no dehan, “Mestri, ami hakarak O bele halo buat saida deit nebee ami husu ba O.”
verses.36: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi hakarak Hau halo saida ba imi?”
verses.37: Sira dehan ba Nia, “Foo fatin mai ami hodi ami bele tuur iha O nia sorin iha O nia glória - ema ida iha O nia liman loos no ema ida iha O nia liman karuk.”
verses.38: Maibee Jesus dehan ba sira, “Imi la hatene kona ba saida mak imi husu. Imi bele hemu hosi kopu nebee Hau hemu ka? No imi bele simu batizmu nebee Hau simu ka?”
verses.39: No sira dehan ba Nia, “Ami bele.” Jesus dehan ba sira, “Imi sei hemu duni hosi kopu nebee Hau hemu; no imi sei simu batizmu nebee Hau simu.
verses.40: Maibee atu tuur iha Hau nia liman loos no iha Hau nia liman karuk nee laos Hau nian atu foo. Aman sei foo fatin nee ba sira nebee Nia prepara ona atu foo.”
verses.41: No bainhira sira nain sanulu seluk rona ona kona ba ida nee, sira komesa sai hirus ho Tiago no João.
verses.42: Maibee Jesus bolu sira mai iha Nia, no dehan ba sira, “Imi hatene ona katak ema Jentiu sira nia xefi sira domina povu nee nudar povu nia nai. No sira nia ema boot sira diriji sira ho kbiit.
verses.43: Maibee imi keta halo hanesan nee. Ema nebee hakarak sai boot iha imi nia leet tenki serví imi.
verses.44: No ema nebee hakarak sai primeiru iha imi nia leet tenki sai atan ba ema hotu.
verses.45: Tanba Ema Nia Oan mos la mai hodi ema bele serví Nia, maibee Nia mai hodi Nia bele serví ema, no foo Ninia moris hodi hola fali ema barak.”
verses.46: No sira mai too iha Jerikó. Nia sai hosi Jerikó ho Ninia eskolante sira no ema barak hosi povu nee. No ema matan delek naran Bartimeu, nebee Timeu nia oan mane, tuur iha dalan ninin hodi husu ezmola.
verses.47: Bainhira nia rona katak ema nee mak Jesus hosi Nazaré, nia komesa hakilar, no nia dehan, “Jesus, David Nia Oan, hatudu laran luak mai hau!”
verses.48: Ema barak haruka nia sai nonook. Maibee nia hakilar makaas liu tan, “David Nia Oan, hatudu laran luak mai hau!”
verses.49: Jesus para no haruka sira bolu ema ida nee. No sira bolu ema matan delek nee, no dehan ba nia, “Aten brani no hamriik ba, tanba Nia bolu o.”
verses.50: Nia soe ninia manta no hamriik kedas no baa too iha Jesus.
verses.51: No Jesus hataan ba nia, “O hakarak Hau halo saida ba o?” Ema matan delek dehan ba Nia, “Rabi, halo hau haree fali.”
verses.52: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Baa deit; o nia fiar mak salva o.” Nia bele haree kedas, no nia tuir Jesus iha dalan.

verses.1: Bainhira sira besik ba Jerusalém, no sira too iha Betfage no Betánia, iha Foho Oliveira, Jesus haruka Ninia eskolante nain rua,
verses.2: no Nia dehan ba sira, “Tama ba aldeia iha oin nebaa. Imi sei hetan kedas kuda buru oan ida nebee kesi hela, nebee ema seidauk sae. Kore nia no lori mai.
verses.3: No se ema dehan ba imi, ‘Tanba saa mak imi halo nunee?’ imi sei dehan, ‘Nai presiza kuda buru nee,’ no nia sei haruka mai fali kedas.”
verses.4: Sira baa no hetan kuda buru oan ida nebee kesi hela iha dalan ninin, iha odamatan liur. No sira kore nia.
verses.5: No ema balu nebee hamriik iha nebaa husu sira, “Imi halo saida no tanba saa mak imi kore kuda buru oan nee?”
verses.6: Eskolante hataan ba ema sira iha nebaa tuir Jesus nia orden. Nunee ema sira nee husik sira baa deit.
verses.7: No sira lori kuda buru oan nee ba Jesus. Sira tau sira nia ropa iha kuda buru nia leten no Jesus sae kuda buru nee.
verses.8: Depois ema barak nahe sira nia ropa iha dalan. Ema seluk taa ai sanak sira iha nebaa no tau iha dalan.
verses.9: Sira nebee lao iha oin no sira nebee lao iha kotuk hakilar, “Hosana! Bensaun ba Nia nebee mai hodi Nai nia naran!
verses.10: Bensaun ba reinu nebee mai hosi ita nia aman David! Hosana iha fatin aas liu!”
verses.11: Jesus tama ba Jerusalém, no Nia tama iha Templu. Bainhira Nia haree ona ba buat hotu iha nebaa, no tempu liu ona, Nia sai hodi baa Betánia ho sira nain sanulu resin rua.
verses.12: Loron tuir mai, bainhira sira mai hosi Betánia, Jesus hamlaha.
verses.13: Nia haree hosi dook ai figeira huun ida nebee iha ai tahan. Nia baa hodi haree took, se ai figeira nee iha fuan ka lae. Maibee bainhira Nia too, Nia la hetan buat ida, só ai tahan deit. Tanba seidauk too tempu nebee ai figeira foo fuan.
verses.14: Jesus dehan ba ai figeira nee, “Ema sei la haan tan ai fuan hosi o too rohan laek.” No Ninia eskolante sira rona liafuan nee.
verses.15: Sira mai too iha Jerusalém no Jesus tama iha Templu. Nia komesa duni sai sira nebee faan no sosa iha Templu. Nia baku fila meza sira nebee ema uza hodi troka osan no banku nebee ema uza hodi faan manu pombu.
verses.16: No Nia la husik ema ida lori sasaan liu hosi Templu.
verses.17: Nia hanorin sira no dehan ba sira, “Laos ema hakerek nanis ona, ‘Ema sei hanaran Hau nia uma nudar uma orasaun nian ba nasaun hotu’? Maibee imi halo fatin nee sai fali naok-teen sira nia knuuk.”
verses.18: Xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira rona liafuan nee, no buka oinsaa sira bele halakon Jesus. Sira tauk Nia tanba ema lubun tomak hakfodak kona ba Ninia hanorin.
verses.19: No bainhira rai nakaras ona, sira sai hosi sidade nee.
verses.20: Iha dadeer-saan, bainhira sira lao hela iha dalan, sira haree ai figeira uluk nee maran tiha ona hosi ninia abut.
verses.21: Depois Pedro hanoin hetan no dehan ba Jesus, “Rabi, tebes, ai figeira nebee O foo malisan nee sai maran tiha ona.”
verses.22: No Jesus hataan ba sira, “Fiar ba Maromak.
verses.23: Tanba Hau dehan lo-loos ba imi, katak ema nebee dehan ba foho nee, ‘Hiit o nia aan, no soe aan ba tasi laran.’ No se nia la dúvida iha ninia fuan laran, maibee nia fiar katak buat sira nebee nia dehan sei akontese duni; nia sei hetan tuir buat nebee nia dehan.
verses.24: Nunee Hau dehan ba imi, buat saida deit mak imi husu liu hosi orasaun, fiar katak imi simu, no imi sei hetan duni.
verses.25: No bainhira imi hamriik hodi halo orasaun, foo perdua ba, se imi iha buat ruma nebee hasoru ema seluk. Nunee mos imi nia Aman iha lalehan bele foo perdua ba imi kona ba imi nia sala.”
verses.27: Sira mai fali too Jerusalém. Bainhira Jesus lao hela iha Templu laran, xefi saserdote sira, eskriba sira no katuas sira mai hasoru Nia.
verses.28: No sira dehan ba Nia, “Liu hosi kbiit ida nebee mak O halo buat sira nee? See mak foo kbiit nee ba O hodi halo buat sira nee?”
verses.29: No Jesus hataan no dehan ba sira, “Hau sei husu imi pergunta ida. Se imi hataan mai Hau, nunee Hau sei foo hatene ba imi liu hosi kbiit ida nebee mak Hau halo buat sira nee.
verses.30: Batizmu hosi João nee mai hosi lalehan, ka hosi ema? Hataan mai Hau lai.”
verses.31: No sira koalia ba malu no dehan, “Se ita dehan, ‘Hosi lalehan,’ Nia sei dehan ba ita, ‘Tanba saa mak imi la fiar nia?’
verses.32: Maibee se ita dehan, ‘Hosi ema’” - sira tauk povu nee, tanba ema hotu haree João nudar profeta ida duni.
verses.33: Sira hataan ba Jesus, “Ami la hatene.” No Jesus dehan ba sira, “Entaun Hau mos sei la foo hatene ba imi liu hosi kbiit ida nebee mak Hau halo buat sira nee.”

verses.1: Jesus komesa koalia ba sira liu hosi ai knanoik sira. “Mane ida kuda toos uvas ida. Nia halo lutu haleu toos nee. Nia kee rai kuak hodi halo fatin sama uvas no nia halo uma seguru ida. Nia foo aluga ba ema hodi servisu iha toos nee no nia baa rai dook.
verses.2: No tuir tempu nebee loos, nia haruka atan ida ba ema nebee servisu iha toos hodi nia bele simu toos uvas nia ai fuan hosi ema sira nee.
verses.3: Maibee sira kaer atan nee, baku nia, no haruka nia fila ho liman mamuk.
verses.4: Toos nain haruka atan ida fali. Maibee sira baku ninia ulun no hamoe nia.
verses.5: Toos nain haruka atan ida fali tan. Maibee sira oho nia. Sira halo hanesan nee ho atan barak - sira baku balu no oho balu.
verses.6: Toos nain nee iha ema ida tan - ninia oan mane nebee nia hadomi. Ikus liu, toos nain nee haruka oan nee ba sira, tanba nia dehan, ‘Sira sei respeita hau nia oan.’
verses.7: Maibee ema nebee servisu iha toos dehan ba malu, ‘Ida nee mak oan mane nebee simu toos nudar liman rohan. Mai, husik ita oho nia no liman rohan nee sei sai ita nian.’
verses.8: No sira kaer nia, oho nia, no soe nia sai hosi toos uvas.
verses.9: Nunee toos nain sei halo saida? Nia sei mai no halakon ema nebee servisu iha toos nee, no nia sei foo toos uvas nee ba ema seluk.
verses.10: Imi seidauk lee Eskritura nee ka?
verses.11: Nai mak halo ida nee,
verses.12: Nunee ema sira nee buka atu kaer Nia, maibee sira tauk povu nee. Tanba sira hatene katak Nia koalia ai knanoik nee hodi hasoru sira. Entaun sira husik Nia no sira sai.
verses.13: Sira haruka ema Farizeu no ema Herodes balu ba Jesus hodi buka sala ruma hosi Ninia liafuan.
verses.14: No bainhira sira too ba Jesus, sira dehan ba Nia, “Mestri, ami hatene katak Ita Boot mak loos. Ita Boot la tauk ema ida no la fihir ema nia oin. Maibee Ita Boot hanorin Maromak nia dalan ho lia loos. Entaun, ita tenki foo osan impostu ba César ka lae?
verses.15: Ita sei foo, ka ita la foo?” Maibee Jesus hatene sira nia laran makerek no Nia dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi koko Hau? Lori osan denáriu ida mai Hau, hodi Hau bele haree osan nee.”
verses.16: No sira lori osan ida mai. Nia dehan ba sira, “Figura nee see nian no naran nee see nian?” No sira dehan ba Nia, “César nian.”
verses.17: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Foo ba César buat nebee César nian, no foo ba Maromak buat nebee Maromak nian.” No sira admira Nia.
verses.18: Depois ema Saduseu sira mai hasoru Jesus. Nebee sira dehan katak ema mate sei la moris hias. No sira husu Jesus,
verses.19: “Mestri, Moisés hakerek ona ba ami katak se mane ida mate, no nia husik ninia feen, no oan sira la iha, entaun ninia maun ka alin tenki kaben ho ema mate nee nia feen, no hetan oan ba mane nee.
verses.20: Iha tempu ida, iha maun-alin nain hitu: no ida primeiru hola feto ida. Depois nia mate no la iha oan.
verses.21: Depois ida segundu kaben fali ho feto faluk nee, no nia mate no la iha oan. No hanesan nee mos ho ida terseiru.
verses.22: No sira nain hitu la iha oan. Ikus mai, feto nee mos mate.
verses.23: Iha tempu nebee ema moris hias ona, bainhira sira hadeer fali, feto nee sei sai see nia feen? Tanba sira nain hitu hotu hola nia.”
verses.24: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Laos imi koalia sala, tanba imi la hatene Eskritura ka Maromak nia kbiit?
verses.25: Tanba bainhira sira moris hias ona hosi mate, sira la kaben, no sira la foo feto atu kaben. Maibee sira sai hanesan anju sira iha lalehan.
verses.26: No kona ba ema mate bele moris hias: imi seidauk lee livru hosi Moisés ka? Maromak koalia ho nia hosi ai badak no dehan, ‘Hau mak Abraão nia Maromak, no Isak nia Maromak, no Jacó nia Maromak.’
verses.27: Nia laos Maromak ba ema mate, maibee Nia mak Maromak ba ema moris. Nunee, imi hanoin sala duni.”
verses.28: Depois ema ida hosi eskriba sira mai, no nia rona sira diskuti malu. Nia haree katak Jesus hataan ba sira ho liafuan nebee diak. Entaun nia husu Jesus, “Ukun fuan ida nebee mak uluk liu hotu?”
verses.29: Jesus hataan ba nia, “Ida nebee uluk liu ukun fuan hotu mak nee: ‘Rona ba, Oh Israel: Nai, ita nia Maromak, Nai mak ida deit.
verses.30: O tenki hadomi Nai, o nia Maromak, ho o nia laran tomak, o nia klamar tomak, o nia neon tomak, no o nia forsa tomak.’ Ida nee mak ukun fuan uluk liu.
verses.31: No ida segundu mak hanesan nee, nebee dehan, ‘O tenki hadomi o nia maluk hanesan o nia aan rasik.’ La iha ukun fuan seluk nebee boot liu ukun fuan rua nee.”
verses.32: Ema eskriba nee dehan ba Nia, “Ida nee loos, Mestri. O hatete lia loos. Tanba Maromak ida deit, no la iha tan Maromak seluk, só Nia deit.
verses.33: No hadomi Nia ho laran tomak, no kompriensaun tomak, no forsa tomak; no hadomi o nia maluk hanesan o nia aan rasik - hahalok nee mak importante liu sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu sira seluk.”
verses.34: Bainhira Jesus haree katak ema nee hataan ho matenek klean, Nia dehan ba ema nee, “O la dook hosi Maromak nia reinu.” No ema seluk la brani atu husu tan pergunta ba Nia.
verses.35: Bainhira Jesus hanorin hela iha Templu, Nia husu, “Oinsaa eskriba sira dehan katak Kristu mak oan mane hosi David?
verses.36: Tanba liu hosi Espíritu Santu David rasik dehan,
verses.37: David rasik bolu Nia Nai. Entaun oinsaa mak Nia David nia oan mane?” No ema lubun boot nee rona Nia ho laran kontenti.
verses.38: Bainhira Jesus hanorin hela sira, Nia dehan, “Kuidadu ho ema eskriba sira. Tanba sira gosta lao ba-mai ho ropa naruk no sira gosta simu kumprimentus iha merkadu.
verses.39: Sira gosta tuur iha kadeira diak liu iha sinagoga sira, no fatin nebee iha onra liu iha festa sira.
verses.40: Maibee sira hadau feto faluk sira nia uma. Sira finji halo orasaun nar-naruk. Ema sira nee sei hetan terus boot liu.
verses.41: Tuir mai, Jesus tuur iha tezourária nia oin. Nia haree oinsaa povu nee hatama osan iha tezourária. Ema barak nebee riku hatama osan barak.
verses.42: No feto faluk kiak ida mai. Feto nee hatama osan sentavu rua, nebee osan besi kiik ida.
verses.43: Jesus bolu ba Ninia eskolante sira, no dehan ba sira, “Tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, katak feto faluk kiak nee hatama barak liu fali oferta hosi ema seluk hotu nebee hatama osan ba tezourária.
verses.44: Tanba ema hotu hatama oferta hosi sira nia riku-soin resin. Maibee nia hatama buat hotu nebee nia iha, buat hotu nebee nia presiza hodi moris.”

verses.1: Bainhira Jesus sai dadaun hosi Templu, Ninia eskolante ida dehan ba Nia, “Mestri, haree took fatuk sira nee no uma sira nee!”
verses.2: No Jesus hataan ba nia, “O haree uma boot sira nee ka? La iha fatuk ida nebee husik hela iha fatuk seluk nia leten. Ema sei sobu hotu.”
verses.3: Bainhira Nia tuur iha Foho Oliveira nebee bele hateke ba Templu, Pedro, Tiago, João no André husu Nia mes-mesak,
verses.4: “Foo hatene mai ami, bainhira mak buat sira nee sei akontese? No sinál saida mak hatudu katak buat hotu nee besik atu kumpri?
verses.5: Jesus komesa hataan ba sira, “Kuidadu atu ema ida la bele lohi imi.
verses.6: Tanba ema barak sei mai hodi Hau nia naran, no dehan, ‘Hau mak Nia,’ no sira sei lohi ema barak.
verses.7: Bainhira imi rona kona ba funu sira no lia anin kona ba funu sira, imi keta tauk. Tanba buat sira nee tenki akontese, maibee tempu rohan seidauk too mai.
verses.8: Tanba nasaun ida sei hasoru nasaun seluk, no reinu ida sei hasoru reinu seluk. No rai sei nakdoko iha fatin balu. No fatin balu sei hetan rai hamlaha no tempu susar. Buat sira nee hatudu katak tempu susar foin hahuu.
verses.9: Maibee kuidadu aan, tanba sira sei entrega imi ba tribunál. No sira sei baku imi iha sinagoga sira. No imi tenki hamriik iha governadór no liurai sira nia oin tanba Hau nia naran, hodi foo sai testemunha ba sira.
verses.10: No ema sei haklaken uluk evanjelhu nee iha nasaun hotu.
verses.11: Maibee bainhira sira sei lori imi, no entrega imi ba tribunál, lalika preokupa kona ba saida mak imi sei koalia. Foo sai buat hotu nebee imi sei hetan iha tempu nebaa. Tanba nee laos imi nebee koalia, maibee Espíritu Santu.
verses.12: Maun ida sei faan ninia alin ba kastigu mate. No aman ida sei faan ninia oan. No oan sira sei hamriik hasoru sira nia inan-aman, no entrega sira ba kastigu mate.
verses.13: No ema hotu sei odi imi tanba Hau nia naran. Maibee ema nebee tahan too rohan sei hetan salvasaun.
verses.14: Maibee bainhira imi haree buat foer liu nebee estraga, nebee profeta Daniel foo sai nanis ona, no buat ida nee hamriik iha fatin nebee tuir lo-loos nia la bele, (husik nia nebee lee bele kompriende) nunee husik sira nebee iha Judeia halai ba foho.
verses.15: Ema nebee iha uma leten keta tuun ba uma laran, ka tama uma atu foti sasaan ida hosi ninia uma laran.
verses.16: Ema nebee iha toos laran keta fila fali atu foti ninia ropa.
verses.17: Maibee susar ba sira nebee isin rua, no ba sira nebee sei foo susu iha tempu nebaa!
verses.18: Halo orasaun ba atu ida nee la bele akontese iha tempu malirin.
verses.19: Tanba tempu nebaa mak tempu ida nebee terus makaas, nebee seidauk akontese dezde mundu hahuu, no ida nee sei la akontese tan iha tempu tuir mai.
verses.20: Se karik Nai la habadak tempu nee, la iha ema ida nebee bele hetan salvasaun. Maibee Nia sei habadak tempu nee tanba sira nebee Nia hili ona.
verses.21: Se ema ruma dehan ba imi, ‘Haree ba, Kristu iha nee!’ ka ‘Haree ba, Nia iha nebaa!’ imi keta fiar.
verses.22: Tanba kristu falsu sira no profeta falsu sira sei hamriik, no sira sei hatudu sinál no milagre oi-oin atu lohi, se bele karik, sira nebee Maromak hili ona.
verses.23: Maibee matan moris ba: Hau foo hatene nanis ona ba imi kona ba buat nee hotu.
verses.24: Maibee iha tempu nebaa, tuir tempu terus nee, loro matan sei sai nakukun, no fulan sei la foo naroman.
verses.25: Fitun sira sei monu hosi lalehan, no kbiit sira nebee iha lalehan sei nakdoko.
verses.26: Depois sira sei haree Ema Nia Oan mai iha kalohan sira ho kbiit no glória boot.
verses.27: Depois Nia sei haruka Ninia anju sira, no sira sei halibur hamutuk ema sira nebee Nia hili ona hosi fatin hotu, hosi fatin nebee dook liu iha mundu too fatin nebee dook liu iha lalehan.
verses.28: Aprende lai ai knanoik ida hosi ai figeira nee: bainhira ninia sanak foin nurak, no tahan sira foin dikin, imi hatene katak tempu bailoron besik ona.
verses.29: Nunee hanesan mos ba imi, bainhira imi haree buat sira akontese ona, imi bele hatene katak Nia besik ona, no too ona iha portaun.
verses.30: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, jerasaun nee sei la lakon, too buat hotu nee akontese ona.
verses.31: Lalehan no mundu sei lakon, maibee Hau nia liafuan sei nunka lakon.
verses.32: “Maibee la iha ema ida nebee hatene loron ka oras nee, inklui mos anju sira iha lalehan no Oan Mane. Só Aman deit mak hatene.
verses.33: Matan moris nafatin ba, halo orasaun no keta dukur. Tanba imi la hatene bainhira tempu nee sei mai.
verses.34: Tanba ida nee hanesan ema ida nebee halo viajen dook, no nia husik ninia uma. Nia foo knaar ba ninia atan sira, no servisu ba ema ida-idak, no nia haruka ema nebee hein portaun atu matan moris nafatin.
verses.35: Nunee matan moris nafatin ba. Tanba imi la hatene bainhira uma nain atu mai. Karik nia mai iha rai nakaras, kalan boot, tempu manu kokoreek, ka iha dadeer.
verses.36: Keta halo be Nia mai derepenti deit no hetan imi dukur.
verses.37: No buat nebee Hau dehan ba imi Hau dehan ba ema hotu: Matan moris ba!”

verses.1: Iha loron rua tan, sira selebra Páskua no Festa Paun Fermentu Laek. No xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira buka dalan atu kaer Jesus sub-subar no oho Nia.
verses.2: Maibee sira dehan, “La bele halo ida nee iha tempu festa nian, hodi povu la sai hirus.”
verses.3: Jesus baa iha Betánia no tama ba Simão Ema Lepra nia uma. Bainhira Jesus tuur hodi haan, feto ida mai ho botir alabastro nebee iha mina morin nardu moos. Mina morin nee karun tebes. Feto nee harahun botir no fui mina ba Jesus nia ulun.
verses.4: Ema balu sai hirus, no dehan, “Tanba saa mak nia estraga deit mina morin nee?
verses.5: Tanba ita bele faan mina morin nee ho folin osan denáriu atus tolu resin no foo ba ema kiak.” No sira siak feto nee.
verses.6: Jesus dehan, “Husik nia ba. Tanba saa mak imi halo susar ba feto nee? Nia halo buat diak mai Hau.
verses.7: Tanba imi sempre iha ema kiak ho imi, no iha tempu saida deit imi bele halo diak ba sira. Maibee imi sei la iha Hau nafatin.
verses.8: Nia halo buat nebee nia bele halo. Nia fui mina morin ba Hau nia isin lolon molok atu hakoi isin nee.
verses.9: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, iha fatin hotu iha mundu tomak nebee ema haklaken evanjelhu nee, sira mos konta buat nebee feto nee halo ona hodi hanoin fali nia.”
verses.10: No Judas Iskariotes, ema ida hosi sira nain sanulu resin rua, baa xefi saserdote sira hodi faan Jesus ba sira.
verses.11: Bainhira sira rona, sira haksolok, no sira promete atu foo osan mutin ba nia. No Judas buka tempu diak atu faan Jesus.
verses.12: Iha loron primeiru iha Festa Paun Fermentu Laek nian, bainhira sira halo sakrifísiu Páskua nian, Jesus nia eskolante sira dehan ba Nia, “O hakarak ami baa nebee atu prepara fatin hodi O bele haan Páskua?”
verses.13: Jesus haruka Ninia eskolante nain rua, no Nia dehan ba sira, “Tama ba sidade, no iha nebaa imi sei hetan mane ida nebee lori bee iha sanan rai ida. Tuir nia ba.
verses.14: No iha fatin nebee nia sei tama, imi dehan ba uma nain, ‘Mestri dehan, Hau nia salaun iha nebee, hodi Hau bele haan Páskua ho Hau nia eskolante sira?’
verses.15: No nia sei hatudu imi salaun boot iha andar leten nebee iha ona sasaan no prontu ona. Imi bele prepara iha nebaa ba ita.”
verses.16: Ninia eskolante sira lao ba no tama ba sidade. Sira hetan buat hotu tuir Ninia liafuan nebee Nia hatete ona ba sira. No sira prepara ba Páskua.
verses.17: Bainhira kalan ona, Jesus mai ho sira nain sanulu resin rua.
verses.18: Bainhira sira tuur no haan hela, Jesus dehan, “Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, katak ema ida hosi imi, nebee haan hamutuk ho Hau, sei faan Hau.”
verses.19: Sira komesa sai tristi, no ida-idak husu Nia, “Ida nee mak hau ka?”
verses.20: Jesus hataan no dehan ba sira, “Imi nain sanulu resin rua nee ida mak nia. Ida nebee hatama ninia liman iha bikan hamutuk ho Hau.
verses.21: Tanba Ema Nia Oan sei baa duni, tuir liafuan nebee hakerek nanis ona kona ba Nia. Maibee susar ba ema ida nebee faan Ema Nia Oan! Diak liu se ema nee nunka moris mai.”
verses.22: Bainhira sira haan hela, Jesus foti paun no Nia foo bensaun. Depois Nia silu paun nee, foo ba sira no dehan, “Simu no haan ba. Nee mak Hau nia isin.”
verses.23: No Nia foti kopu ida no foo agradese. Depois Nia foo kopu nee ba sira no sira hotu hemu hosi kopu nee.
verses.24: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Nee mak Hau nia raan ba aliansa foun, nebee fakar tanba ema barak.
verses.25: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, Hau sei la hemu tan hosi uvas fuan nee too loron nebee Hau hemu foun fali iha Maromak nia reinu.”
verses.26: Bainhira sira hananu tiha knananuk ida, sira sai ba Foho Oliveira.
verses.27: No Jesus dehan ba sira, “Imi hotu sei monu, tanba ema hakerek nanis ona, ‘Hau sei baku bibi atan, no bibi sira sei halai namkari.’
verses.28: Maibee bainhira Hau moris hias ona, Hau sei baa Galileia uluk liu imi.”
verses.29: Pedro hataan ba Nia, “Maski ema hotu monu, maibee hau lae.”
verses.30: Jesus dehan ba Pedro, “Tebes Hau dehan ba o, katak iha kalan nee, molok manu kokoreek dala rua, o sei nega Hau dala tolu.”
verses.31: Maibee Pedro koalia makaas liu tan, “Maski hau tenki mate ho O, hau sei nunka nega O.” No sira hotu dehan hanesan.
verses.32: Depois sira baa fatin naran Getsemani. No Jesus dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Tuur iha nee, no Hau sei halo orasaun.”
verses.33: Jesus lori Pedro, Tiago no João, no Nia hahuu sai laran taridu no laran susar tebes.
verses.34: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Hau nia laran tristi tebe-tebes, too atu mate. Hein iha nee, no hadeer nafatin ba.”
verses.35: Nia baa tan uitoan, no Nia monu ba rai. Nia halo orasaun katak, se bele karik, tempu nee sei sai hosi Nia.
verses.36: No nia dehan, “Apaa, Aman, buat hotu bele deit ba O. Hasai tiha kopu nee hosi Hau. Laos tuir Hau nia hakarak, maibee tuir O nia hakarak.”
verses.37: Depois Nia fila ba eskolante sira, no Nia hetan sira toba dukur hela. Nia dehan ba Pedro, “Simão, o toba dukur hela ka? O la bele hadeer too oras ida deit ka?
verses.38: Matan moris ba no halo orasaun nafatin, hodi imi la monu ba tentasaun. Espíritu hakarak, maibee isin fraku.”
verses.39: Nia hadook aan fali no halo orasaun, no Nia koalia liafuan hanesan.
verses.40: No Nia fila fali mai no hetan sira toba dukur fali. Tanba sira nia matan dukur loos, no sira la hatene oinsaa atu hataan ba Nia.
verses.41: Nia mai fali ba dala tolu, no dehan ba sira, “Imi toba dukur no deskansa hela ka? Too ona! Oras nee mai ona. Ema atu faan Ema Nia Oan ba sala nain sira nia liman.
verses.42: Hamriik ba, no husik ita baa lai. Tebes, Hau nia traidór besik mai ona.”
verses.43: Bainhira Jesus koalia dadaun, Judas, nebee hosi sira nain sanulu resin rua, too mai. Nia mai ho ema lubun boot nebee lori surik no ai dona. Sira mai hosi xefi saserdote sira, eskriba sira no katuas sira.
verses.44: No traidór nee prepara ona sinál ba sira, no dehan, “Ema nebee hau sei rei, Nia mak nee. Kaer metin Nia no lori Nia sai.”
verses.45: Nia hakbesik kedas ba Jesus, no dehan, “Rabi, Rabi!” No nia rei Jesus.
verses.46: No sira tau liman ba Jesus hodi kaer Nia.
verses.47: Maibee ema ida nebee hamriik besik losu ninia surik no taa saserdote boot nia atan no tesi sai atan nee nia tilun.
verses.48: No Jesus hataan no dehan ba sira, “Imi sai mai atu hasoru naok-teen ka? Tanba nee imi mai ho surik no ai dona sira hodi kaer Hau ka?
verses.49: Loro-loron Hau hamutuk ho imi no hanorin iha Templu, no imi la kaer Hau. Maibee husik ita kumpri Eskritura sira nee.
verses.50: Depois sira hotu husik Nia, no halai.
verses.51: Iha joven mane ida nebee tuir Jesus. Nia hatais deit hena linhu ida. Sira kaer nia,
verses.52: maibee nia husik ninia hena linhu no halai ho isin tanan.
verses.53: Sira lori Jesus sai ba saserdote boot. Xefi saserdote hotu no katuas sira no eskriba sira halibur hamutuk.
verses.54: Maibee Pedro tuir Jesus hosi dook too iha saserdote boot nia pátiu laran. Nia tuur ho guarda sira hodi haneruk ahi.
verses.55: No xefi saserdote sira no tribunál buka testemunha atu hasoru Jesus hodi kastigu mate Nia, maibee sira la hetan ida.
verses.56: Tanba sasin falsu barak mai foo testemunha hasoru Nia, maibee sira nia liafuan la haan malu.
verses.57: Ema balu hamriik no foo sasin falsu hasoru Nia, no dehan,
verses.58: “Ami rona ona katak Nia dehan, ‘Hau sei sobu Templu nee, nebee halo ho liman, no iha loron tolu nia laran Hau sei harii ida seluk nebee la halo ho liman.’”
verses.59: Maibee sira nia liafuan nee mos la haan malu.
verses.60: No saserdote boot hamriik iha sira nia leet. Nia husu Jesus, no dehan, “O la hataan buat ida ka? Saida mak nee, nebee sasin sira nee foo sai hasoru O?”
verses.61: Maibee Jesus nonook hela deit, no la hataan buat ida. Saserdote boot husu fali Nia, no dehan ba Nia, “O mak Kristu nebee Oan Mane Hosi Adora Nain ka?”
verses.62: No Jesus dehan, “Hau mak nee, no imi sei haree Ema Nia Oan tuur iha Kbiit Nain nia liman loos, no Nia sei mai hosi lalehan ho kalohan.”
verses.63: Nunee saserdote boot lees ninia ropa, no dehan, “Tanba saa mak ita presiza sasin tan?
verses.64: Imi rona ona liafuan aat hasoru Maromak! Imi hanoin saida?” No sira hotu desidi katak Nia merese atu simu kastigu mate.
verses.65: No balu komesa tafui kabeen ba Nia no taka Ninia oin. Sira tuku Nia no dehan ba Nia, “Profesia ba!” No guarda sira baku Nia ho sira nia liman.
verses.66: Pedro sei iha pátiu iha kraik, no saserdote boot nia atan feto ida mai.
verses.67: Bainhira atan feto nee haree Pedro haneruk hela ahi, nia hateke ba Pedro, no dehan, “Ita mos hamutuk ho Jesus hosi Nazaré.”
verses.68: Maibee nia nega liafuan nee no dehan, “Hau la hatene ka kompriende buat nebee mak o dehan.” Nunee nia sai ba portaun. No manu kokoreek.
verses.69: Depois atan feto haree fali nia, no komesa dehan ba sira nebee hamriik besik, “Ema ida nee mai hosi sira.”
verses.70: No nia nega fali liafuan nee. Tuir mai, sira nebee hamriik besik nia dehan fali ba Pedro, “Tebes, o mos ema ida hosi sira. Tanba o mak ema Galileia.”
verses.71: Maibee nia komesa foo malisan no jura, no nia dehan, “Hau la konhese mane ida nebee imi koalia dadaun nee.”
verses.72: No manu kokoreek kedas ba dala rua. Pedro hanoin hetan fali liafuan nebee Jesus dehan ba nia, “Molok manu kokoreek ba dala rua, o sei nega Hau dala tolu.” No bainhira nia hanoin ida nee, nia tanis.

verses.1: Bainhira dadeer ona, xefi saserdote sira koalia hamutuk ho katuas sira, eskriba sira no tribunál tomak. Sira kesi Jesus no lori Nia sai no entrega Nia ba Pilatos.
verses.2: Pilatos husu Jesus, “O mak ema Judeu nia liurai ka?” Jesus hataan ba nia, “Ita rasik mak hatete nunee.”
verses.3: Depois xefi saserdote sira akuza Jesus kona ba buat barak. Maibee Jesus la hataan buat ida.
verses.4: Pilatos husu fali Nia, no dehan, “O sei la hataan buat ida ka? Tebes, sira kesar buat barak hasoru O.”
verses.5: Maibee Jesus la hataan buat ida. Nunee Pilatos hakfodak.
verses.6: Baibain iha festa nee, Pilatos husik ema ida atu sai hosi kastigu. Nia husik ema ida nebee povu hili.
verses.7: No sira iha ema dadur ida, naran Barabás. Nia iha kastigu hela ho sira nebee kontra governu. Tanba nia oho ema iha tempu nebee sira kontra governu.
verses.8: No ema lubun nee mai no hakilar hodi komesa husu Pilatos atu halo hanesan baibain nia halo ba sira.
verses.9: Maibee Pilatos hataan ba sira, no dehan, “Imi hakarak hau husik ema Judeu sira nia Liurai ka?”
verses.10: Tanba Pilatos hatene katak xefi saserdote sira entrega Jesus ba nia tanba sira laran moras.
verses.11: Maibee xefi saserdote sira soran ema lubun nee atu husu Pilatos husik fali Barabás ba sira.
verses.12: No Pilatos hataan no dehan fali ba sira, “Entaun hau sei halo saida ho mane ida nebee imi bolu ema Judeu sira nia Liurai?”
verses.13: No sira hakilar fali, “Prega Nia ba krús!”
verses.14: Pilatos dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak, Nia halo aat saida?” Maibee sira hakilar makaas liu tan, “Prega Nia ba krús!”
verses.15: Pilatos hakarak halo ema lubun nee kontenti, entaun nia husik Barabás ba sira, no entrega Jesus ba kastigu. Pilatos haruka ema baku Jesus ho sikote no lori Nia atu prega Nia ba krús.
verses.16: No soldadu sira lori Jesus ba palásiu, nebee governadór nia postu, no sira halibur tropas hotu.
verses.17: Sira foo hatais Nia ho hena kór uvas. Sira bobar ai tarak hodi halo koroa ida no tau ba Nia.
verses.18: No sira komesa kumprimenta Nia, no dehan, “Viva, Liurai hosi ema Judeu sira!”
verses.19: No sira baku Ninia ulun ho fafulu kain ida. Sira tafui ba Nia no hakneak hodi adora Nia.
verses.20: No bainhira sira hamoe ona Nia, sira kolu hena kór uvas hosi Nia no foo hatais Nia ho Ninia ropa rasik. Depois sira lori Nia sai atu prega Nia ba krús.
verses.21: Sira obriga ema ida naran Simão hosi Sirene, nebee lao liu fatin nee hosi foho, atu lori Jesus nia krús. Simão mak Alexandre no Rufus nia aman.
verses.22: No sira lori Jesus ba fatin naran Golgota (nee katak Ulun Ruin).
verses.23: Sira foo tua uvas kahur ho mina mira ba Jesus atu hemu, maibee Nia la simu ida nee.
verses.24: Depois sira prega Nia ba krús. No sira fahe Ninia ropa. Sira dada rifa atu hatene see mak hetan ropa ida nebee.
verses.25: Sira prega Nia ba krús iha tuku sia dadeer.
verses.26: Avizu iha Ninia ulun leten nebee akuza Nia dehan, “Ema Judeu nia Liurai.”
verses.27: Sira prega naok-teen nain rua ba krús ho Jesus. Ida iha Nia liman loos no ida seluk iha Nia liman karuk.
verses.29: Ema sira nebee lao liu fatin nee koalia aat ba Nia. Sira doko sira nia ulun, no dehan, “Ha! O nebee bele harahun Templu, no harii fali iha loron tolu nia laran.
verses.30: Salva aan ba! Tuun mai hosi krús.”
verses.31: Hanesan nee mos xefi saserdote sira hamoe Nia. Sira dehan ba malu, ho eskriba sira, “Nia salva ona ema seluk, maibee Nia la bele salva Nia aan rasik!
verses.32: Husik Kristu nee, Liurai hosi Israel, tuun mai agora hosi krús. Ho ida nee ita bele haree no fiar.” No sira nebee iha krús ho Nia mos goza Nia.
verses.33: Bainhira meiudia, nakukun taka rai tomak too tuku tolu lokraik.
verses.34: Iha tuku tolu lokraik, Jesus hakilar ho lian makaas, no dehan, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” katak, ‘Hau nia Maromak, Hau nia Maromak, tanba saa mak O husik Hau?’
verses.35: Ema balu nebee hamriik iha nebaa rona Nia no dehan, “Tebes, Nia bolu Elias.”
verses.36: Ema ida halai no foti esponza ida, habokon iha tua siin no tau iha fafulu kain ida hodi foo hemu ba Nia, no dehan, “Husik ba. Ita haree took, se Elias mai atu hatuun Nia ka lae.”
verses.37: Depois Jesus hakilar ho lian makaas, no Nia iis kotu.
verses.38: No Templu nia veo naklees fahe ba rua hosi leten too kraik.
verses.39: Bainhira komandante, nebee hamriik iha Jesus nia oin, haree oinsaa Nia iis kotu, komandante dehan, “Tebes, mane ida nee mak Maromak nia Oan.”
verses.40: Feto balu haree hosi dook. Feto sira nee inklui Maria Madalena, no Maria nebee Tiago Kiik no José nia inan, no Salome.
verses.41: Uluk, bainhira Jesus iha Galileia, sira tuir Nia no serví Nia. No feto barak seluk sae mai ba Jerusalém ho Jesus.
verses.42: Bainhira rai nakaras ona, no tanba loron nee mak loron preparasaun, nebee loron molok loron Sabdu,
verses.43: iha ema ida naran José hosi Arimateia nebee mai. Ema respeita nia, no nia mak ema nebee membru ida iha tribunál. Nia mos hein Maromak nia reinu. Nia baa ho aten brani ba Pilatos, no husu Jesus nia mate isin.
verses.44: Pilatos hakfodak katak Jesus mate tiha ona. Nia bolu ba ninia komandante no husu se Jesus mate ona ka lae.
verses.45: No bainhira nia hatene ona hosi komandante, nia foo mate isin nee ba José.
verses.46: Nunee José lori hena linhu diak no nia hatuun Jesus. Nia falun Jesus iha hena linhu nee. Depois nia rai Jesus iha rate nebee kee hosi fatuk. No nia duir fatuk boot ida hodi taka rate nia odamatan.
verses.47: Maria Madalena no Maria nebee José nia inan haree fatin nebee sira hatoba Jesus.

verses.1: Liu tiha loron Sabdu, Maria Madalena, Maria nebee Tiago nia inan, no Salome lori buat morin hodi kose ba Jesus nia mate isin.
verses.2: No iha dadeer-saan sedu iha loron primeiru iha semana nee, bainhira loro matan foin sae, sira baa too rate.
verses.3: No sira dehan ba malu, “See mak bele duir sai fatuk hosi rate nia odamatan?”
verses.4: No bainhira sira hateke ba, sira haree katak fatuk nee duir sai ona. Maibee fatuk nee boot tebes.
verses.5: Sira tama ba rate no haree joven mane ida nebee tuur hela iha sorin loos. Nia hatais ropa naruk nebee mutin. No sira tauk.
verses.6: Nia dehan ba sira, “Keta tauk. Imi buka Jesus hosi Nazaré, nebee ema prega ona ba krús. Nia moris hias ona; Nia laos iha nee. Haree fatin nebee sira hatoba Nia.
verses.7: Maibee imi baa deit. No foo hatene ba Ninia eskolante sira, inklui mos Pedro, katak Nia baa Galileia uluk imi. Imi sei haree Nia iha nebaa, tuir Ninia liafuan ba imi.”
verses.8: Sira sai lalais no halai hosi rate tanba sira nakdedar no hakfodak. No sira la foo hatene buat ida ba ema ida tanba sira tauk.
verses.9: [Iha loron primeiru, iha dadeer-saan, bainhira Jesus moris hias ona, Nia hatudu aan primeiru ba Maria Madalena. Uluk Nia duni sai diabu hitu hosi Maria nee.
verses.10: No Maria baa no foo hatene ba sira nebee uluk hamutuk ho Jesus tanba sira halerik no tanis hela.
verses.11: Bainhira sira rona katak Jesus moris hias ona no Maria haree ona Nia, sira la fiar.
verses.12: Liu tiha buat sira nee, Jesus hatudu aan ho ilas oin seluk ba sira nain rua. Sira lao dadaun atu baa foho.
verses.13: Nunee ema nain rua nee fila fali no foo hatene ba sira seluk. Maibee sira la fiar nain rua nee.
verses.14: Tuir mai, Jesus hatudu aan ba sira nain sanulu resin ida bainhira sira tuur dadaun iha meza. Nia hasee sira tanba sira la fiar no iha laran toos. Tanba sira la fiar ema nebee haree ona Nia bainhira Nia moris hias ona.
verses.15: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Baa mundu tomak, no foo sai evanjelhu ba kriasaun hotu-hotu.
verses.16: Nia nebee fiar no simu batizmu sei hetan salvasaun. Maibee nia nebee la fiar sei hetan kastigu.
verses.17: No sinál sira nee sei tuir sira nebee fiar: hodi Hau nia naran sira sei duni sai diabu sira, koalia ho lian foun sira,
verses.18: foti samea sira; no se sira hemu veneno, ida nee sei la halo sira moras; no sira sei tau liman ba ema moras, no ema nee sei sai diak fali.”
verses.19: Bainhira Nai Jesus koalia ona ba sira, Nia sae ba lalehan, no tuur iha Maromak nia liman loos.
verses.20: No sira lao ba, no haklaken iha fatin hotu-hotu. Nai servisu ho sira, no hametin liafuan nee ho sinál sira.]

verses.1: Ema barak koko ona atu halibur informasaun kona ba buat nebee akontese ona iha ita nia leet.
verses.2: Sira nebee sasin hosi uluk kedas no atan ba liafuan nee mak hatoo fali ba ita.
verses.3: Nunee hau, nudar ema nebee tuir di-diak buat hotu nee kleur ona, hanoin mos diak atu hakerek tu-tuir buat hirak nee ba o, Teofilo, nebee hau respeita.
verses.4: Hodi nunee, o bele hatene metin liafuan nebee ema hanorin ona ba o.
verses.5: Iha tempu nebee Herodes mak liurai iha Judeia, iha saserdote ida naran Zakarias. Nia mai hosi grupu Abia nian. Ninia feen mak Isabel, nebee mai hosi Arão nia jerasaun.
verses.6: Sira nain rua mak ema loos iha Maromak nia oin. Sira iha hahalok loos no lao tuir Nai nia ukun fuan no estatutu hotu.
verses.7: Sira la iha oan tanba Isabel la bele kous. No sira nain rua idade liu ona.
verses.8: Iha loron ida, Zakarias serví nudar saserdote iha Maromak nia oin tuir ninia grupu nia knaar.
verses.9: Tuir kostumi saserdote nian, sira dada rifa no rifa monu ba Zakarias atu tama Nai nia Templu no sunu insensu.
verses.10: Ema lubun tomak hosi povu nee halo hela orasaun iha liur iha oras sunu insensu nian.
verses.11: No Nai nia anju ida mosu ba Zakarias no hamriik iha altár insensu nia sorin loos.
verses.12: Bainhira Zakarias haree anju nee, nia nakdedar no sai tauk.
verses.13: Maibee anju dehan ba nia, “Keta tauk, Zakarias, tanba Maromak rona ona o nia orasaun. O nia feen Isabel sei kous oan mane ida. No o sei hanaran nia João.
verses.14: No o sei sai kontenti no haksolok. Ema barak sei haksolok bainhira nia moris mai.
verses.15: Tanba nia sei sai boot iha Nai nia oin. Nia sei la hemu tua uvas ka tua seluk. No dezde nia iha ninia inan nia oan fatin nia sei sai nakonu ho Espíritu Santu.
verses.16: Nia sei halo ema Israel barak fila fali ba Nai, sira nia Maromak.
verses.17: No nia sei lao iha Nai nia oin ho espíritu no kbiit hosi Elias, atu halo aman sira nia fuan laran fila ba sira nia oan sira, no halo ema nebee la rona tuir atu fila ba matenek klean hosi ema loos. Nunee nia sei prepara povu ida ba Nai.”
verses.18: Zakarias dehan ba anju, “Oinsaa mak hau bele hatene ida nee? Tanba hau katuas ona, no hau nia feen mos idade liu ona.”
verses.19: No anju hataan ba nia, “Hau mak Gabriel, nebee hamriik iha Maromak nia prezensa. Nia haruka hau atu koalia ho o no hatoo liafuan diak nee ba o.
verses.20: No tebes, o sei sai monok no la bele koalia too loron nebee buat sira nee akontese. Tanba o la fiar hau nia liafuan, nebee sei kumpri tuir liafuan nee nia tempu.”
verses.21: Povu nee hein hela Zakarias. Sira hakfodak tanba nia hela kleur iha Templu laran.
verses.22: No bainhira nia sai mai, nia la bele koalia ba sira. Nunee sira hatene katak nia haree vizaun ida iha Templu laran. Tanba nia halo sinál ba sira maibee nia monok nafatin.
verses.23: Tuir mai, bainhira ninia loron ministériu hotu ona, nia sai ba ninia uma rasik.
verses.24: Liu tiha tempu nebaa, Zakarias nia feen Isabel sai isin rua. Nia subar aan too fulan lima no dehan,
verses.25: “Nai halo nunee mai hau iha tempu nebee Nia haree hau, atu hasai hau nia moe iha ema nia leet.”
verses.26: Liu tiha fulan neen, Maromak haruka anju Gabriel ba sidade ida naran Nazaré iha Galileia,
verses.27: atu baa feto raan ida nebee troka prenda ona ho mane ida naran José. José mai hosi David nia jerasaun. Feto raan nee nia naran Maria.
verses.28: Anju ida nee mai ba Maria, no dehan, “Salóm, o nebee hetan bensaun boot. Nai hamutuk ho o.”
verses.29: Bainhira Maria haree anju, nia laran nakdedar kona ba liafuan nee. Nia koko atu kompriende kumprimentu nee dehan saida loos.
verses.30: Anju dehan ba nia, “Keta tauk, Maria. Tanba o hetan ona grasa ho Maromak.
verses.31: No tebes, o sei sai isin rua, no tuur ahi oan mane ida. O sei hanaran Nia Jesus.
verses.32: Nia sei sai boot tebes, no sira sei bolu Nia ‘Ida Nebee Aas Liu nia Oan’, no Nai Maromak sei foo Ninia aman David nia kadunan ba Nia.
verses.33: Nia sei ukun Jacó nia uma kain too tinan ba tinan, no Ninia reinu sei la iha rohan.”
verses.34: Depois Maria dehan ba anju, “Oinsaa mak ida nee bele akontese, tanba hau seidauk toba ho mane ida?”
verses.35: Anju hataan no dehan ba nia, “Espíritu Santu sei tuun mai ba o, no kbiit hosi Ida Nebee Aas Liu sei hamahon o. Nee duni, Oan nebee atu moris mai nee mak santu. Nia mak Maromak nia Oan.
verses.36: No tebes, o nia prima Isabel, maski nia ferik ona, mos kous oan mane ida. Ema dehan nia kous la bele, maibee nia isin rua fulan neen ona.
verses.37: Tanba ho Maromak la iha buat ida nebee la bele.”
verses.38: Maria dehan, “Tebes, hau mak Nai nia atan feto. Husik Nia halo tuir ita boot nia liafuan mai hau.” No anju nee husik hela nia.
verses.39: Iha tempu nebaa, Maria hamriik no baa lalais foho, too sidade ida iha Judá.
verses.40: Nia tama Zakarias nia uma no kumprimenta Isabel.
verses.41: Bainhira Isabel rona Maria nia kumprimentus, bebee nee book aan kedas iha ninia oan fatin. Isabel sai nakonu ho Espíritu Santu,
verses.42: no nia koalia ho lian makaas, no dehan, “Bensaun ba o iha feto sira nia leet, no bensaun ba oan hosi o nia oan fatin.
verses.43: No tanba saa mak hau hetan ida nee, katak hau nia Nai nia inan sei mai vizita hau?
verses.44: Tanba tebes, bainhira hau nia tilun rona lian hosi o nia kumprimentus nee, bebee iha hau nia oan fatin book aan kedas ho laran haksolok.
verses.45: No bensaun ba o nebee fiar katak Nai sei kumpri buat nebee Nia hatete ona ba o.”
verses.46: Maria dehan,
verses.47: no hau nia espíritu haksolok iha Maromak, hau nia Salvadór.
verses.48: Tanba Nia hanoin Ninia atan feto nebee ema kiik.
verses.49: Tanba Nia nebee iha kbiit halo buat sira nebee boot mai hau;
verses.50: Nia hatudu laran luak ba sira nebee hamtauk Nia
verses.51: Nia hatudu forsa ho Ninia liman;
verses.52: Nia hatuun ukun nain sira hosi sira nia kadeira,
verses.53: Nia halo ema nebee hamlaha sai bosu ho buat nebee diak,
verses.54: Nia ajuda ona Ninia atan Israel,
verses.55: hanesan Nia dehan ona ba ita nia bei-ala sira,
verses.56: No Maria hela ho Isabel maizoumenus fulan tolu. Depois nia fila fali ba ninia uma rasik.
verses.57: Tempu too ona ba Isabel atu tuur ahi. No nia hetan oan mane ida.
verses.58: Ninia vizinhu sira no maluk sira rona ona oinsaa Nai hatudu laran luak boot ba nia, no sira haksolok ho nia.
verses.59: Tuir mai, iha loron ualu, ema mai atu foo sirkunsizaun ba bebee nee. Sira hakarak hanaran nia Zakarias, tuir ninia aman nia naran.
verses.60: Maibee ninia inan dehan, “Lae; ita sei hanaran nia João.”
verses.61: No sira dehan ba nia, “La iha ema ida hosi o nia família mak iha naran ida nee.”
verses.62: Sira halo sinál sira ba oan nia aman hodi husu oinsaa nia hakarak hanaran ninia oan mane nee.
verses.63: No Zakarias husu fatuk belar ida no nia hakerek, “Ninia naran mak João.” No sira hotu hakfodak.
verses.64: Depois Zakarias nia ibun nakloke kedas, no ninia nanaal sai mamar fali. Nia koalia no hahii Maromak.
verses.65: No ema hotu nebee hela iha área nee sai tauk. Sira konta istória nee iha fatin hotu iha foho Judeia.
verses.66: Ema hotu nebee rona nunee rai istória nee iha sira nia fuan laran. No sira dehan, “Labarik nee sei sai ema see loos?” Tanba Nai nia liman mak hamutuk ho nia.
verses.67: João nia aman Zakarias sai nakonu ho Espíritu Santu. Nia profesia no dehan,
verses.69: Nia foti aas dikur salvasaun nian ba ita
verses.70: tuir Ninia liafuan liu hosi Ninia profeta santu sira nia ibun
verses.71: katak Nia sei salva ita hosi ita nia inimigu sira,
verses.72: Nunee Nia hatudu laran luak nebee Nia promete ona ba ita nia bei-ala sira,
verses.73: juramentu nebee nia jura ba ita nia aman Abraão,
verses.74: katak Nia sei hasai ita hosi ita nia inimigu sira nia liman
verses.75: ho santidade no hahalok loos iha Ninia oin, durante ita nia moris tomak.
verses.76: No o, oan, ema sei bolu o profeta hosi Ida Nebee Aas Liu;
verses.77: O sei foo hatene ba Ninia povu kona ba salvasaun,
verses.78: tanba ita nia Maromak nia laran luak tebes,
verses.79: hodi foo naroman ba sira nebee tuur iha nakukun laran no iha lalatak mate nian,
verses.80: Labarik nee sai boot no ninia espíritu sai forti. Nia hela iha rai fuik maran too loron nebee nia hatudu aan ba Israel.

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, César Augusto foo sai avizu katak ema hotu iha mundu tomak tenki rejistu.
verses.2: Ida nee mak rejistu primeiru bainhira Kirinu mak governadór iha Síria.
verses.3: Nunee ema hotu baa hodi rejistu. Ema ida-idak baa ninia aldeia rasik.
verses.4: No José mos sae ba. Nia sai hosi sidade Nazaré iha Galileia no baa Judeia, ba sidade David nian, nebee naran Belém. Tanba José hosi David nia uma kain no jerasaun.
verses.5: Nia baa hodi rejistu ho Maria tanba sira nain rua troka prenda ona. No Maria isin rua todan ona.
verses.6: Entaun, bainhira sira iha nebaa, Maria nia loron atu tuur ahi too ona.
verses.7: No nia tuur ahi oan mane primeiru. Nia falun ninia oan ho hena no hatoba nia iha animál nia haan fatin, tanba la iha fatin iha uma ida atu hela.
verses.8: Iha rai nebaa, bibi atan balu hela iha rai luan hodi hein sira nia bibi lubun sira iha kalan.
verses.9: No tebes, Nai nia anju ida mosu ba sira, no Nai nia glória nabilan haleu sira. No sira sai tauk tebes.
verses.10: Anju nee dehan ba sira, “Keta tauk, tanba tebes, hau hatoo liafuan diak nebee sei foo haksolok boot ba povu hotu.
verses.11: Tanba ohin, iha sidade David nian, Salvadór ida moris mai ba imi. Nia mak Nai Kristu.
verses.12: No ida nee sei sai sinál ba imi: Imi sei hetan bebee ida nebee ema falun ho hena no hatoba iha animál nia haan fatin.”
verses.13: Derepenti lubun boot hosi forsa lalehan nian mosu mai ho anju nee no hahii Maromak, no dehan,
verses.14: “Glória ba Maromak iha fatin aas liu,
verses.15: Bainhira anju sira husik ona sira no fila ba lalehan, bibi atan sira dehan ba malu, “Mai ita baa kedas ba Belém, no haree buat nebee akontese nee, nebee Nai foo hatene ona ba ita.”
verses.16: Sira baa lalais no hetan Maria, José no bebee nebee toba hela iha animál nia haan fatin.
verses.17: Bainhira sira haree tiha ida nee, sira foo hatene ba ema iha nebaa kona ba buat nebee sira rona kona ba bebee ida nee.
verses.18: No ema hotu nebee rona tiha ida nee sai hakfodak kona ba buat sira nebee sira rona liu hosi bibi atan sira.
verses.19: Maibee Maria hanoin kona ba buat sira nee hotu, no rai buat sira nee iha ninia fuan laran.
verses.20: Bibi atan sira fila fali. No sira foo glória no hahii Maromak tanba buat hotu nebee sira rona no haree, tuir buat nebee anju foo sai ona ba sira.
verses.21: No bainhira loron ualu too ona hodi foo sirkunsizaun ba oan nee, sira hanaran nia Jesus. Ida nee tuir naran nebee anju foo ona molok Jesus mosu iha oan fatin.
verses.22: Bainhira tempu too ona kona ba seremonia hamoos aan nian tuir Lei hosi Moisés, sira lori Jesus ba Jerusalém, hodi entrega Nia ba Nai.
verses.23: Tanba tuir liafuan nebee hakerek nanis ona iha Lei hosi Nai, “Oan mane hotu nebee moris mai primeiru sei sai santu ba Nai.”
verses.24: Sira baa atu oferese sakrifísiu tuir liafuan nebee dehan nanis ona iha Lei hosi Nai, “Manu lakateu pár ida ka manu pombu oan rua.”
verses.25: Tebes, iha mane ida iha Jerusalém, nebee naran Simeão. Mane nee mak ema moris loos no hamtauk Maromak. Nia hein hela tempu kamaan ba Israel. No nia iha Espíritu Santu.
verses.26: Nia hatene liu hosi Espíritu Santu katak nia sei la mate molok nia haree Nai nia Kristu.
verses.27: No liu hosi Espíritu nia tama ba Templu. No bainhira Jesus nia inan-aman lori mai bebee nee atu halo tuir kostumi Lei nian,
verses.28: Simeão simu Jesus iha ninia liman. Nia hahii Maromak no dehan,
verses.29: “Nai, agora O bele husik O nia atan hau sai ho dame,
verses.30: Tanba hau nia matan haree ona O nia salvasaun,
verses.31: nebee O prepara tiha ona iha povu hotu nia oin,
verses.32: naroman ida hodi hatudu ba ema Jentiu sira,
verses.33: Jesus nia inan-aman hakfodak kona ba liafuan nebee Simeão koalia kona ba bebee nee.
verses.34: Simeão foo bensaun ba sira, no dehan ba Jesus nia inan Maria, “Tebes, tanba labarik nee, ema barak iha Israel sei monu tuun no ema barak sei hamriik sae. No Nia sei sai sinál ida nebee ema kontra,
verses.35: (no surik ida sei sona borus o nia klamar mos), hodi hatudu sai ema barak nia hanoin iha sira nia fuan laran.”
verses.36: Iha profeta ida naran Ana. Nia mak Fanuel nia oan feto, hosi suku Aser. Nia idade liu ona. Liu tiha tempu feto raan, nia hela ho ninia laen too tinan hitu.
verses.37: Depois nia hela nudar feto faluk ida too maizoumenus too tinan ualu-nulu resin haat. No nia la husik Templu, maibee loron-kalan nia adora ho jejún no orasaun.
verses.38: Iha tempu nee kedas, nia mos hakbesik ba sira no foo agradese ba Nai. Nia koalia kona ba Jesus ba ema hotu nebee hein hela tempu nebee Maromak sei hola fali Jerusalém.
verses.39: Bainhira sira halo ona buat hotu tuir Lei hosi Nai, sira fila fali ba Galileia, ba sira nia sidade Nazaré.
verses.40: Labarik nee sai boot ba dadauk no Nia sai forti iha espíritu. Nia nakonu ho matenek klean no Nia iha grasa hosi Maromak.
verses.41: Tinan-tinan, Jesus nia inan-aman baa Jerusalém hodi tuir Festa Páskua.
verses.42: Bainhira Nia tinan sanulu resin rua ona, sira sae ba Jerusalém hodi tuir festa nee hanesan baibain.
verses.43: Bainhira loron Festa nee kompletu ona sira fila fali ba, maibee labarik Jesus sei hela iha Jerusalém. José no Ninia inan la hatene ida nee.
verses.44: Sira hanoin Nia iha grupu laran nee. Bainhira sira lao too loron ida, sira buka Jesus iha sira nia família no maluk sira nia leet.
verses.45: No bainhira sira la hetan Nia, sira fila fali ba Jerusalém hodi buka Nia.
verses.46: Liu tiha loron tolu, sira hetan Nia iha Templu. Nia tuur hela iha mestri sira nia leet hodi rona no husu pergunta ba sira.
verses.47: Ema hotu nebee rona Nia hakfodak ho Ninia kompriensaun no Ninia resposta.
verses.48: Bainhira Jesus nia inan-aman haree Nia, sira hakfodak. No Ninia inan dehan ba Nia, “Oan, tanba saa mak O halo nunee mai ami? Tebes, O nia aman no hau buka O ho laran susar.”
verses.49: Nia dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi buka Hau? Imi la hatene katak Hau tenki iha Hau nia Aman nia uma ka?”
verses.50: No sira la kompriende liafuan nebee Nia dehan ba sira.
verses.51: Nia tuun ba ho sira no fila fali ba Nazaré. No Nia halo tuir sira nia hakarak. Maibee Ninia inan rai liafuan hotu nee iha ninia fuan laran.
verses.52: Jesus sai matenek no boot ba dadauk. Nia hetan grasa ho Maromak no ema.

verses.1: Bainhira César Tibério ukun too tinan sanulu resin lima ona, Pónsio Pilatos mak governadór iha Judeia, Herodes mak ukun nain iha Galileia, no ninia maluk Filipe mak ukun nain iha Ituraea no iha rejiaun Trakonitis, no Lisanias mak ukun nain iha Abilene,
verses.2: no Anas no Kaifas mak saserdote boot sira. Iha tempu nebaa, Maromak nia liafuan mai ba João, Zakarias nia oan mane, iha rai fuik maran.
verses.3: No João tama ba rai hotu nebee besik Jordaun. Nia haklaken kona ba batizmu arepende nian hodi hetan perdua hosi sala.
verses.4: Tuir liafuan nebee hakerek nanis ona iha livru nebee iha profeta Isaias nia liafuan, nebee dehan, “Lian hosi ema ida nebee hakilar iha rai fuik maran:
verses.5: Tate tiha foho leet hotu hodi halo tetuk,
verses.6: No ema hotu sei haree
verses.7: Depois João dehan ba ema lubun sira nebee sai mai atu simu batizmu hosi nia, “Oh samea nia oan sira, see mak foo avizu ba imi atu halai hosi kastigu nebee atu mai?
