verses.8: Hatudu hahalok katak imi arepende duni. La bele hahuu dehan iha imi nia laran, ‘Ami nia aman mak Abraão.’ Tanba hau dehan ba imi katak hosi fatuk sira nee Maromak bele halo oan sira ba Abraão.
verses.9: Agora, baliu tau ona iha ai huun sira nia abut. Nunee ai huun hotu nebee la foo fuan diak, sei tesi tuun no soe ba ahi laran.”
verses.10: Ema lubun boot sira nee husu nia, no dehan, “Nunee ami tenki halo saida?”
verses.11: Nia hataan no dehan ba sira, “Ema nebee iha unuk tahan rua, husik nia fahe ba ema nebee la iha. No nia nebee iha ai haan, halo mos nunee.”
verses.12: Depois kobradór impostu sira mos mai atu simu batizmu. No sira dehan ba nia, “Mestri, ami tenki halo saida?”
verses.13: Nia dehan ba sira, “Keta kobra liu fali buat nebee imi tenki simu.”
verses.14: No soldadu sira mos husu ba nia, no dehan, “No ami tenki halo saida?” Nia dehan ba sira, “Keta hanehan ka duun matak ema hodi hetan osan - simu deit imi nia saláriu ho laran kontenti.”
verses.15: Povu nee buka duni Kristu. No ema hotu hanoin iha sira nia fuan laran kona ba João, keta nia mak Kristu karik.
verses.16: Nunee João hataan, no dehan ba sira hotu, “Hau foo batizmu ba imi ho bee; maibee ida fali sei mai nebee forti liu hau. Hau la merese atu kore Ninia sandálias nia tali. Nia sei foo batizmu ba imi ho Espíritu Santu no ahi.
verses.17: Nia kaer Ninia garfu boot hodi haliri, no Nia sei hamoos Ninia haliri fatin. Nia sei halibur Ninia trigu iha armazén, maibee Nia sei sunu trigu kain ho ahi nebee la bele hamate.”
verses.18: No ho liafuan barak seluk tan nia haklaken evanjelhu ba povu nee.
verses.19: Maibee João foo sala ba ukun nain Herodes, tanba Herodes kaben ho Herodias nebee ninia alin Filipe nia feen, no mos tanba buat aat hotu nebee Herodes halo ona.
verses.20: No Herodes aumenta sala ida tan ba buat hotu nebee nia halo ona: nia kastigu João iha komarka.
verses.21: Bainhira povu hotu nee simu ona batizmu, Jesus mos simu batizmu. No bainhira Jesus halo hela orasaun, lalehan nakloke,
verses.22: no Espíritu Santu tuun mai ba Nia ho oin hanesan manu pombu ida. Lian ida mai hosi lalehan, nebee dehan, “O mak Hau nia Oan Mane nebee Hau hadomi. O halo Hau kontenti liu.”
verses.23: Jesus maizoumenus tinan tolu-nulu bainhira Nia hahuu Ninia ministériu. Nia mak oan mane hosi José (tuir ema nia hanoin), nebee oan mane hosi Heli,
verses.24: nebee oan mane hosi Matat, nebee oan mane hosi Levi, nebee oan mane hosi Melki, nebee oan mane hosi Janai, nebee oan mane hosi José,
verses.25: nebee oan mane hosi Matatias, nebee oan mane hosi Amos, nebee oan mane hosi Naum, nebee oan mane hosi Esli, nebee oan mane hosi Nagai,
verses.26: nebee oan mane hosi Maat, nebee oan mane hosi Matatias, nebee oan mane hosi Semei, nebee oan mane hosi Josek, nebee oan mane hosi Joda,
verses.27: nebee oan mane hosi Joanan, nebee oan mane hosi Resa, nebee oan mane hosi Zorobabel, nebee oan mane hosi Seatiel, nebee oan mane hosi Neri,
verses.28: nebee oan mane hosi Melki, nebee oan mane hosi Adi, nebee oan mane hosi Kosam, nebee oan mane hosi Elmadam, nebee oan mane hosi Er,
verses.29: nebee oan mane hosi Josué, nebee oan mane hosi Eliezer, nebee oan mane hosi Jorim, nebee oan mane hosi Matat, nebee oan mane hosi Levi,
verses.30: nebee oan mane hosi Simeão, nebee oan mane hosi Judá, nebee oan mane hosi José, nebee oan mane hosi Jonam, nebee oan mane hosi Eliakim,
verses.31: nebee oan mane hosi Melea, nebee oan mane hosi Mena, nebee oan mane hosi Matata, nebee oan mane hosi Natan, nebee oan mane hosi David,
verses.32: nebee oan mane hosi Jessé, nebee oan mane hosi Obed, nebee oan mane hosi Boaz, nebee oan mane hosi Salmon, nebee oan mane hosi Nason,
verses.33: nebee oan mane hosi Aminadab, nebee oan mane hosi Admin, nebee oan mane hosi Arni, nebee oan mane hosi Hezron, nebee oan mane hosi Perez, nebee oan mane hosi Judá,
verses.34: nebee oan mane hosi Jacó, nebee oan mane hosi Isak, nebee oan mane hosi Abraão, nebee oan mane hosi Tera, nebee oan mane hosi Naor,
verses.35: nebee oan mane hosi Serug, nebee oan mane hosi Reú, nebee oan mane hosi Peleg, nebee oan mane hosi Eber, nebee oan mane hosi Selá,
verses.36: nebee oan mane hosi Kenan, nebee oan mane hosi Arpaxad, nebee oan mane hosi Sem, nebee oan mane hosi Noé, nebee oan mane hosi Lamek,
verses.37: nebee oan mane hosi Matusalém, nebee oan mane hosi Enok, nebee oan mane hosi Jared, nebee oan mane hosi Maalalel, nebee oan mane hosi Kenan,
verses.38: nebee oan mane hosi Enos, nebee oan mane hosi Set, nebee oan mane hosi Adão, nebee oan mane hosi Maromak.

verses.1: Jesus nakonu ho Espíritu Santu. Nia husik Jordaun no Espíritu lori Nia ba rai fuik maran
verses.2: too loron haat-nulu. No Diabu tenta Nia. Nia la haan buat ida durante loron sira nee. No bainhira loron sira nee hotu ona, Nia hamlaha.
verses.3: Diabu dehan ba Nia, “Se O Maromak nia Oan duni, haruka fatuk sira nee sai paun.”
verses.4: Maibee Jesus hataan, “Sira hakerek nanis ona, ‘Ema sei la moris liu hosi paun deit.’”
verses.5: Depois Diabu lori Nia sae ba foho aas no hatudu reinu hotu iha mundu ba Nia iha momentu ida deit.
verses.6: No Diabu dehan ba Nia, “Hau sei foo kbiit hotu nee no sira nia glória ba O. Tanba buat hotu nee entrega ona mai hau, no hau bele entrega ba ida nebee hau hakarak.
verses.7: Se O adora hau, buat hotu nee sei sai O nian.”
verses.8: Maibee Jesus hataan, “Sira hakerek nanis ona,
verses.9: Tuir mai Diabu lori Nia ba Jerusalém, no tau Nia iha Templu nia tutun. Diabu dehan ba Nia, “Se O Maromak nia Oan duni, soe O nia aan tuun hosi nee.
verses.10: Tanba sira hakerek nanis ona,
verses.11: Sira sei lori O iha sira nia liman,
verses.12: Maibee Jesus hataan, “Sira dehan nanis ona, ‘Keta koko Nai, imi nia Maromak.’”
verses.13: No bainhira tentasaun hosi Diabu nee hotu ona, nia husik Jesus no nia hein too tempu seluk nebee diak.
verses.14: Jesus fila fali ba Galileia iha kbiit hosi Espíritu. No ema konta kona ba Nia iha fatin hotu iha distritu nebaa.
verses.15: Nia hanorin iha sira nia sinagoga sira, no ema hotu gaba Nia.
verses.16: Jesus mai ba Nazaré, iha fatin nebee Nia sai boot. Iha loron Sabdu, Nia tama ba sinagoga hanesan baibain. No Nia hamriik hodi lee.
verses.17: Sira foo livru hosi profeta Isaias ba Nia. No bainhira Nia loke tiha livru nee, Nia hetan fatin nebee hakerek,
verses.18: “Nai nia Espíritu mak iha hau,
verses.19: atu haklaken tinan nebee Nai hatudu laran diak.”
verses.20: Depois Jesus taka tiha livru nee, Nia foo fali ba ida nebee serví, no Nia tuur. Matan hotu hosi ema iha sinagoga nee hateke metin ba Nia.
verses.21: No Nia komesa dehan ba sira, “Loron ohin, eskritura nebee imi foin rona nee kumpri ona.”
verses.22: Ema hotu koalia diak kona ba Nia. Sira admira liafuan grasa nebee sai hosi Ninia ibun. No sira dehan, “Laos ema nee mak José nia oan mane?”
verses.23: Nia dehan ba sira, “Tebes imi sei dehan mai Hau liafuan nee, ‘Doutór, kura aan rasik ba’ no ‘buat nebee ami rona O halo iha Kafarnaum, halo mos iha nee, iha o nia rai.’”
verses.24: Nia dehan, “Tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, ema sei la simu profeta ida iha ninia rai rasik.
verses.25: Maibee Hau hatete loloos ba imi, iha Elias nia tempu, Israel iha feto faluk barak bainhira lalehan taka tiha too tinan tolu no fulan neen, iha tempu nebee iha rai hamlaha boot iha rai hotu nee.
verses.26: Maibee Maromak la haruka Elias ba sira, só deit ba feto faluk ida iha Sarepta, iha rai Sidon.
verses.27: No iha profeta Eliseu nia tempu, Israel iha ema moras lepra barak. Maibee la iha ida nebee sai moos, só deit Naaman hosi Síria.”
verses.28: Bainhira ema iha sinagoga rona tiha liafuan hirak nee, sira hotu sai hirus makaas.
verses.29: Sira hamriik no duni sai Nia hosi sidade. Sidade nee harii iha foho nebee iha rai naruk. Entaun sira lori Nia ba foho ninin nee atu soe Nia tuun.
verses.30: Maibee Nia lao liu hosi sira nia leet no sai hosi fatin nee.
verses.31: Jesus tuun ba Kafarnaum, nebee sidade ida iha Galileia. Nia hanorin sira iha loron Sabdu.
verses.32: No sira hakfodak ho Ninia hanorin. Tanba Ninia liafuan iha kbiit.
verses.33: No iha sinagoga nee iha mane ida nebee iha espíritu hosi diabu foer. Mane nee hakilar ho lian makaas,
verses.34: no dehan, “Hei! Jesus hosi Nazaré, O halo saida ho ami? O mai atu halakon ami ka? Hau hatene O nee see loos - O mak Ida Nebee Santu hosi Maromak.”
verses.35: Jesus siak nia dehan, “Nonook lai, no sai hosi ema nee!” Diabu soe tuun mane nee iha ema nia leet. Depois nia sai hosi mane nee no la hakanek nia.
verses.36: Ema hotu hakfodak, no sira koalia ba malu, dehan, “Saida mak liafuan nee? Tanba ho kbiit no podér mak Nia manda espíritu aat sira, no sira sai duni!”
verses.37: No sira konta kona ba Jesus iha fatin hotu iha rai nebaa.
verses.38: Jesus hamriik no sai hosi sinagoga. Nia tama ba Simão nia uma. Simão nia banin feto moras todan ho isin manas, no sira husu Jesus kona ba nia.
verses.39: Jesus hamriik iha feto nee nia sorin no haruka isin manas sai. Moras nee husik nia no nia hamriik kedas hodi serví sira.
verses.40: Bainhira loro matan monu dadaun, ema hotu nebee iha maluk ho moras oi-oin lori sira ba Jesus. No Jesus tau Ninia liman ba ema ida-idak nee no kura sira.
verses.41: Diabu sira mos sai hosi ema barak. Sira hakilar no dehan, “O mak Maromak nia Oan!” Maibee Nia siak sira no la husik sira atu koalia, tanba sira hatene katak Nia mak Kristu.
verses.42: Loron tuir mai, Nia sai hosi fatin nee no tama ba rai mamuk. No povu buka tuir Nia, no mai too Nia. Sira koko tahan Nia atu Nia la bele husik sira.
verses.43: Maibee Nia dehan ba sira, “Hau tenki haklaken evanjelhu kona ba Maromak nia reinu ba sidade sira seluk mos. Tanba nee mak Maromak haruka Hau mai.”
verses.44: No Nia kontinua haklaken iha sinagoga sira iha Judeia.

verses.1: Tuir mai, ema lubun boot nee sena malu atu hakbesik ba Jesus hodi rona Maromak nia liafuan bainhira Nia hamriik iha Lago Genesaré ninin.
verses.2: Nia haree roo rua iha tasi ibun nee. Maibee peskadór sira tuun ona hosi roo sira nee hodi fasi sira nia dai.
verses.3: No Nia sae roo ida nebee Simão nian. Depois Nia husu Simão atu dudu roo sai uitoan hosi rai. Nia tuur no hanorin povu nee hosi roo laran.
verses.4: Bainhira Nia koalia hotu ona, Nia dehan ba Simão, “Lori roo ba tasi klean, no hatuun imi nia dai hodi kaer ikan.”
verses.5: Simão hataan no dehan ba nia, “Mestri, ami servisu todan kalan tomak tiha ona, no ami la hetan buat ida. Maski nunee, tanba O mak dehan, hau sei hatuun dai.”
verses.6: No bainhira sira halo nunee, sira kaer ikan barak tebes, too sira nia dai komesa naklees.
verses.7: Sira foti liman atu bolu ba sira nia maluk sira nebee iha roo seluk nee atu mai ajuda sira. Nunee sira seluk mai no halo roo rua nee nakonu, too roo besik atu mout.
verses.8: Bainhira Simão Pedro haree ida nee, nia monu iha Jesus nia ain. No nia dehan, “Hadook aan hosi hau, Oh Nai, tanba hau ema sala nain.”
verses.9: Tanba Simão no ema hotu ho nia hakfodak kona ba ikan nebee sira hetan nee.
verses.10: Ema sira nee inklui mos Tiago no João, Zebedeu nia oan mane sira, nebee servisu hamutuk ho Simão. No Jesus dehan ba Simão, “Keta tauk. Hosi agora ba oin o sei kaer ema.”
verses.11: No bainhira sira dada roo ba rai maran, sira husik buat hotu, no tuir Nia.
verses.12: Tuir mai, bainhira Jesus iha sidade ida, tebes mane ida mai nebee nakonu ho moras lepra. Bainhira mane nee haree Jesus, nia monu ho oin ba rai, no husu makaas ba Jesus, “Nai, se O hakarak, O bele halo hau sai moos.”
verses.13: Jesus lolo liman no kaer mane nee, no dehan, “Hau hakarak. Sai moos ba.” No moras lepra sai kedas hosi mane nee.
verses.14: Jesus manda nia atu la bele koalia ho ema ida, no dehan, “Baa hatudu aan ba saserdote. Foo oferta hodi hamoos aan nebee Moises manda hodi sai testemunha ba sira.”
verses.15: Maibee ema habelar liu tan fali liafuan kona ba Jesus. Nunee ema lubun boot sira mai halibur hamutuk atu rona Nia, no atu Nia bele kura sira nia moras.
verses.16: Maibee Jesus hadook aan ba rai fuik maran no halo orasaun.
verses.17: Iha loron ida, bainhira Jesus hanorin hela, ema Farizeu sira no mestri sira nebee hanorin Lei tuur iha nebaa. Sira mai hosi aldeia hotu hosi Galileia, Judeia no Jerusalém. No Nai nia kbiit mak hamutuk ho Jesus hodi kura ema.
verses.18: No tebes, ema balu lori mane ida nebee isin mate, nebee latan hela iha toba fatin. Sira buka dalan atu lori mane nee ba Jesus, no tau nia iha Jesus nia oin.
verses.19: Maibee sira la bele hetan dalan atu lori mane nee ba uma laran tanba ema lubun boot. Entaun sira sae ba uma leten no loke kuak iha telha. Sira hatuun nia ho ninia biti iha ema nia leet iha Jesus nia oin.
verses.20: Bainhira Jesus haree sira nia fiar, Nia dehan, “Mane, o nia sala sira hetan perdua ona.”
verses.21: Eskriba no ema Farizeu sira komesa hanoin, no dehan, “See mak nee, nebee koalia aat Maromak? See mak bele foo perdua ba sala? Só Maromak deit mak bele.”
verses.22: Maibee bainhira Jesus hatene sira nia hanoin, Nia hataan ba sira, “Imi hanoin saida iha imi nia fuan laran?
verses.23: Saida mak fasil liu, atu dehan, ‘O nia sala sira hetan perdua ona?’ ka atu dehan, ‘Hamriik no lao ba’?
verses.24: Maibee hodi imi bele hatene katak Ema Nia Oan iha kbiit iha mundu atu foo perdua ba sala sira, (Nia hatete ba ema isin mate nee) Hau dehan ba o, hamriik ba, foti o nia biti, no fila ba o nia uma.”
verses.25: Mane nee hamriik kedas iha sira nia oin. Nia foti ninia toba fatin, sai ba ninia uma rasik no hahii Maromak.
verses.26: Sira hotu hakfodak no hahii Maromak. Sira tauk tebes no dehan, “Ohin loron, ita haree buat oin seluk duni!”
verses.27: Tuir buat sira nee Jesus sai ba no haree kobradór impostu ida, naran Levi, nebee tuur hela iha fatin nebee ema selu taxa. Nia dehan ba Levi, “Tuir Hau!”
verses.28: Nunee Levi husik buat hotu no tuir Nia.
verses.29: No Levi halo festa boot iha ninia uma. Ema barak mai hosi kobradór impostu sira no ema seluk nebee tuur hamutuk ho sira.
verses.30: Maibee eskriba no ema Farizeu sira murmura hasoru Jesus nia eskolante sira, no dehan, “Tanba saa mak imi haan no hemu ho kobradór impostu sira no sala nain sira?”
verses.31: No Jesus hataan ba sira, “Ema ho saude diak la presiza doutór, maibee ema moras mak presiza.
verses.32: Hau mai, laos atu bolu ema moris loos, maibee atu bolu sala nain sira hodi arepende.”
verses.33: Sira dehan ba Jesus, “Tanba saa mak João nia eskolante sira jejún beibeik no halo orasaun, no ema Farizeu sira nia eskolante sira halo mos nunee, maibee Ita Boot nian haan no hemu hela deit?”
verses.34: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Ita bele haruka noivu nia belun sira atu halo jejún bainhira sira sei hamutuk ho noivu nee ka?
verses.35: Maibee loron sei too mai bainhira ema foti noivu nee hosi sira, depois sira sei jejún iha loron nebaa.”
verses.36: No Nia koalia mos ai knanoik ida ba sira, “La iha ema ida lees ropa foun hodi taka ropa tuan. Se hanesan nee, nia lees tiha ona ropa foun no hena foun nee haree la hanesan ho hena tuan.
verses.37: No la iha ema ida tau tua uvas foun ba tua kulit tuan. Tanba se ema halo nunee, tua uvas foun bele halo tua kulit nakfera. Tua uvas nee sei nakfakar no tua kulit mos sei sai aat.
verses.38: Maibee ema tau tua uvas foun iha tua kulit foun.
verses.39: No la iha ema ida nebee hemu ona tua uvas tuan hakarak hemu fali tua uvas foun. Tanba nia dehan, ‘Tuan nee mak diak.’”

6.title: Jesus Mak Nai Ba Loron Sabdu

verses.1: Iha loron Sabdu ida, Jesus lao liu hosi toos batar, no Ninia eskolante sira silu batar, behu ho sira nia liman no haan.
verses.2: No ema farizeu balu dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi halo buat nebee lei bandu iha loron Sabdu?”
verses.3: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Imi la lee buat nebee David halo ka, bainhira nia ho sira nebee hamutuk ho nia hamlaha?
verses.4: Nia tama Maromak nia uma, no nia foti no haan paun santu, no nia foo mos ba sira nebee hamutuk ho nia. Maibee nia halo buat nebee lei bandu, tanba saserdote sira deit mak bele haan paun nee.”
verses.5: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Ema Nia Oan mak Nai ba loron Sabdu.”
verses.6: Iha loron Sabdu seluk, Nia tama ba sinagoga ida no hanorin. No iha mane ida iha nebaa, ninia liman loos mate.
verses.7: Eskriba no ema Farizeu sira haree tu-tuir Nia, hodi hatene Nia atu kura ema nee iha loron Sabdu ka lae. Tanba sira buka razaun atu akuza Nia.
verses.8: Maibee Nia hatene sira nia hanoin, no dehan ba mane nebee iha liman mate, “Hamriik ba, no mai hamriik iha klaran.” No ema nee hamriik no baa iha klaran.
verses.9: Depois Jesus dehan ba sira, “Hau husu imi: Tuir lei, iha loron Sabdu, ema bele halo diak ka aat? Ema bele salva moris ka halakon moris?”
verses.10: Nia hateke ba sira hotu, no Nia dehan ba mane nee, “Lolo o nia liman ba.” Mane nee halo tuir, no ninia liman sai diak hotu.
verses.11: Maibee sira hirus too raan nakali, no koalia ba malu atu halo saida ba Jesus.
verses.12: Iha tempu nebaa, Jesus sae foho atu halo orasaun. Nia halo orasaun ba Maromak too kalan tomak.
verses.13: Bainhira rai loron ona, Nia bolu Ninia eskolante sira. No hosi eskolante sira nee Nia hili ema nain sanulu resin rua nebee Nia hanaran apostolu:
verses.14: Simão, nebee Nia hanaran Pedro, no André, Simão nia alin, Tiago no João, Filipe no Bartolomeu,
verses.15: Mateus no Tomé, no Tiago, Alfeu nia oan, no Simão nebee tuir partidu Zelote,
verses.16: no Judas, Tiago nia alin, no Judas Iskariotes, nebee sai traidór.
verses.17: Jesus tuun mai ho sira, no hamriik iha rai tetuk, ho eskolante barak no ema lubun boot nebee mai hosi rai Judeia tomak no Jerusalém, no hosi tasi ibun iha Tiro no Sidon.
verses.18: Sira mai atu rona Nia, no hodi Nia bele kura sira hosi sira nia moras. Nia kura mos sira nebee hetan terus tanba espíritu aat sira.
verses.19: No ema lubun boot hakarak kona Nia, tanba kbiit sai hosi Nia, no kura sira hotu.
verses.20: Jesus hateke ba Ninia eskolante sira, no dehan, “Haksolok ba imi nebee kiak, tanba Maromak nia reinu mak imi nian.
verses.21: Haksolok ba imi nebee agora hamlaha, tanba imi sei sai bosu. Haksolok ba imi nebee agora tanis, tanba imi sei hamnasa.
verses.22: Haksolok ba imi bainhira ema odi imi, la simu imi, tarata imi, no soe imi nia naran hanesan buat aat, tanba Ema Nia Oan!
verses.23: Haksolok ba iha loron nebaa, no haksoit ho ksolok, tanba tebes, imi hetan kolen boot iha lalehan. Tanba sira nia bei-ala sira mos halo nunee ba profeta sira.
verses.24: Maibee susar ba imi nebee riku, tanba imi hetan ona imi nia tempu hakmatek.
verses.25: Susar ba imi nebee bosu agora, tanba imi sei sai hamlaha. Susar ba imi nebee hamnasa agora, tanba imi sei tanis no halerik.
verses.26: Susar ba imi, bainhira ema hotu koalia diak kona ba imi. Tanba sira nia bei-ala sira halo nunee ba profeta falsu sira.
verses.27: Maibee Hau hatete ba imi nebee rona: Hadomi imi nia inimigu, no halo diak ba sira nebee odi imi.
verses.28: Foo bensaun ba sira nebee foo malisan ba imi, no halo orasaun ba sira nebee koalia aat ba imi.
verses.29: Ba nia nebee basa o iha hasan sorin, see tan o nia hasan sorin seluk. No ba nia nebee hadau o nia batina, la bele hapara nia atu foti mos o nia faru.
verses.30: Foo ba ema hotu nebee husu hosi o. No keta husu fali o nia sasaan nebee ema hadau hosi o.
verses.31: Buat nebee imi hakarak ema halo ba imi, halo nunee mos ba ema.
verses.32: Tanba se imi hadomi sira nebee hadomi imi, nunee imi hetan benefísiu saida? Tanba sala nain sira mos hadomi ema nebee hadomi sira.
verses.33: No se imi halo diak ba sira nebee halo diak ba imi, nunee imi hetan benefísiu saida? Tanba sala nain sira mos halo hanesan nee.
verses.34: No se karik imi foo empresta ba sira nebee imi fiar bele selu fali imi, nunee imi hetan benefísiu saida? Tanba sala nain sira mos foo empresta ba sala nain seluk, hodi simu montante hanesan.
verses.35: Maibee hadomi imi nia inimigu, halo diak, foo empresta, no lalika hein atu hetan fali buat ida. Nunee imi sei hetan kolen boot, no imi sei sai Ida Nebee Aas Liu nia oan. Tanba Nia hatudu laran diak ba sira nebee la foo agradese no mos ba ema aat sira.
verses.36: Nee duni, hatudu laran luak, hanesan imi nia Aman mos hatudu laran luak.
verses.37: Keta foo sala ba ema, atu nunee ema la foo sala ba imi. Keta kondena, no ema sei la kondena imi. Foo perdua ba, no imi sei hetan perdua.
verses.38: Foo ba, no imi sei hetan. Nia sei sukat di-diak, hanehan tuun, doko tan, enxe resin no tau iha imi nia hitin. Tanba buat nebee imi sukat ba ema, nunee ema sei sukat fali ba imi.”
verses.39: No Nia konta ai knanoik ida ba sira, “Ema matan delek ida bele hatudu dalan ba ema matan delek seluk ka lae? Laos sira nain rua monu ba rai kuak?
verses.40: Eskolante ida la bele sae boot liu ninia mestri, maibee ema hotu nebee simu hanorin kompletu sei sai hanesan ninia mestri.
verses.41: Tanba saa mak o haree duut lahan ida nebee iha o nia maluk nia matan, maibee o la haree fali ai kabelak nebee iha o nia matan?
verses.42: Ka oinsaa mak o bele dehan ba o nia maluk, ‘Maluk, husik hau hasai lai duut lahan ida nee hosi ita nia matan,’ bainhira o la haree ai kabelak nebee iha o nia matan? O mak ema laran makerek! Hasai lai ai kabelak hosi o nia matan rasik, depois o bele haree ho matan moos atu hasai duut lahan hosi o nia maluk nia matan.
verses.43: Ai huun diak la foo fali ai fuan dodok. No ai huun dodok la foo fali ai fuan diak.
verses.44: Tanba ema hatene ai huun ida-idak tuir ninia ai fuan. Ema la kuu figeira hosi ai tarak, no ema la kuu uvas hosi duut tarak.
verses.45: Ema diak foo sai buat diak hosi riku-soin diak nebee iha ninia fuan laran, no ema aat foo sai buat aat hosi riku-soin aat iha ninia fuan laran. Tanba ema nia ibun sei koalia sai buat nebee nakonu hela iha ninia fuan laran.
verses.46: “Tanba saa mak imi bolu Hau, ‘Nai, Nai,’ no la halo tuir buat nebee Hau hatete ba imi?
verses.47: Ema hotu nebee hakbesik mai Hau no rona Hau nia liafuan no halo tuir, Hau sei hatudu ba imi katak ema nee hanesan saida:
verses.48: Nia hanesan ema ida nebee harii uma ida, no nia kee rai klean, no halo fundasaun iha fatuk leten. Depois bee sae no mota baku makaas ba uma nee, maibee la bele halo uma nee nakdoko, tanba ema harii di-diak uma nee.
verses.49: Maibee nia nebee rona no la halo tuir, nia hanesan ema ida nebee harii uma iha rai maibee fundasaun la iha. Mota baku makaas ba uma nee, no uma monu kedas no rahun aat liu.”

verses.1: Bainhira Jesus koalia hotu ona hodi povu nee bele rona, Nia tama ba Kafarnaum.
verses.2: No komandante ida iha atan ida nebee nia hadomi. Maibee atan nee moras too besik atu mate.
verses.3: Bainhira komandante rona kona ba Jesus, nia haruka ema Judeu sira nia katuas balu ba Jesus hodi husu Jesus atu mai no kura ninia atan.
verses.4: No bainhira sira mai ba Jesus, sira husu kedas ba Nia, no dehan, “Ema nee merese atu Ita Boot halo nunee ba nia.
verses.5: Tanba nia hadomi ita nia nasaun, no nia harii ami nia sinagoga.”
verses.6: No Jesus baa ho sira. No bainhira Nia la dook hosi uma nee, komandante haruka ninia maluk sira ba Jesus hodi dehan, “Nai, lalika halo kole Ita Boot nia aan. Tanba hau la merese atu simu Ita Boot iha hau nia uma.
verses.7: Nunee hau hanoin katak hau la merese atu baa hasoru Ita Boot. Maibee foo sai liafuan deit, no hau nia atan sei sai diak.
verses.8: Tanba hau mos mane ida nebee iha autoridade okos, no hau iha soldadu sira iha hau nia okos. Hau dehan ba ida, ‘Baa!’ no nia baa; no hau dehan ba ida seluk, ‘Mai!’ no nia mai. No ba hau nia atan, ‘Halo ida nee!’ no nia halo tuir.”
verses.9: Bainhira Jesus rona tiha liafuan nee, Nia admira komandante nee. Nia fila aan no dehan ba sira nebee lao tuir Nia, “Hau dehan ba imi, Hau seidauk hetan ema ho fiar nebee hanesan nee iha Israel.”
verses.10: No bainhira sira nebee komandante haruka nee fila fali ba uma, sira hetan atan nee ho isin diak ona.
verses.11: Liu tiha tempu nee, Jesus tama sidade ida naran Naim. Eskolante sira no povu barak lao hamutuk ho Nia.
verses.12: Bainhira Nia besik ona sidade nia portaun, tebes, ema lori sai mane ida nebee mate ona. Mane nee mak oan mane mesak hosi inan ida, no inan nee mak feto faluk. Ema barak hosi sidade lao ho feto faluk nee.
verses.13: No bainhira Nai haree feto nee, Nia hanoin tebes feto nee, no dehan ba nia, “Keta tanis.”
verses.14: Depois Jesus hakbesik no tau liman ba kaixaun. No sira nebee lori kaixaun nee para tiha no hamriik deit. Jesus dehan, “Joven, Hau dehan ba o, hadeer ba.”
verses.15: No ema ida nebee mate nee hadeer, no tuur, no nia hahuu koalia. No Jesus entrega nia ba ninia inan.
verses.16: Ema hotu sai tauk tebes no sira hahii Maromak, no dehan, “Profeta boot ida mai ona iha ita nia leet!” no “Maromak mai vizita ona Ninia povu!”
verses.17: Ema habelar liafuan nee kona ba Nia iha rai Judeia tomak no iha área hotu nebee besik iha nebaa.
verses.18: João nia eskolante sira foo hatene ba João kona ba buat hotu nee. No João
verses.19: bolu ninia eskolante nain rua no haruka sira ba Jesus hodi dehan, “O mak Nia nebee atu mai, ka ami tenki hein ema seluk?”
verses.20: Bainhira ema nee too iha Jesus, sira dehan, “João Batista haruka ami ba O, no dehan, O mak Nia nebee atu mai, ka ami tenki hein ema seluk?”
verses.21: No iha oras nee, Jesus foin kura ema barak ho isin moras no moras peste, no Nia duni sai espíritu aat sira, no Nia halo ema barak nebee matan delek bele haree fali.
verses.22: No Jesus hataan ba sira, “Fila fali ba, no foo hatene ba João kona ba buat nebee imi haree no rona nee, katak ema matan delek sira bele haree, ema ain kudeik sira bele lao, ema moras lepra sira sai moos, ema tilun diuk sira bele rona, ema mate sira moris fali, no ema kiak sira rona evanjelhu.
verses.23: Haksolok ba ema nebee la monu ba sala tanba Hau.”
verses.24: No bainhira João nia manu-ain sira sai ona, Jesus hahuu koalia ba povu nee kona ba João, “Imi lao sai ba rai fuik hodi haree saida? Duut manulain nebee anin doko ka?
verses.25: Entaun imi lao ba hodi haree saida? Mane ida nebee hatais ropa furak ka? Tebes, sira nebee hatais ropa furak no iha moris diak nee hela iha liurai sira nia uma.
verses.26: Entaun imi lao ba hodi haree saida? Profeta ida ka? Sin, no Hau hatete ba imi, ema ida nee boot liu fali profeta sira.
verses.27: Tanba sira hakerek nanis ona kona ba nia nunee,
verses.28: Tebes Hau hatete ba imi, hosi ema nebee moris hosi feto, la iha ema ida mak boot liu João Batista. Maibee ema nebee kiik liu iha reinu Maromak nian mak boot liu fali nia.”
verses.29: No bainhira povu hotu rona nunee, inklui mos kobradór impostu sira, sira foo sai katak Maromak justu, tanba sira simu ona batizmu hosi João.
verses.30: Maibee ema Farizeu sira no ema nebee hatene lei lakohi tuir Maromak nia hakarak, no sira la simu batizmu hosi João.
verses.31: “Maibee Hau kompara jerasaun nee ho see? No sira hanesan saida?
verses.32: Sira hanesan labarik sira nebee tuur iha merkadu, no bolu ba malu dehan,
verses.33: Tanba João Batista mai no nia la haan paun no la hemu tua uvas, no imi dehan, ‘Nia iha diabu ida.’
verses.34: Ema Nia Oan mai no Nia haan no hemu, no imi dehan, ‘Tebes, mane nee mak ema kaan-teen no lanu-teen ida! Nia halo kolega ho kobradór impostu no sala nain sira!’
verses.35: Maibee matenek klean sei hatudu aan loos liu hosi ninia oan sira.”
verses.36: Ema Farizeu ida husu Jesus atu haan hamutuk ho nia. Entaun Jesus tama ba ema Farizeu nia uma no tuur hodi haan.
verses.37: No tebes, feto ida hosi sidade nee, nebee sala nain, rona katak Jesus tuur hodi haan iha Farizeu nia uma. Nunee feto nee lori mina morin iha botir alabastro.
verses.38: Nia hamriik iha Jesus nia ain iha kotuk. Nia komesa habokon Jesus nia ain ho ninia matan been, no nia hamaran Jesus nia ain ho ninia fuuk. Depois nia rei no fui mina morin ba Jesus nia ain.
verses.39: Bainhira ema Farizeu nebee konvida Jesus haree buat nee, nia hanoin iha nia laran, “Se Mane nee profeta ida karik, Nia sei hatene feto nee see loos nebee kona hela Nia, katak feto nee mak sala nain ida.”
verses.40: No Jesus hataan ba ema Farizeu nee, “Simão, Hau iha liafuan ruma atu koalia ba o.” No nia dehan, “Mestri, koalia ba.”
verses.41: “Iha ema ida nebee foo osan debe ba ema nain rua. Ema ida debe osan denáriu atus lima (500), no ida fali debe osan denáriu lima-nulu (50).
verses.42: No bainhira sira la iha buat ida atu selu fali, nia foo perdua tiha sira nain rua nia tusan. Entaun foo hatene mai Hau, ida nebee mak sei hadomi nia liu tan?”
verses.43: Simão hataan, “Hau hanoin karik ida nebee simu perdaun hosi tusan boot liu.” No Nia dehan ba Simão, “O tesi lia loos.”
verses.44: Depois Nia fila oin ba feto nee, no dehan ba Simão, “O haree feto nee ka? Hau tama o nia uma, no o la foo bee mai Hau atu fase Hau nia ain, maibee nia habokon Hau nia ain ho ninia matan been, no hamaran ho ninia fuuk.
verses.45: O la rei Hau, maibee hosi oras nebee Hau tama, feto nee la para atu rei Hau nia ain.
verses.46: O la fui mina ba Hau nia ulun, maibee feto nee fui mina morin ba Hau nia ain.
verses.47: Nunee Hau hatete ba o katak, ninia sala, maski barak, hetan ona perdaun. Tanba nee, nia hatudu domin boot. Maibee ba nia nebee hetan perdua uitoan, nia mos hadomi uitoan.”
verses.48: No Jesus dehan ba feto nee, “O nia sala sira hetan perdua ona.”
verses.49: No sira nebee tuur no haan hela ho Nia komesa koalia ba malu, “See mak ema nee, atu Nia foo mos perdua ba sala?”
verses.50: No Nia dehan ba feto nee, “O nia fiar salva ona o. Lao ba ho dame.”

verses.1: Tuir tempu nee, Jesus lao ba sidade sira no aldeia sira hodi haklaken no foo sai evanjelhu kona ba Maromak nia reinu. No sira nain sanulu resin rua lao hamutuk ho Nia.
verses.2: Iha mos feto balu, nebee Nia kura tiha hosi espíritu aat sira no moras oi-oin, inklui Maria ho naran Madalena, nebee diabu nain hitu sai hosi nia,
verses.3: no Joana, feen hosi Kuza nebee Herodes nia xefi funsionáriu, no Susana, no ema barak seluk, nebee suporta sira hosi sira nia riku-soin rasik.
verses.4: Ema barak halibur hamutuk no sira baa haree Jesus hosi sidade ba sidade. No Nia koalia ho sira liu hosi ai knanoik ida:
verses.5: “Toos nain ida lao baa hodi kari ninia fini. Bainhira nia kari ba, balu monu iha dalan ninin. Ema sama fini nee no manu hosi loro leten haan hotu tiha fini nee.
verses.6: No balu monu iha fatuk leten. Bainhira sira foin tubun, sira namlaik hotu tanba bee la iha.
verses.7: No balu monu tiha iha ai tarak laran. No ai tarak moris hamutuk ho fini sira nee no hanehan tiha sira.
verses.8: No fini seluk monu iha rai diak, sira moris no foo fali fuan too dala atus ida.” No bainhira Nia koalia ona buat sira nee, Nia hatete, “Nia nebee iha tilun hodi rona, husik nia rona ba.”
verses.9: Jesus nia eskolante sira husu Nia kona ba ai knanoik nee katak saida.
verses.10: No Nia dehan, “Imi deit bele simu segredu kona ba Maromak nia reinu. Maibee sira seluk rona liu hosi ai knanoik sira, ‘hodi nunee sira haree maibee la haree moos, no sira rona maibee la kompriende.’
verses.11: Agora, ai knanoik hanesan nee: fini mak Maromak nia liafuan.
verses.12: Sira nebee iha dalan ninin mak sira nebee rona, depois diabu mai no hasai liafuan hosi sira nia fuan laran, hodi sira la bele fiar no hetan salvasaun.
verses.13: Sira nebee iha fatuk leten mak sira nebee rona no simu liafuan nee ho haksolok, maibee sira nia abut la iha. Nunee sira fiar too tempu uitoan, maibee bainhira tempu susar mai, sira monu lakon tiha.
verses.14: No sira nebee monu iha ai tarak laran mak sira nebee rona, maibee bainhira sira lao ba oin sira preokupa no buka riku-soin no buat nebee halo sira nia moris kontenti. Buat sira nee mai hanehan sira too sira la foo fuan tasak.
verses.15: Maibee sira nebee iha rai diak mak sira nebee iha fuan laran nebee onestu no diak. Sira rona liafuan nee no kaer metin, no ho pasiénsia sira foo fuan.
verses.16: “La iha ema ida mak sunu ahi oan ida, depois taka ho sanan rai ka tau fali iha kama okos. Maibee nia tau ahi oan iha ahi oan nia fatin atu nunee sira nebee tama mai bele haree naroman nee.
verses.17: Nunee la iha buat ida nebee subar, nebee sei la hatudu sai; no la iha segredu ida, nebee sei la nakloke hodi ema hatene.
verses.18: Entaun hanoin di-diak oinsaa imi rona: tanba nia nebee iha ona, nia sei hetan tan; maibee nia nebee la iha, buat nebee nia hanoin nia sei iha, buat nee mos sei foti sai hosi nia.”
verses.19: Depois Jesus nia inan no alin sira mai too Nia. Maibee sira la konsege hakbesik ba Nia tanba ema barak nee.
verses.20: No ema foo hatene ba Nia, no dehan, “O nia inan no alin sira hamriik iha liur, no sira hakarak haree O.”
verses.21: Maibee Nia hataan sira, dehan, “Hau nia inan no Hau nia alin sira mak sira nebee rona Maromak nia liafuan, no halo tuir.”
verses.22: Loron ida, Jesus sae roo ida ho Ninia eskolante sira. No Nia dehan ba sira, “Mai ita hakur ba tasi sorin ba.” Entaun sira baa.
verses.23: Maibee bainhira sira baa dadaun, Jesus toba dukur. Depois anin boot tuun mai ba tasi nee, no sira nia roo sai nakonu ho bee. Sira hasoru perigu duni.
verses.24: Sira baa Jesus, fanu Nia no dehan, “Mestri, Mestri, ita atu mate!” Nunee Nia hamriik, no siak anin no laloran boot. Depois anin no laloran para no sai hakmatek tiha.
verses.25: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi nia fiar iha nebee?” No sira tauk no admira, no dehan ba malu, “See mak nee? Tanba Nia manda mos anin no tasi, no sira halo tuir Nia.”
verses.26: Sira too ba rai Gerasa, nebee iha Galileia nia sorin ba.
verses.27: No bainhira Jesus foin too tasi ibun, Nia hasoru mane ida hosi sidade nee, nebee iha diabu sira. Kleur ona mane nee la hatais ropa, no nia la hela iha uma ida, maibee nia hela iha rate laran.
verses.28: Bainhira nia haree Jesus, nia hakilar, no monu iha Jesus nia oin. Ho lian makaas nia dehan, “O hakarak saida hosi hau, Jesus, Oan Mane hosi Maromak Nebee Aas Liu? Hau husu boot, keta haterus hau.”
verses.29: Tanba Jesus manda ona espíritu foer atu sai hosi mane nee. (Tanba dala barak espíritu foer nee kastigu nia, no ema kesi nia ho korenti no besi, maibee nia hakotu besi sira nee no diabu duni nia tama ba rai fuik.)
verses.30: No Jesus husu nia, dehan, “O nia naran saida?” No nia hataan, “Batalhaun.”  Tanba diabu barak tama tiha ona ba nia.
verses.31: No sira husu beibeik ba Jesus atu la bele haruka sira tama ba infernu.
verses.32: Iha tempu nee, fahi barak haan hela iha foho. Entaun sira husu Jesus atu husik sira tama ba fahi sira nee. No Jesus husik sira baa.
verses.33: Nunee diabu sira sai hosi mane nee, no tama tiha ba fahi sira. Depois fahi hotu halai saruntu, tuun foho lolon, tama tasi, no sira mout hotu.
verses.34: Bainhira ema sira nebee hein fahi haree saida mak akontese, sira halai baa no konta sai istória nee iha sidade no iha rai nebaa.
verses.35: Nunee ema sira sai atu haree saida mak akontese. Sira mai too Jesus, no hetan mane nebee diabu sira sai tiha ona hosi nia. Nia tuur hela iha Jesus nia ain no nia hatais ona ropa no hanoin loos ona. Nunee sira tauk.
verses.36: No sira nebee haree rasik buat sira nee konta fali oinsaa Jesus kura mane ida nee, nebee uluk diabu domina.
verses.37: Nunee ema hotu hosi rai Gerasa iha nebaa husu Jesus atu sai hosi sira. Tanba sira tauk tebes. Entaun Jesus sae roo no fila fali.
verses.38: Mane ida nebee diabu sira sai tiha hosi nia husu beibeik atu bele baa hamutuk ho Jesus, maibee Jesus haruka nia fila ba, no dehan,
verses.39: “Fila ba o nia uma, no foo sai buat barak nebee Maromak halo tiha ona ba o.” No nia fila ba, no foo sai iha sidade tomak kona ba buat hotu nebee Jesus halo tiha ona ba nia.
verses.40: No tuir mai, bainhira Jesus fila mai, ema lubun boot simu Nia ho laran kontenti, tanba sira hotu hein hela Nia.
verses.41: No mane ida naran Jairo mai. Nia mak ukun nain ida iha sinagoga nee. Nia monu iha Jesus nia ain no husu Jesus atu tama ba ninia uma.
verses.42: Tanba nia iha oan feto ida deit, nebee maizoumenus tinan sanulu resin rua, no feto nee besik atu mate. Maibee bainhira Jesus baa dadaun, ema lubun boot sena Nia.
verses.43: No iha nebaa iha feto ida nebee iha moras raan suli durante tinan sanulu resin rua. Feto nee gasta buat hotu nebee nia iha hodi selu doutór sira. Maibee la iha ema ida nebee bele kura nia.
verses.44: Feto ida nee hakbesik ba Jesus hosi kotuk, no nia kona Jesus nia ropa ninin. Depois ninia raan suli nee para kedas.
verses.45: No Jesus dehan, “See mak kona Hau?” Bainhira sira hotu nega kona ba ida nee, Pedro no sira nebee hamutuk ho Jesus dehan, “Mestri, ema lubun boot nee haleu O no sena hela O.”
verses.46: Maibee Jesus dehan, “Ema ida kona ona Hau, tanba Hau hatene katak kbiit sai ona hosi Hau.”
verses.47: No bainhira feto ida nee haree katak nia la bele subar, nia mai ho nakdedar no monu iha Jesus nia oin. Iha ema hotu nia oin, nia foo sai ba Jesus tanba saa mak nia kona Jesus no oinsaa ninia isin sai diak kedas.
verses.48: Depois Jesus dehan ba nia, “Oan feto, o nia fiar mak salva o. Lao ba ho dame.”
verses.49: Bainhira Jesus koalia hela, ema ida mai hosi Jairo nia uma, no dehan ba sinagoga nia ukun nain nee, “Ita boot nia oan feto mate ona, lalika halo kole tan Mestri nee.”
verses.50: Maibee bainhira Jesus rona tiha nunee, Nia hataan ba Jairo, “Keta tauk, fiar deit, no nia sei sai diak fali.”
verses.51: Bainhira Jesus mai too uma, Nia la husik ema ida atu tama hamutuk ho Nia, só deit Pedro, Tiago, no João, no labarik feto nee nia inan-aman.
verses.52: No ema hotu tanis lelir tanba labarik feto nee. Maibee Jesus dehan, “Keta tanis. Nia la mate ida, nia só toba deit.”
verses.53: No hamnasa fali Jesus, tanba sira hatene katak nia mate ona.
verses.54: Maibee Jesus kaer labarik feto nia liman, no bolu nia,dehan, “Noi, hadeer ba!”
verses.55: No ninia espíritu mai fali, no nia hamriik kedas. Jesus haruka sira foo haan ba nia.
verses.56: Ninia inan-aman hakfodak. Maibee Jesus manda sira atu la bele foo sai ba ema ida buat nebee akontese nee.

verses.1: Depois Jesus bolu eskolante sira nain sanulu resin rua atu mai hamutuk. Nia foo ba sira kbiit no autoridade atu duni sai diabu sira hotu no kura moras.
verses.2: Nia haruka sira baa haklaken kona ba Maromak nia reinu no kura ema moras.
verses.3: Nia dehan ba sira, “La bele lori buat ida iha imi nia viajen, laos ai tonka, ka bornál, ka paun, ka osan. La bele lori faru rua.
verses.4: No bainhira imi tama uma ida, hela iha nebaa no lalika sai hosi uma nee.
verses.5: Iha fatin nebee deit ema la simu imi, bainhira imi sai hosi sidade nee, liki tiha rai rahun hosi imi nia ain nudar testemunha hasoru sira.”
verses.6: Depois sira sai no lao baa aldeia sira. Sira haklaken evanjelhu no kura ema iha fatin hotu.
verses.7: Herodes, nebee xefi distritu, rona kona ba buat hotu nebee Jesus halo. Nia konfuzaun, tanba ema balu dehan katak João moris hias ona hosi mate.
verses.8: No ema balu dehan katak Elias mosu mai. No ema seluk dehan katak profeta ida hosi tempu antigu moris hias ona.
verses.9: Herodes dehan, “Hau tesi sai ona João nia ulun. Maibee see mak nee, nebee hau rona informasaun nee?” No nia buka atu haree Jesus.
verses.10: Bainhira apostolu sira fila fali mai, sira foo hatene ba Jesus kona ba buat hotu nebee sira halo ona. Depois Nia lori sira no sees aan baa iha aldeia ida naran Betsaida.
verses.11: Bainhira povu hatene ona, sira baa atu tuir Nia. Nia simu sira no koalia ba sira kona ba Maromak nia reinu. No Nia kura sira nebee presiza hetan kura.
verses.12: Bainhira loron nee besik hotu ona, sira nain sanulu resin rua mai no dehan ba Jesus, “Haruka ema lubun boot nee sai ba, hodi sira bele tama ba aldeia sira no fatin seluk iha área nee. Nunee sira bele hetan fatin atu toba no haan. Tanba fatin iha nee rai mamuk.
verses.13: Maibee Jesus dehan ba sira, “Imi mak foo haan ba sira.” No sira dehan, “Ami nia hahaan la iha, só deit paun lima no ikan rua. Karik ami baa sosa ai haan hodi foo ba ema hotu nee ka?”
verses.14: Tanba ema sira nee maizoumenus mane nain rihun lima (5.000). No Nia dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Haruka sira tuur fahe ba grupu, hodi grupu ida-idak iha maizoumenus ema nain lima-nulu.”
verses.15: Sira halo tuir no haruka ema hotu tuur.
verses.16: Depois Nia foti paun lima no ikan rua. Nia foti matan hateke ba lalehan, no foo bensaun ba ai haan nee. Depois Nia silu paun nee no foo ba eskolante sira hodi fahe ba ema lubun boot.
verses.17: No sira hotu haan too bosu. Depois sira halibur ai haan resin too iha bote sanulu resin rua.
verses.18: Tuir mai, Jesus halo orasaun mesak, no Ninia eskolante sira sei hamutuk ho Nia. No Nia husu sira, “Povu dehan katak Hau nee see?”
verses.19: Sira hataan, “João Batista; maibee balu dehan Elias; no ema seluk dehan profeta ida hosi tempu antigu moris hias ona.”
verses.20: Nia dehan ba sira, “Maibee imi dehan katak Hau nee see?” Pedro hataan, “Maromak nia Kristu.”
verses.21: Nia foo orden makaas ba sira, no bandu sira atu la bele foo hatene ba ema ida kona ba ida nee.
verses.22: Nia dehan, “Ema Nia Oan tenki hetan terus barak. No katuas sira, xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira sei rejeita Nia. Ema sei oho Nia, no Nia sei moris hias iha loron terseiru.”
verses.23: Jesus dehan ba sira hotu, “Se ema ida hakarak mai tuir Hau, husik nia nega aan, no foti ninia krús loro-loron, no tuir Hau.
verses.24: Tanba ema nebee hakarak salva ninia moris sei lakon ninia moris. Maibee ema nebee lakon ninia moris tanba Hau sei salva ninia moris.
verses.25: Tanba ema ida manaan saida, se nia hetan mundu tomak, maibee nia lakon aan ka estraga ninia aan rasik?
verses.26: Tanba se ema ruma moe kona ba Hau no Hau nia liafuan, Ema Nia Oan sei moe kona ba ema nee bainhira Nia mai iha Ninia glória, no iha Ninia Aman nia glória, no iha anju santu sira nia glória.
verses.27: Maibee Hau hatete lo-loos ba imi, ema balu nebee hamriik iha nee sei la sai mate too sira haree Maromak nia reinu.”
verses.28: Liu tiha maizoumenus loron ualu hosi tempu nebee Jesus foo sai liafuan nee, Nia lori Pedro, João no Tiago, no sae foho ida hodi halo orasaun.
verses.29: No bainhira Nia halo hela orasaun, Ninia oin nakfilak, no Ninia ropa sai mutin no nabilan.
verses.30: No tebes, ema nain rua koalia ho Nia. Ema nee mak Moisés no Elias,
verses.31: nebee mosu mai ho glória. Sira koalia kona ba oinsaa Nia sei husik mundu nee, nebee Nia atu kumpri iha Jerusalém.
verses.32: Maibee Pedro no sira nebee ho Nia sei dukur loos. Bainhira sira hadeer, sira haree Ninia glória, no ema nain rua nebee hamriik hela ho Nia.
verses.33: No tuir mai, bainhira nain rua nee atu sai hosi Jesus, Pedro dehan ba Nia, “Mestri, fatin nee diak atu hela. Husik ami halo tenda tolu: ida ba O, ida ba Moisés, no ida ba Elias.” Pedro la hatene buat nebee nia dehan.
verses.34: Bainhira nia koalia dadaun, kalohan ida mai, no hamahon sira. No sira tauk bainhira sira tama iha kalohan laran.
verses.35: Lian ida mai hosi kalohan nee, no dehan, “Ida nee mak Hau nia Oan Mane nebee Hau hili ona. Rona Nia ba.”
verses.36: No bainhira lian nee koalia hotu ona, sira hetan Jesus mesak deit. No iha tempu nebaa sira nonook, no sira la foo hatene ba ema ida kona ba buat nebee sira haree ona nee.
verses.37: Loron tuir mai, bainhira sira tuun hosi foho, ema lubun boot hasoru Jesus.
verses.38: No tebes, mane ida hosi lubun nee hakilar no dehan, “Mestri, hau husu ho laran, haree lai hau nia oan mane, tanba nia mak hau nia oan mesak deit.
verses.39: Tebes, espíritu ida kaer nia, no nia hakilar derepenti deit. No espíritu nee doko nia too nia kabeen nafurin, no hakanek nia, no kleur foin husik nia.
verses.40: Hau husu ho laran ba O nia eskolante sira atu duni sai espíritu nee, maibee sira la bele.”
verses.41: Jesus hataan, “Oh jerasaun nebee la fiar no hanoin kleuk! Too bainhira mak Hau sei hamutuk ho imi, no tenki hatudu pasiénsia ba imi? Lori o nia oan mane mai iha nee.”
verses.42: No bainhira labarik nee mai dadaun, diabu soe nia ba rai no doko makaas nia. Maibee Jesus siak espíritu aat, no kura labarik nee. Depois Nia foo fali labarik nee ba labarik nia aman.
verses.43: Ema hotu hakfodak ho Maromak nia kbiit boot. Maibee momentu sira hotu admira hela kona ba buat hotu nebee Jesus halo, Nia dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira,
verses.44: “Husik liafuan nee tama duni ba imi nia tilun: ema ida sei entrega Ema Nia Oan ba ema sira nia liman.”
verses.45: Maibee sira la kompriende liafuan nee, no signifikadu nee subar hosi sira, atu sira la bele hatene. No sira tauk atu husu Nia kona ba liafuan nee.
verses.46: Sira komesa diskuti malu kona ba see mak boot liu.
verses.47: Maibee Jesus hatene buat nebee sira hanoin iha sira nia fuan laran, no Nia foti labarik kiik ida, no tau labarik nee iha Ninia sorin.
verses.48: Nia dehan ba sira, “See deit nebee simu labarik kiik nee hodi Hau nia naran simu mos Hau. No see deit nebee simu Hau simu mos Nia nebee haruka Hau mai. Tanba nia nebee kiik liu iha imi hotu nia leet, nia mak ida nebee boot liu.”
verses.49: No João hataan, “Mestri, ami haree ona ema ida duni sai diabu sira hodi O nia naran. Ami haruka nia para, tanba nia la lao tuir ho ita.”
verses.50: Maibee Jesus dehan ba nia, “Keta hapara nia. Tanba ema nebee la kontra ita mak hamutuk ho ita.”
verses.51: Bainhira tempu besik ona atu Jesus sae ba lalehan, Nia desidi metin atu baa Jerusalém.
verses.52: Nia haruka manu-ain sira hodi lao uluk Nia. Sira baa no tama aldeia ida nebee ema Samaria nian hodi prepara fatin ba Nia.
verses.53: Maibee sira la simu Nia, tanba Nia see oin atu baa Jerusalém.
verses.54: No bainhira Ninia eskolante Tiago no João haree nunee, sira dehan, “Nai, O hakarak ami haruka ahi tuun mai hosi lalehan no haan mohu sira ka?”
verses.55: Maibee Nia fila oin, no siak fali sira.
verses.56: No sira baa aldeia seluk.
verses.57: Tuir mai, bainhira sira lao dadaun iha dalan, mane ida dehan ba Nia, “Nai, hau sei tuir O ba fatin nebee deit mak O baa.”
verses.58: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Asu fuik kiik iha rai kuak, no manu fuik iha knuuk; maibee Ema Nia Oan la iha fatin ida atu tau Ninia ulun.”
verses.59: Jesus dehan ba ema ida seluk, “Tuir Hau.” Maibee nia dehan, “Nai, husik hau baa hakoi uluk lai hau nia aman.”
verses.60: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Husik ema mate hakoi sira nia ema mate. Maibee o baa no haklaken kona ba Maromak nia reinu.”
verses.61: Ema seluk tan mos dehan, “Nai, Hau sei tuir O. Maibee husik hau fila uluk lai no foo adeus ba ema iha hau nia uma.”
verses.62: No Jesus dehan ba nia, “Ema ida nebee tau ninia liman ba ai suak hodi fila rai no hateke fali ba kotuk, nia la merese atu serví iha Maromak nia reinu.”

10.title: Jesus Haruka Ema Hitu-nulu Resin Rua

verses.1: Tuir mai, Nai foo knaar ba ema nain hitu-nulu resin rua, no haruka sira nain rua-rua baa uluk Nia no tama sidade no fatin hotu nebee Nia atu baa.
verses.2: Nunee Nia dehan ba sira, “Rezultadu iha toos nee boot tebes, maibee ema atu servisu uitoan deit. Nunee halo orasaun makaas ba rezultadu nia Nain atu haruka servisu nain tama ba Ninia rezultadu nee.
verses.3: Baa deit. Tebes, Hau haruka imi baa nudar bibi oan iha asu fuik sira nia leet.
verses.4: Keta lori osan fatin ka pasta ka sandálias. Keta kumprimenta ema iha dalan.
verses.5: Ba uma hotu nebee imi tama, dehan uluk, ‘Dame ba uma nee!’
verses.6: No se ema dame hela iha nebaa, husik imi nia dame hela ho nia. Se lae, dame nee sei fila fali ba imi.
verses.7: No hela iha uma nee. Haan no hemu buat nebee sira foo. Tanba ema servisu merese atu simu ninia kolen. La bele muda hosi uma ba uma.
verses.8: No iha sidade hotu nebee imi tama, no sira simu imi, haan buat nebee sira tau iha imi nia oin.
verses.9: Kura ema moras iha nebaa, no dehan ba sira, ‘Maromak nia reinu besik ona imi.’
verses.10: Maibee iha sidade hotu nebee imi tama, no sira la simu imi, tama ba dalan boot iha sidade nee, no dehan,
verses.11: ‘Rai rahun mos hosi imi nia sidade, nebee belit ba ami nia ain, ami liki tiha hasoru imi. Maski nunee, hatene metin ba, katak Maromak nia reinu besik ona.’
verses.12: Maibee Hau hatete ba imi, katak iha Loron nebaa, Sodoma sei simu kastigu kamaan liu sidade nee.
verses.13: Susar ba o, Korazin! Susar ba o, Betsaida! Tanba se karik milagre boot nebee halo ona iha imi nia leet sei halo fali iha Tiro no Sidon, sira sei arepende kleur ona no tuur iha hena karoon no ahi kdesan.
verses.14: Maibee iha Loron Tesi Lia, Tiro no Sidon sei simu kastigu kamaan liu fali imi.
verses.15: No o, Kafarnaum, o sei sae ba lalehan ka? O sei tuun ba infernu!
verses.16: Ema nebee rona imi rona mos Hau. No ema nebee hakribi imi, hakribi mos Hau. No ema nebee hakribi Hau, hakribi mos Nia nebee haruka Hau mai.”
verses.17: Ema nain hitu-nulu resin rua fila fali ho haksolok. Sira dehan, “Nai, diabu sira mos tuir ami nia orden hodi O nia naran.”
verses.18: No Jesus dehan ba sira, “Hau haree Satanás monu hosi lalehan hanesan rai lakan.
verses.19: Tebes, Hau foo ona kbiit ba imi atu sama samea no sakunar sira, no atu domina kbiit hotu hosi inimigu. La iha buat ida bele hakanek imi.
verses.20: Maski nunee, lalika haksolok katak espíritu sira tuir imi nia orden, maibee haksolok ba tanba imi nia naran sira hakerek ona iha lalehan.
verses.21: Iha tempu nee, Jesus haksolok iha Espíritu Santu no dehan, “Hau foo agradese ba O, Aman, lalehan no mundu nia Nain, tanba O subar tiha buat sira nee hosi ema matenek klean no hosi ema nebee kompriende, no O hatudu fali buat sira nee ba kiik-oan sira. Loos duni, Aman, tanba O hanoin buat nee diak.
verses.22: Hau nia Aman entrega ona buat hotu mai Hau. La iha ema ida mak konhese Oan Mane, só Aman deit. No mos, la iha ema ida mak konhese Aman nee, só Oan Mane deit, no sira nebee Oan Mane hakarak hatudu Aman ba sira.”
verses.23: Depois Nia fila ba Ninia eskolante sira, no bainhira sira mesak, Nia dehan, “Haksolok ba matan nebee haree buat nebee imi haree.
verses.24: Tanba Hau hatete ba imi katak profeta no liurai barak hakarak haree buat nebee imi haree, maibee sira la haree. No sira hakarak rona buat nebee imi rona, maibee sira la rona.”
verses.25: No tebes, ema ida nebee hatene lei hamriik atu koko Jesus, no nia dehan, “Mestri, hau tenki halo saida atu hetan moris rohan laek?
verses.26: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Saida mak hakerek ona iha Lei? O lee oinsaa?
verses.27: Nia hataan, “O sei hadomi Nai, o nia Maromak, ho o nia fuan laran tomak, o nia klamar tomak, o nia forsa tomak, no o nia neon tomak; no hadomi o nia maluk hanesan o nia aan rasik.”
verses.28: No Jesus dehan ba nia, “O hataan loos. Halo ida nee, no O sei hetan moris.”
verses.29: Maibee nia hakarak hatudu aan nudar ema loos. Entaun nia dehan ba Jesus, “No see mak hau nia maluk?”
verses.30: Jesus hataan dehan, “Iha mane ida sai hosi Jerusalém no tuun ba Jerikó. No nia monu ba naok-teen sira. Sira hadau ninia sasaan, baku tasak nia no husik hela nia besik atu mate.
verses.31: Sorti deit, saserdote ida lao iha dalan nee. Maibee bainhira nia haree mane nee, nia lao liu iha dalan sorin ba.
verses.32: Hanesan mos ema Levi ida mai too iha fatin nebaa. Maibee bainhira nia haree mane nee, nia lao liu iha dalan sorin ba.
verses.33: Maibee ema Samaria ida lao iha dalan no mai too mane nia fatin nee. No bainhira ema Samaria haree mane nee, nia hanoin tebes mane nee.
verses.34: Nia hakbesik ba mane nee, no falun tiha mane nia kanek no fui mina no tua uvas ba kanek nee. Depois nia tula mane nee ho ninia animál no lori mane ba uma aluga ida hodi tau matan ba nia.
verses.35: Aban dadeer, nia foti osan denáriu rua, no foo ba uma nain. Nia dehan ba uma nain, ‘Tau matan ba mane nee, no se ita gasta osan tan karik, hau sei selu fali ita bainhira hau mai fali.’
verses.36: Agora, tuir o nia hanoin, entre sira nain tolu nee, ida nebee mak sai maluk ba mane nebee monu ba naok-teen sira?”
verses.37: Ema nee hataan, “Nia nebee hatudu laran luak ba mane nee.” Nunee Jesus dehan ba nia, “Baa, no halo hanesan.”
verses.38: Bainhira sira lao ba, sira tama aldeia ida. No feto ida naran Marta simu Jesus iha ninia uma.
verses.39: Marta iha alin feto ida naran Maria, nebee tuur iha Jesus nia ain hodi rona Ninia liafuan.
verses.40: Maibee Marta preokupa ho servisu barak atu serví sira. No nia hakbesik ba Jesus no dehan, “Nai, O la hanoin ka katak hau nia alin husik hela hau mesak atu serví? Nunee haruka nia ajuda hau ba.”
verses.41: No Jesus hataan ba nia, “Marta, Marta, o preokupa no hanoin resin kona ba buat barak.
verses.42: Maibee o presiza buat ida deit. Maria hili tiha ona parte ida nebee diak, no ema ida sei la foti ida nee hosi nia.”

verses.1: Tuir mai, Jesus halo orasaun iha fatin ida. Hotu tiha, Ninia eskolante ida dehan ba Nia, “Nai, hanorin ami atu halo orasaun, hanesan João mos hanorin ona ninia eskolante sira.”
verses.2: Nia dehan ba sira, “Bainhira imi halo orasaun, dehan,
verses.3: Haraik ai haan loro-loron nian mai ami.
verses.4: Foo perdaun mai ami nia sala,
verses.5: No Jesus dehan ba sira, “See mak iha kolega nebee, se imi ida baa nia iha kalan boot, no dehan ba nia, ‘Kolega, foo netik paun fuan tolu mai hau.
verses.6: Tanba hau nia maluk ida foin mai hosi rai dook, no hau la iha buat ida atu foo ba nia haan.’
verses.7: No nia hataan hosi uma laran, ‘Keta halo susar mai hau. Tanba odamatan taka metin tiha ona, no hau nia oan sira mak hamutuk ona ho hau iha kama. Hau la bele hadeer hodi foo buat ruma ba o’?
verses.8: Hau dehan ba imi, maski nia sei la hadeer no foo buat ruma tanba ema nee mak ninia kolega, maibee tanba ema husu nafatin, ikus mai nia sei hadeer no foo buat saida deit nebee ema nee presiza.
verses.9: No Hau dehan, Husu ba, no o sei simu; buka ba, no o sei hetan; dere ba, no odamatan sei nakloke ba o.
verses.10: Tanba ema hotu nebee husu sei simu; no nia nebee buka sei hetan; no ba nia nebee dere, odamatan nee sei nakloke ba nia.
verses.11: Iha imi nia leet, iha aman ida nebee bainhira ninia oan husu ikan ida, nia sei foo fali samea ida ba ninia oan nee ka?
verses.12: Ka se nia sei husu manu tolun ida, aman sei foo fali sakunar ida ba nia ka?
verses.13: Nunee, se karik imi, maski imi aat, hatene oinsaa atu foo prezenti diak ba imi nia oan sira, saa tan imi nia Aman iha lalehan sei foo duni Espíritu Santu ba sira nebee husu Nia?”
verses.14: Jesus duni sai diabu ida nebee monok. Bainhira diabu sai ona, ema monok nee bele koalia fali. Nunee povu admira.
verses.15: Maibee ema balu dehan, “Nia duni sai diabu sira hodi Belzebu, nebee diabu sira nia xefi.”
verses.16: No ema seluk hakarak koko Nia. Entaun sira buka hela sinál ida hosi lalehan.
verses.17: Maibee Nia hatene sira nia hanoin, no Nia dehan ba sira, “Reinu hotu nebee fahe aan hodi hasoru ninia aan rasik sei rahun mohu deit; no uma kain ida nebee fahe aan sei monu.
verses.18: No se karik Satanás mos fahe aan hodi hasoru ninia aan rasik, oinsaa ninia reinu bele hamriik? Tanba imi dehan katak Hau duni sai diabu sira hodi Belzebu.
verses.19: Se Hau duni sai diabu sira hodi Belzebu, entaun imi nia oan sira duni sai diabu sira liu hosi see? Nunee sira sei tesi lia ba imi.
verses.20: Maibee se Hau duni sai diabu sira ho liman fuan hosi Maromak, entaun Maromak nia reinu too ona ba imi.
verses.21: Bainhira mane forti ida, nebee iha armas kompletu, hein ninia uma, ninia sasaan sei seguru.
verses.22: Maibee bainhira ema forti liu fali nia mai ataka nia, no manaan nia, ema forti liu nee hadau ninia armas hotu nebee nia tau fiar. Depois ema forti liu nee sei fahe ninia riku-soin.
verses.23: Ema nebee la hamutuk ho Hau mak kontra Hau. No ema nebee la halibur hamutuk ho Hau, namkari deit.
verses.24: Bainhira espíritu foer sai hosi ema ida, nia lao liu hosi rai maran hodi buka fatin deskansa. Maibee bainhira nia la hetan, nia dehan, ‘Hau sei fila fali ba hau nia uma nebee hau husik ona.’
verses.25: Bainhira nia too, nia hetan uma nee dasa tiha no aruma ona.
verses.26: Entaun nia baa, no lori tan espíritu aat hitu nebee aat liu nia. Sira tama no hela iha nebaa. Ikus mai, ema ida nee sai aat liu fali uluk.”
verses.27: Bainhira Jesus koalia dadaun, feto ida hosi ema lubun nia leet, hakilar no dehan ba Nia, “Haksolok ba oan fatin nebee kous O, no susun nebee foo susu ba O!”
verses.28: Maibee Nia dehan, “Tuir lo-loos, haksolok ba sira nebee rona Maromak nia liafuan no halo tuir!”
verses.29: Bainhira ema lubun sira aumenta liu tan, Nia komesa koalia dehan, “Ida nee mak jerasaun aat. Sira buka sinál ida. Maibee sira sei la hetan sinál ida, só deit sinál Jonas nian.
verses.30: Tanba hanesan Jonas sai sinál ida ba ema Nínive sira, nunee mos Ema Nia Oan sei sai sinál ba jerasaun nee.
verses.31: Liurai feto hosi parte súl sei hamriik ho jerasaun nee iha tempu Tesi Lia nian, no nia sei kondena imi. Tanba nia mai hosi mundu rohan hodi rona matenek klean hosi Salomão. No tebes, iha nee iha ema ida nee nebee boot liu fali Salomão.
verses.32: Ema Nínive sei hamriik ho jerasaun nee iha tempu Tesi Lia nian, no sira sei kondena imi. Tanba sira arepende bainhira sira rona haklaken hosi Jonas. No tebes, iha nee iha ema ida nebee boot liu fali Jonas.
verses.33: Ema la sunu ahi oan hodi subar iha fatin segredu, ka taka fali iha baldi okos. Maibee nia tau iha ahi oan nia fatin hodi ema nebee tama uma bele haree naroman nee.
verses.34: Matan mak ahi oan ba isin lolon. Nunee se o nia matan moos, o nia isin tomak sei nakonu ho naroman. Maibee se o nia matan aat, o nia isin tomak sei nakonu ho nakukun.
verses.35: Nunee kuidadu ba, katak naroman nebee iha o nia laran nee laos nakukun.
verses.36: Se o nia isin tomak nakonu ho naroman, no la iha parte ida nebee nakukun, nunee o nia isin tomak sei naroman hanesan ahi oan nebee leno hodi foo naroman ba o.
verses.37: Bainhira Jesus koalia hela, ema Farizeu ida husu Jesus atu mai haan ho nia. Entaun Jesus baa ho nia, no tuur iha meza.
verses.38: Ema Farizeu nee hakfodak tanba Jesus la hamoos aan molok atu haan.
verses.39: No Nai dehan ba nia, “Imi ema Farizeu sira fasi kopu no bikan nia liur, maibee imi nia laran nakonu fali ho hahalok kaan-teen no hahalok aat.
verses.40: Beik-teen sira! Laos Nia nebee kria buat nebee iha liur kria mos buat nebee iha laran?
verses.41: Maibee foo ezmola hosi buat nebee iha laran, no tebes, buat hotu sei sai moos ba imi.
verses.42: Maibee susar ba imi, ema Farizeu sira! Tanba imi foo porsentu sanulu hosi ortelaun, aruda no modo oi-oin, maibee imi husik fali justisa no Maromak nia domin. Tuir lo-loos imi tenki halo buat uluk nee, no la bele husik buat sira seluk.
verses.43: Susar ba imi, ema Farizeu sira! Tanba imi gosta kadeira importante iha sinagoga sira, no imi gosta bainhira ema kumprimenta imi iha merkadu.
verses.44: Susar ba imi, ema eskriba no Farizeu sira, ema laran makerek sira! Tanba imi hanesan rate nebee la iha marka, no ema lao sama iha leten mos la hatene.”
verses.45: Depois ema nebee hatene lei hataan no dehan ba Nia, “Mestri, bainhira Ita Boot koalia hanesan nee, Ita Boot abuza mos ami.”
verses.46: No Jesus dehan, “Susar ba imi mos, ema nebee hatene lei! Tanba imi hatodan ema ho naha nebee susar atu lori, no imi rasik la book naha todan nee ho liman fuan ida.
verses.47: Susar ba imi! Tanba imi hada profeta sira nia rate, maibee imi nia bei-ala sira mak oho profeta sira nee.
verses.48: Tebes, imi sai sasin katak imi konkorda ho imi nia bei-ala sira nia hahalok: tanba sira oho profeta sira, no imi hada sira nia rate.
verses.49: Nunee mos matenek klean hosi Maromak dehan, ‘Hau sei haruka profeta no apostolu sira ba ema sira nee, no sira sei oho no hanehan balu.’
verses.50: Nunee jerasaun nee sei simu kastigu tanba profeta hotu nia raan nebee fakar desde mundu hahuu,
verses.51: hosi Abel nia raan too iha Zakarias nia raan, nebee ema oho iha Templu no altár nia klaran. Tebes Hau hatete ba imi, jerasaun ida nee sei lori todan nee.
verses.52: Susar ba imi, ema nebee hatene lei! Tanba imi hadau ona xavi ba fatin matenek. Imi rasik la tama, no imi taka netik dalan ba sira nebee atu tama.”
verses.53: Bainhira Jesus sai dadaun hosi fatin nee, ema eskriba no Farizeu sira komesa haleu Nia no provoka Nia atu koalia kina ba buat barak.
verses.54: Tanba sira hein atu kasa Nia liu hosi liafuan ruma nebee Nia koalia.

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, bainhira ema rihun ba rihun halibur hamutuk too sira sena malu, Jesus komesa koalia uluk ba Ninia eskolante sira dehan, “Kuidadu kona ba ema Farizeu sira nia fermentu, katak laran makerek.
verses.2: Tanba buat hotu nebee taka hela, sei nakloke; no buat hotu nebee subar hela, ema sei hatene.
verses.3: Nunee buat hotu nebee imi koalia iha fatin nakukun, ema sei rona iha fatin naroman; no buat nebee imi bis-bisu ba tilun iha kuartu laran, ema sei foo sai fali hosi uma leten.
verses.4: “Hau hatete ba imi, Hau nia belun sira, keta tauk sira nebee bele oho isin lolon, depois sira la bele halo buat ida tan.
verses.5: Maibee Hau sei foo hatene ba imi see loos mak imi tenki tauk: imi tenki tauk Nia, nebee bainhira Nia oho tiha, depois Nia iha kbiit atu soe ba infernu. Sin, Hau hatete ba imi, tenki tauk Nia.
verses.6: Laos manu liin lima faan ho folin dolar ida? Maibee ida deit mos Maromak la haluha.
verses.7: Maibee Nia sura imi nia fuuk lahan hotu iha imi nia lun. Nunee keta tauk, tanba imi folin boot liu manu liin barak.
verses.8: Hau hatete ba imi, ema hotu nebee rekonhese Hau iha ema nia oin, Ema Nia Oan mos sei rekonhese nia iha Maromak nia anju sira nia oin.
verses.9: Maibee nia nebee nega Hau iha ema nia oin, Hau mos sei nega nia iha Maromak nia anju sira nia oin.
verses.10: No ema hotu nebee koalia liafuan ida hasoru Ema Nia Oan sei hetan perdua. Maibee nia nebee koalia aat hasoru Espíritu Santu sei la hetan perdua.
verses.11: Bainhira sira lori imi ba sinagoga sira, ba xefi sira, no ba autoridade sira nia oin, lalika preokupa oinsaa atu defende aan, ka saida mak imi sei dehan.
verses.12: Tanba Espíritu Santu sei hanorin imi iha oras nebaa duni kona ba buat nebee imi sei dehan.
verses.13: Ema ida hosi ema lubun nee dehan ba Nia, “Mestri, haruka hau nia maun atu fahe liman rohan ho hau.”
verses.14: Maibee Jesus dehan ba nia, “See mak foti Hau atu sai juis ka tesi lia ba imi?”
verses.15: Depois Jesus dehan ba sira, “Rona di-diak, no kuidadu kona ba laran kaan. Tanba ema nia moris laos kona ba riku-soin nebee nia iha.”
verses.16: No Nia konta ai knanoik ida ba sira, no dehan, “Ema riku ida nia toos foo rezultadu boot.
verses.17: No ema nee hanoin iha nia laran, no dehan, ‘Hau sei halo saida? Tanba Hau la iha fatin atu rai hau nia ai haan nee.’
verses.18: Ema nee dehan, ‘Hau sei halo ida nee: Hau sei sobu hau nia armazén, no harii fali boot liu tan. Depois hau sei rai hau nia ai haan no sasaan hotu.
verses.19: No hau sei dehan ba hau nia klamar, “Klamar, o rai tiha ona sasaan barak nebee natoon ba tinan barak. Deskansa lai - haan, hemu no haksolok ba.”’
verses.20: Maibee Maromak dehan ba nia, ‘Beik-teen! Iha kalan nee kedas, Hau sei foti fali o nia klamar. Nunee see mak hetan sasaan nebee o rai tiha ona nee?’
verses.21: Nunee mos ba nia nebee halibur riku-soin ba ninia aan rasik, maibee la sai riku ba Maromak.”
verses.22: Jesus dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Nunee Hau hatete ba imi: keta preokupa kona ba imi nia moris, atu haan saida; no kona ba imi nia isin, atu hatais saida.
verses.23: Moris iha folin liu fali ai haan, no isin iha folin liu fali ropa.
verses.24: Hanoin took manu metan sira: Sira la kuda ka silu, no sira la iha gudang ka armazén. Maibee Maromak foo haan ba sira. Oinsaa liu tan mak imi iha folin boot liu fali manu sira nee!
verses.25: See mak bele aumenta oras ida ba ninia moris rasik liu hosi preokupa nee?
verses.26: Nunee se imi la bele halo buat kiik hanesan nee, tanba saa mak imi preokupa kona ba buat seluk?
verses.27: Hanoin took, oinsaa ai funan sai buras. Sira la servisu ka dulas kabas. Maibee Hau hatete ba imi, katak Salomão nia glória hotu mos la hatais furak hanesan ai funan sira nee ida.
verses.28: Entaun, se Maromak foo hatais ba duut hanesan nee, nebee loron ohin moris iha rai luan, depois loron aban ema soe fali ba ahi, oinsaa liu tan mak Nia sei foo hatais imi? Oh imi nebee fiar kiik!
verses.29: Lalika buka buat ruma atu haan ka buat ruma atu hemu, no keta hanoin barak.
verses.30: Tanba nasaun hotu iha mundu buka buat sira nee. No imi nia Aman hatene katak imi presiza buat sira nee.
verses.31: Maibee buka Maromak nia reinu, no Nia sei haraik buat sira nee hotu ba imi.
verses.32: “Bibi lubun kiik, keta tauk. Tanba imi nia Aman hakarak foo reinu ba imi.
verses.33: Faan tiha imi nia sasaan, no foo ba ema kiak. Prepara ba imi nia aan osan fatin nebee la sai tuan, katak riku-soin iha lalehan nebee la lakon. Tanba naok-teen la bele hakbesik no ular la bele estraga riku-soin nebee iha lalehan.
verses.34: Tanba iha fatin nebee imi rai imi nia riku-soin, imi nia fuan laran mos iha nebaa.
verses.35: Imi tenki hatais hodi prontu, no imi nia ahi oan tenki lakan nafatin.
verses.36: Sai hanesan ema nebee hein sira nia patraun atu fila hosi festa kazamentu. Nunee bainhira nia dere odamatan, sira bele loke kedas ba nia.
verses.37: Haksolok ba atan sira nee, nebee bainhira patraun too mai, nia hetan sira hein hela. Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, katak nia sei hatais aan hodi servisu no haruka sira tuur hodi haan. No nia sei mai no serví sira.
verses.38: Se nia mai kalan boot ka dadeer-saan nakukun, no hetan sira hein hela, nunee haksolok ba atan sira nee!
verses.39: Hatene ba, katak se uma nain hatene oras saida mak naok-teen atu mai, nia sei la husik ninia uma atu naok-teen bele tama.
verses.40: Nunee mos, imi tenki prontu nafatin. Tanba Ema Nia Oan sei mai iha oras nebee imi la hatene.”
verses.41: Depois Pedro dehan ba Jesus, “Nai, O konta ai knanoik nee ba ami deit ka ba ema hotu?”
verses.42: No Nai dehan, “Entaun see mak atan fiel ho matenek klean, nebee ninia patraun sei halo nia sai ulun ba ninia uma kain, atu foo ema sira nia ai haan tuir oras nebee loos?
verses.43: Haksolok ba atan nee, nebee ninia patraun sei mai no hetan nia halo tuir nunee.
verses.44: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, nia sei foti atan nee hodi toma konta ba ninia riku-soin hotu.
verses.45: Maibee se karik atan nee dehan iha ninia fuan laran, ‘Hau nia patraun tardi atu fila mai.’ Nunee nia komesa baku atan mane no atan feto sira. No nia haan hemu too lanu.
verses.46: Depois atan nee nia patraun sei mai iha loron nebee atan nee la hein, no iha oras nebee nia la hatene. Patraun nee sei tesi rahun nia no tau nia ho ema nebee la fiel.
verses.47: Atan nebee hatene ninia patraun nia hakarak, maibee la prepara aan, ka la halo tuir ninia hakarak - atan nee sei hetan kastigu todan.
verses.48: Maibee atan nebee la hatene, no halo buat nebee merese atu simu kastigu, nia sei simu kastigu kamaan. Tanba ema hotu nebee simu barak, tenki foo barak. No nia nebee simu knaar boot, tenki halo boot liu tan.
verses.49: Hau mai atu soe ahi ba mundu nee. No Hau hakarak katak ahi nee lakan ona!
verses.50: Hau iha batizmu ida nebee Hau atu simu. No Hau nia laran susar tebe-tebes too ida nee halo tiha ona!
verses.51: Imi hanoin katak Hau mai atu foo dame ba mundu ka? Laos! Hau dehan ba imi katak Hau sei halo ema kontra malu.
verses.52: Tanba hosi agora ba oin, ema nain lima iha uma ida sei fahe malu. Nain tolu sei kontra nain rua, no nain rua sei kontra nain tolu.
verses.53: Aman sei kontra hasoru oan mane, no oan mane sei hasoru aman. Inan sei hasoru oan feto, no oan feto sei hasoru inan. Banin feto sei hasoru ninia feto foun, no feto foun sei hasoru ninia banin feto.”
verses.54: No Nia dehan mos ba ema lubun nee, “Bainhira imi haree kalohan ida mosu mai iha parte loromonu, imi dehan kedas, ‘Udan atu mai.’ No ida nee akontese duni.
verses.55: No bainhira imi haree anin huu hosi parte súl, imi dehan, ‘Tempu manas sei mai.’ No ida nee akontese duni.
verses.56: Imi ema laran makerek sira! Imi hatene siik buat nebee mosu iha rai no iha loro-leten, maibee tanba saa mak imi la hatene fali atu siik tempu ida nee?
verses.57: Tanba saa mak imi rasik la desidi kona ba buat nebee loos?
verses.58: Bainhira o lao baa juis ho o nia akuzadór, hakaas aan atu resolve lai ho akuzadór iha dalan. Keta halo be nia entrega o ba juis, no juis entrega o ba guarda, no sira soe o ba komarka laran.
verses.59: Tebes, Hau hatete ba o katak o sei la sai hosi fatin nee too o selu osan hotu too sentavu ikus nian.”

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, ema balu foo hatene ba Jesus kona ba ema Galileia balu nebee Pilatos kahur sira nia raan ho sira nia sakrifísiu.
verses.2: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Imi hanoin ema Galileia sira nee hetan terus tanba sira mak sala nain nebee aat liu ema Galileia sira seluk ka?
verses.3: Hau hatete ba imi, laos. Maibee se imi la arepende, imi hotu mos sei lakon hanesan sira.
verses.4: Ka sira nain sanulu resin ualu, nebee uma aas Siloé monu hanehan sira no hamate sira. Imi hanoin katak sira mak sala nain aat liu ema seluk nebee hela iha Jerusalém ka?
verses.5: Hau hatete ba imi, laos. Maibee se imi la arepende, imi hotu mos sei lakon hanesan sira.”
verses.6: Nia konta mos ai knanoik nee: “Mane ida kuda ai figeira ida iha ninia toos uvas. Nia mai atu buka ai fuan hosi ai figeira nee maibee nia la hetan.
verses.7: Entaun nia dehan ba ema nebee servisu iha toos uvas nee, ‘Tebes, too tinan tolu ona, hau mai buka ai fuan hosi ai figeira nee. Maibee hau la hetan ida. Tesi tiha ai huun nee. Tanba saa mak ita husik nia la halo buat ida iha rai nee?’
verses.8: No servisu nain hataan ba nia, ‘Nai, husik nia too tinan ida tan, no hau sei kee rai haleu nia huun no tau karau teen.
verses.9: No se nia foo fuan, diak. Maibee se lae, ita bele tesi tuun nia.’”
verses.10: Jesus hanorin iha sinagoga ida iha loron Sabdu.
verses.11: No tebes, iha feto ida nebee iha espíritu nebee halo nia isin fraku durante tinan sanulu resin ualu. Nia hakruuk bonko deit no la bele hamriik loos.
verses.12: Bainhira Jesus haree feto nee, Nia bolu feto mai. Nia dehan ba feto nee, “Feto, o livre ona hosi o nia moras nee.”
verses.13: No Jesus tau liman ba nia, no nia hamriik loos kedas no hahii Maromak.
verses.14: Maibee sinagoga nia nai ulun hirus tanba Jesus kura ema iha loron Sabdu. No nia dehan ba povu nee, “Iha loron neen hodi halo servisu. Mai hetan kura iha loron sira nee, laos iha loron Sabdu.”
verses.15: Nai hataan ba nia dehan, “O laran makerek, iha loron Sabdu, laos imi ida-idak kore imi nia karau ka kuda buru hosi ninia luhan hodi lori nia ba hemu?
verses.16: Laos feto nee, nebee Abraão nia oan feto ida, nebee Satanás kesi durante tinan sanulu resin ualu, bele sai livre hosi kastigu nee iha loron Sabdu?”
verses.17: No bainhira Nia koalia nunee, ninia inimigu hotu sai moe. No povu hotu haksolok tanba buat furak hotu nebee Nia halo.
verses.18: Depois Jesus dehan, “Maromak nia reinu hanesan saida? No Hau sei kompara reinu nee ho saida?
verses.19: Reinu nee hanesan mostarda musan ida, nebee ema lori no kuda iha ninia toos. Mostarda musan nee moris mai no sai ai huun boot ida. No manu sira iha loro leten mai halo knuuk iha ninia sanak.”
verses.20: No Nia dehan fali, “Hau sei kompara Maromak nia reinu ho saida?
verses.21: Reinu nee hanesan fermentu, nebee feto ida foti no kahur hamutuk ho trigu baldi tolu, too masa tomak sae.”
verses.22: Jesus kontinua lao liu hosi sidade no aldeia sira atu baa Jerusalém. No Nia kontinua hanorin.
verses.23: Ema ida dehan ba Nia, “Nai, ema uitoan deit sei hetan salvasaun ka?” No Nia dehan ba sira,
verses.24: “Hakaas aan atu tama liu hosi odamatan kloot. Tanba Hau hatete ba imi katak ema barak koko atu tama no sira la bele.
verses.25: Bainhira uma nain hamriik no taka tiha odamatan, imi sei hamriik iha liur no dere odamatan. No imi sei dehan, ‘Nai, Nai, loke lai odamatan mai ami.’ No nia sei hataan ba imi, ‘Hau la hatene imi mai hosi nebee.’
verses.26: Depois imi sei hahuu dehan, ‘Ami haan hemu ona iha ita boot nia prezensa, no ita boot hanorin iha ami nia dalan sira.’
verses.27: Maibee nia sei dehan, ‘Hau hatete ba imi, Hau la hatene imi mai hosi nebee. Hadook aan tiha hosi hau, imi hotu nebee halo hahalok aat.’
verses.28: No imi sei tanis no ruun nehan bainhira imi haree Abraão, Isak no Jacó, no profeta sira hotu iha Maromak nia reinu, no Maromak soe imi rasik sai ba liur.
verses.29: No ema sei mai hosi parte lorosae no loromonu, hosi parte norte no súl. No sira sei tuur iha Maromak nia reinu.
verses.30: Tebes, ema nebee ikus sei sai primeiru. No ema nebee primeiru sei sai ikus.
verses.31: Iha oras nee, ema Farizeu balu mai no dehan ba Jesus, “Sai tiha hosi fatin nee, tanba Herodes hakarak oho O.”
verses.32: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi baa no foo hatene ba asu fuik kiik nee, ‘Tebes, Hau duni sai diabu sira no Hau kura ema ohin no aban. No iha loron terseiru Hau sei halo kompletu.
verses.33: Maski nunee Hau tenki kontinua lao ohin, aban no loron tuir mai. Tanba profeta ida la bele mate iha Jerusalém nia liur.’
verses.34: Oh Jerusalém, Jerusalém, nebee oho profeta sira, no tuda mate sira nebee Maromak haruka ba o! Dala hira ona Hau hakarak halibur hamutuk o nia oan sira, hanesan manu inan halibur ninia oan sira iha ninia liras okos. Maibee imi lakohi!
verses.35: Tebes, Maromak husik tiha ona imi nia uma nee. Tebes, Hau hatete ba imi katak imi sei la haree tan Hau too tempu nebee imi dehan, ‘Bensaun ba Nia nebee mai hodi Nai nia naran.’”

verses.1: Iha loron Sabdu ida, bainhira Jesus tama ba iha xefi Farizeu ida nia uma atu haan, sira haree tu-tuir Nia.
verses.2: No tebes, iha mane ida iha Ninia oin nebee moras isin bubu.
verses.3: Jesus hataan ba ema nebee hatene lei no ema Farizeu sira dehan, “Tuir lei, ita bele kura iha loron Sabdu ka lae?”
verses.4: Maibee sira nonook deit. Entaun Jesus tau liman ba ema nee, kura nia no haruka nia baa.
verses.5: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Iha imi nia leet, see mak iha oan ka karau ida nebee monu iha bee posu iha loron Sabdu no la hasai kedas nia?”
verses.6: No sira la bele hataan liafuan ida kona ba buat hirak nee.
verses.7: Bainhira Jesus haree oinsaa bainaka sira hili tuur fatin nebee importante, Nia konta ai knanoik ida ba sira. Nia dehan ba sira,
verses.8: “Bainhira ema konvida o ba festa kazamentu ida, keta tuur iha fatin importante. Keta halo be nia konvida ema boot liu fali o.
verses.9: No nia nebee konvida imi nain rua sei mai no dehan ba o, ‘Foo fatin nee ba ema ida nee.’ Nunee o komesa sai moe no tenki baa fatin iha kotuk liu.
verses.10: Maibee bainhira ema konvida o, baa tuur iha kotuk liu. No bainhira nia nebee konvida o mai, nia bele dehan ba o, ‘Belun, mai tuur lai iha oin.’ Entaun o sei simu onra iha ema hotu nia oin nebee tuur iha meza hamutuk ho o.
verses.11: Tanba ema nebee foti aan, Nai sei hatuun nia; no ema nebee haraik aan, Nai sei foti aas nia.”
verses.12: Depois Jesus dehan ba ema nebee konvida Nia, “Bainhira o prepara haan kalan ka festa ida, keta konvida o nia belun sira, ka o nia maun-alin sira, ka o nia família, ka o nia vizinhu sira nebee riku. Tanba sira bele mos konvida fali o, no selu fali o.
verses.13: Maibee bainhira o halo festa, konvida ema kiak sira, ema aleijadu sira, ema ain aat sira no ema matan delek sira.
verses.14: No o sei simu bensaun, tanba sira la bele selu fali o. Tanba o sei simu o nia kolen iha tempu nebee ema loos sei moris hias.”
verses.15: Rona tiha buat sira nee, ema ida hosi sira nebee tuur haan ho Jesus dehan ba Jesus, “Haksolok ba nia nebee sei haan paun iha Maromak nia reinu!”
verses.16: Maibee Jesus dehan ba nia, “Mane ida halo festa boot no konvida ema barak.
verses.17: Bainhira oras festa nian too ona, nia haruka ninia atan baa atu dehan ba sira nebee nia konvida ona nee, ‘Mai, tanba buat hotu prontu ona.’
verses.18: Maibee sira hotu hahuu foo razaun oi-oin. Ida primeiru dehan ba nia, ‘Hau foin sosa rai ida, no hau tenki baa no haree rai nee. Hau husu deskulpa lai.’
verses.19: No ida seluk dehan, ‘Hau foin sosa karau pár lima, no hau baa atu koko sira. Hau husu deskulpa lai.’
verses.20: No ida seluk tan dehan, ‘Hau foin kaben ho hau nia feen, nunee hau la bele baa.’
verses.21: Nunee atan mai, no foo hatene ba ninia nai kona ba buat sira nee. Depois uma nain nee sai hirus no dehan ba ninia atan, ‘Sai lalais baa estrada-estrada no dalan kiik sira iha sidade. No lori mai ema kiak, ema aleijadu, ema ain aat no ema matan delek.’
verses.22: Tuir mai, atan dehan, ‘Nai, ida nee halo tiha ona tuir ita boot nia orden. Maibee fatin sei iha.’
verses.23: No nai nee dehan ba ninia atan, ‘Sai ba dalan boot no toos sira, no obriga ema tama mai, hodi hau nia uma bele sai nakonu.
verses.24: Tanba hau dehan ba imi, hosi sira nebee hau konvida uluk nee, ida mos sei la koko hahaan iha hau nia festa.’”
verses.25: Ema lubun boot sira akompanha Jesus. No Nia fila oin no dehan ba sira,
verses.26: “Se ema ida hakbesik mai Hau, no nia la odi ninia inan-aman, feen, oan sira, maun-alin sira, no sin, ninia moris rasik mos, nia la bele sai Hau nia eskolante.
verses.27: No ema nebee la lori ninia krús no lao tuir Hau, nia la bele sai Hau nia eskolante.
verses.28: Tanba imi ida nebee hakarak harii uma aas ida, laos nia tuur uluk lai no sura folin hira hodi haree ninia osan too atu halo too hotu?
verses.29: Se lae, bainhira nia hada fundasaun no la bele halo too hotu, ema hotu nebee haree ida nee komesa goza nia.
verses.30: No sira sei dehan, ‘Ema nee hahuu harii uma, maibee nia la bele halo too hotu.’
verses.31: Ou se iha liurai ida nebee atu funu hasoru liurai seluk. Laos nia tuur uluk lai no tetu di-diak atu nia bele baa ho soldadu nain rihun sanulu hodi hasoru ida nebee iha soldadu nain rihun rua-nulu ka lae?
verses.32: Se lae, bainhira ida seluk dook hela, nia sei haruka reprezentante sira atu husu oinsaa atu halo dame.
verses.33: Nunee mos, se imi ida la husik buat hotu nebee nia iha, nia la bele sai Hau nia eskolante.
verses.34: Masin mak diak. Maibee se masin nee lakon meer karik, oinsaa halo nia sai meer fali?
verses.35: Masin nee la diak ba toos ka atu tau iha teen fatin, maibee atu soe deit ba liur. Nia nebee iha tilun, husik nia rona ba.”

verses.1: Ema kobradór impostu no sala nain sira hotu kontinua hakbesik ba Jesus.
verses.2: No ema Farizeu no eskriba sira murmura dehan, “Mane nee simu sala nain sira, no Nia haan hamutuk ho sira.”
verses.3: No Jesus konta ai knanoik ida nee ba sira dehan,
verses.4: “Se ema ida iha bibi atus ida, no nia lakon bibi ida hosi bibi lubun boot nee. See mak la husik bibi sia-nulu resin sia nee iha rai fuik, hodi baa buka ida nebee lakon too nia hetan fali bibi ida nee?
verses.5: No bainhira nia hetan ona bibi ida nee, nia haksolok no tau bibi nee iha ninia kabaas.
verses.6: Bainhira nia fila ba uma, nia bolu hamutuk ninia belun no maluk sira. Nia dehan ba sira, ‘Haksolok ba ho hau. Tanba hau hetan fali hau nia bibi nebee lakon.’
verses.7: Nunee Hau hatete ba imi, iha lalehan sira haksolok kona ba sala nain ida nebee arepende. Sira haksolok liu fali duké ema loos nain sia-nulu resin sia nebee la presiza arepende.
verses.8: Ka se iha feto ida nebee iha osan mutin sanulu no nia lakon ida. Laos nia sunu ahi oan ida no dasa uma laran hodi buka di-diak too nia hetan fali osan nee?
verses.9: No bainhira nia hetan fali, nia bolu hamutuk ninia belun no vizinhu sira. No nia dehan, ‘Haksolok ba ho hau. Tanba hau hetan fali osan mutin ida nebee hau lakon.’
verses.10: Nunee Hau hatete ba imi, Maromak nia anju sira haksolok kona ba sala nain ida nebee arepende.”
verses.11: Jesus dehan, “Mane ida iha oan mane nain rua.
verses.12: Oan mane kiik dehan ba ninia aman, ‘Aman, foo riku-soin parte ida nebee atu sai hau nian.’ Entaun aman nee fahe ninia riku-soin ba sira nain rua.
verses.13: Liu tiha loron balu, oan mane kiik halibur hamutuk ninia riku-soin hotu no halo viajen ba rai dook. Iha nebaa nia gasta ninia riku-soin ho moris arbiru deit.
verses.14: No bainhira nia gasta tiha buat hotu, fatin iha nebaa hasoru rai hamlaha boot. No nia komesa hamlaha.
verses.15: Entaun nia baa no servisu ba rai nain ida iha rai nebaa. No rai nain nee haruka nia hein fahi iha ninia toos.
verses.16: No nia hakarak loos atu haa ho fahi nia hahaan. Maibee la iha ema ida nebee foo buat ida ba nia.
verses.17: Bainhira nia hanoin kona ba ninia aan, nia dehan, ‘Hau nia apaa iha atan hira nebee iha ai haan natoon no mos resin, maibee iha nee hau hamlaha atu mate!
verses.18: Hau sei hamriik no fila ba hau nia aman, no dehan ba nia, “Apaa, hau halo sala ona hasoru lalehan no iha ita boot nia oin.
verses.19: No hau la merese tan atu ita boot bolu hau ita boot nia oan. Halo hau nudar ita boot nia atan servisu nain ida.”’
verses.20: Depois nia hamriik, no baa ninia aman. Maibee bainhira nia sei dook, ninia aman haree nia, no hanoin tebe-tebes nia. No ninia aman halai ba no hakuak nia no rei nia.
verses.21: No oan mane dehan ba nia, ‘Apaa, hau halo ona sala hasoru lalehan no iha ita boot nia oin. Hau la merese tan atu ita boot bolu hau ita boot nia oan.’
