verses.22: Maibee aman nee dehan ba ninia atan sira, ‘Lori mai lalais ropa furak liu, no foo hatais nia. No tau kadeli ba ninia liman no sandálias ba ninia ain.
verses.23: Lori mai karau oan bokur ida no oho nia. Mai ita haan no selebra ba.
verses.24: Tanba hau nia oan nee uluk mate, no agora nia moris fali; uluk nia lakon, no agora hau hetan fali nia.’ No sira komesa selebra.
verses.25: Maibee ninia oan mane boot sei iha toos hela. No bainhira nia fila mai besik uma nia rona múzika no ema dansa.
verses.26: Nunee nia bolu atan ida, no husu kona ba buat sira nee.
verses.27: Atan nee dehan ba nia, ‘Ita nia alin fila fali mai ona. No ita nia aman oho tiha karau oan bokur tanba nia hetan fali ninia oan ho isin diak.’
verses.28: Ho ida nee oan boot sai hirus, no nia lakohi tama ba uma laran. Ninia aman sai hodi hamaus nia.
verses.29: No oan boot nee hataan ba ninia aman dehan, ‘Haree took, tinan barak ona hau serví ita boot. Hau nunka kontra ita boot nia orden. Maibee ita boot nunka foo mai hau bibi oan ida hodi hau bele halo festa ho hau nia belun sira.
verses.30: Maibee bainhira ita boot nia oan nee mai fali, nebee halakon ita boot nia riku-soin ho feto aat sira, ita boot oho kedas karau oan bokur tanba nia.’
verses.31: Aman nee dehan ba nia, ‘Oan, o sempre hamutuk ho hau, no buat hotu nebee hau nian mak o nian.
verses.32: Maibee ida nee loos katak ita selebra no haksolok. Tanba o nia alin nee uluk mate, no agora nia moris fali; uluk nia lakon, no agora hau hetan fali nia.’”

verses.1: Jesus dehan mos ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Ema riku ida iha ema responsavel ida. No nia rona katak ema responsavel nee gasta ninia riku-soin.
verses.2: Entaun nia bolu ema nee no dehan ba nia, ‘Tanba saa mak hau rona liafuan nee kona ba o? Foo relatóriu ida mai hau kona ba o nia servisu. Tanba o la bele kontinua nudar ema responsavel.’
verses.3: Depois ema responsavel nee hanoin iha ninia laran, ‘Hau atu halo saida? Tanba hau nia nai atu hasai hau hosi hau nia knaar. Hau la iha forsa atu kee rai, no hau moe atu husu ezmola.
verses.4: Hau hatene ona saida mak hau sei halo, atu nunee bainhira nia hasai hau hosi knaar nee, ema bele simu hau iha sira nia uma laran.’
verses.5: Entaun nia bolu ema ida-idak nebee debe osan hosi ninia nai, no nia dehan ba ida primeiru, ‘O debe hira hosi hau nia nai?’
verses.6: Ema nee dehan, ‘Mina azeiti kalen atus ida.’ Ema responsavel dehan ba nia, ‘Foti o nia nota, tuur lalais lai, no hakerek lima-nulu.’
verses.7: Depois nia dehan ba ida seluk, ‘No o debe hira?’ Ema nee dehan, ‘Trigu bidon atus ida.’ No nia dehan ba ema nee, ‘Foti o nia nota, no hakerek ualu-nulu.’
verses.8: Patraun gaba ema responsavel nebee la onestu, tanba nia hatudu matenek kroat. Tanba mundu nee nia oan sira hatudu matenek kroat ba sira nia jerasaun, liu fali naroman nia oan sira.
verses.9: No Hau hatete ba imi, Halo belun sira ba imi nia aan liu hosi riku-soin aat. Nunee bainhira buat sira nee lakon, sira bele simu imi ba fatin rohan laek.
verses.10: Ema nebee hatudu fidelidade ho buat kiik, nia sei hatudu fidelidade mos ho buat boot. No ema nebee la onestu ho buat kiik, nia sei la onestu mos ho buat boot.
verses.11: Nunee se imi la hatudu fidelidade ho riku-soin aat, see mak fiar imi ho riku-soin lo-loos?
verses.12: No se imi la hatudu fidelidade ho buat nebee ema seluk nian, see mak foo imi buat ruma atu sai imi nian?
verses.13: La iha atan ida nebee bele serví patraun rua. Tanba nia sei odi ida, no hadomi ida seluk; ka nia sei apoia ida, no hakribi ida seluk. Imi la bele serví Maromak no riku-soin.”
verses.14: Ema Farizeu sira nebee hadomi osan rona buat sira nee hotu, no sira hakribi Nia.
verses.15: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi mak ema nebee hatudu aan nudar ema loos iha ema nia oin, maibee Maromak hatene imi nia fuan laran. Tanba buat nebee ema foti aas, buat nee mak foer liu iha Maromak nia oin.
verses.16: Lei no profeta sira foo sai too João. Hosi tempu nebaa ema haklaken evanjelhu kona ba Maromak nia reinu, no ema hotu hakaas aan atu tama.
verses.17: Maibee fasil liu katak lalehan no mundu lakon, duké asentu ida lakon hosi Lei.
verses.18: Ema hotu nebee soe ninia feen, no kaben ho ema seluk, halo sala adultériu. No ema nebee kaben ho feto nee, nebee ninia laen soe ona, mak halo sala adultériu. Ema Riku No Lázaro
verses.19: “Iha ema riku ida nebee hatais ho hena kór uvas no hena linhu. No loro-loron nia haan hahaan festa nian.
verses.20: No iha ema kiak naran Lázaro nebee tuur iha ema riku nia portaun hodi husu ezmola. No ninia isin nakonu ho kanek fisur.
verses.21: Nia hakarak haan hahaan rahun nebee monu hosi ema riku nia meza. No mos asu sira mai no lambe ninia fisur.
verses.22: Tuir mai, ema kiak nee mate, no anju sira lori nia ba Abraão nia sorin. Ema riku mos mate no ema hakoi nia.
verses.23: Iha infernu, ema riku hetan terus boot. Nia foti ninia matan no haree Abraão iha fatin dook, no Lázaro iha ninia sorin.
verses.24: Ema riku hakilar dehan, ‘Aman Abraão, hatudu laran luak mai hau. Haruka Lázaro atu habokon ninia liman fuan tutun ho bee hodi halo malirin hau nia nanaal. Tanba hau hetan terus boot iha ahi nee.’
verses.25: Maibee Abraão dehan, ‘Oan, hanoin hetan katak durante o nia moris o hetan buat sira nebee diak, no Lázaro hetan buat sira nebee aat. Maibee agora nia senti kamaan iha nee, no o hetan terus boot.
verses.26: Liu tan nee, entre o ho ami iha rai kuak klean tebes. Nunee ema iha nee, nebee hakarak hakat ba o, la bele. No ema hosi nebaa la bele hakat mai ami.’
verses.27: Depois nia dehan, ‘Entaun aman, favór ida, haruka Lázaro ba hau nia aman nia uma.
verses.28: Tanba hau iha maun-alin nain lima. Nia bele foo testemunha ba sira hodi sira mos la mai too fatin terus iha nee.’
verses.29: Maibee Abraão dehan, ‘Sira iha Moisés no profeta sira. Husik sira rona ba ema sira nee.’
verses.30: No nia dehan, ‘Lae, aman Abraão, maibee se ema ida hosi fatin mate baa hasoru sira, sira sei arepende.’
verses.31: Abraão dehan ba nia, ‘Se sira la rona Moisés no profeta sira, nunee sira sei la troka hanoin maski ema ida moris hias hosi mate.’”

verses.1: Depois Jesus dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Lasu nebee halo ema monu ba sala sei mai duni. Maibee susar ba nia nebee lori mai lasu nee!
verses.2: Diak liu ema kesi fatuk boot dulas batar nian ba ninia kakorok no soe nia ba tasi laran, duké nia halo kiik-oan sira nee ida atu monu ba sala.
verses.3: Kuidadu aan ba! Se o nia maluk halo sala hasoru o, koriji nia. No se nia arepende karik, foo perdua ba nia.
verses.4: No se nia halo sala hasoru o dala hitu iha loron ida, no dala hitu nia fila fali ba o, no dehan, ‘Hau arepende,’ nunee o tenki foo perdua ba nia.”
verses.5: Apostolu sira dehan ba Nai, “Aumenta tan ami nia fiar.”
verses.6: Nai dehan, “Se imi iha fiar hanesan mostarda musan ida, imi bele dehan ba ai figeira boot nee, ‘Fokit aan ba, no kuda fali iha tasi laran,’ no nia sei halo tuir.
verses.7: Iha imi nia leet, iha ema ida nebee se karik nia iha atan ida nebee fila rai ka hein bibi, no atan nee fila fali hosi toos no patraun dehan, ‘Mai lai no tuur hodi haan’?
verses.8: Laos nia sei dehan ba atan nee, ‘Prepara hau nia hahaan. No hatais aan atu serví hau bainhira hau haan hemu. Depois mak o bele haan hemu.’
verses.9: Nia sei foo obrigadu ba ninia atan tanba atan halo tuir orden sira nee ka?
verses.10: Hanesan nee mos ho imi, bainhira imi halo tuir orden hotu nebee imi simu, dehan, ‘Ami mak atan sira nebee folin laek. Ami halo tuir deit ami nia obrigasaun.’”
verses.11: Bainhira sira halo viajen ba Jerusalém, Jesus lao hosi Galileia too Samaria.
verses.12: No Nia tama ba aldeia ida. Iha nebaa ema moras lepra nain sanulu mai hasoru Nia, maibee sira hamriik dook.
verses.13: Sira bolu ho lian makaas dehan, “Jesus, Mestri, hatudu laran luak mai ami.”
verses.14: No bainhira Nia haree sira, Nia dehan ba sira, “Baa hatudu aan ba saserdote sira.” No bainhira sira lao hela iha dalan sira sai moos.
verses.15: Bainhira ema sira nee ida haree katak nia hetan isin diak ona, nia fila fali no hahii Maromak ho lian makaas.
verses.16: Nia monu tuun ho oin ba rai iha Jesus nia ain no foo agradese. No nia mak ema Samaria ida.
verses.17: Jesus hataan dehan, “Laos ema nain sanulu sai moos? Entaun nain sia nee iha nebee?
verses.18: La iha ema ida mak fila fali hodi foo glória ba Maromak, só deit ema estranjeiru nee ka?”
verses.19: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Hamriik no baa deit. O nia fiar mak salva tiha o.”
verses.20: Ema Farizeu sira husu bainhira mak Maromak nia reinu sei mai. Jesus hataan ba sira dehan, “Maromak nia reinu sei mai, maibee laos ho sinál sira nebee imi bele haree.
verses.21: No ema sei la dehan, ‘Haree iha nee!’ ka, ‘Haree iha nebaa!’ Tanba tebes, Maromak nia reinu mak iha imi nia leet.”
verses.22: Jesus dehan ba eskolante sira, “Tempu sei too mai bainhira imi sei hakarak haree loron ida hosi Ema Nia Oan, no imi sei la haree ida nee.
verses.23: No sira sei dehan ba imi, ‘Haree iha nebaa!’ ka, ‘Haree iha nee!’ Keta baa, no keta lao tuir sira.
verses.24: Tanba hanesan rai lakan nebee nabilan hosi lalehan rohan ida too rohan seluk, nunee mos ho Ema Nia Oan iha Ninia loron.
verses.25: Maibee uluk lai Nia tenki simu terus barak, no jerasaun nee sei rejeita Nia.
verses.26: Tanba hanesan iha Noé nia tempu, nunee mos iha Ema Nia Oan nia tempu.
verses.27: Sira haan hemu hela, no sira kaben no troka prenda atu kaben, too loron nebee Noé tama tiha ba roo boot laran. Depois rai nabeen mai no halakon sira hotu.
verses.28: Hanesan mos iha Ló nia tempu. Sira haan hemu, sosa no faan, kuda toos no harii uma.
verses.29: Maibee iha loron nebee Ló sai hosi Sodoma, ahi no fatuk klaak tuun mai hosi lalehan, no halakon sira hotu.
verses.30: Nunee mos sei akontese iha loron nebee Ema Nia Oan hatudu aan.
verses.31: Iha loron nebaa, nia nebee sei iha uma leten, no iha sasaan iha uma laran, keta tuun mai atu foti sasaan hosi uma laran. No mos nia nebee iha toos, keta fila fali mai.
verses.32: Hanoin hetan Ló nia feen.
verses.33: See deit nebee hakarak salva ninia moris sei lakon ninia moris; no see deit nebee lakon ninia moris sei salva ninia moris.
verses.34: Hau hatete ba imi, iha kalan nebaa sei iha ema nain rua iha kama ida; Maromak sei lori tiha ida, no Nia sei husik hela ida seluk.
verses.35: Feto nain rua sei fai batar hamutuk; Maromak sei lori tiha ida, no Nia sei husik hela ida seluk.
verses.36: Ema nain rua sei iha toos; Maromak sei lori tiha ida, no Nia sei husik hela ida seluk.”
verses.37: Sira hataan ba Nia, “Iha nebee, Nai?” No Nia dehan ba sira, “Iha fatin nebee iha mate isin, iha nebaa manu makikit halibur hamutuk.”

verses.1: Jesus konta ai knanoik ida ba sira hodi sira bele kontinua halo orasaun nafatin, no keta rende.
verses.2: Nia dehan, “Iha sidade ida iha juis ida. Nia la hamtauk Maromak no la respeita ema.
verses.3: No sidade nee iha mos feto faluk ida. Nia baa hasoru beibeik juis nee no dehan, ‘Foo justisa mai hau hasoru hau nia akuzadór.’
verses.4: Fo-foun juis nee lakohi. Maibee tuir mai nia dehan ba nia aan, ‘Mezmu hau la hamtauk Maromak no la respeita ema,
verses.5: maibee tanba feto faluk nee kria problema nafatin, hau sei foo justisa ba nia. Se lae, nia sei halo hau kole tanba nia mai beibeik.’”
verses.6: Depois Nai dehan, “Rona saida mak juis nebee la justu nee dehan.
verses.7: Laos Maromak sei foo justisa ba Ninia ema nebee Nia hili ona, nebee hakilar ba Nia loron-kalan? Nia sei dada tempu kona ba sira ka?
verses.8: Hau hatete ba imi katak Nia sei foo justisa ba sira lalais. Maski nunee, bainhira Ema Nia Oan mai, Nia sei hetan fiar iha mundu nee ka lae?”
verses.9: Jesus konta mos ai knanoik nee ba ema sira nebee fiar aan katak sira ema moris loos no sira hakribi ema seluk:
verses.10: “Ema nain rua sae ba Templu hodi halo orasaun. Ida ema Farizeu no ida seluk ema kobradór impostu.
verses.11: Farizeu nee hamriik mesak no halo orasaun nunee, ‘Maromak, hau foo agradese ba Ita Boot, katak hau la hanesan ema seluk, nebee hamatak sasaan, la justu, halo sala seksuál, no hau la hanesan mos ho kobradór impostu nee.
verses.12: Hau jejún dala rua kada semana ida, no hau foo porsentu sanulu hosi buat hotu nebee hau hetan.’
verses.13: Maibee kobradór impostu nee, nia hamriik dook, no lakohi foti sae ninia matan ba lalehan, maibee nia tuku ninia hirus matan no dehan, ‘Maromak, hatudu grasa mai hau nebee sala nain!’
verses.14: Hau hatete ba imi, mane ida nee tuun fali ba ninia uma ho laran loos; maibee laos ema Farizeu nee. Tanba ema hotu nebee foti aan, Maromak sei hatuun nia; no nia nebee haraik aan, Maromak sei foti aas nia.”
verses.15: Ema sira lori mos labarik kiik-oan ba Jesus hodi Nia bele tau liman ba sira. Maibee bainhira Ninia eskolante sira haree ida nee, sira siak ema sira nee.
verses.16: Maibee Jesus bolu kiik-oan sira mai, no dehan, “Husik kiik-oan sira nee hakbesik mai Hau, no keta hapara sira. Tanba ema hanesan nee mak simu Maromak nia reinu.
verses.17: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, ema nebee la simu Maromak nia reinu hanesan labarik kiik-oan ida, nia sei la bele tama reinu nee.”
verses.18: Xefi ida husu Jesus dehan, “Mestri Diak, hau tenki halo saida atu hetan moris rohan laek?”
verses.19: No Jesus dehan ba nia, “Tanba saa mak o bolu Hau diak? La iha ida nebee diak, só Maromak mesak deit.
verses.20: O hatene ona ukun fuan sira: ‘Keta halo sala seksuál, keta oho, keta naok, keta foo sasin falsu, foo onra ba o nia inan-aman.’”
verses.21: No xefi dehan, “Hau halo tuir buat sira nee hotu dezde hau sei kiik.”
verses.22: Bainhira Jesus rona nunee, Nia dehan ba xefi, “O sei falta buat ida: faan tiha buat hotu nebee o iha, no fahe ba ema kiak sira, no o sei hetan riku-soin iha lalehan. No mai tuir Hau.”
verses.23: Bainhira xefi rona nunee, nia sai tristi tebes, tanba nia riku loos.
verses.24: No bainhira Jesus haree katak xefi nee tristi tebes, Nia dehan, “Susar duni ba sira nebee iha riku-soin atu tama Maromak nia reinu!
verses.25: Tanba fasil liu ba kuda kamelu ida atu tama liu hosi daun kuak, duké ema riku ida atu tama ba Maromak nia reinu.”
verses.26: Ema sira nebee rona nunee dehan, “Entaun see mak bele hetan salvasaun?”
verses.27: Maibee Jesus dehan, “Buat nebee ema la bele halo, Maromak bele halo.”
verses.28: Depois Pedro dehan, “Tebes, ami husik ona ami nia sasaan, no tuir O.”
verses.29: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Hau dehan lo-loos ba imi, katak ema nebee husik uma, feen, maun-alin, inan-aman, ka oan sira, tanba Maromak nia reinu,
verses.30: ema nee sei simu barak liu tan iha tempu agora, no moris rohan laek iha tempu nebee atu mai.”
verses.31: Depois Jesus halibur sira nain sanulu resin rua nee, no dehan ba sira, “Tebes, ita sae dadaun ba Jerusalém, no buat hotu nebee profeta sira hakerek ona kona ba Ema Nia Oan sei akontese.
verses.32: Tanba ema sei entrega Nia ba ema Jentiu sira, no sira sei goza Nia, no halo terus ba Nia, no tafui kabeen ba Nia.
verses.33: No sira sei baku Nia ho sikoti, no oho Nia. No iha loron terseiru Nia sei moris hias.”
verses.34: Maibee sira la kompriende buat ida hosi liafuan nee. Liafuan nee subar hela hosi sira no sira la hatene buat nebee Jesus dehan.
verses.35: Tuir mai, bainhira Jesus hakbesik ba Jerikó, ema matan delek ida tuur hela iha dalan ninin hodi husu ezmola.
verses.36: Nia rona ema lubun boot lao liu dadaun, nunee nia husu saida mak akontese.
verses.37: No sira foo hatene ba nia, “Jesus hosi Nazaré mak liu dadaun.”
verses.38: Entaun nia hakilar no dehan, “Jesus, Oan Mane hosi David, hatudu laran luak mai hau!”
verses.39: No sira nebee lao uluk siak nia no haruka nia nonook. Maibee nia hakilar makaas liu tan, “Oan Mane hosi David, hatudu laran luak mai hau!”
verses.40: Jesus para, no haruka sira lori ema nee ba Nia. Bainhira ema nee hakbesik, Jesus husu nia,
verses.41: “Saida mak o hakarak Hau halo ba o?” No nia dehan, “Nai, hau hakarak haree.”
verses.42: No Jesus dehan ba nia, “O bele haree. O nia fiar mak salva ona o.”
verses.43: Nia bele haree kedas. No nia lao tuir Jesus no foo glória ba Maromak. No povu hotu nebee haree ida nee hahii Maromak.

verses.1: Jesus tama Jerikó no Nia lao liu dadaun.
verses.2: No tebes, iha mane ida naran Zakeu, nebee xefi ba kobradór impostu sira. Nia ema riku ida.
verses.3: Nia hakarak haree Jesus maibee nia la bele tanba ema lubun boot nee, no nia ema ain badak.
verses.4: Entaun nia halai uluk, no nia sae ai figeira boot. Nia sae hodi haree Jesus nebee atu lao liu fatin nee.
verses.5: Bainhira Jesus too iha fatin nee, Nia hateke ba leten no dehan ba Zakeu, “Zakeu, tuun lalais mai. Tanba ohin Hau sei hela iha o nia uma.”
verses.6: Nunee nia tuun lalais, no simu Jesus ho laran haksolok.
verses.7: No bainhira povu haree ida nee, sira hotu murmura dehan, “Nia baa hodi sai bainaka ba mane ida nebee sala nain.”
verses.8: Tuir mai, Zakeu hamriik, no dehan ba Nai, “Tebes, Nai, hau sei fahe hau nia riku-soin ba rua hodi foo sorin ida ba ema kiak. No se hau hamatak ona ema karik, hau sei foo fali dala haat.”
verses.9: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Ohin loron salvasaun mai tiha ona iha uma nee, tanba nia mos Abraão nia oan.
verses.10: Tanba Ema Nia Oan mai hodi buka no salva ema nebee lakon.”
verses.11: Bainhira ema rona liafuan nee, Jesus foo sai ai knanoik ida, tanba Nia besik too Jerusalém, no sira hanoin katak Maromak nia reinu atu mosu mai kedas.
verses.12: Nunee Nia dehan, “Ema boot ida baa rai dook hodi simu reinu ida no fila fali mai.
verses.13: No nia bolu ninia atan nain sanulu. Nia foo osan mean sanulu ba sira no dehan ba sira, ‘Fila liman ba too hau mai fali.’
verses.14: Maibee ninia povu odi nia. Sira haruka mensajen tuir nia nebee dehan, ‘Ami lakohi mane ida nee ukun ami.’
verses.15: Tuir mai, bainhira nia simu ona reinu no nia fila fali, nia haruka ema bolu atan sira mai hasoru nia. Tanba nia foo ona osan mean ba sira no nia hakarak hatene ema ida-idak nee manaan hira liu hosi fila liman.
verses.16: Atan primeiru mai no dehan, ‘Nai, ita boot nia osan mean ida manaan fali osan mean sanulu.’
verses.17: No nia dehan ba atan nee, ‘Diak! O mak atan diak. Tanba o hatudu fidelidade ho buat uitoan, nunee hau foo ba o knaar ba sidade sanulu.’
verses.18: Depois atan segundu mai no dehan, ‘Nai, o nia osan mean ida manaan fali osan mean lima.’
verses.19: No nia dehan ba atan nee, ‘O mos bele simu knaar ba sidade lima.’
verses.20: Depois atan ida fali mai no dehan, ‘Nai, iha nee mak ita boot nia osan mean ida. Hau falun ho hena no rai di-diak.
verses.21: Tanba hau tauk ita boot. Tanba ita boot mak ema siak-teen, nebee foti buat nebee ita boot la rai, no kuu buat nebee ita boot la kuda.’
verses.22: No nia dehan ba atan nee, ‘Hau sei tesi lia ba o tuir liafuan nebee sai hosi o nia ibun rasik, atan aat nee! O hatene ona ka, katak hau ema siak-teen, nebee foti buat nebee hau la rai, no kuu buat nebee hau la kuda ka?
verses.23: Entaun tanba saa mak o la rai hau nia osan iha banku? Nunee, bainhira hau mai fali hau bele hetan hau nia osan ho nia funan.’
verses.24: No ema boot nee dehan ba sira nebee hamriik iha sorin, ‘Foti tiha osan mean ida nee hosi nia, no foo ba atan nebee iha osan mean sanulu.’
verses.25: Sira dehan ba nia, ‘Nai, nia iha ona osan mean sanulu!’
verses.26: ‘Hau hatete ba imi, katak ba ema ida-idak nebee iha ona, hau sei foo tan; no hosi nia nebee la iha, buat uitoan nebee nia sei iha hau sei hasai.
verses.27: Maibee hau nia inimigu sira, nebee lakohi hau atu ukun sira, lori sira mai no oho sira iha hau nia oin.’”
verses.28: Bainhira Jesus koalia tiha nunee, Nia lao uluk, no sae ba Jerusalém.
verses.29: Bainhira Nia besik Betfage no Betánia, iha foho nebee naran Foho Oliveira, Nia haruka eskolante nain rua,
verses.30: no dehan, “Tama ba aldeia iha ita nia oin nee. Bainhira imi tama tiha, imi sei hetan kuda buru oan ida nebee kesi hela. Ema seidauk sae kuda buru oan nee. Kore nia, no lori nia mai.
verses.31: Se ema ida husu imi, ‘Tanba saa mak imi kore nia?’ Imi sei hataan nunee, ‘Tanba Nai presiza nia.’”
verses.32: Entaun sira nebee Jesus haruka ona baa no hetan ida nee tuir buat nebee Nia hatete ona ba sira.
verses.33: No bainhira sira kore dadaun kuda buru oan nee, kuda buru nia nain dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi kore kuda buru oan nee?”
verses.34: Sira dehan, “Nai presiza nia.”
verses.35: Sira lori kuda buru oan nee ba Jesus. Sira tau sira nia ropa iha kuda buru oan leten, no sira tau Jesus iha leten.
verses.36: No bainhira Jesus liu dadaun, sira nahe sira nia ropa iha dalan.
verses.37: Bainhira Nia besik ona, no too iha dalan nebee tuun hosi Foho Oliveira, Ninia eskolante lubun tomak hahuu haksolok no hahii Maromak ho lian makaas tanba milagre hotu nebee sira haree tiha ona.
verses.38: Sira dehan, “Bensaun ba Liurai nebee mai hodi Nai nia naran! Dame iha lalehan, no glória iha fatin aas liu!”
verses.39: Maibee ema Farizeu balu nebee iha ema lubun boot nia leet dehan ba Nia, “Mestri, hasee O nia eskolante sira.”
verses.40: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Hau hatete ba imi, se sira nonook, fatuk sira sei hakilar.”
verses.41: Bainhira Jesus besik ona, Nia haree Jerusalém no tanis kona ba sidade nee.
verses.42: Nia dehan, “Se o rasik bele hatene loron ohin kona ba buat nebee bele halo dame! Maibee agora buat sira nee subar ona hosi o nia matan.
verses.43: Tanba tempu sei mai, bainhira o nia inimigu sira sei halo lutu kroat haleu o, no sira sei serka o no hanehan o iha sor-sorin.
verses.44: Sira sei harahun o no o nia oan sira nebee iha o nia laran. Sira sei la husik fatuk ida iha fatuk seluk nia leten. Tanba o la hatene tempu nebee Nai mak vizita o.”
verses.45: Jesus tama Templu, no komesa duni sai sira nebee faan sasaan.
verses.46: Nia dehan ba ema sira nee, “Ema hakerek nanis ona, ‘Hau nia uma mak uma orasaun nian.’ Maibee imi halo fatin nee sai fali naok-teen sira nia knuuk.”
verses.47: No Jesus hanorin loro-loron iha Templu. Maibee xefi saserdote sira, eskriba sira no xefi hosi povu nee buka dalan atu halakon Nia.
verses.48: Maibee sira la bele halo buat ida tanba povu hotu rona hela deit Ninia liafuan.

verses.1: Tuir mai, Jesus hanorin povu iha Templu no Nia haklaken evanjelhu. Iha loron ida, xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira mai hamutuk ho katuas sira,
verses.2: no dehan ba Nia, “Foo hatene mai ami, liu hosi kbiit saida mak O halo buat sira nee? Se mak foo kbiit nee ba O?”
verses.3: No Jesus hataan sira dehan, “Hau mos sei husu imi pergunta ida. Foo hatene mai Hau lai:
verses.4: Batizmu hosi João mai hosi nebee? Hosi lalehan, ka hosi ema?”
verses.5: No sira koalia ba malu no dehan, “Se ita dehan, ‘Hosi lalehan,’ Nia sei dehan, ‘Tanba saa mak imi la fiar nia?’
verses.6: Maibee se ita sei dehan, ‘Hosi ema,’ povu hotu nee sei foti fatuk hodi tuda mate ita. Tanba sira fiar katak João mak profeta ida.”
verses.7: Entaun sira hataan katak sira la hatene batizmu nee mai hosi nebee.
verses.8: No Jesus dehan ba sira, “Nunee Hau mos sei la foo hatene ba imi liu hosi kbiit saida mak Hau halo buat sira nee.”
verses.9: Depois Jesus komesa konta ai knanoik ida ba povu nee: “Ema ida kuda toos uvas ida. Depois nia foo aluga ba ema hodi servisu iha toos nee no nia baa rai dook no hela kleur iha nebaa.
verses.10: No iha tempu koileta, nia haruka atan ida ba ema nebee servisu iha toos nee, atu nunee sira bele foo ba nia uvas fuan balu hosi toos uvas. Maibee ema sira nebee servisu iha toos baku atan nee, no duni nia sai ho liman mamuk.
verses.11: No toos nain haruka fali atan seluk. Maibee ema nebee servisu iha toos nee baku mos atan nee, despreza nia, no duni nia sai ho liman mamuk.
verses.12: Toos nain haruka tan atan terseiru. No sira hakanek mos nia, no soe nia sai ba liur.
verses.13: Depois nain ba toos uvas nee dehan, ‘Hau sei halo saida? Hau sei haruka hau nia oan mane ida nebee hau hadomi. Karik sira sei respeita nia bainhira sira haree nia.’
verses.14: Maibee bainhira ema nebee servisu iha toos nee haree toos nain nia oan, sira koalia hamutuk no dehan, ‘Nia mak simu toos nudar liman rohan. Mai ita oho nia hodi liman rohan nee sai ita nian.’
verses.15: Entaun sira soe oan mane nee ba toos liur no oho tiha nia. Nunee nain ba toos uvas nee sei halo saida ba sira?
verses.16: Nia sei mai no halakon ema sira nebee servisu iha toos uvas nee. No nia sei foo toos uvas ba ema seluk.” Bainhira sira rona tiha liafuan nee, sira dehan, “Nee la bele!”
verses.17: No Jesus hateke ba sira, no dehan, “Entaun saida mak liafuan nee, nebee ema hakerek nanis ona:
verses.18: Ema nebee monu ba fatuk nee sei rahun; no bainhira fatuk nee monu ba ema nia leten, fatuk nee sei deut ema nee.”
verses.19: Xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira koko atu kaer Jesus iha tempu nee kedas. Tanba sira hatene katak Nia konta ai knanoik nee hodi hasoru sira. Maibee sira tauk povu.
verses.20: Nunee xefi saserdote sira haree tu-tuir Jesus. Sira haruka espiaun sira atu finji nudar ema loos. Atu nunee sira bele lasu Nia liu hosi Ninia liafuan. Sira hakarak entrega Nia ba governadór nia kbiit no autoridade.
verses.21: Entaun sira husu Nia, “Mestri, ami hatene katak O koalia no hanorin loos. No O la fihir ema nia oin maibee O hanorin Maromak nia dalan ho lia loos.
verses.22: Nunee tuir lei, ita tenki foo osan impostu ba César ka lae?”
verses.23: Maibee Nia haree sira nia lasu, no dehan ba sira,
verses.24: “Hatudu lai osan denáriu ida mai Hau. Figura nee see nian no naran nee see nian?” Sira hataan, “César nian.”
verses.25: Entaun Nia dehan ba sira, “Nunee foo ba César buat nebee César nian, no foo ba Maromak buat nebee Maromak nian.”
verses.26: Sira la bele lasu Nia liu hosi Ninia liafuan iha povu nia oin. Ninia resposta halo sira admira fali no sira sai nonook.
verses.27: Depois ema Saduseu balu hakbesik ba Jesus. Sira la fiar katak ema bele moris hias. No sira husu Nia,
verses.28: “Mestri, Moisés hakerek ba ami katak se mane ida nia maun mate, nebee husik hela ninia feen, maibee oan la iha, nunee alin nee tenki kaben fali ho feto faluk nee. No alin nee tenki hakiak oan ba ninia maun.
verses.29: Entaun iha maun-alin nain hitu. Mane ba dala ida kaben ho feto ida. Depois nia mate no la iha oan.
verses.30: Alin ba dala rua hola ninia maun nia feto faluk nee. Nia mos mate no la iha oan.
verses.31: No alin ba dala tolu hola feto faluk nee. No hanesan nee too alin mane ba dala hitu. Sira mate hotu no la iha oan.
verses.32: Ikus mai, feto faluk mos mate.
verses.33: Entaun iha tempu nebee ema moris hias ona, feto nee mak see nia feen loos? Tanba sira nain hitu kaben ho nia.”
verses.34: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Ema iha mundu nee kaben, no foo ema hodi kaben.
verses.35: Maibee sira nebee merese atu tama ba tempu iha nebaa, no moris hias hosi mate, sira la kaben no sira la foo ema hodi kaben.
verses.36: No sira la bele mate tan. Tanba sira sei sai hanesan ho anju sira. Sira sai Maromak nia oan sira. Tanba sira mak oan hosi tempu moris hias nian.
verses.37: Agora, kona ba ema mate bele moris hias ka lae, Moisés hatudu ida nee iha ai badak bainhira nia bolu Nai nudar Abraão nia Maromak, Isak nia Maromak, no Jacó nia Maromak.
verses.38: Tanba Nia laos Maromak ba ema mate, maibee ba ema moris. Tanba ema hotu moris hela ba Nia.”
verses.39: Depois ema eskriba balu hataan, “Mestri, O koalia diak.”
verses.40: No sira la brani atu husu pergunta ida tan ba Nia.
verses.41: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Oinsaa sira bele dehan katak Kristu mak David nia oan mane?
verses.42: Tanba David rasik dehan iha Livru Salmu Sira,
verses.43: too Hau halo O nia inimigu sira sai fatin ida hodi tau O nia ain.”’
verses.44: Nunee David bolu Nia Nai, entaun oinsaa mak Nia David nia oan mane?”
verses.45: Bainhira ema hotu rona dadaun, Nia dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira,
verses.46: “Kuidadu kona ba ema eskriba sira. Tanba sira hakarak lao ho batina naruk. Sira gosta simu kumprimentus iha merkadu. Sira gosta kadeira nebee diak liu iha sinagoga no fatin importante iha festa.
verses.47: Maibee sira tolan feto faluk sira nia uma. No sira finji atu halo orasaun naruk. Ema hanesan nee sei hetan kastigu makaas liu.”

verses.1: Tuir mai, Jesus hateke ba, no Nia haree ema hatama sira nia oferta iha tezourária.
verses.2: Nia haree mos feto faluk ida hatama sentavu rua.
verses.3: No Jesus dehan, “Tebes, Hau hatete ba imi, katak feto faluk kiak nee hatama barak liu fali ema seluk hotu.
verses.4: Tanba ema hotu hatama oferta hosi sira nia riku-soin resin. Maibee maski feto nee kiak, nia hatama buat hotu nebee nia presiza hodi moris.”
verses.5: Bainhira ema balu koalia kona ba Templu, no oinsaa ema hafurak templu nee ho fatuk murak no oferta sira, Jesus dehan,
verses.6: “Kona ba uma boot nebee imi haree dadaun nee, tempu sei mai bainhira la iha fatuk ida nebee husik hela iha fatuk seluk nia leten. Ema sei sobu hotu.”
verses.7: No sira husu Nia dehan, “Mestri, bainhira buat sira nee hotu sei mosu? No sinál saida mak hatudu katak buat sira nee hotu besik atu akontese?”
verses.8: No Nia dehan, “Kuidadu katak ema la lohi imi. Tanba ema barak sei mai hodi Hau nia naran, no dehan, ‘Hau mak Nia!’ no, ‘Tempu besik ona!’ Keta lao tuir sira.
verses.9: Maibee bainhira imi rona kona ba nasaun funu malu no ema halo revolusaun, keta tauk. Tanba buat sira nee tenki akontese, maibee tempu rohan seidauk too mai.”
verses.10: Depois Jesus dehan ba sira, “Nasaun ida sei hamriik hasoru nasaun seluk, no reinu ida sei hasoru reinu seluk.
verses.11: Rai nakdoko makaas sei akontese. No fatin balu sei hetan rai hamlaha no moras peste. Buat nebee halo ema tauk no sinál boot sira sei mosu hosi lalehan.
verses.12: Maibee molok buat hotu nee, ema sei kaer imi no haterus imi. Sira sei entrega imi ba sinagoga no komarka sira. No sira sei lori imi ba liurai sira no ukun nain sira nia oin tanba Hau nia naran.
verses.13: Ida nee sei sai oportunidade ba imi atu foo sasin.
verses.14: Nunee desidi iha imi nia fuan laran, atu la bele hanoin molok oinsaa imi sei hataan.
verses.15: Tanba Hau sei foo ba imi liafuan ho matenek klean. No imi nia inimigu sira sei la bele hamriik hasoru imi ka kontra imi.
verses.16: Imi nia inan-aman, maun-alin, maluk no belun sira sei faan imi. No sira sei foo kastigu mate ba imi balu.
verses.17: No ema hotu sei odi imi tanba Hau nia naran.
verses.18: Maibee imi nia fuuk lahan ida mos sei la lakon hosi imi nia ulun.
verses.19: Liu hosi tahan nafatin mak imi sei hetan imi nia moris.
verses.20: Bainhira imi haree forsa militár sira haleu Jerusalém, entaun hatene katak sidade nee atu lakon.
verses.21: Husik sira nebee iha Judeia halai ba foho. No husik sira nebee iha sidade laran sai tiha. No sira nebee iha rai luan keta tama fali ba sidade nee.
verses.22: Tanba loron sira nee mak loron kastigu nian, hodi kumpri buat hotu nebee hakerek nanis ona.
verses.23: Maibee susar ba feto sira nebee isin rua, no ba sira nebee foo susu hela iha tempu nebaa! Tanba terus boot sei hasoru rai nee, no hirus manas sei hasoru povu nee.
verses.24: Sira sei monu liu hosi surik kroat, no ema sei lori sira sai nudar ema dadur ba nasaun hotu. Ema Jentiu sira sei sama tuun Jerusalém too tempu ema Jentiu sira nian kumpri ona.
verses.25: Sinál sira sei mosu mai iha loro matan, iha fulan, no iha fitun sira. No iha mundu, terus sei hasoru nasaun sira, no sira sei la hatene atu halo saida tanba tasi siak no laloran boot.
verses.26: Ema sei dezmaia no tauk tebes kona ba buat nebee atu mai hasoru mundu nee. Tanba kbiit iha lalehan sei nakdoko.
verses.27: Depois sira sei haree Ema Nia Oan mai iha kalohan ida ho kbiit no glória boot.
verses.28: No bainhira buat sira nee hahuu atu akontese, hamriik loos no foti imi nia ulun; tanba imi nia salvasaun besik ona.”
verses.29: Jesus konta ai knanoik ida ba sira: “Haree ba ai figeira nee, no ai huun hotu.
verses.30: Bainhira sira dikin ba, imi haree no hatene katak tempu bailoron besik ona.
verses.31: Nunee mos, bainhira imi haree buat sira nee akontese, imi hatene katak Maromak nia reinu besik ona.
verses.32: Tebes Hau dehan ba imi, jerasaun nee sei la lakon, too buat hotu nee akontese ona.
verses.33: Lalehan no mundu sei lakon, maibee Hau nia liafuan sei nunka lakon.
verses.34: Kuidadu aan ba atu imi nia laran la sai todan ho ulun fatuk moras tanba lanu, no keta preokupa kona ba imi nia moris. Se imi halo hanesan nee, loron nee sei hasoru imi derepenti deit nudar lasu ida.
verses.35: Tanba loron nee sei hasoru ema hotu iha mundu tomak.
verses.36: Nunee matan moris ba no halo orasaun nafatin, katak imi bele iha kbiit atu halai sai hosi buat hotu nebee sei akontese, no hodi imi bele hamriik iha Ema Nia Oan nia oin.”
verses.37: Loro-loron Jesus hanorin iha Templu. Maibee iha kalan Nia sai fali no baa toba iha foho ida naran Foho Oliveira.
verses.38: Iha dadeer-saan, povu hotu baa Templu atu rona Nia.

verses.1: Festa Paun Fermentu Laek besik ona, nebee sira bolu Páskua.
verses.2: No xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira buka dalan atu oho Jesus, tanba sira tauk povu.
verses.3: Depois Satanás tama ba Judas, naran Iskariotes, nebee ema ida hosi sira nain sanulu resin rua.
verses.4: No nia sai hodi baa koalia ho xefi saserdote sira no komandante sira kona ba oinsaa nia bele faan Jesus ba sira.
verses.5: Sira kontenti, no promete atu foo osan ba nia.
verses.6: Nia konkorda no buka oportunidade atu faan Jesus ba sira bainhira ema lubun boot la iha.
verses.7: Loron Paun Fermentu Laek nian too ona, bainhira sira tenki oho bibi oan Páskua nian.
verses.8: Entaun Jesus haruka Pedro no João, no dehan, “Baa prepara Páskua ba ita, hodi ita bele haan.”
verses.9: No sira dehan ba Nia, “O hakarak ami prepara iha nebee?”
verses.10: Nia dehan ba sira, “Tebes, bainhira imi tama tiha ba sidade, mane ida nebee lori sanan rai bee nian sei hasoru imi. Imi lao tuir nia ba uma ida nebee nia tama.
verses.11: No imi sei dehan uma nain, ‘Mestri dehan, “Fatin iha nebee, mak Hau bele haan Páskua ho Hau nia eskolante sira?”’
verses.12: Nia sei hatudu ba imi kuartu boot iha andar leten nebee iha sasaan ona. Imi bele prepara iha nebaa.”
verses.13: No sira baa, no hetan buat sira nee tuir saida mak Jesus hatete ona ba sira. No sira prepara Páskua.
verses.14: Bainhira oras too ona, Jesus tuur iha meza hamutuk ho apostolu sira.
verses.15: Nia dehan ba sira, “Hau hakarak tebe-tebes atu haan Páskua nee ho imi molok Hau hetan terus.
verses.16: Tanba Hau hatete ba imi, Hau sei la haan tan ida nee too ida nee kumpri ona iha Maromak nia reinu.”
verses.17: Jesus foti kopu, no Nia foo agradese, no dehan, “Simu ida nee, no fahe ba malu.
verses.18: Tanba Hau hatete ba imi, hosi agora ba oin Hau sei la hemu tan hosi uvas fuan too Maromak nia reinu mai.”
verses.19: No Nia foti paun no foo agradese. Depois Nia silu paun nee no foo ba sira. Nia dehan, “Ida nee mak Hau nia isin nebee Hau foo tanba imi. Halo ida nee hodi hanoin Hau.”
verses.20: Hanesan nee mos, bainhira sira haan tiha, Nia foti kopu, no dehan, “Ida nee mak aliansa foun iha Hau nia raan, nebee sei fakar tanba imi.
verses.21: Maibee tebes, ema nia liman nebee atu faan Hau mak hamutuk hela ho Hau iha meza nee.
verses.22: Tebes, Ema Nia Oan sei baa tuir planu nebee halo tiha ona. Maibee susar ba ema ida nebee faan Nia!”
verses.23: No sira komesa husu ba malu kona ba see mak atu halo ida nee.
verses.24: Eskolante sira komesa haksesuk malu kona ba see mak boot liu.
verses.25: No Jesus dehan ba sira, “Liurai sira hosi ema Jentiu sira domina sira nia povu. No sira nebee halao autoridade simu naran ‘tulun nain’.
verses.26: Maibee imi la bele hanesan nee. Nia nebee boot liu iha imi nia leet tenki sai kiik liu. No nia nebee xefi tenki sai ema nebee serví.
verses.27: Tanba see mak boot liu, nia nebee tuur iha meja, ka nia nebee serví? Laos nia nebee tuur iha meja? Maibee Hau iha imi nia leet nudar ema nebee serví.
verses.28: Imi lao hamutuk ona ho Hau durante Hau nia tempu susar.
verses.29: No Hau foo reinu ida ba imi, hanesan Hau nia Aman foo ona mai Hau.
verses.30: Nunee imi bele haan hemu iha Hau nia meza iha Hau nia reinu. No imi sei tuur iha kadunan hodi tesi lia ba Israel nia suku sanulu resin rua.
verses.31: “Simão, Simão, tebes, Satanás hakarak hetan o hodi nia bele peneira o hanesan trigu.
verses.32: Maibee Hau halo orasaun ona kona ba o, hodi o nia fiar la bele lakon. No bainhira o fila fali, hametin o nia maluk sira.”
verses.33: Pedro dehan ba Nia, “Nai, hau prontu atu baa hamutuk ho O, too komarka no mos too mate.”
verses.34: Jesus dehan, “Hau hatete ba o, Pedro, katak ohin, molok manu aman kokoreek, o sei nega dala tolu katak o la konhese Hau.”
verses.35: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Uluk, bainhira Hau haruka imi baa no imi la lori osan fatin ka pasta ka sandálias, imi falta buat ruma nee ka?” No sira dehan, “Lae.”
verses.36: Depois Nia dehan ba sira, “Maibee agora, nia nebee iha osan fatin no pasta, husik nia lori ba. No nia nebee la iha surik, husik nia faan ninia ropa, no sosa surik ida.
verses.37: Tanba Hau hatete ba imi, katak Eskritura nee tenki kumpri iha Hau: ‘Sira sura Nia hamutuk ho sala nain sira.’ Tanba buat nebee hakerek nanis ona kona ba Hau besik kumpri ona.”
verses.38: No sira dehan, “Nai, haree surik rua iha nee.” No Nia dehan ba sira, “Too ona.”
verses.39: Depois Jesus sai, no hanesan baibain, Nia baa Foho Oliveira. No Ninia eskolante sira mos tuir Nia.
verses.40: Bainhira Nia too ona fatin nee, Nia dehan ba sira, “Halo orasaun atu imi la monu ba tentasaun.”
verses.41: Nia hadook aan hosi sira, maizoumenus dook hanesan ema soe fatuk ida. No Nia hakneak no halo orasaun,
verses.42: Nia dehan, “Aman, se O hakarak, hasai tiha kopu nee hosi Hau. Maski nunee, laos tuir Hau nia hakarak, maibee tuir O nia hakarak.”
verses.43: Depois anju ida hosi lalehan mosu ba Nia hodi foo forsa ba Nia.
verses.44: Nia laran susar tebe-tebes no halo orasaun makaas liu tan, too Ninia kosar sai hanesan raan nebee turuk boot ba rai.
verses.45: Bainhira Nia hamriik hosi halo orasaun, Nia fila ba Ninia eskolante sira, no Nia hetan sira toba dukur hela tanba sira laran tristi.
verses.46: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi toba dukur? Hadeer ba no halo orasaun, atu imi la tama ba tentasaun.”
verses.47: Bainhira Jesus koalia hela, ema lubun boot mai. Ema ida naran Judas, nebee hosi sira nain sanulu resin rua, lao iha sira nia oin. Judas hakbesik ba Jesus atu rei Nia.
verses.48: Maibee Jesus dehan ba nia, “Judas, o sei faan Ema Nia Oan ho rei ida ka?”
verses.49: Bainhira sira nebee hamutuk ho Jesus haree buat nebee atu akontese, sira dehan ba Jesus, “Nai, ami sei ataka ho surik ka?”
verses.50: Depois ema ida hosi sira ataka saserdote boot nia atan. No nia tesi kotu atan nee nia tilun sorin loos.
verses.51: Maibee Jesus dehan, “Too ona!” No Nia kaer atan nia tilun, no kura tiha nia.
verses.52: Depois Jesus dehan ba xefi saserdote sira, komandante sira hosi Templu, no katuas sira, nebee mai hasoru Nia, “Imi mai ho surik no ai dona atu hasoru naok-teen ida ka?
verses.53: Loro-loron Hau hamutuk ho imi iha Templu, no imi la lolo liman atu kaer Hau. Maibee agora mak imi nia tempu, ho kbiit nakukun nian.”
verses.54: Depois sira kaer Nia, no lori Nia ba saserdote boot nia uma. No Pedro lao tuir hosi dook.
verses.55: Bainhira sira sunu ahi iha pátiu klaran, no tuur hamutuk, Pedro mos tuur iha sira nia leet.
verses.56: Maibee atan feto ida haree nia bainhira nia tuur hela besik ahi. Atan feto fihir nia no dehan, “Mane ida nee mos hamutuk ho Nia.”
verses.57: Maibee Pedro nega liafuan nee dehan, “Feto, hau la hatene Nia.”
verses.58: No la kleur tan, ema seluk haree nia, no dehan, “O mos ema ida hosi sira.” Maibee Pedro dehan, “Mane, laos hau.”
verses.59: Liu tiha maizoumenus oras ida, ema ida seluk konfirma dehan, “Tebes, mane nee mos hamutuk ho Nia. Tanba nia mos ema Galileia.”
verses.60: Maibee Pedro dehan, “Mane, hau la hatene saida mak o koalia nee.” No iha momentu nee kedas, bainhira nia koalia hela, manu aman kokoreek.
verses.61: No Nai fila oin no hateke ba Pedro. No Pedro hanoin hetan fali liafuan hosi Nai, no oinsaa Nia dehan ba Pedro, “Ohin, molok manu aman kokoreek, o sei nega Hau dala tolu.”
verses.62: Depois Pedro sai ba liur no tanis makaas.
verses.63: Ema nebee kaer Jesus goza Nia no baku Nia.
verses.64: No bainhira sira taka tiha Ninia matan ho hena, sira baku Ninia oin, no husu Nia, “Profesia ba, see mak baku O?”
verses.65: No sira koalia liafuan aat barak tan hasoru Nia.
verses.66: Bainhira loron naroman ona, katuas sira hosi povu nee, xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira halibur hamutuk. Sira lori Jesus ba sira nia tribunál, no dehan,
verses.67: “O mak Kristu ka lae? Foo hatene mai ami lai.” Nia dehan ba sira, “Se Hau foo hatene ba imi, imi sei la fiar.
verses.68: No se Hau husu imi, imi sei la hataan Hau.
verses.69: Maibee hosi agora ba oin, Ema Nia Oan sei tuur iha Maromak nia kbiit nia liman loos.”
verses.70: Depois sira hotu dehan, “Entaun O mak Maromak nia Oan ka?” No Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi dehan katak Hau mak nee.”
verses.71: No sira dehan, “Tanba saa mak ita presiza tan sasin? Ita rona tiha ona hosi Ninia ibun rasik.”

verses.1: Depois ema lubun tomak nee hamriik, no lori Jesus ba Pilatos.
verses.2: Sira komesa akuza Nia dehan, “Ami hetan Mane nee lohi ami nia nasaun. Nia bandu ema atu la selu impostu ba César, no Nia dehan katak Nia mak Kristu, nebee liurai ida.”
verses.3: Pilatos husu Nia dehan, “O mak ema Judeu sira nia liurai ka?” No Nia hataan dehan, “Ita mak hatete nunee.”
verses.4: Depois Pilatos dehan ba xefi saserdote sira no ema lubun nee, “Hau la hetan sala ida iha Mane nee.”
verses.5: Maibee sira ulun toos nafatin, no dehan, “Nia soran povu nee, no hanorin iha rai Judeu hotu, hahuu hosi Galileia too iha fatin nee.”
verses.6: Bainhira Pilatos rona ida nee, nia husu Mane nee mak ema Galileia ka lae.
verses.7: Bainhira Pilatos hatene katak Jesus mai hosi distritu nebee Herodes mak ukun, nia haruka Jesus ba Herodes. Tanba Herodes mos iha Jerusalém iha tempu nebaa.
verses.8: No bainhira Herodes haree Jesus, nia kontenti loos. Kleur ona nia hakarak haree Jesus. Tanba nia rona tiha buat barak kona ba Jesus, no nia hein katak nia bele haree Jesus halo milagre ruma.
verses.9: No Herodes husu pergunta barak ba Jesus, maibee Jesus la hataan buat ida.
verses.10: Xefi saserdote sira no eskriba sira hamriik no akuza makaas Jesus.
verses.11: No Herodes ho ninia soldadu sira goza Jesus no hamoe Nia. Sira foo hatais Nia ho ropa furak no haruka Nia fila fali ba Pilatos.
verses.12: Iha loron nebaa, Pilatos no Herodes sai kolega. Tanba uluk sira odi malu.
verses.13: Pilatos bolu xefi saserdote sira, ukun nain sira no povu nee atu mai halibur hamutuk.
verses.14: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi lori mai hau Mane nee nudar ida nebee lohi povu. No tebes, hau husu pergunta ba Nia iha imi nia oin. Imi akuza Nia maibee hau la hetan sala ida iha Mane nee tuir buat hotu nebee imi dehan.
verses.15: No Herodes mos la hetan sala ida, tanba Herodes haruka Nia mai fali. Haree ba, Nia la halo buat ida nebee halo Nia merese atu hetan kastigu mate.
verses.16: Nunee hau sei baku Nia, no husik Nia ba.”
verses.18: Maibee sira hotu hakilar hamutuk, “Halakon Mane nee, no husik Barabás ba ami.”
verses.19: Barabás mak ema ida nebee tama komarka tanba nia hahuu revolusaun ida iha sidade no nia oho ema.
verses.20: Dala ida tan Pilatos koalia ba sira tanba nia hakarak husik Jesus.
verses.21: Maibee sira hakilar nafatin, “Prega Nia ba krús! Prega Nia ba krús!”
verses.22: Ba dala tolu Pilatos dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak? Nia halo sala saida? Hau la hetan razaun ida atu foo kastigu mate ba Nia. Nunee hau sei baku Nia, no husik Nia ba.”
verses.23: Maibee sira hakilar makaas, no obriga nia atu prega Jesus ba krús. No sira nia lian manaan.
verses.24: Entaun Pilatos desidi atu halo tuir sira nia hakarak.
verses.25: Nia husik ema ida nebee tama komarka tanba halo revolusaun no oho ema. Maibee nia entrega Jesus ba sira nia hakarak.
verses.26: Bainhira sira lori sai Jesus, sira kaer Simão, ema Sirene, nebee tama mai hosi foho. Sira tau krús ba nia hodi nia bele lori krús nee tuir Jesus.
verses.27: Povu lubun boot lao tuir Nia, inklui feto sira nebee tanis no halerik tanba Nia.
verses.28: Maibee Jesus fila oin ba sira no dehan, “Jerusalém nia oan feto sira, keta tanis tanba Hau, maibee tanis ba imi nia aan rasik, no ba imi nia oan sira.
verses.29: Tanba tebes, tempu sei too mai, bainhira sira sei dehan, ‘Haksolok ba feto sira nebee oan la iha, no ba oan fatin nebee nunka kous, no ba susun nebee nunka foo susu!
verses.30: Iha tempu nebaa, sira sei hahuu dehan ba foho, ‘Monu hanehan tiha ami,’ no ba foho oan, ‘Taka tiha ami.’
verses.31: Tanba se sira halo buat sira nee bainhira ai huun sei matak hela, entaun sira sei halo saida bainhira ai huun nee sai maran?”
verses.32: Sira lori ema aat nain rua tan atu foo kastigu mate hamutuk ho Jesus.
verses.33: Depois sira mai too fatin ida naran Ulun Ruin. Iha nebaa, sira prega Jesus ba krús. Sira prega mos ema aat nain rua nee no tau ida iha Ninia sorin loos no ida seluk iha Ninia sorin karuk.
verses.34: Depois Jesus dehan, “Aman, foo perdua ba sira, tanba sira la hatene buat nebee sira halo.” No sira dada rifa atu fahe Ninia ropa.
verses.35: No povu nee hamriik hela hodi haree. Maibee ukun nain sira tarata Nia, no dehan, “Nia salva ona ema seluk, nunee husik Nia salva Ninia aan rasik; se Nia mak Kristu, nebee Maromak hili.”
verses.36: Soldadu sira mos goza Nia. Sira hakbesik ba Nia, no koko foo tua siin ba Nia.
verses.37: No sira dehan, “Se O mak ema Judeu sira nia liurai, salva aan ba!”
verses.38: No sira hakerek avizu iha Nia ulun leten, “Nee mak ema Judeu sira nia liurai.”
verses.39: Ema aat ida nebee tara hela koalia aat ba Jesus. Nia dehan, “Se O mak Kristu, salva aan ba no mos salva ami!”
verses.40: Maibee ida seluk nee siak nia dehan, “O la hamtauk Maromak ka? Tanba o hetan kastigu hanesan.
verses.41: Ita hetan kastigu tuir justisa, tanba sira selu ita tuir ita nia hahalok. Maibee Mane ida nee la halo aat ida.”
verses.42: No nia dehan ba Jesus, “Nai, hanoin hau bainhira O tama ba O nia reinu.”
verses.43: No Jesus dehan ba nia, “Tebes Hau dehan ba o, ohin loron kedas o sei hamutuk ho Hau iha Paraizu.”
verses.44: Tuir mai, maizoumenus iha meiudia, nakukun taka rai tomak too tuku tolu lokraik.
verses.45: Loro matan sai nakukun, no veo iha Templu naklees fahe ba rua iha klaran.
verses.46: Depois Jesus hakilar ho lian makaas, no Nia dehan, “Aman, Hau entrega Hau nia espíritu ba O nia liman!” Bainhira Nia koalia tiha nunee, Nia iis kotu.
verses.47: Bainhira komandante haree buat nebee akontese, nia hahii Maromak, no dehan, “Tebes duni, Mane ida nee mak ema loos.”
verses.48: No povu hotu nebee halibur hamutuk hodi hateke ba, bainhira sira haree tiha buat sira nee, sira tuku hirus matan no fila fali ba uma.
verses.49: Ema hotu nebee konhese Jesus no feto sira nebee tuir Nia hosi Galileia, hamriik dook no haree buat sira nee.
verses.50: Tebes, iha ema ida naran José, hosi sidade Arimatea iha rai Judeia. Nia mak membru ida hosi tribunál. Nia ema diak no loos.
verses.51: Ema ida nee la konkorda ho desizaun no hahalok hosi sira seluk. No nia hein Maromak nia reinu.
verses.52: Nia baa hasoru Pilatos, no husu atu hetan Jesus nia mate isin.
verses.53: Tuir mai, nia hatuun mate isin, no falun tiha ho hena linhu. Depois nia tau mate isin iha rate nebee ema kee tiha hosi fatuk. Ema seidauk tau mate isin seluk iha rate nee.
verses.54: Loron nee mak loron preparasaun, no loron Sabdu besik atu hahuu ona.
verses.55: Feto sira nebee mai ho Jesus hosi Galileia mos tuir. No feto sira haree rate nee, no oinsaa ema tau Jesus nia mate isin.
verses.56: No sira fila fali hodi prepara ai morin no mina morin oi-oin. Iha loron Sabdu sira deskansa tuir ukun fuan.

verses.1: Iha loron primeiru ba semana nee, iha dadeer-saan nakukun, feto sira baa rate. Sira lori ai morin nebee sira prepara ona.
verses.2: No sira haree katak fatuk duir sai tiha ona hosi rate.
verses.3: Sira tama maibee la hetan Nai Jesus nia mate isin.
verses.4: Bainhira sira duvida hela kona ba ida nee, tebes, ema nain rua hamriik ho ropa nabilan iha sira nia sorin.
verses.5: Feto sira nee tauk, no hakneak ho oin ba rai. Nain rua nee dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi buka ida nebee moris iha mate sira nia leet?
verses.6: Nia la iha nee, maibee Nia moris hias ona. Hanoin hetan oinsaa Nia koalia ho imi bainhira Nia sei iha Galileia.
verses.7: Nia dehan, ‘Ema sei entrega Ema Nia Oan ba sala nain sira nia liman. Sira sei prega Nia ba krús, no iha loron terseiru Nia sei moris hias.’”
verses.8: No sira hanoin hetan Jesus nia liafuan.
verses.9: Sira fila fali hosi rate, no foo hatene buat hotu nee ba sira nain sanulu resin ida, no mos ba sira seluk hotu.
verses.10: Feto sira nebee konta buat sira nee ba apostolu sira mak Maria Madalena, Joana, Maria nebee Tiago nia inan, no feto sira seluk nebee hamutuk ho sira.
verses.11: Maibee ema hanoin feto sira nee nia liafuan mak istória naran deit, no sira la fiar.
verses.12: Maibee Pedro hamriik no halai ba rate. Nia hakruuk no haree deit ropa linhu. Nia sai fali no hanoin iha laran kona ba buat nebee akontese.
verses.13: Iha loron nee kedas, nain rua hosi sira lao ba aldeia ida naran Emaus. Aldeia nee dook maizoumenus kilometru sanulu resin ida hosi Jerusalém.
verses.14: No sira koalia hamutuk kona ba buat hotu nebee akontese ona.
verses.15: Tuir mai, bainhira sira koalia no hanoin hela, Jesus rasik hakbesik no lao hamutuk ho sira.
verses.16: Maibee sira nia matan la hatene Nia.
verses.17: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi koalia ba malu kona ba saida bainhira imi lao dadaun nee?” No sira nain rua para tiha ho oin tristi.
verses.18: Ema ida hosi sira, naran Cleopas, hataan no dehan ba Nia, “Ita mak estranjeiru mesak deit iha Jerusalém nebee la hatene buat sira nebee foin akontese iha nebaa iha tempu nee?”
verses.19: Nia dehan ba sira, “Kona ba saida?” No sira dehan ba Nia, “Kona ba Jesus hosi Nazaré. Nia mak profeta ida nebee hatudu kbiit ho liafuan no hahalok iha Maromak nia oin no iha povu hotu nia oin.
verses.20: No oinsaa xefi saserdote sira no ita nia ukun nain sira entrega Nia atu simu kastigu mate. No ema prega ona Nia ba krús.
verses.21: Maibee ami hanoin katak Nia mak ema nebee atu hola fali Israel. Sin, no liu tan nee, ohin mak loron terseiru hosi tempu nebee buat hirak nee akontese.
verses.22: No mos, feto balu hosi ami nia grupu halo ami hakfodak. Tanba ohin dadeer sedu, sira baa rate
verses.23: maibee sira la hetan Ninia mate isin. Sira mai fali no dehan katak sira haree vizaun ida ho anju sira, nebee dehan katak Nia moris hias ona.
verses.24: No ema balu hosi ami baa rate no hetan buat sira nee tuir buat nebee feto sira hatete. Maibee sira la haree Nia.”
verses.25: Depois Nia dehan ba sira, “Oh beik-teen sira! Imi iha fuan laran nebee neineik atu fiar buat hotu nebee profeta sira koalia nanis ona!
verses.26: Laos Kristu tenki simu terus sira nee, no tama ba Ninia glória?”
verses.27: No hahuu hosi Moisés no profeta sira hotu, Nia esplika ba sira buat hotu nebee hakerek iha Eskritura kona ba Nia.
verses.28: Bainhira sira besik ona ba aldeia nebee sira atu tama, Nia lao hanesan Nia atu baa fatin seluk.
verses.29: Maibee sira obriga Nia, no dehan, “Mai hela ho ami. Tanba besik kalan ona, no loron matan besik atu monu ona.” Entaun Nia tama hodi hela ho sira.
verses.30: Bainhira Nia tuur haan hamutuk ho sira, Nia foti paun no foo bensa. No Nia silu paun no foo ba sira.
verses.31: Depois sira nia matan nakloke, no sira konhese Nia. No Nia lakon kedas hosi sira nia oin.
verses.32: Sira dehan ba malu, “Laos ita senti ita nia fuan laran lakan bainhira Nia koalia hela ho ita iha dalan no Nia loke Eskritura sira ba ita?”
verses.33: Sira hamriik iha oras nee kedas no fila fali ba Jerusalém. Sira hetan apostolu nain sanulu resin ida halibur ho ema nebee hamutuk ho sira,
verses.34: nebee dehan, “Nai moris hias ona, no Nia mosu ba Simão!”
verses.35: Depois ema nain rua nee konta kona ba buat sira nebee akontese iha dalan, no oinsaa sira konhese Nia bainhira Nia silu paun.
verses.36: Bainhira sira koalia hela nunee, Jesus rasik hamriik iha sira nia leet. No Nia dehan ba sira, “Dame hela ho imi!”
verses.37: Maibee sira tauk tebes no hakfodak tanba sira hanoin katak sira haree mate klamar ida.
verses.38: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Tanba saa mak imi laran taridu? No tanba saa mak imi laran ru-rua?
verses.39: Haree took Hau nia liman no Hau nia ain. Ida nee mak Hau rasik. Kaer Hau no haree ba. Mate klamar la iha isin no ruin hanesan imi haree katak Hau iha.”
verses.40: No bainhira Nia koalia tiha nunee, Nia hatudu Ninia liman no ain ba sira.
verses.41: Sira seidauk fiar tanba sira haksolok demais no admira. Nunee Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi iha buat ruma iha nee atu haan ka?”
verses.42: No sira foo ikan tunu pedasuk ida ba Nia.
verses.43: Nia foti ikan nee no haan iha sira nia oin.
verses.44: Tuir mai, Nia dehan ba sira, “Hau koalia ona liafuan nee bainhira Hau sei hamutuk ho imi. Hau dehan katak buat hotu-hotu nebee hakerek nanis ona kona ba Hau iha Lei hosi Moisés, iha profeta sira, no iha Salmu sira, tenki kumpri duni.
verses.45: Depois Nia loke sira nia neon hodi sira bele kompriende Eskritura.
verses.46: Nia dehan ba sira, “Ida nee hakerek nanis ona, katak Kristu tenki hetan terus no iha loron terseiru Nia sei moris hias hosi mate,
verses.47: no katak ema bele arepende no hetan perdua ba sala hodi Ninia naran. No ema sei haklaken liafuan nee iha nasaun hotu, hahuu hosi Jerusalém.
verses.48: Imi mak sasin kona ba buat sira nee.
verses.49: Tebes, Hau sei haruka promesa ida ba imi hosi Hau nia Aman. Maibee hein iha sidade nee, too imi simu kbiit hosi leten.”
verses.50: Jesus lori sira sai ba Betánia. No Nia foti Ninia liman hodi foo bensaun ba sira.
verses.51: Bainhira Nia foo dadaun bensaun ba sira, Nia husik sira no sae ba lalehan.
verses.52: Sira adora Nia, no fila fali ba Jerusalém ho haksolok boot.
verses.53: No sira hela nafatin iha Templu hodi hahii Maromak.

verses.1: Hahuu fo-foun, Liafuan iha nanis ona. No Liafuan nee hamutuk ho Maromak. No Liafuan nee mak Maromak.
verses.2: Nia hamutuk ho Maromak hori uluk kedas.
verses.3: Maromak halo buat hotu-hotu liu hosi Nia. Maromak la halo buat ida ketak hosi Nia.
verses.4: Iha Nia mak moris. No moris nee mak naroman ba ema.
verses.5: Naroman nee nabilan iha nakukun. No nakukun la bele halakon naroman nee.
verses.6: Iha mane ida nebee Maromak haruka, ninia naran João.
verses.7: Nia mai nudar sasin ida, atu foo sasin kona ba naroman nee, hodi nunee ema hotu bele fiar liu hosi nia.
verses.8: Nia laos naroman nee, maibee nia mai atu foo sasin kona ba naroman nee.
verses.9: Naroman lo-loos nee, nebee foo naroman ba ema hotu, atu tama mai iha mundu.
verses.10: Nia iha mundu ona, no Maromak halo mundu liu hosi Nia, maibee mundu la konhese Nia.
verses.11: Nia mai ba Ninia rai rasik, maibee Ninia povu la simu Nia.
verses.12: Maibee ema hotu nebee simu Nia, nebee fiar ba Ninia naran, Nia foo kbiit atu sai Maromak nia oan sira.
verses.13: Sira moris mai laos hosi raan, ka hosi isin nia hakarak, ka hosi ema nia hakarak, maibee hosi Maromak.
verses.14: Liafuan nee sai ema ida, no Nia hela iha ita nia leet. Ita haree tiha ona Ninia glória, glória nudar Aman Nia Oan Mane Mesak, nakonu ho grasa no lia loos.
verses.15: João foo sasin kona ba Nia, no hakilar dehan, “Nia mak ida nebee hau dehan ona, ‘Nia nebee mai tuir hau mak uluk hau, tanba Nia iha tiha ona uluk liu hau.’”
verses.16: Hosi Ninia laran nakonu, ita hotu simu ona, no grasa tu-tuir grasa.
verses.17: Tanba Maromak foo ona lei liu hosi Moisés, maibee grasa no lia loos mai liu hosi Jesus Kristu.
verses.18: La iha ema ida nebee haree ona Maromak, só Oan Mane Mesak deit, nebee iha Maromak nia sorin, Nia mak foo sai ona kona ba Maromak.
verses.19: João foo sai testemunha ida nee, bainhira ema Judeu sira haruka saserdote no ema Levi sira hosi Jerusalém hodi husu nia, “O nee see?”
verses.20: Nia foo sai, no nia la nega; maibee nia foo sai, “Hau laos Kristu.”
verses.21: No sira husu nia, “Entaun nusaa? O mak Elias ka?” No nia dehan, “Hau laos.” “O mak Profeta ka?” No nia hataan, “Lae.”
verses.22: Entaun sira dehan ba nia, “O nee see? Ami presiza foo resposta ba sira nebee haruka ami. O dehan saa kona ba o nia aan?”
verses.23: Nia dehan, “Hau mak lian hosi ema ida nebee hakilar iha rai fuik laran, ‘Halo loos Nai nia dalan,’ hanesan profeta Isaias dehan ona.
verses.24: (Ema Farizeu sira mak haruka ema sira nee.)
verses.25: No sira husu nia, “Tanba saa mak o foo batizmu, see o laos Kristu, ka Elias, ka Profeta?”
verses.26: João hataan ba sira, “Hau foo batizmu ho bee. Maibee iha ida nebee hamriik iha imi nia leet nebee imi la hatene.
verses.27: Nia mak ida nebee tuir hau. Maibee atu kore Ninia sandálias talin mos, hau la merese.”
verses.28: Buat sira nee akontese iha Betánia iha Jordaun sorin ba, iha fatin nebee João foo batizmu.
verses.29: Loron tuir mai, João haree Jesus mai hakbesik ba nia, no nia dehan, “Haree ba, Maromak nia Bibi Oan nebee kasu mundu nia sala!
verses.30: Nia mak ida nebee hau dehan tiha ona, ‘Mane ida nebee tuir hau mak uluk hau, tanba Nia mak iha ona uluk liu hau.’
verses.31: Hau la hatene Nia. Maibee hau mai no foo batizmu ho bee tanba razaun nee, hodi hatudu Nia ba Israel.”
verses.32: No João foo testemunha no dehan, “Hau haree Espíritu tuun hosi lalehan hanesan manu pombu ida, no Espíritu nee hela iha Nia.
verses.33: Hau la hatene Nia. Maibee Nia nebee haruka hau atu foo batizmu ho bee hatete mai hau dehan, ‘Nia nebee o sei haree Espíritu tuun ba, no hela iha Nia, mak ida nebee foo batizmu ho Espíritu Santu.’
verses.34: Hau haree tiha ona, no foo sasin katak Nia mak Maromak nia Oan.”
verses.35: Loron tuir mai, João hamriik ho ninia eskolante nain rua;
verses.36: Nia haree Jesus lao dadaun, no nia dehan, “Haree ba, Maromak nia Bibi Oan!”
verses.37: Eskolante rua nee rona nia koalia nunee no sira tuir Jesus.
verses.38: Jesus fila oin no haree sira lao tuir Nia, no Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi buka saida?” Sira dehan ba Nia, “Rabi” (nee katak Mestri), “O hela iha nebee?”
verses.39: Nia dehan ba sira, “Mai no imi sei haree.” Sira baa no haree fatin nebee Nia hela. No iha loron nee sira hela ho Nia, tanba tempu nee maizoumenus tuku haat lokraik.
verses.40: Ema ida hosi sira nain rua nebee rona tiha João nia liafuan no tuir Jesus mak André, nebee Simão Pedro nia alin rasik.
verses.41: Nia baa hetan uluk ninia maun Simão, no dehan ba nia, “Ami hetan ona Mesias” (nee katak Kristu).
verses.42: No nia lori Simão ba Jesus. Bainhira Jesus haree Simão, Nia dehan, “O mak Simão, João nia oan mane. Ema sei bolu o Kefas” (nee katak Pedro).
verses.43: Loron tuir mai, Jesus desidi atu baa Galileia. Nia hetan Filipe, no dehan ba nia, “Tuir Hau.”
verses.44: Filipe mak ema hosi Betsaida, nebee André no Pedro nia sidade.
verses.45: Filipe hetan Natanael, no dehan ba nia, “Ami hetan ona Nia nebee Lei hosi Moisés no profeta sira hakerek nanis ona. Nia mak Jesus hosi Nazaré, José nia oan mane.”
verses.46: No Natanael dehan ba nia, “Buat diak ida bele mai hosi Nazaré ka?” Filipe dehan ba nia, “Mai no haree.”
verses.47: Jesus haree Natanael mai dadaun, no dehan kona ba nia, “Tebes, ema Israel duni, nebee la iha lia bosok iha nia laran!”
verses.48: Natanael dehan ba Jesus, “Oinsaa O konhese hau?” Jesus hataan ba nia, “Molok Filipe bolu o, Hau haree ona o bainhira o sei iha ai figeira huun nia okos.”
verses.49: Natanael hataan no dehan ba Nia, “Rabi, O mak Maromak Nia Oan! O mak Liurai hosi Israel!”
verses.50: Jesus hataan ba nia, “O fiar tanba Hau dehan ba o katak Hau haree ona o iha ai figeira huun nia okos ka? O sei haree buat sira nebee boot liu ida nee.”
verses.51: No Jesus dehan ba nia, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, tuir mai imi sei haree lalehan nakloke, no Maromak nia anju sira sei tuun-sae ba Ema Nia Oan.”

verses.1: Iha loron terseiru, iha festa kazamentu ida iha Kaná, nebee iha Galileia. No Jesus nia inan mos iha nebaa.
verses.2: Ema konvida mos Jesus ho Ninia eskolante sira ba festa kazamentu nee.
verses.3: Bainhira sira nia tua uvas la too, Jesus nia inan dehan ba Nia, “Sira nia tua uvas hotu ona.”
verses.4: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Feto, tanba saa mak involve Hau? Hau nia tempu seidauk too.”
verses.5: Ninia inan dehan ba atan sira, “Halo tuir buat hotu nebee Nia dehan ba imi.”
verses.6: Iha nebaa iha sanan boot neen nebee halo hosi fatuk. Ema Judeu sira baibain uza sanan boot nee hodi hamoos aan tuir sira nia kostumi. Sanan boot ida-idak bele simu bee litru ualu-nulu too atus ida rua-nulu.
verses.7: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Enxe nakonu bee ba sanan boot sira nee.” No sira enxe nakonu sanan boot sira nee too ibun.
verses.8: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Kuru ba, no lori ba festa nain.” No sira lori ba.
verses.9: Bainhira festa nain koko ona bee nebee nakfilak ona ba tua uvas, nia bolu noivu. Nia la hatene tua uvas nee mai hosi nebee, maibee atan sira nebee kuru bee hatene.
verses.10: Festa nain dehan ba noivu, “Ema hotu foo uluk tua uvas diak. No bainhira ema lanu ona mak foin foo tua uvas nebee laduun diak. Maibee o rai hela tua uvas diak too agora.”
verses.11: Jesus halo Ninia milagre primeiru nee iha Kaná, nebee iha Galileia. Ho ida nee Nia hatudu sai Ninia glória. No Ninia eskolante sira fiar ba Nia.
verses.12: Tuir mai Nia tuun ba Kafarnaum ho Ninia inan, ninia alin sira no Ninia eskolante sira. No sira hela iha nebaa too loron balu deit.
verses.13: Ema Judeu sira nia Festa Páskua besik ona, no Jesus sae ba Jerusalém.
verses.14: Iha Templu laran nia hetan sira nebee faan karau, bibi no manu pombu, no ema sira nebee troka osan mos tuur iha nebaa.
verses.15: Depois Nia halo sikoti hosi tali, no Nia duni sai sira hotu hosi Templu, hamutuk ho bibi no karau sira. Nia fakar sai osan hosi ema nebee troka osan no Nia baku fila sira nia meza.
verses.16: Nia dehan ba sira nebee faan manu pombu, “Lori sai tiha buat sira nee! Keta halo Hau nia Aman nia uma sai fali uma negósiu nian!”
verses.17: No Ninia eskolante sira hanoin hetan liafuan nebee hakerek nanis ona, “Laran manas ba O nia uma haan mohu hau.”
verses.18: Ema Judeu sira dehan ba Nia, “Sinál saida mak O sei hatudu mai ami, hodi O bele halo buat sira nee?”
verses.19: Jesus hataan ba sira dehan, “Halakon Templu nee no Hau sei harii fali iha loron tolu nia laran.”
verses.20: Ema Judeu sira dehan, “Templu nee haan tinan haat-nulu resin neen hodi harii. No O sei harii fali iha loron tolu nia laran ka?”
verses.21: Maibee Jesus koalia kona ba templu nebee Ninia isin lolon rasik.
verses.22: Bainhira Nia moris hias ona hosi mate, Ninia eskolante sira hanoin hetan katak Nia dehan tiha ona liafuan nee. No sira fiar eskritura, no liafuan nebee Jesus koalia tiha ona.
verses.23: Bainhira Jesus iha Jerusalém iha Festa Páskua nian, ema barak tau fiar iha Ninia naran, tanba sira haree milagre sira nebee Nia halo.
verses.24: Maibee Jesus la fiar sira, tanba Nia konhese ema hotu.
verses.25: No Nia la presiza ema foo hatene kona ba sira nia hanoin. Tanba Nia hatene saida mak iha ema nia fuan laran.

verses.1: Ema ida naran Nicodemos mai hosi ema Farizeu sira. Nia mak ukun nain ida hosi ema Judeu sira.
verses.2: Nia mai hasoru Jesus iha kalan no dehan, “Rabi, ami hatene katak Ita mak mestri ida nebee mai hosi Maromak. Tanba ema ida la bele halo milagre sira nee, se Maromak la hamutuk ho nia.”
verses.3: Jesus hataan ba nia, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba o, se ema la moris fali, nia la bele haree Maromak nia reinu.”
verses.4: Nicodemos dehan ba Jesus, “Oinsaa mak ema ida bele moris fali bainhira nia katuas ona? Nia bele tama fali ba ninia inan nia oan fatin atu moris fali ka?”
verses.5: Jesus hataan, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba o, se ema ida la moris hosi bee no hosi Espíritu, nia la bele tama ba Maromak nia reinu.
verses.6: Buat nebee moris hosi isin mak isin. No buat nebee moris hosi Espíritu mak espíritu.
verses.7: Keta hakfodak katak Hau dehan ba o, ‘O tenki moris fali.’
verses.8: Anin huu ba fatin nebee nia hakarak. O bele rona anin nia lian maibee o la hatene anin nee mai hosi nebee no atu baa nebee. Nunee mos ho ema hotu nebee moris hosi Espíritu.”
verses.9: Nicodemos hataan ba Jesus, “Oinsaa mak buat sira nee bele akontese?”
verses.10: Jesus hataan ba nia, “O mak Israel nia mestri maibee o la kompriende buat sira nee ka?
verses.11: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba o katak ami koalia kona ba buat nebee ami hatene, no foo testemunha kona ba buat nebee ami haree ona, maibee imi la simu ami nia testemunha.
verses.12: Se Hau koalia ho o kona ba buat mundu nian no o la fiar, oinsaa mak o bele fiar bainhira Hau koalia kona ba buat lalehan nian?
verses.13: La iha ema ida nebee sae tiha ona ba lalehan, só Nia nebee tuun mai hosi lalehan, nee mak Ema Nia Oan.
verses.14: Hanesan Moisés hiit sae samea iha rai fuik maran, nunee mos ema sei hiit sae Ema Nia Oan,
verses.15: atu see-see deit nebee fiar ba Nia sei hetan moris rohan laek.”
verses.16: “Tanba Maromak hadomi tebes mundu, too Nia foo Ninia Oan Mane mesak, atu ema hotu nebee fiar ba Nia sei la lakon, maibee sei hetan moris rohan laek.
verses.17: Tanba Maromak haruka Ninia Oan Mane mai iha mundu, laos atu foo sala ba mundu, maibee atu mundu bele hetan salvasaun liu hosi Nia.
verses.18: Ema nebee fiar ba Nia la hetan kastigu. Maibee ema nebee la fiar ba Nia hetan ona kastigu, tanba ema nee la fiar ba Maromak nia Oan mesak nia naran.
verses.19: Kastigu mai tanba nee: tanba naroman mai ona iha mundu, maibee ema hadomi nakukun liu fali naroman, tanba sira nia hahalok mak aat.
verses.20: Tanba ema hotu nebee halo aat mak odi naroman. No sira la mai iha naroman, atu ema la haree sira nia hahalok.
verses.21: Maibee nia nebee halo buat nebee loos sei mai iha naroman, atu ema bele haree katak nia halao ninia hahalok iha Maromak.”
verses.22: Nee hotu tiha, Jesus no Ninia eskolante sira tama ba rai Judeia. Nia hela iha nebaa ho sira no foo batizmu.
verses.23: João mos foo batizmu iha Enon, besik Salim, tanba iha nebaa iha bee barak. No ema mai no hetan batizmu.
verses.24: Tanba iha tempu nee João seidauk tama ba komarka laran.
verses.25: Depois João nia eskolante balu diskuti malu ho ema Judeu ida kona ba serimonia hamoos aan.
verses.26: No sira mai ba João, no dehan ba nia, “Rabi, Nia nebee hamutuk ho ita boot iha Jordaun sorin ba, nebee ita boot foo sasin kona ba Nia, tebes Nia mos foo batizmu, no ema hotu baa hasoru Nia.”
verses.27: João hataan, “Ema ida la bele simu buat ida, só deit buat nebee Maromak foo ba nia hosi lalehan.
verses.28: Imi rasik bele foo sasin katak hau dehan, ‘Hau laos Kristu, maibee Maromak haruka hau mai uluk Nia.’
verses.29: Noivu mak simu noiva. Noivu nia belun, nebee hamriik atu rona nia, haksolok tebes bainhira nia rona noivu nia lian. Hau nia haksolok nee kompletu ona.
verses.30: Nia tenki sai boot liu, maibee hau tenki sai kiik liu.
verses.31: Nia nebee mai hosi leten mak aas liu hotu. Nia nebee mai hosi mundu mak mundu nian, no koalia hanesan ema hosi mundu. Nia nebee mai hosi lalehan mak aas liu hotu.
verses.32: Nia foo testemunha kona ba buat nebee Nia haree no rona, maibee ema la simu Ninia testemunha.
verses.33: Ema nebee simu Ninia testemunha deklara katak Maromak mak loos.
verses.34: Tanba Nia nebee Maromak haruka nee koalia Maromak nia liafuan, tanba Maromak foo Espíritu makaas tebes ba Nia.
verses.35: Aman hadomi Oan Mane, no foo ona buat hotu ba Ninia liman.
verses.36: Ema nebee fiar ba Oan Mane hetan moris rohan laek. No ema nebee la halo tuir Oan Mane sei la haree moris; maibee Maromak nia laran hirus hela ho nia.”

verses.1: Jesus hatene katak ema Farizeu sira rona ona katak Jesus foo batizmu no hetan eskolante barak liu João.
verses.2: Tuir lo-loos, laos Jesus rasik nebee foo batizmu, maibee Ninia eskolante sira.
verses.3: Entaun Jesus sai hosi Judeia, no lao fali ba Galileia.
verses.4: No Nia tenki lao liu hosi Samaria.
verses.5: Nia mai ba sidade ida iha Samaria, naran Sikar. Fatin nee besik rai nebee uluk Jacó foo ba ninia oan mane José.
verses.6: Jacó nia bee posu iha nebaa. Jesus kole ho Ninia viajen no Nia tuur iha bee posu nia sorin. Oras nee besik meiudia.
verses.7: Feto Samaria ida mai atu kuru bee. Jesus dehan ba nia, “Foo bee mai Hau atu hemu.”
verses.8: Tanba Ninia eskolante sira baa tiha ona sidade hodi sosa ai haan.
verses.9: Feto Samaria nee dehan ba Nia, “Oinsaa mak Ita, ema Judeu ida, husu fali bee hemu hosi hau, feto Samaria ida?” Tanba ema Judeu sira la koalia ho ema Samaria sira.
verses.10: Jesus hataan ba nia, “Se o hatene karik Maromak nia prezenti, no See loos mak dehan ba o, ‘Foo bee mai Hau atu hemu,’ o sei husu Nia, no Nia sei foo bee moris nian ba o.”
verses.11: Feto nee dehan ba Jesus, “Mestri, Ita la iha buat ida atu kuru bee, no bee posu nee klean. Nunee ita bele hetan bee moris nian hosi nebee?
verses.12: Ita mak boot liu fali ami nia aman Jacó, nebee foo bee posu nee mai ami ka? Nia rasik hemu hosi bee posu nee, no ninia oan sira, no ninia karau sira mos hemu hosi bee nee.”
verses.13: Jesus hataan ba nia, “Ema hotu nebee hemu hosi bee nee sei hamrook fali.
verses.14: Maibee ema nebee hemu hosi bee nebee Hau sei foo ba nia sei nunka hamrook. Tanba bee nebee Hau sei foo ba nia sei sai bee matan nebee suli sai too moris rohan laek.”
verses.15: Feto nee dehan ba Jesus, “Mestri, foo bee nee mai hau, hodi hau la bele hamrook tan, no hau la presiza mai tan iha nee atu kuru bee.”
verses.16: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Baa bolu o nia laen, no mai iha nee.”
verses.17: Feto hataan, “Hau la iha laen.” Jesus dehan ba nia, “O koalia loos bainhira o dehan, ‘Hau la iha laen.’
verses.18: Tanba o hola ona laen nain lima. No mane nebee agora moris hamutuk ho o laos o nia laen. Nunee o koalia loos duni.”
verses.19: Feto dehan ba Nia, “Mestri, hau haree katak Ita mak profeta ida.
verses.20: Ami nia bei-ala sira adora iha foho nee. Maibee imi dehan katak ema tenki adora iha Jerusalém.”
verses.21: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Feto, fiar Hau ba: tempu sei mai bainhira imi sei la adora Aman iha foho nee ka iha Jerusalém.
verses.22: Imi adora buat nebee imi la hatene. Ami adora buat nebee ami hatene. Tanba salvasaun mai hosi ema Judeu sira.
verses.23: Maibee oras sei mai, no agora tempu too ona, bainhira ema nebee adora lo-loos sei adora Aman iha espíritu no iha lia loos. Tanba Aman buka ema hanesan nee atu adora Nia.
verses.24: Maromak mak Espíritu, no sira nebee adora Nia tenki adora iha espíritu no iha lia loos.”
verses.25: Feto nee dehan ba Nia, “Hau hatene katak Mesias sei mai, nebee ema bolu Kristu. Bainhira Nia mai, Nia sei foo hatene buat hotu mai ami.”
verses.26: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Hau mak Nia, nebee koalia dadaun ho o.”
verses.27: Iha momentu nee, Ninia eskolante sira too mai. No sira hakfodak katak Nia koalia ho feto ida. Maibee sira ida la husu, “O presiza saida?” ka, “Tanba saa mak O koalia ho nia?”
verses.28: Feto nee husik hela ninia sanan rai no fila fali ba sidade. No nia dehan ba ema,
verses.29: “Mai lai! Haree mane ida nebee foo hatene mai hau kona ba buat hotu nebee hau halo tiha ona. Nia mak Kristu karik?”
verses.30: Depois sira sai hosi sidade, no mai atu hasoru Nia.
verses.31: Iha tempu nee, Ninia eskolante sira husu Nia, no dehan, “Rabi, haan lai.”
verses.32: Maibee Nia dehan ba sira, “Hau iha ai haan hodi haan nebee imi la hatene.”
verses.33: Nunee eskolante sira dehan ba malu, “Ema lori buat ruma ba Nia atu haan ka?”
verses.34: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Hau nia ai haan mak atu halo tuir Ninia hakarak nebee haruka Hau mai, no atu halo Ninia servisu too kompletu.
verses.35: Laos imi dehan, ‘Sei hela fulan haat, depois tempu silu batar’? Tebes, Hau hatete ba imi, “Foti sae imi nia matan no haree ba. Toos sira nee prontu atu silu.
verses.36: Nia nebee silu simu ninia kolen, no nia halibur rezultadu ba moris rohan laek. Nunee ida nebee kari fini no ida nebee silu sei haksolok hamutuk.
verses.37: Tanba iha nee liafuan nee loos duni, katak, ‘Ida kari, no ida seluk silu.’
verses.38: Hau haruka imi atu silu iha fatin nebee imi la servisu. Ema seluk mak halo servisu nee, no imi hetan benefísiu hosi sira nia kolen.”
verses.39: Ema Samaria sira hosi sidade nee fiar ba Jesus tanba testemunha hosi feto, nebee dehan, “Nia foo hatene mai hau kona ba buat hotu nebee hau halo ona.”
verses.40: Nunee bainhira ema Samaria sira mai too Jesus, sira husu Nia atu hela ho sira. No Nia hela iha nebaa too loron rua.
verses.41: No ema barak liu tan fiar tanba Ninia liafuan.
verses.42: Sira dehan ba feto nee, “Agora ami fiar, laos tanba o nia liafuan, maibee tanba ami rasik rona Nia. No ami hatene duni katak Nia mak mundu nia Salvadór.”
verses.43: Liu tiha loron rua, Nia sai hosi fatin nee, no tama ba Galileia.
verses.44: (Jesus rasik foo sasin katak profeta ida la iha folin iha ninia rai rasik.)
verses.45: Entaun bainhira Nia tama mai Galileia, ema Galileia sira simu Nia, tanba sira haree ona buat hotu nebee Nia halo iha festa iha Jerusalém. Tanba sira mos baa festa nee.
verses.46: Entaun Jesus mai fali too Kana, iha Galileia, iha fatin nebee Nia halo bee nakfilak ba tua uvas. No iha Kafarnaum iha ema boot ida nebee nia oan mane moras.
verses.47: Bainhira ema boot nee rona katak Jesus mai ona hosi Judeia too Galileia, nia baa hasoru Jesus. Nia husu Jesus atu tuun mai, no kura ninia oan mane. Tanba oan nee besik atu mate.
verses.48: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Se karik imi la haree sinál no milagre sira, imi sei la fiar.”
verses.49: Ema boot nee dehan ba Jesus, “Mestri, tuun mai molok hau nia oan mate.”
verses.50: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Baa deit, o nia oan sei moris.” No ema boot nee fiar liafuan nebee Jesus koalia ba nia, no nia baa.
verses.51: No bainhira nia tuun dadaun, ninia atan sira hasoru nia, no foo hatene ba nia, “O nia oan mane sei moris hela.”
verses.52: Nia husu atan sira tuku hira mak oan nee komesa diak fali. No atan sira dehan ba nia, “Horiseik, tuku ida lokraik mak ninia isin manas lakon.”
verses.53: Nunee aman hatene katak iha oras nee duni mak Jesus dehan ba nia, “O nia oan mane sei moris.” No nia fiar, hamutuk ho ninia uma kain tomak.
verses.54: Ida nee mak milagre segundu nebee Jesus halo, bainhira Nia mai hosi Judeia no tama ba Galileia.

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, ema Judeu sira halo festa no Jesus sae ba Jerusalém.
verses.2: Jerusalém iha kolan ida besik Portaun Bibi, nebee iha lian Ebreu naran Betesda. Kolan nee iha varanda lima.
verses.3: Ema aleijadu barak toba iha varanda sira nee: ema matan delek, ain aat no isin mate.
verses.5: Iha nebaa iha mane ida nebee moras too tinan tolu-nulu resin ualu ona.
verses.6: Bainhira Jesus haree mane nee toba iha nebaa no Nia hatene katak mane nee toba iha nebaa too tempu kleur ona, Nia dehan ba mane nee, “O hakarak sai diak ka?”
verses.7: Mane aleijadu hataan ba Nia, “Senhor, hau la iha ema ida atu hatama hau ba kolan nee bainhira bee book aan. Tanba bainhira hau baa, ema seluk tama uluk liu hau.”
verses.8: Jesus dehan ba mane nee, “Hamriik ba. Foti o nia biti, no lao ba.”
verses.9: No mane nee sai diak kedas. Nia foti ninia biti, no lao. Maibee loron nee mak loron Sabdu.
verses.10: Nunee ema Judeu sira dehan ba mane nebee foin isin diak, “Ohin loron Sabdu. Tuir lei, o keta lori o nia biti.”
verses.11: Nia hataan ba sira, “Ema nebee foo isin diak mai hau dehan mai hau, ‘Foti o nia biti, no lao ba.’”
verses.12: Entaun sira husu nia, “See mak dehan ba o, ‘Foti o nia biti, no lao ba’?”
verses.13: No mane nebee foin hetan kura nee la hatene see mak kura nia. Tanba Jesus lao sai nonook ba ema lubun boot nia klaran iha fatin nebaa.
verses.14: Tuir mai, Jesus hetan mane nee iha Templu, no dehan ba nia, “Haree ba, o isin diak ona! Keta halo sala tan atu nunee buat nebee aat liu tan la bele kona o.”
verses.15: Mane nee sai ba no foo hatene ba ema Judeu sira katak ema nebee foo isin diak ba nia mak Jesus.
verses.16: Nunee ema Judeu sira hanehan Jesus, tanba Nia halo buat sira nee iha loron Sabdu.
verses.17: Maibee Jesus hataan ba sira, “Hau nia Aman servisu nafatin too agora, no Hau mos servisu nafatin.”
verses.18: Nunee ema Judeu hakaas aan liu tan atu oho Nia. Tanba Nia la kontra deit loron Sabdu, maibee Nia mos bolu Maromak nudar Ninia Aman rasik. Ho ida nee Nia halo Nia aan hanesan ho Maromak.
verses.19: Entaun Jesus dehan ba sira, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, Oan Mane la bele halo buat ida mesak deit. Só Nia halo deit buat nebee Nia haree Aman halo. Tanba saida deit mak Aman halo, Oan Mane mos halo hanesan.
verses.20: Tanba Aman hadomi Oan Mane, no hatudu ba Oan Mane buat hotu nebee Nia halo. No Nia sei hatudu ba Oan Mane hahalok boot liu fali buat sira nee, hodi halo imi admira.
verses.21: Tanba hanesan Aman halo ema mate hadeer fali, no foo moris ba sira; nunee Oan Mane sei foo moris ba ema nebee Nia hakarak.
verses.22: Tanba Aman la tesi lia ba ema ida, maibee Nia foo knaar ba Oan Mane atu tesi lia ba ema hotu,
verses.23: atu nunee, ema hotu bele foo onra ba Oan Mane, hanesan sira foo onra ba Aman. See deit nebee la foo onra ba Oan Mane, ema nee mos la foo onra ba Aman nebee haruka Nia mai.
verses.24: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, ema nebee rona Hau nia liafuan, no fiar Ida nebee haruka Hau mai, nia hetan moris rohan laek. Nia sei la hetan kastigu. Nia muda hosi mate ba moris.
verses.25: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, oras sei mai, no agora too ona, bainhira ema mate sei rona Maromak nia Oan nia lian, no sira nebee rona sei moris.
verses.26: Tanba hanesan Aman iha moris iha Ninia aan rasik, nunee mos, Nia foo ona ba Oan Mane hodi Nia mos iha moris iha Ninia aan rasik.
verses.27: No Aman foo ona kbiit ba Oan Mane atu tesi lia, tanba Nia mak Ema Nia Oan.
verses.28: Keta admira kona ba ida nee, tanba oras sei mai bainhira ema hotu nebee iha rate laran sei rona Ninia lian,
verses.29: no sira sei sai mai. Ema nebee halo diak, sei hadeer fali no tama ba moris. No ema nebee halo aat, sei hadeer fali no tama ba kastigu.
verses.30: Hau la bele halo buat ida mesak deit. Hau tesi lia tuir buat nebee Hau rona. No Hau tesi lia loos. Tanba Hau la buka Hau nia hakarak rasik, maibee hakarak hosi Nia nebee haruka ona Hau mai.
verses.31: Se Hau foo sasin kona ba Hau nia aan rasik, Hau nia sasin nee la loos.
verses.32: Iha ida seluk nebee foo sasin kona ba Hau, no Hau hatene katak sasin nebee nia foo mak loos.
verses.33: Imi haruka ona ema ba João, no nia foo sasin ba lia loos.
verses.34: Hau la simu sasin hosi ema, maibee Hau dehan buat sira nee hodi imi bele hetan salvasaun.
verses.35: João mak ahi oan nebee lakan no nabilan. No imi kontenti atu haksolok too tempu uitoan iha ninia naroman.
verses.36: Maibee Hau iha sasin nebee boot liu João nian. Tanba Aman foo servisu mai Hau atu halo too kompletu. No Hau halo duni servisu nee. No servisu nee foo sasin kona ba Hau katak Aman mak haruka Hau mai.
verses.37: No Aman nebee haruka Hau mai, Nia rasik foo sasin kona ba Hau. Imi nunka rona Ninia lian, no imi nunka haree Ninia oin.
verses.38: Ninia liafuan la hela iha imi nia laran, tanba imi la fiar Ida nebee Nia haruka mai.
verses.39: Imi buka hatene Eskritura sira, tanba imi hanoin katak iha Eskritura mak imi hetan moris rohan laek. No Eskritura foo sasin kona ba Hau.
verses.40: Maibee imi lakohi mai iha Hau, hodi imi bele hetan moris.
verses.41: Hau la simu glória hosi ema.
verses.42: Maibee Hau hatene katak imi la iha Maromak nia domin iha imi nia laran.
verses.43: Hau mai hodi Hau nia Aman nia naran, no imi la simu Hau. Se karik ema seluk mai hodi ninia naran rasik, imi sei simu nia.
verses.44: Oinsaa mak imi bele fiar? Tanba imi simu glória hosi ema seluk, maibee imi la buka glória nebee mai hosi Maromak, nebee Maromak mesak deit.
verses.45: Keta hanoin katak Hau foo sala ba imi iha Aman nia oin. Tanba imi espera ba Moisés, maibee nia mak ida nebee foo sala ba imi.
verses.46: Tanba se karik imi fiar Moisés, imi sei fiar Hau. Tanba nia hakerek tiha ona kona ba Hau.
verses.47: Maibee se imi la fiar buat nebee nia hakerek, oinsaa mak imi bele fiar Hau nia liafuan?”

6.title: Ai Haan Ba Ema Rihun Lima

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, Jesus baa iha Tasi Galileia nia sorin ba, nebee ema bolu Tasi Tiberiades.
verses.2: Ema lubun boot tuir Nia tanba sira haree ona Ninia milagre sira nebee Nia halo ba ema moras sira.
verses.3: No Jesus sae foho ida, no Nia tuur iha nebaa ho Ninia eskolante sira.
verses.4: No ema Judeu sira nia Festa Páskua besik ona.
verses.5: Jesus foti matan no haree ema lubun boot mai dadaun atu hasoru Nia. Entaun Nia dehan ba Filipe, “Ita bele sosa paun iha nebee atu ema sira nee bele haan?”
verses.6: Nia dehan ida nee atu koko Filipe. Tanba Nia hatene ona saida mak Nia atu halo.
