verses.7: Filipe hataan ba Nia, “Osan denáriu atus rua mos la too atu sosa paun hodi ema ida-idak bele hetan paun pedasuk kiik ida.”
verses.8: Ninia eskolante ida naran, André, Simão Pedro nia alin, dehan ba Nia,
verses.9: “Iha labarik mane ida iha nee. Nia iha paun fuan lima nebee halo hosi trigu boot, no ikan kiik rua. Maibee oinsaa mak ida nee bele too ba ema barak tebes nee?”
verses.10: No Jesus dehan, “Haruka sira tuur.” Fatin nebaa iha duut barak. Entaun ema tuur, no sira maizoumenus ema mane nain rihun lima.
verses.11: Jesus foti paun sira nee. Nia foo agradese, no fahe paun ba eskolante sira. Depois eskolante sira fahe ba sira nebee tuur. Nia halo hanesan ho ikan too sira bosu.
verses.12: Bainhira sira bosu ona, Nia dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Halibur tiha hahaan restu. La bele estraga buat ida.”
verses.13: Nunee sira halibur hamutuk hahaan resin nee. Sira halibur pedasuk sira hosi paun trigu boot fuan lima too bote sanulu resin rua nakonu. Hahaan nee mak resin hosi buat nebee ema haan tiha ona.
verses.14: Bainhira povu haree ona milagre nebee Jesus halo nee, sira dehan, “Tebes duni, Nia mak Profeta nebee atu tama mai iha mundu nee!”
verses.15: Jesus haree katak sira atu mai kaer Nia no obriga Nia atu sai liurai, nunee Nia husik sira no sae ba foho mes-mesak.
verses.16: Bainhira rai nakaras ona, Jesus nia eskolante sira tuun ba tasi.
verses.17: Sira sae roo ida atu hakur tasi ba iha Kafarnaum. Kalan ona, no Jesus seidauk mai too sira.
verses.18: Depois tasi sai boot tanba anin huu makaas.
verses.19: Bainhira sira hean roo too maizoumenus kilometru lima ka neen, sira haree Jesus lao iha tasi leten. Nia hakbesik ba roo no sira tauk.
verses.20: Maibee Nia dehan ba sira, “Nee mak Hau. Keta tauk!”
verses.21: Nunee, sira kontenti atu simu Nia tama ba iha roo laran. No derepenti roo too iha fatin nebee sira atu baa.
verses.22: Loron tuir mai, ema lubun nebee hela iha tasi sorin ba haree katak la iha roo seluk iha nebaa, só deit roo ida nebee Jesus nia eskolante sira sae tiha. No sira hatene katak Jesus la baa ho Ninia eskolante sira iha roo laran, maibee Ninia eskolante sira mak baa mesak.
verses.23: Roo sira seluk mai hosi Tiberiades besik too fatin nebee Nai foo agradese no sira haan paun.
verses.24: Nunee bainhira ema lubun nee haree katak Jesus la iha, no Ninia eskolante sira mos la iha, sira sae roo no baa too Kafarnaum hodi buka Jesus.
verses.25: Bainhira sira hetan Nia iha tasi sorin ba, sira dehan ba Nia, “Rabi, bainhira mak O too iha nee?”
verses.26: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi: Imi buka Hau, laos tanba imi haree milagre sira, maibee tanba imi haan paun too bosu.
verses.27: Keta servisu atu hetan hahaan nebee lakon mohu, maibee servisu atu hetan hahaan nebee dura too moris rohan laek. Ema Nia Oan sei foo hahaan nee ba imi. Tanba Aman Maromak tau tiha ona marka ba Nia.”
verses.28: Depois sira dehan ba Nia, “Saida mak ami tenki halo atu halao Maromak nia servisu?”
verses.29: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Ida nee mak Maromak nia servisu, katak imi fiar ba Ida nebee Nia haruka mai.”
verses.30: Nunee sira dehan ba Jesus, “Entaun sinál saida mak O sei hatudu, hodi ami bele haree no fiar O? O sei halo saida?
verses.31: Ami nia bei-ala sira haan maná iha rai fuik, tuir liafuan nebee hakerek ona, ‘Nia foo paun hosi lalehan ba sira atu haan.’”
verses.32: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi katak laos Moisés mak foo paun hosi lalehan ba imi, maibee Hau nia Aman mak foo Paun lo-loos hosi lalehan ba imi.
verses.33: Tanba Maromak nia Paun mak Nia nebee tuun mai hosi lalehan, no foo moris ba mundu.”
verses.34: Sira dehan ba Nia, “Nai, foo nafatin paun nee mai ami.”
verses.35: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Hau mak Paun moris nian. Ema nebee mai ba Hau sei la hamlaha tan. No ema nebee fiar ba Hau sei la hamrook tan.
verses.36: Maibee Hau dehan ona ba imi, katak imi haree ona Hau, maibee imi la fiar.
verses.37: Ema hotu nebee Aman foo mai Hau, sei mai iha Hau. No nia nebee mai iha Hau, Hau sei la duni sai.
verses.38: Tanba Hau tuun mai hosi lalehan, laos atu halo tuir Hau nia hakarak, maibee atu halo tuir hakarak hosi Ida nebee haruka Hau mai.
verses.39: Ida nebee haruka Hau mai, Ninia hakarak mak nee: katak Hau sei la lakon ema ida hosi ema hotu nebee Nia foo mai Hau, maibee Hau sei halo sira moris hias iha loron ikus.
verses.40: Tanba nee mak Hau nia Aman nia hakarak: katak ema hotu nebee haree Oan Mane no fiar ba Nia, sei hetan moris rohan laek. No Hau sei halo nia moris hias iha loron ikus.
verses.41: Entaun ema Judeu sira murmura kona ba Jesus, tanba Nia dehan, “Hau mak Paun nebee tuun mai hosi lalehan.”
verses.42: No sira dehan, “Laos Nia mak Jesus, José nia Oan Mane? Laos ami konhese Ninia inan-aman? Nusaa mak agora Nia dehan, ‘Hau tuun mai hosi lalehan?’”
verses.43: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Keta murmura ba malu.
verses.44: La iha ema ida bele mai iha Hau, só deit Aman, nebee haruka ona Hau, mak dada nia. No Hau sei halo nia moris hias iha loron ikus.
verses.45: Profeta sira hakerek nanis ona, ‘Maromak sei hanorin sira hotu.’ Ema hotu nebee rona no aprende tiha hosi Aman, sei mai iha Hau.
verses.46: La iha ema ida nebee haree ona Aman, só deit Nia nebee mai hosi Maromak; Nia mak haree ona Aman.
verses.47: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, ema nebee fiar mak hetan moris rohan laek.
verses.48: Hau mak Paun moris nian.
verses.49: Imi nia bei-ala sira haan maná iha rai fuik, no sira mate ona.
verses.50: Maibee Paun ida nee tuun mai hosi lalehan, no ema nebee haan Paun nee sei la mate.
verses.51: Hau mak Paun moris nian nebee tuun mai hosi lalehan. Se ema haan Paun nee, nia sei moris tinan ba tinan. Paun nebee Hau sei foo hodi mundu bele moris mak Hau nia isin.”
verses.52: Nunee ema Judeu sira haksesuk malu no dehan, “Oinsaa mak Ema nee bele foo Ninia isin mai ita atu haan?”
verses.53: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, se imi la haan Ema Nia Oan nia isin, no la hemu Ninia raan, imi la iha moris iha imi nia laran.
verses.54: See-see deit nebee haan Hau nia isin no hemu Hau nia raan, nia hetan moris rohan laek. No Hau sei halo nia moris hias iha loron ikus.
verses.55: Tanba Hau nia isin mak ai haan lo-loos, no Hau nia raan mak hemu lo-loos.
verses.56: Ema nebee haan Hau nia isin, no hemu Hau nia raan, nia mak hela iha Hau, no Hau hela iha nia.
verses.57: Hanesan Aman nebee moris mak haruka Hau mai, no Hau moris tanba Aman, nunee mos ema nebee haan Hau, sei moris tanba Hau.
verses.58: Ida nee mak Paun nebee tuun mai hosi lalehan. No Paun nee la hanesan paun nebee imi nia bei-ala sira haan no depois sira mate. Tanba ema nebee haan hosi Paun nee sei moris tinan ba tinan.”
verses.59: Jesus dehan buat sira nee iha sinagoga, bainhira Nia hanorin iha Kafarnaum.
verses.60: Bainhira Ninia eskolante sira rona tiha liafuan nee, barak dehan, “Liafuan nee todan. See mak bele rona?”
verses.61: Maibee Jesus hatene iha Ninia laran katak Ninia eskolante sira murmura kona ba liafuan nee. Nunee Nia dehan ba sira, “Liafuan nee halo imi monu ka?
verses.62: Nunee saa tan se imi haree Ema Nia Oan sae ba fatin nebee Nia hela uluk?
verses.63: Espíritu mak foo moris; isin la folin buat ida. Liafuan nebee Hau koalia ona ba imi mak espíritu no moris.
verses.64: Maibee imi balu la fiar.” Tanba Jesus hatene hori uluk kedas, see mak la fiar, no ida nebee sei faan Nia.
verses.65: No Nia dehan, “Tanba nee mak Hau dehan ba imi katak la iha ema ida bele mai iha Hau, só deit nia nebee Aman foo lisensa atu mai.”
verses.66: Liu tiha tempu nee, Jesus nia eskolante barak fila kotuk no lakohi lao tan ho Nia.
verses.67: Nunee Jesus dehan ba sira nain sanulu resin rua, “Imi mos hakarak baa ka?”
verses.68: Simão Pedro hataan ba Nia, “Nai, ami atu baa ho see loos? O mak iha liafuan moris rohan laek nian.
verses.69: Ami fiar no hatene duni katak O mak Ida Nebee Santu hosi Maromak.”
verses.70: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Laos Hau rasik mak hili imi nain sanulu resin rua? Maibee ema ida hosi imi mak diabu ida.”
verses.71: Nia koalia kona ba Judas, Simão Iskariotes nia oan. Tanba nia mak ida nebee sei faan Jesus, maski nia mak ida hosi sira nain sanulu resin rua.

verses.1: Tuir mai, Jesus lao ba-mai iha Galileia. Nia la lao ba-mai iha Judeia, tanba ema Judeu sira buka atu oho Nia.
verses.2: Ema Judeu sira nia Festa Baraka besik ona.
verses.3: Nunee Ninia alin sira dehan ba Nia, “Sai hosi fatin nee, no baa Judeia, hodi O nia eskolante sira mos bele haree buat nebee O halo.
verses.4: Tanba se karik ema ida hakarak sai ema konhesidu, nia la servisu sub-subar deit. Se O halo buat sira nee, hatudu aan ba mundu.”
verses.5: Tanba Ninia alin sira mos la fiar ba Nia.
verses.6: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Hau nia tempu seidauk too. Maibee imi nia tempu iha nafatin.
verses.7: Mundu la bele odi imi, maibee mundu odi Hau. Tanba Hau foo sasin kona ba sira, katak buat nebee sira halo mak aat.
verses.8: Imi sae ba no tuir festa nee. Hau la baa festa nee tanba Hau nia tempu seidauk too.”
verses.9: Koalia tiha nunee, Nia hela iha Galileia.
verses.10: Maibee bainhira Ninia alin sira baa tiha ona, depois Nia mos sae ba festa. Nia la baa hodi ema hatene, maibee Nia baa nonook deit.
verses.11: Ema Judeu sira buka Nia iha festa, no dehan, “Nia iha nebee?”
verses.12: No iha povu nia leet ema murmura barak kona ba Nia. Balu dehan, “Nia ema diak.” Ema seluk dehan, “Lae; Nia lori povu ba dalan sala.”
verses.13: Maibee ema la koalia kona ba Nia iha ema barak nia oin tanba sira tauk ema Judeu sira.
verses.14: Tuir mai, maizoumenus too iha festa klaran, Jesus sae ba iha Templu. No Nia hahuu hanorin iha nebaa.
verses.15: Ema Judeu sira admira, no dehan, “Oinsaa mak ema nee hatene liafuan nee? Tanba Nia nunka baa eskola.”
verses.16: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Hau nia doutrina laos Hau nian. Maibee doutrina nee mai hosi Nia nebee haruka Hau mai.
verses.17: Ema nebee hakarak halo tuir Maromak nia hakarak sei hatene doutrina nee mai hosi Maromak ka Hau koalia hosi Hau nia aan rasik.
verses.18: Nia nebee koalia hosi ninia aan rasik buka glória ba ninia aan rasik. Maibee nia nebee buka glória ba ida nebee haruka nia mai, ema nee mak loos, no la iha buat nebee la loos iha nia.
verses.19: Laos Moisés foo Lei ba imi? Maibe imi ida la tuir Lei nee. Tanba saa mak imi buka atu oho Hau?”
verses.20: Povu nee hataan, “O iha diabu ida! See mak buka atu oho O?"
verses.21: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Hau halo milagre ida, no imi hotu hakfodak.
verses.22: Moisés foo sirkunsizaun ba imi, no imi foo sirkunsizaun ba ema iha loron Sabdu (maski nee laos hosi Moisés, maibee hosi bei-ala sira).
verses.23: Se ema bele simu sirkunsizaun iha loron Sabdu, hodi nunee imi la kontra Moisés nia Lei, entaun tanba saa mak imi hirus Hau bainhira Hau halo ema nia isin tomak diak iha loron Sabdu?
verses.24: Keta tesi lia tuir buat nebee imi haree deit, maibee tesi lia tuir julgamentu lo-loos.”
verses.25: Entaun ema balu hosi povu Jerusalém dehan, “Laos Nia mak mane nebee sira buka atu oho?
verses.26: Maibee haree took, Nia koalia iha ema barak nia oin, no sira la dehan buat ida ba Nia. Nai ulun sira hatene lo-loos katak Nia mak Kristu duni karik?
verses.27: Maibee ita hatene ema nee mai hosi nebee. Bainhira Kristu mai, la iha ema ida mak hatene Nia mai hosi nebee.”
verses.28: Entaun bainhira Jesus hanorin hela iha Templu, Nia foo sai ho lian makaas, “Imi hatene Hau, no imi hatene Hau mai hosi fatin nebee. Maibee Hau la mai tuir Hau nia hakarak rasik. Nia nebee haruka Hau mai, Nia mak loos. No imi la hatene Nia.
verses.29: Hau hatene Nia. Tanba Hau mai hosi Nia, no Nia mak haruka Hau mai.”
verses.30: Entaun sira buka atu kaer Nia. Maibee la iha ema ida mak tau liman ba Nia, tanba Ninia oras seidauk too.
verses.31: Maski nunee ema barak hosi povu nee fiar ba Nia, no dehan, “Bainhira Kristu mosu mai, Nia sei halo milagre barak liu fali buat nebee ema ida nee halo ka?”
verses.32: Ema Farizeu sira rona katak povu nee murmura hanesan nee kona ba Jesus. Nunee ema Farizeu sira no xefi saserdote sira haruka guarda sira atu baa kaer Nia.
verses.33: Entaun Jesus dehan, “Hau sei hamutuk ho imi too tempu uitoan tan. Depois Hau sei fila fali ba Ida nebee haruka Hau mai.
verses.34: Imi sei buka Hau, no imi sei la hetan Hau. Iha fatin nebee Hau hela, imi la bele baa.”
verses.35: Ema Judeu sira dehan ba malu, “Nia sei baa nebee, hodi ami la bele hetan Nia? Nia sei baa too ema Judeu sira nebee hela iha rai liur, iha ema Gregu sira nia leet, no hanorin ema Gregu sira ka?
verses.36: Ninia liafuan nee katak saida bainhira Nia dehan, ‘Imi sei buka Hau, no imi sei la hetan Hau,’ no ‘Iha fatin nebee Hau hela, imi la bele baa’?”
verses.37: Iha loron ikus, nebee iha loron boot iha festa nee, Jesus hamriik no foo sai ho lian makaas, “Se ema ruma hamrook karik, husik nia mai iha Hau, no hemu.
verses.38: See deit nebee fiar iha Hau, hanesan eskritura dehan, ‘Hosi ninia laran sei suli sai mota bee moris nian.’”
verses.39: Nia koalia kona ba Espíritu nebee sira nebee fiar ba Nia sei simu. Maibee too tempu nee, Maromak seidauk foo Espíritu Santu, tanba Jesus seidauk hetan glória.
verses.40: Bainhira sira rona liafuan nee, povu balu dehan, “Loos duni, Nia mak Profeta.”
verses.41: Ema seluk dehan, “Nia mak Kristu.” Maibee ema balu tan dehan, “Kristu sei mai hosi Galileia ka?
verses.42: Laos eskritura dehan katak Kristu sei mai hosi David nia bei-oan, no hosi Belém, aldeia nebee uluk David hela ka?”
verses.43: Nunee povu fahe malu tanba Nia.
verses.44: Sira balu hakarak kaer Nia; maibee la iha ema ida mak brani atu tau liman ba Nia.
verses.45: Depois guarda sira fila fali ba xefi saserdote sira no ema Farizeu sira. Sira husu guarda sira nee, “Tanba saa mak imi la lori Nia mai?”
verses.46: Guarda sira hataan, “La iha ema ida nebee koalia hanesan Mane nee!”
verses.47: Ema Farizeu sira hataan, “Nia mos lohi imi ka?
verses.48: Iha nai ulun ida ka ema Farizeu sira ida nebee fiar ona ba Nia ka?
verses.49: Maibee povu nee, nebee la hatene Lei, sira hetan malisan.”
verses.50: Sira ida naran Nicodemos, nebee uluk hasoru Jesus iha kalan, dehan ba sira,
verses.51: “Ita nia Lei tesi lia ba ema ida molok ita rona nia ka, no hatene saida mak nia halo?”
verses.52: Sira hataan ba nia, “Ita mos hosi Galileia ka? Buka no haree took. Tanba la iha profeta ida nebee sae mai hosi Galileia.”
verses.53: [No sira ida-idak fila ba ninia uma.

verses.1: Maibee Jesus baa Foho Oliveira.
verses.2: Iha dadeer-saan, Nia tama fali ba Templu. Povu hotu hakbesik mai Nia, no Nia tuur hodi hanorin sira.
verses.3: Ema eskriba no Farizeu sira lori feto ida ba Jesus nebee sira kaer toman bainhira feto nee halo hela sala adultériu. Sira tau feto nee iha ema nia leet.
verses.4: No sira dehan ba Jesus, “Mestri, ema toman feto nee bainhira nia halo hela sala adultériu.
verses.5: Tuir Lei, Moisés manda ita atu tuda mate feto hanesan nee ho fatuk. Maibee O dehan oinsaa?”
verses.6: Sira koalia hanesan nee hodi koko Nia, atu sira bele akuza Nia. Maibee Jesus hakruuk no hakerek iha rai ho Ninia liman fuan.
verses.7: Bainhira sira husu beibeik ba Nia, Nia hamriik no dehan ba sira, “Imi ida nebee sala la iha, husik nia tuda uluk fatuk ba feto nee.”
verses.8: No Nia hakruuk fali no hakerek iha rai.
verses.9: Bainhira sira rona liafuan nee, sira ida-idak sai deit, hahuu hosi katuas sira. Ikus mai, Jesus mesak deit ho feto nebee hamriik iha Ninia oin.
verses.10: Bainhira Jesus hamriik, no haree ema sira nee ida la iha, só feto deit, Nia dehan ba feto, “Feto, sira baa nebee? La iha ema ida mak kondena o ka?
verses.11: Feto dehan, “La iha, Nai.” No Jesus dehan ba nia, “Hau mos la kondena o. Baa deit, no keta halo sala tan.”]
verses.12: Jesus koalia tan ba sira, no dehan, “Hau mak naroman mundu nian. Ema nebee tuir Hau sei la lao iha nakukun laran, maibee nia sei iha naroman moris nian.”
verses.13: Entaun ema Farizeu sira dehan ba Nia, “O foo sasin kona ba O nia aan rasik. Nunee O nia sasin la loos.”
verses.14: Jesus hataan, “Maski Hau foo sasin kona ba Hau nia aan rasik, Hau nia sasin nee loos. Tanba Hau hatene Hau mai hosi nebee no Hau atu baa iha nebee. Maibee imi la hatene Hau mai hosi nebee no Hau atu baa iha nebee.
verses.15: Imi tesi lia tuir sistema isin nian. Hau la tesi lia ba ema ida.
verses.16: Maibee se Hau tesi lia karik, Hau nia julgamentu mak loos. Tanba Hau la mesak, maibee Hau hamutuk ho Aman nebee haruka Hau mai.
verses.17: Iha imi nia Lei sira hakerek katak testemunha hosi ema nain rua mak loos.
verses.18: Hau mak ida nebee foo sasin kona ba Hau nia aan rasik, no Aman nebee haruka Hau mai foo sasin kona ba Hau.”
verses.19: Entaun sira dehan ba Nia, “O nia Aman iha nebee?” Jesus hataan, “Imi la hatene Hau ka Hau nia Aman. Se imi hatene Hau, imi sei hatene mos Hau nia Aman.”
verses.20: Jesus koalia liafuan nee iha tezourária, bainhira Nia hanorin iha Templu. Maibee la iha ema ida mak kaer Nia, tanba Ninia oras seidauk too.
verses.21: Jesus dehan fali ba sira, “Hau sei sai baa, no imi sei buka Hau, maibee imi sei mate iha imi nia sala. Fatin nebee Hau baa, imi la bele baa.”
verses.22: Nunee ema Judeu sira dehan, “Nia sei oho aan ka? Tanba Nia dehan, ‘Fatin nebee Hau baa, imi la bele baa.’”
verses.23: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi hosi kraik; Hau hosi leten. Imi hosi mundu nee; Hau laos hosi mundu nee.
verses.24: Nunee Hau dehan ba imi, katak imi sei mate iha imi nia sala. Tanba se imi la fiar katak Hau mak Nia, imi sei mate iha imi nia sala.”
verses.25: Entaun sira husu ba Nia, “See mak O?” Jesus dehan ba sira, “Hau mak Nia nebee Hau dehan nafatin ba imi hori uluk kedas.
verses.26: Hau iha buat barak atu dehan kona ba imi, no buat barak atu tesi lia. Maibee Nia nebee haruka Hau mai mak loos. No Hau foo sai ba mundu liafuan nebee Hau rona hosi Nia.”
verses.27: Sira la kompriende katak Nia koalia ba sira kona ba Aman.
verses.28: Entaun Jesus dehan ba sira, “Bainhira imi hiit sae Ema Nia Oan, mak foin imi hatene katak Hau mak Nia. No imi sei hatene katak Hau la halo buat ida hosi Hau nia aan rasik, maibee Hau foo sai buat sira nebee Hau nia Aman hanorin mai Hau.
verses.29: Nia nebee haruka Hau mai mak hamutuk ho Hau. Nia la husik Hau mesak, tanba Hau sempre halo buat sira nebee halo Nia kontenti.”
verses.30: Bainhira Jesus koalia liafuan nee, ema barak fiar ba Nia.
verses.31: Jesus dehan ba ema Judeu sira nebee fiar ba Nia, “Se imi hela iha Hau nia liafuan, imi mak Hau nia eskolante duni.
verses.32: No imi sei hatene lia loos, no lia loos sei halo imi livre.”
verses.33: Sira hataan ba Nia, “Ami mak Abraão nia bei-oan, no ami nunka sai atan ba ema ida. Nusaa mak O dehan, ‘Imi sei sai livre’?”
verses.34: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, see deit nebee halo sala mak atan ba sala.
verses.35: Atan sei la hela nafatin iha uma too tinan ba tinan, maibee Oan Mane mak hela nafatin too tinan ba tinan.
verses.36: Nunee se Oan Mane mak halo imi livre, imi sei sai livre duni.
verses.37: Hau hatene katak imi mak Abraão nia bei-oan. Maibee imi buka atu oho Hau, tanba Hau nia liafuan la hetan fatin iha imi nia laran.
verses.38: Hau koalia buat nebee Hau haree ona hosi Hau nia Aman, no imi halo buat nebee imi haree ona hosi imi nia aman.”
verses.39: Sira hataan ba Nia, “Abraão mak ami nia aman.” Jesus dehan ba sira, “Se imi mak Abraão nia oan duni, imi sei halo tuir Abraão nia hahalok.
verses.40: Maibee agora imi buka atu oho Hau, nebee foo sai ba imi lia loos nebee Hau rona hosi Maromak. Abraão la halo ida nee.
verses.41: Imi halo tuir hahalok hosi imi nia aman.” Sira dehan ba Nia, “Ami la moris mai hosi sala seksuál. Ami iha Aman ida deit, nebee Maromak.”
verses.42: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Se Maromak imi nia Aman, imi sei hadomi Hau. Tanba Hau mai hosi Maromak no Hau iha nee. Hau la mai tanba Hau nia hakarak rasik, maibee Nia mak haruka Hau mai.
verses.43: Tanba saa mak imi la kompriende buat nebee Hau dehan? Tanba imi la bele rona Hau nia liafuan.
verses.44: Imi hosi imi nia aman diabu. No imi hakarak halo tuir imi nia aman nia hakarak. Hori uluk kedas nia mak oho door. Nia la bele hamriik iha lia loos, tanba la iha lia loos iha nia. Bainhira nia koalia bosok, nia koalia tuir ninia aan rasik. Tanba nia mak bosok-teen, no lia bosok nia aman.
verses.45: Maibee tanba Hau koalia lia loos ba imi, nunee imi la fiar Hau.
verses.46: Imi ida nebee mak bele hatudu katak Hau halo sala? Se Hau koalia lia loos, tanba saa mak imi la fiar Hau?
verses.47: Ema nebee hosi Maromak rona Maromak nia liafuan. Imi la rona tanba imi la mai hosi Maromak.”
verses.48: Ema Judeu sira hataan ba Nia, “Laos ami koalia loos bainhira ami dehan katak O mak ema Samaria, no O iha diabu ida?”
verses.49: Jesus hataan, “Hau la iha diabu ida. Maibee Hau foo onra ba Hau nia Aman, no imi despreza Hau.
verses.50: Hau la buka glória ba Hau nia aan rasik. Iha Ida nebee buka glória nee no Nia mak Juis.
verses.51: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, se ema ida halo tuir Hau nia liafuan, nia sei nunka mate.”
verses.52: Ema Judeu sira dehan ba Nia, “Agora ami hatene katak O iha diabu ida! Abraão mate ona, no profeta sira mos mate ona. Maibee O dehan, ‘Se ema ida halo tuir Hau nia liafuan, nia sei nunka mate.’
verses.53: O boot liu fali ami nia aman Abraão nebee mate ona ka? No profeta sira mos mate ona! O halo aan nee see fali?”
verses.54: Jesus hataan, “Se Hau foo onra ba Hau nia aan, Hau nia onra nee la iha folin. Hau nia Aman mak foo onra mai Hau, Nia nebee imi dehan, ‘Nia mak ami nia Maromak.’
verses.55: Maibee imi la konhese Nia. Hau konhese Nia. No se Hau dehan, ‘Hau la konhese Nia,’ Hau sei sai bosok-teen hanesan mos imi. Maibee Hau konhese duni Nia, no halo tuir Ninia liafuan.
verses.56: Imi nia aman Abraão haksolok bainhira nia haree Hau nia loron mai. Nia haree loron nee, no nia kontenti.”
verses.57: Nunee ema Judeu sira dehan ba Nia, “O nia tinan seidauk too lima-nulu, no O haree tiha ona Abraão ka?”
verses.58: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, molok Abraão moris, Hau iha ona.”
verses.59: Nunee sira foti fatuk atu tuda Nia. Maibee Jesus subar aan, no sai hosi Templu.

verses.1: Bainhira Jesus liu dadaun, Nia haree mane ida nebee moris mai matan delek nanis.
verses.2: No Ninia eskolante sira husu Nia, “Rabi, see mak sala hodi halo nia moris mai matan delek? Mane nee ka ninia inan-aman?”
verses.3: Jesus hataan, “Laos katak mane nee mak sala ka ninia inan-aman mak sala, maibee hodi Maromak bele hatudu Ninia hahalok liu hosi mane nee.
verses.4: Bainhira sei loron hela, ita tenki halo servisu hosi Nia nebee haruka Hau mai. Tanba kalan sei mai, bainhira ema ida la bele servisu.
verses.5: Bainhira Hau sei iha mundu hela, Hau mak naroman ba mundu.”
verses.6: Koalia tiha nunee, Nia tafui kabeen ba rai no halo tahu ho Ninia kabeen. Depois Nia kose tahu nee ba ema matan delek nia matan.
verses.7: Nia dehan ba mane nee, “Baa fasi iha kolan Siloé.” (nee katak ‘Haruka’) Entaun mane nee baa no fasi aan. Nia mai fali no bele haree ona.
verses.8: Mane nee nia vizinhu sira no sira nebee uluk haree nia baibain husu ezmola, dehan, “Laos nia mak mane nebee uluk tuur husu ezmola?”
verses.9: Balu dehan, “Nia mak mane nee duni.” Ema seluk dehan, “Lae, só nia iha oin hanesan mane nee.” Maibee nia rasik dehan, “Hau mak nia.”
verses.10: Nunee sira dehan ba nia, “Oinsaa mak o nia matan nakloke?”
verses.11: Nia hataan dehan, “Mane ida naran Jesus halo tahu, no kose ba hau nia matan. Nia dehan mai hau, ‘Baa fasi iha kolan Siloé.’ Hau baa fasi tiha, no hau bele haree.”
verses.12: Sira dehan ba nia, “Ema nee iha nebee?” Nia dehan, “Hau la hatene.”
verses.13: Sira lori mane nebee uluk matan delek ba ema Farizeu sira.
verses.14: No loron nebee Jesus halo tahu no loke mane nee nia matan mak loron Sabdu.
verses.15: Entaun ema Farizeu sira husu fali nia oinsaa nia bele haree. Nia dehan ba sira, “Ema tau tahu ba hau nia matan. Hau fasi aan, no agora hau haree.”
verses.16: Ema Farizeu balu dehan, “Ema nee laos hosi Maromak. Tanba Nia la halo tuir loron Sabdu.” Ema seluk dehan, “Oinsaa mak sala nain ida bele halo milagre sira hanesan nee?” Nunee sira haksesuk malu.
verses.17: Entaun sira dehan fali ba ema matan delek nee, “O dehan saida kona ba Ema nebee loke o nia matan?” Mane nee dehan, “Nia mak profeta ida.”
verses.18: Maibee ema Judeu sira la fiar katak mane nee uluk matan delek no agora bele haree. Entaun sira bolu inan-aman hosi mane nebee bele haree fali nee.
verses.19: Ema Farizeu husu sira, “Ida nee mak imi nia oan nebee imi dehan katak nia moris mai matan delek ka? Entaun oinsaa mak agora nia bele haree?
verses.20: Mane nee nia inan-aman hataan, “Ami hatene katak mane nee mak ami nia oan, no katak nia moris mai matan delek.
verses.21: Maibee kona ba oinsaa mak agora nia bele haree, ami la hatene. No ami la hatene see mak loke ninia matan. Nia boot ona, husu took nia. Nia bele hataan mesak.”
verses.22: Ninia inan-aman koalia hanesan nee tanba sira tauk ema Judeu sira. Tanba ema Judeu sira konkorda ona katak se ema ruma konfesa katak Jesus mak Kristu, sira sei hasai ema nee hosi sinagoga.
verses.23: Nunee ninia inan-aman dehan, “Nia boot ona, husu took nia.”
verses.24: Sira bolu fali mane nebee uluk matan delek, no sira dehan ba nia, “Foo glória ba Maromak. Ami hatene katak Ema nee mak sala nain.”
verses.25: Nia hataan, “Se Nia mak sala nain ka lae, hau la hatene. Só hau hatene deit buat ida nee: uluk hau matan delek, no agora hau haree.”
verses.26: Sira dehan fali ba mane nee, “Nia halo saida ba o? Oinsaa mak Nia loke o nia matan?”
verses.27: Mane nee hataan ba sira, “Hau foo hatene ona ba imi, no imi la rona. Tanba saa mak imi hakarak rona fali? Imi mos hakarak sai Ninia eskolante sira ka?”
verses.28: No sira hatete aat mane nee no dehan, “O mak Ninia eskolante, maibee ami mak Moisés nia eskolante sira.
verses.29: Ami hatene katak Maromak koalia ba Moisés. Maibee kona ba ema nee, ami la hatene Nia mai hosi nebee.”
verses.30: Mane nee hataan no dehan ba sira, “Nee ka, hau admira! Imi la hatene Nia mai hosi nebee, maibee Nia loke hau nia matan.
verses.31: Ita hatene katak Maromak la rona tuir sala nain sira. Maibee Maromak rona ba ema nebee adora Maromak no halo tuir Ninia hakarak.
verses.32: Hori uluk kedas too agora ema seidauk rona kona ba ema ida nebee loke matan hosi ema nebee moris mai matan delek.
verses.33: Se Mane nee laos hosi Maromak karik, Nia la bele halo buat ida.”
verses.34: Sira hataan ba nia, “O moris mai iha sala laran, no o hakarak hanorin fali ami ka?” No sira duni sai tiha nia ba liur.
verses.35: Jesus rona katak sira duni sai mane nee. Bainhira Nia hetan mane nee, Nia dehan, “O fiar ba Maromak nia Oan ka?”
verses.36: Mane nee hataan dehan, “Nai, Nia mak see? Atu nunee hau bele fiar ba Nia.”
verses.37: No Jesus dehan ba mane nee, “O haree tiha ona Nia, no Nia mak koalia dadaun ho o.”
verses.38: Mane nee dehan, “Nai, hau fiar.” No mane nee adora Nia.
verses.39: Jesus dehan, “Tanba tesi lia mak Hau tama mai iha mundu nee, atu sira nebee la haree bele haree, no sira nebee bele haree sei sai matan delek.”
verses.40: Ema Farizeu balu nebee besik Nia rona liafuan nee, no dehan ba Nia, “Ami mos matan delek ka?”
verses.41: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Se imi matan delek, imi la iha sala. Maibee agora imi dehan, ‘Ami bele haree,’ nunee imi nia sala hela nafatin.”

verses.1: “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, nia nebee tama bibi luhan laos liu hosi odamatan, maibee sae liu hosi fatin seluk, nia mak naok-teen no hadau door.
verses.2: Maibee nia nebee tama liu hosi odamatan mak bibi atan ba bibi sira nee.
verses.3: Ema nebee hein odamatan sei loke odamatan ba nia. Bibi sira rona ninia lian. Nia bolu ninia bibi ho sira nia naran, no nia lori sira sai ba liur.
verses.4: Bainhira nia lori sai tiha ninia bibi hotu, nia lao iha sira nia oin. Bibi sira lao tuir nia tanba sira hatene ninia lian.
verses.5: Sira sei la lao tuir ema oin foun, maibee sira sei halai hosi nia tanba sira la konhese ema nee nia lian.”
verses.6: Jesus konta ai knanoik ida nee ba sira, maibee sira la kompriende buat nebee Nia dehan ba sira.
verses.7: Entaun Jesus koalia tan ba sira, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, Hau mak odamatan ba bibi sira.
verses.8: Ema hotu nebee mai uluk Hau mak naok-teen no hadau door. Maibee bibi sira la rona sira.
verses.9: Hau mak odamatan. See deit nebee tama liu hosi Hau sei hetan salvasaun. Nia sei tama-sai no hetan duut hodi haan.
verses.10: Naok-teen mai deit atu naok, oho no estraga. Hau mai hodi sira bele hetan moris, no hetan moris too nakonu resin.
verses.11: Hau mak Bibi Atan diak. Bibi Atan diak foo ninia moris tanba bibi.
verses.12: Ema nebee simu osan hodi hein deit bibi no laos bibi atan, no bibi sira nee laos ninian, bainhira nia haree asu fuik mai, nia husik hela bibi no halai. Asu fuik hadau sira no halo sira halai namkari.
verses.13: Ema nee halai tanba nia servisu nain deit no nia la hanoin bibi nee.
verses.14: Hau mak Bibi Atan diak. Hau konhese Hau nia bibi, no Hau nia bibi konhese Hau,
verses.15: hanesan mos Aman konhese Hau, no Hau konhese Aman. No Hau foo Hau nia moris tanba bibi.
verses.16: Hau iha bibi seluk nebee laos hosi luhan ida nee. Hau tenki lori mos sira mai. Sira sei rona Hau nia lian, no sira sei sai bibi lubun ida deit ho bibi atan ida deit.
verses.17: Aman hadomi Hau, tanba Hau foo Hau nia moris atu nunee Hau bele foti fali moris nee.
verses.18: Ema la hasai Hau nia moris hosi Hau, maibee Hau rasik mak foo Hau nia moris. Hau iha kbiit atu foo, no Hau iha kbiit atu foti fali moris nee. Orden nee Hau simu ona hosi Hau nia Aman.”
verses.19: Dala ida tan, ema Judeu sira haksesuk malu tanba liafuan nee.
verses.20: Sira barak dehan, “Nia iha diabu ida no Nia bulak. Tanba saa mak ita rona hela Nia?”
verses.21: Ema seluk dehan, “Liafuan sira nee laos hosi ema nebee iha diabu ida. Diabu ida bele loke ema matan delek nia matan ka?”
verses.22: Iha tempu malirin, sira halo Festa Dedikasaun iha Jerusalém.
verses.23: Jesus lao iha Templu, iha Salomão nia Portiku.
verses.24: Ema Judeu sira mai haleu Nia, no dehan ba Nia, “Too bainhira mak O halo ami hanoin ru-rua? Se O mak Kristu, hatete lo-loos mai ami deit.”
verses.25: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Hau foo hatene ona ba imi, no imi la fiar. Buat sira nebee Hau halo hodi Hau nia Aman nia naran foo sasin kona ba Hau.
verses.26: Maibee imi la fiar tanba imi laos hosi Hau nia bibi lubun.
verses.27: Hau nia bibi sira rona Hau nia lian. Hau konhese sira, no sira lao tuir Hau.
verses.28: Hau foo moris rohan laek ba sira, no sira sei nunka lakon. La iha ema ida bele hadau sira hosi Hau nia liman.
verses.29: Hau nia Aman, nebee foo sira mai Hau, mak boot liu hotu. No la iha ema ida bele hadau sira hosi Hau nia Aman nia liman.
verses.30: Hau no Hau nia Aman ida deit.”
verses.31: Nunee ema Judeu sira foti fatuk atu tuda mate Nia.
verses.32: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Hau hatudu ona ba imi hahalok diak barak hosi Hau nia Aman. Tanba hahalok ida nebee mak imi atu tuda fatuk mai Hau?”
verses.33: Ema Judeu sira hataan ba Nia, dehan, “Ami la tuda fatuk ba O tanba hahalok diak, maibee tanba O koalia aat Maromak. Tanba maski O ema deit, O halo aan hanesan Maromak.”
verses.34: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Laos ema hakerek nanis ona iha imi nia Lei, ‘Hau dehan, imi mak maromak sira’?
verses.35: Se nia hanaran sira ‘maromak sira,’ nebee simu Maromak nia liafuan - no ita la bele estraga eskritura -
verses.36: oinsaa mak imi hatete kona ba Nia nebee Aman haketak nudar santu, no haruka ba mundu, ‘O koalia aat Maromak,’ tanba Hau dehan, ‘Hau mak Maromak nia Oan’?
verses.37: Se Hau la halo tuir Hau nia Aman nia hahalok, entaun imi lalika fiar Hau.
verses.38: Maibee se Hau halo buat sira nee, maski imi la fiar Hau, fiar hahalok nee. Nunee imi bele hatene no fiar katak Aman hela iha Hau, no Hau hela iha Aman.”
verses.39: Nunee sira buka fali atu kaer Nia. Maibee Nia konsege sai hosi sira nia liman.
verses.40: Jesus lao fali ba Jordaun nia sorin ba. Nia baa too fatin nebee uluk João foo batizmu, no Nia hela iha nebaa.
verses.41: Ema barak mai hasoru Nia. Sira dehan, “João la halo milagre ida, maibee buat hotu nebee João dehan kona ba ema nee mak loos.”
verses.42: No ema barak fiar ba Nia iha nebaa.

verses.1: Mane ida naran Lázaro moras. Nia hosi Betánia, Maria no ninia biin Marta nia aldeia.
verses.2: (Ida nee mak Maria nebee fui mina morin ba Nai, no kose Nai nia ain ho ninia fuuk. Ninia maun Lázaro mak moras.)
verses.3: Nunee Lázaro nia feton sira haruka lia menon ba Jesus, atu dehan, “Tebes Nai, nia nebee O hadomi nee moras hela.”
verses.4: Bainhira Jesus rona nunee, Nia dehan, “Moras nee la lori nia ba mate, maibee atu hatudu Maromak nia glória, hodi Maromak nia Oan bele hetan glória liu hosi nia.”
verses.5: Jesus hadomi Marta, ninia alin feto no Lázaro.
verses.6: Bainhira Jesus rona ona katak Lázaro moras, Nia hein loron rua tan iha fatin nebee Nia hela.
verses.7: Tuir mai, Nia dehan ba Ninia eskolante sira, “Mai ita tama fali ba Judeia.”
verses.8: Ninia eskolante sira dehan ba Nia, “Rabi, foin dadauk ema Judeu sira buka atu tuda mate O, no O hakarak fila fali ba nebaa ka?”
verses.9: Jesus hataan, “Laos loron ida iha oras sanulu resin rua ka? Se ema lao iha loron, nia la sidi, tanba nia haree naroman hosi mundu nee.
verses.10: Maibee se ema lao iha kalan, nia sidi, tanba nia la iha naroman iha nia.”
verses.11: Koalia tiha nunee, Nia dehan tan, “Ita nia belun Lázaro toba tiha ona. Maibee Hau baa atu fanu nia.”
verses.12: Ninia eskolante sira dehan, “Nai, se nia toba, nia sei sai diak fali.”
verses.13: Jesus koalia kona ba Lázaro nia mate, maibee sira hanoin katak Jesus dehan nia toba dukur.
verses.14: Depois Jesus koalia klaru, “Lázaro mate ona.
verses.15: No tanba imi, Hau kontenti katak Hau la iha nebaa, atu nunee imi bele fiar. Mai ita baa haree nia.”
verses.16: Nunee Tomé, nebee naran Kaduak, dehan ba ninia maluk eskolante sira, “Mai ita mos baa, atu ita bele mate hamutuk ho Nia.”
verses.17: Bainhira Jesus too mai, Nia rona katak sira hakoi Lázaro iha rate laran too loron haat ona.
verses.18: Betánia nee besik ba Jerusalém, maizoumenus kilómetru tolu.
verses.19: No ema Judeu barak mai haree Marta no Maria, atu foo kamaan ba sira tanba sira nia maun nee.
verses.20: Bainhira Marta rona tiha katak Jesus mai dadaun, nia baa kedas atu hasoru Jesus. Maibee Maria tuur hela iha uma.
verses.21: Marta dehan ba Jesus, “Nai, se O iha nee karik, hau nia maun la mate.
verses.22: Maibee agora mos hau hatene katak saida deit nebee O husu hosi Maromak, Maromak sei foo ba O.”
verses.23: Jesus dehan ba nia, “O nia maun sei moris hias.
verses.24: Marta dehan ba Jesus, “Hau hatene katak nia sei moris hias iha tempu nebee ema moris hias iha loron ikus.”
verses.25: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Hau mak moris hias no Hau mak moris. Ema nebee fiar mai Hau, maski nia mate, nia sei moris.
verses.26: No ema hotu nebee moris no fiar mai Hau sei nunka mate. O fiar ida nee ka?
verses.27: Marta hataan ba Jesus, “Sin, Nai. Hau fiar katak O mak Kristu, Maromak nia Oan, nebee atu mai iha mundu.”
verses.28: Bainhira Marta koalia tiha ida nee, nia baa no bolu sub-subar ninia alin Maria. Nia dehan, “Mestri mai ona, no Nia bolu o.”
verses.29: Rona tiha nunee, Maria hamriik lalais, no baa hasoru Jesus.
verses.30: Tanba Jesus seidauk tama ba aldeia laran, maibee Nia sei iha fatin nebee Marta hasoru Nia.
verses.31: Bainhira ema Judeu sira nebee hamutuk ho Maria iha uma laran hodi konsola nia, haree katak Maria hamriik lalais no sai ba, sira tuir nia. Tanba sira dehan, “Nia baa rate atu tanis iha nebaa.”
verses.32: Bainhira Maria mai too fatin nebee Jesus iha no haree Nia, Maria monu iha Jesus nia ain. Nia dehan ba Jesus, “Nai, se O iha nee karik, hau nia maun sei la mate.”
verses.33: Bainhira Jesus haree Maria tanis, no ema Judeu sira nebee mai hamutuk ho Maria mos tanis, Nia espíritu tristi no laran susar.
verses.34: Nia dehan, “Imi hakoi nia iha nebee?” Sira dehan ba Nia, “Nai, mai no haree.”
verses.35: Jesus tanis.
verses.36: Nunee ema Judeu sira dehan, “Haree ba, oinsaa Jesus hadomi nia!”
verses.37: Maibee ema balu dehan, “Nia loke ema matan delek nia matan. Tanba saa mak Nia la bele halo buat ida hodi ema nee la mate?”
verses.38: Jesus sai tristi fali iha laran no Nia mai too iha rate. Rate nee mak fatuk kuak nebee ema taka tiha ho fatuk.
verses.39: Jesus dehan, “Hasai tiha fatuk.” Marta, ema mate nia alin, dehan ba Nia, “Nai, agora nia dois ona. Tanba nia mate loron haat ona.”
verses.40: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Laos Hau dehan ona ba o katak se o fiar, o sei haree Maromak nia glória?”
verses.41: Entaun sira hasai fatuk nee. No Jesus foti matan no dehan, “Aman, Hau foo agradese ba O, tanba O rona ona Hau.
verses.42: Hau hatene katak O sempre rona Hau. Maibee Hau koalia nunee tanba povu nebee hamriik iha nee, hodi sira bele fiar katak O haruka Hau mai.”
verses.43: No bainhira Nia koalia liafuan nee, Nia hakilar ho lian makaas, “Lázaro, sai mai!”
verses.44: No nia nebee mate sai mai. Ninia ain no liman bobar hela ho hena. No ninia oin mos taka hela ho hena ida. Jesus dehan ba sira, “Kore tiha nia, no husik nia ba.”
verses.45: Ema Judeu barak nebee mai ho Maria no haree buat nebee Jesus halo, fiar ba Nia.
verses.46: Maibee sira balu baa hasoru ema Farizeu sira no foo hatene ba sira kona ba buat nebee Jesus halo.
verses.47: Entaun xefi saserdote sira no ema Farizeu sira halo enkontru no dehan, “Ita atu halo saida? Tanba ema ida nee halo milagre barak.
verses.48: Se ita husik Nia hanesan nee, ema hotu sei fiar ba Nia. No ema Roma sira sei mai no hasai ita nia fatin no ita nia nasaun.”
verses.49: Maibee ema sira nee ida, naran Kaifas, nebee saserdote boot iha tinan nebaa, dehan ba sira, “Imi la hatene buat ida.
verses.50: Imi la kompriende katak diak liu ema ida mate tanba povu nee, duké nasaun tomak lakon.”
verses.51: Nia la dehan ida nee hosi ninia aan rasik. Maibee iha tinan nebaa, nia saserdote boot, no nia profesia katak Jesus sei mate tanba nasaun nee.
verses.52: No laos tanba nasaun nee deit, maibee atu halibur hamutuk Maromak nia oan sira nebee namkari ba rai liur hodi sai ida deit.
verses.53: Entaun hosi loron nee ba oin, sira halo planu atu oho Jesus.
verses.54: Nunee Jesus la lao tan iha ema Judeu sira nia leet hodi ema bele haree. Maibee Nia ba fatin nebee besik rai fuik. Nia baa sidade Efraim no hela iha nebaa ho Ninia eskolante sira.
verses.55: Ema Judeu sira besik atu halo Páskua. No ema barak mai hosi foho hodi sae ba Jerusalém molok Páskua hodi hamoos aan.
verses.56: Sira buka Jesus no koalia ba malu bainhira sira hamriik iha Templu, “Ita hanoin nusaa, Nia sei la mai tuir festa nee ka?”
verses.57: Xefi saserdote sira no ema Farizeu sira foo ona orden ida katak, se ema ruma hatene Jesus iha nebee, nia tenki foo hatene ba sira atu sira bele kaer Jesus.

verses.1: Loron neen molok Páskua, Jesus baa too iha Betánia, fatin nebee Lázaro hela. Lázaro mak ida nebee uluk mate no Jesus halo moris hias ona hosi mate.
verses.2: Sira konvida Jesus mai haan kalan. Marta serví no Lázaro tuur hamutuk ho sira iha meza ho Jesus.
verses.3: Maria foti mina morin nardu moos, besik litru sorin, nebee karun tebes. Nia fui mina nee ba iha Jesus nia ain, no hamaran Jesus nia ain ho ninia fuuk. No uma nee sai nakonu ho mina nia morin.
verses.4: Depois Jesus nia eskolante ida, naran Judas Iskariotes, nebee atu faan Nia, dehan,
verses.5: “Tanba saa mak la faan mina morin nee ho folin denáriu atus tolu, no foo ba ema kiak?”
verses.6: Judas dehan ida nee laos tanba nia hanoin ema kiak, maibee tanba nia mak naok-teen. Nia lori kofre no nia foti osan nee ba ninia aan rasik.
verses.7: Jesus dehan, “Husik nia ba. Nia hanoin atu rai ida nee ba loron nebee hakoi Hau.
verses.8: Tanba ema kiak sempre hamutuk ho imi, maibee Hau sei la hamutuk nafatin ho imi.
verses.9: Bainhira ema lubun boot hosi ema Judeu sira hatene katak Jesus iha nebaa, sira mai too fatin nee. Sira mai laos deit tanba Jesus, maibee atu haree mos Lázaro, nebee Jesus halo moris hias ona hosi mate.
verses.10: Maibee xefi saserdote sira koalia hamutuk atu oho mos Lázaro.
verses.11: Tanba Lázaro nee mak ema Judeu barak husik sira no fiar ba Jesus.
verses.12: Loron tuir mai, ema lubun boot nebee mai ona ba festa, rona katak Jesus atu tama ba Jerusalém.
verses.13: Sira foti ramus sanak hosi ai palma sira, no sai ba atu hasoru Nia. Sira hakilar, “Hosana! Bensaun ba Nia nebee mai hodi Nai nia naran, ba Liurai hosi Israel!”
verses.14: Jesus hetan kuda buru oan ida, no Nia sae kuda buru nee. Ida nee tuir liafuan nebee hakerek nanis ona,
verses.15: “Keta tauk, oan feto hosi Zion,
verses.16: Fo-foun, Jesus nia eskolante sira la kompriende buat sira nee. Maibee bainhira Jesus simu glória, sira hanoin hetan katak buat sira nee hakerek nanis ona kona ba Nia, no katak ema halo buat sira nee ba Nia.
verses.17: Ema lubun nebee uluk hamutuk ho Jesus bainhira nia bolu Lázaro hosi rate no halo nia moris hias hosi mate kontinua foo sasin nafatin.
verses.18: Tanba nee mak ema lubun sai ba hodi hasoru Nia tanba sira rona katak Nia halo milagre ida nee.
verses.19: Nunee ema Farizeu sira dehan ba malu, “Ita haree katak ita la manaan buat ida. Haree took, mundu tomak lao tuir Nia.”
verses.20: Ema Gregu balu iha povu nia leet sae mai hodi halo adorasaun iha festa.
verses.21: Sira hakbesik ba Filipe, nebee hosi Betsaida iha Galileia, no husu nia, “Senhor, ami hakarak haree Jesus.”
verses.22: Filipe baa no foo hatene ba André. Depois André no Filipe foo hatene ba Jesus.
verses.23: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Oras too ona, atu Ema Nia Oan simu glória.
verses.24: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, se trigu musan ida la monu ba rai no mate, nia hela mesak deit. Maibee se nia mate, nia bele foo fuan barak.
verses.25: Nia nebee hadomi ninia moris sei lakon ninia moris. No nia nebee odi ninia moris iha mundu nee sei kaer nafatin too moris rohan laek.
verses.26: Se ema ruma serví Hau, husik nia tuir Hau. Iha fatin nebee Hau iha, Hau nia atan mos iha nebaa. Se ema ruma serví Hau, Hau nia Aman sei foo onra ba nia.
verses.27: Agora Hau iha laran susar. Hau sei dehan saida? ‘Aman, salva Hau hosi oras nee’? Maibee tanba razaun nee mak Hau mai too oras nee.
verses.28: Aman, foo glória ba O nia naran.” Depois lian mai hosi lalehan no dehan, “Hau foo ona glória ba Hau nia naran, no Hau sei foo tan glória ba naran nee.”
verses.29: Ema lubun nebee hamriik iha nebaa no rona lian nee dehan katak nee mak rai tarutu ida. Ema seluk dehan, “Anju ida koalia ba Nia.”
verses.30: Jesus hataan, “Lian nee la mosu tanba Hau, maibee tanba imi.
verses.31: Tempu tesi lia mai ona ba mundu nee. Agora Maromak sei duni sai mundu nee nia ukun nain.
verses.32: No Hau, bainhira sira hiit sae Hau hosi rai, Hau sei dada ema hotu mai Hau.”
verses.33: Nia dehan ida nee hodi hatudu oinsaa mak Nia atu mate.
verses.34: Ema lubun nee hataan ba Nia, “Ami rona tiha hosi Lei katak Kristu sei hela ba nafatin. Entaun oinsaa mak O dehan, ‘Sira tenki hiit sae Ema Nia Oan? See loos mak Ema Nia Oan nee?”
verses.35: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Naroman sei iha imi nia leet too tempu uitoan tan. Lao ba bainhira imi sei iha naroman, hodi nakukun la hadau imi. Tanba ema nebee lao iha nakukun laran la hatene nia baa nebee.
verses.36: Fiar ba naroman bainhira imi sei iha naroman nee, atu nunee imi bele sai naroman nia oan sira.” Bainhira Jesus koalia tiha nunee, Nia sai no subar Aan hosi sira.
verses.37: Maski Jesus halo ona milagre barak iha sira nia oin, sira la fiar nafatin ba Nia.
verses.38: Ida nee kumpri liafuan hosi profeta Isaias, nebee dehan,
verses.39: Nunee sira la bele fiar, tanba Isaias dehan fali,
verses.40: “Nia halo sira nia matan sai delek,
verses.41: Isaias dehan buat sira nee tanba nia haree Jesus nia glória, no koalia kona ba Nia.
verses.42: Maski nunee, ema barak hosi ukun nain sira mos fiar ba Nia. Maibee sira la foo sai sira nia fiar tanba sira tauk ema Farizeu sira. Tanba sira lakohi ema soe sira hosi sinagoga.
verses.43: Tanba sira hadomi liu glória hosi ema duké glória hosi Maromak.
verses.44: Jesus hakilar no dehan, “Ema nebee fiar mai Hau, laos fiar mai Hau maibee fiar ba Nia nebee haruka Hau mai.
verses.45: No ema nebee haree Hau, haree Nia nebee haruka Hau mai.
verses.46: Hau mai iha mundu nudar naroman, atu ema nebee fiar mai Hau sei la hela iha nakukun laran.
verses.47: No se ema ruma rona Hau nia liafuan, no la halo tuir, Hau la tesi lia ba nia. Tanba Hau mai laos atu tesi lia ba mundu, maibee atu salva mundu.
verses.48: Ema nee rejeita Hau, no la simu Hau nia liafuan, iha Ida nebee sei tesi lia ba nia. Liafuan nebee Hau koalia ona sei tesi lia ba nia iha loron ikus.
verses.49: Tanba Hau la koalia hosi Hau nia aan rasik, maibee Aman nebee haruka Hau mai mak foo ukun fuan ida mai Hau - saida mak atu dehan no saida mak atu koalia.
verses.50: No Hau hatene katak Ninia ukun fuan mak moris rohan laek. Buat nebee Hau koalia nunee, Hau koalia tuir buat nebee Aman foo hatene ona mai Hau.

13.title: Jesus Fasi Eskolante Sira Nia Ain

verses.1: Molok Festa Páskua, bainhira Jesus hatene katak Ninia oras too ona atu sai hosi mundu nee hodi baa Aman. Nia hadomi Ninia maluk sira nebee iha mundu, no Nia sei hadomi sira too rohan.
verses.2: Sira haan kalan dadaun, no diabu hatama ona hanoin iha Judas Iskariotes, Simão nia oan, nia fuan laran atu faan Jesus.
verses.3: Jesus hatene katak Aman foo ona buat hotu ba Ninia liman, no katak Nia mai hosi Maromak, no Nia atu fila fali ba Maromak.
verses.4: Nia hamriik hosi fatin haan kalan, tau Ninia ropa iha sorin, foti toalha ida no kesi ba Ninia kanotak.
verses.5: Depois Nia fui bee ba basia ida, no komesa fasi Ninia eskolante sira nia ain, no hamaran sira ho toalha nebee Nia kesi ba Ninia kanotak nee.
verses.6: Nia mai too Simão Pedro, no Pedro dehan ba Nia, “Nai, O sei fasi hau nia ain ka?”
verses.7: Jesus hataan ba nia, “Agora o seidauk kompriende buat nebee Hau halo, maibee tuir mai o sei kompriende.”
verses.8: Pedro dehan ba Nia, “O sei nunka fasi hau nia ain.” Jesus hataan ba nia, “Se Hau la fasi o, o sei la hamutuk ho Hau.”
verses.9: Simão Pedro dehan ba Nia, “Nai, laos hau nia ain deit, maibee fasi mos hau nia liman no hau nia ulun!”
verses.10: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Ema nebee hariis ona, la presiza fasi fali, só deit ninia ain, tanba nia isin tomak moos ona. No imi moos ona, maibee laos imi hotu.”
verses.11: Tanba Nia hatene ona see mak atu faan Nia. Nunee Nia dehan, “Laos imi hotu mak moos.”
verses.12: Bainhira Nia fasi ona sira nia ain, Nia foti fali Ninia ropa no tuur fali. No Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi hatene buat nebee Hau foin halo ba imi ka lae?
verses.13: Imi bolu Hau Mestri no Nai, no imi koalia nee loos, tanba Hau nunee duni.
verses.14: Entaun se Hau, nebee imi nia Nai no Mestri, fasi ona imi nia ain, nunee imi mos tenki halo ida nee ba malu, atu fasi imi nia maluk nia ain.
verses.15: Tanba Hau foo ezemplu ona ba imi, katak imi tenki halo hanesan Hau halo ba imi.
verses.16: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, atan ida la boot liu fali ninia nai; no nia nebee haruka ema mak boot liu ema nebee nia haruka.
verses.17: Imi hatene buat sira nee karik, imi sei haksolok se imi halo tuir.
verses.18: Hau la koalia kona ba imi hotu. Hau hatene sira nebee Hau hili ona. Maibee atu kumpri eskritura, ‘Nia nebee haan paun hamutuk ho Hau mak hamriik hasoru Hau.’
verses.19: Agora Hau foo hatene ba imi molok ida nee akontese. Nunee, bainhira ida nee akontese, imi bele fiar katak Hau mak Nia.
verses.20: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, ema nebee simu ida nebee Hau haruka ba, simu mos Hau. No ema nebee simu Hau, simu mos Nia nebee haruka Hau mai.”
verses.21: Koalia tiha nunee, Jesus iha laran susar iha espíritu, no Nia foo sai, “Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, katak ema ida hosi imi sei faan Hau.”
verses.22: Eskolante sira hateke ba malu. Sira la hatene Nia koalia kona ba see loos.
verses.23: Eskolante ida nebee Jesus hadomi tuur besik Jesus.
verses.24: Entaun Simão Pedro foo sinál ba eskolante ida nee atu husu Jesus, Nia koalia kona ba see loos.
verses.25: Nunee, eskolante nee, nebee sadere ba Jesus nia hirus matan, dehan ba Nia, “Nai, see mak ema nee?”
verses.26: Jesus hataan, “Nia mak ida nebee Hau sei foo paun pedasuk nee, nebee Hau atu habokon.” No bainhira Jesus habokon tiha paun nee, Nia foo ba Judas Iskariotes, Simão nia oan.
verses.27: Bainhira Judas simu paun nee, Satanás tama kedas iha nia laran. Depois Jesus dehan ba nia, “Buat nebee o atu halo, halo lalais ba.”
verses.28: La iha ema ida iha meza hatene tanba saa mak Jesus koalia hanesan nee ba Judas.
verses.29: Judas kaer kofre, entaun sira balu hanoin katak Jesus dehan ba nia, “Sosa buat nebee ita presiza ba festa nee,” ka nia sei baa foo buat ruma ba ema kiak.
verses.30: Bainhira Judas simu ona paun nee, nia sai kedas. No rai kalan ona.
verses.31: Bainhira Judas sai tiha ona, Jesus dehan, “Agora Ema Nia Oan simu glória, no Maromak simu glória iha Nia.
verses.32: Se Maromak simu glória iha Nia, Maromak sei foo glória ba Nia iha Maromak nia Aan rasik, no foo kedas glória nee ba Nia.
verses.33: Kiik-oan sira, Hau sei hamutuk ho imi too tempu uitoan tan. Imi sei buka Hau, no hanesan Hau dehan ba ema Judeu sira, agora Hau dehan mos ba imi, ‘Iha fatin nebee mak Hau atu baa, imi la bele baa.’
verses.34: Hau foo ukun fuan foun ida ba imi hodi imi sei hadomi malu: hadomi malu hanesan Hau hadomi imi.
verses.35: Nunee ema hotu sei hatene katak imi mak Hau nia eskolante sira, se imi hatudu domin ba malu.”
verses.36: Simão Pedro dehan ba Nia, “Nai, O atu baa nebee?” Jesus hataan ba Pedro, “Iha fatin nebee mak Hau atu baa, o la bele baa agora. Maibee depois mak o sei tuir.”
verses.37: Pedro dehan ba Nia, “Nai, tanba saa mak agora hau la bele tuir O? Hau prontu atu foo hau nia moris tanba O.”
verses.38: Jesus hataan, “O sei foo duni o nia moris tanba Hau ka? Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba o, molok manu aman kokoreek, o sei nega Hau dala tolu.”

14.title: Hau Mak Dalan, Lia Loos No Moris

verses.1: Keta laran susar: fiar ba Maromak, fiar mos ba Hau.
verses.2: Hau nia Aman nia uma iha fatin barak atu hela. Se la nunee karik, Hau sei foo hatene ba imi. Hau baa atu prepara fatin ba imi.
verses.3: No se Hau baa no prepara fatin ba imi, Hau sei mai fali, no lori imi ba Hau nia fatin. Nunee iha fatin nebee Hau hela, imi mos bele hela iha nebaa.
verses.4: Imi hatene dalan ba fatin nebee Hau atu baa.
verses.5: Tomé dehan ba Nia, “Nai, ami la hatene O atu baa nebee. Entaun oinsaa mak ami bele hatene dalan nee?”
verses.6: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Hau mak dalan, lia loos no moris. Ema ida la bele hakbesik ba Aman, só deit liu hosi Hau.
verses.7: Se imi konhese ona Hau, imi sei konhese mos Hau nia Aman. No hosi ohin ba oin, imi konhese Nia no haree ona Nia.”
verses.8: Filipe dehan ba Jesus, “Nai, hatudu Aman mai ami, no ida nee too ona ba ami.”
verses.9: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Hau hamutuk ho o too tempu kleur ona, Filipe, no o seidauk konhese Hau ka? Nia nebee haree ona Hau mak haree ona Aman. Entaun nusaa mak o dehan, ‘Hatudu Aman mai ami’?
verses.10: Imi la fiar katak Hau hela iha Aman, no Aman hela iha Hau ka? Liafuan nebee Hau koalia ba imi, Hau la koalia hosi Hau nia Aan rasik. Maibee Aman nebee hela iha Hau mak halao Ninia servisu.
verses.11: Fiar Hau katak Hau hela iha Aman, no Aman hela iha Hau. Se lae, fiar Hau tanba servisu nebee Hau halo ona nee.
verses.12: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi katak ema nebee fiar ba Hau, sei halo mos servisu nebee Hau halo. No nia sei halo servisu boot liu fali sira nee, tanba Hau atu baa Aman.
verses.13: No buat hotu nebee imi husu hodi Hau nia naran, Hau sei halo, atu nunee Aman bele hetan glória iha Oan Mane.
verses.14: Se imi husu Hau buat naran deit hodi Hau nia naran, Hau sei halo.
verses.15: “Se imi hadomi Hau, imi sei halo tuir Hau nia ukun fuan sira.
verses.16: No Hau sei husu ba Aman, no Nia sei foo imi Ajudadór ida seluk hodi hela ho imi too rohan laek.
verses.17: Nia mak Espíritu lia loos nian. Mundu la bele simu Nia, tanba mundu la haree Nia no la konhese Nia. Maibee imi konhese Nia, tanba Nia hela ho imi no Nia sei hela iha imi nia laran.
verses.18: Hau sei la husik imi sai oan kiak. Hau sei mai fali ba imi.
verses.19: La kleur tan, mundu sei la haree tan Hau. Maibee imi sei haree Hau. Tanba Hau moris, imi mos sei moris.
verses.20: Iha loron nebaa, imi sei hatene katak Hau hela iha Hau nia Aman, no imi iha Hau, no Hau iha imi.
verses.21: Ema nebee simu Hau nia ukun fuan sira, no halo tuir ukun fuan sira nee, nia mak ema nebee hadomi Hau. No nia nebee hadomi Hau, Hau nia Aman sei hadomi nia, no Hau sei hadomi nia, no Hau sei hatudu Aan ba nia.
verses.22: Judas (laos Iskariotes) dehan ba Jesus, “Nai, nusaa mak O hatudu Aan ba ami no laos ba mundu?”
verses.23: Jesus hataan ba nia, “Se ema ida hadomi Hau, nia sei halo tuir Hau nia liafuan. No Hau nia Aman sei hadomi nia, no Ami sei mai ba nia, no halo Ami nia hela fatin ho nia.
verses.24: Ema nebee la hadomi Hau, la halo tuir Hau nia liafuan. Liafuan nebee imi rona nee laos Hau nian, maibee liafuan nee mak Aman nian nebee haruka Hau mai.
verses.25: Hau koalia buat sira nee ba imi bainhira Hau sei hamutuk ho imi.
verses.26: Maibee Ajudadór, katak Espíritu Santu, nebee Aman sei haruka mai hodi Hau nia naran, Nia sei hanorin buat hotu ba imi, no halo imi hanoin hetan buat hotu nebee Hau dehan ona ba imi.
verses.27: Hau husik dame ba imi. Hau foo Hau nia dame ba imi. Hau foo ba imi laos hanesan mundu foo. Keta laran susar, no keta laran tauk.
verses.28: Imi rona ona katak Hau dehan ba imi, ‘Hau sei baa, no Hau sei fila fali ba imi.’ Se imi hadomi Hau, imi sei haksolok tanba Hau atu baa Aman, tanba Aman mak boot liu Hau.
verses.29: Agora, Hau foo hatene ona ba imi molok buat sira nee akontese, atu nunee, bainhira akontese ona, imi bele fiar Hau.
verses.30: Hau sei la koalia barak tan ho imi, tanba ukun nain mundu nee nian mai dadaun. Nia la iha kbiit atu ukun Hau,
verses.31: maibee Hau halo tuir buat nebee Aman manda ona Hau, hodi mundu bele hatene katak Hau hadomi Aman. Hamriik ba, mai ita sai hosi fatin nee.

verses.1: “Hau mak uvas huun lo-loos, no Hau nia Aman mak toos nain.
verses.2: Sanak hotu iha Hau nebee la foo fuan, Nia hasai tiha. No sanak hotu nebee foo fuan, Nia hamoos hodi bele foo fuan liu tan.
verses.3: Imi moos ona tanba liafuan nebee Hau koalia ona ba imi.
verses.4: Hela iha Hau, no Hau iha imi. Hanesan uvas sanak la bele foo fuan mesak, maibee tenki hela iha uvas huun, nunee mos imi la bele foo fuan, só imi hela iha Hau.
verses.5: Hau mak uvas huun, imi mak sanak sira. Ema nebee hela iha Hau, no Hau iha nia, ema nee sei foo fuan barak. Tanba ketak hosi Hau, imi la bele halo buat ida.
verses.6: Se ema ida la hela iha Hau, toos nain sei soe nia hanesan sanak ida no nia sai maran. Depois ema halibur sanak sira nee, soe ba ahi laran no sunu tiha.
verses.7: Se imi hela iha Hau, no Hau nia liafuan hela iha imi, imi bele husu saida deit nebee imi hakarak, no ida nee sei halo ba imi.
verses.8: Nunee Hau nia Aman hetan glória bainhira imi foo fuan barak. Ho ida nee imi sei hatudu aan katak imi mak Hau nia eskolante sira.
verses.9: Hanesan Aman hadomi Hau, nunee mos Hau hadomi imi. Hela nafatin iha Hau nia domin.
verses.10: Se imi halo tuir Hau nia ukun fuan sira, imi sei hela nafatin iha Hau nia domin. Hanesan Hau mos halo tuir Hau nia Aman nia ukun fuan sira, no hela iha Ninia domin.
verses.11: Hau koalia buat sira nee ba imi hodi Hau nia ksolok bele hela iha imi, no imi nia ksolok sei sai nakonu.
verses.12: Ida nee mak Hau nia ukun fuan, katak imi hadomi malu hanesan Hau hadomi imi.
verses.13: La iha domin boot liu nee, katak ema foo ninia moris tanba ninia belun sira.
verses.14: Imi mak Hau nia belun sira, se imi halo buat nebee Hau manda ba imi.
verses.15: Hau la bolu tan imi atan. Tanba atan la hatene saida mak ninia nai halo. Maibee Hau bolu imi belun. Tanba buat hotu nebee Hau rona hosi Hau nia Aman, Hau hatoo ona ba imi.
verses.16: Laos imi mak hili Hau, maibee Hau mak hili imi. Hau foo knaar ba imi katak imi tenki baa no foo fuan, no imi nia fuan sei hela nafatin. Buat hotu nebee imi husu hosi Aman hodi Hau nia naran, Nia sei foo ba imi.
verses.17: Hau manda buat sira nee ba imi, hodi imi sei hadomi malu.
verses.18: Se mundu odi imi karik, imi hatene katak sira odi uluk tiha ona Hau.
verses.19: Se imi hosi mundu, mundu sei hadomi imi nudar sira nian. Maibee imi laos mundu nian, tanba Hau hili ona imi sai hosi mundu, nunee mundu odi imi.
verses.20: Hanoin hetan liafuan nebee Hau dehan ona ba imi, ‘Atan la boot liu fali ninia nai.’ Se sira foo terus ba Hau, sira mos sei foo terus ba imi. Se sira halo tuir Hau nia liafuan, sira mos sei halo tuir imi nia liafuan.
verses.21: Maibee sira sei halo buat hotu nee ba imi tanba Hau nia naran, tanba sira la hatene Nia nebee haruka Hau mai.
verses.22: Se Hau la mai no koalia ba sira, sira la iha sala. Maibee agora sira la bele finji katak sira la iha sala.
verses.23: Ema nebee odi Hau, odi mos Hau nia Aman.
verses.24: Se Hau la halo milagre iha sira nia leet, nebee ema seluk la halo, sira la iha sala. Maibee agora sira haree ona no odi Hau no mos Hau nia Aman.
verses.25: Maibee nee tenki kumpri liafuan nebee hakerek ona iha sira nia Lei katak, ‘Sira odi Hau maski razaun la iha.’
verses.26: Maibee Hau sei haruka Ajudadór ba imi, nebee mai hosi Aman. Nia mak Espíritu lia loos nian nebee mai hosi Aman. Nia sei foo sasin kona ba Hau.
verses.27: No imi mos sei foo sasin, tanba hori uluk kedas imi hamutuk ho Hau.

verses.1: “Hau hatete buat sira nee ba imi hodi imi la monu ba sala.
verses.2: Sira sei hasai imi hosi sinagoga sira. No mos, tempu sei too mai bainhira ema nebee oho imi sei hanoin katak nia serví Maromak.
verses.3: Sira sei halo buat sira nee tanba sira la konhese Aman, ka Hau.
verses.4: Maibee Hau foo hatene kona ba buat sira nee ba imi, katak bainhira tempu nee mai, imi bele hanoin hetan katak Hau foo hatene ona ba imi. Fo-foun Hau la foo hatene kona ba buat sira nee ba imi, tanba Hau sei hamutuk ho imi.
verses.5: “Agora Hau atu baa Nia nebee haruka Hau mai. No imi la husu hau, ‘O atu baa nebee?’
verses.6: Maibee tanba Hau dehan buat sira nee ba imi, imi nia fuan laran sai tristi tebe-tebes.
verses.7: Maski nunee Hau dehan lia loos ba imi: diak liu ba imi katak Hau baa. Tanba se Hau la baa, Ajudadór sei la mai ba imi. Maibee se Hau baa, Hau sei haruka Nia ba imi.
verses.8: No bainhira Nia mai, Nia sei foo hanoin ba mundu kona ba sala, moris loos no julgamentu.
verses.9: Kona ba sala, tanba sira la fiar ba Hau.
verses.10: Kona ba moris loos, tanba Hau baa Hau nia Aman, no imi sei la haree tan Hau.
verses.11: No kona ba julgamentu, tanba mundu nee nia ukun nain hasoru ona tesi lia.
verses.12: Hau sei iha buat barak atu foo sai ba imi, maibee agora imi la toman atu lori buat sira nee.
verses.13: Maibee bainhira Espíritu lia loos nian mai, Nia sei lori imi tama ba lia loos hotu. Tanba Nia sei la koalia hosi Ninia aan rasik, maibee Nia sei koalia buat hotu nebee Nia rona. No Nia sei foo sai ba imi kona ba buat sira nebee atu mai.
verses.14: Nia sei foo glória mai Hau. Tanba Nia sei simu buat nebee Hau nian, no foo sai ba imi.
verses.15: Buat hotu nebee Aman nian mak Hau nian. Tanba nee mak Hau dehan katak Espíritu sei simu buat nebee Hau nian, no foo sai ba imi.
verses.16: “La kleur tan imi sei la haree tan Hau. Depois la kleur tan fali, imi sei haree Hau.”
verses.17: Entaun Ninia eskolante balu koalia ba malu, “Nia dehan saida ba ita nebee, ‘La kleur tan imi la haree ona Hau. Depois la kleur tan fali, imi sei haree Hau;’ no, ‘Tanba Hau baa Aman’?”
verses.18: Nunee sira dehan, “Saida mak liafuan nee, nebee Nia dehan, ‘La kleur tan’? Ita la hatene saida mak Nia dehan.”
verses.19: Jesus hatene katak sira hakarak husu Nia. Entaun Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi husu ba malu kona ba Hau nia liafuan ohin nee ka, ‘La kleur tan imi la haree ona Hau. Depois la kleur tan fali, imi sei haree Hau’?
verses.20: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, katak imi sei tanis no halerik, maibee mundu sei haksolok. Imi sei laran susar. Maibee imi nia laran susar nee sei sai haksolok.
verses.21: Bainhira feto ida atu tuur ahi, nia laran susar tanba ninia oras too ona. Maibee bainhira nia tuur ahi ona no iha bebee, nia la hanoin hetan tan ninia terus, tanba nia haksolok katak ema ida moris mai ona iha mundu nee.
verses.22: Nunee mos agora imi laran susar. Maibee Hau sei haree fali imi, no imi nia fuan laran sei haksolok. No la iha ema ida mak bele hasai imi nia ksolok hosi imi.
verses.23: Iha loron nebaa, imi sei la husu Hau buat ida. Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba imi, buat hotu nebee imi husu hosi Aman hodi Hau nia naran, Nia sei foo ba imi.
verses.24: Too agora imi seidauk husu buat ida hodi Hau nia naran. Husu ba, no imi sei simu, hodi imi nia ksolok sei sai nakonu.
verses.25: Hau koalia ona buat sira nee ba imi liu hosi komparasaun. Maibee tempu sei too mai bainhira Hau sei la koalia tan ba imi ho komparasaun, maibee Hau sei koalia mo-moos ba imi kona ba Aman.
verses.26: Iha loron nebaa, imi sei husu hodi Hau nia naran. Maibee Hau la dehan ba imi katak Hau sei hatoo imi nia pedidu ba Aman.
verses.27: Tanba Aman rasik hadomi imi, tanba imi hadomi Hau, no imi fiar katak Hau mai hosi Maromak.
verses.28: Hau mai hosi Aman, no Hau tama mai iha mundu nee. No agora Hau sei husik mundu, no fila fali ba Aman.”
verses.29: Ninia eskolante sira dehan ba Nia, “Ah, agora O koalia mo-moos, no la uza ona komparasaun!
verses.30: Agora ami hatene katak O hatene buat hotu-hotu, no la presiza ema ida atu husu O. Tanba nee mak ami fiar katak O mai hosi Maromak.”
verses.31: Jesus hataan ba sira, “Agora imi fiar ka?
verses.32: Rona ba, oras sei too mai, no too duni ona, katak imi sei namkari, ida-idak baa ninia uma. Imi sei husik Hau mesak. Maibee Hau la mesak, tanba Aman mak hamutuk ho Hau.
verses.33: Hau koalia buat sira nee ba imi, atu imi bele iha dame iha Hau. Iha mundu nee imi sei hetan susar. Maibee aten brani ba; Hau manaan tiha ona mundu.”

verses.1: Bainhira Jesus koalia tiha liafuan nee, Nia foti matan ba lalehan no dehan, “Aman, oras too ona. Foo glória ba O nia Oan Mane, atu nunee O nia Oan Mane mos bele foo glória ba O.
verses.2: Tanba O foo ona ba Nia kbiit atu ukun isin hotu, atu Nia bele foo moris rohan laek ba sira hotu nebee O foo ona ba Nia.
verses.3: Ida nee mak moris rohan laek, katak sira bele konhese O, Maromak loos mesak deit, no Jesus Kristu, nebee O haruka mai.
verses.4: Hau foo ona glória ba O iha mundu. Hau halo kompletu ona servisu nebee O foo mai Hau atu halo.
verses.5: Agora, Oh Aman, foo glória mai Hau iha O nia prezensa ho glória nebee Hau iha uluk ho O, molok mundu mosu mai.
verses.6: Hau foo sai ona O nia naran ba ema nebee O foo mai Hau hosi mundu. Sira mak O nian, no O foo sira mai Hau. No sira halo tuir O nia liafuan.
verses.7: Agora sira hatene katak buat hotu nebee O foo ona mai Hau mai hosi O.
verses.8: Tanba Hau foo ona ba sira liafuan nebee O foo mai Hau. No sira simu ona liafuan nee. No sira hatene lo-loos ona katak Hau mai hosi O, no sira fiar ona katak O mak haruka Hau mai.
verses.9: Hau halo orasaun ba sira. Hau la halo orasaun ba mundu, maibee kona ba sira nebee O foo ona mai Hau, tanba sira mak O nian.
verses.10: Buat hotu nebee Hau nian mak O nian, no O nian mak Hau nian. No Hau hetan glória iha sira.
verses.11: Agora, Hau la hela tan iha mundu, maibee sira sei iha mundu, no Hau atu baa too O. Aman Santu, tau matan ba sira iha O nia naran, sira nebee O foo ona mai Hau, atu sira bele sai ida deit, hanesan Ita mak ida deit.
verses.12: Durante tempu nebee Hau hamutuk ho sira, Hau tau matan ba sira iha O nia naran. O mak foo sira mai Hau, no Hau tau matan ba sira. Sira ida la lakon, só deit oan lakon nian, hodi kumpri eskritura.
verses.13: Agora Hau atu baa too O. Hau koalia buat sira nee iha mundu atu sira bele sai nakonu ho Hau nia ksolok.
verses.14: Hau foo tiha ona O nia liafuan ba sira. No mundu odi sira, tanba sira laos hosi mundu, hanesan Hau mos laos hosi mundu.
verses.15: Hau la husu katak O hasai sira hosi mundu, maibee katak O proteje sira hosi aat nain.
verses.16: Sira laos hosi mundu, hanesan Hau mos laos hosi mundu.
verses.17: Halo sira santu liu hosi lia loos. O nia liafuan mak lia loos.
verses.18: Hanesan O haruka Hau ba mundu, nunee mos Hau haruka sira ba mundu.
verses.19: No tanba sira mak Hau halo Aan santu, atu nunee sira mos bele sai santu iha lia loos.
verses.20: Hau la husu kona ba sira deit, maibee Hau husu mos kona ba sira nebee sei fiar ba Hau liu hosi sira nia liafuan;
verses.21: atu nunee sira hotu sai ida deit. Hanesan O, Aman, iha Hau, no Hau iha O, nunee mos sira bele hela iha Ita. Nunee mundu bele fiar katak O mak haruka Hau mai.
verses.22: Hau foo ona ba sira glória nebee O foo mai Hau, atu nunee sira bele sai ida deit, hanesan Ita mak ida deit.
verses.23: Hau iha sira, no O iha Hau. Nunee sira bele sai perfeitu nudar ida deit. No mundu bele hatene katak O mak haruka Hau, no katak O hadomi sira hanesan mos O hadomi Hau.
verses.24: Aman, Hau hakarak katak sira nebee O foo ona mai Hau bele hamutuk ho Hau iha fatin nebee Hau hela, atu nunee sira bele haree Hau nia glória nebee O foo ona mai Hau. Tanba O hadomi Hau molok mundu nee hahuu.
verses.25: Oh Aman loos, maski mundu la konhese O, Hau konhese O, no ema sira nee hatene katak O haruka Hau mai.
verses.26: No Hau foo hatene ona O nia naran ba sira, no Hau sei foo hatene nafatin kona ba O nia naran, atu nunee domin nebee O hadomi Hau bele hela iha sira, no Hau hela iha sira.”

verses.1: Bainhira Jesus koalia liafuan nee hotu, Nia lao sai ba liur ho Ninia eskolante sira no hakur mota Sedron. Nia tama ba toos ida iha fatin nebaa ho Ninia eskolante sira.
verses.2: Judas, nebee atu faan Nia, mos hatene fatin nee, tanba dala barak Jesus halibur hamutuk ho Ninia eskolante sira iha nebaa.
verses.3: Judas simu ona soldadu lubun ida no guarda sira hosi xefi saserdote sira no Farizeu sira. No nia mai ho ema sira nee ho lampu, ai lakan no armas kroat.
verses.4: Jesus hatene ona buat hotu nebee atu akontese ba Nia. Nunee Nia hakat ba oin no dehan ba sira, “Imi buka see?”
verses.5: Sira hataan ba Nia, “Jesus hosi Nazaré.” Jesus dehan ba sira, “Hau mak nee.” No Judas, nebee faan Nia, mos hamriik hamutuk ho sira.
verses.6: Bainhira Nia dehan ba sira, “Hau mak nee”, sira hakiduk kedas no monu ba rai.
verses.7: Nunee Nia husu fali ba sira, “Imi buka see?” No sira dehan, “Jesus hosi Nazaré.”
verses.8: Jesus hataan, “Hau foo hatene ona ba imi katak Hau mak nee. Se imi buka Hau, husik sira seluk nee sai ba.”
verses.9: Ida nee atu kumpri liafuan nebee Jesus koalia ona, “Hau la lakon ema ida hosi sira nebee O foo mai Hau.”
verses.10: Depois Simão Pedro, nebee iha surik ida, losu surik nee no ataka saserdote boot nia atan. Nia sabir tiha atan nia tilun sorin loos. Atan nee nia naran Malkos.
verses.11: Jesus dehan ba Pedro, “Hatama fali o nia surik iha ninia fatin. Hau sei la hemu kopu nebee Hau nia Aman foo ona mai Hau ka?”
verses.12: Depois soldadu lubun, komandante ho guarda ema Judeu sira nian kaer tiha Jesus no futu Nia.
verses.13: Sira lori Nia uluk ba Anas. Tanba Anas mak Kaifas nia banin mane. Iha tinan nebaa, Kaifas mak saserdote boot.
verses.14: Kaifas mak ema nebee foo konselhu ba ema Judeu sira katak diak liu ema ida deit mate ba povu.
verses.15: Simão Pedro no mos eskolante ida seluk lao tuir Jesus. Saserdote boot konhese eskolante ida seluk nee, nunee nia bele tama saserdote boot nia pátiu ho Jesus.
verses.16: Maibee Pedro hamriik iha odamatan liur. Eskolante ida seluk, nebee saserdote boot konhese nee, koalia ba atan feto nebee hein odamatan no lori Pedro tama ba laran.
verses.17: Atan feto nebee hein odamatan dehan ba Pedro, “Laos o mos Mane nee nia eskolante ida?” Pedro dehan, “Hau lae.”
verses.18: Atan no guarda sira halo ona ahi ho ahi klaak tanba tempu nee malirin. No sira hamriik haneruk ahi. No Pedro hamriik ho sira hodi haneruk ahi.
verses.19: Depois saserdote boot husu Jesus kona ba Ninia eskolante sira no kona ba Ninia hanorin.
verses.20: Jesus hataan ba saserdote boot, “Hau koalia iha ema hotu nia oin. Hau hanorin beibeik iha sinagoga no iha Templu, iha fatin nebee ema Judeu sira sempre halibur hamutuk. Hau la koalia sub-subar buat ida.
verses.21: Tanba saa mak o husu Hau? Husu ba sira nebee rona tiha Hau kona ba buat nebee Hau dehan ba sira. Tebes, sira hatene buat nebee Hau dehan.”
verses.22: Bainhira Jesus koalia tiha nunee, guarda ida nebee hamriik iha nebaa basa Jesus ho ninia liman, no dehan, “O hataan ba saserdote boot hanesan nee ka?”
verses.23: Jesus hataan ba nia, “Se Hau koalia sala karik, foo sai sala nee. Maibee se Hau koalia loos, tanba saa mak o basa Hau?”
verses.24: Depois Anas haruka Jesus, nebee futu metin hela, ba saserdote boot Kaifas.
verses.25: Simão Pedro hamriik hela hodi haneruk ahi. Nunee ema sira dehan ba nia, “Laos o mos Ninia eskolante ida ka?” Pedro nega dehan, “Hau lae.”
verses.26: Depois saserdote boot nia atan sira ida, nebee maluk ho ida nebee mak Pedro sabir tiha ninia tilun, dehan, “Laos hau haree o iha toos ho Nia?”
verses.27: Pedro nega fali. No iha momentu nee kedas manu mos kokoreek.
verses.28: Depois sira lori Jesus hosi Kaifas nia uma ba governadór nia postu. Oras nee sei sedu, no sira rasik la tama ba governadór nia postu hodi sira la bele halo foer sira nia aan; atu nunee sira bele haan Páskua.
verses.29: Pilatos sai ba liur hodi hasoru sira, no dehan, “Imi akuza Mane nee kona ba saida?”
verses.30: Sira hataan ba Pilatos, “Se Nia laos kriminozu, ami sei la lori Nia ba ita boot.”
verses.31: Depois Pilatos dehan ba sira, “Lori Nia ba, no tesi lia ba Nia tuir imi nia lei.” Nunee ema Judeu sira dehan ba Pilatos, “Tuir lei, ami la bele foo kastigu mate ba ema ida.”
verses.32: Ida nee akontese hodi kumpri liafuan nebee Jesus koalia ona atu hatudu oinsaa mak Nia atu mate.
verses.33: Depois Pilatos tama fali ba ninia uma governadór nian. Nia bolu Jesus, no dehan, “O mak ema Judeu sira nia liurai ka?”
verses.34: Jesus hataan, “Ita koalia nunee tanba ita nia hanoin rasik ka ema seluk koalia ba ita kona ba Hau?”
verses.35: Pilatos hataan, “Hau mak ema Judeu ka? O nia nasaun rasik no xefi saserdote sira mak entrega O mai hau. O halo saida?”
verses.36: Jesus hataan, “Hau nia reinu laos hosi mundu nee. Se Hau nia reinu hosi mundu nee, entaun Hau nia atan sira sei luta atu ema Judeu sira la kaer Hau. Maibee Hau nia reinu laos hosi mundu nee.”
verses.37: Nunee Pilatos dehan ba Nia, “Entaun O mak Liurai ka?” Jesus hataan, “Ita rasik mak dehan katak Hau mak Liurai. Tanba nee mak Hau moris mai, no tanba nee mak Hau tama mai mundu, atu foo sasin ba lia loos. Ema hotu nebee hosi lia loos rona Hau nia lian.”
verses.38: Pilatos dehan ba nia, “Saida mak lia loos?” Koalia tiha nunee, Pilatos sai fali ba ema Judeu sira, no dehan ba sira, “Hau la hetan sala ida iha Nia.
verses.39: Maibee imi iha kostumi ida, katak hau tenki husik ema ida ba imi iha tempu Páskua. Nunee imi hakarak hau husik ema Judeu sira nia Liurai ba imi ka?”
verses.40: Sira hotu hakilar fali, “Laos Mane nee, maibee Barabás.” Barabás mak naok-teen ida.

verses.1: Depois Pilatos lori Jesus, no baku Nia ho sikote.
verses.2: Soldadu sira bobar ai tarak hodi halo koroa, no tau iha Ninia ulun. No sira foo hatais Nia ho hena kór uvas.
verses.3: Sira dehan, “Viva! Liurai ema Judeu nian!” No sira basa Nia ho sira nia liman.
verses.4: Pilatos sai fali, no dehan ba sira, “Tebes, hau lori Nia sai mai liur ba imi atu imi bele hatene katak hau la hetan sala ida iha Nia.”
verses.5: Depois Jesus sai mai. Nia hatais hela koroa hosi ai tarak no hena kór uvas. No Pilatos dehan ba sira, “Haree ba, Mane mak nee!”
verses.6: Bainhira xefi saserdote sira no guarda sira haree Nia, sira hakilar, “Prega Nia ba krús! Prega Nia ba krús!” Pilatos dehan ba sira, “Imi rasik lori Nia no prega Nia ba krús. Tanba hau la hetan sala ida iha Nia.”
verses.7: Ema Judeu sira hataan, “Ami iha lei, no tuir ami nia lei nee Nia tenki mate tanba Nia foti Ninia Aan nudar Maromak nia Oan.”
verses.8: Bainhira Pilatos rona tiha liafuan nee, nia sai tauk liu tan.
verses.9: Nia tama fali ba uma governadór nian no dehan ba Jesus, “O mai hosi nebee?” Maibee Jesus la hataan buat ida.
verses.10: Entaun Pilatos dehan ba Nia, “O la koalia mai hau ka? O la hatene ka, katak hau iha kbiit atu prega O ba krús, no hau iha kbiit atu husik O livre?”
verses.11: Jesus hataan, “Ita la iha kbiit ida hasoru Hau, só deit kbiit nebee ita simu hosi leten. Nunee ema nebee entrega Hau ba ita mak halo sala boot liu tan.”
verses.12: Hosi oras nee ba oin, Pilatos buka atu husik Jesus livre. Maibee ema Judeu sira hakilar dehan, “Se ita boot husik Mane nee livre, ita boot laos César nia belun. Ema nebee foti aan nudar liurai, nia kontra César.”
verses.13: Bainhira Pilatos rona tiha liafuan nee, nia lori Jesus sai ba liur. Nia tuur iha kadeira tesi lia nian iha fatin nebee bolu Fatuk Belar, no iha lian Ebreu, bolu Gabata.
verses.14: Loron nee mak loron preparasaun ba Páskua, no oras maizoumenus meiudia. No Pilatos dehan ba ema Judeu sira, “Haree ba, imi nia Liurai!”
verses.15: Maibee sira hakilar, “Halakon Nia! Halakon Nia! Prega Nia ba krús!” Pilatos dehan ba sira, “Hau sei prega imi nia Liurai ba krús ka?” Xefi saserdote sira hataan, “Ami la iha liurai, só César deit.”
verses.16: Depois Pilatos entrega Jesus ba sira atu prega Nia ba krús. No sira lori Jesus.
verses.17: Jesus lori Ninia krús no lao sai ba fatin naran Ulun Ruin, nebee iha lian Aramaiku naran Golgota.
verses.18: Sira prega Jesus ba krús iha nebaa. Sira prega mos ema nain rua ho Nia, iha sor-sorin, no Jesus iha klaran.
verses.19: Pilatos hakerek avizu ida no tau iha krús. Liafuan nee dehan: “Jesus Hosi Nazaré, Ema Judeu Nia Liurai.”
verses.20: Ema Judeu barak lee avizu ida nee tanba fatin nebee sira prega Jesus ba krús besik sidade. No liafuan nee hakerek iha lian Aramaiku, Latin no Gregu.
verses.21: Depois ema Judeu sira nia xefi saserdote sira dehan ba Pilatos, “Keta hakerek, ‘Ema Judeu Nia Liurai,’ maibee katak, ‘Ema nee dehan: Hau mak ema Judeu nia Liurai.’”
verses.22: Pilatos hataan, “Buat nebee hau hakerek ona nee, hau hakerek ona!”
verses.23: Bainhira soldadu sira prega tiha Jesus ba krús, sira foti Ninia ropa no fahe ba parte haat hodi soldadu ida-idak hetan parte ida. Maibee Ninia faru naruk nee la suku tanba soru deit hosi leten too kraik.
verses.24: Entaun sira dehan ba malu, “Ita lalika lees ropa nee. Maibee mai ita dada rifa atu hatene see mak hetan.” Ida nee akontese atu kumpri eskritura nebee dehan,
verses.25: Jesus nia inan, Ninia inan nia alin feto, Maria nebee Kleofas nia feen, no Maria Madalena hamriik besik krús.
verses.26: Bainhira Jesus haree Ninia inan, no eskolante ida nebee Nia hadomi hamriik besik, Nia dehan ba Ninia inan, “Feto, haree ba, o nia oan mane!”
verses.27: Depois Nia dehan ba eskolante ida nee, “Haree ba, o nia inan mak nee!” Entaun hosi oras nee, eskolante ida nee simu feto nee ba ninia uma.
verses.28: Liu tiha nee, Jesus hatene buat hotu kompletu ona. No hodi kumpri eskritura, Nia dehan, “Hau hamrook.”
verses.29: Iha nebaa, ema tau buli ida nebee nakonu ho tua siin. Sira habokon esponja ida iha tua siin nee, tau iha ai sanak isope, no lolo ba Ninia ibun.
verses.30: Bainhira Jesus simu tiha tua siin nee, Nia dehan, “Hotu ona.” Depois Nia hakruuk Ninia ulun, no entrega Ninia espíritu.
verses.31: Loron nee mak loron preparasaun, no loron Sabdu nebee tuir mai mak loron boot. Tanba nee ema Judeu sira husu Pilatos katak nia bele baku tohar ema sira nee nia ain no hasai sira. Nunee mate isin sira nee la bele hela iha krús iha loron Sabdu.
verses.32: Entaun soldadu sira mai, no baku tohar ema primeiru nia ain, no mos ida seluk nebee prega iha krús ho Jesus.
verses.33: Maibee bainhira sira too iha Jesus, sira haree katak Nia mate ona, nunee sira la baku tohar Ninia ain.
verses.34: Maibee soldadu ida sona Ninia sorin ho dima, no raan ho bee suli sai kedas.
verses.35: Ema nebee haree ida nee mak foo sasin. No ninia sasin nee loos. Nia hatene katak nia koalia lia loos. Nunee imi mos bele fiar.
verses.36: Tanba buat sira nee akontese hodi kumpri eskritura, “Ninia ruin ida mos sei la tohar.”
verses.37: No eskritura ida fali dehan, “Sira sei hateke ba nia nebee sira sona.”
verses.38: Tuir mai, José hosi Arimateia husu Pilatos atu nia bele foti Jesus nia mate isin. Nia mak Jesus nia eskolante ida, maibee sub-subar deit tanba nia tauk ema Judeu sira. Pilatos foo lisensa ba nia, entaun nia baa no foti Jesus nia mate isin.
verses.39: Nicodemos mos mai no lori buat morin, nebee kahur mina mira ho aloes, maizoumenus kilograma tolu-nulu resin tolu. Nia mak ema nebee uluk baa hasoru Jesus iha kalan.
verses.40: Sira foti Jesus nia mate isin, no falun ho hena linhu no buat morin, tuir ema Judeu sira nia kostumi atu hakoi mate isin.
verses.41: Fatin nebee sira prega Jesus ba krús nee iha jardin ida. No jardin nee iha rate foun ida nebee ema seidauk tau mate isin.
verses.42: Entaun tanba ema Judeu sira nia loron preparasaun, no tanba rate nee besik fatin nee, sira tau Jesus iha nebaa.

verses.1: Iha loron primeiru iha semana nee, dadeer-saan nakukun, Maria Madalena baa sedu too iha rate. Nia haree katak fatuk nee hasai tiha ona hosi rate.
verses.2: Entaun nia halai no baa hasoru Simão Pedro, no eskolante ida seluk, nebee Jesus hadomi, no dehan ba sira, “Sira foti tiha ona Nai hosi rate, no ami la hatene sira tau Nia iha nebee.”
verses.3: Nunee Pedro sai ba, ho eskolante ida fali, atu baa rate.
verses.4: Sira nain rua halai hamutuk. No eskolante ida seluk lalais liu Pedro, no nia too uluk iha rate.
verses.5: No nia hakruuk hodi hateke ba laran. Nia haree ropa linhu rai hela iha nebaa, maibee nia la tama.
verses.6: Depois Simão Pedro too tuir nia, no tama ba rate laran. Nia haree ropa linhu nebee rai hela.
verses.7: Hena nebee falun ba Jesus nia ulun la hamutuk ho ropa linhu, maibee lulun tiha no tau ketak iha fatin seluk.
verses.8: Depois eskolante ida seluk, nebee too uluk ba rate, mos tama ba laran. Nia haree no fiar.
verses.9: Tanba sira seidauk kompriende eskritura, katak Jesus tenki moris hias hosi mate.
verses.10: Depois eskolante sira fila fali ba sira nia uma.
verses.11: Maibee Maria hamriik iha rate liur no tanis hela. Bainhira nia tanis hela, nia hakruuk hodi hateke ba rate laran.
verses.12: No nia haree anju rua nebee hatais ropa mutin no tuur iha fatin nebee uluk ema tau Jesus. Ida tuur iha ulun fatin, no ida seluk tuur iha ain fatin.
verses.13: Sira dehan ba nia, “Feto, tanba saa mak o tanis?” Nia dehan ba sira, “Tanba sira foti ona hau nia Nai, no Hau la hatene sira tau Nia iha nebee.”
verses.14: Bainhira nia koalia nunee, nia fila oin no haree Jesus hamriik iha nebaa. Maibee nia la hatene katak ema nee mak Jesus.
verses.15: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Feto, tanba saa mak o tanis? O buka see?” Maria hanoin katak Jesus mak ema nebee servisu iha jardin. Maria dehan, “Senhor, se karik Ita Boot lori ona Nia hosi fatin nee, foo hatene mai hau, Ita Boot tau Nia iha fatin nebee, no hau sei baa foti Nia.”
verses.16: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Maria.” Maria fila oin, no dehan ba Nia, “Rabi!” (katak ‘Mestri’).
verses.17: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Keta kaer Hau, tanba Hau seidauk sae ba Hau nia Aman. Maibee baa hasoru Hau nia maun-alin sira, no dehan ba sira, ‘Hau sei sae ba Hau nia Aman, no imi nia Aman, ba Hau nia Maromak, no imi nia Maromak.’”
verses.18: Maria Madalena baa no foo hatene ba eskolante sira, “Hau haree ona Nai!” No nia hatoo liafuan nebee Jesus dehan ba nia.
verses.19: Iha loron nee, nebee loron primeiru iha semana nee, bainhira kalan ona no odamatan taka tiha, eskolante sira halibur hamutuk tanba sira tauk ema Judeu sira. No Jesus mai no hamriik iha sira nia leet. Nia dehan ba sira, “Dame hela ho imi.”
verses.20: Koalia tiha nunee, Jesus hatudu Ninia liman no Ninia sorin ba sira. Bainhira eskolante sira haree Nai, sira haksolok.
verses.21: Depois Jesus dehan fali ba sira, “Dame hela ho imi. Hanesan Aman haruka ona Hau, nunee mos Hau haruka imi.”
verses.22: Koalia tiha nunee, Nia huu iis ba sira, no dehan ba sira, “Simu Espíritu Santu ba.
verses.23: Se imi foo perdua ba ema ruma nia sala, sira sei hetan perdua. Se imi la foo perdua ba ema, sira sei la hetan.”
verses.24: Maibee Tomé, ema ida hosi sira nain sanulu resin rua nee, nebee bolu Kaduak, la hamutuk ho sira bainhira Jesus mai.
