verses.25: Entaun eskolante sira seluk dehan ba nia, “Ami haree ona Nai.” Maibee nia dehan ba sira, “Se hau la haree Ninia kanek hosi pregu iha Ninia liman, no se hau la tau hau nia liman fuan iha kanek hosi pregu nee, no se hau la hatama hau nia liman ba Ninia sorin, hau sei nunka fiar.”
verses.26: Liu tiha loron ualu, Jesus nia eskolante sira halibur hamutuk fali iha uma laran. No Tomé mos hamutuk ho sira. Maski odamatan xavi metin hela, Jesus mai, no hamriik iha sira nia leet. No Nia dehan, “Dame hela ho imi.”
verses.27: Depois Nia dehan ba Tomé, “Tau o nia liman fuan iha nee, no haree Hau nia liman. Lolo o nia liman, no hatama ba Hau nia sorin. Keta lakon fiar, maibee fiar ba.”
verses.28: Tomé hataan ba Nia, “Hau nia Nai no hau nia Maromak!”
verses.29: Jesus dehan ba Tomé, “O fiar tanba o haree Hau ka? Haksolok ba sira nebee fiar, maski la haree.”
verses.30: Jesus halo milagre barak tan iha Ninia eskolante sira nia oin nebee la hakerek iha surat ida nee.
verses.31: Maibee buat sira nee hakerek ona atu imi bele fiar katak Jesus mak Kristu, Maromak nia Oan; no katak liu hosi fiar nee, imi bele hetan moris iha Ninia naran.

verses.1: Tuir mai, Jesus hatudu Aan fali ba eskolante sira iha Tasi Tiberiades. No Nia hatudu Aan hanesan nee.
verses.2: Simão Pedro halibur hamutuk ho Tomé, nebee bolu Kaduak, Natanael hosi Kana iha Galileia, Zebedeu nia oan mane sira, no Jesus nia eskolante rua tan.
verses.3: Simão Pedro dehan ba sira, “Hau baa kaer ikan lai.” Sira dehan ba nia, “Ami mos baa ho ita.” Sira baa no sae roo. Maibee kalan nee sira la hetan buat ida.
verses.4: Bainhira dadeer-saan ona, Jesus hamriik iha tasi ibun, maibee eskolante sira nee la hatene katak Nia mak Jesus.
verses.5: Depois Jesus dehan ba sira, “Labarik sira, modo iha ka lae?” Sira hataan ba Nia, “La iha.”
verses.6: No Nia dehan ba sira, “Soe dai ba roo nia sorin loos, no imi sei hetan.” Nunee sira soe dai, no sira la bele dada fali dai nee tanba ikan barak tebe-tebes.
verses.7: Nunee eskolante ida nebee Jesus hadomi dehan ba Pedro, “Ema nee mak Nai!” Bainhira Simão Pedro rona katak ema nee mak Nai, nia hatais ninia ropa (tanba nia isin tanan) no haksoit ba tasi laran.
verses.8: Eskolante sira seluk mai ho roo no dada dai nebee nakonu ho ikan, tanba sira laduun dook hosi rai maran, maizoumenus metru sia-nulu.
verses.9: Bainhira sira too rai maran, sira haree ahi klaak ho ikan tunu hela no mos paun.
verses.10: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Lori mai ikan balu nebee imi foin kaer nee.”
verses.11: Entaun Simão Pedro sae roo no dada dai nee ba rai maran, nakonu ho ikan boot, hamutuk atus ida lima-nulu resin tolu. Maski ikan barak, maibee dai nee la naklees.
verses.12: Jesus dehan ba sira, “Mai haan.” La iha eskolante ida mak brani atu husu Nia, “See mak O?” Tanba sira hatene katak Nia mak Nai.
verses.13: Jesus hakbesik mai, foti paun no foo ba sira. Nia halo hanesan nunee ho ikan.
verses.14: Nee mak dala tolu ona nebee Jesus hatudu Aan ba Ninia eskolante sira, bainhira Nia moris hias ona hosi mate.
verses.15: Bainhira sira haan hotu tiha, Jesus dehan ba Simão Pedro, “Simão, João nia oan, o hadomi Hau liu fali sira nee ka?” Pedro dehan ba Jesus, “Sin, Nai. O hatene katak hau hadomi O.” Jesus dehan ba nia, “Foo haan ba Hau nia bibi oan sira.”
verses.16: Ba dala rua, Jesus dehan ba nia, “Simão, João nia oan, o hadomi Hau ka?” Nia dehan ba Jesus, “Sin, Nai. O hatene katak hau hadomi O.” Jesus dehan ba nia, “Tau matan ba Hau nia bibi sira.”
verses.17: Ba dala tolu, Jesus dehan ba nia, “Simão, João nia oan, o hadomi Hau ka?” Pedro sai tristi tanba Jesus husu dala tolu ona, “O hadomi Hau ka?” No nia dehan ba Jesus, “Nai, O hatene buat hotu. O hatene katak hau hadomi O.” Jesus dehan ba nia, “Foo haan ba Hau nia bibi sira.
verses.18: Tebes, tebes, Hau dehan ba o, katak bainhira o sei joven, o hatais aan no lao baa nebee deit tuir o nia hakarak. Maibee bainhira o sai katuas ona, o sei lolo o nia liman, no ema seluk sei foo hatais o, no lori o ba fatin nebee o lakohi.”
verses.19: Jesus koalia nunee hodi foo hatene oinsaa mak Pedro atu mate hodi foo glória ba Maromak. No bainhira Jesus koalia tiha liafuan nee, Nia dehan ba Pedro, “Tuir Hau.”
verses.20: Depois Pedro fila oin no haree eskolante ida nebee Jesus hadomi lao tuir sira. Nia mak ida nebee uluk sadere ba Jesus nia hirus matan bainhira haan kalan no dehan, “Nai, see mak ema nee, nebee atu faan O?”
verses.21: Bainhira Pedro haree eskolante nee, nia dehan ba Jesus, “Nai, oinsaa kona ba ema nee?”
verses.22: Jesus dehan ba nia, “Se karik Hau hakarak ema nee hela too Hau mai fali, saida mak nee ba o? O tuir Hau ba!”
verses.23: Entaun liafuan nee habelar iha maun-alin sira nia leet, katak eskolante nee sei la mate. Maibee Jesus la dehan ba nia katak ema nee la mate. Maibee Jesus dehan, “Se karik Hau hakarak ema nee hela too Hau mai fali, saida mak nee ba o?”
verses.24: Eskolante ida nee mak foo sasin kona ba buat sira nee, no nia mak hakerek buat sira nee. No ita hatene katak ninia sasin nee mak loos.
verses.25: Tuir lo-loos, iha buat barak tan nebee Jesus halo. Se karik ema hakerek buat sira nee hotu, hau hanoin katak mundu mos la too atu rai livru sira nee, nebee ema bele hakerek.

verses.1: Iha surat primeiru, Oh Teofilo, hau hakerek kona ba buat hotu nebee Jesus komesa halo no hanorin,
verses.2: too loron nebee Nia sae ba. Molok Nia sae ba, Nia foo ukun fuan sira liu hosi Espíritu Santu ba apostolu sira nebee Nia hili tiha ona.
verses.3: Bainhira Nia hetan ona Ninia terus, Nia hatudu Aan ba sira katak Nia moris hias ona. Nia prova dala barak durante loron haat-nulu katak Nia moris duni no Nia koalia kona ba Maromak nia reinu.
verses.4: Bainhira Nia sei hamutuk ho sira, Nia manda sira atu la bele sai hosi Jerusalém, maibee hein promesa hosi Aman. Nia dehan, “Imi rona ona kona ba ida nee hosi Hau.
verses.5: Tanba João foo batizmu ho bee, maibee la kleur tan, imi sei simu batizmu ho Espíritu Santu.”
verses.6: Entaun bainhira sira halibur hamutuk ona, sira husu Jesus, “Nai, iha tempu nee, O sei harii fali reinu ba Israel?”
verses.7: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi la iha direitu atu hatene oras ka tempu nebee Aman hili ho Ninia autoridade.
verses.8: Maibee imi sei simu kbiit bainhira Espíritu Santu tuun ba imi. No imi sei sai Hau nia sasin iha Jerusalém, iha Judeia no Samaria tomak, no too mundu nia rohan.”
verses.9: Koalia tiha nunee, bainhira sira hateke hela, Nia sae ba. Kalohan ida simu Nia hodi sira la bele haree tan Nia.
verses.10: Bainhira Nia sae dadaun no sira hateke hela ba lalehan, derepenti mane nain rua nebee hatais ropa mutin hamriik iha sira nia sorin.
verses.11: No nain rua nee dehan, “Ema Galileia sira, tanba saa mak imi hamriik hodi hateke ba lalehan? Jesus nee, nebee sae ona hosi imi ba lalehan, sei fila fali mai hanesan imi haree Nia tama ba lalehan.”
verses.12: Depois sira fila fali hosi Foho Oliveira ba Jerusalém. Foho nee besik Jerusalém, maizoumenus lao tuir viajen loron Sabdu nian.
verses.13: Bainhira sira tama Jerusalém, sira sae ba salaun iha andar leten tanba sira hela iha nebaa. Iha nebaa mak Pedro, Tiago, João, André, Filipe, Tomé, Bartolomeu, Mateus, Tiago nebee Alfeu nia oan, Simão Zelotes, no Judas nebee Tiago nia alin.
verses.14: Sira hotu kontinua ho laran ida deit atu entrega aan ba orasaun. Sira hamutuk ho feto balu, inklui Maria, Jesus nia inan, no Ninia alin sira.
verses.15: Grupu nee iha ema maizoumenus nain atus ida rua-nulu. Iha tempu nebaa, Pedro hamriik iha eskolante sira nia leet, no dehan,
verses.16: “Maun-alin sira, Eskritura tenki kumpri, nebee Espíritu Santu koalia nanis ona liu hosi David nia ibun kona ba Judas. Tanba Judas sai matadalan ba sira nebee kaer Jesus.
verses.17: Tanba uluk ita sura Judas hamutuk ho ita, no nia hola parte iha ministériu nee.”
verses.18: (Mane nee sosa toos ida ho osan hosi ninia hahalok aat. Nia monu ho ulun tuun ba rai. Ninia kanotak nakfera, no ninia tee oan fakar sai.
verses.19: Ema hotu nebee hela iha Jerusalém hatene kona ba ida nee. Nunee sira bolu fatin nee ‘Akeldama’ iha sira nia lian, katak ‘Toos Raan Nian’.)
verses.20: Tanba iha livru Salmu ema hakerek nanis ona,
verses.21: “Nunee hanoin ema ida nebee hamutuk ho ita durante tempu hotu nebee Nai Jesus lao ba-mai iha ita nia leet.
verses.22: Ida nee hahuu hosi tempu nebee João foo batizmu too loron nebee Nia sae hosi imi. Ema ida hosi sira tenki sai sasin hamutuk ho ita kona ba Jesus moris hias ona.
verses.23: No sira hanoin ema rua, José nebee bolu Barsabas, ho naran mos Justo, no Matias.
verses.24: Sira halo orasaun no dehan, “Oh Nai, O hatene ema hotu nia fuan laran. Hatudu ema ida nebee O hili hosi ema nain rua nee.
verses.25: Atu nunee nia bele hola parte iha ministériu nee no sai apostolu. Tanba Judas husik ona knaar nee atu baa ninia fatin.”
verses.26: Depois sira dada rifa kona ba sira nain rua nee, no rifa monu kona Matias. Entaun sira sura nia hamutuk ho apostolu nain sanulu resin ida.

verses.1: Bainhira too ona loron Pentekosta, sira hotu halibur hamutuk iha fatin ida.
verses.2: Derepenti lian ida mai hosi lalehan. Lian nee hanesan anin boot nebee huu makaas no halo uma nakonu iha fatin nebee sira tuur.
verses.3: Depois buat ida mosu mai nebee iha oin hanesan nanaal ahi lakan nian, nebee fahe no tuun ba ema ida-idak.
verses.4: Sira hotu sai nakonu ho Espíritu Santu no komesa koalia ho lian seluk, tuir lian nebee Espíritu foo ba sira.
verses.5: Iha tempu nebaa, ema Judeu sira hela iha Jerusalém nebee hamtauk Maromak no mai hosi nasaun hotu iha lalehan okos.
verses.6: No bainhira sira rona lian nee, sira mai hamutuk too ema lubun boot. Sira bilaan tiha tanba sira rona disípulu sira koalia iha sira ida-idak ninia lian rasik.
verses.7: Sira hotu hakfodak no admira. No sira dehan, “Tebes, laos ema hotu nebee koalia dadaun nee mak ema Galileia sira?
verses.8: Oinsaa mak ita ida-idak rona ita nia lian rasik?
verses.9: Ita mai hosi Pártia, Média, no Elam. No iha ema nebee baibain hela iha Mezopotámia, Judeia, Kapadósia, Pontus, Ázia,
verses.10: Frígia, Pamfília, Ejitu, no área Líbia nebee besik Sirene, no ema rai liur hosi Roma,
verses.11: inklui mos ema Judeu sira no ema nebee simu relijiaun Judeu nian, no ema Kreta no Arábia. Ita rona sira koalia iha ita nia lian rasik kona ba Maromak nia hahalok furak.”
verses.12: No sira hotu hakfodak no bilaan. Sira dehan ba malu, “Nee signifika saida?”
verses.13: Ema seluk goza sira no dehan, “Ema sira nee nakonu ho tua uvas.”
verses.14: Maibee Pedro hamriik ho sira nain sanulu resin ida. Nia koalia ba ema lubun boot ho lian makaas no dehan, “Ema Judeia sira, no imi hotu imi nebee hela iha Jerusalém, hatene di-diak no rona hau nia liafuan.
verses.15: Tanba ema sira nee la lanu, hanesan imi hanoin, tanba oras nee tuku sia dadeer.
verses.16: Maibee ida nee mak buat nebee koalia ona liu hosi profeta Joel:
verses.17: ‘Iha tempu ikus, ida nee sei akontese, dehan Maromak,
verses.18: Ba Hau nia atan mane no hau nia atan feto sira mos
verses.19: No Hau sei hatudu milagre sira iha lalehan iha leten,
verses.20: Loro matan sei sai nakukun
verses.21: No ema hotu nebee bolu ba Nai nia naran
verses.22: Ema hosi Israel, rona liafuan nee: Maromak hatudu katak Nia haruka Jesus hosi Nazaré, tanba Maromak halao kbiit, milagre no sinál sira liu hosi Jesus iha imi nia leet. Imi mos hatene ida nee.
verses.23: Ema entrega Jesus ba imi tuir Maromak nia planu no Nia hatene ida nee uluk kedas. No imi prega Jesus ba krús no oho Nia liu hosi ema aat sira nia liman.
verses.24: Maromak halo Jesus moris hias ona. Nia kore terus mate nian hosi Jesus. Tanba terus mate nee la iha kbiit atu kaer Jesus.
verses.25: Tanba David koalia kona ba Nia,
verses.26: Nunee mak Hau nia fuan laran haksolok,
verses.27: Tanba O sei la husik Hau nia klamar iha Fatin Mate,
verses.28: O foo hatene dalan moris nian mai Hau,
verses.29: Maun-alin sira, hau bele koalia lo-loos ba imi kona ba ita nia bei-ala David, katak nia mate ona no mos ema hakoi ona nia. No ninia rate sei iha ita nia leet too ohin loron.
verses.30: Nunee tanba David mak profeta ida, nia hatene katak Maromak jura ona ba nia katak Maromak sei tau ninia bei-oan ida iha ninia kadunan.
verses.31: Tanba nee David hatene uluk no dehan katak Kristu sei moris hias, no Maromak sei la husik Ninia klamar iha Fatin Mate, no mos Ninia isin sei la sai dodok.
verses.32: Maromak halo Jesus nee moris hias ona. No ami hotu sai sasin kona ba ida nee.
verses.33: Nunee tanba Nia sae ona ba Maromak nia liman loos, no Nia simu ona Espíritu Santu nebee Aman promete, Nia fakar buat nee, nebee imi haree no rona.
verses.34: Tanba David la sae ba lalehan, maibee nia rasik dehan,
verses.35: too Hau tau O nia inimigu sira iha O nia ain okos.”’
verses.36: Nunee Israel nia uma kain tomak bele hatene lo-loos katak Maromak halo Jesus nee, nebee imi prega ona ba krús, nudar Nai no Kristu.”
verses.37: Bainhira sira rona tiha nunee, sira nia laran kanek, no sira dehan ba Pedro no apostolu sira seluk, “Maun-alin sira, ami tenki halo saida?”
verses.38: Depois Pedro dehan ba sira, “Arepende ba, no imi ida-idak simu batizmu hodi Jesus Kristu nia naran atu hetan perdua ba sala, no imi sei simu prezenti Espíritu Santu nian.
verses.39: Tanba promesa nee ba imi, no ba imi nia oan sira, no ba ema hotu nebee dook, ema hotu nebee Nai, ita nia Maromak, sei bolu.”
verses.40: Pedro koalia liafuan barak hodi foo sasin no foo korajen ba sira, no dehan, “Salva aan hosi jerasaun aat nee.”
verses.41: Depois sira nebee simu ninia liafuan ho laran kontenti hetan batizmu. Iha loron nee, sira aumenta maizoumenus ema nain rihun tolu.
verses.42: Sira kontinua tuir metin ba apostolu sira nia hanorin no lao hamutuk, silu paun no halo orasaun.
verses.43: Ema hotu tauk sira. Tanba apostolu sira halo milagre no sinál barak.
verses.44: No ema hotu nebee fiar halibur hamutuk, no sira fahe buat hotu nebee sira iha ba malu.
verses.45: Sira faan sira nia riku-soin no sasaan, no fahe osan nee ba ema hotu, tuir buat nebee ema ida-idak presiza.
verses.46: Loro-loron, sira halibur hamutuk iha Templu no silu paun hosi uma ba uma. Sira haan sira nia hahaan ho haksolok no laran luak.
verses.47: Sira hahii Maromak, no simu favór hosi povu tomak. No loro-loron, Nai aumenta sira nia igreja ho ema nebee hakarak simu salvasaun.

verses.1: Pedro no João sae ba Templu iha oras orasaun nian, nebee tuku tolu lokraik.
verses.2: No iha mane ida nebee ain aat hosi moris mai kedas. Loro-loron ema lori nia no tau nia iha Templu nia portaun ida naran Furak, atu nunee nia bele husu ezmola hosi sira nebee tama ba Templu.
verses.3: Bainhira nia haree Pedro no João atu tama ba Templu, nia husu ezmola.
verses.4: Pedro, no mos João, fihir ba nia no dehan, “Hateke mai ami.”
verses.5: No nia foo atensaun ba sira, tanba nia hanoin atu simu buat ruma hosi sira.
verses.6: Depois Pedro dehan, “Hau la iha osan mutin ka osan mean, maibee buat nebee hau iha mak hau foo ba o. Hodi Jesus Kristu hosi Nazaré nia naran, hamriik no lao ba!”
verses.7: Pedro kaer ninia liman loos no ajuda nia hamriik. No ninia ain no ain fukun sai forti kedas.
verses.8: No nia haksoit no hahuu lao. Nia tama ba Templu ho sira no nia lao, haksoit no hahii Maromak.
verses.9: Povu hotu nee haree nia lao no hahii Maromak.
verses.10: Sira hatene katak nia mak ema nebee tuur hodi husu ezmola iha Portaun Furak iha Templu. No sira admira no hakfodak tebes kona ba buat nebee akontese ba nia.
verses.11: Bainhira mane nee kaer dadaun Pedro no João, povu hotu admira tebes no halai hamutuk ba sira iha portiku nebee bolu Salomão nian.
verses.12: Bainhira Pedro haree ida nee, nia dehan ba povu, “Ema Israel, tanba saa mak imi hakfodak kona ba ida nee? Ka tanba saa mak imi hateke mai ami atu hanoin katak liu hosi ami nia kbiit rasik ka hahalok santu mak ami halo mane nee lao?
verses.13: Abraão nia Maromak, Isak nia Maromak, no Jacó nia Maromak, nebee ita nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak, foo ona glória ba Ninia Atan Jesus. Imi entrega Nia no nega Nia iha Pilatos nia oin, maski Pilatos desidi ona atu husik Nia.
verses.14: Maibee imi nega Ida Nebee Santu no Loos, no imi husu fali atu hetan ema nebee mak oho door.
verses.15: Imi oho Moris Nia Huun, maibee Maromak halo Nia moris hias ona. No ami mak sasin ba ida nee.
verses.16: No hodi Ninia naran, no liu hosi fiar ba Ninia naran, mak mane nee sai forti, nebee imi haree no hatene. Fiar ba Jesus mak foo saude kompletu ba mane nee iha imi hotu nia oin.
verses.17: Agora, maun-alin sira, hau hatene katak imi la hatene buat nebee imi halo ona nee, hanesan mos imi nia nai ulun sira.
verses.18: Maibee buat nebee Maromak foo sai nanis ona liu hosi profeta hotu nia ibun, katak Kristu sei hetan terus, buat nee Nia kumpri ona.
verses.19: Nunee arepende ba, no fila fali ba Maromak hodi Nia bele hamoos imi nia sala, no imi bele hetan tempu hakmatek iha Nai nia prezensa.
verses.20: No Nia bele haruka Kristu nebee Nia foo ona ba imi, nee mak Jesus.
verses.21: Lalehan tenki simu Jesus too tempu atu halo buat hotu sai foun. Maromak koalia ona hosi tempu antigu kona ba tempu nee liu hosi Ninia profeta santu sira nia ibun.
verses.22: Tanba Moisés dehan, ‘Nai, imi nia Maromak, sei foti Profeta ida ba imi hosi imi nia maun-alin sira nia leet, nebee hanesan hau. Imi tenki rona buat hotu nebee mak Nia hatete ba imi.
verses.23: No ida nee sei akontese, katak ema hotu nebee la rona tuir Profeta nee sei lakon hosi ninia povu nia leet.’
verses.24: No profeta hotu nebee koalia ona, hosi Samuel no sira nebee tuir nia, sira mos foo sai kona ba tempu agora nee.
verses.25: Imi mak profeta sira nia oan, no oan hosi aliansa nebee Maromak halo ona ho imi nia bei-ala sira, bainhira Nia dehan ba Abraão, ‘Liu hosi o nia bei-oan mak família hotu iha mundu sei hetan bensaun.’
verses.26: Maromak hili tiha ona Ninia Atan no haruka Nia uluk ba imi, atu foo bensaun ba imi, no fila imi ida-idak hosi imi nia hahalok aat.”

verses.1: Bainhira Pedro no João koalia hela ba povu nee, saserdote sira, xefi seguransa hosi Templu no ema Saduseu sira mai hasoru sira.
verses.2: Ema sira nee hanoin barak tanba sira hanorin povu no haklaken liu hosi Jesus kona ba moris hias hosi mate.
verses.3: Sira kaer apostolu nain rua nee no hatama ba komarka too aban, tanba rai nakaras ona.
verses.4: Maibee ema barak nebee rona tiha liafuan nee fiar kedas. No ema mane nee aumenta too maizoumenus rihun lima.
verses.5: Loron tuir mai, ema sira nia nai ulun sira, katuas sira, no eskriba sira halibur hamutuk iha Jerusalém.
verses.6: Sira mai hamutuk ho saserdote boot naran Anas, no Kaifas, João, Alexandre, no ema hotu hosi saserdote boot nia família.
verses.7: No bainhira sira tau apostolu nain rua nee iha sira nia klaran, sira husu, “Liu hosi kbiit saida ka hodi naran saida mak imi halo ida nee?”
verses.8: Nunee Pedro, nakonu ho Espíritu Santu, dehan ba sira, “Nai ulun sira ba povu nee no katuas sira,
verses.9: se ohin loron imi husu ami kona ba servisu diak nebee ami halo ba ema aleijadu nee no oinsaa mak nia hetan isin diak,
verses.10: entaun ami foo hatene ba imi hotu, no povu hotu iha Israel, katak liu hosi Jesus Kristu hosi Nazaré nia naran, nebee imi prega ona ba krús, nebee Maromak halo moris hias ona hosi mate, liu hosi Nia mak ema nee hamriik iha imi nia oin ho saude diak.
verses.11: Nia mak Fatuk no imi mak badaen sira nebee rejeita Nia, maibee Nia sai fali fatuk ulun iha lidun.
verses.12: La iha salvasaun iha ema seluk, tanba la iha naran seluk iha lalehan okos nebee Maromak foo ba ema hodi ita bele hetan salvasaun.”
verses.13: Bainhira sira haree Pedro no João nee brani, no hatene katak sira nain rua mak ema nebee la ba eskola no ema baibain, sira admira. No sira rekonhese katak ema nain rua nee uluk hamutuk ho Jesus.
verses.14: Maibee tanba ema nebee hetan ona isin diak hamriik hela iha sira nia oin, sira la bele dehan buat ida hasoru ema nain rua nee.
verses.15: Entaun sira haruka Pedro no João sai ba liur hosi tribunál hodi sira bele koalia ba malu.
verses.16: Depois sira dehan, “Ita bele halo saida ba ema sira nee? Tanba tebes ema hotu nebee hela iha Jerusalém hatene ona katak milagre ida akontese liu hosi sira. No ita la bele nega ida nee.
verses.17: Maibee atu ida nee la bele habelar tan iha povu nia leet, mai ita ameasa sira atu la bele koalia tan liu hosi Mane nee nia naran.”
verses.18: Entaun sira bolu ema nain rua nee no manda sira atu la bele koalia tan ka hanorin hodi Jesus nia naran.
verses.19: Maibee Pedro no João hataan no dehan ba sira, “Se ida nee loos iha Maromak nia oin atu rona tuir imi liu fali Maromak, imi bele desidi.
verses.20: Tanba ami la bele para atu koalia kona ba buat sira nebee ami haree no rona tiha ona.”
verses.21: Entaun bainhira sira ameasa tan ema nain rua nee, sira husik nain rua nee ba. Sira la hetan dalan ida atu foo kastigu ba sira tanba povu nee. Tanba ema hotu foo glória ba Maromak tanba buat nebee akontese ona.
verses.22: Tanba mane nebee simu milagre hodi hetan isin diak nee mak tinan haat-nulu resin.
verses.23: Bainhira Pedro no João sai livre ona, sira fila ba sira nia maluk sira, no konta buat hotu nebee xefi saserdote no katuas sira dehan ba sira.
verses.24: Rona tiha nunee, sira hotu hasae sira nia lian ba Maromak, no dehan, “Nai, O mak Maromak nebee halo lalehan, mundu no tasi, no buat hotu iha fatin sira nee.
verses.25: Hodi Espíritu Santu, O koalia liu hosi ami nia bei-ala David, nebee O nia atan,
verses.26: Liurai sira iha mundu hamriik,
verses.27: Tanba tebes ema iha sidade nee halibur hamutuk atu hasoru O nia Oan Santu Jesus, nebee O foo ona unsaun, inklui Herodes, Pónsio Pilatos, ho ema Jentiu sira, no povu Israel.
verses.28: Sira halo ona buat hotu nebee O nia liman no O nia hakarak desidi nanis ona atu akontese.
verses.29: No agora, Nai, haree sira nia liafuan ameasa nee no foo aten brani ba O nia atan sira, hodi ami bele kontinua foo sai O nia liafuan.
verses.30: Lolo O nia liman atu kura no halao sinál no milagre oi-oin hodi O nia Atan Santu Jesus nia naran.”
verses.31: No bainhira sira halo ona orasaun, rai nakdoko iha fatin nebee sira halibur hamutuk nee. No sira hotu sai nakonu ho Espíritu Santu, no sira foo sai Maromak nia liafuan ho aten brani.
verses.32: Ema hotu nebee fiar nee iha neon ida laran ida. La iha ema ida nebee dehan katak sasaan nebee nia iha mak ninian mesak, maibee sira fahe buat hotu hamutuk.
verses.33: Apostolu sira foo sai sira nia testemunha ho kbiit makaas kona ba Nai Jesus moris hias ona. No sira hotu simu grasa boot.
verses.34: La iha ema ida iha sira nia leet nebee falta buat ida. Tanba sira hotu nebee iha rai ka uma faan buat sira nee no lori mai osan hosi buat nebee sira faan.
verses.35: Depois sira rai osan nee iha apostolu sira nia ain. No apostolu sira fahe osan nee ba ema ida-idak tuir buat nebee nia presiza.
verses.36: Iha ema ida naran José, nebee apostolu sira hanaran Barnabé (katak ‘konsola door nia oan’), nebee ema Levi hosi rai Xipre.
verses.37: Nia faan toos ida nebee ninian no lori osan mai no tau iha apostolu sira nia ain.

verses.1: Maibee mane ida naran Ananias ho ninia feen Safira faan sira nia rai ida.
verses.2: Ananias kaer hela osan nee balu, no ninia feen hatene. Depois nia lori osan balu deit no tau iha apostolu sira nia ain.
verses.3: Maibee Pedro dehan, “Ananias, tanba saa mak o nia fuan laran sai nakonu ho Satanás too o bosok Espíritu Santu, no kaer hela osan balu hosi rai nia folin nee?
verses.4: Bainhira o seidauk faan rai nee, laos rai nee o nian? No bainhira o faan tiha, laos o bele halo saida deit ho osan nee? Tanba saa mak o hanoin atu halo buat nee iha o nia fuan laran? O la bosok ema, maibee o bosok Maromak.”
verses.5: Bainhira Ananias rona tiha liafuan nee, nia monu kedas ba rai, no nia iis kotu. No ema hotu nebee rona kona ba buat sira nee sai tauk tebes.
verses.6: Depois joven mane sira hamriik, falun nia, lori nia sai no hakoi nia.
verses.7: Liu tiha maizoumenus oras tolu, ninia feen tama mai, maibee nia la hatene saida mak akontese ona.
verses.8: No Pedro dehan ba nia, “Foo hatene mai hau, imi faan rai ho folin nee ka?” No nia dehan, “Loos, folin mak nee.”
verses.9: Pedro dehan ba nia, “Oinsaa mak imi hanoin hamutuk atu koko Nai nia Espíritu? Tebes, ain hosi sira nebee foin hakoi o nia laen nee mai too odamatan ona, no sira sei lori o sai.”
verses.10: Iha momentu nee kedas, nia monu ba rai iha Pedro nia ain no nia iis kotu. Bainhira joven mane sira tama mai, sira hetan feto nee mate ona, entaun sira lori nia sai no hakoi nia iha ninia laen nia sorin.
verses.11: Igreja tomak no ema hotu nebee rona kona ba buat sira nee sai tauk tebes.
verses.12: Apostolu halo sinál no milagre oi-oin ho sira nia liman iha povu nia leet. No sira hotu halibur hamutuk iha Portiku Salomão nian.
verses.13: Ema seluk la brani atu tama hamutuk ho sira, maibee ema seluk foo respeitu boot ba sira.
verses.14: No ema nebee fiar ba Nai aumenta ba beibeik. Ema lubun sira nee inklui mane no feto.
verses.15: Sira mos lori sai ema moras ba dalan, no tau iha kama no biti, atu nunee Pedro nia lalatak bele kona sira balu bainhira nia lao liu.
verses.16: Ema barak mos mai hosi aldeia-aldeia besik Jerusalém. Sira lori ema nebee moras no ema nebee simu terus hosi espíritu aat. No ema ida-idak hetan isin diak.
verses.17: Maibee saserdote boot hamriik, no ema hotu nebee hamutuk ho nia (nee mak ema Saduseu sira), no sira sai nakonu ho laran moras.
verses.18: Sira kaer apostolu sira, no tau sira iha komarka públiku.
verses.19: Maibee iha kalan, Nai nia anju loke odamatan iha komarka. Nia lori sira sai ba liur, no dehan,
verses.20: “Baa hamriik iha Templu, no koalia ba povu liafuan hotu kona ba Moris nee.”
verses.21: Rona tiha nunee, sira tama ba Templu iha dadeer-saan sedu no hanorin ema. Tuir mai, saserdote boot mai ho sira nebee hamutuk ho nia. Nia bolu tribunál mai halibur hamutuk, no katuas sira hotu hosi povu Israel. Depois nia haruka ema atu lori mai apostolu sira hosi komarka.
verses.22: Maibee bainhira guarda sira baa, sira la hetan apostolu sira iha komarka. Sira fila fali no foo hatene ba sira,
verses.23: no dehan, “Ami haree komarka nee taka metin hela no seguru, no seguransa sira hamriik hela iha odamatan oin. Maibee bainhira ami loke odamatan, ami la hetan ema ida iha laran.”
verses.24: Bainhira xefi seguransa hosi Templu no xefi saserdote sira rona tiha buat sira nee, sira sai bilaan no la hatene saida mak sei akontese hosi ida nee.
verses.25: Depois ema ida mai no foo hatene ba sira, “Haree took! Ema sira nebee imi tau iha komarka nee agora hamriik hela iha Templu no hanorin povu.”
verses.26: Nunee xefi seguransa ho guarda sira baa no lori apostolu sira mai. Maibee sira la kaer ho brutu, tanba sira tauk povu nee bele tuda fatuk ba sira.
verses.27: No bainhira sira lori apostolu sira mai, sira tau sira iha tribunál nia oin. No saserdote boot husu sira,
verses.28: no dehan, “Laos ami manda imi atu imi keta hanorin hodi naran nee? No tebes, imi halo nakonu Jerusalém ho imi nia hanorin. No imi hakarak atu foo sala ba ami kona ba Mane nee nia raan.”
verses.29: Depois Pedro no apostolu sira seluk nee hataan, “Ami tenki halo tuir Maromak duké ema.
verses.30: Ita nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak halo Jesus moris hias ona, nebee imi oho bainhira imi prega Nia ba ai huun ida.
verses.31: Maromak foti aas Jesus ba Ninia liman loos atu sai Nai Ulun no Salvadór, atu foo hahalok arepende ba Israel no perdua ba sala.
verses.32: Ami mak sasin ba buat sira nee, hamutuk ho Espíritu Santu, nebee Maromak foo ona ba sira nebee halo tuir Nia.”
verses.33: Rona tiha nunee, sira sai hirus makaas, no hakarak oho apostolu sira.
verses.34: Maibee ema Farizeu ida naran Gamaliel hamriik iha tribunál. Nia mak ema nebee hanorin lei no ema hotu respeita nia. Nia haruka ema lori apostolu sira sai ba liur too tempu uitoan.
verses.35: Nia dehan ba sira, “Ema Israel, hanoin di-diak kona ba buat nebee imi hakarak atu halo ba ema sira nee.
verses.36: Tanba molok tempu nee, Teudas mosu mai no foti aan nudar ema boot ida. Maizoumenus ema nain atus haat tuir nia. Ema oho nia no ema hotu nebee tuir nia namkari deit no buat nee para ona.
verses.37: Tuir tempu nebaa, Judas mosu mai hosi Galileia iha tempu sensus nian. Ema barak lao tuir nia. Maibee nia mos lakon no ema hotu nebee tuir nia namkari deit.
verses.38: No agora hau dehan ba imi kona ba asuntu ida nee, hadook aan tiha hosi ema sira nee no husik sira ba. Tanba se karik planu nee ka hahalok nee mai hosi ema, ida nee sei lakon deit.
verses.39: Maibee se ida nee mai hosi Maromak, imi la bele halakon ida nee. Ikus mai, karik imi halo funu hasoru Maromak!” Entaun sira simu ninia liafuan.
verses.40: Depois sira bolu fali apostolu sira, no baku sira ho sikote. No sira manda apostolu sira nee atu la bele koalia hodi Jesus nia naran. Depois sira husik apostolu sira baa.
verses.41: Apostolu sira sai hosi tribunál nia oin, no sira haksolok katak sira merese atu simu terus tanba Naran nee.
verses.42: No loro-loron iha Templu no iha uma hotu sira la para atu hanorin no haklaken katak Jesus mak Kristu.

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, bainhira eskolante sira aumenta ba beibeik, ema Helen sira hamriik hodi murmura hasoru ema Ebreu sira. Tanba sira nia feto faluk sira la hetan ai haan nebee fahe loro-loron.
verses.2: Entaun sira nain sanulu resin rua bolu mai disípulu hotu, no dehan, “Ida nee la loos katak ami tenki husik Maromak nia liafuan atu serví iha meza.
verses.3: Nunee maun-alin sira, hili mane nain hitu hosi imi nia leet nebee iha naran diak, nakonu ho Espíritu Santu no matenek klean. No ami bele foo knaar ba sira atu lori servisu nee.
verses.4: Maibee ami sei foo aan tomak ba orasaun no ministériu liafuan nian.”
verses.5: Ema hotu kontenti ho liafuan nee. Entaun sira hili Estevão, ema ida nebee nakonu ho fiar no Espíritu Santu, no Filipe, Prokoro, Nikanor, Timão, Parmenas, no Nicolau, hosi Antiokia nebee uluk muda ba relijiaun Judeu nian.
verses.6: Disípulu sira tau ema nain hitu nee iha apostolu sira nia oin. No apostolu sira halo orasaun no tau liman ba sira nain hitu nee.
verses.7: No Maromak nia liafuan habelar ba beibeik. No eskolante sira iha Jerusalém sai barak tebes. No saserdote barak mos halo tuir fiar nee.
verses.8: No Estevão, nebee nakonu ho grasa no kbiit, halo sinál boot no milagre sira iha povu nia leet.
verses.9: Depois ema balu mai hosi sinagoga naran Ema Livre, no ema Sirene, ema Alexandria, ema Silisia no ema Ázia sira. Ema sira nee mai diskuti malu ho Estevão.
verses.10: No sira la bele hasoru matenek klean no Espíritu nebee nia koalia nee.
verses.11: Depois ho hahalok sub-subar, sira haruka ema nebee dehan, “Ami rona nia koalia aat hasoru Moisés no Maromak.”
verses.12: No sira soran povu nee, no katuas sira, no eskriba sira. Sira mai hasoru nia, kaer nia no lori nia ba tribunál.
verses.13: Sira foti sasin falsu nebee dehan, “Mane nee la para atu koalia liafuan aat hasoru fatin santu nee no lei.
verses.14: Tanba ami rona tiha nia dehan katak Jesus hosi Nazaré sei halakon fatin nee, no sei troka kostumi sira nebee Moisés entrega mai ita.”
verses.15: No ema hotu nebee tuur iha tribunál hateke ba Estevão. No sira haree ninia oin hanesan anju nia oin.

verses.1: Saserdote boot dehan, “Buat sira nee loos ka?”
verses.2: Estevão dehan, “Maun-alin no aman sira, rona hau ba. Maromak Glória Nain hatudu Aan ba ita nia bei-ala Abraão, bainhira nia sei hela iha Mezopotámia, molok nia hela iha Haran.
verses.3: Maromak dehan ba nia, ‘Lao sai hosi o nia rai, no hosi o nia família, no tama ba rai nebee Hau sei hatudu ba o.’
verses.4: Depois nia sai hosi ema Kaldeia nia rai no hela iha Haran. Bainhira ninia aman mate ona, Maromak lori nia hosi fatin nebaa hodi tama mai iha rai nee, nebee agora imi hela dadaun.
verses.5: Maibee Maromak la foo liman rohan ida hosi rai nee ba nia, ain fatin ida mos lae. Maibee Maromak promete atu foo rai nee ba nia atu sai ninian, no ba ninia bei-oan sira tuir nia, maski nia oan la iha.
verses.6: No Maromak koalia hanesan nee, katak ninia bei-oan sira sei sai ema lao rai iha rai seluk, no katak ema iha rai seluk nee sei kastigu sira no hanehan sira ba tinan atus haat.
verses.7: Maibee Maromak dehan, ‘Hau sei tesi lia ba nasaun nebee sira serví. Hotu tiha, sira sei sai mai no adora Hau iha fatin nee.’
verses.8: No Maromak foo aliansa sirkunsizaun nian ba Abraão. No Abraão hetan Isak, no foo sirkunsizaun ba nia iha loron ualu. Isak hetan Jacó, no Jacó hetan família nia nai ulun sanulu resin rua.
verses.9: Família nia ulun sira nee faan José ba Ejitu tanba sira laran moras. Maibee Maromak hamutuk ho nia.
verses.10: Maromak salva nia hosi ninia terus hotu, no foo grasa no matenek klean ba nia iha Faraó nia oin, liurai hosi Ejitu. No Faraó foo knaar ba José nudar governadór ba Ejitu no Faraó nia uma kain tomak.
verses.11: Tuir mai, rai hamlaha boot mosu iha rai Ejitu no Kanaan, no sira hetan terus boot. No ita nia bei-ala sira la bele hetan ai haan.
verses.12: Maibee bainhira Jacó rona katak Ejitu iha batar, nia haruka ita nia bei-ala sira baa Ejitu ba dala ida.
verses.13: No bainhira sira baa Ejitu ba dala rua, José foo hatene ninia aan ba ninia maun-alin sira. No Faraó foin konhese José nia maun-alin sira.
verses.14: Depois José haruka sira baa bolu ninia aman Jacó, no ninia família tomak, ema nain hitu-nulu resin lima atu mai ba nia.
verses.15: Entaun Jacó tuun ba Ejitu. No nia ho ita nia bei-ala sira mate iha nebaa.
verses.16: No ema lori sira nia mate ruin baa Sikém no hakoi iha rate nebee uluk Abraão sosa ho osan folin ida hosi Hamor nia oan mane sira iha Sikém.
verses.17: Maibee bainhira tempu atu kumpri promesa besik ona, nebee Maromak jura ba Abraão, povu nee aumenta no sai barak iha Ejitu.
verses.18: Tuir mai, liurai seluk ukun nebee la konhese José.
verses.19: Liurai nee halo aat ba ita nia família. Nia haruka ita nia bei-ala sira husik sira nia kiik-oan sira iha liur atu sira la bele moris.
verses.20: Iha tempu nebaa mak Moisés moris. Nia bonitu iha Maromak nia oin. Ninia família hakiak nia iha ninia aman nia uma too fulan tolu.
verses.21: Bainhira sira husik Moisés iha liur, Faraó nia oan feto foti nia, no hakiak nia nudar ninia oan rasik.
verses.22: No Moisés simu hanorin tuir ema Ejitu sira nia matenek hotu. No nia iha kbiit boot iha liafuan no hahalok.
verses.23: Bainhira nia tinan haat-nulu, nia hanoin atu vizita ninia maluk sira, nebee ema Israel.
verses.24: Nia haree ema Ejitu halo aat ba ema Israel ida. Nia defende ema Israel nebee simu terus nee no baku ema Ejitu hodi selu fali terus nee.
verses.25: Tanba nia hanoin ninia maluk sira sei kompriende oinsaa Maromak foo salvasaun ba sira liu hosi ninia liman. Maibee sira la kompriende.
verses.26: Loron tuir mai, nia baa haree sira no ema Israel nain rua baku malu. Nia koko ajuda sira halo dame no dehan, ‘Mane sira, imi mak maluk sira. Tanba saa mak imi halo aat ba malu?’
verses.27: Maibee ema nebee halo aat ba ninia maluk dudu sees Moisés, no dehan, ‘See mak halo ita ukun nain no juis ida ba ami?
verses.28: Ita atu oho hau, hanesan horiseik ita oho tiha ema Ejitu nee?’
verses.29: Bainhira Moisés rona liafuan nee, nia halai no sai ema lao rai iha rai Midian. Iha nebaa nia hetan oan mane nain rua.
verses.30: Liu tiha tinan haat-nulu, anju ida mosu mai ba Moisés iha rai fuik maran, iha Foho Sinai, iha ai badak ida nebee lakan.
verses.31: Bainhira Moisés haree ida nee, nia admira. No bainhira nia hakbesik hodi haree tan, nia rona lian hosi Nai.
verses.32: Nai dehan, ‘Hau mak o nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak, Abraão nia Maromak, Isak nia Maromak, no Jacó nia Maromak.’ Moisés nakdedar, no nia la brani atu haree tan.
verses.33: Depois Nai dehan ba nia, ‘Hasai sandálias hosi o nia ain, tanba fatin nebee o hamriik mak rai santu.
verses.34: Hau haree duni Hau nia povu nia terus iha Ejitu. No Hau rona tiha sira nia halerik. No Hau tuun mai hodi salva sira. Agora mai, Hau sei haruka o baa Ejitu.’
verses.35: Uluk sira lakohi simu Moisés, no dehan, ‘See mak halo ita sai ukun nain no juis ida?’ Maibee depois Maromak haruka nia nudar ukun nain no hola-nain, liu hosi anju nebee mosu ba nia iha ai badak.
verses.36: Mane nee lori sira sai, no nia hatudu milagre no sinál sira iha rai Ejitu, no iha Tasi Teberau, no iha rai fuik too tinan haat-nulu.
verses.37: Nia mak Moisés, nebee dehan ba ema Israel sira, ‘Maromak sei foti Profeta ida ba imi hosi imi nia maluk sira nebee hanesan hau.’
verses.38: Nia mak ida nebee hamutuk ho povu Israel iha rai fuik ho anju nebee koalia ba nia iha Foho Sinai, no ba ita nia bei-ala sira. Nia simu liafuan moris hodi hatoo ba ita.
verses.39: Ita nia bei-ala sira lakohi halo tuir Moises maibee sira dudu nia sees. Iha sira nia fuan laran sira fila ba Ejitu.
verses.40: Sira dehan ba Arão, ‘Halo maromak sira ba ami atu lao iha ami nia oin. Tanba Moisés nee, nebee lori ami sai hosi rai Ejitu, ami la hatene saida mak akontese ba nia.’
verses.41: No iha tempu nebaa, sira halo karau oan, no oferese sakrifísiu ba ídulu nee. Sira haksolok ho buat nebee sira halo ho sira nia liman.
verses.42: Maibee Maromak fila oin, no husik sira adora forsa sira iha lalehan, tuir liafuan nebee hakerek nanis ona iha profeta sira nia livru,
verses.43: Imi foti sae Moloke nia tenda,
verses.44: Ita nia bei-ala sira iha Tenda Testemunha iha rai fuik. Maromak koalia ho Moisés no foo hatene oinsaa atu halo Tenda nee, tuir modelu nebee Moisés haree.
verses.45: Tuir mai, ita nia bei-ala sira lori Tenda nee ho Josué no tama ba rai nee. Sira hadau nasaun sira nebee Maromak duni sai iha ita nia bei-ala sira nia oin. No Tenda nee hela too tempu David nian.
verses.46: David hetan grasa iha Maromak nia oin. Nia husu atu buka fatin hodi Jakó nia Maromak bele hela.
verses.47: Maibee Salomão mak harii uma ba Maromak.
verses.48: Maski nunee, Ida Nebee Aas Liu la hela iha uma sira nebee ema nia liman mak halo, hanesan profeta dehan nanis ona,
verses.49: ‘Lalehan mak Hau nia kadunan,
verses.50: Laos Hau nia liman mak halo buat sira nee hotu?’
verses.51: Imi ema ulun toos no ema nebee la halo sirkunsizaun ba fuan laran no tilun. Imi sempre kontra Espíritu Santu. Hanesan imi nia bei-ala sira halo, nunee mos imi halo.
verses.52: Profeta ida nebee mak imi nia bei-ala sira la haterus? Sira oho ema sira nebee uluk foo sai kona ba Ida Nebee Loos nebee atu mai. No imi rasik faan no oho Nia.
verses.53: Imi simu lei nebee anju sira hatoo, maibee imi la halo tuir lei nee.”
verses.54: Bainhira sira rona tiha buat sira nee, sira sai hirus makaas no ruun nehan ba Estevão.
verses.55: Maibee Estevão, nebee nakonu ho Espíritu Santu, hateke sae ba lalehan, no haree Maromak nia glória, no Jesus hamriik iha Maromak nia liman loos.
verses.56: Nia dehan, “Tebes, hau haree lalehan nakloke, no Ema Nia Oan hamriik iha Maromak nia liman loos.”
verses.57: Maibee sira hakilar ho lian makaas, no taka sira nia tilun, no halai hamutuk ba nia.
verses.58: Sira soe nia ba sidade liur no tuda mate nia ho fatuk. No sasin sira tau sira nia ropa iha joven mane ida nia ain nebee naran Saul.
verses.59: Bainhira sira tuda dadaun Estevão, nia dehan, “Nai Jesus, simu hau nia espíritu.”
verses.60: Nia hakneak, no hakilar ho lian makaas, “Nai, keta foo sala nee ba sira.” Koalia tiha ida nee, nia toba mate.

verses.1: Saul konkorda ho Estevão nia mate nee. Iha loron nebaa, ema hahuu foo terus makaas ba igreja iha Jerusalém. No sarani sira namkari ba distritu hotu iha Judeia no Samaria, só apostolu sira deit mak hela iha Jerusalém.
verses.2: No ema nebee hamtauk Maromak lori Estevão hodi hakoi nia. No sira tanis lelir makaas kona ba nia.
verses.3: Saul kria problema barak ba igreja. Nia tama uma ida-idak, rasta sai mane no feto no hatama sira ba komarka.
verses.4: Nunee sira nebee namkari ba fatin seluk kontinua baa fatin hotu-hotu hodi haklaken evanjelhu.
verses.5: Filipe tuun ba sidade Samaria, no haklaken kona ba Kristu ba sira.
verses.6: No povu nee, ho laran ida deit, foo atensaun ba buat sira nebee Filipe dehan bainhira sira rona nia no haree milagre sira nebee nia halo.
verses.7: Tanba espíritu aat sira hakilar ho lian makaas no sai mai hosi ema barak nebee sira domina. No ema barak nebee isin maten no ain kudeik hetan kura.
verses.8: No ema haksolok tebes iha sidade nee.
verses.9: Maibee iha mane ida iha sidade nee, naran Simão. Uluk nia matan-dook no halo povu iha Samaria admira. Nia dehan katak nia rasik mak ema makaas.
verses.10: Ema hotu, hosi kiik too boot, foo atensaun ba nia. Sira dehan, “Mane nee mak kbiit hosi Maromak, nebee hanaran Makaas.”
verses.11: Sira foo atensaun ba nia tanba kleur ona nia halo sira admira ho ninia hahalok lulik nian.
verses.12: Maibee bainhira sira fiar Filipe nebee haklaken evanjelhu kona ba Maromak nia reinu no Jesus Kristu nia naran, sira simu batizmu, inklui mane no feto sira.
verses.13: Simão mos fiar. No bainhira nia simu batizmu, nia lao tuir Filipe. Simão admira kona ba milagre no sinál sira nebee Filipe halo.
verses.14: Bainhira apostolu sira iha Jerusalém rona katak Samaria simu Maromak nia liafuan, sira haruka Pedro no João ba sira.
verses.15: Pedro no João tuun ba no halo orasaun ba sira, atu sira bele simu Espíritu Santu.
verses.16: Tanba Espíritu seidauk tuun ba sira. Sira simu deit batizmu iha Nai Jesus nia naran.
verses.17: Pedro no João tau sira nia liman ba ema sira nee, no sira simu Espíritu Santu.
verses.18: Bainhira Simão haree katak Espíritu Santu mai ba ema liu hosi apostolu sira nia liman, nia oferese osan.
verses.19: No nia dehan, “Foo mos kbiit nee mai hau, atu bainhira hau tau hau nia liman ba see-see deit, sira bele simu Espíritu Santu.”
verses.20: Maibee Pedro dehan ba nia, “O nia osan sei lakon ho o, tanba o hanoin katak o bele sosa Maromak nia prezenti ho osan.
verses.21: O la iha parte ka fatin iha liafuan nee. Tanba o nia fuan laran la loos iha Maromak nia oin.
verses.22: Nunee arepende hosi o nia hahalok aat. Halo orasaun ba Maromak. Karik o nia hanoin iha o nia fuan laran bele hetan perdua.
verses.23: Tanba hau haree katak o iha hanoin moruk, no hahalok nebee la loos sei kastigu fali o.”
verses.24: Simão hataan, “Halo orasaun ba Nai tanba hau, katak buat sira nebee ita koalia la bele kona hau.”
verses.25: Bainhira sira foo sai no haklaken Nai nia liafuan, sira fila fali ba Jerusalém. No sira kontinua haklaken evanjelhu iha ema Samaria sira nia aldeia barak.
verses.26: Nai nia anju koalia ba Filipe, no dehan, “Hamriik ba, no baa diresaun súl nian. Lao tuir dalan nebee tuun hosi Jerusalém ba Gaza, nebee iha rai fuik maran.”
verses.27: Filipe hamriik no baa. No tebes, iha mane ida hosi Etiópia, nebee funsionáriu ida. Nia mak nai ulun ida hosi Kandase, liurai feto hosi ema Etiópia sira. Ema nee toma konta ba liurai feto nia riku-soin hotu. Foin dadauk, nia mai too Jerusalém hodi adora,
verses.28: no nia fila fali ba. Nia tuur iha ninia kuda kareta no lee hela surat profeta Isaias nian.
verses.29: Depois Espíritu dehan ba Filipe, “Hakbesik no lao hamutuk ho kuda kareta nee.”
verses.30: Entaun Filipe halai ba nia, no rona nia lee hela surat profeta Isaias nian. Filipe dehan, “Ita kompriende buat nebee ita lee ka lae?”
verses.31: Nia dehan, “Oinsaa mak hau bele kompriende, se la iha ema ida atu esplika mai hau?” No nia konvida Filipe atu sae no tuur ho nia.
verses.32: Nia lee iha fatin ida hosi eskritura nebee dehan,
verses.33: Ema hamoe nia no la foo justisa ba nia,
verses.34: Funsionáriu nee dehan ba Filipe, “Hau husu ita, profeta nee koalia kona ba see? Kona ba ninia aan rasik ka kona ba ema seluk?”
verses.35: Depois Filipe loke ninia ibun, no hahuu hosi eskritura nee, nia foo sai evanjelhu kona ba Jesus ba ema Etiópia nee.
verses.36: No bainhira sira baa dadaun iha dalan, sira mai too bee lihun ida. Funsionáriu nee dehan, “Haree took bee iha nee! Saida mak hapara hau atu simu batizmu?”
verses.38: Funsionáriu haruka ema para kuda kareta. No sira nain rua tuun ba bee, Filipe no funsionáriu, no Filipe foo batizmu ba nia.
verses.39: Bainhira sira sai hosi bee laran, Nai nia Espíritu lori sai Filipe. Funsionáriu nee la haree tan Filipe. No funsionáriu nee kontinua ninia viajen ho haksolok.
verses.40: Maibee Filipe mosu iha Azotus. No bainhira nia lao liu, nia haklaken evanjelhu iha sidade hotu too nia mai iha Sezareia.

verses.1: Maibee Saul kontinua ameasa Nai nia eskolante sira no koalia atu oho sira. Nia baa saserdote boot
verses.2: no husu surat sira ba sinagoga sira iha Damasku, katak se nia hetan ema hosi Dalan nee, maski mane ka feto, nia bele kesi sira no lori ba Jerusalém.
verses.3: Bainhira nia lao iha dalan no nia besik iha Damasku, derepenti naroman hosi lalehan leno haleu nia.
verses.4: Nia monu ba rai no rona lian ida nebee dehan ba nia, “Saul, Saul, tanba saa mak o halo terus mai Hau?”
verses.5: No nia dehan, “See mak Ita, Nai?” Nai dehan, “Hau mak Jesus nebee o haterus.”
verses.6: Nia nakdedar no bilaan, no nia dehan, “Nai, Ita hakarak hau halo saida?” Nai dehan ba nia, “Hamriik ba, no tama iha sidade. Depois o sei hatene saida mak o tenki halo.”
verses.7: Ema nebee lao hamutuk ho nia hamriik hela no la bele koalia. Sira rona lian nee maibee sira la haree ema ida.
verses.8: Saul hamriik hosi rai. Bainhira nia loke tiha ninia matan nia la bele haree buat ida. Entaun sira kaer nia liman no lori nia tama ba Damasku.
verses.9: Ba loron tolu nia la bele haree, no nia la haan ka hemu.
verses.10: Iha eskolante ida iha Damasku nebee naran Ananias. Nai koalia ba nia iha vizaun ida, no dehan, “Ananias.” Nia dehan, “Hau mak nee, Nai.”
verses.11: Nai dehan ba nia, “Hamriik ba, no tama dalan ida naran Loos. Husu iha Judas nia uma kona ba ema ida naran Saul, hosi Tarsu. Tanba tebes, nia halo hela orasaun.
verses.12: Nia haree ona iha vizaun ida ema ida naran Ananias mai no tau ninia liman ba nia, atu nia bele haree fali.”
verses.13: Depois Ananias hataan, “Nai, hau rona tiha ona hosi ema barak kona ba mane nee katak nia halo aat barak ba Ita nia santu sira iha Jerusalém.
verses.14: No nia iha nee ho kbiit hosi xefi saserdote sira atu kesi ema hotu nebee bolu ba Ita nia naran.”
verses.15: Maibee Nai dehan ba nia, “Lao ba, tanba nia mak Hau nia alat nebee Hau hili atu lori Hau nia naran ba ema Jentiu sira, liurai sira no ema Israel sira.
verses.16: Tanba Hau sei hatudu ba nia terus hotu nebee nia tenki simu tanba Hau nia naran.”
verses.17: Nunee Ananias lao ba, no nia tama ba uma nee. Nia tau ninia liman ba Saul, no dehan, “Maun Saul, Nai Jesus, nebee mosu ba ita iha dalan bainhira ita lao hela, Nia haruka hau atu ita bele haree fali no sai nakonu ho Espíritu Santu.”
verses.18: No derepenti buat ruma hanesan ikan nia kulit kiik kiik nee monu hosi Saul nia matan, no nia bele haree fali. Nia hamriik no simu batizmu.
verses.19: Bainhira nia simu hahaan, ninia isin forti fali. No Saul hela loron balu ho eskolante sira nebee iha Damasku.
verses.20: Saul haklaken kedas iha sinagoga sira kona ba Kristu, katak Nia mak Maromak nia Oan.
verses.21: No ema hotu nebee rona nia hakfodak. Sira dehan, “Laos nia mak ema nebee foo terus ba sira iha Jerusalém nebee bolu ba Naran nee? No laos nia mai iha nee atu halo hanesan, atu kesi sira no lori sira ba xefi saserdote sira?”
verses.22: Maibee Saul hetan kbiit liu tan, no nia halo konfuzaun ba ema Judeu sira nebee hela iha Damasku. Tanba nia prova katak Jesus mak Kristu. Saul Tenki Sai Hosi Damasku
verses.23: Liu tiha loron barak, ema Judeu sira koalia hamutuk no halo planu atu oho nia.
verses.24: Maibee Saul hatene sira nia planu. Sira hein iha portaun loron-kalan atu oho nia.
verses.25: Tuir mai, iha kalan, ninia eskolante sira lori nia no hatuun nia iha moru liur liu hosi bote ida.
verses.26: Bainhira Saul mai too Jerusalém, nia koko atu halibur hamutuk ho eskolante sira. Maibee sira hotu tauk nia no la fiar katak nia sai eskolante ida.
verses.27: Maibee Barnabé foti nia, no lori nia ba apostolu sira. Barnabé konta ba sira oinsaa Saul haree Nai iha dalan, no katak Nai koalia ona ho nia, no oinsaa iha Damasku nia haklaken ho brani hodi Jesus nia naran.
verses.28: Entaun nia lao ba-mai hamutuk ho sira iha Jerusalém. No nia haklaken ho aten brani hodi Nai nia naran.
verses.29: Nia koalia no diskuti malu ho ema Helen sira. Maibee sira buka atu oho nia.
verses.30: Bainhira maun-alin sira nee hatene ida nee, sira lori nia tuun ba Sezareia, no haruka nia baa Tarsu.
verses.31: Entaun igreja sira hetan tempu hakmatek iha rai tomak iha Judeia, Galileia no Samaria. Sira sai metin liu tan no lao ho laran nebee hamtauk ba Nai no simu kamaan hosi Espíritu Santu. No sira aumenta ba bei-beik.
verses.32: Tuir mai, bainhira Pedro lao ba-mai iha sira hotu nia leet, nia mos tuun ba santu sira nebee hela iha Lida.
verses.33: No iha nebaa nia hetan mane ida naran Eneias. Eneias toba deit iha ninia kama too tinan ualu ona, tanba nia ema aleijadu.
verses.34: Pedro dehan ba nia, “Eneias, Jesus Kristu kura ona o. Hamriik ba, no aruma o nia kama.” No nia hamriik kedas.
verses.35: Ema hotu nebee hela iha Lida no Saron haree nia, no sira hotu fila ba Nai.
verses.36: Iha Jope iha eskolante ida naran Tabita, nebee bele tradus ba Dorcas. Feto nee nakonu ho hahalok diak no karidade.
verses.37: Iha tempu nebaa, nia moras, no nia mate. Bainhira sira foo hariis tiha ninia mate isin, sira tau nia iha kuartu iha andar leten.
verses.38: Lida besik Jope no eskolante sira rona katak Pedro mak iha nebaa. Nunee sira haruka ema nain rua ba nia, atu husu nia, “Favór ida, mai lai, no keta demora.”
verses.39: Entaun Pedro hamriik no baa kedas ho sira. Bainhira nia too, sira lori nia ba kuartu iha andar leten. Feto faluk hotu hamriik hela no tanis. Sira hatudu ropa no tais ba Pedro nebee Dorcas halo bainhira nia hamutuk ho sira.
verses.40: Maibee Pedro haruka sira sai ba liur. Depois nia hakneak no halo orasaun. Nia fila oin ba mate isin nee no dehan, “Tabita, hadeer ba.” No Dorcas loke ninia matan. Bainhira Dorcas haree Pedro, nia tuur.
verses.41: Pedro kaer ninia liman no ajuda nia hamriik. Depois Pedro bolu santu sira no feto faluk sira, no hatudu ba sira Dorcas nebee moris fali.
verses.42: Ema hotu iha Jope tomak hatene kona ba ida nee, no ema barak fiar ba Nai.
verses.43: Pedro hela loron barak iha Jope ho ema ida naran Simão nebee habai animál kulit.

verses.1: Iha Sezareia iha mane ida naran Cornélio. Nia mak komandante ida ba kompanhia ida naran Batalhaun Itália.
verses.2: Nia mak ema loos nebee hamtauk Maromak hamutuk ho ninia uma kain tomak. Nia foo ezmola barak ba povu no sempre halo orasaun ba Maromak.
verses.3: Nia haree mo-moos vizaun ida maizoumenus tuku tolu lokraik. Iha vizaun nee, anju ida mai hosi Maromak ba nia, no dehan ba nia, “Cornélio.”
verses.4: Bainhira nia haree anju nee nia tauk no dehan, “Saida, Nai?” No anju dehan ba nia, “O nia orasaun no ezmola sira sae nudar buat nebee foo hanoin ba Maromak.
verses.5: Entaun agora, haruka ema ba Jope no bolu ema ida naran Simão, nebee ema bolu Pedro.
verses.6: Nia hela ho ema ida naran Simão nia uma nebee habai animál kulit. Ninia uma besik tasi.”
verses.7: Bainhira anju nebee koalia ba Cornélio sai ona, Cornélio bolu ema nain rua hosi ninia atan sira no soldadu ida nebee ema loos no hein nia.
verses.8: Nia konta buat hotu nee ba sira no haruka sira ba Jope.
verses.9: Loron tuir mai, bainhira sira lao dadaun no besik ba sidade, Pedro sae ba uma leten no halo orasaun, maizoumenus iha meiudia.
verses.10: Nia sai hamlaha tebes no hakarak haan. Maibee bainhira ema sei prepara hela hahaan, nia sai bilaan ho vizaun ida.
verses.11: Nia haree lalehan nakloke, no buat ida hanesan hena luan tuun ba nia, hanesan ema kaer lidun haat hodi hatuun ba rai.
verses.12: No animál oi-oin iha hena laran nee, inklui buat nebee dolar iha rai no manu sira iha loro leten.
verses.13: No nia rona lian ida nebee dehan, “Pedro, hamriik ona. Oho no haan ba.”
verses.14: Maibee Pedro dehan, “La bele, Nai. Tanba hau nunka haan buat ida nebee foer ka la moos.”
verses.15: Lian nee koalia fali ba nia ba dala rua, “Buat nebee Maromak halo moos, keta bolu foer.”
verses.16: Ida nee akontese dala tolu. Depois hena nee sae kedas ba iha lalehan.
verses.17: Bainhira Pedro hanoin hela iha ninia fuan laran kona ba vizaun nee katak saida, tebes, ema nebee Cornélio haruka foin husu kona ba Simão nia uma, no sira hamriik iha odamatan.
verses.18: Sira bolu no husu kona ba Simão, nebee ema bolu Pedro, katak nia hela iha nebaa ka lae.
verses.19: Bainhira Pedro hanoin hela vizaun nee, Espíritu dehan ba nia, “Tebes, ema nain tolu buka o.
verses.20: Hamriik no tuun ba kraik. Baa hamutuk ho sira no keta laran ru-rua, tanba Hau mak haruka sira.”
verses.21: Pedro tuun ba sira, no nia dehan, “Hau mak ema nebee imi buka. Tanba saa mak imi mai?”
verses.22: Sira dehan, “Cornélio, nebee komandante ida, mak mane nebee loos no hamtauk Maromak. Ema Judeu sira nia nasaun tomak koalia diak kona ba nia. Anju santu ida haruka nia atu bolu ita ba ninia uma hodi rona liafuan hosi ita.”
verses.23: Entaun Pedro konvida sira tama no hela ho nia. Loron tuir mai, Pedro baa hamutuk ho sira, no maun-alin balu hosi Jope mos akompanha nia.
verses.24: Loron tuir mai, sira tama tiha ba Sezareia. No Cornélio hein hela sira. Cornélio halibur hamutuk tiha ona ninia família no belun diak sira iha nebaa.
verses.25: Bainhira Pedro tama, Cornélio hasoru nia, no monu iha ninia ain, no adora nia.
verses.26: Maibee Pedro foti nia, no dehan, “Hamriik ba. Hau mos mane ida.”
verses.27: No bainhira Pedro koalia dadaun ho nia, Pedro tama ba uma laran no haree ema barak halibur hamutuk ona.
verses.28: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi rasik hatene ona katak lei bandu ema Judeu ida atu la bele hasoru malu ka vizita ema ida hosi nasaun seluk. Maibee Maromak hatudu ona hau katak hau la bele bolu ema ida foer ka la moos.
verses.29: Nunee bainhira imi bolu hau mai, hau mai kedas no la hanoin ida nee. Entaun hau husu tanba saa mak imi bolu hau?”
verses.30: No Cornélio dehan, “Loron haat liu ba, maizoumenus oras hanesan nee, iha tuku tolu lokraik, hau halo orasaun iha hau nia uma. No tebes, ema ida nebee hatais ropa nabilan hamriik iha hau nia oin.
verses.31: Ema nee dehan, ‘Cornélio, Maromak rona tiha o nia orasaun no Nia hanoin hetan o nia ezmola.
verses.32: Nee duni, haruka ema ba Jope hodi bolu mai Simão, nebee ema bolu Pedro. Nia hela iha Simão nia uma, besik tasi, ema nebee habai animál nia kulit.’
verses.33: Entaun hau haruka kedas ema ba ita. No ita hatudu laran diak atu mai. Nunee agora ami hotu hein iha nee iha Maromak nia oin hodi rona buat hotu nebee Nai haruka ita atu foo sai.”
verses.34: Entaun Pedro loke ninia ibun, no dehan, “Loos duni, hau haree katak Maromak la hanoin ema ida liu fali ema seluk.
verses.35: Maibee Nia simu ema hosi nasaun hotu nebee hamtauk Nia no halo buat nebee loos.
verses.36: Maromak haruka evanjelhu ba ema Israel, no haklaken dame liu hosi Jesus Kristu. Jesus mak Nai ba buat hotu.
verses.37: Imi hatene ona buat nebee akontese iha rai Judeia tomak, komesa hosi Galileia tuir batizmu nebee João haklaken.
verses.38: Maromak fui mina ba Jesus hosi Nazaré ho Espíritu Santu no kbiit. Nia baa iha nebee-nebee hodi halo diak no kura ema hotu nebee diabu halo terus, tanba Maromak hamutuk ho Nia.
verses.39: Ami mak sasin ba buat hotu nebee Nia halo iha ema Judeu sira nia rai no iha Jerusalém. No sira oho Nia bainhira sira tara Nia iha ai huun ida.
verses.40: Maromak halo Nia moris hias ona iha loron terseiru. Maromak halo Nia mosu mai,
verses.41: laos ba povu hotu, maibee ba ami nebee Maromak hili ona nudar sasin sira. Ami haan hemu ho Nia bainhira Nia moris hias ona hosi mate.
verses.42: Nia haruka ami atu haklaken ba povu no foo sasin katak Maromak foti Nia atu sai Juis ba ema moris no ema mate.
verses.43: Profeta hotu foo sasin katak ema hotu nebee tau fiar iha Nia sei hetan perdua ba sala liu hosi Ninia naran.”
verses.44: Bainhira Pedro koalia dadaun kona ba buat sira nee, Espíritu Santu tuun ba sira hotu nebee rona liafuan nee.
verses.45: No fiar nain sira, nebee iha sirkunsizaun no mai ho Pedro, hakfodak tanba Maromak fakar mos prezenti Espíritu Santu ba ema Jentiu sira.
verses.46: Tanba sira rona ema sira nee koalia ho lian oi-oin no hahii Maromak. Depois Pedro dehan,
verses.47: “See mak bandu sira atu la bele simu batizmu ho bee? Tanba sira simu ona Espíritu Santu hanesan ami.”
verses.48: No nia haruka sira atu simu batizmu hodi Jesus Kristu nia naran. Depois sira husu nia atu hela loron ruma ho sira.

verses.1: Apostolu sira no maun-alin sira nebee iha Judeia rona katak ema Jentiu sira mos simu Maromak nia liafuan.
verses.2: No bainhira Pedro sae too iha Jerusalém, sira nebee hosi grupu sirkunsizaun haksesuk malu ho nia.
verses.3: Sira dehan, “Ita tama ba ema nebee la simu sirkunsizaun no haan hamutuk ho sira.”
verses.4: Maibee Pedro konta ba sira hosi hahuu tuir buat hotu nebee akontese. Nia dehan,
verses.5: “Bainhira hau iha sidade Jope no halo orasaun, hau sai bilaan ho vizaun ida. No hau haree buat ida hanesan hena boot ida nebee tuun hosi lalehan liu hosi lidun haat. Buat nee tuun mai too hau.
verses.6: Hau hateke di-diak no haree animál ain haat, animál fuik, buat nebee dolar, no manu sira hosi loro leten.
verses.7: Depois Hau rona lian ida dehan mai hau, ‘Pedro, hamriik ona. Oho no haan ba.’
verses.8: Maibee Hau dehan, ‘La bele, Nai. Tanba buat nebee foer ka la moos nunka tama iha hau nia ibun.’
verses.9: Maibee lian hosi lalehan nee hataan hau ba dala rua, ‘Buat nebee Maromak halo moos, keta bolu foer.’
verses.10: Ida nee akontese dala tolu. Depois buat hotu nee sae fali ba lalehan.
verses.11: No tebes, iha momentu nee, ema nain tolu mai too uma nebee ami hela. Mane ida haruka sira hosi Sezareia hodi buka hau.
verses.12: No Espíritu haruka hau atu baa ho sira, no keta laran ru-rua. Maun-alin nain neen nee mos baa hamutuk ho hau, no ami tama ba mane nee nia uma.
verses.13: Nia konta ba ami oinsaa nia haree anju ida iha ninia uma. Anju nee hamriik no dehan ba nia, ‘Haruka ema ba Jope no lori mai Simão, nebee ema bolu Pedro.
verses.14: Nia sei foo sai liafuan. Liu hosi liafuan nee o no o nia uma kain tomak bele hetan salvasaun.’
verses.15: No bainhira hau hahuu koalia, Espíritu Santu tuun ba sira hanesan ba ami iha tempu hahuu.
verses.16: Depois hau hanoin hetan Nai nia liafuan, nebee Nia dehan, ‘João foo batizmu ho bee, maibee imi sei simu batizmu ho Espíritu Santu.’
verses.17: Entaun se Maromak foo prezenti nee ba sira hanesan Nia foo mos mai ita bainhira ita fiar ba Nai Jesus Kristu, oinsaa mak hau bele taka dalan ba Maromak?”
verses.18: Bainhira sira rona tiha buat sira nee, sira nonook deit. No sira foo glória ba Maromak, no dehan, “Entaun Maromak foo mos ba ema Jentiu sira atu arepende hodi hetan moris.”
verses.19: Uluk, bainhira Estevão mate, ema haterus sarani sira. No sira namkari tanba terus nee no baa too rai Fenísia, Xipre no Antiokia. Maibee sira haklaken liafuan ba ema Judeu sira deit.
verses.20: Ema sira nee balu hosi Xipre no Sirene. Bainhira sira too iha Antiokia, sira koalia mos ba ema Helen sira no haklaken kona ba Nai Jesus.
verses.21: No Nai nia liman mak hamutuk ho sira. Ema barak fiar no fila ba Nai.
verses.22: Igreja iha Jerusalém rona kona ba ida nee. Entaun sira haruka Barnabé atu baa too iha Antiokia.
verses.23: Bainhira nia too, nia haree Maromak nia grasa. Nia kontenti no foo korajen ba sira hotu atu kontinua ho laran metin ba Nai.
verses.24: Tanba Barnabé mak ema diak. Nia nakonu ho Espíritu Santu no fiar. No ema barak tan fiar ba Nai.
verses.25: Depois Barnabé baa Tarsu hodi buka Saul.
verses.26: Bainhira nia hetan Saul, nia lori Saul ba Antiokia. Sira halibur hamutuk ho igreja nee durante tinan ida tomak no hanorin ema barak. Iha Antiokia mak foin ema komesa bolu eskolante sira Kristaun.
verses.27: Iha tempu nebaa, profeta sira tuun mai hosi Jerusalém ba Antiokia.
verses.28: No ida naran Agabus foo sai liu hosi Espíritu katak rai hamlaha boot sei akontese iha mundu tomak (ida nee akontese iha Cláudio nia tempu).
verses.29: Entaun eskolante sira, tuir ida-idak nia kbiit, desidi atu haruka ajuda ba maun-alin sira nebee hela iha Judeia.
verses.30: No sira halo ida nee duni, hodi haruka ajuda ba katuas sira liu hosi Barnabé no Saul nia liman.

12.title: Herodes Oho Tiago No Kastigu Pedro

verses.1: Iha tempu nebaa, liurai Herodes lolo ninia liman atu halo terus ba ema balu hosi igreja.
verses.2: Nia oho Tiago, João nia maun, ho surik.
verses.3: Bainhira nia haree ida nee halo ema Judeu sira kontenti, nia desidi atu kaer mos Pedro. Iha tempu nebaa sira halo festa Paun Fermentu Laek.
verses.4: Bainhira nia kaer ona Pedro, nia tau Pedro iha komarka. Nia entrega Pedro ba soldadu grupu haat atu tau matan ba nia. Grupu ida-idak iha soldadu nain haat. Tanba nia hanoin atu hein too Páskua hotu mak foin hatudu Pedro ba povu.
verses.5: Nunee Pedro hela iha komarka. Maibee igreja kontinua halo orasaun ho laran manas ba Maromak tanba nia.
verses.6: Bainhira Herodes hanoin atu lori nia sai, iha kalan nee duni, Pedro toba dukur iha soldadu nain rua nia klaran. Sira kesi nia ho korenti no guarda sira hein iha odamatan oin ba komarka nee.
verses.7: No tebes, Nai nia anju mosu mai ba Pedro, no naroman ida nabilan iha komarka. Anju nee baku Pedro nia sorin hodi fanu nia, no dehan, “Hamriik lalais!” No korenti sira monu hosi ninia liman.
verses.8: Anju nee dehan ba nia, “Hatais aan, no kesi o nia sandálias.” Pedro halo tuir. Anju dehan ba nia, “Hatais o nia unuk no tuir hau.”
verses.9: Depois nia lao sai no tuir anju. Nia la hatene katak buat nebee anju halo dadaun nee mak realidade, maibee nia hanoin katak nia haree vizaun ida.
verses.10: Bainhira sira liu ona guarda primeiru no segundu, sira mai too portaun besi nebee tama ba sidade. Portaun nee nakloke deit ba sira no sira lao sai. Sira kontinua lao liu dalan ida. Depois anju sees hosi nia.
verses.11: Bainhira Pedro hanoin lo-loos, nia dehan, “Agora hau hatene duni katak Nai haruka tiha ona Ninia anju no salva hau hosi Herodes nia liman, no hosi povu Judeu sira nia planu hotu.”
verses.12: Bainhira nia hatene ona ida nee, nia baa Maria nia uma. Maria mak João nia inan. João nia naran seluk mak Marcos. Iha nebaa ema barak halibur hamutuk no halo hela orasaun.
verses.13: Pedro dere odamatan iha dalan no atan feto ida naran Rode mai atu haree.
verses.14: Bainhira nia rona Pedro nia lian, nia la loke odamatan tanba nia haksolok liu. Maibee nia halai no foo hatene katak Pedro hamriik iha odamatan liur.
verses.15: No sira dehan ba nia, “O bulak!” Maibee nia dehan nafatin katak ida nee loos duni. Entaun sira dehan, “Nee mak Pedro nia anju.”
verses.16: Maibee Pedro kontinua dere odamatan. Bainhira sira loke tiha odamatan no haree nia, sira hakfodak.
verses.17: Maibee nia foo sinál ho liman atu halo sira nonook no nia konta ba sira oinsaa Nai lori nia sai hosi komarka. No nia dehan, “Foo hatene buat sira nee ba Tiago, no ba maun-alin sira.” Depois nia sai, no baa fatin seluk.
verses.18: Bainhira rai loron ona, soldadu sira hanoin barak kona ba buat nebee akontese ba Pedro.
verses.19: No bainhira Herodes buka ona nia, no la hetan nia, Herodes husu tan guarda sira, depois haruka ema oho sira. Tuir mai, nia tuun hosi Judeia ba Sezareia no hela iha nebaa.
verses.20: Herodes sai hirus makaas ho ema Tiro no Sidon. Entaun sira mai nudar ema ida deit atu hasoru nia. Sira hetan apoiu hosi liurai nia funsionáriu boot naran Blasto, no husu dame. Tanba sira nia rai depende ba liurai nia rai hodi hetan ai haan.
verses.21: Iha loron nebee sira marka, Herodes hatais ninia ropa liurai nian, tuur iha ninia kadunan, no halo diskursu ba sira.
verses.22: No povu nee hakilar, no dehan, “Ida nee lian hosi maromak ida, laos hosi ema ida!”
verses.23: Iha momentu nee kedas, Nai nia anju kona nia, tanba nia la foo glória ba Maromak. No ular haan tiha nia no nia iis kotu.
verses.24: Maibee Maromak nia liafuan haburas no habelar ba nafatin.
verses.25: Bainhira Barnabé no Saul halao ona sira nia ministériu, sira fila fali hosi Jerusalém. No sira lori João, nebee ema bolu Marcos.

verses.1: Igreja nebee iha Antiokia iha profeta no mestri sira: Barnabé, Simeão nebee ema bolu Niger, Lúcio hosi Sirene, Manaen nebee membru ida hosi ukun-nain Herodes nia konselhu, no Saul.
verses.2: Bainhira sira adora hela Nai no halo jejún, Espíritu Santu dehan, “Haketak Barnabé no Saul ba Hau hodi halo servisu nebee Hau bolu ona sira atu halo.”
verses.3: Entaun bainhira sira halo tiha jejún no orasaun, sira tau liman ba sira no haruka sira sai.
verses.4: Entaun, tanba Espíritu Santu haruka sira sai, sira baa Seléusia. No hosi nebaa sira sae roo ba Xipre.
verses.5: Bainhira sira too iha Salamina, sira haklaken Maromak nia liafuan iha ema Judeu nia sinagoga sira. No sira iha mos João hodi ajuda sira.
verses.6: Bainhira sira lao liu ilha tomak too iha Pafos, sira hetan matan dook ida nebee profeta falsu. Nia mak ema Judeu ida naran Bar-Jesus.
verses.7: Nia mak hamutuk ho xefi postu ba rai nee naran Sérgio Paulo, ema matenek ida. Xefi nee bolu Barnabé no Saul tanba nia hakarak rona Maromak nia liafuan.
verses.8: Matan dook nia naran bele tradus ba Elimas. Elimas kontra hasoru sira tanba nia hakarak halo xefi husik fiar nee.
verses.9: Entaun Saul (nebee ema bolu Paulo) nakonu ho Espíritu Santu, no hateke di-diak ba Elimas.
verses.10: No nia dehan, “O mak diabu nia oan. O mak inimigu ba hahalok loos hotu. O nakonu ho hahalok nebee bosok no aat. O sei la para atu halo kleuk Nai nia dalan loos ka?
verses.11: Agora, tebes, Nai nia liman sei kona o, no o sei sai matan delek. O sei la haree loro matan ba tempu balu.” No iha momentu nee kedas abu-abu mahar no nakukun tuun ba Elimas. Nia lao ba-mai buka ema atu kaer nia liman hodi lori nia.
verses.12: Bainhira xefi haree ida nee nia fiar, tanba nia hakfodak ho hanorin hosi Nai.
verses.13: Paulo no sira nebee hamutuk ho nia sae roo iha Pafos no baa Perga iha Pamfília. No João husik sira no fila fali ba Jerusalém.
verses.14: Maibee sira sai hosi Perga no baa too iha Antiokia nebee iha Pisídia. Sira tama ba sinagoga iha loron Sabdu no tuur iha nebaa.
verses.15: Bainhira ema lee tiha ona hosi Lei no Profeta sira, nai ulun sira hosi sinagoga nee haruka ema husu sira, no dehan, “Maun-alin sira, se imi iha liafuan ruma hodi foo korajen ba povu nee, koalia ba.”
verses.16: Entaun Paulo hamriik, no foo sinál ho ninia liman hodi dehan, “Ema Israel sira, no imi nebee hamtauk Maromak, rona ba.
verses.17: Povu Israel nia Maromak hili ita nia bei-ala sira, no foti aas povu nee bainhira sira hela nudar estranjeiru iha rai Ejitu. No ho liman forti Nia lori sira sai hosi rai nebaa.
verses.18: No durante tinan haat-nulu Maromak hatudu pasiénsia ba sira iha rai fuik.
verses.19: No bainhira Nia halakon ona nasaun hitu iha rai Kanaan, Nia fahe rai nee ba sira nudar liman rohan.
verses.20: Buat hotu nee haan maizoumenus tinan atus haat lima-nulu. Depois Nia foo juis sira ba povu nee too profeta Samuel.
verses.21: Tuir mai sira husu liurai ida. No Maromak foo Saul, Kis nia oan mane, ba sira. Nia mak ema hosi suku Benjamin. No Saul ukun too tinan haat-nulu.
verses.22: Bainhira Nia hasai Saul, Nia foti David nudar sira nia liurai. Nia foo sai testemunha no dehan, “Hau hetan David, Jessé nia oan mane. Nia mak mane ida nebee tuir Hau nia fuan laran, no nia sei halo tuir buat hotu nebee Hau hakarak.”
verses.23: Hosi mane nee nia bei-oan, Maromak foti Salvadór ida ba Israel tuir Ninia promesa. Salvadór nee mak Jesus.
verses.24: Molok Jesus mai, João foo sai kona ba batizmu arepende nian ba povu Israel hotu.
verses.25: No bainhira João halo hotu ninia knaar, nia dehan, ‘Imi hanoin hau nee see? Hau laos Nia. Maibee, tebes, ema ida sei tuir hau. Hau la merese atu kore Ninia sandálias talin iha Ninia ain.’
verses.26: Maun-alin sira, nebee Abraão nia oan sira, no ema iha imi nia leet nebee hamtauk Maromak, Nia haruka ona liafuan salvasaun nian nee mai ita.
verses.27: Ema nebee hela iha Jerusalém, no sira nia nai ulun sira, la rekonhese Jesus. No sira la kompriende liafuan hosi Profeta sira nebee ema lee Sabdu Sabdu. Tanba nee sira kumpri liafuan nee bainhira sira kondena Nia.
verses.28: Maski sira la hetan razaun ida atu foo kastigu mate ba Nia, sira husu Pilatos atu oho Nia.
verses.29: No bainhira sira kumpri ona buat hotu nebee hakerek nanis ona kona ba Nia, sira hatuun Nia hosi ai huun, no tau Nia iha rate ida.
verses.30: Maibee Maromak halo Nia moris hias ona hosi mate.
verses.31: Durante loron barak nia laran Nia hatudu aan ba sira nebee uluk sae hosi Galileia ba Jerusalém hamutuk ho Nia. Depois sira sai Ninia sasin ba povu nee.
verses.32: No ami hatoo evanjelhu nee ba imi kona ba promesa nebee Maromak halo ba bei-ala sira.
verses.33: Nia kumpri ona promesa nee ba ami, nebee sira nia bei-oan sira. Tanba Nia halo Jesus moris hias ona. Ida nee tuir buat nebee hakerek nanis ona iha Salmu segundu,
verses.34: No kona ba Maromak halo Jesus moris hias ona hosi mate, no Ninia isin sei la sai dodok, Nia dehan ida nee,
verses.35: Nunee Nia dehan mos iha Salmu seluk, ‘O sei la husik O nia Ema Santu atu sai isin dodok.’
verses.36: Tanba bainhira David serví tiha ona Maromak nia hakarak ba ninia jerasaun, nia mate. Depois sira tau nia hamutuk ho ninia bei-ala sira no nia sai isin dodok.
verses.37: Maibee Nia nebee Maromak halo moris hias ona la sai isin dodok.
verses.38: Nunee hatene ba, maun-alin sira, ami foo sai ba imi katak perdua ba sala mai liu hosi Mane nee.
verses.39: Imi la bele sai loos liu hosi Moisés nia lei. Maibee ema hotu nebee fiar bele sai loos hosi buat hotu liu hosi Nia.
verses.40: Nunee kuidadu katak liafuan hosi profeta sira la bele akontese:
verses.41: ‘Haree ba, imi goza door sira,
verses.42: Bainhira sira sai dadaun, ema sira nee husu sira atu bele koalia kona ba liafuan nee ba sira iha Sabdu oin.
verses.43: Bainhira sinagoga taka tiha, ema Judeu barak no fiar nain sira tuir Paulo no Barnabé. Paulo no Barnabé koalia ba sira no foo korajen ba sira atu lao nafatin iha Maromak nia grasa.
verses.44: Iha loron Sabdu tuir mai, besik ema hotu hosi sidade nee halibur hamutuk atu rona Nai nia liafuan.
verses.45: Maibee bainhira ema Judeu sira haree ema lubun boot nee, sira sai laran moras tebes. Sira hahuu kontra liafuan hosi Paulo no koalia aat ba nia.
verses.46: Depois Paulo no Barnabé koalia ho aten brani, no dehan, “Tuir lo-loos ami tenki foo sai Maromak nia liafuan uluk ba imi. Maibee tanba imi dudu sees liafuan nee, no desidi katak imi la merese atu simu moris rohan laek, tebes, ami sei fila ba ema Jentiu sira.
verses.47: Tanba Nai haruka ami, no dehan,
verses.48: Bainhira ema Jentiu sira rona tiha ida nee, sira haksolok no foo glória ba Nai nia liafuan. No ema hotu nebee Maromak hili ona atu simu moris rohan laek, ema sira nee fiar.
verses.49: No Nai nia liafuan habelar tan ba rejiaun nee tomak.
verses.50: Maibee ema Judeu sira lori lia ba feto naran boot sira nebee hamtauk Maromak, no mos sidade nia nai ulun sira, hanehan Paulo no Barnabé, no duni sai sira nain rua hosi sira nia distritu.
verses.51: Maibee sira nain rua liki rai rahun hosi sira nia ain hasoru ema sira nee. Depois sira baa Ikónio.
verses.52: No eskolante sira sai nakonu ho laran haksolok no ho Espíritu Santu.

verses.1: Iha Ikónio, sira tama hamutuk ba ema Judeu sira nia sinagoga, no koalia ho liafuan nebee halo ema Judeu no ema Gregu barak fiar.
verses.2: Maibee ema Judeu sira nebee la fiar lori lia ba ema Jentiu sira, no halo sira hanoin aat ba maun-alin sira nee.
verses.3: Entaun sira hela kleur iha nebaa no koalia ho aten brani kona ba Nai. No Nai foo sasin ba liafuan kona ba Ninia grasa ho sinál no milagre sira nebee Nia foo liu hosi sira nia liman.
verses.4: Maibee povu hosi sidade nee fahe ba rua. Balu tuir ema Judeu sira, no balu tuir apostolu sira.
verses.5: Ema Jentiu sira no ema Judeu sira, hamutuk ho sira nia nai ulun sira, koko atu ataka no tuda fatuk ba Paulo no Barnabé.
verses.6: Maibee Paulo no Barnabé rona kona ba planu nee no halai ba Listra no Derbe, sidade sira iha Likaónia, no mos ba rejiaun iha nebaa.
verses.7: No iha nebaa sira kontinua haklaken evanjelhu.
verses.8: Ema ida nebee iha ain fraku tuur iha Listra. Nia ain kudeik hosi nia moris mai, nunee nia nunka lao.
verses.9: Ema nee rona Paulo koalia. Paulo fihir di-diak nia no haree katak nia iha fiar atu hetan isin diak.
verses.10: Entaun Paulo dehan ho lian makaas, “Hamriik ba iha o nia ain.” No ema nee haksoit sae kedas no komesa lao.
verses.11: Bainhira povu haree buat nebee Paulo halo nee, sira hakilar iha lian Likaónia nian, “Nee mak maromak sira nebee tuun mai ba ita ho oin hanesan ema!”
verses.12: Sira hanaran Barnabé ‘Zeus’ no Paulo ‘Hermes’, tanba nia baibain koalia.
verses.13: Amu lulik hosi Zeus iha templu nebee iha fatin nebee tama ba sidade. No nia lori karau no ai funan ba portaun tanba nia hakarak halo sakrifísiu ho ema lubun nee.
verses.14: Bainhira apostolu Barnabé no Paulo rona tiha ida nee, sira lees sira nia ropa, no halai ba iha ema lubun nee nia leet. Sira hakilar dehan,
verses.15: “Maluk sira, tanba saa mak imi halo buat sira nee? Ami mos ema hanesan imi. Ami haklaken ba imi atu imi fila hosi buat mamuk sira nee ba Maromak nebee moris. Nia mak halo lalehan, mundu, tasi, no buat hotu iha laran.
verses.16: Iha tempu uluk Nia husik nasaun sira lao tuir sira ida-idak nia dalan.
verses.17: Maski nunee, Nia sempre foo sasin tanba Nia halo diak. Nia foo udan hosi lalehan no ai fuan tuir tempu, hodi halo imi nia laran nakonu ho hahaan no haksolok.”
verses.18: Maski sira koalia liafuan nee sira iha difikuldade, maibee ikus mai sira konsege hanetik povu nee atu la bele halo sakrifísiu ba sira.
verses.19: Maibee ema Judeu sira mai hosi Antiokia no Ikónio, no konsege troka povu nia hanoin atu tuda fatuk ba Paulo. Depois sira rasta nia sai hosi sidade, tanba sira hanoin nia mate ona.
verses.20: Maibee bainhira eskolante sira halibur haleu nia, nia hamriik no tama ba sidade. Loron tuir mai nia ho Barnabé sai ba Derbe.
verses.21: Bainhira sira haklaken evanjelhu no halo eskolante barak iha sidade nebaa, sira fila fali ba Listra, Ikónio no Antiokia.
verses.22: Sira hametin eskolante sira nia laran, no foo korajen ba sira atu kontinua iha fiar. Sira dehan katak ita tenki liu hosi terus barak atu tama ba Maromak nia reinu.
verses.23: Sira foti ema nudar katuas sira iha igreja ida-idak. Sira halo orasaun no jejún, no entrega katuas sira nee ba Nai, nebee sira fiar.
verses.24: Depois sira lao liu Pisídia, no too iha Pamfília.
verses.25: Bainhira sira haklaken liafuan iha Perga, sira tuun ba Atália.
verses.26: Hosi nebaa sira sae roo ba Antiokia. Nee mak fatin nebee ema entrega sira ba Maromak nia grasa atu halo servisu nebee sira halo hotu ona.
verses.27: Bainhira sira too mai, sira halibur igreja mai hamutuk. Depois sira konta kona ba buat hotu nebee Maromak halo ho sira, no oinsaa Nia loke odamatan hodi ema Jentiu sira bele fiar.
verses.28: No sira hela kleur iha nebaa ho eskolante sira.

verses.1: Maibee ema balu tuun mai hosi Judeia no hanorin maun-alin sira, “Se imi la simu sirkunsizaun tuir kostumi hosi Moisés, imi la bele hetan salvasaun.”
verses.2: Paulo no Barnabé haksesuk malu no diskuti malu makaas ho sira. Entaun igreja nee desidi atu haruka Paulo no Barnabé, ho ema balu tan, atu sae ba Jerusalém hodi koalia ho apostolu sira no katuas sira kona ba asuntu nee.
verses.3: No bainhira igreja nee haruka ona sira, sira lao liu Fenísia no Samaria. Iha fatin nebaa sira konta buat hotu kona ba oinsaa ema Jentiu sira fiar. No liafuan nee foo ksolok boot ba maun-alin sira hotu.
verses.4: Bainhira sira mai too Jerusalém, igreja ho apostolu no katuas sira simu sira. No sira foo sai buat hotu nebee Maromak halo ona ho sira.
verses.5: Maibee ema balu hosi partidu Farizeu nian nebee fiar ona, hamriik no dehan, “Ita tenki foo sirkunsizaun ba ema sira nee, no haruka sira atu halo tuir lei hosi Moisés.”
verses.6: Apostolu sira no katuas sira halibur hamutuk hodi koalia kona ba asuntu ida nee.
verses.7: Bainhira sira diskuti ba-mai kleur ona, Pedro hamriik, no dehan ba sira, “Maun-alin sira, imi hatene uluk Maromak hili hau hosi imi nia leet hodi ema Jentiu sira bele rona liu hosi hau nia ibun kona ba evanjelhu no sira bele fiar.
verses.8: No Maromak, nebee hatene ema nia fuan laran, foo sasin bainhira Nia foo Espíritu Santu ba sira, hanesan Nia foo ona ba ita.
verses.9: Nia haree sira hanesan deit ho ita, no Nia hamoos sira nia fuan laran liu hosi fiar.
verses.10: Nunee tanba saa mak imi koko Maromak, atu tau ai leba todan iha eskolante sira nia kabaas, nebee ita nia bei-ala sira no ita mos la bele lori?
verses.11: Maibee ita fiar katak liu hosi Nai Jesus nia grasa ita sei hetan salvasaun, hanesan mos ho sira.”
verses.12: No ema hotu iha sorumutu nee sai nonook no rona ba Barnabé no Paulo. Nain rua nee konta kona ba milagre no sinál sira nebee Maromak halo iha ema Jentiu sira nia leet liu hosi sira.
verses.13: Bainhira sira koalia tiha ona, Tiago hataan, “Maun-alin sira, rona hau ba.
verses.14: Simeão deklara ona oinsaa uluk Maromak hanoin ema Jentiu sira hodi foti hosi sira povu ida ba Ninia naran.
verses.15: No profeta sira nia liafuan mos konkorda, tanba sira hakerek nanis ona,
verses.16: ‘Tuir mai, Hau sei fila fali, no harii fali David nia tenda nebee monu ona;
verses.17: hodi ema restu bele buka tuir Nai,
verses.18: nebee ema hatene hori uluk kedas.’
verses.19: Nee duni tuir hau nia hanoin, ita keta halo susar tan ba ema Jentiu sira nebee fila ba Maromak.
verses.20: Maibee ita sei hakerek ba sira atu hadook aan hosi buat sira nebee foer hosi ídulu sira, hosi sala seksuál, hosi animál nebee buti mate no hosi raan.
verses.21: Tanba hosi tempu antigu ema haklaken kona ba Moisés iha sidade hotu, no sira lee ninia liafuan Sabdu-Sabdu iha sinagoga sira.”
verses.22: Nunee apostolu sira no katuas sira, ho igreja tomak, konkorda atu hili ema balu hosi sira nia leet no haruka sira ba Antiokia ho Paulo no Barnabé. Entaun sira hili Judas, nebee ema bolu Barsabás, no Silas. Sira mak ema lideransa iha maun-alin sira nia leet.
verses.23: No sira hakerek surat ida nee: ‘Hosi maun-alin sira, inklui apostolu no katuas sira. Ba maun-alin sira nebee ema Jentiu sira iha Antiokia, Síria no Silísia. Kumprimentus!
verses.24: Ami rona katak ema balu sai hosi ami no kria problema ba imi ho liafuan ruma no halo imi nia laran dúvida maski ami la haruka sira.
verses.25: Nunee ami hanoin diak ho laran ida deit atu hili ema balu no haruka sira ba imi hamutuk ho ami nia doben Barnabé no Paulo.
verses.26: Sira hasoru ona perigu atu mate tanba ita nia Nai Jesus Kristu nia naran.
verses.27: Nunee ami haruka Judas no Silas, no sira mos sei hatoo liafuan hanesan nee ba imi liu hosi sira nia ibun.
verses.28: Tanba Espíritu Santu, no mos ami, hanoin atu la bele foo todan tan ba imi, liu fali buat nebee importante nee:
verses.29: katak imi hadook aan hosi buat sira nebee foer hosi ídulu sira, hosi raan, hosi animál nebee buti mate no hosi sala seksuál. Se imi hadook aan hosi buat sira nee, imi sei halo diak. Adeus.’
verses.30: Entaun bainhira apostolu sira husik sira, sira baa iha Antiokia. Bainhira sira halibur ema lubun boot hamutuk, sira entrega surat nee ba sira.
verses.31: Bainhira ema sira nee lee tiha surat nee, sira haksolok tanba sira simu korajen.
verses.32: Judas no Silas, nebee mos profeta sira, foo korajen ba maun-alin sira nee ho liafuan barak no hametin sira.
verses.33: Bainhira sira hela tiha iha nebaa too tempu ruma, maun-alin sira nee husik sira baa ho dame atu fila fali ba sira nebee haruka sira mai nee.
verses.35: Maibee Paulo no Barnabé kontinua hela iha Antiokia. Sira hanorin no haklaken Nai nia liafuan hamutuk ho ema barak tan.
verses.36: Liu tiha tempu ruma, Paulo dehan ba Barnabé, “Mai ita baa fali no vizita ita nia maun-alin sira iha sidade hotu nebee uluk ita haklaken Nai nia liafuan, no haree sira lao oinsaa.”
verses.37: Barnabé hakarak lori João ho sira, nebee ema bolu Marcos.
verses.38: Maibee Paulo hanoin la diak atu lori Marcos ho sira. Tanba nia husik sira iha Pamfília no la baa ho sira hodi halo servisu nee.
verses.39: Sira diskuti malu makaas tebes too sira fahe malu. Barnabé lori Marcos, no nia sae roo ba Xipre.
verses.40: No Paulo hili Silas. Maun-alin sira entrega sira ba Maromak nia grasa no sira sai ba.
verses.41: Depois nia lao liu Síria no Silísia hodi hametin igreja sira.
