verses.1: Paulo too Derbe no Listra. Iha eskolante ida naran Timóteo iha nebaa. Nia mak oan mane hosi feto Judeu ida nebee fiar. Maibee ninia aman mak ema Gregu.
verses.2: Maun-alin sira hosi Listra no Ikónio koalia diak kona ba nia.
verses.3: Paulo hakarak lao hamutuk ho nia. Entaun Paulo lori nia no foo sirkunsizaun ba nia tanba ema Judeu sira nebee hela iha nebaa. Tanba sira hotu hatene katak ninia aman mak ema Gregu.
verses.4: Bainhira sira lao ba sidade sira, sira hatoo desizaun ba maun-alin sira nebee apostolu no katuas sira halo tiha ona iha Jerusalém.
verses.5: Entaun igreja sira sai metin liu tan iha fiar, no loro-loron sira aumenta ba beibeik.
verses.6: Sira lao liu rejiaun Frígia no Galásia, tanba Espíritu Santu taka dalan ba sira atu haklaken liafuan iha Ázia.
verses.7: Bainhira sira too iha Mízia, sira koko atu tama ba Bitínia. Maibee Jesus nia Espíritu la husik sira atu baa nebaa.
verses.8: Entaun sira lao liu hosi Mízia no tuun ba Tróade.
verses.9: No Paulo hetan vizaun ida iha kalan. Nia haree ema Masedónia ida hamriik no husu nia, “Mai too iha Masedónia no ajuda ami.”
verses.10: Bainhira nia haree tiha vizaun nee, ami buka atu tama kedas ba Masedónia. Tanba ami hanoin katak Maromak bolu ona ami atu haklaken evanjelhu ba sira.
verses.11: Nunee ami sae roo iha Tróade, no ami baa loos deit too Samotrásia, no loron tuir mai too Neápolis.
verses.12: No hosi nebaa ami baa Filipe, nebee sidade boot iha distritu Masedónia. Sidade nee mos postu Roma nian. No ami hela loron balu iha sidade nee.
verses.13: Iha loron Sabdu, ami sai hosi sidade no lao ba mota ibun, tanba ami hanoin atu hetan fatin hodi halo orasaun. Ami tuur no koalia ba feto sira nebee halibur iha nebaa.
verses.14: No iha feto ida nebee rona ami naran Lídia, nebee baibain faan hena kór uvas. Feto nee hosi sidade Tiatira no nia adora Maromak. Nai loke ninia fuan laran atu rona di-diak ba buat nebee Paulo koalia.
verses.15: No bainhira nia simu ona batizmu hamutuk ho ninia uma kain, nia husu ami, no dehan, “Se imi hanoin katak hau fiar metin ba Nai, entaun tama mai hau nia uma, no hela iha nebaa.” No nia obriga ami too ami simu.
verses.16: Bainhira ami lao dadaun ba fatin orasaun nian, ami hasoru atan feto ida nebee iha espíritu nebee bele siik. Ninia patraun sira manaan osan boot hosi ninia servisu nebee nia siik futuru.
verses.17: Feto nee lao tuir Paulo no ami, no hakilar, “Ema sira nee mak Maromak Aas Liu nia atan sira nebee haklaken ba imi kona ba dalan ba salvasaun.”
verses.18: Nia halo nunee ba loron barak. Maibee Paulo sai baruk ho hahalok nee no nia fila oin no dehan ba espíritu, “Hau manda o hodi Jesus Kristu nia naran atu sai hosi nia.” No iha oras nee kedas, espíritu nee sai hosi nia.
verses.19: Bainhira ninia patraun sira haree katak sira la bele manaan tan osan liu hosi nia, sira kaer Paulo no Silas, no rasta sira ba ukun nain sira iha merkadu.
verses.20: Sira lori Paulo no Silas ba juis sira no dehan, “Ema Judeu sira nee halo rungu-ranga iha ita nia sidade.
verses.21: Sira hanorin kostumi sira nebee kontra ami nia lei. Nunee ami ema Roma la bele simu ka halo tuir kostumi sira nee.”
verses.22: No ema lubun nee halibur hamutuk hodi hasoru sira. Entaun juis sira lees sai tiha Paulo no Silas nia ropa no haruka ema baku sira ho ai.
verses.23: Bainhira ema baku sira dala barak ona, juis sira nee soe sira ba komarka laran no haruka guarda atu tau matan di-diak ba sira.
verses.24: Ho orden ida nee, guarda soe sira ba iha komarka laran liu no hatama sira nia ain iha ai kabelak kuak nebee xavi metin.
verses.25: Iha kalan boot, Paulo no Silas halo hela orasaun no kanta hahii Maromak. No ema dadur rona sira.
verses.26: Derepenti rai nakdoko makaas too komarka nia fundasaun mos nakdoko. Odamatan hotu nakloke kedas no ema dadur nia korenti nebee kesi sira namkore hotu.
verses.27: Depois xefi guarda iha komarka hadeer no haree komarka nia odamatan loke tiha. Entaun nia losu kedas ninia surik atu oho aan tanba nia hanoin ema dadur sira halai tiha ona.
verses.28: Maibee Paulo hakilar ho lian makaas no dehan, “Keta hakanek aan, tanba ami hotu sei iha nee.”
verses.29: Xefi guarda nee husu ahi oan no nia halai tama ba laran. Nia tauk no nakdedar. Nia monu iha Paulo no Silas nia oin.
verses.30: Depois nia lori sira sai, no dehan, “Senhor sira, hau tenki halo saida atu hetan salvasaun?”
verses.31: Sira dehan, “Fiar ba Nai Jesus no ita sei hetan salvasaun, ita no ita nia uma kain.”
verses.32: No sira koalia Nai nia liafuan ba nia, no ba ema hotu nebee iha ninia uma.
verses.33: Iha oras nee kedas, bainhira sei kalan hela, nia lori sira no fasi sira nia kanek. Depois nia no ninia família tomak simu kedas batizmu.
verses.34: Nia lori sira ba iha ninia uma laran no nia foo haan ba sira. No nia haksolok ho ninia uma kain tomak tanba nia fiar ona ba Maromak.
verses.35: Maibee bainhira rai loron ona, juis sira haruka polísia no dehan, “Husik ema sira nee sai tiha.”
verses.36: Xefi guarda foo hatene liafuan nee ba Paulo, no dehan, “Juis sira haruka ami husik imi ba. Entaun sai ba no lao ho dame.”
verses.37: Maibee Paulo dehan ba sira, “Sira baku ami iha ema hotu nia oin maski sira seidauk tesi lia ba ami nebee ema Roma. Depois sira soe ami ba komarka laran. No agora sira hakarak dudu ami sai sub-subar deit ka? La bele! Husik sira mai rasik no lori ami sai.”
verses.38: Polísia foo hatene liafuan nee ba juis sira. No sira sai tauk tebe-tebes bainhira sira rona katak Paulo no Silas mak ema Roma.
verses.39: Entaun juis sira mai no husu deskulpa ba sira. Depois juis sira lori sira sai no husu sira atu sai hosi sidade nee.
verses.40: Entaun sira sai hosi komarka no tama ba Lídia nia uma. Sira haree maun-alin sira no foo korajen ba sira. Depois sira sai ba.

verses.1: Bainhira sira lao liu Amfípolis no Apolónia, sira too iha Tesalónika nebee iha ema Judeu sira nia sinagoga ida.
verses.2: Hanesan baibain, Paulo tama ba sinagoga nee. No durante Sabdu tolu tu-tuir malu nia diskuti ba-mai ho sira ho liafuan hosi Eskritura sira.
verses.3: Nia esplika no prova katak Kristu tenki hetan terus no moris hias hosi mate. No nia dehan, “Jesus nee, nebee hau haklaken dadaun ba imi, mak Kristu.”
verses.4: Ema balu hosi ema sira nee fiar no tuir Paulo no Silas. No ema Gregu barak nebee hamtauk Maromak mos fiar. Feto boot sira balu mos fiar, no laos uitoan deit.
verses.5: Maibee ema Judeu sira sai laran moras. Sira foti ema aat balu nebee halimar deit iha merkadu no halibur ema lubun hodi halo rungu-ranga iha sidade nee. Sira ataka Jason nia uma no koko atu lori sira sai ba povu nee.
verses.6: No bainhira sira la hetan Paulo no Silas, sira rasta sai Jason no maun-alin balu. Sira lori ema sira nee ba ukun nain sira iha sidade, no hakilar dehan, “Ema sira nee halo rungu-ranga iha mundu tomak no sira mai iha nee mos.
verses.7: Jason simu ona ema sira nee. No sira hotu kontra César nia lei tanba sira dehan katak iha liurai seluk, nebee Jesus.”
verses.8: Bainhira povu no ukun nain sira rona tiha buat sira nee sira hanoin barak.
verses.9: No bainhira sira haruka Jason no nia maluk sira selu multa atu la halo tan, sira husik tiha ema sira nee.
verses.10: Bainhira kalan ona, maun-alin sira nee haruka Paulo no Silas sai kedas ba Bereia. Bainhira sira too iha nebaa, sira tama ema Judeu sira nia sinagoga.
verses.11: Ema sira nee hanoin diak liu ema Tesalónika. Tanba sira simu liafuan nee ho neon prontu. Loro-loron sira buka hatene iha Eskritura sira atu haree se liafuan nee loos ka lae.
verses.12: Nunee ema sira nee barak fiar. No ema Gregu mos fiar, inklui feto naran boot no mos mane sira, no laos uitoan deit.
verses.13: Maibee bainhira ema Judeu sira iha Tesalónika rona katak Paulo haklaken mos Maromak nia liafuan iha Bereia, sira baa too iha nebaa no provoka ema lubun boot sira nee.
verses.14: Entaun maun-alin sira haruka kedas Paulo tuun ba tasi ibun. Maibee Silas no Timóteo hela nafatin iha Bereia.
verses.15: Sira nebee lao hamutuk ho Paulo lori nia too iha Atenas. Sira simu lia menon ba Silas no Timóteo atu baa lalais hasoru Paulo. Depois ema sira nee husik nia.
verses.16: Bainhira Paulo hein hela sira iha Atenas, ninia espíritu sai manas tanba nia haree sidade nee nakonu ho ídulu sira.
verses.17: Nunee nia diskuti ho ema Judeu sira no ema sira nebee hamtauk Maromak iha sinagoga, no loro-loron iha merkadu ho ema see deit nebee iha nebaa.
verses.18: Depois ema filozofia balu, nebee tuir Epikureu no Estoiku nia hanorin, diskuti malu ho nia. Ema balu nee dehan, “Regadór nee dehan saida?” Ema seluk dehan, “Karik nia koalia kona ba maromak sira hosi rai liur.” (Tanba nia haklaken kona ba Jesus no moris hias hosi mate.)
verses.19: No sira foti nia no lori nia ba Areópago. Sira dehan, “Ita bele foo hatene mai ami kona ba hanorin foun nebee ita foo sai nee.
verses.20: Tanba ita hatoo liafuan oin seluk ba ami nia tilun. Nunee ami hakarak hatene liafuan nee katak saida.”
verses.21: Ema Atenas hotu no ema estranjeiru nebee hela iha nebaa la halo buat seluk tanba sira hakarak deit atu konta no rona buat foun.
verses.22: Depois Paulo hamriik iha Areópago laran no dehan, “Imi ema Atenas, hau haree katak imi sempre badinas atu halo tuir relijiaun.
verses.23: Tanba bainhira hau lao lemo iha fatin nee no haree imi nia sasaan adorasaun nian, hau hetan mos altár ida nebee ema hakerek, ‘Ba maromak nebee ita la hatene.’ Nunee buat nebee imi adora maski la hatene nee, hau atu foo sai ba imi.
verses.24: Maromak nebee halo mundu no buat hotu iha mundu nee mak Nai ba lalehan no mundu. Nunee Nia la hela iha templu sira nebee ema halo ho liman.
verses.25: Nia la falta buat ida. Nunee Nia la presiza ema nia liman atu serví Nia. Tanba Nia mak foo moris, iis no buat hotu ba ema hotu.
verses.26: No hosi ema ida deit Nia halo nasaun hotu atu hela iha mundu tomak. No Nia desidi sira nia tempu no fatin nebee sira hela,
verses.27: atu nunee sira bele buka Maromak, no karik sira bele lolo liman ba Nia no hetan Nia. Maibee tuir lo-loos Nia laduun dook hosi ema ida-idak.
verses.28: Tanba
verses.29: Nunee tanba ita mak Maromak nia oan sira, ita la bele hanoin katak Maromak hanesan osan mean, osan mutin ka fatuk. Nia laos estátua nebee ema halo tuir sira nia hanoin.
verses.30: Iha tempu uluk nebee ema la hatene, Maromak husik deit hahalok nee. Maibee agora Nia haruka ema hotu iha fatin hotu atu arepende.
verses.31: Tanba Nia marka ona loron ida atu tesi lia ba mundu ho hahalok loos liu hosi Mane ida nebee Nia hili tiha ona. Nia hametin desizaun nee ba ema hotu bainhira Nia halo Mane nee moris hias hosi mate.”
verses.32: Bainhira sira rona kona ba ema moris hias hosi mate, balu goza nia. Maibee ema seluk dehan, “Ami sei rona fali ita kona ba hanorin nee.”
verses.33: Entaun Paulo sai hosi sira nia leet.
verses.34: Maibee ema balu lao tuir nia no sira fiar. Ema sira nee inklui Dionísio nebee hosi Areópago, feto ida naran Damaris no ema seluk tan hamutuk ho sira.

verses.1: Tuir mai, Paulo sai hosi Atenas no baa iha Korinto.
verses.2: Nia hetan ema Judeu ida naran Akila nebee moris iha Pontus. Akila foin mai hosi Itália ho ninia feen Priscila tanba Cláudio haruka ema Judeu hotu atu sai hosi Roma. Entaun Paulo baa hasoru sira.
verses.3: Paulo hatene servisu hanesan ho sira nebee atu halo tenda. Entaun nia hela ho sira no servisu.
verses.4: Sabdu Sabdu nia koalia iha sinagoga no koko atu manaan ema Judeu no ema Gregu sira.
verses.5: Bainhira Silas no Timóteo mai hosi Masedónia, Paulo servisu ho liafuan nebee foo sasin ba ema Judeu sira katak Jesus mak Kristu.
verses.6: Maibee sira kontra nia no koalia aat hasoru nia. Nunee nia liki tiha ninia ropa no dehan ba sira, “Husik imi nia raan fila fali ba imi nia ulun. Hau moos ona. Hosi agora ba oin, hau sei baa ema Jentiu sira.”
verses.7: Depois nia sai hosi fatin nee no tama ba Tísio Justo nia uma. Justo adora Maromak no ninia uma iha sinagoga nia sorin.
verses.8: Krispo, sinagoga nia nai ulun, fiar ba Nai ho ninia uma kain tomak. No ema Korinto barak nebee rona, fiar no simu batizmu.
verses.9: Depois Nai koalia ba Paulo liu hosi vizaun ida iha kalan. Nia dehan, “Keta tauk, maibee koalia ba no keta nonook.
verses.10: Tanba Hau hamutuk ho o, no la iha ema ida nebee ataka o hodi halo aat ba o. Tanba Hau iha ema barak iha sidade nee.”
verses.11: Paulo hela iha nebaa too tinan ida fulan neen no hanorin Maromak nia liafuan iha sira nia leet.
verses.12: Maibee bainhira Gálio mak governadór iha Akaia, ema Judeu sira halibur hamutuk hodi ataka Paulo, no sira lori nia ba tribunál.
verses.13: Sira dehan, “Ema nee dada ema atu adora Maromak tuir dalan nebee kontra lei.
verses.14: No bainhira Paulo atu loke ninia ibun, Gálio dehan ba ema Judeu sira, “Oh ema Judeu sira, se ida nee asuntu kona ba hahalok aat ka krimi violénsia, entaun hau iha razaun ida atu rona imi.
verses.15: Maibee tanba ida nee mak pergunta kona ba liafuan no naran sira hosi imi nia lei, entaun imi rasik rezolva ba. Tanba hau sei la tesi lia kona ba buat sira nee.”
verses.16: No nia duni sira sai hosi tribunál.
verses.17: Depois sira hotu kaer Sóstenes, sinagoga nia nai ulun, no baku nia iha tribunál nia oin. Maibee Gálio la hanoin kona ba hahalok sira nee.
verses.18: Tuir mai, Paulo hela kleur iha nebaa. Depois nia husik maun-alin sira nee no sae roo hodi baa Síria. Nia baa ho Priscila no Akila. Iha Senkreia nia tesi ninia fuuk, tanba nia halo juramentu ida.
verses.19: No sira baa too iha Éfezu. Paulo husik sira iha nebaa, maibee nia rasik tama ba sinagoga hodi diskuti ho ema Judeu sira.
verses.20: Sira husu nia atu hela kleur liu tan, maibee nia lakohi.
verses.21: Bainhira nia foo adeus ba sira, nia dehan, “Hau sei fila fali ba imi, se Maromak hakarak.” Depois nia sae roo hodi sai hosi Éfezu.
verses.22: Nia tuun hosi roo iha Sezareia, no nia lao sae ba no foo kumprimentus ba igreja. Depois nia tuun ba Antiokia.
verses.23: Bainhira nia hela ona too tempu uitoan iha nebaa, nia sai fali no lao hosi sidade ba sidade iha rejiaun Galásia no Frígia hodi hametin eskolante sira hotu.
verses.24: Ema Judeu ida naran Apolo nebee moris iha Alexandria mai too Éfezu. Nia matenek atu koalia no hatene di-diak Eskritura sira.
verses.25: Mane ida nee simu ona hanorin kona ba Nai nia dalan. Nia iha laran manas ho espíritu, nunee nia koalia no hanorin lo-loos kona ba Jesus. Maibee nia hatene deit kona ba batizmu hosi João.
verses.26: Nia komesa koalia ho brani iha sinagoga. Maibee bainhira Akila no Priscila rona nia, sira lori nia no esplika diak liu tan kona ba Maromak nia dalan ba nia.
verses.27: No bainhira nia hakarak tama ba Akaia, maun-alin sira foo korajen ba nia no hakerek ba eskolante sira atu simu nia. Bainhira nia too iha nebaa, nia foo ajuda barak ba sira nebee fiar liu hosi grasa.
verses.28: Tanba ho liafuan klaru nia diskuti ho ema Judeu sira iha ema nia oin. Nia hatudu liu hosi Eskritura sira katak Jesus mak Kristu.

verses.1: Tuir mai, bainhira Apolo hela iha Korinto, Paulo lao liu hosi foho too iha Éfezu. No nia hetan eskolante balu iha nebaa.
verses.2: Nia dehan ba sira, “Imi simu Espíritu Santu bainhira imi fiar ka lae?” No sira dehan ba nia, “Lae, ami la rona buat ida kona ba Espíritu Santu.”
verses.3: Nia dehan ba sira, “Entaun imi simu batizmu ida nebee?” No sira dehan, “João nia batizmu.”
verses.4: Paulo dehan, “João foo batizmu arepende nian. Nia foo hatene ba povu atu fiar ba Ida nebee atu tuir nia, nebee Jesus.”
verses.5: Rona tiha ida nee, sira simu batizmu hodi Nai Jesus nia naran.
verses.6: No bainhira Paulo tau ninia liman ba sira, Espíritu Santu tuun ba sira. No sira koalia ho lian oi-oin no profesia.
verses.7: Sira hamutuk maizoumenus mane nain sanulu resin rua.
verses.8: Depois Paulo tama sinagoga, no koalia ho brani durante fulan tolu. Nia diskuti malu ho sira no dada ema nia hanoin kona ba Maromak nia reinu.
verses.9: Maibee ema balu sai ulun toos no lakohi fiar. Sira koalia aat kona ba Dalan nee iha ema lubun boot nia oin. Entaun Paulo sai hosi sira no lori eskolante sira ho nia. Loro-loron nia hanorin iha eskola Tirano.
verses.10: Nia halo ida nee durante tinan rua, too ema hotu nebee hela iha Ázia rona Nai nia liafuan, inklui ema Judeu no ema Gregu sira.
verses.11: Maromak halo milagre furak sira liu hosi Paulo nia liman.
verses.12: Tanba nee ema foti mos lensu no hena nebee kona ninia isin no lori ba ema sira nebee moras. No sira nia moras lakon kedas no espíritu aat sira sai hosi sira.
verses.13: Depois iha ema Judeu balu nebee lao ba-mai hodi duni sai espíritu aat sira. Ema sira nee koko atu uza Nai Jesus nia naran ho ema nebee iha espíritu aat. Sira dehan, “Hau manda o hodi Jesus nebee Paulo mak haklaken.”
verses.14: Iha ema Judeu ida naran Skeva nebee xefi saserdote. Nia iha oan mane nain hitu nebee koko atu halo hanesan nee.
verses.15: No espíritu aat hataan ba sira, “Hau hatene Jesus no hau hatene Paulo, maibee imi nee see?”
verses.16: No mane nebee iha espíritu aat haksoit ba sira no domina sira. Nia ataka sira too sira halai sai hosi uma nee ho isin molik no kanek.
verses.17: Ema Judeu no ema Gregu hotu nebee hela iha Éfezu rona kona ba ida nee. Sira sai tauk no foti aas Nai Jesus nia naran.
verses.18: Ema barak nebee fiar ona mai hodi konfesa no foo sai sira nia hahalok.
verses.19: No ema barak nebee involve aan iha hahalok lulik halibur hamutuk sira nia livru sira. Sira sunu livru sira nee iha ema hotu nia oin. Bainhira ema sura livru nia folin, sira haree folin nee too osan mutin rihun lima-nulu.
verses.20: Entaun Nai nia liafuan kontinua aumenta no sai forsa liu tan.
verses.21: Liu tiha buat sira nee, Paulo desidi iha Espíritu atu lao liu Masedónia no Akaia, no baa Jerusalém. Nia dehan, “Bainhira hau too tiha iha nebaa, hau mos tenki haree Roma.”
verses.22: Nia haruka nain rua hosi ninia ajudante sira, nebee Timóteo no Erasto, atu tama ba Masedónia. Maibee nia rasik hela iha Ázia too tempu balu tan.
verses.23: Iha tempu nee, rungu-ranga ida mosu kona ba Dalan nee, no laos uitoan deit.
verses.24: Tanba iha ema ida naran Demétrio nebee badaen osan mutin. Nia halo ortóriu osan mutin ba Ártemis. No nia lori bisnis nee, nebee laos bisnis kiik, ho badaen osan mutin sira.
verses.25: Nia halibur ema sira nee hamutuk ho badaen sira seluk no dehan, “Maluk sira, imi hatene katak liu hosi servisu nee ita sai riku.
verses.26: No mos imi haree no rona, katak laos deit iha Éfezu, maibee kuaze iha Ázia tomak, Paulo dada ema barak atu tuir hanoin seluk. Nia dehan katak maromak sira nebee ema halo ho liman nee laos maromak.
verses.27: Nunee perigu bele mai, laos deit katak ema bele koalia aat ba ita nia servisu, maibee ema bele hanoin aat ba maromak boot Ártemis nia templu. Depois sira sei hatuun nia hosi ninia glória, nebee ema hotu iha Ázia no mundu adora.”
verses.28: Bainhira sira rona tiha liafuan nee, sira nia laran nakali no sira hakilar, “Ártemis hosi ema Éfezu mak boot liu!”
verses.29: Sidade sai nakonu ho rungu-ranga nee. Sira kaer Gaio no Aristarco, ema hosi Masedónia, nebee lao hamutuk ho Paulo, no sira halai hamutuk ba iha estadium.
verses.30: No bainhira Paulo hanoin atu tama ba povu nee, eskolante sira la husik nia.
verses.31: Nai ulun balu hosi Ázia, nebee ninia kolega sira, haruka lia menon ba nia hodi husu nia atu keta tama ba estadium.
verses.32: Ema balu hakilar buat ida, no ema balu hakilar buat seluk. Tanba sorumutu nee konfuzaun. No ema barak liu la hatene tanba saa mak sira mai hamutuk.
verses.33: Ema balu hosi ema lubun boot nee dudu Alexandre ba oin nebee ema Judeu sira hili. No Alexandre foti liman atu hatoo liafuan ba povu nee.
verses.34: Maibee bainhira sira hatene katak nia mak ema Judeu ida, sira hotu hakilar ho lian ida deit too maizoumenus oras rua, “Ártemis hosi ema Éfezu mak boot liu!”
verses.35: Bainhira sidade nia sekretariu hakalma ema lubun boot nee, nia dehan, “Ema Éfezu, see mak la hatene katak ema Éfezu nia sidade tau matan ba Ártemis boot nia templu no ba fatuk lulik nebee monu hosi lalehan?
verses.36: Tanba ema la bele nega buat sira nee, diak liu imi hakmatek deit no la bele halo arbiru.
verses.37: Tanba imi lori ema sira nee maski sira la naok buat ida hosi templu no la koalia aat ita nia maromak feto.
verses.38: Nunee se Demétrio, no badaen sira nebee hamutuk ho nia, iha kazu ruma nebee hasoru ema ida, entaun tribunál sei loke hela no juis sira sei iha nebaa. Husik sira tau akuzasaun ba malu.
verses.39: Maibee se imi buka atu koalia kona ba buat seluk, ida nee bele rezolve iha sorumutu baibain nian.
verses.40: Tanba ita iha perigu atu simu kastigu tanba rungu-ranga ohin loron nee, tanba problema nee nia huun la iha.”
verses.41: Koalia tiha nunee, nia haruka sorumutu nee fahe malu.

verses.1: Bainhira barulhu nee para tiha, Paulo bolu eskolante sira no foo korajen ba sira. Depois nia foo adeus ba sira no sai ba Masedónia.
verses.2: Bainhira nia lao haleu ona fatin nebaa no foo korajen boot ba sira, nia baa iha Grésia.
verses.3: Nia hela too fulan tolu iha nebaa. Maibee bainhira nia atu sae roo hodi baa Síria, nia rona ema Judeu sira halo planu aat hasoru nia. Entaun nia desidi atu fila fali liu hosi Masedónia.
verses.4: Ema nebee lao hamutuk ho Paulo inklui Piro nia oan Sopater, nebee ema Bereia, Aristarco no Asiku, nebee ema Tesalónika, Gaio hosi Derbe, Timóteo, no Tíkiko ho Trófimo hosi Ázia.
verses.5: Ema sira nee lao uluk hodi hein ami iha Tróade.
verses.6: Bainhira festa Paun Fermentu Laek hotu tiha, ami sae roo iha Filipe. Liu tiha loron lima, ami too ba sira nebee iha Tróade. No ami hela loron hitu iha nebaa.
verses.7: Iha loron primeiru ba semana nee, bainhira ami halibur hamutuk hodi silu paun, Paulo haklaken ba ema sira nee. Nia atu husik sira iha loron aban entaun nia kontinua koalia too kalan boot.
verses.8: Sira iha ahi oan barak iha andar leten iha fatin nebee sira halibur hamutuk.
verses.9: Joven mane ida naran Éutiko tuur iha janela. Bainhira Paulo haklaken kleur ona, joven mane nee toba dukur loos. No tanba nia matan dukur haluha rai, nia monu tuun hosi andar tolu nee. Ema baa foti nia maibee nia mate ona.
verses.10: Paulo tuun ba, hakruuk ba nia no hakuak nia, no dehan, “Keta laran taridu, tanba nia sei moris.”
verses.11: Bainhira Paulo sae fila fali, nia silu paun no haan hamutuk ho sira. Nia koalia kleur ho sira too loron sae. Depois nia baa.
verses.12: No sira lori joven mane nee, no sira haksolok tebes tanba nia moris hela.
verses.13: Maibee ami lao uluk ba roo. Ami sae roo no baa Asós hodi foti Paulo iha nebaa. Tanba nia halo planu hanesan nee hodi nia bele lao ain deit.
verses.14: No bainhira nia hasoru ami iha Asós, ami foti nia no baa too iha Mitilene.
verses.15: Ami sae roo iha nebaa no loron tuir mai ami too iha Kio nia oin, no loron tuir mai ami too iha Samos. Loron tuir mai, ami too iha Mileto.
verses.16: Tanba Paulo desidi ona atu liu deit Éfezu hodi la haan tempu iha Ázia. Nia hakaas aan atu too iha Jerusalém, sei bele karik, iha loron Pentekosta.
verses.17: Hosi Miletus Paulo haruka lia menon ba Éfezu atu bolu katuas sira hosi igreja nee.
verses.18: Bainhira sira too mai, nia dehan ba sira, “Imi hatene oinsaa hau hela iha imi nia leet hosi loron primeiru nebee hau tama Ázia too tempu hotu.
verses.19: Hau serví Nai ho laran haraik aan, ho matan been, no ho terus nebee hasoru hau tanba planu aat hosi ema Judeu sira.
verses.20: Hau la subar buat ida nebee diak hosi imi, maibee hau hatudu imi. Hau hanorin imi iha fatin publiku no hosi uma ba uma.
verses.21: Hau foo sasin ba ema Judeu sira no mos ba ema Gregu sira, atu arepende ba Maromak no tau fiar ba ita nia Nai Jesus Kristu.
verses.22: No agora, tebes, hau atu baa Jerusalém, tanba Espíritu obriga hau. No hau la hatene saida mak sei akontese mai hau iha nebaa.
verses.23: Só deit Espíritu Santu foo hatene mai hau iha sidade hotu katak kastigu no terus sei hasoru hau.
verses.24: Maibee hau la foo folin ba hau nia moris se hau bele kontinua too rohan no halo kompletu ministériu nebee hau simu hosi Nai Jesus, atu foo sasin ba evanjelhu kona ba Maromak nia grasa.
verses.25: No agora, tebes, hau hatene katak imi hotu iha fatin nebee hau lao ba-mai hodi haklaken Maromak nia reinu, sei la haree tan hau nia oin.
verses.26: Nunee, ohin loron, hau foo sasin ba imi katak hau moos hosi imi hotu nia raan.
verses.27: Tanba hau la subar aan, maibee hau foo sai ba imi Maromak nia hakarak hotu.
verses.28: Nunee tau matan di-diak ba imi nia aan rasik no ba bibi lubun nee. Espíritu Santu hili imi atu tau matan no foo haan ba Maromak nia igreja, nebee Nia hola ho Ninia raan rasik.
verses.29: Tanba Hau hatene katak, bainhira hau baa tiha, asu fuik boot sira sei tama iha imi nia leet, no sira sei la husik bibi lubun nee.
verses.30: No hosi imi rasik, ema sei mosu mai no bobar lia hodi dada eskolante sira atu lao tuir sira.
verses.31: Nunee matan moris ba! Hanoin hetan katak durante tinan tolu hau la para atu foo hanoin ba imi ida-idak loron-kalan ho matan been.
verses.32: Agora, hau entrega imi ba Maromak, no ba Ninia liafuan grasa nian. Liafuan nee bele hametin imi, no foo ba imi liman rohan hamutuk ho ema hotu nebee sai santu ona.
verses.33: Hau la hanoin atu hetan ema nia osan mutin, osan mean ka ropa.
verses.34: Imi rasik hatene katak liman nee serví hau atu hetan buat nebee hau presiza no mos sira nebee hamutuk ho hau.
verses.35: Iha buat hotu hau hatudu ona ba imi katak liu hosi servisu makaas hanesan nee ita tenki ajuda sira nebee fraku. Hanoin hetan Nai Jesus nia liafuan, oinsaa Nia rasik dehan, ‘Haksolok liu atu foo, duké atu simu.’”
verses.36: Koalia tiha nunee, nia hakneak no halo orasaun ho sira hotu.
verses.37: No sira hotu tanis makaas. Sira hakuak Paulo no rei nia.
verses.38: Liu-liu sira tristi kona ba ninia liafuan nebee nia dehan katak sira sei la haree tan ninia oin. Depois sira lao hamutuk ho nia too iha roo.

verses.1: Bainhira ami foo adeus ba sira, ami sae roo, no ami baa loos deit too Kos. Loron tuir mai ami ba Rodes, no hosi nebaa ami too Patara.
verses.2: Ami hetan roo ida nebee atu baa Fenísia. Nunee ami sae roo nee no ami baa.
verses.3: Bainhira ami haree Xipre, ami kontinua liu ba, ho Xipre iha ami nia sorin karuk. Ami baa Síria, no ami too rai maran iha Tiro tanba roo presiza hatuun sasaan iha nebaa.
verses.4: Ami hetan eskolante sira no hela iha nebaa too loron hitu. No liu hosi Espíritu, sira dehan ba Paulo atu la bele sae ba Jerusalém.
verses.5: Bainhira loron sira nee hotu ona, ami husik sira hodi kontinua ami nia viajen. Sira hotu, inklui feto no labarik sira, lori ami too iha sidade liur. Depois ami hakneak iha tasi ibun no halo orasaun.
verses.6: Bainhira ami foo adeus ba sira, ami sae roo no sira fila fali ba uma.
verses.7: Bainhira ami nia viajen hosi Tiro hotu ona, ami too iha Tolome. Ami kumprimenta maun-alin sira no hela ho sira loron ida.
verses.8: Loron tuir mai, ami husik sira no baa too Sezareia. Ami tama Evanjelista Filipe nia uma, nebee ema ida hosi sira nain hitu. No ami hela ho nia.
verses.9: Nia iha oan feto nain haat nebee sei klosan no sira hotu profesia.
verses.10: Ami hela iha nebaa loron balu tan no profeta ida naran Ágabo tuun mai hosi Judeia.
verses.11: Nia mai too ami no foti Paulo nia sintu. Nia kesi ninia ain no liman rasik no dehan, “Espíritu Santu hatete nunee, ‘Hanesan nee ema Judeu sira iha Jerusalém sei kesi sintu nee nia nain, no entrega nia ba ema Jentiu sira nia liman.’”
verses.12: Rona tiha nunee, ami no mos sira nebee hela iha fatin nee husu boot ba Paulo atu la bele sae ba Jerusalém.
verses.13: Depois Paulo hataan, “Tanba saa mak imi tanis no hakanek hau nia fuan? Tanba hau prontu laos deit atu ema kesi hau, maibee hau prontu mos atu mate iha Jerusalém tanba Nai Jesus nia naran.”
verses.14: No bainhira nia lakohi troka ninia hanoin, ami para tiha no dehan, “Tuir deit Nai nia hakarak ba.”
verses.15: Liu tiha loron sira nee, ami prepara aan no sae ba Jerusalém.
verses.16: Eskolante balu hosi Sezareia mos lao hamutuk ho ami. Sira lori ami ba Manason nia uma hodi hela ho nia. Nia hosi Xipre no nia mak eskolante hori uluk kedas.
verses.17: Bainhira ami too iha Jerusalém, maun-alin sira nee simu ami ho laran kontenti.
verses.18: Loron tuir mai, Paulo hamutuk ho ami baa hasoru Tiago. No katuas hotu mos iha nebaa.
verses.19: Nia kumprimenta sira, depois nia hatoo buat hotu nebee Maromak halo ona iha ema Jentiu sira nia leet liu hosi ninia ministériu.
verses.20: Rona tiha nunee, sira foo glória ba Maromak. No sira dehan ba nia, “Maun, ita haree katak ema Judeu rihun ba rihun fiar ona. No sira hotu iha laran manas atu tuir lei.
verses.21: No ema dehan ona ba sira kona ba ita, katak ita hanorin ema Judeu hotu iha nasaun seluk atu husik Moisés. Sira dehan katak ita haruka ema atu la bele foo sirkunsizaun ba sira nia oan sira no la lao tuir ita nia kostumi sira.
verses.22: Nunee ita atu halo saida? Sira sei rona duni katak ita too mai ona.
verses.23: Entaun halo tuir buat nebee ami atu dehan ba ita. Ami iha mane nain haat nebee halo ona juramentu.
verses.24: Lori mane sira nee no hamoos ita nia aan hamutuk ho sira. Selu buat nebee sira presiza hodi ema bele koi sira nia fuuk. Nunee ema hotu bele hatene katak liafuan nebee sira rona kona ba ita nee la loos. No sira sei hatene katak ita rasik moris tuir lei.
verses.25: Maibee kona ba ema Jentiu sira nebee fiar, ami hakerek ona surat ho ami nia desizaun katak sira hadook aan hosi buat sira nebee foer hosi ídulu sira, hosi raan, hosi animál nebee buti mate no hosi sala seksuál.”
verses.26: Depois Paulo lori mane sira nee, no loron tuir mai nia hamoos aan hamutuk ho sira no tama ba Templu. Nia foo hatene ba ema iha Templu kona ba bainhira mak loron hamoos aan nian hotu ona no oferta nebee nia sei foo kona ba mane ida-idak nee.
verses.27: Bainhira loron hitu nee besik hotu ona, ema Judeu sira hosi Ázia haree Paulo iha Templu. Sira halo rungu-ranga ho ema hotu iha nebaa no kaer nia.
verses.28: Sira hakilar, “Ema Israel, ajuda ba! Mane nee mak hanorin ema hotu iha fatin hotu atu kontra hasoru ita nia povu, lei no fatin iha nee. No mos nia lori ema Gregu sira tama mai Templu no hafoer fatin santu nee.”
verses.29: Tanba uluk sira haree Trófimo hosi Éfezu hamutuk ho Paulo iha sidade, no sira hanoin katak Paulo lori ona nia tama ba Templu.
verses.30: No sidade tomak sai rungu-ranga. Povu nee halai nadodon mai. Sira foti Paulo no dada nia sai hosi Templu. No ema taka kedas portaun.
verses.31: Bainhira sira koko atu oho nia, ema lori lia menon baa too komandante boot ba batalhaun atu foo hatene katak Jerusalém tomak sai rungu-ranga.
verses.32: Nia foti kedas soldadu no kapitaun sira no halai tuun ba sira. Bainhira povu haree komandante boot nee no soldadu sira, sira la baku tan Paulo.
verses.33: Komandante boot hakbesik no kaer Paulo. Nia haruka ema kesi Paulo ho korenti rua. Depois nia husu ema nee mak see no saida mak ema nee halo.
verses.34: Iha ema lubun nee, balu hakilar buat ida no balu hakilar buat seluk. Tanba rungu-ranga nee, nia la bele hatene loloos. Entaun nia haruka soldadu sira lori Paulo ba postu laran.
verses.35: No bainhira Paulo too iha eskada, soldadu sira tenki hiit no lori nia tanba ema lubun boot nia violénsia.
verses.36: Tanba ema lubun boot nee tuir hela nia no hakilar, “Halakon tiha nia!”
verses.37: Bainhira sira besik atu lori Paulo tama ba postu, nia dehan ba komandante boot, “Hau bele koalia buat ruma ba ita?” Komandante boot hataan, “Ita hatene lian Gregu ka?
verses.38: Laos ita mak ema Ejitu nebee foin lalais halibur ema atu hatuun governu, depois ita lori oho door nain rihun haat ba rai fuik laran?”
verses.39: Maibee Paulo dehan, “Hau mak ema Judeu ida hosi Tarsu, sidade ida iha Silísia. Hau sidadaun hosi sidade boot nee. No hau husu favór ida, husik hau koalia ba povu nee.”
verses.40: Bainhira komandante boot foo lisensa ba nia, Paulo hamriik iha eskada no foti liman ba povu nee. Bainhira sira hotu nonook, nia koalia ba sira iha lian Ebreu.

verses.1: “Maun-alin no aman sira, rona hau nia liafuan atu defende aan iha imi nia oin.”
verses.2: Bainhira sira rona Paulo koalia ba sira ho lian Ebreu, sira hotu hakmatek liu tan. No nia dehan,
verses.3: “Hau ema Judeu ida, moris iha Tarsu iha Silísia. Maibee hau sai boot iha sidade nee. Hau aprende iha Gamaliel nia ain tuir metodu lo-loos hosi ita nia bei-ala sira nia lei. Hau iha laran manas ba Maromak hanesan imi hotu ohin loron.
verses.4: Hau haterus Dalan nee too ema mate. Hau kastigu mane no feto no hatama sira ba komarka.
verses.5: Saserdote boot no katuas boot sira hotu bele foo sasin kona ba hau nee. Hau simu surat hosi sira atu lori ba maun-alin sira. Nunee hau halo viajen ba Damasku hodi kaer ema sira nee iha nebaa, kesi sira no lori ba Jerusalém atu hetan kastigu.
verses.6: Bainhira hau lao dadaun iha dalan no besik ona ba Damasku, maizoumenus iha meiudia, derepenti naroman boot hosi lalehan nabilan haleu hau.
verses.7: Hau monu ba rai no rona lian ida dehan mai hau, ‘Saul, Saul, tanba saa mak o haterus Hau?’
verses.8: Hau hataan, ‘See mak Ita, Nai?’ No Nia dehan mai hau, ‘Hau mak Jesus hosi Nazaré, nebee o haterus.’
verses.9: Sira nebee hamutuk ho hau haree naroman nee maibee sira la kompriende lian hosi Ida nebee koalia mai hau.
verses.10: Hau dehan, ‘Hau tenki halo saida, Nai?’ No Nai dehan mai hau, ‘Hamriik ba, no tama ba Damasku. Iha nebaa o sei rona kona ba buat hotu nebee o tenki halo.’
verses.11: No hau la bele haree tanba naroman nee nabilan tebes. Nunee sira nebee hamutuk ho hau kaer hau nia liman no lori hau too Damasku.
verses.12: Iha nebaa iha ema ida naran Ananias nebee hamtauk Maromak no tuir lei. Ema Judeu hotu nebee hela iha nebaa koalia diak kona ba nia.
verses.13: Nia mai hasoru hau, no hamriik iha hau nia sorin no dehan mai hau, ‘Maun Saul, haree fali ba.’ Iha oras nee kedas hau bele haree fali no hau haree nia.
verses.14: Nia dehan, ‘Ita nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak hili ona ita atu hatene Ninia hakarak, atu haree Ida Nebee Loos no atu rona lian hosi Ninia ibun.
verses.15: Tanba ita sei sai Ninia sasin ba ema hotu kona ba buat nebee ita haree no rona ona.
verses.16: No agora, tanba saa mak ita hein tan? Hamriik ba, no simu batizmu. Hamoos ita nia sala sira no bolu ba Ninia naran.’
verses.17: Bainhira hau fila fali ba Jerusalém, hau halo orasaun iha Templu no hau hetan vizaun ida.
verses.18: Hau haree Jesus dehan mai hau, ‘Lalais, o tenki sai kedas hosi Jerusalém. Tanba sira sei la simu o nia sasin kona ba Hau.
verses.19: Hau dehan, ‘Nai, sira rasik hatene katak hau baa hosi sinagoga ida ba sinagoga seluk hodi hatama ba komarka no baku ema sira nebee fiar Ita.
verses.20: No bainhira Ita nia sasin Estevão fakar ninia raan, hau mos hamriik iha sorin hodi foo apoiu no tau matan ba ema sira nia ropa nebee oho nia.’
verses.21: No Nia dehan mai hau, ‘Baa! Tanba Hau sei haruka o ba fatin dook, ba ema Jentiu sira.’”
verses.22: Sira rona Paulo too nia foo sai liafuan nee. Depois sira hakilar dehan, “Halakon tiha mane nee hosi mundu, tanba nia la merese atu moris!”
verses.23: No bainhira sira hakilar hela, sira hasai sira nia ropa no soe rai rahun ba leten.
verses.24: Komandante boot haruka soldadu sira lori Paulo ba postu laran. Nia haruka sira baku Paulo ho sikote hodi buka hatene tanba saa mak ema lubun boot nee hakilar hasoru nia hanesan nee.
verses.25: No bainhira sira kesi nia ho tali atu baku nia, Paulo dehan ba kapitaun nebee hamriik besik, “Tuir lei, imi bele baku sidadaun Roma ida ho sikote maski seidauk tesi lia ba nia?”
verses.26: Rona tiha nunee, kapitaun baa no foo hatene ba komandante boot. Nia dehan, “Ita boot atu halo saida? Tanba mane nee mak sidadaun Roma.”
verses.27: Depois komandante boot mai no dehan ba nia, “Foo hatene mai hau, ita mak sidadaun Roma ka?” Nia dehan, “Sin.”
verses.28: Komandante boot hataan, “Hau tenki selu osan boot hodi sai sidadaun.” Paulo dehan, “Maibee hau moris mai nudar sidadaun.”
verses.29: Nunee sira nebee atu baku nia hakiduk kedas. No komandante boot mos sai tauk bainhira nia hatene ona katak Paulo mak sidadaun Roma tanba nia kesi ona Paulo.
verses.30: Loron tuir mai, komandante boot hakarak hatene lo-loos tanba saa mak ema Judeu sira akuza Paulo. Entaun nia kore korenti hosi Paulo nia liman. Nia bolu xefi saserdote sira no ema Judeu nia tribunál tomak atu halibur hamutuk. No nia lori Paulo tuun ba no tau nia iha sira nia oin.

verses.1: Paulo hateke di-diak ba tribunál no dehan, “Maun-alin sira, too ohin loron hau sempre halao hau nia moris tuir buat nebee hau hanoin mak loos iha Maromak nia oin.”
verses.2: No saserdote boot Ananias haruka sira nebee hamriik besik nia atu baku ninia ibun.
verses.3: Depois Paulo dehan ba nia, “Maromak sei baku ita, nebee moru mutin deit! Nusaa mak ita tuur hodi tesi lia tuir lei, maibee ita haruka ema baku hau maski hahalok ida nee kontra lei?”
verses.4: No sira nebee hamriik besik dehan, “O sei koalia aat ba Maromak nia saserdote boot ka?”
verses.5: Paulo dehan, “Maun-alin sira, hau la hatene katak nia mak saserdote boot. Tanba ema hakerek nanis ona, ‘O sei la koalia aat hasoru o nia povu nia nai ulun.’”
verses.6: Bainhira Paulo haree katak ema balu hosi grupu Saduseu no ema seluk hosi grupu Farizeu, nia koalia ho lian makaas iha tribunál, “Maun-alin sira, hau ema Farizeu ida, oan mane hosi ema Farizeu ida. Ema tesi lia mai hau kona ba ema moris hias hosi mate.”
verses.7: Bainhira nia koalia nunee, ema Farizeu sira no ema Saduseu sira komesa haksesuk malu. No sorumutu nee fahe ba rua.
verses.8: Tanba ema Saduseu sira dehan katak ema la bele moris hias hosi mate, no la iha anju ka espíritu. Maibee ema Farizeu fiar buat hotu nee.
verses.9: No sira komesa hakilar makaas. Ema eskriba balu hosi grupu Farizeu hamriik atu luta no dehan, “Ami la hetan buat aat ida iha mane nee. Karik espíritu ka anju ida koalia ona ba nia.”
verses.10: Bainhira sira haksesuk malu makaas, komandante boot tauk katak sira atu lees rahun Paulo. Entaun nia haruka soldadu sira atu tuun ba no foti Paulo hosi sira nia leet ho forsa hodi lori nia ba postu.
verses.11: Tuir mai iha kalan, Nai hamriik besik nia no dehan, “Aten brani ba, tanba hanesan o foo sasin kona ba Hau iha Jerusalém, nunee mos o tenki foo sasin iha Roma.”
verses.12: Loron tuir mai, ema Judeu sira balu halibur hamutuk no halo juramentu ho malisan ida. Sira jura katak sira sei la haan ka hemu fali too sira oho Paulo.
verses.13: Ema nain haat-nulu resin mak futu lia nee.
verses.14: Sira baa hasoru xefi saserdote no katuas sira, no dehan, “Ami halo ona juramentu ho malisan boot katak ami sei la haan buat ida too ami oho Paulo.
verses.15: Entaun agora, imi ho tribunál foo avizu ba komandante boot atu lori Paulo tuun ba imi aban. Finji katak imi atu husu hodi hatene diak liu tan kona ba nia. No ami prontu atu oho nia molok nia besik mai.”
verses.16: Maibee Paulo nia feton nia oan mane rona kona ba sira nia emboskada. Entaun joven mane nee baa tama ba postu no foo hatene ba Paulo.
verses.17: Depois Paulo bolu kapitaun ida no dehan, “Lori joven mane nee ba komandante boot tanba nia iha buat ruma atu hatoo ba komandante nee.
verses.18: Entaun kapitaun foti nia no lori nia ba komandante boot no dehan, “Paulo, nebee iha dadur laran, bolu hau no husu hau atu lori joven mane nee ba ita boot tanba nia iha buat ruma atu hatoo ba ita boot.”
verses.19: Depois komandante boot kaer joven mane nia liman, no lori nia ketak atu husu mes-mesak ba nia no dehan, “O hakarak hatoo saida mai hau?”
verses.20: Joven mane nee dehan, “Ema Judeu sira futu lia hodi husu ita boot atu aban lori Paulo tuun ba tribunál. Sira sei finji atu husu hodi hatene diak liu tan kona ba nia.
verses.21: Maibee keta halo tuir sira nia hakarak. Tanba iha ema nain haat-nulu resin nebee halo emboskada ida atu ataka nia. Sira halo ona juramentu ho malisan ida katak sira sei la haan ka hemu fali too sira oho nia. Sira prontu agora, no hein hela ita boot nia desizaun.”
verses.22: Entaun komandante boot husik joven mane atu sai, no haruka nia, “La bele foo hatene ba ema ida katak o hatoo buat sira nee mai hau.”
verses.23: Depois komandante boot bolu kapitaun nain rua no dehan, “Prepara soldadu nain atus rua, soldadu nain hitu-nulu nebee sae kuda, no soldadu nain atus rua nebee lori dima. Orsida kalan tuku sia imi sei baa Sezareia.
verses.24: Prepara mos kuda atu Paulo bele sae no lori nia kuidadu too governadór Felix.”
verses.25: Depois nia hakerek surat ida hanesan nee:
verses.26: “Ba sua eselénsia governadór Felix. Hosi Cláudio Lísias. Kumprimentus.
verses.27: Ema Judeu sira kaer mane nee no sira besik atu oho nia. Maibee hau mai ho soldadu sira no salva nia, tanba hau rona katak nia mak sidadaun Roma ida.
verses.28: Hau hakarak hatene tanba saa mak sira akuza nia, entaun hau lori nia ba sira nia tribunál.
verses.29: Hau haree katak sira akuza nia kona ba asuntu ruma hosi sira nia lei. Maibee sira la iha akuzasaun nebee merese atu foo kastigu mate ba nia ka hatama nia ba komarka.
verses.30: No bainhira ema foo hatene mai hau katak ema Judeu sira halo emboskada atu ataka nia, hau manda kedas atu ema lori nia baa ita boot. No hau haruka ninia akuzadór sira atu hatoo sira nia liafuan hasoru nia.”
verses.31: Depois soldadu sira halo tuir orden nee. Sira foti Paulo iha kalan nee no lori nia ba Antipátride.
verses.32: Loron tuir mai, sira husik soldadu nebee sae kuda atu kontinua lori nia. No soldadu sira seluk fila fali ba postu.
verses.33: Bainhira sira too iha Sezareia, sira foo surat ba governadór, no lori mos Paulo atu hamriik iha ninia oin.
verses.34: Bainhira governadór lee tiha ona surat nee, nia husu Paulo nee hosi distritu ida nebee. No bainhira nia hatene katak Paulo hosi Silísia,
verses.35: nia dehan, “Hau sei rona o nia kazu bainhira o nia akuzadór sira mai. No nia haruka ema tau matan ba nia iha Herodes nia postu.”

verses.1: Liu tiha loron lima, saserdote boot Ananias tuun mai hamutuk ho katuas sira, no ema ida nebee koalia diak, naran Tértulo. Sira foo sai sira nia kazu hasoru Paulo iha governadór nia oin.
verses.2: Bainhira sira bolu Paulo mai, Tértulo komesa akuza nia no dehan, “Ami hela hakmatek tebes tanba ita boot. No tanba ita boot hanoin ami, nasaun ida nee sai diak loos.
verses.3: Oh Felix nebee diak liu, iha fatin hotu ami sempre agradese tebe-tebes kona ba buat sira nee.
verses.4: Maibee atu hau la bele halo ita boot sai kole tan, hau husu favór ida, tanba ita boot nia laran diak, atu rona ami koalia uitoan.
verses.5: Tanba ami hetan mane nee, nebee sai nudar moras peste, nia halo rungu-ranga ho ema Judeu sira hotu iha mundu tomak, no nia mak lideransa ba grupu Nazareno.
verses.6: Nia mos koko atu halo foer Templu. Maibee ami kaer nia.
verses.8: Ita boot rasik bele husu di-diak mane nee kona ba buat hotu nebee ami akuza nia.”
verses.9: Ema Judeu sira mos hametin liafuan nee, no sira dehan katak buat sira nee loos duni.
verses.10: Bainhira governadór foo sinál ba Paulo atu koalia, nia hataan, “Hau hatene katak ita boot mak juis ba nasaun nee ba tinan barak ona. Nunee hau kontenti atu defende aan.
verses.11: Ita boot bele hatene lo-loos katak seidauk liu loron sanulu resin rua hosi tempu nebee hau sae ba Jerusalém atu halo adorasaun.
verses.12: No sira la hetan hau diskuti malu ho ema ida iha Templu, no hau la halo rungu-ranga ho povu iha sinagoga sira ka iha sidade.
verses.13: No ho buat sira nebee agora sira akuza hau nee, sira la bele prova ba ita boot.
verses.14: Maibee ida nee mak hau konfesa ba ita boot, tuir Dalan nebee sira bolu grupu relijiaun ida, hau adora hau nia bei-ala sira nia Maromak, no fiar buat hotu nebee hakerek iha lei no profeta sira.
verses.15: No hau iha esperansa ida iha Maromak, nebee sira mos simu, katak ema sei moris hias hosi mate, inklui ema loos no ema nebee la loos.
verses.16: Nunee hau sempre hakaas aan atu lao ho konsiénsia moos ba Maromak, no ba ema.
verses.17: Agora, liu tiha tinan barak, hau mai atu lori osan hodi ajuda hau nia nasaun, no atu foo oferta.
verses.18: Bainhira hau halo buat sira nee, ema Judeu sira hosi Ázia hetan hau ho isin moos iha Templu. Hau laos ho ema lubun boot ka halo rungu-ranga.
verses.19: Tuir lo-loos ema Judeu sira nee tenki mai iha nee iha ita boot nia oin hodi akuza, se sira iha buat ruma hasoru hau.
verses.20: Se lae, husik ema nebee iha nee ona bele dehan buat aat nebee sira hetan ona bainhira hau hamriik iha tribunál nia oin.
verses.21: Só deit karik buat ida nee, katak bainhira hau hamriik iha sira nia leet hau koalia makaas hodi dehan, ‘Hau iha tribunál ohin loron tanba hanorin katak ema bele moris hias hosi mate.’”
verses.22: Bainhira Felix rona tiha buat sira nee, no tanba nia hatene di-diak kona ba Dalan nee, entaun nia haruka sira hein. Nia dehan, “Bainhira komandante boot Lísias tuun mai, hau sei tesi lia ba imi nia kazu.”
verses.23: Nia haruka kapitaun ida atu hatama Paulo ba komarka maibee foo liberdade uitoan ba nia. Kapitaun bele husik ninia maluk sira naran deit atu ajuda tuir buat nebee nia presiza.
verses.24: Liu tiha loron balu, Felix mai ho ninia feen Drusila, nebee feto Judeu ida. Nia haruka ema lori Paulo mai no rona nia koalia kona ba fiar iha Jesus Kristu.
verses.25: No bainhira Paulo diskuti kona ba hahalok loos, kontrola aan no julgamentu nebee atu mai, Felix sai tauk no hataan, “Baa deit agora. Bainhira hau iha tempu diak hau sei bolu o.”
verses.26: Felix hein katak nia bele simu osan hosi Paulo atu husik nia. Nunee Felix haruka nia mai dala barak no koalia ho nia.
verses.27: Liu tiha tinan rua, Pórsio Festo simu knaar troka Felix. No Felix hakarak halo buat ida diak ba ema Judeu sira entaun nia husik Paulo iha komarka.

verses.1: Bainhira Festo tama distritu nee, no liu tiha loron tolu, nia sae hosi Sezareia ba Jerusalém.
verses.2: Depois saserdote boot no ema Judeu nia xefi sira foo hatene ba nia kona ba sira nia kazu hasoru Paulo. Sira husu nia
verses.3: atu halo favór ida no haruka Paulo mai Jerusalém. Tanba sira iha planu atu halo emboskada iha dalan hodi oho Paulo.
verses.4: Maibee Festo hataan katak Paulo tenki hein iha Sezareia no nia rasik besik atu fila fali ba nebaa.
verses.5: Nia dehan, “Husik ema nebee iha kbiit iha imi nia leet tuun mai ho hau, no se iha buat ruma hasoru mane nee, imi bele akuza nia.”
verses.6: Bainhira Festo hela hamutuk ho sira too loron ualu ka sanulu tan, nia tuun ba Sezareia. Loron tuir mai nia tuur iha kadeira tesi lia nian no haruka ema lori Paulo mai.
verses.7: Bainhira Paulo mai ona, ema Judeu sira nebee tuun mai hosi Jerusalém hamriik haleu nia, no sira foo sala barak no todan hasoru Paulo. Maibee sira la bele prova buat sira nee.
verses.8: Paulo defende aan no dehan, “Hau la halo sala hasoru ema Judeu sira nia lei, ka hasoru Templu, ka hasoru César.”
verses.9: Maibee Festo hakarak halo favór ida ba ema Judeu sira. Entaun nia dehan ba Paulo, “O bele sae ba Jerusalém ka? Nunee hau bele tesi lia ba o kona ba buat sira nee.”
verses.10: Paulo dehan, “Hau hamriik dadaun iha César nia kadeira tesi lia nia oin. Tuir lo-loos ita boot tenki tesi lia mai hau iha nee. Hau la halo sala ida hasoru ema Judeu sira. No ita boot hatene lo-loos ida nee.
verses.11: Se karik hau mak sala nain, no merese atu simu kastigu mate, hau la buka atu hasai aan hosi kastigu mate nee. Maibee se karik la iha buat ida atu prova sira nia kazu hasoru hau, entaun la iha ema ida nebee bele entrega hau ba sira. Hau husu atu baa César.”
verses.12: Festo konsulta ho ninia tribunál depois nia hataan, “O husu atu baa César. Entaun ba César o sei baa.”
verses.13: Liu tiha loron balu, liurai Agripa no Berenice mai iha Sezareia atu vizita Festo.
verses.14: Bainhira sira hela iha nebaa too loron barak ona, Festo foo hatene ba liurai kona ba Paulo nia kazu. Nia dehan, “Iha mane ida nebee Felix husik iha komarka.
verses.15: Bainhira hau baa Jerusalém, xefi saserdote no ema Judeu nia katuas sira foo sai sira nia kazu hasoru ema nee. No sira hakarak hau tesi lia atu kondena nia.
verses.16: Hau hataan ba sira katak tuir Roma nia kostumi ami la entrega ema atu simu kastigu molok ema nee bele hasoru ninia akuzadór sira oin ho oin. Ema bele foo sala ba nia, depois nia tenki iha oportunidade atu defende aan.
verses.17: Nunee bainhira sira too mai, hau la demora tan no loron tuir mai hau tuur iha kadeira tesi lia nian no haruka ema lori mane nee mai.
verses.18: Bainhira akuzadór sira nee hamriik, sira la foo sala ida nebee hau hanoin sira atu foo.
verses.19: Maibee sira iha asuntu ruma hasoru nia kona ba sira nia relijiaun, no kona ba ema ida naran Jesus, nebee mate ona, no Paulo dehan katak Nia moris hela.
verses.20: No tanba hau la hatene oinsaa atu investiga pergunta sira nee, hau husu nia se nia hakarak baa Jerusalém hodi hau bele tesi lia ba nia kona ba asuntu sira nee.
verses.21: Maibee bainhira Paulo husu atu hein desizaun hosi liurai boot, hau haruka ema lori nia ba komarka too hau bele haruka nia ba César.”
verses.22: Depois Agripa dehan ba Festo, “Hau mos hakarak rona mane nee.” Festo dehan, “Aban, ita boot sei rona nia.”
verses.23: Loron tuir mai, Agripa no Berenice mai ho serimonia boot. Sira tama tribunál hamutuk ho komandante boot sira no ema boot sira hosi sidade nee. Depois Festo haruka ema lori Paulo mai.
verses.24: Festo dehan, “Liurai Agripa, no ema hotu nebee marka prezensa iha nee ho ami. Imi haree mane nee, nebee ema Judea sira hotu husu mai hau iha Jerusalém, no mos iha nee, no hakilar katak nia la bele moris tan.
verses.25: Maibee bainhira hau haree katak nia la halo buat ida nebee merese atu simu kastigu mate, no katak nia rasik husu atu baa liurai boot, hau desidi atu haruka nia baa.
verses.26: Maibee hau la iha buat ida nebee metin atu hakerek ba hau nia nai kona ba nia. Tanba nee mak hau lori nia mai iha imi nia oin, liu-liu ba ita boot, liurai Agripa, atu nunee, bainhira ita buka hatene di-diak tiha, hau bele iha buat ruma atu hakerek.
verses.27: Tanba hau hanoin laduun diak atu haruka ema dadur ida no la hakerek sala nebee ema akuza hasoru nia.”

verses.1: Depois Agripa dehan ba Paulo, “O bele koalia hodi defende o nia aan.” Entaun Paulo lolo liman no nia koalia nunee:
verses.2: “Hau kontenti, liurai Agripa, atu defende hau nia aan ohin loron iha ita boot nia oin kona ba buat hotu nebee ema Judeu sira akuza hasoru hau.
verses.3: Liu-liu tanba ita boot hatene di-diak kona ba ema Judeu sira nia kostumi hotu no oinsaa sira haksesuk malu. Nee duni hau husu favór ida katak ita boot rona hau ho pasiénsia.
verses.4: Ema Judeu sira hotu hatene ona kona ba hau nia moris nee oinsaa dezde hau sei joven, komesa hosi tempu nebee hau hela iha hau nia rai rasik no iha Jerusalém.
verses.5: Sira hatene kleur ona, se sira hakarak foo sasin karik, katak hau moris nudar ema Farizeu. Ida nee mak grupu nebee tuir ami nia relijiaun makaas liu ema seluk.
verses.6: No agora hau hamriik iha tribunál nee tanba esperansa iha promesa nebee Maromak halo ba ami nia bei-ala sira.
verses.7: Ami nia suku sanulu resin rua espera atu simu promesa nee. Nunee sira hakaas aan atu serví Maromak loron-kalan. No tanba esperansa nee mak ema Judeu sira akuza fali hau, Oh liurai!
verses.8: Tanba saa mak imi hanoin katak Maromak la bele halo ema moris hias hosi mate?
verses.9: Hau rasik hanoin duni katak hau tenki halo buat barak atu kontra hasoru Jesus hosi Nazaré nia naran.
verses.10: No hau mos halo duni ida nee iha Jerusalém. Hau simu autoridade hosi xefi saserdote sira no hau hatama santu sira barak iha komarka. Hau mos konkorda bainhira sira atu foo kastigu mate ba ema sira nee.
verses.11: Dala barak hau foo terus ba sira iha sinagoga hotu. Hau koko halo sira atu koalia aat. Hau sai hirus makaas no duni sira too sidade sira iha rai seluk hodi hanehan sira.
verses.12: Tanba nee mak hau baa Damasku ho autoridade no lisensa hosi xefi saserdote sira.
verses.13: Iha meiudia, Oh liurai, hau haree iha dalan nee naroman ida hosi lalehan. Naroman ida nee nabilan makaas liu loro matan no leno haleu hau no sira nebee halo viajen hamutuk ho hau.
verses.14: Bainhira ami hotu monu ba rai, hau rona lian ida koalia mai hau, no dehan iha lian Ebreu, ‘Saul, Saul, tanba saa mak o foo terus mai Hau? Susar ba o atu tebe ai meik.’
verses.15: Hau dehan, ‘Se mak Ita, Nai?’ No Nia dehan, ‘Hau mak Jesus nebee o haterus.
verses.16: Maibee hamriik ba iha o nia ain. Hau mosu mai ba o hodi foo knaar ba o atu sai atan no sasin ba Hau nebee o haree ona nee, no kona ba buat sira nebee Hau sei hamosu ba o.
verses.17: Hau sei salva o hosi povu nee no hosi ema Jentiu sira nebee Hau haruka o atu baa.
verses.18: Hau haruka o atu loke sira nia matan, no fila sira hosi nakukun ba naroman, no fila hosi Satanás nia kbiit ba Maromak. Nunee sira bele hetan perdua ba sala no simu liman rohan hamutuk ho sira nebee sai santu liu hosi fiar iha Hau.’
verses.19: Nunee, Oh liurai Agripa, hau la kontra vizaun hosi lalehan.
verses.20: Maibee uluk hau haklaken ba sira nebee iha Damasku, iha Jerusalém, iha rai Judeia tomak no ba ema Jentiu sira, katak sira tenki arepende no fila ba Maromak, no sira tenki lao ho hahalok nebee hatudu katak sira arepende ona.
verses.21: Tanba razaun nee mak ema Judeu sira kaer hau iha Templu, no sira koko atu oho hau.
verses.22: Too ohin loron hau hetan ajuda hosi Maromak. Nunee hau hamriik iha nee no foo sasin ba ema kiik no boot. Hau dehan deit buat nebee profeta sira no Moisés dehan ona atu akontese:
verses.23: katak Kristu tenki hetan terus, no Nia primeiru atu moris hias hosi mate, no Nia foo sai naroman ba povu nee no ba ema Jentiu sira.”
verses.24: Bainhira Paulo koalia dadaun hanesan nee, Festo dehan ho lian makaas, “Paulo, o bulak ona. O estuda barak demais too o sai bulak!”
verses.25: Maibee nia dehan, “Hau laos bulak, senhor Festo nebee hau respeita. Maibee hau koalia lia loos nebee ita bele kompriende.
verses.26: Tanba liurai hatene ona kona ba buat sira nee. Nunee hau brani atu koalia nakloke iha ninia oin. Tanba tuir hau nia hanoin, nia hatene buat hotu nee, tanba ami halo ida nee laos iha fatin subar.
verses.27: Liurai Agripa, ita boot fiar profeta sira ka lae? Hau hatene ita boot fiar.”
verses.28: Depois Agripa dehan ba Paulo, “Iha tempu badak deit o hanoin atu halo hau sai ema Kristaun ka?”
verses.29: Paulo dehan, “Iha tempu badak ka naruk, hau harohan ba Maromak, katak laos ita boot deit, maibee ema hotu nebee rona hau ohin loron bele sai hanesan hau - só deit laos ho korenti nebee kesi hau nee.”
verses.30: Depois liurai hamriik hamutuk ho governadór, Berenice no sira nebee tuur hamutuk ho sira.
verses.31: Bainhira sira ba fatin mes-mesak, sira koalia ba malu no dehan, “Mane nee la halo buat ida nebee merese atu simu kastigu mate ka komarka.”
verses.32: Depois Agripa dehan ba Festo, “Mane nee bele sai livre se nia la husu atu baa César.”

verses.1: Bainhira sira desidi katak ami sei sae roo ba Itália, sira entrega Paulo no ema dadur sira seluk ba komandante ida naran Júlio, hosi batalhaun Augusto nian.
verses.2: Ami sae roo ida hosi Adramítio no komesa baa ho planu atu baa fatin balu iha Ázia. Aristarco, ema Masedónia nebee hosi Tesalónika, baa hamutuk ho ami.
verses.3: Loron tuir mai, ami para iha Sidon. Júlio hatudu laran diak ba Paulo no foo lisensa ba nia atu baa haree ninia belun sira hodi sira bele tau matan ba nia.
verses.4: Bainhira ami sai hosi fatin nee, ami baa liu hosi Xipre nia sorin hakmatek, tanba anin huu hasoru ami.
verses.5: Bainhira ami baa liu hosi Silísia no Pamfília, ami too iha Mira iha Lícia.
verses.6: Iha nebaa komandante hetan roo ida hosi Alexandria nebee atu baa Itália, no nia hatama ami iha roo nee.
verses.7: Roo halai neineik deit too loron barak no ami liu hosi Knido ho susar tanba anin huu hasoru ami. Nunee ami baa liu hosi Kreta nia sorin hakmatek, iha Salmone nia oin.
verses.8: Ami kontinua baa ho susar, no ami too iha fatin ida naran Ibun Diak, nebee besik sidade Laseia.
verses.9: Viajen nee haan tempu kleur no agora tempu perigu atu baa tasi, tanba tempu jejún liu ona. Nunee Paulo foo hanoin ba sira,
verses.10: no dehan, “Senhor sira, hau haree katak viajen nee sei lori susar ba ita no estraga buat barak, laos ba sasaan no roo nee, maibee mos ba ita nia moris.”
verses.11: Maibee komandante fiar ema nebee kaer roo no roo nain liu fali buat nebee Paulo dehan.
verses.12: No tanba tasi ibun nee laduun diak atu hela durante tempu malirin, ema barak liu hanoin atu tama ba tasi no koko atu baa too iha Fenix. Fatin nee mak pontikais ida iha Kreta, nebee haree ba parte súl too loromonu no mos ba parte norte too loromonu.
verses.13: Bainhira anin hosi parte súl huu neineik, sira hanoin katak sira hetan oportunidade diak. Entaun sira hasae ankor no lori roo besik rai maran Kreta.
verses.14: Maibee la kleur, anin makaas ida naran ‘Anin Lorosae’ huu hasoru ami.
verses.15: Bainhira anin kaer roo nee, no ami la bele kontra anin, ami husik anin lori ami.
verses.16: Ami baa liu hosi ilha ida nia sorin hakmatek, naran Kauda. No ho susar boot ami konsege hatama roo nee nia roo kiik.
verses.17: Bainhira sira hasae tiha roo kiik, sira kesi tali liu hosi roo okos hodi hametin roo. Depois sira hatuun ankor tanba sira tauk atu kona rai iha Sirte. No anin lori deit ami.
verses.18: Laloran boot baku makaas ami. Nunee loron tuir mai sira komesa soe sasaan balu ba tasi laran.
verses.19: No iha loron terseiru, sira soe roo nia sasaan ho sira nia liman rasik.
verses.20: Bainhira ami la haree hetan loro matan ka fitun ba loron barak, no laloran boot makaas baku hela ami, ema hotu lakon esperansa atu hetan salvasaun.
verses.21: Kleur ona, ema sira nee la haan. Entaun Paulo hamriik iha sira nia leet, no nia dehan, “Senhor sira, diak liu imi rona tuir hau nia liafuan uluk nee no la sai hosi Kreta. Nunee ita la hetan susar nee no ita mos la lakon sasaan.
verses.22: Agora, hau foo korajen ba imi, aten brani ba! Tanba imi ida sei la lakon ninia moris, só roo deit mak sei lakon.
verses.23: Tanba horikalan anju ida hosi hau nia Maromak, nebee hau serví, hamriik iha hau nia oin.
verses.24: Anju nee dehan, ‘Keta tauk, Paulo, tanba o tenki hamriik iha César nia oin. No tebes, Maromak foo ba o ema hotu nebee iha roo laran hamutuk ho o.’
verses.25: Nee duni, maluk sira, aten brani ba. Tanba hau fiar Maromak katak buat hotu nebee Nia foo hatene mai hau nee sei akontese duni.
verses.26: Maski nunee ita tenki kona rai iha ilha ida.”
verses.27: Bainhira too kalan sanulu resin haat, no anin huu hela ami iha tasi Adria, maizoumenus iha kalan boot, ema nebee servisu iha roo senti katak ita besik rai maran.
verses.28: Sira sukat tasi klean no hetan metru tolu-nulu resin neen. Bainhira sira baa tan uitoan, sira sukat fali, no hetan metru rua-nulu resin hitu.
verses.29: Sira tauk ita sei xoke fatuk. Entaun sira soe ankor ba roo kotuk no harohan atu loron mai lalais.
verses.30: Ema nebee servisu iha roo buka atu halai husik hela roo. Entaun sira finji atu soe ankor hosi roo ulun, maibee tuir loloos sira hatuun roo kiik ba tasi.
verses.31: Paulo dehan ba komandante no ba soldadu sira, “Se ema sira nee la hela iha roo laran, ita sei la hetan salvasaun.”
verses.32: Nee duni soldadu sira tesi kotu tali hosi roo kiik, no husik roo kiik nee ba.
verses.33: Bainhira rai besik naroman ona, Paulo husu sira atu simu hahaan. Nia dehan, “Agora loron sanulu resin haat ona, no imi hein hela deit no la haan buat ida.
verses.34: Nunee hau husu imi atu haan buat ruma. Ida nee bele foo forsa ba imi. Tanba fuuk lahan ida mos sei la monu hosi imi ida nia ulun.”
verses.35: Koalia tiha nunee, nia foti paun, no foo agradese ba Maromak iha sira hotu nia oin. No bainhira nia silu tiha paun nee, nia komesa haan.
verses.36: Depois sira hotu hetan korajen, no sira mos haan buat ruma.
verses.37: Ami hotu iha roo laran nee hamutuk ema nain atus rua hitu-nulu resin neen (276).
verses.38: Bainhira sira haan natoon ona, sira soe trigu ba tasi laran hodi halo roo kamaan liu tan.
verses.39: Bainhira rai naroman ona, sira la hatene rai. Maibee sira haree hetan tasi ibun ho rai henek. Entaun sira hanoin atu koko, se bele karik, atu lori roo baa iha nebaa.
verses.40: No bainhira sira tesi tiha talin ba ankor sira nee, sira husik ankor sira iha tasi. No iha momentu nee mos sira kore tali kamudi nian. Sira hasae tiha laan iha roo ulun hodi simu anin no koko lori roo ba rai maran.
verses.41: Depois sira xoke rai iha fatin nebee seidauk too rai maran. Roo nia ulun kona metin no la muda, maibee laloran boot komesa baku rahun roo nia kotuk.
verses.42: Soldadu sira hanoin atu oho ema dadur hotu hodi sira la bele nani sai no halai lakon.
verses.43: Maibee komandante hakarak salva Paulo entaun nia la husik sira halao planu nee. Nia haruka sira nebee bele nani atu haksoit uluk ba tasi no baa too rai maran.
verses.44: Depois sira seluk bele uza ai kabelak no buat rahun hosi roo. Nunee ami hotu too iha rai maran ho diak.

verses.1: Bainhira ami too rai maran ho diak, ami foin hatene katak ilha nee naran Malta.
verses.2: Ema hosi rai nebaa hatudu laran diak tebes mai ami. Sira sunu ahi no simu ami hotu, tanba udan tau no rai malirin.
verses.3: Bainhira Paulo halibur ai sunu ruma no tau iha ahi, samea sai mai tanba manas no tata metin ninia liman.
verses.4: Bainhira ema hosi rai nebaa haree animál perigu nee tabele hela iha ninia liman, sira dehan ba malu, “Tebes duni, mane nee mak oho door. Maski nia konsege sai hosi tasi ho isin diak, maibee justisa la husik nia moris.”
verses.5: Paulo hisik tiha animál nee ba ahi no nia la sai moras.
verses.6: Sira hein nia isin bubu ka monu mate derepenti deit. Maibee bainhira sira hein kleur ona, no sira haree nia la sai moras, entaun sira troka sira nia hanoin no dehan katak nia mak maromak ida.
verses.7: Xefi iha ilha nee mak rai nain iha área nebaa. Xefi nia naran Públio no nia simu ami no tau matan ba ami durante loron tolu.
verses.8: Tuir mai, Públio nia aman toba hela tanba moras ho isin manas no tee been. Paulo tama ba ninia fatin no halo orasaun, no tau liman ba nia no kura nia.
verses.9: Bainhira Paulo halo tiha ida nee, ema seluk nebee iha moras iha ilha nee mai no nia kura sira hotu.
verses.10: Sira hatudu respeitu boot mai ami. No bainhira ami atu sai, sira foo buat hotu nebee ami presiza.
verses.11: Liu tiha fulan tolu, ami sae roo ida hosi Alexandria, nebee hela iha ilha nee durante tempu malirin. Roo nia sinál mak ‘maromak kaduak’.
verses.12: Ami baa too rai maran iha Sirakuza no hela iha nebaa loron tolu.
verses.13: Hosi nebaa ami kontinua baa too iha Régio. Liu tiha loron ida, anin huu hosi parte súl no loron tuir mai ami too iha Puteoli.
verses.14: Iha nebaa ami hetan maun-alin sira. Sira konvida ami atu hela loron hitu ho sira. Depois ami baa Roma.
verses.15: Bainhira maun-alin sira iha Roma rona kona ba ami, sira mai dook too iha Merkadu Ápio no Loja Tolu. Bainhira Paulo haree sira, nia foo agradese ba Maromak no sai aten brani.
verses.16: Bainhira ami too iha Roma, komandante foo lisensa ba Paulo atu hela mesak ho soldadu ida nebee hein nia.
verses.17: Liu tiha loron tolu, Paulo bolu ema Judeu sira nia xefi sira atu mai hamutuk. Bainhira sira halibur hamutuk ona, nia dehan ba sira, “Maun-alin sira, maski hau la halo buat ida hasoru ita nia povu ka ita nia bei-ala sira nia kostumi, maibee iha Jerusalém sira entrega hau nudar ema dadur ba iha ema Roma sira nia liman.
verses.18: Bainhira ema Roma sira husu di-diak mai hau, sira hakarak husik hau tanba la iha razaun atu foo kastigu mate ba hau.
verses.19: Maibee bainhira ema Judeu sira kontra hasoru ida nee, hau presiza husu atu baa César - maski hau la iha kazu ida hasoru hau nia nasaun.
verses.20: Tanba razaun nee mak hau husu atu hasoru imi no koalia ho imi. Tanba sira kesi hau ho korenti nee tanba Israel nia esperansa.”
verses.21: No sira dehan ba nia, “Ami seidauk simu surat ruma hosi Judeia kona ba ita. No hosi maun-alin sira nebee mai iha nee, la iha ida mak konta ka koalia aat kona ba ita.
verses.22: Maibee ami hakarak rona hosi ita kona ba ita nia hanoin. Tanba kona ba grupu relijiaun nee, ami hatene katak ema iha fatin hotu koalia hasoru grupu nee.”
verses.23: Bainhira sira marka loron ida ba Paulo, ema barak mai iha ninia hela fatin. Nia haklaken no foo sasin kona ba Maromak nia reinu. Hosi dadeer too kalan, nia koko dada sira atu fiar no hatudu oinsaa lei hosi Moisés no profeta sira koalia kona ba Jesus.
verses.24: Ema balu fiar buat nebee nia dehan, maibee ema seluk la fiar.
verses.25: Sira diskuti malu depois sira sai bainhira Paulo foo sai liafuan ida nee, “Espíritu Santu koalia loos bainhira Nia dehan ba ita nia bei-ala sira liu hosi profeta Isaias,
verses.26: ‘Baa povu nee, no dehan,
verses.27: Tanba povu nee nia fuan laran sai toos,
verses.28: Nunee hatene di-diak katak Maromak haruka Ninia salvasaun ba ema Jentiu sira, no sira sei rona tuir.”
verses.30: Paulo hela tinan rua iha nebaa iha uma nebee nia aluga. No nia simu ema hotu nebee baa vizita nia.
verses.31: Ho brani nia haklaken Maromak nia reinu no hanorin kona ba Nai Jesus Kristu, no ema la bandu nia.

verses.1: Paulo, atan ida hosi Jesus Kristu, nebee Jesus bolu atu sai apostolu, no haketak nia ba Maromak nia evanjelhu.
verses.2: Hori uluk kedas Maromak promesa evanjelhu nee liu hosi Ninia profeta sira iha Eskritura santu.
verses.3: Evanjelhu nee kona ba Ninia Oan Mane, nebee David nia bei-oan tuir isin.
verses.4: Maromak deklara katak Nia mak Maromak nia Oan ho kbiit, tuir Espíritu santidade nian. Maromak halo Nia moris hias ona hosi mate. Nia mak Jesus Kristu, ita nia Nai.
verses.5: Liu hosi Nia, ami simu ona grasa no knaar apostolu nian atu dada nasaun hotu hodi halo tuir fiar tanba Ninia naran.
verses.6: Ida nee inklui mos imi, nebee Nia bolu atu sai Jesus Kristu nian.
verses.7: Ba ema hotu iha Roma, nebee Maromak hadomi no bolu atu sai santu sira: Grasa no dame ba imi hosi ita nia Aman Maromak no Nai Jesus Kristu.
verses.8: Uluk nanain, hau foo agradese ba hau nia Maromak liu hosi Jesus Kristu tanba imi hotu. Tanba ema iha mundu tomak konta kona ba imi nia fiar.
verses.9: Hau serví Maromak ho hau nia espíritu atu foo sai evanjelhu kona ba Ninia Oan Mane. Nia mak hau nia sasin katak hau la para atu temi imi iha hau nia orasaun.
verses.10: Hau sempre husu oinsaa, tuir Maromak nia hakarak, katak loron ida hau bele halo viajen ba imi.
verses.11: Tanba hau hakarak tebes atu haree imi, atu nunee hau bele hatoo prezenti espirituál ruma ba imi hodi hametin imi.
verses.12: Atu nunee ita bele foo korajen ba malu, liu hosi ita nia fiar - imi nian no hau nian.
verses.13: Hau hakarak foo hatene ba imi, maun-alin sira, katak dala barak ona hau hanoin atu baa vizita imi. Maibee too agora buat ruma taka dalan. Hau hakarak hetan rezultadu ruma iha imi nia leet, hanesan iha ema Jentiu seluk sira nia leet.
verses.14: Hau iha obrigasaun ba ema Gregu sira, no mos ba sira nebee laos ema Gregu, inklui ema matenek no ema beik.
verses.15: Nunee hau hakarak tebes atu haklaken mos evanjelhu ba imi nebee iha Roma.
verses.16: Hau la moe kona ba evanjelhu. Tanba evanjelhu nee mak kbiit hosi Maromak atu foo salvasaun ba ema hotu nebee fiar, primeiru ba ema Judeu no mos ba ema Gregu.
verses.17: Tanba evanjelhu nee hatudu Maromak nia hahalok loos, hosi fiar ba fiar, tuir buat nebee ema hakerek nanis ona, “Ema loos sei moris liu hosi fiar.”
verses.18: Tanba Maromak nia laran hirus mosu mai hosi lalehan hasoru ema nia hahalok nebee la hamtauk no la loos. Tanba liu hosi hahalok la loos ema hanehan lia loos.
verses.19: Tanba buat nebee ema bele hatene kona ba Maromak, ema bele hatene mo-moos deit, tanba Maromak hatudu ona buat sira nee ba ema.
verses.20: Tanba maski ema la haree ho matan buat nebee Maromak nian, katak Ninia kbiit rohan laek no Ninia karakter nudar Maromak, sira sei bele hatene mo-moos. Tanba dezde Nia kria mundu, ema bele kompriende buat sira nee liu hosi buat nebee Nia halo ona. Nunee ema la iha razaun atu la fiar.
verses.21: Tanba maski sira hatene Maromak, sira la foo glória ba Nia nudar Maromak no sira la foo agradese ba Nia. Maibee sira nia hanoin lakon ona folin, no sira nia laran beik sai nakukun.
verses.22: Sira foti aan nudar ema matenek klean, afinál sira sai beik-teen.
verses.23: Sira husik glória hosi Maromak nebee nunka mate hodi hetan estátua ho modelu hanesan ema nebee bele mate, no hanesan manu, animál ain haat no animál sira nebee dolar.
verses.24: Nunee Maromak entrega sira ba sira nia laran nebee kaan atu sai foer no estraga sira nia isin lolon ho ema seluk.
verses.25: Tanba sira troka Maromak nia lia loos ho lia bosok. Sira adora no serví kriasaun laos Kriadór, nebee simu bensaun too rohan laek! Amén.
verses.26: Tanba razaun nee Maromak husik sira tuir sira nia hakarak nebee la loos. Sira nia feto sira troka relasaun naturál atu halo tuir buat nebee kontra hasoru hahalok naturál.
verses.27: Hanesan nee mos mane sira husik relasaun naturál ho feto sira no kaan fali mane seluk. Mane halao hahalok moe nian ho mane sira seluk, no sira simu kastigu tuir sira nia sala.
verses.28: Sira lakohi atu hanoin Maromak, entaun Maromak husik sira ba hanoin folin laek atu halo buat nebee tuir lo-loos la bele halo.
verses.29: Sira sai nakonu ho buat oi-oin nebee la loos, hahalok sala, laran kaan no hahalok aat. Sira sai nakonu ho laran moras no sira oho ema. Sira sempre istori malu, bosok malu, hanoin aat no lori lia.
verses.30: Sira koalia aat kona ba ema seluk, odi Maromak, la iha respeitu, foti aan, gaba aan, halo planu aat no la halo tuir inan-aman.
verses.31: Sira beik no la fiel. Sira la hatudu laran diak ka laran luak.
verses.32: Maski sira hatene Maromak nia estatutu katak sira nebee halo buat sira nee merese atu mate, sira kontinua halo nafatin buat sira nee. Laos nee deit, maibee sira apoia ema seluk nebee halo mos buat sira nee.

verses.1: Nee duni, Oh ema, o la iha razaun atu tesi lia ba ema seluk. Tanba bainhira o tesi lia ba ema seluk, o kondena o nia aan rasik. Tanba maski o tesi lia, o mos halo hanesan sira.
verses.2: Ita hatene katak Maromak tesi lia lo-loos ba ema nebee halo buat sira nee.
verses.3: Oh ema nebee tesi lia ba ema seluk nebee halo buat sira nee, maibee o mos halo hanesan, o hanoin katak o bele halai sees hodi Maromak la tesi lia ba o ka?
verses.4: Ou karik o hakribi Maromak nia laran diak tebes, nebee Nia hein hela ho pasiénsia naruk. O la hatene katak Maromak hatudu laran diak nee hodi o bele arepende ka?
verses.5: Maibee o aumenta ba beibeik Maromak nia laran hirus hasoru o tanba o ulun toos no lakohi arepende. Laran hirus nee sei mai iha loron nebee Maromak tesi lia ho hahalok loos.
verses.6: Nia sei selu ema ida-idak tuir ema nia hahalok.
verses.7: Ba sira nebee halo diak ho pasiénsia hodi hetan glória, onra no moris nebee nunka mate, Maromak sei foo moris rohan laek.
verses.8: Maibee ba sira nebee buka aan deit provoka ema seluk no lakohi halo tuir lia loos, maibee halo tuir hahalok nebee la loos, Maromak sei hatudu laran nakali no hirus.
verses.9: Ema hotu nebee halo aat sei hetan terus no susar, primeiru ba ema Judeu no mos ba ema Jentiu.
verses.10: Maibee ema hotu nebee halo diak sei hetan glória, onra no dame, primeiru ba ema Judeu no mos ba ema Jentiu.
verses.11: Tanba Maromak la fihir ba ema ida.
verses.12: Tanba ema hotu nebee halo sala maski sira la hatene lei, sira sei lakon ketak hosi lei. No ema hotu nebee halo sala bainhira sira hatene lei, Maromak sei tesi lia ba sira tuir lei nee.
verses.13: Tanba laos ema nebee rona deit lei mak ema nebee sai loos iha Maromak nia oin, maibee sira nebee halo tuir lei mak sai loos.
verses.14: Tanba bainhira ema Jentiu sira, nebee la iha lei, halo tuir deit buat nebee lei haruka, sira sai lei ba sira nia aan rasik, maski sira la iha lei.
verses.15: Sira hatudu katak hahalok hosi lei nee hakerek ona iha sira nia fuan laran. Sira nia konsiénsia mos foo sasin, no sira nia hanoin mos akuza sira no mos defende sira.
verses.16: Tuir evanjelhu nebee hau haklaken, ida nee sei akontese iha loron nebee Maromak tesi lia ba ema nia segredu liu hosi Jesus Kristu.
verses.17: Maibee karik o dehan katak o mak ema Judeu ida, no o sadere ba lei, no o gaba aan tanba Maromak,
verses.18: no o hatene Ninia hakarak, no aprova buat nebee diak tebes, tanba o simu hanorin hosi lei.
verses.19: Karik o hanoin duni katak o rasik mak matadalan ba ema matan delek, no naroman ida ba sira nebee iha nakukun laran.
verses.20: Karik o koriji ema beik no hanorin labarik kiik-oan sira, tanba o iha lei nebee hatudu matenek no lia loos.
verses.21: Nunee o nebee hanorin ema seluk, o hanorin o nia aan rasik ka lae? O haklaken dehan keta naok, maibee o rasik naok ka lae?
verses.22: O dehan ema keta halo sala seksuál, maibee o halo sala seksuál ka lae? O hakribi estátua lulik sira, maibee o naok fali hosi templu sira ka lae?
verses.23: O gaba aan tanba lei, maibee o despreza Maromak tanba o la halo tuir lei nee.
verses.24: Nunee ema hakerek nanis ona, “Ema Jentiu sira koalia aat Maromak tanba imi.”
verses.25: Tanba sirkunsizaun iha benefísiu, se o halo tuir lei karik. Maibee se o la halo tuir lei, o nia sirkunsizaun nee lakon deit no o sai hanesan ema nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun.
verses.26: Nunee se ema nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun halo tuir hahalok loos hosi lei, laos nia hanesan ema nebee hetan ona sirkunsizaun?
verses.27: Depois nia nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun iha isin maibee halo tuir lei, nia sei tesi lia ba o nebee iha regulamentu no sirkunsizaun maibee kontra fali lei.
verses.28: Tanba ema ida laos ema Judeu iha liur deit, no sirkunsizaun nee laos iha liur no kona ba isin lolon.
verses.29: Maibee ema ida mak ema Judeu iha ninia laran, no sirkunsizaun nee kona ba fuan laran, iha espíritu, no laos kona ba regulamentu. Laos ema mak foti aas nia, maibee Maromak.

verses.1: Entaun ema Judeu sira hetan benefísiu saida? No sirkunsizaun iha folin saida?
verses.2: Iha folin boot oi-oin. Liu-liu tanba sira simu liafuan hosi Maromak.
verses.3: Maibee oinsaa, se ema Judeu balu la hatudu fidelidade karik? Sira nia hahalok nee sei halakon Maromak nia fidelidade ka?
verses.4: La bele! Ema hotu bele sai bosok-teen, maibee Maromak loos hela. Hanesan ema hakerek nanis ona,
verses.5: Maibee se ita nia hahalok aat hatudu katak Maromak iha hahalok loos, ita sei dehan saida? Karik Maromak la hatudu hahalok loos bainhira Nia hatudu laran hirus ba ita ka? (Hau koalia nudar ema ida.)
verses.6: La bele! Se nunee, oinsaa mak Maromak bele tesi lia ba mundu?
verses.7: Maibee se karik hau nia liafuan bosok halo ema foo glória tan ba Maromak tanba Ninia lia loos, tanba saa mak hau hetan hela kastigu nudar sala nain?
verses.8: No tanba saa mak ita la halo aat hodi buat diak bele akontese? Ema balu koalia aat kona ba ami tanba sira dehan katak ami koalia hanesan nee. Kastigu nebee sira hetan mak loos.
verses.9: Nunee oinsaa? Ita ema Judeu diak liu fali sira ka? Lae liu! Tanba ita foin hatudu katak sala ukun ema hotu, inklui ema Judeu sira no ema Jentiu sira.
verses.10: Hanesan sira hakerek nanis ona,
verses.11: La iha ema ida nebee kompriende,
verses.12: Sira hotu lao sees ona, hamutuk sira sai folin laek;
verses.13: “Sira nia kakorok hanesan rate nebee nakloke hela,
verses.14: “Sira nia ibun nakonu ho malisan no liafuan moruk.”
verses.15: “Sira nia ain halai atu fakar raan.”
verses.16: “Sira lao tuir dalan nebee halakon no foo terus.
verses.17: Sira la hatene dalan dame nian.”
verses.18: “Sira nia matan la hamtauk Maromak.”
verses.19: Agora, ita hatene katak saida mak lei dehan, lei nee dehan ba sira nebee iha lei nia okos. Atu nunee ibun hotu sei nonook, no ema hotu iha mundu merese atu simu kastigu iha Maromak nia oin.
verses.20: Tanba la iha ema ida nebee sai loos iha Maromak nia oin liu hosi halo tuir lei. Maibee liu hosi lei ita hatene kona ba ita nia sala.
verses.21: Maibee agora, moris loos mosu mai hosi Maromak nebee ketak hosi lei. Lei no profeta sira foo sasin kona ba moris loos nee.
verses.22: Ema hotu nebee fiar bele hetan moris loos hosi Maromak. Ida nee mai liu hosi fiar iha Jesus Kristu. Ema hotu hanesan deit.
verses.23: Tanba ema hotu-hotu halo ona sala, no sira la too Maromak nia glória.
verses.24: Maibee ita bele sai loos liu hosi Ninia grasa nebee Nia foo gratis deit. Tanba Nia hola fali ita iha Jesus Kristu.
verses.25: Maromak tau Jesus nudar sakrifísiu nebee taka ita nia sala nebee ita simu liu hosi fiar iha Jesus nia raan. Ida nee hatudu Maromak nia hahalok loos tanba Nia hatudu pasiénsia kona ba sala iha tempu uluk.
verses.26: Ida nee mos hatudu Ninia hahalok loos iha tempu agora. Nunee Nia mak loos, no Nia mak Ida nebee halo ema loos nebee fiar iha Jesus.
verses.27: Entaun ita bele gaba aan ka? La bele! Ida nee liu hosi lei saida? Liu hosi lei hahalok nian? Lae, maibee liu hosi lei fiar nian.
verses.28: Tanba ita hatene ona katak ema sai loos liu hosi fiar, nebee ketak hosi hahalok nebee tuir lei.
verses.29: Nia mak Maromak ba ema Judeu sira deit ka? Laos Nia mos Maromak ba ema Jentiu sira? Sin, ba ema Jentiu sira mos.
verses.30: Tanba iha Maromak ida deit, nebee sei halo loos sira nebee iha sirkunsizaun liu hosi fiar, no mos sira nebee la iha sirkunsizaun liu hosi fiar.
verses.31: Entaun ita halakon lei tanba fiar ka? La bele! Maibee, ita hametin lei.

4.title: Abraão Sai Loos Liu Hosi Fiar

verses.1: Entaun ita bele dehan saida kona ba Abraão, nebee ita nia bei-ala tuir isin? Nia manaan saida?
verses.2: Tanba se Abraão sai loos liu hosi hahalok, nia bele gaba aan. Maibee laos iha Maromak nia oin.
verses.3: Tanba Eskritura dehan saida? “Abraão fiar ba Maromak, no Maromak sura fiar nee nudar moris loos.”
verses.4: Agora, ba nia nebee servisu, ninia patraun la sura ninia kolen nudar prezenti ida, maibee nudar buat nebee merese atu simu.
verses.5: No ba nia nebee la servisu maibee fiar deit ba Ida nebee halo ema sai loos nebee seidauk konhese Maromak, ninia fiar nee sura nudar moris loos.
verses.6: David mos koalia kona ba haksolok ba ema nebee Maromak sura nudar ema moris loos ketak hosi ninia hahalok:
verses.7: “Haksolok ba sira nebee hetan perdaun hosi sira nia hahalok aat,
verses.8: Haksolok ba ema nebee Nai la sura ninia sala.”
verses.9: Laran haksolok nee só ba deit sira nebee hetan sirkunsizaun ka ba mos sira nebee la hetan sirkunsizaun? Tanba ita dehan ona katak Maromak sura Abraão nia fiar nudar moris loos.
verses.10: Oinsaa Maromak sura ida nee ba nia? Ida nee molok ka depois nia hetan sirkunsizaun? Laos depois, maibee molok nia hetan sirkunsizaun.
verses.11: Nia simu sirkunsizaun nudar sinál ida nebee hatudu katak nia iha ona moris loos liu hosi fiar molok nia hetan sirkunsizaun. Nunee nia sai aman ba ema hotu nebee fiar maski sira la hetan sirkunsizaun hodi Maromak bele sura moris loos ba sira mos.
verses.12: No nia mak aman ba sira nebee hetan sirkunsizaun, nebee laos hetan sirkunsizaun deit, maibee sira mos lao tuir Abraão nia fiar nebee nia iha molok nia hetan sirkunsizaun.
verses.13: Tanba Abraão no ninia bei-oan sira hetan promesa katak nia sei simu mundu nudar liman rohan. Promesa nee la mai liu hosi lei maibee liu hosi moris loos nebee mai hosi fiar.
verses.14: Tanba se sira nebee halo tuir lei mak simu liman rohan nee, entaun fiar sai mamuk no promesa nee la iha folin.
verses.15: Tanba lei lori mai Maromak nia laran hirus. Maibee se lei la iha, entaun sala nebee kontra lei mos la iha.
verses.16: Tanba nee promesa depende ba fiar, atu nunee promesa bele mai liu hosi grasa. No bei-oan hotu bele simu promesa nee - laos deit sira nebee halo tuir lei maibee sira mos nebee lao tuir Abraão nia fiar. Nia mak aman ba ita hotu.
verses.17: Hanesan ema hakerek nanis ona, “Hau halo o sai aman ba nasaun barak.” Abraão fiar ba Maromak nebee halo ema mate sai moris fali no bolu buat nebee la iha atu mosu mai.
verses.18: Maski esperansa la iha, Abraão iha esperansa atu fiar katak nia sei sai aman ba nasaun barak. Tanba Maromak foo hatene ba nia, “O nia bei-oan sira sei sai hanesan nee.”
verses.19: Nia la sai fraku iha ninia fiar bainhira nia hanoin ninia isin rasik, nebee hanesan mate ona (tanba nia maizoumenus tinan atus ida), no mos bainhira nia hanoin Sara nia oan fatin nebee la bele hetan oan.
verses.20: Nia la lakon fiar ho laran ru-rua kona ba Maromak nia promesa, maibee nia fiar metin no foo glória ba Maromak.
verses.21: Abraão laran metin katak Maromak bele halo tuir duni buat nebee Nia promete ona.
verses.22: Tanba nee mak Maromak sura Abraão nia fiar nudar moris loos.
verses.23: Liafuan nebee hakerek, “sura ba nia”, la hakerek ba nia deit.
