verses.19: Maski nunee Maromak nia fundasaun metin sei hamriik hela, nebee hakerek liafuan nee: “Nai hatene sira nebee Ninian,” no, “Ema hotu nebee foo sai Nai nia naran tenki husik tiha hahalok aat.”
verses.20: Agora, uma boot iha bikan osan mean no osan mutin. Maibee iha mos bikan nebee halo hosi ai no rai mean. Balu uza ba servisu onra nian no balu uza ba servisu nebee la foo onra.
verses.21: Se ema ida hamoos aan hosi buat nebee la foo onra, nia sei sai bikan ida ba servisu onra nian. Nia sei sai santu, no uma nain bele uza nia tanba nia prontu atu halo servisu diak oi-oin.
verses.22: Entaun halai sees hosi buat sira nebee joven sira kaan. Duni tuir hahalok loos, fiar, domin no dame, hamutuk ho sira nebee bolu ba Nai ho laran moos.
verses.23: Maibee hadook aan hosi pergunta sira nebee beik no la matenek tanba o hatene katak sira lori ema atu istori malu.
verses.24: Nai nia atan la bele istori malu ho ema, maibee hatudu laran diak ba ema hotu, hatene atu hanorin, no tahan buat aat ho pasiénsia.
verses.25: Nia sei koriji ho laran maus ema nebee kontra nia. Karik Maromak sei foo oportunidade ba sira atu arepende no hatene kona ba lia loos.
verses.26: Atu nunee sira bele hanoin loos no halai sai hosi Diabu nia lasu, tanba Diabu kaer ona sira hodi halo tuir ninia hakarak.

verses.1: Maibee kompriende ida nee ba, katak iha loron ikus, tempu susar sei mai.
verses.2: Tanba ema sei hadomi deit sira nia aan rasik, hadomi osan, gaba aan, foti aan, koalia aat, la halo tuir inan-aman, la foo agradese, la santu,
verses.3: la iha laran diak, lakohi halo dame, konta aat ema nia vida, la kontrola aan, halo violénsia, la hadomi buat nebee diak,
verses.4: sai traidór, halo sala lalais, loko aan no hadomi liu atu halo aan kontenti duké hadomi Maromak.
verses.5: Sira hatudu oin ida nebee hamtauk Maromak, maibee sira nega hahalok nee nia kbiit. Hadook aan hosi ema hanesan nee.
verses.6: Tanba hosi sira nia leet, ema balu tama sub-subar iha ema seluk nia uma no kaer dadur feto beik sira nebee halo sala barak no lao sala ho laran nebee kaan buat oi-oin.
verses.7: Sira sempre aprende maibee nunka hetan matenek lia loos nian.
verses.8: Hanesan Janes no Jambres kontra hasoru Moisés, nunee mos sira kontra hasoru lia loos. Ema sira nee iha neon aat liu no la too atu fiar.
verses.9: Maibee sira sei la bele kontinua. Tanba ema hotu sei haree sira nia hahalok beik, hanesan mos ho Janes no Jambres.
verses.10: Maibee o tuir ona hau nia hanorin, hau nia hahalok, hau nia objetivu iha moris nee, hau nia fiar, hau nia pasiénsia, hau nia domin, hau nia laran metin,
verses.11: no hau nia terus no susar nebee hasoru hau iha Antiokia, Ikónio no Listra. Hau tahan terus sira nee, no Nai salva tiha hau hosi terus hotu nee.
verses.12: Loos duni, ema hotu nebee hakarak moris ho laran nebee hamtauk Maromak iha Kristu Jesus sei hetan terus.
verses.13: No ema aat no bosok-teen sira sei sai aat ba beibeik. Sira sei lohi ema no ema sei lohi sira.
verses.14: Maibee kona ba o, kontinua iha buat nebee o aprende no fiar metin ona, tanba o konhese nia nebee hanorin o.
verses.15: Tanba dezde o sei kiik, o hatene surat santu sira nebee bele foo matenek klean ba o hodi hetan salvasaun liu hosi fiar iha Kristu Jesus.
verses.16: Maromak huu sai Eskritura hotu, no Eskritura nee foo benefísiu hodi hanorin, hatudu sala, koriji no foo treinu iha moris loos,
verses.17: atu nunee Maromak nia ema bele sai hanesan tasak no kompletu ona atu halo buat diak hotu.

verses.1: Hau haruka o iha Maromak no Nai Jesus Kristu nia prezensa, nebee sei tesi lia ba ema moris no ema mate bainhira Nia mosu mai ho Ninia reinu:
verses.2: Haklaken liafuan ba. O tenki prontu, iha tempu diak no tempu la diak. Foo hanoin, koriji no foo korajen ho pasiénsia no hanorin tomak.
verses.3: Tanba tempu sei too mai bainhira ema sei la simu tan hanorin diak. Maibee sira sei iha tilun katar atu halibur mestri sira nebee koalia tuir buat nebee sira hakarak.
verses.4: No sira sei fila kotuk hodi la rona tan lia loos. No sira sei lao lakon ba ai knanoik arbiru deit.
verses.5: Maibee kona ba o, sempre hanoin di-diak, tahan ba iha susar laran, halo servisu evanjelizmu nian no kumpri o nia ministériu.
verses.6: Tanba hau sai ona oferta hemu nian nebee fui dadaun, no tempu too ona hodi hau sai.
verses.7: Hau luta tiha ona iha funu diak, hau halai taru ona too rohan, hau kaer metin ona iha fiar.
verses.8: Agora hela deit koroa moris loos nian ba hau. Nai nebee juis loos sei foo koroa nee mai hau iha loron nebaa. No laos hau deit mak hetan, maibee sira hotu mos nebee hein ho domin ba loron nebee Nia sei hatudu aan.
verses.9: Hakaas aan atu mai lalais hodi haree hau.
verses.10: Tanba Demas mak husik tiha ona hau. Nia hadomi mundu nee no sai ona hodi baa Tesalónika. Cresente baa ona Galásia, no Tito baa ona Dalmásia.
verses.11: Só Lucas deit mak hamutuk ho hau. Foti Marcos, no lori nia hamutuk ho o. Tanba nia foo benefísiu mai hau iha ministériu.
verses.12: Hau haruka ona Tíkiko ba Éfezu.
verses.13: Bainhira o mai, lori mai hau nia unuk nebee hau rai iha Tróade ho Carpo. Lori mos livru sira no liu-liu surat sira.
verses.14: Alexandre, nebee badaen besi riti, halo buat aat barak mai hau. Nai sei selu fali nia tuir ninia hahalok.
verses.15: O mos tenki kuidadu kona ba nia tanba nia kontra makaas ita nia liafuan.
verses.16: Bainhira hau defende aan ba dala ida, la iha ema ida mak hamriik hamutuk ho hau, maibee sira hotu husik hau. Hau hein katak Maromak la foo sala ba sira.
verses.17: Maski nunee, Nai hamriik hamutuk ho hau, no foo kbiit mai hau. Nunee hau bele foo sai liafuan hotu no ema Jentiu hotu bele rona liafuan nee. No Nia hasai hau hosi liaun nia ibun.
verses.18: Nai sei hasai hau hosi hahalok aat hotu, no Nia sei lori hau ho diak ba Ninia reinu lalehan nian. Glória ba Nia too tinan ba tinan. Amén.
verses.19: Foo kumprimentus ba Prisca no Akila, no ba Onesíforo nia uma kain.
verses.20: Erasto hela iha Korinto, no hau husik Trófimo iha Mileto tanba nia moras.
verses.21: Hakaas aan atu mai too hau molok tempu malirin. Eubulo haruka kumprimentus ba o, no mos Pudente, Lino, Cláudia no maun-alin sira hotu.
verses.22: Nai Jesus Kristu hamutuk ho o nia espíritu. Grasa hamutuk ho imi.

verses.1: Hosi Paulo, Maromak nia atan ida, no Jesus Kristu nia apostolu ida. Hau mak apostolu tanba sira nia fiar nebee Maromak hili ona hodi sira bele hatene lia loos tuir moris nebee hamtauk Maromak.
verses.2: Moris nee iha esperansa ba moris rohan laek. Maromak, nebee nunka bosok, promete ida nee molok mundu hahuu.
verses.3: Tuir tempu loos, Maromak hatudu sai ida nee iha Ninia liafuan liu hosi haklaken. Hau simu knaar nee liu hosi mandamentu hosi Maromak, ita nia Salvadór.
verses.4: Ba Tito, hau nia oan lo-loos tuir fiar nebee ita hotu simu. Grasa, laran luak, no dame, hosi Aman Maromak no Kristu Jesus, ita nia Salvadór.
verses.5: Tanba razaun nee mak hau husik o iha Kreta, hodi o bele hadia buat sira nebee sei falta, no foo knaar ba katuas sira iha sidade hotu tuir diresaun nebee hau foo ona ba o.
verses.6: Hili ema nebee moos hosi sala, laen nebee iha feen ida, no ninia oan sira fiar, nebee laos nakar-teen ka kontradór.
verses.7: Tanba pastor ida nebee Maromak nia atan tenki moos hosi sala, laos ema nebee foti aan, la sai hirus lalais, la lanu, la halo violénsia ka la kaan atu manaan.
verses.8: Maibee nia gosta simu bainaka, hadomi buat nebee diak no ukun aan. Nia iha hahalok nebee loos, santu no metin.
verses.9: Nia tenki kaer metin ba liafuan fiel nebee ita hanorin. Nunee nia bele hanorin doutrina loos no nia bele koriji sira nebee kontra liafuan nee.
verses.10: Tanba ema barak kontra, koalia saugati deit no lohi, liu-liu sira nebee hosi grupu sirkunsizaun.
verses.11: La bele foo lisensa ba sira atu koalia. Tanba sira kria problema ba uma kain sira liu hosi hanorin nebee tuir lo-loos la bele hanorin. Sira hanorin buat nee hodi sira bele manaan buat nebee foer.
verses.12: Ema Kreta ida, nebee sira nia profeta rasik, dehan ona, “Ema Kreta sira mesak bosok-teen, animál fuik nebee aat no kabun-teek nebee baruk.”
verses.13: Liafuan nee mak loos. Nunee hasee sira makaas hodi sira bele sai diak iha fiar.
verses.14: No sira sei la hanoin tuir ema Judeu sira nia ai knanoik arbiru, no mandamentu hosi ema nebee fila kotuk ba lia loos.
verses.15: Ba ema moos, buat hotu moos. Maibee ba sira nebee foer no la fiar, la iha buat ida nebee moos. Sira nia neon no konsiénsia mos foer.
verses.16: Sira foo sai katak sira konhese Maromak, maibee sira nega Nia liu hosi sira nia hahalok. Sira aat tebes, lakohi halo tuir no la too atu halo buat ida nebee diak.

verses.1: Maibee kona ba o, hanorin tuir doutrina loos.
verses.2: Katuas sira tenki hanoin lo-loos, lao ho onra, ukun aan, no lao diak iha fiar, domin no pasiénsia.
verses.3: Ferik sira mos tenki lao ho laran santu, la koalia aat ema no la lanu. Sira tenki hanorin buat nebee diak.
verses.4: Nunee sira sei foo treinu ba joven feto atu hadomi sira nia laen no hadomi sira nia oan sira.
verses.5: Sira tenki ukun aan, iha laran moos, servisu iha uma, hatudu laran diak no hakruuk ba sira nia laen, atu nunee ema la koalia aat Maromak nia liafuan.
verses.6: Foo korajen mos ba joven mane atu ukun aan.
verses.7: Iha buat hotu, hatudu aan nudar ezemplu ba hahalok diak. Iha o nia hanorin hatudu laran loos no mos onra.
verses.8: Koalia diak hodi ema la bele foo sala ba o. Nunee ema nebee kontra o sei sai moe no la hetan buat aat ida hasoru ita.
verses.9: Atan sira tenki hakruuk ba sira nia patraun iha buat hotu. Sira tenki halo kontenti sira nia patraun no la bele koalia hasoru nia.
verses.10: Sira la bele foti sasaan sub-subar, maibee tenki hatudu laran metin diak. Nunee iha buat hotu sira bele hafurak hanorin hosi Maromak, ita nia Salvadór.
verses.11: Tanba Maromak hatudu sai ona Ninia grasa nebee lori salvasaun ba ema hotu.
verses.12: Grasa nee foo hanorin ba ita atu fila kotuk ba hahalok nebee la hamtauk Maromak no atu la kaan buat mundu nian. Grasa nee hanorin ita atu moris ho hanoin diak, hahalok loos no hamtauk Maromak iha tempu nee.
verses.13: Ita hein esperansa ksolok nian no glória hosi ita nia Maromak boot no Salvadór Jesus Kristu nebee sei hatudu aan.
verses.14: Nia foo Ninia aan rasik tanba ita, atu hola fali ita hosi hahalok aat hotu. Nia hamoos ita hodi sai Ninia povu rasik nebee laran manas atu halo buat nebee diak.
verses.15: Foo sai buat sira nee. Foo korajen no koriji ema ho autoridade tomak. Keta husik ema hatuun o.

verses.1: Foo hanoin ba sira atu hakruuk ba ukun nain sira no halo tuir autoridade sira. Sira tenki prontu atu halo servisu hotu nebee diak.
verses.2: Haruka sira atu la bele koalia aat kona ba ema ida no lalika istori malu. Maibee sira tenki hatudu laran diak no laran maus nafatin ba ema hotu.
verses.3: Tanba uluk ita rasik mos beik, la halo tuir buat nebee loos maibee tuir liafuan bosok. Ita sai atan ba hahalok nebee kaan buat saida deit no buka kontenti oi-oin. Ita moris ho laran nebee hanoin aat ema no laran moras. Ema odi ita no ita odi malu.
verses.4: Maibee bainhira Maromak, ita nia Salvadór, hatudu Ninia laran diak no domin,
verses.5: Nia salva ona ita, laos tanba hahalok loos nebee ita halo, maibee tuir Ninia laran luak. Nia salva ita liu hosi moris foun nebee hamoos ita no liu hosi Espíritu Santu nebee halo ita sai foun fali.
verses.6: Nia fakar Espíritu nee barak ba ita liu hosi Jesus Kristu, ita nia Salvadór.
verses.7: Ita sai ema loos liu hosi Ninia grasa. Nunee ita bele simu liman rohan nebee esperansa ba moris rohan laek.
verses.8: Ida nee mak liafuan fiel, no hau hakarak o koalia beibeik kona ba buat sira nee. Nunee sira nebee fiar ba Maromak bele kuidadu atu entrega aan ba hahalok diak. Buat sira nee mak diak no foo benefísiu ba ema.
verses.9: Maibee hadook aan hosi pergunta sira nebee beik no lista kona ba bei-ala sira nia naran. Keta istori malu ka haksesuk malu kona ba lei. Tanba buat sira nee la foo benefísiu no la iha folin.
verses.10: Kona ba ema nebee halo sarani sira fahe malu, koriji nia dala ida no dala rua, depois keta liga tan ho nia.
verses.11: Ita hatene katak ema hanesan nee lao la loos no sala nain. Nia kondena deit ninia aan rasik.
verses.12: Bainhira hau haruka Artemas ka Tíkiko ba o, hakaas aan atu mai vizita hau iha Nikópolis. Tanba hau desidi ona atu hela iha nebaa durante tempu malirin.
verses.13: Hakaas aan atu haruka lalais advogadu Zenas no Apolo ba sira nia viajen. Haree katak sira la falta buat ida.
verses.14: Ita nia povu tenki aprende atu entrega aan ba hahalok diak atu sira bele ajuda ema iha tempu susar no foo rezultadu diak.
verses.15: Ema hotu nebee hamutuk ho hau haruka kumprimentus ba o. Foo kumprimentus ba sira nebee hadomi ami iha fiar.

verses.1: Hosi Paulo, ema dadur tanba Kristu Jesus, no hosi ita nia maluk Timóteo.
verses.2: no ba ita nia feton Afia, no Arkipo, ita nia maluk funu nain, no igreja nebee iha o nia uma.
verses.3: Grasa ba imi, no dame, hosi ita nia Aman Maromak no Nai Jesus Kristu.
verses.4: Hau sempre foo agradese ba hau nia Maromak bainhira hau hanoin o iha hau nia orasaun sira.
verses.5: Tanba hau rona kona ba o nia domin no fiar nebee o hatudu ba Nai Jesus no ba santu sira hotu.
verses.6: Hau halo orasaun katak o bele fahe o nia fiar ho rezultadu diak. Atu nunee o bele sai nakonu ho matenek kona ba buat diak hotu nebee iha ita nia laran tanba Kristu.
verses.7: Santu sira hetan deskansa tanba o. Nunee, hau nia maluk, hau hetan ksolok boot no laran kamaan tanba o nia domin nee.
verses.8: Tanba nee, maski hau iha brani iha Kristu atu manda o atu halo buat nebee loos,
verses.9: maibee tanba domin, hau hanoin diak liu katak hau husu deit. Hau, Paulo, nebee katuas ona no mos ema dadur hela tanba Kristu Jesus,
verses.10: hau mak husu o kona ba hau nia oan Onésimo. Hau sai ona ninia aman bainhira hau iha komarka laran.
verses.11: Uluk nia la iha folin ba o, maibee agora nia iha folin duni ba o no mos ba hau.
verses.12: Hau haruka nia fila fali ba o. Nia mak hau nia fuan laran rasik.
verses.13: Hau sei kontenti atu husik nia hela nafatin hamutuk ho hau, atu nunee nia bele serví hau hodi o nia naran durante tempu nebee hau sei iha komarka laran tanba evanjelhu.
verses.14: Maibee hau hanoin diak liu katak hau la halo buat ida se hau la hetan lisensa hosi o, atu nunee o la hatudu hahalok diak tanba obrigasaun maibee tanba o rasik hakarak duni.
verses.15: Tanba razaun nee karik mak nia sai ketak hosi o, atu nunee o bele simu fali nia too rohan laek.
verses.16: Agora, o bele simu nia laos nudar atan, maibee buat nebee diak liu atan, nebee nudar maluk doben ida. Tebes nia mak maluk doben ba hau, maibee oinsaa liu tan ba o, iha isin no mos iha Nai.
verses.17: Se o haree hau nudar maluk ida, entaun simu nia hanesan o simu hau.
verses.18: Se nia halo sala hasoru o, ka nia tenki selu fali buat ruma ba o, entaun konta fali tusan nee nudar hau nian.
verses.19: Hau, Paulo, hakerek ida nee ho hau nia liman: Hau sei selu fali. Hau sei la konta katak o nia tusan ba hau nee mak o nia aan rasik.
verses.20: Sin, maluk, hau hakarak simu benefísiu ruma hosi o iha Nai. Foo kamaan ba hau nia laran iha Nai.
verses.21: Hau hakerek ba o tanba hau fiar katak o sei halo tuir hau nia hakarak. No hau hatene katak o sei halo liu fali buat nebee hau hatete.
verses.22: No mos, prepara fatin ida ba hau. Tanba hau hein katak, liu hosi o nia orasaun sira, Maromak sei foo hau ba o.
verses.23: Epafras, hau nia maluk dadur iha Kristu Jesus, haruka ninia kumprimentus ba o.
verses.24: No mos Marcos, Aristarco, Demas no Lucas, hau nia maluk servisu nain sira nee, haruka kumprimentus.
verses.25: Grasa hosi ita nia Nai Jesus Kristu sei hamutuk ho o nia espíritu.

1.title: Maromak Nia Oan Mane Mak Primieru

verses.1: Uluk liu, Maromak koalia ba ita nia bei-ala sira liu hosi profeta sira dala barak no liu hosi dalan oi-oin.
verses.2: Maibee iha tempu ikus nee, Nia koalia ba ita liu hosi Ninia Oan Mane. Nia foti Ninia Oan Mane atu simu buat hotu nudar liman rohan. No liu hosi Ninia Oan Mane mak Nia kria mundu.
verses.3: Oan Mane nee mak nabilan hosi Maromak nia glória. Nia mak Maromak nia ilas lo-loos. No Nia lori kriasaun tomak liu hosi Ninia liafuan nia kbiit. Bainhira Nia hamoos tiha sala, Nia tuur iha Majestade nia liman sorin loos iha fatin aas.
verses.4: Nia sai diak liu anju sira, hanesan Ninia naran nebee Nia simu ona nudar liman rohan mak aas liu sira nian.
verses.5: Tanba Maromak dehan ba anju ida nebee,
verses.6: No ida fali, bainhira Nia haruka Oan Boot nee atu moris mai iha mundu, Nia dehan,
verses.7: Kona ba anju sira, Maromak dehan,
verses.8: Maibee kona ba Oan Mane nee, Nia dehan,
verses.9: O hadomi hahalok loos, no odi hahalok aat.
verses.10: No,
verses.11: Sira sei lakon, maibee O sei hela nafatin.
verses.12: hanesan manta ida O sei lulun sira,
verses.13: No ba anju ida nebee mak Maromak dehan,
verses.14: Laos anju sira mak atan espíritu sira, nebee Maromak haruka sai ba hodi serví ema sira nebee sei simu salvasaun nudar liman rohan?

verses.1: Nunee ita tenki kaer metin liu tan ba buat nebee ita rona ona atu ita la lao sees hosi liafuan nee.
verses.2: Tanba se liafuan nebee mai liu hosi anju sira mak metin, no sala hotu no hahalok hotu nebee la tuir liafuan nee simu ona kastigu loos,
verses.3: entaun oinsaa mak ita bele halai sai, se ita la hanoin salvasaun boot nee? Tanba Nai foo sai uluk kona ba salvasaun nee, depois sira nebee rona mak hametin liafuan nee ba ita.
verses.4: No Maromak mos foo sasin liu hosi sinál no hahalok furak, no ho milagre oi-oin no prezenti sira hosi Espíritu Santu tuir Ninia hakarak.
verses.5: Ita koalia kona ba mundu nebee sei tuir mai. Maromak la halo mundu nebee sei tuir mai nee atu hakruuk ba anju sira.
verses.6: Iha fatin ida sira foo testemunha nee,
verses.7: O halo nia kiik liu anju sira too tempu uitoan,
verses.8: no tau buat hotu iha ninia ain okos hodi hakruuk ba nia.”
verses.9: Maibee ita haree Jesus. Maromak halo Nia sai kiik liu anju sira too tempu uitoan. No Maromak foo koroa ba Nia nebee iha glória no onra tanba Nia terus too mate, atu nunee, liu hosi Maromak nia grasa, Nia sai mate tanba ema hotu.
verses.10: Buat hotu nebee iha, iha tanba Maromak no liu hosi Maromak. No Nia lori oan barak ba glória. Entaun ida nee loos, katak Nia sei halo Huun ba sira nia salvasaun sai perfeitu liu hosi terus.
verses.11: Tanba Nia nebee halo santu no sira nebee sai santu, sira hotu mai hosi ida deit. Nunee Nia la moe atu bolu sira nudar alin sira.
verses.12: Nia dehan,
verses.13: No ida fali,
verses.14: Nee duni, tanba oan sira nee iha isin no raan, Nia rasik mos hola parte ho isin no raan nee, atu nunee liu hosi mate, Nia bele halakon ida nebee iha podér mate nian, nee katak Diabu.
verses.15: No Nia bele salva mos ema hotu nebee tauk mate, nebee hela nudar atan ba tauk nee durante sira nia moris tomak.
verses.16: Tanba tebes, Nia la tulun anju sira, maibee Nia tulun Abraão nia jerasaun.
verses.17: Nee duni Nia tenki sai hanesan Ninia alin sira iha buat hotu. Nunee Nia bele sai Saserdote Boot nebee iha laran luak no laran fiel iha ministériu Maromak nian. Entaun Nia bele hamoos povu nia sala.
verses.18: Tanba Nia rasik simu ona terus bainhira Nia hetan tentasaun, nunee Nia bele ajuda sira seluk nebee hetan tentasaun.

verses.1: Nee duni, maun-alin santu sira, nebee Maromak bolu ba lalehan, hanoin Jesus nebee Apostolu no Saserdote Aas, nebee ita foo sai nee.
verses.2: Nia hatudu fidelidade ba Maromak nebee foo knaar ba Nia, hanesan mos Moisés hatudu fidelidade iha Maromak nia uma kain tomak.
verses.3: Tanba Jesus merese atu simu glória boot liu fali Moisés nian, hanesan badaen uma simu glória boot liu uma nebee nia halo.
verses.4: Tanba sempre iha ema nebee halo uma ida-idak, maibee Nia nebee halo buat hotu mak Maromak.
verses.5: Agora Moisés mak fiel iha Maromak nia uma kain tomak nudar atan ida atu foo sasin kona ba buat sira nebee atu foo sai iha futuru.
verses.6: Maibee Kristu mak fiel nudar Oan Mane nebee toma konta ba Maromak nia uma. No ita mak Ninia uma, se ita kaer metin ba ita nia konfiansa no ita nia esperansa nebee ita gaba nee.
verses.7: Nee duni, hanesan Espíritu Santu dehan,
verses.8: la bele ulun toos hanesan iha tempu uluk nebee imi kontra hasoru Hau,
verses.9: Iha nebaa imi nia bei-ala sira koko Hau,
verses.10: Jerasaun nee provoka Hau,
verses.11: Tanba nee Hau jura ho laran nakali,
verses.12: Kuidadu ba, maun-alin sira! Keta halo be imi ida iha fuan laran aat no la fiar, nebee halo imi monu sai hosi Maromak Moris.
verses.13: Maibee loro-loron foo korajen ba malu bainhira tempu nee sei bolu “Ohin Loron,” atu nunee imi ida la bele sai ulun toos liu hosi sala nebee lohi ita.
verses.14: Tanba ita hola parte ona iha Kristu, se ita kaer duni ita nia konfiansa hosi huun too rohan.
verses.15: Hanesan sira dehan nanis ona,
verses.16: Tanba see mak rona no kontra hasoru Maromak? Laos ema hotu nebee Moisés lori sai hosi Ejitu?
verses.17: No see mak provoka Maromak durante tinan haat-nulu? Laos sira nebee sala, no monu mate iha rai fuik?
verses.18: No bainhira Maromak jura katak sira sei nunka tama ba Ninia fatin deskansa, Nia koalia kona ba see? Laos sira nebee la halo tuir Nia?
verses.19: Nunee ita haree katak sira la bele tama tanba sira la fiar.

verses.1: Nee duni, tanba promesa atu tama ba Maromak nia fatin deskansa sei iha nafatin, mai ita hamtauk ba. Keta halo be imi ida la konsege atu too iha fatin nebaa.
verses.2: Tanba evanjelhu mai ona too ita, hanesan mos ba sira. Maibee liafuan nebee sira rona nee la foo benefísiu ba sira, tanba sira la sai ida deit liu hosi fiar hamutuk ho sira nebee rona tuir.
verses.3: Tanba ita nebee fiar ona tama ba fatin deskansa nee. Nia dehan ona,
verses.4: Tanba iha fatin ida Nia koalia ona kona ba loron hitu hanesan nee, “Maromak deskansa hosi Ninia servisu hotu iha loron hitu.”
verses.5: No dala ida tan iha fatin nee, Nia dehan,
verses.6: Nee duni, ema balu sei tama ba fatin nee, no sira nebee uluk simu evanjelhu la konsege atu tama tanba sira la fiar.
verses.7: Hanesan nee fali, Nia marka loron ida nebee, “Ohin Loron.” Tanba nee, liu tiha tempu naruk, Nia dehan liu hosi David liafuan nebee hakerek ona,
verses.8: Tanba se Josué foo ona deskansa ba sira, entaun liu tiha tempu nee Maromak se la koalia tan kona ba loron seluk.
verses.9: Entaun, sei iha deskansa Sabdu nian ba Maromak nia povu.
verses.10: Tanba ema nebee tama ona ba Maromak nia fatin deskansa mak deskansa ona hosi ninia servisu hanesan Maromak mos deskansa hosi Ninia servisu.
verses.11: Nunee mai ita hakaas aan atu tama ba fatin deskansa nee, atu nunee la iha ema ida nebee monu hanesan nee tanba sira la halo tuir.
verses.12: Tanba Maromak nia liafuan mak moris no iha podér, no kroat liu fali surik nebee kroat iha sor-sorin. Liafuan nee sei sona too fahe mos klamar no espíritu, fukun no dolen, no bele hatudu fuan laran nia hanoin no kompriensaun.
verses.13: No la iha kriatura ida nebee bele subar hosi Maromak nia matan. Maibee buat hotu molik no nakloke ba Maromak nia matan. Nunee ita tenki hataan ba Nia kona ba ita nia hahalok.
verses.14: Nee duni, tanba ita iha Saserdote Boot nebee lao liu lalehan sira, nebee Jesus, Maromak nia Oan, mai ita kaer metin ba liafuan nebee ita foo sai nee.
verses.15: Tanba ita la iha saserdote boot nebee la bele kompriende ita nia laran fraku. Maibee ita iha Saserdote Boot nebee hasoru tentasaun oi-oin hanesan mos ita, maibee Nia la sala.
verses.16: Nunee mai ita hakbesik ba kadunan grasa nian ho konfiansa, atu ita bele simu laran luak no hetan grasa nebee tulun ita iha tempu nebee ita presiza.

verses.1: Tanba bainhira sira foti saserdote boot hosi ema nia leet, nia simu knaar atu halo ministériu ba Maromak hodi povu nia naran, atu oferese oferta no sakrifísiu tanba ema nia sala.
verses.2: Nia bele hatudu laran maus ba sira nebee la hatene no la tuir dalan loos, tanba nia mos iha laran fraku kona ba buat oi-oin.
verses.3: Tanba razaun nee mak nia tenki oferese sakrifísiu tanba ninia sala rasik, hanesan nia halo tanba povu nia sala.
verses.4: La iha ema ida nebee foti ninia aan rasik atu simu onra nee, maibee só deit Maromak bolu nia, hanesan ho Arão.
verses.5: Nunee mos Kristu la foo glória nee ba Ninia aan rasik atu sai Saserdote Boot. Maibee Nia simu knaar nee hosi Ida nebee dehan ba Nia,
verses.6: Hanesan Nia dehan mos iha fatin seluk,
verses.7: Bainhira Jesus sei iha nee iha isin lolon, Nia oferese orasaun no pedidu sira, ho lian makaas no matan been, ba Ida nebee bele salva Nia hosi mate. No Maromak rona Nia tanba Nia hamtauk Maromak.
verses.8: Maski Nia mak Oan Mane, Nia aprende atu halo tuir Maromak liu hosi Ninia terus.
verses.9: No bainhira Nia sai perfeitu ona, Nia sai huun ba salvasaun rohan laek ba ema hotu nebee halo tuir Nia.
verses.10: Tanba Maromak foti Nia nudar Saserdote Boot tuir Melkizedek nia orden.
verses.11: Ami iha buat barak atu dehan kona ba buat sira nee, no liafuan nee susar atu esplika tanba imi baruk atu rona.
verses.12: Tuir lo-loos, agora imi sai ona mestri, maibee imi presiza ema ida atu hanorin fali imi kona ba prinsípiu baziku hosi Maromak nia liafuan. Imi presiza susu been laos ai haan toos.
verses.13: Tanba ema hotu nebee hemu deit susu been la iha matenek kona ba liafuan moris loos nian, tanba nia mak labarik deit.
verses.14: Maibee ai haan toos mak ba ema nebee iha maturidade, ba sira nebee halo treinu beibeik liu hosi pratika hodi hetan podér atu tetu no hatene saida mak diak no saida mak aat.

verses.1: Entaun mai ita husik Kristu nia hanorin báziku no hakat ba maturidade. Ita sei la hada fali fundasaun nebee ita presiza arepende hosi hahalok mate no fiar ba Maromak,
verses.2: no hanorin kona ba batizmu, no tau liman ba ema, no sai moris hias hosi mate, no tesi lia ba rohan laek.
verses.3: No ita sei halo ida nee, se Maromak foo lisensa karik.
verses.4: Tanba la bele halo tuir mai nee – se ema sira nebee uluk simu naroman, no koko ona prezenti hosi lalehan, no hola parte ona ho Espíritu Santu,
verses.5: no koko ona Maromak nia liafuan nebee diak no kbiit hosi tempu nebee atu mai,
verses.6: no depois sira monu sees - ita la bele lori sira mai fali atu arepende. Tanba sira prega fila fali Maromak nia Oan ba krús. Ida nee hakanek sira nia aan rasik no hamoe Kristu iha ema nia oin.
verses.7: Tanba Maromak foo bensaun ba toos nebee hemu udan nebee tuun beibeik ba nia no foo produsaun nebee iha benefísiu ba sira nebee halo toos nee.
verses.8: Maibee se toos nee foo duut tarak no ai tarak deit, nia la iha folin no besik atu simu malisan. Ikus mai toos nain sei sunu nia.
verses.9: Maibee doben sira, maski ami koalia hanesan nee, maibee kona ba imi, ami fiar metin kona ba buat nebee diak liu tan - buat nebee salvasaun nian.
verses.10: Tanba Maromak mak justu no Nia sei la haluha imi nia servisu no kolen domin nian. Tanba imi hatudu katak imi hadomi Ninia naran bainhira imi serví santu sira, hanesan mos imi halo dadaun.
verses.11: No ami hakarak katak imi ida-idak badinas atu lao ho laran metin nebee nakonu ho esperansa too rohan.
verses.12: Keta sai baruk maibee halo tuir sira nebee simu promesa sira nudar liman rohan tanba sira hatudu fiar no pasiénsia.
verses.13: Tanba bainhira Maromak halo promesa ba Abraão, Nia la bele jura hodi buat nebee boot liu fali Nia aan. Entaun Nia jura hodi Ninia aan rasik.
verses.14: Nia dehan, “Tebes Hau sei foo bensaun ba o no habarak o.”
verses.15: Nee duni, bainhira nia hein ho pasiénsia nia simu promesa nee.
verses.16: Tanba ema jura hodi buat nebee boot liu fali sira nia aan rasik. No bainhira ema haksesuk malu, juramentu ida bele sai liafuan ikus hodi konfirma buat nebee sira dehan.
verses.17: Entaun bainhira Maromak hakarak hatudu metin liu tan ba sira nebee simu promesa nudar liman rohan katak Ninia planu nee sei la muda, Nia foo garantia liu hosi juramentu.
verses.18: No liu hosi buat rua nee, nebee la bele muda, tanba Maromak la bele bosok, ita bele simu korajen boot. Tanba ita halai ona ba fatin seguru hodi kaer metin ba esperansa nebee Nia tau iha ita nia oin.
verses.19: Ita iha ankór seguru no metin ba ita nia klamar, esperansa nebee tama ba laran liu, nebee iha veo nia kotuk.
verses.20: Jesus tama ona uluk ita, tanba Nia sai ona Saserdote Boot too tinan ba tinan tuir Melkizedek nia orden.

verses.1: Melkizedek mak liurai hosi Salem no saserdote ba Maromak Aas Liu. Nia hasoru Abraão bainhira Abraão fila fali mai hosi funu nebee nia oho liurai sira. No Melkizedek foo bensaun ba Abraão.
verses.2: No Abraão foo porsentu sanulu hosi buat hotu ba Melkizedek. Primeiru, ninia naran nia signifika katak ‘liurai moris loos nian’. Depois, nia mos liurai hosi Salem, nebee ‘liurai dame nian’.
verses.3: Nia la iha aman ka inan, no lista bei-ala la iha. Ninia loron sira la iha huun, no ninia moris la iha rohan. Maibee hanesan Maromak nia Oan, nia hela nafatin nudar saserdote too tinan ba tinan.
verses.4: Hanoin took, oinsaa ema nee mak boot duni! Aman boot Abraão mos foo porsentu sanulu hosi riku-soin nebee nia hadau.
verses.5: No Levi nia bei-oan sira nebee simu knaar nudar saserdote iha mandamentu iha lei atu foti porsentu sanulu hosi povu, nebee sira nia maun-alin sira, maski povu nee mos Abraão nia bei-oan sira.
verses.6: Maibee mane nee, nebee laos hosi Levi nia jerasaun, nia simu porsentu sanulu hosi Abraão no foo bensaun ba Abraão nebee iha ona promesa sira.
verses.7: Ita la bele kontra liafuan nee katak ida nebee kiik liu simu bensaun hosi ida nebee boot liu.
verses.8: Ema uluk nee simu porsentu sanulu maski sira mate. Maibee mane nee simu porsentu sanulu maski ita foo sasin ona katak nia moris hela.
verses.9: Ita bele mos dehan katak Levi rasik, nebee simu porsentu sanulu, selu fali porsentu sanulu liu hosi Abraão.
verses.10: Tanba nia sei iha ninia bei-ala nia kanotak laran bainhira Abraão hasoru Melkizedek.
verses.11: Agora, se ema bele sai perfeitu liu hosi saserdote Levi sira (nebee povu simu lei liu hosi saserdote sira nee), tanba saa mak ita presiza saserdote seluk nebee simu knaar tuir Melkizedek nia orden, no laos saserdote nebee simu knaar tuir Arão nia orden?
verses.12: Tanba bainhira sistema saserdote troka, entaun lei mos tenki troka.
verses.13: Tanba ita koalia kona ba Mane ida nebee mai hosi suku seluk. No suku seluk nee nunka iha ema ida nebee serví iha altár.
verses.14: Tanba ita hatene katak ita nia Nai mai hosi Judá. No Moisés nunka koalia kona ba saserdote nebee mai hosi suku nee.
verses.15: Maibee ida nee mak klaru liu tan bainhira Saserdote seluk simu knaar hanesan Melkizedek.
verses.16: Nia sai saserdote laos tuir lei kona ba jerasaun isin nian maibee tuir kbiit hosi moris nebee nunka lakon.
verses.17: Tanba Eskritura foo sasin ona,
verses.18: Tanba ita tau deit lei uluk nee ba sorin ida tanba lei nee fraku no la foo benefísiu.
verses.19: Tanba lei la halo buat ida perfeitu. Maibee esperansa diak liu tan mai ona. No liu hosi esperansa nee ita hakbesik ba Maromak.
verses.20: No ida nee akontese ho juramentu. Tanba uluk, sira nebee sai saserdote la hetan juramentu.
verses.21: Maibee Ida seluk nee sai saserdote ho juramentu liu hosi Nia nebee dehan ba saserdote nee,
verses.22: Nunee Jesus sai ona garantia ba aliansa nebee diak liu tan.
verses.23: Saserdote sira uluk mak barak. Sira la bele kontinua serví nudar saserdote tanba sira mate.
verses.24: Maibee Jesus mak saserdote ba nafatin, tanba Nia kontinua too tinan ba tinan.
verses.25: Tanba nee, Nia bele salva too kompletu duni sira nebee hakbesik ba Maromak liu hosi Nia. Tanba Nia sempre moris atu halo orasaun ba sira.
verses.26: Tanba ida nee mak loos duni katak ita iha Saserdote Boot hanesan nee, nebee santu, inosenti, la foer, ketak hosi sala nain sira, no aas liu lalehan sira.
verses.27: Nia la presiza halo hanesan saserdote sira uluk. Tanba loro-loron sira oferese sakrifísiu, primeiru ba sira nia sala rasik, depois ba povu nian. Maibee Jesus halo sakrifísiu dala ida deit nebee too ona bainhira Nia oferese Ninia aan rasik.
verses.28: Tanba lei foo knaar ba ema nebee fraku atu sai saserdote boot sira. Maibee liafuan nebee tuir lei, nebee mai hosi juramentu, foo knaar ba Oan Mane, nebee sai perfeitu ona too rohan laek.

8.title: Saserdote Boot Ba Aliansa Diak Liu

verses.1: Agora ita koalia ohin nee hodi halo pontu ida nee: Ita iha Saserdote Boot hanesan nee, nebee tuur iha Majestade nia kadunan nia sorin loos iha lalehan.
verses.2: Nia halo ministériu iha fatin santu, iha Tenda loos, nebee Nai mak harii, laos ema.
verses.3: Tanba saserdote boot hotu simu knaar hodi oferese prezenti no sakrifísiu. Nunee Saserdote ida nee tenki iha buat ruma atu oferese.
verses.4: Agora, se Nia iha mundu nee, Nia sei la sai saserdote ida, tanba ita iha ona saserdote sira nebee oferese prezenti sira tuir lei.
verses.5: Buat sira nee mak kopia ida no lalatak ida hosi buat sira nebee lalehan nian. Tanba bainhira Moisés besik atu harii Tenda, Maromak foo orden ba nia, no dehan, “Haree ba katak o halo buat hotu tuir dezenhu nebee Hau hatudu ba o iha foho.”
verses.6: Maibee agora Kristu simu ona ministériu nebee aas liu fali tuan nian, hanesan aliansa nebee Nia lori nudar mediadór mak diak liu. Tanba aliansa nee mai liu hosi promesa sira nebee diak liu.
verses.7: Tanba se karik aliansa primeiru la iha problema ida, entaun ita la presiza buka aliansa segundu.
verses.8: Maibee Nia hetan problema ho sira tanba Nia dehan,
verses.9: Aliansa foun nee sei la hanesan aliansa nebee Hau halo uluk ho sira nia bei-ala sira
verses.10: Tanba ida nee mak aliansa nebee Hau sei halo ho uma kain Israel
verses.11: No ema ida-idak sei la hanorin tan ninia maluk,
verses.12: Tanba Hau sei hatudu laran luak ba sira nia hahalok aat,
verses.13: Bainhira Nia koalia kona ba aliansa foun, Nia halo ida primeiru nee la vale ona. No buat nebee la vale ona no sai tuan nee besik atu lakon mohu deit.

verses.1: Agora, aliansa uluk mos iha regulamentu kona ba oinsaa atu adora Maromak no fatin iha mundu nebee santu.
verses.2: Tanba sira prepara Tabernakulu. Sira tau kandelabru, meza no Paun Prezensa Nian iha laran, neebe iha fatin primeiru. Sira bolu fatin nee Fatin Santu.
verses.3: Iha veo segundu nia kotuk iha fatin nebee bolu Fatin Santu Liu.
verses.4: Fatin nee iha altár osan mean hodi sunu insensu no Arka Aliansa nebee taka sor-sorin ho osan mean. Iha Arka Aliansa nia laran sira tau buli osan mean nebee iha maná, Arão nia ai tonka nebee dikin, no fatuk belar aliansa nian.
verses.5: Iha Arka Aliansa nia leten iha Glória nia kerubim sira nebee hamahon Matan Dame. Maibee agora ita la bele koalia klean liu kona ba buat sira nee.
verses.6: Bainhira sira halo tiha preparasaun nee, saserdote sira tama beibeik ba fatin primeiru hodi halao sira nia ministériu.
verses.7: Maibee ba fatin segundu, saserdote boot tama mesak deit tinan ida dala ida. Nia tenki lori raan nebee nia oferese tanba ninia aan rasik no tanba povu nia sala sira nebee sira la hatene.
verses.8: Ho ida nee, Espíritu Santu hatudu katak dalan atu tama ba fatin santu sira nee seidauk loke bainhira fatin primeiru sei hamriik hela.
verses.9: (Ida nee reprezenta tempu agora.) Sira oferese prezenti no sakrifísiu nebee la bele halo ema nebee adora nee nia konsiénsia sai perfeitu.
verses.10: Buat sira nee iha relasaun deit ho ai haan, hemu no serimónia hodi hamoos buat ruma, nebee regulamentu sira kona ba isin lolon nebee sira tenki tuir too tempu nebee halo buat hotu sai loos.
verses.11: Maibee bainhira Kristu mai nudar Saserdote Boot, Nia lori buat sira nebee diak nebee mai ona. Nia tama liu hosi Tenda nebee boot liu no perfeitu liu (nebee liman hosi kriasaun la halo).
verses.12: Nia tama dala ida deit ba fatin santu, laos liu hosi bibi no karau oan sira nia raan, maibee liu hosi Ninia raan rasik. Nunee Nia hola fali ita too tinan ba tinan.
verses.13: Tanba se raan hosi karau aman no bibi, no ahi kdesan hosi karau inan nebee hisik ba ema foer, bele hamoos ema nia isin hodi sai santu,
verses.14: entaun oinsaa liu tan ho Kristu nia raan, tanba Nia la iha sala no Nia oferese aan liu hosi Espíritu Rohan Laek ba Maromak, atu nunee Nia bele hamoos imi nia konsiénsia hosi hahalok mate atu serví Maromak Moris.
verses.15: Nee duni Nia mak mediadór ba aliansa foun atu ema nebee Maromak bolu ona bele simu liman rohan nebee Nia promesa too tinan ba tinan. Tanba Jesus mate ona hodi hola fali sira hosi sala aat nebee sira halo hasoru aliansa primeiru.
verses.16: Tanba bainhira ema hakerek surat mate nian, ita tenki hein ema nee mate lai mak bele tuir surat nee.
verses.17: Tanba surat nee iha folin só deit bainhira ema nee mate ona. Surat nee la iha forsa bainhira ema nebee hakerek surat nee sei moris hela.
verses.18: Tanba nee aliansa primeiru mos presiza raan hodi hahuu.
verses.19: Tanba bainhira Moisés foo sai tiha ona ukun fuan hotu hosi lei ba povu tomak nee, nia foti raan hosi karau oan no bibi sira, hamutuk ho bee, kabas mean no isope no hisik ba livru nee no povu tomak.
verses.20: Nia dehan, “Ida nee mak raan hosi aliansa nebee Maromak manda ba imi.”
verses.21: No mos nia hisik raan nee ba Tabernakulu no sasaan hotu nebee uza iha ministériu.
verses.22: Nee duni, tuir lei kuaze buat hotu tenki halo moos ho raan. Bainhira raan la fakar, la iha perdua ba sala.
verses.23: Buat nebee kopia deit hosi buat lalehan nian presiza halo moos ho regulamentu sira nee. Maibee buat lalehan nian presiza sakrifísiu nebee diak liu tan.
verses.24: Tanba Kristu la tama ba fatin santu nebee ema halo ho liman, nebee kopia hosi buat sira nebee loos, maibee Nia tama ba lalehan hodi hamriik iha Maromak nia prezensa tanba ita.
verses.25: Kristu la oferese aan beibeik hanesan saserdote boot nebee tama ba fatin santu tinan-tinan ho raan nebee laos ninian.
verses.26: Tanba se hanesan nee, Kristu tenki hetan terus beibeik hosi tempu nebee mundu hahuu. Maibee agora Nia hatudu aan dala ida deit iha tempu nia rohan hodi halakon sala liu hosi Ninia aan rasik nebee Nia oferese nudar sakrifísiu.
verses.27: Ema tenki mate dala ida, depois sira hetan julgamentu.
verses.28: Nunee mos Kristu oferese aan dala ida hodi lori ema barak nia sala. No Nia sei mosu mai ba dala rua laos atu halakon sala maibee atu salva sira nebee hein Nia ho laran.

verses.1: Tanba lei mak lalatak deit hosi buat diak sira nebee atu mai. Lei nee laos ilas lo-loos hosi realidade sira nee. Nunee lei la bele halo ema sai perfeitu liu hosi sakrifísiu nebee sira oferese tinan-tinan nafatin deit hodi hakbesik ba Maromak.
verses.2: Se bele karik, laos sira sei para ona no la oferese tan sakrifísiu sira nee? Tanba ema nebee adora nee sei sai moos ona no la iha tan konsiénsia ba sala sira.
verses.3: Maibee tinan-tinan sakrifísiu sira nee halo sira hanoin hetan sira nia sala.
verses.4: Tanba karau aman no bibi sira nia raan nunka bele hasai sala.
verses.5: Tanba nee, bainhira Kristu tama mai iha mundu, Nia dehan,
verses.6: Ita la kontenti ho sakrifísiu tunu motuk
verses.7: Depois Hau dehan, ‘Tebes, Hau mai atu halo tuir O nia hakarak, Oh Maromak,
verses.8: Bainhira Nia dehan iha leten nee, “Ita lakohi no la kontenti ho sakrifísiu, oferta sira, sakrifísiu tunu motuk no sakrifísiu sala nian” (sira oferese buat sira nee tuir lei),
verses.9: depois Nia dehan, “Tebes, Hau mai atu halo tuir Ita nia hakarak.” Nia halakon tiha ida primeiru atu estabelese ida segundu.
verses.10: No tuir hakarak nee ita sai santu ona liu hosi Jesus Kristu nia isin lolon nebee Nia oferese dala ida deit.
verses.11: Loro-loron saserdote hotu hamriik hodi halo sira nia ministériu. Sira oferese beibeik sakrifísiu hanesan nebee nunka bele hasai sala.
verses.12: Maibee bainhira Kristu oferese sakrifísiu ida deit ba tempu hotu tanba sala, Nia tuur iha Maromak nia liman loos.
verses.13: Hosi tempu nee, Nia hein too Ninia inimigu sira sai fatin ida hodi tau Ninia ain.
verses.14: Tanba liu hosi oferta ida deit Nia halo ema perfeitu too tinan ba tinan nebee sai santu hela.
verses.15: Espíritu Santu mos foo sasin ba ita. Tanba primeiru Nia dehan,
verses.16: “Ida nee mak aliansa nebee Hau sei halo ho sira
verses.17: Depois Nia aumenta,
verses.18: Bainhira Maromak foo ona perdua ba sala, ita la presiza halo oferta tan kona ba sala.
verses.19: Nee duni, maun-alin sira, ita iha konfiansa atu tama ba fatin santu sira liu hosi Jesus nia raan,
verses.20: nebee liu hosi dalan foun no moris nebee Nia loke tiha ba ita liu hosi veo, nebee liu hosi Ninia isin.
verses.21: No tanba ita iha Saserdote boot liu nebee toma konta ba Maromak nia uma,
verses.22: mai ita hakbesik ho fuan laran loos nebee fiar metin duni. Tanba Nia hisik tiha ona ita nia fuan laran hodi halakon konsiénsia aat, no Nia fasi tiha ona ita nia isin lolon ho bee moos.
verses.23: Mai ita kaer metin ba ita nia esperansa nebee ita foo sai nee no keta nakdedar, tanba Nia nebee promete mak fiel.
verses.24: Mai ita hanoin oinsaa ita bele foo hanoin ba malu atu hatudu domin no hahalok diak.
verses.25: Keta haluha atu halibur hamutuk, hanesan ema balu toman ona. Maibee foo korajen ba malu, no halo liu tan tanba ita haree katak Loron nee besik ona.
verses.26: Tanba se ita kontinua halo sala tuir ita nia hakarak bainhira ita hatene ona kona ba lia loos, entaun la iha tan sakrifísiu ba sala sira.
verses.27: Maibee hela deit atu hein julgamentu ho laran tauk no ahi manas nebee sei haan mohu mos ita nia inimigu sira.
verses.28: Ema nebee la halo tuir Moisés nia lei sei la hetan laran luak, maibee nia hetan kastigu mate bainhira ema nain rua ka tolu foo sasin.
verses.29: Entaun imi hanoin oinsaa liu tan mak ema merese atu hetan kastigu todan liu tan nebee sama Maromak nia Oan, hafoer raan aliansa nian nebee uluk halo nia santu, no halo Espíritu grasa nian sai hirus makaas?
verses.30: Tanba ita hatene Nia nebee dehan, “Vingansa mak Hau nian, no Hau sei selu fali.” No ida fali, “Nai sei tesi lia ba Ninia povu.”
verses.31: Nee mak tauk duni atu monu ba Maromak Moris nia liman.
verses.32: Maibee hanoin hetan tempu uluk. Bainhira imi simu tiha ona naroman, imi tahan iha luta todan ho terus.
verses.33: Dala ruma sira hamoe no haterus imi iha povu nia oin. Dala ruma imi hola parte ho ema nebee sira haterus ona.
verses.34: Tanba imi hatudu laran luak ba sira nebee iha komarka laran. No imi simu ho laran ksolok bainhira ema hadau imi nia rai, tanba imi hatene katak imi rasik iha riku-soin nebee diak liu tan no hela ba nafatin.
verses.35: Nunee keta soe imi nia konfiansa nebee sei lori kolen boot ba imi.
verses.36: Tanba imi presiza tahan hela, atu nunee, bainhira imi halo ona Maromak nia hakarak, imi bele simu buat nebee Nia promete ona.
verses.37: Tanba,
verses.38: maibee Hau nia ema loos sei moris liu hosi ninia fiar,
verses.39: Maibee ita la hola parte hamutuk ho sira nebee hakiduk no sei lakon, maibee ita hamutuk ho sira nebee fiar no salva sira nia moris.

verses.1: Agora, fiar mak laran metin ba buat sira nebee ita espera atu simu, no hatudu realidade kona ba buat sira nebee ita la haree.
verses.2: Tanba liu hosi fiar mak Maromak gaba ema iha tempu antigu.
verses.3: Liu hosi fiar mak ita kompriende katak Maromak nia liafuan kria buat hotu, atu nunee Nia halo buat nebee ita haree hosi buat nebee ita la haree.
verses.4: Liu hosi fiar mak Abel oferese sakrifísiu ida ba Maromak nebee diak liu fali Kaín nian. Maromak gaba nia nudar ema loos tanba Maromak simu ninia prezenti sira. No maski nia mate ona, nia koalia hela liu hosi ninia fiar.
verses.5: Liu hosi fiar mak Maromak foti sae Enok atu nia la haree mate. Ema buka la hetan nia tanba Maromak foti sae nia. Molok Maromak foti sae nia, Maromak gaba nia tanba nia halo Maromak kontenti.
verses.6: Maibee se ita la fiar, ita la bele halo Maromak kontenti. Tanba ema nebee hakbesik ba Maromak tenki fiar katak Maromak iha duni no Nia sei foo kolen ba sira nebee buka Nia ho laran.
verses.7: Liu hosi fiar mak Noé halo roo boot hodi salva ninia uma kain ho laran nebee hamtauk Maromak. Tanba nia simu avizu hosi Maromak kona ba buat nebee sei akontese nebee ema seidauk haree. Liu hosi buat nee nia kondena mundu no simu moris loos nudar liman rohan nebee mai liu hosi fiar.
verses.8: Liu hosi fiar mak Abraão halo tuir Maromak bainhira Maromak bolu nia atu sai ba fatin nebee nia sei simu nudar liman rohan. Nia sai ba, maski nia la hatene atu baa nebee.
verses.9: Liu hosi fiar mak nia baa hela iha rai promesa nian, hanesan iha rai liur. Nia hela iha tenda hamutuk ho Isak no Jacó, nebee simu promesa nee nudar liman rohan hamutuk ho nia.
verses.10: Tanba nia hein sidade nebee iha fundasaun, sidade nebee Maromak mak halo ninia dezenhu no harii.
verses.11: Liu hosi fiar mak Sara mos simu kbiit atu sai isin rua maski ninia idade liu tiha ona. Tanba nia hanoin katak Ida nebee promete mak fiel.
verses.12: Nunee hosi mane ida, nebee mos besik atu mate, sira hetan oan barak tebes, hanesan fitun iha lalehan no barak hanesan rai henek ki-kiik iha tasi ibun nebee la bele sura.
verses.13: Ema hotu nee fiar too mate. Sira la hetan promesa sira nee. Maibee sira haree no simu buat sira nee hosi dook. No sira foo sai katak sira mak estranjeiru no ema lao rai iha mundu nee.
verses.14: Tanba ema nebee koalia hanesan nee hatudu ho klaru katak sira buka sira nia rai rasik.
verses.15: Se karik sira hanoin nafatin rai nebee sira husik ona, sira bele hetan oportunidade atu fila fali ba rai nee.
verses.16: Maibee sira buka rai nebee diak liu tan, nebee rai lalehan nian. Nunee Maromak la moe bainhira ema bolu Nia nudar sira nia Maromak, tanba Nia prepara ona sidade ida ba sira.
verses.17: Liu hosi fiar mak Abraão oferese Isak bainhira Maromak koko nia. Nia simu ona promesa sira nee no nia atu oferese ninia oan mane mesak,
verses.18: maski Maromak dehan ona, “O sei hetan bei-oan sira liu hosi Isak.”
verses.19: Abraão hanoin katak Maromak bele halo Isak moris hias hosi mate. No ita bele dehan ho liafuan figura nian katak nia simu duni Isak hosi mate.
verses.20: Liu hosi fiar mak Isak foo bensaun ba Jacó no Esau kona ba buat nebee atu mai.
verses.21: Liu hosi fiar mak Jacó, bainhira nia besik atu mate, foo bensaun ba José nia oan mane ida-idak. No nia sadere ba ninia ai tonka hodi adora.
verses.22: Liu hosi fiar mak José, bainhira nia besik atu mate, koalia kona ba oinsaa mak ema Israel sira sei sai hosi Ejitu no nia foo orden kona ba ninia mate ruin.
verses.23: Liu hosi fiar mak Moisés, bainhira nia moris mai, ninia inan-aman subar nia too fulan tolu. Sira haree katak nia mak oan bonitu no sira la tauk kona ba liurai nia orden.
verses.24: Liu hosi fiar mak Moisés, bainhira nia boot ona, lakohi atu ema bolu nia nudar Faraó nia oan feto nia oan mane.
verses.25: Maibee nia hili atu simu terus hamutuk ho Maromak nia povu duké nia kontenti iha sala too tempu uitoan deit.
verses.26: Nia hanoin katak atu sai moe tanba Kristu mak folin boot liu riku-soin iha Ejitu, tanba nia haree ba kolen nee.
verses.27: Liu hosi fiar mak nia husik rai Ejitu. Nia la tauk liurai nia laran nakali. Maibee nia tahan nafatin tanba nia haree Ida nebee ema la bele haree.
verses.28: Liu hosi fiar mak nia halo Páskua, no hisik raan hodi Estragadór nebee oho oan primeiru la bele kona sira.
verses.29: Liu hosi fiar mak sira lao liu Tasi Mean hanesan liu hosi rai maran. Maibee bainhira ema Ejitu sira koko halo hanesan nee sira mout mate.
verses.30: Liu hosi fiar mak Jerikó nia moru sira monu tuun bainhira ema Israel lao haleu sira too loron hitu.
verses.31: Liu hosi fiar mak Rahab, nebee feto luroon, la mate hamutuk ho sira nebee la fiar tanba nia simu espiaun sira ho diak.
verses.32: No hau sei bele dehan saida tan? Tanba tempu la too atu hau bele konta kona ba Gideão, Barak, Sansão, Jefte, no mos David, Samuel, no profeta sira.
verses.33: Liu hosi fiar mak sira manaan reinu sira, halao justisa, hetan promesa sira, taka liaun sira nia ibun,
verses.34: hamate ahi makaas, halai sai hosi surik kroat, hetan kbiit bainhira sira fraku, hatudu brani iha funu, no duni sai tropas hosi rai liur.
verses.35: Feto sira simu fali ema mate nebee moris hias. Ema seluk simu terus no lakohi atu sai livre hodi sira bele moris hias ho moris ida nebee diak liu tan.
verses.36: Ema seluk simu susar bainhira ema hamoe sira no baku sira ho sikote. No ema seluk simu korenti dadur no tama komarka.
verses.37: Ema tuda mate sira ho fatuk, tesi kotu sira ho kadoo no oho sira ho surik. Sira hatais bibi malae no bibi timor nia kulit no lao lemo rai. Sira falta sasaan no sira hetan terus no susar boot.
verses.38: Mundu la merese atu simu sira. Sira lao lemo-lemo iha rai fuik maran, iha foho, iha rai kuak no fatuk kuak.
verses.39: Maromak gaba ema hotu nee tanba sira nia fiar, maibee sira la hetan buat nebee Nia promete ba sira.
verses.40: Maromak halo planu ona atu foo buat nebee diak liu tan ba ita, atu nunee, hamutuk ho ita, sira bele sai perfeitu.

verses.1: Nee duni, tanba sasin barak tebes hanesan kalohan mak haleu ita, mai ita mos soe tiha todan hotu, no sala nebee belit metin ba ita, no mai ita halai taru ho pasiénsia tuir dalan nebee iha ita nia oin.
verses.2: Hateke ba Jesus, nebee huun no rohan ba ita nia fiar. Tanba ksolok nebee iha Ninia oin, Nia tahan iha krús no la hanoin kona ba moe hosi krús nee. Depois Nia tuur iha Maromak nia kadunan sorin loos.
verses.3: Hanoin Nia nebee tahan terus hasoru Ninia aan rasik hosi sala nain sira atu nunee imi la bele sai kole ka fraku iha imi nia laran.
verses.4: Iha luta hasoru sala, imi seidauk luta too imi fakar imi nia raan.
verses.5: Imi haluha tiha ona korajen nebee bolu imi nudar oan sira ka?
verses.6: Tanba Nai foo disiplina ba ema nebee Nia hadomi,
verses.7: Se imi tahan disiplina, Maromak halo ba imi hanesan ba oan sira. Tanba oan ida nebee mak ninia aman la foo disiplina?
verses.8: Maibee se imi la hetan disiplina karik, nebee oan hotu simu, entaun imi laos hosi família nee no laos oan sira.
verses.9: Liu tan nee, ita iha aman sira iha mundu nebee foo disiplina mai ita no ita respeita sira. Oinsaa liu tan mak ita hakruuk ba espíritu sira nia Aman no ita bele moris?
verses.10: Tanba sira disiplina ita too tempu uitoan tuir sira nia hanoin. Maibee Maromak disiplina ita hodi halo diak ba ita, katak ita bele hola parte iha Ninia santidade.
verses.11: Iha momentu nee, ita senti disiplina nee halo susar ba ita no la halo ita kontenti. Maibee tuir mai, disiplina foo rezultadu dame nian nebee hahalok loos ba sira nebee simu treinu hosi disiplina nee.
verses.12: Nee duni, foti imi nia liman nebee senti kole, no hametin imi nia ain tuur nebee fraku.
verses.13: Halo dalan loos ba imi nia ain hodi ain aat la bele naksalak maibee bele sai diak fali.
verses.14: Hakaas aan atu dame malu ho ema hotu. No hakaas aan ba santidade. Tanba se ema la santu sira sei la haree Nai.
verses.15: Haree di-diak hodi la bele husik ema ida atu lao sees hosi Maromak nia grasa. Keta husik “abut moruk” atu dikin mai hodi kria problema no halo ema barak sai foer.
verses.16: Haree katak la iha ema ida nebee halo sala seksuál ka la santu hanesan Esau nebee faan ninia direitu nudar oan primeiru hodi haan dala ida deit.
verses.17: Tanba imi hatene oinsaa tuir mai, bainhira nia hakarak simu bensaun nudar liman rohan, ninia aman rejeita nia. Tanba nia la hetan oportunidade atu arepende maski nia buka duni ho matan been.
verses.18: Tanba imi la baa too iha foho nebee imi bele kona, nebee sunu ho ahi. Imi la baa too iha kalohan metan, rai nakukun no anin fuik.
verses.19: Imi la baa too lian hosi korneta no lian nebee foo sai liafuan atu sira nebee rona husu makaas katak sira la presiza rona tan liafuan nee.
verses.20: Tanba sira la bele tahan orden nebee sira hetan, “Se animál ida mos kona foho nee, imi tenki tuda mate nia.”
verses.21: Tebes buat nee halo sira tauk duni, too Moisés dehan, “Hau tauk tebes no nakdedar.”
verses.22: Maibee imi too iha foho Zion, no too iha Maromak Moris nia sidade, nebee Jerusalém lalehan nian, no too iha anju barak demais nebee la bele sura.
verses.23: Imi too iha kongregasaun hosi oan primeiru sira nebee naran hakerek ona iha lalehan, no too Maromak nebee sei tesi lia ba buat hotu, no too espíritu sira hosi ema moris loos nebee sai perfeitu ona.
verses.24: Imi too Jesus nebee mediadór ba aliansa foun, no ba raan hikis nian nebee foo sai liafuan nebee diak liu Abel nia raan.
verses.25: Haree katak imi simu Nia nebee koalia dadaun. Tanba se sira la bele halai sees bainhira sira lakohi simu nia nebee foo hanoin ba sira iha mundu, oinsaa liu tan mak ita la bele halai sees se ita lakohi simu Nia nebee foo hanoin ba ita hosi lalehan.
verses.26: Iha tempu nebaa, Ninia lian doko mundu. Maibee agora Nia promete, “Dala ida tan Hau sei doko laos mundu deit, maibee Hau sei doko mos lalehan.”
verses.27: Liafuan nee, “Dala ida tan,” hatudu katak Nia sei hasai tiha buat nebee doko ona, nebee buat nebee halo tiha ona, atu nunee buat nebee la bele doko sei hela nafatin.
verses.28: Nunee mai ita foo agradese tanba ita simu reinu ida nebee la bele doko. Nee duni, mai ita adora Maromak tuir Ninia hakarak ho laran nebee respeita no hamtauk Nia.
verses.29: Tanba ita nia Maromak mak ahi nebee haan mohu.

verses.1: Kontinua hadomi malu nudar maun-alin sira.
verses.2: Keta haluha atu simu ema oin foun. Tanba liu hosi hahalok nee ema balu simu mos anju sira maski sira la hatene.
verses.3: Hanoin hetan sira nebee iha komarka laran, hanesan imi mos iha komarka laran hamutuk ho sira. Hanoin hetan sira nebee hetan terus, tanba imi mos iha isin lolon.
verses.4: Foo onra ba moris kaben nian no keta halo foer kama kaben nian. Tanba Maromak sei foo kastigu ba sira nebee halo sala seksuál no sala adultériu.
verses.5: Kuidadu aan katak imi nia moris nee livre atu la hadomi osan. Sai kontenti ho buat nebee imi iha ona. Tanba Nia dehan, “Hau sei nunka husik o, no Hau sei nunka haluha o.”
verses.6: Nunee ita bele dehan ho konfiansa,
verses.7: Hanoin hetan imi nia lider sira, sira nebee foo sai ona Maromak nia liafuan ba imi. Haree rezultadu hosi sira nia moris, no halo tuir sira nia fiar.
verses.8: Jesus Kristu mak hanesan deit, horiseik, ohin loron no too tinan ba tinan.
verses.9: Keta husik ema lori imi sai ho hanorin oi-oin no la loos. Tanba diak liu ita hametin ita nia fuan laran ho grasa duké ai haan nebee la foo benefísiu ba sira nebee hanoin deit kona ba ai haan.
verses.10: Ita iha altár ida, no sira nebee serví iha Tabernakulu la iha direitu atu haan hosi altár nee.
verses.11: Saserdote boot lori animál sira nia raan ba iha fatin santu sira nudar sakrifísiu sala nian. Depois sira lori animál sira nia isin lolon ba iha akampamentu nia liur hodi sunu.
verses.12: Nunee mos Jesus hetan terus iha portaun nia liur hodi halo ema santu liu hosi Ninia aan rasik.
verses.13: Nunee mai ita baa Jesus nebee iha akampamentu nia liur no lori moe nebee Nia mos lori.
verses.14: Tanba iha nee ita la iha sidade nebee hela ba nafatin, maibee ita buka sidade ida nebee atu mai.
verses.15: Nunee liu hosi Nia, mai ita oferese nafatin sakrifísiu nebee hahii Maromak, nebee liafuan hosi ibun nebee foo sai Ninia naran.
verses.16: Keta haluha atu halo diak no atu fahe buat nebee ita iha. Tanba Maromak kontenti kona ba sakrifísiu hanesan nee.
verses.17: Halo tuir sira nebee lidera imi no hakruuk ba sira. Tanba sira tau matan ba imi nia klamar nudar ema nebee tenki hataan ba Maromak. Husik sira halao sira nia knaar ho laran haksolok, laos ho laran tristi nebee la foo benefísiu ba imi.
verses.18: Halo orasaun ba Maromak kona ba ami. Tanba ami hanoin metin katak ami iha konsiénsia moos, nebee ami hakarak halo buat hotu ho laran onestu.
verses.19: Hau husu ho laran ba imi atu hakaas aan hodi halo ida nee hodi hau bele fila fali lalais ba imi.
verses.20: Agora, hau husu atu Maromak Dame Nian nebee lori fali hosi mate ita nia Nai Jesus, nebee bibi atan boot ba bibi nee, liu hosi Ninia raan hosi aliansa rohan laek,
verses.21: atu foo buat hotu nebee diak ba imi hodi imi bele halo tuir Ninia hakarak. Nia sei servisu iha ita nia laran tuir buat nebee Nia gosta haree, liu hosi Jesus Kristu, nebee sei hetan glória too tinan ba tinan. Amén.
verses.22: Hau husu imi, maun-alin sira, simu hau nia liafuan korajen nee, tanba hau hakerek surat badak deit.
verses.23: Hau hakarak foo hatene katak ita nia alin Timóteo sai livre ona. Se nia too mai lalais karik, hau bele baa vizita imi hamutuk ho nia.
verses.24: Foo kumprimentus ba imi nia lider sira hotu no ba santu sira hotu. Sira nebee mai hosi Itália foo kumprimentus ba imi.
verses.25: Grasa hamutuk ho imi hotu.

verses.1: Hosi Tiago, Maromak no Nai Jesus Kristu nia atan. Ba suku sanulu resin rua nebee namkari iha fatin oi-oin: Kumprimentus.
verses.2: Hau nia maun-alin sira, haksolok ba bainhira imi hasoru susar oi-oin.
verses.3: Tanba imi hatene katak bainhira sira koko imi nia fiar, rezultadu mak imi tahan hela.
verses.4: Tahan too rohan atu nunee imi bele sai perfeitu no kompletu, no la falta buat ida.
verses.5: Se imi ida falta matenek klean, nia bele husu ba Maromak. Maromak sei foo matenek klean ho laran luak no la buka sala. Maromak sei foo ba ema nee.
verses.6: Maibee nia tenki husu ho fiar, no la bele namlele iha ninia hanoin. Tanba nia nebee namlele iha ninia hanoin mak hanesan laloran iha tasi nebee anin baku ba-mai.
verses.7: Ema ida nee la bele hanoin katak nia sei simu buat ida hosi Nai.
verses.8: Tanba nia laran ru-rua no nia la metin iha ninia dalan hotu.
verses.9: Maluk ida nebee kiak bele kontenti iha ninia pozisaun aas.
verses.10: Maibee ema riku bele kontenti iha ninia pozisaun nebee tuun. Tanba nia sei lakon deit hanesan duut nia ai funan ida.
verses.11: Tanba loro matan sae no sai manas makaas. Duut nee namlaik, no ai funan nee monu, no ninia oin furak lakon tiha. Nunee mos ema riku sei lakon deit bainhira nia duni tuir dadaun ninia planu.
verses.12: Haksolok ba ema nebee tahan bainhira nia hasoru tentasaun. Tanba bainhira nia manaan tiha, nia sei simu koroa moris nian. Nai promesa ona koroa nee ba sira nebee hadomi Nia.
verses.13: Bainhira nia hasoru tentasaun, nia la bele dehan, “Tentasaun nee mai hosi Maromak.” Tanba buat aat la bele lori tentasaun ba Maromak, no Maromak la lori tentasaun ba ema ida.
verses.14: Maibee ema ida-idak hetan tentasaun bainhira ninia laran rasik mak kaan buat ruma no dada nia too nia monu ba lasu.
verses.15: Bainhira laran kaan nee mosu mai ona, rezultadu mak sala. No bainhira sala kompletu ona, rezultadu mak mate.
verses.16: Keta husik ema lohi imi, hau nia maun-alin doben sira.
verses.17: Prezenti hotu nebee diak no perfeitu mai hosi leten, no tuun mai hosi Aman naroman nian. Nia la muda. Ninia lalatak mos la muda.
verses.18: Nia foo moris ba ita liu hosi liafuan loos tuir Ninia hakarak, atu nunee ita bele sai hanesan rezultadu primeiru hosi Ninia kriatura sira.
verses.19: Nee duni, hau nia maun-alin doben sira, mai ita hotu lalais atu rona, neineik atu koalia no neineik atu sai hirus.
verses.20: Tanba ema nia laran hirus la hatudu Maromak nia hahalok loos.
verses.21: Tanba nee soe tiha buat hotu nebee foer no hahalok aat makaas, no simu liafuan ho laran maus nebee Nia kuda iha imi nia laran hodi salva imi nia moris.
verses.22: Maibee sai ema nebee halo tuir liafuan nee, laos ema nebee rona deit, hodi imi la lohi imi nia aan rasik.
verses.23: Tanba se ema ida rona deit liafuan nee no la halo tuir, nia hanesan ema nebee haree di-diak ninia oin iha espelhu ida.
verses.24: Bainhira nia haree tiha ninia aan, nia baa deit no haluha kedas ninia oin nee oinsaa.
verses.25: Maibee ema nebee haree duni ba lei liberdade nian nebee perfeitu, no kontinua iha lei nee, nebee la rona deit depois haluha fali, maibee nia mos halo tuir, ema nee sei hetan bensaun iha buat nebee nia halo.
verses.26: Se ema ida hanoin katak nia tuir relijiaun maibee nia la kontrola ninia nanaal, nia lohi ninia fuan laran. Ema nee nia relijiaun la iha folin.
verses.27: Relijiaun nebee moos no la foer iha Aman Maromak nia oin mak nee: atu tau matan ba oan kiak no feto faluk iha sira nia terus, no kuidadu aan katak ita la sai foer hosi mundu.

2.title: La Bele Fihir Ba Ema Ida

verses.1: Hau nia maun-alin sira nebee metin ho fiar iha ita nia Nai Jesus Kristu, Nai glória nian, la bele fihir ba ema ida.
verses.2: Tanba se karik imi iha ema ida nebee tau kadeli osan mean no hatais ropa furak no tama ba imi nia sorumutu, no imi iha mos ema kiak nebee tama mai ho ropa foer.
verses.3: No se imi haree ba nia nebee hatais ropa furak no dehan ba nia, “Ita boot bele tuur iha fatin diak nee,” no imi dehan fali ba ema kiak, “O hamriik iha nebaa, ka tuur iha hau nia ain nee.”
verses.4: Laos imi haree ema la hanesan no sai juis ho hanoin aat?
verses.5: Rona mai, hau nia maun-alin doben sira, laos Maromak hili ona ema kiak iha mundu nee atu sai riku iha fiar? Nia hili sira atu simu reinu nudar liman rohan nebee Nia promete ona atu foo ba sira nebee hadomi Nia.
verses.6: Maibee imi despreza ema kiak. Laos ema riku haterus imi no lori imi ba tribunál nia oin?
verses.7: Laos sira koalia aat kona ba Naran onra nian nebee imi simu ona nee?
verses.8: Se imi kumpri duni Liurai nia lei iha Eskritura, “O tenki hadomi o nia maluk hanesan o nia aan rasik,” nunee imi halo diak.
verses.9: Maibee se imi fihir ba ema ida, imi halo sala, no lei sei kondena imi nudar sala nain sira.
verses.10: Tanba ema nebee halo tuir lei tomak maibee nia monu iha ukun fuan ida deit, nia kontra lei tomak.
verses.11: Tanba Maromak nebee dehan, “Keta halo sala seksuál,” dehan mos, “Keta oho.” Agora, se o la halo sala seksuál maibee se o oho ema, nunee o sai ema nebee kontra lei.
verses.12: Entaun koalia no hatudu hahalok nudar ema nebee Maromak sei tesi lia tuir lei liberdade nian.
verses.13: Tanba Nia sei la hatudu laran luak bainhira Nia tesi lia ba ema nebee la hatudu laran luak. Laran luak sei manaan liu fali tesi lia.
verses.14: Hau nia alin sira, ema ida hetan benefísiu saida se nia iha fiar maibee la iha hahalok diak? Fiar nee sei salva nia ka?
verses.15: Se maun ka alin ida isin molik no la iha ai haan loro-loron nian,
verses.16: no imi ida dehan ba ema nee, “Lao ba ho dame, hau hein katak o sai manas no bosu.” Se imi la foo buat nebee sira nia isin lolon presiza, ida nee halo benefísiu saida?
verses.17: Nunee mos ho fiar nebee la iha hahalok, fiar nee mate.
verses.18: Maibee ema ida sei dehan, “Ita iha fiar, no hau iha hahalok.” Hatudu ita nia fiar nebee hahalok la iha no hau sei hatudu hau nia fiar liu hosi hau nia hahalok.
verses.19: O fiar katak Maromak mak ida deit; o halo diak. Diabu sira mos fiar - no sira nakdedar!
verses.20: Oh ema beik, o hakarak hau hatudu o katak fiar nebee la iha hahalok mak fiar nebee mamuk ka?
verses.21: Laos ita nia aman Abraão sai loos liu hosi ninia hahalok? Tanba nia oferese ninia oan mane Isak iha altár.
verses.22: Ita haree katak ninia fiar nee lao hamutuk ho ninia hahalok, no fiar nee sai kompletu liu hosi ninia hahalok.
verses.23: No Eskritura sai loos nebee dehan, “Abraão fiar ba Maromak, no Maromak sura ida nee ba nia nudar moris loos.” No Abraão sai Maromak nia belun.
verses.24: Imi haree katak ema sai loos liu hosi hahalok no laos liu hosi fiar deit.
verses.25: Hanesan nee mos ho feto luroon Rahab. Laos nia sai loos liu hosi ninia hahalok? Tanba nia simu manu-ain sira no haruka sira baa liu hosi dalan seluk.
verses.26: Tanba hanesan isin lolon nebee la iha espíritu mak mate, nunee mos fiar nebee la iha hahalok mak mate.

verses.1: Hau nia maun-alin sira, la bele husik ema barak hosi imi nia leet atu sai mestri sira. Tanba imi hatene katak Maromak sei tesi lia todan liu ba ita nebee hanorin.
verses.2: Tanba ita hotu monu liu hosi dalan oi-oin. Se ema ida la monu iha buat nebee nia koalia, ema nee perfeitu, no nia bele kontrola mos ninia isin lolon tomak.
verses.3: Tebes, ita tau besi freiu nian iha kuda nia ibun atu sira halo tuir ita. Nunee ita bele diriji mos sira nia isin lolon tomak.
verses.4: Haree took roo boot mos. Maski roo sira boot loos no anin makaas huu sira, maibee roo nain diriji roo nee ho kamudi kiik-oan. No roo nee lao ba tuir roo nain nia hakarak.
verses.5: Nunee mos nanaal nee buat kiik-oan maibee nia gaba makaas. Tebes, oinsaa ai laran boot loos bele lakan tanba ahi kiik-oan!
verses.6: No nanaal nee hanesan ahi ida, hanesan mundu nebee nakonu ho hahalok la loos. Nanaal bele hafoer isin lolon tomak. Nia hanesan ahi nebee sunu ita nia moris tomak, no nia sai lakan liu hosi infernu.
verses.7: Tanba ema bele hamaus animál oi-oin hanesan animál fuik, manu, animál nebee dolar no animál iha tasi. No ema hamaus ona animál sira nee.
verses.8: Maibee la iha ema ida nebee bele hamaus nanaal nee. Nia aat duni no nakonu ho veneno nebee bele halo mate.
verses.9: Ita uza ita nia nanaal atu foo bensaun ba ita nia Nai no Aman, no ho nanaal nee ita foo mos malisan ba ema, nebee Maromak halo tuir Ninia ilas.
verses.10: Hosi ibun ida deit bensaun no malisan suli sai. Hau nia maun-alin sira, tuir lo-loos la bele halo hanesan nee.
verses.11: Bee moos no bee meer bele suli sai hosi bee matan ida deit ka?
verses.12: Hau nia maun-alin sira, ai figeira bele foo oliveira fuan ka? Ai uvas bele foo figeira fuan ka? Nunee mos bee matan nebee iha bee meer la bele foo bee moos.
verses.13: See mak iha matenek klean no kompriensaun iha imi nia leet? Husik nia hatudu hahalok diak liu hosi buat nebee nia halo ho laran maus nebee mai hosi matenek klean.
verses.14: Maibee se imi iha laran moras nebee moruk no provoka malu iha imi nia fuan laran, keta gaba aan no bosok hasoru lia loos.
verses.15: Matenek klean nee la mai hosi leten maibee hosi mundu, nebee laos espíritu nian maibee diabu nian.
verses.16: Tanba iha fatin nebee ita hetan laran moras no ema buka aan rasik, ita hetan mos konfuzaun no hahalok aat hotu.
verses.17: Maibee matenek klean hosi leten nee primeiru mak moos, depois matenek nee halo dame, no nia maus, no bele simu ema seluk nia hanoin, no nia nakonu ho laran luak no fuan diak, no la fihir ema ida no la iha laran makerek.
verses.18: Ema nebee halo dame mos kuda dame hodi hetan rezultadu moris loos.

4.title: Haraik Aan Iha Nai Nia Oin

verses.1: Saida mak halo imi istori malu no baku malu? Laos tanba imi kaan buat oi-oin nebee halo funu iha imi nia leet?
verses.2: Imi kaan buat nebee imi la iha, nunee imi oho. Imi laran moras no imi la hetan, nunee imi baku malu no istori malu. Imi la hetan tanba imi la husu.
verses.3: Imi husu maibee imi la simu, tanba imi husu la loos, atu imi bele goza deit tuir buat nebee imi nia laran kaan hela.
verses.4: Imi mak ema adultériu! Imi kompriende ka lae katak bainhira imi hadomi mundu nee, imi kontra hasoru Maromak? See mak hakarak sai belun ho mundu nee, sai Maromak nia inimigu.
verses.5: Imi hanoin katak Eskritura la iha razaun atu dehan, “Nia hakarak ho laran moras espíritu nebee Nia halo hodi hela iha ita nia laran”?
verses.6: Maibee Nia foo grasa liu tan ba ita. Nunee Eskritura dehan, “Maromak kontra ema nebee foti aan, maibee Nia foo grasa ba ema nebee haraik aan.”
verses.7: Nee duni hakruuk ba Maromak. Kontra hasoru Diabu, no nia sei halai hosi imi.
verses.8: Hakbesik ba Maromak, no Nia sei hakbesik ba imi. Fasi imi nia liman, imi nebee sala nain, no hamoos imi nia fuan laran, imi nebee laran ru-rua.
verses.9: Sai laran tristi, halerik no tanis ba. Keta hamnasa tan maibee halerik ba. Keta haksolok tan maibee laran todan ba.
verses.10: Haraik aan iha Nai nia oin, no Nia sei foti sae imi.
verses.11: Keta koalia aat hasoru malu, maun-alin sira. Nia nebee koalia aat hasoru ninia maluk, no tesi lia hasoru ninia maluk, mak koalia aat hasoru lei, no tesi lia hasoru lei. Maibee sei imi tesi lia hasoru lei, imi laos ema nebee halo tuir lei maibee imi mak juis fali.
verses.12: Iha Ida deit nebee foo lei no Nia mak Juis. Nia bele salva no Nia bele halakon. Maibee see mak o atu tesi lia hasoru ema seluk?
verses.13: Agora, imi balu dehan, “Ohin ka aban, ita sei baa sidade iha nebaa, no ita sei hela iha nebaa too tinan ida. Ita sei sosa no faan fali, no hetan lukru diak.”
verses.14: Maibee imi la hatene loron aban nee sei lao oinsaa. Saida mak imi nia moris? Imi mak abu-abu, nebee mosu mai too tempu uitoan deit no la kleur lakon fali.
verses.15: Maibee tuir lo-loos imi tenki dehan, “Se Nai hakarak, ita sei moris no halo ida nee ka ida nebaa.”
verses.16: Maibee agora imi gaba aan no loko aan. Gaba aan hanesan nee mak hahalok aat.
verses.17: See deit mak hatene buat diak nebee nia tenki halo, maibee nia la halo ida nee, nia sala.

verses.1: Pedro
verses.2: Imi nia riku-soin sai aat ona, no ular haan tiha ona imi nia ropa.
verses.3: Imi nia osan mean no osan mutin feruju ona. Ferujen nee sei sai sasin hasoru imi, no sei haan imi nia isin hanesan ahi. Imi halibur riku-soin iha tempu ikus.
verses.4: Tebes, ema servisu hodi koa imi nia toos maibee imi bosok sira no la selu sira nia kolen. No kolen nee hakilar hasoru imi. No ema servisu nain sira nia lian hakilar nee sae too ona Nai Forsa Nain nia tilun.
verses.5: Imi moris haksolok iha mundu no buka diak ba imi nia aan deit. Imi habokur imi nia fuan laran ba loron oho nian.
verses.6: Imi foo kastigu no oho ona ema loos nebee la kontra imi.
verses.7: Nee duni, maun-alin sira, hatudu pasiénsia ba too Nai fila fali mai. Haree took, oinsaa toos nain hein rezultadu folin nian hosi rai. Nia iha pasiénsia kona ba rezultadu nee, too nia hetan udan primeiru no udan ikus nian.
verses.8: Imi mos tenki iha pasiénsia. No hametin imi nia fuan laran, tanba Nai besik atu fila fali mai ona.
verses.9: Maun-alin sira, keta mur-mura hasoru malu, atu imi la hetan kastigu. Haree ba, Juis hamriik ona iha odamatan oin!
verses.10: Hau nia maun-alin sira, hanoin profeta sira nebee koalia hodi Nai nia naran. Hanoin sira nudar ezemplu iha tempu susar no hatudu pasiénsia.
verses.11: Tebes, ita hanoin katak sira nebee tahan ona mak hetan bensaun. Imi rona ona oinsaa Job iha laran metin no imi haree ona Nai nia planu, no oinsaa Nai hatudu laran diak no laran luak.
verses.12: Maibee liu-liu, hau nia maun-alin sira, keta jura, laos liu hosi lalehan ka mundu ka liu hosi juramentu oin seluk. Maibee imi nia “sin” tenki sin; no imi nia “lae” tenki lae, atu nunee imi la monu ba kastigu laran.
verses.13: Iha ema ruma iha imi nia leet nebee iha susar ka? Nia bele halo orasaun. Iha ema ruma nebee haksolok ka? Nia bele kanta hahii Nai.
verses.14: Iha ema ruma iha imi nia leet nebee moras ka? Nia bele bolu katuas sira iha igreja, no sira bele halo orasaun ba nia, no kose mina ba nia hodi Nai nia naran.
verses.15: No orasaun hosi fiar sei salva ema nebee moras, no Nai sei foti sae nia. No se nia halo ona sala, nia sei hetan perdua.
verses.16: Konfesa imi nia sala ba malu, no halo orasaun ba malu, atu nunee imi bele hetan kura. Orasaun nebee ema loos mak halo iha forsa boot tebes.
verses.17: Elias mak ema ida nebee iha isin hanesan ita. Nia halo orasaun ho laran atu udan la mai, no udan la mai duni too tinan tolu fulan neen iha rai nee.
verses.18: Depois nia halo orasaun no lalehan foo fali udan, no rai nee foo ninia produsaun.
verses.19: Maun-alin sira, se ema ida iha imi nia leet lao sees hosi lia loos, no ema ida lori nia mai fali,
verses.20: foo hatene ba ema nee katak ema nebee lori sala nain ida mai fali bainhira nia lao sees sei salva ninia klamar hosi mate no sei taka sala barak.

verses.1: Hosi Pedro, Jesus Kristu nia apostolu ida. Ba ema nebee Maromak hili, nebee sai ema lao rai no namkari iha rai Pontus, Galásia, Kapadósia, Ázia no Bitínia.
verses.2: Aman Maromak hili ona imi hori uluk kedas tuir Ninia matenek. Nia hili ona imi liu hosi Espíritu nebee halo imi santu atu halo tuir Jesus Kristu no simu raan nebee Nia hisik ba imi. Grasa no dame barak tebes ba imi.
verses.3: Bensaun ba Nai Jesus Kristu nia Maromak no Aman! Tuir Ninia laran luak nebee boot tebes, Nia halo ita moris mai fali ba esperansa moris nian. Ita moris mai fali liu hosi Jesus Kristu nebee moris hias ona hosi mate.
verses.4: Ita moris mai ba liman rohan nebee nunka sai aat, la foer no sei nunka lakon, nebee Nia rai iha lalehan ba imi.
verses.5: Maromak proteje imi ho Ninia kbiit liu hosi fiar iha salvasaun nebee Nia prepara ona atu hatudu sai iha tempu ikus.
verses.6: Tanba nee mak imi haksolok ba. Maibee agora, too tempu uitoan, imi tristi tanba imi hetan susar oi-oin.
verses.7: Buat sira nee koko imi nia fiar. Imi nia fiar nee folin boot liu fali osan mean nebee mohu maski ema koko ho ahi. Rezultadu nee mak hahii, glória no onra bainhira Jesus Kristu mosu mai.
verses.8: Maski imi seidauk haree Nia, imi hadomi Nia. Maski imi la haree Nia agora, imi tau fiar iha Nia. No imi haksolok ho ksolok nebee ema la bele esplika, nebee nakonu ho glória.
verses.9: Tanba imi simu rezultadu hosi imi nia fiar, imi nia klamar nia salvasaun.
verses.10: Profeta uluk sira foo sai profesia kona ba grasa nebee imi hetan. Sira buka di-diak ho badinas atu hatene kona ba salvasaun nee.
verses.11: Kristu nia Espíritu iha sira nia laran foo sai kona ba Kristu nia terus no glória nebee tuir mai. Nunee sira buka atu hatene ema ka tempu ida nebee mak Espíritu hatudu kona ba buat hirak nee.
verses.12: Espíritu hatudu ba sira katak sira la serví sira nia aan rasik maibee sira serví imi. Tanba ema foo sai ona ba imi kona ba buat sira nee liu hosi evanjelhu nebee sira haklaken ba imi liu hosi Espíritu Santu. Maromak haruka Espíritu Santu nee hosi lalehan. Anju sira hakarak duni atu hatene kona ba buat sira nee.
verses.13: Tanba nee prepara tiha imi nia neon, hanoin di-diak no tau imi nia esperansa tomak ba grasa nebee imi sei simu bainhira Jesus Kristu hatudu aan.
verses.14: Imi mak oan sira nebee halo tuir imi nia Aman, entaun keta halo tuir buat uluk nebee imi kaan bainhira imi seidauk hatene loos.
verses.15: Maibee hanesan Nia nebee bolu ona imi mak santu, nunee imi tenki santu iha buat hotu nebee imi halo.
verses.16: Tanba Eskritura hakerek nanis ona, “Imi tenki santu, tanba Hau mak santu.”
verses.17: No se imi bolu ba Nia nudar Aman, nebee tesi lia tuir ema ida-idak nia hahalok no la fihir ema ida, entaun hamtauk Nia iha imi nia hahalok durante tempu nebee imi mak ema lao rai.
verses.18: Tanba imi hatene katak Nia hola fali imi hosi imi nia hahalok folin laek nebee imi simu nudar liman rohan hosi imi nia bei-ala sira. Nia hola fali imi laos ho buat sira nebee bele lakon hanesan osan mutin no osan mean,
verses.19: maibee ho Kristu nia raan nebee folin boot. Tanba Nia mak Bibi Oan nebee la aat no la foer.
verses.20: Maromak konhese Nia molok mundu hahuu. Maibee Maromak hatudu sai Nia iha tempu ikus nee tanba imi.
verses.21: Imi tau fiar iha Maromak liu hosi Jesus. Maromak halo Nia moris hias ona hosi mate no foo glória ba Nia. Nunee imi tau fiar no esperansa iha Maromak.
verses.22: Imi hamoos ona imi nia klamar liu hosi hahalok nebee halo tuir lia loos, entaun hadomi imi nia maun-alin sira ho domin loos. Hakaas aan atu hadomi malu ho fuan laran nebee moos.
verses.23: Tanba imi moris mai fali ona, laos hosi fini nebee bele sai aat, maibee hosi fini nebee la bele sai aat, liu hosi Maromak nia liafuan nebee moris no hela too tinan ba tinan.
verses.24: Tanba
verses.25: maibee Nai nia liafuan sei hela too tinan ba tinan.”

verses.1: Entaun hasai tiha hahalok aat hotu inklui hahalok hotu nebee lohi ema, laran makerek, laran moras no koalia aat ema seluk.
verses.2: Hanesan bebee sira nebee foin moris mai, buka susu been espirituál nebee moos, atu nunee imi bele sai boot iha salvasaun.
verses.3: Tanba imi koko ona no hatene duni katak Nai mak diak.
verses.4: Imi hakbesik ba Nia nebee Fatuk Moris. Ema fila kotuk ba Nia, maibee Maromak hili Nia nebee folin boot.
verses.5: Imi mos hanesan fatuk moris nebee Maromak uza hodi hada uma espirituál. Imi sai saserdote santu nebee oferese sakrifísiu espirituál liu hosi Jesus Kristu nebee Maromak bele simu.
verses.6: Tanba Eskritura iha liafuan nee,
verses.7: Entaun imi nebee fiar sei hetan onra. Maibee ba sira nebee la fiar,
verses.8: No,
verses.9: Maibee imi mak jerasaun ida nebee Maromak hili, saserdote liurai nian, nasaun nebee santu, no povu espesiál; atu nunee imi bele hahii Nia iha ema nia oin tanba Nia bolu imi hosi nakukun laran hodi imi bele tama ba Ninia naroman nebee furak tebes.
verses.10: Uluk imi laos povu ida, maibee agora imi mak Maromak nia povu. Uluk imi la hetan laran luak, maibee agora imi hetan ona laran luak.
verses.11: Maun-alin doben sira, hau husu imi ho laran, tanba imi mak ema estranjeiru no ema lao rai, entaun haketak aan hosi hahalok nebee kaan buat isin nian, nebee halo funu hasoru imi nia klamar.
verses.12: Lao ho hahalok onestu iha ema Jentiu sira nia leet. Atu nunee, bainhira sira koalia hasoru imi nudar ema aat, sira sei haree imi nia hahalok diak no foo glória ba Maromak iha loron nebee Nia mai vizita ita.
verses.13: Hakruuk ba autoridade hotu tanba Nai, inklui mos liurai nebee aas liu,
verses.14: ka governadór sira. Tanba liurai haruka governadór sira atu kastigu ema nebee halo aat no gaba ema nebee halo diak.
verses.15: Tanba nee mak Maromak nia hakarak, katak liu hosi hahalok diak imi bele halo ema beik-teen sira nebee la hatene buat ida atu sai nonook.
verses.16: Moris nudar ema nebee livre, maibee keta uza imi nia liberdade atu subar hahalok aat. Maibee moris nudar Maromak nia atan sira.
verses.17: Foo onra ba ema hotu. Hadomi maun-alin sira. Hamtauk Maromak. Foo onra ba liurai.
verses.18: Atan sira, hakruuk ba imi nia patraun ho respeitu boot, laos deit ba patraun nebee diak no laran maus, maibee mos ba patraun nebee la justu.
verses.19: Tanba ida nee mak grasa, katak ema ida tahan iha tempu susar bainhira nia hetan terus nebee la justu tanba nia hanoin hela Maromak.
verses.20: Tanba ita hetan benefísiu saida bainhira imi halo sala no imi tahan ema nebee baku imi? Maibee se imi halo diak, no imi hetan terus tanba hahalok nee no imi tahan hela, ida nee mak grasa iha Maromak nia oin.
verses.21: Tanba Maromak bolu imi atu hetan terus nee. Tanba Kristu mos hetan terus tanba imi. Nia foo ezemplu ba imi katak imi bele lao tuir Ninia ain fatin.
verses.22: “Nia la halo sala ida, no la iha liafuan bosok iha Ninia ibun.”
verses.23: Bainhira ema tolok Nia, Nia la tolok fali sira. Bainhira Nia hetan terus, Nia la ameasa sira. Maibee Nia entrega aan ba Ida nebee tesi lia ho justisa.
verses.24: Kristu rasik mak lori ita nia sala iha Ninia isin lolon iha ai huun nee, atu ita bele mate ba sala, no moris ba hahalok loos. Liu hosi Ninia kanek mak imi hetan kura.
verses.25: Tanba uluk imi hanesan bibi nebee lao sala dalan, maibee agora imi fila fali mai ba Bibi Atan nebee tau matan ba imi nia klamar.

verses.1: Hanesan nee mos, feen sira, hakruuk ba imi nia laen. Nunee se sira balu la halo tuir liafuan nee, ita bele manaan sira, laos liu hosi liafuan ida, maibee liu hosi sira nia feen sira nia hahalok.
verses.2: Tanba sira sei haree imi nia hahalok moos nebee foo respeitu.
verses.3: Keta hafurak aan iha liur - nebee sasin fuuk, tara osan mean ka hatais ropa furak.
verses.4: Maibee hatais imi nia aan ho buat nebee subar iha imi nia fuan laran, ho espíritu maus no kalma nebee furak no nunka lakon. Ida nee mak folin boot iha Maromak nia oin.
verses.5: Tanba iha tempu uluk, feto santu sira nebee espera iha Maromak mak hafurak aan hanesan nee hodi hakruuk ba sira nia laen.
verses.6: Nunee mos Sara halo tuir Abraão nia hakarak no bolu nia ‘nai’. No imi mak Sara nia oan sira, se imi halo diak no la tauk buat ida nebee halo ema hakfodak.
verses.7: Hanesan nee mos, laen sira, hela hamutuk ho imi nia feen sira ho hahalok nebee kompriende sira. Hafolin feto sira tanba sira fraku liu imi, hanesan vazu nebee fraku. Tanba sira sei simu grasa moris nian hamutuk ho imi nudar liman rohan. Halo hanesan nee atu Maromak bele rona imi nia orasaun sira.
verses.8: Ikus mai, imi hotu hanoin ho neon ida deit. Hanoin malu, hadomi malu nudar maun-alin sira, hatudu laran maus ba malu no laran nebee haraik aan.
verses.9: Keta selu aat ho aat fali, ka hataan tolok ho tolok fali. Maibee foo bensaun. Tanba imi hatene katak Maromak bolu imi ba hahalok nee atu nunee imi bele simu bensaun nudar liman rohan.
verses.10: Tanba,
verses.11: Nia tenki fila sees hosi buat aat no halo buat nebee diak;
verses.12: Tanba Nai sei tau matan ba ema nebee moris loos,
verses.13: See mak halo aat ba imi se imi hakaas aan atu halo buat nebee diak?
verses.14: Maibee se imi hetan terus tanba hahalok loos, imi sei hetan bensaun. Keta tauk sira, no lalika hanoin barak.
