verses.4: Anju ba dala tolu fakar ninia manko ba iha mota no bee matan no sira sai raan.
verses.5: No hau rona anju nebee toma konta ba bee sira nee dehan,
verses.6: Tanba sira fakar santu sira no profeta sira nia raan,
verses.7: No hau rona altár dehan,
verses.8: Anju ba dala haat fakar ninia manko ba loro matan, no loro matan hetan lisensa atu sunu ema ho ahi.
verses.9: Loro matan nia ahi manas sunu sira. No sira koalia aat kona ba Maromak nia naran, maski Maromak iha kbiit hodi haruka susar boot hirak nee. Sira la arepende ka foo glória ba Nia.
verses.10: Anju ba dala lima fakar ninia manko ba animál siak nia kadunan, no ninia reinu sai nakukun liu. Povu nee tata sira nia nanaal tanba sira moras.
verses.11: Sira koalia aat kona ba Maromak iha lalehan tanba sira nia moras no kanek dodok. Maibee sira la arepende hosi sira nia hahalok.
verses.12: Anju ba dala neen fakar ninia manko ba mota boot Eufrates, no bee iha nebaa sai maran hotu hodi prepara dalan ba liurai sira hosi parte lorosae.
verses.13: No hau haree espíritu foer tolu hanesan manduku nebee sai mai hosi samea naga nia ibun, no hosi animál siak nia ibun, no hosi profeta falsu nia ibun.
verses.14: Tanba sira mak espíritu diabu nian nebee halo sinál sira. Sira baa too liurai sira iha mundu tomak hodi halibur sira atu halo funu iha Maromak Kbiit Makaas nia loron boot.
verses.15: (“Tebes, Hau sei mai hanesan naok-teen ida. Haksolok ba nia nebee hadeer hela, no hatais hela ninia ropa, atu nia la lao ho isin molik no ema la haree ninia moe!”)
verses.16: No sira halibur hamutuk liurai sira nee iha fatin ida naran Armagedon iha lian Ebreu.
verses.17: Anju ba dala hitu fakar ninia manko ba loro leten, no lian ida sai hosi kadunan nebee iha Templu iha lalehan no dehan, “Hotu ona!”
verses.18: No rai lakan taa ba-mai, rai tarutu ho lian makaas, no rai nakdoko makaas liu duké rai nakdoko hotu dezde ema iha mundu. Rai nakdoko makaas duni.
verses.19: Sidade boot fahe ba parte tolu no nasaun sira nia sidade sira monu tuun. Maromak hanoin hetan Babilónia Boot nee no halo sidade nee hemu hosi kopu nebee iha Ninia tua uvas, katak Ninia laran hirus nakali tebes.
verses.20: Ilha hotu-hotu mos halai no foho lakon hotu.
verses.21: No udan jelu fatuk boot nebee maizoumenus kilo tolu-nulu resin lima monu tuun hosi lalehan ba povu. No ema sira nee koalia aat kona ba Maromak tanba susar nee boot tebe-tebes.

17.title: Feto Luroon Boot No Animál Siak

verses.1: Tuir mai anju ida hosi anju hitu nebee iha manko hitu, mai no nia dehan mai hau, “Mai no hau sei hatudu ba o kastigu nebee hasoru feto luroon boot nebee tuur iha bee barak nia leten.
verses.2: Liurai sira iha mundu halo sala seksuál ho nia. No ema nebee hela iha mundu lanu tiha ho tua uvas nebee ninia sala seksuál.”
verses.3: No nia lori hau iha espíritu hodi sai ba rai fuik. No hau haree feto ida nebee tuur iha animál siak mean nia leten. Animál siak nee nakonu ho naran nebee koalia aat Maromak, no nia iha ulun hitu ho dikur sanulu.
verses.4: Feto nee hatais ropa kór uvas no mean. Nia hafurak aan ho osan mean, fatuk murak no pérola. Nia kaer iha ninia liman kopu osan mean ida nebee nakonu ho hahalok aat no hahalok foer hosi ninia sala seksuál.
verses.5: No nia iha naran mistériu nebee hakerek iha ninia reen toos: “Babilónia Boot, Inan Ba Feto Luroon Sira no Hahalok Foer Iha Mundu.”
verses.6: No hau haree feto nee lanu ho raan hosi santu sira, nebee raan hosi sira nebee foo sasin kona ba Jesus. Bainhira hau haree nia hau admira tebe-tebes.
verses.7: Anju nee dehan mai hau, “Tanba saa mak o admira? Hau sei foo hatene ba o mistériu kona ba feto nee, no kona ba animál siak nebee iha ulun hitu no dikur sanulu, nebee lori nia.
verses.8: Animál siak nebee o haree nee uluk iha, maibee agora la iha, no nia atu sae hosi rai kuak klean liu no atu lakon mohu. No ema nebee hela iha mundu, nebee sira nia naran la hakerek iha livru moris nian hosi tempu nebee mundu hahuu, sira sei admira bainhira sira haree animál siak nee. Tanba uluk nia iha, no agora la iha, no nia sei mosu fali mai.
verses.9: Liafuan nee presiza neon ho matenek klean: ulun hitu mak foho hitu nebee feto nee tuur iha leten.
verses.10: Sira mos liurai hitu. Liurai lima monu tiha ona, ida sei iha hela, no ida fali seidauk mai. No bainhira nia mosu mai nia tenki hela too tempu uitoan deit.
verses.11: No kona ba animál siak nebee uluk iha, no agora la iha, nia mak liurai ba dala ualu, maibee nia mak liurai hitu nee nian. No nia sei lakon mohu tiha.
verses.12: No dikur sanulu nebee o haree mak liurai sanulu nebee seidauk simu reinu ida. Maibee sira atu simu kbiit nudar liurai too oras ida, hamutuk ho animál siak.
verses.13: Sira iha neon ida deit, no sira entrega sira nia kbiit no podér ba animál siak.
verses.14: Sira sei halo funu hasoru Bibi Oan, no Bibi Oan sei manaan sira. Tanba Nia mak Nai ba nai sira, no Liurai ba liurai sira. No sira nebee hamutuk ho Nia mak ema nebee Nia hili no bolu no sira iha laran metin.”
verses.15: No anju dehan mai hau, “Bee barak nebee o haree ona nee, iha fatin nebee feto luroon tuur, nee katak povu sira, ema lubun boot sira, nasaun sira no lian sira.
verses.16: No dikur sanulu nebee o haree ona iha animál siak nee, sira sei odi feto luroon, no sei harahun nia no halo nia molik. Sira sei haan ninia isin no sunu nia ho ahi.
verses.17: Tanba Maromak tau hanoin iha sira nia fuan laran atu halao Ninia planu ho neon ida deit. Sira sei entrega sira nia reinu ba animál siak too Maromak nia liafuan kumpri ona.
verses.18: No feto nebee o haree nee mak sidade boot nebee ukun liurai sira iha mundu.”

verses.1: Liu tiha nee, hau haree anju ida fali tuun mai hosi lalehan, nebee iha kbiit boot no mundu sai naroman ho ninia glória.
verses.2: No nia hakilar ho lian makaas dehan,
verses.3: Tanba nasaun hotu hemu ona tua uvas nebee kaan ninia sala seksuál,
verses.4: No hau rona lian ida tan hosi lalehan dehan,
verses.5: Tanba ninia sala sira sae ona too lalehan,
verses.6: Selu fali nia tuir dalan nebee nia selu fali ema seluk sira,
verses.7: Hanesan nia foo glória ba ninia aan rasik no hela kontenti deit,
verses.8: Tanba nee iha loron ida deit nia sei hetan susar boot,
verses.9: No liurai sira iha mundu, nebee halo sala seksuál no hela kontenti deit ho feto nee, sira sei tanis no halerik tanba nia bainhira sira haree suar hosi ahi nebee haan nia.
verses.10: Sira sei hamriik dook tanba sira tauk ninia terus. No sira sei dehan,
verses.11: Negosiante sira iha mundu sei tanis no halerik tanba nia. Tanba ema sei la sosa tan sira nia sasaan.
verses.12: Sasaan nee mak halo hosi osan mean, osan mutin, fatuk murak, pérola, hena linhu diak, hena kór uvas, hena seda, hena kór mean, ai morin oi-oin, sasaan hosi marfín, ai folin boot, riti, besi no fatuk marmore,
verses.13: no mos ai kanela, temperus, insensu, mira, mina morin, tua uvas, mina oliveira, trigu diak, fini trigu, karau, bibi, kuda, kuda kareta no atan sira (katak klamar sira).
verses.14: “Ai fuan nebee o nia klamar kaan nee
verses.15: Negosiante sira nebee faan buat sira nee, nebee sai riku hosi nia, sira sei hamriik dook tanba sira tauk ninia terus. Sira sei tanis no halerik,
verses.16: “Susar, susar, ba sidade boot
verses.17: Tanba iha oras ida deit riku-soin hotu nee lakon.” Roo nain hotu no ema hotu nebee servisu iha roo laran, no ema hotu nebee ba-mai iha tasi hodi halo negóziu hamriik dook.
verses.18: Bainhira sira haree suar hosi ahi nebee sunu nia, sira hakilar dehan,
verses.19: No sira soe rai rahun ba sira nia ulun, tanis no halerik. Sira hakilar dehan,
verses.20: Haksolok ba tanba nia, Oh lalehan,
verses.21: Tuir mai anju boot ida foti fatuk ida hanesan fatuk boot nebee dulas trigu no nia soe fatuk nee ba tasi. Nia dehan,
verses.22: Ema sei la rona tan lian hosi ema nebee toka arpa ka halo múzika,
verses.23: no ahi oan nia naroman
verses.24: No sidade nee iha raan hosi profeta sira no santu sira,

verses.1: Liu tiha nee hau rona buat nebee hanesan lian makaas ida hosi lubun boot tebes iha lalehan. Sira hakilar dehan,
verses.2: tanba Nia tesi lia loos no justu;
verses.3: Sira hakilar dala i1 1da tan dehan,
verses.4: No katuas sira nain rua-nulu resin haat no animál moris haat monu tuun no adora Maromak nebee tuur iha kadunan. Sira dehan, “Amén. Aleluia!”
verses.5: No lian ida mai hosi kadunan dehan,
verses.6: Turi mai hau rona buat nebee hanesan lian ida hosi ema lubun boot tebes, hanesan lian makaas hosi bee barak, no hanesan lian hosi rai tarutu makaas, nebee hakilar dehan,
verses.7: Mai ita kontenti no haksolok ba,
verses.8: No Noiva nee hetan lisensa atu hatais aan
verses.9: Anju nee dehan mai hau, “Hakerek ida nee ba: Haksolok ba sira nebee hetan konvite ba Bibi Oan nia festa kazamentu.” No nia dehan mai hau, “Nee mak liafuan loos hosi Maromak.”
verses.10: No hau monu tuun ba ninia ain atu adora nia, maibee nia dehan mai hau, “O keta halo ida nee! Hau mak maluk atan hamutuk ho o no o nia maun-alin sira nebee kaer metin ba Jesus nia testemunha. Adora deit Maromak.” Tanba Jesus nia testemunha mak espíritu profesia nian.
verses.11: Tuir mai hau haree lalehan nakloke, no tebes, kuda mutin ida! No Nia nebee sae kuda nee iha naran Fiel no Loos. Nia tesi lia no halo funu ho hahalok loos.
verses.12: Ninia matan hanesan ahi lakan, no Nia iha koroa barak iha Ninia ulun. No Nia iha naran nebee hakerek iha Nia no la iha ema ida nebee hatene, só Nia deit mak hatene.
verses.13: Nia hatais ropa nebee hoban iha raan. No Ninia naran mak Maromak nia Liafuan.
verses.14: Forsa sira iha lalehan hatais hena linhu diak, mutin no moos. No sira sae kuda mutin hodi tuir Nia.
verses.15: No surik kroat ida sai hosi Ninia ibun. Nia uza surik nee hodi oho nasaun sira. No Nia sei ukun sira ho rota besi. Nia sei sama uvas fatin nebee Maromak Kbiit Makaas nia laran hirus nakali.
verses.16: Nia iha naran ida nebee hakerek iha Ninia ropa no iha Ninia ain kelen, ‘Liurai ba liurai sira no Nai ba nai sira.’
verses.17: Tuir mai hau haree anju ida hamriik iha loro matan. No nia hakilar ho lian makaas ba manu hotu nebee semo iha leten, dehan “Mai no halibur hamutuk ba Maromak nia festa boot,
verses.18: atu haan isin hosi liurai sira, komandante sira, asuwain sira, kuda no sira nebee sae kuda, no isin hosi ema hotu, livre no atan, kiik no boot.”
verses.19: No hau haree animál siak no liurai sira iha mundu, no sira nia forsa militár. Sira halibur hamutuk atu halo funu hasoru Nia nebee sae kuda nee no Ninia forsa.
verses.20: Nia nebee sae kuda hadau animál siak hamutuk ho profeta falsu. Profeta falsu nee halo sinál sira iha animál siak nia oin. Liu hosi sinál sira nee nia lohi ema nebee simu ona marka hosi animál siak no sira nebee adora ninia estátua. No Nai soe sira nain rua nee, nebee sei moris hela, ba iha lago ahi nebee lakan ho fatuk klaak.
verses.21: No Nia nebee sae kuda nee oho sira restu ho surik nebee sai hosi Ninia ibun. No manu hotu haan sira nia isin too bosu.

verses.1: Tuir mai hau haree anju ida tuun mai hosi lalehan. Nia kaer hela xavi ba rai kuak klean liu no nia lori korenti boot ida iha ninia liman.
verses.2: Nia kaer tiha samea naga, nee mak samea antigu, nebee Diabu no Satanás, no kesi samea nee too tinan rihun ida.
verses.3: Nia soe Satanás ba iha rai kuak klean liu no taka rai kuak nee ho selo atu nunee nia la bele lohi tan nasaun sira, too tinan rihun ida hotu ona. Tuir tempu nee, Satanás tenki sai livre too tempu uitoan.
verses.4: Tuir mai hau haree kadunan sira, no ema nebee tuur iha kadunan sira nee simu kbiit atu tesi lia. No mos hau haree klamar sira hosi sira nebee mate tanba ema tesi sai sira nia ulun. Sira mate tanba Jesus nia testemunha no tanba Maromak nia liafuan. No hau haree sira nebee la adora animál siak ka ninia estátua no sira la simu marka hosi animál siak nee iha sira nia reen toos ka liman. Sira moris hias no ukun hamutuk ho Kristu too tinan rihun ida.
verses.5: Maibee ema restu nebee mate la moris hias too tinan rihun ida nee hotu ona. Nee mak tempu primeiru nebee ema moris hias hosi mate.
verses.6: Ema nebee hola parte iha tempu primeiru nebee moris hias hosi mate mak haksolok no santu! Mate segundu la iha podér ba sira. Maibee sira sei sai Maromak no Kristu nia saserdote, no sira sei ukun hamutuk ho Nia too tinan rihun ida.
verses.7: Bainhira tinan rihun ida nee hotu ona, Satanás sei sai livre hosi ninia komarka.
verses.8: Nia sei sai atu lohi nasaun sira nebee iha mundu nia parte haat, Gog no Magog, hodi halibur sira hamutuk atu halo funu. Sira nia númeru barak hanesan rai henek iha tasi.
verses.9: Sira marxa liu hosi rai tetuk iha mundu no haleu santu sira nia akampamentu no sidade nebee Maromak hadomi. Maibee ahi tuun mai hosi lalehan no haan motuk sira.
verses.10: No Nai soe Diabu, nebee lohi tiha sira, ba iha lago ahi ho fatuk klaak. Animál siak no profeta falsu mak iha nebaa. Loron-kalan sira sei hetan terus too tinan ba tinan.
verses.11: Tuir mai hau haree kadunan boot ida nebee mutin no Nia nebee tuur iha kadunan nee. Rai no loro leten halai sai hosi Ninia prezensa, no la iha fatin ida ba sira.
verses.12: No hau haree ema mate, kiik no boot, hamriik iha kadunan oin. Nai loke livru sira no Nia loke mos livru ida seluk, nebee livru moris nian. Nia tesi lia ba ema mate liu hosi buat nebee hakerek iha livru sira nee, tuir ema nia hahalok.
verses.13: No tasi entrega ema mate nebee iha tasi laran. Fatin Mate no Infernu mos entrega ema mate nebee iha laran. No Nai tesi lia ba sira ida-idak tuir sira nia hahalok.
verses.14: Tuir mai Nia soe Fatin Mate no Infernu ba iha lago ahi. Ida nee mak mate segundu.
verses.15: No ema sira nebee naran la hakerek iha livru moris nian, sira mos soe tama ba iha lago ahi.

verses.1: Tuir mai hau haree lalehan foun no mundu foun. Tanba lalehan uluk nian no mundu uluk nian lakon tiha, no tasi la iha tan.
verses.2: No hau haree sidade santu, Jerusalém foun, tuun mai hosi Maromak iha lalehan, nebee prepara ona nudar noiva ba ninia Laen.
verses.3: No hau rona lian makaas ida hosi kadunan dehan, “Tebes, Maromak nia Tenda mak hamutuk ho ema, no Nia sei hela hamutuk ho sira. Sira sei sai Ninia povu, no Maromak rasik sei hamutuk ho sira, no Nia sei sai sira nia Maromak.
verses.4: Maromak sei hamaran matan been hotu hosi sira nia matan. La iha tan mate, no la iha tan laran susar, tanis ka moras. Tanba buat sira nebee uluk nian liu tiha ona.”
verses.5: No Ida nebee tuur iha kadunan dehan, “Tebes, Hau halo buat hotu sai foun.” Nia dehan mos, “Hakerek liafuan nee, tanba liafuan nee fiel no loos.”
verses.6: No Nia dehan mai hau, “Loos ona! Hau mak Alfa no Omega, huun no rohan. Ba nia nebee hamrook Hau sei foo bee hosi bee matan moris nian, no nia la presiza selu.
verses.7: Ema nebee manaan sei simu buat nee nudar liman rohan. Hau sei sai ninia Maromak, no nia sei sai Hau nia oan.
verses.8: Maibee ba sira nebee tauk, la fiar no halo buat foer, no oho door sira, sira nebee halo sala seksuál, matan dook sira, sira nebee adora ídulu no bosok-teen hotu, sira nia fatin mak iha lago laran nebee lakan ho ahi no fatuk klaak. Ida nee mak mate segundu.”
verses.9: Tuir mai anju ida mai hosi anju hitu nebee iha manko hitu nakonu ho susar boot hitu ikus nian. Nia koalia mai hau dehan, “Mai, no hau sei hatudu ba o Noiva nebee Bibi Oan nia feen.”
verses.10: No nia lori hau sai iha Espíritu ba foho boot ida nebee aas tebes. Nia hatudu mai hau sidade santu Jerusalém, nebee tuun mai hosi Maromak iha lalehan.
verses.11: Sidade nee iha Maromak nia glória, no nia nabilan hanesan fatuk murak nebee folin boot liu, hanesan jaspe, no nia moos hanesan kristál.
verses.12: Sidade nee iha moru boot nebee aas tebes, ho portaun sanulu resin rua. No portaun sira nee iha anju sanulu resin rua. Iha portaun sira nee hakerek naran hosi suku sanulu resin rua nia nebee Israel nia oan mane sira.
verses.13: Parte lorosae iha portaun tolu, parte norte iha portaun tolu, parte súl iha portaun tolu, no parte loromonu iha portaun tolu.
verses.14: No sidade nia moru iha fundasaun sanulu resin rua, no iha fundasaun sira nee hakerek Bibi Oan nia apostolu nain sanulu resin rua nia naran.
verses.15: No nia nebee koalia ho hau kaer fafulu kain osan mean atu sukat sidade nee, ninia portaun sira no ninia moru.
verses.16: Sidade nee kuadradu. Nia naruk no luan hanesan. Anju nee sukat sidade ho ninia fafulu, no hetan kilometru rihun rua atus rua (2.200). Nia naruk, luan no aas hanesan.
verses.17: No nia sukat mos moru nee no hetan metru neen-nulu resin lima. Ida nee tuir sukat ema nian nebee hanesan mos ho anju nian.
verses.18: Moru nee halo ho fatuk jaspe, no sidade nee halo ho osan mean, nebee mo-moos hanesan vidru.
verses.19: Sidade nia moru nia fundasaun nee furak ho fatuk murak oi-oin. Fundasaun primeiru mak jaspe, segundu mak safira, terseiru mak agata, haat mak esmeralda,
verses.20: lima mak onix, neen mak karneliu, hitu mak krizolitu, ualu mak berilu, sia mak topáziu, sanulu mak krisoprazu, sanulu resin ida mak jasintu, sanulu resin rua mak ametista.
verses.21: No portaun sanulu resin rua nee mak pérola sanulu resin rua. Portaun ida-idak halo hosi pérola ida. No sidade nia estrada mak osan mean nebee moos, nebee mo-moos hanesan vidru.
verses.22: No hau la haree templu ida iha sidade laran, tanba Nai Maromak Kbiit Makaas no Bibi Oan mak sidade nia Templu.
verses.23: No sidade nee la presiza loro matan ka fulan atu leno ba nia. Tanba Maromak nia glória mak foo naroman ba nia, no Bibi Oan mak ninia ahi-oan.
verses.24: Nasaun sira sei lao iha naroman nee. No liurai sira iha mundu sei lori sira nia glória ba iha sidade nee.
verses.25: No ninia portaun sira sei nunka taka iha loron, no iha nebaa kalan la iha.
verses.26: Sira sei lori nasaun sira nia glória no onra ba iha sidade nee.
verses.27: Maibee buat hotu nebee foer sei la tama sidade nee. Ema nebee halo buat aat liu no falsu sei la tama. Só ema sira nebee naran hakerek ona iha Bibi Oan nia livru moris nian mak tama.

verses.1: Tuir mai anju nee hatudu mai hau mota bee moris nian, nebee nabilan hanesan kristál. Mota nee suli sai hosi Maromak no Bibi Oan nia kadunan.
verses.2: Mota nee suli liu hosi estrada klaran iha sidade nee. No mos iha mota nia sor-sorin iha Ai Huun Moris Nian nebee foo ai fuan oin sanulu resin rua. Nia foo ninia fuan nee fulan fulan. No ai huun nee nia tahan bele uza hodi kura nasaun sira.
verses.3: No la iha tan buat ida nebee iha malisan iha nebaa, maibee Maromak no Bibi Oan nia kadunan sei iha sidade nee. No Ninia atan sira sei adora Nia.
verses.4: No sira sei haree Ninia oin, no Ninia naran sei hakerek iha sira nia reen toos.
verses.5: No sei la iha tan kalan. Sira la presiza naroman hosi ahi oan ka loro matan, tanba Nai Maromak mak sira nia naroman. No sira sei ukun too tinan ba tinan.
verses.6: No nia dehan mai hau, “Liafuan sira nee mak fiel no loos. Nai, nebee Maromak ba profeta sira nia espíritu, mak haruka ona Ninia anju atu hatudu Ninia atan sira saida mak la kleur tan sei akontese.”
verses.7: “Tebes, la kleur tan Hau sei mai. Haksolok ba nia nebee kaer metin ba liafuan hosi profesia iha livru nee.”
verses.8: Hau, João, mak ida nebee rona no haree buat sira nee. No bainhira hau rona no haree ona buat sira nee, hau monu iha anju nee nia ain nebee hatudu buat sira nee mai hau hodi adora nia.
verses.9: Maibee nia dehan mai hau, “O keta halo ida nee! Hau mak maluk atan hamutuk ho o no o nia maun-alin nebee profeta sira, no sira nebee kaer metin ba liafuan iha livru nee. Adora deit Maromak.”
verses.10: No nia dehan mai hau, “Keta tau selo hodi taka liafuan hosi profesia iha livru nee. Tanba tempu nee besik ona.
verses.11: Ema nebee halo aat, husik nia halo aat nafatin ba. No ema nebee foer, husik nia foer nafatin ba. Ema nebee moris loos, husik nia halo loos nafatin ba. No ema nebee santu, husik nia santu nafatin ba.”
verses.12: “No tebes, la kleur tan Hau sei mai. No Hau sei lori kolen nebee Hau sei selu fali ba ema ida-idak tuir ninia hahalok.
verses.13: Hau mak Alfa no Omega, primeiru no ikus, huun no rohan.”
verses.14: Haksolok ba sira nebee hamoos sira nia ropa, atu nunee sira bele hetan direitu atu haan hosi Ai Huun Moris Nian no atu sira bele tama sidade nee liu hosi portaun sira.
verses.15: Iha liur mak asu sira, matan dook sira, ema nebee halo sala seksuál, oho door sira, ema nebee adora ídulu no ema hotu nebee hadomi no halo buat nebee falsu.
verses.16: “Hau, Jesus, haruka ona Hau nia anju atu foo sasin ba imi kona ba buat sira nee hodi hatoo ba igreja sira. Hau mak David nia abut no bei-oan, no fitun nebee nabilan iha dadeer-saan.
verses.17: Espíritu no Noiva dehan, “Mai.” No husik ema nebee rona dehan, “Mai.” Husik ema nebee hamrook bele mai. Husik ema nebee hakarak bele foti bee moris nian, no lalika selu.
verses.18: Hau foo hanoin ba ema hotu nebee rona liafuan hosi profesia iha livru nee: se ema ida aumenta tan liafuan ruma ba profesia nee, Maromak sei aumenta susar boot nebee hakerek ona iha livru nee ba nia;
verses.19: no se ema ida hasai liafuan ruma hosi livru nee nia profesia, Maromak sei hasai ema nee nia parte iha Ai Huun Moris Nian no iha sidade santu, nebee hakerek ona iha livru nee.
verses.20: Nia nebee foo sasin kona ba buat sira nee dehan, “Tebes, la kleur tan, Hau sei mai.” Amén. Mai, Nai Jesus!
verses.21: Grasa hosi Nai Jesus hamutuk ho imi hotu. Amén.
